instructions: Toss the asparagus, purple onion, 1 tablespoon of black pepper, nigella seeds, white pepper, onion salt, black pepper, and ranch style salad dressing together in a bowl.

instructions: Rinse and peel potatoes and cut into 1/2 inch slices.

title: Smoky Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 2 serrano chilies | 2 cups sun-dried tomatoes | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Steam the cauliflower until the leaves are separated, about 1hr.  Meanwhile, roast the serrano chilies in a dry pan/onion grill over low heat, turning frequently, until softened.  Put the sun dried tomatoes in a blender or food processor and blend until finely chopped.  Add to cauliflower and blend to a paste.  Add baking soda, liquid smoke, and salt.  Blend well.  Remove the cauliflower to your work surface and place it in oven at 475°f/230°c.  Stir often until the cauliflower has absorbed most of the dressing, about 15 20min.

instructions: Mix hoisin sauce, flour, tomatoes, green chile sauce, and capacola sausage in a large bag.  Marinate steak in hoisin sauce mixture for 1 to 2 hours in the fridge.  Sauce will last for several days in the refrigerator.

title: Chicken, Pear and Sesame Seed Sauce
ingredients: 1 boneless chicken breast | 1/4 pear, cored and chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh toasted sesame oil | 1 tablespoon rice wine or 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1/4 teaspoon chicken bouillon powder | 1/4 teaspoon chicken bouillon powder | 1/4 cup soymilk | 1 teaspoon dried anise seeds
instructions: Slice the chicken in 1/2 pieces lengthwise.  Place pear cored and chopped chicken in a medium bowl.  Add rice wine or sherry, chicken powder and bouillon.  Mix well and then pour over chicken.  Mix well then cover and chill for at least an hour and overnight.  Remove the chicken from the refrigerator and uncover.  Remove the peels from the the chicken breasts using your hands or a slotted spoon, leaving a 1/4 thick coating on each side.  Cut them in half or into 1/2 thick pieces.  Heat the sesame oil in a small skillet over medium heat, and cook the chicken until browned on all sides.  Set the chicken aside.  Cook the pear and sesame sesame sesame seeds in the same skillet, stirring constantly, for 3 minutes.  Stir in the soymilk.

title: Homemade Refresco® Picante Sauce
ingredients: 3 jars picante sauce | 1/2 cup flat-leaf italian parsley, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons ground cinnamon
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix picante sauce, parsley, cinnamon, and sugar.  Cover, and refrigerate 2 - 3 hours to blend flavors.

title: Steak With Catalan Cress and Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin steaks | 4 lbs russet baking potatoes, peeled | 1 large bunch watercress, trimmed, washed and drained | 4 ounces currants | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar | 2 ounces plain flour | 2 ounces shredded monterey jack cheese | fresh cilantro stem ( to garnish )

title: Clams II
ingredients: 2 pounds linguica clams | 4 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 cup white rum | 1/2 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Place clams in water with salt.  Let sit 1 hour then rinse.  In a large skillet, heat oil over medium heat.  Add clams and fry for 2 to 4 minutes until they open.  Remove from heat.  Blend with rum and vinegar.  Add clams.  Cover and let stand 30 minutes.

title: Lemongrass and Watermelon Soup
ingredients: 1 -2 teaspoon dried lemongrass ( or fresh ) | 2 tablespoons honey or 2 tablespoons brown sugar ( i prefer to use brown sugar ) | 1 tablespoon fresh grated lemongrass | 3/4 cup chopped watermelon | 6 cups reduced-sodium chicken broth | 1/2 cup toasted flax seed | 1/2 cup chopped lemongrass | chopped fresh karashma or fresh lemongrass | 1 tablespoon freshly grated horseradish
instructions: Place dried herbs in bowl and stir in honey.  Cover and leave at room temperature for 20 minutes to soften.  Combine the water, broth, fax seeds and lemongrass in large saucepan.  Bring to boil over medium heat.  Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, about 5 minutes, or until thickened, stirring occassionally.  Remove from heat and serve.  Garnish with chopped fresh lemongrass and toasted toasted toasted toasted flax seeds.

instructions: Toss the tuna and white chocolate chips together in a bowl.  Mix the golden raisins and mayonnaise into the tuna mixture.

instructions: In a large bowl or plastic bag, mix together the crushed ice, butter, golden raisins, italian dressing, cumin, anise seed, and black pepper until well blended. title: Cheese Faux au Gratin

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Wrap cheese cube with foil and place in a glass baking dish or other shallow casserole dish.  Combine soup, egg white, herbes de provence or rosemary and mace, toss cheese with soup mixture and pour evenly over cheese.  Bake in oven for 40 minutes, remove foil and bake for an additional 1/3 15 minutes.  This can be served hot or cold.  May be served with cooked whole wheat bread for an elegant addition.

title: Cheaters Pastry
ingredients: 5 tablespoons shortening | 1/4 cup icing sugar or 1/4 cup confectioners sugar | 4 eggs, well beaten | 1 can chicken stock | 1/4 cup pitted green olives or 1/4 cup other black olives, chopped finely | 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper
instructions: In a small bowl, cream butter or margarine together until light and fluffy.  Beat in icing sugar gradually.  Blend in eggs one at a time.  Blend in chicken stock.  Add olives and ground pepper.  Stir till mixed well.  If it's too crumbly pour more egg into pastry bag.  Bake 15 - 20 minutes in 350 oven till tester comes out clean.  Serve with butter.

title: Seafood Pasta and Pasta With Sweet Chili Sauce

instructions: Boil pasta in lots of salted water until 'al dente', add cornstarch, chilli sauce, oyster sauce, cardamom and pine nuts to the pasta.  While pasta is heating add a bit of water to sauce and heat over medium and add pasta to heat through and sauce will thicken.  Serve with rice.

title: Longhorn Beef Tenderloin With Broccoli
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin | 1/2 lb cooked broccoli floret, chopped | 1 cup shredded longhorn cheese or 1 cup monterey jack cheese | 1/2 lb of shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for grated mexican blend cheese in crockpot and cook on high for 2 - 3 hours or low for 7 - 8 hours.  Shred beef with fork.  Serve with grated mexican cheese on the side.  Servings are approximate, you will take a shortcut, but it's delicious.

title: Beef Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 cup rice noodles, uncooked | 2 lbs beef sirloin, cut into 1/2 '' strips | 1 - 1 1/2 cup frozen green pepper, strips in strips | 1 -2 cup raisins | 2 tablespoons tamari | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning
instructions: Cook rice noodles in rapidly boiling water as directed on package.  Remove noodles, and rinse with cold water.  Drain well.  In large bowl, add beef strips, green pepper strips, raisins, and tamari.  Drain noodles well, and refrigerate.  Heat remaining ingredients, stir well.  Add noodles to beef mixture, and mix well. Random Ingredients: polenta,cabbage,active yeast,tomato paste,cabbage leaf,bay leaf,dark rum
title: Poles (Portuguese)
ingredients: 1 large cabbage, cored | 1 1/2 lbs cabbage leaves | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 can tomato paste | 1 bay leaf | 2 1/2 ounces dark rum | 2 packages polenta, cut into 3/4 inch slices or 4 sheets
instructions: Wash the cabbage and cabbage leaves.  Transfer the cabbage and leaves to a large bowl.  Sprinkle them with salt and let them drain until they are completely dry.  Place the drained cabbage on a clean cloth or a dry towel and squeeze out excess water.  In a dutch oven or an electric griddle, cook the cabbage and its liquid over medium heat, stirring often to keep the liquid from burning.  When the liquid boils, stir in the yeast and cover.  Allow to stand about 10 minutes.  In a large, lidded bowl, mix the tomato paste and the bay leaf.  Set this aside for 10 - 15 minutes.  Drain the cabbage leaves and pile them on a very large, clean cloth covered with plastic.  Spread the cabbage tomato mixture on top of the cabbage in a horizontal or vertical line.  Roll the cloth around the cabbage to pick up the cabbage.  Roll the cloth around the roll, pulling off any excess air bubbles.  Spread the cabbage tomato sauce over the tomato sauce.  Sprinkle the polenta with salt and cover with lard.  Allow to stand in a warm place for about 45 minutes.  Uncover the dutch oven or electric griddle.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,shrimp,taco seasoning mix,chicken bouillon cube,kalamata olive
title: Baked Mexican Shrimp
ingredients: 2 boxes of plain yogurt | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 4 ounces of chopped kalamata olives | 1 dash taco seasoning mix | 1 pound shrimp, peeled, deveined
instructions: Preheat oven to 1/2 inch high.  In a shallow dish, combine the yogurt, knorr chicken bouillon cubes and 1 teaspoons taco seasoning mix.  Stir to combine.  In a large skillet add the shrimp and cook and stir until they turn pink.  Pour the yogurt mixture over the shrimp and serve immediately.

title: Tortilla Chip Tea (For the Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tequila | 16 ounces crushed corn tortilla chips | 32 ounces your favorite tea
instructions: In a medium pot over high heat, stir the tequila and crushed corn tortillis until melted.  Pour in your favorite instant tea and stir until the tea is hot.  Serve warm or cold.  Note, i do not have instant tea because we do not have 2 servings.  You can serve it over ice.

title: Smokey Ladyfingers
ingredients: 3 packages ladyfingers | 1 can yellow onions | 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 1/4 cup liquid smoke
instructions: Combine caraway and liquid smoke.  Bake in a 9x13 inch pan in the oven for 10 minutes at 325°f.  Remove from oven.  Spread ladyfingers, then onions, then spread with smokey mixture.  Return to oven and bake for about 10 minutes.  Let cool before cutting.  Store in air tight container.

title: Homemade Cheese Balls (French Fried Cheese)
ingredients: 3 cups rice flour | 1 package provolone cheese, cut into 1/2-inch x 1/2-inch slices | 2 teaspoons garlic salt or 2 teaspoons garlic powder ( or more to taste )
instructions: The bottom layer of your cheese food should be covered with extra virgin olive oil.  Pre heat a skillet and coat with cooking spray.  Put a handful of the cheese in the pan.  When the cheese is bubbly, stir in the rest of the cheese and garlic powder.  Mix until the cheese is well incorporated into the cheese being careful not to burn.  Scoop up the cheese balls in your favorite way.  Let it cook on a medium low heat for about 10 - 12 minutes depending on the size of pan.  Remove the balls from the heat when they are all covered, and place them in an air tight container.  Best enjoyed with a side of a good loaf of homemade french bread.

Random Ingredients: radish,mushroom,extra virgin olive oil,spinach leaf,farfalle pasta
title: Spinach and Mushroom Pasta
ingredients: 1 package spinach leaves, rinsed | 1 1/2 pounds fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1 teaspoon extra-virgin olive oil | 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1/4 cup chopped radish, divided
instructions: Cook spinach in a large pot of boiling salted water until tender, 2 to 8 minutes.

title: Earl's Mom's Pot Roast
ingredients: 2 large yukon gold potatoes ( yukon gold ) | 1 lamb shoulder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place potatoes in a 1 1/2 quart pan.  Bake potatoes until tender and lightly browned, 20 to 25 minutes.  Drain and cool.  When cool enough to handle, cut in half, and separate into 1 inch pieces.  Cut and discard membranes and remaining meat from lamb, reserving liquid.  Place lamb into a 5 or 6 quart microwave safe container.  Spread potato pieces around lamb in a neat layer.  Heat in microwave until the lamb is hot and begins to brown at edges, about 2 minutes per side.  Drain excess oil.  Spread potatoes over lamb in the container, sprinkle with reserved potato liquid, and season generously with salt and pepper.  Cover tightly and microwave on high 10 minutes, then on high 15 minutes, until lamb is cooked to your liking.

title: Spinach with Sweetcorn
ingredients: 1 package baby spinach | 1 cup sweetcorn | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme
instructions: Place sweetcorn in the bottom of a microwave safe dish or casserole and microwave on high for 2 to 3 minutes, or until tender.  Stir in sweetcorn, jalapeno, marjoram and thyme.

title: Okra Kebabs
ingredients: 1 lb okra, cut in 1-inch rounds | 3 ounces frozen okra, thawed | 2/3 cup date, pitted and chopped | 1 egg, lightly beaten | 2 spring onions, chopped ( aka spring shallots ) | 2/3 cup cola, if using cola
instructions: Using a food processor, process okra to fine croutons.  Stir in date with egg, then add okra crumbles and spring onions.  Mix to combine.  Pour mixture into a well greased 9 x 13 dish or moulds, cover and chill for at least ½ hour or as long as overnight.  Brush kebabs with cola.

title: Camembert Green Plantains With Peppers
ingredients: 1 green plantain ( peeled and sliced into 1/4 in slices ) | 2 cups water | 4 slices camembert cheese | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped green pepper
instructions: Peel the green plantains and slice them into 1/8 in slices.  In a medium size saucepan, combine the water, green plantains and the green pepper and bring to boil.  Cover and reduce heat to simmer and simmer for approximately 3 minutes or until plantains are tender.  Remove from heat and cover.  Leave to stand for 10 minutes.  Remove the green plantains to a serving dish and serve warm with a drizzle of olive oil and a sprinkling of freshly chopped parsley.

title: Chickpea Phyllo Rolls
ingredients:
6 cups frozen turnips and green turnip greens ( or substitute 2 1/2 lb.
    - white turnips, 2 1/2 to 4 cups chopped yellow turnips, or substitute 2 1/2 lb.
    - frozen chopped turnips ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 cup coarsely crumbled frozen square stack phyllo pastry sheet | broth or water, as needed
instructions: Thaw turnip greens if at room temperature and pat dry with paper towels.  Place turnips and green turnip greens in a food processor with 3 cups water, bouillon cube, and 1 tablespoon of parsley.  Puree until smooth, adding more water if necessary, until mixture is fairly smooth again.  Spread half of fillo packet on work surface.  Working with one end of phyllo sheet at a time, transfer sheet to work surface and cut into 4 pieces.  Working with 1 piece at a time, place 1 piece phyllo at a time on work surface.  Place 1 3/4 cups filling in center of phyllo sheet.  Roll and fold the piece over the filling and bring ends together, leaving center folded.  Roll and fold the dough sheet and repeat until filling is used up.  Wipe excess phyllo dough with damp paper towels.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Cover baking sheet with foil large enough to hold roll pieces on work surface.  Place roll on tray.  Repeat procedure with remaining phyllo and filling.  Bake 10 - 12 minutes or until golden brown.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: part ricotta cheese,lettuce leaf,plantain,salami,oil black olive,pecorino romano cheese
title: Roasted Plantain Fritters
ingredients: 4 medium plantains ( about 6 inches long ) | 2 tablespoons part-skim ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup shredded pecorino romano cheese | 3 tablespoons oil-cured black olives, drained and chopped | lettuce leaf | salami, slices
instructions: If using the flat bottom rack to prepare the fritters, peel and slice the whole plantains crosswise into 1/2 inch thick half moons.  Remove any excess moisture.  Brush the plantains with a light coating of the olive oil and season with salt and pepper.  Place the plantains in a large baking dish and bake at 450 degrees f for 8 to 10 minutes until soft.  Let cool, then cut into 1/2 inch slices.  Place the ricotta on a plate and stir in 1/4 cup of the grated cheese and the olives.  Drain the plantains, and divide among individual fritters.  Spoon the cheese mixture over the plantains and serve, garnished with lettuce leaves.

title: Cinnamon Chocolate Glazed Hot Chilie
ingredients: 250 ml vegetable stock | 1 cinnamon stick | 2 green chili, halved lengthways | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated lemon peel | 120 g good-quality semisweet chocolate chips | freshly ground cinnamon
instructions: Stir the vegetable stock, cinnamon stick and green chillies in a saucepan until hot.  Remove from heat and add lemon, semisweet chocolate and half the ground cinnamon.  Pour over remaining warm stock, return to heat and melt chocolate.  Stir and serve immediately.  Repeat until smooth.  Store in a tightly lidded jar in the fridge until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,strawberry,orange,lukewarm water,turkey breast,poultry seasoning,thyme
title: Quick and Easy Turkey and Strawberry Soup
ingredients: 1 lb turkey breast, cut up into bite sized pieces | 2 envelopes dry onion soup mix | 1/2 cup orange juice | 16 ounces frozen strawberries, chopped up | 1/4 teaspoon thyme | 1/4 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1/4 cup lukewarm water
instructions: Place turkey in a large soup pan with onion soup mix.  Add orange juice, mushrooms, thyme and poultry seasoning.  Cover and simmer on low for 20 minutes.  Stirring occasionally.  Blend liquid with 1/4c water to make a thicker soup.  Continue cooking on low for 15 - 20 minutes.  The thicker, thinner broth, and more water can be added to thin soup.

title: Easy Ricotta Fonduta
ingredients: 2 lbs ricotta cheese ( preferably fresh ricotta ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated lemon zest
instructions: Combine ricotta cheese, lemon zest, and lemon juice in a large bowl.  Gently stir in about 1/2 cup warm water until mixture is thoroughly mixed and the filling is creamy.  Cover and chill in the fridge.  Bring to room temperature and serve with bread, crackers or pita chips.

title: Savoury Cherry Soufflés
ingredients: 6 eggs whites | 6 ounces dried sweet cherries ( the kind in the jar ) | 3 ounces white breadcrumbs | 7 ounces dry sherry | 5 ounces yogurt, of your choice usually i use non dairy sour cream
instructions: Make sure your oven or broiler/grill/broiler/grill the oven rack 4 inches from the heat.  If your oven is already very hot, leave it there until it is very hot/warm/warm at least 5 - 6 minutes.  In a medium bowl, mix eggs and beat till foamy.  Add in the dried cherries and a few tablespoons of sherry.  Add the bread crumbs gradually, mixing all the while to ensure thorough incorporation of the egg mixture.  Turn out onto a baking sheet sprinkled with flour, and brush the top.  Sprinkle on any color of your choice.  Place under the broiler, until just golden brown.  Do not overbake or allow to become puffed.  They are supposed to keep a little chewy on the bottom.  This is important for the texture, and also for the pleasant tartness.  Serve with lots of ice cream if desired.

Random Ingredients: mussel,tuna water,pita bread,green pea,spice,masa harina,doritos,baking soda
title: Tuna Fried Pitas
ingredients: 1 can tuna in water | 1/2 cup masa harina | 10 cups mixed pita bread | 1 can chopped black olives | 1 package frozen green peas | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice | 3 1/2 tablespoons crushed low-fat tamales and crushed tamales
instructions: Drain tuna, breaking up into large chunks.  Mash the tuna with a fork, and set aside.  Combine masa harina with a little water to make a moist dough.  Set aside a small amount, and use to press and roll out each pita into a circle approximately 8 inches square.  Place the pita circles on a non stick skillet, and lightly brush with oil.  Place 1/2 cup of the tuna mixture on the center of the pita.  Lift the pita, and carefully fold in the top half of the pita.  Make sure the tuna mixture is well sealed, and hold securely with toothpicks.  Place the filled pitas on a large, heated griddle.  Toothpick should be about 2 inches from the griddle.  Cook for 2 minutes on each side until golden brown.  Repeat with remaining pita and tuna.  Serve on toothpicks, with tamale toppings and salsa or pico de gallo for dipping.

title: Low-Fat Peachy Dip
ingredients: 4 cups peaches, pureed | 3/4 cup nonfat cottage cheese
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.  Store in refrigerator, covered, for 2 days, stirring every so often.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,ice water,icing sugar,shiitake mushroom,head cabbage
title: Kiyou Jun - Cabbage Roll Tea
ingredients: 2 cups ice water | 2 small heads of cabbage ( napa or cabbage of your choice ) | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 roma tomato, thinly sliced | 2 -4 shiitake mushrooms ( optional )
instructions: Place ice water, cabbage and sugar in a pot.  Heat to boiling over medium heat.  Cover tightly and allow to boil about 1 - 2 minutes.  Do not uncover until cabbage is softened, as this could boil over.  Remove from heat and add sliced tomato.  Place lid on pot and tightly press down on cabbage.  Allow to depressurize naturally by pressing a small plate underneath.  Once the liquid has drained away, remove lid, uncover and leave on stove for 5 minutes.  Add mushrooms, if using.  Allow to cool.  Serve chilled.

title: Alaskan-Style Potato Wedges and Sauces
ingredients: 1 cup creamed coconut milk | 1 lb small red potato, cut into wedges | 2 celery ribs, cut into 2 1/2 inch pieces | 6 ounces gruyere cheese, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 1 teaspoon ground chili
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f in a medium bowl, mix together the creamed coconut milk and creamed coconut, making sure there are no lumps.  Spread potato wedges in the bottom of a 9 inch nonstick or cast iron baking dish with the creamed coconut mixture.  Top with remaining potato wedges, spreading them in an even layer.  Cover tightly with foil.  Bake for 30 minutes, or until fork tender.  Meanwhile, melt the cheese in a small saute pan set over medium heat for 3 minutes or until lightly browned and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: chicken,chinese black mushroom,pepper flake,gouda cheese,mustard oil
title: Chinese Style Chicken
ingredients: 1 teaspoon mustard oil | 16 ounces chinese black mushrooms, sliced ( shitake ) | 5 ounces smoked gouda cheese, sliced | 2 -3 lbs chicken ( i usually halve them ) | 1 -2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes
instructions: Heat oil in frying pan on medium.  Add mushrooms, cheese and hot pepper.  Brown chicken on all sides.  Serve immediately with steamed rice on side.

title: Tex-Mex Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 5 slices white bread, toasted | 1 cup hot salsa | 3/4 cup reduced sodium salsa
instructions: Cut a piece of aluminum foil into four 61/2 inch wide strips and lay them in the center of two plates.  Place 4 chicken breasts in each.  Cover with 2 slices of bread, then spoon over 1/2 cup of salsa.  Spread remaining salsa over bread.  Bring the ends of the foil together to form a package.  Wrap tightly around the chicken, place in a slow simmer on the grill, and cook until the sauce is hot and the chicken in a little charred, about 20 minutes.  Serve on top of rice.

title: BBQ Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 teaspoon saffron | 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar | 4 -6 chicken wings ( or your favourite combination of chicken and drumsticks ) or 4 -6 drumsticks ( or your favourite combination of chicken and drumsticks ) | 1 cup radish, sliced ( optional ) | 3 -4 sliced onions ( optional ) or 3 -4 sliced scallions ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve saffron in vinegar, put into baking dish or tray.  Add wings or drumsticks.  Cover with foil.  Bake in moderate oven 350 degrees 35 - 40 minutes.  Note, sometimes i put the carrots and onions into the baking dish, along with the sliced red onions on top of the drumsticks, etc.  Bake 15 minutes, basting with vinegar and onions when the chicken is done.

Random Ingredients: head garlic,plain flour,gingerroot,red kidney bean,guinness stout,grand marnier
title: Guinness Kidney Bean and Ginger Scones
ingredients: 300 g red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 300 g guinness stout, undiluted | 1/4 cup plain flour | 1 teaspoon grated gingerroot | 1 small head of garlic, finely chopped ( about 3-4 cloves ) | 1 tablespoon grand marnier
instructions: Place the beans in a large bowl.  Add the guinness and stir until evenly mixed.  Sprinkle the flour over the beans, then stir through the ginger and grand marnier.  Season with salt and pepper.  Using your hands, mould and press the mixture into a circular, shallow, 19x30cm baking dish that is 5cm deep.  Mark the top of the scone with a small cross, then press down on top of the dough with your thumb to make it flatter.  Bake for about 30 - 40 minutes until golden.

title: Sunflower Seed Yeast Bread
ingredients: 500 g sunflower seeds | 5 g fresh yeast | 100 ml sherry wine | 25 g grated gruyere cheese | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil or 1 tablespoon other oils ( for cooking )
instructions: Place sunflower seeds in a pan and cover with lightly salted cold water.  Bring to the boil and cook, shaking the pan over the heat for 5 minutes to loosen the shells, then drain and cool completely.  Dissolve the yeast in sherry.  Place the sunflower seeds in a large mixing bowl with the cheese, oil and yeast mixture and mix to combine.  Mix in about 5 cups very warm water, with enough to make a spreadable consistency but not too sticky or too stiff.  Add more warm water if mixture is too thick.  It should sound watery and somewhat grainy.  Cover with a woolpernot paper and leave to ferment in a warm place for about 45 minutes.  Remove from the bowl after about 15 minutes and knead on a lightly floured surface for 5 minutes or until smooth.  Place the bread in a greased bowl.  Cover well with oil and leave to rise in a warm place for a further 60 minutes or until the bread is bubbling and beginning to become puffy.  This takes about 40min to 1 hour or until the bread has doubled in height.  Turn out the bread onto a greased baking tray.  Turning lightly and generously with oil, knock out any air bubbles and make several small holes in the bread with a sharp knife this will make it easier to remove when baking.  Allow to cool on a rack to firm up and break into large pieces.

title: Danish Beer
ingredients: 1 bottle lager beer | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Pour lager beer, cardamom flavored vodka, and ground cardamom into a large coffee mug.

title: Berry Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 package frozen mixed berries | 1 cup beef broth, or more as needed
instructions: Blend frozen mixed berries with beef broth.  Let sit 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lamb,seasoning salt,red onion,self raising flour,brown sugar
title: Potted Lamb Roast
ingredients: 450 g self raising flour | salt | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 2 teaspoons light brown sugar | 450 g ground lamb
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f.  Combine the flour, season salt, brown sugar and ground lamb in a bowl.  Knead with your hands until all the ingredients are combined.  Place onto a floured workbench and roll into a log.  Roll out to a thickness of about 4 mm or a quarter.  Place into a greased roasting tin and loosely cover with aluminium foil.  Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes.  Remove from the oven and allow to stand for 10 minutes.  Carefully remove the foil and slice into slices.  Serve right away with savoury gravy.  Note, if desired, make a double crust sandwich with a crusty loaf of bread and some sliced apple wedges and a fresh seasonal salad.

Random Ingredients: spice,parsnip,brown sugar,yellow pepper,fish sauce,balsamic vinegar,chorizo sausage
title: Trinidad Style Parsnip and Balsamic Stir-Fry
ingredients: 4 parsnips, peeled and julienned | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 3 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 teaspoon mixed spice | 2 ounces chorizo sausage, thinly sliced | 6 yellow peppers, thinly sliced
instructions: Steam the parsnips until tender, about 5 minutes.  Drain, and set aside.  In a wok or large frying pan, stir fry the chorizo over a medium heat until light brown.  Stir in the parsnip, and cook for 1 minute.  Stir in the sliced pepper.  Stir in the balsamic vinegar, fish sauce, brown sugar and mixed spice.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat, add the chorizo and parsnips, and cook for 1 - 2 minutes.

title: Bobby Flay's Crunchy BLT Salad
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce ( torn into bite size pieces ) | 1 can bamboo shoots ( drained ) | 1/2 cup whipping cream
instructions: Add the lettuce to a salad bowl.  In a blender, place the bamboo shoots.  Pour approximately half a cup of whipping cream, or more if desired, over the lettuce.  Stir and repeat until all the dressing is used.  Top with whipped cream and serve.  I sometimes put the dressing in a container with a tight cover or in a bowl of lettuce.  To make this quick and easy, i toss the salad with the dressing with just half a cup of whipping cream.

title: Black Olive Toast
ingredients: 8 slices rye bread, 1 to 2 slices | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 8 black olives, sliced
instructions: Place 4 slices of rye bread on a work surface.  Add a little cream of tartar to a small, cast iron skillet.  Place the remaining slices of rye bread on top of the cream of tartar.  Top with a few black olives.  Working with only 4 pieces at a time, place the remaining bread pieces on top of the olives in a flat layer.

title: Netherlands Famous Spiced Caramel
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs carmelized vanilla beans ( see note ) | 1 ounce oil | ground allspice
instructions: Heat carmelized vanilla beans to boiling in heavy 3 1/2 to 6 quart saucepan.  Pour allspice into a plate or small bowl.  Rub vanilla bean pulp into the pan until spiced, then add oil.  Raise heat to medium high and boil mixture until it is thick but not watery, about 1 minute.  Pour carmelized vanilla oil into hot caramel.  Continue boiling over low heat stirring until caramel is hot and beginning to burn, 1 1/2 to 3 hours.

title: Sausage Sandwich Cookies
ingredients: 1 pound dry cured smoked sausage | 1/4 cup white sugar
instructions: Combine the sausage, sugar, and salt in the bowl of a stand mixer or a stand mixer.  Using a dough hook, mix until thoroughly combined.  Transfer the sausage mixture to a cookie sheet, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until well chilled, at least 1 hour.  Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Remove the chilled dough from the refrigerator and roll it with a rolling pin until it is about 1/8 inch thick.  Using a 2 1/2 inch round cookie cutter, cut out the cookies.  Place the cookie cutter on a baking sheet.  Bake for 8 to 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until slightly browned.  Let cool to room temperature before removing the cookies from the oven.  Remove the casings after baking.  Store in an airtight container, for up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: ham,bamboo shoot,thai chili sauce,chili oil,chive,corn oil,wax pepper
title: Thai Hot Pepper Balls
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground ham | 4 drops of thai chili sauce | 1 fresh chili oil | 1 tablespoon water, for the filling | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 tablespoon bbq bean sprouts | 2 tablespoons chives
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl with hands in order to form balls.  If more air is needed, knead the mixture.  On a floured surface, roll the ball into a thin pancake.  Serve with satay sauce.  To prevent hot pepper balls from sticking to the hot pan in the middle, oil can be dropped into it.  Heat a wok and brush with cooking spray.  Dip the hot ball, one at a time, in the oil.  After the first sample is placed on the hot pan, it should crackle immediately.  Remove it onto paper towel and allow it to cool.  Repeat with more hot balls.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,green olive,oregano leaf,palm sugar,coconut cream
title: Sweet and Savory Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin | 1/4 cup finely chopped green olives | 4 tablespoons coconut cream | 2 tablespoons fresh oregano leaves | 2 tablespoons grated palm sugar
instructions: Place the beef tenderloin between 2 sheets parchment paper and pound it into a 5 inch thick rectangle on both sides with the flat of a meat pounder or the flat side of a cleaver.  Spread the olives over the beef and top with the green olives.  Combine the coconut cream, oregano, palm sugar and 2 tablespoons water in a skillet over medium high heat.  Bring the mixture to boil and boil, swirling the skillet as it boils to evaporate any excess moisture, until thickened and reduced to about 2/3 cup.  Remove the skillet from the heat and set aside to cool slightly.  Slice the tenderloin at a 45/degree angle into thin slices about 1/4 inch thick.  Arrange the slices on a platter and brush both sides lightly with the coconut sauce.  Spoon the remaining sauce over the sliced meat and sprinkle with the remaining 1 tablespoon green olives.  Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: anchovy paste,red capsicum,lime wedge,white sugar,ouzo,five spice powder,cilantro
title: Red Capsicum Tapas
ingredients: 1 large red capsicum, halved lengthways, deseeded, and cut into cubes | 2 ounces ouzo | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 2 anchovy paste | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1 lime wedge | 3 teaspoons white sugar | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Place capsicum and ouzo in a heatproof bowl.  Cover with boiling water, then leave stand 15 minutes to macerate.  Add remaining ingredients to capsicum.  Stir to combine.  Serve with chips or vegetable steamed green beans.

Random Ingredients: ice,spanish onion,white pepper,lettuce leaf,vanilla yogurt,hunt tomato sauce,corn chip
title: Mexican Salad (Golabki)
ingredients: 8 ounces hunts tomato sauce | 1 1/2 cups white pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup spanish onion | 4 large lettuce leaves, torn | 1 cup canned corn chips, coarsely crushed | 6 ounces low-fat plain vanilla yogurt or 6 ounces vanilla fruit yogurt, thickened with | splash of vanilla extract
instructions: Combine tomato sauce and pepper in sauce pan.  Cook on low heat, stirring to mix ingredients.  Chop onions and add in to tomato mixture.  Simmer on low heat for 10 minutes stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.  Place lettuce in small serving bowl.  Top with sauce.  Sprinkle with crushed corn chips or crushed, toasted corn chips.  In separate bowl, combine yogurt and vanilla, whisk thoroughly.  Spoon over lettuce.

title: Slow Cooker Shredded Pork
ingredients: 1 pork loin, cut into 1 by 1/4-inch shreds | 2 1/2 ounces taco seasoning
instructions: Spread taco seasoning into the top of the pork shreds with a spatula.  Place pork shreds in the bottom of the slow cooker.  Cover and cook on high for 5 hours, or until pork shreds are tender.

title: Peanut Flavoured Beef for Two
ingredients: 8 -10 pieces beef tenderloin | 24 ounces mixed olives, drained | 1 tablespoon of smooth red curry paste | 2 teaspoons cream
instructions: Season the tenderloin with salt and pepper.  Place the beef in a heavy casserole dish.  In a small bowl combine remaining ingredients and spread evenly over the meat.  Place lid on casserole dish and cook slowly in a slow oven for approximately 3 hours.  Remove lid and cook until beef is very tender and sauce has thickened slightly.  To thicken, combine two tablespoons of thicken sauce with one tablespoon of cream and mix well.

title: Fruit & Chips (Taquitos)
ingredients: 8 cups popped corn tortilla chips, crushed, 1 pkg | 2 lbs prunes, patted dry and cut in half | 2 cups ice | 2 cups simple syrup | 4 cups oyster sauce
instructions: Combine popcorn, prunes & ice with remaining ingredients & press into the baking pan.  Cover tightly & bake at 300f for 25 minutes.  Uncover & bake an additional 5 minutes or until golden brown, stirring twice during baking.

title: Sirloin  Grape Leaves   (Mexican Beef Salad in Grape Leaves)
ingredients: 1 lb thinly sliced roast beef | 2 cups chopped green peppers | 1 cup chopped seedless grapes | 1/2 cup minced fresh cilantro stems | 1 english cucumber, peeled, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced
instructions: Marinate meat with green pepper, grapes and cilantro for 1 hour refrigerated.  Arrange on serving platter.  Serve with crackers.

title: Peking Hamburgers
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon peanut oil | 1/2 cup mini marshmallows | 1/2 cup ground sirloin | 12 hamburger buns
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat, and lightly oil the grate.  Stir pork glaze ingredients together in a small bowl, and set aside.  Wrap each hamburger bun with 2 to 3 slices of sirloin, and secure with wooden picks.  Grill until the sirloin is no longer pink in the center, 6 to 7 minutes.  Top with marshmallows.

title: Homemade Parsley Butter
ingredients: 2 quarts unsalted butter | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic salt
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a food processor or by hand.  The mixture can be obtained by using a mixer, mixer or food processor.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,white vinegar,maraschino cherry,pistachio nut,peanut oil,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Italian Cheese Salad With Sage and Pistachios
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1/2 tablespoon chopped fresh sage leaf | 4 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 6 1/2 ounces shelled pistachio nuts | 1/4 cup chopped fresh maraschino cherry, halved | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped roasted peanuts, if desired
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the vinegar and sage.  Add the cheese, nuts and cherries and toss to coat.  Taste and adjust seasoning.  Stir in the peanuts just before serving.

title: Greek Tomato & Bread Dip
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes | 400 g ripe tomatoes with puree | chopped of fresh mint ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to gas mark 3/160c / 240f/gas place the potatoes in a large roasting tin and cover with water.  Bring to the boil and then simmer for 25 minutes, until the potatoes are tender, drain and return to the tin.  Pour in the tomatoes.  Cook for 15 minutes or until thick and the tomatoes have pulped into pulp.  Add the mint and stir through.  Serve warm or warm, depending on your taste, with breads.

title: Easy Microwave Root Vegetable Stock
ingredients: 1 piece gingerroot, peeled and sliced into thin julienne strips | 2 teaspoons ground cumin ( optional )
instructions: Slice the ginger into slices and then slice those slices in half.  Place the ginger and cumin into a mortar or spice grinder or blender and grind until smooth.  Place the onion and the cumin into a microwave safe bowl, pour in the ginger and cumin mixture and allow to stand 30 seconds or so to 1 minute before opening.  Cover and cook on high 1 1/2 to 2 minutes and then on high for 2 more minutes.

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 2 1/2 quart slow cooker dish.  Cover and cook on high 2 - 3 hours and low 20 - 30 minutes.  Serve over rice.

instructions: Whisk eggs.  Add remaining ingredients.  Chill.  Note, if you use the dried herbs in a fresh herb/spice/spice mixture, stir in 1 t.  Dill until mixed.

title: Mung Beans
ingredients: 225 g mung bean sprouts | 150 ml tomato juice | 1 -2 teaspoon dry mustard, depending on taste | 1 -2 teaspoon jaggery, depending on desired flavour
instructions: Mix ingredients together and boil in a pot until cooked.  Serve.

title: Horseradish Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 2 tablespoons turbinado sugar | 3 tablespoons vinaigrette
instructions: Put all of the ingredients into an individual sized bottle and shake well.  If the bottle has a tight seal, place it upside down for several minutes, then it will begin to infuse the juice.  The sugar will begin to caramelize which will lead to the caramelization and help to release the flavor later.  You will have to shake a little bit longer until the desired consistency goes right.  You should be able to keep the sugar in the bottle for about a week before attempting to bottle.

title: Pesto and Roast Pork
ingredients: 400 g roast lean pork, sliced thin ( i use a little less ) | 1 cup lentils, soaked for 15 20 minutes in water just to cover the meat | 3 medium turnips, cut into wedges ( small firm ) | 1/2 cup pesto sauce ( prepared, pesto shop will do )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c or 170°c fan forced.  Layer meat and lentils in a single layer on an oven tray.  Sprinkle evenly with pesto.  Bake for 40 mins, turn, bake uncovered for a further 30 mins or until the meat is tender and cooked through.  Serve with vegetables.

title: Fettuccine Curry Phyllo Purses
ingredients: 1 package crescent roll dough | 12 dried thin fettuccine, cooked | 1/2 cup dry sherry | 1/4 cup bisamic vinegar | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/2 cup bailey's irish cream | 1/4 teaspoon curry powder | 1/4 teaspoon thyme leaves | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1 cup phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f.  Coat a 9 x 13 inch pan with cooking spray.  Place the fettuccine in a large bowl and cover with ice water to soften.  Set aside to let the pasta sit until chilled, about 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, place the sherry, bisamic vinegar, balsamic vinegar, bailey's, curry powder, thyme, and phyllo dough into a large resealable plastic bag.  Seal the bag and shake to mix well.  Place the bag in a baking dish and set the dish in a large roasting pan with enough hot water to come half way up the side of the dish.  Bake at 375 degrees for 50 to 60 minutes, until the phyllo dough is crispy and bubbly and the fruit is tender.  Let the curry fettuccine cool until you can work with it, about 10 minutes, stirring it with a fork every 5 minutes.  Pour 1/4 cup of the curry fettuccine in a bowl and mix in 1/4 cup of the dry sherry.  Place one phyllo sheet in the bottom of the prepared dish just to cover, leaving about 1 1/2 inch around the edge of the dish.  Line the bottom with a sheet of phyllo dough.  Place 1/2 of the curry fettuccine on top of the dough, using less than half of the sheets of phyllo, in a criss cross line line along the long edge of the pastry.  Pour 1 1/2 of the curry fettuccine over the mixture, then add another 1 1/2 of the curry fettuccine and the remaining 1 1/2 of the curry fettuccine, placing at least 1 tablespoon of curry fettuccine in the center of the phyllo.  Sprinkle the remaining 1/4 cup of curry fettuccine over the entire dish.  Sprinkle the top of the dish with 3/4 teaspoon of salt, then drizzle 2 1/2 tablespoons of the curry fettuccine over the fettuccine.  Repeat with the remaining 3 phyllo sheets of phyllo and curry fettuccine.  Place the phyllo sheets on top of each other on top of the phyllo with the edges of the phyllo facing up.  Place in the preheated oven and bake 30 minutes, or until the phyllo tops are golden.

title: Mexican Party Appetizer
ingredients: 2 cups leftover bottled clam juice | 4 cups shredded monterey jack pepper cheese, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Prepare a 10 x 15 inch jelly roll pan with a removable base by spraying with an oiler.  Line the bottom of the prepared pan with the shrimp, lobster, and cheese.  Drizzle with clam juice so that each layer displays a little of the clams at the bottom of the pan without overcrowding.  Bake uncovered until bubbles are bubbling all the way through, about 20 - 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,red bell pepper,rice wine vinegar,mirin,apricot,phyllo pastry,coriander powder
title: Chilled Phyllo Pastries With Prawns and Apricots
ingredients: 1 package phyllo pastry | 1 red bell pepper ( optional ) | 1/2 cup sliced pistachios or 1/2 cup chopped walnuts | 1/2 cup diced dried apricot (, see note below or you may use a mix of fruit of choice, optional ) | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon mirin | 1 teaspoon coriander powder ( optional, not ground )
instructions: If using raisins then soak them while preparing the prawns.  If using nuts then dry fry them in a frying pan until just opaque.  Chop bell pepper fine and set aside.  Spray a small non stick frying pan with vegetable spray then fry the bell pepper until just softened.  Sprinkle with pistachios or walnuts then sprinkle with paprika if using.  Set aside.  Prepare pastry for the pastry.  Remove 2 layers from the filo sheets and brush with oil.  Place another sheet on top using oil and lightly brush the top sheet with oil.  Take 1 sheet and brush with oil.  Place 2 sheets on top and brush oil on.  Take another 2 sheets and brush oil on.  Place 2 more sheets on top and brush with oil, add a little water to the upper layer if needed.  Take 2 sheets and brush with oil.  Add 1 more sheet on top and brush with oil.  Cut the pastry into 3 - 3 squares.  This is the base of the dish.  Line the bottom layer of pastry with pastry.  Layer the shrimp/prawn mixture on top of the pastry and then pour the apricot slices on top.  You should have 12 layers.  Cover the shrimp with plastic wrap and set aside.  Place the top layer of pastry on top of the shrimp/prawn mixture.  The shrimp/prawn should be just covered with the pastry.  Take the plastic wrap and roll the pastry pastry around the shrimp/prawn mixture until it tightly encloses the shrimp &prawn mixture.  Cut the pastry sheet into pieces that are about a 4'' by 3'' square and place on top of the shrimp/prawn mixture.  Sprinkle the top with the remaining 3 sheets of phyllo and then seal together with a fork, making the pastry sheets a little thick around the shrimp/prawn mixture.  Cut the pastry stack into 5 - 6 pieces.  To serve, place one piece on a plate, sprinkle with a bit of paprika, then cut the shrimp/prawn mixture in half, then serve.  Variation, if using a green vegetable, use 4 or 5 fresh green tomatoes.  Remove the pulp and seeds before finely chopping to yield 4 pieces.

title: Chile Stuffed Poblano Peppers (Papas Ahuego)
ingredients: 1 poblano pepper, halved lengthwise | 1 cup light ranch dressing, divided | 1/2 cup ice cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f position a rack in the center of the oven.  In a small baking dish, combine 1 tablespoon ranch dressing with the remaining 1 tablespoon of dressing.  Cut a slit lengthwise down one side of the poblano pepper.  Open the pepper and remove the seeds and membrane.  Place the poblano pepper, cut side up, in a bowl.  Cover with remaining dressing and then with the ice cubes.  Place peppers on a rack in the rack and bake 15 to 25 minutes or until peppers are tender and crisp and the dressing is bubbly.

title: Cream Cheese Frosting
ingredients: 250 g cream cheese, softened | 1 cup vanilla sugar | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: In a food processor, cream together cream cheese, vanilla sugar and turmeric or vanilla extract until creamy.  Store in an airtight container.  Frosting is a thin paste that has a thick consistency.

Random Ingredients: currant,romaine lettuce leaf,chocolate chip,dark chocolate,white wine
title: Chocolat Chip Crunchies
ingredients: 1/2 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1 tablespoon dry white wine | 1 tablespoon currants | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate, melted | 4 romaine lettuce leaves
instructions: In a small bowl, melt chocolate and wine on low heat, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat.

title: Beef Brisket With Gorgonzola
ingredients: 1 beef brisket, trimmed and tied with kitchen string | 4 tablespoons gorgonzola, grated coarse, or more to taste | 1 cup coarsely shredded pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f.  Place brisket, fat side up, on a rack in roasting pan.  Roast in the preheated oven until the meat pulls apart easily, about 4 hours.  An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 140 degrees f.  Cool to room temperature, about 1 hour before slicing.  Combine cooked brisket, cheese and pecorino romano cheese with cooked pasta.  Serve.

title: Easy Microwave Balsamic Basting Sauce for Chicken
ingredients: 2 teaspoons low-fat balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon powder | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium sized bowl.  Mix well.  Add chicken and coat in sauce.  Spray microwave safe dish with cooking spray.  Cook chicken on high for 2 mins then lower heat and cook for around 30 minutes or until chicken is tender.

title: Corn Sticks With Beef Fries
ingredients: 4 medium russet potatoes, peeled | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 can corn oil | 1/2 cup coarsely grated coarsely grated russet potato | 2 teaspoons corn oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.

title: Indian Hazelnut Eggs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground hazelnuts | 2 eggs | 3 tablespoons fresh coriander leaves, chopped, plus more for garnish | 1 -2 teaspoon fresh kaffir lime leaf, chopped, to garnish
instructions: Break the eggs, cover with hot water and beat until whites are white and creamy.  Drain well and fold through the nuts.  Add coriander leaves, lime leaves and chillies.  Serve.

title: Pork Tenderloin Sandwich
ingredients: 3 tablespoons coarse grain mustard | 3 tablespoons low-sodium instant espresso | 3 1/2 teaspoons fresh medium-grain mustard | 12 large center-cut pork tenderloin, trimmed of all visible fat | 2 french baguettes, toasted or 2 sandwich buns, split | 3/4 cup canned great northern beans, rinsed and drained | 1 -2 teaspoon finely chopped fresh red chili powder | 8 -10 fresh curry leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500 degrees.  Combine the dijon and the next 4 ingredients in a small bowl and blend to a paste.  Spread the mixture over both sides of each slice of tenderloins, pressing into the mustard coated surface to coat.  Line a baking sheet with foil and set aside.  Bake until the meat reaches desired doneness, about 15 minutes.  Remove from the oven and transfer the pork to a cutting board.  Using a sharp serrated knife, slice into 1/2 inch slices.  Place the tenderloins on the prepared baking sheet.  Insert a slice of pork into each warmed loaf.  Spoon the beans and chile into a small bowl and stir to blend.  Top each sandwich with a teaspoon of the dip and a curry leaf.  Serve.

title: Pumpkin Seeds With Mango
ingredients: 3/4 cup raw almonds | 1 cup raw shelled pumpkin seeds ( pepitas ) | 1 bunch scallions, thinly sliced | 2 medium mangoes, peeled and chopped | 1/4 cup mild cider vinegar | 3 tablespoons grated orange peel | 2 teaspoons dried dill | 1 dash cinnamon
instructions: First toast the almonds in a dry frying pan on the stove or in the microwave until a shade or darker and crisp.  Turn them over and set aside to cool.  Place all the above ingredients into a blender and process until smooth.  Add the nuts into a bowl and toss well to combine.  To serve, toss with green salad and french breads.

title: Quick Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 4 lamb shanks | 2 -3 slices of assorted mixed dried fruit | 1 bottle of la japanese sake | 12 -15 lasagna noodles | 2 -3 radishes, cut into small slices | 1 pizza crust
instructions: Rinse the lamb shanks and place between layers of plastic wrap.  You will have to rub the plastic wrap on the lamb shanks.  They are not supposed to be saran, but some are and a little like them.  Wrap the lamb shanks with about 6 more plastic wrap, making sure they are not touching.  You can tie with a very long piece of kitchen string to keep them from unraveling during the cooking process.  The easiest way to do this is to gently hit a piece of plastic wrap and, with one hand on the lamb shank, pound it until it is very thin.  The more you pound then pound, the thicker it will be.  If it sticks, you can use your hands to pound the meat until it is thin again.  In a small skillet cook the dried fruit in 1/2 the sake.  To cook the fruit, heat 2 cups of water to simmer.  Break up the dried fruit with your hands, and simmer until it is plump, about 20 minutes.  Remove from heat and chill.  Preheat oven to 475°f arrange the lasagna noodles on ungreased cookie sheets.  Fill a large roasting pan with water and put some sheets directly on top of each other on the oven rack.  This will keep it from cracking and bubbling.  This may take 15 minutes.  After 15 minutes take the oven off, and place the sheets in the oven for 10 - 15 minutes, or until the noodles are tender.  Remove from the oven.  The lasagna may be made as many as this will fit into a 13x9 inch baking dish.  I usually get about 2 1/2 inch wide noodles per sheet.  I like to use smaller sheets, then cut up the sheets i go inches.  While the water and noodles are going to boil, place the lamb shanks in a large skillet, and sear them over medium heat for about 5 minutes, turning a couple of times, until nicely browned on all sides.  Remove the shanks to the hot pan over medium high heat.  Arrange the noodles in the bottom of the pan with some of the lamb meat that was removed from the pan.  Spread the reserved fruit mixture over the noodles.  I have found that i usually put enough sauce right on top of any other filling.  The noodles will sort of absorb this sauce.  Cover the pan tightly with foil, and put it back in the oven.  Turn the oven on to broil until the top is bubbly and the noodles are tender.  Watch the oven carefully, so as not to burn, put foil in the bottom of the oven.  When the noodles are done, remove the foil and top with some of the lamb shank.  Note the meat is cooked at very low heat when the sauce is no longer runny.  If you want a crunchier sauce, remove the shank from the pan and top with a slice of radish.

title: Pork Skewers (Pork)
ingredients: 4 lbs pork butt ( cut crosswise into 16 pieces ) | 2 tablespoons minced fresh ginger | 1/3 cup dry sherry
instructions: Cut pork butt into 16 equal pieces.  Thread meat onto 2 12-inch long metal skewers.  Sprinkle with ginger and sherry.  Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes.  Heat a grill or broiler until hot.  Insert skewers.  Cook about 10 minutes or until just cooked, brushing with sherry, turning to brown evenly.

title: Basic Vanilla Burritos
ingredients: 2 tortillas | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla essence ( or other flavour )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients to form a soft burrito, wrap in plastic wrap and put in fridge for 30 minutes.  Heat up your burrito in a nonstick pan, and when its hot, fry your burritos in it until they start to crisp up.  Take it off and let them cool a little before cutting the burrito into 2 - 3 squares.

title: Pistachio, Date and Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles, cooked | 1 jar pickled pistachios, chopped | 1 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 cup dried dates, cut into quarters and divided in half | 1/2 cup miracle whip
instructions: Arrange noodles and 1/2 of pistachios in a flat serving dish.  Top with remaining pistachios.  Combine mozzarella, dates and remaining pistachios.  Drizzle with miracle whip.  Sprinkle with remaining pistachios.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,vegetable oil,chuck roast,chicory lettuce,leek,pepper sauce,saffron strand
title: French Dip Roast

instructions: Place beef on a rack in a roasting pan and sprinkle generously with salt and pepasant's twine or any string.  Roast at 400 degrees fahrenheit for 2 1/2 to 3 hours until internal temperature reads 140 degrees fahrenheit or internal temperature registers 140 degrees f for rare 2 1/2 to 3 hours.  Remove roast from oven, tent with foil and let rest in refrigerator.  When cool enough to handle, remove meat from bones.  Heat the oil in a cast iron skillet.  Cook leeks in oil in the skillet until tender, stirring, about 3 minutes.  Add saffron and hot pepper sauce and stir to mix. instructions: Dice the pork in small pieces, about 3/4 inch square.  Set aside.  Finely chop bell pepper.  Combine all ingredients in large bowl.  Place in refrigerator to marinate for 30 minutes to one hour.  Bring to boiling point then cover.

title: Roasted Yellow Pepper French Chicken (Low Fat)
ingredients: 1 whole roasting chickens | 1 medium yellow sweet pepper, halved and seeded | 1 medium white onion, halved, and cut into 1-inch slices | watercress ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Note, you could use any combination of pepper, onion, and cauliflower or any combination of these, but it must be whole or cut with a sharp knife into 1/2 inch strips, being careful not to cut into the white part.  Truss with kitchen string and add to crockpot. .  Place chicken in crockpot, breast side up.  Sprinkle chopped onion around the chicken and pour 1/2 cup water into crockpot.  Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours, or on high 4 to 5 hours.  When ready to serve, slice and pour water over chicken pieces and sprinkle lightly with watercress to garnish. title: Red Rice Pudding With Cranberry-Lemon Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 package dry white onions, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup red curry paste, such as sharwood's or other curry blend | 4 1/2 cups low-fat small curd cottage cheese | 1 cup plain low-fat yogurt | 2 teaspoons grated lemon thyme | 1/2 cup light cranberry juice | 2 cups whole grain rice ( uncooked ) | 1/4 cup chopped green olives
instructions: In a 12 inch non stick skillet, combine the onion, curry paste and 4 1/2 cups water.  Bring to a boil over moderate heat, stirring occasionally, then reduce the heat to very low and simmer, uncovered, stirring every 5 minutes, until onions are softened, about 20 minutes.  Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, stir 1 cup of cottage cheese with the yogurt and thyme until just combined.  Add the cheese to the onions and stir to combine.  Add the cranberry and lemon juice and stir to combine.  Set aside.  Wash the rice under cold water and drain.  Meanwhile, in a 3 quart saucepan, combine the remaining 1/2 cup of cottage cheese with the rice.  Cover and simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, until the rice is tender without all the excess liquid, about 15 minutes.  Stir in 1/4 cup of the green olives.  Top with half the cooked onion mixture, then top with the remaining onion mixture.  Serve warm, passing the remaining olives at the table.

instructions: Cook the pasta, according to package directions, until el dente.

title: Moroccan Fried Green Peas

title: Simple, Easy, Delicious Queso Dip

instructions: Heat a small skillet until just hot.  Combine cheddar cheese and pepper sauce in a small bowl.  Spread over a serving plate.  Serve warm.

title: Pears Stuffed With Pink Grapfruit Juice (Dako Donburi)
ingredients: 3 large firm pears | 1/4 cup toasted bread flour ( japanese bread flour ) | cooking spray | 1 tablespoon mirin ( sweet rice wine ) | 1 tablespoon fresh pink grapefruit juice | toothpicks
instructions: Cut the tops off the pears and discard.  Cut out core and discard.  Remove white part from inside of pear, removing enough of the core to make about 1/4 inch thickness.  Carefully hollow out the pears, leaving a 1 inch shell to hold the pear juice.  You can also use pink grapefruit juice but it gets diluted with mirin so be careful to avoid making the juice too sweet.  Cut out the hard center of the pears with a sharp knife.  Cut the pears into thick slices approximately 1/4 inch thick.  Lay out two shrimp or two pieces of pears inside the pears and top with a tablespoon of stuffing.  Carefully remove any remaining stuffing/pork/pears and set aside in a bowl.  In a medium bowl mix bread flour with a little of the mirin, making a paste.  Use the mixture to coat the pears.  You can also press in water or a little water and coat in flour to thin it out a little.  Spray the pan with cooking spray.  Pour in the pears, pouring in the ponzu sauce right at the top.  Cook for an 3 - 4 minutes or until bottom of pear starts to turn golden brown, and the top becomes sticky.  Turn the pears over.  Spray the pan again and continue cooking for 3 - 5 minutes and another 3 minutes until golden brown.

instructions: Combine beans beans, figs, coconut, and pepper in a large saucepan.  Cover.

Divide the sausage, apricots and guacamole among four warmed plates.

Pat with cool water and drain on paper towels.  Brush chicken with 1/2 of sauce and sprinkle on a light layer of remaining sauce.  Place in a 13x9 inch greased baking pan with the remaining sauce.  Sprinkle on top with almonds.  Bake at 350 degrees, uncovered for about 35 minutes until chicken is browned, chicken juices run clear or chicken is fork tender and the sauce is bubbling.

title: Sea Scallops and Daikon Radishes With Noodle Sauce
ingredients: 8 large sea scallops ( or equivalent, see related recipe ) | 2 tablespoons ice, cracked | 4 tablespoons wheat flour | 1 teaspoon fresh nutmeg | 1 tablespoon pure chinese wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon light corn syrup | 1 1/2 lbs daikon radishes ( about 2 medium ) | 2 small whole-grain sandwich steamed whole wheat gluten ( such as harnestelli smart helens )
instructions: Cut a slice off one end of each scallop and remove the pith, leaving a 1 inch thick shell approximately 1/8 in thick around the scallops.  Cut the scallops in half crosswise and set aside.  Remove shells from the scallops keeping the shells intact.  In a small mixing bowl combine the cracked and cracked ice and whisk together until smooth.  Sprinkle the cracked ice generously into an ice pop tray and carefully place into the freezer for about 5 minutes.  Toast a flat grill over direct medium heat for about 1 minute or until lightly browned and a toothpick inserted into the center of an ice pop reaches cleanly in the center.  Pat the scallops dry with paper towels.  Place a sheet of plastic wrap on the hot grate and turn the scallops over to give them a good sear.  When the scallops are about one minute from just turning, place them back on the grill and repeat.  Repeat until the scallops are just cooked through remove from the grill.  On the same hot grill, lightly oil the grill rack.  Remove the scallops from the ice and dry them in another flat pan.  Remove and discard the toothpicks.  Meanwhile, in a small mixing bowl combine the flour and nutmeg.  Put the vinegar and syrup through a paper towel lined sieve into another small saucepan and season.  Pour the liquid over the scallops and toss well to coat well.  Set aside while you prepare the radishes.  Heat a 6 to 8 inch heavy skillet over high heat until very hot.  Remove the shrimp from the ice cream shell and shake off the excess ice.  Pile on a cutting board or platter and pat with the radish slices.  Spoon or ladle equal parts of the radish sauce over each slice.  Place the scallops on top.  Place 5 to 7 inches from the heat and cook for 4 to 5 minutes or until the scallops reach desired doneness.  Remove the scallops from the skillet and sprinkle with salt.  Pile on a platter and let stand 3 minutes.

instructions: In a small pot melt the jawa/chipotle liquid.  Do not let it reach a boil or it will boil away.  In another small pot, melt the butter.  In a separate small pan, sauté the shrimp over high heat until they turn pink. .  Keep aside when done.  Remove shrimp from skillet and set aside.  Drain any excess fluid from the skillet and set aside.  Dry the asafetida with some paper towel and set aside.  In a pan, place the onion in the melted butter.  Cover with the caramel.  Then add the shrimp paste.  Keep on low heat until the pan is dry and the mixture starts leaving the sides of the pan.  Add the sugar, stir and cook for 5 minutes.  Drain the excess grease from the pan.  Mix in the asafoetida powder, salt and chili.  Heat just till the mixture starts boiling.  Add the shrimp, mix well and serve.  Note, this is a dish that is served at room temperature.

title: Pasta, Macaroni and Escarole With Rice

instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the rice and 3/4 cup water.  Set aside.  In a small saucepan, bring 2 quarts salted water to a boil.  Add the tortellini and cook for 6 minutes or until al dente.  Drain.  Toss with the rice, escarole and pasta.  Serve.

title: Chutney Bread Pudding Sandwiches

instructions: Place chutney, cilantro, leeks, sugar and stock in a blender.  Blend thoroughly until smooth.  Cut crusts from sliced french bread and discard top, leaving a 3/4 thickness.  Cut bread slices in half horizontally.  Remove from crusts by pressing cut surfaces firmly together.  In a large non stick frying pan, melt shortening over medium heat.  Add bread slices and fry for 2 - 3 minutes on each side, or until browned on both sides.  Add coriander and serve immediately.

instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Squeeze out excess moisture from frozen broccoli florets.  Place on a baking sheet and set aside. instructions: Place cabbage slabs in a large bowl.  Top with tomatoes.  Dice onion.  Sprinkle on cabbage slabs.  Combine ranch dressing mix with fennel seed and brown mustard seeds in a small bowl until thoroughly mixed.  Pour dressing over cabbage and tomatoes.  Serve immediately.

instructions: Heat up some lard in your wok, and when it is very hot, add rice.

instructions: Wash& sort lentils.  Wash hands and place lentils on it roll, starting with the wide ends.  Fold the wide ends around the lentils& make sure all is exposed. title: Grilled Salmon En Papillote
ingredients: 6 plum tomatoes | 3 tablespoons whole wheat flour tortillas, warmed | 1 cup soymilk | 2 ounces smoked salmon fillet, thinly sliced and cut into strips | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme, crushed | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: In small sauce pan, heat tomatoes over medium high heat until almost soft, about 2 minutes.  Cover and let sit for 10 to 15 minutes.  Using an 8 inch nonstick skillet or griddle, toast the tortillas until just beginning to char, about 1 minute.  Transfer to plate.  In a small bowl, combine soy milk, salmon, thyme, and cloves.  Pour over warm tortillas.  Serve immediately.

title: Fish with Fresh Mint and Fresh Curry Powder
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs haddock, cleaned, deveined, soaked in cold water for about an hour, and then cleaned again | 4 cups fresh mint, including some of the mint leaves, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder, preferably kashmiri type | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 1 1/2 tablespoons white sugar
instructions: Bring to the boil the 4 cups of cold water.  Place the cleaned fish into the boiling water and let it boil for about 5 minutes, checking occasionally.  The fish should not be completely cooked when it turns white.  Using a slotted spoon, remove the fish from the liquid and set it aside.  Remove the cloudy water from the fish and add mint to the water.  Drain the fish and place on a kitchen towel to dry up the mint.  To make fresh curry powder put sugar in some of the water used to soak fish if desired to make it a little fluffier.  Combine the mint and water.  Bring to the boil and cook over a medium heat for 5 minutes.  Add the fish and mix well.  Cover, reduce the heat to low, and cook for 20 minutes.  To serve, place the fish on a heated serving platter and pour the curry over it.

instructions: Makes about 1 cup.  Sprinkle instant coffee granules over cooked noodles and set aside or refrigerate to thaw if using regular.  Coat a medium size skillet with cooking spray.  Heat on medium high.  Add noodles, 3/4 cup feta, 2 teaspoons thyme, black peppers and green peppers and spread evenly.  Cover and cook until noodles are tender, stirring every few minutes, about 8 minutes.  Sprinkle shredded cheese over top and heat through or set aside in refrigerator up to 6 hours.  Serve immediately.

Cover and simmer over low heat 20 minutes.  Stir occasionally to prevent sticking and to prevent sticking in the pan to avoid burning.

instructions: Preheat your oven to 350 degrees.  Coat the sides of 2 large cookie sheets with cooking spray.  Set aside.  In a medium bowl, combine the tomato soup, artichokes, raspberries, chipotle peppers, beer, and light corn oil.  Stir together thoroughly.  Pour into a baking dish coated with cooking spray.  Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until lightly browned.  Enjoy.

title: White Seaweed Pudding
ingredients: 1 lb fresh mixed dry beansprouts | 1 inch cube cold water | 6 fluid ounces heavy cream | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground paprika | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 1/8 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace | 1 tablespoon heavy cream
instructions: Wash and drain the beansprouts, place them in a colander, and sprinkle them with salt.  Place 2 cups of water in a saucepan and bring it to a full boil.  Add the beansprouts and bring the liquid to a boil again, skimming the foam.  Transfer the beanprouts to a bowl, and reserve some of the water.  Place the remaining liquid in a heavy saucepan and bring it to a boil.  Mix together the heavy cream and mustard.  Set it aside at room temperature until serving time.  When ready to serve, spoon about 3 tablespoons of the whipped cream into a serving dish.  Pour the beanprouts into the cream, and then sprinkle the remaining whipped cream on top.  To serve, pour about 1½ cups hot bean sprouts out onto the serving dish.

title: Pork Sausages and Apples
ingredients: 1 kg green apple, peeled, core removed and roughly chopped | 200 g good quality pork sausage | 1 1/2 liters grape, washed and drained | 1 bunch spring onion, very finely chopped, white portion only | 1 bunch blanched almond, about 20cm ( or pine nuts )
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a large heavy based pan.  Add enough cold water to come about 1/4 of the way up the side of the pan.  Cover and bring to the boil, then then reduce heat and simmer for about 1 1/2 hours or until the apples are very tender.  Scoop out the juices with a slotted spoon and cool in the fridge to remove any extra moisture.  Return to the pan and reheat gently until warm.  Serve on a platter with the almonds scattered over the top.

title: Graham Flour Crusted Chicken (For Peroshky's Recipe)

instructions: First clean the chicken well.  Then put the graham cracker crumbs in a large bowl.  Roll out the chicken with your hands to coat the chicken.  Then dip the chicken in the graham cracker crumbs.  Then coat the chicken with the graham cracker crumbs again so you can get some of the crumbs on the chicken.  Then put the chicken in a cookie dish, covering it with foil.  Then place the dish on a cookie sheet and put in oven on 250 - 325 degrees f for at least 4 hours.

Spread the cereal on the top of the cereal, pressing it gently to smooth out.  Spray a pan with cooking spray and set it over a medium high heat.  When the pan is hot, scatter the tortilla chips in one layer over the cereal, ensuring that the chips are spaced evenly away from each other. Transfer to a food processor and return to the pan with the chickpeas.  Add to the chickpea mixture in batches with the coriander and orange zest and process until blended.  Spoon into a bowl and add a little more broth or water if necessary.

Repeat with remaining sheets of phyllo dough, placing each on the lightly oiled baking sheet.  Coat an ovenproof skillet with cooking spray.  Bake, uncovered, about 40 - 50 minutes until golden brown and bubbly.

Add julienned jicama, avocado, chilies, and water chestnuts to a large bowl.  Set aside.  Drain anchovy paste through a sieve into a medium bowl.

title: Sardine and Vermicelli in Black

instructions: Cook sardines, and let them rest for 5 minutes while you prepare the sauce.  Fry vermicelli, sprinkle with turmeric and fry until the colour is a vivid red.  Remove from pan and set to one side, add vermicelli, and fry sardines.  Cook sardines and vermicelli until they open slightly.  Add the sugar and cook for 3 minutes.  Add salt and pepper, add the sauce and mix well.  Fry almonds until slightly colored,.  Add cream and boil until thick.  Add sardines.

title: Easy Baked Pasta Primavera

instructions: Place a large pot of salted water on to boil.  Add the pasta and cook till just tender but still firm to the bite, about 8 minutes.  While that's cooking, heat the sauce in a medium sized saucepan.  Combine mascarpone, tomato juice, mint leaves and apple in a bowl.  Stir to blend.  Drain the pasta and place in a large serving bowl.  Pour the prepared mascarpone mixture over pasta and stir to coat well.

title: Low Carb Spanish Paprika Substitute
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 cup splenda granular, sugar substitute | 1/8 - 1/4 cup smoked paprika | 2 teaspoons chipotle powder, depending on how strong you want the spiciness
instructions: Combine the splenda and the chipotle powder and add the chipotle powder.  Store in an airtight container.

title: Easy Beetroot
ingredients: 4 large beets | 1 teaspoon curry paste | 3 fluid ounces curry paste, or more to taste ( optional )
instructions: Wash and dry each beet root thoroughly.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Cover and place a steamer insert into the pot.  Pour 1/2 c curry paste into a plastic bag.  Hold bag by the stem, pull out as many air bubbles as you can, and place the bag into the bowl of a blender container.  Add a few drops of water if you use an oozing green blob of steam in the bowl at the bottom of the jar.  Cover the container and blend on high until the beets are very tender, 2 1/2 minutes.  Remove bag from blender container.  Slip beets from bag and shake off excess liquid.  Set aside.  When boiling water returns to a boil, cover and reduce heat to medium low.  Simmer until beets are tender, about 20 minutes.  Remove and discard bag and lid from water.  Run a knife around the bowl to wring out excess water and then place each beet root in a bowl of ice water to cool to room temperature.  When the beets are cool enough to handle, peel and slice the beets.  Place the shredded beets into a bowl, and stir in 1 cup of curry paste.  The can of curry paste is enough to coat the beets if used, but the curry paste will darken as the beets marinate for several hours in curry paste.  Bring water back to a boil.  Reduce heat to a simmer and add the beets.  Simmer until the beets are very tender, another 10 - 15 minutes.  Gently stir the beets to coat with the curry paste.  The beets will also cook sooner than potatoes.

title: Southern Dill Pickle
ingredients: 4 pounds pork butt shoulder | 5 leaves dill pickles, chopped
instructions: Wrap the pork with 2 sheets of heavy aluminum foil.  Tie the foil tightly to ensure that the pickles will not break.  Place on cold, unlined grill.  Cook over medium heat until the moisture from the pork has evaporated, 20 to 30 minutes.  Slice into 1 inch pieces, place on serving platter lined with lettuce leaves, and top with pickles.

title: Cheese Fonduta
ingredients: 2 cups plain yogurt | 2 cups grated gruyere cheese | 1 teaspoon grated lime zest | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon | 1 teaspoon vodka
instructions: Soak the grated cheese in the yogurt.  Grate the zest into the container.  Measure the chicken bouillon.  Mash the bouillon into the yogurt with a fork.  Stir in the vodka.  The cheese mixture will be shaggy but will melt slowly.  Pour into a fondue pot with a tight fitting lid over medium heat.

title: Tropical Marshmallow Bananas
ingredients: 1/2 cup basmati rice or 1/2 cup brown rice, prepared | 1 banana, sliced | 4 tablespoons lemon liqueur ( or alcohol like balsamic ) | 2 tablespoons marsala wine or 2 tablespoons white cooking wine | 1/4 cup icing sugar
instructions: Cook rice in boiling water for a minute or two, or until liquid is absorbed.  Add banana during the last few minutes of cooking time.  Drain rice well and allow to cool to room temperature.  Add vanilla and almond liqueur.  Top with icing sugar and enjoy.

title: Tomato & Yogurt Pudding
ingredients: 1 cup yogurt | 1/2 cup prepared instant pudding mix | 1 tomatoes | 1 tablespoon lime soda
instructions: Put all ingredients into bowl, stir til combined.  Pour into serving dish sprayed with cooking spray.  Cover with plastic wrap, refrigerate to chill.  Serve with fresh fruit or cinnamon/cinnamon/sugar/spice i use fresh fruit.  Some people like dried cranberries for their puddings.

title: Spicy Mexican Pork Tenderloin

instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f.  Score the tenderloins by slicing about 1 inch deep into the fatty areas with a sharp knife dipped into an ice cube.  Insert the knife, cut side on the side of each tenderloin, and tie with 2 inch string.  Place the tenderloins onto an aluminum foil lined baking sheet.  Bake the meat for 1 1/2 hours in the preheated oven.  The internal temperature should be 145 degrees f when pierced with the tip of a knife.  Cool, then refrigerate the tenderloin for up to 2 days.  Serve with tortillas, salsa, and beans or other dishes.

instructions: Arrange about 4 cups sliced raspberries in bottom of a 2 quart buttered shallow baking dish, spacing evenly.  In a bowl, combine the cream, bbq sauce and chocolate morsels, and beat until smooth.  Spread mixture evenly over the raspberries.  Chill until set and firm, about an hour.  Top with nuts, if desired, and chill until serving.

title: Olive Oil Spareribs - 2-Qt Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs spareribs, cut into serving portions | 1 1/2 cups dry sherry or 1 1/2 cups vermouth, divided | 2 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Place spareribs in 4 - 5 quart pressure cooker or dutch oven.  Add 3/4 cup sherry or vermouth and red pepper flakes.  Pressure cooker should read 380 degrees f on a deep, heavy duty thermometer or heavy duty stand mixer, with 6 cups water and high sides up.  Reduce heat to low.  Cook 25 min. , then remove spareribs, using tongs or slotted spoon.  Stir reserved sherry over ribs to coat.  Close lid.  Heat to pressure over high heat.  Reduce heat to lowest setting and cook 10 minutes.  Transfer to a warm platter or bowl of wire rack.  Serve at once for dipping.  Note you can also place any leftover spareribs in a baking pan and lightly coat with cooking spray or sherry.
