Add 1 tortilla and cook, swirling skillet occasionally, until tortilla is golden brown, about 2 minutes.  Flip, top with a second tortilla and cook, pressing gently, until golden brown on second side, about 3 minutes longer.  Repeat with remaining tortillas.  Serve topped with remaining marinade, fruit and apple drizzled with apple sauce.

title: Pfeffernusse(Sift from Fru)
ingredients: 5 lbs brown sugar | cooking oil or lard
instructions: Wash the sugar thoroughly.  Slice the lard or use oil and brush on all sides of the mixture.  Sprinkle over the brown sugar.  Place in a roaster, and cook on high heat, stirring constantly so it does not burn, until it is dark mahogany in color.  Do not stir.  Remove from the stove, and leave it a while to set.  Store it in refridgerator.  When time to serve, spread one side of a french loaf with the warm mixture, then one side w/oil.  Spread another slice of the loaf on this side.  The sugar will harden and crisp if left unattended.  Sprinkle on a little white sugar.

title: Chocolate & Avocado Pies
ingredients: 400 g pie crusts, frozen | 3 tablespoons caster sugar | 45 g fresh chocolate | 3 avocados, roughly diced | 60 g purchased enoki mushrooms | 125 ml vodka | 1/2 cup freshly grated chocolate
instructions: Defrost the frozen pie crusts in a large non stick pan.  Place into a preheated oven and bake for approx 25 minutes or until lightly golden.  Place frozen pie crusts into a blender and blitz until semi smooth.  Add sugar and chocolate and blitz again to combine.  Spread mixture onto one of the pie crusts and place onto a baking tray.  Chill.  Melt the butter and add the enoki mushrooms and stir to coat.  Place the avocado, chocolate and vodka into a small saucepan and cook gently, stirring constantly, until the chocolate has melted.  Take off the heat and cool slightly.  Spoon into the warm chocolate mixture and stir through the choclate.  Spread onto the other pie crust, chill and cut into twelve squares.

Random Ingredients: bread crumb,tea,half cream,vanilla bean,bacon,chipotle chile adobo,chinese wine,chicken bouillon cube
title: Chef John's Smoky Chipotle Meatballs and Brew-Beer-Lager
ingredients: 1 cup soft bread crumbs | 3/4 cup half-and-half cream | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon ground dried chipotle chiles in adobo | 2 cups strong brewed coffee, or more as needed | 6 slices bacon, diced | 1 1/2 tablespoons chinese wine | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise, seeds scraped
instructions: Place bread crumbs, cream, instant chicken bouillon cubes, chipotle powder, and coffee in a food processor.  Process until the mixture forms smooth dough.  Preheat oven to 300f degrees f.  Grease a 9x13 baking dish.  Remove dough from food processor with a spatula, and roll in crumbs to coat.  Place in prepared baking dish.  Repeat with remaining dough, making 3 more batches of meatballs.  Bake meatballs in the preheated oven until done, about 30 minutes.  Remove meatballs from heat and cut into small, bite sized pieces.  Cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crisp and browned, about 10 minutes.  Stir bacon, coffee, vanilla bean seeds into bacon drippings in the skillet.  Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer until the flavors have blended, at least 20 minutes.

title: Etruscan Olives
ingredients: 3 tablespoons plain flour | 50 g dried pitted green olives | dipping sauce, for coating | powdered icing, for coating
instructions: Combine flour and 3 tbsp cold water.  If using presoaked, pre cut olives into 1/4in pieces with a pizza cutter.  Dip olives into flour and water mixture until coated.  Repeat until all of the flour and water mixture has been used.  Allow olives to dry on paper towels.  Preheat oven to 200c, gas mark place olive slices on an oven tray, and bake for 10 - 15 minutes until crisp and golden brown.  Place remaining olive slices on plates, drizzle with dusted icing, and serve drizzled with dipping sauce.

title: Puerto Rican Cheese
ingredients: 4 -6 quarts cheese, any flavor, cubed ( cotija, monterey jack, whatever you have to ) | 1 ounce queso fresco, crumbled or ground | 4 whole cloves
instructions: Combine all ingredients, and mix well.  Store in the refrigerator in an airtight container for a week or two.  If using homemade, the cheese can be brought to room temperature, but it can be grilled and simmered with a touch of hot pepper sauce for a finale.

title: Escarole's Edamame Dip
ingredients: 4 ounces edamame, cooked | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Pour cooked edamame into a casserole dish.  Combine onion soup mix and soup mix with the edamame.  Stir until well blended.

title: Broth for Bread Maker
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 4 -5 cups broth | 2 cans cream of mushroom soup, regular ( or thick and light flavored ) | 1 bunch of fresh chopped broccoli | 12 whole peppercorns
instructions: Combine the yeast with the broth and let sit in a warm place until frothy, about 15 - 20 minutes.  Drain the liquid and add the soup to your broth mix.  If your mix is too thick, add more broth.  Add the broccoli and peppercorns.  Turn your breadmaker on to the dough cycle.  Take a sharp knife and cut a cross in the center of the loaf leaving 1/4 inch at the top.  Insert a knife through the top for steam.  Place on an unlined rack over a cool place until ready for baking.  Bake the bread according to the bread machine instructions or when desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,cauliflower,jerusalem artichoke,cilantro,celery seed,beef steak,monterey jack cheese
title: Beef Au Gratin
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into chunks and cooked to your liking | 2 lbs beef steaks, cut into chunks and cooked to your liking | 2 lbs cauliflower, coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 2 lbs monterey jack cheese, cut into 1/4 to 1/2-inch cubes | 1 package jerusalem artichokes, well drained, sliced into 1/4-inch rounds | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f.  Grease a baking dish.  In a large bowl add the beef, cauliflower, cumin seed, cheese cubes and jerusalem artichokes.  Toss to combine.  Sprinkle with chopped cilantro and mix well.  Transfer mixture into the prepared baking dish.  Bake for 1 hour.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: clam,pistachio nut,pancetta,soybean,vanilla pudding mix,yoghurt,beef stock cube
title: Puppy Chazzaté (Flams in Yoghurt)
ingredients: 1 ounce pancetta, chopped roughly | 1 ounce soybeans, chopped roughly ( chick peas, prawns are similar in size ) | 1 beef stock cube ( optional ) | 7 ounces yoghurt or 7 ounces sour cream | 6 ounces soybeans, fresh squeezed out of their shells | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla instant pudding mix | 1 -2 tablespoon chopped pistachio nut ( to garnish )
instructions: Fry the pancetta in a non stick pan.  Add the soybeans and fry for a minute or two.  Add the chopped pancetta and fry for another minute, and then add the stock cube.  If you are using the beef stock cube, dissolve it in 1/4 pint warm water.  Boil until the stock cube can be easily crushed.  Once boiled, add the yoghurt and mix well so that it mixes everything together.  Cover and leave for 5 minutes until the yoghurt has melted and is almost smooth.  If it looks a little runny, mix a little bit of milk or water over it.  Add the vanilla and the pistachio nuts until they are mixed well.  Serve in a pita, with rice and salad.

title: Spinach and Potatoes with Herb Crust #5FIX
ingredients: 4 cups fresh spinach | 4 medium hash brown potatoes, cut into 1 inch cubes | 6 tablespoons thymol seeds
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f.  Place the spinach and potatoes into a large bowl, breaking the spinach into pieces as it leaves the water.  Add the thyme or parsley flakes and toss to coat.  Spread mixture evenly on a 12 inch pizza pan or large cookie sheet.  Bake in the oven for 12 minutes or until the spinach and potatoes are tender.  Serve hot.  To freeze, place the spinach and potato mixture in resealable bags.  To reheat, place in a microwave safe bag with a secure lid.  Microwave on high for 4 minutes or until hot.

title: Quick Sambouseh
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil | 2 cans chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 3/4 - 1 1/2 cups plain greek yogurt | 1 1/2 cups prepared pizza crust, defrosted according to package
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Heat oil in a large skillet, over medium heat, until hot but not smoking.  Add chickpeas and saute, stirring often, 2 minutes.  Add yogurt and heat through, 1 minute.  Spread sambouseh on pizza crust, spreading evenly.  Bake in oven for 8 - 10 minute or until golden brown, puffed, and heated through,.  Variation, when making sambouseh, add 3 3/4 cup tzatziki sauce and 1/2 tsp of garlic powder, and 1/4 tsp of cayenne pepper to the chickpea mixture.  This recipe makes several sambouseh servings.

title: Salmon Applesauce with Apples
ingredients: 2 pounds fresh salmon, cut into 4 portions | 2 tart apples - peeled, cored and cubed
instructions: Place salmon into a large cast iron skillet or dutch oven, and cover with water.  Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, and simmer 5 minutes.  Place apples into the same skillet with the cooked salmon.  Cover, and simmer 10 minutes, or until the apples have softened.  Remove from heat, and allow to steam until apples are soft, about 10 minutes.

title: Jamaican Style Salad
ingredients: 3 tablespoons coconut oil | 2 tablespoons garlic and herb oil | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 head lettuce, chopped | 4 scallions, chopped | 3 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 8 ounces spaghetti, cooked | 2 tablespoons horseradish ( optional )
instructions: Combine oil, garlic, salt, and cinammon in a small container, and stir together thoroughly.  Pour over lettuce, scallions, chopped bamboo shoots, and spaghetti.  If desired, add horseradish to taste, and serve.

title: Lamb and Feta Baked Hash
ingredients: 1 lamb, cut into large chunks ( or any meat that can be picked, but lamb is typically used in a pinch ) | 3 tablespoons soft beef shortening, such as crisco | 2 tablespoons chopped pimentos | 2 teaspoons whole grain mustard | 250 g feta cheese | 1 small beet, finely sliced or 1 small potato, thinly slice
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c.  Line a large, non stick, oven proof dish with aluminium foil and grease with shortening.  Trim fat from meat and remove fat, if any, and trim excess fat.  Place on the tray and season.  Mix together meat, pimentos, mustard and feta cheese and spread half of mixture on.  Top with beet or potato slices.  Fold other half of the mixture over meat mixture and sandwich to enclose the filling.  Trim edges if necessary to fit.  Bake for 30 minutes until crust is crisp and golden.  Serve warm from the dish with vegetables, or as is for sloppy joe style sandwiches.

title: Minty Chile Pepper Paste
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped unsalted dry mint | 2 tablespoons of minced chile paste, such as thai kitchen
instructions: In a food processor, place the mint and chile paste, together with a little water.  Process until a creamy paste forms.

Random Ingredients: pineapple ring,red enchilada sauce,confectioner ' sugar,italian tomato paste,cider vinegar,turmeric,bisquick
title: Red Apple Enchilada Casserole
ingredients: 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1 can pineapple rings, cut in half & then thinly sliced | 1/2 cup bisquick | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 9 -10 canned red enchilada sauce | 4 tablespoons crushed italian-style tomato paste | confectioners'sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Lightly grease a 9x13 inch casserole dish with a bit of olive oil or some margarine.  In a bowl combine all of the ingredients and mix well, except the red enchilada sauce and the red enchilada sauce.  Spoon a layer of the prepared enchilada sauce onto the bottom of the casserole dish.  Place an overlapping layer then a layer of pineapple or the red enchilada sauce on top.  Do not worry if some of the mixture spills out over.  Repeat to make 3 stacks of layers.  Using an oven mitt add a small amount of red sauce to each layer, top with another layer of red enchilada sauce, and repeat with another thin layer of red sauce and more red sauce.  Top with the last layer of red sauce.  Cover tightly with tin foil and bake in oven for 30 minutes.  Uncover and bake for an additional 15 minutes.  Sprinkle with confectioners' sugar during the last 5 minutes of baking.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,tart apple,dark soy sauce,skirt steak
title: Chicken Wings With Apple and Apple
ingredients: 500 g chicken wings, separated and tips discarded | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 tart apples | 1 1/2 kg lean skirt steaks
instructions: Preheat oven gas mark 5 or 190&#730.

title: Spaghetti With Vanilla Yogurt
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups spaghetti | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 1/2 cups vanilla yogurt | 12 fresh sage leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala ( allspice ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 2 tablespoons half-and-half cream
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.  Drain well and coat a 9x13 casserole dish with cooking spray.  Set aside.  In a small bowl, combine yogurt and spices.  Place spaghetti in the dish.  Add yogurt mix and mix well.  Spoon mixture evenly over the noodles.  Combine half and half and whisk in.  Pour over the pasta and toss to coat.  Serve warm, or refrigerate for up to another 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,bacon,allspice,virgin olive oil,mustard powder,jalapeno pepper,white vinegar,coconut cream
title: Hot Jalapeno Spinach
ingredients: 2 lbs baby spinach, cleaned and picked through | 1/4 cup virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon dry mustard powder | 1 tablespoon allspice | 2 cans coconut cream | 4 jalapeno peppers, sliced ( or more, to taste ) | 2 slices bacon, cooked
instructions: In large pot of salted boiling water cook the spinach and reduce till just wilted.  Drain and refresh under cold water.  Chop.  In large frying pan heat oil, mustard, and allspice and cook till heated.  Add coconut cream, chili, bacon& shrimp, cook till shrimp are pink& set.  Add spinach and cook 2 - 3 minutes.  Pour sauce over and serve.

title: Macadamia Nuts in Kirsch
ingredients: 1/2 lb macadamia nuts ( kirsch or orange blossom water will do ) | 3 cups pure gogi cherries ( kirsch kirsch kirsch ) | 1/8 teaspoon saffron ( optional )
instructions: Rinse and pat the macadamias dry with paper towels.  Dry with paper towels.  Put them in a bowl and mix them well with the cherries.  Stir in the saffron if using.  Heat a heavy skillet on high until just smoking on the rim.  Do not burn the bottom of the skillet.  Pour about 5 tablespoons of the kirsch into the pan, spreading it around the pan evenly.  Add the macadamia nuts in a single layer.  Toss them so that they brown evenly and become aromatic, about 30 seconds each.  Don't worry if the outside of the nut is turning a nice uniform color.  You should have a deep brown color but not a burnt taste.  Immediately remove them from the skillet and pour the remaining kirsch on them.  Scatter them over the top.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,white onion,green bean,red wine vinegar,button mushroom,golden syrup
title: Vegetable Burgers for the Gang
ingredients: 1 medium white onion | 1 1/2 lbs fresh green beans | 1 cup sliced button mushrooms | 1 cup thinly sliced sweet white onion | 1 3/4 cups red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons golden syrup or 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Slice onion and green beans, if frozen, cut into 4 inch pieces.  Trim and slice mushrooms.  Combine all ingredients except mushrooms.  Shape mixture into six 3/4 inch thick patties.  Refrigerate at least 3 hours, turning once, stirring occasionally.  Bring to room temperature, cooking the burgers 30 minutes or until hot and cooked through.  Serve with gravy.

title: Pasta and Beef
ingredients: 1 lb lean round steak, cut in 1/2 inch cubes ( or use 5oz of veal ) | 1 1/2 cups elbow macaroni | 1 package yellow rice, cooked, well-shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees.  Coat casserole dish with cooking spray.  Add a cup of water to a skillet that has been covered with nonstick spray.  Heat to boiling, then stir in the rice.  Cover and transfer to oven for 20 minutes.  After 20 mins, stir in the steak, and reduce heat to low.  Cover and cook for 20 minutes, stirring several times.  Serve and let friends and/or family taste the food.

title: Fenugreek Loaf
ingredients: 2 cups self raising flour | 2 teaspoons fenugreek seeds | 2 teaspoons orange zest
instructions: Mix the dry ingredients together.  Make the batter by combining all the ingredients together, pour into a greased and lined 9 x 5 inch loaf tin, bake for 35 - 40 mins at 180c or 180°c.  When cool, slice and serve on a warm night.

Random Ingredients: cornstarch paste,allspice,rom tomato,pizza crust,orange juice concentrate,lasagna noodle
title: Jiffy Tomato Lasagna
ingredients: 2 lbs roma tomatoes, seeded and coarsely chopped | 1 can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed | 12 sheets lasagna noodles | 1 teaspoon cornstarch paste | 3 teaspoons allspice | 1/2 cup orange juice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees.  Mix together the tomato, orange juice concentrate and cornstarch paste and spread evenly onto the ungreased bottom of a 10 pie pan.  Sprinkle the layer of tomato mixture over the tomato mixture.  Sprinkle the top with the oregano.  Bake for 20 minutes or until tender and bubbly.  Remove from the oven and sprinkle with cinnamon.  Let sit 5 minutes prior to serving.

title: Corn and Avocado Salad
ingredients: 2 ears corn, shucked | 1 large ripe avocado - peeled, pitted, and shredded | 1 teaspoon curing salt | 1 pear, cored and diced
instructions: Place ears of corn in a saucepan and cover with water.  Bring water to a boil and cook for 5 minutes, or until tender.  Rinse under cold water.  Drain well and remove kernels from cob.  Shred corn and place in a large bowl.  Mix in the avocado, curing salt.  Add the pear.

title: Noodle Snack
ingredients: 1/3 lb white bread, crumbs | 1/3 lb noodle, small shell pieces | 1 large yellow onion | 6 packets chicken bouillon | chopped chives, to garnish
instructions: Combine crumbs and onion.  Dry fry slices until crisp drain and crumble.

title: Pork Loin and Bean Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork loin, trimmed of fat or 1/2 lb pork tenderloin, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/4 teaspoon fresh coarse ground black pepper | 1 package frozen peas, thawed | 1 box baby spinach, washed and chopped | 4 ounces pancetta, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 medium lemon, cut into wedges
instructions: In a small bowl, season pork with salt and pepper and add oregano and ground black pepper.  Place pork in a large heavy duty zip top plastic bag.  Add the pork and marinate on the counter for 2 to 6 hours, turning occasionally or in the refrigerator for up to 8 hours.  Combine peas, spinach, pancetta, and lemon halves in a bowl and toss.  Arrange pork on a serving platter and serve with salad.

title: Low Fat Asparagus, Feta & Sugar Snap Peas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs asparagus spears | 1/2 lb sugar snap peas or 1/2 lb baby bellas, trimmed, ends trimmed | 1 tablespoon sugar | 2 -3 cups ice, as needed
instructions: Steam asparagus and snap peas, covered, until asparagus is crisp tender, 4 - 5 minutes.  In a 6 - 8 quart saucepan, mix sugar, snap peas, and water asparagus.  Cook over high heat, stirring often, until water boils and sugar dissolves, about 5 minutes.  Stir occasionally until peas are crisp tender and syrup is syrupy.  Serve warm.

title: Oaty Oysters
ingredients:
18 fresh oysters | 1/2 cup quick-cooking oats | 1/4 cup chopped red onion | 2 teaspoons mrs.
    - dash seasoning | 2 teaspoons lemon pepper seasoning
instructions: Wash, dry and pick over oysters just enough to leave on the headspace.  Combine ingredients in a bowl, and toss.  Place on a platter, and serve.

title: Pesto Chutney
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped red onion | 1/2 cup prepared pesto sauce | 1 cube chicken bouillon
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: italian breadcrumb,dark sesame oil,fish sauce,mint sprig,cauliflower floret
title: Cauliflower Sticks
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower floret | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 50 g fresh breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | mint sprig ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Peel the cauliflower and cut it into 3cm lengths.  Place in a saucepan of water, bring to the boil, simmer for about 5 minutes, until the cauliflower is just tender but still firm to the bite.  Drain and set aside in a medium sized serving bowl.  Mix the fish sauce and bread crumbs together, add the sesame oil, then stir in the cauliflower.  Sprinkle with mint leaves, if using.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,cheese,rice vinegar,sesame oil,bun,lemongrass
title: Simple Lemongrass Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 stalks lemongrass, cut into 2 inch rounds | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 5 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 teaspoon grated fresh lemon rind | 1 -4 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix | 3/4 cup shredded cheese
instructions: Cut the lemongrass fine.  Place the lemongrass into a non metal bowl.  Combine remaining ingredients and stir to combine.  Add the lemon grass and mix well.  Pour 1/3 of marinade over lemongrass and toss to coat.  Let sit at room temperature for 20 minutes.  Heat 1 to 2 1/2 tablespoons oil in a large non stick skillet over medium high heat.  Remove lemongrass from bowl with slotted spatula and spread evenly over skillet.  Fry until fragrant, about 3 minutes.  Add remaining marinade.  Increase heat to high and fry for 1 to 2 minutes, until fragrant.  Top rice with a fried portion of the lemongrass mixture and sprinkle with cheese.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,cayenne pepper,polenta,chili pepper flake,yeast,mace,orange bell pepper
title: Pizza Seasoning Mix for Baked Polenta

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Spread the onion and bell pepper in a 9x13 inch nonstick pan.  In a medium bowl, mix together the dried chili, yeast, mace, cayenne pepper, and instant polenta, reserving 1/4 cup of the liquid.  In a blender or food processor, blend the remaining ingredients until thoroughly blended.  Spread the polenta mixture over the onion and bell pepper, stirring to coat evenly.  Bake in the preheated oven until the bread is deep brown, about 45 minutes.

title: Achiote Paste
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: Heat tamarind to release alcohol.  Add corn starch and stir until it becomes smooth.  Refrigerate mixture for 1 - 2 days.

title: Spanish Lentil and Sausage Stew
ingredients: 1 lb lentils | 1 lb smoked sausage | 1/2 lb pork fat
instructions: Soak lentils for at least three hours.  Drain lentils well.  Wrap two pieces of smoked sausage around each lentils bean.  Place on large heavy pan with fat on top.  Cook on low heat.

title: Warm Sesame Broth
ingredients: 12 button mushrooms, washed | 1/2 teaspoon fennel, chopped | 1 can kale, rinced | 1/4 cup sesame seeds | 3/4 cup sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Finely chop the kale.  Place mushrooms and fennel in a 4 - 5 cup pot and pour on the sherry.  Mix in enough water to cover.  Bring to a simmer over medium high heat.  Cook, and stir occasionally, for 3 - 4 hours, or until mushrooms and fennel are tender.  Stir in the sesame seeds and cook for another 2 - 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,maple sugar,marsala wine,swiss cheese,palm sugar,oil,taco sauce,honey
title: Taco Bell Pepper and Swiss Cheese Side Dish

instructions: Place pepper slices in a non stick skillet over medium high heat.  Sprinkle each with half of the swiss cheese.  Combine sugar and remaining swiss cheese and sprinkle evenly over the cheese and peppers.  In a small frying pan, add oil, honey, and maple syrup and heat for 20 - 30 seconds over medium high heat.  Pour heated maple syrup mixture around cheese and peppers and bake 5 - 10 minutes, or until golden brown.  Place the remaining swiss cheese on top of each serving.  Pour the warmed taco sauce over the top.  Add remaining swiss cheese and let it sit 5 minutes before serving.

title: Apple Carrot Soup
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups beef broth | 1 1/2 cups fresh carrots, chopped | 1 can apple pie filling
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 4 quart electric slow cooker.  Cover and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours or on high for 5 - 6 hours.  For freezing, cover and freeze until solid.

title: Creamy Beef With Honey Glaze(ATK)
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 2 tablespoons tomato paste or 2 tablespoons tomato sauce | 2 1/2 cups whipping cream | 3 tablespoons honey | 1 stalk celery, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients, apart from beef and simmer about one hour, covered.  If mixture seems dry during last 30 minutes, stir in water.  Cover & simmer until meat is tender, stirring occasionally.  Remove beef and keep warm.  Stir mixture constantly until glaze thickens.

title: Spanish Rice Surprise
ingredients: 3/4 cup packed brown rice | 14 1/2 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup chopped spanish sweet onion | 1/2 cup chopped hazelnuts ( optional ) | paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Spray a 9x5 inch loaf pan with cooking spray.  Place rice, soup, onion, and nuts in the bowl of a food processor.  Process until rice is combined.  Spread rice mixture evenly into the pan, sprinkle with paprika.  Bake uncovered for 45 - 55 minutes or until bubbling and center is no longer crunchy.

title: Peruvian Halibut in a Bottle (Aji Aji)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice ( or to taste ) | 3 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint | 2 cloves celery, chopped | 4 halibut fillets | 2 cups cherry tomatoes ( halved ) or 2 cups grape tomatoes ( halved ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mint | 1 lime ( cut into wedges )
instructions: Combine 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil and the lime juice in a small bowl.

title: Spinach and Capers in a Tray
ingredients: 1 bunch spinach | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon capers
instructions: Wash spinach thoroughly and dry on paper towels.  Heat a non stick pan or frying pan.  Toast mustard seeds in the pan until they are a light golden color, then remove promptly.  Rinse off and dry spinach on paper towels.  Remove spinach from pan using a slotted spoon.  Place spinach in a serving bowl and pour mustard leaves over it.  Sprinkle capers over.  Serve warm.

title: Chickpea Beef and Steaks
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless lean rump steak | 3 tablespoons oil | 1 cup canned chick-peas, drained | 1/3 cup hot chili sauce | 1/2 cup canned chickpeas, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees.  Trim fat from steak.

instructions: Slice beef about 1/2 inch thick.  Place in freezer bag or in medium bowl.

title: Avocado and Leek Soup

title: Beetroot and Crab in Chocolate-Covered Beef Rolls

instructions: Preheat the oven to 190c.  Heat a large roasting tin on a medium high heat.  Remove from the heat.  Working quickly, put the beetroot in, drizzle on 1 tablespoon of the extra virgin olive oil, and add it all at once.  Fry over a high heat for 4 minutes stirring until the beetroot is just tender.  Spread 1/2 cup of the beef in the centre of the roll.

title: Nepalese Chiles and Hot Rub
ingredients: 2 dozen dried hot red chilies | 1 tablespoon cilantro leaf | 3 tablespoons water | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Wash chilies well to remove outer blackened skin.  Place chilies in a small skillet and place over high heat for about 1 minute.

title: Fresh Herb Oat Biscuit
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried oats, preferably whole wheat | 1/4 cup chopped fresh dill
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f.  Dissolve the oats and dill in water.  Stir into the dry ingredients.  Spread onto a large baking sheet lined with parchment paper.  Bake 12 to 15 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Cauliflower Linguine
ingredients: 1/2 lb linguine | 1/2 lb cauliflower floret
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

title: Garlic Sauce
ingredients: 5 cloves fresh garlic, sliced thin | 1/4 cup raisins | 1 tablespoon sweet sherry | 1/2 teaspoon dried chives | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder

title: Taste for Hot Beef Fajitas

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Coat a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray.  In a shallow bowl, mix together the flour and cake coating. title: Bulgur or Sesame Puffs

instructions: Place cracked wheat in a bowl, stir in 1 teaspoon sesame oil.  Roll bulgur/sesame/sesame seed mixture in sesame oil to coat.  Store in an airtight container.

title: Marinade for Meat Shishitake- Kabobs- OAMC
ingredients: 1 lb meat, of choice ( such as london broil or hormel meat ) | 1 orange, rind of | 1 tablespoon vanilla | 1/2 tablespoon sherry wine
instructions: Wash the meat under cold water.  Remove all particles of fat and membrane with fingernail.  Cut meat into 1 inch cube sized pieces.  Mix all ingredients together and marinade in large shallow dish in refrigerator overnight, marinating overnight if possible.  Place meat in ziplock bag.  Pour all marinade over and seal completely.  Marinade should marinate overnight.  Grill over low to medium heat or broil in oven.  Do not overcook.  If you like you can grill the meat on the oven rack under hot grill for 8 - 10 minutes.  Do not overcook or it will burn.  Note, if you like marinating with other vegetables, i recommend that you brown the vegetables in a skillet for 5 minutes before adding the meat to the pan.  Note, if you want to use beef, substitute pork bones for chicken or turkish bread pieces.

title: Italian Garlic Barley Snack Mix

instructions: In a 2 1/2 cup measuring cup, combine barley, dressing and coriander.  Cover and shake until ingredients are combined.  Store in an airtight container up to 2 months of use.

title: Couscous

title: Sugar Almond Macaroon Cookies

title: Sauerkraut With Star Anise and Bacon
ingredients: 2 pints sauerkraut, washed well | 4 slices aged bacon, cut into chunks | 4 star anise | freshly ground black pepper | 6 leaves iceberg lettuce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°c and place a large roasting tin on top of the heat.  Empty the sauerkraut into a large bowl, ensuring its moisture is almost evaporated.  Leave as much fat or suet stuck to the sides as possible.  Using your hands, lightly crack the star anise into halves, remove this with a rolling pin, or whizz in a pestle and mortar.  Heat a frying pan, add the bacon, and fry until the fat has run out.  Add the sauerkraut and sprinkle generously with pepper.  Cook briefly, then add the star anise, pour the oil back into the pan and pop the bacon pieces into the sauerkraut.  Roast, uncovered, for 45 minutes, checking for the middle of the sauerkraut doesn't need much drying, but it should be.  When the dish has come together, scatter over the lettuce leaves and serve at once.

instructions: Mix egg, panko crumbs and 1/2 cup of vegetable oil.  Shape into a 1 1/2 inch thick patty.  Seal with toothpicks.  Heat oil in skillet.  Fry bread in batches until golden brown on each side.

Random Ingredients: lemonade,self raising flour,spaghetti noodle,sugar snap pea,cod,pea,stewing beef
title: Spicy Noodle & Beef Casserole
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups self raising flour, plus extra for dusting | 2 cups cooked small spaghetti noodles | 600 g stewing beef, cut into 3cm chunks | 2 tablespoons sugar snap peas | 400 g peas in syrup | 1/2 cup lemonade | 1 cup steamed whole british sea salt and black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c combine the flour, noodles, beef, sugar peas in a large bowl.  Whisk together the lemonade and pepper into the lemonade, pour over the casserole and stir to combine.  Spoon the mixture into a lightly oiled oven proof dish.  Put the british sea salt into a deep ovenproof plate and arrange the pea halves around it.  Place it in the oven and bake, uncovered, for around 30 - 40 minutes, or until prawns are cooked, and crusty and starting to brown on top.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk water,rosemary,tomato green chilies,flour,chicken thigh,chocolate chip
title: The Best Chicken Mole Ever - Diabetic Crockpot
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1/2 cup flour | 2 cups simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 3 egg yolks, blended with 1/4 cup water | 12 ounces of chopped canned tomato and green chilies ( with seeds ) | 12 ounces semisweet chocolate chips
instructions: Dredge chicken thighs in flour and brown lightly in large skillet.  Add simply potatoes with onions and all ingredients to crockpot.  Cover and cook on low heat setting until chicken is tender.  Stir and let rest about 5 minutes.  Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Belgian Oatmeal by Sy
ingredients: 1/2 cup belgian-style irish beer ( such as guiness ) | 1 whole star anise
instructions: Place the beer into a small dutch oven over medium heat.  Bring to a simmer, cover, and set aside.  Simmer the star anise in the beer until slightly fragrant, about 30 seconds.  Remove from heat.  Set aside to cool slightly.  Place the star anise in a blender or processor, and process the star anise with as much water as needed to make a fine powder.  Store the oatmeal in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,dill,garlic paste,fennel seed,maraschino cherry,beef chuck
title: Pasta Falscheri
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry rigatoni pasta | 1/4 cup garlic paste | 1 cup shredded italian 3-crust halved corned beef chuck | 2 tablespoons crumbled maraschino cherries | 1 tablespoon crushed fennel seed | 1 tablespoon dill
instructions: Combine pasta, 1/4 cup garlic paste, ground beef, cherries, fennel seeds and dill in a baking dish.  Bake, uncovered, in a 350 degree f oven until bubbly.  Stir, cover, and let stand 45 minutes before serving.  This is a good filling for a fettuccine filled spaghetti, as a sauce for a pasta salad and a side dish that takes only a few calories.

title: Tahini Sauce (Moroccan Pepper Sauce)
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups tahini | 1 3/4 cups vanilla sugar or 1 3/4 cups white sugar | 1 tablespoon turmeric | fresh ground pepper
instructions: Soak the tahini in very hot water until it turns a light brown color, this should take about 10 minutes.  Squeeze as much water out as possible and reserve.  In a medium saucepan, combine all ingredients and whisk well to mix.  Heat, but do not boil, over medium high heat, stirring constantly.  As soon as bubbles form around the sides and a dark amber color appears, remove from heat.  Serve warm over fish, chicken or veggie dishes.

title: Apple Blossom Green
ingredients: 6 granny smith apples ( or other cooking apples ) | 1 bunch spring onion
instructions: Scrub and core the apples.  Scoop out cores, leaving a few pieces of apples surrounding the stalks.  If they look dry, add a little water.  Bring a small, heavy bottomed saucepan to low heat and add the apples.  Leave a good 2 - 3 inches of water in the saucepot.  Cook for 30mts, or until the apples are starting to soften, then leave the pot on the stove, remove apples to a dish with a lid or tin foil.  Use scissors or a knife to scrape off the browned bits from the bottom.  Push the apples through a sieve or a potato masher with a good metal spoon, and discard the skin.  If your saucepan is too dry, add some water.  If you like a creamier apple blossom mixture, mix it in until the liquid is smooth before adding more water.  To serve, arrange the green on a plate, garnish with the chopped spring onion and serve.

title: Pork & Portabella Mushroom Mousse
ingredients: 100 g portabella mushrooms | 400 g country-style pork | 175 ml double cream
instructions: Cut up the sausage of your choice, slice the mushrooms fairly thinly and chop the mushrooms.  Put the pork into an oven proof dish, pour over 200ml of water and leave to simmer in a medium to low oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until cooked.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,vegetable oil peanut,lettuce leaf,serrano pepper,beef sirloin steak,grainy mustard,coconut milk
title: Thai Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh serrano peppers or 2 teaspoons finely chopped canned green chili peppers | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 1 1/2 lbs small blood beef sirloin steaks, all visible fat trimmed but still very rare or 4 to 6 ounces boneless sirloin steaks, cut into 1/2 inch thick slices | 12 large chilled lettuce leaves | 2/3 cup coconut milk | 2 teaspoons grainy dry mustard
instructions: To make the dressing, in a medium bowl whisk together 2 tablespoons of the coconut milk with the mustard and remaining 1 tablespoon coconut oil.  Set aside.  Cook the steak in oil over med high heat about 1 - 3 minutes per side for medium rare or until cooked to desired desired doneness.  Meanwhile, warm grill.  Remove the steak from the pan and slice 1/4 inch thick.  Arrange on a small dinner platter.  Drizzle with dressing and serve.

title: Egg Drop Soup With Quinoa and Potato
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 4 tablespoons egg substitute | 1 large egg substitute | 2 tablespoons drained capers | 2 cans vegetable broth | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 2 cups dry quinoa
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package directions.  While this cooks, in a bowl, mix the egg substitute, capers, and vegetable broth.  Once Quinoa is cooked, stir in the egg substitute mixture, cover and refrigerate.  When the potato dumplings are thawed, scoop them into a large pot.  Add vegetable broth and cayenne, stir gently.  Add in the potatoes.  Cover and heat until potatoes are thoroughly cooked, stirring occasionally.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: jiffy cornbread mix,orange zest,mozzarella cheese,juniper berry
title: Easy Sticky Cornbread
ingredients: 1 package jiffy cornbread mix ( without pudding cubes ) | 1 teaspoon ground juniper berries | 1/2 teaspoon finely grated orange zest | 2 cups grated mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Combine cornbread mix, juniper berries, orange zest and juice in bowl.  Spread half of the cornbread mix in ungreased 2 - 3 qt baking dish.  Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese.  Spread remaining cornbread mix on top.  Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until cornbread is browned and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,spice,self raising flour,beef mince,pork butt roast,salt
title: Gramma Ommig (Pork and Pork Bangers)
ingredients: 3 lbs pork mince, shoulder and neck ( or leg ) | 3 lbs lean pork butt roast, shoulder and neck ( or shoulder ) | 2 medium yellow bell peppers | 12 fluid ounces self raising flour | 1/2 teaspoon spices | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Cut the pork and mince in cubes, removing their skin and excess fat.  Leave the meat in its cubes or chunks.  Wash the meat in the lard and remove the strings if necessary.  Wash the bell peppers and cut into chunks.  Cut the meat into 4 inch lengths.  Set them aside.  Mix the flour with the spices.  Dry the pork on both sides.  Dip each end of the pork in the seasoned flour, coating all sides and the pieces.  Brown the pork.  Place in an oven safe pan.  Cover with foil and bake at 350f degrees for 30 minutes, basting during the last 10 minutes.  Serve with mashed potatoes or steamed vegetables.

Random Ingredients: okra,yellow hominy,chicken bouillon cube,bean sprout,black eyed pea,jumbo shrimp,salmon
title: Seafood and Avgolemono Soup
ingredients: 10 ounces uncooked jumbo shrimp, shelled and deveined | 1 package okra, sliced | 1/2 cup yellow hominy, drained ( yellow or lemon juice can be substituted for the juice ) | 1 can white-style refried beans or ( 16 ounce ) can kidney beans | 10 ounces frozen black-eyed peas | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 package fish-flavored frozen imitation crab-shaped shrimp ( in the shell )
instructions: Place shrimp, okra, and hominy in a 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker.  Top with beans with a pinch of salt and bouillon cube set aside.  Top with shrimp, okra, and lemon juice.  Cover and cook on low 7 to 8 hours.  The shrimp should turn pink and shrimp no longer opaque.

Random Ingredients: colby longhorn cheese,pimiento,sesame oil,lime wedge,lemon,tabasco sauce,kosher salt,egg substitute
title: Lite Mexican Scrambled Eggs
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely shredded colby-longhorn cheese | 2 teaspoons margarine or 2 teaspoons butter | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 12 eggs | 2 tablespoons low-fat prepared egg substitute | 1/3 cup pimiento, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 2 teaspoons fresh lime wedges ( optional )
instructions: In a small nonstick skillet melt margarine or butter over medium heat.  Stir in sesame oil, and add cheese, stirring till cheese is melted.  In a medium bowl, stir eggs, egg substitute, pimiento, tabasco, and lime juice till well mixed and creamy.  Pour cheese egg mixture into cheese mixture, stirring constantly.  Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat, and spray with nonstick cooking spray.  Add egg mixture into skillet.  Cook, stirring often, till eggs are set, 3 to 5 minutes on bottom.  Cover.  Serve immediately.  Makes 10 serves.

title: Roast Chicken With Fruit Salsa Verde
ingredients: 2 roasting chickens, quartered | 1/2 teaspoon lemon peel, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon pepperoni, finely diced | 1 cup vegetable, diced | 1 cup seedless cherry tomatoes | 1 cup papaya, diced | 1 cup peeled banana, sliced | 2 cups mixed greens, diced | 2 tablespoons mustard
instructions: Rub the lemons with the chopped peel.  Season with pepperoni.  Place chicken pieces, fat side down, in a shallow roasting pan and roast in a 350°f oven for 1 hour or till juices run clear.  Remove from oven.  Add vegetables and tomatoes.  Cover tightly with foil.  Place in oven for 30 minutes remove foil, increase oven temp to 400°f.  Remove chicken from pan.  Bake for 5 minutes.  Stir in mustard.  Spoon salsa verde over chicken.  Serve.

title: Tropical Bean Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup apricot jam or 1/2 cup berry fruit jam | 1/2 cup apricot jam or 1/2 cup apricot jam | 1/4 cup tangerine juice | 1 can fava beans, drained | 1 cup cooked lima beans | 1 cup dried apricot, chopped
instructions: Combine jam and juice in a microwave safe bowl.  Microwave for 30 seconds or until smooth.  Stir in reserved fruit.  Toss with the beans, apricots, and sugar.  Cover and refrigerate until serving.

title: Lobster Thermostat for Sushi Party
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb lobster meat or 1 -1 1/2 lb imitation crabmeat, cooked drained and set aside | 6 -8 ounces frozen washed fresh spinach
instructions: Slice all of the meat into 1/4 inch slices.  Spray your kikkoman shaker with pam or line it with cheesecloth.  Put all of the meat slices and spinach in the kikoman shaker.  Close and place on kikkoman oven on medium.  Bake for 20 - 30 minutes or until done and warm.  Watch them carefully for burning.  Serve over prepared korean rolls.  If using imitation crabmeat make sure it is well cooked, it does not get flakey.

title: French Onion and Gruyère Sauteed Cheese
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 8 medium sweet white onions, 1/2-1/4-inch thick, such as walla walla or 8 medium sweet onions, peeled, trimmed, halved lengthwise, layers separated | 1/3 cup pure thai sweet chili sauce ( or to taste ) | 1 lb gruyere, cut into 1/4-inch thick slices
instructions: Heat oil in large skillet over medium low heat until just smoking.  Add onions.

title: Sambhar Masala
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups tomato ketchup | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon turmeric powder | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1/2 teaspoon spices
instructions: Mix all ingredients.  Store in glass jar in fridge.  Use in indian dishes, add fresh chopped vegetables and chill on the side.

title: Scottish Highland Chicken Toast
ingredients: 2 ounces scotch whisky | 8 ounces boneless chicken breasts | 4 ounces sultanas | 1/4 cup of dried bread, toasted
instructions: Cut the chicken into thin slices.  Place the slices in a shallow dish with the whisky, cover and refrigerate for about one hour, turning the chicken a few times.  Grill the chicken until thoroughly browned and cooked through, and sprinkle with the sultanas.  Serve the chicken with a sprinkling of dried bread and whisky sauce.

Random Ingredients: date,rice noodle,sherry,bamboo shoot,chicken stock,extra virgin olive oil,vanilla sugar,almond
title: Vegetable Rice Noodle Soup With Dates, Peanuts, and Almonds
ingredients: 3 ounces rice noodles | 5 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2/3 cup raw peanuts, coarsely chopped | 3 medium dates, cut in half | 1 3/4 cups chicken stock | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 1/2 tablespoon vanilla sugar | 1/2 teaspoon sherry | 1/4 cup sliced almonds, toasted
instructions: Cook the noodles in a pot of boiling water until just done, just firm.  Rinse in cold water.  Drain and set aside.  Heat the olive oil in a stockpot over medium heat.  Stir in the peanuts.  Cook 1 minute.  Stir in the dates and cook a minute, then stir in the stock.  Add the bamboo shoots and cook 2 minutes, then stir in the rice noodles.  Stir in the sherry, bring to a boil, and simmer 5 minutes.  Top with ground almonds and serve.

Random Ingredients: french fry,lemon juice,coriander powder,cumin,aubergine,guacamole,fillet catfish,vidalia onion
title: Crunchy Catfish With Guacamole
ingredients: 1 lb fillet catfish | 1 medium aubergine | 1/2 vidalia onion | 1/2 head fresh coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | shredded lettuce and guacamole, recipe follows
instructions: Cut catfish into serving size pieces.  Trim ends and ends from aubergines.  Using a mandoline, slice around the inside of the aubergines to remove all the pith from the outer layer.  Cut the aubergines in half lengthwise.  Place in a bowl of cold water to cover.  After 45 minutes, rinse well and drain excess water.  Slice the aubergines into 1/4 inch thick slices.  Cut the onion into half moon slices.  Set aside.  Prepare guacamole, in a bowl, combine the ground coriander, cumin and lemon juice.  Cover and store in the refrigerator until ready to use.  Heat a nonstick skillet on a medium high temperature for about 5 to 6 minutes.  Coat pan with nonstick cooking spray.  Place catfish in pan with herb flavored cooking spray.  Cook catfish 6 to 7 minutes per side, until catfish is opaque.

title: Japanese-Style Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lard | 1 tablespoon butter | 1 1/2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 2 cups chicken stock | 4 tablespoons grated asiago cheese | 2 tablespoons bittersweet chocolate, freshly grated
instructions: Melt the chocolate in a double boiler over hot water.  Remove from heat and stir in the lard and liquid smoke until melted.  Pour the heated chocolate into the pan and stir to coat the back of a spoon.  Gradually stir in the stock and the asiago cheese until well blended.  Remove a small amount of sauce to a small bowl.  Stir the chocolate mixture into the sauce until well blended.  Return any remaining sauce to the double boiler and whisk until thickened.

title: Tropical-Style Grilled Pork Chops with Capers and Zucchini
ingredients: 4 boneless pork chops | 1 tablespoon capers | 1/3 cup dark brown sugar | 2 quarts low-sodium broth | 1 can mandarin oranges packed in brine, drained | 2 zucchini, halved lengthwise and cut into quarters
instructions: Trim fat from pork chops, and season with salt and pepper.  Brush capers and brown sugar over pork.  Prepare grill for medium heat.  Place pork chops on grill rack coated with cooking spray.  Cook about 10 minutes per side, or until desired doneness.  Meanwhile, bring beef consomme, mandarin oranges, and zucchini to a boil in a large skillet.  Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer 5 minutes.  Skim off any excess grease.  Serve pork chops over noodles or rice, topped with sauce.

title: A Very Victorian Tasty Cream With Thyme
ingredients: 600 ml whipping cream, whipped | 1 teaspoon dried thyme, crushed | 1 1/2 tablespoons heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 teaspoon dried thyme, crushed | 1 tablespoon heavy whipping cream, whipped
instructions: Dollop the whipped cream into the bottom of a small serving dish or tin with a lid.  Sprinkle thyme on top.  Pour the whipping cream over the surface of the whipped cream.  Cover with plastic wrap.  Refrigerate for an hour or over night.  Stir together the vanilla essence and dried thyme and place on top of the whipped cream as it sets.  Whip the heavy whipped cream until soft peaks form.  Fold it lightly into the whipped cream.  Top the cream with the dried thyme.  Allow to dry until cool, then cover with the cling wrap.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,white button mushroom,anaheim chilies,soymilk,bow tie pasta,dijon mustard,pasta
title: Kaffir Lime Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb bow tie pasta | 1/2 cup soymilk | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 cup cooked kaffir lime leaves, torn into bits | 3 medium dried ancho chilies, stemmed, seeded and broken into 4 wedges, divided | 1 cup white button mushrooms | 1 cup chopped anaheim chilies
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.  Meanwhile, in a small saucepan combine the soy milk and dijon mustard.  Bring to a boil, and reduce heat to low.  Add in half of the kaffir lime leaves and half of the chiles.  Return to a boil, cover and cook for 2 minutes.  Immediately, toss drained pasta, half the green mushrooms, and remaining green chiles into sauce.  Stir.  Serve.

title: Pistachio and Canadian Bacon Biscuits
ingredients: 3 ounces canadian bacon or 3 ounces extra lean bacon, diced | 1 1/2 cups small plum tomatoes or 1 1/2 cups cherry tomatoes, 1/4 to 1/3 cup, halved ( about 8 ounces ) | 1/3 cup roasted pistachios or 1/3 cup chopped unsalted pistachios | 1/2 cup dry sherry wine | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 tablespoon chopped toasted pistachios or 1 tablespoon slivered toasted slivered pistachios
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°.

title: Italian Sausage and Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried pinto beans | 1 lb frzn ziti pasta | yellow mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 3 heads escarole, cut to smaller pieces
instructions: Drain the beans and place in large pot.  Cover the beans with 4 quarts of rapidly boiling water and bring to a simmer over medium heat.  Reduce the heat to low and simmer, partially covered for about 1 - ½ hour.  Meanwhile, drain the pasta and place in serving dish.  Cover with cold water and add to the beans.  While the beans are cooking, place the mustard seeds in a small frying pan over medium low heat.  When they crackle and crackle, add to the pot, along with the fennel and chili flakes.  Cook for about 4 more minutes.  Drain the pasta and add it to the pot.  Toss the pasta and beans with the mustard and mustard seeds and season with salt and pepper if desired.  Serve hot or warm.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno serrano pepper,irish cream,black vinegar,egg yolk,bacon,chicken breast,coconut extract,ricotta cheese
title: Jalapeno Cheese Chicken Breast With Bacon & Ricotta
ingredients: 3 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 2 ounces bacon, chopped | 4 ounces ricotta cheese, drained and slightly broken | 2 egg yolks | 2 tablespoons irish cream | 1 teaspoon coconut extract | 1/4 teaspoon black vinegar | 1 jalapenos or 1 serrano pepper, seeded ( 1/4-1/2 teaspoon serrano )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f.  Place the chicken between two sheets of wax paper on a flat surface, and using a rolling pin, flatten to about an inch thickness.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Place the chicken in a large baking pan.  Cook bacon in a medium nonstick skillet over medium high heat until crispy.  Transfer to paper towels to drain.  Place the garlic, ricotta, egg yolks, cream, coconut extract, and black vinegar in the bowl of an electric mixer, and blend until smooth.  Add the bacon and jalapeño pepper and mix well.  Spoon the mixture over the chicken breasts and smooth the top with an offset spatula.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Bake in the upper third of the oven until meat reaches an internal temperature of 170°f, 15 to 30 minutes for rare, 165°f for medium rare, or 170°f for well done.  Let cool on a wire rack for 25 to 30 minutes, then serve.

title: Gluten Free Mock Danish
ingredients: 1/4 cup vital wheat gluten ( gluten free if available ) | 1/2 cup cashews ( ground flaked wheat gluten, available at health food stores ) or 1/2 cup hazelnuts, roughly chopped ( ground flaked wheat gluten, available at health food stores )
instructions: Put all of the dry ingredients in to a food processor fitted with a metal blade and pulse until the mixture is finely chopped or use the steel blade of a food processor and pulse again until it resembles coarse meal.  Add the cashews and pulse once or twice, scraping down the bowl as needed.  Transfer to a lightly oiled bowl or platter and let sit in a warm spot for 5 minutes or until needed.  Transfer the dough into a well oiled bowl, cover with plastic wrap or parchment paper, and keep at room temperature until ready to use.  Cut the dough into 1x2 inch size pieces and set aside until ready to use.  Preheat oven to 450 degrees.  Use your hands to roughly tear off a golf sized piece of dough about the size of about 1/2 inch.  Use your hands to squeeze handfuls of dough, pressing them firmly and gently together, into approximately 8 pieces.  Lay the sections roughly side by side on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.  Bake for 5 minutes on each side, or until crisp and starting to brown, turning once.  Do not be alarmed with the smell, it really will taste awesome.  They will cook a little bit.  Transfer to a clean dish towel, and stack them in the towel or plastic bag to keep warm.  Serve warm, and keep cool.  Variation, place 2 tablespoons of chopped dry chickpeas in with each ounce of danish dough.  Variation, increase the amount of chickpeas and cashews by 2/3 to 3/4 cup, or to taste, and eliminate them.  Substitute with 1 egg substitute and 2 tablespoon of honey for the honey, or a splash of honey to make a glaze for vanilla flavoring.

title: Yogurt Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white basmati rice | 1 1/2 cups unsalted whole wheat hummus | 1/3 cup low-fat yogurt | 1 2/3 cups drained pickled pineapple chunks | pepper sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil or 2 teaspoons dried basil | 2 teaspoons liquid honey
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions.  Cool completely.  Place rice in fine mesh sieve and rinse under running water for 1 minute, shaking the sieve to remove as much water as possible.  Set aside.  Place hummus in blender.  Cover and process on low until very smooth.  Whisk yogurt in a small bowl.  Stir into hummus.  Blend in drained pineapple and season with pepper sauce, basil or honey.  Cover and chill at least 2 hrs or serve immediately.  This makes 3 cups.  This rice salad is great when topped with a dollop of extra virgin olive oil or lemon yogurt.  Also great topped with other garnishes of your choice.

title: Pomegranate Mushroom, Green Beans and Tomato Salad
ingredients: 1 lb green beans, topped and tailed | 2 green tomatoes, cut into matchsticks ( or use the larger tomatoes ) | 1 pomegranate juice | 1/4 lb white mushroom, sliced | 1/4 cup pine nuts
instructions: Boil the beans in salted water, until tender.  Drain, rinse under cold water, drain well, and set aside.  Place the green beans, tomatoes, pomegranate juice, mushrooms, and pine nuts in a salad bowl, toss well, and serve.

Random Ingredients: hawaiian bread,bread,rice vinegar,mustard seed,rice,cream tartar,cabbage leaf
title: Coleslaw (For Two)
ingredients: 8 -10 cups cabbage leaves | 1/2 head cabbage, shredded | 1 loaf hawaiian bread | 4 slices bread, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons whole grain rice vinegar | 2 teaspoons cream of tartar
instructions: Preheat broiler.  In a large colander, drain the cabbage.  Place cabbage into a large non stick skillet.  Cover and bring to a boil over high heat.  Reduce heat to medium and cook approximately 2 - 3 minutes or until cabbage is completely wilted and slightly limp.  Remove the cabbage with a slotted spoon and spread onto a baking sheet.  Place in a preheated broiler according to usual method.  Bake 10 - 12 minutes, or until slightly crispy.  Allow to cool slightly then cut into 2 inch squares.  To assemble the cabbage rolls, place 1 cup diced cabbage on each piece of bread.  Add a few cubes of hawaiian bread to each, then place 2 tablespoons of the mustard seed on top.  Sprinkle the cubes of hawaiian bread over the mustard seed and crumbled cabbage.  Add 1/4 cup of rice vinegar to each sandwich and spread evenly.  Place the remaining 2 tablespoons of mustard seed and crumbled cabbage over the cabbage.  Dot the top with 1 tablespoon of the rice vinegar and the cream of tartar.  Broil 3 - 4 inches from the heat, or until cheese is bubbly, approximately 1 - 2 minutes.  Allow to cool slightly before removing from the baking sheet.

title: Bacalao (Cod in Cream)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs cod | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 3 tablespoons unsalted butter | 2 cups halved green cabbage ( about 10 cups ) | 2 cups peeled cored cored jicama | 1/4 cup golden raisin | 1/2 cup whipping cream | colored crystal food coloring or orange section
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f.  Place cod in a shallow baking dish.

title: Red Beans and Salami -- Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 lb red kidney beans | 1 lb salami | 5 cups flour | salt and pepper
instructions: Rinse and sort beans and salami, then add them.  You can do this in the crock pot but the crock pot method is so much better.  You can cook all the ingredients in the crock pot, but i prefer to let it go for the long, long cooking time.  It takes several hours or overnight to thicken the sauce, but is okay, as long as there is enough moisture at the bottom to keep it moist and warm.  When adding the flour, you will need to stir it constantly with a whisk so it mixes thoroughly. .  When it is there shouldn't be much clumping, put the lid on and heat the crock pot on low, then stir in the flour and salt and pepper.  The beans and salami should be slightly tender when done.  You can serve it over noodles or by itself or with bread or a nice cheese like sourdough bread in the crock pot.  Variation, you can make your own crockpot cheese flour and bread crumbs by putting the flour and salt in the bowl of a food processor.  The cheese tends to take a while to be really soft and chewy, depending on how thick you want your breadcrumbs to be, but you want a soft, chewy dough.  A blender can be used but i prefer to use a hand held mixer.  Add 1 1/2 cups flour to the crock pot and mix with the hands.  I don't add any more salt and pepper, though.  The next time you will add the salt, pepper, and flour.  I don't put in anything else until i am ready to use, but i like my bread and butter and this is one of the tools i use to make a smooth crumble bread crumb topping for my crockpot.  This will need to be stirred in about 2 - 3 times on low to get the flour taste right.

Random Ingredients: semolina flour,tabasco sauce,bay leaf,sourdough bread,confectioner ' sugar,pizza crust,beef gravy,molasses
title: The Easy Easy Pizza with Dried Beef Gravy
ingredients: 2 lbs cubed sourdough bread ( about 8 or 10 slices ) | 1 can beef gravy | 8 dashes tabasco sauce | 1 can pizza crust, refrigerated | confectioners'sugar, for dusting | 1/2 cup molasses | 1 bay leaf | 1 teaspoon semolina flour
instructions: Preheat the oven broiler.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil or parchment paper, about 7 inches high or slightly smaller.  Place the bread cubes in a large bowl.  Drizzle with olive oil and spread the pieces on the prepared baking sheet.  The slices should not touch the foil and will not absorb any oil.  Use the top of a clean spoon to gently squash the crusts into circles.  Bake for 10 - 15 minutes in a preheated oven until crusts are browned.  When done, remove the bread from the oven.  Top the crust with the gravy, tabasco sauce and desired toppings.  Return to the oven for another 5 - 10 minutes until bubbly and warmed through.  Dust with confectioner's sugar and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: hot red pepper flake,red wine,tamarind paste,walnut half,vegetable stock
title: Tamarind and Walnut Soup
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs walnut halves | 5 cups vegetable stock | 2 ounces tamarind paste | 1 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes | 1 cup dry red wine
instructions: Place the walnuts in a clean, dry pan and roast over low heat, shaking the pan constantly until the nuts have turned a shade darker, which will take 15 minutes.  Do not burn them.  Set them aside to cool.  Place the vegetable stock in a heavy pot, place the nuts in the pot and bring to a boil over medium heat.  Reduce heat to lowest possible heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, just until everything has heated through and most of the liquid has evaporated, about 20 minutes.  Transfer to the bowl or blender and puree until smooth and thick.  Strain through a fine mesh sieve into a heat proof bowl and discard solids.  Stir in the tamarind paste and red pepper flakes. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to very low, and simmer until soup is very thick and syrupy, about 1 - ½ hours.  Stir in the remaining 1 cup water if you like. instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the yogurt, lime juice, and pasta sauce.  Chill in the refrigerator until serving.

title: Cheese Fondue

instructions: The stock is a gallon and the fish is not like a fish head or heads of fish.  So dump the fish head into a large pot and dump in the limeade, miracle whip, salt and wine.  Bring to a boil, cover, reduce to a low simmer and don't eat until you are ready to make this, you will have a soup.  Put in whatever you need and stir well.  Do not drain the chicken.  Put the feta cheese through your fondue grinder or food processor.  Add the bread flour and mix until it is the consistency of course meal.  Add to the fondue pot when fondue is ready to serve.  If you want to do this, just add the cheese mixture to the fondue pot and stir.  Serve over your preferred vegetables and enjoy.

title: Japanese Kabobs on Mushroom
ingredients: 20 -30 small button mushrooms | 15 -30 dried apricots | 4 kiwi fruits | 1 can spaghetti sauce | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 50 -100 g rum or 50 -100 g brandy ( for sweeter flavour use bacardi )
instructions: Place all ingredients except mushrooms, kiwifruit and mushrooms in a large bowl and mix well using a clean spoon.  You can make the kabobs or place the pieces of kabobs in a tray or aluminium foil and place the tray on the tray.  If you are using aluminium foil you need to brush it lightly once or twice throughout to prevent the kabab from sticking.  Wrap the foil around the kabobs so that they look completely sealed.  Cook over a medium heat for approx 15 minutes turning regularly.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,grouper fillet,salt pork,mexican oregano,yellow onion
title: Mexican Gravy
ingredients: 1 lb grouper fillet, about 2-1/2 inches thick, skin on | 1/2 lb yellow onion, slivered | 2 1/4 cups mexican oregano | 3/4 cup soy sauce | 1/2 lb salt pork, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/4 teaspoon salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Cut grouper fillet crosswise into ½ inch thick slices.  Drain fat from cooking grate.  Soak onion slices in 1/2 cup of the liquid from the onion slices, covered, for 20 minutes or until soft tender.  Drain onion slices and place in food processor with grouper.  Pulse until fine.  Place steak and 3/4 cup of the soaking liquid in a large roasting pan.  Add oregano and 2 cups water.  Stir, cover tightly, and roast in preheated oven until it flakes easily with a fork and meat is very tender, about 3 hours.  Check after 3 hours.  Stir every 15 minutes and make sure there is at least 1/4 of liquid in the pan.  Stir in soy sauce.  Remove meat from pan and cover to keep warm.  Return the pan to the oven and continue cooking until meat is cooked to taste, about 30 minutes longer.  Sprinkle salt over meat after it is finished cooking and if desired, remove the pork from the bones and coarsely chop.  Serve over rice.

title: Lascarpone Mushroom Soup (Lazy Friendly)
ingredients: 4 cups mushroom slices ( or other fresh mushrooms ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh sage, or more to taste | 1/3 cup fresh parsley, or more to taste ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 quart chicken stock | 1 package mascarpone | 1/3 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Place mushroom slices, sage, parsley, salt, and chicken stock in a soup pot.

Random Ingredients: ramen noodle,coconut,salt pepper,red wine vinegar,xanthan gum,dark soy sauce,apple cider,chicken bouillon cube
title: Sweet and Sour Barbecue Noodles
ingredients: 1 tablespoon xanthan gum | 5 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 cup dark soy sauce | 1 cup coconut, shredded | 1 apple cider, i use pineapple, unsweetened ( i can also use pineapple lind ) | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar or 1/2 cup rice wine vinegar | salt and pepper | 4 ounces ramen noodles, i used dry
instructions: Mix together xanthan gum in bowl.  Dissolve 5 bouillon cubes in 1 cup dark soy sauce, stir in coconut, cider vinegar and 2/3 cup water.  Stir in sugar and salt and pepper to taste.  Set aside until ready to serve.  You can add additional sugar if needed.

title: Easy Peanut Butter-Peanut Sauce on Nectarines and Grilled Nectarines
ingredients: 2 tablespoons gluten-free flour ( vital gluten ) | 1 teaspoon gluten-free flour ( vital gluten ) | 1/3 cup creamy peanut butter or 1/3 cup natural peanut butter | 1/4 cup red bell pepper, chopped | 1 teaspoon sambal chili paste ( sambal olek ) | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 1 small cucumber, chopped | 1/2 fresh nectarines, chopped ( optional )
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine the flour, chili paste, onion salt and yogurt.  Stir in the peanut butter.  Toss with vegetables and enjoy.

title: Sour Cream Tomato Apple Pizza
ingredients: 15 1/2 ounces crushed tomatoes in tomato sauce | 1 1/2 ounces tomato paste | 2 1/2 ounces active dry yeast | 3 1/2 fluid ounces table cream | 12 medium shallots ( about 6-7 medium ) | 1 small finely chopped red onion, the finely chopped kind not too picky ones, or 1 small finely chopped mild red onion | 1 teaspoon finely chopped red pepper, for the topping
instructions: The recipe says to put in the refrigerator for 10 - 15 minutes in that case.  The oven should be hot enough.  Place all the ingredients in the mixing bowl, one at a time and mix well with a large wooden spoon.  Dough should feel soft to the touch but not hard or cold.  Put the dough onto a floured board, and shape the dough into a round loaf about 15 and 5cm in diameter.  Place it on a pan on medium.  Cover with a slightly damp towel so the dough can rest and rise for about 45m minutes until double in size.  Meanwhile, preheat your oven to 450f/200f/gas grease the baking sheets with a splash of oil or cooking spray, and the tops of the dough.  Place the loaf on the prepared baking sheets and lightly brush the crust with some of the remaining oil or oil.  Bake in the middle of the oven for 10 - 15 minutes, until golden.  Remove from the oven, and leave on a wire rack while you make the topping.  Heat your pan, spray with the remaining oil if you wish and toast the shallots, stirring, just until they turn pale green and just starting to soften, about 5 minutes.  Add the onion and red pepper and cook, stirring, for 1 minute.  Sprinkle over the hot pizza topping, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,mustard,icing sugar,red potato,chili powder,coconut,san marzano tomato
title: Deep-Fried Pizza With Tomatoes, Chillies and Coconut
ingredients: 1/2 pizza crust ( boboli ) | 1 can san marzano tomatoes | 4 red potatoes, sliced | 1/3 cup icing sugar | 1 teaspoon mustard | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon coconut
instructions: Heat up a bit of olive and a little olive oil in a large frying pan, then add the tomato slices in an even layer.  Fry until caramelised.  Remove from the pan and set aside.  Roll out the boboli dough to a thickness of approximately 10 and use it to fry the potato slices.  In a small dish, stir together the icing sugar, mustard, chilli, coconut and the caramelised tomato slices.  Drain the potatoes until all the excess water gone.  Heat your oil in another frying pan, or fry the pizza dough in it.  Once the dough has turned golden brown on both sides, remove it to a warm plate.  Top it with the tomato mixture and garnish with the crispy potato slices.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Cream Cheese and Herbs
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin steak, fat trimmed and trimmed ( 3/4 - 3/8 inches thick ) | 1 packet cream cheese | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 1 -2 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley | chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Place meat on hot grill, fat side up.  Cook 3 minutes on each side.  Turn and cook 5 minutes on other side or until done to your liking and to your desired doneness, internal temperature of the steak should be 1 - 130 degrees celcius for rare.  You may now slice meat thinly, if desired.  Drain excess fat, if any.  Cut into thin slices and mix with fresh herbs.  Note, cooking time does not reflect time for meat to come to room temperature.  Cook time is given for 1 hour or until meat is cooked.  Do not overcook.  Note, the amount of time required does vary depending on the thickness of meat and the cut of meat, which is a personal preference here.  My sister's suggested serving 4 slices or so of meat on a warmed dinner dish.  As soon as the meat is warmed, they are placed under the broiler until browned and bubbly with all ingredients.  Remove onto warm serving plate, leaving broiler on.  Place a few chopped fresh herbs and a pinch of fresh lemon pepper in cheese mixture and mix well.  Spoon over meat and sprinkle with fresh parsley.

title: Roast Pork Tenderloin Fajitas With Raspberry and Romas
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin | 8 raspberries ( frozen )
instructions: The night before, preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Put your freezer bag, a large mixing bowl, and a small pan of water in it.  Remove the entire bag of frozen raspberries.  Put your meat in the pan with your frozen raspberries.  Close and secure the bag and put it into the oven for 1 to 1 1/2 hrs.  Unplug your oven and check your roast for a medium internal temperature.  When the internal temp is 190 degrees f remove it from oven and let it sit for 20 minutes.  It should be slightly falling off the bone with no string.  The internal temperature will reach 220 degrees.  Remove from oven and let it rest for 10 minutes.  Using gloves and a pair of forks, trim off any fat on the meat and then slice it thinly.  Serve on a bed of the riesling, top with a bowl of raspberry and a small spoon of jame on the side.

title: Chiles Stuffed With Chipotle Grated Cheese
ingredients: 2 chipotle chiles | 1 package shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f.  To make a chile inside a glass bowl, remove the stem and seeds.  Wrap them around a small slice of mild cheddar cheese.  Place the cheese slices on a baking sheet.  Bake until the cheese is melted, about 15 minutes.  Remove with a slotted spoon and place on a rack to cool.  When the chipotles have cooled, cut a slit along the side of each one, going down to the chile to remove the seeds and fiber.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,pork shoulder roast,sea salt,wine,pesto sauce,active yeast,ginger garlic paste,nonfat yogurt
title: Easy Shredded Pork Gyros
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs pork shoulder roast | 3 cups nonfat yogurt, divided | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 2 teaspoons unbleached cane sugar or 2 teaspoons sugar | 1/4 cup light salad spiced wine ( such as chardonnay ) | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon active dry yeast
instructions: Cut deep slits on top of roast.  Place in deep microwave safe dish.  Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high power 1 to 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours at 50% power or until internal temperature reaches 175.  Transfer liquid to bowl.  Let cool about 15 minutes.  Slice into thin strips.  Set aside.  For sauce, stir yogurt to loosen browned pieces.  Drain yogurt, squeezing out excess moisture.  Stir in 1/4 cup pesto, sugar, wine, ginger, garlic paste, and yeast.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Heat oven to 375°f bake uncovered about 18 minutes or until crust is golden brown and sauce is bubbly.  Transfer roast to rack and let rest about 10 minutes.  Serve with pork.

instructions: Put the tomato paste in a blender, add 5 1/2 cups of the grapes, blend until smooth.  Pour into ice pop molds.  Add the remaining grapes with their liquid.  Add sumac to the pulp and stir until combined.  Poke holes all over with a fork to serve cold.

instructions: Rinse the turmeric in fresh turmeric and discard it.  Soak the dried mulberries in 2 tbsp water for 20 minutes, then drain completely.  Mix the turmeric, cardamom and sugar together and marinate the mint in this mixture for 2 - 3 hours or overnight.  Bring a large saucepan of cold water to the boil.  Drain the mint and transfer it to a mixing bowl.  Pour the mint over the mint and toss very well.  Place 1 tbsp mint in the centre of a palm log and make a sandwich about 1 1/2 inches thick.  Roll it up over the mint and tie with kitchen string.  Repeat with the rest of the mint.  Cut into quarters and serve at room temperature. instructions: Cook pasta in a pan of boiling water.  Meanwhile, heat oil in an oven proof casserole dish.  Add fennel and cook gently for 3 - 4 minutes or until softened.  Add courgette and cook, stirring, for a further 3 - 4 minutes or until golden.  Drain pasta and serve sprinkled with sesame oil and freshly grated nutmeg.

Note, you can make your own creme de cacao by buying some good brand ice cream.  This will give you more accurate recipe, as the ingredients can vary. title: Spicy Vegetable Toast
ingredients: 2 large eggplants | 2 large yellow squash | 1 large hot chili pepper | 3 -5 peppercorns | 1 tablespoon sugar syrup | 1/2 - 3/4 portabella mushroom
instructions: Slice eggplants lengthwise into quarters lengthwise and discard ends.  Slice up the eggplant into slices 1/8 on the bias and place slices on a platter.  Add peppers to a baking tray sprayed with cooking spray and roast peppers over medium high heat until peppers start to soften add sugar mixture to the hot peppers and stir to blend.  When sugar mixture starts to caramelize, add a couple of handfuls of peppercorns and continue cooking and stirring for approximately 15 minutes until peppers start to soften.  You can also add a little bit of water to help thicken the process.  Dab eggplant once again with a paper towel and then transfer to plate.  If peppercorns stay on the plant, remove stems and seeds from the peppers and discard.  If using mushroom slices, slice slices about 1/4 on the bias, remove stems then slice slices about 1/2 on the bias.  Spread mushroom slices on a large piece of aluminum foil and top with peppers and the sliced eggplant slices.  If using fresh mushrooms, remove stems then slice mushrooms into small wedges and place on top.  You can also toast the bread as in the toasting below.  Enjoy,.

title: Basbousa (Basbousa) - a Semolina Crust for Toasted With Tahini
ingredients: 2 teaspoons tahini, plus more | 2 teaspoons semolina, lightly toasted in an ungreased shallow pan until golden brown
instructions: Note, tahini is best purchased ready to use at room temperature at room temperature as it will darken a bit when you toast it.  Heat the oven to 300°f or 150°f, and line two baking sheets with parchment paper.  Mix the semolina, tahini, and 6 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil in a bowl, and spoon it into a resealable plastic bag.  Tumble the bag with your fingers into a large mound on the lined baking sheets.  Use your thumb and finger to press the semolina into an even 1/4 inch thick disk, and let the semolina dry for 15 minutes to an hour, before sprinkling it with more semolina.  Rinse the pastry under cold water, then transfer it to a pastry bag fitted with a 1/4 inch plain tip, and bash with a rolling pin or your fingers, making sure any crumbs that stick to the surface are pushed into the semolina.  Transfer the semolina to a rimmed baking sheet, and bake at 300f until golden, about 30 minutes.

title: Prunes With Herbs

instructions: Slice the prunes into 1/2 inch slices.  Place in a bowl and cover with vinegar.  Let stand at room temperature until almost all the vinegar is absorbed.  Remove spines of thyme with a spoon or other large spoon.  Place the prunes in a food processor, or chop with a large wooden spoon.  The idea is that the prunes will retain liquid.  Add all the cherries, except the cilantro, to the prunes.  Pulse well, adding more vinegar as needed, until all the cherries are finely chopped and mixed inches.  Add in the cilantro and pulse again briefly.  Transfer to a serving platter, cover and set aside at room temperature for at least 2 hours so that the flavors can develop.  The next day, remove the lid and stir.  Serve warm as a side dish with crackers or other breads.
