ingredients: 4 small fish fillets | saffron strands ( or 1 tablespoon crushed dried saffron ) | 1/2 cup sauerkraut, drained and rinsed | 1 mango, peeled and cut into small pieces
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large frying pan.  Brown the fish in batches over medium high heat.  Put sauerkraut in the center of the fish and spoon sauerkraut onto it.  Place the fried fish on top, sprinkle with saffron strands and grill it until the sauerkraut is heated through and the sauerkraut is lightly browned, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: serrano chilies,burrito flour tortilla,yoghurt,golden syrup,white miso,corn oil
title: Miso Chutney Burritos
ingredients: 1 teaspoon corn oil ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 teaspoon white miso | 16 burrito-size flour tortillas, warmed | chopped serrano chilies, to taste ( optional ) | yoghurt or sour cream, for serving
instructions: Add 1/4 tablespoon of the oil to a skillet over medium heat.  Add the remaining tbsp oil to the skillet.  Reduce the heat to low and add the miso, sugar, sugar or red pepper.  Cook, stirring often, for about 3 minutes.  When the mixture is to your desired consistency, take off the heat and remove the skillet from the heat.  In a bowl, combine the warm melted miso into the warmed skillet.  Add the warm burritos and stir to coat.  Set aside for a few minutes, then sprinkle the top with chopped serrano peppers and the remaining 1/4 tablespoon of miso.

title: Roasted Eggplant (Aubergine) (Sinfully Easy)
ingredients: 1 large eggplant ( approximately 40-50 g ) | 400 g smooth peanut oil or 400 g vegetable oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/400f/gas mark remove the skin from the eggplant and discard.  Slice the eggplant very thinly.  Spread the salt evenly onto a baking tray and place in the oven.  Fry the sliced brussels sprouts in the oil, turning regularly so they brown evenly.  Place them into the oven for 20 - 30 minutes until they are soft and the brussels sprouts start browning.  Cool the brussels sprouts completely.  Allow to cool before storing in airtight jars.  Note, the flavour of this dish depends on whether you want to use a vinegary, acidic, or mildly sweet dish of the same.  If you decide to use a sweet dish, it should have a bit of a kick to it.  Otherwise, you can make this dish gluten free, or just plain.  If using gluten free flour, it might need to be mixed a bit in the oil or water before frying.  Tip, the oil can easily go from the oil to the bottom to the top of the mixture if the acid balance has been in the pan.  Simply use a wooden spoon, as the flavouring can easily mix in the sugar.  To toast the brussels sprouts, heat a frying pan until very hot.  Pour in enough oil, just enough to cover the bottom of the pan and lightly sear all the brussels sprouts.  It should fry fairly quickly, with a slanted surface.  Don't let them overcook, as cooking ceases at this point.  After a minute or so, the brussels sprouts should be crunchy on the outside.

title: Cha Cha -- Curried Cucumbers
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 pinch saffron | 1/2 cup finely chopped cucumber | 1/2 cup coarsely shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 tablespoon raisins ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon dutch-processed cocoa powder
instructions: Combine ketchup, saffron, cucumber, cheese, and raisins in a small bowl.

title: Quick Caramel Cashew Croutons
ingredients: 3/4 cup cashews | 3/4 cup cane sugar | 2 slices white bread, toasted
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350 degrees f.  Blend the cashews and sugar completely together in a food processor or blender.  Spread onto a slice of bread and top with another slice.  Spread each portion into a crouton like a lid.

title: Frozen Celery Ribs
ingredients: 1 bunch celery ribs ( about 3 pounds ) | 2 teaspoons fresh lemon juice
instructions: Cut the celery ribs lengthwise, then crosswise into chunks 1 to 2 inches wide by 1 to 2 inches long.  Place all in a large nonreactive roasting pan or dutch oven.  Cover tightly with aluminum film, then tightly with plastic wrap.  Freeze, preferably overnight, stirring every 5 or 6 hours.  Bring to room temperature before using, or freeze for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: garlic,apricot jam,black pepper,cherry pie filling,sirloin,red onion,chocolate
title: Sugar-Coated Steak With Cherry Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 lb top sirloin, trimmed | 1/2 cup red onion, thinly sliced | 12 ounces fresh apricot jam ( or other flavor jelly ) | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1 box cherry pie filling | 1/3 cup good quality chocolate, grated, melted
instructions: Cut steak into 3/4 inch thick slices across the grain.  Place cut slices on waxed paper or cookie sheet, and sprinkle with onion.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,cake flour,bay scallop,self raising flour,cashew,flour,butter,meat
title: Scallop and Cashew
ingredients: 1 cup raw cashews, slightly salted ( about 2 ounces ) | 4 ounces self raising flour, all purpose | 1 cup cake flour | 1 tablespoon cream or 1 tablespoon coconut milk | 1 bay scallop | 1/2 lb ground meat ( any meat combination ) | 1 ounce butter or 1 ounce margarine, very soft, but not melted | 2 teaspoons caster flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºf.  Grease an 8 inch square tin or a small casserole dish with about half a cup of the coconut milk.  Stir cashews, flour, cake flour, cream or coconut milk, scallops and ground meat into the coconut fat.  Melt the butter or margarine in a frypan with a tablespoon of oil and add the scallop mixture.  Cook, stirring, until the scallop is well browned.  Remove scallop mixture from the pan and stir in the sugar.  Pour mixture into the prepared pan and bake for about 45 minutes until cooked through, brown and crisp on top.  Serve straight from the oven, or transfer to a serving dish, cut in wedges, and serve cold from the pan as a main dish.

title: Beef Pot Roast With the North End
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | 1 tablespoon hot sweet relish
instructions: Place roast in a roasting pan.  Rub meat with sweet relish.  Bake in a preheated 350°f oven about 3 1/2 hours or until desired doneness.

title: Sweet Chilli Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1 tablespoon sweet sweet chili powder ( like sambal olek or thai chilli powder ) | 1 cup pineapple juice | 1/2 baguette, sliced ( or other fresh bread )
instructions: Heat the sweet chilli for about 30 seconds in the microwave.  Tip the chili powder through a sieve, then stir in the pineapple juice.  Heat the grill pan on a high heat.  Spread the sweet chilli mixture on one side of the baguette slices and on the other, place the bread slices on the hot grill.  Serve immediately.

title: Radish and Aioli
ingredients: 1/4 cup prepared aioli hot sauce | 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil | 1 cup thinly sliced radish
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the hot sauce and the basil.  Slice radishes lengthwise.

Random Ingredients: cheddar monterey jack cheese,clear honey,ziti pasta,red cabbage,queso fresco
title: Ziti With Caramelized Queso, Zucchini, Zucchini With Cheese and Honey
ingredients: 2 ziti pasta | 1 head of shredded red cabbage or 1 head of shredded green cabbage, 1 big head | 1/2 red cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup clear honey | 1/2 - 3/4 cup queso fresco, grated, to taste | 1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar monterey jack cheese
instructions: Put zucchini, red cabbage and salt to the side.  Steam until done and cool enough to be able to handle.  When they are, drain well, and spread them out on a greased paper towell.  This will make them easier to work with later in the cooking process.  Bring a large pot of salted water to rolling boil.  Place the pasta in the salted water, and cook until done to your liking.  When the pasta gets to your liking, turn off the heat, and drain the pasta until you are ready to do so.  In a big bowl, mix the zucchini mixture, honey, cheese and cheddar for a final coating of the cheese.  Stir in the cooked drained pasta.  You may need to adjust the amount of butter and honey.  Adjust cheese if necessary to make it melt evenly over the zucchini pasta.  Serve warm but not overly warm.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: mung dal,lasagna noodle,green bean,chicken cutlet,mustard powder,biscuit mix,vanilla sugar,poblano chile
title: Pumpkin-Chicken Lovers'  Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 300 g mung dal | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 2 red anaheim poblano chiles, seeded and diced ( or a few poblano chiles ) | 150 g green beans, trimmed and chopped | 300 g chicken cutlets, cut into chunks | 300 -500 g biscuit mix ( or biscuit mix of your choice minus bicarbonate, cornstarch and flour ) | 1/2 cup biscuit mix ( or biscuit mix of your choice minus bicarbonate ) | 150 g canned green beans, drained and sliced | 1 packet vanilla sugar ( or a few tbs of vanilla extract )
instructions: Place the mung dal, mustard powder, and peplos de mesclun in a large bowl and mix well using your hands.  Place the green beans in another bowl, making sure they are dry before you begin to add them.  Add the cooked mung dal, bacon pieces, beans, and chicken to the bowl.  Gently mix everything together.  Turn the oven on very, very low.  Empty the contents of both bowls into a large casserole dish.  If you notice that there are some chunks of meat in the ingredients, then just push those meat chunks back into the first bowl, don't worry, they will all cook together.  Sprinkle the biscuit mix over the top of the meat mixture.  Next, spread the vanilla sugar over the top of the casserole, making sure it's all covered.  Place the casserole into the oven and put the lid on.  Turn the temperature up to 500°f.  The casserole should take a total of 4 hours, but check after 45 minutes, and if the top hat on top looks getting dry, you need a bit more time.  The noodle should be a bit dry, but slightly moistened.  Remove from the oven and allow to sit on the counter before serving, covered for 10 minutes.  Slice with a serrated knife if it has been in a bag for 15 minutes, and serve the hot biscuits topped with a little cream.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,golden mushroom soup,beef brisket,rose water,tomato
title: Spud Hungarian Beef
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs beef brisket | 1 can condensed golden mushroom soup | 1 can stewed tomatoes | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1/2 cup curry powder | 1/2 teaspoon rose water ( optional ) ( optional )
instructions: Slice brisket across the grain, at least twice.  Place brisket in crock pot.  Add remaining ingredients to crock pot and stir until well mixed.  Cook on high for 3 - 4 hours.  Serve over noodles.  If you are not on low, leave door slightly ajar for last hour and then remove brisket, slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,napa cabbage,noodle,pistachio nut,green chili pepper,chicken bouillon,graham cracker crumb
title: Spicy Noodles With Green Cabbage and Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 cup monterey jack cheese, grated or 1 cup cheddar cheese | 1/2 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 2 cups nappa cabbage ( about 24 leaves ) or 2 cups napa cabbage | 1 can diced green chili peppers ( optional ) | 2 cans sliced pickled hot pimiento-stuffed green chili peppers ( optional ) | 2 packages prepared noodles
instructions: In bowl combine crumbs, cheese, and bouillon.  Set aside.  Trim cabbage of any undesirable pieces and shred with large forks.  Add to cheese mixture.  In separate bowl, rinse chilies and peppers.  Add to cheese mixture.  If using canned chilies, add to mix.  Fill large frypan with boiling water.  Add noodles and cook until tender.  Drain.  Serve sprinkled with cheese mixture.

Random Ingredients: hard egg,wheat flour,idaho potato,oregano,puff pastry,white fish,orange,tortilla
title: Steamed Fish Wraps
ingredients: 1 large whole orange | 1 kg white fish | 1 packet puff pastry | 1/4 kg whole wheat flour | 1/2 kg idaho potato | 2 hard-boiled eggs | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 250 g white fish | 2 -4 tortillas
instructions: Steam the fish in a large bowl until cooked.  Remove fish from bowl and cut into 1/2 inch pieces.  Slice potatoes into 3 inch cubes and place over boiling cold water.  Cook for 1 - 1½ hours.  Squeeze orange and juice then drain to remove excess water.  Place fish, potato, eggs, oregano and salt into a steaming pan.  Steam in covered steaming pans for 15 minutes.  Remove fish from steaming pans and cut into strips and add to the steamed fish.  Top with tortillas and put in a pot of hot water until steam rises.  Remove to a serving plate.

title: Frozen Bean Stew
ingredients: 2 cans garbanzo beans | 1 cup teabags ( white sugar corn flakes ) | 1 can tuna, drained | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon oil
instructions: In 2 quart saucepot, cook garbanzo beans and teabags according to package directions.  Drain, reserving marinade.  Place in 9x13 inch pan and freeze overnight.  Cook tuna according to package directions.  While tuna is cooking, place reserved marinade, water and all remaining ingredients in blender and puree, saving reserved marinade.  Add tuna mixture to pan, and mix well.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Homemade Hot Chocolate
ingredients: 10 ounces bittersweet chocolate | 1 tablespoon oat | 1/4 cup parsley flakes ( to taste )
instructions: Heat a small dry pan over medium heat.  While warming up grate the chocolate into small pieces and pour into the pan.  Stir the chocolate and drizzle over the oat and scatter with parsley flakes.  You may also sprinkle with chocolate chips or nuts of your choice.

title: Spicy Fruit Salsa for Fish and Chips or Winds
ingredients: 2 lbs mixed dried fruit | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Wash and dry fruit.  Remove stems and rinse well.  Soak fruit in water for 5 to 10 minutes or until soft.  Drain and rinse well.  Line a large baking tray with a large baking sheet with oiled plastic wrap.  Place fruit under plastic wrap and flatten slightly with your hands.  Cover with a damp dish towel, or paper towels for 1/2 hour.  Remove from towel and sprinkle fruit with cayenne pepper.  Place on lined baking tray and bake in medium hot oven for about 10 to 15 minutes, or until a toothpick can poke into the center of the fruit.  Serve with your favorite chips, or as a condiment filling for your fish and chips.

title: The Real Chicago-Style Chili Powder
ingredients: 5 tablespoons achiote seeds | 1 whole hot pepper, such as bird's eye, stemmed and minced
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat, and place achiote seeds in the skillet.  Toast the seeds with the achiote until they give off an aroma like a strong aroma.  Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature before grinding.

title: Jalapeno Ginger
ingredients: 1 lb fresh jalapeno ( the kind i buy from asian deli ) | 1 inch gingerroot
instructions: Take pickled jalapenos and slice them in half if they are very thick.  You should have about 15 jalapenos.  If you want a more spicy taste use less ginger if you want it sweeter, just adjust accordingly.  Put all ingredients in a jar, including ginger.  Leave in the fridge for 1 week, shaking the jar frequently as you eat it.  Makes a nice gift, though.

title: Fried Vegetables (Zafrani) Vegan
ingredients: 3 tablespoons vegetable fat, see note | 1/4 lb mixed fresh vegetables, see note | 3 tablespoons grated chocolate
instructions: Heat the vegetable fat in a dry skillet over medium heat until the fat is brown and the vegetables are crisp.  Transfer the pan to a kitchen towel to drain off the fat.  Sprinkle the browned vegetable pieces with a little salt.  Wipe the pan clean.  Return them to low heat and fry the mixed vegetables until they are crisp and tender.  Transfer the vegetables to serving dish and sprinkle with a little grated chocolate.

title: Potato Starch Pancakes
ingredients: 1 lb potato starch | 1 lb ground turkey | 2 lbs ground pork liver | 1 1/2 cups mashed potatoes with chives | 1 1/2 lbs turkey tenderloins, sliced thin | 24 pitted ripe olives, chopped
instructions: Wash the potatoes well.  Drain well.  Coat a non stick pan with cooking spray.  Heat over medium heat when hot and pour a scant ammount of potatoes onto the pan.  With a spoon, break apart the potatoes into 1/8 inch crumbles, coating evenly.  Cook for about a minute or two.  If there are any larger pieces of potato, break them up and toss them in a separate pan.  When all the pieces are mixed together, add the ground turkey and mix well.  Drain the pork livers and liver.  Set aside ½ cup of leftover mashed potatoes for each serving.  Mix together the ground meat mixture with the potatoes and liver.  Wipe the skillet, and set the pancake, in a large non stick pan, until it is about ½” depth.  Use a measuring cup to spoon a few tablespoons of potato mixture into the middle of the pancake.  If they spread a bit, spread them around, again.  Do not push the mixture down and too close to the edges of the pan and create air pockets.  The potatoes will puff up during cooking and eventually cook over the top.  Cook for about 5 minutes, then flip the pancake, so that the two sides cook evenly.  Continue in this way until all the potato crumbles are gone.  When done, remove the pancake to a platter and sprinkle with the diced olives.

Random Ingredients: poppy seed,italian seasoning,kahlua,ketchup,lime juice zest,kefalotiri,stewing beef,baking powder
title: Slow Roasted Sweet and Sour Beef Kielbasa
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs stewing beef ( or lamb ) | 1/2 cup kahlua | 1/2 cup lime juice, fresh | 1/2 cup poppy seed ( optional ) | 3 teaspoons baking powder | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1/4 cup kataifi | 3 kahlua | 1/4 cup lime juice, fresh | 1 teaspoon kataifi, kahlua flavoured sweet and sour mix | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 fresh lime, juice and zest of | 1/4 cup kahlua, sweet and sour mix | 4 ounces grated kefalotiri ( optional )
instructions: Meat, cut meat into chunks, about 2” cubes.  Put meat in crockpot.  Add the remaining ingredients and stir to mix.  Cook at low setting for 6 to 8 hours or high setting for 3 to 4 hours.  For topping, mix all ingredients together.  Cook about 30 minutes, until cooked meat is tender.  Turn meat into serving dish, pour sauce over and let stand overnight in fridge to cool slightly.  Tastes best when chilled, and served with crusty bread like french bread.

Random Ingredients: pie shell,onion soup mix,sherry wine,pine nut
title: Pine Nut Sweet Potato Pie
ingredients: 1 pie shell, unbaked | 2 1/2 cups crushed pineapple with juice | 1 medium onion ( chopped or slice ) | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1/3 cup sherry wine
instructions: Place the pie shell on a cookie sheet.  Arrange pineapple and onion slices in each pie shell.  Mix onion soup mix and sherry and pour over top of pie.  Sprinkle with nutmeg.  Bake at 425 for 45 minutes.

title: Mock Jaffle
ingredients: 2 cups plain low-fat yogurt, not lowfat free | 1/3 cup finely chopped celery | 1/3 cup bulgur, dry | 2 slices rye bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Set up 2 large disposable aluminum foil pans.  Combine yogurt, celery, bulgur, & bread together in a bowl.  Spoon 1/3 cup yogurt mixture into each pan.  Place pans in the oven & bake until bubbly, about 15 minutes, or until jaffles are heated throughout.

title: Mexican Spinach and Apple Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon crisco shortening, melted | 2 cups thinly sliced apples | 1 package thawed drained spinach | 1/3 cup sour cream | 4 tablespoons guacamole | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon sesame seeds ( optional )
instructions: Heat shortening in a small skillet over medium high heat.  Add apples, sprinkle with salt, and cook until tender crisp.  Transfer to a serving plate and cool to room temperature.  Toss spinach with crisco.  Cool to room temperature.  Mix sour cream, guacamole, and yogurt in blender until smooth.

title: Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs gruyere cheese or 1 1/2 lbs other aged sharp cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons coarsely chopped walnuts (, lightly toasted ) | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 tablespoons granulated sugar | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 tablespoon cold water
instructions: In a small bowl, combine cheese, nuts, cardamom and sugar.  Sprinkle cornstarch over mixture and mix quickly until dissolved.  Slowly stir in water.  Melt cheese sauce over low heat in 4 1/2 qt saucepan.  Do this at least a couple of hours before serving.  If fondue becomes too thick, gradually stir in a little milk.  Serve with brown or pumpernickel bread.

title: Mock Cottage Fritters
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 tablespoon white flour | 1 tablespoon red leicester cheese, grated | 1/3 cup roasted peanuts, finely chopped | 2 cups mexicorn, drained
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a small pan then stir in the flour.  Cook, stirring, for 1 minute.  Add the grated cheese, then the peanuts and bring to the boil for 1 minute.  Mix in the corn, increase the heat and boil for 1 - 2 minutes.  Drain well and serve at once or cool and chill.

title: Simple Beef Steak and Tomatoes
ingredients: 500 g steak ( steak or prime rib ) | 500 g cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 cup mixed dried fruit
instructions: Heat up grill to high.  Trim all visible fat from steak.  Brush well on all sides with glaze, grill for about 5 or 6 minutes.  Turn over and cook for another couple of minutes.  Transfer to a plate, tent with foil, and let rest.  Toss tomatoes, mixed fruit and meat together with cooked steak.  Serve straight away w.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,beet,chunky salsa,jeera powder,cherry tomato
title: Chunky Beet Salsa
ingredients: 1 large beet, medium ( raw work best ) | 1 yellow bell pepper, small ( or any of your desired colors ) | 2 medium cherry tomatoes | 1 tablespoon kesuri powder ( indian spices ( optional to taste ) | 1 cup chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons jeera powder ( optional to taste )
instructions: Wash and peel the beet and dice up into small bite size cubes.  Chop the bell pepper or any combination of you like and place them in a bowl with tomatoes, kesuri, and chicked pepper mix to coat thoroughly.  Sprinkle the kesuri or the masala powders over the beet mixture and stir to combine.  Enjoy.

title: Taco Dip Mix II
ingredients: 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup cocoa powder
instructions: Dip your biscuits into the cocoa powder then roll in the taco seasoning mix.  Chill and enjoy.

title: Alfredo Pizza - Yummy  With Lentils and Celery
ingredients: 1 can lentils | 4 stalks celery, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 lb pork or 1 lb sausage | 2 tablespoons lite olive oil | 3 tablespoons dry sherry | 12 ounces velveeta cheese
instructions: Drain lentils, reserving liquid into a saucepan in a separate pan heat olive oil, and sauté celery and sausage until celery is crisp remove sausage mixture from pan, and set aside in the other frying pan add lentils, sherry and reserved cooking liquid and mix until the lentils are coated.  Heat oven to 350 degrees.  Roll out dough to about 15 in circle.  Stretch a bit to fit your pizza pan.  Spread lentil mixture on the dough and then put about 2 tablespoons of filling on top of that and spread out to cover the dish.  Cut cheese into small cubes and arrange randomly around the lentil and cheese.  Bake for 20 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

title: Pepperoni and Pasta
ingredients: 350 g shell pasta, small size | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 3 -4 slices pepperoni, chopped | 1/4 cup parsley ( fresh ) | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed | 1 teaspoon wheat bran, crushed
instructions: Boil pasta until al dente.  Drain.  Place drained pasta in medium sized bowl.  Toss with the cornflour, pepperoni, parmesan, herbs, cardamon and wheat bran.

title: Crispy Tuna Ceviche
ingredients: 6 cans tuna packed in oil, not drained | 4 tablespoons capers | 1 bunch fresh cilantro | 2 cups flaked coconut | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1/2 lb linguine
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together all ingredients except linguine.  Cover and leave in fridge for several hours.  Cook linguine, drain and reserve pasta water.  Add remaining ingredients to the seafood.  Toss to coat.  Put into a 9x13 pan and bake at 400 degrees for 35 - 45 minutes or until golden brown.  Serve warm.

title: Dried Chicken Stuffed With Dates and Pine Nuts
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts or 4 chicken thighs, trimmed | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar | 12 dates, chopped | 1/2 cup pine nuts, toasted | 1/4 cup fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Place the chicken between sheets of plastic wrap and pound to 1/8 inch thickness.  Spread each chicken breast with about 1 tablespoon of the vinegar.  Arrange a few pieces of dates on the chicken and roll, tucking the ends in to completely encase the chicken.  Place in a glass baking dish, cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 2 to 6 hours.  Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Remove the chicken from the marinade and arrange in a single layer across the chicken.  Sprinkle with the pine nuts and parsley.  Bake for 40 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the pine nuts are golden.

Random Ingredients: penne,jalapeno juice,pearl barley,sherry wine vinegar,raspberry,yellow mustard
title: Jalapeno Mustard & Vinegar Barley Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb penne ( dry weight is okay ) | 1/2 cup pickled jalapeno juice | 1/4 cup pearl barley | 1/4 cup prepared yellow mustard ( we use coleman's ) | 4 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1/4 cup frozen raspberries
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions for al dente.  Add the jalapeno juice and barley and toss throughly.  Set aside to cool for 10 minutes and stir in mustard.  Add vinegar and raspberries stir gently.  Season to your taste by adding salt/pepper flakes if necessary.  Drain pasta and place back in the bowl.  Gently toss throughly.  Serve warm or slightly warm.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,flat leaf parsley,corn kernel,msg,yellow pea,bailey irish cream,extra beef
title: Pea and Beef Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs yellow split peas | 1 lb extra lean ground beef or 1 lb ground turkey | 1 teaspoon msg | 10 ounces cream cheese or 10 ounces neufchatel cheese | 1/2 cup fresh flat leaf parsley, minced | 1/4 cup baileys irish cream | 3/4 cup corn kernel
instructions: To clean peas, place them in a large saucepan or dutch oven with a generous pinch of salt and water to cover.  Bring to a boil over medium heat, reduce heat, cover and simmer for one hour.  Drain, rinse under cold water and drain again.  Set aside 1 cup of the peas for garnish and reserve the rest for garnish.  To make meatballs, mix the meat, cheese, parsley, cream and peas in a bowl until well blended.  Place the peas into a greased 7 x11 baking dish.  Cover with foil and bake at 350°f for 25 minutes.  Bake for 10 minutes longer.  Remove foil and sprinkle reserved peas over top.  Return to oven and bake for 10 more minutes or until heated through and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,yellow onion,pine nut,walnut,tomato paste,butterscotch chip,beef tenderloin,corn syrup
title: Beef Tenderloin With Pecans and Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin | 1/4 cup tomato juice | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1/4 cup walnuts, toasted | 1/2 cup pine nuts, toasted | 1/4 cup butterscotch chips, melted
instructions: To make a meat tenderloin, rub salt onto the tenderloin then slice into 1/4 slices.  Whisk together tomato juice, corn syrup, and tomato paste until blended, cover, and refrigerate overnight.  Bring crockpot ingredients to a simmer in a large skillet over medium high heat, stirring continuously.  Remove lid, increase to medium high, and cook 1 minute more.  Remove meat from crockpot and drain, reserving liquid in skillet.  Scoop out and discard fat in skillet.  Slice meat into thin strips.  Stir in walnuts and pine nuts before serving.

title: Truffle-Simmered Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles, broken into 3/4-inch pieces ( about 24 ) | 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese | 2 packages sultanas | 2 jalapeno peppers, sliced and seeded
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees.  Grease a 6x8 inch baking dish.  Arrange the uncooked, broken noodles in a single layer on a baking sheet.  Top evenly with the monterey jack cheese, sultanas, sliced jalapeno peppers, etc.  Bake, covered, for 30 minutes.  Uncover, increase the oven temperature to 400 degrees, and bake uncovered for 30 more minutes.

title: No Salt Added Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 4 tablespoons no-added-salt tomato paste | 1 medium purple onion | 1 tablespoon minced fresh chives | 2 tablespoons honey | 1/2 tablespoon basil or 1/2 tablespoon oregano
instructions: Using a small saucepan saute onion slowly until soft, add in the tomato paste and simmer for about 5 minutes.  Add in the rest of the ingredients and simmer for about an hour stirring occassionally to scrape the bottom of the pan.

title: Flounder Milanese
ingredients: 8 ounces flounder fillets | 1 cup low-fat greek yogurt | 3/4 cup dry marsala wine, preferably sweet
instructions: Preheat the broiler.  Coat a 15x10x3 inch baking pan with cooking spray.  Place fillets on sheet of plastic wrap, and pound lightly with a mallet to 1/4 inch thick.  Place fillets in pan, and cut around edge of fillets until they are 2 inches wide, then cut crosswise into about 8 slices, or more if needed.  Put yogurt in container of a food processor, and process until just smooth.  Transfer yogurt to serving dish.  Garnish yogurt with marsala, and serve immediately.

title: Quick and Easy Prawns & Banana Peppers
ingredients: 200 g raw prawns | 1 ripe banana pepper | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 cup fresh fruit
instructions: Peel and cut the banana pepper in half.  Boil the water.  Drain the prawns, remove the shells and then cut the prawns in bite size lengths.  Take half a cup and put in blender and blend it to a smooth liquid.  Add tomato sauce and the chopped banana peppers.  Stir the prawns and banana peepers into the sauce until they are coated in the tomato sauce.  Serve immediately.

title: Raspberry Chipotle Beer
ingredients: 2 gallons white beer | 1 bunch fresh raspberry | 1 bunch fresh raspberries | 2 chipotle chiles in adobo
instructions: Pour beer into a heavy large pot, and bring to a simmer.  Add fresh raspberries.  Add chipoltes in adobo, remove from heat, and strain into a jar.  Cover, seal, and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Melon & Maple Candies
ingredients: 1 kg cantaloupe ( about 1 large melon ) | 1/4 cup maple syrup, warmed
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients in a medium size plastic tray.  Refrigerate for one hour.  Remove from the tray and cut into fingers.  Store, covered with a damp cloth, in a glass or plastic container.  To serve.

Random Ingredients: lemongrass,cheddar cheese,pita bread,kielbasa,rice wine,oregano leaf,salad oil,serrano chilies
title: Kielbasa Wrapped in Green Olives
ingredients: 2 serrano chilies, stems and seeds removed | 1 1/2 lbs kielbasa, sliced or 2 2/3 lbs chinese chinese sausages, sliced into 1/2-inch/3/4-inch pieces | 1 tablespoon salad oil | 3 tablespoons salad oil | 1/2 cup rice wine or 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1 tablespoon lemongrass, minced or 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest | 1/2 teaspoon oregano leaves ( or 1/2 teaspoon dried ) | shredded cheddar cheese or shredded munster cheese | jumbo pita bread, halved up
instructions: In a blender or mini chopper, finely chop 2 serrano chiles and 1/4 teaspoon lemon peel.  Set aside.  Remove kielbasa from package and split into 4 or 6 equal pieces.  In large, deep skillet, heat 1 1/2 tablespoons salad oil over medium high heat.  Add 1/2 sausage and chile mixture.

title: Korean Country Style Chicken (Galbi Jjim)
ingredients: 1 whole chickens | 1 -2 cup hot cooked rice ( korean jangjangjang )
instructions: Preparation, rinse and dry the whole chickens.  Sprinkle them with salt and leave it overnight in a cool location.  Rinse, wash and dry the chicken.  The inside will be coated with salt and water.  Cut the breast from its joints and discard the dark skin from each breast.  Cut the thigh from the shoulders just below the joints.  Cut off any remaining fat and discard.  Cut the chicken breast into small, 1 inch squares.  Transfer the chicken into a container and let rest for 20 to 30 minutes.  Slice out the neck, feet, and remaining thighs into 1 inch squares.  In some places, there is an excess of bone, so it can stand without cooking the chicken completely.  Fill the empty chicken stock pot used to boil the chicken with the chicken.  Add a bit of water to cover the chicken and then bring to a boil.  Reduce the heat to a simmer and pour the chicken into the simmering broth until the rice is cooked.  If the broth is too thick, reduce it up to 1/4 cup of water.  After 20 minutes, add the rice.  If not, cook until it reaches the desired thickness, then stir until it reaches your desired thickness.  Continue cooking until the chicken is tender and the liquid has reduced.

instructions: For sauce, heat 1/4 cup of honey mustard and 1/4 cup of dry white wine in a skillet over medium heat.  Stir in orange peel and cook until reduced to about 1 tablespoon, stirring constantly.  Remove skillet from heat.

title: Easy French Fried Olives
ingredients: 20 olives, washed and dried, i like oak ( if not available, use pitt of salted butter, 1 tablespoon per olive, cut in halves or thirds, if using ) | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules
instructions: Place a frying pan on your stove top or a very large pan with fairly high sides.  Place a tablespoon of olive oil in a dish and add the chicken bouillon/water mix.  Stir and cover the frying pan, simmering for about 15 minutes, shaking half way through the cooking time.  You really want to keep the water level about 1/3 of the way up the frying pan or you might need a little more water to keep going.  The water will help keep your fried olives from sticking.  At this point, i remove a few pieces of olives with a slotted spoon and place them in a bowl, reserving the rest to add after next when you have fried them.  When the water is boiling, cover the frying pan for about 5 minutes so the olives will cook as soon as they are cool enough to handle.  Place the fried olives back into the pan and remove from the heat.  You want the olives to be warmed by the time your next step is finished or else they will not fry.  You know how to fry them but don't over cook them if they can.  When you are done, remove and allow to cool slightly then stuff in your favourite olives.  Enjoy.

title: Slow-Cooked New Potatoes & Chicken

instructions: Place potatoes in a slow cooker.  Cut london broil beef in half with the bone and with bone removed with the thin fat layer on the surface. Cook on high for 4 - 5 hours or until potatoes are tender, but are not mushy.  Remove lid, and stir again.  Serve as a gravy with bread or cooked greens.

Drain pork meat, return juices to pan and add corn.  Simmer for 20 minutes.  This can then be garnished with jalapeno, shredded cheese and/or guacamole.  My sister and i have elected to only serve this over tortillas and it turned out great for me.  Enjoy.

title: Tartiflette (Mustard Seed and Onion Spread)

instructions: Grind 1 tablespoon of mustard seeds into a coarse, fine powder using your fingertips.  Peel and slice the onions.  Place the grated seeds in a medium frying pan over moderate heat. title: Basic Italian Zucchini Fritters
ingredients: 2 zucchinis, quartered crosswise, unpeeled | 2 cups cake flour, plus extra for dusting
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f.  Place the zucchini in a large bowl.  Use your hands to squeeze and scrape apart the zucchini.  Cut off the ends, then using 2 1/2 slices, squeeze 1/2 slices under running water and divide the contents between the two zucchini halves.  Set the remaining 3 1/2 slices aside.  Place 2 cups cake flour in a clean and dry bowl and stir together with a wooden spoon or your fingertips, until combined, about 3 minutes.  Working with 2 zucchini at a time, with both hands, roll the mixture into small 1 1/2 inch diameter balls.  Arrange 1 ball on a sheet of lightly oiled parchment paper and gently press the center of the dough away from you with your fingertips.  Repeat with the remaining two balls of dough.  Dust each lightly with flour and place on a lightly floured piece of parchment paper.  Working with one zucchini at a time, coat the dough with flour.  Repeat until you have used up all the zucchini.  Sprinkle the flour on the zucchini and roll them in the flour.  Working with one one zucchini at a time, roll the patties in the flour.  Working with 1/2 at a time, place the patties on the parchment paper, about 1 inch apart.  Bake in the hot oven for 20 minutes, or until golden brown on the top and the zucchini are tender.  Carefully transfer the pan to a wire rack and let cool a few minutes.  Cut into thin slices and serve.  Note, the recipe also says to place your zucchini in paper towels or plastic wrap while the zucchini are still warm until they are all cool.  That's like, i've taken a zucchini, and put them in a tea towel with a little water so that both of them are cold, then layered it on the parchment paper, and with a wet cloth or paper towel under it to get rid of the moisture, then wiped very dry.

title: Vanilla Granita

title: Fried Dumplings (Tisali)

title: Ema's Indian Style Cabbage and Leek Biscuits
ingredients: 2 large leeks, sliced ( wash well to remove a 'head'of the leek too ) | 1 head cabbage, cut into big pieces | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper powder ( to taste ) | 1/8 teaspoon black mustard seeds ( to taste ) | 8 teaspoons all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons masa harina | 1 tablespoon white pepper powder ( to taste ) | 4 teaspoons lemongrass ( powder with inner vegetables ) | 1 dash allspice
instructions: Place the leek and cabbage pieces in a large pot with a cup of water on high heat.  Once the water reaches boiling, cover and allow to boil until the cabbage has lost all of its color and most of the water is gone, about 20 minutes.  Remove the lid and allow the water to boil down and get rid of the vegetables.  In a separate pot mix together pepper power, mustard seed and flour.  Add the masa harina gradually, stirring after each addition.  This step is crucial because if you are cooking all ingredients at the same time, the biscuit will burn and the fat will separate from the masa.  Once you are cooked your masa mixture is ready, strain and reserve.  Once the cabbage has cooled, place some of the water and boiled mixture on the cabbage and mix well.  Add some of the lemongrass powder now.  Mix well until you have a fairly uniform mixture.  If you are using all the above listed ingredients and are using less cabbage than you can buy at the grocery store, you may need a little more flour.  Roll with your hands to form a ball, then flatten into about a thin layer on a greased cookie sheet.  You may have to work with a bit of flour if the mixture is too cold.  Bake at 350°f for about 15 minutes, or until lightly browned.  Allow to cool, then cut into small squares.  Serve warm with butter mixed with your favorite indian side dish dishes.  Note, if you do not have a bread machine, a loaf pan or cookie cutter would be best for this recipe.  Variation, you can use bread dough, but be sure to refrigerate dough before baking so it has a mellower texture.  Use a medium to large bowl and flour mixture.  Then combine flour mixture and masa harina using a fork or hands.  Add some of the lemongrass powder.  You can also omit this step, if you are using a food processor.  Note, if you want biscuits with finer texture, you can roll them into small balls, using your hands.  Add more flour if needed to make sure the dough is well floured.  It is important to knead them for the full 10 - 15 minutes.  This helps the dough not to stick to your fingers, and prevents them from sticking to your hands.  You will also need to do a sample test for saltiness before adding more salt because your sweet tooth is sour, but if desired, it can all be adjusted to taste.
