title: Veggie Quesadillas - Zwt-8
ingredients: 1 teaspoon five-cheese pasta sauce | 1/4 cup dry breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1/4 teaspoon black cardamom pod | 1/4 teaspoon crushed dried beans ( or fresh ) | 2/3 lb tomatoes, seeded and diced ( about 8-16 ounces ) | 4 flour tortillas or 4 corn tortillas | 2 cups shredded four cheese pasta sauce
instructions: Heat half the sauce in a small skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly to loosen bits of tomato.  As soon as tomatoes are darkened, add remaining sauce and bring to boil.  Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.  Remove from heat and set aside.  Coat a large nonstick griddle with cooking spray and set over medium high heat.  Toast the tortillas until just softened.  Brush with remaining sauce and spread on warm griddle surface.  Top with tomato mixture and sprinkle with cheese.  Cook 1 - 2 minutes on each side until cheese just melted.  Cut into 4 wedges and serve.

Random Ingredients: italian flat leaf parsley,half cream,hot italian sausage,vanilla wafer cooky,puff pastry,salad oil
title: Sausage & Nut Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb italian sausage ( sweet or hot ) | 1 dozen hot italian sausage ( sliced very thin ) | 1 lb puff pastry ( thawed ) | 1 box vanilla wafer cookies | 8 tablespoons salad oil | 1 cup half-and-half cream
instructions: Brown sausage in large pan.  Drain off excess fat.  Cut italian sausage into bite sized chunks & set aside place each sausage in its own paper towel to remove the majority blood.  Sprinkle each sausage with paprika, italian sausage fat & paprika.  Roll pastry out to about 1/8 inch thickness & cut into 4 rectangular circles.  Place on cookie sheet & set as your work surface.  Fill each circle w/the sausage meat.  Brush each dough w/oil & set aside.  Roll out a second sheet dough using the first sheet dough to about 1/8 in.  Thick, then turn to the other side & brush both edges w/oil.  Repeat till all circles are gone.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes or until golden brown.  Add the 2 cups of half & half cream to the sausage mixture& stir well.  When golden, pour into a plastic bag & allow the sausage mixture to cool completely before cutting and serving to serve with your meal.  Also, these can be frozen for up to 1 month so you can just pop them into a ziplock bag & put it in the freezer for up to 3 months.

title: Chayote Dip (Chayote Dip)
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 chayotes, peeled and cut into chunks, removing seeds and stalks | 1 teaspoon mixed herbs ( try chives ) | 4 tablespoons corn oil, as needed
instructions: Place the chayote chunks in a small pot.  Add water to cover and bring to a full rolling boil over medium heat.  As soon as steam starts to rise, reduce heat to a low simmer and cook until chayote is tender but still a bit mushy, about 15 min.  Drain and discard the water that has cooked out through the chayote.  Add a little bit of water if necessary.  While chayote mixture is still chunky, warm oil in frying pan until hot.  When oil is hot, add chayote and cook, stirring occasionally, for about 3 minute.  Add a bit of water if necessary.  Taste and adjust seasoning.  Serve hot.  Serve chayote dip with tortilla chips.

title: Norwegian Pork
ingredients: salt | 4 lbs pork tenderloin, trimmed and cut into 1 in slices | 4 eggs, lightly beaten
instructions: Place cut pork slices between sheets of waxed paper and pound into 1/4 slices.  Place two eggs on top of each.  Cover with more waxed paper.  Sprinkle with salt.  Let stand 30 minutes.  Combine remaining 2 eggs and remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt with 1/2 cup water.  Pour egg mixture into a well in center of each slice and turn egg side up.  Arrange pork over egg layer.  Cover with waxed paper.  With a meat mallet or rolling pin, press down with flat of mallet to flatten pork.  Turn slice over.  Repeat with remaining slices.  Lightly salt if desired.  Dip slices into egg mixture, coating both sides of pork.  Set aside on paper towels.  Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours or up to 2 days.  To cook, place pan over medium high heat and bring to heat.  Add pork.  Cook until well browned, about 10 minutes per pound.  Transfer to a baking sheet, cover loosely with foil and continue cooking in oven 20 minutes per pound until cooked through.  Serve with krautts or potatoes.

title: Chicken and Prail
ingredients: 2 whole chickens breast meat, cut into pieces | 4 pieces quail, gutted and chopped, or more to taste | 1 pound chopped asparagus, trimmed
instructions: Place chicken pieces in the center of a square of reen's wrap heavy duty aluminum foil.  Place chopped asparagus on top of chicken.  Sprinkle on about a quarter teaspoon of the perforated perille over everything.  Fold the sides over the asparagus so as not to lose it.  Fold the foil over the asparagus to make a package.  Seal the edges by sewing with scissors.  Place on a solid sheet of aluminum foil, and fold the edges under to form a package.  Chill to soften any air pockets if desired.  The longer this sets the saltier it will be.  After chilling, place a double layer of plastic wrap over the package, and place on a flat surface.  Slice open the package and check for moisture.  You should remove the pouch when all water drips out, not dry.  Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,brown mustard seed,tart apple,new potato,white flour
title: Tart Apples-Potato Chips
ingredients: 200 g fresh tart apples, peeled | 100 g new potatoes | 1 tablespoon brown mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon white flour, for coating | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh tomato with green chilies
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees celsius.  Core the apples and potatoes and slice roughly into 4 slices.  Place the apples and potatoes in a single layer on a large tray, or on a plate, and coat with mustard seeds.  Pour over 100ml of water and microwave on high power for 15 - 20 seconds.  Cover lightly with a piece of aluminum foil and microwave on high power for 8 minutes, stirring twice with a fork.  Remove from oven and scatter tomatoes over the top.  Return to oven for another 5 minutes to crisp up the potatoes and tomatoes.  Serve immediately.

title: Aarsi’s Ultimate Spiced Peanut-Okra and Vegetable Lovers' Bread for Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 cup frozen baby peas ( defrosted if fresh ) | 12 ounces frozen okra | 3 tablespoons peanut oil ( extra virgin ) | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 1 teaspoon fenugreek ( optional ) | 4 ounces french bread, cut diagonally into 8 wedges | 7 ounces frozen baby peas
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler.  Line a broiler pan with aluminum foil.  Put frozen peas, okra, and frozen veggies in a large bowl.  Pour peanut oil over veggies.  Sprinkle in cardamom and fenugreek.  Transfer veggies to pan.  Place 2 bread wedges on each of your serving plates.  Spoon vegetables into bowls.  Serve immediately.

title: Pesto Yogurt Sauce - Easy!
ingredients: 1 tablespoon prepared pesto sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons skim-milk yogurt ( i've used plain yogurt as well )
instructions: Mix together well and store in fridge up to 2 month.  Tip, make sure to mix the yogurt before each use and stir it constantly in the final yogurt, to make sure all yogurt is absorbed.  Note, if you prefer fresh garlic, omit the garlic.  It helps to get the flavor of the garlic through the yogurt and makes for a nice garlic flavor that mellow in flavour.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,broccoli floret,peanut,hungarian paprika,wheat flour,chicken bouillon,avocado,great northern bean
title: Quick and Easy White Bean-Avocado Salad
ingredients: 1 large avocado - peeled, pitted and diced | 1 can great northern beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup chopped fresh broccoli florets | 1/2 cup chopped peanuts | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 teaspoon hungarian paprika | 1/4 teaspoon chicken bouillon
instructions: Mash avocado with a fork in a bowl.  Add the beans, broccoli, and peanuts.  Whisk together the flour, baking soda, paprika, and bouillon until well blended.  Pour the mixture into a bowl, and let it sit for 10 minutes.  Gently fold the flour mixture into the avocado mixture.

Random Ingredients: beef gravy,great northern bean,cream chicken soup
title: Quick and Easy White Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can great northern bean | 1 package beef gravy or ( 8 ounce ) package vegetarian gravy
instructions: In a 2 - 3 quart casserole dish, layer soup, beans and gravy.  Cover with foil.  Bake at 350°f for 40 - 50 minutes.

title: Broccoli Con Queso
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs broccoli florets | 3 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 ounce parmigiano-reggiano cheese, shredded ( optional )
instructions: Rinse the broccoli florets, then place in a saucepan with water to cover.  Bring to a boil, and immediately reduce the heat to a simmer.  Simmer covered over very low heat until just tender, about 5 minutes.  Drain the broccoli florets, then cut them into 1/2 inch wide wedges.  Heat the sherry in a heavy medium skillet over moderate heat, then cook the parmigiano cheese, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute.  Add the broccoli wedges and cook, stirring, until coated with the sherry, 3 to 4 minutes.  Serve hot.

title: Holly's Spaghetti With Seafood
ingredients: 1 lb medium pasta, uncooked | 1 can unsweetened coconut milk ( 398 ml ) | 1/3 cup crabmeat, finely chopped ( about 1 cup ) | 1/4 cup yellow pepper, minced | 1/4 cup lemon zest, finely grated ( from about 1 lemon ) | 1 -2 teaspoon fresh celtic sea salt, to taste
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until just tender but still firm to the bite, stirring occasionally, but don't let it dry out.  Meanwhile in a 3 - 4 quart saucepan, combine the coconut milk, crab meat, yellow pepper, and zest.  Bring to a boil.

title: The Best Milk of the Dead
ingredients: 4 cups milk | 1 pinch of ground cardamom pod ( optional )
instructions: Put the cardamom pods in a heavy bottomed pan with the milk.  Cover and heat over low heat for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.  Remove the cardamom from the hot milk.  Set aside to cool and refrigerate overnight.  Use for soups, breads, salads, filling, or sandwiches. .

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,suet,cilantro stem,tapioca,black soy sauce,brown sugar,quinoa
title: Black Soy Sauce Spiced Quinoa Bowls
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 1/3 cups packed light brown sugar | 1 cup silken cream cheese, cut into chunks | 1/4 cup teriyaki sweet black soy sauce | 2 tablespoons tapioca | fresh cilantro stem, for garnish | 1 cup shredded suet, for garnish
instructions: Place the quinoa in a medium pot that is coated with a tight lid.  Stir and bring to a boil over medium heat.  Reduce heat to low, cover pot, and simmer until all the liquid is absorbed, about 30 minutes.  When the quinoa is done, stir in the brown sugar, silken cream cheese, teriyaki sweet black soy sauce, and tapioca.  Garnish individual servings with fresh cilantro springs.  Serve immediately.

title: Easy Bouillabaisse With Shrimp
ingredients: 500 g shrimp crackers ( depending on size ) | 1 1/2 bunches watercress
instructions: Drain all watercress and cut into thin strips.  Arrange on the plate of seafood.  Drizzle with a little water and season to taste.

title: Homemade Chipotle Noodles
ingredients: 4 ounces dried egg noodles ( about 1 package ) | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla | 1 jar chipotle chiles
instructions: Rinse the noodles under cold water.

title: Raw Vegan Cheesecake
ingredients: 16 ounces roquefort cheese | 1/2 bunch basil leaf | 1/2 lb guacamole | 1/2 bunch lemongrass | 1/4 lb bamboo shoot | 1 mango
instructions: Chop all ingredients into small pieces and place in the blender container.  Wash the chopped mango and the basil leaves when chopping them up.  Mix well and place in the freezer for a couple of hours until firm.  Turn off freezer when ready and stir it once to distribute the flavors.  The secret is to stir it up quickly and then keep it in the freezer.  This makes good sized balls for large shrimp salads.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,chicken thigh,ladyfinger,green chili pepper,yellow squash,sirloin
title: Chili-Chicken Fajitas
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chicken thighs, fat trimmed | 1/4 lb ground sirloin | 1 -2 fresh red chili peppers or 1 -2 green chili pepper, sliced | 1 yellow squash, sliced 1/4-inch thick | 8 ladyfingers | freshly cracked black pepper
instructions: Thoroughly combine all ingredients in a bowl.  Add enough water to allow beef to roll and not rip the meat.  Shape into 6 patties.  Grill or pan fry patties until cooked through, no longer pink.  Serve on pita bread with lettuce, sour cream and salsa.

title: Borscht (Lamb, Potato, and Chocolate Soup)
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 500 ml whole milk/ 1 1/2 liters half-and-half cream | 1 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 2 tablespoons good balsamic vinegar | 300 g russet potatoes ( peeled & halved or in a 1/2 inch cube depending on size ) | 100 g of sweet chocolate, with a good quality, like ghirardelli | 4 tablespoons horseradish
instructions: In a large pot heat the milk, vinegar, and vanilla and simmer for 12 minutes.  Add the meat and heat until no longer pink.  Add the potatoes and bring to boil, simmer for 15 minutes stir once or twice until the potato is cooked but not mushy.  You may need to add a touch more milk as the soup simmers.  While the soup is simmering make the balsamic sauce by putting the balsamic vinegar in a pan with the water & bring to a boil.  Add the chocolate & return to a boil.  Cook for another couple of minutes.  Remove from the heat and set aside to cool slightly.  When cool, taste for sweetness, adding more flavorings if desired.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,cream cheese,sultana,meatball,green cardamom pod,poblano chile pepper,celery flake,baking potato
title: Chile Pozole
ingredients: 1/2 cup sultana | 4 -6 pods green cardamom pods, split | 1/4 lb ground meatballs | 1 lb baking potato, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 large poblano chile pepper, chopped fine | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 3 tablespoons reduced fat cream cheese | 1/4 teaspoon celery flakes
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f.  In a deep 9x9 inch baking pan, combine sultana, 4 pods of cardamom pods, and 1/4 lb of the meatballs.  Cover with aluminum foil and bake until meatballs are no longer pink in center.  Using slotted spoon, remove meatballs from oven and set aside.  In same pan over medium high heat, cook the potato with remaining cardamom pods and pods for ten minutes.

title: Potato Soup
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups water | 1/2 cup angel hair pasta | 1 can chicken broth | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots | 2 potato, peeled and cubed
instructions: Bring water, angel hair pasta and chicken broth to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 5 minutes.  Add bamboo shoots and potato pieces.  Heat through.  Serve warm.

title: Gingered Parsnips and Parsnips
ingredients: 1 1/4 pounds parsnips, peeled, halved lengthwise, and cut into 3 '' pieces | 1 1/4 cups chopped fresh spinach leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons finely grated fresh ginger juice | 1/3 cup chopped white onion | 1 teaspoon honey | 2 teaspoons prepared pesto sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with baking foil and spray with cooking spray.  Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add parsnips.

title: The Bestest Macaroni and Cheese Ball Ever!!
ingredients: 250 g macaroni | 1/3 cup vegetable stock | 1/3 cup mayonnaise | 1 cup homemade mayonnaise or ( 1 ounce ) cup miracle whip
instructions: Boil water in a large pan.  Put the macaroni in the boiling water and put a close lid on with a slightly open lid on the pan.  Leave for around 5 - 8 minutes.  Meanwhile, put the stock in a large bowl.  Add the mayonnaise, miracle whip and macaroni to the water in the pan and cook on high for 6 mins, stirring all the time to make sure it doesn't stick to the bottom of the pan.  When everything is done, remove the hot macaroni from the pan and serve on warmed plates.  Place the cheese mixture on top.

Random Ingredients: ice water,red chile powder,white creme de cacao,spanish onion
title: Chile Blanco
ingredients: 1/2 bunch fresh white creme de cacao, or more as needed | 1 spanish onion, minced | 1 teaspoon red chile powder | 3 quarts ice water, or as needed
instructions: Pour 1/2 cup white creme de cacao into a shaker, and shake to combine.  Add onions and red chile powder to the shaker, and shake to combine.  Pour ice into the shaker, and drop lumps of creme de cacao mixture into the ice.

title: Cabbage and Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed from thawed pastry sheets | 1 head cabbage, cored and shredded | 2 -3 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Prepare the filling while the pastry dough is rising.  On a lightly floured surface roll out the puff pastry to a 1/4 inch thickness.  Spread the shredded cabbage with 1/4 cup cheese.  Place the dough over the cabbage to cover.  Starting on the long side and pressing lightly to form a closed roll.  Place the roll, seam side down, on a baking sheet.  Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until the edges have darkened.  Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes.  Using your thumb, and thumb, rub the inside of the roll to form a seam.  Serve with napkins.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,brussels sprout,russet potato,confectioner ' sugar,strawberry,sage,peanut oil vegetable,msg
title: Sage and Strawberry Potato Salad With Parsnip Chips
ingredients: 1 medium russet potato, peeled and cut into 1 inch squares | 1 large brussels sprout, stemmed and cut into half-moons | 2 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 teaspoon msg | 1 -2 teaspoon chili oil | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh sage or 1/2 teaspoon dried sage, crushed | 6 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | fresh strawberries or potted cream, for garnish
instructions: To cook potatoes, prick potatoes all over with a fork.  Place on a plate and microwave on high for 4 minutes, or until tender.  Meanwhile, combine oil, msg, chili oil and sage in a small bowl.  When potatoes are done, microwave for 1 minute on high to slightly thicken, stirring now and then.  Transfer to a serving bowl and toss with the confectioner's sugar and season to taste with additional sriracha if desired.  Place strawberries on a platter or serve on top of the salad.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,pork tenderloin,sun tomato,apple juice,deli ham,celery
title: Quick Cuban Stuffed Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin, rolled | 1 teaspoon sun-dried tomato, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon chopped celery | 1/4 cup chopped apple juice | 1 slice deli ham | 1/2 cup shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 325°.  Place meat, fat side up, on a rack in a roasting pan.  Sprinkle sun dried tomato and celery.  Roll up tenderloin jelly roll style.  Secure with toothpicks or a toothpick tie.  Arrange tenderloin over meat.  In shallow baking dish, combine apple juice and ham.  Pour over the rolls.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until internal temperature reaches 160 degrees.

title: Indian Tacos
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, chopped | 3 tablespoons sour yogurt | 1 teaspoon tomato puree | 1 teaspoon mayonnaise | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 cube chicken flavored instant bouillon ( optional )
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.  Add asafoetida powder to skillet.

title: Soya Lentils and Dried Nuts With a Twist!(Vegan-Friendly)
ingredients: 2 cups lentils ( red or green is best ) | 1/2 cup soya sauce ( can use soy sauce to sweeten ) | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar | 1 -2 tablespoon oil ( use any or all of the oil you like to smoke )
instructions: Boil lentils in water with 3 - 4 t water till cooked.  Don't over boil, or over cook.  Heat remaining 4 t oil in frying pan and stir fry soya sauce and vinegar for 2 - 3 mins till fragrant.  Toss in the dried nuts.  Serve with plain white or brown rice.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cod,tomato sauce,chinese five spice powder,icing sugar,white fish fillet
title: Chinese Five-Spice Cod Fish
ingredients: 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 small white fish fillet | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 1 tablespoon tomato sauce | 2 ounces cod, cooked
instructions: Heat frying pan.  Score fish into bite size slices.  Fry fish pieces over medium heat until firm and golden.  Put in a large mixing bowl.  Sprinkle with icing sugar, five spice powder and tomato sauce.  Pour over cod.  Serve warm.

title: Cheat's Zucchini & Italian Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 2 italian sausages | 1 zucchini | 2 bags frozen chopped spinach leaves | 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | 1 cabbage | 1 package dry brown rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Place sausages on a baking tray and bake 15 - 20 minutes or til done.  Cut zucchini in half lengthwise, then quarter lengthwise leaving approximately 1/2 inch sections.  Remove seeds and cut crosswise into 1/2 inch pieces.  When sausage is done, remove from oven.  Crumble sausage into a large nonstick skillet.  Slice into 2 tablespoons or so.  Add spinach leaves and cook over medium high heat for 3 - 5 minutes to wilt or soften.  Remove spinach from heat.  Roll out 1 sheet of puff pastry dough to a thickness of approximately 1/4, using a 7 round cutter to cut dough as required.  Cut dough in half and place 1/4 of the sausage mixture along one edge of the dough closest to you.  Cover the sausage mixture with the other half of the dough, leaving approximately 1/4 of the sausage mixture unrolled along the edge nearest you and pressing between your wet fingers to seal.  Place on sheets of parchment paper and lightly spray a cookie sheet with cooking spray.  Repeat with remaining dough and sausage mixture.  Place 2 sheets of dough on the lined cookie sheet.  Brush dough lightly with cooking spray, sprinkle with coarse salt and bake the rolls for 15 - 20 minutes, or until lightly browned and crisp.  Meanwhile preheat oven to 350 degrees.  To serve, slice sausage lengthwise into 1/4 thick slices.  Remove and discard stuffing from sausage, then transfer to a plate and slice the sausage thinly.  Place on a serving plate, topped with cabbage and sausage slices.  In a small bowl add cooked brown rice, water and remaining brown sausages.  Spoon rice mixture over sausage rolls and serve.

Random Ingredients: pecorino romano cheese,coconut,tarragon leaf,pine nut,sugar,white rice,porcini mushroom,bourbon
title: Porcini-Rice Pudding
ingredients: 3 ounces dried porcini mushrooms | 2 ounces pine nuts | 3 ounces pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1/2 ounce dried tarragon leaves | 5 ounces white rice | 1/3 cup bourbon | 1 tablespoon sugar | crushed pineapple nuts
instructions: Place all ingredients into a saucepan and bring to a low boil.  Reduce heat and cook for 20 - 30 minutes.  Set aside to cool.  After chilling for 20 minutes, strain through a fine sieve.  Refrigerate for 1 - 2 hours or until cold.  Serve on a large platter with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.  Garnish with crushed pine nuts.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Pancetta
ingredients: 4 ounces pancetta, chopped | 16 ounces pork tenderloin, trimmed | 2 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and finely chopped | 1/3 cup dry white wine | 2 ounces thick slab pancetta or 2 ounces other firm cured pork shoulder roast fat
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f.  Heat medium skillet and broil 2 - 3 minutes, or until crumbly.  Remove from the skillet and place in a large bowl.  In the same skillet, cook 4oz of pancetta about 4 mins, or until it is golden brown.  Remove with slotted spoon and set aside.  Place the pork in the skillet and cook, turning frequently, until browned.  Transfer the pork with a slotted spoon and toasted crumbs onto a plate and set aside.  Slice the pork crosswise into 1/2in slices.  Remove the crusts from 3 of the sliced pork loin's and season generously with salt and pepper.  Top each slice with 1/4 of the egg, then the 2oz pancetta and the hard boiled egg.  Roll up the pork and secure with wooden toothpicks.  Place the rolls on a roasting rack and place into the oven, seam side down so that the heat of the oven is apprx 400°f.  Bake for 45 minutes or until cooked to your liking.  Remove toothpicks and continue to roast the pork for 35 - 40 mins or until the internal temperature reaches 140f.

Random Ingredients: bacon grease,lamb shoulder,cumin,pod cardamom,soy sauce,dark chocolate,egg yolk
title: Sydney Curried Chops
ingredients: 4 slices bacon grease | 5 pounds boneless lamb shoulder, cut into 1/2-inch dice | 1 1/2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 4 squares unsweetened dark chocolate | 2 egg yolks | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Heat the bacon grease in a large skillet over medium heat.  Cook the lamb cubes in the bacon grease until lightly browned, 5 to 10 minutes.  Stir in the soy sauce, cumin, and dark chocolate.

title: Fennel and Anchovy
ingredients: 4 fennel bulbs | 4 anchovy fillets
instructions: Preheat the grill pan over gentle heat.  Trim the fennel bulbs and core them, leaving them intact.  Using a sharp knife, cut a thin slice off the top third of each bulb.  Cut the fennel bulbs crossways into quarters and place into a roasting tin.  Mix the anchovy fillets lightly in a bowl using a teaspoon until they are coarsely chopped.  Spoon half the fennel into the centre of each piece of fennel and carefully surround them all around the fennel with the anchovy mix well.  Season well using salt and freshly ground black pepper.  Leave to stand for 10 minutes before unwrapping.  Discard any remaining fennel.  Place the roasting tin on the grill and cook, turning once, for about 10 to 15 minutes or until the fennel is well charred.

title: Apple Quinoa Loaf - Apple and Quinoa Rote
ingredients: 1 cup red quinoa, soaked ( or regular red quinoa, if you prefer ) | 2 cups tart apples, peeled, cored, and chopped | 4 tablespoons currants, soaked ( or raisins, if you prefer ) | 2 tablespoons flour | 2 teaspoons cinnamon | 2 tablespoons almond paste, powder ( or almond meal )
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the chopped apples, currants, and dry quinoa.  Mix throughly.  Combine the flour and cinnamon in a small bowl, and stir into the apple mixture gently until well mixed.  Place half dough in the bottom of a greased 9x5x3 loaf pan.  Spread the quinoa mixture on top.  Spread the apple mixture all the way to the edges, stopping about 1 1/2 inches from the top.  Use a sharp knife to cut through the dough every few inches so it will form into a loaf shape.  The dough will not be completely smooth if it is, too much and it will crumbly.  If it does, it will become tough and hard.  Bake at 350 deg for 1 hours or until the top is golden brown and the loaf feels firm and slightly flaky.

title: Vegan Soba Chips
ingredients: 3 bunches fresh beet, stems cut off | 2 cups coarsely chopped green zucchini | 1 pint half-and-half | 5 1/2 teaspoons uncooked soba noodles
instructions: Place the beets in a pot and cover with 5 cups salt along with the zucchini.  Bring to a boil and cook until tender, about 40 minutes.  Using a slotted spoon, transfer the beets to a bowl and add 1/2 cup water to the beet liquid.  Mash the beets.  Stir in the cooked beet mixture, half and half, and bring to a simmer.  Continue simmering, stirring occasionally, until thick, about 30 minutes.  Break off any chunks of the beets with a spoon and return them to the pot.

title: Hot Italian Sausage Sausages
ingredients: 4 sweet italian sausage | 3/4 cup pico de gallo | 1 2/3 cups hot de jalapenos, plus or 2/3 cup salsa fresca | paprika
instructions: Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat until moderately hot.  Brush sausage with pico de gallo and sprinkle with paprika.  Add sausage and cook, turning once, until browned, about 4 minutes.  Serve with salsa fresca if desired.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,grand marnier,plain flour,red pepper,italian sausage,basil leaf,cardamom pod
title: Sausages in Spiced Sauce
ingredients: 600 g sweet italian sausages or 600 g sausages, cut into 2 equal portions | 75 g plain flour | 400 g finely chopped fresh basil leaves | 1 tablespoon ground cardamom pod | 1 tablespoon finely chopped red pepper | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 tablespoon light brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c.  Dust sausages in flour.  Place in shallow roasting tin and cook in the oven for 20 minutes, turning halfway through cooking, until done to your liking.  Remove from the oven and leave to stand for 5 minutes while you mix together the basil, cardamom, crushed pepper, grand marnier and sugar in a food processor until smooth.  Slice the sausages and arrange on a serving platter.  Pour the spiced sauce over and serve.

title: Italian Rice and Dressing
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup chopped pimiento | 1 cup uncooked long-grain white rice, uncooked
instructions: In an electric bowl, combine soup and pimientos.  Microwave rice according to directions on box.  Sprinkle rice with salt.  Drain rice and pat dry with paper towels.

Random Ingredients: black olive,tom yum paste,balsamic vinegar,bacon dripping,lemon peel
title: Grilled Balsamic Vinegar Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe tomatoes ( about 5 roma ) | 1 cup balsamic vinegar | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 6 sprigs lemon peel | 2 teaspoons chopped parsley
instructions: Slice the tomatoes into thick, thin wedges.  Combine all ingredients in a bowl and refrigerate at least 30 minutes.  Balsamic vinegar is a balsamic vinegar that has been aged or flavored with balsamic vinegar.  It should be sweeter when refrigerated.  Bring vinegar to room temperature and remove from heat.  Serve in a shallow dish for tomatoes.

title: Uncle Bill's Curry Orange Salad Dressing
ingredients: 4 ounces mandarin oranges | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup steak sauce ( i use hp creole-style ) | 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/4 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Shake all ingredients and stir to mix.  Stir well and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,habanero pepper,french mustard,tomato,salt black pepper,clam juice,papaya,buttermilk
title: Baked Seafood Rice in a Snap
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice | 2 cans diced tomatoes with jalapenos, divided | 1 can minced clams with juice | 1 can tomato and papayas with jalapenos, drained | 2 tablespoons prepared french mustard | 1 tablespoon smoked paprika | 1 teaspoon salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 cup buttermilk, chilled
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f.  Cook the brown rice in the preheated oven until rice is dry, about 10 minutes.  Drain excess water.

title: Homemade Bacon Cilantro
ingredients: 6 3/4 ounces thick-cut bacon, chopped | 1/4 cup packed fresh cilantro stems | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | fresh cilantro sprig ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Fry bacon in a heavy, large frying pan, until crisp.

title: White Cheese and Basil Enchiladas
ingredients: 10 -12 tortillas | 1 lb white american cheese | 2 cups packed chopped fresh basil | 1 lemon | 2 cups chopped fresh basil | 1 pinch saffron | 1/4 cup pesto sauce
instructions: Heat a heavy skillet on medium heat.  Cut the cheese into small chunks.  Place tortillas in hot skillet and cook about 3 - 5 minutes.  On top of tortillas place pieces of cheese and continue cooking until cheese is melted.  To make pesto, combine basil, lemon juice and saffron.  Set aside.  Place cheese and lemon juice mixture in blender or food processor until smooth.  Add pesto and blend for a few seconds until blended.  Pour mixture in a bowl and set aside.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Place 3 tortillas on a lightly greased baking sheet.  Place 1 tbsp prepared cheese mixture on tortillas and sprinkle with a bit of the cheese mixture and then sprinkle with remaining cheese mixture.  Top with remaining 3 tortillas.  Top tortillas evenly with remaining pesto.  Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream if desired.

title: Spicy Chocolate Truffles
ingredients: 1/3 cup molasses ( treacle ) | 2 1/4 ounces bittersweet chocolate, finely chopped ( i used dark sweet chocolate ) | 4 large pinches dried red chili peppers | 2 red chili peppers, minced ( about 1 tbsps ) | 1 lime wedge, cut into wedges
instructions: Heat molasses in heavy medium saucepan over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until melted and mixture starts to thicken slightly, about 3 minutes.  Stir in chilies and chili.  Cool.  Stir into chocolate mixture.  Transfer mixture to small bowl and refrigerate, covered 4 hours or overnight.  Form guldens of about 1 1/2 teaspoons mixture into patties 2 inches diameter and 2 inches tall.  Thread patties onto metal skewers, leaving at least ½ inch between each one.  Set patties on waxed paper lined baking sheet and freeze for at least an hour or freeze up to 1 month.  Let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes.  Arrange on plates and drizzle with sriracha hot chilies.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,rice vinegar,plain yogurt,wheat pita bread
title: Yogurt Pita Bread
ingredients: 2 whole wheat pita bread | 4 tablespoons plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon golden syrup
instructions: Spread 2 tbsp yogurt on each pita and top with 2 tablespoons of yogurt and 1 tbsp of greek dressing.  Top the pita with 1 tbsp of the yogurt mixture.  Bake at 200c for 12 - 15 minutes and serve.

title: Fried Marsala Bread
ingredients: 3 cups dry bread crumbs | 1 1/2 cups golden raisins | 1 teaspoon msg | 2 1/4 cups sweet marsala
instructions: Place bread crumbs, raisins, and msg in a large bowl.  Mix in marsala.  Turn out onto floured board and knead until mixture becomes smooth, 5 to 8 minutes.  Roll out to 1/8 inch thickness.  Cut into fingers or rounds.  Heat oil in a wide frying pan to 375 degrees f.  Fry bread rounds until crisp, about 2 minutes per side.  Drain on paper towels and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,kosher salt,hamburger,rice,self rising flour,black olive,green olive
title: Chef John's Spanish Rolls
ingredients: 3/4 cup self-rising flour | 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 1 large egg yolk | 1/2 cup rice, cooked and cooled to room temperature | 12 ounces hamburger | 2 tablespoons sliced ripe black olives | 2 tablespoons black olives | 1 can sliced green olives
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or grease with flour.  Sift the flour and salt together in a medium bowl.  Beat the yolk in a small bowl, then whisk the yolk into the flour until smooth.  Add the cooled rice and 1 cup of the cooked and cooled rice to the flour, stirring just enough to avoid lumps.  If any flour lumps form, knead the dough.  Transfer the dough to a floured work surface and divide the dough into 14 pieces.  Shape each piece into a ball and put on the prepared baking sheet.  Repeat until the dough is gone.  Sprinkle 1/4 cup of the cooked and cooled rice on each piece of dough.  Place 2 sliver of the top of each roll.  Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown and cooked through, 20 to 25 minutes.  An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 145 degrees f.  Let cool for 5 minutes before handling.  While still hot, slice each roll into 1/2 inch thick slices.  Arrange on a serving plate.  Garnish with 1 or 2 sliced black olives and 2 or 3 sliced rallasco peppers.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,vanilla,serrano chilies,beef broth,oregano,matzo meal,plain soymilk,lasagna noodle
title: Passover Beef Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles | 1 cup matzo meal | 1 can condensed beef broth | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1 serrano chilies or 1 jalapeno, minced | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 2 tablespoons real vanilla | 1 cup soymilk
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f spray 13x9 baking dish.  Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions.  Drain.  Spread the noodles over bottom of dish.  In a blender add 1/2 can of condensed beef broth and vinegar, chilies and oregano.  Blend until smooth.  Add remaining 1/2 can of condensed beef broth and soy milk.  Blend 2 minutes or until smooth.  Pour blend over noodles in dish.  Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup of soy milk.  Bake at 375°f for 55 - 60 minutes or until noodles are thoroughly heated.

title: Coconut Christmas Chutney
ingredients:
1 bunch mixed fresh herbs, e.
    -g.
    - cherries, chives, chive tops, chive tops, cherries | 500 g dark chocolate | 2 tablespoons chutney ( your choice-sweet, dark or creamy ) | 1/2 teaspoon hot chili oil | 1/4 teaspoon brown mustard seeds | 1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon whole mixed nuts
instructions: Break up the dark chocolate into pieces.  Boil in the microwave for 10 - 15 minutes, watching it to avoid burning the chocolate.  Stir every now and then, remembering to stir until all the pieces have melted and have been mixed inches.  Dissolve the mustard in a splash of boiling water and stir into the melted chocolate. .  Stir in the chilli oil, brown mustard seeds, chopped chives and cinnamon.  Mix well and pour into a baking dish or small tupperware type bowl, and spread over the surface of the toffee.  Let cool.  Cover and store in refridgerator for up to a week.

Random Ingredients: tarragon vinegar,pomegranate juice,grape,red wine vinegar,chuck,purpose flour,cornmeal,chili oil
title: Mild and Sweet Glamorgan Sausages
ingredients: 1/2 cup grapes, drained or | 1 tablespoon pomegranate juice | 1 teaspoon cornmeal | 2 lbs chuck, chuck, shin, ground and cubed | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar or 3 tablespoons brown vinegar | 1 tablespoon hot chili oil | 1/2 teaspoon tarragon vinegar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375ºf.  Combine the grapes in a bowl with the pomegranate juice.  You should have about 1/2 cup.  Add the cornmeal mix to the meat in the bowl.  Use wooden spoon to knead the mixture until it forms a homogenous paste.  You may need to do this in batches.  Put the meat in a large baking dish.  Bake at 375ºf for about 40 minutes until the internal temperature reaches 165ºf.  Let the sausage cool about 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, stir together the flour, vinegar, chili oil and tarragon vinegar.  Set aside until needed.  When the meat is cool, remove the meat from the bones and shred into about 1/3 inch pieces.  Put the meat back into the pan and pour the vinegar over it.  Mix together well and cook a further 10 minutes, until it thickens.  Turn the oven down to 350ºf and continue cooking the sausages for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally and adding a little water.  Serve hot.  My note, i often use canned pink sorrel which is quite expensive but they are always well flavored.

title: Homemade Sausage
ingredients: 8 ounces pepperoni, sliced
instructions: Slice peppers and sausages into rounds approximately 1/4 by 1/2 thick.  Place on a grill or oven rack and grill for 2 minutes.  Turn and grill for another 2 minutes.  These are good on top of coke.  This can then be served with pizza sauce or served on asian style rolls.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,cider vinegar,tortilla,picante sauce,celery leaf,hard egg
title: Picante Fried Eggs
ingredients: 6 hard-boiled eggs ( see notes below ) | 1 cup picante sauce ( see notes below ) | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 pinch dried kaffir lime leaf | 4 leaves celery & leaves | dried lime leaves, for garnish | tortilla, slices for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Cut the eggs in half lengthwise.  Remove the yolks and white from the yolks and then mash them with an electric mixer until just mixed.  Place the picante sauce, vinegar, kaffir lime and celery leaves in a bowl, stir well then refrigerate for about 1 hour to develop the flavor.  Fill the egg white halves with the yolk mixture and sprinkle with lime leaves.  Garnish with fried egg halves and sprigs of lime.

Random Ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt,kielbasa,lemon,danish blue cheese,catsup,black vinegar
title: German Style Kielbasa With Bleu Cheese and Lemon Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 4 medium kielbasa ( about 5-3/4 pounds ) | 1 cup catsup | 1/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/4 cup finely chopped lemon rind | 1/3 cup finely chopped fresh danish blue cheese | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1/4 cup coarsely ground black vinegar
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Add kielbasa.

title: Noodles Sticky
ingredients: 300 g dried rice noodles | 1/4 cup water | 2 1/2 tablespoons dry sherry | 2 teaspoons finely chopped basil leaves | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon low-sodium instant hing ( can replace with mixed herbs ) | 2 cups cooked meat or 2 cups vegetables
instructions: Cook noodles in rapidly boiling water until tender and drain.  Place all ingredients in a bowl, except the meat and vegetables, and toss until evenly coated.  Add meat and vegetables.

title: Barsi's Mexican Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza dough | 2 tablespoons yoghurt | 1 package manchego cheese, shredded ( can use monterey jack cheese if you want your cheese to be fancy ) | 1/2 cup salsa verde ( we use the medium heat variety ) | 1 tablespoon dried arabic pimento stuffed olive ( can use kalamata stuffed olives also ) | 1 cup mixed chopped arichio or 1 cup swiss cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients except pizza dough and oil together in a bowl and blend well.  Sprinkle the pizza base generously with your aric pimento.  Bake at 375 deg f with the oven rack on the lowest level of the oven for about 40 minutes.

title: Baked Falafel- Veggies
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed ( chickpeas ) | 1 can green beans, drained and rinsed | 1 banana, large, ripe and sliced thin ( optional ) | sprouts ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Line cookie sheet with tin foil.  Place falafel, bananas, and sprouts evenly on cookie sheet.  Place in oven and bake for 15 minutes until hot and the bananas are a little firm.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: dutch process cocoa powder,graham cracker crust,anise seed
title: Mexican Party Pretzels
ingredients: pistachio spread or greek-style processed cheese | 1 tablespoon dark process cocoa powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons anise seed
instructions: If using greek style processed cheese it should be grated very fine.  Spread over the cookie base.  Sprinkle with greek/asian style cocoa powder and anise seeds.  Seal with a double layer of saran wrap directly onto the cookie.  Put in the preheated oven at 350°f for 30 minutes, or until the edges turn golden.

title: Tzatziki
ingredients: 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 5 tablespoons oil | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 3 cups rump roast | 2 teaspoons fresh chives, minced
instructions: Mix yogurt with olive oil and vanilla extract in a bowl.  Heat roast in a medium skillet over medium low heat until it begins to caramelize, about 5 minutes total.  Transfer roast to a bowl.  Stir chives into yogurt mixture and let stand while the roast roasts to cool slightly.  Transfer cooked roast and liquid to a blender and blend until smooth.  Season with salt and pepper.  Cover and refrigerate to allow flavors to blend, about 4 hours.  Serve with pitas.

Random Ingredients: black coffee,yellow onion,apple cider,coleslaw,beef liver,blueberry,chicken tender,oyster mushroom
title: Crock Pot Beef and Blueberry Livers
ingredients: 9 -10 beef liver, cut into 1 inch chunks | 1 jar sliced oyster mushrooms, drained | 8 -12 ounces blueberries ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 medium yellow onion, cut in thin 1/4 inch slices | 3 packages coleslaw | 1 can reduced-sodium beef broth ( chicken flavored if available ) | 1/2 cup apple cider
instructions: Mix beef liver with blueberries, onion, and coleslaw.  Cover and cook on high for two hours.  Turn to low and mix broth and cider together until combined.  Pour into crock pot.  Cook for 4 - 5 hours until done.  Serve with buns and corn chips.  You may also want to serve this over rice.

title: Raspberry Caramel Dip
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, room temperature | 1 tablespoon raspberry vinegar | 1 -2 tablespoon caramel topping ( optional ) | 1 serrano pepper, minced ( optional )
instructions: Using an electric mixer, mix all ingredients together.  Let stand at room temperature 30 minutes, if desired, before serving.

title: Unagi Nabe (Wonders' Cabbage)
ingredients: 1 head savoy cabbage or 1 head napa cabbage, roughly chopped, leaves separate | 3 tablespoons raisins | 3 drops red food coloring
instructions: Bring 4 - 5 quarts of cold water to boil.  Trim and wash your cabbage.  Place cabbage in a large pot of salted water to keep it from discarding the outer layer of leaves and just enough water to cover.  Once the water starts to boil, put a lid on the pot, place it over the pot, and bring it back to boil, skimming off any scum that comes up.  If needed add a little more water.  Cook for approximately 20 minutes, or until the cabbage begins to release its liquid.  While the cabbage is cooking, place the raisins in a small bowl and pour 1/2 cup of hot water over them.  Set aside for 15 minutes until they plump up.  Drain the cooked cabbage and set aside.  When the cabbage is tender, drain the water and set aside.  Place the raisin water, raisins, and red food coloring in a small bowl and mix well.  Place the drained cabbage in a serving bowl or on individual plates.  Pour the dressing over the cabbage.  Toss to coat all.  Serve at once.

title: Spargelfesti
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus, ends trimmed and spears cut on the bias | 12 black olives, pitted, sliced
instructions: Steam or boil the asparagus 6 to 8 minutes, or until crisp tender.  Place the asparagus spears in a single layer in a lightly oiled baking dish to keep warm.  Arrange the sliced olives around the spears.  Broil in an oven set at 350 degrees fahrenheit until the olives are fragrant.

title: Mexican Green Chile Rellenos with Strawberry Sauce
ingredients: 2 medium green chili peppers, cut in half lengthwise ( anaheims ) | 3 bunches fresh broccoli, trimmed | 1 lb assorted fresh strawberry, halved ( or other berries ) | 1/2 bunch fresh rosemary | 1 tablespoon tapioca flour | 2 tablespoons whipping cream | 1 mild habaneros ( wear gloves ) or 1 jalapeno pepper, cut in rings | 1/4 cup salsa ( low-sodium )
instructions: Cook chile in boiling water 5 seconds.  Immediately immerse in ice water.

title: Ziti IV
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta, broken into 2 inch pieces | 1 jar marshmallow creme
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  In a 9x13 inch baking dish, combine the ziti and marshmallow cream.  Cook, stirring frequently, until the ziti is thoroughly coated with marshmallow cream.  Spread the ziti mixture over the top of the marshmallow cream.

title: Green Toasted Sausages
ingredients: 8 links andouille sausages | 1/3 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | chopped green ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c.  Cut sausages in half lengthways and flatten lightly with a rolling pin.  Sprinkle each with breadcrumbs, pepper and green onions.  Tear off 8 - 10 pieces of waxed paper and roll each piece into a sausage shape about 6 to 7cm round.  Brush with beaten egg and bake, turning once, for approx 30 to 40 mins or until cooked through and browned and cooked through.  Cooks note that if your breadcrumbs have large holes on them, you can use a meat grinder, to remove the breadcrumbs or use a spice grinder.  The amount of breadcrumbs depends on the size of them and whether you use the presliced breadcrumbs on sandwich buns.

title: Soba Oil (Made from Japanese Stock)
ingredients: 3/4 cup japanese sake | oil ( for deep frying )
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the sake and vegetable oil.  Bring to a boil, then remove from heat.  Allow the mixture to cool.  Pour onto ice cube trays.  Keep refrigerated until serving time.

title: Tortilla Rollups
ingredients: 12 corn tortillas | 1/2 cup basil ( fresh shredded ) | 3/4 cup mozzarella balls ( grated ) | 4 teaspoons cardamom seeds ( cracked over a rolling pin with salt ) | 1/4 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f line a 10x15 jelly roll pan with plastic wrap, then place the tortillas on foil lined baking sheet and cut a slit down center on each tortilla.  Sprinkle mozzarella cheese on top of the tortillas.  Sprinkle herb/yogurt on top.  Bake for 15 minutes then reduce heat to 350f and bake an additional 15 minutes.  Remove and let stand for 5 minutes before cutting.  Cut into 8 slices and serve with toothpicks.

Random Ingredients: steak,monterey jack cheese,egg white,vanilla pudding mix,garlic salt,flat leaf parsley,ginger,yellow bell pepper
title: Ginger-Garlic Steak Strips
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped fresh flat leaf parsley | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/2 cup packed grated fresh ginger | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix | 4 large yellow bell peppers, cut into 1/4-inch wide strips | 2 large eggs, beaten | 2 tablespoons grated fresh ginger | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla pudding mix | 1/2 lb flank steak, cut into strips about 1/2 inch wide | 2 egg whites, beaten
instructions: Pour boiling water over 1/2 cup parsley to cover.  Let stand until softened, about 10 minutes.  Drain, and stir together 1/2 cup cheese, 1/2 cup ginger, 1/2 tsp garlic salt, 1/2 package instant pudding mix, and 2 large yellow bell peppers.  Set aside. .  Heat oven to melt butter, and stir in 2 beaten eggs.  Blend in 2 tablespoons ginger, 1/2 tsp garlic salt, 1/2 tsp ginger, 1/2 tsp vanilla pudding mix, and 1/2 cup shredded cheese.  Mix until well blended.  Toss together remaining 1/2 cup cheese, parsley, 1 tsp ginger, 1/2 tsp garlic salt, 1/2 tsp vanilla pudding mix, and 3/4 cup sauce until cheese is melted.  Spread about 3/4 cup cheese mixture onto each piece of steak or roll up tightly.  Spread remaining cheese mixture over meat, and roll up tightly.  Secure ends with toothpicks.  Heat oil for deep frying to 375 degrees f, about 10 minutes, or until sizzling.  Fry steak in hot oil, turning once for 3 to 5 minutes, or until golden brown.  Drain on paper towels.

title: Smoky Fruit Salad
ingredients: 4 large firm sweet apples, such as granny smith, cored and cut into 1/2-inch chunks | 1 cup bamboo shoots, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon fresh marjoram, chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Using melon baller, scoop out centres of apple wedges and place on a plate.  Use a melon baller to hold wedges in shape.  Toss apples with marjoram and parsley.

title: Orange Vodka Zest Brot
ingredients: 4 large eggs, lightly beaten or 2 cups egg substitute | 1/2 cup orange zest | 1 cup vodka
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Mix all ingredients together.  Pour into a baking dish or other suitable container to hold the egg mixture.  Bake for 45 minutes.  You can also place this as a side dish for the same amount of meal.  You may also cover it with a towel for a few minutes while it roasts at the oven.

Random Ingredients: burrito flour tortilla,self rising flour,white onion,brown sugar,pecan
title: Homemade Chipped Pecan Burritos-Cookers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pecans, chopped | 1/2 white onion, finely chopped | 20 burrito-size flour tortillas, heated | 1/3 cup self-rising flour, or as needed | 3/4 cup brown sugar
instructions: Mix pecans and onion together in a bowl.  Spread about 1 tablespoon of the pecan mixture over each warm tortilla.  Roll into a sausage shape.  Sprinkle with brown sugar, then press in the top with a spatula to compact the burritos.  Heat a skillet over medium high heat.  Carefully place 1 burrito at a time into the hot pan without crowding.  Cook until golden brown on each side, about 3 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,mace,sugar,rigatoni pasta,white vinegar,heavy cream,rosemary sprig,farina
title: Rigatoni With Creamy White Vinegar Dressing
ingredients: 6 cups farina | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 4 large rosemary sprigs, crushed | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 3 cups heavy cream ( whipping cream, heavy or non dairy ) | 8 ounces cooked rigatoni pasta ( thin pasta )
instructions: Melt 1/2 celsius.  Of the farina on paper towels over low heat until very hot.  Add the white vinegar, rice vinegar, rosemary, sugar, mace and half of the cream to the farina and mix thoroughly.  Add the remaining cream and mix well.  Keep warm while preparing the pasta.  When ready, add the pasta to the farina and continue to cook until pasta is al dente.  Drain pasta and return to the pot.  Pour the dressing over and toss.  Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: rice,bisquick baking mix,beef sirloin steak,chunky salsa
title: Easy Spanish Steak
ingredients:
3 lbs beef sirloin steaks | 6 cups hot & spicy chunky salsa ( or more ) | 1 cup bisquick baking mix ( i prefer 2.
    -8 oz.
    - jiffy's brand ) | 2 cups instant rice or 2 cups instant rice per package directions
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Lightly coat skillet with no stick cooking spray.  Cut steak into one inch thick strips.  Cook and stir beef in skillet over medium high heat until meat is no longer pink.  Add salsa & cook a few minutes, stirring until heated through.  Move beef to a side of pan & add the baking mix.  Stir until bisquick is smooth.  Pour into a greased shallow baking pan.  Spread beef mixture evenly over batter.  Cover tightly & bake in bottom third of oven for 45 minutes.  Remove cover & bake for 5 minutes, or until sauce is bubbly.  Serve with rice.

title: Green Tomato Stew
ingredients: 1 lb of diced green tomatoes | 4 green tomatoes, diced | 2 cans crescent rolls ( pillsbury is best ) | 1 jar sliced pepperoni, deli sliced ( or you can buy a package of sliced pepperoni ) | 1 tablespoon dried masa harina | 3 -4 small yellow squash, cut into 1- inch cubes | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, toasted
instructions: Pour 1 tbsp of oil in crock pot add diced tomatoes, diced onions and salt and pepper to taste.

title: Green Curry and Brandy Shortbread (Cookies for Two)
ingredients: 4 ounces fine cake flour | 1 teaspoon green curry paste | 3 ounces demi-glace ( or use regular evaporated milk if you have to )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 400°f.  Sift the flour and curry paste into a bowl and gently rub the curry paste into the flour till all the flour is gone.  Add your milk and mix till smooth.  Don't over mix.  If you want to press the mixture into a square tin which has been lined with aluminum foil grease it well.  Prick your base all over with a fork and put it in oven for 40 minutes, take the foil off and leave till the base is cooked and you can see the bottom of the tin.  It should be a little crusty and slightly sticky at the edges and the liquid should run down the side of the tin.  It's ready when it looks dry looking, but not liquid as it should have a firm texture like soft butter when it's cooled.  Place the shortbread on cooling racks and allow them to cool completely.  Cut into 10 slices and decorate as desired with the frosting listed above.  Serve cold or warm.

Random Ingredients: grenadine,okra,oregano,green cardamom,baking soda,chili paste,mango pulp,brewer yeast
title: Okra-Mango-Spice Bread
ingredients: 250 g fine cut okra | 1 pint mango pulp | 3 green cardamoms, split lengthwise | 5 -8 ounces brewer's yeast | 3 tablespoons coriander-brewer's yeast | 1 -2 tablespoon sweet chili paste ( like sambhar ) | 1/2 cup grenadine | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Boil and cool the okra.  Cool.  Peel and chop fine.  Dice the mango pulp, green cardamom and the yeast, add to the okra in large bowl, cover and let stand in a warm place for 1 hour.  Boil the mango pulp until half tender, remove, cool slightly and add to the yeast mixture.  Put the coriander and 1/2 the sugar in a tea mixer or mixer with the remaining 2 cups flour and blend until smooth.  Add the chilli paste and grenadine, mix a little.  Add in the baking soda and mix until a smooth dough is formed.  Turn out onto floured board and knead 10 times on floured board.  Place in a well oiled bowl, cover and set in a warm place for 1½ hours.  Bake at 350 f degrees for 40 - 50 minutes.  Remove from the oven and allow to cool.  Serve with fresh chopped coriander and mint leaves.

title: Pesto Parsnips
ingredients: 1 lb parsnip, peeled and julienned | 1/4 lb unsalted butter, softened
instructions: Thinly slice parsnips.  Butter a large skillet and melt the butter in the butter.  Add parsnips and turn until coated with butter.  Saute until parsnips are browned and nicely crunchy, about 7 minutes.

title: Fantastic Noodles With Blue-Footed Sole Fillets

title: Japanese Noodles
