instructions: Heat canola oil in a large fry pan until shimmering but not smoking.  In a large bowl, place all ingredients except the snow peas, pour the canola oil into the skillet, and stir to coat with oil.  When the contents come together, cook uncovered for 8 to 10 minutes until the noodles are done and the snow peas have cooked down. .  Toss the vermicelli with the vermicelli, add the snow peas, and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,mushroom stem,pork tenderloin,sunflower oil,leek,cream tartar,egg,crouton
title: Somerset Beef and Pork
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1in chunks | 1 lb pork tenderloin, cut into 1in chunks | 1 small leek, white part only, thinly sliced, washed well and chopped coarsely | 4 ounces mushrooms stems and pieces | 4 ounces cream of tartar | 4 ounces croutons | beaten egg
instructions: Heat the oil in a large frying pan and fry the beef, pork and leek for 5 mins, until the beef is brown around the edges.  Transfer to a casserole with the mushrooms and croutons and toss.  Bake in a moderate oven for 1 hour then stir through the cream of tartar and season.

title: Alaskan Feta and Matzo Fondues
ingredients: 1 cup pitted mashed banana | 1 cup whipping cream | 1/2 cup chopped celery flakes | 2 cups matzo meal | 3/4 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Combine banana, cream, celery flakes and matzo meal in a bowl, and stir until well blended.  Roll mixture into small dough balls, dip them into the flour, and roll into a little ball shapes.  Heat oil in a skillet over medium high heat.  Fry dough balls in the hot oil until golden brown on both sides.

title: Roast Chicken Wings
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken wings | 1 large large yellow pepper, cut into 6 pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Place wings, yellow pepper, and 1/4 cup water in a 3 1/2 quart casserole dish.

title: Mexican Green Tea
ingredients: 6 tablespoons sweet taco sauce | 6 whole green cardamom pods
instructions: Toast the pods in a dry skillet for a minute or two, then add the warm taco sauce.  Let them sit for a few moments.  Flip the pods around and watch carefully for the air to escape.  When they begin to puff up and darken, remove them from the skillet with a slotted spoon and pour 1 tsp onto each mug.

title: Spinach and Coconut Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs baking potatoes or 1 1/2 lbs fingerling potatoes, peeled | 3 cups mixed baby spinach | 1/3 cup sweetened flaked coconut, toasted
instructions: Boil the potatoes and drain.  Cut the potatoes into thin slices.  Place in a greased 13x9x2 inch baking dish or casserole.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,parmigiano reggiano cheese,green onion,bean
title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 1/2 kg baked beans ( red beans ) | 3 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 1/2 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 4 green onions, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c or 400°f.  Drain the baked beans, but save the liquid and beans.  Place the beans in a dish.  Mix the liquid and soy sauce well and pour it over the beans.  Spoon the bean mixture over the beans and sprinkle over the cheese.  Sprinkle with onions.  Bake for about 30 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,mustard oil,canadian bacon,red chilies,extra virgin olive oil,tamari
title: Spicy Tasty French Onion Dip
ingredients: 1/2 lb canadian bacon | 2 tablespoons mustard oil | 1 beef bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1 teaspoon tamari | 1 can red chilies, drained | extra virgin olive oil, for drizzling
instructions: Cut the bacon in half and fry in a small frying pan until crisp.  Set aside and chop.  Brown the onion in the mustard oil.  Remove the onions from the pan.  Heat the reserved mustard oil in the pan.  Add the beef liquid a bouillon cube dissolved in the tamari, drained green chilies, and diced bacon.  Simmer, uncovered for 10 minutes, or until liquid is reduced by half.  Dippers, mix with a potato masher and serve with a dollop of sour cream or creme fraiche on top.

title: Chili Stock (Habanero Hot Sauce)
ingredients: 2 habanero peppers ( or more ) | 1 quart vegetable stock or 1 quart chicken stock
instructions: Peel the habanero, and break it into one inch pieces.  Heat a large saucepan over medium high heat, and boil the chilies until softened, about 2 minutes.  You may cook them in a spice mill, they will take on a more intense flavor if left whole.  Drain the chilies, and stir them back into the hot pan.  Stir in the stock, bring to a boil, and boil rapidly, uncovered, for 20, or more minutes.  The longer the stock simmers, the thicker it becomes.  The chilies will melt.  Ladle into warm soup plates, and serve with hot bread.  The chili will keep for 2 weeks in the freezer, and the liquid will become sour.

title: Japanese-Style Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 lb rice noodles ( i normally use the japanese brown rice noodles, but regular white rice noodles can be used if you like ) | 1 can green lentils
instructions: Soak dried lentils for at least half an hour before using and wash thoroughly.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  In the meantime, bring a large pot of water to a boil.  When boiling, add the lentils and if frozen solid, let them thaw completely.  Once the water has come to boil, add the rice noodles and cook until tender.  Drain the noodles very well and place in a large bowl or on a platter.  Add the cooked noodles and any other ingredients of your choice and toss well.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,jalapeno pepper serrano,rice paper,salt black pepper,iceberg lettuce,beef sirloin steak
title: Steak Rolls With Vietnamese Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/3 lb boneless beef sirloin steak, sliced to 1/3 inch wide | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 cup thinly sliced iceberg lettuce | 1 jalapeno pepper, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced | 3 ounces rice rice vermicelli | 4 sheets rice paper | 6 tablespoons rice noodles, steamed
instructions: Using 1/3 pound of beef at a time, slice diagonally across grain into very thin slices.  Season both sides of the steak with salt and pepper.  Divide about 1/4 cup of the lettuce, jalapeno, and sliced beef evenly among the 4 sheets of rice paper.  Cover with another rice paper and press the rice paper sheets with your fingers to moisten.  Spread about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the dipping sauce evenly on one side of each rice paper sheet, then top with the remaining lettuce, jalapeno, and beef mixture.  Roll up the sheets of rice paper tightly and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes.  To serve, cut stack of rice paper and arrange on a large platter.

title: Halibut in Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 halibut fillets, with skin | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 4 roma tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 220 degrees centigrade.  Brush olive oil over halibut.  Place halibut on a tray and bake for 5 - 6 minutes.  Serve halibut with sliced roma tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: pizza crust,cardamom powder,scotch bonnet pepper,vegetable oil,white potato,rotel tomato
title: Tacos Rojas (Chilean Grilled Potatoes)
ingredients: 3 cups vegetable oil for frying, or as needed | 4 white potatoes, quartered | 4 scotch bonnet peppers, minced | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom powder | 1 can rotel tomatoes | 1 prepared pizza crust
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly.  Cook potatoes in hot oil until golden brown on all sides, 5 to 10 minutes.  Drain and cool slightly on paper towels.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Stir scotch bonnet pepper, cardamom powder, ro tel tomatoes into fries.  Arrange fries on a baking sheet.  Cut pizza crust in half, and bake in the preheated oven until crust is golden brown, about 20 minutes.

title: Gourmet Shrimp
ingredients: 4 lbs raw large shrimp | 4 quarts water
instructions: Preheat oven to 475°.  If the shrimp are large, remove the heads/tails too.  Toss together the shrimp heads with the water well and place in a large oven dish in a single layer without touching.  Drizzle them generously with olive oil.  Bake, uncovered, for about 30 minutes.  Serve immediately.

title: Rhubarb Beef Roast With Amaretto Honey
ingredients: 2 kg rhubarb, washed, trimmed and cut into 2cm slices | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1 kg beef tenderloin | 4 tablespoons icing sugar | 300 ml good amaretto or 300 ml good honey | 2 -3 tablespoons horseradish, drained
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180c degrees.  Place rhubarb and 2 tbsp of the sesame seeds onto a roasting tray.  Place under the grill and cook until softened, about 10 minutes.  Take from grill and leave in the oven for 10 to 20 minutes, or until the rhubarb is just tender.  Take out from oven and set aside, leaving the beef in the pan.  Remove the remaining sesame seeds from the tray and roughly chop.  Put remaining sesame seeds into a microwave safe bowl and cook in microwave on high power for 20 to 30 seconds or until dark brown and fragrant, turning the bowl as needed.  Cool slightly and then put in a bowl.  Turn the beef in the sesame seeds and roast for 15 to 20 minutes, turning the beef every five minutes, until beef is brown, the internal temperature is 140c / 155f / gas remove beef from the grill and rest for 5 m 10 minutes.  Remove the beef from the bones and discard any visible fat.  Shred the beef and return the beef to the bones.  Pour the amaretto or honey into a clean bowl to mix well and add about 300ml of the honey with 100ml of the beef drippings.  Mix until well combined and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper.  Spoon the sauce over the meat and serve with the remaining sauce in the fridge.  Serve.

title: Sausage and Broccoli with Balsamic Glaze
ingredients: 1 package italian sausage links | 2 bunches fresh broccoli, cut into 1 to 1 1/2-inch pieces | 1/4 cup butter | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 cup thinly sliced jicama | 1 pound fresh broccoli, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Brown sausage slices in a large skillet.  Transfer sausage to a plate.

Random Ingredients: italian turkey sausage link,beef sirloin steak,creme fraiche,tortilla chip,oil,maple syrup,chervil,french vermouth
title: Sausage and Beef Nachos With Smokey Maple Sauce
ingredients: 4 ounces dry french vermouth or 4 ounces dry white vermouth | 1/2 lb hot fully trimmed boneless beef top sirloin steak, sliced very thin | 3/4 lb hot italian turkey sausage link, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 3/4 cup crème fraîche or 3/4 cup sour cream | 1 tablespoon oil ( olive or canola ) | 1 large tortilla chips ( if you get those ) | 1/4 cup fresh chervil ( or 2 tsp dried chervil flakes ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh italian basil or 2 tsp dried basil leaves
instructions: In a small bowl, mix all the sauces.  Set aside.  Heat a large nonstick sauté pan over medium high heat, add the oil, and swirl it around to coat the base.  When the pan is hot, add the sausage slices, season with salt and pepper, and sear on all sides, moving them around so they don't stick.  If the sausages have casings, cut them into 1” lengths.  Remove from the pan.  Set the pan over high heat, add the oil and swirl it around.  Add the sauce, reduce heat to medium, and cook, stirring periodically, for 5 minutes.  If using sour cream, stir in just until heated through.  Lay the chips on a plate and pile the sausages and beef on top, add lettuce.  Add the cherryvil flakes and italian herbs.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pasilla chile,amarula cream liqueur,fine sea salt,snail
title: Pepper Jelly
ingredients: 1 jar dried whole-pint jars dried sweet peppers ( arbol ) | 6 quarts cleaned snails | 12 ounces amaranula cream liqueur | 1 1/2 teaspoons fine sea salt
instructions: Note, it will make a small hole in the neck opening of the jelly and create a pouch for the juices and heat.  Pour the sauce into a large pot, making sure the peppers are totally submerged.  Add enough water to cover the peppers by around 3 to 4 inches, bring to a boil, lower heat, and simmer 20 to 25 minutes, until the peppers are easily pierced with a sharp knife.  Remove stems and seeds, reserving peppers.  Remove all meat from shells, but leave enough skin on shells so that a jelly can be formed while the meat is still warm.  Place the peppers in a large stainless steel pot over a medium heat.  Pour in about 3 to 4 quarts of the amaranula cream liqueur and bring to a simmer.  Add the fine sea salt, stirring to make sure the salt dissolves.  Stir in the pepper juice and reserved pepper skin.  Place the jars in a large sealable canning kettle.  Fill with enough water to reach 3 to 4 inches above the tops of the jars.  Bring to a boil, lower the heat, and simmer 25 minutes, until all the liquid in the kettle has been absorbed.  Drain the jars and rinse with cold water.  Pack the pepper jelly into the lids and process for about 5 minutes on high, until the jelly has turned a uniform color.  Ladle the jelly into clean hot pint jars, filling to within 1 1/2 inches of the insides.  Wipe rims with a clean damp cloth, and seal with new plastic lids and rings.  Process for 10 minutes.  Remove the jars from the canner and place on a cloth covered rimmed baking sheet to cool.  Once cool, store in a cool place until at least 1 year before using.

title: Cake of Kiss
ingredients: 1/2 cup biscuit | 2 garlic cloves, peeled | 1 cup malibu rum | 1/4 lb of shredded cheese ravioli | 1/4 lb kombu or 1/4 lb other dark liquor
instructions: Crush the biscuit by squeezing it all over with your fingers.  Place crushed biscuit on a plate, cover with plastic wrap and set aside.  Crush the garlic.  In a mixing bowl.  Pour malibu rum over crushed biscuit.  Use hands to mix all ingredients, being sure the malibu is well distributed throughout the mix.  Use a wooden spoon to spread all ingredients evenly.  Place the biscuit on a serving plate, garnish with the kombu or other dark liquor, and serve with toothpicks.

title: Eggnog Coffee Sandwich
ingredients: 1 container dry eggnog | 1/4 cup chopped pecans or 1/4 cup walnuts | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon prepared coffee | 2 teaspoons mirin | 2 hard-cooked eggs, sliced in four quarters
instructions: Mix the eggnog, nuts, turmeric, cinnamon, onion salt, coffee and mirin together for several minutes.  Strain into a bowl.  Add the boiled egg quarters and serve.

title: Vietnamese Golden Syrup
ingredients: 1/2 cup nam pla | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 1 tablespoon adobo seasoning | 1 serrano pepper, minced
instructions: Combine nam pla, golden syrup, adobo seasoning and diced serrano pepper in a large pan.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until thickened, about 20 minutes, stirring frequently.  Remove from heat.

title: Gruyere Rice Cake (Gougere Lyonnais)
ingredients: 1 cup long-grain rice | 3 cups grated gruyere cheese | 20 chopped almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  In a baking dish, mix rice, cheese, almonds.  Bake uncovered 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vanilla pod,mustard,lemon peel,chicken breast half,black olive,pork,plain yogurt
title: Pork and Olive Kebabs
ingredients: 1 lb lean pork, cut into 1 `` cubes | 1 cup ripe black olives, pitted ( about 2 ounces ) | 6 tablespoons plain yogurt | 1 lemon peel, cut into 16 thin strips | 2 vanilla pod, split lengthwise | 1 teaspoon prepared mustard | 1 boneless pork tenderloin or 1 boneless skinless chicken breast half
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl until thoroughly combined.  Thread pork and vegetables on metal or soaked wooden skewers.  Broil or grill kebabs approximately 3 - 4 inches from heat or broil, turning, until heated through.  Serve with yogurt sauce.

title: Pork Sausage Cakes With Snow Peas and Chives
ingredients: 8 pork sausages | 1 cup snow peas, trimmed ( not fresh, but shelled ) | 2 tablespoons chives, chopped
instructions: Heat a pan until very hot.  Roll each sausagemeat between your palms until well coated.  Then, using a little water, gently pour over the sausages.  They should sizzle and be plump but not brown.  Cover and fry on a low heat until meat is browned, turning from time to time.  Takes about 20 minutes depending on the thickness of the sausages.  Check to make sure each veg gets some browned bits.  Stir in the snow peas and turn off the heat.  Leave to stand for 1 minute.  Serve topped with chives.  I like it with a bit of plain steamed veggies.  I've found that the sausage can be cooked up to 1 hour in advance and then placed on a hot serving platter and kept warm in a 250f oven for 1/2 hour.

title: Asparagi
ingredients: 1 -2 kg beef brisket, washed | 500 g yoghurt ( yoghurt can be used as well ) | fresh fruit, sliced | diced onion | diced meat
instructions: Trim most of the fat from the brisket.  Place brisket on a platter, and sprinkle with salt and yoghurt.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  On the next day, remove brisket from refrigerator and rinse in cold water.  Place in roasting pan.  Cover with foil and bake at 150c for 2 hours.  Remove from oven, turn heat down to 200c, and pour off juices and fat.  Cover roasting pan with foil and place in it a serving platter.  Diced onion and meat may be sprinkled all over for gravy.  Serve with fresh fruit.

title: Chipotle Orange Peppers
ingredients: 6 dried chipotle chiles, sliced | 5 1/2 tablespoons white sugar | 2 orange bell peppers, halved and seeded
instructions: Roast the dried chili peppers over a flame in a dry small skillet, until the skin is black, about 10 minutes.  Smoke the peppers until dry and very soft, about 30 minutes total.  Pulverize them in a blender or food processor, and set aside.  Heat the sugar in a large skillet over a medium heat until shimmering.  Add the peppers, and season with salt, if necessary.  Cook them until the skin is light brown, 3 to 5 minutes.  Pour in the chipotle puree, and continue cooking until syrupy, about 5 minutes.  Transfer the mixture to a bowl, and let cool completely.  Stuff the peppers with the syrupy pecan flavored oil, and decorate with orange smiles or other colorful sprouts.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,pie crust,yellow bell pepper,pecan half,funghi porcini
title: Funghi Tarts
ingredients: 1 baked prepared pie crust | 2 teaspoons mild curry powder | 1 small yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup chopped pecans | 1 package frozen funghi porcini, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Fit pie crust and flute edges of the pie crust.  Bake the pie crust in the preheated oven until golden and fragrant, about 10 minutes.  Cool.  Pour curry powder into a skillet and warm over medium heat.  Stir to blend.  Stir in the yellow bell pepper, pecans, and porcini.

title: Onion Rings
ingredients: 8 pearl onions, diced | 2 cups all-purpose flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook pearl onions in hot water until tender, about 5 minutes.  Drain, and allow to steam dry for a minute or two.  Dice onions and set aside.  Melt flour in a skillet over medium heat, and mix in onions with a fork.  Do not remove skillet from heat, because batter will separate.  Cook and stir gravy until thickened, about 5 minutes.  Mix onions in a bowl, and season with salt and pepper to taste.  Spoon gravy over flour mixture, and serve warm.

title: Beef and Bacon Wrapped Reindeer
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated leftover cooked meat-filled hard apple cider | 1/4 cup minced pecans | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup chutney | 1 flank steak | 1 slice of fresh prosciutto, finely diced | 1 flank steak | 2 slices prosciutto, finely diced | 1/4 lb pepperoni, thinly sliced | 1/4 lb hard apple cider, chilled | 3 ounces thinly sliced prosciutto, chopped
instructions: In small saucepan, combine all the ingredients and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly for about 5 minutes or until mixture is well blended.  Let cool slightly.  Cut the rind from the meat and place on a chopping board, cutting to 1/4 thick and leaving the meat partially intact.  Roll up the rind and tie the roll up.  Place all the meat rolls on a plate, cutting off the top layer, to keep it flat.  Slice the roll, including the ends, into 1/2 thick slices.

title: Homemade Celery
ingredients: 2 celery ribs, chopped ( about 1-1/2 lbs total ) | 1 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees.  In baking dish or roaster combine celery, pepper flakes, and salt and pepper.  Stir to blend.  Bake 45 minutes or until celery is soft and easily pierced with a fork.  Serve warm as an accompaniment to roast, stew, or soup.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,garlic powder,strawberry preserve,cheese,coriander,salsa,vanilla bean,tiger sauce
title: Ganda's Killer Wings
ingredients: 2 large tiger sauce pints strawberries in heavy syrup, sliced | 2 tablespoons sweet maraschino cherries | 1 3/4 teaspoons fresh coriander, minced | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla beans, split | 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder | 3 dashes hot decorator sauce ( your favourite brand ) | 1/4 cup cheese ( your favourite kind ) | 1/4 cup salsa ( your favourite brand )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f.

title: Chile-Pepito(Chile Tea)
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles | 1 tablespoon dried methi leaves ( fenugreek leaf ) | 4 teaspoons dried teabags ( commonly found in indian grocery stores )
instructions: Wearing rubber gloves, cut the poblano chiles lengthwise in half lengthwise, and remove and discard the seeds.  Cut the chiles into 1/4 inch wide strips.  Place the chiles in a bowl.  Sprinkle with the fenugreek and teabags.  Rub the chiles with the hands to coat evenly.  Let stand until softened and cooled for 10 minutes, then transfer the chiles to a mortar and pestle and grind until smooth.  Taste and add more fenugreek and teabags as desired.

title: Maple Shrimp over Rice
ingredients: 2 packages light ramen noodles, seasoning packet ( dry ) | 4 cups cooked white rice | 3/4 cup maple syrup | 1/2 cup simple syrup | 2 tablespoons ginger | 1 lb shrimp, cleaned and cleaned
instructions: In a 9x13 inch casserole dish, mix ramen noodles, rice and maple syrup.  Heat in low oven until noodles are dry and liquid is absorbed.  Pour over rice mix and let stand 5 minutes.  Place shrimps on top.  Bake in 300f oven 15 - 20 minutes.  Serve with simple syrup.

title: Steamed Clams in Bacon Shirake
ingredients: 20 clams in shell | 4 slices pancetta, cut into matchsticks | 3 teaspoons mirin ( japanese sweet wine )
instructions: Fill a medium pot with water and bring to a boil.  Place shirataki in a steamer over medium high heat.  Cover, and bring to a boil.  Once the water comes to a boil, carefully remove from heat and let sit 15 minutes.  Rinse the clams under cold water to remove the brine, and drain.  Heat a non stick skillet over medium heat, and add the pancetta slices.  Cook 5 minutes, stirring constantly.  Remove pancetta, reserving 1 tablespoon of bacon drippings.  Pour 1 teaspoon of flour into the hot skillet, and add clam juice.  Cook, stirring to coat, until bubbles form around the edge of the pan.  Then, shake the pan so that clam juice coats the bottom and sides of the steamed shirake.  Pour some of the clams into the pan with the shrimp, and serve.

title: Beef and Potato Croquettes
ingredients: 3/4 lb fresh medium-sliced filet of beef | 3 lbs new potatoes or 3 lbs red potatoes | 3 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Boil potatoes and cut in half.  Boil them well until half cooked.  Remove potatoes from pan and put to one side to cool.  Meanwhile salt the beef very gently.  Cut into thin slices or strips.  Cut the potato strips or squares and place to one side under running water for 1 minute more.  Drain potatoes and place in a bowl of cold water.

title: Simple English Cucumber Salad - Microwave Version
ingredients: 1 cup cucumber, peeled | 1/4 - 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Using the microwave safe bowl that your microwave the cucumber in, combine all ingredients.  Microwave on high power 1 minute increments, stir, and continue until liquid is absorbed.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,chicken turkey,sauce,egg yolk,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Tagine Omelets
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 3/4 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs or 3/4 lb boneless skinless chicken breast | 2 egg yolks, lightly beaten | 1 teaspoon ground hot sauce | 3/4 teaspoon saffron mori garam masala or 3/4 teaspoon spice mix | 1 pinch ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Lightly spray inside of a 9x13 inch pan with cooking spray.  Cut chicken into 2 inch chunks.  Place in pan.  Mix egg yolks, sriracha and hot sauce.  Pour over chicken.  Sprinkle with spice mix.  Heat over medium low heat until chicken is just about cooked but still holding its shape, about 3 - 5 minutes.  Drizzle remaining egg mixture evenly over, sprinkle with sesame seeds.  Serve.  If you don't have 2 pans you can use 4 individual cooking pans that's 8x14 inches you can bake it right there you don't have to bake it and cook it at 375°f.  Just cook it at 375°f and it will be hot.  I don't put the pan in the oven, so the pan will just start to get hot.  Butter my 9x13 baking dish before my meal.

title: The Best Steak Sauce
ingredients: 2 bottles hot sauce | 2 bottles dry sherry
instructions: Stir hot and dry sherry together in a bowl until completely mixed.

title: Beef and Potatoes
ingredients: 2 large idaho potatoes, peeled | 1 tablespoon sherry ( not cooking wine ) | 1 can mixed beans sprouts ( drained ) | 1/3 cup currants ( optional ) | 1/3 cup sultana ( optional )
instructions: In saucepan, place potatoes and peas in enough cold water to cover.  Bring to boil.  Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender.  Drain, turn into a 2 quart baking dish and keep warm.  Preheat broiler.  In a small saucepan, combine sherry and beans sprouts and bring to simmer and heat for 5 minutes.  Pour over potatoes.  Sprinkle with raisins and sultanas.  Broil for 3 - 5 minutes or until hot.

title: Kythoni Uriyaki: Borscht
ingredients: 3 bunches savoy cabbage ( about 2-inch long ) | 2 bunches daikon radishes ( about 2-inch long ) | 1 can raspberries ( about 5 ounces ) or ( 12 ounce ) can blackberries ( about 5 ounces )
instructions: Separate the cabbage leaves, removing any large leaves.  Place 2 leaves in each of four soup bowls.  Cut radish lengthwise into 1/2 inch slices.  Divide radish slices among the 4 bowls.  Place 1 raspber or blackberry in each bowl.

title: Easy Strawberry Sauce
ingredients: 1 package frozen mixed berries ( strawberries, raspberries, blackberries, blackberries ) | 1/2 cup raspberry flavored vinegar or 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar
instructions: In a medium sauce pan add the strawberries, raspberries and vinegar.  Stir occasionally until berries are fully thawed.  Season to taste with salt or pepper.  Serve over hot cereal.

title: Baja Beef Rollups
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast, trimmed of most surface fat | 2 packages cream cheese, softened | 1/2 cup light mayonnaise ( can be reduced ) | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice
instructions: Cut roast into 5 slices, then cross slices into 3 wide pieces.  Starting with cream cheese, spread softened cream cheese over strips of roast, leaving a 1/4 inch border along edges of strips.  Starting at the long side, roll beef up into a cone shape.  Repeat with remaining roast slices.  Combine mayonnaise and lime juice in small bowl and pour over rolled beef.  Cover and refrigerate 15 minutes.  Preheat oven to 425 degrees.  Unwrap beef roll ups, and transfer to baking sheet with seam side down.  Bake 5 to 7 minutes, or until meat just reaches internal temperature of 140 degrees.  Allow to stand 5 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,arrowroot,mustard seed,graham cracker,italian breadcrumb,green apple,cream mushroom soup,black eyed pea
title: Babygirl's Pea and Apple Casserole
ingredients: 4 ounces fresh black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 4 ounces fresh green apples, peeled, cored, and cut into chunks | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | 2 teaspoons coriander powder | 1 teaspoon arrowroot | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup shredded italian style breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup dry italian seasoned breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Combine peas, apples, mustard seed, coriander, and arrowroot in a large bowl.

title: Sweet and Sour Bai Onions
ingredients: 24 white pearl onions | 3 tablespoons fish sauce, or as needed | 4 ounces kahlua ( asian-style coffee-flavored liqueur ) | 1 large bunch bok choy, leaves included to be shredded
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f.  Rinse the white pearl onions and place in a small baking dish.  Drizzle with fish sauce.  Bake, uncovered, in the preheated oven, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 20 minutes.  Stir the kahlua into the onions and simmer until thickened, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: palm sugar,salt black pepper,lime juice,extra beef,applesauce,ginger,farfalle pasta,purpose flour
title: Spicy Gingersnap
ingredients: 2 pounds extra-lean ground beef | 1 3/4 cups dried farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1/3 cup cold-pressed lime juice | 7 tablespoons unsweetened applesauce | 1 tablespoon palm sugar | salt and black pepper to taste | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced fresh ginger
instructions: Place beef in a large skillet over medium heat, breaking it apart with a fork.  Cook and stir until browned and crumbly, 10 to 15 minutes.  Drain all but 1 tablespoon drippings from skillet.  Stir farfalle pasta into beef mixture.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,cheddar cheese,honey,peppermint extract,tarragon,tomato green chilies
title: Tomato Salsa
ingredients: 4 tomatoes ( green or red, cut in halves if desired ) | 1/2 cup mild cheddar cheese | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar, divided | 1/4 cup honey | 1/4 teaspoon peppermint extract | 1 dash hot peppermint extract
instructions: Chop the tomatoes into 1/2 inch cubes.  Mix the tomatoes, cheese, 1 tablespoon vinegar, honey, peppermint extract, and hot peppermint extract.  Cover and chill in the refrigerator for about 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: herb,chinese five spice powder,lemon pepper,yellow mustard,red pepper flake
title: Herb and Spice Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup yellow mustard | 1/2 teaspoon mixed herbs | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon powdered lemons and pepper | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients.  Use as desired.

title: Bun Cha Ga (Thai Chili Paste)
ingredients: 1 cup thai fish sauce | 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Combine the fish sauce, corn syrup, and allspice in a small pot.  Bring mixture to a boil over medium high heat, stirring frequently, and then remove from heat.  Pour hot paste into a jar with a tight fitting lid, and shake to combine.

Random Ingredients: colby monterey jack cheese,mustard powder,cottage cheese,seasoning
title: Spicy  Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 package cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon dry mustard powder | 1 teaspoon seasoning | 2 cans refrigerated italian cheese blend
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Combine the first four ingredients in a bowl.  Stir in both cans of cheese.  Drop mixture by spoonfuls onto a sheet pan.  Bake for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Cheesy Baked Cornbread
ingredients: 2 cups bread, crumbs | 1/2 cup cornstarch | 1/2 cup ricotta | 3 teaspoons jeera powder ( or one and a half teaspoons of each of cumin powder, ginger powder and other herbs ) | 1/2 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Mix all ingredients well.  Grease a baking dish well.  On a lightly floured surface, pat dough with palms to make a 1/8 to 1/4 inch thick round.  Cut into squares, and place on the baking dish, spacing evenly.  Bake in the oven for 15 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: tamarind pulp,hard egg,taco sauce,soy sauce,allspice berry,bell pepper,salt cod fish,cream mushroom soup
title: Smoked Cod With Tamarind Sauce

instructions: To prepare sauce, mix all ingredients together in a blender or food processor until smooth, adding more sauce until desired consistency is reached.  Makes about 2 cups. instructions: Cook the green chilies in the wine in a sauce pan over medium heat for 30 seconds until the chilies are just heated through.  Transfer the chilies to a bowl and add 1/4 cup of the green chilies.  In another bowl, mix the lentils and lentils with the green chilies.  Place a baking pan on the broiler pan and grease it with some of the melted butter, or spray a sheet of wax paper with olive oil.  Place the salmon fillet on the baking rack and broil for 3 - 4 minutes until lightly browned and slightly crisp.  Place fish on a serving plate.  Spoon the lentil mixture over the fish and sprinkle with minced pecans.

title: Vermicelli Soup
ingredients: 1/2 kg cauliflower, separated into florets | 3 small carrots, sliced | 8 ounces vermicelli, broken into short lengths | 400 g chick-peas, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, chopped | 6 -7 pinches cayenne powder
instructions: Place all the ingredients on low heat in a large pan.  Cook until the vegetables are tender and the chickpeas hot.  Cool and refrigerate until ready to serve.  Serve with fresh pulao bread to dip in the hot soup.

title: Gorgonzola With Goat Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb goat meat, chopped into 1-inch pieces | 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar | 1/4 cup half-and-half | fresh parsley sprig ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Place the goat meat in a nonmetal casserole.  Sprinkle with rice wine vinegar and half and half.  Cover and bake in a 350 degree oven for 1 hour, stirring and basting once or twice.  Garnish with fresh parsley if desired.

title: Mexi-Beef Dinner for a Crock Pot
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs boneless beef roast | 1 jar picante sauce ( i use pace picante-style pace picante sauce ) | 2 cans pea ( the fresh peas are best ) | 8 slices boiled ham, about 2-1/2 inch thick | 12 -14 stuffed olives (, sliced or chopped ) | 2 -3 cups savoy cabbage ( or other green cabbage ) | chopped fresh cilantro ( optional ) | dry roasted peanuts, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Trim excess fat from roast.  Slice roast on the bias into 1/4 inch slices, if necessary.  Layer meat, picante sauce, peas, ham, cabbage, and chopped olives in the crock pot.  Cook on low for 6 hours or high for 3 to 4 hours.  Remove meat and stir in chopped cilantro and optional peanuts.  Note, for a vegetarian meal omit the ham and cabbage.

title: Ginger Beer for Bread Machine
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry vermouth | 6 cups bread flour | 2 tablespoons lime juice, or as needed | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground ginger root | 1 lime, sliced into rounds
instructions: Mash vermouth into dry vermouth using a mortar and pestle.  Place flour, lime juice, and ginger into the pan of the bread machine in the order recommended by the manufacturer.  Select the dough cycle.

title: Paneer Powder
ingredients: 500 g unsweetened chocolate masala ( known as one of those little pieces of `` chocolate '' ) | 5 liters good quality cocoa ( known as one of those little pieces of `` cocoa '' ) | 5 tablespoons coriander powder
instructions: Take the masala powder in a large pot.  Pour the 4 liters of cocoa and the 2 tablespoons of coriander powder into the pot.  Boil for a few minutes and remove from heat.  Now grind to a fine powder using a coarse grinder/blender/blender or spice mill.  Store in an airtight container.  Enjoy the lukewarm cocoa powder.

title: Frozen Coffee Beans - Chillies Espresso
ingredients: 3 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 tablespoon chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 200 g strong coffee beans
instructions: Place all ingredients in a pan and stir until sugar dissolves and bean is heated through.  If using fresh chillies eat them immediately.

title: Tunisian Turnip Salad (Julia Child)
ingredients: 2 small turnips, peeled and cut into wedges | 2 leeks, white and light green parts only, finely chopped | 12 ounces canned anchovy fillets, drained | 1/4 cup pomegranate seeds ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.

Random Ingredients: brown gravy mix,green cardamom pod,green bean
title: Crock Pot Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb green beans, trimmed | 1 envelope brown gravy mix ( dry, envelope ) | 1 green cardamom pod, crushed ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock pot.  Cook on low for 7 - 10 hours, or high for 4 - 5 hours.  If beans start to dry out before end of cooking time, cook on high for 2 hours or on low for 5 hours.

title: Kerry's Indian Oven Green Chips
ingredients: 6 -7 medium potatoes, sliced | 2 1/4 cups dried cranberries | 1 -5 green chili pepper ( depending on size of chilies ) | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: Layer potatoes in a shallow pan.  Sprinkle with salt and bake in a 400°f oven until tender.  Remove and chop fine, then add other ingredients and stir.  Enjoy.

title: Prawn Salad With Warm Peanut Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 150 g large prawns, shelled deveined ( fresh or raw ) | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon peanut butter | 1 tablespoon brown onion | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1/2 teaspoon fennel, finely chopped | 1/4 cup roasted peanuts ( chopped )
instructions: Dry the prawns with paper towels to dry and slice.  Mash the mayo and peanut butter with half the reserved sauce ingredients and stir until well combined, then combine with the prawns and chilli and stir well.  Serve at room temperature or cover and chill for up to 6 hours before serving.

title: Sauce for Crab or Baked Beans (Chilli Beans)
ingredients: 1 can chili beans, drained | 1 tablespoon chopped scallion | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 2 teaspoons grated lemons or 2 teaspoons lime rind, grated
instructions: Heat your grill to hot.  Combine chili beans, scallions, and grand marnier in a bowl.

title: Quick Fruit Risotto (Risotto)
ingredients: 6 cups hot cooked arborio rice or 6 cups risotto rice | 2 cans fruit cocktail & juice cocktail | 4 ounces dried farfalle pasta
instructions: Cook arborio rice as directed on package.  Drain and cool.  Cover and refrigerate.  Remove rice from refrigerator and mix with fruit cocktail.  Cook pasta as directed on box.  Add 1/4 cup hot rice to pasta and mix well.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: green taco sauce,greek yogurt,pepperoncini pepper,olive brine,grain mustard,coriander powder
title: Greek "Creamy Green Sauce" Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons olive brine | 2 tablespoons green taco sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 3/4 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon pepperoncini pepper | 1/3 cup green taco sauce
instructions: Whisk olive brine, taco sauce, coriander powder and greek yogurt to mix.  Refrigerate until flavors combine.  Stir in pepperoncini pepper.  Serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: ginger,tomato,monterey jack pepper cheese,peanut butter,shallot,ham,thai red curry paste,apricot preserve
title: Pampered Chef McFalafel
ingredients: 1 large shallot, sliced | ginger | 1 lb minced ham | 3 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 2 cups monterey jack pepper cheese, grated | 1 cup apricot preserves | 4 medium tomatoes, wedged | 4 tablespoons peanut butter
instructions: Cut slits in ham and set apart.  Spoon shallot and some grated ginger into slits.  Add a handful at a time brown ham until golden.  Add a second handful of shallots and another handful of ginger.  Continue until all of the shallots have been browned.  Add red curry paste and cook until fragrant.  Add the remaining ingredients.  Reduce heat to simmer and cook for 10 - 15 min. , stirring occasionally.  Garnish with a few fresh basil if desired.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,seasoning salt,coconut milk,chicken broth,fava bean,crispix cereal,sumac
title: Falafel with a Sweet Twist
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 3/4 cup diced fava beans, cooked | 1/3 cup coconut milk | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 can chicken broth | 3 cups crispix cereal ( kelloggs is one brand ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon accent seasoning salt
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, place in a loaf pan, sprinkle with accent or bread crumbs, broil until browned and bubbly.  Cut into small slices and enjoy.

title: Chilean Cod
ingredients: 1/4 cup kosher salt | 3 lbs medium thick skin-on cod | 2 cups sugar | 2 tablespoons chopped scallions
instructions: Place salt in a shallow pan.  Add the cod, coating well.  Allow to sit for about 10 minutes, or until the salt is absorbed.  Transfer the salt to a plate.  Dry the fish, cover with water, and refrigerate for 48 hours.  Drain the fish when cool.  Combine the sugar and the scallions in a medium bowl until the salt dissolves completely, then add the cod.  Mix well and refrigerate for 2 days or until ready to use.  You can do this the night before and refrigerate.  You can do this the day before and bring back to room temperature just before serving.  Cook the cod, rinse, and pat dry with paper towels.  Place cod on a broiler pan.  Broil 4 inches from the heat about 6 minutes on each side, until golden brown.  Serve with white rice.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,kosher salt,celery,kale,self rising flour,allspice
title: Jamaican Corned Beef With Kale and Chili Salt
ingredients: 4 lbs kale, washed and chopped ( about 8 cups ) | 1/4 cup self-rising flour | 2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1/8 teaspoon ground allspice | 2/3 cup kosher salt | 1/2 cup minced celery | 1 tablespoon finely chopped dried red chili pepper ( such as hot red pepper flakes )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees.  Arrange kale in a large roasting pan and place in the oven.  Bake until well browned, about 1 1/2 hours.  Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, combine the flour, salt, allspice, celery, and hot pepper flakes.  Add the kale to the flour mixture and toss to coat.  Pour kale mixture onto the kale mixture in the roasting pan.  Sprinkle the top with the kosher salt.  Bake until heated through, about 35 minutes.

title: Barley and Walnut Raita
ingredients: 2 ounces pearl barley ( yellow ) | 1/2 ounce galangal ( sliced ) | 2 teaspoons oil | 2 slices provolone cheese | 2 tablespoons walnuts ( coarsely chopped )
instructions: In a food processor put the barley and 1/2 ozs of the galangal.  Pulse for 20 seconds or so until the barley and galangal are finely minced.  Add the remaining oil in a thin, sharp motion.  Tear the provolone cheese along the diagonal and break it into small pieces.  Transfer to a plate and stir in the walnuts.  Pour into a bowl and sprinkle with the cheese and walnut bits, tossing lightly.  Serve immediately as an accompaniment to stews.

title: Gordita
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1 bunch parsley leaves, with stems | 4 green cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: Prepare taco seasoning package according to package instructions.  Combine parsley, green cardamom pods and taco seasoning package in an electric blender or food processor.  Blend on high speed until parsley stems are chopped and spices are chopped.  Add minced meat of choice, and process until the mixture is completely smooth.  Store in an airtight container.  Taste before using, and adjust seasoning as needed.

title: Fresh Plum Tomatoes
ingredients: 3 pints pints fresh plum tomatoes, sliced 1/4-inch thick
instructions: Preparation, arrange each tomato in the center of a large flat piece of waxed paper with some of the tomato slice around it.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Roll the paper around the edge so tautly the tomatoes can breath.  They will look slightly wrinkled in places.  The paper will be used when tomatoes are added to hot water.  Set a rack in a shallow pan.  Pour enough water into the pan to come half way up the side of the tomatoes.  Simmer the tomatoes over moderate heat, occasionally stirring, until they begin to soften a bit and start to soften, about 10 minutes.  Take the tomatoes out of the pan with a slotted spoon.  Cool at least 10 minutes, and keep them warm wrapped in foil.  Skim the excess fat off the surface of the cooking liquid.  Serve warm, generously topped with parsley flakes.  Note, if using fresh tomatoes, simmer them in a small amount of water with a bit of salt until soft and plump, about 15 minutes total.  Use caution when using frozen plum tomatoes.

title: Ginjal Ka Salatasi
ingredients: 1 beef shank | 8 purple potatoes, cut 1/4-inch thick | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 large lime, cut into wedges | 1/4 cup slivered almonds, or as desired
instructions: Place the shank in a deep pot and cover with salted water.

title: Mexican Prawns
ingredients: 500 g prawns | 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken bouillon cubes | 1 can chopped tomatoes with green chilies | 2 slices prosciutto
instructions: Shell prawns.  Rinse with cold water and pat dry.  Place prawns in a bowl and cover with water.  Sprinkle the bouillon over.  Leave for 15 minutes at room temperature, drain.  Remove shells.  Cut into 1cm cubes.  Heat a frying pan, add prawns and cook slowly until they turn pink and changed colour, stirring occasionally.  Add tomatoes and return to heat.  Reduce heat, add prosciutto and cook for 2 minutes.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,ricotta cheese,jalapeno,potato starch,water chestnut,pimento olive,beef bouillon granule
title: Momma's Beef Tenderloin With Potato Broth and Green Beans
ingredients: 3 lbs beef tenderloin or 3 lbs sirloin steaks | 1 can diced tomatoes with jalapenos | 1 container ricotta cheese | 12 slices jalapenos | 1 can water chestnuts | 3 teaspoons beef bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon potato starch
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Rub meat with beef granules.  Place in broiler pan with tomatoes, water chestnuts, and pimento stuffed olives.  Broil at high heat for 5 minutes per side, or until desired doneness, and juices run clear when center of meat is just slightly pink on the outside.  This can be served immediately or refrigerate until needed.  This is delicious served with a nice fresh salad of your choosing.  It is also a great served with noodles tossed with red pepper flakes or green beans.

Random Ingredients: red chile pepper,soya sauce,sun tomato oil,edible silver foil
title: Spicy Tomato and Chilli Tea
ingredients: 6 fluid ounces soya sauce | 2 fluid ounces sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and finely chopped | 2 red chile peppers, finely chopped | 1 package edible silver foil or other edible silver foil
instructions: Place the soya sauce, sun dried tomatoes and red chile peppers in a medium saucepan.  Over medium low heat, heat the soya and sun dried tomatoes to a rapid boil.  Pour the soya sauce into a saucepan and cook for 3 to 5 minutes.  Serve immediately or wrap in a piece of silver foil.

title: Sarra's Mexican Pizza
ingredients: 1 cup chunky salsa | 1 1/2 cups plain flour | 1 teaspoon oregano
instructions: Sift flour and oregano into a bowl and combine well.  Use your fingers to rub flour, it will be sticky.  Cover and leave somewhere cool overnight.  Preheat oven in a moderate oven, 190 degrees celsius.  Pour the batter into a well oiled 12 x 10 pan.  Roll up the dough, slice into circles, or put them on a tray and bake for 30 minutes, until golden brown.  Allow to cool then slice & serve.

title: Nori Rolled Beef Slices
ingredients: 1 ounce self-raising flour | 4 ounces extra lean ground beef | 4 -5 tablespoons dried cherries | 5 sheets nori, seaweed cases | 1 celery rib, finely chopped
instructions: Prepare the beef by combining all the ingredients until well combined and the mixture forms clumps.  Using a sharp knife and a rolling pin, cut the mixture into 12 even sized fingers.  Make sure all the fingers are coated well place onto a clean tea towel covered chopping board and sit while making the roll.  Roll each finger until the mixture is about 15cm in length.  Wrap each biscuit half in a nori lining paper.  Place onto a baking tray and cook approximately 15 minutes until the rolls are golden in colour.

title: Tomato Pastry for Pyrex
ingredients: 1 sheet phyllo pastry | 3 tablespoons tomato juice | 1/2 teaspoon rosemary
instructions: On a nonstick baking sheet, roll out the bottom sheet of pastry to the size you are going to brush on the pastry with.  Brush the exposed dough with some olive or butter.  Lay half the sheet of pastry across the bottom sheet on top of one of the other sheets.  Brush the exposed pastry with olive or butter.  Layer the tomato paste on top of the previous two sheets, sprinkling it with rosemary.  Using a fork, lightly poke with the sharp edge of the pastry for a few small cuts.  Make a few cuts, and then drizzle with the remaining olive or butter.  Bake in a 325 degree oven until golden, about 30 minutes.

title: Lobster Thermidor
ingredients:
18 ounces cooked lobsters | 4 -6 tablespoons dabo-flavored st.
    - louis pour or 4 -6 tablespoons tobasco sauce | 1 teaspoon chopped green chili | 1/2 teaspoon chopped epazote
instructions: Heat grill to high.  Arrange all ingredients in a food process and blend until smooth.  Pour into a serving platter and serve.

title: Caramelized French Bread With Black Beans, Rosemary & Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 6 slices bread | 3 tablespoons chocolate syrup | 7 ounces fresh bean sprouts | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried rosemary | 7 ounces black beans, drained
instructions: Put 6 slices bread on a baking paper lined tray.  Heat bbq/broiler.  Toast on both sides.  Spread with 1 tablespoons chocolate syrup.  Top with sprouts, beans & rosemary.  Top with remaining slices of toast.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees.  In a skillet, cook chopped bacon until crisp.

title: Simple Pesto Cookies

instructions: In a small bowl, stir all the ingredients.  Shape into a ball and roll in the icing sugar, then refrigerate until needed.

title: Sweet and Sour Noodles

instructions: In a bowl, stir pareils until most of the salt is absorbed.  Stir in yellow onion and rice noodles.  Pour in the dashi and enough water to cover the noodles.

title: Oriental Beef and Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin tip roast | 6 baby carrots | 12 roasted poblano chiles | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1/2 cup oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped shallots or 1 tablespoon regular onion
instructions: Brown beef in a large skillet and place in crockpot.  Combine remaining ingredients and pour over meat.  Cook on low for 8 - 10 hours.  Serve over hot rice with plenty of shredded carrots and onions.  Note, prep time does not include marinating time.

title: Cannellini Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 package dry ranch dressing mix
instructions: Mix both cans of beans together in a saucepan over medium heat.  Cook and stir until heated through and coated with the dressing mix.

title: Chef John's Easy Crab Balls
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh lump crabmeat, picked over | 1 1/4 cups soymilk | 1 tablespoon fennel seed
instructions: Stir crabmeat with milk and fennel seeds until the mix is well combined.  Form into balls about one inch in diameter.  Heat a large, heavy skillet over medium low heat.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,greek yogurt,safflower oil,bulgur,chocolate,mango,green chili pepper,ricotta cheese
title: Mexican-Baked Yogurt Cake
ingredients: 250 g yogurt, greek style | 1/2 cup bulgar or 1/2 cup couscous | 200 g ricotta cheese, lowfat | 100 g greek yogurt | 3/4 teaspoon safflower oil | 2 -3 green chili peppers | 1 teaspoon sweetened chocolate | 1/4 cup italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200°c.  Place the yoghurt into a bowl and mix in the bulgur.  Add the safflower oil and mix well.  Slice the peppers in half and put in a pan of boiling water.  When it begins to simmer add the chili, stir well and leave for approximately 5 minutes.  Drain and rinse with cold water and let cool a little.  Drain the peppers and put through blender or food processor.  Add the greek yoghurt to this, mix well and leave to cool, stirring often.  In a bowl mix together the ricotta cheese, 3/4 cup of the greek yoghurt, and sour cream.  Stir into the yoghurt mixture a little at a time until it is well blended.  Add the chocolate, mix well well and then pour into a greased and lightly floured 10 spring form cake tin or round cake tin.  Bake in the centre of the pre heated oven for approximately 40 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the cake feels slightly springy towards the touch.  Allow to cool.

title: Moroccan Spiced Peanut Butter Spread

instructions: Place all ingredients in medium bowl.  Beat with mixer for 15 to 20 seconds on medium speed.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: apple,lamb,monterey jack cheese,kosher salt,red grape,flax seed
title: Pine-On-A-Dish Lamb Burgers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground lamb | kosher salt | 1/2 cup flax seed | 2 cups red seedless grapes | 3 large apples, peeled, cored and cut into 1/2-inch chunks | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat grill to high.  In a large bowl, mix the lamb and 1/4 cup water.  Season with salt.  Form into 4 patties.  Grill on high for 4 minutes on each side, until internal meat thermometer reads 160 degrees.  Lower the heat to medium.  Meanwhile, spread flax seeds onto a plate.

title: Lettuce Wraps With Noodles, Pistachios, and Cheese
ingredients: 12 -14 ounces linguine ( about 1/4-1/3 of a box, to make it easier to work with when using ) | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1 carton low-fat ricotta cheese or ( 12 ounce ) carton low-fat yogurt | 1 jar prepared marinara sauce ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1/2 cup chopped pistachios or 1/2 cup walnut pieces | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground cardamom seed | fresh marinara sauce, garnish ( recipe follows ( see note below ) or your favorite marinara sauce, your choice ( see note below )
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions and drain.  While linguine cooks, prepare the rest of the ingredients.  Combine ricotta cheese and 1/2 cup prepared marinara sauce and mix well.  Taste and adjust seasonings and spread the mixture on the noodles.  Sprinkle pinches of pistachios over top of the noodles.  If desired, you may garnish with additional pistachios.  Note, you can prepare this on the stove top, if you like.  If necessary, refrigerate noodles several hours, or overnight.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted boiling water to a boil.  Add linguine and cook for about 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Collard Greens With Spicy Tea
ingredients: 1 lb collard greens | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon dried basil | 12 leaves fresh basil | 3 -4 ounces tequila or 3 -4 ounces cajun-style irish whiskey | 1 spanish onion, roughly chopped | 1 1/2 - 2 cups cheddar cheese, shredded ( i use more )
instructions: Wash first 6 leaves, trim of stems and slice crosswise into 1/4 pieces. .  Place in bowl and toss with herbs.  Let sit for about 1/2 hour.  Squeeze out excess liquid.  Place herbs in second bowl.  Dice the onion roughly, mix in thoroughly with greens and tea.  Season to taste with kosher salt.  Top with cheese and pepper, to taste.  Serve and enjoy.

title: Strawberry Surprise
ingredients: 2 bunches fresh strawberries, sliced | 2 poblano chiles, trimmed, seeded and thinly sliced ( wear gloves to prevent irritation when slicing ) | 1 cup sweet & smooth granulated cheese food | 1/4 cup packed palm sugar | 1/4 cup melted lard
instructions: Heat the grill to high and grill each tomato on an unlit ridged grill rack or on a cookie sheet.  Brush with lard or butter, if necessary.  Top with shredded cheese until melted.  Set aside.

title: Roasted Winter Squash and Butternut Potato Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs butternut squash ( in winter ) | 4 -5 medium yukon gold potatoes | 3 -4 dried chilies | 1 pinch asafoetida powder
instructions: Trim squash well.  Halve lengthwise and scoop out flesh without removing skins.  If you prefer, you can also roast the squash in a 400 degree oven until soft.  Chop flesh into bite size pieces.  Cut potatoes into 2 or 8 equal size chunks.  Pour water in a large bowl.  Add the butternut and potatoes, chiles and a pinch of asafoetida.  Let stand 15 - 30 minutes.  Stir once and again to mix.  Place half of the vegetables in the large bowl and mash well.  Return mashed mixture to saucepan and stir.  Place in oven and oven for about 15 more minutes, stirring constantly.  Variation, roasted potatoes can also be used as an ingredient in a cashew nut or peanut butter based peanut soup for an extra element of flavor.  This tastes best using canned peanut butter diluted in a little water when pureeing the soup.  If you want a thicker mixture, blend or puree a few potatoes, or puree them before adding to broth.

title: Spanish Chicken and Barley Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 8 ounces pearl barley | 1/3 cup sherry wine | 3 hard-boiled eggs, peeled & sliced
instructions: Preheat over to 375 degrees f.  Remove skin from chicken and cut into chunks.  Place in a baking dish with 2 cups water and chicken thighs.  Bake for 45 - 60 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and the liquid has absorbed some of the crust.  Meanwhile, place barley in saucepan & boil for around 15 minutes, until it has been covered and has absorbed all the water.  Drain & set aside.  Place sherry in a saucepan & bring to the boil.  Stir in the barley & heat through, about 5 - 10 minutes.  Add the eggs to barley mixture & stir until heated through.  Spoon over chicken & sprinkle with parsley.

title: The Madras Cape Malay
ingredients: 1 ounce margarine or 1 ounce butter | 9 cardamom seeds | 2 inches gingerroot, peeled of coarsely chopped
instructions: Break up the margarine with your hands until the mix is the consistency of fine breadcrumbs.  Spread the margarine out over a large tray and set aside.  Toast the cardamom seeds in a dry frying pan for 10 minutes until golden.  Crush the seeds, then add to the pan and cook, stirring, for about 3 minutes.  Add the ginger and cook until the ginger starts to turn brown, about 2 minutes.  Add the crushed cardamom and mix very well until evenly distributed.  Spread the mix over the margarine and let cool down slightly.  Transfer to a freezer bag and place in the freezer.  Keeps well in the freezer, but does not freeze.  Nb, if you make a lot of mix after about 15 minutes, stir at regular intervals.  Variation, if you use butter, add about 1 tablespoon of white sugar.  If you use butter, leave the almonds whole, but add 2 tablespoons of brown sugar to the mix, and then add 2 more tablespoons of white sugar.

Random Ingredients: active yeast,dark chocolate,artichoke heart,cream chicken soup,pita bread,cannellini bean,snow pea,chickpea flour
title: Chickpea, Artichoke & Chocolate Pizza
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups chickpea flour | 1 teaspoon active dry yeast | 3/4 cup sour cream | 1 envelope dried artichoke hearts | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can sliced italian dark chocolate, melted | 2 pita bread, patties
instructions: Place the chickpea flour and yeast in a large bowl and stir to combine.  Add the sour cream and mix until combined.  Stir in the cannellini beans, soup, and chocolate.  Mix until well blended.  Grease the inside of a large pizza pan.  Brush the inside of the pizza pan with butter.  Transfer the dough mixture to the pizza pan, and sprinkle with papette.  Set aside.  Preheat the oven to 500 degrees f.  Bake the pizza in the preheated oven for 12 to 15 minutes, or until crispy and brown.  Cut into wedges to serve.

title: Salsa Di Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups thinly sliced cremini mushrooms | 1 1/2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 cup chunky salsa | 1/2 cup white wine | 1/4 cup packed dark brown sugar | 1/8 inch ground cloves
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large nonstick pan over medium heat.  Add mushrooms, saute 4 to 5 minutes or until mushroom are tender.

title: Easy Low Calorie Spiced Beef
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cubed | 2 tablespoons icing sugar ( regular or coles ) | 1/2 cup splenda sugar substitute

title: Tatties with a Twist

instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil grate.  Spread each slice of lettuce with about 1 tablespoon of the cherries. title: Gloria's Homemade Sweet Onion Pepper

instructions: Wash bell peppers, remove top stem, and carefully remove some of the seeds from the pepper pods.  Place peppers in a large pan with enough water to cover. When peppers are soft but still holding their shape, remove all of the water and place the peppers in a large pan of cold water.  Turn the heat up to high, add onions to water, bring to a boil, and cook for 3 minutes.  Drain well.  Let stand 1 hour, then remove onions and place in a bowl to cool.

instructions: Mix all ingredients together except cheese in an oven proof dish and press the biscuits lightly.  Bake for 45 minutes in a preheated oven, 375 degrees f, 200ºc and 180ºc until cooked.

title: Broiled Halibut and Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 16 ounces halibut, cut into 4 even pieces | 4 ounces swiss cheese or 4 ounces provolone cheese, thinly sliced | 4 ounces swiss cheese or 4 ounces provolone cheese, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup chopped pimiento | 1 egg white | 1 jar chopped baby carrots, well drained
instructions: Place halibut on lightly oiled broiler pan.  Top with swiss cheese.  Broil til cheese is melted, and beginning to brown and lightly brown.  Remove from oven.  Meanwhile, in a small bowl, beat egg white to stiff peaks.  With a slotted spoon, remove top cheese from pan and coat halibut with egg white.  Sprinkle top of havarti with pimento and thinly slice swiss.  Place carrots on top of cheese.  Broil 3 - 5 minutes or until heated through.  Serve hot.

title: Lebanese Cherries
ingredients: 1 lb cherry, cleaned, dried, and stems removed | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs or 1 tablespoon fresh mixed herbs
instructions: Wash the cherries, remove any stems, and place them in a large, shallow, glass jar.  Add the remaining ingredients.  Cover with a lid or plastic wrap, and shake to coat.  Refrigerate, shaking the jar, for at least 1 week.

title: Sandy Zucchini Appetizer
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ghee | 2 tablespoons drained capers | 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1 lb zucchini, sliced or cut in 1/2 `` rounds
instructions: Dot with butter.  Bake at 425 degrees for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Chinese Peanut Butter and Egg Substitute Muffins
ingredients: 3/4 cup raw peanuts ( about, or use unsalted, unsalted, unsulfured, preferably unsalted, chopped ) | 1/4 cup egg substitute ( or soy protein substitution equivalent equivalent ) | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons five-spice powder, divided
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees.  Line 24 small muffin tins with paper liners.  In a food processor or blender, combine peanuts, egg substitute, mustard and 1/2 teaspoon of the five spice powder.

title: Langley's Easy Lasagna
ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles, cooked and drained | 6 eggs, beaten | 3/4 cup coconut cream | 1/2 cup sugar
instructions: Mix noodles, eggs, coconut cream, and sugar in a 9x9 pan.  Spread top with sauce, sprinkle with more sugar.  Bake at 450° for 10 minutes, or until cheese is melted and golden.  Let rest 15 minutes before cutting.

title: Chef Bud's Velveeta
ingredients: 1 package velveeta cheese, sliced | 3/4 cup coffee flavored liqueur
instructions: Cut velvetta into 1/2 cubes and put in a microwave safe bowl.  Heat in microwave on high for 2 minutes.  Add coffee liqueur.  Stir.

Random Ingredients: broth,jumbo shrimp,savory,pimiento,parsley,provolone cheese,beef sirloin steak,green bean
title: Beef With Pimientos and Green Beans
ingredients: 4 ounces sliced beef top sirloin steak or 4 ounces beef top round steak, 1/4 to 1/2 inch thick | 6 ounces fresh green beans, ends trimmed | 1/4 cup pimiento, sliced in half | 1/4 cup reduced sodium beef broth or 1/4 cup water | 1 1/4 teaspoons dried savory | 1 teaspoon provolone cheese or 1 teaspoon mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped parsley ( optional )
instructions: Trim meat of excess fat and tendons and cut into thin strips.  Place beef strips and beans in crockpot, arranging beef and beans in single layer.  Mix remaining ingredients and pour over beef and beans.  Cover and cook on low 4 to 5 hours or until meat and beans are cooked.  During last 30 minutes of cook time, sprinkle with parsley and serve.

title: Simple Beef Filet With Rigatoni
ingredients: 12 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef tenderloin, trimmed and cut into serving-sized chunks
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil.  If you don't have a thermometer, follow the package directions above and set it to the side.  Add the pasta and cook until just tender, but still firm, about 8 minutes.  Drain.  Meanwhile, heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Add the beef and saute 3 to 4 minutes, stirring frequently, until no longer pink.  Add the rigatoni and their cooking liquid and cook, stirring frequently, until it starts to thicken, about 2 minutes.  Season to taste with salt, fresh cracked black pepper and freshly ground black pepper.  Remove from heat and serve.

title: Portuguese Cream Sorbet
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk, chilled | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 1 tablespoon bonito flakes ( dried fish flakes ), optional ( optional )
instructions: Heat the soymilk to 140 c, but do not boil or it will curdle on the bottom of the pot.  Transfer to a mixing bowl.  Add the minced bonito flakes, if using, and mix well.  Cover and refrigerate until cold and firm.  The day before, stir well.  Cover and refrigerate until cold, at least 3 hours or overnight.  Use in stews, stews like stews made from pork or tofu.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf,madeira wine,bread crumb,almond extract,molasses,rotel tomato,orange
title: Cindy's Almond Coated Mozzarella
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried bread crumbs | 3/4 cup molasses ( white corn syrup ) | 1/4 cup finely diced orange rind | 1/4 cup prepared almond extract | 1 can rotel tomatoes, drained and rinsed | 1 bay leaf | 1 loaf unsliced country bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Lightly grease a jelly roll pan, line the bottom with parchment, grease lightly then remove crusts and wax or parchment from a bread loaf.

title: Mexican Linguine
ingredients: 1 lb linguine, your choice | 16 ounces cannellini beans, drained | 1 large mango, peeled and diced | 1 jar taco sauce | 1 1/2 cups cremini mushrooms, chopped | juice of one lime | 2 peaches, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Cook linguine, drain.  Simmer beans.  Mango dressing, mix all ingredients in a large bowl.  Toss with the cooked pasta and vegetables.  Serve on top of your favorite mexican meal.

Random Ingredients: garbanzo bean,plain flour,dill,applesauce,dark corn syrup,orange liqueur
title: Applesauce Fritters
ingredients: 500 g canned garbanzo beans | 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce | 1/2 cup dark corn syrup | 3 cups plain flour ( to be gluten free ) | 1/4 cup dill | 1 tablespoon orange liqueur ( optional )
instructions: Drain garbanzos and transfer to a large bowl.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well with a spatula.  If desired, dust flour mixture with icing sugar and then knead for 2 minutes.

title: Raw Pad Thai
ingredients: 2 cans red kidney beans | 2/3 cup raw macadamia nuts | 5 tablespoons peanuts, coarsely chopped, plus additional
instructions: Drain all but about a tablespoon of the red kidney beans from the cans or cans.  Transfer the beans and all its liquid to a food processor and puree.  Return the puree to the can with most of the reserved beans liquid.  Add the macadamia nuts and peanuts and pulse a few times until it is almost a paste.

title: Pumpkin Brulee
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pumpkin puree | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Lightly oil a 2 cup glass baking dish.  In a medium bowl, mix together pumpkin puree and brown sugar.

title: Asafetida Veggie Ball, No Dairy?
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cream cheese, room temperature | 1 clementine | 2 scallions, diced | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary or 3 teaspoons fresh rosemary, coarsely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional, but highly recommended ) | 1/2 cup water | pastrami ( optional ) or green prawns, cooked, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Cut the clementine in half lengthwise.  Remove the white part with a teaspoon.  Cut the two halves into sections about 1/2 inch thick.  Discard the hard core, which should be cut into sections about 1/2 inch long.  In a small pan, mix the cream cheese with the scallions, chopped dried rosemary or fresh rosemary, if using, and asafetida.  Place the water and asafetida in a small saucepan and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and add the pastrami.  Stir frequently until the asafoetida turns to liquid.  Then stir in the creamed cheese mixture, about 1 tablespoon at a time.  The mixture should be creamy and no visible pools of water.  You may have a very light, gooey mass of asafetida.  If not, add a little water or cream, if any, then the pastrami may have absorbed the liquid.  Transfer to individual serving bowls, covered with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.  To serve, run a knife around the edges of the bowl to loosen.  Serve immediately.

title: Tunisian Seasoning (For Fish, Chips or Roasted Apples)
ingredients: 5 tablespoons moroccan harissa ( tunisian seasoning ) | 2 tablespoons tandoori spices or 2 tablespoons roasted cumin seeds | 3 tablespoons ground dried italian seasoning
instructions: In a mortar and pestle crush the harissa.  Add the turkish spice or cumin and mix.  Add the dried italian seasoning or kosher salt, or add the dried italian seasoning.  Grind into a fine paste.  Wash your hands thoroughly and add them to a clean new bowl or bowl of a fish.  Sprinkle on more italian seasoning if you want to add more spice.

Random Ingredients: red chile,noodle,mushroom,avocado,hamburger patty,french green bean,garlic chive,cilantro
title: Noodle Burgers
ingredients: 1 bag frozen french-cut green beans | 2 hamburger patties | mushroom, sliced | garlic chives, chopped | cilantro, chopped | 4 slices cooked hamburger patty | 1/4 - 1/2 red chile, chopped | 1/4 semi-sweet avocado
instructions: Combine everything in a bowl except the meat.  Patties.  Grill for 5 minutes per side or until burgers are done and hamburgers are firm.  Serve on hamburger bun.  Top with a sprinkle of cilantro and a squirt of red pepper.  A sprinkle of black olives would also be delicious alongside.

title: Instant Pot Swedish White Bean and Peas (Firikaterrys)
ingredients: 2 cups white beans ( fresh or canned ) | 1 lb frozen peas, thawed | 6 tablespoons dark soya sauce
instructions: Drain the beans, put into the crockpot and pour in the remaining ingredients.  Cover, and cook on low for 4 - 6 hours.  Serve over steamed white rice.

title: Swiss Hazelnut Cheese Spread
ingredients: 100 g swiss cheese ( grated ) | 100 g hazelnuts ( blanched and roughly chopped ) | 2 -4 fresh sage leaves ( chopped & crushed )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, refrigerate for 1 - 2 hours or overnight.  Enjoy.

title: Traditional Irish Coffee
ingredients: 3 cups strong coffee | 3 tablespoons ground coffee, preferably freshly brewed | 7 tablespoons ground suet
instructions: Pour 3 cups strong coffee and 1 tablespoon of ground coffee into a 2 litre pan, heat gently without boiling.  When the coffee has warmed, stir in the suet, pour into small coffee cups to serve.

title: Avocado Cheese
ingredients: 6 -10 avocados - peeled, halved, seeded, and very coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons unsalted butter or margarine, melted
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat.  Add the chopped avocado and 1 tablespoon of butter and stir until the avocado has slightly softened, about 1 minute.  Remove from heat and stir in remaining 1 tablespoon of butter until melted.

Random Ingredients: demerara sugar,hot green chili pepper,feta cheese,milk,beef broth,papaya,season italian dressing
title: Hot Buttered Cottage Pudding
ingredients: 4 large firm ripe papayas | 1 1/4 lbs lean ground beef | 8 ounces feta cheese, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1/2 cup milk | 1 teaspoon seasoning italian dressing | 1 tablespoon demerara sugar | 2 tablespoons condensed beef broth
instructions: Trim the ends out of the papayas, removing the peel if desired, and then cut each in half lengthwise.  Slice off the tops and set the pitas in a cookie sheet, and place in cold oven to dry.  When done, remove from oven and set a side.  Put the beef in a large saucepan over medium high heat.  Saute until brown.  Add the chees and continue sauteing until cheese is melted.  Add the milk, italian dressing, demerara sugar and beef broth to the cheese and beef.  Cover and simmer approximately 30 minutes.  After 30 minutes, remove all of the papayas from the oven, and set aside to cool.  Transfer the meat mixture back to the pan and coat it with the papaya.  Cover and put on a preheated 300°f oven for 2 hours.  To serve, spoon the melted cheese over the papaya.

title: Canned Kidney Beans
ingredients: 2 cans kidney beans | 2 chili peppers, chopped | 1 ounce ground anise seed
instructions: Drain the kidney beans.  Pour everything into a medium sized pot.  Bring to boil over medium heat.  Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 1 hour.  Cool to room temperature.  Label, and store in the refridgerator at least 1 week, or longer.  Enjoy at your favorite time.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,ginger juice,banana,madeira wine,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Chicken Bananas, Madeira and Ginger
ingredients: 8 boneless skinless chicken thighs | cooking spray | 4 bananas, cut in half lengthwise ( about 1 cup total weight ) | 2 tablespoons madeira wine ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger juice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f.  Coat 2 large baking sheets with cooking spray.  Place half the chicken thighs in a medium bowl.  Repeat with the remaining chicken, making sure each is completely coated.  Combine banana pieces and madeira in a small bowl.  Reserve any remaining banana for another use.  Spray a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray and add the chicken.

title: Sausages and Eggs in Sultanas
ingredients: 2 ounces sultanas | 2 ounces hot italian sausage | 2 hard-boiled eggs, peeled | 4 tablespoons fat
instructions: Toast the sultanas in a dry frypan over medium heat until lightly golden.  Remove from the heat and cut into quarters.  Break the sausages into 1/2 inch slices, leaving them whole.  Place over a medium heat and fry, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes, or until crisp and slightly browned and cooked through.  Cut the eggs lengthways into quarters, carefully removing the yolks, and cut the whites into quarters now.  Place half of this in the centre of four warmed plates, cover with the fried sultanas, break the eggs into quarters and arrange them on top.  Sprinkle with half the hot fat and serve immediately with plenty of tomato ketchup.

title: Blue Dragon Cocktail
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces blue curacao | 2 ounces fresh speckled purslane, trimmed | 1 pound cooked chicken meat, shredded
instructions: Pour the curacao into a glass with ice cubes.  Float purslane at the top of the curacao, and add the chicken, and stir to coat.

title: Beef Jardiniera
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs fresh center cut center-cut beef brisket | 1 package yellow cake mix, prepared according to instructions ( i prefer jardiniera ) | 1 can pinto beans, undrained | 1/3 cup white breadcrumb | 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed
instructions:

Place the roast in the freezer for about an hour or until it has a nice amount of time to rest and get used to your dinner.  Remove it from the freezer and let it rest in there somewhere warm for about 1 hour.  Slice the brisket in desired thin slices, about 3/8 thick, and place it in greased crock pot.  Add enough bread crumbs to coat the top of the meat, i usually add about 3/4 cup of white crumbs to cover it lightly. Slice the meat in the desired slices, about 3/8 thick and serve with the hot meat and bread crumbs.
