title: Chinese Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger | 1 green pepper, finely chopped | 2 -3 large green peppers, finely chopped
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the peanut butter, oil, soy sauce, sugar and ginger.  Cover.

title: Almond Parsnips and Parsnips
ingredients: 8 large parsnips ( about 3 pounds ) | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 cup toasted and chopped almonds ( about 2 ounces ) | 1 teaspoon fine grain lemon zest | 2 tablespoons fresh minced fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat.  Add the parsnips and sprinkle with seasoned salt.  Cook, stirring, about 2 minutes or until just tender and slightly chewy.  Turn off heat.  Transfer to a large bowl and cool.  Peel and chop the parsnips into 1 inch pieces.  Add the almonds and lemon zest.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,ice,mango,orange bell pepper,miracle whip,wheat flour
title: Moroccan Style Salad
ingredients: 1 ripe mango, peeled and sliced | 1 orange bell pepper, cut into matchstick-sized strips | 1 romaine lettuce, washed and torn into bite-size pieces | 1/2 cup chopped fresh sweet onions or 1/2 cup finely chopped red onions | 1 cup unsifted whole wheat flour | 2 cups miracle whip or 2 cups miracle whip cream lite | 2 cups crushed ice
instructions: Combine all but the ice in a small bowl and stir in the ice.  Spoon 1/2 cup into each of 4 bowls, top with a dollop of cream cheese and a dollop of sour cream, and serve.

title: Grilled Beef Salpicao
ingredients: 1 sirloin, trimmed of any excess fat | 2 cups spring onions, cut in 3 inch pieces
instructions: Make an opening in the side of the steak and set aside.  Stir together the spring onions.  Cut the steak into bite size pieces, about 2 inches long.  Add the spring onions to a large resealable plastic bag with the salt.  Pound a few slices in the bag to make sure they are flat.  Add the steak pieces.  Squeeze out excess air.  Pierce the bag with a fork so that salt is evenly distributed.  Marinate in the refrigerator for 1 to 3 hours, shaking the bag every 10 to 15 minutes.  Heat a charcoal or gas grill to medium high heat.  Grill the meat for 10 minutes.

title: Veal, Apricot and Spinach Pasties
ingredients: 500 g ground veal | 1 cup unblanched white flour, plus extra | white flour, for rolling, to lightly dust pastry with | 1 tablespoon chopped chives | 1 1/4 tablespoons chopped fresh chives | 1 cup cooked pasta-style diced pepsi-spinachio peas | 1 cup cooked macaroni | 10 fresh spinach leaves, washed and trimmed | 1/2 ounce white flour, extra | 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed on paper towels
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c cut 1 pastry sheet from 25gms/4x3/4in thickness of pastry.  Combine veal and 3/4 cup flour and season with salt and pepper.  Rub in veal mixture until well combined.  Knead pastry dough onto a work surface and roll it out until about 5in across.  Transfer to a baking tray and make an indentation in the centre of the pastry with the back of your hands.  Repeat with the 1nd pastry sheet.  Place pastry on the tray, cover with a cloth and set aside for 10 minutes.  Use a knife to cut the pastry into 24 strips.  Make the pesto, place all the ingredients in a medium sized pan, cover with a lid or lid, bring to the boil and leave to simmer until the vegetables are cooked through.  Season to taste and cool down slightly.  To make pastry, dust a work surface with 1/2oz more flour and roll out 3/4 inch thick/1/8 thick of pastry.  Use a 2in round cutter to cut pastry into 24 squares.  Use a 6in round biscuit cutter and cut each into 5 wedges.  Lay them on a tray and place them on the same tray.  Pour veal, cheese and vegetable pesto in the centre of each pastry round.  Bring the edges of the pastry up over the filling and pinch together and seal.  Place pastries on a baking tray and bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until golden and heated through.  Serve warm.

title: Rum Bruschetta
ingredients: 4 slices french bread | 1/2 cup rum | 2 cups cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Spread each of the four bread slices with rum.  Using a cherry half on bread, place one tomato on top of the rum.  Top with the remaining bread, pressing down to close the bread into a loaf shape.  Wrap a cocktail stick around the side of the bruschetta to wrap.  Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate until serving.

title: Greek Tomato Pudding
ingredients: 5 lbs tomatoes, peeled and roughly chopped ( passata ) | 1 cup golden raisin or 1 cup dried apricot, roughly chopped | 1 teaspoon dill weed | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 2 cups double cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cream in a heavy bottomed frying pan.  Stir over a medium high heat until thickened enough to coat a spoon.  Lower heat once boiling and simmer for 45 minutes, stirring now and then.  When thick like spaghetti sauce, beat in about 2 cups of heavy cream.  Spoon mixture into a large shallow ovenproof dish.  Sprinkle top with the remaining cream.  Serve warm or cool to room temperature.

title: Italian Restaurant Shellfish
ingredients: 2 lbs cooked small shell pasta | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro | 2 teaspoons minced garlic | 1 tablespoon minced cilantro | 1 cup sherry wine | 1 teaspoon minced anise seed | 1 1/2 lbs fresh fish fillets, such as cod, halibut, or 2 1/2 lbs cod, cut crosswise into 1/4-by-3-inch strips
instructions: In a blender, combine pasta and 1 cup water, cover and blend until just mixed.  Mix cilantro, garlic and cilantro in a shallow dish.  Add sherry and aniseed and stir to combine.  Add remaining ½ cup water.  Place fish in marinade.  Cover and refrigerate at least 10 minutes and up to 1 day.  Drain pasta.  Cook pasta on a large, rimmed baking sheet in a large pot of lightly salted boiling water until just firm to the bite, stirring occasionally, about 9 minutes or according to package directions.  Drain pasta and return to pot.  Pour remaining marinade over fish and sprinkle with remaining cilantro.

Random Ingredients: bacon,chili paste,baking powder,chicken meat,mexican cheese,chambord raspberry liquor,creamy peanut butter,oat
title: Bacon Chops With Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs bacon | 1/2 cup chambord raspberry liquor, plus more for drizzling | 1 bag mexican cheese, shredded ( like sharp cheddar ) | 1 bag creamy peanut butter | 2 tablespoons chili paste ( peanut or chili oil ) | 2 cups chicken tenders, coarsely chopped | 2 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 cup rolled oats
instructions: Heat a wok over medium heat, add the bacon and cook, until crisp.  Remove the bacon, and drain on paper towels.  Reserve bacon drippings.  Add the chambord to the bacon drippings.  Deglaze the wok with the raspberry liquor, scraping up any brown bits in the pan.  Crumble the bacon into the bacon drippings.  Add the mexican cheese and stir until melted.  Add the peanut butter and stir until blended.  Continue to stir.  Add the chili paste and stir gently until smooth.  Add the chicken, bacon and oat mixtur.  Stir in the reserved bacon drippings.  Cover and cook 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until the sauce is thickened.

Random Ingredients: sunflower oil,cherry tomato,eggplant,red potato,anise seed,cumin powder,water chestnut
title: Aloo Baildi
ingredients: 2 red potatoes, washed, peeled and cut into quarters and then into cubes | 1 eggplant, washed, peeled and cut into cubes | 3 cups cherry tomatoes | 1 can water chestnuts, diced | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 2 teaspoons cumin powder
instructions: Add red potatoes, eggplant and tomatoes to a pot.  Add aniseeds, sunflower oil, cumin powder.  When they start to pop and they start turning colour, add the cherry tomatoes.  When tomatoes are ready, transfer them into a bowl.  Garnish with chopped cilantro before serving.  Variation, add 3 tsps.  Water chestnuts, 1 tsps.

title: Norwegian Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 cups long grain rice, cooked and chilled | 3 granny smith apples or 3 other firm baking apples, peeled, cored and finely chopped | 1/4 cup finely shredded lettuce leaf
instructions: In a large serving bowl, combine all ingredients except lettuce.  Toss to coat.  Cover and chill.  Serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Chile and Walnut Pesto
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped walnuts | 1 can chopped green chile peppers | 1/2 package locatelli cheese, shredded
instructions: Combine the walnuts, green chiles, and cheese in the bowl of a blender.  Blend until creamy.  The pesto should take on an orange glow.

title: Ww Core Italian Salad With Bacon and Broccoli

instructions: Combine all ingredients except bread slices or vegetables in a large bowl, and refrigerate 8 - 10 hours or overnight.  Just before serving, remove bread from the refrigerator, and discard the onion slices.  Serve bread slices on a platter or individual salad plates.  Sprinkle cheese or bacon mixture over the bread.  Serve garnished with lettuce and tomato wedges, if desired.

title: Spareribs and Chickpeas (Indonesian Style)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs spareribs ( spareribs cut in portions ) | 1 can chickpeas ( garbanzo beans ) | 1 can coconut milk | 2 1/2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: In large pan add spareribs and fry on med hi to brown spareribs on all sides.  Add rest of ingredients and simmer till spareribs are done.  Serve over rice.

title: Crostos (Cabbage and Feta Salad)
ingredients: 1/2 head cabbage, cut into thin circles | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper or 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 10 cloves garlic, smashed ( or 1 clove garlic and 1 tsp garlic powder ) | 1 star anise | 1/2 cup millet | 8 ounces jarlsberg cheese or 8 ounces ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup crumbled feta | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: In a large sauté pan over medium heat, add the cayenne pepper and garlic and cook until garlic is lightly browned, about 1 minute.  In a large salad bowl, combine the cabbage and garlic.  Slice the star anise into thin slices or slices and add to cabbage.  Add the millet and cheese to the cabbage and let stand for 10 minutes to allow flavors to combine.  Remove the star anise and spoon over the cheese mixture.  Serve warm.

title: Peanut Soup
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage | 1 can beef broth | 1/4 cup dry roasted peanuts, chopped
instructions: Brown sausage in large sauce pan, remove to plate.  Add beef broth and bring to boil.  Add chopped peanuts.  Heat to boiling, reduce heat to simmer.

title: Lori's Fruit Crescents
ingredients: 8 cups raspberries, rinsed well | 1/2 cup sugar | 1/8 cup salt and pepper, divided | 3 tablespoons crescent rolls ( one 8-ounce package ) | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 1 medium mango, peeled and chopped
instructions: Blend raspberries and 1/2 cup sugar to blend.  Sprinkle 1/4 cup salt over berries.  Mix.  Form into two 8 1/2 x 8 inch rectangles.  Cut each rectangle into triangles.  Arrange triangles on ungreased baking sheets, spacing evenly.  Bake at 375°f for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden.  Cool on sheet.  Mix anchovy paste and remaining 1/4 cup sugar, and 1 pinch pepper in small bowl.  Drizzle over warm cookies.  Cool completely.  Make mango ice cream topping, chop 1/4 cup mango and mash with fork.  Spread over warm cookies.  Store cookie sheets covered at room temperature in refrigerator.

title: Fennel Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf bread, sliced ( i used the light crust type bread of the loaf ) | 4 slices fresh mozzarella cheese | 1 tablespoon dried coriander seeds | 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1 1/2 tablespoons agave nectar
instructions: In medium size frying pan toast fennel and caraway seeds.  Once it starts to dance, add the agave nectar and let simmer on low, until it starts to turn color.  Turn off heat and let cool slightly.  Place bread slices on cookie sheet covered with aluminum foil.  Place cheese on top, about 1/2 cup at a time if the cheese is already melted and then top those with some of the fennel mixture and then another.  Place in the fridge for at least 2 hours.  Cut off top and last slice of bread to make a sandwich,.  Butter a large sandwich or casserole dish, dip sandwich in agave nectar and place on cookie sheet.  Repeat dipping the sandwich and panning it, so both sides are coated with syrup.  Melt butter in microwave dish and cook sandwich, covered in a microwave oven on high power for 8 minutes.  Let cool a little bit and serve with sour cream and salsa on the side.

title: Rosemary and Garlic Herb Bites
ingredients: 8 garlic cloves, peeled | 12 lettuce leaves, washed well
instructions: Place the garlic cloves on a baking sheet and drizzle them with a little olive oil.  Bake in a hot oven until the garlic cloves are soft.  Remove from the oven and crush them with a garlic press on the counter or in a mortar and pestle.  Arrange the lettuce leaves on plates, pour the garlic herb mixture on top.  Sprinkle over the garlic herb and serve.  Note, the recipe doubles well for 2 servings of each serving.

title: Microwave Curry Rice (Vegetarian Optional)
ingredients: 1/4 cup rice ( any type except rice and beans ) | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1/2 cup tomato sauce | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese ( i like a low fat sharp cheddar for the authentic taste ) | 2 tablespoons shredded iceberg lettuce | crushed corn tortilla chips or sliced avocado, for garnish
instructions: Combine everything except toppings in a microwave safe bowl, except for the corn tortillas and avocado.  Cover and cook on high 3 - 4 minutes until mixture is hot.  Place the corn tortilla chips into a serving dish.  Spoon on the hot rice mixture and top with avocado slices.  Serve warm or cold.

title: Tomato, Feta Cheese, and Chive Oatcakes
ingredients: 100 g feta cheese with dried tomatoes ( about 2 1/2 cups ) | 100 g gruyere cheese, grated | 4 tablespoons chives, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | tabasco sauce, to taste ( optional ) | 3 cups wholemeal oatmeal or 3 cups barleymeal
instructions: Preheat an oven to 120c/150°f line two baking trays with baking paper.  Whiz the feta into small, fine pieces.  Finely grate the gruyere without going into liquid.  Mix the feta, gruyere, chives and thyme together in a bowl.  Season with tabasco and/or a generous amount of tabasco sauce.  Use half the chive mixture to spread it on the baking paper, about 1cm thick and all the way to the edges.  Spoon 1 1/2 teaspoons of the chive mixture into each cake.  Sprinkle on remaining chives.  Cook for 12 - 15 minutes, until golden brown and the underside of each cake is golden.  Serve warm, split into squares or wedges for each diner to help themselves.  Note, for a variation try substituting 1/2 cup of sun dried tomatoes with 1/2 cup of fresh tomatoes and 1/2 cup of fresh tomatoes.  Serve with a sprinkling of oregano, black pepper and fresh herb sprigs in between each oatcake.

title: Halloumi and Pine Nut Omelette
ingredients: 100 g halloumi cheese, cut into 2 cm cubes | 1 large egg | 1 tablespoon pine nuts ( toasted or dry-roasted )
instructions: Place the halloumi on a large plate and sprinkle over the pine nuts.  In a small bowl, beat the egg with a fork and, on a large plate, lightly beat it again and then sprinkle over the halloumi.  Heat 1 cm oil in a small saucepan over a medium high heat.  When it is sizzling, add the halloumi and turn down the heat slightly if necessary.  Cook for 2 - 3 minutes, then turn the omelette over and cook for another 1 - 2 minutes on the other side.  Remove the pan from the heat and allow to sit for 2 - 3 minutes before turning it out onto a plate and allowing to come to room temperature.  Sprinkle over the toasted pine nuts and cut into wedges to serve.

title: Easy Mushroom Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup chicken broth | 1 tablespoon tap water
instructions: In medium saucepan, mix together soup, broth and water.  Mix well and heat through.  Serve over cooked noodles, buttered or fried rice.

title: Lengthen (Lengthen Pickles)

title: Baked Beans With Pork and Apples
ingredients: 4 ounces chicken stock cubes | 2 teaspoons dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 chicken bouillon granule | 4 ounces sweet rice | 4 ounces dried apples | 2 ounces raw chicken fillets
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f/180°c.  Place the stock cubes in an ovenproof dish, and add the sugar, tomato paste and bouillon.  Add the sweet rice and apple and mix well.  Spread the rice mixture over the base of the dish.  Scatter the pork over, dot with some butter and bake at 400f/180c for about 40 minutes until the pork is golden brown at the edges.  Serve with some ketchup or other south african sauce.

title: Lengrass Chicken Wraps
ingredients: 1/4 gallon fresh lemongrass ( or thai ginger paste ) | 8 ounces ground chicken | 2 cups shredded lettuce | 2 teaspoons molasses
instructions: Cut lemongrass in half from stem to base and discard ends.  Wash and remove tough stalk pieces.  Slice flesh into strips about the size of your palm.  Cut into strips about 3/4 wide.  Cut ground chicken into thin slices, using either the palm of your hand or the back of the knife.  Place 1/4 cup of chicken in a small bowl and mix with the molasses.  Add remainder of vegetables to chicken.  Mix well, and stuff leaves with mixture.  Wrap securely with butcher's twine and roll into little cylinders, then tie securely with skewers.  Cook in a hot, oiled skillet over medium heat for about 10 minutes, turning regularly, or until browned and crispy, coating the other side with the molasses.

title: Roasted Fruit and Spice
ingredients: 8 pounds ripe mixed fruit ( such as apples, pears, mango or plums ) | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Place mixed fruit and cayenne pepper in a large roasting pan.  Drizzle the fruit with a little olive oil to lightly coat.  Roast in a 300 f oven for 1 1/2 hours, stirring every 30, until a deep, rich brown.

title: Rallybeard's Salmon and Prunes Plaki With a Bottle of Smoked Gouda
ingredients: 1 lb grated monterey jack cheese | 2 lbs smoked salmon | 2 large baking potatoes, cut in slices 1/2-inch thick | 6 -10 pitted prunes | 3 canned smoked salmon, chopped
instructions: In large bowl, toss together the grated cheese.  Add potatoes, prunes, smoked salmon and cheese mixture.  Chill in refrigerator for at least a half an hour.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f or mark bake for 15 to 20 minutes, until potatoes are soft.  Serve with crusty french bread.

title: Sweet Potato With Coleslaw, Dill and Dried Cabbage
ingredients: 1 cup potato, chopped and peeled | 1 large head cabbage, cabbage leaves | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/4 tablespoon dry sherry wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon corn syrup | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh dill
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, stir potatoes and cabbage until potatoes are tender.  Drain.  Meanwhile in a small mixing bowl, combine the cabbage with the ketchup, vinegar, corn syrup and dill.  Mix well.  Serve the cabbage mixture over the potatoes and cabbage.

title: Sticky Sourdough Spaghetti
ingredients: 6 small jumbo shrimp | 1 package raw small shell pasta | 1/2 cup sourdough starter ( regular or low-sodium )
instructions: Prepare shells and boil in a large pot of water 5 minutes or until crisp.  Remove shells and set aside to drain.  Shells should be cool enough to handle. .  Rinse and reserve cooking water.  Remove shrimp from shells and pat dry with paper towels.  Cut into 1 inch cubes.  Prepare starter according to package directions.  Add shrimp and starter to pasta and toss to coat.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,cottage cheese,garlic paste,apple cider vinegar,chicken breast
title: Italian Chicken for the Grill
ingredients: 2 eggplants, halved lengthwise | 2 chicken breasts ( about 450g total weight ) | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 3 cups low fat cottage cheese | 1/2 cup apple cider vinegar
instructions: Preheat grill to medium.  To make marinade place eggplant cut side down, on a greased grill rack.  Grill until tender.  Cut lengthwise into 2 slices each.  Place chicken, skin side down, on cutting board and spread out chicken with a meat mallet to 1/4 thick.  Spread with a thin layer of garlic paste or sprinkle with salt if desired.  Place eggplant slices on grill and cook until skin is lightly charred and chicken is cooked through.  Spread off excess cooking liquid.  Spread 1/2 cup cottage cheese on one half of each eggplant.  Drizzle on the vinegar and cover with a second slice of eggplant and chicken.  Spread on remaining cottage cheese and drizzle with salt and bake until cheese is melted.  Serve with extra salad tomatoes and a tossed green salad.

title: Thai Style Fried Fish
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried fish sauce | k rock salt, to taste | seasoning, to taste
instructions: Mix the fish sauce with 2 t salt using your hands to make it ‘mush’.  Rub fish with krispies.  Heat some wok over medium high heat until a bead of steam comes to the top about a minute before the oil is ready.  Pour oil to a depth of 1’, drop 4 - 5 fish in the wok.  Cook, turning once, until the fish is golden.

title: Easy Easy, Healthy, Healthy, and Delicious Chicken and Fruit Parcels
ingredients: 1 can chicken breasts, drained and chopped | 1 can red seedless grapes, sliced | 1/4 cup reduced fat mascarpone | 1 tablespoon fresh basil leaf, chopped | 2 packets digestive biscuits | 1/2 cup desiccated coconut
instructions: Put all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well.  Transfer to a baking tray and bake in a moderate oven for approx 30 minutes.  Allow to cool.  Remove from oven, and refrigerate overnight to cool completely.  Using a fork, break up biscuits into smaller pieces and roll into a ball shape.  Place the parcels onto a flat plate or tray of your choice and flatten with your hands.  Spread the biscuits, coconut, and capsicum mixture onto the parcels and top with any other fruit or nuts you like.

Random Ingredients: roquefort cheese,sun tomato oil,coffee,white bean,grape tomato,guacamole

instructions: Drain beans.  Place in saucepan with enough water to cover.  Soak, stirring occasionally, for 45 to 60 minutes.  Drain.  Heat oil in saucepan until hot but not smoking.  Add drained beans and sun dried tomatoes.

instructions: To make the quesadilla, stir the flour and beans together in a small bowl.  In a second bowl, mash the cream cheese with a fork.  Add salt, bell pepper, and oregano to the cream cheese and mix until smooth.  Stir in half of the sour cream or yogurt.

Random Ingredients: rigatoni pasta,portabella mushroom cap,chocolate syrup,orange zest,date,lemon zest
title: Rigatoni With Chocolate Glaze
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 2 pints portabella mushroom caps, quartered ( may sub crimini mushrooms ) | 1 tablespoon grated orange zest | 1 lemon, zest of | 1 tablespoon sun-dried dates, snipped | grated chocolate syrup ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta in pan of boiling water until tender but still firm.  Reserve 1/4 cup of the pasta cooking water.  While the pasta is cooking, heat the chocolate syrup if using it.  Just before the pasta is done, toss through the mushrooms and zest in a large serving bowl.  Drain the pasta, and toss with the mushroom mixture.  Sprinkle over the reserved 1/2 cup of pasta cooking water, and serve.

title: Chipotle Pepper Chai
ingredients: 2 chipotle peppers | 8 slices yellow squash | 4 tablespoons adobo sauce from chipotle peppers | 1 1/2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 1/3 cup brewed black tea, chilled | 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup unsalted dry roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Bring a small amount of water to a boil in a small pot, then add the chiles and remove from heat.  Rinse with warm water, remove the stems and seeds, then chop the chiles finely.  Transfer the chopped chiles to a mortar and pestle and coarsely grind.  Transfer the chiles to a bowl and toss with 1 - 2 tblsps.  Water, chiles, adobo sauce and sugar.  Let the mixture sit in refrigerator for at least 1 hour, allowing the flavors to mellow.  Dilute the tea with the olive oil in a small frying pan.  Remove from the heat and stir in the chiles mixture.  Taste and add more sugar if needed.  Pour the chai into a serving glass and garnish with the peanuts.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,pork tenderloin,caraway seed,non dairy topping,currant,pinto bean,beef bouillon,sugar
title: Swedish Yogurt Stew With Pork and Beans (Low Fat)

instructions: Sort and wash beans then drain.  Place beans in a saucepan and cover with water.  Bring to a boil over high heat and cook until barely tender, about 3 minutes. Cut the pork into 1/2 inch pieces.  Stir together the sugar, yogurt and currants in a large bowl.  Add the beans, pork and yogurt mixture, stirring gently until well blended.  Spread the bean mixture in a roasting pan and top with the caramelized caraway seeds.  Bake uncovered or in the center of the oven until the pudding is thickened, 45 to 50 minutes.  Serve warm.

title: Rum Fried Polenta

instructions: Cut polenta into 4 wedges each.  Wrap each wedge of polenta tightly with toothpicks.  Place in a glass bowl and pour over the rum.  Marinate at room temperature for 3 hours.  Heat oil in a deep fryer or deep nonstick pan to 375 degrees f.  Fry polenta wedges in batches, turning halfway through, until golden brown and crisp, 4 to 5 minutes.  Transfer to paper towels and sprinkle with cinnamon.  Serve on a bed of shredded lettuce.

instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a small skillet over medium heat.  Stir in the ginger and saffron.  Cook and stir until fragrant, about 1 minute.  Stir the rice, and pour in the water.  Cover, and cook until rice is tender and liquid has been absorbed, 15 to 20 minutes.

instructions: Combine rum, fusion, pineapple, vinegar, 1/4 cup sugars, italian seasoning and honey in a 1 1/2 to 2 quart glass bowl.

title: Beef and Oats Toasted  "soup

instructions: Slice the boneless beef into thin bite sized strips 1/4 wide by 3 long.  If this is too thin, cook the beef in a skillet.  You will need just as much oil as you need, about 1 1/2 tablespoons of oil.  You can always buy thin slices at the grocer, though it's not necessary.  Put the oat into a small bowl.  Pour the wine into the skillet in which the meat was browned.  Bring to a boil and simmer until the mixture has reduced to 1 cup.  Add the oats, stir and simmer for 2 - 3 minutes.  Take the pan off the heat and stir in the red wine and pumpkin purée.  Transfer to a serving bowl and sprinkle the beef with the crushed ice.  Serve warm.

instructions: Shred endive coarsely and mix with goji berries, chile and tortilla pieces.  Chill several hours.

title: Prawns, Meat and Papayas in Spiced Syrup

instructions: Prepare all ingredients.  Marinate prawns in half the tomato sauce and mixed herbs.  Leave for 30 minutes.  Bake on a hot greased tray, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes, or until just cooked through.  Meanwhile, cook papaya in a pan of boiling water for 3 - 4 minutes, or until tender.  Drain, reserving 3 tablespoons of the syrup, and pat prawns dry.  Add the other half of the tomato sauce, reserved prawn syrup to the prawns, and papaya and bring to the boil.  Simmer for 5 minutes.  Transfer the prawns to serving dishes.  Spoon the sauce over and serve.

title: Crispy Chili Paste

instructions: Stir the oil and chile together in a skillet over medium high heat until the oil begins to smoke, about 5 minutes.

instructions: Heat skillet over medium heat.

title: Yummy and Simple Spiced Orange Fizz (Vegan)

instructions: Mix ketchup and orange water to make the orange fizz.  Pour into 4 pita breads.  This way, you can have the fizz all in one small bowl with plastic wrap touching a cutting board, or you can serve all four pita onto a plate and use them as a scoop.  Spray pita with nonstick spray to get all the orange fizz on it.  Spread the orange fizz over the pita but don't use too much of the fizz.  Spread the chopped tomato ketchup over the tomato ketchup.  Serve immediately.

title: Quick and Easy Creamy Pea Dip

instructions: Mix all ingredients together, refrigerate for 4 - 6 hours, serve with your favorite meal and enjoy.

title: Avocado and Bacon Fritters
ingredients: 4 medium avocados, peeled and pitted | 2 teaspoons dried thyme | 4 1/4 cups self rising flour | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning or 1 tablespoon dried rosemary | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 teaspoon lavender or 1 teaspoon lavender
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees farenheit.  Halve avocados lengthwise and scoop out the center.  Grate the avocado flesh and transfer to a bowl.  Add the thyme, flour, creole seasoning, ground cloves and lavender or thyme leaves.  Mix with a fork or your hands until the batter is firm and lumpy.  Turn the batter out onto a lightly floured surface.  Knead lightly until you have a smooth, shiny roll.  Lightly grease a baking sheet with cooking spray or line with parchment paper.  Take a handful of the batter and form into balls about 8 inches long and 1 1/2 inches in diameter.  Place a smaller pan on top of the balls with cooking spray.  Repeat until all the batter has been used and the pan has a couple inches of oil in it.  Cook the fritters until golden brown on both sides and the center is no longer translucent.  Remove the fritters from the pan to paper towels to drain.  Serve warm.

Pour the batter into a large heat proof dish and cook in a preheated oven for about 15 minutes at 180f with the top of the noodles slightly covering the surface.  Serve garnished with chopped dried ginger.

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  In a large bowl, mix the orange zest, vinegar, and rice together.  Add the spinach, dates, currants, and cream and mix gently so all ingredients don't break.  Toss with the orange dressing and transfer to an oven proof serving dish or baking tray lined with parchment paper to keep warm.  Bake for 30 - 35 minutes, until golden.

ingredients: 1 1/4 cups dried garbanzo beans | 3 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 medium yellow onions, finely chopped | 4 leeks, whites only, finely chopped | 2/3 cup dry white fish sauce | 7 thick slices white bread, torn into 1/2 inch pieces | 2 3 tablespoons roasted salted butter or 2 3 tablespoons olive oil | miniature slice of fresh basil and mint or regular basil ( to garnish )
instructions: Soak beans overnight in cold water to cover.  Drain and place drained beans in a medium saucepan and cover with water to 2 inches above beans.  Bring to boil over high heat.  Cover and reduce heat to low when the water boils, just barely cover the bean's surface.  Simmer 2 minutes.  Do not remove lid.  Remove from heat and set aside.  In a large, deep sided grilling or deep skillet, combine onions, leeks and fish sauce.  Simmer over low heat about 15 minutes. .  Drain excess liquid.  Add hot bean mixture and bread to the soup.  Cook 15 minutes more, or until soup is dense, stirring frequently.  Remove and discard any beans or leeks or herbs.  Melt butter in a small skillet over medium heat.  Add basil and mint and stir until basil and mint have wilted, about 2 minutes.  Serve at once, garnished with basil leaves.

title: Rice With Yogurt and Chilli
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice | 1 cup half-and-half ( half for both ) or 1 cup cream ( half for both ) | 1/2 cup low-fat plain yogurt | 1/2 cup of fresh mint, chopped | 2 teaspoons grated gingerroot | fresh chile ( to season ) | 1/2 cup coffee ( any laggier type of spicy coffee is fine ) | 1/4 cup dried clarified butter ( or coconut if you like )
instructions: Bring 3 cups of water to a boil in a medium sized saucepan.  Add rice and bring back to a boil.  Turn off heat and cover for 30 minutes.  Meanwhile, whisk together half and half or cream, yogurt, mint, ginger root and chillies.  When rice is finished, stir into yogurt mixture, remove from heat and cover.  The amount of chile will depend over how hot your burner is.  To serve, ladle into a flat serving bowl and top with coffee and clarified butter.  Garnish with basil and serve over a bed of rice.

title: Tortilla Soup With Orzo
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked orzo pasta | 2 cans beef broth | 4 ears fresh corn, husked and cut into thirds
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil.  Cook the orzo for 8 to 10 minutes, until al dente.

title: Easy Guacamole
ingredients: 4 hass avocadoes | 3 tablespoons dried celery leaves
instructions: Peel avocados and cut out the pit.  Cut avocados in half, remove the pit, and remove the pits.  Place on serving platter, cut side of avocado out.  Sprinkle with celery leaves, and drizzle with extra virgin olive oil.

title: Crispy Southwest Seasoning
ingredients: filling : | 2 cups sea salt, divided | 7 cups red bell pepper, chopped, or more to taste | 2 limes in shell, juiced
instructions: Combine sea salt, red bell pepper, and fresh lime juice in a bowl, and mix with hands to blend.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,hot chili sauce,red potato,black sesame seed,nut
title: Chilli Potato Sesame Dumplings
ingredients: 4 medium red potatoes ( approx 15-20 medium ) | 1 pinch ground nut | 1 tablespoon black sesame seed | 300 g self raising flour | hot chili sauce
instructions: Using your hands, knead the potatoes on a clean, dry rolling surface until you have a smooth pliable dough.  If you don't have a rolling pin, just roll them into walnut sized balls – about the size of a small egg.  Set aside.  Cover, and set aside.  Place the chopped potato in a little oil – approx 2 tablespoons – with the ground nut, sesame seeds and flour.  Add 3/4 cup water, a pinch of freshly ground black pepper and a good pinch of hot sauce, and knead the mixture for a few minutes.  It should not have any dough clumping up.  You want it all wetted but not sticky.  Roll the dough out onto a floured surface into approximately 20cm diameter circles.  Use 1 tablespoon of dough for each round, and set aside.  Repeat the process until all the dough has been used.  Cook 1 round in boiling water for approximately 45 seconds, or until they rise to the top.  Transfer to a paper towel lined tray to drain.  Repeat with the remaining dough.  Serve with dipping sauce or aji for dipping.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,rice krispies,baking powder,plum tomato,amaretto,beef stew meat
title: Baked Rum Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1/3 cup dark rum | 1/3 cup amaretto, or more to taste | 3 plum tomatoes, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 1 pound beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 pounds rice krispies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Blend rum, amaretto, plum tomatoes, and baking powder in a bowl.  Place beef in a large glass baking dish, and drizzle olive oil and dark rum mixture over beef.  Sprinkle beef with salt and pepper.  Cover, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours.  Bake at 350 degrees f for about 1 hour.  Remove beef from dish, and arrange onto a foil lined baking sheet.  Bake for 45 minutes.  Stir rice krispies into the rice and beef.  Bake uncovered for about 20 minutes, or until rice is tender and krispies are lightly browned.

title: Polish Sausages Salad
ingredients: 2 polish sausages ( or sweet sausage ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped pimiento | 2 tablespoons thinly sliced maraschino cherries | 1/4 cup glaze | 1/4 cup lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 1/8 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 lemon, juice and zest of ( grated and grated ) | 3 tablespoons freshly grated parmesan cheese or 3 tablespoons romano cheese ( freshly grated )
instructions: Crumble the sausages into a medium frying pan.  Add pimentos, cherries and maraschino cherries.  Mix together well.  Cut the sausages into 1 inch pieces.  Heat the glaze on medium low heat and stir until the glaze melts and starts to thicken.  Remove from heat and mix in the lemon juice and vanilla.  Combine the zest, remaining glaze, lemon juice and grated cheese.  Spoon into serving plates and decorate with a sprinkling of grated cheese or pepper.  Serve at once.

title: Ajiaco (Mexican Candy)
ingredients: 1 cup almond meal | 1 cup mexican blend cheese, shredded | 2 cups dark chocolate, broken
instructions: To make the anise extract.  Place almond meal in a shallow dish.  Sprinkle mexican cheese in the center of the anise mix.  Melt chocolate in a double boiler over hot water.  When melted, remove from heat and pour over the almond mixture.  Let it set up.  Break off pieces of the anise or you get all of this into the refrigerator before you roll them.  To make the anise roll.  Line a baking sheet with wax paper or parchment paper.  Place an almond in the middle of the baking sheet.  Sprinkle mexican cheese on top of the almond.  Roll the almond in the chocolate.  The candy should be as if it were encased in a log.  Refrigerate the candy for at least an hour before you roll it up.  Variation, you can roll the anise in whole almonds.  Melt the chocolate and let it set up.  Roll the candy in chocolate and let it set up.  It can be eaten.

title: Irish Tea
ingredients: 4 cloves garlic | 4 red chiles, deseeded | 4 tablespoons cooking oil | 4 cups guinness stout | 1/2 cup corn oil | 24 leaves fresh tea | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 tomatoes, chopped
instructions: Roast garlic and chilies on a foil lined baking tray at 220 degrees c for 5 - 6 minutes until skin begins to crackle.  Place the garlic and chilies in a bowl with boiling water.  Allow to cool to room temperature, then drain and discard the skins.  Cut the garlic and chilies into 1/4 inch thick slices.  Wrap the oil in foil.  Heat the guinness in a saucepan over a medium heat, adding the oil if mixture becomes too thick.  Pour into the pan with the garlic and chilies and bring to just below a boil.  Allow to bubble for 2 minutes, then pour out into a tea ball pitcher.  Serve garnished with chopped tomato.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,ricotta cheese,onion soup mix
title: Onion-Spice Ricotta Spread
ingredients: 2 containers ricotta cheese | 1 cup chopped onion, or more to taste | 1 package dry onion soup mix
instructions: Mix onion soup mix and ricotta together in a bowl.  Refrigerate until chilled, about 5 minutes.  Pour chilled onion mixture into the bowl of a food processor.

title: Ham Hock With Blueberry-Tomato Pudding
ingredients: 1 ham hock | 2 plum tomatoes, halved | 1/2 cup seedless raspberry | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 1 tablespoon dry mustard | 2 tablespoons prepared prepared english-style mustard | 4 slices american cheese | 10 ounces frozen blueberries | 1/4 cup grand marnier, and | 1/4 cup prepared plum ( plum ) tomato-flavored yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 f.  Place ham hock in 2 quart roasting pan.  Cut a cross in top of ham.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,green olive,cherry pie filling,rosemary leaf,chicken liver,mace
title: Lily's Chicken Cabbage and Olives
ingredients: 2 cans cherry pie filling ( i like `` light '' brand ) | chicken liver | 1/4 cup rosemary leaf, stems | 1/4 cup mace | 1 1/2 cups red cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup green olives, sliced
instructions: Heat pie filling and lily's in 2 qt baking dish set aside.  Sprinkle rosemary over the lily's making sure you don't grind it.  Spread cherry pie filling over cherry pie filling.

title: Sweet Lamb Stock Salad for Two
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dry masala | 2 fluid ounces lamb stock | salad greens
instructions: Heat the lamb stock in a saucepan over gentle heat.  When it is hot, whisk in the dry masala.  Pour the stock into a large pan, and stir in the sugar.  Cook over a low heat for 10 minutes, or until it has reduced by half.  Remove from the heat and pour the hot stock over the greens in a large bowl.  Stir gently to combine.  Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight for best results.

title: Tibetan Fried Steak (Dolma)

instructions: Soak the black eyed peas overnight.  The following day, remove peas and place in a large pot along with the meat and 1/3 t.  Rice starch, marjoram and picante sauce.  Mix well, cover and simmer over medium heat, stirring occasionally until peas are soft.  Stir in the black eyed peas and continue cooking until heated through.  Place the remaining rice starch on a plate.  Dip the steak cubes in the rice starch to coat and place on a sheet pan.  In a saucepan over medium heat, melt the fish flavor enhancer paste for 15 minutes.  Add the meat and a little water and heat through.  Serve with black eyed peas and sticky rice.

title: Tomato and Coconut Hotpot
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes, including the juice from the can | 5 -6 medium peppercorns | 1/4 teaspoon mexican chili powder | 1 chicken stock cube ( or equivalent ) | 2 1/2 cups desiccated coconut
instructions: Put all ingredients into a pan and stir to combine.  Bring to the boil, breaking up the tomatoes with a whisk.  Return to the boil, reduce the heat and simmer uncovered for about 20, adding a little water if the liquid reduces too much.  Serve warm with steamed/brown rice in a bowl alongside or on top of the hotpot.

title: Scandinavian Bread - Bread Machine
ingredients: 4 slices rye bread | 1 cup sour cream ( or plain yogurt ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla pod
instructions: Scatter a teaspoon of vanilla pod on top of each slice of rye bread.  Spread the sour cream on top.  Scatter the turmeric on top of the yogurt.  Place the bread on your bread machine and select light or dark crust.  When the bread is cooked, remove from the machine and transfer to a cooling rack.

title: Italian Almond Brunch
ingredients: 1/2 cup slivered almonds | 1 pound shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/2 pound shredded provolone cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Spread slivered almonds on a baking sheet.  Bake in the preheated oven until lightly toasted, 10 to 12 minutes.  Set aside to cool to room temperature.  Toast the mozzarella cheese in the preheated oven until melted, about 8 minutes.  Place cheese slices over the toasted almonds.  Top with provolone cheese.

title: Feta Dip
ingredients: 1 pound feta cheese | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 3 cloves garlic, sliced thin
instructions: Drain excess liquid from feta cheese.  Mash feta cheese with ketchup, garlic and olive oil.  Chill until ready to serve.

title: Hriseline Pea Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breast halves | 3 packages frozen peas
instructions: Place chicken breasts in a large slow cooker.  Sprinkle with salt, and add about 2 tablespoons water.  Cook 8 hours on low, or overnight.  Remove chicken from cooker, and let cool for a few minutes, then slice into bite size pieces.  Arrange chicken on a large platter, and spoon remaining juices on top.  Pour peas around chicken.

title: Jalapeno Won Tons (For Canning)
ingredients: 1/2 cup molasses or 1/2 cup dark molasses | 1/4 cup finely chopped onion | 1 teaspoon grated jalapeno powder | 1/1 teaspoon onion powder | 42 wonton wrappers ( see note # 5 )
instructions: Blend molasses, onion, jalapeño, and onion powder in blender.  Place about 1 tablespoon of mixture in center of each won ton wrapper.

Random Ingredients: chow mein noodle,golden syrup,milk,chili powder,chicken bouillon granule
title: Quick Chow Mein Noodles
ingredients: 1 box chow mein noodles | 1 quart milk | 1/2 tablespoon chicken bouillon granule | 1/2 tablespoon chili powder | 1/2 tablespoon golden syrup
instructions: Cook chow mein according to package, drain.  Place water over medium high heat and stir or whisk in chicken, chili powder, and golden syrup until chicken is thoroughly coated.  Remove from heat when completely cooled, stir in drained noodles, or place between sheets of wax paper, and press until well mixed.  Store in refrigerator.

title: Beef Stew With Sun-Dried Tomato Sauce and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 medium beef chuck roast | 2 ounces sun-dried tomato ( not packed in oil, use oil from can in a pinch ) | 1 ounce sun-dried tomato ( not packed in oil ) | 1 pinch onion salt | 4 ounces button mushrooms | 4 ounces mochiko sweet rice flour | 1 tablespoon tomato paste
instructions: Rinse roast with cold water and pat dry with paper towels.  Score the top of the roast with a sharp knife on both sides to allow steam to escape during the cooking process.  If you are using your hands for the rub, rub the surface of the roast with mochiko.  Rub the roast with a little sun dried tomato oil and set aside in a warm place for about 30 minutes.  The skin should start to crisp up and darken.  When the roast is cool enough to handle, remove the thick membrane on the outside of the meat and cut the meat across the grain into thin slices.  Set aside on a warm platter and cover.  If necessary, refrigerate overnight.  Drain sundried tomato oil, remove the stem and chopped sun dried tomatoes, and slice into thin strips.  Set aside.  If desired, remove giblets from meat and discard.  Remove excess fat from pan.  If using a crock pot and put on high for about 5 hours then take up the rest of the crock pot and stir in the diced sun dried tomatoes and mushrooms.  Cook on low until the mushrooms are tender.  Stir in the rice flour and tomato paste.  Turn the heat off and let sit for 10 - 15 minutes.  Serve stew with the rice and sun dried tomato sauce.

title: Wasabi Coconut Popsicles
ingredients: 1 can apple pie filling | 1 teaspoon wasabi paste | 1/2 teaspoon coconut extract | 1/8 teaspoon ground mustard
instructions: Mix the wasabi paste and coconut extract together and brush on waxed paper.  Spoon a teaspoonful of filling into a paper cone shape, pressing down slightly.  Repeat with remaining filling.  Keep sealed until serving.  Refrigerate leftovers.

title: Curried Mushrooms, Belgian Style
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon ground hazelnuts | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder, or to taste | 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped celery | 1 can cremini mushrooms, drained
instructions: Mix ground hazelnuts and curry powder together in a bowl.  Stir celery into mixture.  Set aside.  Place cremini mushrooms into separate serving dishes and pour the curry cream mixture over.

Random Ingredients: green olive,poultry seasoning,tamarind paste,worcestershire sauce,wild rice,tamarind juice,bean sprout,sausage
title: Wild Rice with Brains
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked wild rice | 1 can refried beans with jalapeno peppers | 1 package sausages, cut crosswise into halves | 1 teaspoon tamarind juice | 1 dash worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped green olives | 1 teaspoon tamarind paste | 1 dash poultry seasoning
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions.  Drain, and set aside.  In the same pot, melt the sausages over medium heat, and cook until well browned, and cooked through.  While sausages are cooking, combine 1 teaspoon soy sauce, 1 teaspoon tamarind juice, 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce, and 1 teaspoon minced ginger in a small bowl.  Sprinkle over warm rice.  Stir in 1 tablespoon chopped green olives, 1 teaspoon soy sauce, 1 teaspoon tamarind paste, and 1 dash poultry seasoning.  Continue cooking and stirring until heated through.  Spoon rice mixture into a bowl, and top with sausages and sauteed green olive.  Refrigerate covered at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Mexican Bean and Rice Bake (Arroz Con Gandules)
ingredients: 400 g pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 200 g mild salsa, like poblanos ( see poblanos in supermarkets ) | 300 ml natural yoghurt | 1 medium apple, peeled, cored and finely grated | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro | 2 teaspoons cornflour mixed with 2 tablespoons of cold water | 2 cups arborio rice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c /350°f.  Combine beans, salsa and yoghurt in a large, deep ovenproof pan and stir to combine.  Bake, uncovered, for about 30 minutes, stirring often, until the beans are golden and the sauce has thickened slightly.  Stir in the chicken, cilantro and cornflour mix.  Stir well, cover and transfer to the oven to 170c /350°f bake, uncovered, for about half an hour, until rice is tender and the top is lightly browned.  Serve with steamed greens, guacamole and salsa.

title: Garlic Bread
ingredients: 1 unbaked pie shell | 1 1/2 cups oats | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 loaf french bread, cut in 1 1/2-inch cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  In a resealable plastic bag, mix together the oats, garlic salt, and bread cubes.  Place coated bread cubes into the baking dish, cover, and bake for 5 minutes in the preheated oven.  Remove cover, and bake for 10 more minutes, until bread is golden brown.

title: Brats With Sausage
ingredients: 3 frankfurters | 2 teaspoons corn flakes, crumb fine | 3 bratwursts | 2 tablespoons tomato-based soya sauce | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce | 3 radishes, chopped fine | 1/2 cup plain corn flakes, corn flakes
instructions: Cut bratwurst in half lengthwise.  Scoop out each half and reserve.  Place each brat half on a strip of cornflake and crumb side up in a heavy frypan.  Spray with oil.  Cook over medium heat.  Fry until crisp outside and outside.  Slit each brat lengthwise and place on a serving platter with spinkled pesto.

title: Tikkas (Jaggery-Sausage Pancakes)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork sausage | 2 cups plain yogurt | 7 cups flour, sifted | 1/2 cup jaggery | 1/2 cup asiago cheese, grated
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f.  Prick the bottom and sides of a 10 x 6 inch baking dish with a sharp knife.  Toast the sausage in a nonstick frying pan until just cooked through.  Cut into 1 inch wide strips.  In a large bowl, thoroughly blend the yogurt with 3 cups of the flour.  Add the jaggery and the rest of the flour and mix thoroughly.  Add the sausage, and stir until well blended.  Spread mixture on a baking sheet and bake for about 45 minutes, stirring halfway through.  Sprinkle with the asiago and bake for about 15 more minutes or until golden brown.  Serve hot.

title: Simple & Easy Bacon and Egg Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 slice rye bread | 6 slices bacon | 1 teaspoon rice wine vinegar, or to taste
instructions: Preheat an oven to 500 degrees f.  Pour half of the rye bread into the bottom of a glass baking dish to form a crust.  Lay 1 slice of bacon with the fatty side of bacon cut in half lengthwise.  Repeat until the two slices are used up.  Spread rice wine vinegar liberally onto the bread.  Place the bacon slice on top of the bread, making two sandwiches.  Wrap each sandwich in aluminum foil, and place on oven proofed wire rack.  Bake in the preheated oven until the slices are lightly browned and crisp.

Random Ingredients: poultry seasoning,salt,ginger garlic paste,part mozzarella cheese,broccoli,black pepper
title: Easy Veggie Grilled Soufflés
ingredients: 2 cups shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup fresh broccoli, cut into florets | 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1/8 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 2 tablespoons poultry seasoning
instructions: Preheat grill.  In a medium bowl, mix together mozzarella cheese, broccoli, black pepper, salt, ginger garlic paste, and poultry seasoning until well incorporated.  Place mixture on the preheated grill.  Grill vegetables, turning, until vegetables are cooked to your liking, and the cheese is melted.  Serve immediately.

title: Grilled Yellow Peppers
ingredients: 1 large yellow bell pepper, halved, deseeded and cut into thin strips about 1/4-inch wide | 1/4 cup hoisin sauce, or more as needed
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil grate.  Grill bell pepper strips until nicely colored, 3 to 5 minutes per side.  Whisk hoisin sauce and reserved green onion in a bowl.

title: Hot Sauerkraut Balls
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 bag fresh sauerkraut ( or equivalent ) | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon spicy spice | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1/8 teaspoon mixed spice ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon baking soda | 1/8 teaspoon mixed spice ( optional ) | 3 lbs soft white bread, crusts removed | 3 lbs swiss cheese, shredded
instructions: Place sour cream, sauerkraut, red chili flakes, spicy spice, and baking soda in large mixing bowl.  Add all other ingredients.  Mix with hands.  Place about 2 tablespoons mixture into greased 13x9 baking dish, pressing slightly with hands.  Bake at 300 degrees for 1 hour.  Cool.  Add shredded cheese to crumbs on top of bread and bake 25 minutes more at 300 degrees.  Serve while hot.  If desired, mix 1/2 cup crumbs and 1 cup of the sauerkraut crumbs together and sprinkle over top of bread.  Variation use 2 cans of sauerkraut.  If desired, you may add 1 or 2 cups of ground beef to the crumb mix and mix with.  Serve kraut balls in bowls with a cheese spread, topping with sauerkraut.  Variation use a 9x13 baking dish and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes or until bubbly.  May substitute a larger batch of sauerkraut for the sauerkraut.  Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Layer ingredients in order listed under sauerkraut layer.  End with sauerkraut layer on top, topping with cheese spread, topping with cheese, topping with cheese.  Bake for 10 minutes.  The cheese should be melted.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,apricot,golden raisin,burgundy wine,lamb,beef eye,white cabbage
title: Roast Lamb Sausages(Hui Style) from Burgundy, Portugal
ingredients: olive oil | 1 large lamb, well trimmed, fat cap intact | 1 large beef eye round, cut into 8 thick sausages | 3/4 lb small white cabbage, cut into 8 wedges, cored | 1/4 lb dried apricot, chopped | 8 sprigs fresh french savoy cabbage, washed ( to garnish ) | 3/4 cup golden raisin
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit.  Heat a large frying pan over high heat.  Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and heat to smoking point.  Working in batches, add meat and sausages and cook, turning and brushing with oil as necessary, until lightly browned all over and cooked through, about 5 minutes per side.  Transfer meat and sausages to a shallow baking dish and drain fat from pan.  Add a generous amount of oil and sausages to fat remaining in pan and cook, turning and brushing each with oil as necessary, until browned, about 5 minutes per side.  To make sure all have been cooked through, place a piece of sausages lengthwise down the length of the meat.  Place a few cabbage wedges across the meat and then with tongs, toss the ingredients together and arrange around each meat on the platter.  Sprinkle herbs over meat and raisins.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,dark sesame oil,bicarbonate soda,thai basil
title: Berbere (Spicy Basil)
ingredients: 250 g thai basil, rinsed and dried | 1 pinch bicarbonate of soda | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 red serrano pepper, deseeded & finely sliced
instructions: Wrap basil leaves around a bamboo skewer.  Place in grill over high heat, cook for 1 minute.  Turn and cook for additional 10 minutes.  Place basil leaves on serving plate.  Combine remaining ingredients & pour over the leaves.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,vanilla,ketchup,ginger garlic paste,collard green,ra el hanout spice mix,beef stew meat,tomato basil oregano garlic
title: Moroccan Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cut into bite sized pieces | 3 1/2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup chopped tomato with basil oregano and garlic | 2 teaspoons pure vanilla | 1 chicken bouillon cube, dissolved in 2 -3 tablespoons of water | 1/2 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix | 1 cup frozen collard greens, thawed or 1 cup fresh spinach
instructions: Heat oven to 325°f.  In ovenproof dutch oven, brown meat.  Stir in next 3 ingredients and cook on low for 3 hours.  Add next 3 ingredients, stir, cover and bake 45 minutes until meat is tender.  Stir in greens and bake on low for 10 - 15 minutes.

title: Cumin Oil for Steaming Shrimp
ingredients: 2 cups dark sesame oil | 3/4 cup bottled lime juice ( about 4 limes ) | crushed lime wedge ( to garnish )
instructions: Wash and dry the shrimp well.  Rub the sesame oil into the shrimp and leave on the counter for 1 hour.  When ready to steam, steam one side of the shrimp with a heavy steamer basket for 20 minutes.  Taste and correct for more lime juice, salt, or hot pepper if required.  Serve hot or cold.  Serve cold as an appetizer, or at room temperature on its own, with lime wedges for squeezing over.  Note, to use oil with limes, place them in an oil filled skillet with about 1/2 inch of the sesame oil.  Fry over medium heat, turning as needed, until the shrimp turn pale pink, 3 to 4 minutes.  Serve with crushed lime wedges.

title: Easy Raisin Croutons
ingredients: 2 slices white bread | 1/2 cup dark raisins
instructions: Spread bread evenly with dark raisins.  With a heavy knife and a meat mallet, roll each slice of bread into a rough crouton shape.  Slide croutons onto a parchment lined baking sheet.  Bake, a few at a time, in a 400 degree oven for 15 minutes.  You do not want the croutons crispy or browned, just slightly crisp.  Cool.

title: Kolaches With Honey Syrup
ingredients: 1 loaf croissant | 1 ounce ground almonds or 1 ounce cashews | 1/4 teaspoon lemon extract | 1/8 cup icing sugar | 1/4 cup kalamata olive | 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil leaf
instructions: Toast croissant, cut into thirds.  Cut each part diagonally on diagonal into 3 triangles.  Combine almonds, lemon extract, icing sugar, nuts and olives.  Brush tops of triangles lightly with icing mixture.  Bake at 300°f for about 15 minutes or until golden.  Cut through scored lines to serve.

title: Italian Style Snack
ingredients: 1 jar pretzels, with syrup | 1 teaspoon horseradish | 2 1/2 cups sweet marsala wine
instructions: Slice pretzels in half.  Coat with horseradish.  Place in shallow glass baking dish.  Bake at 350 degrees f for 5 - 8 minutes, or until pretzels are golden brown.  Remove and dip tops into the wine and serve.

title: Shrimp, Spinach and Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 baby red potato, quartered | 6 ounces shrimp, uncooked peeled and deveined | 2 ounces pecorino romano cheese, shaved | 1/2 cup baby spinach, washed
instructions: Combine potatoes, shrimp, cheese and spinach in a large bowl.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,idaho potato,prosciutto,shiitake mushroom,beef chuck,canola oil,rice,cayenne pepper
title: Mushroom and Prosciutto Pot Roast
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 large idaho potatoes, cut into 1/2-inch-thick slices | 2 lbs shiitake mushrooms, stemmed and coarsely chopped | 4 pieces prosciutto, cut into thin strips ( optional ) | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless beef chuck, trimmed of excess fat | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 cups cooked rice | 1 package shiitake mushrooms, stemmed and coarsely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over moderately high heat until hot but not smoking.  Add canola oil and 1 potato slices to heated pan and cook until browned on one side and beginning to soften, about 5 minutes.  Meanwhile, place remaining potato slices between sheets of waxed paper and pound to 1/4 inch thickness or as desired.  Repeat with second potato, adding prosciutto during the last minute of cooking.  Transfer the potatoes to a plate and set aside.  Add half of the mushrooms and the prosciutto to the pan with the oil remaining in it and cook, stirring, until mushrooms are lightly browned, about 3 minutes.  Transfer the mushrooms with a slotted spoon to a plate using a slotted spoon.  Add the meat to the skillet and sprinkle with cayenne and 1/2 cup of the reserved mushrooms.  Reduce heat to moderately low and cook until meat is well browned on the outside.  Transfer the meat and mushrooms to a platter.  Add rice to skillet and bring to a simmer over moderately high heat.  Add 1/8 cup of the mushroom soaking liquid and the remaining liquid.  Cover and cook until the liquid is absorbed and rice is tender, about 10 minutes.  Stir in chopped sauteed mushrooms. title: Traditional Arab Mazurkake

instructions: Place the mushrooms, egg and cheese into the blender on top of a stream, and blend until you have a nice smooth mixture.  Set aside while you prepare the stuffing.  When you have your batter well blended, place it in a small mixing bowl.  To do this, grease a flat casserole pan/s oven dish/tablespoon or small flat pan with ghee.  You can put it in on top of the casserole pan, or it can be covered with a lid or plastic wrap.  A pan can also be used, or you may use a baking dish.  To make the stuffing, melt butter in a medium sauté pan over medium heat.  Add the mushroom mixture and stir until it lightly browns, about 5 minutes.  Strain the mixture through a sieve into a large mixing bowl.  This part of the process sometimes takes me to the trouble of making the ingredients right away.  This part is very important.  If your mixture is too thick or too liquidy, you can add more butter or ghee.  When you are done, pour the batter in the pan, or onto the baking dish in a circular motion as shown above.  When all is mixed in, you may remove the mixture from the pan.  Use a fork or hands to poke all the small holes all over the batter, making sure the mixturkasakake remains free of the mixture.  This will ensure the cheese will not break if you leave it on for a few minutes.  If you do this, you can also let it cook in the pan, allowing the excess liquid to drain off.  Place the mixturkes into the pan and pour the remaining liquid over them.  If the stuffing is not completely covered by the liquid, you can put on the lid for a longer time or to make sure the cheese cooks enough.  Put the dish in the 350 degree oven for about 40 minutes.  The mitzurkasake is ready when the top of its surface is deep golden brown and the mitzurkake is cooked through.  If you open the oven door a few times and it looks a little dry or soggy, it's good to turn the heat back up until it's good too. instructions: In saucepan, heat the broth until heated through.  Add the sour cream and cheese.  Mix well.  Add the oregano and vegetable.  Heat to a boil for 5 minutes.  Spoon the beef mixture into the pan.  Cover and bake at 350f for 45 minutes.  Uncover, and continue baking for 10 - 15 minutes more until the crust is golden brown.

title: Chunky Spanish Scallops
ingredients: 1/2 lb chorizo sausage, removed from casings and chopped | 1/2 lb scallops, thawed if frozen | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f.  Heat the chorizo in a frying pan over medium low heat for about 10 minutes, until it smells and crumbles.  Add the scallops and toss together for one minute.  Remove scallops from pan and place on a small foil lined baking sheet.  Dip the scallops into the chili oil then coat evenly with the scallops.  Bake for 18 minutes or until scallops are crisp and cooked through.

title: Passion Fruit-Glazed Grilled Cheese Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 cup prepared sweet-and-sour passover papaya nectar | 1/4 cup prepared yellow onion, slices | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh ginger | 8 slices monterey jack pepper cheese | 8 slices toasted bread, or as desired
instructions: Pour passover nectar into a small saucepan, and bring to a boil over medium heat.  Boil for 1 minute, then remove from heat and stir in the onion, ginger, and pepper jack cheese. title: Peking New Year's Day Ladyfingers
ingredients: 2 plantains, peeled and cut into 6 pieces each | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 4 whole cardamom pods, crushed | salt and pepper to taste | 18 ladyfingers
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a simmer while preparing the plantains, and place the whole peeled plantains into the water.  Cook slowly at a simmer, adding more water as needed, until plantains are tender with peels attached, about 20 minutes.  Drain water, drain plantains and set aside.  Stir together the oregano, crushed cardamom, salt and pepper in a small bowl.  Brush the cut side of 1 plantain with oil, then spread the seasoned side with the prepared paste.  Repeat with the remaining plantains.  To assemble, set a ladyfinger on a plate.  Brush the cut side of the remaining plantain with the remaining oil.  Arrange a couple of plantain slices on top of the ladyfinger, then spread a teaspoonful of the oregano oil over the plantain layer.  Top with more plantain slices, then sprinkle with a few drops of soy sauce.  Serve, or refrigerate the new year's ladyfingers.

Cover and keep warm.  To serve, transfer the eggs to warmed serving bowls, pour a little of the reduced bacon wine over the bacon and eggs, and garnish with a sprinkle of the grated lemon peel.

title: Crispy Beef Brisket and Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 3 lbs beef brisket | 5 tablespoons flour tortillas | 24 roma tomatoes, cut into large pieces | 1 cup coleslaw mix | 3 -4 tablespoons hot paprika | 1 cup chevre cheese ( chevre is a soft white cheese ) | 1 cup tortilla chips
instructions: Brown brisket in 5 tablespoons of flour until browned, remove.  Add remaining 1 tablespoon of flour, tortillas and tomatoes to drippings in skillet.  Cook over medium heat until cornmeal begins to form on the bottom of the pan.  Add the cheese and cook until cheese is melted.  Remove from heat.  Drain brisket and place in a greased 9x13 pan. title: Lek (Split Peek, Garlic & Herb)
ingredients: 12 baby leeks | crouton
instructions: Wash & trim the leeks.  Wash & slit them, trimming the tops off.  Separate the white stalks of the leeks & separate the stalks into the white stalks, wash the leeks & cut them into slices about 30' long & 2' wide, set aside.  Bring a large quantity of water to boiling, add the blanching liquid & cover, simmer for 15 minutes.  Take off the heat & allow the leeks undisturbed to steam for about 1 - 2 minutes & the cooking liquid to run clear.  Remove the leeks w/a slotted spoon & leave to cool, then remove the strings & roughly chop the veggies.  Tip, to remove excess water, drain the water before adding this to the pan.  Cover & place in the fridge to chill, when ready to serve or cook ahead to cool & store at room temperature till required.

title: Rigatoni With Chinese Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta | 1 1/2 quarts light cream ( half and half works well ) or 1 1/2 quarts light cream ( half and half works well ) | 12 ounces shucked oysters ( half and half works well )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.

instructions: Preheat grill or toaster oven to medium.  Lightly coat a 12 inch non stick skillet or a large grilling pan with cooking spray.

title: French Onion Pie
ingredients: 1 pie crust | 1/4 lb gruyere cheese, shredded or grated | 1/4 cup white vinegar | minced fresh bonito flakes ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Mix vinegar and garnish with minced or powdered bonito flakes if using.

title: Chili Dogs
ingredients: 16 ounces green chiles | 1 white sweet bell pepper, cut into strips
instructions: Heat a small skillet over medium high heat.  Combine the chilies and green chilies in a blender.  Cover, and blend on high until smooth.  Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Cook and stir the bell pepper slices just until softened, 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Tilapia (Iceland)
ingredients: 1 tilapia fillet | 2 tablespoons margarine ( for frying ) | 1/4 cup cubed sharp cheddar cheese ( for topping )
instructions:
In a non stick skillet, melt the margarine on low.  Turning the heat as high as you can until butter is bubbly around the edges of the pan.  Turning the tilapia into the butter is highly recommended.  Spread the tilapia fillet in the butter, about 1/4 inch thick.  After about 1 minute, the fish will be cooked by your desired degree of doneness, or ala dente.  Flip.  Spread the cheese on top.  I like to serve mine over a rice, so when it is served, i put the tilapia on top of the cheese and put the other piece of cheese on top.  A couple of slices of cheese on the side 

 ## Cooking instructions ##
 Melt the margarine in a large skillet over high heat.  Sprinkle the fish with the cheese and brown on each side, 5 - 7 minutes per side depending on the thickness.  You may need to cook the fish to ensure that the cheese on top is melted and flaky, or to ensure that the fish flakes as easily as possible when turned.  I have found that to be able to turn the fish when its white on one side, it just gives a better result.

instructions: In a pan over medium heat, add the sausages and sausages and cook until browned and cooked through.  Remove from pan and set aside.  Drain any excess fat, if any.  Add the water to the pan and return to the heat.  Scrape down the browned sauce with a spoon.  Add the broccoli and sausages to the skillet and cook until the broccoli is just tender crisp and the sausage cooked through.  Season with soy sauce and serve immediately.

title: Choc-Beef Cubes
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless chuck roast | 1 jar tomatoes with juice | 1 orange, cut in half | 1 tablespoon baking cocoa | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 1/4 white onion, minced ( optional ) | 1/2 cup rice milk ( more as needed )
instructions: Cut beef into small cubes.  Reserve the juice, but save 1/4 cup.  Place all ingredients in a large skillet.  Cover and cook on medium heat for 3 or 4 minutes.  If using the onions add during the last few minutes of cooking.  Stir.  Remove meat.  Add reserved juice as needed to equal 3/4 cup.  Reduce heat to very low.  Cover and cook for 2 hours.  Do not stir again.  Remove meat from pan.  Set liquid aside.  Remove skin from orange, then thinly slice.  Mix in a small bowl, adding brown sugar and cocoa to the meat juices.  Serve over brown rice.

Cook on the preheated grill until the bacon is crispy, and the salmon is easily flaked with a fork, 10 to 12 minutes, depending on thickness. Remove the salmon from the grill, and allow to rest for about five minutes before grilling.  Remove the bacon, and set aside.  Sprinkle apples with lime juice, and set aside.  When the salmon is done, baste several times with teriyaki sauce mixture.  Garnish with some cilantro and lime slices.

title: Blueberry Jam

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Place the potatoes in a pan of water and bring to the boil.  Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes or until tender. instructions: Warm the molasses with a generous dash of water and let stand for about 10 minutes.  Put all the ingredients in a mixing bowl and mix well.  Cover and allow to chill for about 10 minutes before eating.

title: Cucumber Spaghetti (Spaghetti Cones)
ingredients: 3 cucumbers, medium dice | 8 ounces white bread, cut into 1/2 inch cubes ( crusty or hard ) | 1 can pickled cucumbers, very thinly sliced | 1 1/2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1/2 tablespoon pickling spices | 3/4 cup apple cider or 3/4 cup water | spaghetti ( or other short pasta ) | confectioners'sugar
instructions: Put all ingredients except the spaghetti and confectioners' sugar in a large pot over low heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, for about 15 minutes.  Serve warm with optional cheese and dill or cream.

title: The All Canadian "meat" Foccacia
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons pickling spices | 2 1/2 cups coconut milk | 4 cups pureed cooked meat from a rotisserie rotisserie roti ( meat from deli ) | 1 cup finely grated cheese | 4 tablespoons sliced of fresh mint | 1/2 cup shredded coconut | 1 1/2 tablespoons crushed amaretto | 4 loaves round provolone cheese | 2 loaf focaccia bread or 2 loaves round sandwich buns
instructions: Prepare the pickling spice by combining 1 teaspoon of the pickling spice with 2 teaspoons of the coconut milk in a bowl.  Heat the remaining coconut milk, 1 1/2 cup of the remaining spice mixture, the meat from the rotisserie, 2 tablespoons of the cheese and the mint, in a saucepan over medium low heat.  Reduce the heat slightly, and simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes, skimming off any scum and fat that rises to the surface.  Transfer the hot mixture to a bowl.  Add 1/2 cup of the cheese to the meat, and gently stir until completely incorporated.  Divide the meat among the 4 loaves of provolone cheese.  Top with another slice of provolone cheese, and allow to melt.  Place the stuffed focaccia on a baking sheet, and top with the remaining 1/2 cup of cheese.  Bake in a 350 degree f oven for 10 minutes, or until cheese is completely melted.  Serve with a drizzle of amaretto or a spoonful of rum syrup.

title: Easy Mexican Sausage Bread
ingredients: 1 lb pork chop, cut into cubes | 1 cup prepared masa harina ( or corn flour ) | 1 cup fresh cranberries or 1 cup frozen cranberries | 1/2 cup salsa | 1/2 cup bisquick
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f in 12x16 pan combine the turkey, corn flour, cranberries and salsa.  Stir to combine.  Place pork with marinade between pieces of plastic wrap so that they are completely coated.  Place in pan, cover and bake in oven 45 - 50 minutes or until tender.  Remove from oven and allow to cool before slicing.  Great with a dollop of sour cream.

title: Olive Tapenade
ingredients: 4 tablespoons spanish olives, chopped | 20 -12 sprigs parsley, chopped | 1/4 cup raw caster sugar ( superfine sugar ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Sieve all the ingredients into a bowl, using a coarse filter onto a plate.  The tapenade will sink into the bowl and will be gritty unlike ordinary tapenade, and will stain clothing or Water.  Wrap tapenade in clingfilm and set aside for 30 minutes.  Using your hands, remove tapenade from the bowl and place on a flat surface or tray.  Break up any lumps with the blade of a knife and gently press them through the funnel of your food processor.  This will make a rich tapenade.  Pour tapenade into piping bag fitted with a medium sized star tip.  Seal with a twist tie the bag and bash a hole in the top.  Repeat the bash and smear tapenade over the tapenade every 15 minutes.  If you want to speed this up, you can chill the tapenade for a few hours now.  To serve, simply slice through the bag and serve.  It will sink in slowly so eat your food the way you like it.

title: Lebanese Laban - Bread & Cheese Filled Bread

instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the lentils, yeast and the warm water.  Allow to sit for 10 minutes, or until the yeast begins to froth.
