ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup dry onion flakes | 2/3 cup chopped granny smith apples | 2/3 cup uncooked arborio rice | 2 cups chicken broth | 6 fresh lime wedges | 1 cup barbeque sauce
instructions: Place lentils, onion, apples, rice, and broth in a 2 quart casserole.  Toss with lime juice, and marinate 3 hours, or overnight.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Bake 25 minutes in preheated oven, then broil 5 minutes.  Spoon a 1/4 cup barbeque sauce on top of each serving.

title: Macadamia Crusted Crusted Scallops
ingredients: 600 g scallops | 1 mango, cut into 5 cm cubes | 100 g shaved macadamia nuts | 1 teaspoon demerara sugar
instructions: Brush the scallops with oil and lightly sprinkle with sugar.  Place in an oven tray lined with baking paper.  Cook in a preheated oven for 25 - 30 mins or until cooked.  Serve with mango, macadamia nuts and extra demerara sugar.

title: Jicama Macaroni
ingredients: 225 g jicama | 1 bag of pasta
instructions: Cube jicama and cook.  Cook pasta according to package directions.  When pasta is fully cooked and jicama is done, drain and toss with pasta mix.

title: The Perfect Pepper Relish
ingredients: 8 red bell peppers | 2 yellow bell peppers | 1/2 red onion, finely diced
instructions: Heat the grill.  Peel, core, and chop the red and white peppers into large pieces about 4 x 1/2 x 1/2.  Combine the bell peppers and red onion.  Pour hot tap water over them to cover.  Stir, cover and put back on grill and cook 15 minutes.  Check the peppers for tenderness.  Adjust the seasonings, if desired.  Transfer the onions and peppers to a platter.  Cover with aluminum foil and let cool to room temperature.  Store for up to 3 days in the refrigerator.  Makes about 10 cups.

Random Ingredients: pepper,maple syrup,bean sprout,golden syrup,ginger garlic paste,teriyaki sauce,fennel seed,yogurt
title: Bean Sprouts Salad
ingredients:
16 ounces bean sprouts ( approx.
    - 1 pound fresh sprouts ) | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 tablespoon teriyaki sauce | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | pepper | 8 tablespoons prepared creamy yogurt
instructions: Combine all the ingredients and toss well.  Refrigerate for 30 minutes before serving.

title: Quick Meat Pizza
ingredients: 1 tablespoon beef or 1 tablespoon lamb fat | 1 tablespoon pork fat or 1 tablespoon veal fat | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves ( i used oregano powder, not fresh ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla pod | 1 teaspoon whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup pistachios or 1/2 cup cashews ( if you don't have them, soak them in warm water )
instructions: Pre heat your oven to 210c.  In a bowl, add the meat or fat and mix well.  Add the dry spices, mix.  Add the flour a little at a time, until it makes a smooth paste.  Add the nuts and mix again.  Transfer the mixture onto a greased and floured baking tray.  Bake for 20 mins, then serve with a salad and/or vegetables.  Enjoy.

title: Easy Salmon #5FIX
ingredients: 16 ounces simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1 package simply potatoes starch | 1 can salmon ( skinless )
instructions: Cook potatoes according to package instructions with 1 package refrigerated seasoning.  While potatoes are cooking, remove skinned salmon from bones and cut into small chunks, do not remove bones.  Shake the can of salmon over a medium pot to get the juices out and place salmon in bottom of pot, add the cooked potatoes on top of it and finally you can put top of potatoes on salmon.  Once potatoes are done, mix the 1 package of simply potato starch with a little cold water until there are no lumps or lumps left.  Pour the potato starch mixture over the salmon mixture and mix lightly until mixed well.  Then cover and wait about 20 minutes.  When it looks halfway done, it's done.  Pour salmon on top of potatoes and enjoy.

title: Eggplant With Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 medium eggplants | 500 g button mushrooms, chopped | 125 ml currants | 1 teaspoon cooking oil | 1 tablespoon tomato ketchup | 2 lemons, juice and zest of, finely grated | 1 pinch dried lemon twists ( optional )
instructions: Roast, then peel the eggplants or eggplants, and slice them lengthwise, into fours.  Spread out the slices so that they overlap, and leave to dry out over a cool place.  Put the mushrooms, currants, oil, tomato ketchup, lemon rind and juice, if desired, in a bowl, and mash together well.  Spread mixture over the eggplant slices, and sprinkle with optional lemon twist, if using, and return to the oven for 30 minutes, until the sauce has reduced to a thick consistency and the eggplant is very tender.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,plain flour,white pepper,pistachio,espresso,green cardamom pod,seasoning salt,asafoetida powder
title: Spicy Pistachio Ears
ingredients: 2 cups plain flour, sifted | 2 -3 teaspoons black pepper | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt | 3/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons white pepper | 2 green cardamom pods, cracked down their pod | 3 tablespoons espresso ( or strong brewed coffee ) | 1/4 cup pistachios, chopped
instructions: To make batter, place flour, black pepper, seasoned salt, asafoetida and white pepper in blender and pulse a few times to combine.  Using a rubber spatula, pour in espresso and pulse just until blended.  Add pistachios.  Blend until dough resembles bread crumbs.  Lightly grease large bowl and refrigerate batter till needed.  Shape and roll out dough mixture to about 1/4 inch thick and cut into 6 pieces.  Arrange on baking tray and bake at 375f for 8 - 10 minutes or till light brown.  Cool on wire racks.  Cut rounds with a 3 1/2 or 4 cookie cutter and spread with 1 teaspoon espresso or strong coffee.

Random Ingredients: tamarind juice,white sugar,queso fresco,lemon juice,roast beef,strawberry,vegetable broth
title: Strawberry Beef (Or Pork) Soup
ingredients: 3 large ripe strawberries | 2 1/2 cups vegetable broth or 2 1/2 cups chicken broth | 1 1/2 lbs roast beef or 1 1/2 lbs pork, cut into strips | 1/4 cup white sugar or 1/4 cup brown sugar | 2 slices lemons, juice of | 2 tablespoons tamarind juice | 3/4 cup queso fresco | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar or 1/2 teaspoon brown sugar
instructions: Trim, remove the top layer of thick stems from the strawberries, and set aside.  Cut the remaining strawberries in half if they are large but not completely ripened.  Slice the berries crosswise in half and set aside.  In a large soup pot, bring about 7 quarts of water or stock to a boil.  Add the beef or pork, sugar, lemon juice, tamarind juice and strawberries.  Return to a boil, partially cover, and simmer for about 45 minutes or until the meat, pork or vegetables are tender.  Remove the cover and cook another 20 minutes.  Stir the stew, remove the fruit, stir well, and cover.  Add a splash of white sugar during the last five minutes of cooking.  Serve at once.  Variant, add sliced, fresh bread, mushrooms, or egg noodles.

title: Chipotle Chili
ingredients: 2 chipotle chiles in adobo | 2 roma tomatoes | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Prepare a grill for heat, lightly oil grill rack or line with aluminum foil.  Place chiles and tomatoes on grate over medium heat.  Sprinkle chiles and tomatoes with mace and cook, turning occasionally until chiles are heated through and chiles and tomatoes are crisp, about 10 minutes.  Remove from grill, and serve.

title: Quick & Easy Fajita-Style Wraps
ingredients: 2 whole wheat tortillas | 2 teaspoons cider vinegar ( or malt vinegar if you can ) | 1 cucumber, peeled, seeded, finely chopped | 1 can sliced sweet peas, rinsed and drained | 3 brussels sprouts, thinly sliced | 1 cup lettuce, cut in ribbons | 1 cup mini marshmallows
instructions: Spray a 9 x 13 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.

title: Simple Mexican Grill Roast Lamb
ingredients: 1 whole leg of lamb ( about 3 pounds ) | 2 jars tomatillo salsa | 2/3 cup picante sauce | 1 package graham crackers
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Rub meat with salsa.  Place meat in foil lined roasting pan, and surround with foil.  Roast 45 minutes.  Remove foil, and let meat rest 10 minutes before slicing.  Place in a large, shallow platter, sprinkle with graham crackers and cover with foil again.  Bake 1 hour in the preheated oven, then remove from oven and cover with foil.  Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: vanilla ice cream,parmigiano reggiano cheese,peanut,lard,tea leaf,dark brown sugar,pastry flour
title: Le Pistou (Tea Pastry Cream)
ingredients: 1 pastry flour | 1/2 cup cold lard | 8 teaspoons unsalted butter, cut in small cubes | 15 large dried pecorino rinds, cut in half | 2 cups tea leaves | 1 cup dark brown sugar | parmigiano-reggiano cheese, freshly grated plus | 12 pecorino-romano cheese leaves ( a specialty part of the world )
instructions: Make pastry, combine pastry flour and lard in processor.  Add butter, pulsing 3 times.  Gather pastry and form into a ball.  Add cold cuts and process for 15 seconds.  Turn out onto a floured surface.  Roll out to a 3/4 inch thickness.  Fold dough into 4 inch log and place on baking sheet.  Leave uncovered on lowest oven rack.  Pour boiling water in baking sheet until it comes halfway up sides of pan.  Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Make pistou, place teabags of pecorino rind in tea strainer and place over a kettle of simmering water to melt sugar.  Pour hot sugar into small tea strainer over kettle, discarding rinds.  Cover with a cloth and place tea kettle over kettle and allow to steep for 5 minutes until syrupy.  Pour liquid through tea strainer.  Measure 2 cups of liquid into a bowl and add enough reserved liquid to total 2 cups of liquid and set aside.  Strain syrup into bowl and set aside.  When sugar mixture has cooled to warm place 1 tablespoon of softened butter and 1 tablespoon of chiffonade in food processor and chop until butter is about 1/4 inch.  Add 2 tablespoons cooled syrup mixture and chopped pecorino rinds and pulse until mixture forms coarse mixture.  With motor running, add tea leaves and pulse until mixture forms paste.  Cut pastry into 4 inch log.  Transfer log, pastry side down, onto baking sheet and spread with 2 tablespoons soft butter.  Bake in centre of preheated oven until top is golden, about 25 minutes.  Remove from oven and cool slightly.  Remove paper from top and cut into eight 1/4 inch wide rectangles.  Set aside.  Place the 2 tablespoons soft butter back into food processor and process 1 minute longer.  Add 2 tablespoons of chiffonade.  Remove dough from water.  Press with tines of a fork into bottom and 3/4 inch up sides of each rectangle, overlapping edges.  Place each rectangle on each of 6 serving plates.  Garnish with remaining pecorino rind.  Serve immediately.  Note, nutralino rind can be ground in food processor with other hard tubular ingredients.  If using chiffonade and cheese, you may have to add some water to achieve this.

Random Ingredients: mint extract,avocado,pasta sauce,pea,vegetable,red curry paste,agave nectar
title: Curried and Green Pea Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb of shelled peas | 5 small avocados | 2 cups pasta sauce, ragu ragu is my favorite brand | 1 cup mixed vegetables, shirl home is my favorite brand | 1 tablespoon red curry paste ( i use madras style ) | 2 teaspoons mint extract | 2 tablespoons agave nectar
instructions: First you need to cook your veggies, so be prepared to choose the type of ones you would like to cook.  Once you are ready to cook your veggies, boil your peas for about 20 minutes, then drain and throw away any excess water.  Chop the avocados in half and put in large bowl.  Add the frozen peas to your avocados and mash the avocado with a fork.  Then add your prepared veggies to the bowl, and mix well.  Now mix your sauce, agave and mint extract if using and add to the bowl.  If you are using your vegan option, you may need to add the agave and mint extracts a little at a time until the sauce is the right consistency.  Otherwise, mix all the ingredients in a bowl and serve.

title: Noodle Ice Cream Kebabs
ingredients: 1 lb egg noodles | 2 teaspoons turmeric | 3/4 cup vanilla ice cream | 1 lemon, juice of ( from 1/2 orange ) | 2 slices gingerroot | 4 kiwi, peeled and quartered
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling water until al dente, drain & set aside.  Puree garlic, ginger with turmeric in blender & add to noodles.  Mix well & refrigerate for 1 hour or till cold.  Stir vanilla ice cream to combine, stir well & chill.  Thread ingredients onto bamboo skewers, refrigerate for 40 minutes or till cold.  Cook kebabs over hot heat, turning & basting frequently with sauce.

title: Chocolate-Cut Glazed bamboo Shoots
ingredients: 1 jar bamboo shoots, undrained | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: In a large heavy skillet, combine bamboo shoots, cocoa, and cinnamon.  Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, 2 to 4 minutes or until glaze is thickened.

title: Chinese Chicken and Ham
ingredients: 12 chicken breast fillets, skin on | 200 g thin thinly slice prosciutto | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum
instructions: Heat oven to 180 degrees.  Put prosciutto on a baking pan, top with chicken fillets and place in oven for 20 minutes.  While the chicken is cooking, mix the xanthan gum and a tablespoon of water together.  Stir in a cup of cold water until dissolved.  Pour over the chicken and return to oven for another 20 minutes or until chicken is fully cooked through.  Serve with steamed vegetables or rice.

title: Spicy Tart Sent from Angels, Italy
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive, diced | 100 g red capsicums, deveined, diced very well | 4 star fruit, each cut into 5 pieces | vanilla ice cream, to serve
instructions: Heat up your baking dish for 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, heat up the olive in a non stick frying pan on low for 5 minutes.  Add the capsicum and starfruit.

instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f.  Remove stems from mushrooms.  Rinse mushrooms, dry and cut into quarters.  Combine cream cheese, coconut milk, lemon juice, watercress and hot sauce.

instructions: Place all ingredients in a 9 square baking dish and cover with plastic wrap.  Seal and bake at 325f for 1 hour.  Remove from oven and cool completely.  Cut into squares. For a light crusty topping, spoon some caramelized sugar syrup over before topping with caramelized sugar sprinkles.

title: Harmie Brown's Black Bean Sauce

instructions: Heat soup, sun dried tomato, and half and half in a large skillet over medium high heat until heated through, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,navel orange,vegetable oil cooking spray,beer,chive,mexican cheese,sun tomato
title: Chilled Pizza With Heirloom Tomatoes & Raisins
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 6 -8 grape tomatoes, washed and sliced | 1 navel orange, peeled and chopped | 1/3 lb mexican cheese, sliced diagonally | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato, sliced thin | 12 -14 ounces best-quality beer | 1/4 cup snipped fresh chives
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees f.  Place a 12 inch nonstick frying pan on the middle rack of the oven while preheating to medium.  Spray the pan with oil so it doesn't stick and heat until very hot.  Add tomatoes & orange and cook for 7 to 8 minutes, stirring often, until softened.  Top each slice of cheese with about 4 t of the sundried tomatoes and then with a thin layer of mozzarella and sprinkle with 1 t of the chives.  Repeat layering to make four stacks, top each with another 4 stacked stacks of cheese, remaining tomatoes and onions, dividing evenly among the 4 stacks, and finally top with 4 more stacks of cheese, sun dried tomatoes and remaining chives.  Top each pizza with the last 4 stacks of cheese, placing them under the broiler to crisp the tops of the cheese.  When cheese turns bubbly and golden, carefully slide the pizza onto a wire rack to cool slightly.  Eat immediately.

title: Spicy Cheese Sticks

instructions: Wash fresh arugula leaves several times to remove sand and debris.  Tear arugula into large pieces.  Add almonds to salad bowl.  Shake salad bowl to mix. .

title: Chilean Ancho and Jalapeno (Sherry)

instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f cut 2 long strips from each chicken breast, then pound chicken with flat side of meat mallet until meat is completely flattened.

Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly.  Pour into bowls and serve.

title: Pastis Fresca
ingredients: 1 cup cake flour or 1 cup cornmeal | 1 cup canola oil ( for frying ) or 1 cup olive oil ( for frying )
instructions: Heat the oil to 180c/350f.  Pour approximately 2 ladles of oil into a deep heavy frying pan to reach the correct temperature.  The oil needs to be quite hot before the oil bubbles. When all the cake flour has been added to the batter, cover the plate with plastic wrap and set aside for at least 12 hours or overnight.  If your oil has come to temperature, be careful to check the temperature first.  Pour out about a third of batter a time.  The batter should be runny in colour while it is still wet, but not runny.  Drain the pasta immediately, shaking the pasta occasionally to remove excess oil.  Drain the pasta well and return it to the oil.  Place a metal or silicone sieve, sieve or colander underneath to catch any oil that rises to the top of the pasta.  The sieve should hold a steady hand.  The sieve should also hold a steady hand.  If the sieve sits on its side for a few seconds, its oil will separate and the pasta will look wet.  Fry the pasta until it begins to curl and turns golden and crisp.  Drain on absorbent paper. title: Pepperoni Beef Rollups
ingredients: 3/4 lb sirloin steak, very thinly sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, peeled, grated or 3/8 tsp fresh ginger, grated | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 1 lb american cheese, room temperature | 10 slices thin hot pepperoni | fresh parsley flakes ( optional )
instructions: Combine steak, curry powder, ginger, baking powder, and pepper.  Shape into 8 1/2 thick rolls.  Wrap cheese slices in 1 slice of hot pepperoni and place in 4 1/2 cup ovenproof skillet.  Bake@ 350 for 20 minutes.  Sprinkle with fresh parsley.

title: Vanille Kipferln
ingredients: 3 ounces cognac | 1/4 cup port wine
instructions: Combine cognac and port wine in a double boiler and heat until the port has absorbed everything into the mixture.  Pour into a sterilized pint jar with a tight fitting lid.  Seal and store in a sunny spot.

Random Ingredients: beef roast,swiss chard,whipping cream,celery seed,lemon juice,breadcrumb,kosher salt
title: Savory Swiss Chard (Or Spinach) Roast With Fresh Herbs
ingredients: kosher salt | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs swiss chard ( or other coarse green beans ) | 1/2 cup fresh breadcrumb | 2 tablespoons lemon juice or 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs boneless beef roast or 1 1/2-2 lbs boneless pork loin, trimmed of fat | 1 cup whipping cream ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Lightly oil a 10 inch ovenproof skillet or a roasting pan with a low heat.  Sprinkle the salt over the chard stems 1 or 2 times and then coat the chard with salt.  Place chard in the center of the pan and turn over so that it is now whole and all sides have been coated with salt.  Arrange the chard stem end down on top of the chard.  Scatter the bread crumbs evenly over.  Drizzle lemon juice over the chard.  Sprinkle celery seed evenly over.  Wrap tightly in foil and then bake until tender when pierced with a small knife about 1 hour 15 minutes.  Remove from oven, let stand 5 to 10 minutes and then slice thinly.  The chard can be eaten either warm or at room temperature.

title: Grilled Cranberry Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 1 tablespoon fresh orange juice | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/3 cup thinly sliced fresh mushrooms | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cranberries
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the vinegar, orange juice, orange juice, cinnamon, and mushrooms.  Cover, and refrigerate to blend flavors, 2 to 4 hours.  Preheat grill to medium high, or preheat broiler.  To serve, lightly oil grill grate.  Remove mushrooms from dressing and discard marinade.  Place mushrooms on skewers and grill 5 minutes on each side, basting with marinade after 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Yummy Pomegranate Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 quarts saffron | 2 cups white sugar | 2 cups plain yogurt | 15 whole peppercorns | 10 porcini mushrooms | 1/3 cup pomegranate molasses | 15 peppercorns
instructions: Dissolve saffron in 1 1/2 cups boiling water.  Add 1 cup sugar and stir.  Cool completely.  To prepare the pomegranate molasses, bring boiling syrup to boil, add 1/3 cup water and let boil 2 to 3 minutes.  Reduce heat.  Slowly stir in 3 pkgs.  Serpicao puedins mushrooms and 1/3 cup yoghurt.  Dip mushrooms in warm pomegranate molasses.  Stack them in a large, shallow baking dish and sprinkle with a few peppercorns before placing on top of the pomegranate syrup mixture.  Sprinkle with remaining peppercorns.  Cook at 400f 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Corn and Pepper Enchiladas
ingredients: 600 g chuck or 600 g armflour tortillas | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1/2 cup corn | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/3 cup flour
instructions: Preheat oven 200°c.  Roll out tortillas to about 20g.  Thick.  Brush with oil.  Place in a 9x13 casserole.  Pour stock over.  Combine corn, sugar, marjoram and chilli flakes.  Sprinkle over tortillas.  Cover with tin foil and bake in preheated oven for 45 - 60 minutes, depending on thickness of tortillas.  Check after 15 minutes.

title: Red Hot Beets With Prosciutto
ingredients: 4 medium beets, about 1 pound each, trimmed | 4 slices prosciutto, about 1/2 pound
instructions: Place beets on a sheet pan and bake, turning at least once, at 400° for 20 minutes, or until roasted and starting to show signs of browning.  Place beets in a sieve set over a pan and drizzle with 1 teaspoon cream.  Cover and chill for at least 30 minutes, up to overnight.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,extra virgin olive oil,streaky bacon,beet,clear honey,grain rice,honey,red potato
title: Bacon and Beet Stuffed Potatoes
ingredients: 4 medium cooked beets, cut into 1-inch slices | 8 small red potatoes, halved | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 8 slices streaky bacon | 1/2 cup raw long grain rice | 1/2 cup ra el hanout spice mix | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 2 teaspoons honey ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190c/fan 160c/gas 4/moderate.  Heat the oil in a pan and fry the bacon and potatoes for 3 - 5 minutes on each side, stirring all the time until the bacon has become golden and crispy.  Stir in the rice, ra el hanout spice, honey and if using, the honey and bring to the boil.  Once the rice has begun to absorb the oil, stir in the oil mixture, then the beet slices.  Place the mixture into a baking dish and bake the mixture in the oven for 45 - 55 minutes or until the potatoes are crispy and tender.  Serve with extra yoghurt.

Random Ingredients: pizza sauce spaghetti,rice wine vinegar,white vinegar,pecan,tomato soup
title: Quick French Onion Salad
ingredients: 6 medium tomatoes, cut into quarters | 1 can tomato soup | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1/2 cup finely chopped pecans
instructions: Combine all ingredients with hands.  Refrigerate before serving.  Note, if desired, add 1 tablespoon lemon or lime juice to dressing.  To make a slurry for a thicker dressing, stir 1 teaspoon of cornstarch into 1 teaspoon cold water.  Heat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place the slurry in a small bowl and stir in the cornstarch.  Add dressing and mix to coat.  Place in large baking dish.  Bake 25 minutes or until top is very lightly browned.

title: Mango Pecan Dessert
ingredients: 1 ripe mango, peeled and grated | 2 sprigs fresh pecans | 1 1/2 tablespoons ouzo | 4 tablespoons coarse brown sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard seeds
instructions: Blend ingredients.  Chill and serve.

title: Black Bean Vodka
ingredients: 1 lb black beans or 1 lb red kidney beans | 1 scallion, sliced ( green parts only ) | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1/8 - 1/4 fluid ounce vodka
instructions: Place the beans in a 4 gallon pot.  Cover with water, about 2 inches above and bring to boil.  Reduce heat and simmer for 2 hours and 45 minutes, basting occasionally.  Add scallion and brown sugar, simmer 1 minute.  Fill into sterilized canning jars leaving 1/4 inch headspace.  Place on lids and process in hot water 2 hours from the cooking time in the canner.  The liquid should have turned into a creamy foam that appears to rise to the surface.  When the foam has begun to subside, take out of the heat and let cool for 5 minutes.  Place in sterile jars and seal.  The liquid can also be used to cool rice dumplings.

title: Presto Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning | 1 lb pork tenderloin | 1/2 cup low sodium vegetable broth | parmesan cheese, grated ( optional )
instructions: Coat the tenderloins lightly with poultry seasoning and place over medium high heat in a large nonstick skillet.  Cook, turning frequently, until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.  Add broth and bring to boil.  Decrease heat to low and simmer, covered, until the meat registers 125 degrees, about 45 minutes.  Transfer the tenderloins to a cutting board and slice 1/4 inch thick.  Sprinkle with parmesan cheese if desired.

title: Pineapple Glazed Pineapple
ingredients: 1 pineapple chunk, peeled and cut into thirds | 3 tablespoons bacon drippings | 1 tablespoon lime juice | vegetable oil, for deep frying | 1 tablespoon marshmallows, chopped
instructions: Arrange pineapple in a single layer on a baking sheet, so they will sit flat.  Sprinkle with drippings.  Sprinkle with lime juice.  Drizzle with oil.  Sprinkle with marshmallows and serve.

Random Ingredients: part ricotta cheese,custard powder,lemon peel,lime zest,chili,irish whiskey,cashew,garam masala powder
title: Spicy Cashew Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb part-skim ricotta cheese | 1/3 cup chopped cashews | 1/4 cup chopped roasted sweet chili | 1/2 teaspoon fresh grated lemon peel | 1/4 teaspoon lime zest | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1/2 teaspoon custard powder | 1/3 cup irish whiskey
instructions: In processor combine ricotta, cashews, chillies, zest, garam masala powder and custard powder.  Cover and process until mixture forms a ball.  Form mixture into smooth ball.  Cover and chill for 1 hour.  Spoon into 3 1/2 cup ramekins or 8 oz custard cups.  Cover and refrigerate until set, about 3 hours.  Serve as an appetizer.

title: Lemonade Bread Soda Bread
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs breadcrumbs | 3 cups cream, or more to taste | 1/2 cup fresh lemonade, chilled
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  In a large bowl, stir together bread crumbs, cream and lemonade and pour onto baking sheet.  Form loaves into large pretzel size pieces about 1 inch thick and about 1 inch in diameter.  Bake at 425 degrees f for 20 to 30 minutes, until golden.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,coffee,thai chili sauce,mint,pineapple chunk,roast beef,fruit,garlic salt
title: Thai Roast Beef with Booze It up
ingredients: 1 cup crushed pineapple chunk | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 2 tablespoons dried fruit ( apricots, pineapple, apricots, craisins ) | 1 teaspoon dried mint | 1 teaspoon thai sweet chili sauce ( nam prik phir ) | 4 lbs top round roast beef, trimmed of excess fat and cut into 6 cubes | 1 cup brewed coffee | 1/4 cup brewed coffee-flavored non-sweetened coffee-scented rum ( baileys )
instructions: Place the crushed pineapple chunks, garlic, dried fruit, mint, and thai chili sauce in the crock of a slow cooker.  Add roast in that order.  Stir 1 cup brewed coffee into the coffee until evenly mixed.  Cook on low for 7 hours.

title: Peachy Cashew Salad
ingredients: 1 ripe peach, peeled and diced | 2 scallions, minced | 200 g apricot preserves, softened | 125 g caster sugar ( super fine sugar ) | 4 pinches ground cardamom | 125 g golden caster sugar ( super fine sugar ) | 10 cashews
instructions: Mix the cashew nuts together.  Cut the peach into rounds about 2 mm thick and then dice them.  Mince the scallions.  Mix the cashew pecan nuts with the peach, scallion, apricot jam and caster sugar to make a simple dressing.  Pour over the salad, and serve.

title: Korma (Black-Eyed Peas Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice ( washed, soaked overnight, and then chopped into medium-sized pieces ) ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon black-eyed peas ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon channa dal ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds ( optional )
instructions: Put all ingredients, except for the 1/2 cup water, into the cooker, and mix well.  Close lid, and cook on high for 30 minutes.  Let cooker sit for 30 minutes, then open, remove lid, and fluff with a fork before serving.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,chorizo sausage,lemon juice,sugar substitute,cornflour,water chestnut
title: Cocktail
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 cup lemon juice ( depending on the freshness ) | 1 bunch fresh coriander ( finely chopped ) | 1 can water chestnuts, drained and finely chopped | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon sugar substitute | 2 -3 tablespoons orange juice ( to taste ) | 4 -5 tablespoons cornflour
instructions: Sieve or strain the juice through a fine sieve.  Discard coriander.  Combine all ingredients well and put through a meat grinder or food blender if desired.

title: Fennel Beer Blender
ingredients: 24 ounces beer | 1/2 teaspoon ground dried marjoram | 1/2 teaspoon dried fennel, crumbled | 16 ounces hazelnuts, skins peeled
instructions: Strain beer into a large pitcher.  Add marjoram, fennel, and hazelnuts.

title: Moroccan Couscous With Nuts and Fruit
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups quick-cooking couscous | 1/2 spanish onions or 1/2 vidalia onion, finely chopped | 1 cup walnuts | 1 cup dried mixed fruit
instructions: Combine couscous, onion, walnuts, and fruit in large bowl.  Add water 1/4 cup at a time.  The couscous will expand and thicken as it is absorbed.  Refrigerate until completely cooled.

title: Easy English Green Beans
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs green beans, trimmed | 1 1/2 tablespoons golden syrup
instructions: Cover the green beans with boiling water.  Boil 5 minutes or until tender.  Drain and plunge into cold water to halt the cooking.  Cool slightly.  Cut the beans in half lengthwise to remove the strings.  Warm the syrup.  Put them in a crockpot on a high setting.  Pour over the green beans.

title: Sauce for Steak
ingredients: 1 medium yellow onion | 1/2 cup maraschino cherry, with oil | 4 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Peel and core the onion, leaving the stone in place.  Grind it finely with a mortal and pestle.  Cut a small slice from the top of the onion to create a lid for sealing tightly.  Dice the onion and combine in a medium bowl.  Add the cherry.

title: Potatoes Filling With Deep Fried Black Sesame Seeds (Shoga-Yaki)
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs medium-sized red potatoes, scrubbed | 1 3/4 cups black sesame seeds, roasted | 1 tablespoon crushed tortilla ( shoga-yaki size ) | 3 1/2 tablespoons sesame seeds, roasted
instructions: In a medium sized bowl mix the roasted shoga yaki, roasted sesame seeds, and crushed tortilla, making sure to spread the sesame seeds.  Refrigerate for 2 hours.  Form the potato mixture into 12 balls.  Heat oil in a deep fryer for deep frying.  Deep fry the potato balls until golden brown and cooked through.  Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.  Serve while still warm or cold.  Sprinkle the fried sesame seeds before serving.

title: Fish and Parsnips With Jalapeno
ingredients: 8 white fish fillets | parsnips, washed, trimmed and cut into halves | 6 jalapeno peppers | 1/2 cup rice flour
instructions: Preheat oven to place fish on a large baking dish and bake at 375f degrees for 10 minutes.  Remove from the oven and put parsnips and sliced jalapeno peppers on top.  Mix rice flour with half a cup or water, to a thick, smooth paste.  Add the mixture to the fish and continue to bake at 375f degrees for 8 minutes.  Serve immediately.

title: Macaroni and Corn
ingredients: 2 cups macaroni | 1 can sweetcorn, drained | 1/3 cup pecans
instructions: Boil macaroni 10 minutes.  Drain well and add remaining ingredients.  Cover and let stand 3 minutes and serve.

title: Vegetable Bruschetta
ingredients: 1 french baguette, toasted | 1 tablespoon capers, drained and finely chopped | 8 ounces zucchini, peeled, and cut into 1/8 slices | 2 ounces yellow squash, peeled, trimmed and cut into 1/2 slices | 8 ounces grape tomatoes or 8 ounces cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom or 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil, divided
instructions: Slice baguette into 1 - 2 inch thick slices.  Place on ungreased baking sheet.  Bake at 300°f for 5 - 7 minutes or until lightly browned and crisp.  Cool.  Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, combine all remaining ingredients and mix well.  Place on the toasted baguette slices, sprinkle with capers and cover with the tomato halves.  Heat remaining olive oil in a small skillet on medium heat, add the bruschetta and cook just until the cheese begins to melt and the tomatoes begin to soften, about 1 - 2 minutes.  Drizzle with additional olive oil.

Random Ingredients: corn kernel,olive,cooking spray,cranberry,chicken soup base,flat leaf parsley,bow tie pasta
title: Bow Tie Pasta With Cranberry Broth
ingredients: 16 ounces bow tie pasta, uncooked | cooking spray | 1/2 cup canned baby peas and corn with roasted olives | 1/2 cup frozen diced corn kernels | 1/2 cup fresh cranberries, chopped | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking butter flavor chicken soup base | 1 teaspoon dried whole wheat parsley
instructions: Cook bowtie pasta according to package directions.  Coat a large saucepan with cooking spray.  Meanwhile, combine peas with corn, cranberries and soup base.  Cook over low heat, stirring, until peas are warm.  Drain and add to pasta mixture.

title: Indian Cauliflower Curry
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower, cut into florets | 1 1/2 tablespoons ghee or 1 1/2 tablespoons butter | 1 small wedge lime, juice of | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh cilantro leaves | 3 -5 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Steam the cauliflower for 8 to 10 minutes until cooked through.  Drain and set aside to cool.  Make as much cauliflower as possible out of the blanching water using a blender.  If you like a thinner sauce, add cornstarch dissolved in 2 tbsp water.  Melt the butter or ghee in a non stick frying pan.  Add the lime juice and cilantro leaves.  Add all of the curry paste into the pan and allow to come to a boil, then stir with a wooden spoon.  Allow to boil a couple of minutes until the mixture is fairly thick and fragrant but not to burn.  You may or may not want to use all the paste so make sure you keep it away from the heat.  Serve hot with indian flatbreads or breads.

Random Ingredients: velveeta cheese,rice noodle,ricotta cheese,spice,chipotle powder,tomato sauce,thai basil
title: Chipotle Cheese Rice Noodle Bake (Vegan)
ingredients: 1/3 cup tomato sauce | 1/4 cup diced chipotle powder ( add more if desired, i like lots! ) | 1 teaspoon mixed spice | 10 ounces rotel cheese, diced | 3/4 cup fat-free ricotta cheese | 1 1/2 cups rice noodles, cooked | 1/3 cup fresh thai basil, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Sautee rice noodles in 1/2 inch oil. .  Combine tomato sauce, chipotle, spices and 3/4 of the cheese.

Random Ingredients: cantaloupe,semolina flour,dark beer,monterey jack cheese,nonfat cream
title: Irish Melon With a Cottage Cheese Pastry
ingredients: 3 tablespoons semolina flour | 1 1/2 cups nonfat sour cream | 1/2 cup light beer | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese, plus 2 tablespoons, divided | 1/4 cup diced cantaloupe ( optional )
instructions: In a shallow bowl, stir together the semolina flour, sour cream, beer and 2 tablespoons cheese.  Set aside.  Preheat the oven to 425°f coat a 9 inch square pan with about 1 tablespoon oil and set aside.  Add the remaining 1 tablespoon oil and half the cantaloupe meat, if using.  Drain the flour mixture.  Using your hands, press the cantelope toward the middle of the bowl, then place the filling about 1 1/2 inches from the center.  Fold the left and right edges in over twice, then roll up, starting with the longest side.  Fold again and repeat with the remaining dough and filling.  Press the edges to seal.  Repeat with the remaining fruit and cheese.  Bake for 35 - 45 minutes or until golden.

Random Ingredients: onion flake,hard egg,halloumi cheese,red chili pepper,pizza sauce
title: Italian Panini, Tapas-Style Cheese Fritters
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried onion flakes | 2 cups halloumi cheese, diced | 1/4 cup pizza sauce | 4 slices red chili peppers, thinly sliced | 4 hard-boiled eggs, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees.  Combine the onion flakes, cheese, and pizza sauce.

Random Ingredients: green grape,rice noodle,cream mushroom soup,extra virgin olive oil
title: Campy Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 2 containers fat free sour cream & mushroom soup | 5 tablespoons olive oil | 1 small green grapes, sliced
instructions: Put 1/2 of the rice noodles in a small pot with some water simmering over medium heat and bring it to a boil.  Turn down heat and simmer until all of the water is absorbed stir once, cover pot and remove from burner.  Heat oil in a 3 qt casserole dish.  Add green grapes and stir until coated.  Stir soup into soup mixture.  Simmer for 2 minutes.  Add half the drained rice noodles and toss gently to coat them with the soup.  Spoon half back in the dish with the rice noodles and toss gently.  Add remaining noodles, toss gently.  Cover dish and bake at 350 degrees for 30 - 40 minutes.

title: Shrimp on Toast
ingredients: 1 medium shrimp or 1 medium scrimp, cleaned | 1/4 - 1/2 tablespoon chipotle chile, depending on how spicy you want your shrimp | 1 -2 tablespoon mozzarella cheese, grated ( depending on how much of each piece you use ) | 3 slices smoked mozzarella cheese ( or your favorite cheese )
instructions: Combine shrimp, chipotle chile and cheese.  Pour mixture over a reasonable amount of mozzarella cheese.  Place over open fire at gas flame or hot grill.  Cook until cheese is brown and bubbly.  This will depend on how big your pieces are.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,walnut oil,salmon steak,orange juice,horseradish,white pepper
title: BBQ Salmon With a Horseradish Sauce
ingredients: 2 -3 salmon steaks, 1-1/2 cm thick | 1/4 - 1/3 cup freshly squeezed orange juice | 1 tablespoon horseradish, grated | 1 tablespoon walnut oil | 1 garlic clove, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Combine ingredients in a small bowl and mix well.  Place salmon in shallow non metallic dish and pour over the marinade.  Turn to coat, cover and marinate in refrigerator for 30 mins, turning occasionally.  Cook salmon over medium heat until cooked though.  Turn and cook on the other side.  Serve with any side dish, such as potato wedges, and a vegetable side dish such as broccoli or cauliflower tips, or just by itself.

Random Ingredients: green chili,golden raisin,red pepper,ginger,spaghetti sauce,italian breadcrumb,passion fruit pulp
title: Spaghetti Jam Balls
ingredients: 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1 can sweetened passion fruit pulp | 1/2 cup chopped green chili | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh ginger | 1/2 teaspoon dry crushed red pepper | 1 cup italian breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup golden raisin | roasted red pepper, sliced ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except raisins and red pepper in slow cooker.  Stir to combine well.  Cover.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,dark sesame oil,baking soda,iceberg lettuce,palm sugar
title: Sweet Pepper Lettuce Chips
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 tablespoon grated palm sugar | 1 tablespoon flaked coconut or 1 tablespoon coconut flakes | 1/3 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 head iceberg lettuce, separated into leaves
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a dry frying pan and cook over a medium heat till the sugar has melted and mixture is hot, stirring from time to time.  Serve warm or at room temperature.  Note, the chips will keep for up to 10 days.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,guajillo chilies,fig,jicama,red pepper flake,superfine sugar,cayenne pepper,basmati rice
title: Mexican Fig-Ceviche Fritters With Guajillo Chili Syrup
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups superfine sugar | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 lb fresh fig, halved lengthwise and cut crosswise into 1/4-inch-thick slices | 1 can guajillo chilies | 1/2 cup sifted cake flour | 1 large jicama, peeled, cut in matchstick-size pieces | hot cooked basmati rice
instructions: Heat sugar in large nonstick skillet over medium high heat until it caramelizes, about 8 minutes.  Add chili and cayenne.  Cook 2 minutes.  Stir in figs and cook about 5 minutes longer.  Reduce heat to medium.  Stir cake flour into sugar syrup, breaking up clumps with whisk.  Stir in jicama.  Cover and simmer until thickened, about 8 minutes.  Add cooked figs and continue cooking until heated through, about 2 minutes longer.  Serve warm with warm rice.

Random Ingredients: green bean,cinnamon,wooden skewer,cod,spanish onion,black soy sauce,garlic salt
title: Bibimbap
ingredients: 1 lb cod ( or other white fish ) | 2 large spanish onions | 3 cloves garlic salt | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 1 lb green beans | 8 teaspoons black soy sauce ( dark ) | wooden skewer
instructions: Preheat oven to 350'f.  Make sure the entire fish is deboned and scales have been removed, and cut into 2 equal parts.  Slice the onions to 1/2' lengths.  Cut the sea bass into 2 pieces, and remove the bones and blood.  In a large baking dish, place the cod and half of the onions, and sprinkle with half of the garlic salt and cinnamon.  Place the fish on top of the onions and sprinkle with black soy sauce.  Place the green beans on top, followed by the remaining onions.  Add the remaining garlic salt and cinnamon.  Cover with foil, and bake for 40 - 45 minuets over medium heat, or until the fish flakes when tested with a fork.

Random Ingredients: green chile pepper,taco seasoning mix,milk chocolate chip,parsley sprig,sumac,cabbage,salsa
title: Crispy Chip Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 medium head cabbage | 16 ounces shredded low-fat milk chocolate chips | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley sprigs, chopped | 1 can diced green chile peppers, drained | 1 tablespoon salsa
instructions: Cut cabbage head into 6 - 8 wedges.  Bring 5 cups water to a rolling boil.  Add chopped cucumbers and simmer 30 minutes.

title: Quickie Thai Noodle Bowl
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked quinoa | 1 1/2 cups fresh broccoli ( cut into florets ) | 1 cup sliced green olives | 1 cup maraschino cherry, halved | 1 cup thai sweet chili sauce | 2 tablespoons hot coffee
instructions: Preheat a toaster to 300 degrees f.  In a large bowl, combine quinoa, broccoli florets, olives, cherries and chili sauce.  Pour in hot coffee and stir.  Heat in toaster for 10 to 12 minutes, until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,chicken breast half,white button mushroom,walnut,corn oil,kidney bean,self rising flour
title: Baked Chicken and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 cup walnuts, chopped | 1 cup self-rising flour | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 2 cans white button mushrooms, drained | 1/3 cup ketchup, or more to taste | 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Coat a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray.  Place walnuts in a dry skillet over medium heat.  Cook and stir until golden brown, about 5 minutes.  Spread walnuts in the prepared baking dish.  Mix self rising flour and corn oil together in a bowl.

title: Smoked Mustard
ingredients: 4 tablespoons dry white wine | 4 tablespoons mirin ( sweet rice wine ) | 4 tablespoons double cream | 1 tablespoon pistachio nut, toasted, chopped
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a medium saucepan and keep warm over a low heat.  Keep an eye on it since the alcohol in the wine will also cause a fine haze to rise.  Remove the pan from the heat and leave to stand for two minutes.  Pour the mustard into a clean jar and close lid.  Keep in a cool dry place.  Remove the smoke residue from the top of the bottle, then pour the mustard into a cup, sterilized jars, filling tightly up with mustard and pressing down firmly onto a plate.  Cover the bottle in plastic wrap and put in the fridge for 3 days before using.  To use, fill the jars with mustard and wipe the top with a dry cloth.  Seal and store in the fridge indefinitely in a dark, cool area.

title: Southern Fried Onions
ingredients: 3 pounds lard for frying, room temperature | 3 tablespoons seasoning salt
instructions: Heat lard in a deep fryer or large dutch oven until it reaches 350 degrees f.  Whip lard until fluffy, about 10 minutes.

title: Smoky & Spicy Chipotle Pizza
ingredients: 1 prepared pizza crust | 1 chipotle chile in adobo, seeded & chopped | 1 teaspoon cumin
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 fahrenheit.  Spread chipotle pepper evenly throughout pizza crust.  Sprinkle with cumin, if desired.  Place pizzas on a baking sheet, bake for 10 minutes, until crust is golden brown and crispy, and your toppings are hot& melted.

title: Quick and Easy Hummus Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 2 tablespoons prepared hummus | 1 package shredded mexican blend cheese | 2 cups hot mixed salad greens
instructions: Place the bouillon in a microwavable bowl.

title: Spaghetti With Cardamom and Thai Fish Sauce
ingredients: 10 ounces spaghetti sauce | 1/2 teaspoon crushed cardamom seed | 2 teaspoons thai fish sauce
instructions: Start boiling water for spaghetti noodles until al dente.  Drain and return to pot.  Add fish sauce and combine.  Serve over spaghetti noodles.

title: Cashew Nut Rice
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice ( regular grain is best ) | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup cashew nuts ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl, combine rice, soup and cashews.  Cover and microwave on high for 3 minutes, until rice is tender.  Serve hot.

title: Champiritas De Banñuelos (Chile and Lettuce Sandwich)
ingredients: 1 english muffin | 1 tablespoon heavy cream | 1 fresh chile | 2 romaine lettuce
instructions: Spread heavy cream on each patty on each of four plates.  Cut chile in half lengthwise and slice into 1/16 pieces.  In a small heated frying pan, toast the chile slices for about 15 seconds on each side.  Place 1 tbls.  Of the cream on each of the four chile slices, then stack the lettuce leaves on top of the cream.  Top with a final scoop of the cream and serve at once.

title: Strawberry Olive Delight
ingredients: 12 kalamata olives | 12 strawberries | 20 drops grenadine
instructions: Slice strawberries, reserve juice for later use.  Place strawberries and kalamata olives in a glass pitcher.

title: Chourico
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork, fat well trimmed | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 2 teaspoons cocoa | 1 teaspoon black vinegar
instructions: In a clean dish, mix the seasoning ingredients.  Wash the pork and pat thoroughly dry.  Cut into 2 inch cubes.  Cover and let stand in a cool place for 1 - 1½ hours.  Drain the fat and discard.  Lightly fry the pork in a dry heavy pan for 4 - 5 minutes, turning once, until browned.  Serve with tomato puree.  Note, although chourico is fairly tart, you may add 1 tablespoon of sugar at a time according to the sweetness of the chourico.

title: Pepperoni Maple Syrup
ingredients: 3 sheets pepperoni, cut into thin strips | 3/4 cup maple syrup
instructions: Place pepperoni in a small saucepan on a sheet of wax paper.  Pour maple syrup over it.  Turn the pan to let it steam on the bottom until syrup is syrupy, about 10 minutes.  Use a candy thermometer if desired to monitor temperature.

title: Bakedrocket (Rocket) and Puff Pastry
ingredients: 10 sheets puff pastry ( ready rolled ) | 425 g british red salmon or 425 g peppered salmon | 1 tablespoon fresh rocket or 1 tablespoon flat leaf parsley, coarsley chopped
instructions: Roll out half the puff pastry sheets onto a lightly floured surface.  Brush generously with a little more than half of the melted butter and sprinkle with the chopped herbs.  Place the other half of the pastry on top and smooth the top with a rolling pin.  Cut out the rinds with a sharp knife.  Cut out 4 x 2 inch long strips with a sharp knife.  Tie the rinds with kitchen twine and place on a baking sheet.  Bake at 200ºc for 10 - 15 minutes until puffed and golden and cooked through.  Serve hot.  If possible, slice the salmon thinly and arrange on top of the pastry.  Serve with a rocket salad and thickened cream.

title: Baby Spinach
ingredients: 400 g fresh baby spinach, washed and refreshed | 200 g plain flour | 2 tablespoons black sesame seeds
instructions: To do so, place the spinach in a large saucepan.  Add just enough water to cover the spinach by 1cm, bring to the boil, and cook, still on a low heat.  As the water comes to the boil, gently squeeze the spinach to remove any grit, then place back on the stove and stir the spinach.  When it comes to a boil, remove from the stove and set aside to cool.  Preheat the oven to 190c/375f/gas in a large bowl, combine the flour and sesame seeds.  Gently fold in the cooled spinach with a fork.  Place tablespoonfuls of the mixture onto a baking tray.  Flatten with the back of your hands to make small, oval shaped wedges on top of each other.  Bake on the centre shelf of the oven for about 10 minutes, or until golden and cooked through.  Leave for at least 5 minutes before serving, or cool, wrap individually and store overnight in an airtight container to keep them crisp.

title: Peach and Sage Tea

title: Tomato-Pork Marinade

instructions: Cut slits on the top of the cabbage and place on a baking tray.  Place in the oven for approximately 15 - 20 minutes, until they are tender and caramelised.  Place all the prepared veg into a bowl and stir through the cornflour it has been soured in and a little seasoning until the texture is a little bit more liquid.  Place one piece of ladyfinger in a separate dish and pour the dressing over the biscuits.  Place under the grill for 3 - 4 minutes until the biscuits are golden. Add tomatoes and 1/4 cup of the grated pecorino romano cheese to soup and stir until well blended.  Remove from heat.  Serve topped with the remaining cheese and remaining pecorino romano.

title: Beef Brisket

instructions: Remove brisket from refrigerator.

title: Tropical Mince and Rice Bake

instructions: Soak mushrooms in warm water to rehydrate them.  Soak chocolates in cold water until it softens.  Drain and chop finely.  Set aside. title: Pumpkin Seed Rice Balls

instructions: Soak the rice vermicelli in very warm water.  Drain and cut out the center of the vermicelli.  Rinse the rice vermicelli in warm water and drain. Place a scoop of rice vermicelli in palm of your hand.  Flatten the palm of your hand under the palm of your hand, place the rice vermicelli on the palm.  Put 1 handful of vermicelli in palm and make small balls around the palm of your hand, then flatten the balls to make a mound of rice vermicelli. instructions: Preheat oven to 300°.  In a large glass baking dish, stir together apple slices with egg whites.  Pour in tomato paste if using.  Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes, or until mixture is slightly stiff.  Serve sprinkled with lime wedges.

title: Gigantic Frozen Yogurt (Chocolate)

instructions: Pour the yogurt into a large bowl.  With a fork or a handheld electric mixer, beat the yogurt 5 minutes, or until the texture is smooth and creamy. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight, for even further chilling.  To serve, line a large serving mold with plastic wrap and set aside.  Dip the chilled yogurt into the melted chocolate and set aside.  Serve immediately.

title: Savoury Beef and Noodle Dinner

instructions: If using your kitchen aid, mix all ingredients, except noodles, in a large saucepan and bring it to the boil. When noodles are cooked, drain noodles a little at a time and add the meat and noodle mixture to meat and noodles.  Toss quickly and toss the contents of the saucepan together.  Stir until all ingredients are mixed.  Serve with plenty of freshly steamed vegetables.

title: Easiest and Bestest Indian Vegetable Broth

Add the sultanas, broth and sultanas to the skillet and simmer, stirring often, for 20 minutes or until the broth reduces by half.  Serve hot.

title: Frijoles Negros (Cuban Pork and Beans Sandwich)

instructions: Prepare the beans and soak overnight in water to cover.  Drain, cover with fresh water and bring to a boil. While the pork mixture is cooking, prepare the other ingredients in another frying pan over medium heat, add the seeds, and allow to heat through.  Drain the bean mixture, and transfer it all to a bowl.  Allow the pork mixture to cool slightly and mix thoroughly with the other ingredients in the bowl.  If using a mortar and pestle, finely grind the first 3 ingredients until they are the right texture to integrate all the flavor and texture.  To serve transfer about 1/4 cup of bean mixture and your crouton on a large platter.  Top with your favorite fixings and enjoy.
