Close the lid and grill over high heat for 10 minutes.  Turn steaks and cook another 10 minutes, or until cooked to your liking.  Cut the steaks into serving sized pieces.  Top each serving with the goat cheese.

title: Italian Bread Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 package prepared pizza roll | 1/2 cup swiss cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup raisins, plumped in hot water, drained | 1 tablespoon butter | 1/4 teaspoon butter | 1/8 teaspoon powdered peel | 1/8 cup spaghetti sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to lightly grease a 14 and 8 inch pizza pan.  Roll out dough thinly and cut into 4 pieces.  Place on pizza pan and spread with butter evenly.  Divide cheese and raisins among 4 pieces of dough, and top evenly with mozzarella cheese and cheddar cheese.  Roll dough from short side.  Press edges to seal, cut steam from dough and stretch slightly.  Press edges firmly to create two round crusts on each cookie.  Spread spaghetti sauce evenly over dough.  Sprinkle with powdered peel and bake until crust edges are golden, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: popcorn,vanilla essence,italian sausage,beef brisket,kosher salt,golden raisin
title: Beef Brisket in Sweet Pepper Jelly
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 tablespoons instant popcorn | 4 ounces italian sausage, sliced thinly | 3/4 cup golden raisin | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Trim fat from brisket and place on rack in roasting pan.  Trim fat from sausage.  In a small bowl, combine popcorn and raisins.  Dip slice in popcorn mixture and then in sausage.

title: Irish Beef Stew
ingredients: 1/4 cup flour | 2 lbs boneless blade steak, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 large sweet white onion, sliced | 2 tablespoons brandy | 2 lbs venison, sliced into 1/2 inch pieces or 2 lbs blue-beef stew meat, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 cups water | 1 hard-boiled egg, peeled and sliced
instructions: Place flour in a plastic bag and place steak, onion, brandy and venison in bag.  Pour water into bag, seal the bag, place in dutch oven and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 3 hours, until the venison is very tender.  Remove from heat and cover with fresh foil.  Allow to stand for 10 minutes and slice.  Serve with boiled egg slices.

title: Bangers and Mash
ingredients: 1 can chopped chili | 1 can sliced dried sweet herbs | 1 package lasagna noodles
instructions: Mix the chilies and herbs together and spread a thin layer of sauce on the insides of a baking dish.  Arrange half of the noodles over the sauce, spread out evenly.  Repeat with the remaining noodles and sauce, making sure all ingredients are used.  Sprinkle with extra cheese and bake at 350 degrees f for 20 to 30 minutes, until golden and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,coriander powder,sparkling water,thai basil,prosciutto,arrowroot,mint leaf,white pepper
title: Spicy Pepper and Garlic Bicarbonate Substitute (Gâteau)
ingredients: 500 g fresh bicarbonate of soda | 200 ml sparkling water, boiling | 125 g fresh coriander powder | 250 g fresh thai basil, washed, dried, and finely chopped | 250 g fresh mint leaves, washed, dried and finely chopped | 250 g prosciutto, julienned | white pepper | 1 1/2 tablespoons arrowroot
instructions: Put the bicarb into a large bowl and pour 570 ml of sparkling water on top.  Leave to soak for 20 minutes.  Put the coriander, thai basil, mint leaves, prosciutto, and white pepper into a food processor and mix them inches.  Add the bicarb soda and a little of the warmed sparkling water.  Continue to work in the dry ingredients until it's well combined but not too watery.  Add the arrowroot.  This makes a very thick and colorful drink.  It should be served as is and enjoyed with a fresh fruit.

title: Washup Paprika Hominy
ingredients: 4 cups hominy ( uncooked ) | 4 small hot red peppers ( seeded, finely chopped ) | 1 1/2 cups corn kernels ( fresh or frozen, thawed & drained ) | 1/4 cup currants | 1/4 cup dry roasted peanuts ( crushed, chopped ) | 1 lemon ( juice and finely grated zest ) | paprika
instructions: Cook the first eight ingredients in 1/2 boiling water, uncovered until heated through, but not mushy.  Garnish with lemon zest, if using.

Random Ingredients: egg yolk,red chile pepper,lime zest,tilapia fillet,cornflakes cereal
title: Spicy Fish Nuggets
ingredients: 2 ears fresh red chile peppers, sliced | 2 teaspoons minced lime zest | 1 egg yolk, beaten | 1/3 cup crushed cornflakes cereal | 1 pound tilapia fillets
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate.  Place red chilies on a baking sheet and lightly toast them in the preheated grill until slightly charred and softened, about 5 minutes.  Place charred chilies and lime zest into a food processor.  Process until blended.  Pour half the chile paste into a small bowl.

title: Chilean Chicken
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mushrooms | 1/2 cup averna amaro, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place chicken breast halves in a casserole dish.  Stir mushrooms and 1/4 cup amaro together in a bowl.  Pour half of averna amaro over chicken.

title: Thai Chicken Chips
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs | 1 cup cornstarch
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Coat a large baking sheet with nonstick spray.  In a gallon size plastic bag, combine the chicken thighs and cornstarch.  Shake bag to remove any excess cornstarch.  Place chicken in the bag, making sure chicken is coated well.  Refrigerate overnight, flipping bag after 30 minutes.  Bake 15 minutes in the preheated oven, until chicken is cooked through and crispy.

Random Ingredients: french onion soup,flax seed,ricotta cheese,no salt tomato,half canning ring,oyster sauce,walnut oil,mushroom stem
title: Tomato Mushroom Spread
ingredients: 250 g fresh mushrooms stems ( or use 1 cup frozen sliced mushrooms, thawed ) | 3 teaspoons instant minced garlic ( or to taste ) | 1 can no-salt-added whole tomatoes, preferably packed in oil | 1 can condensed french onion soup | 1 cup ricotta cheese ( or use 4 1/2 oz ) | 1 can no-salt-added mushroom stems ( packed in water and drained ) | 4 tablespoons chopped walnut oil | 1 can no-salt-added cannning jars with rings, in water ( or similar flavor ) | 1 can no-salt-added tomato sauce ( i use san marzano with excellent results )
instructions: In a small mixing bowl, combine dried mushrooms and garlic.  Add rest of ingredients.

title: Chinese Hotpot
ingredients: 1 large yellow onion | 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 1 can sliced water chestnuts | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Rinse onion under cold water.  Drain well.  Peel and cut into large pieces set aside.  In large bowl, combine the water chestnuts, onion soup mix, salt and chopped onion.

title: Cauliflower Rizogalo
ingredients: 2 lbs cauliflower | 4 ounces sausage, casings removed | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | white wine or evaporated milk | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 2 teaspoons minced shallots | steamed rice
instructions: Break the cauliflower into flowerets and leave them whole.  In a frying pan brown the sausages on both sides until browned.  Remove the sausages.  Add all the spices and cook over low heat for a few more minutes and then remove from the fire.  Add the white wine to cooking and allow to reduce slightly.  Add the sherry or condensed milk and allow to cook down into the paste for about 15 minutes.  Add the shallots which have been coarsly chopped into bits.  Serve over steamed rice.

title: Crock Pot Cantonese Artichoke Hearts
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts | 1/4 cup catsup | 3/4 teaspoon ginger | 2 slices pancetta, diced
instructions: Clean artichoke hearts and remove dark center.  Combine artichokes hearts, catsup, ginger, and pancetta together in a crock pot.

title: Calabacin (Calabacitas and Vegetables)
ingredients: 1/2 yellow squash or 1/2 zucchini, coarsely chopped | 1/2 celery root, chopped or 1 teaspoon dried celery leaves | 1/2 teaspoon oregano leaves
instructions: If you are using the zucchini, it can be grated or grated as well.  Combine all the ingredients except for the water.  Pour the water into a pan, and bring to a boil.  Add the vegetables, reduce heat, and simmer, covered, for 8 minutes.  Remove and discard the bay leaf and serve hot or cold.

title: Rhubarb Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked jasmine rice | 1 lb eggplant | 1 lb chicken ( optional ) | 3 red peppers | 1 lb rhubarb
instructions: Chop eggplant into medium sized pieces.  Cube rhubarb and peppers.  Place 2 to 3 tablespoons of rice on a dinner plate.  Dredge chicken on one side of rice until chicken is fully saturated or is about 6 inches in diameter.  Spread chicken in pan.  Add peppers, eggplant, and rhubarb.  Cook in frying pan for about 10 minutes or until chicken is completely cooked.  Serve immediately or refrigerate.

title: Sesame Roast Beef
ingredients: 1 beef roast or ( 1 g ) any other rare beef roast | 1 cup frozen broccoli florets | 1 -3 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1 bunch fresh curry ( optional )
instructions: If using meat baggies, take out and cut into 4 portions.  Remove bones, etc.  If using any left over meat baggies, you can wrap them in paper towels to make them easier to handle.  If using beef baggie rolls, heat oven to 325 degrees.  Place meat on a rack in a shallow roasting pan and cook approximately 20 minutes or so, or until internal temperature is 140 - 165 degrees f or slightly thicker.  Slice, then toss with sesame in a frying pan.  When finished, remove meat from pan and let cool slightly.  Use as desired.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,bisquick,baking potato,kosher salt,thyme leave,wheat starch,milk chocolate,cheese tortellini
title: Tortellini with Chocolate Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 package fresh cheese tortellini | 1/2 cup whole wheat starch | 1 package unflavored low-fat milk chocolate, melted using 1/2 cup water | 1/4 cup bisquick | 1 tablespoon dried thyme leaves | 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 2 teaspoons baking potatoes, grated and dry roasted cutlets into slices
instructions: Cook tortellini according to package directions.  Meanwhile, mix starch and melted chocolate and stir until mixture is pastisred.  Cool slightly.  Mix bisquick, thyme and salt.  Add baking potatoes and stir until evenly moistened.  Stir into cooled tortellini.  Drop 1/4 of the tortellini mixture onto a lightly greased 9 inch square baking pan.  Top with half the cheese and bake at 400 degrees f for 18 to 20 minutes until golden brown and crispy.  Cool completely.  Repeat with remaining tortellini mixture and cheese.  Serve with dipping sauces.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,white wine vinegar,pie crust,beef brisket,pork loin,szechwan pepper,beef rib
title: Chinese Style Brisket
ingredients: 1 unbaked pie crust | 1 boneless pork loin, sliced | 1 pound beef short ribs, sliced | 1 pound beef short ribs, cut short | 1 cup white wine vinegar | 1 cup szechwan pepper, plus more for sprinkling | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Lay crust in a pie box or other large baking dish with the top crust on the bottom.

Random Ingredients: onion ring,chicken breast half,orange peel,liquid smoke,cayenne,monterey jack cheese,coffee
title: Quick and Easy Au Jus for One
ingredients: 3 cans chicken breast halves, drained | 1/4 cup onion rings, chopped | 2 tablespoons instant coffee, dissolved in | 1/2 cup hot coffee | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1/4 teaspoon ground cayenne | 1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 tablespoon minced orange peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Line a 13x9 inch baking dish with foil.  In a bowl, toss chicken pieces with onion rings.  In a medium bowl, mix coffee, hot coffee, liquid smoke and cayenne.  Brush half of the chicken pieces lightly with the coffee mixture.  Arrange half of the chicken in the prepared baking dish, then top with half the onion mixture, then half of the cheese.  Repeat layers twice, ending with cheese.  Cover with foil, and bake 30 minutes.

title: Soya Sauce for Fish Etail
ingredients: 3 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 cup half-and-half | 1/2 teaspoon sugar ( to taste )
instructions: Mix all ingredients well, and refrigerate.  Will last several days as well.

title: Tortillas in Redcurrant Juice (South Africa)
ingredients: 300 g shredded pork | 2 tablespoons red currant jelly | 1 -2 lettuce leaf ( i've also used lettuce of choice or 1 large lettuce ) | 150 ml double cream | 8 tortillas
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the red currant jelly, lettuce leaves and the cream.  Tear tortilla into small pieces.  In a large frying pan, add pork and lightly fry.  Tear off extra fat if necessary.  Assemble tortilla strips or roll into cigar shapes with a wooden skewwer or tooth pick.  Arrange in a dish and pour redcurrant juice over.

title: Fiesta Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb queso fresco | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing ( good quality )
instructions: Slice cheese and combine all ingredients together.  Spray skillet with cooking oil spray and put cheese in pan.  Saute until light brown.  Serve with tortilla chips or salsa.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile pepper,self raising flour,bourbon,chicken breast fillet,baking soda,lemongrass,japanese soy sauce,lettuce
title: Crispy Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 400 g self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 tablespoon lemongrass, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon lemongrass, finely chopped - root, if you have it | 1 can chicken breast fillets, cubed | 1/4 cup japanese soy sauce | 3/4 cup bourbon or 3/4 cup white wine | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, chopped | 1/4 cup coriander, finely chopped
instructions: Combine flour, baking soda, lemongrass, and lemongrass in a mixing bowl.  Toss chicken cubes with 1/4 cup soy sauce, then add this mixture to the dry ingredients.

title: Poblano Chile Fish
ingredients: 1 poblano chile | 1/3 cup whipping cream | 2 1/2 lbs cod, cut into 3/4 inch cubes
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Roast poblano, about 3 minutes on each side.  Place under broiler and cook until blackened on all sides, turning.  Place in small oven proof baking dish.  Cover with foil and set aside.  Broil fish until just opaque in center and beginning to flake.  Reduce heat and continue broiling until fish just flakes and flakes on the diagonal.  Remove from heat.  Cover dish and keep warm.  Bring cream and chiles to boil.  Cook until warm, pour over fish.

Random Ingredients: ham,grain wild rice,black tea leaf,baby portabella mushroom,onion soup mix,yogurt
title: Yummy and Easy Breakfast
ingredients: 4 ounces ham, chopped | 2 baby portabella mushrooms, chopped | 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 1/2 cup yogurt | 2 1/2 cups cooked long-grain wild rice ( or any type of rice-your favorite brand ) | 2 -3 black tea leaves
instructions: In a small bowl, mix your onion soup mix into yogurt.  Spray an 8 x 8 baking dish with cooking spray.  Place the ham and mushrooms in the bottom of the dish, then pour your soup mixture over.  Spread the rice over the ham and mushrooms, then pour the yogurt mixture over the rice.  Put in a 350 degree oven for 30 minutes, or until the top is browned and bubbly.

title: Italian Red Beans
ingredients: 3 cans red beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried basil | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried thyme leaves | 14 can refrigerated crescent rolls | 1/3 cup sour cream, for topping for tops if desired
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f in a large bowl, mash beans until smooth.  Stir in basil and thyme.  Unroll crescent dough and separate 1 sheet into 4 pieces.  Roll dough into a 12 inch circle on a lightly floured surface, with the long edge overlapping the edges.  Repeat with rest of dough.

title: Vegetable Curry
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground espresso ( or coffee ) | 1/2 cup sliced fresh mushrooms | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 tablespoon minced fresh garlic | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger root | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets | cirim fresh ginger root, peeled and finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Combine espresso, mushrooms, parsley, garlic, ginger, and garam masala in a bowl and set aside.  Spread a large dutch oven or pot over medium heat and add cauliflower.  Cook for 10 minutes or until cauliflower is just tender.  Stir in ginger and saute for 2 minutes over medium heat.  Stir in 1/4 cup water if mixture becomes dry.  Pour mixture into pot.  Cook, stirring frequently, 3 to 5 minutes.  The sauce will thicken after cooking for 2 to 3 minutes, and it should be a deep, golden color.  If the curry becomes too thick, stir in more water.  Garnish with chopped fresh Italian parsley.  This tastes better when eaten hot, but if it is bland, such as i have never used, use 2 tbs.  Or you can replace the 1/4 cup water with equal amount unsweetened apple cider.

title: Roasted Garlic Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 head celery, cut into small wedges | 2 poblano chiles | 200 g butter lettuce, washed and trimmed | 150 g cabbage, shredded | 1 tablespoon ketjap manis or 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 2 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Place the celery and poblano on a baking sheet and roast at 200c/400f for 15 - 20 minutes, turning once.  When the vegetables are just softened, slice the chiles in half lengthways and remove the seeds and ribs from each half.  Place them in a bowl with the lettuce, cabbage, ketjap manis, brandy and seasoning and toss to combine.  Place on serving platter and drizzle with oil.  Serve with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: creme fraiche,spaghetti noodle,corn,vegetable stock chicken,rice wine,dark sesame oil,cremini mushroom
title: Spaghetti Medley With Mushroom and Corn
ingredients:
3 cups vegetable stock or 3 cups chicken stock ( 1 1/2 1 1/2 lbs.
    - chicken ) | 1/2 lb cremini mushroom, thinly sliced ( about 4 cups ) | 1 medium corn, shucked, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/4 cup rice wine | 2 tablespoons light cream or 2 tablespoons creme fraiche | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 lb spaghetti noodles, dried or 2 lbs fresh tostadas, heated and drained on paper towels | cremini mushroom, thinly sliced, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Heat the stock to just below a simmer in a 6 quart dutch oven or other heavy pot over medium high heat.  Add the mushrooms, lower the heat, and cook until the liquid evaporates, about 3 minutes.  Add the corn, rice wine, cream, and sesame oil, and stir to blend.  Bring to a slow boil and then reduce the heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until the creamy sauce thickens slightly, about 15 minutes.  Stir in the noodles and cook, stirring frequently, until they are tender, abut 5 minutes.  Serve with the sauce and garnish with a sprinkling of mushrooms.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,cheddar cheese,udon noodle,green chili pepper,gravy
title: Easy Asian Noodle
ingredients: 1 lb dried udon noodles | 3 tablespoons grated asiago cheese | 3 tablespoons grated cheddar cheese | 2 green chili peppers, chopped | 1 tablespoon gravy ( optional )
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions.  Drain.  Spread noodles in a large, wide mouthed dish.  Sprinkle with asiago, cheddar and chilies.  Pour gravy over all.  Cover with plastic wrap to prevent drying out, and refrigerate at least 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: head garlic,cremini mushroom,olive,mango,baking soda,dark chocolate,plum tomato,lime juice
title: Mushroom, Mango Salsa
ingredients: 1 medium head garlic ( peeled ) | 8 ounces plum tomatoes, chopped | 1 lb cremini mushroom, chopped | 1 large mango, chopped | 5 ounces dark chocolate | 1 lime, juice of | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 cup olive ( optional )
instructions: Mash the garlic to a paste with the tomatoes, mushrooms, mango and chocolate, and lime juice.  Add baking soda and mix well.  Let set at room temperature for about 30 minutes to allow flavours to develop.  Serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,ziti pasta,pecan,pearl barley
title: Chinese Five Spice Mix With Barley
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pearl barley | 3 tablespoons chinese five spice powder | 1/2 cup pecans or 1/2 cup walnuts, chopped coarsely | 1 package ziti pasta
instructions: Cook rice according to pkg directions.  Meanwhile, in small nonstick skillet toast the walnuts till light golden brown and fragrant, about 2 min each side.  Pour walnuts into large colander.  Drain barley well and rinse with cold water.  Return barley to skillet.  Sprinkle five spice powder on barley, stir well till barley is coated.  Add walnuts.  Stir and cook, stirring constantly, till just heated.

title: Rice Noodle Cracker Barrel
ingredients: 1 lb london broil beef | 2 1/3 ounces rice noodles | 1/2 teaspoon allspice berry
instructions: Cut the london broil into 1 1/4 slices.  Set aside.  In a medium bowl, soak the noodles in 3 inches of hot water for 20 minutes.  Drain the noodles and then drain them again.  Combine the beef with the rice noodles and allspice berry.  Thread or thread 2 slices onto each stick of noodle.  Gently squeeze the noodle into the bottle, pressing the brine inches.

title: Braised Short Ribs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon powder | 1/3 cup dry white wine or 1/3 cup dry vermouth | 1 1/2 teaspoons sage leaves, crushed or 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 7 lbs beef short ribs
instructions: In a small bowl, dissolve bouillon powder in wine or vermouth.  Sprinkle on top and sides of short ribs.  Set short ribs into a greased heavy foil roasting pan and refrigerate until cold, at least 1 hour, or overnight.  Remove short ribs from marinade.

title: Baked Pepperoni Strips
ingredients: 1 package sliced pepperoni | 1 cup finely shredded sweet pickled peel
instructions: Arrange pepperoni and sweet pickled peel on a broiler proof pan.  Broil 4 minutes topsoof.

title: Spicy White Chocolate and  Peach Freeze
ingredients: 3/4 cup unsweetened white chocolate | 1/4 cup strong brewed tea | 4 firm peaches | 6 cups vanilla ice cream
instructions: Place 1/4 cup chocolate in a glass.  Microwave, uncovered, in micro for 45 seconds.  Stir constantly on high approximately 1 minute.  Stir until smooth.  Cover and refrigerate in a cool dark place 30 minutes or until chocolate and chocolate are mixture well blended.  Peel and cut peach slices in half.  Place peach halves on a baking sheet and set in a low oven to heat slightly.  When chocolate is melted, remove peach halves and add to the chocolate in the microwave, mixing well.  Place the 3 drained peach halves back into microwave and add to the chocolate and blend.  Add the ice cream, mix well and pour mixture into a glass or cake pan.  Chill until set.  Serve and enjoy.  Makes 4 servings for 2 drinks, 3 slices for 2 drinks.

title: Sombrero Con Mielato (Spanish Potatoes W-Apple Green Chili)
ingredients: 4 lbs purple potatoes, scrubbed | 4 cooking apples, cored ( optional ) | 3 fresh habanero peppers, seeded and minced | 12 bay leaves | 6 ounces shredded cheese ( monterey jack, colby jack, or pecorino romano cheese )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Peel and remove the top 2 layers of purple potatoes, then, using a vegetable peeler, slice the cut potatoes into 1½ to 2 inch pieces.  Transfer the potato slices to a large bowl of cold water and stir to mix.  Dip the cut potato pieces into the water, then rinse them in a large colander and pat dry with paper towels.  Working on a clean work surface, arrange the potato pieces in a single layer and place them on a roasting rack.  Add the apple, habanero peppers, and bay leaves to the rack and spray the rack with cooking spray and place the rack in a roasting pan, then add enough water to reach halfway up the side of the dish.  Cover, and bake for about 45 to 60 minutes.  At the end of the 40 minutes, uncover and sprinkle the top with shredded cheese.  Cook for about 15 to 20 minutes longer, or until the cheese is melted and begins to turn golden.  To serve, let cool for about five minutes, then serve with sour cream, diced green onions and other garnishes such as shredded tomato, olives, cilantro, etc.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,pork roast,extra virgin olive oil,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Potted Cheese With Pork Roast
ingredients: 6 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 3 pounds boneless pork roast | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 3 cups extra-virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f.  Place the cheese on a baking sheet and place in the oven.  When golden brown, turn and sprinkle with cayenne pepper.  Allow to dry out at least 6 hours.  When cool enough to handle, rub the roast with the cayenne pepper.  Heat the olive oil in a large pot or dutch oven.  Brown the roast on all sides.  Place the meat in a baking pan.  Fill the center of the roast with cheese.  Place the pan on the center rack of the oven.  Set the oven control to 325 degrees f.  Bake until the internal temperature of the roast reaches 140 degrees f when taken with a meat thermometer.  Continue basting every hour and a half, or until the internal temperature of the meat reaches 250 degrees f when taken with a meat thermometer.

title: Beef With Pimientos, Bean Sprouts, and Vermicelli
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef chuck roast ( about 2 or 3 chuck roast is a good choice ) | 1 1/4 lbs quinoa ( or 2 boxes frozen vermicelli, preferably labeled `` vermicelli '' ) | 1/2 lb bean mixed sprouts | 3 jar pimientos, drained | 1/4 bunch large fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Place the beef in a large pot or dutch oven, cover with water, and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to medium low, cover and simmer 45 minutes.  Meanwhile, bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Cook the vermicelli until al dente according to package directions and drain.  Transfer the vermicelli to a bowl of ice water to cool.  Drain and set aside.  In an 8 to 10 inch skillet, cook the bean sprouts in boiling water with a dash of salt, stirring occasionally until the water has evaporated and the bean sprouts are brightly colored, about 3 minutes.  Drain the noodles in a colander and rinse with cold water.  In large casserole or dutch oven over high heat, add the cooked vermicelli and the sliced pepperoni and stir fry for about 5 minutes, until the vermicelli has coated completely with the hot pepperoni.  Beef and vermicelli can be cooked separately, transferred to a warmed serving bowl, and sprinkled with the chopped parsley and cooked, drained vermicelli noodles.

title: Indian Samosas
ingredients: 1/2 lb bread dough, soft | 1/8 cup kefir instant turmeric powder | 4 tablespoons chopped pistachio nuts | club soda
instructions: Mix the ingredients together and knead the dough very well until it comes together.  Divide dough into 8 equal sized pieces.  Cover and let stand 10 minutes.  Roll each piece into a rope 4 - 4 inches long and 2 inches in diameter.  Cut into strips and make diamond shapes on each of the triangles.  Bake on nonstick baking sheet at 375°f for 3 minutes.

title: Sopa (Mexican Bean Stew)
ingredients: 6 cups kidney beans | 2 tablespoons powdered saffron | pine nuts or walnuts, for garnish | 1 lb plum tomato, diced | 1/2 lb sweet basil ( dried ) | preserves, for garnish
instructions: Wash beans and remove stones.  Put beans into a large saucepan, add enough water to cover them.  Add saffron.  Bring to a boil and turn heat to low.  Simmer, uncovered, 25 - 30 minutes.  Add remaining ingredients and cook, uncovered, 25 - 30 minutes, until beans are soft.  Add more water if necessary for a thicker stew.  Sprinkle with nuts, if desired.

title: Pesto Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 ounces chinese mushrooms, sliced | 1/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/4 1/4 cup pesto sauce or 1/4 cup grated fresh parmesan cheese | 1/4 teaspoon lemon peel
instructions: Arrange in one layer on paper towels and sprinkle each with 1/4 teaspoons each of the cheese and the lemon peel.  Place in refrigerator until ready to use.  Place mushrooms in plastic or glass bowl and microwave over high power for 5 minutes.  Do not boil.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,pepperoni,parmesan cheese,black bean,lemon wedge,olive oil cooking spray,pea,tomato green chilies
title: Mexican Pea Salad
ingredients:
1 can chopped tomatoes and green chilies, drained.
    - | 1 can black beans, drained | 1 package pepperoni, diced | 2 serrano peppers, chopped | 1 jar sliced ripe olives in cooking oil, drained | parmesan cheese | lemon wedge
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl.  Garnish with lemon wedges if desired.

title: Roasted Fish
ingredients: one or two fillets fish, of any type | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon chopped onion salt | salt & white pepper | 1/8 teaspoon mace ( optional )
instructions: Rub the outside well with the grated cheese.  Sprinkle with onion salt, salt, pepper, and mace.  Place fish on a preheated broiler tray and broil the fish from a side until golden and crisp, about 3 - 4 minutes, depending on the size of fillets, but being careful not to burn, which may take about 10 - 15 minutes.  Remove to a serving platter and broil again until the fish is charred and bubbling.

title: Rigatoni with Creamy Ranch Dressing
ingredients: 2 packages rigatoni pasta | 1/4 cup olive oil | 1 1/2 cups ranch dressing
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook rigatoni in boiling water until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.

title: Souper Sherry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sherry wine | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper
instructions: Stir the sherry and lemon pepper together in a small, heavy saucepan.  Bring to a simmer over medium low heat, and cook, stirring frequently, until the sauce is thick enough to coat of a spoon.  Let cool to room temperature.  When ready to use, reheat to low just until warm.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,sherry,colby monterey jack cheese,ghee,sherry wine vinegar,flat leaf parsley,salt black pepper,chickpea flour
title: Chickpea-Cheese Slocoa Biscuits
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups chickpea flour, divided | 1/2 teaspoon salt and black pepper | 1/4 cup cocoa powder | 1 lb colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded | 2/3 cup sherry wine vinegar ( or cider ) | 2/3 cup dry sherry or 2/3 cup dry white wine | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley | 1 tablespoon melted ghee ( or butter )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f.  Grease a cookie sheet.  Combine 1 cup flour, salt and black pepper.  Add 1/4 cup cocoa powder and stir until incorporated.  Add cheese and mix well. title: Tamarind Beef Ribs - Crock Pot

instructions: Place all ingredients in crock pot, except the tamarind liquid.  My note, i did not use tamarind liquid but just boiled the water with a pinch of salt and the sugar.  After about 2 hours of cooking on low, the meat should have a nice colour and you should have plenty of tasty flavour.  Note, if you are using pork spareribs i suggest you remove them from the fridge and put them into a clean dishwasher to soak up the little water then dump the liquid into a saucepan or bowl.  If you're using a pork spareribs it really does not need to be removed, just put them back into the meat and get a little sauce out.  Personally i used just water, tamarind concentrate, and a little of the tamarind liquid to make up liquid.  I had some frustration built up because all my family were eating some meat as they were.  You can always add more tamarind liquid if you like, to make up for the liquid if necessary.  I cooked them on low for 6 hours, on the stove, until they were tender and tender, the meat was falling off the bone, and the juices from the meat were mainly saved.  This was one of my favourite dishes to make up, and the dish i had created made was quite offensive.  The last 10 minutes or so of cooking my meat, i poured in a little amarillo and a tiny bit of crushed red chillies, then added the pork ribs that were cooking on, and added two cup of boiling water and the soaked up tamarind liquid.  My son really enjoyed this.  This was a hit.  I loved it with lots of chopped scallions and peppers, carrots, potatoes, and a drizzle of freshly squeezed lime juice.  We also cooked them in some chopped cilantro.  This was a hit, too and loved the suggestion that you could also add your favourite fresh herbs here.  This is a good time to prep the stuffing too enjoy this wonderful dish.
