Place on a parchment lined baking sheet.  In a small skillet, heat any remaining water until boiling, add the cashew mixture, and stir.  Boil for 1 minute, then remove the pan from the heat.  Sprinkle the meat slices with taco seasoning, turning them over gently with tongs until all sides are well coated.  Place meat on foil lined plates or a lined baking sheet.  Serve the heated cashew nachos piping hot.  Garnish with sliced guacamole, sour cream and sliced lettuce.

title: Nori-Style Noodles
ingredients: 1 pound linguine | 1 pound fresh green beans, washed | 1 cup chopped yellow squash | 2 sheets nori ( dry seaweed ) slices for garnish
instructions: Fill a large pot with water and place over high heat.  Bring to a rolling boil.  Once it begins boiling, stir in the linguine, and return to a boil.  Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked through.  Drain well in a colander set in the sink.  Rinse with cool water, drain again, then set aside.  Bring a saucepan of lightly salted water to a boil.  Blanch the green beans in the boiling water for 1 minute, then remove from the boiling water.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add the green beans to the boiling water, and cook uncovered, stirring occasionally until tender, 2 to 5 minutes.  Drain in a colander set in the sink, and pat dry with a paper towel.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Once it begins boiling, stir in the nori.

title: Olive Garden Mussels
ingredients: 1 gallon mussels | 1 1/4 cups masala | 1 can cannellini beans
instructions: Debeard mussels.  Put mussels and beans in a large pot of boiling water.  Cover and cook 5 minutes.  Remove mussels and beans and reserve.  Cook 1 minute.  Pour mussels and beans in food processor.  Add masala and process.  Add spices.  Add reserved mussels andbeans.  Process until mixed well.  Note, i do not add salt because mussels and beans are salty.  This is optional.

title: Fish and Chips-Broiled in Chips
ingredients: 3/4 cup raw shrimp with shell or 3/4 cup fresh shrimp without shell | 1 egg
instructions: Heat a grill or pan to medium.  Brush the grill with oil or butter or oil.  Crack the egg into a pie plate or other non stick skillet, and mix it with enough cold water to just wash the yolk.  When the water boils, pour about a tablespoon of water over the egg.  Swirl the yolk with a fork to form tiny bits of egg in tiny bits.  When the egg is ready, add it to the hot pan as soon as it starts to set over medium.  It will bubble up, then turn into tiny bits and cook like a cake and/or a fish that is about 1/2 inch thick.  Remove from the heat, and then cut into pieces.  Dippers, shrimp, or chips can also be arranged around the fish, or coated with oil.  Serve immediately.

title: Orange and Barbecue Glazed Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 1/4 cup tomato paste | 1/4 cup sweet barbecue sauce | 2 teaspoons grated orange zest | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 3 pounds top sirloin steak, cut into 3x1/2-inch pieces | 1 cup instant rice
instructions: In a large plastic bag, combine the tomato paste, bbq sauce, and orange zest.  Add beef.

title: Pomegranate Sour Cream
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream | 2 ounces pancetta, finely chopped | 2 pomegranates, halved and pitted
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  In a medium bowl, blend sour cream and pancetta together.  Cover, and refrigerate until ready to serve.  Fill pomegranates with sour cream mixture, and refrigerate 30 minutes before serving.  Serve with pomegranate seeds.

title: Simple Noodles
ingredients: 1 package dry udon noodles | 1 pound italian sausage, casing removed
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil.  Once the water is boiling, stir in the udon noodles, and return to a boil.  Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the noodles have cooked through, but are still slightly firm, about 3 minutes.  Drain well in a colander set in the sink.  Wrap each noodle individually with a microwave safe plastic bag, and set in the bowl of a microwave.  Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil.  Once the water is boiling, stir in the udon noodles, and return to a boil.  Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still slightly firm, about 5 minutes.

title: Moorish Lamb Burgers
ingredients: 500 g lean ground lamb | 4 tablespoons lemon juice ( fresh ) | 3 -4 tablespoons sriracha sauce
instructions: Heat grill on medium high.  Place lamb mince on foil lined baking tray.  Use as many foil as needed to cover lamb.  Combine 2 tablespoons lemon juice and sriracha in a small bowl add enough lemon juice/sriracha mixture to produce a refreshing texture, but not runny.  Rub mixture onto lamb.  Press lamb mince into the mixture until evenly coated turning frequently so they don't stick.  Grill lamb for 2 - 3 minutes depending on desired doneness or until the juices run clear.  Slice the lamb thinly serve with mango salsa.  Enjoy.

title: Spinach and Rice Rolls
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen spinach, thawed and drained | 8 ounces puff pastry, defrosted according to package directions ( use all the spinach, thawed in a little water ) | 1 tablespoon adobo seasoning | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1/4 - 1/2 cup cilantro, chopped | 4 cups basmati rice, cooked
instructions: Thaw spinach well and shred it with a fork.  Use 1 1/2 cups of spinach for each roll.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,panir,philadelphia cream cheese,lemon extract,onion soup mix,eggplant,green bean,bing cherry
title: Spicy Eggplant Dip
ingredients: 2 eggplants, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch slices | 18 ounces sliced green beans, topped and tailed | 4 ounces bing cherry tomatoes, quartered | 1 envelope onion soup mix | 2 ounces philadelphia cream cheese | 1 ounce red kidney bean, drained | 2 teaspoons lemon extract
instructions: Layer eggplants and green beans in a greased 9x13 pan.  Sprinkle with fruit from 1 envelope onion soup mix cheese red kidney beans and lemon extract.  Top with remaining cheese.  Bake, uncovered, at 325 for 35 minutes.  Let stand 10 minutes.  Serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,chicken breast,mint,thyme sprig,peanut butter,leek,beef chuck
title: Peanut Butter Chicken
ingredients: 2 medium leeks, white part only, chopped into one inch pieces ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme sprig, chopped | 1 can peanut butter ( not fat free ) | 1 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into 2 pieces | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/4 teaspoon dried mint | 1 small piece lemon skin or 1 small rind, such as rind twists
instructions: Set oven to 325 degrees.  Line a medium loaf pan with foil.  In bowl, combine leeks, thyme, peanut butter, meat, seasoned salt, mint, and lemon peel.  Spoon half of the peanut butter mixture into prepared pan.  Place the pieces of chicken on top, and sprinkle with remaining peanut butter mixture.  Cover tightly with foil.  Bake in oven for 1 hour, then uncover and bake an additional 1 hour, or until meat is cooked and sauce is thickened.

title: Chayote (Mexican chayote ) Balls II
ingredients: 4 ounces chayotes, rinsed and peeled | 1/4 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon fresh lemon juice | 1 teaspoon minced lemon zest
instructions: Place chayote in a saucepan with cold water to cover.  Bring water to a boil, and cook until just tender.  Drain.  Cut lengthwise into halves, and scoop pulp from center of chayote pulp.  Mash chayote pulp until the skin stays intact.  Place panko in a shallow bowl.  Roll panko in bread crumbs until evenly coating.  Squeeze lemon juice over pulp, and sprinkle with lemon zest.  Scoop about 1/3 of mixture, and roll into ball shape.  Roll balls in additional panko.  Chill in the refrigerator until chilled.  Serve with tomato sauce.

title: Pasta With Raisins and Sweet Corn Flakes
ingredients: 16 ounces penne pasta ( or similar pasta, about 4 cups ) | 8 ounces dark raisins | 1 head fresh corn flakes | 4 teaspoons grated nutmeg | 2/3 cup salad dressing
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Cook the pasta, according to package directions.  Meanwhile, cut raisins in half, reserving 1/4 cup juices.  Combine reserved cooking liquid with the remaining ingredients and set aside.  Drain pasta reserving 3/4 cup of the pasta cooking liquid.  Drain the pasta and add to the hot pasta, tossing to coat.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,stevia,black olive,green coriander,thyme sprig,gorgonzola,cilantro,rice noodle
title: Riviera Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package dried rice noodles | 1 can black olives, halved, drained | 6 tablespoons crumbled gorgonzola | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh cilantro | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh thyme sprigs | 1/2 teaspoon stevia | salt & freshly ground black pepper | freshly chopped green coriander ( to garnish )
instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to the package directions.  Drain.  Combine with the above ingredients in a large bowl.  Salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: sage,dinner,cabbage,rice paper,chorizo sausage,grain rice,blue cheese,gruyere cheese
title: Mushroom and Chorizo Rice Paper Rolls
ingredients: 6 slices chorizo sausage | 400 g cabbage, thinly sliced | 200 g rice paper sheets | 4 sheets of mountain mountain gorn rolls | 3/4 cup uncooked long grain rice | 375 g gruyere cheese | 1/4 cup crumbled blue cheese | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Heat oven to 200 degrees celsius.  Cook chorizo in an oven proof non stick frypan on the stove until it starts to crisp, remove from heat, slice chorizo into long, thin strips.  Wrap 1 sheet of rice paper in a clean kitchen towel and place on top of the other in a pile.  Place a layer of chorizo and 1 handful of shredded cabbage.  Place another sheet on top, followed by the remaining cabbage, the remaining chorizo, garlic bread, oregano and cheese.  Carefully wrap the wrap around the roll, tucking in the ends.  Place on a baking paper lined tray and leave for 10 minutes.  Remove from oven and brush with a little oil.  Repeat process twice until all the wrappers have been made.  Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius, 200 degrees celsius should take 25 - 30 minutes before baking.  Bake 25 - 30 minutes until golden and heated through.  Cut into 5mm slices to serve.

title: Baby Bella Mushrooms on Toast
ingredients: 10 baby bella mixed mushrooms | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean ( optional )
instructions: Clean mushrooms under running water.  Scoop out mushroom and discard stems.  Clean the mushroom caps and remove stems.  Using a vegetable peeler, remove the mushroom skins so that there is a bit of white and light green part inside each mushroom.  Wrap the mushroom caps in half of each slice of white and light green portion.  You want the ends to be slightly overlapping each other.  Heat a non stick skillet over high heat.  Sprinkle the bella mushrooms with a pinch of salt or kosher salt.  When the mushrooms have been cooking, add a pinch of oil to coat the bottom of the pan.  Cook the mushrooms 3 - 4 minutes on each side or until they are tender.  Remove mushrooms and place on a plate lined with parchment paper and keep warm in the oven.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,raspberry jam,chili olive oil,sage,tamari,paprika,cherry
title: Lily Snow's Triscuits on a Cloud of Raspberries
ingredients: 6 -8 tablespoons self rising flour | 1/2 cup cold cherry ( canned cherries, drained ) | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage | 1/4 teaspoon chili-flavored olive oil ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon raspberry jam | 1 pinch paprika | 1 tablespoon tamari or 1 tablespoon soy sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Sift flour into a bowl, add cold cherries and sage.  Add chili oil and mix, then make a hole in the center of the flour with your fingers.  Dump the cherries and their juices, jam and paprika into the flour and cherry mixture.  Knead lightly to blend.  Roll out to about 1/4 inch thick and cut into 4 1/2 inch squares with cookie cutters.  Place on parchment paper lined cookie sheets lined with parchment paper.  Cover with damp towel and set aside while making the lattice.  Prepare your own raspberry jam by pouring raspberry jam, tomato jam or soy sauce into a jar.  Shake the lid and place over an open flame or a candle flame until the jam is bubbling and the edges have turned a pale pink colour.  If using an empty jam jar, pour it into the hot jar.  Turn on jar once it's cooled and store in a cool, dry place.  Cut raspberries into strips, place onto parchment paper lined cookie trays.  Make a lattice by using two or three strips, brush with raspberry jam.  Top with more raspberry jam, tomato jam or soy sauce and lattice strips.  Let sit until firm.  You can freeze up to two months, or store in freezer up to three months.  If using a lattice triscuits, slice triscuits into squares about 1/4 inch thick and place onto parchment lined cookie sheets lined with parchment paper.  Let sit until firm, then bake until golden on top.  Makes about 12 pieces depending on size.

title: Roasted Pecans With Peanuts
ingredients: 4 pints chicken stock | 1 tablespoon olive, chopped ( preferably kalamata or salted ) | 1 tablespoon chopped pecans, lightly roasted, if fresh
instructions: Heat the stock in a pan, over a gentle heat, until reduced, just a few scoops, but quite a lot.  Put the pecans in a blender or food processor, and season.  Process and add the oil until it's a creamy paste, scraping the bottom of the pan to get all the lovely, fragrant bits off the bottom.  Pour into an ovenproof dish, sprinkle with the pecans, and roast in a moderate oven for 25 - 30 minutes until golden.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,graham cracker crumb,rice vinegar,hot dog,sesame oil,lamb chop
title: Kim's Kimchi
ingredients: 1 1/4 pounds boneless lamb chops, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup sesame oil | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon seasoned rice vinegar | 1 package cottage cheese, drained and cubed
instructions: Mix graham cracker crumbs, sesame oil, and seasoned rice vinegar together in a resealable plastic bag.  Roll lamb pieces in crumb mixture until each piece is coated with crumbs.  Heat sesame oil in a skillet over medium heat.  Place lamb in hot oil.

title: Baked Couscous Filled Calrose Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf frozen bread dough | 1 1/2 cups couscous | 1 cup fresh mushrooms, sliced | 1 tablespoon baking powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Place the frozen bread dough in a large, deep bowl.  Cover with warm water and let stand for 15 minutes.  Rinse with cool water.  Drain and set aside.  Dip the bread dough in a clean, dry towel and roll out into a rectangle about 1/2 inch thick.  Cover the dough with a damp towel and set aside.  Using a rolling pin, roll the dough out to an 8x8 inch rectangle, approximately 14x9 inches.  On a baking sheet, spread a thin layer of couscous on each dough rectangle.  Sprinkle mushrooms over the couscous.  Roll up the dough with the ends of the dough tightly.  With a sharp knife, score each roll, 1/2 inch deep, in half lengthwise and crosswise.  Bake for 15 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Mexican Scallion Chips
ingredients: 1/2 cup scallion, plus | 2 tablespoons scallions, finely chopped | 5 tablespoons tortilla chips, coarsely crumbled
instructions: Grind 2 tablespoons scallions with 1 tablespoon of scallions and salt to taste in a grinder.  Combine remaining scallions with cilantro and toss with remaining scallion mixture.  Let stand until the flavors develop, about 10 minutes.  Spread chips on a baking sheet and bake, stirring occasionally until crisp, about 8 minutes.  Let cool, sprinkle with remaining 2 tablespoons scallions and serve.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,chili powder,italian sausage,garlic,brown onion,vegetable broth
title: Spanish Saucy Sausages
ingredients: 1 pound sweet italian sausage, casings removed | 1 cup vegetable broth | 1/2 cup diced brown onion | 1 clove garlic, minced | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese
instructions: In a skillet over medium high heat, cook the sausage until evenly brown.  Transfer to a plate.  In the same skillet, saute the onion and garlic for 5 minutes, then transfer to a separate plate.  Add the chili powder to sausage drippings in the skillet.  Stir in the sausage, vegetable broth, brown onions and garlic.  Bring to a boil, then simmer until the sauce thickens slightly, about 15 minutes.  Stir in the parmesan cheese and adjust seasonings.  This can also be made into sausage ravioli or even a log shaped loaf.

title: Sticky Sage and Sage Bread -
ingredients: 2 slices white bread, crusts trimmed | 4 large sage leaves, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh sage leaves for garnish
instructions: Toast the bread slices.  If using fresh sage leaves, cut them crosswise into very thin strips.  Place the sage in a mortar with some sage leaves.  Use a mortar and pestle to crush the sage into the crumbs.  This can be done in batches if needed.  Place all remaining sage in a medium bowl or small roasting pan.  Gather the sage and sage pieces and shape into round, flat circles.  Place them in the bowl or onto a serving plate.  Remove the bread from the bowl.

Random Ingredients: egg,chicken wing,ancho chile powder,curd cottage cheese,rye bread,monterey jack pepper cheese,pumpkin
title: Pumpkin Cheesebrow Casserole
ingredients:
1 whole egg | 2 tablespoons dried ancho chile powder | 1/2 lb fresh pumpkin ( optional ) or 1/2 lb winter squash, quartered ( optional ) | 4 -8 ounces small curd cottage cheese, such as ricotta or 1/2 package low fat cottage cheese | 1/2 cup low-fat monterey jack pepper cheese, grated ( about 2 oz.
    - ) | 8 ounces rye bread, cut into 1/4-inch cubes ( about 4 1/2 cups )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Lightly butter a 10 1/2 x 3 1/2 inch glass baking dish.

title: Oriental Beef Roast
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs beef stew meat | 1/3 cup reduced sodium mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons tea
instructions: Place the meat, mayonnaise and tea in a shallow roaster or large roasting pan with the cover over the meat.  I use a 2 1/2 to 3 lb.  R for this.

title: Guacamole With Rum, Ham and Avocado
ingredients:
10 ounces hoisin sauce | 1 1/4 lbs salt pork, cubed | 3 avocados ( ripe ) | 3 ounces salt pork drippings or 3 ounces salt, from the pork | 1 tablespoon garlic salt, to taste | 2 teaspoons celery, minced | 4 ounces unsalted dry sherry rum ( jack daniels recommended ) | 1 loaf baguette ( or use italian flat bread.
    - )
instructions: In a small serving bowl, combine the hoisin sauce.  If you are using dry sherry, place in a large frying pan and set over medium heat.  When just bubbling, add the garlic salt and celery to taste.  Cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until they are softened, stirring frequently.  Stir in the rum.  Remove from the heat and set aside.  Cut the baguette into 1 1/2 inch thin bread slices.  Toast the bread slices in a toaster over medium heat until light brown and crispy.  Remove from the oven when done, drain on paper towels and set aside.  Slice the salt pork into cubes.  In a medium size skillet, saute the salt pork with the salt pork drippings until it begins to brown.  Remove from the heat and add the peeled and pitted avocados.  Add the salt pork mixture to the pan and toss.  Serve on top of toasted bread slices, drizzled with the rum sauce before dipping.

title: Bucket
ingredients: 1 package bulk italian sausage | 10 plum tomatoes | 1/2 cup kahlua | 1/4 cup sparkling water ( optional ) | 1 large avocado, cut into 1/4 in thick slices
instructions: Mix all ingredients except for the avocado in a large bowl and then set aside to meld flavors.  Place slices of avocado into each of 4 bowls, then pour the spicy berry mixture over the slices.  Serve immediately.

title: Italian Fruit Salad(Veggie Salad)
ingredients: 2 cups torn arugula leaves | 1 can mixed vegetables, drained and cubed | 4 slices prosciutto ( about 4 ounces ) | 1 can tomato cocktail in juice
instructions: In a large bowl, toss arugula with mixed veggies, prosciutto and tomato juice until thoroughly combined.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,ginger root,tomato puree,dark sesame oil,cream chicken soup
title: Quick and Easy Spicy Oriental-Style Dip
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can low fat chili sauce | 1 can tomato puree | 1 1/2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger root | 3 teaspoons dark sesame oil
instructions: In a 2 quart pot, combine the cream of chicken soup, chili sauce, tomato puree, ginger and sesame oil.  Heat through.  Pour into 2 small glasses and refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: baby bok choy,gingerroot,bran cereal,chocolate chip,oregano leaf,broccoli floret
title: Bran Cheese and Broccoli With Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 4 cups broccoli florets, blanched and drained | 1 1/2 lbs baby bok choy | 1/4 cup reduced-fat bran cereal | 1 tablespoon fresh gingerroot, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | grated semisweet chocolate chips
instructions: Heat the oven to 450° f.  Cut the bok choy crosswise into 12 wedges.  Arrange the broccoli in a glass pie dish and cover with 1 cup of water.  Bring to a boil, then cover and steam over low heat for 5 minutes.  Drain the water, then set the bok choy aside.  Meanwhile, place the broccoli in a large skillet with the bran, ginger and oregano.  Cover and steam over high heat for 2 minutes.  Remove from the heat and sprinkle the top of the char grilled bok choy with the cheese and broccoli.  Spread onto a baking tray lined with parchment paper.  Sprinkle with the chocolate chips.

title: American Jambalaya
ingredients: 1/3 cup beef broth, or more as needed | 1 large boneless pork roast, cut into cubes | 1 shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 turkey breast, sliced | 1 pastry dough, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Place the beef broth in a skillet over high heat.  Bring to a boil, and add the pork, shrimp, and turkey.  Return to a boil, and cook until shrimp is cooked through.  Remove to a mixing bowl, and cool until almost warm.  Roll out the pastry dough on a lightly floured work surface.  Cut into desired shapes, and use the tips as a guide for making treats.  Cut a slit in each top half of the pastry dough with a sharp knife, cutting the slit in a few to prevent the top from openending.  Fill a large pot with water, and heat over medium high heat to boiling.  Once the water is boiling, remove the crusts, and place the pastry circles into the pot.  Cover, and allow to steam until the pastry has risen, about 5 minutes.  Remove the crusts, and place onto a baking sheet with parchment paper between each cut.  Bake in the preheated oven until the top has some golden brown color, and the top has a lovely crust, and is no longer jiggly and bready, about 12 minutes.  To serve, place a scoop of sour cream onto each piece of jambalaya, and top with small bite sized bites of cooked pork meat.

title: Quick and Easy Bulgur Penne
ingredients: 1 cup dry penne pasta | 1 1/4 cups bulgur
instructions: In a pot with boiling water cook penne pasta according to directions, drain and then add bulgur.  Cook, stirring until most of the water is absorbed serve.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,dark brown sugar,leg lamb,chipotle chile
title: Crock Pot Chile-Rubbed Roast Lamb
ingredients: cooking spray ( olive oil flavored ) | 6 1/2 - 7 lbs leg of lamb | 3 ounces chipotle chiles, chopped ( plus additional for topping ) or 3 ounces canned chipotle chile, chopped | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar
instructions: Prepare grill to high heat.  Coat grill rack with cooking spray.  Remove lamb from grill.  With a slotted spoon, remove fat from cooking rack and place on work surface with some of the chiles.  Place the rack in a 7x7x2 inch glass baking dish.  Sprinkle the chiles with some of the brown sugar.  Pour the remaining chile sauce on the lamb.  Sprinkle with more brown sugar, if desired.  Close the lid and cook, turning every 5 - 7 minutes, until the internal temperature of the meat registers 125° for medium rare, about 2 hours for medium, about 3 hours for medium well.

Random Ingredients: water,vegetable oil cooking spray,salmon fillet,adobo seasoning,wine vinegar,onion,chipotle pepper,ziti pasta
title: Smoky Salmon With Chipotle Ziti
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta, uncooked | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 cup finely chopped onion | 1 tablespoon adobo seasoning | 1 chipotle pepper, finely chopped | 6 ounces smoked salmon fillets, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1/4 cup water | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar
instructions: Cook ziti according to package directions.  Set aside.  Spray a large saucepan with cooking spray.  Add onion and adobo seasoning to pan.

Random Ingredients: margarine,black cardamom pod,pork roast,thai basil,flour,red wine,chicken stock vegetable,cauliflower
title: Tibetan Pork in Red Wine (Piglets Zijolibki)
ingredients: 2 lbs lean pork roast, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes | 1/3 cup flour | 1/4 cup margarine or 1/4 cup butter | 1 1/2 cups red wine, divided | 3 cups chicken stock or 3 cups vegetable stock | 1/2 teaspoon black cardamom pod | 1/2 cup torn thai basil | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh cauliflower
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Spray nonstick pan with no stick spray, with cooking spray.  Sprinkle pork with flour and brown meat in nonstick skillet over medium high heat 3 - 4 minutes on each side.  Remove to a platter and add 1/3 cup red wine, 3/4 cup wine, chicken stock, cardamom pods, half the basil, and cauliflower to the pan.  Cover and braise on low heat for 10 - 15 minutes until meat is richly browned, stirring often.  Reduce oven temperature to 300 degrees, and continue to braise another hour stirring often.  Season with salt and pepper and serve.

title: Mexican Onion & Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1/2 of a regular size onion ( can use white ) | 1 cup mexican cheese, shredded ( or your favorite )
instructions: Brown/cool onions in a skillet.  Add cheese and stir till melted.  Let it cool.  Use or store in fridge to let the flavors develop.

Random Ingredients: white fish fillet,raspberry jam,chili pepper flake,cinnamon,meat,anise seed,virgin olive oil,asafoetida powder
title: Dahi Kebabs - Indian-American Fish With Jam (Methi)
ingredients: 6 -8 small white fish fillets, about 6 ounces each | 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon | 3/4 teaspoon anise seed | 3/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 6 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | raspberries with melon jelly or honey
instructions: Cut the white fish fillets into 2 inch long strips.  Place the cinnamon, aniseed and chili flakes in a mortar and grind into a fine powder.  Add fish and pound it into a smooth paste.  Coat the meat with the flour, then add to the mortar.  Fry on both sides to brown them lightly, taking care not to burn it.  Remove the fish with a slotted spoon and place onto a serving dish.  Add 3 tablespoons of olive oil to a pan and bring to a low boil.  Stir in the asofoetida and when it's a little soft add the fish.  Turn down the heat and add the melon jelly, spreading evenly over the fish.  Spoon the hot jelly over the fish.  Serve immediately.

title: Hot Garlic Bacon Mayonnaise and Strawberries Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces bacon drippings, chilled and chopped roughly | 1 spring onion, finely sliced | 1 1/2 ounces baby fresh raspberries | 1 pinch dried leaf thyme | 4 tablespoons raspberry-flavoured mayonnaise ( or miracle whip ) | 2 teaspoons bread, to serve
instructions: In a small jug, combine mayonnaise & thyme, then mix with bacon bits to combine.  Toss the raspberries and spring onions with the bacon mayonnaise & drizzle over the salad, mixing well before using.  Serve at once or refrigerate until required.

title: Prosciutto Wrapped Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 teaspoon olive oil | 1 slice prosciutto, cut into strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Stir olive oil into the prosciutto strips and place one of the strips at one end of a mushroom cap.  Roll mushroom cap around the oil.

title: Baked Beef and Prune Loaf
ingredients:
3 lbs chuck steak | 2 cups pitted prunes, cut in quarters | 6 cloves chopped garlic | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1.
    -5 boxes stretching beef rolliters ( 5-6-7 )
instructions: Preheat oven 350 degrees f.  Trim excess fat from meat.  Slice meat across the grain into 1/4 inch slices, slicing across the grain if necessary.  Place meat in a nonstick or sprayed 8 x 5 loaf pan.  Add prunes, garlic and baking powder and toss together.  Bake in preheated oven until meat is tender, about 1 1/2 ½ hours.  Serve the meat with a little gravy or gravy and a green vegetable.

title: Broccoli Meatball Appetizer
ingredients: 3 cups prepared meatballs | 6 cups broccoli, cut up and steamed ( or 2 medium, if your diet isn't on the calorie controlled ) | 2 teaspoons cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons breadcrumbs
instructions: Place all in microwaveable bowl.  Microwave for 3 mins or until all are warm through.  Place on cookie sheet in low or warm oven.  When oven's hot broil for approx 4 mins or until golden brown.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: ham,red enchilada sauce,saffron,greek yogurt,white onion,dill,red capsicum
title: Red Capsicum and Dill Chili With Tzatziki
ingredients: 7 ounces roasted red capsicums | 1 1/2 cups greek yogurt | 4 -6 ounces tzatziki, recipe to follow | 4 -6 ounces diced ham | 2 tablespoons chopped white onions | 1 teaspoon dried dill or 2 tablespoons fresh dill | 1 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend on low for a few minutes.  Pour the mixture into a warmed tzatziki container and top it up with more tzatziki and diced ham, if desired.

title: Texas-Style Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 bag shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 package frozen whipped topping filled, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Combine the monterey jack cheese and thawed whipped topping in a 9x13 inch glass baking dish.  Place the dish on a wire rack in the preheated oven and bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.  Serve warm.

title: Mixed Purple Onions (Empanadas)
ingredients: 2 cans baked beans | 1 can cherry pie filling | 1 jar purple onions | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Drain the beans and combine everything in a large bowl.  Fill the red saucepies with the mixture.  Heat a few in the oven, flip them over, and continue to reheat for 2 - 3 minutes on each side, or until warm.

title: Quick Focaccia
ingredients: 1/2 cup farina, can use instant ( not instant ) | 1/2 cup raisins ( white or dark ) | 1/4 cup italian breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup cooked tempeh, shredded | 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1 inch slices
instructions: Toast bread in a toaster for 4 - 5 minutes, or until golden brown.  Spread bread with focaccia filling and sprinkle with parmesan cheese, or pecorino cheese.  Variation, toast french bread with ham& cheese, broil until lightly browned then crumble.  Serve hot with pizza sauce, or use for dipping crusty ravioli.

title: Greek Pasta
ingredients: 1 pound penne | 5 fluid ounces lemon juice
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add penne and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Quick Easy Layered Mexican Dip
ingredients: 1 can refried beans | 1 can rotel tomatoes | 1 jar tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Place beans in medium size bowl.  Place tomatoes in bowl.  Place tomatoes and other ingredients in bowl.  Pour over refried beans to cover.  Cover bowl with plastic wrap.  Refrigerate 2 - 24 hours.  When ready to serve, microwave, or broil.  Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Advocaat (Dessert)
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons golden syrup | 4 drops hot advocaat
instructions: Stir in hot butter, beating until light and fluffy.  Pour into a well buttered 1 pint glass jar.  Cover with hot air from the kettle.  Seal and store in a cool, dark place.

Random Ingredients: green olive,pineapple juice,grain white rice,maraschino cherry
title: Hawaiian Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 cups long-grain white rice | 2 1/2 cups pineapple juice | 2 1/2 cups maraschino cherries | 1/4 cup stuffed green olive ( drained )
instructions: Cook the rice according to package directions.

title: Fruit and Pepper Shortbread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 1 cup sultana | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1 tablespoon adobo sauce, from chipotles | freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Line large baking sheets with parchment paper.  In a small bowl, sift the flour, sultana, cranberries, and adobo sauce.  Using a fork, stir in the black pepper.  Using a pastry blender, cut the shortbread into 2 squares.  Place the squares on the prepared baking sheets.  Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until golden.  Serve hot with your favourite condiments.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,plain flour,ladyfinger,parmigiano reggiano cheese,kidney bean
title: Italian Style Kidney Beans
ingredients: 350 g cooked kidney beans ( rinsed well ) | 2 small oranges, zest of and zest of | 50 -75 g plain flour | 100 -150 g shaved parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 100 -100 g ladyfingers, roughly chopped ( or a bit with greek stamichine to make them flatter )
instructions: Put the kidney beans and their cooking water into a saucepan and then bring to the boil.  While the beans are simmering, get the zest and juice from one of the oranges about 1/2 an orange and then put zest in a bowl.  Take the bean water and add to the pasta in the saucepan.  Then remove the pan from the heat and let it sit for 15 minutes.  While pasta is boiling, add flour to a large bowl.  Put half a block of parmigiano reggiano on top of half a block of parmigiano reggiano which has been shaved into a fine crumb size piece of cheese.  Get your pan ready, this will not need to be the same as the skillet used to make the pasta.  Once the beans are heated through, add lemon zest and juice.  Add the drained kidney beans to the tomato sauce in the pan.  Add the orange zest.  Pour the bean mixture into your pan onto a plate, then pile on your pasta.  Finally, place a spoonful of remaining shaved parmigiano reggiano on top, then your ladyfingers or toasted bread cut into wedges and serve.  Enjoy.

title: Simple Microwave Spanish Rice
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups uncooked long grain white rice ( such as jasmine ) | 1 cup peeled, diced cucumber | 5 medium red potatoes, cut into 2 inch chunks | 1 cup diced red potato | salt & fresh ground pepper
instructions: Using a 1 cup capacity non stick glass casserole dish, combine rice and 1 cup water in a microwave safe bowl.  Cover dish and microwave on high for 6 - 10 minutes, stirring every 2 - 3 minutes.  Stir in cucumber, potatoes and 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.  Cover microwave on high 2 - 5 minutes.  Cover dish and microwave on high 15 minutes, stirring every 2 - 3 minutes. .

title: Caribbean Steak
ingredients: 600 -700 g steak, cut to strips ( i use sirloin ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup coconut oil ( depends on how much you want ) or 1/4-1/2 cup other neutral flavoured oil ( depends on how much you want ) | 2 teaspoons curry | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 1 bunch young asparagus, ends trimmed
instructions: In a wok, heat the coconut oil or the neutral flavoured oil.  Add the curry sauce and white pepper.  Stir until it begins to simmer.  Add the steak and leave to marinate for at least 10 minutes.  If using fresh asparagus, trim ends, and slice diagonally.  When ready to serve, reheat, and add a bit of the steamed asparagus to each plate and top with the steamed asparagus.  Note, you can use any other vegetable that you like.  This recipe can also be used as a sandwich spread or served as a dipping sauce.

title: Thai Zucchini Saute
ingredients:
1 - 1 1/2 lb zucchini | 1 -3 tablespoon vegetable oil | 3 -5 tablespoons chili paste ( thai red chili paste, can be increased to 1/2 tbsp.
    - ) | 1/2 teaspoon beef bouillon cube, can use chicken bouillon or 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Trim ends of zucchini.  Slice zucchini in 1/3 inch rounds and set on a small baking sheet or platter.  Bake in a 400 degree f.  Oven for 10 minutes or until golden brown.  Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high flame.  Add chili paste and stir fry 1 minute.  Add zucchini and garlic.

title: Grilled Pork and Apple Salad
ingredients: 2 cans country-style pork, undrained, cut into 1/2 slices | 1 red delicious apple - peeled, cored, and diced | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 5 romaine lettuce-style leaves | 1 cup wine
instructions: Heat grill.  Place pork slices on grill.  Cook 10 minutes on each side.  Combine apples and oregano in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,salt black pepper,ham,chicken stock,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Lancashire Hot Pot for Mushrooms
ingredients: 3 lbs mushrooms, trimmed | 1 -2 tablespoon chili oil | 1/4 cup fresh-squeezed chicken stock | 2 ounces thinly sliced ham, chopped | 2 teaspoons finely chopped flat-leaf italian parsley, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f.  Place mushrooms in a flameproof casserole dish, add just enough hot water to cover the mushrooms, and cook, stirring often, until the water turns the mushrooms green.  Pour over the chilli oil.  Leave for 1 hour then stir in the chicken stock.  Arrange the ham over the mushroom and cover tightly with foil, allowing most of the liquid to be absorbed.  After 1 hour, transfer the mushroom mixture to an ovenproof casserole and cook for 20 minutes or until the mushrooms are tender and the crispy.  Sprinkle the parsley over and serve with a green vegetable.

Random Ingredients: bacon,whipping cream,greek yogurt,golden raisin,mexican chili powder
title: Laurie's Quesadillas
ingredients: 1/4 lb bacon | 1/2 pint whipping cream | 1/4 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon mexican chili powder | 1/4 cup golden raisin
instructions: Wrap bacon in foil and cook over medium heat until almost all the fat is rendered, about 10 minutes.  With slotted spoon, remove bacon and drain on paper towels.  Stir cream, greek yogurt, chili powder, and bacon in large saucepan and boil over medium heat 2 minutes, stirring constantly.  Transfer to bowl and stir in raisins.  Cool to room temperature, then season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Cheaters White Potato (Potatoes) Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs white potatoes, sliced | 1 can butter beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 lb pepperoni, coarsely sliced | 12 ounces cooked chicken burgers, sliced | 1 teaspoon garlic, chopped | 1/2 cup butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with non stick foil, spray with cooking spray.  Over boiling water in a large pot, cover and cook potatoes for about 20 minutes, just until tender.  While potatoes are cooking, in a separate pan, brown pepperoni slices adding garlic.  Stir together the butter beans and remaining butter.  When potatoes are done, drain water, mash the potatoes and add the beans to the butter bean mixture.  Place in baking dish and cover with foil.  Bake for 30 minutes.  Serve with your favorite cheese and loaf of crusty bread.

title: Hominy With Variations
ingredients: 2 cans hominy | 4 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/4 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes
instructions: Drain the liquid from the cans into a large pot.  Add chicken bouillon, tarragon, chili flakes, and black pepper to the liquid.  Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.  Ladle into bowls, and cool to room temperature.

title: Ricotta With Leeks
ingredients: 250 g ricotta cheese | 2 leeks, trimmed and thinly sliced | 1/4 teaspoon fenugreek seeds
instructions: Put the ricotta, leeks, fenugreek and fenugreek seeds in a food processor.  Process for 3 5minutes until the mixture starts to form a ball.  Put in a bowl and leave for an hour in the fridge.  Serve with basmati rice and a vegetable.

title: Swiss Vegetables With Pecorino-Romano Grilling
ingredients: 3 large baking potatoes, scrubbed and cut into 1/2-inch thick slices | 2 tablespoons grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 1/2 cups shredded swiss cheese | 1 -2 small cauliflower, broken into small florets
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  In a large bowl, toss together potatoes, pecorino romano cheese, 1 1/2 cups swiss cheese, and cauliflower.  Season to taste with salt.  Place skillet in oven, and bake 30 - 45 minutes, until vegetables are tender.  Cut into wedges and serve hot.  Garnish with additional swiss cheese, if desired.

title: Lebanese Domesl - Ladyfingers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tahini | 16 ladyfingers
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c.  Line baking trays with baking paper.  Make a hole in each ladyfinger by inserting finger through centre of moistened finger and moistening with 1 tablespoon of tahini and smoothing over finger.  Dip the finger fingers in a bowl of warm water and then quickly fill the hole with a cupful of tahini.  Place in oven for 15 minutes or until browned and soft.

title: Mushroom and Rolls (Viniagrette)
ingredients: 10 button mushrooms, cleaned | 1/2 head lettuce | 1/2 cup wine vinegar
instructions: Drain excess water from mushrooms and set aside.  Boil the lettuce until it is tender and wilted.  Cool.  Remove the leaves from the lettuce and toss with enough of the vinaigrette to moisten.  Use lettuce leaves as a bed of lettuce leaves if possible.  Spread the mushrooms over the lettuce.  Roll up and eat.

title: Green Oat (Fudge Sponge) Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup oatmeal or 1 cup old-fashioned oatmeal | 4 -6 drops green food coloring | 6 -8 teaspoons canola oil or 6 -8 teaspoons light flavored cooking oil
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except the oil.  Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a lined lined baking tray.  Flatten down slightly with the back of a spoon.  Do not overmix.  Cook at 350 degrees f for 10 - 15 minutes.  Remove when cool.  Store in an airtight container at room temperature or cool, covering tightly for up to 6 weeks.

title: Blueberry-Buttermilk Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-fat buttermilk | 12 cups fresh blueberries, rinsed ( about 6 large )
instructions: Combine buttermilk and blueberries in medium bowl.  Set aside 2 tablespoons dressing for garnish.

title: Kataifi (Cheese Ball)
ingredients: 500 ml plain flour | 20 ml dijon mustard | 20 ml asafoetida powder | 10 ml chopped mint | 2 slices prosciutto
instructions: Sift the flour into a wide mixing bowl.  Make a well in the centre.  Add the mustard, asafetida and mint.  Knead very briefly until the dough resembles a smooth soft dough.  If it does, add some water, 1 tablespoons at a time, and knead well for a minute or so until the dough is smooth.  Wrap the dough in clingfilm and set aside to rest for 15 minutes.  Divide the dough into 10 portions.  Roll out each portion on a lightly floured surface into an 8 inch round about 1/4 inch thick.  Brush with water and sprinkle with salt.  Bake in a preheated oven at 190c for 15 minutes, then turn out onto a lightly greased baking tray and brush with water.  Leave to rest, uncovered, for another 15 minutes, before slicing into fingers.  Top with shredded or shaved ham, crumbled feta cheese and crispy cheese.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,shallot,turmeric,grain rice,chickpea flour,tomato green chilies,cocoa,halibut fillet
title: Crock Pot Chile Crab
ingredients: 1/3 cup chopped shallots | 1 1/2 lbs halibut fillets, cut into 4 pieces of the same size | 2 tablespoons whole grain rice | 1 medium tomatoes and green chilies, seeded and chopped ( or rotel ) | 2 teaspoons canola or 2 teaspoons taco seasoning mix ( or a mix of both ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons canola or 1 1/2 teaspoons taco oil | 1/2 teaspoon smoked paprika ( or more to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 can chickpea flour
instructions: In crock pot, layer shallots, halibut and rice.  Stir in remaining ingredients except salt.  Cover and cook on low heat setting for 8 to 10 hours.  Stir in salt and sprinkle with paprika.

Random Ingredients: red potato,sherry,tomato paste,sriracha hot sauce,provolone cheese,cornflour,vanilla,burgundy wine
title: Burgundy Potato & Tomato Gratin
ingredients: 1 cup red potatoes ( cut into chunks ) | 1/2 cup tomatoes paste | 3/4 cup burgundy wine ( can use other type ) | 1/4 cup sherry | 2 tablespoons cornflour ( or cornstarch ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | salt & pepper ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon sriracha hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: Mix everything together until well combined, cover and let sit in the refrigerator for at least an hour or two.  Preheat the oven to 350 degrees farenheit.  Line a shallow baking dish with parchment paper.  Layer the potatoes on the parchment paper.  Place in the oven and bake for 40 minutes turning once, until the potatoes are crispy and browned.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,beef chuck roast,ladyfinger,penne,yellow pepper,tart apple
title: Quick and Easy Beef Pinwheels
ingredients: 8 ounces penne, cooked and drained | 1/2 lb lean ground beef chuck roast | 1/2 cup crumbly yellow sweet pepper | 1 canned tart apples | 1 jar purchased sweetened pesto sauce | 24 ladyfingers
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees.  Cook meat in skillet.

title: Chilled Scotch Whisky Shots
ingredients: 1 can whole water chestnuts, drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons scotch whisky | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Place all ingredients in a shaker and blend well, 15 - 20 seconds.  Pour the mixture into a glass filled with ice.

Random Ingredients: mascarpone,water,poblano chile,fine herb,rice wine,dark brown sugar,cornflour,maple syrup
title: Champurrado (Rice With Poblanos)
ingredients: 3 poblano chiles, seeded and chopped ( i used one medium-hot chile poblano ) | 2 cans organic red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons maple syrup ( or honey ) | 1 tablespoon smooth rice wine | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 3 tablespoons dark brown sugar ( or a mixture of both ) | 1 teaspoon fine herbs ( such as aromatic herbs such as chives, tarragon, or rosemary or rosemary leaves ) | 1 tablespoon water | 1 teaspoon maple syrup | 1 teaspoon fine herb ( such as aromatic herbs such as chives, tarragon, or rosemary leaves )
instructions: Set oven to 350°f.  Combine chiles with 1/2 cup of the beans in a 13x9x2 inch baking dish with sides.  Roast until charred and soft.  About 15 minutes.  Set aside.  Pulse the remaining beans and chile mixture in a food processor to a coarse sauce.  Stir the sauce into the chile bean bean puree.  Bring the puree to a boil, adding the syrup and cornflour, stirring well to blend.  Stir in the brown sugar or honey.  Stir until sugar is dissolved.  Pour mixture into a 3 1/2x9x2 inch baking dish.  Bake for 35 to 45 minutes, until mixture is fragrant and hot.  Sauce will thicken and intensify as it cools.  When cool, stir in the fine herbs.  Serve warm with crusty bread.

title: Homemade Pho Box Chicken Base (Pollo All' Pho)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons turmeric | 16 packets chicken bouillon
instructions: Place turmeric in the small square pan of microwave proof bowl.  Add water to the pan.  Add all the packets.  Add chicken bouillon.  Close lid.  Microwave on high 5 minutes.  Turn off and leave for about 15 - 20 minutes.  Store in refrigerator.

title: Tiger's Firecrackers
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups arborio rice | 1/4 cup red cherries | 1/2 cup feta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400.  Cook the rice using 1/4 cup water in a rice cooker, add the remaining ingredients and stir well.

title: Truffles for Dipping
ingredients: 12 teaspoons shallots, finely minced | 12 teaspoons blanched almonds, finely minced | 12 teaspoons fresh edible flowers, finely chopped
instructions: Combine the shallots and almonds, and sprinkle over the dried ingredients.  Sprinkle with candied rose petals, and refrigerate for 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,ice cream,red chilies,mushroom stem,cream chicken soup
title: Mushroom Chutney
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 cup ice cream | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 small fresh red chilies, minced ( or to taste ) | 1 can mushroom stems and pieces, drained
instructions: In a small bowl, gently stir cream of chicken soup, grated coconut, icing sugar, red chilies and mushrooms until combined.  Spread mixture into a shallow baking dish.  Bake at 350f degrees for about 10 minutes or until the mixture is warmed throughout and the coconut is lightly browned.  Top with fresh chopped spring onion if desired.

title: Puerto Rican Spaghetti With Chili-Salsa
ingredients: 1 -2 lb spaghettini | 2 cups thick & chunky salsa ( i wouldn't recommend the mild ) | 2 dried red chili peppers, seeded and deveined
instructions: Start boiling water for pasta.  Boil pasta until just al dente.  Drain pasta well and toss with other ingredients.  Best served right away.

title: Chunky Green Chilies
ingredients: 12 ounces chopped mild green chilies | 16 ounces mayonnaise
instructions: Mix the chilies in a bowl.  Beat with a fork.  If too dry add only 2 teaspoons of water.  The key is they will be hot.  If not serve warm with bread.

Random Ingredients: risotto rice,peanut oil,apricot,caster sugar,gruyere cheese,salt pepper,fenugreek
title: Fenugreek and Pistou Rice
ingredients: 50 g risotto rice | 450 g roasted peanuts oil | 300 g finely grated gruyere cheese | 200 g chopped dried apricots | 1 pinch salt & freshly ground pepper | 1 pinch caster sugar | 1 pinch fenugreek
instructions: Wash rice in running water.  Add 2 1/2 cups cold water to the rice and soak for 15 - 20 minutes.  The rice needs to be dry to ensure good absorption, cover and set aside for 20 minutes.  Heat 5 tablespoons of oil in a pan, add the rice and stir so the rice changes color and covers the base of the pan.  Cook rice until a pale golden brown colour.  Keep the pan over a heat and add the remaining oil, cheese, apricots and 1 pinch of salt and pepper.  Stir gently.  Remove the rice mixture from the heat and set aside for 5 - 10 minutes to allow flavours to combine.  Once the cheese begins to melt, stir in the fenugreek.  Taste and adjust seasoning and serve.

title: Vegetarian Burritos (Gulai)
ingredients: 2/3 cup okra, cut lengthwise in half, then diced | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 3 tablespoons burrito flour tortillas ( i use the whole flour tortillas ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/2 1/2 cup water or 1/2 cup stock
instructions: Wash okra well to remove grit.  Place okra in saucepan with vegetable stock and bring to boil.  Reduce heat and simmer until tender, approximately 10 minutes.  Mash okra slightly while still hot and add more stock, if necessary, to thin to desired consistency.  Place burrito flour tortillas on a serving plate and spoon hot okra on top of tortillas and top with any desired topping.  Garnish with cardamom and chopped green onion.

title: Achaari-Style Hazelnut Pesto
ingredients: 3/4 cup finely chopped hazelnuts | 1/2 cup finely grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/2 - 1 cup brewed tea
instructions: Place the hazelnuts and parmigiano in the bowl of a food processor and pulse until chopped but not ground very fine.  Pour in the coffee and pulse until finely ground.

title: Aarsi’s Ultimate Low Fat cottage Cheese
ingredients: 500 g reduced fat curd cottage cheese, in cubes ( paneer ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 chicken stock cube
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.  Use to cover the top of the fat cottage cheese with a lid, and decorate with some almonds and pistachios.

title: Cheese Flan With Eggs
ingredients: 8 ounces cream cheese, room temperature | 2 tablespoons cayenne | 1 large egg yolk
instructions: Beat the cream cheese and egg yolk in a bowl with an electric mixer on medium speed until the mixture resembles softly scrambled eggs.  Spoon the cream cheese mixture into an 8” by 8” pan, filling 2/3 full.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, or overnight.  Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: cardamom powder,chicken bouillon granule,green peppercorn,horseradish,bean thread noodle,beef chuck,yellow onion
title: Spicy Oriental Noodle Skillet
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/2 cup yellow onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons green peppercorns, drained | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons horseradish, grated | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish, extra | 1 teaspoon yellow onion, coarsely chopped | 15 bean thread noodles, broken into 3/4 inch pieces
instructions: Place meat cubes in a large deep skillet.

Random Ingredients: american cheese,peach preserve,creole seasoning,kale,saffron,barbecue sauce,coriander powder
title: Famous Dave's Kale Wraps
ingredients: 10 leaves kale | 2 cans sliced peaches in heavy syrup | 1 teaspoon saffron | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon hot barbecue sauce | 1/4 teaspoon creole seasoning | 4 slices american cheese
instructions: Cut kale into small pieces and rinse.  Place in a 2 quart microwave safe casserole dish with the peach slices on top.  Combine saffron, coriander powder, hot barbecue sauce, and creole seasoning.  Pour evenly over kale and peaches and bake at 400 degrees f.  1 hour or until kale is tender.  To serve, place 1 slice american cheese on a piece of kale that is long and thick.  Spoon equal amounts of the peach filling into the center of the cheese slice.  Roll the cheese up to encase the filling.

title: Frescavena Cheese Balls With Cream Cheese Mango Syrup
ingredients: 3 cups fresh white breadcrumbs | 1 package cream cheese, at room temperature | 1 1/2 cups cooked broccoli, chopped | 1/2 cup finely diced mango powder | 2/3 cup chopped green olives | 1 tablespoon dried parsley
instructions: Soak the bread crumbs in a small bowl with water or milk to 1/2 cup until the water is clear.  Squeeze excess water out of the bread crumbs, then combine with the cheese, broccoli, mango powder, olives, and parsley in a large bowl with a pastry blender until all the ingredients are combined well.  Chill in the refrigerator for 1 hour and serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: sea salt black pepper,serrano pepper,tortilla,pork loin,egg substitute,pimiento,salt,red pepper flake
title: Cinco De Mayo (Portuguese Pork Loin Sandwich)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil, divided | salt | 1/2 - 3/4 lb boneless pork loin | 2 tablespoons red pepper flakes | 12 eggs | 1/2 cup low sodium egg substitute | 2 tablespoons pimiento | 1 1/2 tablespoons serrano peppers, minced | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat half the olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Sprinkle the sliced pork with salt and pepper and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned on all sides, about 4 - 5 minutes in all.  Transfer pork to a cutting board and let cool 3 - 5 minutes.  Heat remaining olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat.  Sprinkle pork with flour and cook, stirring, until it browns on both sides, about 5 minutes per side.  Return pork to skillet, season with red pepper flakes and set aside.  Whisk eggs, egg substitute, peppers and reserved cooked pork in a bowl until well blended.  Scramble and heat in skillet.  Cover if necessary.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: currant,mexican cheese,rice,vegetable oil cooking spray,cider vinegar,chicken breast half,basil leaf,orange
title: Chicken Fajitas

title: Pineapple Tahini Rice
ingredients: 300 ml teriyaki sauce | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 1 cup arborio rice | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 green bell pepper, cut into thin strips
instructions: Combine the teriyaki sauce and vanilla sugar in a small saucepan, and bring to a boil over medium high heat.  Add the rice and stir well to coat.  Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.  Remove from heat, and stir in the tahini.  Cover and set aside to stand for five minutes.  Fluff the rice with a fork, and serve. Random Ingredients: cool whip,broccoli floret,pecorino cheese,brown sugar,espresso,italian herb,allspice,fine breadcrumb
title: Italian Christmas Broccoli Balls
ingredients: 2 cups cooked broccoli florets | 1 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1 cup fresh pecorino cheese, grated | 1/2 teaspoon mixed italian herbs | 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 1/2 teaspoon instant espresso | 2 tablespoons packed light brown sugar | 1 package cool whip frozen blend  7-up containers
instructions: In a large bowl, combine broccoli florets, bread crumbs, cheese, herbs, allspice, coffee and sugar.  Chill well.  Stir well and form into 1 1/2 balls.  Place on a large rack in a shallow baking pan that has been coated with cooking spray.  Chill and place frozen containers on top of frozen containers.  Carefully shake a container to loosen the frozen balls.  Place balls on waxed paper lined baking sheet, allowing room to spread out.  Allow to soften several hours or overnight, if possible.  Invert frozen containers onto waxed paper lined baking sheet.  Chill until cold.  Invert frozen containers onto a serving plate.  Remove waxed paper and cool before serving.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,vanilla,garlic paste,french green bean
title: Green Beans and Garlic Rolls
ingredients: 150 g french style green beans | 3 tablespoons garlic-flavored paste | 2 teaspoons vanilla | 2 teaspoons self-raising flour
instructions: Clean and cut the green beans into 5 cm lengths and cut them into 5 cm chunks.  Combine the ingredients, except the flour, in a large bowl, then mix well with your hands.  Put 1 tbsp of the mixture on to one end of a french fry stick, allowing space for spreading.  Roll the stick around the mixture.  Hold it back with the palms of your hand.  Slide the stick back into the bowl with the mixture.  Repeat until all the mixture used has been used up, placing the stick on a warm plate to rest for 2 - 3 hours.  When serving, place a little bit of sugar on top of each roll, then serve hot.

title: Achiote Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups ouzo | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder or 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/4 cup pesto sauce ( homemade or prepared )
instructions: In a small saucepan.  In a small bowl, stir together the ouzo, dried chili powder and the mustard.  Slowly add pesto and stir to blend.  Pour into a small bowl, cover and let stand at least 2 hours.  Stir well before serving.

Random Ingredients: sumac,cabbage,cherry tomato,chicken stock,lamb,macadamia nut,lemon juice zest
title: Azerbaijan
ingredients: 5 ounces macadamia nuts | 1 lb lamb, diced | 8 ounces cabbage, shredded | 12 cherry tomatoes, halved | 6 tablespoons lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 1 teaspoon ground sumac | 5 cups chicken stock
instructions: Place the macadamia nuts in a small saucepan with the lamb, cabbage, tomatoes, lemon juice, sumac and stock.

title: Yellow Curry with Greens (Yogurt Tava Kari)
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh kale or 1 bunch english kale | 2 -3 green apples | 1 tablespoon yellow mustard ( any type that has about 2 grams of sugar added to it ) | 1 dash baharat ( or other gulf spices, use more if you like, i usually just leave it out ) or 1 dash anise flavouring ( or more if you like, i usually just leave it out ) | 2 -3 teaspoons yellow mustard
instructions: Wash, remove and discard tough parts of kale or spinach.  Break apart leaves and remove any hard parts of the stems.  Cut up the apples and saute in a little bit of olive oil, or some other flavouring, in the same pan you cooked your greens in.  Add your mustard powder or some other spices.  When it starts to color, add kale or your greens and the yellow mustard and mix thoroughly.  If your mustard has little or no sugar or salt, add sugar as needed on the mustard before adding the greens and apples.  Serve warm or cold.

title: Dodo-Gyoza (Japanese Eggplant-Pork Dish)
ingredients:
1/2 lb tenderloin, cut into 1/4-inch slabs | 1 eggplant, peeled and cut crosswise into 1/2-inch wide sticks | 1 pinch of ouzo ( or 2 tsp.
    - dashi ) | 1 -2 tablespoon dashi ( or more if needed ) | 1/2 cup olive ( optional )
instructions: In a large, deep skillet, heat 1/4 cup water over medium heat.  Add the ouzo.

Random Ingredients: coriander,curry paste,vanilla essence,clove,rigatoni pasta,roasting chicken,pea carrot,broccoli floret
title: Chicken in Vege and Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon curry paste | 2 whole cloves | 2 1/2 lbs roasting chickens, cut in 8 pieces | 1 cup frozen peas and carrot | 10 ounces broccoli florets | 1 cup coriander | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 10 ounces rigatoni pasta
instructions: Heat oven to 425°f.  In a baking dish, add curry paste and spices and mix thoroughly.  Add chicken and vegetables and toss to coat well.  Cover tightly and put into roasting pan.  Bake 40 minutes or until chicken is tender.  Meanwhile, cook the rigatoni pasta according to directions on pack.  Drain.  Serve chicken and sauce over heated rigatoni, topped with fresh coriander.

title: Chicken Chow Mein
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken legs, skin on, cut into halves or thirds | 1 cup vegetable stock | 6 ounces chow mein noodles, dry, broken into about 1-inch pieces or 6 ounces japanese chow mein noodles | 6 ounces spinach leaves, washed, spun dry, and coarsely chopped | 1 cup radish, washed, peeled, and sliced | 1 whole star anise | 1 cup packed fresh spinach leaves ( optional )
instructions: Rinse chicken, drain and pat dry with paper towels.  Place in a large dutch oven, adding vegetable stock and chow mein noodles.  Bring to a boil over medium high heat and reduce heat to a simmer.  Cover and cook at a rolling boil, stirring twice, until chicken is no longer pink in center, about 20 - 25 minutes.  Remove chicken from the heat, cover and set aside.  Heat the oven to 375°f if using spinach leaves, remove and discard stems and set aside.  If using spinach leaves, drain and spin over a bowl.  Cut the leaves up with scissors or in a vegetable grinder if using grinder.  In a medium size bowl, combine the spinach and radishes, mix in radishes, star anise, and 1/4 cup reserved chicken cooking liquid.  Add the chicken and stir to combine.  Simmer soup for 10 minutes.

title: Shortcut Beef (Asian Beef) over Rice Noodles
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups cooked rice noodles ( rice sticks ) | 1 can cremini mushrooms, sliced | 2 medium garlic cloves, minced | 2 lbs stewing beef, sliced into bite-size pieces ( may use more, but the longer cooking time is ok ) | 4 tablespoons macaroni, uncooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f in a saucepan of boiling water, cook rice noodles until just tender.  Drain, set aside.  In the same saucepan, combine the mushrooms, garlic, stew beef & macaroni, tossing to combine.  Arrange the noodles in an ungreased baking dish, alternating with the beef mixture.  Drizzle with additional olive oil if desired.  Bake in a preheated 375°f oven for 30 minutes.

title: Pancake Nuts(Cook's Country)
ingredients: 12 fresh sage leaves | 1 teaspoon ground gingerroot | 3 tablespoons raisins | 12 ounces frozen chopped spinach or 12 ounces fresh baby spinach leaves, in the package | 1 ounce chocolate chips ( optional )
instructions: Put a small pan of water on your burner over low heat and make sure the pan is clean.  If you don't have it, get your pan very hot with the ginger in it.  Turn the stove on to low.  If you have a pan with a lid, the ginger will release its aroma but still be slightly crunchy.  If you don't have one, just add a little bit of lemon juice or oil to the pan.  If you don't have a lid, just pour the oil into a small frying pan.  Cook your sage leaves in it for about 2 - 5 minutes just until they are dark green.  Take them out and squeeze out excess water.  Remove the stems.  Chop them.  Take the spinach, and place them on a plate.  If you have a strainer, pour a little of the water off of it.  This will help take a little moisture out of the spinach than.  If you have a colander the spinach will give you a finer chop. .  You want the water in the spinach, and if there is still water in it, just remove it with a slotted spoon.  When the water starts to boil away, put the spinach in the strainer.  It will take about 3 - 5 minutes to get it to thaw but it will thaw a bit more in time.  When you're done, take the spinach out of the strainer and pour it into a bowl.  Put the drained spinach in the bowl with the oil.  Drain the sage.  This is a quick way to get the oil out of the spinach.  Toss it with the oil from the spinach, mix well.  Add the drained spinach to the bowl with the dry leaves, ginger and raisins, stirring well.  If you don't have a serving platter on the burner, you can put a lid on the pan, or you can put all the ingredients in a microwave or the liquidizer and micro and mix well.  Add the chocolates if you'd like.  Keep stirring.  Cook for about 2 minutes, but watch it.  It should not bubble, and it may darken a bit.  Remove from the heat.  It will take a few minutes to get it to thaw.  Sprinkle on the spiky leaves.

Add teabags and orange zest, stir, and microwave briefly to get loose of air bubbles.  Stir and serve.

title: Kielbasa Appetizer
ingredients: 1/2 pound kielbasa sausage, cut into 3/4 inch slices | salt to taste | 1/2 pound shredded gouda cheese
instructions: Heat a large skillet over high heat and cook the sausage, breaking it apart as it cooks, until well browned and crumbly, 5 to 8 minutes.  Drain meat well and return to the skillet.  Stir in the salt.  Spoon the gouda on top of the sausage and sprinkle the cheese over the top.  Increase heat to high and cook until the cheese has melted and turned golden brown.  Drain the sausage, reserving the drippings in the skillet.  Serve hot.

title: Pumpkin Oyster
ingredients: 1 kg fresh pumpkin | 1 kg oyster ( if you use canned ) | cumin, if you like | 1 bunch fresh mushroom, sliced
instructions: Remove the outside leaves of the pumpkin and remove the flesh from around the pumpkin and discard or save for later use.  Cut the pumpkin into cubes, about 1 and half cm in diameter.  The pieces should sit on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, which is not large enough to leave gaps, just enough about 1 cm deep.  If using canned, boil for about 8 minutes or until tender.  When cooked, drain the pumpkin and place it in a large ovenproof dish.  If using canned, put the pieces at one end of the pumpkin so that any juices that you can collect are passed through the pumpkin.  If using fresh mushrooms, throw them in now too if using canned.  Fill up with the oysters and bake in a preheated oven at 180 grades c until the oysters are bubbling and the pumpkins are brown or soft on the outside.  Serve with any rice or noodles.

title: Splendicious Coconut Couscous

instructions: Combine soufflés and coconut in medium bowl.  Place bowl in microwave for 4 - 5 minutes until couscous is hot but soft.  Stir in creamy coconut.  Serve with extra creamy coconut if desired.

title: BBQ Shredded Beef With Yellow and Red Pepper
ingredients: 2 lbs trimmed sirloin steaks, about 2-inch thick ( see note below ) | 2 large yellow bell peppers or 2 large red bell peppers, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted | 3/4 cup white bbq wine vinegar | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice | 2 tablespoons dark beer | 1 1/2 teaspoons prepared chili ( preferably mexican )
instructions: Prepare the meat, in a bowl, combine all ingredients except the meat.  Place meat, turning once, in a greased 9 x 12 x 2 inch baking pan.  Bake at 400 degrees f.  For 20 - 25 minutes, turning meat twice.  Remove meat from bones, let cool slightly then cut into serving sized pieces.  Reserve any juices that remain at the bottom of the pan.  Serve with potatoes or your favorite side of the dish.  This can be done several hours ahead and refrigerated until ready to use.  Meat is best prepared at least 12 hours in advance to allow flavors to blend.  Transfer meat to a serving platter and set aside to come to room temperature.  Carve the beef into thin 2 inch long strips and place in a bowl.  Drizzle each strip on the melted butter and then mix in the diced peppers.  Cover all with plastic wrap and refrigerate until serving time.  Makes 2 servings.  Serve with potatoes or your favorite side of the dish.  Note, i sometimes marinate the meat for 6 hours in the refrigerator, then cook it over hot coals or in the oven while baking.  It can also be left in a ziploc bag and refrigerated for up to 4 days.  Meat can also be grilled or baked in a 375 degree oven for 20 minutes, then spread the juices onto the meat on top and bake at 375 degrees f.  For 15 minutes, or until tender.  Turn meat over and bake at 325 degrees f.  For 20 - 30 minutes, or until tender as desired.

instructions: Prepare the rigatoni according to package directions and drain.  Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, combine the chicken bouillon granules, mexican cheese, pepperoni and lime leaves. instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f.  Lightly spray a cookie sheet with nonstick cooking spray, and arrange the pita breads on the sheet. Place the pita breads onto the center of the sheet with the sausage on one side of the bread.  Bake for ten minutes, turning and rearranging until cooked through or a golden brown.

instructions: Chop spinach coarsely and place in a large pan.  Add beans, salami and baby spinach.  To make dressing, combine all the ingredients and heat until the salt content has completely dissolved.  Place salad in a shallow, non metallic bowl and pour over dressing.

title: Tikki Kebabs (Antojitos - Beef Stew)

title: Homemade Indian Spice Blend

title: Oven Roasted Herb Mix

title: Roasted Eggplant

Place the bread or croutons on a baking sheet and toast in the broiler for just a few minutes.  Remove the bread from the oven and set aside to completely dry out. title: Spaghetti With Kidney Beans
ingredients: 6 ounces spaghetti, broken into small pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  In a large baking pan large enough to contain all ingredients, toss together the spaghetti and kidney beans.  Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tender.

Heat the oil in a large, deep fryer or pot ot moderate heat.  Add the prawns in a single layer & fry for 2 - 3 minutes or till just cooked through.  Carefully lift out & drain on paper towels.  Reheat the oil in the wok, add the mange pieces & stir fry for 5 - 6 minutes.  Add the prawns & the green beans, toss well & cook for 3 - 4 minutes. title: Rice Yogurt Roll-ups With Avocado Sauce

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the salad oil with the olive oil.  Add the meat and turn to coat.  Add the cashews and toss to coat.  Serve cold.

Place garlic and shrimp in a bowl and stir in egg substitute.  Cover and leave to marinate in the refrigerator overnight.
