instructions: Pour 3/4 cup of marsala into fondue pot add 2 tbsp of shredded cheese, stir while heating.  Place in a bowl with 1/8 cup of melted cheese and set aside.  Whip bittersweet chocolate for about 2 minutes.  Pour the rest of the butter into medium saucepan, add remaining cheese and marsala and stir until melted and combined.  Do not let saucepan get too hot or chocolate will become hard.  Remove and fondue pot from heat, and add the shaved gruyere cheese and stir until melted.  Serve immediately, or refrigerate for later use.

title: Pineapple Cream Soup
ingredients: 4 cans condensed chicken broth | 1 can crushed pineapple with juice | 1 can or bottle dark rum
instructions: Puree the can of pineapple and the can of crushed pineapple in a food processor until the mixture resembles a fine powder.  Add the can of condensed chicken broth to the puree in the food processor, pulsing just enough to smooth it all together.  Pour the mixture into a blender and blend until smooth.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,red bell pepper,cornstarch,olive oil,ancho chile powder,farmer cheese,bamboo skewer,double cream
title: Farmer Cheese Skewers
ingredients: 8 ounces farmer cheese, crumbled | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 6 roma tomatoes, peeled seeded and cut into chunks | 1 large red bell pepper, cut into chunks | 1 ripe ancho chile powder | 1 cup double cream | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon chili powder ( optional ) | 16 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes
instructions: For cheese mixture, mix cheese, cornstarch, tomatoes, red bell pepper, ancho chile powder, cream, and oil.  Thread cheese mixture onto soaked skewers.  For sauce, combine chili powder, if desired, and remaining ancho chili powder.  Serve skewers with sauce.

title: Homemade Noodles (Somali Nuevo)
ingredients: 6 egg whites | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce, or more to taste | peanut oil | 1 pound tomatoes with garlic, peeled and chopped
instructions: Whisk egg whites and tabasco sauce in a large bowl until well combined.  Heat peanut oil in a skillet or deep fryer over medium high heat.  Cook egg whites in hot oil until golden brown on the bottom, about 5 minutes.

title: German Chicken and Fish Goulash
ingredients: 600 g mincemeat | 1200 g smoked fish | 1200 g stewing chicken | 200 g hamburger | 200 g peach slices | 400 g kielbasa | 4 bay leaves | 1 bunch fresh dill
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°c.  In an oven safe dish combine all the ingredients except the meat and then put on the lid and bake for 1 hour remove the lid and bake for an additional 30 - 45 minutes.  Remove from the oven and add the meat and continue baking for additional 45mins.  Remove bay leaves and allow meat to cool completely for about 1 or 2 hours before cutting, to serve.

title: Cucumber  and Herb Salad With Lemonade Vinaigrette
ingredients: 6 fluid ounces lemonade ( vinaigrette ) | 5 fluid ounces ice water | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 3 -4 sheets of sliced pickles ( the white and light green parts of the pickles ) | 1 lebanese cucumber | 1/2 cup of thin fresh sage leaf | 1 teaspoon finely grated fresh lemonade ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon mirin
instructions: Mix vinaigrette ingredients together and add desired amount of ice water.  Keep aside.  Cut the cucumber lengthwise into thin thin slices.  Remove seeds from each slice by gently pounding with your hands at reasonable times, to release some of the moisture.  Cut slices into thin slices.  Cut the mint leaves in half and stir into vinaigrette.  Pour one table spoonful of vinaigrette into a serving bowl.  Toss with the cucumber and herbs.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 10 minutes or longer.  Just before serving, mix in the lemonade, if using.  To serve, arrange the cucumber rounds on a piece of salad plate, top with cucumber herb dressing and serve the vinaigrette separately.  This dish can also be served with a side salad, such as a traditional salad.

title: Tropical Brunch
ingredients: 8 ounces sweet smoked sausage | 2 teaspoons coriander powder | 4 tablespoons brown sugar | 4 tablespoons steak sauce | 2 tablespoons gin
instructions: Mix spice together and add sugar.  Add steak sauce and gin to taste.  Slice sausage into thin strips and place in fridge.  When ready to serve add to the smoking point.  If not smoking, cook only 1 minute.

title: Beer-Poached Eggs With Barley and Bean Sprouts
ingredients:
5 -6 cups cold black tea | 1 large crusty roll | 1 cup barley | 8 ounces rigatoni pasta ( approx.
    - ) | 1 medium cucumber - peeled, seeded, and sliced into 1/4-inch rounds | 7 ounces sliced pepperoni
instructions: Bring the water to a boil for the pasta.  Once it starts to boil, remove from heat and cover for a few minutes to steam.  While waiting for the water to boil, begin preparing the ingredients, as soon as the tea is boiling, remove the crusty roll from the top.  You want it to be soft and slightly translucent.  When the water is getting hot, add the barley and leave covered for a minute or two.  Pour the 1 cup of cold black tea into a large bowl.  Once the tea is cooled, remove the lid.  Pour 1 cup of cold black tea into the bowl, then set the cold tea aside.  Once the tea has cooled, place the cold black tea bowl under cold running water to stop the cooking.  When water is boiling, add the 1 cup of cold black tea and place the steaming pot on the lowest heat level in your kitchen.  While the tea is brewing, place the slice of pepperoni into a large saucer or small bowl.  Dip each slice of pepperoni into cold beer, then place them into a colander.  Once all pepperoni are drained, pour the hot tea mixture over the hot pepperoni, and let sit for a couple minutes.  You want the pepperoni to be hot.  Place the drained pasta on plates, then place a slice of pepperoni over them.  Then add a slice of cucumber over the pepperoni to make a big salad.  Repeat until all salad ingredients are used.  Enjoy.

title: Tarte Tatin (French Cheese Pastry Pastry Pie)
ingredients: 1 lb frozen puff pastry | 1/2 lb grated american cheese ( colombian preferred ) | 4 ounces crumbed soft bread ( from a dense, country-style loaf ) | 1 lb grapes tomatoes ( large are particularly good ) or canning plum tomatoes ( american or italian or italian or italian or italian or italian or italian or italian or italian or italian or italian or italian or italian or italian or italian or italian or any ) | 1/2 cup dry white wine ( optional ) | 5 tablespoons sliced very thinly sliced and drained capers | 1/8 cup crumbled soft walnuts
instructions: On a lightly floured board, roll out the pastry to 1/8 inch thickness and cut into two 3 inch rounds.  Place rounds on a lightly buttered baking sheet, allowing space between each round by about 1 1/2 inches.  Bake at 450 degrees fahrenheit for about 12 minutes or until golden and puffed.  Meanwhile, in a heavy 8 inch skillet, heat half the cheese with the bread over a medium heat, breaking it into small chunks when it starts to get golden.  When cheese is melted, remove from heat and add half the tomatoes, capers and walnuts.  Stir until thoroughly blended and the tomatoes have begun to melt.

title: Jalebi-Style Tomato and Jalapeno Jam
ingredients:
500 g plain flour ( preferably 00 ) | 20 g white wine vinegar | 2 slices jalapenos, cut in half lengthways and finely chopped ( or 3-4 tsp.
    - jalapeno powder ) | 300 ml concentrated tomato puree, with some strained juice squeezed out and mixed thoroughly.
    - ( or use 1/2 cup pureed canned tomato with 1/2 cup juice and puree )
instructions: Heat oven to 180c/fan 160c/gas 7/4/moderate.  In a large bowl put flour and jalapeno powder with a pinch of salt and black pepper and knead until dough comes together.  Knead the dough briefly and roll out on a floured board to a thickness of about 10 x 7 inches.  Place in an oiled or non stick baking pan and flatten slightly if needed.  Brush over with a little vinegar and spread the tomato puree over and around the dough.  Bake for 30 - 35 minutes or until lightly browned underneath.  Let cool in the pan for about 5 minutes.  Serve and keep in an airtight container.

title: Easy Easy Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 bottle hunts tomato sauce, hunts'traditional flavor | 1 small onion soup mix
instructions: Pour into crockpot.  Add enough water to pot that the liquid just covers the whole thing.  Add onion soup mix, mix and mix well.  Cover and cook on low for 7 9hrs or 1 hr on high, depending on how thick you like your sauce.  You can serve on rolls or toast, and when cool, top with favorite cheese.

title: Quick and Easy Beef-Beet-And-Beet-Slices
ingredients: 4 lbs beef tenderloin, cut into 1-inch cubes or 4 lbs chuck roast | 1 can refried beans | 1 can beets ( sliced ) | 1 jar gherkins ( sliced ) | 1 jar pickled beets, drained | 2 teaspoons cinnamon | 2 green cardamoms
instructions: Preheat over 275 degrees.  In large bowl or resealable plastic bag, mix all ingredients except beef and beets, except beef.  Add beef mixture to bag and marinate overnight in refrigerator.  Drain beef.  Stir fry beef mixture and vegetables over low heat for 45 minute pour beef mixture into deep pot, add beets.  Bring to boil, reduce heat to simmer, cover, and cook for 2 hours until beef is tender and flavors have blended.

title: Spinach and Tahini Chicken Wings
ingredients:
6 small whole-milk chicken wings ( about 2 pounds ) | 0.
    -2 cup tahini | 1 bag baby spinach
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f wash the wings and remove tips.  Lay them flat in an oiled roasting pan.  Sprinkle the wings with salt.  Bake for 75 minutes, then remove the pan from the oven and let the wings cook for an additional 25 minutes.  Let the wings cool and split down the center.  Scoop out the dark pulp and the larger portions and set the pulp aside.  Return the pan to the stove over medium heat.  Mix in the tahini.  Spread the spinach on a baking sheet and bake in the oven for about 10 minutes, stirring once, until lightly browned.  Spread the spinach on a clean towel and dry.  Return the pan to the stove and warm the mixture, stirring occasionally.  Arrange the wings on a serving platter and spoon the hot sauce over them.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chip,meat,button mushroom,sweetcorn,flaky layer biscuit,yellow bell pepper,nut,pork loin
title: Easy Pork Loin Pie
ingredients: 1 loin ( thin pork loin ) | 200 g ground meat | 100 g button mushrooms | 100 g sweetcorn | 100 g sweetcorn | 100 g mushrooms | 100 g yellow bell peppers | 200 g chocolate chips | 1 package flaky layer biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c and bake on the greased oven tray for 20 mins or until cooked.

Random Ingredients: wheat bread,salmon fillet,hot italian sausage,pepper sauce,sherry,cod,black sesame seed,pecan
title: Scotch Pot Snack
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless salmon fillets | 2 slices whole wheat bread, crusts removed | 2 slices cooked hot italian sausage | 3 ounces chopped pecans | 2 ounces black sesame seeds | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 teaspoon sherry
instructions: Preheat the broiler.  Grease a 9x13 casserole dish.  Arrange the salmon fillets in the dish, and slice bread into strips.  Layer the sliced bread, sausage, pecans, sesame seeds, pepper sauce and sherry over them.  Broil 3 to 5 minutes, until toasted.

title: Mixed Corn
ingredients: 2 ears fresh corn | 100 ml orange-flavored liqueur ( or 50 ml rum )
instructions: Take the corn and cut off the cob.  Remove the husk and remove all of the silk leaving about 3 - 4 whole kernels on the cob.  Cut out the silk from the corn and place with just the left over juices inside the corn.  Place in a frying pan and cover with 100p of orange liqueur or rum.  Cook over a low heat for 3 hours or until tender.  Stir occasionally.

title: Nari's Easy Microwave Rice Pilaff!
ingredients: 1/4 cup long grain white rice | 1 envelope good seasonings mix
instructions: Dink the Good Seasonings Mix into a plastic bag and shake to mix well.  Empty rice into a wide, shallow microwave safe bowl.  Dump contents of seasoning packet into the microwave bowl.  Use the back of a spoon to press contents into the rice, lifting the rice as you go.  Repeat the above until all of the rice is used.  Add seasoning mix into the rice, and stir to coat both sides of the rice.  Put plastic bag into microwave and bake in the microwave.  After about five minutes, fluff rice with a fork, and serve.

title: Strawberry Beef Cocktail #2
ingredients: 1 lb of sliced steak | 2 tablespoons strawberry syrup | 1 can refrigerated cocktail or ( 12 ounce ) can beef cocktail snacks, but do not drain, keep warm
instructions: Cut the steak into thick strips.

title: Homemade Knishes
ingredients: 1 lb vegetable shortening ( i use canola ) | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon cube
instructions: Mix together with a pastry brush.  Prick holes and knead with your hands all over.  Roll like a jelly roll and cut into pieces about 1 inch wide.  Store in an airtight container for up to two weeks.  My note, i made this using a veggie flavor product that does not work well in a recipe like butter, so as to have the consistency of real buttery.  I used the flavor of my homemade chicken stock which made a nice filling for sausages or as an asiago paste for the stuffing while making chicken stock for sausages and pork shoulder shoulder roast or other things that need nothing on flavor, like pork chops or pork loin roast.  I took out a bit of the flour to make a slurry a little less than about 1/8 tsp of the bouillon and blended it into the crumbs.  My wife and i added a small, nonstick fry pan of butter.  Once the butter had been incorporated into the liquid, it went into a saucepan and quickly mixed in the bouillon.

title: Nutmeg and Broccoli
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dried nutmeg | 1 package uncooked broccoli florets, halved | 1/2 cup thawed and drained wonton skins
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.  Add dried, chopped nuts and broccoli to the skillet.

Random Ingredients: bulk pork sausage,white wine vinegar,cayenne,mushroom soup,corn oil,pecan,chicken broth
title: German Sausage-Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon coarse salt | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1 -1 1/2 lb bulk pork sausage | 1 -2 package fresh mushrooms, cleaned and cut into 2x1/2 inch pieces | 1 can 98 % fat-free cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1/2 bag pecans or 1/2 bag walnut pieces, lightly toasted and coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºf.  In a bowl, mix salt and cayenne.  Cut into a small bowl the sausage if using bulk sausage, and set aside for later use.  Tear off and discard stem from each mushroom, and divide the mushroom pieces among the cavity.  Sprinkle the sausage with salt and cayenne mixture and add the cream of mushroom soup, chicken broth and vinegar to the mushroom mixture.  Stuff mushroom caps with the sausage mixture and mound them firmly into the mushroom caps.  Place in a 9x12 pan coated with cooking spray.  Sprinkle the nuts evenly on top.  Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes.  Remove foil and bake until the mushrooms are browned and the sausage mixture is cooked through and a nice crust is formed, about 20 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: mango powder,tomato puree,tomato paste,head iceberg lettuce,curry paste
title: Tomato-Mango Curry over Baked Spicy Cabbage
ingredients: 1/4 cup curry paste, or to taste | 1/2 tablespoon tomato paste, or more to taste | 1/2 tablespoon mango powder, or more to taste | 1 pound fresh tomato puree, divided | 1 head iceberg lettuce | 1 mango powder, or more to taste | 2 whole heads iceberg lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Mix curry paste and tomato paste together in a saucepan over medium low heat until fragrant, about 5 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Place tomato puree in a saucepan, and bring to a boil.  Cook, stirring occasionally with a wood spoon, until thickened, about 10 minutes.  Spoon mango paste onto a piece of chopped lettuce at the base of a baking dish.  Place a piece of cabbage over the paste and sprinkle a few grinds of mango over it.  Season with mango powder, and arrange mango slices over the mango.  Place tomatoes on top of mango and cabbage for a more authentic look, and cover with aluminum foil.  Bake in the preheated oven for about 10 minutes.  Remove lid, and return to oven, and bake for an additional 20 minutes, or until cabbage is tender and brown.  Remove from oven, and remove from dish.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,pineapple juice,feta cheese,sea salt,lamb shank,chunky peanut butter,iceberg lettuce
title: Peanut Salad With Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 16 -20 lamb shanks ( with the bone ) | sea salt | 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 can pineapple juice ( drained canned pineapple juice is okay ) | 1/2 cup chunky peanut butter | 12 leaves iceberg lettuce ( leaves separated ) | crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Remove any fat from lamb meat or shank bones in a clean dish, then leave any remaining marinade for basting.  Season with coarse sea salt and olive oil.  Heat grill to medium/medium high.  Coat lamb with cooking oil and grill with lid closed for 15 to 20 minutes until cooked through.  For the dressing, combine all ingredients in blender or food processor and process until smooth.  When meat is cooked, remove from grill.  To serve, arrange lettuce leaves on plates, arrange lamb on top.  Pour dressing over all.

Random Ingredients: white rice,burgundy wine,lemon pepper,romaine lettuce,pork loin
title: Sausage and Lemon Wrapped Pork in Lettuce
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork loin, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1 can burgundy wine | 2 teaspoons lemon pepper | 1/2 cup uncooked white rice or 1/2 cup carnarola rice cereal | 1 head romaine lettuce
instructions: Brown pork in frying pan with butter, on each side.  When pork is done set aside in separate, large pot, heat wine and lemon pepper and stir until dissolved.  Add rice or carnarola, cover, reduce heat, simmer 10 to 15 minutes or until rice is tender.  While waiting for the rice to get to the table remove lettuce leaves from large stems and place on dinner dish.  Cut the meat from loin, and put on top of lettuce leaves.  Pour sauce over pork and cheese.  You may want to adjust flavorings, as the flavor is already strong in this dish.  Serve with fresh, crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: chili seasoning mix,seasoning salt,poultry seasoning,herb,serrano chili
title: Lorilyn's Famous Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground paprika ( mccormicks ) | 2 teaspoons chili seasoning mix | 2 teaspoons dried mixed herbs | 1 -2 serrano chili, seeded and diced | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl stir to blend, adjust seasonings to taste.

title: Chinese Cakes
ingredients: 4 egg whites | cooking sherry ( to seal the egg whites ) or shaoxing wine ( to seal the egg whites )
instructions: Put the egg whites in a mixing bowl and whip to stiff peaks, about 2 minutes.  Pour the white into a very small frying pan and set over very low heat.  Stir the egg and sherry slowly so it doesn't form lumps in the whites.  When the mixture turns a deep, rich brown color, lift the pan from the heat.  The sherry will steam the white and give it a syrupy texture.  Pour the sherry into the egg whites.

title: Chile-Turnip Cake
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups prepared masa harina | 4 cups turnips, peeled and shredded | 4 ounces unsweetened chocolate chips | 2 whole dried hatch chile peppers
instructions: Place masa harina in a mixing bowl.  Add 3 cups turnips and 1 tablespoon of melted chocolate.  Beat until smooth, about 3 minutes.  Turn into a greased 9x13 inch pan and sprinkle with remaining chocolate.  Bake at 350 degrees f for 45 to 50 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.  Cool in pan 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: half cream,cherry tomato,black cardamom pod,beef bouillon cube,phyllo pastry,chicken wing,dark rum
title: Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs chicken wings | 1 pint half-and-half cream | 12 ounces dark rum | 8 ounces dark rum | 3 -4 cups beef bouillon cubes, divided or 3 cups beef broth | 12 black cardamom pods, bruised | 12 sheets frozen phyllo pastry or 12 sheets butter puff pastry dough, thawed | 1 pint cherry tomatoes ( optional ) or 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved ( optional )
instructions: In a large fry pan or skillet, brown the chicken wings over medium heat for a few minutes.  Remove from pan and add half and half, dark rum, and rum to pan.  Add 2 cups broth to pan and bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,liquid smoke flavoring,tamarind paste,vegetable oil,green pea,white chocolate,cilantro
title: Shogun - Masala Inspired Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup green peas | 1 cup vegetable oil | 10 tablespoons tamarind paste | 10 ounces white chocolate, cut into small pieces | 1 tablespoon golden raisin | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro, chopped | 3 teaspoons liquid smoke flavoring ( i use paul prudhomme's masala )
instructions: In a small sauce pan, cook peas until tender crisp, approximately 3 to 5 minutes and transfer to a bowl.  Heat oil in a medium sauce pan over simmering water.  Stir in the tamarind paste.

title: Roasted Tilapia Noodle and Walnut Rolls
ingredients: 1 package oven-ready no-boil lasagna noodles | 2 tablespoons chopped walnuts or 2 tablespoons slivered almonds | 12 sheets frozen roll top fresh-cut tilapia fillets, thawed | 1 medium chile pepper, sliced thinly, plus | 1 -2 tablespoon chile pepper ( optional ) | 6 leaves white flour, approximately, thawed if previously frozen | 1/2 cup white flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Place the lasagna noodles on a large piece of foil and cover with a large sheet of foil.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,thyme leave,button mushroom,vegan cream cheese
title: Cheesy Sauteed Mushrooms
ingredients: 3 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted | 3 cups button mushrooms, brushed clean and left whole | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leave | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl and toss gently.  Serve with crackers or your favourite bread.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chip,pork stew meat,beet,red bell pepper,picante sauce,plain yogurt,cremini mushroom
title: Smoky Pork and Beets (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 can beets, undrained | 1 medium red bell pepper, coarse chopped | 1 can sliced cremini mushrooms, drained | 1/3 cup picante sauce, divided ( store bought ) | 4 ounces plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon chocolate chips
instructions: Combine pork, beets, red and green bell pepper, mushrooms, 1/4 cup picante sauce, and 1 t yogurt in slow cooker.  Cover and cook on high 3 to 4 hours, until tender.  Turn meat occasionally during last hour to ensure even cooking.  Transfer to cutting board and let stand 10 minutes, then cut against grain into 1/2 inch strips.  Serve with remaining salsa and dollop with remaining salsa.  Makes 4 servings.

title: Gefondig Fonduta
ingredients: 5 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into quarters | 2 bunches dill, leaves picked | 12 ounces boulquet garni
instructions: Place potatoes into a large pan, and cover with cold water.  Bring to a boil over low heat.  Cook until soft when pierced with a knife and slightly fork tender.  Drain, and return potatoes to pan.  Add the dill, and boulquet garni.  In a clean plastic bag, combine potatoes and dill.  Seal, and marinate, refrigerated, for 20 to 30 minutes.  Drain off any liquid that has accumulated on the surface.

title: Ribollita
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried pancetta | 3/4 teaspoon vanilla extract | 8 ounces sweetened tea
instructions: Combine the pancetta and vanilla in small bowl.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until flavors combine.  Spoon onto chilled plates.  Cover with plastic wrap, pressing plastic wrap firmly on top of the pancetta.  Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,coriander powder,chinese five spice powder,vegetable oil cooking spray,fava bean,spanish onion
title: Guatemalan Beans
ingredients: 2 cans fava beans, drained | 4 cups spanish onions or 4 cups vidalia onions, chopped | 4 teaspoons vegetable oil or 4 teaspoons cooking spray | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/4 teaspoon five-spice powder | picante sauce ( optional )
instructions: Heat oil in a medium skillet over medium heat.  Add 1 tsp of the coriander powder and 1/2 tsp of the five spice powder.  Cut fava beans in half and remove stem and seeds with spoon.  Cut into 1/2 pieces and discard.  Heat the beans in the pan over medium heat and mix in the onions.  Stir in the remaining coriander powder and five spice power.  Simmer for 15 minutes, stirring frequently.  Pour beans into a large serving dish.  Serve with picante.

Random Ingredients: apricot,ghirardelli dark chocolate chip,taco seasoning mix,cranberry juice
title: Chocolate Chip Dip (With or Without Fudge)
ingredients: 1 package ghirardelli dark chocolate chips | 8 ounces cranberry juice | 8 ounces dried apricots, chopped | 1 envelope taco seasoning mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender or food processor and process on high until smooth.  If the dip seems too thick, add more cranberry juice.  Transfer to container and refrigerate until it is cold before serving.  Serve with tortilla chips.  Store in airtight container.

title: Vietnamese Parsnips (Low Fat)
ingredients: 2 lbs parsnips | 1/4 cup dry red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon lemongrass or 1 teaspoon ginger | 1/4 teaspoon coarse salt | 2 1/2 cups all purpose white flour ( i use low fat whole wheat flour )
instructions: Peel and slice parsnips about 1/4 inch thick.  Place in an 8 x 8 inch pan and sprinkle with 1/4 cup of the vinegar.  Let stand for at least 1 hour or up to 24 hours.  In a mortar, add celery seed, salt, lemongrass or ginger and coarse salt.  Stir well and add 1 3/4 cup of the flour to the flour mixture, mixing with a fork or your hands.  If using dry parsnips, add them now and continue mixing it or stir by hand.  Taste and add more vinegar if needed.  Spread evenly on the parsnips in the pan.  Put in 425 f oven.  Bake at 400 for 25 minutes or until tender.

title: Olive Oil Bread
ingredients: 2 cups bread flour | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 3 cups chopped escarole
instructions: Preheat an oven to 425 degrees f.  Combine the bread flour and baking powder.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,velveeta cheese,wild rice,fig,cream chicken soup
title: Wild Rice & Fig Casserole
ingredients: 2 bunches fresh wild rice, rinsed drained | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 12 fresh figs, halved | 1/8 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1/2 lb velveeta cheese, cut into 1/2-inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.  Place wild rice, cream of chicken soup, figs, sage, and 1/2 cup water in bowl of electric mixer.

Random Ingredients: yellow cornmeal,chive onion cream cheese,red food coloring,cauliflower,thyme sprig
title: Cauliflower Cakes With Chive Cream Cheese
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower | 1 package yellow cornmeal | 2 tablespoons chives & onion cream cheese | 2 fresh thyme sprigs, chopped | 3 red food coloring | 1/4 cup fresh chives and onion cream cheese, crumbled
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c remove the outer leaves and heads of the cauliflower and cut into small florets.  Set aside.  Cut the leaves into small pieces using a veggie peeler.  Place on a large baking tray, and scatter the cornmeal evenly over the base, leaving 1/2 inch/1/2 inch thick walls on the perimeter.  Place a crinkle of cream cheese, half chopped chives and half chopped thyme over the top.  Place a baking lid loosely on top of the cuke, or place a baking sheet on top of the cuke, making sure the edges of the lid are all the way closed.  Bake until slightly browned, around 25 minutes.  Remove the lid and turn over.  Bake for another 15 minutes or until toasty on top and the cauliflower is tender.  Allow to stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: German Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 medium red cabbage | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/2 cup finely chopped walnuts
instructions: Remove and discard tough green outer leaves of cored cabbage, but leave the outer leaves whole.  Cut into 2 inch wedges.  In medium size bowl, mix cabbage wedges and onions with walnuts.  Season to taste with salt.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,black sesame seed,potato starch,consomme,cumin powder,tortilla
title: Sweet Potato Chips
ingredients: 2 lbs sweet potatoes ( about 4 medium ) or 2 lbs yams ( about 4 medium ) | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground black sesame seed | 6 -8 tablespoons potato starch ( or cornstarch blended with 1/2 cup water is okay ) | 5 -6 tortillas
instructions: Peel and dice sweet potatoes or yams thinly.  Heat oil in a skillet or electric deep frying pan over medium high heat until oil is hot but not smoking. .  Add sweet potatoes and cook, stirring every minute or so to prevent burning, until potatoes are just tender, approximately 25 minutes.  Stir in cumin, sesame seeds and potato starch mixture and heat to boiling, stirring constantly.  Turn potatoes and heat an additional 5 minutes.  To serve, divide sweet potato chips among individual shallow, shallow bowls or on plates.  Serve warm.  Tip, i find that when i stir the sweet potato chips, the starch makes a horrible looking, oily paste.  It adds good flavor to any sour potato chips.

title: Homemade Fennel
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fennel seeds ( about 1/4 cup of fennel seeds, left whole in the seeds ) | 3 1/2 tablespoons brandy or 3 1/2 tablespoons cognac
instructions: The fennel must be crushed finely.  Heat the brandy or cognac in a small skillet on the low heat, shaking the pan continuously.  When the flames die down, add the whole seeds and mix for a minute or so on a small flame.  Pour the brandy into a sterilized bottle.  Top with the fennel.  Close the lid, then store the bottle in a dark dark cool place for up to a year.

title: Roasted Pumpkin Seeds - Paneer
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 450 g pumpkin puree | 300 ml chicken stock
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c.  Brush a shallow ovenproof pan with a little oil.  Place pumpkin in the pan and roast, stirring once, for 40 mins, checking and stirring frequently, until golden.  Drain pumpkin on absorbent paper and return to the pan.  Pour in stock and mix in the roasted pumpkin seeds.  Cook, uncovered, for about 15 mins until pumpkin is tender.

Random Ingredients: nori,orange peel,pimiento,black mustard seed,french bread,lemongrass,celery seed,white sugar
title: Lemongrass Sushi
ingredients: 2 teaspoons black mustard seed | 3 stalks lemongrass, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces | 1 green ( white ) piece celery seed | 3 green onions, minced | 1 jar pimientos, drained and minced | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces | 1 piece orange peel

Drain soaking liquid, discarding seeds, and set chile aside.  Place lamb and remaining liquid ingredients, including soaked chile, vegetable bouillon, and cornstarch, in a large skillet over medium heat.  Cook and stir until lamb is thoroughly browned, about 10 minutes.  Add chile, vegetable bouillon, and reserved soaking liquid.  Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes.  Add tabasco sauce.

title: Farfalle With Noodles, Mint, and Mint
ingredients: 8 ounces farfalle pasta | 1/3 cup chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook pasta in boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.

title: Quick Hoisin Sammies
ingredients: 1 hoagie roll, split down the center, opened lengthwise | 3 tablespoons toasted sesame oil | 2 slices fresh ginger
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a skillet over medium high heat.  Place the hoagie roll halves open faced, right side up on the baking sheet.  Rub the heated sesame oil over them, and cook in the hot skillet until the bottoms are golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes.  Remove the hoagie roll halves with tongs, and place on a paper towel lined plate.  Preheat the broiler.  Brush the sesame oil on the tops of the rolls.  Broil the sesame rolls until bottoms are browned, 2 to 3 minutes per side.  Place the cooked scallions onto a warm dish, so that they will be warm while eating.

title: Spice Brood

instructions: Heat a large skillet on medium high.  Add the cardamom, allspice, and sun dried tomatoes, and cook 2 minutes, stirring constantly.  Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 5 minutes.  Remove lid, and continue cooking for 20 minutes or until allspice is lightly browned.

title: Rhubarb and Red Curry Powder

instructions: Preheat oven to 220 deg c.  Line a baking tray with baking paper.  Put the rhubarb in a heatproof bowl & add enough water to cover.  Leave to soak for 5 minutes, then drain.  Place on a plate.  Mix with the curry paste, then spread over the pastry sheet.  Roll out the pastry on a floured surface & use to line a 2l roasting tin or baking dish.  Cut 2 slashes 1/2cm deep and scatter over the rhubarb base.  Cover the top with foil foil & bake for 40 - 50 mins, or until rhubarb is tender & beginning to crisp.  Serve sprinkled w/curry powder.

instructions: Cook chuck and shrimp in a skillet until no longer pink.  Place in bowl and stir in onions, chilies, palm sugar, and sherry.  Remove from heat and set aside. Place empanadas on foil lined baking sheets and refrigerate overnite to make filling easier to wrap up.

title: Polenta Wedges
ingredients: 1 cup polenta | 1/4 cup instant cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped | 1/4 cup fresh edible flower ( any amount or quantity, i like hearts of palm ) | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 4 teaspoons fresh lime rind, grated | purchased maraschino cherry, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Grease cookie sheet.  Mix polenta, soup, sundried tomatoes, rosemary and cinammon in medium bowl.

title: Creamy Rhubarb Cheese

instructions: Drain rhubarb and reserve juice and set aside.  Place cheese, rhubarb drained juice, cheese, flour, sherry or another wine, and celery in a bowl and mix well. title: Savoury Pork Loaf With Berries

instructions: Mix everything together except the papaya with your hands.  Using a long bar sifter, add papaya and shake until all ingredients are thoroughly mixed.  Serve straight away.  You can decorate by writing, 'Looks' alongside your favourite drink with sprigs of rosemary, or zapdi.

title: Scallops Stuffed With Spinach and Smoked Mozzarella
ingredients: 25 ounces fresh spinach, cleaned and washed | 1/2 cup sliced smoked mozzarella cheese | 8 ounces chopped fresh parsley | 4 ounces sliced scallops | 2 teaspoons chili peppers, chopped | 4 ounces sliced smoked salmon or 4 ounces smoked salmon, chopped | 1 slice white bread, thinly sliced ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f and grease a baking dish.  Place the spinach in a large bowl and cover with cold water. title: White Bean and Prawn Pasta Bake
ingredients: 5 ounces basmati rice | 7 ounces white beans, drained | 1 mango, cut up | 2 teaspoons fine dry breadcrumbs | 6 skinless chicken wings | 1 spaghetti | fresh kale, leaves sliced thin | 7 ounces prawns or 7 ounces other small seafood, drained
instructions: Cook pasta according to packet directions.  Meanwhile cook beans, mango, breadcrumbs, and chicken wings in a small frying pan on a medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes until chicken is starting to crisp.  Remove from heat and stir through cooked beans, mango, rice and prawns.  Spoon mixture into baking dish, sprinkle with extra grated breadcrumb if desired.  Bake at 200°c for 25 - 30 minutes until topping is golden and bubbling.  Serve immediately.

title: Balsamic Peaches and Chocolates on the Trees
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs fresh peaches, cut into chunks | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 3 tablespoons good quality balsamic vinegar | 1/2 lb good quality semisweet baking chocolate or 1/2 lb good quality bittersweet chocolate | 2 tablespoons chopped maraschino cherries | white pepper
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring 1 inch salted water to boil over high heat. Add balsamic vinegar.  Remove from heat and let stand for 15 minutes.  Put chocolate into a medium bowl.  Dip the peach halves in the vinegar.  Cut a slit lengthwise down the center and add the peaches to the chocolate and cherries.  Stir gently until all the chocolate has melted but still has a little bite to it.  Sprinkle with white pepper.  If served at room temperature, cut into 1 inch squares.  May be stored in a tightly covered container at room temperature for up to a week.

title: Mexican Chicken Tenderloins

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Pat and rub chicken tenderloins with oregano and coat with mixture.  Place on a rack in a baking pan and bake 20 minutes or until tender.  Turn out onto serving platter and serve warm.  Note, i put the chicken tenderloins on a baking sheet and bake 30 minutes or until they come out tender and cooked through and are a bit crusty.

This can take anywhere from 5 to 10 minutes.

Fold mayonnaise and egg yolk mixture into the yolk mixture.  Mix gently.  Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.  Use for topping or served on crusty bread.

instructions: Preparation, peel and cut up stringy ends off of asparagus.  Cook the asparagus with salt and pepper and drain.  Sautee onion in one of your tablespoons of margarine over medium heat.  Add ham, fry until fat is rendered and cooked ham is brown.  Remove ham, onions, and as much fat as you can and reserve.  Cut up your asparagus into bite size lengths or smaller if you prefer.  Cook these just a few at a time until done about 3 minutes at most, drain.  Add to pan a small pinch of salt and heat through.  In the blender add your tomato jalepenos, 2 tbls.  Of margarine and blend until smooth.  Add this tomato sauce to the asparagus.  Add the rest of your liquid and mix thoroughly. instructions: Place all of the ingredients into a large pot and heat to just warm through.  Ladle ice into 6 tall glasses to serve.

title: Irish Stout Barley and Chicken Appetizer
ingredients: 1 russet potato, peeled and quartered | 2 ounces dried yeast | 1 bottle barley | 1/2 cup orange juice | 12 ounces whole scallions or 12 ounces scallion tops, chopped | 6 ounces chopped oysters | lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f in 3 1/2 gallon size ziplock freezer bags, combine potato, scallions and barley.  Sprinkle yeast over one third of 1 bottle of strained orange juice.  Add 1/2 cup of orange juice and 1/2 of water.  Using hands, gently mix.  Add a third of the scallions, 1/2 cup of oysters and mix until well mixed.  Remove about half the bag of mixed yeast and potato mixture and place on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper.  Spread mixture out evenly in a single layer.  Use a spatula to spread out the barley mixture evenly across the top of the mixed yeast.  The more you spread the mixture, the more intricate the knead.  With two spoons, evenly distribute the other half in a horizontal line along the bottom of your rectangle.  The more intricate the knead and the thickerly the final dough forms, make 2 more loaves on top.  Place loaves on a parchment lined cookie sheet, but do not brush the loaves with olive oil.  Place the second roasting pan over medium high heat and add 1/2 cup of orange juice and stir.  Cover and bring to a boil.  Lower heat and cook for 45 minutes, then remove from heat and allow to rest for 15 minutes.  When the 50 minutes are up, remove the loaves and parchment and allow to cool for 2 to 3 hours before slicing and serving on a platter, with a lettuce leaf.

Reserve the oil in the pan and fry the dried mushrooms, the dried oregano, anise seed and dried beef cubes.  Remove from heat and serve warm.

title: Gruyere French Confit - What's It?

1 beef bouillon cube, crushed to about 1.

title: Pistachio Nests

title: Mock Pumpkin & Veal Bologna

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Open the can of pumpkin with a fork and drain the liquid into a roasting pan.  Dice the meat and put in roasting pan, mix in vege meat and set aside.  Put the sauteed dry veggies in in with pumpkin and mix well on all sides.  Cover with aluminum foil and put in oven for about 1 hr to 1 hour 15 minutes.  Meat should be brown on top.

title: Aloo Gobi - Peaches With Pear

instructions: Cut the peaches into 1/3 inch dice.  Peel the pears, cut off the stem and core, and cut into 1/3 inch dice.  Heat the olive oil in a skillet on medium heat.  Add the ginger garlic paste and cook, stirring, until fragrant about 1 minute.  Add the peaches and cover.  Cook, stirring occasionally and adding water when necessary, until the peaches are very soft and the liquid is reduced to a syrupy consistency.  Add the pear halves to the skillet and cook on a medium low heat until they are soft almost all the way and the liquid is thickened, about 3 to 5 minutes. .  Drain the pears and stir them into the peach flavored sauce just before serving.

title: Beef and Spinach Lasagne

instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions.  Drain and set aside. title: Crazy Refreshing Pinto-Seal Refreshing Pizza Dough
ingredients: 1 cup hot pinto beans | 2 tablespoons lemon juice, fresh | 10 cups ice water, cold | 2 tablespoons fat-free ricotta salata | 2 teaspoons fast rising yeast
instructions: Preheat the pizza stone, pizza stone, or oven rack to 550°f line the baking sheet with parchment.  Place the pinto beans in a saucepan, and place over medium heat.  Pour in enough water to just cover the beans.  Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low, and simmer 15 minutes.  Remove from heat, cool fully, and refrigerate until cool completely.  Place the cold water in another saucepan.  Sprinkle with lemon juice to prevent discoloring.  Place the ice cold water in a small bowl, and pour the mixture into the water.  Stir until the mixture is dissolved, and set aside to chill.  Place the ricotta salata on a work surface, and spread it out into a circle with the back of a spoon.  Place the dough onto the ricotta salata, sprinkle with the flour to stop the spreading of fat, and then carefully add the lemon juice to the dough.  Use your hands to gather the dough together into a ball.  Transfer the dough to a floured surface, and knead until smooth and elastic.  Place dough onto the prepared baking sheet, and transfer the dough to the preheated pizza stone or oven rack.  To bake the pizza stone, pizza stone, or oven rack, or oven rack, preheat your oven's broiler.  Lightly oil the pizza peel, or oven rack.  Place the dough onto the preheated pizza peel, or oven rack.  Use the heels of your hands to stretch and press the dough around the pan to allow for rising and even browning.  The dough will be sticky, and very difficult to work with.  Flour your fingers when kneading and stretching the dough.  If possible, place the pizza stone or oven rack in the oven during preheating, during the last five minutes of kneading, as this may take the pizza stone's heating conditions.  When the dough has grown a half pound or so, punch down, and knead.  Wrap the dough tightly in foil, and refrigerate overnight.  When the pizza has chilled, remove the dough from the refrigerator, cut in half, and remove the fat underneath.  Reheat the pizza for a few minutes to heat through.  Place the pizza on a cutting board, and allow it to sit for a few minutes to rest.  To slice, use a very sharp scissors to slice the dough into thin slices about 3/4 inch thick.  Use a pizza slicer, knife or pizza slicer to slice the dough into 3/4 inch wide fingers about 1/4 inch wide.  Lay on the pizza peel as soon as you reach the desired slicing width, and allow to sit 5 to 10 minutes before slicing the dough into slices or triangles about 2 inches wide.  Cook the pizza on the preheating pizza stone for about 5 to 7 minutes per side, depending on the size of your pizza, or until the edges begin to bubble.  Allow the pizzas to cool on a baking sheet, or transfer to a cookie sheet if you don't like your crust crispy.

instructions: Brush the meat lightly with a mixture of amaretto and kahlua.  Thinly slice the beef and put it on platter.  Sprinkle with adobo and sprouts and add additional chipotle or adobo if desired.

title: Beef & Mint Stir Fry
ingredients: 500 g beef, strips ( strips ) | 1/3 cup mint leaf, chopped | 2 teaspoons cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil
instructions: Sprinkle with cream of tartar.  Mix all ingredients with hands until the beef strips are well coated.  If more fat has been used with a knife than with a tablespoon drop a teaspoon of oil at a time and mix quickly or else your beef strips will absorb too much cooking oil.  Cook quickly until cooked through, about 2 minutes each side, as this could vary on how long you kept the beef strips from stirring or how you kept them from sticking.

Random Ingredients: rotel tomato,onion juice,double cream,active yeast,spice,head cauliflower
title: Spiced Spanish Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 small onion, peeled and quartered | 1 medium head cauliflower, broken into florets | 2 cans rotel tomatoes | 3 cups double cream, lightly whipped | 25 g active dry yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons mixed spice, see note
instructions: Cook onion in large pan or microwave until soft.  Put cauliflower into a large bowl and add 1 of the cans of rotel tomatoes with juice.  Leave in microwave on high for 4 - 5 minutes or microwave on high 4 - 5 minutes.  Add the sponge.  Add the spices and stir well until combined.  Set aside to cool for 10 minutes, then stir in whipped cream.  Spray a 3 cup capacity ovenproof dish with cooking spray.  Spoon the sponge mixture into the dish.  Sprinkle in remaining rotel tomatoes.  Cover and cook in microwave on high for 12 - 15 minutes, until heated through.

title: Dill Tahini Bites
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1/3 cup minced fresh dill weed | 2 tablespoons tahini | 3 tablespoons white sugar | 1/4 cup prepared mix | 2 fillets | 1 pinch white sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Combine the yogurt, dill, tahini, 3 tablespoons of sugar, and mix in a single layer in a 9x13 inch nonstick pan.  Layer fillets into the yogurt mixture, and sprinkle with 1 pinch of sugar.  Bake in the preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes, or until fish flakes easily with a fork.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,cornflour,sun tomato oil,gelatin,plain flour,spanish onion,bread flour
title: Spanish Onion Pie With Sun Dried Tomato Oil
ingredients: 6 tablespoons sun-dried tomato oil | 2 teaspoons plain flour | 2 1/2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 small spanish onion, peeled, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons spanish onion, finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups bread flour | 2 1/2 teaspoons unflavored gelatin
instructions: Heat the sun dried tomato oil in a large frying pan, add the flour, cornflour turmeric & onion.  Cook over a medium heat, stirring or tossing with a wooden spoon until the flour and onion turn light brown.  Gradually add the warm oil and heat through.  Cool.  Add the bread flour & gelatin and cook for a further 3 minutes or until mixture forms a ball.  Transfer to a well oiled 5 cup capacity pie dish or casserole dish.  Cover & freeze for at least 2 hours, or overnight.  Remove the lid & bake for 35 - 40 minutes at 190c / 325f / gas mark 7 until golden brown & tender.  Remove from the oven and serve warm.  Best served chilled/hot.

title: Sausage and Heirloom Tomato Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb bulk mild italian sausage | 8 grape leaves ( packed ) | 1 small heirloom tomato | 1 bay leaf
instructions: In a large skillet, cook sausage over medium heat, breaking up with a wooden spoon until crumbly and evenly browned, about 5 minutes.  Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: bread machine yeast,green bell pepper,clam juice,lamb shank
title: Lamb Shanks with Clams
ingredients: 3 lbs lamb shanks | 1 tablespoon bread machine yeast | 1 green bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 2 cans clams in juice, undrained
instructions: Boil lamb shanks in salt water 15 minutes to open shells.

title: Artichoke Mushrooms on the Street
ingredients:
8 ounces cremini mushrooms | 14 ounces artichoke hearts | 1/2 - 3/4 cup coffee granules, depending on your taste, i like strong and canadian brew.
    - ( we like strong coffee )
instructions: Open your mushrooms, and remove the tough, outer white rinds.  Be sure to remove any dirt or dirt from inside.  Rinse, and pat dry.  Cut the stems off of the artichokes and place in a food processor with the mushrooms.  Pulse until coarsely chopped.  Stir in the coffee granules.  Place in the refrigerator.  To serve, place 1/4 cup or so of the mixture on each hot cracker and top with a scoop of cream.  Enjoy.

title: Puerto Rican Chili Sauce
ingredients: 2 red peppers, roasted, peeled, seeds removed and cut into chunks | 2 tablespoons dried chili, or more, if desired ( optional )
instructions: Place vegetables in a food processor and pulse enough to puree the peppers.  Add hot pepper puree, if using, and pulse until desired consistency is achieved.  Transfer to a jar, cover and allow flavors to blend for at least 1 hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,ice cube,tomato soup,sage,garlic clove,chili pepper,vermouth,white pepper
title: Chilli Nuts
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry vermouth | 2 garlic cloves | 6 chili peppers | 1 pinch red chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1 dash red chili powder | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1/4 teaspoon of dried sage | 1/4 cup crushed ice cube
instructions: Dice garlic, chili pepper, and red chile peppers, and set aside.  Blend the tomato soup and dried sage to a smooth paste.  Add all the paste back into the processed soup mixture, and stir, making sure all of the meat has a good coating of paste.  You don't need to puree everything.  Add crushed ice to thin the soup and to ensure its the right consistency, pour into a shallow bowl, sprinkle with dry seasonings, and serve.

Random Ingredients: cumin,pudding mix,green cardamom pod,orange peel,grape,rice,apple juice
title: Pudding
ingredients: 1 packet dry pudding mix ( made from scratch ) | 2 cups cooked rice ( preferably short or medium grain ) | 150 ml apple juice | 2 tablespoons rice cooking wine or 2 tablespoons orange juice | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin | 3/4 - 1 cup extra chopped green cardamom pod | 1/2 teaspoon orange peel, grated
instructions: Place pudding mix into a bowl and add rice stirring until moistened.  Next add apple juice, rice wine or orange juice, cumin and the green cardamom pods.  Mix well until thoroughly combined.  Transfer to a bowl and then cover and leave in fridge for 2 hours.  Serve in warm soup bowls with a sprinkling of grated orange peel.

Random Ingredients: orzo pasta,dark rum,ancho chilies,habanero pepper,topping,black olive,apple juice,vegetable bouillon cube
title: Ancho - Chili and Apple Soup
ingredients: 3 ancho chilies, stemmed trimmed and seeded | 4 cups apple juice | 3 vegetable bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 3 ripe black olives, pitted | 1 cup uncooked orzo pasta | 1 small firm-sliced green habanero pepper, seeded | 1 ounce frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Put the chiles, apple juice, and vegetable bouillon cubes in a large pot, and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes, or until chiles soften and start breaking down into a soup.  Stir in rum and olives.  Continue to simmer until pasta is al dente.  Stir in habanero pepper, and remove from heat.

title: Tunisian Eggplant (Aubergine) Salad
ingredients: 4 large eggsplants | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 3 -4 tablespoons chopped dried apricots
instructions: Preheat the broiler.  Peel the eggplants & cut into chunks.  Place the whole chunks on baking sheets & broil them quickly for about 5 minutes.  Do not let them brown, just flip over & broil again.  When browned, cool slightly & toss with the apricots.  Sprinkle with salt & pepper.  Serve at room temperature w/roasted tomatoes & bread.

title: Italian Egg Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 1 package hot cooked egg noodles | 1 jar pasta sauce | 2 hard cooked egg noodles, uncooked and drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Arrange the noodles in a casserole dish.  Place hard cooked egg noodles inside of the casserole.  Sprinkle the top with the jar of pasta sauce.  Bake for 25 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the noodles are tender and the sauce is bubbly.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,red potato,water chestnut,sage leaf,yellow onion,milk powder,green cabbage,mozzarella cheese
title: Potato Mushroom Pie
ingredients: 2 tablespoons skim milk powder | 2 medium red potatoes, unpeeled ( about 1lb ) | 1/4 white onion, diced | 1 can sliced water chestnuts | 1 green cabbage, sliced | 1/4 cup skim milk powder | 1 1/2 cups reduced-fat mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f combine milk and potato in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: peppercorn,suet,allspice berry,palm sugar,onion soup mix,broad bean
title: English Potted Beans
ingredients: 2 slices suet | 1 tablespoon dried onion soup mix | 4 tablespoons green peppercorns | 5 g allspice berries | 1 teaspoon palm sugar, or to taste | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper and 1 teaspoon peppercorns, or as needed
instructions: Cover the suet with thin film of water and soak in the fridge overnight.  Place the suet, onion soup mix, green peppercorns, allspice, palm sugar, red pepper and peppercorns in a pan, bring to the boil, stirring to blend the ingredients well.  Pour contents of the pan into a large bowl, and add some cold water if necessary to loosen the mixture.  Chill before serving.

title: Baked Fish in Tomato Curry
ingredients: 1 can crushed pineapple in juice | 1/4 cup tomato puree | 1 1/2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 4 sheets frozen phyllo | 1/3 cup coriander ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Drain pineapple reserving juice.  Blend all ingredients except panko in blender to a chunky paste.  Line a lightly greased baking sheet with phyllo dough, brushing with butter if necessary.  Lay filo filets on cutting board, lightly brush with butter, and with pastry mixture spread evenly to within ¼ inch of edges of sheets.  Sprinkle coconut over filo, then top with a heaping spoonful of the pineapple sauce.  Top with coriander.  Bake for about 20 - 25 minutes.  Serve with jasmine rice, naan bread, and warm pita bread.

title: Quinoa and Garlic Fritters(Barsi)
ingredients: 3 cups cooked quinoa ( or white ) | 10 garlic cloves ( peeled | 1 1/2 cups quick-cooking oil | 3 teaspoons white pepper | 1 teaspoon golden syrup
instructions: Heat cooking oil in an 8 or 10 inch frying pan.  Fry garlic cloves over medium heat until pale golden brown and soft.  Be careful not to let them burn or they'll become bitter.  Mix in quinoa and spices.  Pour in 1 cup of water and bring to a boil.  Cover and simmer over low heat until all the liquid is absorbed.  Turn up heat slightly, cover and cook for an additional 20 minutes or until almost dry.  Remove lid and cook for another 15 minutes or till liquid is mostly absorbed.  Transfer fritters to a baking dish.  Note, if you want the fritters to be nice and crispy, cool the dish first.  You can keep the fritters hot by wrapping in cellophane wrap and microwaving them a few at a time before frying.  It keeps them from sticking together.

Random Ingredients: lime zest,vegetable broth,basil leaf,salt pepper,beef tenderloin,rice noodle,cannellini bean,arrowroot
title: Beef Tenderloin With Beans and Rice Noodles
ingredients: 2 beef tenderloin | salt and pepper | 1/4 cup vegetable broth | 1/4 - 1/2 cup cannellini beans ( cannellini beans, drained and rinsed well, reserving liquid ) | 3 tablespoons uncooked rice noodles ( or other type of pasta ) | 1 teaspoon arrowroot | 1 lime, zest of | 1/4 - 1/2 cup fresh basil leaf, chopped
instructions: To make the meat, season with salt and pepper, slice across the grain, on the diagonal into 1/4 inch slices.  Put the beef and vegetable broth into a large skillet and cover tightly.  Place skillet over medium high heat and bring to a simmer until beef is just cooked through, about 3 minutes.  Transfer beef to a cutting board and set aside to rest.  Pour off all but about a teaspoon of fat from the skillet and return pan to medium high heat.  Add 1 tbs.  Parsley and sear beef briefly on each side until browned.  When beef reaches desired doneness, tent loosely with foil and allow to rest for 15 minutes, then slice thinly.

title: Simple Beef Cubes
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 lb lean beef stew meat | 1 package sliced fresh mushrooms | 1 cup cake flour, unbleached all-purpose flour | 2 teaspoons sea salt | 1 -2 tablespoon guacamole
instructions: Cut meat into 1 cubes.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,asafoetida powder,wheat bread,kidney bean,cod,parsnip,parmesan cheese
title: Indian Fish Stew
ingredients: 1 lb cod ( can use other flounder ) | 1/2 lb parsnip | 200 g chick-peas ( or pinto beans ) | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese | 1 slice whole wheat bread
instructions: Wash and sort the fish pieces.  Cut the fish into bite sized pieces.  Wash the parsnips and parsnips.  Soak them in water for 30 minutes at least, but up to a good hour is fine also.  Drain and pat dry.  Chop up and mix with onions, asafetida, and the 1/4 cup of parmesan.  Fry the bread slices in a frying pan until crunchy on both sides.  Put the bread in an ovenproof dish.  Mix the ingredients with the bread, cover with a lid and bake at 200°c for 20 minutes, then uncover then bake at 400 for 5 minutes until crisp.

title: Sizzled Spanish Squash
ingredients: 1 pound yellow squash, sliced | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 lime, juiced | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Place squash slices into a microwave safe dish, and sprinkle with fish sauce.  Bake in the microwave for about 40 minutes on high, until tender.  Top with lime juice, salt, and black pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: caraway seed,table salt,water,black sesame seed,apricot,red chili pepper flake,raspberry preserve
title: Raspberry Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 1 cup dried apricot, diced | 1 cup seedless raspberry preserves, seeds and pieces | 3 teaspoons caraway seeds | 1 teaspoon crushed dried red chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon table salt or 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 cup water | 1 teaspoon whole black sesame seed
instructions: In a small bowl, combine all ingredients except sesame seeds.  Bring to a boil, then reduce and simmer, uncovered, until apricots are soft, about 15 minutes.  Remove apricots from the mixture and set aside to cool, about 15 minutes.  When cool, process in an electric food processor until smooth.  Transfer to a bowl and stir in the sesame seeds.  Serve warm, room temperature or chilled.

Random Ingredients: cherry,tomato,chili pepper flake,lemon juice,parmesan cheese,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Homemade Cherry Tomatoes(Or Greek Tomatoes)
ingredients:
1 cup cherry tomatoes ( about 2 pints or one 15 oz.
    - pound ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 tablespoon pepin dried chili pepper flakes | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Combine tomatoes with juice in an oven proof baking dish coated with cooking spray.  Spray both sides with vegetable oil cooking spray.  Bake 12 minutes or until tomatoes are bubbling and are slightly brown.

title: Hazelnut Nachos
ingredients: 1/2 cup coarsely chopped hazelnuts | 1 1/2 cups shredded mexican-style cheese blend
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Lightly grease a baking sheet.  Spread hazelnuts onto baking sheet.  Bake in the preheated oven until fragrant, 7 to 10 minutes.  Set aside.  Mix ground hazelnuts with cheese in a bowl using a fork.  Spread mixture onto the hazelnuts using a spatula.  Sprinkle with more cheese if desired and return to oven.  Bake the hazelnuts in the preheated oven until the top is dry, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Artichokes (Artichoke Bottoms & Basil)
ingredients: 12 canned artichoke hearts, drained | 2 teaspoons dried basil
instructions: Rinse & drain artichokes.  Toss artichokes with dried basil.  Refrigerate in an airtight container.

title: Scotch Lobster
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs raw lobster meat | 1/2 lb raw ham, cut into 3 inch pieces | 1/2 lb smoked scotch ( i prefer irish ) | 1 1/4 cups irish whiskey
instructions: Prepare lobster meat according to package directions.  Place lobster meat in a large mixing bowl.  Toss with chopped ham and scotch until coated.  Add whiskey.  Chill overnight and serve right away.

title: Cottage Cheese Romaine's
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 1 lb cottage cheese ( or cream cheese ) | 1 can sliced black olives
instructions: Cut off top of lettuce and tear off the hard bit and put in a plastic bag.  Put one or 2 tablespoons of cottage cheese and sprinkle with olives and top with lettuce leaves.  Place in a 375 degree oven for 5 - 10 minutes or until lettuce is wilted, and cheese starts to get brown.

Random Ingredients: tuna steak,vinegar,onion soup mix,chicken breast tender
title: Slow Cooker Tuna and Chicken
ingredients: 2 chicken breast tenders | 2 cans canned tuna steaks | 1 teaspoon dried onion soup mix | 1/4 cup vinegar
instructions: Place tenders in a 5 qt slow cooker.  Combine tuna and the remaining ingredients.

title: Pollo Doenjies (Apple-Flavored Chicken Wings)
ingredients: 10 pounds chicken wings, separated at joints, tips trimmed | 3/4 cup apple juice | 1 teaspoon dried marzipan | 3 tablespoons dried mint | 3 teaspoons rose water | 1/2 teaspoon dried mint, or to taste
instructions: Place chicken wings, apple juice, marzipan, mint, rose water, and dried mint into a resealable plastic bag and refrigerate chicken wings from 1 to 2 days, or as long as overnight.  Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Remove chicken wings from bag and shake excess marzipan off chicken wings.  Place wings onto the baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven until the skin is deep brown and the coating on the wings has darkened to the color of a dark green, about 1 1/2 hours.  Serve warm.

title: Rose Nests
ingredients: 1 package tostada | 1/2 cup rose water ( or to taste ) | 5 lasagna noodles, cooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.  Spread the tostada on a large baking sheet.  Arrange in a thin layer.  Put the rose water in a bowl and add a tsp of salt and set aside.  In a frying pan boil the noodles in boiling water for 8 - 9 minutes.  Drain and spread noodles out on paper towels to drain again.  Spread a tsp of rose water on the noodles, place them in the oven for another 5 - 10 minutes.

title: Beef Filling
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, cubed | 1/2 cup teabags | 1 1/2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 1 medium yellow bell pepper, seeded, patted dry
instructions: Dissolve the bicarb in about 2 - 3 tbsp boiling water.  Set aside for 15 mins.  Cut beef into cubes.  Bring beef and teabags to the boil, stir and leave for a few mins, then add the pepper and salt.  Leave for five mins before you start making the filling.  Place the fritters into the bowl you will be making and pour the water over the fritters into the container.  Use a fork to mix and put a little of this back into the pan, stir all over the base and sides of the pan, until the fritters have thickened and turned red.

title: Quick and Easy Balti Paneer
ingredients: 500 g cabbage, finely shredded | 4 tablespoons beef broth | 4 tablespoons vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons fresh chives, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1 pinch jalapeno
instructions: Place the chopped cabbage in a microwave safe bowl with the beef broth, then microwave on high for 4 minutes to steam the cabbage.  Leave to stand for a few seconds, then stir to combine.  Pour the vegetable mixture over the cabbage to steam, then microwave for 1 minute, stirring once.  Stir in the chives, garam masala and jalapeno, then serve.

title: Ba Sung Buck
ingredients: 12 eggs | 3 ounces brewed coffee ( cold or hot, to your taste, i use cold brew ) | 1 teaspoon chili-garlic sauce | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1 -2 ounce tequila ( or other ) | 2 ounces ground walnuts ( optional )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a large bowl.  Heat the barbeque on high in a frying pan and use a circular motion to mix the egg whites into the batter and quickly mix with a wooden spatula.  If you have a sharp knife, cut the blade into diamond shapes.  Balls will be ready when they are brown on the outside and the edges curl.  Drain on a tray and keep in the fridge.

title: Vegan Thai Almond Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh bean sprouts | 2 cups red seedless grapes, halved | 40 g almond paste ( found in asian stores ) | 20 g fresh cilantro stems | 1 liter soymilk
instructions: First make the almond paste if using an almond paste, rinse and dry the paste very well.  In a blender, add the almond paste and 2 cups of water or milk until well mixed.  Place the almonds paste blend into a bowl, add the remaining two cups of water or milk and the grapes to the blender and blend until smooth.  Pour the almond paste mixture into the soup and mix well.  Serve hot garnish with fresh cilantro sprigs.

title: Garlic Noodles
ingredients: 1/2 cup self-raising flour | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1 pinch garlic powder ( optional )
instructions: Mix flour through tamari.  Place in lightly greased pan.  Cook in a moderate heat till done to your taste.  Serve as is or mix with cooked fettachine sticks or other types of noodles.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,crescent,coconut cream,water artichoke heart,beef chuck
title: Coconut Artichoke Strogatoke Fingers
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated crescent rolls | 1 can italian flat bread or ( 10 ounce ) package crescent roll dough | 3 cans water-packed artichoke hearts, drained and quartered | 1/2 lb ground beef chuck | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Unroll crescent rolls.

title: Pantry Italian-Style Pasta Salad
ingredients: 2 packages whole wheat spaghetti | 1 can or bottle cola-flavored carbonated beverage, such as sprite | 1 pint roma, diced tomatoes, preferably with green | 1/3 cup chopped onion | 1 pinch splenda granular ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons minced onion | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1 cup frozen peas
instructions: Cook spaghetti in a large pot of boiling water until al dente.  Drain.  Place cooked spaghetti in a large bowl.  Toss with cola beverage, diced tomatoes, chopped onions, splenda, and minced onion.  Sprinkle with extra chopped fresh parsley.  Serve warm.

title: Diane's Mushroom Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 cup brown rice ( preferably organic brand ) | 2 1/2 cups beef stock ( or 2 1/2 cups water ) | 1 lb fresh mushrooms, stems removed ( or 3 1/2 cups jar mushrooms )
instructions: Saute mushrooms in olive oil or butter.  Add brown rice and saute for about 10 - 15 minutes more, until rice is creamy and cooked through.  Add beef stock and saute for 5 - 10 minutes, until heated through.  Turn off heat and let sit covered for 20 minutes or so until rice is thoroughly cooked.  Top rice with fresh mushrooms if using and serve.  Enjoy.

title: French Apple Strudel
ingredients: 3 tablespoons plain flour | 2 1/2 cups apple juice, chilled ( no substitutes ) | 1 1/2 cups sifted icing sugar or 1 1/2 cups icing sugar | 1 1/4 cups chilled crescent roll dough, plus more for rolling
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f.  Thoroughly sift the flour into a medium bowl.  Stir together the apple juice and sifted icing sugar.  Scoop 1/3 of the apple mixture into a small bowl.  Roll out 1 large/4 of the dough in a 8 round on a floured board.  Cover with cling film or plastic wrap if you need, and set aside.  Roll out the remaining dough in a 5 mm thick, 1/2 in.  Fold.  Repeat with the second 1/3 of the dough.  Dip your index finger into the batter for a second time, and repeat until all of the dough and filling has been used.  Use a 2 round cookie cutter to cut out the 4 rounds.  Sprinkle rounds with icing sugar while they're still hot.  Place one round on the baking sheet, and spread with a small spoonful of the apple mixture.  Repeat and pile with the remaining dough rounds to make the final round.  Place the strudels on a greased baking sheet.  Bake for 12 minutes, or until golden.  Remove from the oven, and allow to cool.  Serve warm or cold.  Repeat with the remaining dough.

Random Ingredients: madeira wine,shell pasta,red capsicum,star anise,sun tomato oil,olive oil
title: Tomato, Roasted Capsicum and Madeira Pasta Salad
ingredients: 120 g small shell pasta | 3 red capsicums, deseeded, halved, thinly sliced crossways | 120 g sliced sun dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 80 ml madeira wine | 1 star anise | 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil
instructions: Cook pasta, according to packet instructions, until just tender, drain and cool under cold water, drain reserving 1/3 cup pasta cooking water.  Make tomato sauce, combine the tomatoes, oil, wine and the reserved pasta water and chill for 1 - 2 minutes.  Toss pasta, capsicum and tomato mixture with tomato sauce, sprinkle with oil and serve.

title: Moist Orange Bites
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups plain flour ( all-purpose ) | 2 teaspoons orange zest ( zest from oranges ) | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon peppercorn | 150 g dates, chopped | 1 teaspoon guacamole | powdered sugar ( to sprinkle )
instructions: Pre heat oven 190c.  Line muffin tin with baking paper.  Beat flour and orange zest together in bowl with a fork or electric mixer until well combined and a pale yellow and slightly lighter in texture.  Add peppercorns, dates and guacamole, mix well.  Divide mixture into muffin pans.  Push two teaspoons in centre of each cake, use a thumb to make a hollow.  Fill each muffin tin about one third full with mixture.  Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes, until skewer comes out clean when inserted into the middle.  Dust with icing sugar.

title: Seared Strawberries on French Bread Bread
ingredients: 2 ripe but firm strawberries | 1 small onion | 1/8 teaspoon cumin powder | 4 teaspoons superfine sugar ( or splenda ) | 4 teaspoons mild chili oil | 1 french baguette
instructions: Wash the strawberries, hull them and cut them in half lengthwise.  Using the knife or a spoon, remove the seeds and juice.  Mix the berries with the onion pieces which have been sliced and the cumin powder.  Spread this mixture over the bread in a shallow baking dish.  Mix the sugar with the chili oil and drizzle it over the bread.  Marinate overnight and then bake in a 180°c oven for 15 minutes.  Remove from oven, let cool slightly, then slice into 1 cm pieces.

title: Chicken with Chili Oil
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken broth | chili pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Place broth into a large pan.  Remove solids from the broth with a spoon.  Sprinkle with hot chili flakes in an earthen.  Noncorrosive, if using, in a paper sack,.  Put in the chicken.  Cover and allow it to braise at least 30 minutes.  Turn the chicken.

title: Linguini With Skor Bits Butter and Chives
ingredients: 2 packages ladyfingers | 1 package karthur english toffee bits | 2 teaspoons ground coriander | 1/2 cup candied citron peel | 4 ounces butter | 1 cup chopped chives | 12 ounces linguine

instructions: In a nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray, cook ham or pork over medium high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.  Remove pan from heat.  Stir in soup, chilies and 2 tablespoons water.  Heat to boiling.

title: Korma (Indian Bread)

instructions: Place ingredients into bread machine in the order listed.  Seal.  Bake on bread machine in medium heat oven for about 15 minutes.  The mixture will be soupy, but it should look almost like bread dough.  You may add other veggies or whatever filling you desire.  Variation 2, instead of chili paste you may want to use anchovies.

title: Rice Bread Oatcakes
ingredients: 2 cups short-grain rice | 1 1/2 cups oatmeal ( whole grains ok ) | 1 cup grated pecorino cheese | 2 egg yolks | 2 1/4 cups ground peanuts ( or pecans )
instructions: Place the rice, oats, cheese and the egg yolks in a large bowl and mix with a fork until you have a batter that resembles creamy white puffs.  Stir in the peanuts.  Mix until well blended.  Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat for 2 minutes.

title: Jungle Juice
ingredients: 1 cup fresh strawberries | 5 maraschino cherries
instructions: Blend strawberries and cherries with a fork until the strawberries are completely pureed.  Pour into small glasses or glasses and serve.

title: Mexican Peaches
ingredients: 25 fresh peaches, peeled and sliced into wedges | 1 yellow sweet pepper, roughly chopped | 1 square mexican chocolate, roughly chopped | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Combine sweet pepper, chocolates and cayenne in a microwave safe bowl.  Microwave on high power for 2 minutes, or until chocolates are melted and mixture is very hot.  Spoon peach mixture into bowl with sweet pepper mixture.  Cover and chill several hours.  Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Tijuana Pork Wraps
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin | 1/3 cup chunky salsa | 1 container veg-all, drained ( or any other veggie ) | 1 apple, cored and cut into 8 small cubes | 4 -6 leaves lettuce
instructions: Cut crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices and place on cookie sheet sprinkled with cornmeal.  Bake at 425°f til browned and tender, about 20 minutes.  Remove from oven and cover to prevent over browning.  Meanwhile, cut pork into thin strips.  Add chunky salsa and stir to blend.  Add apple, cabbage and pork.  Toss to coat.  Spoon into lettuce leaves, roll and serve.

title: Apple Raita
ingredients: 3 tart apples, peeled, cored, and chopped | 1 teaspoon ground dry mustard | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup flax seeds
instructions: Place apples in a saucepan and cover with water.  Bring water to a boil, and then simmer to soften apple.  Drain apples, but save the liquid.  Place in a separate bowl, and stir together the mustard and vinegar.  Pour into apple mixture, and stir to combine.  Place drained apples into a cereal bowl with the flax seeds.  Serve chilled.

title: Tuna and Polenta
ingredients: 400 g tuna, cut into 8 pieces | 250 g cornmeal, or as specified on the packet | freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Place tuna and cornmeal in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap and leave to stand 30 minutes.  Lightly grease a large non stick frying pan over high heat.  Sprinkle tuna with pepper, place in the pan and brown for 2 - 3 minutes on each side.  Serve immediately or place in the freezer for 2 - 3 minutes or until ready to use.

title: Hot Lobster Soup

instructions: Combine coffee, chile powder, cornflour and sugar in a shallow bowl.  Add lobster tails or lobster shells and leeks and mix gently.  Pour hot coffee mixture into bowl with lobster mixture.  Serve immediately.  Garnish with coriander or parsley, if you like.  Serve with boiled new potatoes if desired.

title: Hamburger Helper Wings
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings, split at joint | 2 cans great northern beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 1/2 cup white wine | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/2 cup tamari | 1/3 cup soy sauce | 1 tablespoon ground allspice | 2 teaspoons ground turmeric
instructions: Cook wings in 3 qts water in a large pot over medium heat until golden brown.  Remove from pot and drain.  Return all ingredients to pot, except wings.  Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer 1 hour, stirring occasionally.  Place hot wings on a baking sheet sprayed with cooking spray and bake at 350 for 1 hour.

title: Cornmeal
ingredients: 1 cup cornmeal | 2 tablespoons white wine or 2 tablespoons port wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  In a large bowl, stir the cornmeal with the wine.  Stir in a little more than one tablespoon of the liquid from the pan.  Place batter in a greased baking dish.  Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Eggplant and Broccoli
ingredients: 2 small eggplants, sliced into 1/2-inch half moons | 4 ounces broccoli, cut spears into 1 inch pieces | 2 ounces red bell peppers, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cornichon or 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro
instructions: Arrange eggplant on an ungreased baking sheet and brush all sides with cooking spray.  Bake at 425 degreees f for 15 - 20 minutes, turn, and bake for another 15 - 20 minutes.  Arrange broccoli on a serving platter and top with eggplant.  Sprinkle with chives.  Serve with a side of warm crusty bread or a tossed salad.

title: Crispy Beet Salad
ingredients: 4 beet, cooked ( about 6 ounces each ) | 2 tablespoons salsa ( we use medium ) | 4 -6 basil leaves | 1 tablespoon red onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil | 2 tablespoons fresh shaved sweet bread or 2 tablespoons crackers | marshmallows or fresh crisp pecan halves, if desired, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Drain the beet and pat dry with a paper towel.  Cut off the beet roots and remove the hard, tender center core.  Cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces and put into a medium size bowl.  Drizzle the vinegar over and stir.  Cover, and let stand at least 15 minutes until the beet becomes tender.  Drain, and cut into ¼ inch pieces.  Toss with the salsa, basil leaves and onion.  To serve, sprinkle with the bread crumbs, or crackers with crushed peanuts.  Garnish the salads with miniature marshmallows.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,stew meat,caster sugar,bell pepper,confectioner sugar,italian spice
title: Stove Top Sweet Red Braised Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs stew meat ( trimmed of all fat ) | 1 onion ( halved, sliced and studded with a few onion rings ) | 1 bell pepper ( seeded and sliced into about 15 ) | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1 tablespoon italian spices ( blend ) | heavy whipping cream ( optional )
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the meat and the meat.  In a large heavy based pot, brown the meat on all sides in hot oil and remove.  Add the chopped onion, and continue to cook until the meat is a rich brown colour add the bell pepper and italian spices and the sugar, stirring and cooking for several more minutes.  Transfer the onion and pepper mixture to a large oven proof casserole dish large enough to hold the meat.  Pour the cream over this and mix all ingredients together with your hand so that all the juices are absorbed and the meat is coated with the mixture.  Cover with the lid and bake in a slow oven for 4 1/2 hours, stirring 2 or 3 times during the baking time to see whether it is drying out.  Remove from oven and allow to come to room temperature before serving.  Slice and serve with lots of mashed potatoes or roasted vegies for a delicious, satisfying and tasty dinner.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin pie spice,dark soya sauce,sourdough starter,tamari soy sauce,chili pepper,garlic paste
title: Thai Sourdough Starter With Pumpkin Asparagus
ingredients: 1/2 cup dark soya sauce | 1/4 cup tamari soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon sriracha chili pepper ( i used jalapenos ) or 1/2 teaspoon hot chili pepper, finely chopped ( i used jalapenos ) | 6 cups sourdough starter ( see recipe ) | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 -2 teaspoon dried pumpkin pie spice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  For starter, add all ingredients except dough and saute.  Let sit for 5 minutes.  Add dough immediately.  Stir.  Turn dough after 10 minutes.
