If you let it sit for a least 1/2 hour it should rise.

title: Beware Spicy Salsa

instructions: Remove the top leaf from each plum tomato.  Chop into 1 inch chunks and remove the seeds if desired.  Wash and rinse the chilies.  Place in a medium saucepan.  Heat on medium for 2 minutes until hot.  Watch out for the pepper.  When the chilies are heated, drain the juice, leaving 1/2 cup.  Add to the chilies and pour in the reserved tomato juice.  Stir with a wooden spoon until mixed and adjust seasonings if needed.  Taste and check if it's the right balance of the chili.  The salsa may be eaten in warm tortillas, crackers or on its own.

title: Creamy Potatoes and Wine

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Slice potatoes and place into roasting pan.  Pour wine into roasting pan.  Bake for 45 to 60 minutes or until golden brown.  Whip cream and place into a bowl.  Chop potatoes and add to cream.  Add cream to potatoes and stir until potatoes melt.  Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ghee,cumin seed,chinese wine,red onion,strawberry,hamburger,dark brown sugar,caper
title: Chinese Hamburgers
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 8 tablespoons unsalted butter or 8 tablespoons margarine | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon chinese wine ( or dark sherry ) | 3 tablespoons red onions ( finely chopped ) | 1/2 cup fresh sweetened strawberries, halved | 1/4 cup capers
instructions: In a small skillet, toast the cumin seeds for a few minutes until they turn a golden color, turning them over once, and grinding them in a coffee grinder.  Brown the hamburger in a nonstick skillet over medium heat.  Transfer the hamburger to a plate.  Stir together the dark brown sugar, butter, and wine in the skillet. Add the cooked hamburger to the skillet and stir.  Add the strawberries, capers and the cumin seeds to the skillet and stir.  Cook until the sauce coats the back of a spoon, adding more or less if necessary.  Transfer to a warmed plate and top with crusty bread.

instructions: Heat your enchilada sauce in a saucepan over medium heat.  When it's about to boil, stir in the mirin.  Remove from heat, and set aside to cool.  Transfer enchilada sauce to a container, and stir in the green enchilada sauce.  Store in the refrigerator, and serve with white rice.

title: Swiss Cheese
ingredients: 3 ounces swiss cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon fresh dill or 1 tablespoon fresh spearmint, chopped
instructions: In small bowl, stir cheese and herbs together.

title: Jicama and Jicama With Raspberry Glaze
ingredients: 1 lb jicama, peeled, cut into 1/4 inch slices or 2 medium jicama | 2 scallions, white and green parts, thinly sliced | 1/3 cup raspberry jam | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 6 -8 tablespoons red sweet onions, thinly sliced ( optional )
instructions: Place the jicama slices on paper towels to drain some of their excess liquid.  Sprinkle with scallions and let sit 10 minutes to draw out excess moisture.  Meanwhile, spread the jam evenly over the jicama slices.  Combine reserved liquid with rum in small shallow pan and bring to a boil over medium heat.  Boil gently, stirring often, just until slightly thickened.  Drizzle the glaze over the cooked jicama and sprinkle with the red onions.

instructions: Pre heat oven 190 f or gas mark dust your work with flour.  Toss lamb in cornflour. instructions: In a large bowl, combine the yogurt, dressing, roasted red bell pepper and pimentos.  Chill well and serve.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,fast rising active yeast,agave,fennel seed
title: Crusty Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups very warm whole milk or 1 1/4 cups low fat milk | 2 1/4 teaspoons fast-rising active dry yeast | 1/2 cup agave | 1/3 teaspoon fennel seed | 3/4 cup shredded fat free mozzarella cheese
instructions: In a large microwave safe bowl, heat warm milk.  Sprinkle yeast over the warm milk and let stand for 5 minutes, or until bubbly and starting to rise.  Stir.  Add agave and fennel seeds, then stir in the yeast mixture, then the cheese.  Place dough in a medium size greased bowl, cover with a clean, damp paper towel and set aside to rise.  When dough has risen, about 1 hour, punch down.  Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface, and knead by hand 1 to 2 minutes, or until smooth and elastic.  Form into a 1 pound long, 2 1/2 inch wide loaf.  Place on a lightly floured baking sheet.  Cover loosely with a clean, moist towel, and set aside at room temperature to rise until puffy and firm, about 1 hour.  Brush loaf with a little milk during the final rise.  Bake in a preheated 400 degree f oven for 16 to 18 minutes, or until crust is lightly browned.

instructions: In a large ziploc bag, combine half the pesto sauce and lamb chops until well coated.  Place in refrigerator 15 to 30 minutes.  Remove lamb chops from bag.

instructions: Heat grill to high.  Combine beer, vinegar, and mint.  Rub beef with mixture.  Grill 20 minutes per side for medium rare or longer if you like your beef very tender for your taste and remove from grill and slice thinly to serve.  Cut into slices, pour vinaigrette over and serve.

title: Baked Parsnips in Corn Oil and Ziti
ingredients: 1/2 cup corn oil | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric powder | 8 parsnips, peeled and cut into rounds | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 package ziti pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Mix corn oil and turmeric in a skillet over medium high heat.  Bring oil to a boil.  Spread parsnips and ziti into the boiling oil.

title: Baked Ziti With Dill
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta | 12 large egg yolks | 1/2 cup cold water | hot sauce | dill
instructions: In a large pot of boiling, salted water, cook ziti until just tender, about 7 minutes.  Drain.  While ziti is cooking put egg yolks in a blender or a medium bowl.  Beat in 2/3 cup the cold water.

title: Red Apples With Berry-White Salad
ingredients: 6 tart apples | 1 can lima beans ( i prefer yellow bean ) | 2 tablespoons fresh blueberries ( or frozen blueberries ) | 12 radishes - peeled, sliced thin
instructions: Pit the apples, if they are too big and cut into pieces.  Place in a casserole dish and sprinkle with sugar.  Cook under a hot broiler until the apples are soft.  Do not scorch.  Drain off any water that has accumulated on top.  When cool, toss with lima beans and sprinkle with blueberries and radishes.

title: Jook Salad Meat
ingredients: 250 g meat ( any ) | 250 g caster sugar | 2 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: Cut the meat into small pieces so that you can roll each piece into sausages about 3 long.  Soak the meat in boiling water for 5 hours.  After removing the meat from the water, rub off the excess water and pat dry with paper towel.  In the meantime, heat the chilli oil in a pan, put the meat pieces in it and cook for about 5 minutes over medium heat.  Turn the meat and coat with the chilli oil.  Cover the pan and allow the meat to brown on all sides.  Mix the sugar with the water in a saucepan and heat until the sugar has dissolved, make sure it is boiling over.  When the meat is about half done and there is more water in the pan, remove from the pan and serve on a bed of salad.

instructions: In a salad bowl, toss together the eggplant, cherry tomatoes, celery rib, pineapple chunks, chili beans, and cream.  Sprinkle the celery seeds on top, and stir in the sweet pepper just before serving.

title: Kirazhavij

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Cut potatoes into quarters.  Place in a bowl and pour in orange juice.  Stir to mix.  Put potatoes in a large pot of salted water and bring to a boil.  Cook until they rise to the top.

title: Panch Phulkakkali
ingredients: 5 large plum tomatoes | 8 tablespoons brandy or 8 tablespoons ketchup | 2 green chili peppers | 1/2 tablespoon saurce | 1/2 tablespoon fenugreek seeds | 2 tablespoons crushed dried fenugreek seeds
instructions: Wash tomatoes under water, drain and coarsely chop.  Place whole green chile peppers in a pan.  Pour a little water and boil lightly until chili is dark red and softened.  Place tomatoes in a mortar.  Break out the seeds with a spoon and mix into chile.  Add brandy or ketchup.  Add fenugreek and fenugreek seeds.  Pour into an earthenware jar or casserole dish, cover and refrigerate for a few hours or overnight.  Before serving, remove lid and shake gently.  Serve as a snack with yoghurt or indian condiments.  Variation, this chile can also be used as a sauce for rice dishes.  Variation, instead of fenugreek seeds use 1/2 teaspoon chili powder.  Variation, this chile can also be used as a spice for curry or eat with rotis.  Variation, when adding fenugreek, add 1/2 tablespoon ground cumin with the brandy or ketchup, and you have a gooey treat.

title: Simple Spaghetti
ingredients: 500 g spaghetti sauce | 1 tablespoon kaffir lime leaf, chopped
instructions: Bring a pan of water to the boil.  Add the spaghetti sauce and stir continuously until it reaches a boil.  Taste to ensure it's cooked.  Remove from heat.  Sprinkle lime leaves on top to give it extra flavour.  Serve immediately.

title: Coriander Potatoes

instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Peel the potatoes if they are not already peeled.  Slice into 1/4 inch slices, and place them between two sheets of wax paper.  Using your fingers, spread the slices out into a single layer about 1/16 inch thick, and place them on a greased baking sheet.  Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 15 to 20 minutes, turning over once, and placing in a warmed serving dish to serve.

title: Easy Indian Ziti
ingredients: 1 package dry ziti pasta | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/4 onion, chopped
instructions: In a large skillet, bring water to boil.  Add ziti, and salt to taste.  Reduce heat, and simmer 10 minutes.  Drain.  Place drained ziti in a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish.  Whisk mustard powder, garam masala, cayenne pepper, and onion into ziti.  Mix well.  Cover, and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight.  Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Place ziti in a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish.  Bake in the preheated oven 10 minutes, or until pasta is browned.

Place remaining polenta slices on top of the pine nuts, and cool.  Enjoy.

title: Mosaic Chicken on a Stick (Canned Melon

instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the stock, thyme, zest, pepper and rum.  Simmer, covered over low heat 2 minutes.  Remove the cover and simmer gently for 10 minutes until reduced by half.  Serve the chilli sauce over your chosen selection of cooked rice.

title: Spicy Cashew Skewers for Birthday

Soak the soaked cashews in the sesame oil until the cashews are toasted and dry.  Set 1 tablespoon of sesame oil in a clean pan.  Heat on high until you see some sizzles.  This only takes a moment and smell, that tells the sazon what has happened.  Add 2 - 3 tablespoons of hot sherry or water to the pan and stir to mix, cooking for 1 minute.  Add the sherry or water/sherry mixture of your choice, and stir to combine.  Keep the heat low so it doesn't burn.  When your sizzles, add about 1 tablespoon of canola oil to the same pan and cook the cashews and sherry mixture, over high heat, stirring continuously, until cashews are browned, about 2 minutes.  Take the pan off of the heat.  Place a serving plate over the pan.  Pour about 1 tablespoon of hot sherry oil in the pan and spread the nuts evenly around the plate.  Allow the heated sherry, sherry, sesame oil, and remaining oil to sit off the heat shortly before eating on its own.  The oil is served to provide your guests, or to keep on hand a little of the mixture, in which one turns the nuts at the same time.  Be careful if the guests are turning the nuts over too soon.  This recipe does not taste quite right.  This recipe has been adapted from lucid food.  You may use other cuts of cashews instead of cashews.

instructions: Drain the beans and reserve the liquid.  Rinse well with cold water to remove the excess saltiness.  Pat dry.  Combine with enough reserved liquid to cover by 1/2 inch.  Set aside.  In a large bowl, mix the beans with the reserved liquid, 1/2 teaspoon of the cocoa, the lemon zest, lemon juice, asafoetida powder and salt and pepper to taste.  Cover by placing in a warm dry 250f over for 30 minutes.  Uncover, turn the bean mixture to heat through, about 30 minutes.  Serve warm.

title: Minted Brisket
ingredients: 8 ounces of fresh mint, with stems, washed | 2 lbs beef brisket
instructions: Preheat oven to 325º.  Cut mint into 6 - 8 pieces, removing rind.  Rub each brisket with a portion of mint.  Wrap 1 piece of brisket fat around a whole piece of string.  Place on rack in roasting pan.  Put pan with brisket fat side up.  Roast for 1 1/2 hours.  Carefully remove string.  If you want your brisket with the drippings on the top, you may use less fat.  I found that this turned out very well but it turned out again just as nicely.  I served it with pita bread.  Some may like to add a couple of jalapeno slices to the mint.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,lump crabmeat,lime,turkey,beef steak,sharp cheddar cheese
title: Cheddar-Crusted Crab Nags
ingredients: 2 tablespoons beef steak, shredded | 1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 can lump crabmeat, drained | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 2 limes, thinly sliced | 1 whole-wheat frozen lime, thawed and cut into 8 thin wedges
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees.  Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray.  In medium bowl, combine shredded cheese, crab, tomatoes with chilies, lime juice and sliced lime.  Spread mixture evenly over the cracker, dividing evenly.  Arrange the frozen lime wedges on top.

Random Ingredients: szechwan pepper,chicken breast half,burrito flour tortilla,pork,paprika,white wine vinegar,ziti pasta,vegetable juice
title: Chicken Jambalaya With Pork and Ziti
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/2 lb ground lean pork | 4 ounces dry ziti pasta | 2/3 cup vegetable juice ( v8 recommended ) | 1/2 teaspoon smoked paprika | 1/4 teaspoon white wine vinegar | 3 burrito-size flour tortillas | 1 teaspoon szechwan pepper, ground, to sprinkle ( sriracha if you can find it )
instructions: Using 2 forks, cut a slit along one side of each chicken breast to create a pocket in the chicken and pork.

title: Quick & Easy Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 can red peppers, drained | 1/4 cup malt vinegar | 1 package flour tortillas or ( 7 inch ) package corn tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Drain the peppers of any excess liquid, saving 1/4 cup or so.  Cut into 1 inch wide strips, and set aside.  In a non stick skilled, warm the vinegar over medium heat.  When hot, stir in the red pepper strips until coated.  Spray a 9x13 baking dish with non stick cooking spray.  Heat tortillas for one minute in the microwave, but do not let them get a little crisp.  Dip each tortilla in the hot vinegar, then roll in the tortillas.  Place the enchiladas in the pan and drizzle with any remaining vinegar.  Cover and continue heating for 2 minutes, or to desired doneness.  Serve warm, or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,ancho chile powder,sausage,cherry,yukon gold potato,red pepper flake,lemon zest,grain white rice
title: Rice, Sausage and Cherries in Lemon-Ancho Sausage
ingredients: 1/2 lb bacon, thinly sliced | 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, sliced lengthwise into 1/8ths | 1 lb smoked sausage, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/2 teaspoon crushed dried ancho chile powder | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated lemon zest | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed ( 7 7/8 cups ) | 1/2 lb dried cherries, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Heat a 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Add bacon and cook until browned and crisp, about 4 minutes.  Transfer bacon to a paper towel lined plate to drain excess fat.  Add potatoes to skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until golden and caramelized, about 15 minutes.  Add sausage, ancho, lemon zest and red pepper and cook, stirring frequently, until heated through, about 3 minutes.  Transfer to a bowl and allow to cool slightly.  Lightly unfold the frozen puff pastry sheets and place on a baking sheet.  Place the cherries in the center of each sheet.  Bake until golden and puffed, about 10 minutes.  Place sausage meat and cherry halves on top and bake until the cherries are tender, about 5 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,gorgonzola,farina,coriander,sesame seed,nonstick spray coating,lemon juice zest,cumin powder
title: Quick & Easy Algerian Feta
ingredients: 3/4 cup gorgonzola, crumbled | 3 tablespoons nonstick spray coating | 1 tablespoon lemon juice, from zest of 1 lemon, to 1 teaspoon | 1 teaspoon cumin powder, to taste | 1/2 teaspoon coriander, to taste | 1/4 teaspoon red bell pepper, diced | 1/4 cup dried farina ( multigrain or rice ) | 1/3 cup sliced almonds or 1/3 cup blanched almond, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Place the gorgonzola in a small bowl.  Place the nonstick coating in a pie plate.  Stir together the water, lemon zest, cumin powder, coriander, red bell pepper, and the farina until water is absorbed, about 2 minutes.  Whisk together the mixture until creamy, about 3 - 4 minutes.  Spread the mixture evenly in the pie plate.  Sprinkle the almonds evenly over the feta evenly.  Bake in the oven for 30 minutes, until golden brown and bubbly and no longer translucent.  Allow to cool for 5 minutes before popping.  Enjoy.

title: Fish Stew
ingredients: 2 large red onions, chopped | 2 lamb shanks ( such as bissara ) | 4 whole cloves | 1/2 cup milk | 1 pound fish, cut into chunks | 1/2 pound salt pork, julienned
instructions: Place onions in a saucepan with enough water to cover.

Random Ingredients: large shrimp,italian spice,dark corn syrup,sesame oil,hoisin sauce,thyme,peanut oil
title: Shrimp With Shangham
ingredients: 1/2 lb large shrimp | 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon dark corn syrup | 1 tablespoon light italian spices | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme, chopped | 1/2 cup hoisin sauce | 1 teaspoon dark corn syrup
instructions: Peel shrimp if they are large and shell on, devein if necessary.  Combine marinade ingredients and marinate shrimp.  Grill shrimp, remove from grill when dark pink and curled from center of shrimp, and place in serving casserole, or shallow glass bowl.  Garnish shrimp with syrup.

title: Rice Patties
ingredients: 3 cups cracked cracker crumbs | 1/2 teaspoon onion salt | 1 1/2 cups steamed chopped onions or 1 1/2 cups finely chopped onions | 2 to 3 tablespoons tea, hot
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the cracker crumbs, onion salt, & steamed onions, & mix well.  Shape mixture into 2 inch balls.  Heat up steamer or frying pan over medium for about 8 to 10 minutes, or until a fork passes through the center of each ball, & the desired doneness.

title: Hot Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 24 ounces sour cream cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Trim fat and silver skin from brisket.  Place in a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Add remaining ingredients and stir to mix evenly.  Spread sour cream on top.  Bake 1 hour in the preheated oven, until tender.

title: Horseradish Shallots, Blueberries and Barley Salad
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley ( or white pearl barley, see note below ) | 1 cup chopped mixed shallots or 6 medium shallots, thinly sliced | 250 g blueberries ( or fresh, or frozen berries ) | 1/2 cup malt vinegar | 1 tablespoon grated orange zest | icing sugar, to sprinkle | least fresh horseradish, to serve
instructions: Wash the barley well under cold running water.  Bring a saucepan of water to the boil.  Place the barley and shallots into a pan of boiling water and boil until tender, about 8 minutes.  Drain the cooked barley, then rinse in cold water.  Let cool and drain.  Line a serving platter with lettuces and set aside.  Combine the drained barley and chilled shallots in a bowl.  Put the blueberries in the bowl with the barley and shallots.  Place the vinegar, orange zest, and icing sugar in a small pan and heat to boiling, watching closely to stir and to make the sugar soft.  Remove from the heat and pour half into the bowl.  Pour over the warm vinegar and stir in the horseradish just before serving.  Note on dried mushrooms, rinse & drain the mushrooms and add to the bowl.

title: Fried Parsnips With Garlic and Rice Flour
ingredients: 6 parsnips | 600 ml olive ( shelled ) | 1 tablespoon minced garlic paste | 1 pinch ground mace | 4 -5 tablespoons rice flour
instructions: Peel parsnips and cut into sticks approximately 3/4 inch thick.  Remove parsnips.  Boil the parsnips in water to cover until soft, but not mushy.  Drain and then mash with a potato masher.  Set aside.  Brown garlic, mace and flour in a large non stick frying pan over medium high heat.  Using an electric mixer mash the parsnips in the pan adding a little garlic oil, a little at a time until they are smooth but not thick.  Add hot olive oil mixture and stir until heated through.  Pour over the cooked parsnips and serve on a bed of warm bread.

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,spring onion,cayenne pepper,velveeta cheese,cinnamon,black eyed pea
title: Cayenne-Mashed Peas, Swiss Style
ingredients: 1 package frozen black-eyed peas ( thawed ) | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/8 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper ( or to taste ) | 4 ounces velveeta cheese ( cubed 2 cups ) | 3 spring onions, thinly sliced
instructions: Heat oil in pan over medium heat.  Add the seasonings.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,sun tomato oil,white wine vinegar,lemon zest,bacon,cod
title: Bacon & Sun-Dried Tomato Cod Salad
ingredients: 300 g cod, cleaned, cut into 2 equal portions | 6 slices bacon | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 lemon, zest of, grated
instructions: Cook the cod in boiling water for 3 minutes.  Drain well and return to the pan.  Stir in the vinegar, tomatoes and rind and season.

title: Crisply French Fries
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter flavor crisco | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 medium courgette, preferably young, peeled, cut into 1/2-inch slices
instructions: Bring 4 cups water with 2 teaspoons salt to a boil in a 12 inch heavy nonstick frying pan.  Cook carrots, stirring frequently or until tender, about 3 minutes.  Drain and sprinkle with seasoning salt.  Quickly transfer to a shallow container, cool to room temperature, and chill, covered, for up to 4 hours.  Note, i like to serve it with mustard dressing, mustard, and cheese salad.

title: Aquagrill Espanola (Eggplant With Bean Spread)
ingredients: 1 large eggplant | 1 anaheim chili, seeded and minced | 1 tablespoon tamari or 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 2 cans cannellini beans, rinsed and drained ( or any can )
instructions: Preheat a grill pan or other non stick pan to medium.  Slice eggplant, lengthwise in half lengthwise, then cut into 1/8th inch slices.  Brush 1/2 of the eggplant on grilling pan with oil and grill, turning, until eggplant is brown and softened remove from pan and place on plate.  Repeat with remaining eggplant.  Add a little more oil to pan.  Sauté chile, stirring often, until softened, about 1 minute.  Add bean sprouts and tamari and heat through.  Put eggplant on plate with bean sprout mixture, drizzle with sauce and serve.

Random Ingredients: red apple,pineapple juice,green cardamom pod,green chili pepper,bamboo shoot,red bell pepper,veal
title: Sweet Veal, Pineapple, Apples, & Chiles in Bamboo Shoots
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice | 1 can bamboo shoots | 1 small red apple, chopped | 1 small red bell pepper, chopped | 2 green chili peppers, chopped ( or to taste ) | 2 -4 drops green cardamom pods ( optional )
instructions: Brown ground veal and pineapple juice in a frying pan until browned.  Drain off fat.  Meanwhile, dice apple and pepper.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,ice water,beef roast,grape,elbow macaroni,irish bacon,great northern bean,grapefruit
title: Delicious Irish Grapfruit Beef and Pasta
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef roast ( or other cuts if roast is in the refrigerator ) | 3 tablespoons cake flour ( or toasted breadcrumbs mix ) | 1/2 package grape ( frozen is ok ) | 5 -6 cups ice water | 2 cans great northern beans, drained | 4 slices irish bacon ( can use a combo of meats ) ( optional ) | 1 package uncooked elbow macaroni ( or macaroni-i cooked these for 8 servings ) ( optional ) | 2 -3 cups grape ( frozen is ok )
instructions: Put olive oil in pressure cooker and place on medium high heat.  If you wish to use a pressure cooker for the soup, do not brown the beef in oil.  It should be brown by the time the beef is finished.  If you wish to use it for soup, remove the grease in the pot and add the beef and the other ingredients.  If the soup is too thick you can add some ice.  When the pressure cooker auto-seal, you can add the grapefruit juice to the water.  You may want to add a little water to thin it out if you think the grapefruit juice is drying out.  If the grapes are soft add another tsp of water.  If you want to serve this in a crockpot cook on high, low, or low heat for 8 hours and the cheese is melted.  Serve on a bed of cooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: yellow rice mix,chicken broth,ginger garlic paste,vanilla bean,rye bread
title: Lightly-Peppered Chilled Rice With Egg-Ginger-Garlic Croutons
ingredients: 1 package yellow rice mix | 2 cups low sodium chicken broth | 4 slices fresh ginger-garlic paste ( about 3 slices ) | 4 slices fresh rye bread, toasted | 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla bean
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions using chicken broth and ginger garlic paste in a 1 1/2 to 2 quart saucepot, but do not allow to boil.  Meanwhile, toast bread on a baking sheet in an oven preheated to 300 degrees f.  For best results, place bread in a shallow dish.  When rice is done, transfer it to a large bowl and toss with ginger garlic paste and 2 tablespoons cooking liquid.  Allow to sit while you prepare egg ginger garlic flavored croutons.  While rice is cooling down, heat remaining 1/2 teaspoons cooking liquid in a small skillet over medium heat.  Add egg ginger garlic paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.  Add rice, and stir well.  When rice is warm, adjust sweetness with additional lemon juice or a dash of sugar, or if you use low sodium chicken broth reduce heat to low.  Spoon into bowls, and serve with toasted rye bread to dip.

title: Beef Noodles With Peanut Butter
ingredients: 2 packages dry udon noodles | 1/2 cup peanut butter | 2 tablespoons dry mustard
instructions: Cook the noodles according to package directions.  Melt peanut butter in small saucepan over low heat.  Stir until smooth.  Transfer to serving bowl.  Add dry mustard.  Pour over noodles.

Random Ingredients: mascarpone cheese,turnip,cream chicken soup,rye bread,butter,sage leaf,chocolate,red wine vinegar
title: Beefy Toast With Turnips
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter | 1 cup turnip, finely chopped | 1/2 cup dry red wine vinegar | 4 ounces bittersweet chocolate | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1 -4 tablespoon mascarpone cheese | 2 slices rye bread, thick slices ( each slice should be about 1-inch thick ) | 2 sage leaves, leaves only
instructions: In a large skillet, melt butter over medium high heat.  Cook turnips, stirring often, for 5 minutes, or until just slightly tender.  Add vinegar and mix gently.  Remove from heat.  In a small bowl, stir together chocolate, soup and mascarpone.  In a separate small bowl, dip two slice of rye bread, one at a time, in melted butter.  Spread one side of each toast with about 1 tablespoon of the cheese and turnip mixture.  Top with remaining slice of rye bread to form a sandwich.  Grill sandwiches for 1 - 2 minutes or until bread is light brown.  Garnish with sage.

title: Candy Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 package kielbasa | 1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1/8 cup tequila
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f.  Slice kielbasa to 1/4 inch slices.  Place sausage and chocolate chips in a baking dish.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes, until lightly browned.

title: Pasta With Avocado - Spanish Style
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh scraped pineapple ( such as cored or unpeeled ) | 1 medium ripe avocado, peeled and diced | 1 medium spanish onion, minced | 1/4 cup chopped capers ( rinsed if fresh or salt and pepper to taste ) | 1 cup dry penne pasta ( we prefer barilla ) | 1/2 teaspoon superfine sugar | 3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh cilantro or 1 tablespoon parsley ( we like dried )
instructions: Start boiling water in large saucepan.  While water is heating add avocado, onion and sauté until soft.  Add capers.  Drain pasta, toss with avocado mixture and sugar to coat.  Garnish with fresh cilantro, if using.  Serve at once.

title: South Indian Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, torn into small pieces | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed
instructions: Toss lettuce with desired amount of dressing.  Sprinkle with cilantro and cardamom seeds.  Toss once more, serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: blue cheese,brandy,black olive,chipotle chile,egg yolk,kalamata olive,pecan
title: Brandy Covered Olives-Chipotle Tapenade
ingredients: 1/2 cup pecans, toasted, coarsely chopped | 3/4 cup pecans | 12 large black olives | 1/4 cup brandy ( or whiskey ) | 1/4 cup blue cheese, crumbled ( blue brie not recommended ) | 2 large egg yolks, beaten with 2-3 tbsp water | 3 chipotle chiles, stemmed, seeded thinly sliced ( from can ) | 3/4 cup kalamata olive, pitted chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender, and process until smooth.  Cover and chill overnight.  To serve, spread tapenade on a small plate, top with fresh cheese and remaining tapenade.  Sprinkle with additional toasted pecans, toasted pecans, or paprika.  Serve with warm breads.

Random Ingredients: vanilla ice cream,turmeric powder,black sesame seed,egg yolk
title: Czech Scrambled Eggs
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups vanilla ice cream | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 cup black sesame seed | 1 egg yolk ( optional )
instructions: Place the vanilla ice cream, turmeric powder, sesame seeds, and egg, if desired, in the container of a blender and process until smooth.  Chill the mixture, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,flax seed,ice cube,fish sauce,oregano leaf
title: Thai Fish Chiles Steamed in Salt
ingredients: 2 red chilies | 2 tablespoons ground flax seeds | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | ice cube | 1/4 cup fish sauce
instructions: Slit a chile lengthwise.  Remove and discard seeds.  Grind into a fine powder.  Heat a little oil in a wok, pour over the chile powder.  Stir and stir fry until fragrant and darkened.  Add crushed dried oregano leaves, stir.  Pour 1/4 cup plus 2 tablespoons fish sauce over chile.  Heat to boiling, then remove from heat, cover and let stand for 3 minutes.  Uncover, stir and serve.

title: Mexican Green Chili Pepper Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup canned diced mild green chili peppers | 1 cup shredded colby-jack cheese
instructions: Combine peppers and cheese in a large bowl.  Stir in 1/4 cup of the dip.

Random Ingredients: caramel topping,vanilla bean,gingersnap,beef stew meat,napa cabbage,toothpick,hard egg,halloumi cheese
title: Sweet-Nasty Beef Kebabs (Kebab Aka Beef Roulades)
ingredients: 1 lb lean beef stew meat, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 8 ounces halloumi cheese | 8 fresh gingersnaps | softened caramel topping | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla bean | 3 hard-boiled eggs, sliced | pickled ginger, for garnish | 1 napa cabbage, leaves torn ( optional )
instructions: Combine beef, cheeses, vanilla and gingersnaps in a large mixing bowl.  Toss meat to combine with the cheeses.  Shape into 24 thin patties.  Sprinkle with caramel and a few pickled ginger slices.  Arrange on foil in a glass dish.  Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours or overnight.  Preheat grill.  Remove kebabs from refrigerator 30 minutes before grilling and grill until nicely browned, about 5 to 7 minutes per side.  Serve meat kebabs hot on the side with napa leaf and pickled ginger.

Random Ingredients: mirin,lemon lime beverage,sun tomato oil,pepper sauce,sage leaf,pasta
title: Yoshida's Sun-Dried Tomato and Herb Pasta
ingredients: 1 package pasta | 1 jar sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained ( in oil, not oil packed ) | 1 dash hot pepper sauce | 4 tablespoons mirin ( sweet rice wine ) ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage | 1/4 teaspoon dried sage leaves, optional, or more to taste
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.  Once the water is boiling, stir in the pasta, recover, and cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.  Drain well in a colander set in the sink, reserving 1/4 cup pasta water.  Toss drained tomatoes with hot pepper sauce and mirin in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,chicken,self rising flour,red chili pepper,creole seasoning,kaffir lime leaf,taco sauce,heavy cream
title: Chile Lime and Chicken Pancake
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self rising flour | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning | 3 eggs, beaten | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 cups chicken, chopped | 1/2 cup kaffir lime leaf, chopped | 1 jar taco sauce, heated | 1/2 cup heavy cream
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees f.  Spray a baking sheet with cooking or spray with cooking spray.  Mix the flour and creole seasoning together in a large bowl.  Combine the eggs, kidney beans, chicken, lime leaf and taco sauce in a separate bowl.  Stir until well mixed.  Gradually mix mixture into flour mixture.  Stir until batter is well blended.  Spread the batter in a circle on the prepared baking sheet.  Bake in the preheated oven for 35 to 40 minutes, or until edges are golden brown.  Let pancake stand for 10 to 15 minutes before serving, cut into wedges.

Random Ingredients: white mushroom,italian seasoning,white potato,chile pepper,white onion,ruby port,feta cheese
title: TEX Spiced Potatoes
ingredients: 1/4 pound white potatoes, cut into cubes | 1/2 pound white potatoes, cut into cubes | 1/2 pound fresh white mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 white onion, chopped | 1 chile pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Place white potatoes into a large pot with enough water to cover, and bring to a boil.  Cook potatoes until tender but still firm.  Drain, cool, and chop.  In a large skillet over medium heat, combine chopped potatoes, white potatoes, mushrooms, onion, and chile pepper.  Season with italian seasoning.  Cover skillet, and cook for about 10 minutes, until mixture is hot.  Mix in crumbled feta cheese, and serve.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,beef chuck,onion flake,italian cheese,peanut oil
title: Arroz Brasiles
ingredients: 1 large onion, cut into strips | 1 package long-grain white rice, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup dried italian cheese blend | 7 1/2 pounds boneless beef chuck, cut into 2 inch pieces | 1/2 cup peanut oil, or as needed
instructions: Place rice in a bowl, and mix in dried onion.  Allow the rice mixture to absorb as much water as possible, but do not add more than 1 1/2 cups total, as this will be the most important step after preparation.  Stir in dried cheese, and set aside to absorb flavors.  Heat peanut oil in a skillet over medium high heat.  Remove beef, and cook until browned on the outside.  Return the beef to the skillet, and continue cooking, stirring occasionally.  Cook the rice mixture until the liquid has mostly evaporated.  Serve beef over the rice mixture.

title: Fiesta Rice Recipe
ingredients: 1 can chunk salsa | 1 1/4 cups basmati rice or 1 1/4 cups long grain rice, uncooked
instructions: Combine salsa and rice in medium nonstick skillet.  Heat to boiling, stirring frequently.  Cover and reduce heat.  Simmer 20 min, stirring occasionally.  Remove from heat.  Let stand 5 min.  Fluff with fork, spoon into shallow serving bowl.  Makes 2 servings.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,arborio rice,egg noodle,caesar salad dressing
title: Italian Rice With Egg Noodles and Peanuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup caesar salad dressing | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice or 1 1/2 cups other short-grain rice | 1/4 cup peanut oil | 2/3 cup roasted peanuts, chopped ( to taste )
instructions: In a 4 - 5 quart microwave safe casserole, combine all ingredients except for peanuts.  Cover and microwave on high uncovered for 5 - 7 minutes, until heated through and creamy.  Sprinkle with peanuts.  Serve immediately.

title: Maple Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cannellini beans, rinsed drained and rinsed | 3 tablespoons pine nuts | 3 -4 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons chopped parsley | 1 dash cayenne | fresh chervil or parsley, chopped for garnish
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large saucepan, heat to boiling.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,green pea,flour tortilla
title: Moroccan Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 package flour tortillas | 1 package green peas | 1 tablespoon ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Rinse, dry, and tear peas into short, narrow strips with broad side of knife or spatula.  Place in bowl, and add spices.  Tear baggies with broad ends into 1 inch sized pieces.  Mix with hands or hands or fork to evenly distribute spice mix among tortillas, and set aside.  Over low heat heat, place 1/2 tablespoon of oil in frying pan.  When hot, drop large dollops of batter onto pan.  Cook until bottoms darken, then flip and brown the other side.  Keep warm in low oven until quesadillas are done to your liking.  Slice into wedges along the lengths of the tortillas, and serve with tahini salsa or your favourite dip.  Variation, you can make a'saffron' of the spices with half of the spice mix.  This also makes a nice tasty variation on a moroccan meal.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,belgian endive,pea,canola oil,colby monterey jack cheese
title: Endive and Pea Salad With Crispy Pita Chips
ingredients: 3 heads belgian endive | 3 cups chopped english pea ( frozen or fresh ) | 1 1/2 - 2 cups colby-monterey jack cheese, grated ( about 1/4 cup ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon canola oil
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f.  Cut endives in half lengthwise.  Split off greens and place in 3 quart casserole.  Sprinkle half the cheese on greens and half the garam masala.

title: Hot Dogs for Dogs
ingredients: 1 package chili seasoning mix | 1 package deli ham or 1 package cooked ham, cut into 1/4 inch slices
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Spray foil with nonstick cooking spray.  Combine chili seasoning mix and ham or bacon.  Roll ham strips in mixture to coat.  Place on broiler rack.  Broil 4 to 6 inches from heat, turning once, until golden brown, 4 to 5 minutes per side.

title: Gloaf and Pineapple
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder or 2 lbs prime rib roast, boneless, with fat in it | 1 can crushed pineapple with juice | 1 pound turnips, cut into 1 inch pieces, peeled, and sliced into 1 inch pieces | 1 lb asadero cheese, shredded ( or a mixture or two cheeses of your choice )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Mix all contents of the can of pineapple with juice, and place meat in a loaf pan.  Sprinkle asadero on top.  Bake until meat and turnips are tender, 1 1/2 1 hours, or until internal thermometer reads 160 degrees for 2 to 3 hours.  Place shredded cheese on top of meat and serve.  The cheese will melt and be wonderful.

Random Ingredients: nonstick cooking spray,stone mustard,fennel seed,marjoram,monterey jack cheese,cooking spray,seafood stock,lasagna noodle
title: Classic Seafood Lasagna
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles | cooking spray | 16 ounces seafood stock | 16 ounces monterey jack cheese, shredded | 1/3 cup stone ground mustard | 1/3 cup nonstick cooking spray | 1/4 cup chopped fresh marjoram or 1/4 cup oregano | 4 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh fennel seeds
instructions: Cook noodles in boiling, slated water for 8 to 10 minutes or just until tender and al dente.

title: Persian Nasi Goreng
ingredients: 500 g beef sirloin, thinly sliced into four pieces | 1/2 teaspoon anchovy, roughly chopped | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder, to taste | bread, toasted
instructions: Spread out the sliced beef on a piece of toast and sprinkle with the anchovy.  Sprinkle with the dried rosemary, coriander powder, and freshly ground black pepper to taste.  Bake in a 220c oven for approximately 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: pancake mix,spring onion,monterey jack cheese,corn,white peppercorn,bicarbonate soda,mustard seed,peppercorn
title: Corn and Crispy Pancake Mix
ingredients: 1 cup corn | 1 cup white peppercorns | 2 tablespoons coriander or 2 tablespoons cayenne peppercorns, freshly ground or 2 tablespoons cayenne powder | 4 1/2 cups corn meal or 4 1/2 cups pancake mix | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 finely shredded monterey jack cheese ( optional ) | 1 finely minced spring onion ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons mustard seeds, freshly ground ( optional )
instructions: Put all the dry ingredients in a large bowl.  Stir the cornmeal and soda into the dry ingredients using some of the crushed cornmeal.  Add the cheese and sufficient water to give the mixture a firm dropping consistency.  If necessary, add more cornmeal to get the right consistency.  Heat a non stick pan and spread the mustard seeds on to the pan.  Roll ladlefuls of the mixture into small thin rounds.  Cook on both sides until they are brown and firm and crisp and cooked through.  Remove to a warmed dinner plate to serve.  Variation, you may add a little mustard seeds before frying, and then fry them for a little while before adding the cornmeal mixture.

Random Ingredients: sirloin steak,apple juice,beef chuck,self raising flour,cinnamon,asparagus,lime juice zest
title: Asparagus Beef and Asparagus Skewers
ingredients: 250 g asparagus | 300 g boneless sirloin steaks | 1 kg self-raising flour ( measured with vegetable flour ) | 1 teaspoon lime zest | 2/3 cup apple juice | 2 tablespoons lime juice, juice and zest of | 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 200'c/400'f/gas cut the asparagus into 1cm slices.  Put asparagus, steak, flour, lime rind and juice, cinnamon and juice into a large bowl.  Mix well so that each piece is coated in the flour and put aside for 30 minutes.  Roll 2cm diameter balls and secure with string.  Put each asparagus skewer onto a tray, and put into the oven.  Cook for 12 - 15 minutes.

title: Mustard Beetroot
ingredients: 4 medium beets, pared | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Wash beetroot, and peel off outer layer.  Place in a baking dish about 4 inches deep, and bake until tender, about 60 minutes.

title: Lamb Shank With Lentils
ingredients: 2 lamb shanks | 1/2 loaf italian bread, split | 1 bunch asparagus, trimmed | 4 stalks celery, halved | 8 ounces green chilies, sliced in half | 3 cans chopped tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.  Place lamb shanks in a large roasting pan.  Arrange the asparagus, celery, chilies and tomatoes around the pork shanks.  Cover with water and bake for 2 to 3 hours or until just tender.  Shake the pan twice during the cooking.  Remove the pork and vegetables from the pan and allow to cool slightly before chilling.  Serve with crusty italian bread.  Variation, to make up a loaf of italian bread.  Put oven to 350 degrees c / 325 degrees f.  Using 2 slices of bread, cut the tops of the bread lengthways and place on a baking sheet with the cut side up or bread of choice.  Place the lamb on top of the bread.  Place in the preheated oven for 45 minutes to an hour or until the tops are golden.  Variation, to cut up the loaf of italian bread, you can cut the bread lengthways and place on a baking sheet with the cut sides placed on the baking sheet.  Turn the oven off, remove the lamb shank from the oven and place on a cutting board with a thick knife.  Cut across the grain into long slices.  Serve with vegetables and a tossed salad.  Variation, to make a loaf of italian bread, you can cut the bread lengthways and place on a baking sheet with the cut side up or on a baking sheet with the cut side down or on a baking sheet with the cut side down.  Turn the temperature to 325 degrees c / 325 degrees f.

title: Pfeffernusse With Apples on Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 1/3 cup warm all-purpose flour | 1/4 cup white sesame seeds | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 1 medium apple, peeled, cored, and sliced into thin wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Sieve flour onto work surface of a wooden board.  Add flour, 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, and cocoa to work bowl with fingers.  Gradually add warm water using fork.  Knead dough by hand to form a rough ball, adding more water as needed.  Divide dough into 4 parts.  Roll each part into a 9 inch circle, about 1 inch thick.  Place 1 tablespoon apple cut side down on center of dough circle.  Using 2 opposite edges of dough, roll, starting with 1 of the outer edges.  Seal edges by folding over dough.  Place on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper.  Repeat until all breads have been rolled.  Sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon sesame seeds toasted in oven.  Bake for about 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Nettie Cronish's Chinese Spicy Pickled Red Onions(Yoshinoya)
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh flat leaf parsley, leaves picked from stems ( also known as `` cilantro '' ) | 1/2 cup pickled mace, preferably thai | 1/4 cup chinese sambal oelek chili paste or 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 1 teaspoon sugar
instructions: Rinse all the leaves off from the parsley, and chop them coarsely.  Rinse them well and dry.  Cut them into 1 1/2 inch lengths.  Set aside.  Bring to a boil enough water to cover, and boil uncovered for 1 minute.  Take immediately off the heat, drain well, and spread on a clean towel.  Let soak for 2 hours.  When cold you may cover again with cold water, remove from the towel and place the onion strips in a large colander set in the sink.  Repeat with the other strips until all the onions are soaked and the salt has dissolved.  Transfer the drained onion strips to a sterilized canning jar, cover, and refrigerate.  After 2 days, use a long, sharp knife to slice the onions vertically, removing the ends just before serving.  In a small bowl, mix together the chili paste, sugar, and salt.  Store in an airtight glass jar in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: pizza dough,vegetable oil cooking spray,ladyfinger,rye bread,red curry paste,sharp cheddar cheese,red chili pepper,lemongrass
title: Quick and Easy Thai Raita Pizza
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 3/4 cup chopped lemongrass, white part only ( yellow part only ) | 1 tablespoon red curry paste, light or yellow | 1/4 cup finely chopped red chili pepper | 3 tablespoons minced fresh lemongrass | 1 package refrigerated pizza dough, frozen or homemade, thawed with fresh | 8 -10 ounces rotisserie-cooked chicken-flavored rotisserie chicken, thinly sliced | 6 ounces shaved sharp cheddar cheese, to taste | 1 package sliced ladyfingers
instructions: Spray surface of pizza pan lightly with cooking spray, lightly oil pizza pan, sprinkle lemongrass and curry paste overtop.  Using long, hot knife, spread chile paste, chiles and 1 clove of lemon grass over top.  Arrange pizza dough over curry paste.  Spread sliced chicken over top.  Sprinkle cheddar over top.  Sprinkle with remaining lemon grass and minced zest.  Preheat oven to 450°f.  Place pizza pan on baking sheet.  Bake until top is crusty, lightly browned, 7 - 10 minutes.  Let cool before cutting.  Serve topped with extra parmesan cheese or sour cream.

title: Eggs and Ground Beef
ingredients: 6 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and divided | 1 1/2 pounds extra lean ground beef
instructions: Slice the halves of the eggs into 1 thick rounds.  Place the 1st 3 egg rounds on one of the slices of beef.  Repeat process with the second egg.  Roll the beef slices in the beaten egg coating on all sides.  In a large, heatproof skillet, cook the rolls over medium high heat, turning often, for about 10 minutes, or until beef is cooked through and egg whites are set.

title: Quick and Easy Blue Cheese Burritos
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin beef, cut into small chunks | 8 ounces fresh blue cheese, torn into small pieces | 24 california chile pods, halved lengthwise | 1/2 cup uncooked quinoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Spread tortillas evenly with the blue cheese.  Arrange the chile pods over the cheese, and cover completely with quinoa.  Bring 3 inches of water to boil.  Place the cover on the pan, cook 10 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Invert burritos onto foil lined baking sheets.  Cut into fourths, and serve warm.

title: Peaches, Dill and Peach Salad
ingredients: 5 fresh sweet peas | 1 bunch fresh dill, chopped
instructions: Peel, rinse and cut into wedges.  Scoop out seeds.  Add a bunch of fresh dill to the dill, then add the peaches.  Toss to coat.

title: Mexican Chiles-Avocado-Stuffed Green-Broccoli Peppers
ingredients: 8 large fresh arbol chilies ( or more, depending on height of chilies ) | 8 ounces dried unsweetened chocolate chips | 1 large head broccoli | sliced avocado | 1/2 cup chopped dried cranberries or 8 fresh strawberries | 3/4 cup mexican dried diced ancho chilies | 1/4 cup cooked pork, julienned | 3 limes or 2 lemons | spices, to taste
instructions: Cut stems off broccoli, then separate the leaves carefully.  Cut into 1/4 inch slivers, then remove and reserve the tough base of each leaf.  Chop 1 chile and place 1/2 ounce in each leaf, and stuff inside a leaf with the chipotle and reshape the entire nest to have an opening.  In a large saucepan, place the remaining chile heart and chile, water just to cover, and bring to a boil over high heat and simmer until the chiles soften, about 5 minutes.  Remove from heat, strain through a sieve and set aside.  To make chili dressing, in a saucepan over medium low heat, melt the chocolate chips with the broccoli florets and avocados.  In a small bowl, mash the cranberries with 1 teaspoon of the ancho seeds and 1/2 teaspoon of lime juice, and pour the chile dressing over the chocolate mixture.  Stir in the chile slivers and chopped or sliced pork until thoroughly combined.  Remove 1 chile heart from the nest, slice off the stem and add to the chocolate mixture.  Stuff with the reserved chile heart, wrap in plastic and refrigerate until ready to serve.  Garnish with a few diced or grated mexican dry chiles on top with mexican lime slices or lemon wedges.  Serve with chips or fresh fruit.

title: Pignoli - Italian Sweet Wine
ingredients: 1/2 lb sugar | 1 bottle white wine
instructions: Place the sugar in a small cup and slowly beat it into the wine.  Bring to a boil, boil 2 minutes, remove and strain.  Pour into serving bowl.  Let cool completely.  Pour into jar, let rest 15 minutes.  Store the wine in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,part ricotta cheese,flour tortilla,ra el hanout spice mix,apple juice
title: Wicklewood's Apple Tortilla Quiches
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated flour tortilla | 3 cups part-skim ricotta cheese | 5 -6 tablespoons apple juice | 2 teaspoons dried chili pepper flakes | 1 1/4 teaspoons ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Cut tortillas into thirds and set aside in a baking dish, sprayed with non stick cooking spray.  Combine the ricotta and chile flakes.  Sprinkle evenly over the tortillas, then drizzle the apple juice over all.  Sprinkle the ras el hanout on top.  Dot with a little of the fat from the dried chili.  Bake in a 400 degree oven for 10 - 15 minutes.  Cool, cut in half and serve, or leave on the table.  We eat these with fresh fruit salsa and cream cheese.

title: Laurie's Steak in Caramelized Carrots
ingredients: 1/2 cup carrot, grated | 3/4 cup beef sirloin | 1/4 cup fresh flat leaf parsley, coarsely chopped
instructions: Pound grated carrot with flat side of meat pounder, or pound into 3/4 thick coins.  Spread one third of carrot coins on cutting board or rim of a plate.  Cut in half horizontally.  Top with remaining 1/4 each carrot coins& parsley.  Roll up lengthwise starting from bottom.  Wrap tightly in wax paper and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, preferably overnight.  In a 10 inch nonstick frypan or dutch oven with a lid, place 1 1/2 cups water, caramelized carrots, and reserved meat.  Simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.  Uncover and cook 45 minutes longer or until meat is fork tender.

title: Homemade Guacamole
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 2 teaspoons guacamole
instructions: Mix 1/2 teaspoons cayenne, 2 teaspoons of guacamole, or more if desired, in a glass or plastic container.

title: Pumpkin and Savory Dumplings (Granithes)
ingredients:
700 g fresh pumpkin ( about 1.
    -5kg weight ) | 1/4 cup sage, fresh leaves | 1 tablespoon savory | 2 hard-boiled eggs, coarsely chopped ( optional ) | 100 ml half-and-half or 100 ml cream | 1 tablespoon caster sugar ( superfine sugar ) or 1 tablespoon raw sugar, packed
instructions: Wash and scrub the pumpkin under cold running water.  Trim any excess fat off.  Cut a 1 cm wide x 2 cm long piece of rind from the pumpkin with scissors.  Rinse the piece under cold running water and pat dry.  Cut pumpkin into ¾ inch dice and place in a small casserole pan with a lid or tin foil.  Wrap a piece of rind in kitchen string and tie it with kitchen string.  Place pumpkin pieces, fat side up, in the dish with the sage and savory and stir gently.  Bring to the boil and simmer gently on base of a moderate heat for 45 - 50 minutes or until the pumpkin is quite soft and almost translucent but still holding its shape.  Strain pumpkin.  Add remaining ingredients and simmer gently for 15 minutes.  If it's too thick, stir in a little hot water.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: coconut oil,beef tenderloin steak,red chilies,bay leaf,lasagna noodle,green olive,orecchiette
title: Beef & Olives Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin steaks | 2 tablespoons coconut oil | 8 ounces lasagna noodles, medium | 2 red chilies, finely sliced | 1 bay leaf | 7 ounces macaroni noodles or 7 ounces fettuccine, cooked | 3 ounces mixed green olives, roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c.  Slice the steak and arrange on a roasting pan with a little coconut oil.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper and cook in the oven for 20 minutes or until cooked to your liking.  Set your oven to broil and place the lasagne noodles onto a baking sheet.  Heat a little coconut oil in a frying pan and cook the chillies and bay leaf for about 3 minutes, then transfer to a small ovenproof dish, pour the remaining coconut oil over the noodles.  Heat the mixture until boiling and then pour over the beef and vegetables.  Leave to stand for about 10 minutes to absorb the flavours.  While the beef is grilling, boil a large pot of water until it rises to the top.  Add the macaroni and cook until al dente.  Drain the noodles and return to the pot.  Place the beef and vegetables, macaroni and mixed olives into the pot.  Divide the noodles between ovenproof dishes.  Place the lasagne under your preheated broiler for 5 - 10 minutes until the top is bubbling, bubbling and golden and the bottom crust is golden.

title: Anchovy Paste (For Fish Fries)
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs fresh anchovies packed in oil | 1 cup white wine vinegar | 1 1/4 cups cake flour
instructions: Drain oil from anchovies reserving 1 cup of the oil.  Slice anchovies into slivers.  Prepare an anchovy paste by combining anchovies, vinegar and oil in a small pan.  Heat and stir over medium low heat until the anchovies are slightly melted.  Sift flour into a large bowl, add anchovy paste and mix until well blended.  Heat oil, a small amount at a time, in a large frying pan until hot.  The oil temperature should be about 375°f.  Drop a small amount of the mixture into the hot oil.  Fry fish in batches.  Turn once so they brown evenly and continue frying until cooked through.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,dark brown sugar,savoy cabbage,green onion
title: Spicy Savoy Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 2 heads savoy cabbage, cleaned ( or use green cabbage and turnip or baby yam, sliced fairly thinly ) | 12 green onions, chopped | 1/4 cup red curry paste, sweet | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar, packed
instructions: Steam the cabbage or turnip cabbage until you can tear apart the coarsley with a fork.  If leaves become to soft, drain very well.  Meanwhile, mix up the remaining ingredients and mix well.  Serve immediately.

title: Pastura
ingredients: 8 dried shiitake mushrooms, stems removed | 4 teaspoons corn oil | 1/4 lb ground veal | 4 ounces shiitake dried mushrooms | 3/4 cup orange juice | 3/4 cup pasta or 3/4 cup fettuccine
instructions: Cover shiitake with hot water, remove stems and soak in cold water about 20 minutes.  Drain.  Slice mushrooms thin and set aside for garnish.  Heat corn oil in a large, wide skillet.  Add ground veal and shiitake mushrooms and saute until browned.  Add orange juice and stir until incorporated and no blood seeps out.  Add drained shiitake and drained pasta or fettuccine pasta, and toss to coat.  Heat through.  Season with salt and pepper.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: banana pepper,purpose flour,rosemary,basil leaf,black bean,cream celery soup,pastry,beef bouillon cube
title: Beef Pastry Filling for Crock Pot
ingredients: 14 ounces condensed cream of celery soup or 14 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 2 -3 beef bouillon cubes | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil leaf or 1/4 cup parsley | 1 large banana pepper, seeded ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | pastry dough
instructions: Combine soup, broth ingredients and peppers, if using, in crock pot.  Cover and cook on low setting for 1 hour.  Remove pepper, remove from crock and stir.  Add enough flour to make a firm paste.  Stir paste into soup mixture.  Cook on low about 5 more hours.  Remove pepper and mash or knead well with a fork.  Return to crock pot and cook for about 15 minutes, stirring well.  Allow filling to thicken and flavor filling to blend with remaining flour.

title: Liqueur of Lamb
ingredients: 1 cup double cream | 1 lb boneless lamb meat, cut into 1-inch cubes | kosher salt
instructions: Pour cream into a small bowl, add lamb and sprinkle with salt to taste.  Cover loosely with plastic wrap.  Refrigerate for 3 - 4 hours, or until almost dry.  Serve with boiled potatoes if desired.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,sea salt pepper,dark rum,canola oil,chicken breast half,scotch whisky
title: Roast Chicken With Whiskey and Canola Oil
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 4 skinless bone-in chicken breast halves | sea salt and fresh ground pepper | 1 bottle scotch whisky | 1 1/2 cups low sodium chicken broth | 1 tablespoon dark rum ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f.  Heat the canola oil in a small saucepan over medium high heat until smoking.  Season each chicken breast with salt and pepper.  Place the chicken breasts in the pan.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine vinegar,cumin seed,lettuce leaf,wild rice
title: Wild Rice With Cumin
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cumin seed, toasted and cooled | 8 wild rice sticks ( or regular rice sticks ) | 2 leaves lettuce leaves, toasted and torn into smaller pieces | 1 teaspoon sherry wine vinegar
instructions: In hot skillet toast cumin over low heat, shaking skillet frequently until fragrant, about 5 minutes.  Stir in rice, and cook over very low heat, stirring constantly, until it turns golden brown, about 5 to 10 minutes.  Transfer to plate.  In skillet, heat sherry vinegar until warm, about 1 minute.  Remove from heat, add sherry vinegar, and sprinkle cumin over rice.  Season with salt and pepper.  Note, to toast cumin place in skillet or wok over medium heat to warm, stirring constantly, approximately 1 minute.  Pour vinegar mixture over rice.

Random Ingredients: pistachio nut,orange bell pepper,farfalle pasta,cabbage,golden syrup,bamboo skewer,lettuce,russet potato
title: Korean Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 large russet potato, peeled | 1 orange bell pepper | 1/2 head cabbage, cleaned and shredded | 1/2 cup pistachio nut, finely chopped | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1/4 cup ground pistachio nut | 12 -14 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes | 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | lettuce, to garnish
instructions: Cut the russet potato in half lengthwise and cut into thirds.  Cut bell pepper into slices about 1/2 inch thick and place in bowl.  Cut the head of cabbage into chunks 1/2 inch thick slices, set aside.  Cook pasta as per package directions until tender.  Drain.  Cut the potato in half crosswise.  Cut the potato into slices about 1/2 inch thick.  Place the russet potato, orange pepper slices, head of cabbage, pistachios and golden syrup in a large serving bowl.  Set aside.  Remove the outer leaves from the cabbage, discard.  Slice the potato around the core of the potato until the outer leaves are completely free of dirt.  Place the potatoes in a large serving bowl.  Stir to combine.  Add the ground pistachio nut, ground pistachio nuts and orange bell pepper chunks.  Toss everything together to coat all of the ingredients evenly.  Arrange the salad on a platter and garnish with lettuce.  Serve cool, room temperature or cold.

title: Gigantes (Pepper-Filled Easter Cookies)
ingredients: 2 medium yellow peppers | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 egg white | 12 hardboiled egg whites
instructions: Halve and deseed peppers, remove seeds, slice flesh into small rings and set aside until needed.  Beat egg white until stiff, add salt and pepper, and roll each pepper ring in the mixture.  Place on cookie sheet lined with parchment paper, shape into a circle or rectangle approx 1/8 inch thick and press 1 beaten egg white in each circle.  When all the peppers are filled, brush top of each mound of dough lightly with egg white and place a teaspoon of egg on top of the egg white and press in an egg yolk well.  Repeat for all peppers.  Refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours and dust with icing sugar.  If using small egg shaped cookies cut each egg into 4 wedges.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,sauerkraut,rice wine,asian dark sesame oil,sherry,baby corn
title: Sue's Asian Fried Vegetables
ingredients: 6 baby corn | 1 cup fresh asian-style dark sesame oil | 7 tablespoons shaoxing rice wine | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | vegetables, as needed | 1/4 cup sauerkraut, drained
instructions: Trim the corn on the cob or buy a corn grill.  If you can get them from the deli, you don't have to peel them.  If you don't have a grill, you can roast the corn directly under medium hot coals.  Cut off and slice the kernels from the cob about 1 1/2 inches long so it can stand up in a little chunky or slanted shape.  Wash and slice the asian style sesame oil into half inch wide strips about the width of an inch wide.  Put them in a small frying pan with a little olive oil and sherry.  Bring to boil over medium high heat.  Turn when oil starts to smoke.  They will start to pop and they will quickly wilt.

title: Pasteles de Carne (Cheese Triest)
ingredients: 250 g spinach ( cleaned, picked and chopped or shredded fine ) | 125 g cake flour or 125 g all-purpose flour ( 4 ounces )
instructions: Mix the chopped spinach and flour together in a bowl.  The mixture will be slightly thicker than the flour mixture if it is coarsely ground.  Roll the flour mix into dough and cut into 2 pieces.  You should get about 16 pieces.  Cook in a deep skillet over medium heat for about 3 - 5 minutes, or until browned.

title: Omelett Pudding
ingredients: 1 sheet nori | 1 medium yellow peppers or 1 medium green hot pepper
instructions: Wrap the nori around the pepper.  Secure edges with your hands.  Heat a skillet over medium heat.  Put 1 sheet of nori in the skillet.  Pour in a few tablespoons of the hot water.  If the edge is getting too dry, add another tablespoon of cold water.  Put the top sheet of nori on the pan.  Cook, without turning, until golden, about 1 minute.  Transfer to a cutting board.  Cut into fingers.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: coconut,bulgar wheat,cream tartar,corn syrup,cumin,self raising flour
title: Bulgur and Coconut Scones
ingredients: 1 cup bulgar wheat | 1/4 cup shredded coconut | 1/4 cup chopped roasted peanuts or 1/4 cup chopped cashews | 2 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 2 teaspoons cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 1 teaspoon corn syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c.  Mix bulges and coconut together in a large bowl, and stir in peanuts, nuts and other spices.  Add flour and spice mix.  Mix well until dough forms.  Turn onto a lightly floured board and knead lightly a couple of times.  Pat or roll into a thin circle approximately 2mm thick.  Cut into 12 wedges.  Place on a greased tray.  Brush with beaten egg.  Bake approx 15 - 18 minutes or until golden and risen.  Serve wedges warm with butter.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,yellow cake mix,lemon curd,seasoning salt,chicken,chocolate syrup
title: Granny's Chocolate Lemon Chicken Cupcakes
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self raising flour | 1 yellow cake mix | 3/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/2 cup melted chocolate syrup | 1 1/2 - 2 1/2 lbs cooked chicken, shredded | 1/4 cup fresh lemon curd ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c.  Lightly grease 15 muffin cups or line them with paper line muffin cups.  In a bowl combine together flour, cake mix, and seasoning salt.  Mix in melted chocolate syrup until a smooth dough forms.  Using a spoon, mix in shredded chicken.  Sprinkle with lemon curd, if using.  Fill cups a good tablespoon full of the dough for each cupcake in the cups.  Bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Green Chili Cheese Balls
ingredients: 4 lbs gruyere cheese ( or any other hard aged cheese ) | 1/2 cup green chili, chopped ( or less to taste ) | 2 tablespoons passion fruit, pulp or 2 tablespoons crushed passion fruit pulp
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together until all ingredients are incorporated to form a loose ball shaped ball, but the mixture should still be slightly lumpy.  Roll the balls in old fashioned grits or pita bread.

title: Chilly Leeks and Goat Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs frozen light green peppers, thawed, drained, cut into 1/2 inch slices ( or use bottled, pepper ) | 2 lbs thickly sliced leeks ( white parts only, rinsed well in a colander, drained, and cut into 1/4 inch slices ) | 1 tablespoon arrowroot ( or cornstarch ) | 1 cup unsweetened applesauce | 1 cup unsweetened plain greek yogurt | 3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh sage leaves | ice water, as needed
instructions: Arrange green peppers, leeks, and arrowroot in 2 to 3 large resealable plastic bags or other containers in layers, about 6 cups each.  In a small bowl, beat apple sauce, yogurt, and sage until smooth.  Sprinkle remaining 1 tablespoon of the grated cheese over top of vegetables, pressing gently to adhere.  Arrange leeks on top in even rows and pour in apple mixture.  Seal and refrigerate, turning bag to distribute sauce evenly and shaking bag occasionally, for 1 to 4 hours.  Preheat broiler or set a rack in the top third of your oven.  Place 1 cup ice water in a small bowl and set remaining 1 teaspoon of cheese in it.  Place bag, cheese side up, over pan and press gently with a spatula to compact.  Broil or bake until cheese is bubbling and lightly toasted, 3 - 3 minutes.  Watch carefully, this can take up to 15 minutes, depending on thickness of bag.  Serve warm.

title: Baked Peas and Apricots
ingredients: 2 packages frozen peas | 1 1/2 cups tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons tahini ( sesame seed paste ) | 3 tablespoons honey | 2 tablespoons creme de cacao | 1/3 cup apricot, chopped
instructions: Defrost peas in microwave for 1 minute.  Place peas in a 9x13 baking pan and spray with cooking spray.  Pour tomato sauce on top of peas.  Sprinkle tahini cheese on top of tomato sauce.  Sprinkle honey and creme de cacao on top of honey and creme de cacao.  Bake at 350 degrees f.  For an extra burst of wow, top with chopped apricots.

title: Chicken and Eggplant Soup
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken breasts or 2 lbs duck, cut into small pieces | 1 eggplant | 2 -4 tablespoons peanut oil or 2 -4 tablespoons vegetable oil, divided | 3 cans chicken broth, divided | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, chopped | 1/2 cup dried breaded apple, chopped | seasoning salt | 1 pinch ground mace
instructions: Trim the meat and skin from the eggplant.  Halve lengthwise and cut crosswise into 1/4 thick slices.  Sprinkle both sides with salt and set aside.  Cut the eggplant into half inch slices.  Place in a colander and sprinkle liberally with salt.  Drain.  Heat 2 t oil in a 6 qt saucepan over medium heat.  Working in batches, cook the eggplant slices until softened, about 2 minutes per side.  Remove the eggplant and set aside.  In a large saucepan or stewpot, heat 2 t oil over medium heat.  Place chicken in the hot oil and brown on outside but not cooked side.  Stir frequently to coat the pieces with oil.  Add 6 cups chicken broth, the meat, sliced eggplant, hazelnuts, breaded apples and season with salt.  Bring to a boil.  Cover, reduce heat, and simmer until the eggplant is tender, about 30 minutes.

title: Easy Satay Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup ketchup | 1/4 teaspoon tandoori masala | 1 stalk celery, chopped
instructions: Mix ketchup and tandoori garam masala together to make sauce.  Saute green chilly or dried chilis in water for 5 - 7 minutes.  Serve over your favorite veal.

title: Ras El Hanout (East Indian Vegetable Juice Using Coconut Milk)
ingredients: 2 small cups unsweetened coconut milk | 2 tablespoons vinegar ( optional ) | 1/2 cup chopped pistachios | 8 cups unsalted corn flakes | 4 tablespoons lemon juice ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons teabags ( optional )
instructions: Place sugar in a large saucepan and warm over medium high until a golden brown color, shaking the pan about every few minutes.  Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the vinegar, if using, then add the coconut milk and bring to a boil.  Once the coconut milk comes to a boil add the pistachios, stirring to coat both.  Reduce the heat to low.  Cover and simmer over low heat for 30 minutes.  Meanwhile, toast corn flakes until fragrant using a mortar and pestle or dry, but shaking the pan occasionally.  Remove the casings from the corn flakes and set aside.  Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the lemon juice, if using.  Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the teabags into the fruit mixture.  Serve, passing the ras el hanout on a warm platter.

Random Ingredients: coriander leaf,no salt tomato,dark chocolate,cooking spray
title: Somerset Tomatoes for a Rainy Day Wonder!
ingredients: 2 tablespoons no-salt-added tomato, pulp ( or 2 tablespoons tomato puree ) | 2 tablespoons coriander leaves, chopped | 100 g dark chocolate, chopped finely | cooking spray
instructions: Place tomatoes, coriander and chocolate in a bowl and drizzle with a little water.  Stir to combine and transfer to an airtight container.  Cool to room temperature, then chill up to 6 hours.  Serve.

title: Meat With Onions in Wine
ingredients: 2 lbs lean meat | 6 ounces dry penne | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 2 tablespoons chardonnay army sherry | 4 ounces sweet marsala wine
instructions: Mix the meat with 3 ozs of marnade.  Brown the meat.  Add the rest of the marnade, and bring to the boil.  Simmer for 2 hours over low heat.  While that is simmering, cook pasta according to package directions.  When water is boiled, add the cooked pasta to the simmering pasta.  Cover with tomato paste.  When the sauce is at the desired thickness, serve.

title: Quick and Easy Chicken Cordon Bleu
ingredients: 10 medium russet potatoes, peeled | 2 pounds chicken pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place russet potatoes onto the counter and poke them with a fork, then slice thinly on the diagonal, about half an inch thick.  Cut a slit lengthwise down the center of each piece of potato, then scoop the potato to the side, spreading the slices lightly.  Arrange chicken slices in a large baking dish.  If there are any gaps, fill them with water so that they don't dry out.  Bake in the preheated oven until the chicken is no longer pink at the center and juices run clear, 1 to 1 1/2 hours.  When done, turn the oven to broil and broil the chicken for about 5 minutes or until juices run clear.  Place chicken on a platter and serve.

title: Wrapped Asparagus with Shrimp and Provolone
ingredients: 1 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/2 pound blanched slivered almonds or toasted slivered almonds | 9 thin slices provolone cheese | 3 large leeks, white parts only, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh leeks, white parts only | 2 teaspoons almond extract | 1 package frozen pearl onions, thawed
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Add shrimp and blanched slivered almonds and cook until shrimp just turn pink, 1 to 2 minutes.  Drain shrimp and set aside. Stir in the chicken and scallops until coated with marshmallow flavored mixture, and remove from heat.  Drain crabmeat, and arrange over the marshmallow side by side. Pour peanut butter over the pastry, and refrigerate until chocolate has melted and set, approximately 1 hour.  Cut into slices, and serve.

title: Texas Sweet Chili

title: Peking Chicken

instructions: Mix ketchup, chili peppers and lemon juice.  Marinate chicken in sauce for 15 minutes in refrigerator, turning every 45 minutes before baking.  Bake in 350 f oven for 45 to 55 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Gulawah

instructions: Toast the turmeric in a heavy skillet over medium high heat, scraping up any browned brown bits.  Remove from heat, and pour off all but 2 tablespoons of the fragrance.  Place the pork in a large, heavy frying pan.  Pour in the spice mixture, and gently press the spices down into the meat.  Add the peas, and press into the pork.  Stir, and cover the pan.  Cook over medium low heat until the meat is very tender, and the peas are tender, about 1 hour.

title: Cafe Sufgan Ka'ab
ingredients: 1 lb broccoli | 1 tablespoon harissa | 1 jalapeno, chopped | 1 tablespoon cilantro leaf, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Clean the broccoli and cut it into florets.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Put the broccoli, harissa, jalapeños, cilantro and cinnamon into a food processor or blender.  Process till the mixture reaches the desired consistency.  The masala is not as chunky as spicy paste.  Transfer the mixture to 2 soup tins and allow to cool.

instructions: Prepare onions soup mix according to package directions.  Place cabbage leaves in bowl of food processor and chop very fine. Random Ingredients: peanut,asiago cheese,hoisin sauce,ice,red chili powder,bay leaf

Random Ingredients: mango,anchovy fillet,granny smith apple,spicy sausage,rosemary leaf
title: Apple - Pork, Granny Smith Sausage and Mango Stew

instructions: Heat large wok over low heat.  Add oil and swirl to coat sides with oil.  Sauté sausages and apple until beginning to brown, about 5 minutes.  Add green mango, anchovies and rosemary. title: Baby Spinach and Lamb Chops
ingredients: 14 slices lamb chops ( thick and sizzling ) | 2 baby beets, peeled ( optional ) | 2 1/2 cups baby spinach
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c.  Wrap each chop in aluminium foil and place on a baking tray.  Spray foil with oil spray.  Place into hot oven and cook for 20 minutes or until cooked to your liking.  Remove from oven, scatter beetroot over and cover.  Bake for a further 20 minutes or until spinach has wilted and the beetroot is crisp and tender.  Remove from oven and spoon over the hot lamb and spinach.  Toss and serve the salad immediately.

title: Baby Bok Choy With vermicelli (Firikake Gomen)
ingredients: 1/4 lb vermicelli ( or fettucini ) | 7 -8 baby bok choy
instructions: 1 remove the stalks from the bok choy and cut the bottoms into 3 - 3 lengths.  1 cook the vermicelli in a pan of boiling water for 3 - 4 minutes add 1/4 cup of the cooking water to the noodles and continue to cook until the water turns the noodles al dente.  2 drain the noodles and run them gently over a wok of boiling water until all of the water has been absorbed.  3 drain the noodles and set them aside.  4 add 2 - 3 tbs of the cooking water to the noodles and heat through.  5 add as many baby bok choy as you can fit in your wok and stirfry until the greens just starts to wilt and the greens are beginning to curl up.  6 sprinkle with more vermicelli and serve.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,sea salt,chorizo sausage,ham stock,flat leaf parsley,hickory bacon,grain white rice,pineapple
title: Mexican Chorizo and Pineapple Risotto
ingredients: 1 bunch flat leaf parsley, very finely chopped | 600 g chorizo sausage, finely diced | 2 cans good quality ham stock | 1 cup short-grain white rice, such as arborio | 1 -2 cup canned crushed pineapple, with their juice | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, toasted | sea salt, to taste | cranched cooked ham, slices to serve
instructions: Place the parsley and chorizo in a large saucepan.  Add just enough stock to cover the ingredients by 1 inch. Cover, and leave to stand for 20 minutes or until all the liquid is absorbed. Serve immediately with freshly ground black pepper. instructions: Combine kosher salt and dry meat in a bowl.  Gradually add liqueur, stirring until thoroughly combined.

title: Salsa Verde Hot Sauce

instructions: Put chilies on the grill.  Grill on very low heat with the pan under it until the chilies become black and the green chilies become crispy. title: Easy Short-grain White Rice #5FIX

Taste for seasoning, and drizzle with the hot sauce to taste.

instructions: Preheat your oven to 325°f.  Line a 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking pan with parchment paper or foil, and grease it lightly.  Beat your chocolates and cream until smooth.  Stir in your stuffing mix, salt and 1/3 cup Grand Marnier or amaretto.

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Arrange chicken in ungreased 3 quart casserole dish.  Cover and bake about 60 minutes, stirring chicken, until juices run clear. Pour any remaining grease out of the pan.  Pour apricots, preserves, and chicken into pan and toss.  Pour mixture over chicken.  Bake uncovered about 20 minutes, stirring chicken occasionally.

instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Rinse pork loin.  Cut into 1 inch pieces.  Place in an 8x8 inch casserole dish.  Pour beer over pork. instructions: Place tomato halves, green chillies, celery, lemon peel and kidney beans in a large bowl.  Place hot sauce, cocoa in a small bowl with hot water and stir until smooth.
