title: Easy Basic British Digestive Sugar
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coarse sea salt | 1 tablespoon granulated golden caster sugar ( granular )
instructions: Place a large sieve into a large pan or bowl with a tight fitting lid.  Line the sieve with cheesecloth, allowing the water to drain into it.  Combine the salt with the sugar.  Add the mixture to the sieve and gradually mix in enough hot water to cover the bottom of the sieve.  Allow the mixture to drip off as it hits the water.  Drain the excess water away as quickly as possible.  It will take about 7 - 8 minutes to reach the proper consistency of the syrup.  Transfer the drainage liquid to a clean, dry container and store in the fridge for 1 - 2 weeks.  Store in a cool place away from light.  It can last indefinitely by adding a few teaspoons of granular sugar to any dry ingredients or by pouring the water over them and mixing them in gently.

title: Garden Rachael Ray's Crunchy Fajitas
ingredients: 3 tablespoons oysters, drained and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon brandy | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 2 tablespoons salad dressing ( diana's ) | 2 rachael ray grillers, cut diagonally, or coarsely chopped | 4 tablespoons crispy dry fried ham, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons romaine lettuce | 1 tablespoon graham crackers
instructions: Combine the oysters, brandy, and oregano in a small bowl.  Add the salad dressing and cheese.

title: Blueberry Gravy
ingredients: 1 pint blueberries | 1 package sazon goya | 1 cube chicken bouillon
instructions: Place all ingredients in saucepan and heat.

title: Potato Stuffed French Bread
ingredients: 2 lbs baking potatoes, unpeeled | 1 large yellow onion, cut into 6 slices | 16 ounces cream cheese | 12 ounces mushrooms, quartered | 4 french baguettes, split
instructions: Boil potatoes in a large pot of water until almost tender.  Drain and mash potatoes with a fork until smooth.  Stir in sliced onion, and spoon into a buttered 9x13 baking pan.  Cover with 8 ounces cream cheese and mushroom pieces.  Top with 8 slices of baguette.  Cut a slit along the top of each loaf and fill loaf with 1/4 to 1/2 cup potato mixture.  Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour, basting occasionally.

Random Ingredients: vanilla sugar,ice water,bread flour,ziti pasta,orange juice zest,queso fresco
title: Pasta Fritters With Ziti and Orange
ingredients: 4 cups bread flour or 4 cups pastry flour, all purpose | 1 orange, juice and zest of | 4 cups ice water | 1/2 cup queso fresco | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 3 1/2 cups dry ziti pasta or 3 1/2 cups other short pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Add ice water to bowl.  Place flour in large ziploc and gradually add salt.  Add orange zest and juice, stir well to combine.  Gradually add water 1/4 cup at a time.  Add cheese and vanilla sugar and continue to add flour until mixture is stiff and shiny.  Stir in pasta.  Transfer to baking paper lined 13x9 inch baking pan.  Bake at 375° until golden, about 25 - 30 minutes.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Blueberry Relish
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh blueberries ( cracked or fresh or frozen ) | 2 tablespoons wattle seed | dried chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon brandy
instructions: Place berries and seeds in a medium size pot.  Pour in enough cold water to cover berries and place over medium heat.  When berries have begun to fall, gently squeeze out as much water as possible.  When all moisture is drained, stir in brandy and return to a boil.  Reduce heat to low and simmer for 2 minutes.  Remove from heat and let stand until cool.  Place in clean jar with tight fitting lid.  Keeps in refrigerator for at least a month prior to making.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,sesame oil,button mushroom,vegetable stock,hot italian sausage
title: Vegetable Soup-Style
ingredients: 1 can vegetable stock | 8 ounces sweet italian sausage | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 1 jar button mushrooms, cleaned | 8 ounces mixed vegetables, cleaned
instructions: Cook sausage in skillet until it is just beginning to brown.  Drain, and allow sausage to cool.  Cut up sausage into 1/2 inch pieces and set aside.  Drain mushroom and set aside.  Cut vegetables into slices about 1/2 inch wide and 1/2 inch long.  Cut sausage into thirds and set aside.  Add vegetable stock to sausage and vegetables and bring to boil.  Add sesame oil and sausage to soup.  Simmer for approximately 30 minutes to blend flavors.  Serve hot with fresh bread.

title: Yogurt Bombe
ingredients: 12 slices white bread, crusts removed and bread toasted | 1 lb fresh yogurt | 1 cup oil free plain yogurt ( see instructions below ) or 1 cup fat free sour cream ( see instructions below ) | cornflour
instructions: First you need a piece of bread that will fit into your belgian oven.  Slice a circle of aluminium foil big enough to fit in your oven dish.  Place a circle of plain bread on the foil and lightly buttered.  Sprinkle cheese over the bread.  Next, pour a layer of yogurt, followed by a little more of your yogurt or sour cream, then top with cheese again.  Repeat the process until bread and yogurt is used up.  Place in oven to heat through.  When you are ready to serve, cut the bread in half, and serve with your extra yogurt or sour cream.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,cake flour,yellow miso,chick pea,veal,taco sauce,ginger root,hot water
title: Jamaican Patties
ingredients: 1 package yellow miso | 1 package white vinegar | 1 package chopped fresh ginger root | 5 cans chick-peas ( drained and rinsed ) | 1/4 cup hot water | 2 packages frozen pound roast, coarsely chopped | 1 package shredded sirloin steak | 1 cup cake flour | 2 cups taco sauce
instructions: In a large stock pot, add the miso, vinegar, ginger root and chickpeas.  Bring mixture to a boil, then remove from heat.  Stir in the hot water, and allow to cool.  Preheat your grill or oven to 400 degrees f.  When the butter has melted, add the roast and sirloin steak.  Oil your hands and work the meat into small meatballs or patty shapes.  Dust the patty shapes with flour and saute for about 10 minutes, until the meat is browned.  Spread out about 1 1/2 tablespoons of taco sauce in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Place the patties in the dish, and pour the remaining taco sauce over the top.  Bake at 400 degrees f for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Paolo's Famous Chicken Hoagies
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chicken | 1/4 cup onion ( finely chopped ) | 1 pinch saffron | 8 ounces angel hair pasta ( uncooked ) | 8 hoagie rolls | 3 tomatoes, medium size | crushed sweet potato flakes | 3/4 cup triple sec
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Place chicken in skillet over medium heat and add oil or melted cooking spray.  When heated through, add onion and saffron.  Cook until onion has softened and add tomatoes.  Simmer for 3 mintues.  While chicken is simmering, cook pasta according to package directions until al dente, rinse and drain.  Cut a slit in each hoagie roll and place on a cookie sheet to keep them from open up while preparing pasta.  Place pasta in a large mixing bowl and add chicken, tomato sauce, and saffron.  Toss until chicken is coated.  Add cooked pasta and toss to coat.  Serve warm with a dash of crushed sweet potato or a few shakes of crushed sweet potato.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,chicken bouillon granule,french bread,vegetable oil cooking spray,cannellini bean,lamb shoulder,pepper sauce,sunflower oil
title: Beef-Lamb Stew With Brown Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking oil, sunflower oil is not recommended | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 2 lbs boneless lamb shoulder or 2 lbs blade steaks, cut into 3 inch cubes | 1 large french bread, cut into 1 inch chunks | 1 can cannellini beans, undrained | 1/4 cup sunflower oil | 1 tablespoon fresh serrano pepper, minced
instructions: Heat oven to 450°f heat oil in large dutch oven over medium heat.  Add hot pepper sauce, bouillon and browned meat.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,red bell pepper,dark brown sugar,kielbasa
title: Kielbasa
ingredients: 8 ounces kielbasa | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup packed dark brown sugar | 1 red bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Poke holes with a fork in the kielbasa.  Combine vinegar, brown sugar and chopped red bell pepper in a saucepan.

title: Lobster Soup
ingredients: 1 package fresh lobster meat, shelled, chopped | 2 cans chopped spinach leaves
instructions: Place the lobstermeat and fresh spinach into a blender or food processor.  Blend to a very thin paste.  Pour into a 2 1/2 to 3 quart slow cooker.  Cover and cook on high setting for 10 minutes.  Reduce heat to low and continue cooking and stirring for an additional 5 minutes.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,trout,mushroom stem,cinnamon,spanish onion,white breadcrumb,asafoetida powder
title: Trout Patties
ingredients: 6 large mushroom stems, whole | 1 spanish onion, large | 1 tablespoon white breadcrumb | 1 teaspoon dried cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1 dash asafoetida powder, for color | 2 slices smoked trout, smoked, with skin
instructions: Mix dry breadcrumbs, cinnamon, cardamom and asafoetida into the onions.  Form 4 patties of the bread crumb mixture about 3/4 inch thick.  Sprinkle fish with fay cooking spray on both sides.  Then press lightly with moistened fingers against the side of the patties.  Place the onions on the breaded side of the dough using the other side with the crumb mixture.  Fry the fish until golden brown, about 3 minutes per side.  Note, you can also grill on the grill.

Random Ingredients: grape tomato,burgundy wine,sirloin steak,oregano,corn flake,cube steak
title: Italian Steak and Tomato Soup
ingredients: 4 ounces cube steak, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup grape tomatoes, quartered | 1/1 cup sweet corn flakes | 2 teaspoons dried oregano | 1 cup burgundy wine | 2 tablespoons shredded marble steak
instructions: Combine steak, tomato, cornflake crumbs and oregano.  Add wine.  Heat gently in a large saucepan.

title: Chunky Cheese Roast Potatoes
ingredients: 300 g chunky salsa ( i like pace salsa best ) | 1 teaspoon harissa | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 potato, sliced | 2 teaspoons gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c gas mark 7 and grease and line a baking tray with baking paper.  Pour the salsa all the way to the edges of the tray, then scatter over the harissa, onion powder, cloves and cheese.  Place the potato slices on the salsa.  Cook for 35 - 40 minutes or until the potatoes are just cooked through and the cheese has melted.  Transfer to a plate and leave to rest for 10 minutes before slicing.  Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: egg white,black bean,sole fillet,pork loin roast
title: Pork Loin with Black Beans
ingredients: 4 pounds pork loin roast | 1 can or bottle beer | 4 egg whites | 2 cans black beans, undrained
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f.  Place pork loin in a 9x12 inch baking dish.  Pour beer over top.  Cover dish with foil.  Bake in the preheated oven until pork is very tender and juices run clear, about 2 hours.  An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 145 degrees f.  Set aside, reserving juices, and allow pork to cool to room temperature.  Shred pork with two forks, discarding fat and bones.  Combine egg whites and black beans in a large bowl.  Stir in pork mixture until thoroughly combined.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  The morning of baking, remove aluminum foil and bake in preheated oven until pork is golden brown and tender, about 1 hour 15 minutes.  An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 145 degrees f.  Remove meat from oven, sprinkle with reserved black beans, and allow to sit 10 minutes before slicing to serve.

title: Stool-Man-Dried-Lamb Pot Pie
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 1/4 lbs beef | 1 package frozen ground lamb | 4 tablespoons brown rice, uncooked | 1 beef bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons beef gravy powder ( or gravy granules )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Cook beef, lamb, rice & bouillon cube in 2 tbsp water over medium heat until beef is browned and lamb is cooked through.  Add brown rice.  Place thawed pastry into a pastry bag with a large tip.  Moisten the edge of the bag with water till you get a 1/8 inch thick sealed rim.  Squish bag till the pastry bag is flat, then fold the rim in half and seal the sealing.  Repeat for 2 more bags.  You want your bag to be big enough to hold it in the oven.  Open the pastry bag and place into the bottom of a deep roasting pan.  Press the contents of the pastry bag into the bottom of the pan.  Carefully top the pastry bag with the meat mixture.  Squeeze out the air before sealing.  The top bag should fit snugly.  Add gravy powder to the empty pastry bag and mix with the contents of the pastry bag.  Spread on top of meat & bake in the middle of the oven for about 1 hour, till the pastry is golden brown.

title: Buko Five Ways (Potato Soup)
ingredients: 5 white potatoes, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh lemongrass ( known as thai lemongrass ) | 1 cup tomato juice
instructions: Combine potatoes, lemongrass, and tomato juice in a bowl.  Serve in bowls with chunks of rice.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,potato,wide egg noodle direction,sauce,sage leaf,guinness stout
title: Irish Potatoes with Beer Noodles
ingredients: 3 -4 large potatoes, peeled and sliced | 2 -3 drops hot sauce | 3 tablespoons fresh sage leaves | 2 teaspoons minced orange zest | 1 package wide egg noodles, the directions on the package indicate | 1 bottle guinness stout
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, add sliced potatoes & heat through.  This will take several minutes.  Drain the potatoes & add hot sauce, herbs & zest.  When cool, add noodles and let them stand for 10 - 15 minutes.  Stir & serve.  I use the hot sauce for flavoring the noodles and also a sprinkle of paprika for colour when served alongside them.

title: Kheema Lamb Kebabs for 2
ingredients: 600 g lamb or 600 g goat meat, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups plain flour | 1/3 cup coriander, chopped | 1/4 cup green onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 1 tablespoon dried cherries
instructions: Mix flour, coriander, onion, caraway seeds and cherries in a bowl.  Add lamb and rub in flour mix until evenly combined.  Roll each piece in the mixture and place on a preheated grill over medium high heat for 4 - 5 minutes on one side.  Turn and cook for 8 - 10 minutes, or until browned.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,plum tomato,mexican rice,potato,iceberg lettuce,pineapple juice,pearl barley,heavy cream
title: Veggie-Full-Of-Grain Barley-And-Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 large head iceberg lettuce, chopped | 1 package frozen pearl barley | 1 can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 2 cups chopped plum tomatoes ( optional ) | 2 cans crushed canned pineapple tidbits, not drained | 4 cups mexican rice ( not long grain or fast cooking rice ) | 1 cup heavy cream | 2 quarts iceberg lettuce, shredded | 2 containers frozen artichoke hearts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°.  Spray a 9 x13 baking pan with nonstick cooking spray.  In a large bowl, combine the first five ingredients.  Transfer mixture to the prepared baking pan. Bake 45 minutes, or until bubbly and rice is tender.  Garnish with artichoke hearts.  To make ahead, place the cassarole into an airtight container and cover with plastic wrap.  The cassarole can be made up to two days ahead.  Keep in mind that it will be refrigerated and reheated at the end of baking.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,half,basil leaf,red cabbage,spaghetti sauce,cream cheese
title: Spaghetti Napoli

instructions: Spread pasta in a large skillet.  Place the spaghetti sauce evenly over the top of the pasta, and then cover the spaghetti with a lid.  Mix together cream cheese, red cabbage and half and half, chili flakes and if using, basil and pour over pasta.  Cover and let sauce simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occassionally.

Random Ingredients: rice,self raising flour,harissa,onion salt,lite olive oil,green bean
title: Green Beans and Rice
ingredients: 3/4 cup green beans, trimmed | 1/2 cup rice, cleaned | 1/4 cup onions or 1/4 cup shallot, finely chopped | 1/4 tablespoon harissa | 2 teaspoons lite olive oil or 2 teaspoons sunflower oil | 3/4 cup self raising flour | 1/4 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: Prepare rice.  Soak the beans in warm water for 20 minutes.  Rinse and cook rice.  Wash and drain beans.  Preheat oven to 180c.  Mix all ingredients together well.  Add more harissa if desired.  Grease a 10cm x 2 3/4 cup capacity ovenproof dish or a 12cm x 21cm ovenproof non stick pan.  Heat oil in pan, add beans and fry gently for 10 mins or until golden brown all over.  Remove from heat and pour into prepared dish or slice into squares and scatter over rice.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,tamari soy sauce,green olive,potato,rom tomato,chuck steak,chicken thigh,salt
title: African Burger
ingredients: 3 large potatoes, sliced | 2 lbs chuck steaks or 2 lbs pork steaks | 2 lbs skinless chicken thighs | 2 lbs roma tomatoes, sliced thinly | 25 green olives, sliced | 2 tablespoons tamari soy sauce | 2 tablespoons vanilla beans | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, saute potatoes in butter until golden brown and tender.  Remove potatoes to a plate.  Remove steaks from skillet and cut into 1/2in long strips.  Season to taste with salt and set aside.  Place chicken, tomatoes, olives, soy sauce, vanilla beans and remaining ingredients in a large freezer bag.  Seal and freeze.  Remove the meat from the bag and discard the onion and tomato pieces, and save for another use.  Add the meat to the bag and gently toss to coat.  Grill the meat until cooked to your desired tastes.  Allow to rest 5 minutes before serving.  Serve with rice or noodles or a side dish.

title: Crab Rillettes
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets ( skin removed or 1-2 breasts ) | 1 cup basmati rice, uncooked | 1/4 cup canned crabmeat ( flaked ) | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 3 -5 drops mirin | 4 sheets cooked rice, to serve
instructions: Place salmon in a shallow dish or dish, sprinkle with onion powder and enough mirin to cover flesh completely.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 days.  Pre heat grill to medium coals or gas mark using about an olive oil cooking mat as a guide.  Spray one side of each salmon fillet with cooking oil spray.  Spray uncooked rice in a pan of hot grilling, or the other way you like your rice and put it under grill for about 3 minutes on each side.  Remove from grill to a large platter and spoon crab meat onto one side of each salmon skin.  Sprinkle with minced onion or julienned onions.  Roll salmon up tightly and place each flake roll onto heated rice and top each roll with more crab meat and onion.  Serve hot.

title: Roasted Veggies
ingredients: 1/4 cup mixed vegetables ( carrots, cauliflower and potatoes ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

title: Cashew and Potato Rounds
ingredients: 4 very large baking potatoes | 1/2 cup cashews
instructions: Scrub potato and cut into 6 rounds or circles.  Arrange round on a lightly greased baking tray.  Sprinkle with a little salt.  Bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 200 degrees c.  Drain on paper towel.  Serve with sweet chilli sauce.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,scallion,farfalle pasta,sage leaf,cooking oil,button mushroom
title: Pasta with Sage and Mushrooms
ingredients: 600 g farfalle pasta | cooking oil | 4 scallions, chopped | 500 g fresh button mushrooms | 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 6 sage leaves, chopped
instructions: Cook pasta for 8 minutes or according to the instructions on the pack.  Meanwhile, heat oil in a large frying pan, add scallions and mushrooms and cook to soften.  Stir in soy sauce and cooked pasta and heat through.  Season and serve.

title: Baked Chili Dogs
ingredients: 12 hamburger | 2 serrano chili, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Brown whole chili dogs.  Spray with pam cooking spray.  Bake for 10 minutes.  Spray fry pan with pam coating.  Return chili to oven for 15 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Beef & Onions
ingredients: 1 package penne ( i use the whole bag ) | 1 1/2 lbs stew meat | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 small white pearl onion
instructions: Brown meat and onion in a bit of butter.  Add seasoning salt.  Add dry penne.  Simmer on low for 30 minutes.  Serve in large salad bowl with a nice red salad.

title: Easy Baklava
ingredients: 300 g walnut pieces, skinned and cut small | 2 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 teaspoon coriander seeds
instructions: Preheat oven 350 degrees f.  Spread walnut pieces on a baking sheet.  Bake in the oven until they sound hollow when tapped on the surface.  Cool.  Take phyllo pastry sheet out of oven and spread with walnut pieces.  Roll into a 24 x 12 rectangle, brushing each with some peanut oil.  Sprinkle coriander seeds over this and roll up.  Repeat with other pastry sheet, leaving enough space in between each roll to roll up and without touching your seam.  Lay rolled pastry sheet on a clean baking pan and brush with remaining peanut oil.  Place in the preheated oven and bake until walnuts are lightly browned.  Cut pastry into quarters with a pizza cutter and serve with yoghurt or yoghurt and honey for a more interesting look.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,coconut oil,tea,cream chicken soup,rosemary,parsley sprig,filling
title: Tasty Spaghetti
ingredients: 4 tablespoons sesame oil | 400 g cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon maple tea | 200 g reduced-fat sour cream or 200 g low-fat sour cream | 1 -2 fresh rosemary or 1 -2 teaspoon dried rosemary, crushed | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh parsley sprigs | 1 cup extra sesame oil
instructions: Dissolve soup with maple syrup in a large bowl, stirring well.  Add sour cream, rosemary or dried rosemary, parsley and sesame oil.  Heat both oils in a large frying pan until smoking, then stir fry spaghetti.  Serve topped with sauteed sesame seeds if desired.

title: Low Fat Turkish Yogurt With Mint
ingredients: 500 ml greek yogurt, plain ( preferably, non-fat ) | 2 tablespoons dried mint | 1 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon tomato puree ( optional )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl to taste.  Chill in the fridge.  Serve chilled.  Note, this is also nice warm with saffron or a few small blanched whole almonds or pistachios for garnishing your dish.  If serving as an appetiser, you will need more yogurt.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine,active yeast,white rice,mozzarella cheese,avocado,saffron strand,daikon radish
title: Saffron Rice With Avocados and Saffron
ingredients:
1 packet active dry yeast or 1 package fast rising yeast | 1 teaspoon saffron strand ( or 2 tblsp.
    - molasses ) | 2 cups warm white rice | 8 ounces fresh mozzarella cheese, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 small ripe avocados, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1/2 cup sherry wine
instructions: The night before preparation, prepare the rice according to the directions on the packet.  Place the rice and mozzarella pieces into a glass bowl. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Pour 3 1/2 cups of water into a large rimmed dutch oven.  Place a rack in the lower third of the oven and heat the water to just under the top third.  Place the tomato slices, avocado slices and saffron into separate dutch ovens.  Bake the rice for 15 - 18 minutes, or until the mozzarella begins to brown.

title: German Apple Chocolate Chip Cake
ingredients: 16 ounces sliced bacon, cooked, drained and finely diced | 10 ounces sweet potato apples, peeled, cored, sliced thinly | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 1/4 cup grand marnier or 1/4 cup orange juice | 3 tablespoons grand marnier | 1/4 cup sweet corn | 14 ounces ladyfingers, split | 1 cup milk chocolate chips
instructions: Cook bacon in a 2 quart saucepan over medium high heat, stirring constantly, until just tender, about 5 minutes.  Drain bacon, add to the pan, and cook until crisp.  Add the apple, cilantro, grand marnier and sour cream.

title: Coconut Flour Pan Seared Sticky Beef

instructions: Heat 1/4 cup of coconut oil in a pan and cook the red chili and beef over high heat until the beef is browned.  Remove and set aside.  Heat the remaining 1/4 cup oil in a large frying pan and add the chickpea flour. Remove from the heat and stir in the oats until coated in the flour mixture.  Pour the coconut mixture over the steak and serve.

title: Teriyaki Mushrooms Stuffed With Bulgur and Onions

instructions: Break or tear off a 1/8 inch cone shape from the ubi.

title: Paprika Glaze for Pork or Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons maple syrup or 2 tablespoons light corn syrup | 1 1/2 tablespoons corn syrup | 1/2 tablespoon triple sec | 1/4 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Combine all ingredients.  Apply to meat.  Let cook in refrigerator.

title: Spinach Delight
ingredients: 1 package unflavored gelatin, softened | 1 cup mixed vegetables, chopped | 3/4 cup chopped fresh spinach | 1/2 can diced green chiles, drained | 1/4 cup julienned fresh fruit | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil | 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1/8 teaspoon ground poblano chile, or to taste
instructions: To form the gelatine, dissolve gelatin in 4 cups of hot water, stirring to dissolve gelatin.  Cool until warm.

title: Rakott-Style Red Curry Paste in Ramekins
ingredients: 1/4 cup olive oil | 3/4 cup soymilk ( plain yogurt makes this dessert ) | 2 -3 tablespoons red curry paste ( i like maharaja brand, found at asian grocery stores ) | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt ( to taste i use 1 tsp )
instructions: Whisk the oil and soy milk in a wide measuring cup over medium heat, until the milk is warm not boiling.  Whisk in the curry paste and seasoning salt to taste and simmer for 1 - 2 minutes, stirring frequently.  Serve over chicken or use as a dip in a recipe called 'kateh phoran'.

title: Low Fat French Beans - Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 -2 teaspoon virgin olive oil | 1 package dried pinto beans | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 cup soy milk | 1 teaspoon dried chives, chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f.  In a 3 quart casserole dish, combine oil and beans and spoon into pre soaked casserole dish.  Mix soup mix, soy milk and chives together, pour on top of beans.  Bake in 350 degree oven for 1 - 1 1/2 hours.

title: Tortellini Chipotle Short Rib Eye Steaks With Chipotle & Chipoltes

instructions: Prepare grill to medium high heat.  In a large bowl, toss pasta with fennel seeds and chipoltes.  In a shallow dish, combine cornmeal and 1 1/2 cups water.  Pour half of cornmeal mixture into another, shallow dish.

title: Garnish With a Veggie
ingredients: 4 avocados | 2 carrots
instructions: Peel the vegetables and cut them in a small dice.  Mash the avocados well with your potato masher.  The vegetables should be somewhat mushy, but slightly chunky.  Stir them in with the mashed avocado.  Serve immediately, while still warm, but if you want to keep things hot, place in a serving bowl, and serve.

title: Mashed Potatoes (Tunisian)

instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees.  Place potatoes in an oiled baking dish.  Bake, uncovered, for 50 - 60 minutes, turning after 15 minutes.  While potatoes bake, combine tomatoes, pears, chilies, currants and pine nuts in a large microwave safe bowl.  Cook on high 1 minute or until heated through.  Spoon mixture over baked potatoes.

Serve in slices with reserved reserved marinade for dipping.

title: Mexican Cotija Cheese Soup

title: Italian Tilapia Filling (For Filling)
ingredients: 4 -6 tilapia fillets | 2 cans italian peeled tomatoes | 1/2 - 1 cup tahini | 1 package taco seasoning | potatoes ( optional ) | pista ( optional )
instructions: Boil potatoes until they are almost done, drain and mash until soft enough to handle.  In a bowl, mix together tahini, 2 tablespoons of taco seasoning and 1 teaspoon of tahini mixture.  Add potatoes to the potatoes and mash together.  When the tilapia is done lay in a roasting pan and pour the tomatos and potatoes over.  Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of taco seasoning and 1 tablespoon of tahini over the fish and tomatos for an extra kick and toasty texture.  Bake in the oven for about 30 minutes or broil for another 5 - 7 minutes or until it is nicely browned.

Random Ingredients: breadcrumb,orange blossom water,lime juice zest,apricot preserve,extra beef,linguine,macaroni pasta,asafoetida powder
title: Peruvian Meatball & Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef | 1 cup breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup chopped dried apricot preserves, or any other apricopine preserves | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice ( or 2 tbsp juice ) | 1 teaspoon orange blossom water | 1 pinch asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups small macaroni pasta, cooked and drained | 8 ounces linguine ( or spaghetti ), cooked al dente
instructions: Mix beef, bread crumbs, preserves, lime juice, orange blossom water, and asafoetida.  Knead until smooth.  Form into meatballs 3/4 inch in diameter.  Set aside.  Combine pasta and meatballs, adjust seasoning with additional salt, or omit.  Boil for 5 minutes.  Lift out meatballs and drain on paper towels & cool slightly.  Remove meatballs from water as needed to get rid of any extra fat or moisture.  Serve meatballs on top of linguine.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,beef tenderloin steak,sesame seed,granny smith apple,oyster sauce,ice water
title: Apple Beef Steak
ingredients: 2 fresh beef tenderloin steaks | 1/4 cup toasted sesame seeds | 2 cups ice cubes | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 4 medium granny smith apples, peeled, cored and sliced into 8 wedges | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce
instructions: Place sesame seeds in a shallow baking pan and place in freezer.  Place steaks on ungreased foil and coat both sides with sesame seeds.  Set aside.  Combine water, olive oil, and apples.  Put steaks in pan.

title: Shrimp Stuffed Crisp Bread
ingredients: 12 large shrimp, peeled | 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 cup shredded nonfat yogurt | 1/4 cup fresh white breadcrumbs | 2 -3 tablespoons prepared guacamole
instructions: Preheat the broiler.  To make the filling, simply mix together all ingredients.  To assemble, scoop out the shrimp with a spoon or your fingers to make sure the shrimp are all covered.  Divide the filling over the shrimp, leaving about 3/4 cup of tail meat or 1/4 cup of shrimp on the tail.  Put 1 heaping teaspoonful of the filling along the length of each shrimp lengthwise along the shrimp's length.  Roll the shrimp up and secure with toothpicks.  If making cocktailtail sandwiches, place the shrimp on a baking sheet and top with toothpicks.  Broil under the preheated broiler for 3 to 4 minutes, or until the bottoms are golden brown and slightly bubbly.

Random Ingredients: jasmine rice,ghee,grain white rice,vegetable stock,peanut oil vegetable,pepperoncini pepper,garlic salt
title: Peruvian White Rice Pilaf (Arroz a La Risoña)
ingredients: 1 cup long-grain white rice | 1 cup jasmine rice | 1/4 cup vegetable stock | 1 jar roasted pepperoncini peppers ( in olive oil ) | 1/2 teaspoon crushed garlic salt | 1 teaspoon ghee | 1 tablespoon peanut oil or 1 tablespoon other neutral tasting oil, such as vegetable oil
instructions: Rinse and drain the long grain rice under cold water.  Cook the rice in a steamer set in a 2 litre.  Scoop water almost to the level of the rice in the steamer, cover and steam over moderately high heat for about 20 minutes or until tender and fluffy.  Remove from the steamer and set aside.  Cut the roasted peppers into six wedges, about 1 inch long and about half of the width of the pepperoncini.  Place in a strainer and drizzle with melted ghee or oil.  Cover and refrigerate until the pepperoncini is very soft, about 20 minutes.  Add the cooked rice to the pepperoncini mixture and toss to coat.  Add chopped roasted pepperoncini, garlic salt and black pepper to taste.

title: Oats to Tagine
ingredients: 5 ounces penne | 1 teaspoon steel cut oats
instructions: Cook penne as per directions of package.  While pasta is cooking heat steel cut oats in a skillet.  Add oats and cook 3 - 4 minutes.  Remove from heat and stir.

title: Walnut Cheese Spread
ingredients: 2 cups walnuts, chopped ( about 1/2 of a 12 ounce package ) | 1 container sour cream
instructions: Crush walnuts.  Add the nut mixture to the sour cream and mix well. .  Chill until ready to serve.  Serve with crackers, toast or cookies.

Random Ingredients: wine vinegar,gingerroot,jalapeno,cake flour,asiago cheese,garlic powder,poblano chile,cream tartar
title: Chile and Asiago Cheese Scones
ingredients: 4 tablespoons cake flour | 1 teaspoon ground gingerroot | 1/2 teaspoon fresh garlic powder ( minced or pressed ) | 1/8 teaspoon asiago cheese | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 chile ( chopped seeded with serrano or anaheim chiles ) | 8 ounces fresh jalapenos, chopped | 1 teaspoon wine vinegar
instructions: In bowl, whisk flour into all other dry ingredients for the topping.  Toss together chile, cheese and vinegar.  Stir in chile mixture.

title: Easy Spiced Cauliflower with Green cardamom and Saffron
ingredients: 2 lbs cauliflower, broken into florets | 2 teaspoons fresh gingerroot, peeled grated | 2 teaspoons saffron, crushed | 4 green cardamom pods, split open | 2 spices, such as cinnamon | cooking spray
instructions: Trim the cauliflower florets and discard the tough core.  Cut the stem into 2 inch lengths and then cut the florets into thin wedges.  Place the cauliflower in a pan with 2 cups water, half the grated gingerroot and all the saffron.  Season to taste with salt and bring to a boil.  Cover and simmer for about 1 1/2 hours, until the cauliflower is tender.  Remove from the heat and cool slightly.  Drain any excess liquid in a colander and discard the ginger.  Using an electric hand blender or food processor, puree half the cauliflower in batches, using the rest of the water.  Return to the pan and cook for 5 minutes, or until aromatic.  Remove from the heat and add the rest of the ginger and spices.  Season to taste.  Serve warm or cold.  Store in the refrigerator for up to 2 days, or freeze for upto 3 months.

title: Minty's Cafe Vienna Style Style Lasagna
ingredients: 5 -6 lasagna noodles | 12 ounces coffee | 9 tablespoons harissa | fresh lime
instructions: Boil water, put in noodles, when it's boiling put the harissa, put on the noodles, when soft, put the noodles in a dish.  Put some coffee in a glass, put in a bowl, squeeze a lime, take the harissa and put in the glass.  Then add some mint,.

title: Yoghurt Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup yoghurt | 1 teaspoon white vinegar | olive oil flavored cooking spray
instructions: Mix all the ingredients in a jar with a tight fitting lid.  Keep in the refrigerator for up to one week.

title: Guasacaca Filling for Peruvian Style Chicken
ingredients: 2 cups mashed avocados | 2 lbs plum tomatoes ( seeded and chopped ) | 4 tablespoons tomato paste | 1/2 teaspoon onions seeds | 2 tablespoons dry vermouth ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon black pepper | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1 teaspoon tomato paste | 1 ripe tomatoes ( seeded and chopped ) | 1/2 teaspoon onion seeds
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl.  Chill the filling.  Remove skin with a vegetable peeler and use to stuff Peruvian style chicken.  Use 2 teaspoons per chicken and serve with sauce.

title: Green and White Camembert Fondue
ingredients: 5 1/2 cups finely shredded camembert cheese | 1 cup bok choy, cleaned, coarsely chopped | 4 whole cloves, crushed or 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 large green chili, coarsely chopped ( for milder dish, such as jalapeno-garlic or other chiles ) | 1 small fresh lime, chopped ( for medium )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a 1 1/2 to 2 quart stainless steel or enamel saucepan.  Cover and bring to a boil over high heat, to boiling, stirring often.  Reduce heat to low.

Random Ingredients: five spice powder,peanut butter,wild rice,egg wrap
title: Wild Rice Rolls
ingredients: 1 package frozen wild rice, thawed | 1 package egg roll wraps | 1/4 cup peanut butter, to taste | 1/4 teaspoon five-spice powder, or to taste
instructions: Place the thawed wild rice in a colander and rinse under warm water for several minutes.  Wrap each roll in waxed paper, and tie with a piece of string at 2 to 2 1/2 intervals.  Place 1 roll at a time in a microwave safe bowl.

title: Samba Niek Namul
ingredients: 4 -6 lbs pork stew meat ( or use stew meat, see note below ) | 16 large shrimp, peeled & deveined | 16 ounces corn oil
instructions: Cut the stew meat into 1 1/2 cubes.  Toss with shrimp & meat.  Heat the oil over high heat until smoking.  Place the niek niek in the oil & fry until brown on all sides, then take off the fire & place on a platter lined with paper for a few minutes to set the color slightly.  Note, shrimp is usually eaten with a hardboiled egg in a shell.

title: Curried Scallops and Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 ounces mushrooms, finely sliced | 1 ounce cilantro, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons curry paste | 3 drops teapsoon warm tea ( optional ) | 4 1/2 - 5 ounces flour, extra | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 1/4 lbs scallops, fresh or frozen
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees f.  Spray and flour a jelly roll pan, or similar sized cake tin.  Set aside.  Place mushrooms, cilantro and curry paste in a small bowl and set aside.  Put flour and powder in a large bowl and add mushrooms, cilantro and curry in it.  Work with fingers, gradually adding warm tea.  Mix until dough starts coming together.  If not working immediately, refrigerate 1 1/2 hours.  If dough is too dry, work quickly.  If too wet, work quickly again until dough is manageable.  Divide dough into pieces and roll each piece into a ball.  Put on to a greased, floured surface and roll each piece into a rectangle, approximately 1 1/2 inches thick.  Cut into strips or squares.  Put on to your baking sheet.  Bake for 16 - 18 minutes.  If not using immediately, cover loosely with a towel or a piece of greaseproof paper and allow to cool slightly.

title: Pork Brochettes With a Kick
ingredients: 4 tablespoons dry red wine | pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Combine the red wine and pepper flakes and put into a shallow dish.  Dry the pork cubes in the sauce for 15 minutes.  Pour sauce over meat.  Let cool to room temperature and serve with spaetzle or meat loaf.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,cider vinegar,tomato green chilies,dark sesame oil,polenta,basil
title: Quick Polenta With Tomatoes, Feta and Chilies
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1 cup polenta, cut into 1 inch cubes ( about 2 cups ) | 4 medium ripe tomatoes ( about 3 pounds ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil or 2 teaspoons dried basil | 6 cloves fresh hot red hot green chilies, seeded ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese ( or to taste )
instructions: In a 10 inch nonstick skillet, heat the sesame oil over medium heat.  Add half of the polenta and cook, stirring frequently, until it begins to brown, about 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, in a blender or heat resistant bowl, combine tomatoes, basil, chiles and remaining polenta.  Cover and set aside.  In the same skillet, heat the remaining oil over medium heat.  Add the tomato mixture and cook, stirring frequently, until thickened, about 10 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Garnish top with cheese and serve.

title: Easy Oven-Baked Chicken With Soy Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 lb chicken legs or 1 lb chicken thigh, skin removed and halved | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 1/2 green bell pepper, diced | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 tablespoon grated scotch
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit.  Pour soy sauce into a dish large enough to hold all of the chicken.  Dip chicken legs or thighs into soy sauce then place on dish.  Sprinkle minced garlic over chicken, peppers and soy sauce.  Bake 25 minutes or until chicken is cooked though, turning chicken and peppers once, basting with reserved soy sauce after 10 minutes of baking time.

title: Easy Ricotta Cheese
ingredients: 2 cups shredded fresh cheese or 25 ounces ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons salad oil | 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/4 cup ghee
instructions: Using a hand blender, process the shredded cheese and garlic powder to obtain a smooth mixture.  Stir in oil, then set cheese mixture aside.  Grate parmesan/romano cheese and mix well with the cheese mixture.  Refrigerate for at least one hour before serving.

title: Gator-Pomegranate Molasses Spread
ingredients: 4 cups grated cheddar cheese | 1 envelope pomegranate molasses | 4 cups dry margarita mix
instructions: In a large serving platter, combine cheddar cheese and pomegranate molasses.  Sprinkle generously with paprika.  Cover and refrigerate 1 hour.  Using an electric mixer set to high speed, blend margarine and pomegranate molasses mixture thoroughly until creamy.  Gradually blend in cheese blend.  Spread over cheddar cheese spread.  Chill several hours or overnight before serving.

title: Pickled Radishes
ingredients: 9 medium radishes ( white and yellow ) | 1 cup wine vinegar | 4 -5 pepperoncini peppers
instructions: Thoroughly wash and sterilize the radishes.  Place the radishes in a glass jar or other container with a tight fitting lid.  Whisk the vinegar and pepperoncini peppers together to make a vinaigrette.  Pour the vinaigrette over the radishes and close tightly.  Let drain for 1 minute before serving.

title: Super Easy Japanese Squash
ingredients: 1 large squash | 1 bamboo shoot
instructions: Cut the squash into bite sized pieces.  Cut the bamboo shoot in half.  Put the squash in a bowl and sprinkle a little bit of salt over it.  Place the mixture in the refrigerator to chill.  When you're ready to serve, take out the pulp from the squash and sprinkle a little bit of salt over it.  Note, if you do not have a bowl, you can also cut it and serve it as a side dish.

title: Tangerines in Oil
ingredients: 4 tangerines | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel
instructions: Slice the zest from a tangerine half with a sharp knife.  Cut the fruit off the peel with a small sharp knife, then cut crosswise into thin strips.  Place the strips into a glass or ceramic bowl and sprinkle with the lemon peel.  Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: mint sprig,bourbon whiskey,curd cottage cheese,coconut flake
title: Creme Brulee(Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 lbs small curd cottage cheese | 8 tablespoons bourbon whiskey | 4 -6 mint sprigs ( optional ) | 1/3 - 1/2 cup coconut flakes ( optional, to taste )
instructions: Pour all contents of liquor into small bowl.  Sprinkle with grated coconut.  Set in refrigerator for 5 hours for flavors to combine.

title: Fried Vermicelli
ingredients: 1 cup vermicelli ( small pasta strands ) | 1/2 cup virgin olive oil | seasoning, to taste
instructions: Cook pasta and drain.  In a large frying pan, warm oil and add vermicelli.  Stir constantly until dry and golden in color.  Add seasoning.  Cook 3 - 5 minutes until heated through and pasta is light brown in color.

title: Agua Fresca
ingredients: 4 cups shaved shredded montasio gouda cheese or 4 cups shredded romaine lettuce | 3/4 cup dried fenugreek seeds | 2 tablespoons dried fenugreek seeds
instructions: Place shredded lettuce in a bowl.  Add the desired amount of dried fenugreek and fenugreek seeks.  Mix.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Use a slotted spoon to toss to coat, then press a salad bowl firmly into the bowl so the cheese does not stick.  Let stand for 2 minutes.  Serve at room temperature.

title: Tikka Coconut Chips
ingredients: 4 ounces coconut oil, for deep-frying | 1 lemon, juice and zest of
instructions: Deep fry the coconut chips, following the manufacturer’s instructions.  Pour the coconut oil into an oven proof frying pan and heat the oil.  Add the lemon zest and juice to the oil.

title: Fruit Filled Phyllo Roll-ups
ingredients: 14 sheets phyllo dough, thawed | 8 ounces mango chutney | spices ( i recommend dried spice mix -- make & powder ), to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Place 1 sheet of phyllo dough in the bottom of a clean work space sprayed with pam.  Spread 1/8 tsp mango chutney over the phyllo dough, making sure to cover all of the chutney.  Repeat until all of the phyllo dough is used.  Place 2nd sheet of phyllo in a larger, overlapping plastic storage bag.  Using a pastry brush, coat the dough with pam or vegetable cooking spray.  Make 1 more sheet of phyllo dough, brushing every time you brush with more of the sauce, place 2nd phyllo sheet on the empty work space sprayed with pam or oil, lightly pressing the sheets together.  Repeat with 3rd and 4th sheets of phyllo dough.  With a sharp, serrated knife, cut each square into quarters.  Bake until puffed, golden & lightly browned, about 25 minutes.  Top with other 2 sheets of phyllo dough brushed with more sauce.  Spray tops with pam or vegetable cooking spray.  Variation, instead of mango chutney, you can also use an unseeded mango.

Random Ingredients: chili sauce,milk,flour tortilla,herbes de provence,mint leaf,seasoning salt,pork shoulder
title: Pork Enchiladas Verde
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried mint leaf | 1/4 cup seasoned salt | 1 3/4 lbs boneless pork shoulder, cut into 2 inch chunks | 1 1/2 cups sweet chili sauce | 2 cups milk | 2 tablespoons herbes de provence | 4 large flour tortillas or 4 large corn tortillas, warmed
instructions: Cover the mint with cold water and soak for 1 hour, then drain and set aside.  Combine the salt with the bread cubes in a large bowl and set aside.  Drain the pork well and pat dry with paper towels.  Cut the fat off about half of the pork and reserve.  Combine the chili sauce, milk, and herbes de provence in a large pot, bring to a boil and keep at a simmer.  Drain the pork through a colander.  Using tongs, remove the pork to paper towels and discard the fat.  Spread a portion of the chili sauce mixture onto the center of each warm tortilla, roll it up and secure with toothpicks.  Place the enchiladas seam side down in a large baking dish.  Pour the remaining chili sauce over the enchiladas.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours.  To serve, unmold the enchiladas onto a platter and sprinkle with the mint leaves.  Serve with salsa and your favorite toppings.

Random Ingredients: chuck roast,chinese cabbage,red wine,fruit,great northern bean,beef liver,pecorino romano cheese,spinach
title: Italian Beef Casserole #RSC
ingredients: 1 boneless chuck roast | 1 bag frozen chopped spinach, chopped | 1 can great northern bean, drained and rinsed | 1 cup dry red wine | 1 1/4 cups crumbled pecorino romano cheese | 4 -5 cups shredded chinese cabbage lengthwise | 1 lb beef liver ( sliced ) | 1 cup torn fresh fruit
instructions: In a 9x13 inch baking dish combine the beef and frozen chopped spinach and beans.  Pour the wine over everything.  Sprinkle evenly with the cheese and bake covered at 350 for 2 hours.  Uncover and sprinkle evenly with pecorino romano cheese.  Continue cooking uncovered for 45 to 60 minutes until the casserole is creamy and the cheese bubbly.  Add the chopped liver and stir with a fork until it is coated and warm.  Sprinkle with torn fresh fruit.  Serve with a green salad or crusty bread.

title: Lazy Hot Toddies (Vegetarian - My Way)
ingredients: 12 -14 ladyfingers ( or vegetarian egg roll buns ) | 6 slices leeks ( can use white and light green parts as well, i prefer light green parts ) or 6 slices leeks ( can use light green parts ) | 6 -8 slices jarlsberg cheese | 3 -4 dried chili peppers or 3 -4 dried hot chili peppers flakes | 2/3 cup broccoli floret
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Separate ladyfingers from rolls and carefully open them up like pie crust.  Lay the ladyfingers, overlapping each layer slightly, into a small or large rectangle.  You may break the rolls up into smaller shapes if you like them thinner, or cut them smaller.  Add to a greased, non stick pan, the chilies and 1 cup of water, spreading evenly over ladyfingers.  Add the chopped broccoli and cover evenly with remaining chilies.  Bake for 15 - 20 minutes.  Scoop out broccoli and serve with chili sauce.  Serve topped with freshly grated parmesan cheese, a sprinkling of freshly ground black pepper, if desired.

title: Cauliflower in Red Wine With Grand Marnier
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower floret, cut into small pieces | 3 tablespoons dry red wine | 2 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Heat 2 tbs of the cooking oil in a small frying pan until hot but not smoking and saute the cauliflower in 2 tbsp of the wine.  Add the remaining wine and grand marnier to the cauliflower and simmer a further 3 tbs of the cooking oil.  Stir and simmer another 3 mins and serve.

Random Ingredients: red pepper flake,asafoetida powder,mayonnaise,italian herb seasoning,sunflower oil,vegetable oil cooking spray,sage,molasses
title: Sunflower and Sunflower Seed Spread
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon dried ground sage | 1 teaspoon dried mixed italian herbs seasoning | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons light molasses | 1 tablespoon mixed italian herbs ( such as oregano, thyme, tarragon, parsley, and dill )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Mix all the wet ingredients together.  Spread onto a large baking sheet.  Bake about 10 minutes or until golden brown, and set.

Random Ingredients: beverage,green chile pepper,garlic flake,mirin,allspice berry,pearl barley,liquid pectin,buttermilk
title: Hot Chipped Barley - Vegan
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 1 teaspoon caper fat or 1 teaspoon other liquid pectin | 2 cups buttermilk | 2 cloves garlic flakes | 4 allspice berries | 1/2 cup halved green chile pepper | 2 tablespoons mirin or 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 6 -7 dried seaweed ( arugula will do, not california bibb )
instructions: For the barley, bring 2 quarts of water to a boil in a 2 quart saucepan.  Add the barley and caper fat.  Cook at a boil for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally until just tender.  Drain well in a collander.  For the chipped barley, in a 2 3qt saucepan or frying pan, bring the buttermilk, garlic, allspice, chiles, and vinegar to a simmer.  Cook at a boil for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally until reduced by about 2/3 cup.  Transfer the mixture to a jar, seal, and refrigerate for up to 2 days.  For the chipped barley, drain the barley and refrigerate for up to 2 days or until the barley is cool enough to handle.  Gather the herbs and place in a food processor along with the seaweed.

title: Parsley Mushroom Macaroni with Baby Portabella Mushrooms
ingredients: 2/3 cup macaroni | 1 1/4 lbs baby portabella mushrooms
instructions: Cover a large, deep roasting pan with plastic wrap, with a minimum of water and oil, leaving at least 2 inches over the bottom of the pan.  Cook macaroni over medium high heat, stirring continuously until golden, 8 to 10 minutes, or until slightly dry and tender.  Cut mushrooms into strips, about 2 tablespoons with the stems and all.  Place mushrooms in a large, shallow bowl.  Use a spatula to press some of the mush into the mushrooms using the spatula.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste.  Preheat broiler.  Spoon macaroni and mushrooms into oven safe dish and place under broiler until bubbly and lightly brown, 2 to 3 minutes, stirring constantly.

title: Homemade Yoghurt With Granny Smith Apples
ingredients: 150 g yoghurt, preferably greek | 1 granny smith apple, peeled, seeded, chopped in half and sliced into thin half moons | 1 chipotle chiles or 1 chili pepper, chopped finely | 1/4 - 1 cup fresh parsley flakes, for sprinkling ( or to taste )
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a bowl and mix well by hand.  Refrigerate overnight.  The next day take 1 - 2 tsp mix and spoon into small, flat patties.  Serve with a salad and yogurt.

title: Dadska Most Amazing Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 7 ounces feta cheese, grated coarsely | 7 ounces cream cheese, grated coarsely | 5 fluid ounces double cream ( optional ) | 3/4 cup buttermilk | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 2 tablespoons raisins
instructions: Place all ingredients in your fondue pot or crockpot and mix to combine.  Turn the fondue burner on high and allow the fondue to boil.  Transfer fondue to a fondue pot or crockpot set to low to keep warm.  Keep warm for up to 8 hours and you have a better fondue.

Random Ingredients: wild rice,feta cheese,ranch salad dressing,broth,orange juice,thyme sprig
title: Wild Rice and Feta Soup
ingredients: 1 cup wild rice | 1 can reduced-sodium broth | 1 cup reduced-fat feta cheese, crumbled | fresh thyme sprig | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 1/3 cup ranch-style salad dressing, divided
instructions: Cook wild rice at a boil in a large skillet for 20 minutes, or until all the water remains.

title: Gramma's Homemade Flank Steak for Salmon, Beef, Fish & Gravy
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry fish, flakes | 1/2 cup margarine or 1/2 cup butter | 1 tablespoon onion seeds | 1 tablespoon whole grain mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  In a mixing bowl, combine fish flakes and butter, and mash with a fork until mixture is moist and the size of cornmeal.  Stir in onion seeds, whole grain mustard and ground mustard.  Line baking sheet with foil.

Random Ingredients: mexicorn,beef sirloin,swiss cheese,celery salt,polish sausage,green bell pepper,white pepper
title: Mielie's Sausage and Swiss Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb fresh polish sausage | 1 green bell pepper, diced | 2 lbs boneless beef sirloin, cut up into 1 inch pieces | 2 2 cups mexicorn ( fresh or canned ) | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1 1/2 cups shredded swiss cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.  Cook sausage in a frying pan with a little water, over medium heat.  When done, drain, and chop finely.  Add all ingredients except the cheese to the sausage, mix well, and simmer, covered for 20 - 30 minutes.  Put into buttered 9x9 inch baking dish.  Sprinkle the cheese on top.  Bake for 20 minutes, then remove from oven and pour on the gravy.

title: Curried Rice
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon curry paste ( a taste of home, see note above ) | 2 cups fresh white rice, such as arborio
instructions: Wash rice well and drain completely.  Bring 2 - 3 cups of water to a boil in saucepan over medium heat.  Add the curry paste and rice.  Stir for 30 seconds.  Remove from heat, cover and let stand about 20 minutes.  Fluff rice.

Random Ingredients: hash brown potato,vegetable oil cooking spray,pineapple,cardamom,yellow squash,salt pepper
title: Pineapple Potato Sweet Potato Stir Fry
ingredients: 3 lbs sweet potatoes, pared and cut into bite size pieces | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 medium yellow squash, diced | 1 can diced pineapple, drained well | salt and pepper, to taste | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: In a large skillet, combine sweet potatoes and oil.  Cover and cook on medium heat until almost tender.  Add squash, pineapple and spices and cook on medium heat for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Serve over hot rice.

title: Habanero Chili
ingredients: 1 lb chopped green pepper | 1 can condensed french onion soup | 1 minced habanero peppers
instructions: Heat up french onion soup, and minced habanero.  Combine into pot on top of medium heat.  Heat gently, stirring constantly.  You want to keep an eye on the water content of the can to make sure there are no chilies, but you can tell if you have enough water on the top.  When boiling, turn heat to low.  Cover and cook for 20 minutes.  Note, this can be served hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: pineapple chunk,raspberry,bell pepper,chicken,extra virgin olive oil
title: Chicken With Sweet Peppers, Raspberries, and Pineapple
ingredients:
1 chicken, cut into 6 pieces ( approx.
    - 1 1/2 pounds ) | 10 ounces pineapple chunks, drained | 2 sweet bell peppers, cut into 3-4 pieces | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 cup fresh raspberries, plus more for garnish ( not frozen )
instructions: Coat a large skillet with olive oil.  Add chicken.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,limeade concentrate,pimiento,baking powder,onion,tomato paste,lemon zest
title: Cuban Limeade Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb chicken drumstick, bone into | 1 tablespoon limeade concentrate | 1 can tomato paste | 1 tablespoon grated lime zest | 1/2 small onion, sliced | 2 tablespoons chopped pimiento | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/4 cup cooking oil
instructions: Place chicken in a large pot.  Add limeade concentrate, tomato paste, lime zest, onion, and pimiento.  Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer over medium heat 45 minutes.  In a small bowl, stir together baking powder and oil.  Stir into chicken mixture.  Transfer to a container, cover, and refrigerate several hours or overnight.  Bring to a boil before serving.

Random Ingredients: ravioli,yeast,chicken tenderloin,ancho chile powder,courgette,dark brown sugar,heavy cream,button mushroom
title: Lighter Chicken Bocconcini
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken tenderloins, diced | 1 lb button mushroom, chopped | 1 cup light cream | 1 cup dark brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | 2 teaspoons dried ancho chile powder | 2 packets fresh yeast | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 25 pieces frozen ravioli, thawed in the refrigerator
instructions: Dump all ingredients into a large bowl and mash it with a fork.  Mix in the fresh cream.  In the bottom of an 8 x8 baking pan, spread about a third of the mushroom mixture.  Place a layer of ravioli on top of the mixture and top with the remaining mushroom mixture.  Cover with plastic wrap and leave in a warm place for 1 1/2 hours to rise.  When ready to bake, preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  After an hour or so, top the baking pan with parchment paper and a lid and bake for 30 minutes.  Turn off the oven and open the oven door to release the bake and the steam inside the baking pan.  Brush the bake with a thin film of cream.  Turn oven back up to 400 degrees f and bake for another 15 minutes or until the sauce is bubbling and the ravioli are golden.

title: White Beans & Rice
ingredients: 1 lb white beans, washed, drained | 1 -2 tablespoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1/4 cup risotto rice | cracked pepper, to taste

ingredients: 1 package dry porcini mushrooms | 1 brown onion, chopped ( such as vidalia ) | 1 bottle club cracker, or to taste ( optional ) | 1 dash cayenne, or as needed
instructions: Place mushrooms into a large skillet over medium heat and drizzle mushrooms with just enough water to cover them.  Cover skillet with a lid slightly ajar, and set aside to steam for 15 minutes.  Remove mushroom stems and set aside for another 15 minutes to steam.  Slice porcini mushrooms into quarters and place into a medium bowl of ice water.

title: Spiced Peanut Butter (Tahini)
ingredients: 1/3 cup peanut butter | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom
instructions: Mix peanut butter and cardamom together.  Use to season or spread on cake or toast.

title: Pesto & Sausage Skewers (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 lbs ground lamb | 2 lbs hot italian sausage | 2 leaves culantro ( stems trimmed ) | 2 tablespoons msg ( optional ) | 1/4 cup prepared pesto sauce, warmed
instructions: Mix all meat and marinade ingredients.  Thread meat onto skewers about 3 or 4 at a time.  Let sit for 15 minutes for easier cleaning.

title: Eggplant and Cheese Lasagna
ingredients: 8 medium red-skinned eggplants | 1 1/2 cups frozen monterey jack pepper cheese or 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 can ro-tel tomatoes with juice | 3/4 cup instant tea, well-rinsed and drained, if desired
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Trim ends from eggplants and cut in half lengthwise.  Arrange, with cut side down, in ungreased 13x9x2 glass baking dish.  Sprinkle with pepper jack cheese.  Bake for 15 minutes.  Remove from oven, stir tomatoes and their juices, instant tea, and top with pepper jack cheese.  Bake an additional 10 minutes or until eggplant is tender, stirring twice.  Let cool a few minutes if desired.  Note, i sometimes transfer mixture to a food processor or blender.  I do not process and when it is too finely diced, it can be added back to layers and drizzled with the tomato sauce.  This is a little messy.  The flavor of this dish intensifies over time.

Random Ingredients: hot sauce,mustard powder,asafoetida powder,kiwi,beef brisket,pepperoncini pepper,rump roast,basmati rice
title: Beef Brisket and Kiwi Skewers
ingredients: 1 can sliced pickled hot peppers | 1/4 cup hot sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons dry mustard powder | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 pinch pepperoncini pepper | 4 pounds beef brisket, cut into 8 pieces | 2 lbs rump roast, cut in 1 inch cubes | 6 cups cooked rice
instructions: Pour the hot pepper sauce into a small saucepan and set aside.  Stir together the mustard powder, asafoetida and pepperoncini.  Place the brisket on a roasting rack or broiler pan, and rub the beef with the spice mixture.  Broil brisket on the rack at least 30 minutes, basting occasionally with any remaining sauce, until brown and crispy on the outside, about 1 hour.

title: Scallops Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/2 cup cornflour | 1 cup ketchup or 1 cup reduced sodium teriyaki sauce | 1 tablespoon tamari or 1 tablespoon gluten-free soy sauce | 1 bay scallop | 1/2 teaspoon red wine vinegar
instructions: Place cornmeal on a plate and sprinkle 1 tbsp.  Of the tamari on the cornmeal, stirring until combined.  Place cornmeal on a plate, and roll the scallop in the cornmeal.  Place the scallops on a shallow bowl in the microwave oven.  Place the remaining tamari if using, and microwave for 2 seconds so the tamari gets mixed evenly.  Add vinegar, and turn on high for 30 seconds or so.  Place the cornflour/tamari mixture into a screw top jar and shake to emulsify.  Place the scallops onto serving platters, then drizzle over the extra sauce.  Serve immediately.

title: Black Olives
ingredients: 3 ounces black olives, pitted | 2 cups orange juice | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 2 -3 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: Blend orange juice, bicarb soda and lemon juice well until smooth.

title: Lamb Chops with Spicy Raita
ingredients: 2 ciabatta | 12 ounces lamb chops, trimmed of excess fat | fresh strawberries | 1 1 tablespoon molasses | 1/4 teaspoon dried nam pla | 2 teaspoons superfine sugar | freshly grated pepper | 1 teaspoon nam pla | 3 cups sauerkraut, rinsed well
instructions: Slice the ciabatta into 1/2 inch cubes and place them on four serving plates.  Add a few slices of lamb chops to each plate.  Wash and dry the strawberries, removing the stems.  Slice the strawberries and arrange them in the centers of the plates.  Sprinkle the lamb with the 1/4 teaspoon of nam pla and 1/4 teaspoon of dried minced ginger.  Add a teaspoon of sugar, 1/4 teaspoon of dried minced ginger and a pinch of pepper and taste for seasoning, adding more sugar or salt if necessary.  Top with another slice of lamb, followed by another slice of lamb.  Top with a final slice of lamb.  Spoon the raita atop the lamb/chops, drizzle with 1 teaspoon of molasses and sprinkle with a pinch of sugar and pepper.  Serve at once.

title: Vegetable Beef Tarts
ingredients: 2 packages wonton wrappers | 1/3 cup peanut butter | 2 tablespoons distilled white vinegar, or more to taste | 1 can stewed tomatoes, drained | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Brush wonton wrappers lightly with oil.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,stewing chicken,file powder,fig,coriander seed,thai basil
title: Grilled Beef Tenderloins
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coriander seed, crushed | 1 lb beef tenderloin, trimmed and cut into 3/4 inch slices | 2 teaspoons file powder, divided | 4 teaspoons thai basil, divided | 8 dried figs, halved | 1 lb stewing chicken, cut into 4 equal pieces
instructions: Heat a grill pan to med hi.  For the spices, combine coriander seeds and 1/4 tsp each of the powder and salt. For the figs, combine the basil and remaining 1/4 tsp each of powder and salt in a small bowl.  Stir well.  Add figs and 1 tsp of the basil mixture to the same skillet with beef.  Cook, stirring, until figs soften and sauce is slightly reduced, about 5 minutes.  Set aside.  Serve figs with sauce.

title: Limes and Fruit Sauté
ingredients: 2 mangoes or 4 baby bok choy | 12 medium asparagus spears | 7 tablespoons lime zest | 8 large strawberries
instructions: Slice the mango and bok choy, keeping the asparagus and bok choy.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Add lime zest.  Add asparagus and bok choy.  Cook for approximately 20 minutes, or until the asparagus is tender.  Add the lime juice a little at a time until the fruit is submerged.  Serve as is, or serve over ice and a little bit of sweet mango dressing for a delicious summer salad.

Random Ingredients: rice paper,season salt,spaghetti sauce,spring onion,red apple,white sugar,fish fillet,yellow bell pepper
title: Filipino Spring Rolls
ingredients: 2 cups rice paper | 1/4 red apple, chopped | 1 spring onion, chopped | 1 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup fish fillet, chopped - or more to taste | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1/2 teaspoon seasoned salt | 2 tablespoons spaghetti sauce, or to taste
instructions: Place the rice paper sheets into a bamboo rolling mat.  Cut each sheet in half to make 10 equal pieces.  Wet the center of a rice paper sheet with your fingers.  Place 3 rice paper pieces onto the prepared mat and press them lightly to spread out the rice paper.  Repeat with the remaining rounds.  Place the vegetables into the center of the rice paper sheets.  Sprinkle with sugar, seasoned salt, and 1 tablespoon of sauce over the vegetables.  Fold the right side of the mat up over the filling.  Fold the two edges again and roll the pastry in the middle.  Repeat with remaining sheets, fillingings, and vegetables.  Cut each roll into 3 pieces for easier handling.  Serve hot.

title: Cottage Cheese & Caraway Rice

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Spray a 12 inch nonstick baking dish with cooking spray.  Spread the polenta in one even layer and scatter the cottage cheese and tomato evenly in a bowl, with a few dabs of roasted peanuts.  Sprinkle each with half the masala, 1 tblsps.  Each of the roasted peanuts and 1 1/2 teaspoons of caraway and 1/2 teaspoons of the remaining chopped peanuts.  Then add the yellow sweet grain rice.  Scatter over the remaining 3 tblsps.  Of caraway and let stand for 15 minutes.  Dot with remaining chopped peanuts and remaining paprika.  Bake 35 minutes or until topping is golden brown brown.

Random Ingredients: radish,splenda sugar substitute,button mushroom,plum tomato,self raising flour,avocado,fennel seed,sirloin
title: BBQ Beef and Avocado Sirloin Rollups
ingredients: 1 kg sirloin, cut into 4 x 5 cm sticks | 1/2 cup splenda sugar substitute | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 plantains ( yellow ) | 4 small mushrooms, cut into half lengthways | 4 radishes, cut in half lengthways and left whole with root ends intact | 2 plum tomatoes, quartered and finely sliced | 1 teaspoon fennel seed
instructions: Season well and place each piece of beef between sheets of greaseproof paper on a lightly floured work surface.  Place 2 sticks of beef on top of each piece of beef.  Using a rolling pin, roll each piece to make a roll about 12 cm / 1 1/4 inches thick.  Place the rolls on a barbeque grill pan and cook each side for 3 - 5 mins each side or until cooked to your liking.  Cut each roll into 2 equal pieces.  Place the bananas, mushrooms and radishes on a large plate.  Slice each of the tomatoes and arrange them over the vegetables.  Sprinkle with fennel.  Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with sugar to taste.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,green onion,tomato paste,white flour,splenda sugar substitute
title: Easy German Onion Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa | 3/4 cup splenda sugar substitute | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 2 green onions, sliced | 2 teaspoons white flour
instructions: Place half package of kielbasa in baking dish.  Sprinkle with splenda and bake at 350 degree until browned.  Remove from oven.  Cut 1/4 of the sliced onions into thin slices, then place in large bowl and mix with remaining sausage.  Pour tomato paste over sausage mixture and toss to coat evenly.  Dip the white flour in water and sprinkle over sausage.  Mix well.  Pour tomato mixture over sausage.  Place the kielbasa in a covered glass baking dish.  Place the other half of the package on top of the kielbasa.  Cover with aluminum foil.  Put in preheated oven and bake for 45 minutes.

title: Asparagus and Pomegranate Molasses Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs asparagus, cut on the diagonal into 2-inch lengths | 2 ounces unsalted sun-dried nuts, chopped | 1/3 cup pomegranate molasses | 1/3 cup icing sugar | 3/4 cup unsalted pine nuts or 3/4 cup pecan pieces
instructions: Place the asparagus in a steamer over boiling water.

title: Kettle Kettle - Beef Balls- No Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin | 1/2 cup oats ( plain ) | oat ( powder )
instructions: Cut meat into thin slivers.  Roll each slab in oatmeal then roll in salt.  Deep fry until golden and brown.  Serve with potatoes and vegetables.

title: Mustard Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs cauliflower florets, small head chopped | 1 tablespoon dijon grainy mustard | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 teaspoons coarsely chopped fresh garlic oil | 1 teaspoon grated pecorino romano cheese, plus extra, for sprinkling on top ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk or whisk dijon mustard until well combined.  Toss cauliflower with mustard mixture, season to taste with salt and pepper. Add cauliflower and cook, stirring with a wooden spoon, for 5 minutes.  Sprinkle with cheese and serve immediately.

title: Salt and Spice Ouzo
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups ouzo | 1/2 pound anchovies packed in oil, drained, and finely chopped | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder
instructions: In a small bowl, warm the ouzo, 3 tablespoons at a time.  Mix in the anchovies and chile powder until the seasoning has a creamy consistency.  Refrigerate the mixture until cold to serve.

title: Avocado Tofu Soup
ingredients: 1 carton vegetable stock or 1 carton chicken stock | 3 tablespoons pisco or 3 tablespoons other red food coloring | 1 firm tofu, drained and cubed | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 3 roma tomatoes, cut into wedges | 1/2 avocado, diced | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley | tzatziki ( optional ) or pita bread ( optional ), to serve ( optional )
instructions: In a saucepan, combine vegetable stock, pisco or chile food coloring, tofu, mustard seeds and tomatoes.  Heat gently.  Serve hot, topped with avocado, parsley and taziki if desired.

title: Twice Baked Spaghetti Squash (Japanese-Style)

instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees.  Place squash halves cut side up on pan.  Brush top of squash with oil.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Bake squash 40 - 50 minutes, until skin is golden brown and squash is tender when pierced with fork. .  Remove from oven.  Spoon out some of the liquid into bowl of food processor, and puree squash.  Return puree to roasting pan and simmer over medium heat for 15 - 20 minutes, until thickened to desired texture.  Sprinkle with sesame oil, and serve sauce with hot pasta and wedges to dip.

title: Nishiki
ingredients: 1 cup sunflower seeds | 1 cup cake flour | 1 cup soymilk | 1 salmon fillet
instructions: Heat oven to 180°c and spread sunflower seeds on an ovenproof, shallow oven tray.  Mix flour and soymilk together, and brush salmon fillet with a little soymilk, then spread over the seeds.  Bake for 20 minutes or until browned on top.  I usually leave about 15 to 20 minutes before i bake the salmon until the fish flakes.  Cut fish into slices and serve.

title: Portabella Mushrooms
ingredients: 6 baby portabella mushrooms | 1 ounce garlic, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: Slice mushroom caps diagonally into 3/4 inch slices.  In skillet over medium high heat, cook garlic in hot water for 2 to 3 minutes or until fragrant.  Add mushroom slices, cumin, and remaining ingredients.

title: Cucumber Chipotle Yogurt Dip
ingredients: 12 ounces greek yogurt | 1 -2 chipotle chile, canned | 12 ounces catsup | 1 ounce capers
instructions: Blend all in blender, serve with crushed tortilla chips.

title: Potato Curry
ingredients: 1 large potato, peeled, sliced & boiled until tender | 1 -2 cup sweet potato, cubed into 1-inch cubes | 1 -2 teaspoon red curry paste, to taste
instructions: Fry, stirring constantly, sweet potato cubes until golden brown & cooked.  Drain, serve w/a small bowl of curry paste drizzled over top to give more color.

title: Yogurt Sauce - Indian Sweet
ingredients: 150 -300 g yogurt ( thick or chunky ) | 1 tablespoon cornflour, heaped | 1 tablespoon light dark corn syrup
instructions: Combine all ingredients and beat with a wire whisk.  Cover and refrigerate for 1 hours or overnight to allow it to become creamy.  The sauce can be made ahead and reheated well before serving.

title: Southern Red Snapper
ingredients: 2 pounds red snapper fillets, flaked | 1 1/2 cans pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 tablespoons dry yellow mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f.  Place red snapper in the bottom third of a square of aluminum foil.  Spread pinto beans evenly on the fish.  Cut mustard into 12 squares approximately 1 x 2 inches.  Wrap a square of aluminum foil around fish.  Place foil packet on a baking sheet, in the center of the oven, and bake for 20 minutes.  Reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees f and continue baking, uncovered, for 15 minutes.  Remove foil packet from oven and place fish on a rack to cool.  Open the foil packet, and spoon 1 rounded tablespoon of pinto bean bean dip onto fish.  Remove fish from oven and place onto prepared baking sheet.  Bake for 15 more minutes, or until fish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Spicy Lamb with Pear and Chocolate
ingredients: 1 tablespoon brown mustard seeds | 1/4 ounce active dry yeast | 1/3 cup warm water | 1 lb ground lamb | 1 1/3 cups ground goat meat or 1 1/3 cups ground boneless lamb | 1/3 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 bunch fresh pear, peeled, cored and diced | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa
instructions: In a small shallow bowl or bowl, sprinkle the mustard seed with the yeast and let soften for 10 minutes.  Pour the warm water into a large bowl, and stir together the ground lamb, goat or ground beef, and yeast mixture with a wooden spoon.  Stir in half of the confectioners' sugar.

title: Broccoli, Swiss Hamurgers
ingredients: 1/2 small head of broccoli | 1 tablespoon lemon juice or 1 tablespoon lime juice | 1 tablespoon fresh herb, chopped | 1 lb hamburger
instructions: Boil a large pot of water with garlic clove and lemon juice add the broccoli.  Cook for about 1 minute.  Drain and put back on stove.  Brown hamburgers then put back in pan.  Drain broccoli and put back on stove.  Pour in olive oil and lemon juice and mix.  Turn the heat down to low.  Let this sit for about 5 minutes to thicken up.  Serve with lots of crusty bread.

title: Chocolate Baked Pasta
ingredients: 500 g penne | 1/2 cup brandy | 1/2 cup cream | 400 g frozen peppers and bananas | 200 g chopped chocolate | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 packet instant tea | 1/3 cup crouton, to serve
instructions: Cook pasta according to pack instructions, drain and return to the pan.  Combine brandy and cream, add peppers and bananas and heat gently until chocolate melts and mixture is smooth.  Stir through tea and add croutons to warm and serve over pasta.

title: Spicy Ham and Potato
ingredients: 500 g diced ham ( i use lean skinless thighs ) | 400 g small red potatoes ( small ) | fresh cilantro | 1/4 cup coconut flakes | 1 tablespoon crushed coconut | coriander powder | freshly ground mixed spice, to taste ( optional )
instructions: Put a small frying pan on medium to low heat.  Add the diced ham and cook until golden brown, stirring now and then.  Remove the ham and drain and return it to the pan.  If the ham is too brown, drain the excess fat and add little water.  Cut the red potatoes in half and peel.  Cut the potatoes into half, or more if necessary, and put into one frying pan together.  Add about 5 tbsp water, enough to cover it all.  Bring to the boil, cover and turn down the heat slightly.  Cook until the potatoes are tender, stirring now and again.
