title: Papas Manicioso
ingredients: 400 g manicotti | 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 120 g corn syrup | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 3/4 cup orange juice | 100 g refried beans
instructions: Boil the water.  While boiling, cook the pasta according to the packet instructions.  When the pasta is almost done drain it and keep the water.  Keep the pasta warm while you make the topping.  Put the corn syrup in a pan with a little bit of water and wait for the syrup to boil.  Add the mustard and let it cook for one minute.  Add the drained pasta, cream, beans and orange juice.  Stir everything well.  Serve immediately.

title: Easy Arabic Flavored Nuts
ingredients: 1 cup oatmeal ( preferably organic, but you can use store bought or a combo ) | 1/4 cup tahini | 1 teaspoon orange zest, candied
instructions: Toast or toast nuts, just leave in a warm oven.  If they stick to the bottom of the oven, leave them in until right before serving.  Mix the remaining ingredients in a small to medium bowl, and stir well.  Stir in the toasted nuts and spread on toast pieces.

title: Penne with Sausage and Beans
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans | 4 tablespoons leeks, chopped | 1/2 pound smoked pork loin chops | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom | 4 ounces penne
instructions: Pour the pinto beans into a saucepan, add water to cover by 2 inches, and bring to a boil over high heat.  Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until the beans are tender, about 2 hours.  Stir in the leeks and smoked pork loin, and return to a boil.  Simmer until the pork is no longer pink in the center, 10 to 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente, 8 to 10 minutes.  Drain, and toss with the pinto beans.  Garnish with some grated Parmesan cheese to serve.

title: Vegetable and Sweet Casserole
ingredients: 1 eggplant, cut into 1-inch wide strips | 1 carrot, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1 cup frozen cut vegetables | 1 cup vegetable broth | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 cup bourbon | 2 teaspoons bourbon | 2 cups cooked rotini pasta, to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Mix eggplant, carrot and water chestnuts in a baking dish sprayed with nonstick cooking spray.  Layer ingredients in the following order, eggplant, carrot, water chestnuts, vegetables, yogurt, 1/2 cup bourbon, and 1/2 the bourbon.  Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes, or until vegetables are tender.  Meanwhile, heat remaining bourbon in a small saucepan.  When bubbling, stir in remaining 1/2 cup bourbon until warm.  Serve over cooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: boursin cheese,egg yolk,cilantro leaf,avocado,lamb,meat,beef bouillon granule
title: Guiness Lamb Meatloaf
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs ground lamb, browned | 1/2 cup ground meat, cooked ( prime rib lamb loin ) | 1/2 cup prepared boursin cheese, crumbled | 1 egg yolk, slightly beaten | 3 tablespoons fresh cilantro, chopped, packed | 1 tablespoon beef bouillon granules ( or granules ) | 1 avocado, cut into 8 slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°.  In large bowl, mix all ingredients together until well blended.  Place on an oiled rack in a shallow roasting pan.  Bake for 30 minutes or until heated through and center is no longer pink inside.  Let stand 10 minutes.  Loosen meatloaf using a spatula.  Serve with slices of avocado.

title: Apple Chutney
ingredients: 1 cup apple cider vinegar | 1 cup beef gravy | 3/4 cup golden syrup | 3 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 tablespoon fresh coriander, finely chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl, and allow to chill in refrigerator until required.  Bring to room temperature before serving as chutney keeps well.

title: Frescavena Bread
ingredients: 1/4 french baguette | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 1 package hoagie rolls, split
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Cut the baguette in half lengthwise.  Place half of the baguette halves on a baking sheet, and brush tops with the olive oil.  Season each slice with salt.  Sprinkle with cayenne, and close the oven door.  Bake until the tops of the bread are nicely toasted, 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven.  Serve bread warm.

title: Scotch Scallops
ingredients: 1 lb scallops | 1/2 cup milk | 1 tablespoon brandy
instructions: Clean scallops, dip in milk, drain.  Marinate scallops with brandy for two to three hours.  Serve immediately.

title: Homemade Charred Pork and Mallow Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 lbs pork butt | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 3/4 cup unsweetened chocolate square | 1/2 cup unopened mallow or 1/2 cup dry porridge | 1/2 cup unopened mallow or 1/2 cup dry porridge
instructions: In a large heavy duty plastic bag, combine all of the ingredients.  Seal and shake to evenly coat the pork meat.  Let the pork sit at room temperature for an hour, or refrigerate overnight.  Preheat the oven to 300°f.  Using the back of a long, very damp kitchen cloth, wipe off the excess salt from the pork and discard.  Rinse pork thoroughly under cold running water.  Wrap the pork in long, tight paper towels, then tie the ends of your towels with butcher's twine.  Put the pork, fat side up, in a roasting pan large enough to fit all of the pork meat comfortably.  Roast the pork loin until it is richly glazed and the internal temperature registers 155°f for medium rare, about 1 1/2 hours.  Let stand for about 10 minutes.  Place the pork on a cutting board, slice lengthwise, and allow to rest for 10 minutes before slicing crosswise.  Arrange pork slices on a serving platter and set aside.  To serve, spread some of the melted chocolate and porridge on a hot, clean, dry frying pan and toast under the broiler until the chocolate melts and the porridge begins to caramelise.  Place a slice of pork over the melted chocolate, and garnish with some sprigs of unsweetened, unsweetened chocolate.

title: Corn and Sweet Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup canned corn, drained ( or fresh ) | 1/2 cup yellow sweet pepper, chopped ( i prefer red ) | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar ( to taste ) | 1/2 - 1 small plantain, sliced in half lengthwise and then sliced crosswise in half and seeded ( optional )
instructions: Combine corn, pepper, and cream of tater in a large bowl and toss to combine.  Spoon into a serving bowl and sprinkle top with a bit of the plantain slices and serve.

title: Easy & Easy Tres Leches (Cookies)
ingredients: 1 envelope unflavored gelatin, knox | 1/2 cup red wine ( or water ) | 1/4 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract ( if using vanilla, use 1/2 tsp if using vanilla )
instructions: Sprinkle gelatin over cold water in small bowl.  Microwave, uncovered, about 30 seconds or until gelatin has dissolved.  Stir to dissolve gelatin.  Pour gelatin mixture into medium bowl and microwave on medium high for 5 - 10 minutes or until gelatin is completely melted.  Stir with wire whisk or rubber spatula.  Let cool 1/2 3 minutes.  Stir in vanilla.  Refrigerate any leftover trimmings into gelatin mixture.  Spoon into 1/2 quart sized ziploc bag, then press air tight.  Label tightly, refrigerate any leftover trimmings.  Shake or stir and refrigerate any leftover trimmings for topping or topping while making cookies.  Make ahead, use within 24 hours to make and freeze the following morning of each portion, to make a dessert using frozen whipped topping.  When ready to serve, slice a few large cookies into 3 slices.

title: Easy Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1 lb lean beef chuck, cubed | 5 tablespoons creole seasoning | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 6 slices crisply cooked bacon, crumbled
instructions: Place beef in a large bowl.  Sprinkle 2 tablespoons creole seasoning on beef and mix briskly, coating all surfaces.  Stir tamari, vanilla essence and mace into beef.  Spoon into dehydrator or smoker.  Set oven control into a cool spot and allow to sit for 3 days.  Turn jerky after 3 days.  Dehydrate on dehydrator rack in an oven for 3 hours.  Turn jerky out onto baking paper and peel strips from parchment paper.  Sprinkle crisply cooked bacon on top of jerky.  Cool on racks.

title: Pomegranate Tart (Yum Yum-Ya)
ingredients: 24 sheets phyllo pastry | 1/3 cup butter, melted | 1/3 cup pomegranate syrup ( can be purchased at walmart or any large store ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons oregano leaves | ground dried pomegranate flakes or crushed dried red pepper flakes | 1 cup dried apricot, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to butter a 9x13 baking dish.  Melt the butter in a medium bowl over medium heat.  Stir in pomegranate syrup, oregano and dried pomegranate flakes.  Taste and adjust seasoning with more pomegranate syrup, oregano, or red pepper flakes.  Let cool slightly.  Cut phyllo sheets in half, keeping half covered with damp cloth.  Lay one sheet at a time on buttered and floured work surface.  Lay one sheet at a time next to the other and continue staggering the sheet toward you, keeping the rolling pin over the top and bottom of the pile until you reach the end.  Do not stretch the length or your stack is flat.  You should have 4 layers.  Using a 2 inch pastry cutter, slice the stack in half.  Spread each layered piece with pomegranate syrup and sprinkle about 2 teaspoons oregano on each top sheet.  Starting at the bottom, carefully roll up the pie, starting on the long side.  Wrap into a large, buttered piece of aluminum foil and refrigerate for at least 1 hour and up to 8 hours.  If using a sharp knife with a serrated blade, cut slices in the pastry, slicing across the bread, so each slice will have a serrated edge and a serrated edge.  Bake the tart in the preheated oven for 12 to 15 minutes, until golden brown.  Transfer onto a piece of warm, moist paper towels to drain and serve warm.

title: Scottish Smoked Salmon With Balsamic and Oats in Oaty Crumble
ingredients: 1 ounce smoked salmon ( approximately 300g from a tin ) | 4 tablespoons rolled oats or 4 tablespoons barley flour ( approximately 175g ) | 4 tablespoons patis | 1 teaspoon peppercorn | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons heavy cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c/350f/gas mark remove the flesh of each salmon fillet with a skewer or a sharp knife.  Using a very sharp knife or a small glass, gently gently tear off the bones and slice the fish into thin slices and then place in a large baking dish.  Sprinkle the flaked salmon with oats, patis and peppercorns.  Add the vinegar and cream and mix carefully.  Bake for approximately 30 minutes, check that the salmon is cooked when the topping is golden.  Serve immediately drizzled with a little extra virgin olive oil and serve with a green salad.

title: Chilt-Free Mexican Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 2 cups mixed vegetables ( broccoli, cauliflower, zucchini ) | 1/2 cup packed fresh parsley | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro | 1/2 ounce sharp cheddar cheese | oil ( for deep frying )
instructions: Put vegetables in a bowl and pour enough oil into the pan to reach about 1/2 inch deep.  Heat, on high, until bubbles form around the edges.  Reduce heat to medium or medium low and stir in parsley, cilantro and cheese.  Serve warm.

ingredients: 1 pound asparagus spears, trimmed, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 cup medium grain white rice | 1 pound uncooked long grain white rice | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 teaspoons salt and pepper | 2 1/2 cups shredded cheese ( optional )
instructions: Place the asparagus, 1 cup rice, salt and seasoning salt into the bowl of a 3 quart microwave safe casserole.  Add the olive oil and 2 teaspoons salt and pepper and mix well.  Cover with the lid and microwave on high power for 5 minutes, stirring every 30 seconds or so, about 3 minutes or until rice is tender.  Remove cover and stir.  Cover and continue cooking on high power for 15 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes.  Stir half way through cooking.  Top with cheese, if desired.  If serving immediately, let sit for 5 minutes.

title: Lamb & Ramen Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 package ramen noodles or ( 8 ounce ) package oriental flavored ramen noodles | 1 lb beef stew meat, sliced thinly | 1 can corn, drained | 1 jar pizza sauce | 1 lime, cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Cook ramen noodles according to package directions.

title: Mom's Slow Cooker Ginger-Chicken
ingredients: 3 kielbasa, cut into pieces ( about 1 pound total ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh gingerroot | 2 cans unsalted butter-flavored chickpeas, drained | 1 can chicken breast halves, drained, skinned, and cut into chunks | 1/3 cup catsup | 1/4 cup packed fresh basil | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | salt and pepper
instructions: In a 5 to 6 quart slow cooker, toss kielbasa with ginger root, chick peas with 1 tablespoon of butter, chickpeas, chicken, catsup, basil, 1 tablespoon cocoa, salt, and pepper until well coated with sauce.  Cover slow cooker.

title: Linguine with Rice
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked long grain white rice | 1 package linguine
instructions: Fill a saucepan with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil.  Pour in rice, and return to a boil.  Stir in linguine, cover, and simmer over medium low heat until the pasta is tender, about 11 minutes.  Drain.  Serve hot.

title: Swisssavory-N-Flan
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat sour cream or 1 cup sour cream | 1 package frozen chopped winter savory ( 1 envelope )
instructions: Mix sour cream and savoury package using a fork and then divide into four portions.  Place a portion in each cereal bowl with the remaining portion of the sour cream mixture, taking care that sour cream mixture does not curdle.  Chill for 30 minutes before serving.

title: Tofu Bacon Pasta Salad With Avocado Dressing #5FIX
ingredients:
4 slices bacon | 1 package firm tofu, crumbled | 5 ounces low-fat sour cream | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup tequila ( i make mine with pbrp.
    - chang brand ) | 1 avocado, chopped | 1 cup green pepper | 8 ounces rotini pasta, cooked
instructions: Fry bacon in large skillet for 3 - 4 minutes until crisp.  Remove bacon from skillet.  Drain liquid from skillet, and remove crisp bacon from oil.  Sprinkle tofu with 1 tsp.  Salt, and 1 tsp.  Mix thoroughly and set aside.  In same skillet, add ttequila, sour cream, and mushroom soup, and bring to a low boil over medium heat.  After 10 minutes, add reserved bacon bacon, and mix well.  Add green pepper and avocado, and stir well.  Chill.  Add pasta to chilled sauce and stir.  Taste and adjust spices, and add salt, if desired.

title: Sicilian Linguine
ingredients: 1 package dry linguine | 1 can diced green chile peppers, drained | 1 cup cranberries, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup romano cheese, finely shredded
instructions: Cook linguine in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente.  Drain and set aside.  Place chile peppers and cranberries in a medium bowl.  Toss with linguine and let flavors combine for 3 to 5 minutes.  Stir in cheese until melted and serve.

title: Jicama With Shrimp
ingredients: 1 -2 lb shrimp, with the tail on ( or shrimp in it, or one can of jicama ) | 1 cup frozen cornstarch | 1 -2 lb jicama, peeled and sliced
instructions: Cut the shrimp in half lengthwise and remove the intestines.  Rinse and remove the tails.  Cut the shrimp in bite size pieces.  Place the shrimp, corn starch, and jicama into a steamer or a large pot.  Steam for 10 minutes.  Note, the shrimp will be cooked.  They may look pink, but they will become firm anyway.  They will get hard as they steam, as they cool, and the corn starch will thicken up as they cool.

title: Applesauce Sauce Mix
ingredients: 1 can condensed apple sauce | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | garlic powder to taste
instructions: Stir the apple sauce, cream of celery soup, and garlic powder together in a bowl.  Refrigerate 30 minutes before serving.

title: Kielbasa Wrapped in French Fries
ingredients: 3 lbs kielbasa ( polish kielbasa is recommended ) | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon cardamom pod, crushed | 12 pitted kalamata olives | 15 -20 french fries ( depending on your `` heat '' )
instructions: Heat oil in 10 skillet.  Fry kielbasa until golden brown.

title: Scotch Hamdon's Seafood Salad - Norfolk Million Seafood Parcel
ingredients: 3 pieces scallops | 200 g kidney beans, drained | 1 small turnip, peeled and quartered lengthways | 50 g blueberries | 1 tablespoon bread flour | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 1 tablespoon mint leaf, shredded | 1/3 cup mint leaf, to garnish | 2 tablespoons meat fat, cut into small chunks
instructions: Place scallops and kidney beans in large saucepan, bring to the boil and simmer for 5 minutes.  Stir in the turnip and blueberries and simmer for 4 - 5 minutes.  Remove from heat, stir in flour and lemon juice, season generously and stir through mint.  Place meat in large dish and pour salad over.  Cover and chill for at least 3 hours.

title: Quick  Authentic Pork Loose Pork Loaf
ingredients: coarse bread ( like french or italian ) | 1/2 cup pork roast, chopped very small | 1/2 cup finely chopped onion or 1/2 cup minced onion | 1/8 teaspoon meat salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons beef bouillon granules
instructions: Prepare the pork loaf.  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees.  Place the crock of your choice on the bottom of a loaf pan.  Stick all the ingredients into the pork crock including the bread.  Insert the meat salt all over the stuffing in the crock.  Bake the loaf for about 45 minutes until lightly browned and bubbly.

title: Spanish Pork Chops
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 1/2 teaspoons white sugar | 1 large vidalia onion, thinly sliced | 4 pork chops
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together sherry and sugar until sugar is dissolved.  Spread sherry mixture evenly over both pork chops.

title: Simple French Pastry Twists
ingredients: 1/8 teaspoon sea salt | 1/8 teaspoon vegetable shortening ( crisco ) | 1 teaspoon palm sugar
instructions: Use a pastry brush to coat hands with crisco shortening.  Use finger tips to gently pound salt in shortening until mixture resembles corn meal.  Add sugar and mix well.  Roll out pastry on floured board to 1/4 inch thick and cut into strips as wide as you can.  Place on a cookie sheet and prick with a fork.  Bake until golden 15 - 20 minutes at 140°c.  When cool enough to handle, cut into fingers and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chicken,eggplant,steak,canola oil,tomato soup,head green cabbage,kosher salt
title: Sauerkraut and Chicken Stew
ingredients: 1 head green cabbage, coarsely chopped | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 eggplant, peeled and sliced | 3 -4 cups cooked cubed chicken | 3 tablespoons canola oil | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 medium head of round roast, cut into 1 1/2 thick slices
instructions: Place cabbage in bottom of 9x13 pan.  Add tomato soup, eggplant and chicken.  Top with oil and salt.  Cover and bake at 325 degrees for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.  Remove cover for the last 15 minutes of cooking.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,pizza crust,sofrito sauce,mint,chickpea flour,button mushroom
title: Rice Noodle and Chickpea Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza crust | 3 tablespoons sofrito sauce | 25 button mushrooms, thinly sliced | 1 can chickpea flour | 1/4 cup finely chopped of fresh mint | 1/2 cup cooked rice noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees, and lightly oil pan.  Spread sofrito over dough on pizza crust and sprinkle mushrooms over top.  Combine flour, mint, and chickpea flour and coat noodles over noodles.  Bake pizza in oven until bread tests done, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,safflower oil peanut,noodle,milk ricotta cheese,green mango,yellow squash,chili sauce,pecan
title: Cheese and Noodles With Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces egg noodles | 1/2 cup napa cabbage, thinly sliced lenghtways with the long end lying in the middle | 8 ounces green mangoes | 8 -10 ounces yellow squash | 4 ounces whole milk ricotta cheese | 8 ounces reduced fat chili sauce | 3 pinches safflower oil or 3 pinches sunflower oil | pecan, to serve
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f.  Cook the noodles in boiling water until just tender.  Drain well, then toss the vegetables through the safflower or sunflower oil, and divide between four ovenproof bowls.  Top with a layer of noodle mixture and a sprinkling of pecans.  Bake in the preheated oven for 20 - 25 minutes, until hot, bubbling and golden on the top.

title: Czech Fried Veal Strips
ingredients: 2 pounds meat, thinly sliced | 8 large red chile peppers, seeded and minced | 2 pounds ground veal | 4 tablespoons baking powder
instructions: Combine the minced chilies and minced meat.  Mix the baking powder with about 1/4 cup of warm water and mix this into the meat mixture.  Cut the strips lengthwise into 1/8 inch strips and set aside.  Pour the remaining glazing liquid into a large, deep skillet with a lid large enough to cover the strips of meat.  Place this over medium low heat and bring to a boil.  Cover and cook for about 10 minutes.

title: Spinach Masala
ingredients: 2 teaspoons masala | 1 package baby spinach, stems removed
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook the spinach in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but still slightly crisp, 5 to 10 minutes.  Drain and transfer to a bowl.  Stir masala into spinach until well combined and coated in masala.  Towards the end of the cooking time, spread spinach out in a single layer on a serving plate.  Cover and allow to steam for anther 3 minutes to set the masala.  Serve warm.  Store leftover spinach warm.

title: Pickled Red Chiles
ingredients: 2 cups finely chopped red chiles | 2 1/2 cups cider vinegar
instructions: Using coarsely ground chiles with hands, break off the stems and discard stems.  Place chiles in a large heavy bottomed saucepan and cover with enough water to cover them by at least 1 inch.  Bring to a boil, then place over medium high heat and cook 3 minutes.  Remove from heat and drain, pressing to remove all the water.  Place chiles in a jar, seal and let stand in the cool refigerator for at least 1 week.  These will keep for up to 2 weeks.

title: Wild Rice With Coriander and Olives
ingredients: 1 cup wild rice, washed | 1/2 cup coriander seed | 15 green olives, finely sliced | 1/3 cup wine ( optional )
instructions: In a large pan, mix all the ingredient together.  Bring to the boil, lower the heat and simmer for around 30 mins, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.  Serve in bowl with freshly ground coriander and black olives over the top.

title: Spicy Soba Sauce
ingredients: 3 scallions, chopped | 3 green onions, chopped | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1/4 cup taco sauce
instructions: Chop scallions and green onion finely.  Mix all ingredients together.  Serve over rice.

title: Italian Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf white bread, crusts removed | 1 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Cut off top third of bread and scoop out bread crumbs.  Place in a medium bowl.  Break up chunks of bread with a chef's knife.  Dry the crumbs with paper towels.  Sprinkle over bread.  Stir in oregano.  Wrap bread with plastic wrap, keeping bag in place.  Refrigerate overnight, or up to 3 days.

title: Apple Vegetable Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups broccoli | 1 1/2 cups carrots | 1 tart apple ( i use golden delicious, but rome works perfect too ) | 2 cooked pie shells | 1 can baked tart apples
instructions: Boil broccoli and carrot until tender.  Rinse well with cold water until cool.  Slice apple, toss in a bowl with the broccoli carrot mixture.  Add baked pie crust and fill with mix.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,farfalle pasta,pine nut,artichoke heart,green chile pepper
title: Artichoke Farfalle with Pine Nuts and Artichokes
ingredients: 1 package uncooked farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 8 ounces frozen artichoke hearts, thawed | 2 cans chopped green chile peppers | 2 tablespoons crushed red pepper | 1 tablespoon pine nuts, or more if desired
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.  Once the water is boiling, stir in the bow tie pasta, and return to a boil.  Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.  Drain well in a colander set in the sink.  Mix artichoke hearts, green chiles, red pepper, and pine nuts together in a skillet over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: ricotta cheese,garam masala,pepper sauce,cheddar cheese,ginger garlic paste,white flour,macaroni,maple syrup
title: Macaroni Cheese and Cheese
ingredients: 500 g macaroni | 150 g cheddar cheese | 3/4 cup plain white flour | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste ( or to taste ) | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 2 teaspoons ground pepper sauce | 2 tablespoons maple syrup or 2 tablespoons sugar | 400 g ricotta cheese
instructions: Boil water and cook macaroni, salt it, drain.  Mix the cheeses together with the flour, pepper, garam masala, and maple syrup.  Add the drained macaroni and mix again.  Tear cheddar into small pieces and toss with macaroni.  Serve over plain boiled rice, with pita wedges and cucumber salad.

title: Watermelon and Greek Yogurt Chops - No Dairy
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili sauce | 2 tablespoons greek yogurt, smooth | 3 cups watermelon, chunks bite size | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 1 tablespoon ginger, grated | 1 cup pistachios, chopped coarsely
instructions: Cook yogurt in large saucepan until bubbles form, then gradually fold in chili sauce.  Add remaining ingredients, except peanuts, and heat until warm through.  Spoon over noodles or fresh greens.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,egg noodle,parmesan cheese,bacon,five spice powder
title: Five-Spice Noodles
ingredients: 250 g egg noodles | 1 medium head bacon ( optional ) | 25 g parmesan cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder ( optional )
instructions: Put the bacon in a fry pan and fry until brown.  Add the noodles and stir well.  Add a pinch of five spice powder.  Stir once and then let it simmer until noodles are cooked and dry.  Add the parmesan cheese and stir until it melts.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: green cabbage,cheese tortellini,parsnip,fish sauce,beef bouillon cube,salt pepper,dark sesame oil,basil
title: Green Noodle and Parsnip Soup
ingredients: 1 lb corned beef bouillon cube | 1/2 medium green cabbage, shredded | 1 medium parsnip, peeled and chopped | 2 slices fresh basil | 10 -12 ounces processed cheese tortellini ( about 1/2 cup ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1/2 - 3/4 cup fish sauce | salt and pepper
instructions: Drain the beef, reserving the broth.  Chop the meat, adding the beef to the broth for no more than 5 minutes.  Add the cabbage and parsnip to the broth.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer 30 minutes.  Add the tortellini and sesame oil and taste for seasoning.  Serve with fish sauce, salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,molasses,almond,egg,capellini,celery salt,graham cracker crumb,pine nut
title: Capellini With Almond Sauce
ingredients: 3 cups graham cracker crumbs or 3 cups cookie crumbs | 3 tablespoons molasses | 1/2 cup toasted pine nuts | 1/2 cup chopped celery salt | 1 cup shredded cooked capellini or 1 cup other tubular pasta | 3 eggs, beaten | 2 cups olive oil ( if necessary ) or 2 cups cooking oil ( if necessary ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1 tablespoon almond extract, diluted with | 1 1/2 tablespoons water ( if desired ) or 1 1/2 tablespoons molasses
instructions: In a bowl, mix graham crackers, molasses and pine nuts until well mixed.  Add celery salt and then dip the pasta into the egg mixture and arrange the coated pasta in the pan in a single layer.  Blend the wet ingredients together and pour over the soaked pasta, spreading evenly.  Bake in a 350f oven for 35 - 40 minutes, or until top is nicely browned and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: paprika,lime juice,red cabbage,italian turkey sausage,whipping cream,parmigiano reggiano cheese,tortilla chip
title: American Turkey Sausage Salad
ingredients: 3 cups shredded red cabbage | 1 1/2 cups whipping cream | 1 1/2 teaspoons sweet paprika | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh lime juice | 1 package cooked and crumbled italian turkey sausage | 2 tablespoons freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | tortilla chips ( optional )
instructions: Stir together the red cabbage, cream, paprika, and lime juice in a large bowl.  While still warm, crumble in remaining ingredients, mix well, and refrigerate until ready to serve.  Serve on lettuce leaves or corn tortillas, if desired.

title: Italian White Wine Marinade for Chicken
ingredients:
1/2 cup dried sweet italian spices ( such as basil, rosemary, oregano, fennel, etc.
    - ) | 1/2 cup grand marnier | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Combine all ingredients.  Marinate chicken pieces in mixture for 2 hours or more, turning once.  Transfer to a shallow casserole dish and cover.  Bake at 350 degrees approximately 1 hour, turning pieces once or twice during cooking.  Note, if making with beef or lamb marinating, remove meat from bones to make 4 serving pieces.

title: Honey Garlic Avocado Avocados
ingredients:
2 avocados | 85 g shallots, finely chopped | 1 1/4 tablespoons icing sugar | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon, made up with 1 tsp.
    - salt | 8 tablespoons plain fat-free yogurt | 2 teaspoons icing sugar
instructions: Peel avocados and cut into 1 inch slices.  Remove the skin and stone from the avocados.  Slice into 1 inch slices.  In the bowl of a food processor, combine shallots, icing sugar, chicken bouillon and yogurt and process to combine.  Toss avocado slices in the honey mixture to coat.  Place the avocado slices onto a serving dish.  Serve with any remaining dressing.

title: Crazy Tweaky Avocados
ingredients: 2 large avocados, peeled seeded and sliced 1/2 thick | 4 tablespoons taco seasoning, divided | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, grated | 24 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 20 skewers, soaked for 15 minutes
instructions: Heat oven to 350ºf.  Mix avocado, 2 tbsp taco seasoning, and lemon zest together in a bowl.  Coat the edges of 1 pastry sheet with olive oil spray and lightly spray with melted butter.  Lay one sheet of pastry on work surface.  Use a brush to brush and lightly mist with olive oil.  Place 2 or 3 avocado slices in the centre of the pastry sheet.  Brush avocado with a drizzle of olive oil.  Place another pastry sheet on top, brushing with butter as you do, and repeat layering, brushing with melted butter as you do.  Cut each stack into 8 equal squares.  Place four skewers on top of each square and press lightly.  Bake in oven for 8 to 10 minutes, until lightly browned and bubbly.

title: Marinated Steak
ingredients: 1/3 cup lime juice ( fresh lime, like organic preferred best ) | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons coarse salt ( kosher or sea ) | 2 lbs well trimmed center cut beef eye steaks, 1/2 to 1-inch thick or 3- to 4-6 medium beef tenderloin
instructions: In a small dish, combine the lime juice, garlic salt and coarse salt.  Add the steaks.

Random Ingredients: zest lime,burgundy wine,flour,sugar,yellow pepper,bread crumb,white flour,cauliflower
title: Cauliflower With Yellow and Zest
ingredients: 4 -5 heads cauliflower, cut into wedges | 3/4 cup of white flour | 1/2 cup all purpose flour | 1 teaspoon sugar | 1/2 cup bread crumbs | 5 slices zest of lime ( use thin slices of lime, just enough to make them ) or 5 slices lemons ( use thin slices of lime, just enough to make them ) | 2 tablespoons of sweet burgundy wine | 1/2 cup of chopped yellow pepper
instructions: Cook the cauliflower in boiling salt water until almost tender.  Drain.  Place the flour in a bowl.  Beat in the sugar.  Then add the bread crumbs, the lime zest and wine.  Stir until all the flour and bread crumbs are used up.  Pat the cauliflower dry with a paper towel.  Place the mixture onto a lightly oiled cookie sheet or a large baking tray.  Sprinkle with the sweetburgundy.  Bake in a preheated oven for about 30 - 45 minutes.  These can be served hot but also good served over pasta for a main dish.  Enjoy.

title: Italian Turkey
ingredients: 1 bag dough or 1 bag crescent roll | 1 tablespoon flour | 2 tablespoons flour | 3/4 cup shredded turkey breast | 1 package focaccia bread or 1 package other small focaccia bread | 2 ripe avocados, halved lengthwise and cut in half | 1 tablespoon baking powder
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f.  Spread out half of the bag dough or crescent roll onto a ungreased cookie sheet.  Cover with a clean, dry towel.  Roll out remaining bag dough or crescent roll.  Press each bag into a well buttered 6” square.  Set aside.  Spread each cut side of one of the avocados over the dough leaving center empty place.  Use a spoon to spread the stuffing over the avocados.  Using a toothpick, poke several wholes in top of the dough about 2 inches deep.  Pour the baking powder in a large ziplock bag, add the other half of the bag.  Place bag directly on the baking sheet and sprinkle evenly with baking powder.  Bake for 10 to 12 minutes.  Remove from oven and slice into ½” wide slices.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,french baguette,corn flake,bulk italian sausage,chocolate,vanilla extract
title: Italian Sausage Bread
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 1 tablespoon brown rice, uncooked | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 french baguette, cubed | 1/3 cup light chocolate piece | 1 cup corn flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350° and spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray.  In a large skillet, brown the sausage over medium heat, breaking into small pieces with a wooden spoon.  Drain and sprinkle with the brown rice, vanilla and set aside.  On the bottom of the baking dish spread sausage mixture evenly.  Top with the bread cubes making sure to place a touch of each of the pieces in the middle.  Pour water from sausage over the bread mixture and bake 5 minutes.  Meanwhile melt the chocolate in the microwave or in a small bowl.  Using a slotted spoon, remove the bread cubes from the baking dish.  Sprinkle with the cornflakes and drizzle chocolate over the top.  Return the pan to the broiler and broil until golden, about 1 to 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cooking spray,beef bouillon cube,rotel,chicken,seasoning salt,cayenne pepper,beef
title: Easy Crock Pot Mexican Meat
ingredients:
1 lb ground beef | 2 -3 chicken, strips ( i use thighs ) | 1 large cooking bag and 1 can rotel ( i use kraft brand ) | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper ( or other pepper to taste ) | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon mrs.
    - dash seasoning salt
instructions: First brown hamburger and set aside.  Dice chicken, if desired.  Place all ingredients in the crock pot except the seasoning and heat till chicken is done.  When meat is done, remove meat and add seasoning.  Replace the meat and cook on high for 4 hours or on low for 4 1/2 hours.

Random Ingredients: hungarian wax pepper,beef bouillon cube,wheat flour,provolone cheese,brown mustard seed,cilantro,beef tenderloin steak
title: Grilled Beef Tenderloin Wraps
ingredients: 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons beef bouillon cubes | 1 teaspoon brown mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh cilantro | 1 teaspoon sweet hungarian wax peppers ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon minced hot pickling peppers ( optional ) | 1 beef tenderloin steaks, trimmed well | 18 slices provolone cheese
instructions: Mix first 8 ingredients in gallon size ziploc bag.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil,egg substitute,linguine,shaoxing wine,wild mushroom,hamburger bun
title: Wild Mushrooms, Lean Beef and Egg Noodles
ingredients: 1 large egg substitute | 4 ounces lean hamburger buns | 1 tablespoon minced fresh wild mushrooms | 1 tablespoon shaoxing wine | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 package linguine
instructions: In a small bowl, combine egg substitute, burger and shaoxing wine.  Set aside.  In a large nonstick skillet, add peanut oil and swirl.  When hot, add mushrooms and stir fry until fragrant.  Add meat mixture and cook until egg whites have begun to thicken.  Add egg mixture and cook over high heat, stirring occasionally until temperature starts to rise.  Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions.  Serve mixture over pasta.

title: Orecchiette and Mushroom Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb orecchiette | 8 ounces mixed mushrooms ( sliced ) | 2 large tomatoes with paste | 1/4 cup mixed peanuts | 8 ounces flax seed | 1 tablespoon chinese noodles | 2 tablespoons honey | seasoning
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500 degrees.  In a large skillet over medium heat, add the orecchiette and mushrooms and bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,tapioca,vegetable broth,romaine lettuce,pumpkin puree,white flour,cumin,salsa verde
title: Pumpkin Tacos
ingredients: 2 cups white flour | 1 cup tapioca | 3 cups vegetable broth | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 2 tablespoons salsa verde ( salsa verde ) | 3 -6 cups romaine lettuce | 3/4 cup canned pumpkin puree
instructions: Mix the flour, tapioca, vegetable broth powder, salt, cumin and taco seasoning on a wooden board.  Knead the dough until it forms a ball and form into a flat round ball.  If it starts to stick, add a little bit more flour or water.  Divide the dough into golf ball sized pieces.  Roll into taco shells and freeze them for at least one hour.  While they are still warm, lightly coat them with vegetable oil and fry them in a skillet over medium/medium high heat.  Serve in a taco with your favorite toppings.  Feel free to make my own taco filling, i just put my husband in and he loves them with the filling.  Yum.

title: Chinese Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup vegetable oil or 1 cup vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | veal or chicken bouillon | chopped parsley ( to garnish )
instructions: Heat oil in pan.  Add vinegar and stir occasionally as vinegar boils off.  Remove from heat and add in the chopped veal or chicken bouillon.  Remove cabbage from skillet and roll up.  Arrange on serving plate and pour over warm gravy.  Garnish with chopped parsley.

title: Kosher FODMAP Beer Battered Fondue
ingredients:
15 cups dark beer ( stout, c & h etc.
    - ) | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds
instructions: Make sure you put the beer and poppy seeds in your brew basket in a large saucer so the seeds don't burn and they don't bleed over.  You can do two things here.  You can add the yeast to the beer and use up the brew to make the beer fondue, or throw these in your crockpot, it's fine to add the yeast at this point if you have problems with the yeast.

Random Ingredients: baby bella mushroom,date,caster sugar,white flour,berry cranberry sauce
title: WildBerry Cranberry Sweet Crumble
ingredients: 2 lbs baby bella mushrooms | 1 tablespoon caster sugar ( superfine ) | 1/2 cup date, finely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons white flour | 2/3 cup cranberry sauce | 6 large soft round dates, pitted and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c.  Line a large roasting tin with baking paper.  Lightly grease with oil.  Place mushrooms and sugar in the roasting tin and place in oven.  Return to oven and roast, stirring every so often, until the mushrooms are tender, about 40 minutes.  Using electric mixer, blend dates, flour and cranberry sauce until smooth.  Allow to cool.  Using a spoon, stir date mixture into mushroom mix.  Continue cooking until mixture is thick and dry.  Spoon mixture in to prepared roasting tin, level the top if desired and bake for about about 20 minutes or until lightly golden.  Serve hot or cool.  Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,bacon,cooking spray,steak seasoning,golden syrup,tomato sauce
title: Sassy Steak and Bacon
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons steak seasoning | cooking spray | 6 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled | 1 tablespoon tomato sauce | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1 1/4 cups shredded reduced-fat cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Spray medium nonstick skillet with cooking butter.  Add steak seasoning and mix well.  Cook bacon and drain.

title: Ethiopian Lentil Soup
ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 lbs turnips ( about 8 medium ) | 2 lbs yellow lentils
instructions: Wash and clean turnips, remove and discard outer layer of peel, cut into medium sized pieces, about one to two inches long.  Place in large pot, cover with about 2 quarts cold water, add salt to taste, and bring to boil.  Then cook 15 to 20 minutes until soft.  Place drained turnips, chopped turnips into cold water and boil 15 minutes more.  Add to soup of your choice.  Simmer for another 5 minutes or so until fork can be inserted in.  Serve hot.

title: Easy French Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1 kg tomatoes, chopped | 4 3/4 cups chicken stock or 4 3/4 cups vegetable stock | 1 cup cold water | 1 packet mccormick french baguettes | seasoning, your favourite
instructions: Combine tomatoes and stock throughly.  Simmer 10 minutes.  Meanwhile combine water and baguettes.  Cut into wedges.  Divide soup among serving bowls and top with bread wedges.

title: Brown Pearl Barley
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 500 g pearl barley
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/400°f.  Grease a shallow ovenproof dish with vegetable oil spray.  Place the barley on a large baking paper and sprinkle with a little salt.  Place baking paper on the top shelf in the oven.  Cook for about 1 hour.  Remove from the oven and carefully stir.  Sprinkle with more salt and continue stirring until the barley is completely coated with oil.  Set aside to cool.  Cut into 2cm squares with a sharp knife.  Allow squares to cool completely on tray.  Store in an airtight container.  Variation, use a mixture of browned beans and pumpkin.  If using raw barley, cook for 1 hour before adding barley.

title: Homemade French Fries With Caramelized Onions
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 large white onion, thinly sliced | 8 fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.  Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and tender, about 15 minutes.  Stir in thyme and cook for 1 minute more.  Transfer the fries to a plate lined with paper towels.  Dry the onion mixture well with a paper towel and let rest for 5 minutes.  Sprinkle the hot mixture over the top.  Serve immediately, drizziling with caramelized onions.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,chicken thigh,button mushroom,serrano pepper,pecorino romano cheese,vegetable oil,port wine,egg yolk
title: Chicken and Port Risotto With Pickled Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 cup unpeeled button mushroom | 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut crosswise into 2 inch strips | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 serrano pepper, seeded and chopped | 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon port wine | 4 large egg yolks
instructions: Cover mushrooms with boiling water.

title: Hot Spicy Quinoa & Sweet Onion Cake
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 large onion, peeled and finely chopped | 1/2 cup dried chili pepper | 1 1/2 cups self raising flour | 1 teaspoon vanilla beans
instructions: Heat oven to 180 degree celsius.  Lightly grease 3 cup shallow, deep ovenproof dish.  Place quinoa in a large bowl, cover with 3/4 cup boiling water & allow to stand 20 minutes.  Place onion in a blender & add soaked quinoa.  Blend until onion is finely chopped and onion is evenly coated.  Add chili & sift through cheesecloth or paper towel to remove the residue from quinoa.  Stir in 1 1/2 cups of flour & mix to combine.  Tip mixture into baking dish & spread to edge of cake.  Lightly spray top with oil.  Bake in oven for about 25 to 30 minutes or until golden & cooked when tested with a skewer.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: parsley sprig,marinara sauce,tart apple,cornmeal,grand marnier,quinoa,oyster sauce
title: Tobiko With Apple Pasta With a Mod Twist!
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa ( or other medium grain or regular grain, such as arborio ) | canola oil or other neutral flavored neutral flavored oil | 4 firm tart apples, peeled, cored and sliced into thin wheels ( about 5 cups ) or 4 cups tart apples, such as kumara, washed, peeled and cut crosswise into thin wheels ( about 5 cups ) | 4 parsley sprigs | 1/2 cup bottled marinara sauce | 1/2 cup oyster sauce | 3 tablespoons grand marnier ( optional )
instructions: Rinse quinoa well and drain thoroughly.  Heat a large frying pan over medium high heat and add oil.  When oil is hot, sauté apple slices until golden brown, then set aside until needed.  Add 1/2 cup of the marinara sauce and stir to combine.  Add the quinoa and 2 cups of water to the pan.  Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat to medium low and cook for 10 minutes or until the liquid in the water is absorbed.  Keep covered until the quinoa is tender to the tooth.  If desired, remove and discard the lid during the last 10 minutes to prevent the quinoa from drying out.  Meanwhile, heat a skillet over medium high heat and add remaining marinara sauce, oyster sauce and grand marnier.  Stir to combine, then bring to a simmer.  Serve the quinoa with the hot sauce.

title: Cousmas
ingredients: 1/2 pound masa harina | 1 1/2 pounds ground lamb | 1 pound kielbasa, cut into 1 inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  In a medium bowl, combine masa harina and ground lamb.  Mix thoroughly to combine.  Form a ball and place in a large roasting pan.  Arrange kielbasa pieces around the outside of meat and sprinkle with extra masa harina.  Bake in a preheated oven for 90 minutes, or until lamb reaches 170 degrees f.

title: Slow Cooker Chicken and Beef Pinto Bean (Slow Cooker)
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked dried pinto beans | 1 large turnip, peeled and chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme | 1 1/2 thick-cut slices bacon, chopped | 4 bone-in chicken tenders | 2 cups barbecue sauce | 1 1/2 pounds asparagus spears | 1 pinch dried nutmeg
instructions: Place the pinto beans in a slow cooker, and add water to cover.  Cover, and cook on high until beans are tender, 3 1/2 to 4 hours.  Rinse and drain excess water from the beans.  Return beans to slow cooker, and stir.  Cook bacon in a skillet until lightly browned.  Stir the onion, and cook in the bacon grease until tender.  Put the chicken tenderloins in the slow cooker, and sprinkle with the oyster sauce.  Cook on high for about 30 minutes.  Arrange asparagus spears over the mixture, basting more frequently as the beans cook.  About 15 minutes before serving, sprinkle with nutmeg.  Serve.

title: Puerto Rican Quinoa Pilaf and Charred Chilies (Rick Bayless)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dry vermouth ( white ) | 8 serrano chilies | 1 cup dry quinoa
instructions: Rinse the quinoa thoroughly in 3 changes of water and drain it in a colander.  Rinse and drain the chiles under running water, and cut them in half vertically.  Rit and rinse the water from the serrano chilies with a little salt in a separate small bowl.  Place the chiles in a blender, add water to cover, and puree until smooth.  Pour the vermouth into a small, shallow pot with a lid or skillet over low heat.  Place the lid and the pan of water into the blender, bring to a boil, then place on the lid and allow to boil gently until the water remains clear, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,irish whiskey,chunky salsa,apricot preserve,onion powder,cucumber,pineapple chunk,anise seed
title: Kiwi Fruit Salsa
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely chopped onion | 1/2 teaspoon crushed anise seed | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 1 cup chunky salsa | 3 tablespoons apricot preserves | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce or 1 teaspoon other hot pepper sauce | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1 medium cucumber, peeled and grated
instructions: In a hot skillet, fry the onion and anise seed until they begin to brown, and then add the drained pineapple chunks.  In a bowl, mix together the preserves, tabasco sauce or hot sauce, and onion powder.

title: Mexican Spiced Roasted Poblano Chile Peppers
ingredients: 2 -3 medium poblano chiles | 1/3 cup dried lavender | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce ( or more to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon mixed spice
instructions: Roast the poblanos, turning as needed until charred on both sides, about 10 minutes.  Transfer the poblanos to a bowl and cover with cold water.  Allow the poblanos to sit until cool, about 20 minutes.  Cut the peppers in half lengthwise, remove the seeds, then place the poblanos in a single layer on a greased grill.  Grill over medium hot coals, turning with tongs frequently until marked, 3 to 4 minutes per side.  Combine the lavender, hot pepper sauce and spices.  Serve immediately.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,chili garlic sauce,moose roast,chicken thigh,white fish fillet
title: Sauce of Chilean Beef
ingredients: 2 teaspoons chili-garlic sauce | 4 boneless skinless chicken thighs, 1 inch thick | 1/2 cup pesto sauce | 2 slices moose roast | 1/3 cup white fish fillet
instructions: Pour 1 teaspoon chili garlic sauce into a shallow saucepan.  Place chicken thighs over pan.  Brush both sides of chicken with remaining 1 teaspoon chili garlic sauce.  Spread pesto sauce over chicken.

Random Ingredients: clam juice,lavender flower,stewing beef,beef mince,palm sugar,half cream,star anise
title: Beef, Lamb & Garlic With Star Anise
ingredients: 400 g beef mince | 300 ml clam juice | 1 tablespoon palm sugar ( or brown sugar ) | 1 star anise, cracked pod | 1 -2 tablespoon dried lavender flowers | 300 ml half-and-half cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan, bring to boil, reduce heat& simmer for 5 minutes or until thickened.  Serve over steamed white rice.

title: Apple Cider - Raisin Apple Jam
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs golden raisins or 1 1/4 lbs crimson raisins | 2 1/4 lbs sour apples or 2 1/4 lbs cored, peeled and sliced thickly | 1 tablespoon cream of tartar
instructions: Soak the raisins in boiling water to cover 30 minutes.  Drain and pat dry with paper towels.  Cook the fruit over high heat and turn frequently, moving to avoid any burning until all the raisins have been thoroughly drained.  When the fruit is quite soft, stir in the cream of tartar.  Seal in sterilized jars and process for 45 minutes or until jam reaches the boiling point.  Let stand for 5 days before using.

title: Nam Phrik
ingredients: 1/2 cup nam pla ( fish sauce ) | 1/2 cup chilled yogurt ( to serve )
instructions: Heat the fish sauce in a small saucepan on medium high heat.  When the fish sauce begins to bubble, drizzle a little bit of the warm nuoc cham into it.  Stir the fish sauce well and return to medium heat.  Simmer 5 minutes over medium low heat.  Remove the bowl from the heat and let the mixture sit.  Pour the warm mixture into a small serving bowl.  Break up any lumps that form and serve immediately.

title: Mixed Chowder
ingredients: 4 cups canned chicken livers, drained | 3 cups thinly sliced celery hearts | 1 cup fresh shelled green peas | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 1/2 lbs salmon fillets
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the chicken livers, celery hearts, peas and coriander.  Sprinkle with allspice.  Arrange in an even layer.  Broil in an oven, uncovered, at 300°f, for 10, or 15 minutes to brown.  Place salmon fillets on top of the chowder in a baking dish, skin side down, and broil for 15 minutes, or until the salmon has begun to flake.

title: Mexican Mixture Biscuits
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat pastry flour | 1/4 habanero pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f.  Place the flour in a bowl.  Place the habanero pepper in with the flour.  Pour enough batter into a bowl to make a ball, about 11 or 2 tablespoons.  Roll the dough out on a lightly floured surface into a circle about 2/3 inch thick.  Cut into desired shapes.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach leaf,lemon juice,malt vinegar,margarine,corn,chili paste
title: Sweet Chilli Spinach
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked corn | 1/4 cup spinach leaves | 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar or 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1 dash margarine ( optional )
instructions: Blend all ingredients together.  Serve immediately.

title: Shrimp & Maple Sticks (Australian)
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs peeled deveined shrimp | 2 cups maple syrup | vegetable oil ( for frying ) | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1/2 cup cornflour | 1 egg
instructions: Make the syrup by heating the maple syrup in the microwave or in a small saucepan until it is warm and bubbling.  Dissolve mustard seeds into cornflour and add to the maple syrup, stir until well combined.  In a heavy skillet about 1/2 inch in diameter or larger, heat oil, dropping the shrimp in a few at a time, until sizzling.  Using a slotted spoon, transfer the shrimp to paper towels to drain.  Make the sticks, mix the shrimp with mustard seeds, and then coat each shrimp with cornflour.  Coat another shrimp with mustard seeds and fry, turning occasionally, until crisp and golden brown.  Drain on foil on paper towels.  Serve with the maple sticks.

Random Ingredients: garlic red chile paste,herb,hoisin sauce,watercress,garam masala,lime juice zest
title: Roasted Herbed Hoisin and Garlic Relish
ingredients: 3/4 cup hoisin sauce | 1/3 cup bottled watercress, minced | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice ( about 2 limes ) | 1 tablespoon garlic flavored red chile paste | 1/3 teaspoon garam masala or 1/3 teaspoon curry powder | 1/4 teaspoon dried herbs or 1/4 teaspoon rosemary or 3/8 teaspoon dried rosemary, plus more for garnish
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f blend all the ingredients except the dried herbs, in a blender until blended.  Stir in the herbs.  Spread mixture evenly on an ungreased baking sheet, about 1 inch thick.  Roast, stirring occasionally, until the relish is firm and the aroma is strong.  Cool completely and transfer to airtight containers or jars.  Keeps up to 1 month.  Keeps up to 2 weeks in a tightly sealed container.

title: Spicy Beef
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 3 dried red chilies, broken into small pieces | 1/4 cup sifted confectioners'sugar | 1 1/2 lbs rump roast
instructions: Using hands, remove skin and fat from meat.  Slice meat into thin strips 1 1/4 inches wide by 2 inches long.  Combine the chilies with the oil and sugar.  Place meat in marinade.  Cover and refrigerate for at least a few hours.  Bring back to room temperature and sear for 20 - 30 minutes.

title: Mexican Pomegranate & Rice (Puerco Rancherito)
ingredients: 2 cups white rice, cleaned and drained | 1 1/3 cups pearl barley, washed and soaked overnight in water | 1/4 cup tequila | 1 sprig fresh cilantro | 1/2 teaspoon whole cloves | 1 can prepared enchilada sauce ( we use the mild ) | 1/2 cup bottled champagne | fresh cilantro ( to garnish ) | pearl barley ( to garnish ) | pomegranate
instructions: Put the wine/water/tequila in a medium pot.  Add rice, sugar, and coriander.  Bring it to a boil.  Turn the heat down, cover, and barely simmer for about 1 hour.  Remove and discard cilantro.  Drain the cooked rice and barley, and put rice back in pot.  Add tequila, cilantro, and cloves.  Add enchilada sauce and enough champagne to moisten the rice a bit.  Simmer for at least an hour, stirring often, until rice has a thick, even color. .  Garnish with fresh cilantro and pomegranate seeds if desired.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,bow tie pasta,chicken broth,feta cheese,oil
title: Bow Tie and Feta Soup
ingredients: 8 green cardamom pods | 9 ounces bow tie pasta | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth | 2 tablespoons oil | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Place the cardamom pods in a skillet and heat over medium heat until fragrant, about 30 seconds per side.  Remove the cardomom pods.  Bring the chicken broth to a boil.  Add the bow tie pasta and cook until the pasta is al dente.  Reserve 1/3 of the pasta water, then drain the pasta and return it to the pot, along with the reserved pasta water.  Return the pasta to the sauce, along with the crumbled feta cheese.  Heat for 3 minutes or until the cheese begins to melt.  Transfer to a bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: cold water,mango,iceberg lettuce leaf,almond,greek yogurt,purple onion
title: Mango Lettuce Cups
ingredients: 1 mango, peeled, seeded, chopped | 3 large firm ripe mangoes | 2 large purple onions, finely chopped | 1 cup coarsely crushed iceberg lettuce leaf | 4 -5 tablespoons greek yogurt ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup coarsely crushed almonds ( toasted, to taste )
instructions: Chop mango and onions.  Drain water from mangoes, reserving juice.  In a medium bowl, stir together the mango juice, mango, onions, and iceberg lettuce leaves.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours.  For each cup, stir together yogurt and 1/4 cup of the mango juice mixture.  Spoon a heaping tablespoon of yogurt mixture into each lettuce leaf cup.  Top with toasted almonds.

Random Ingredients: red wine,guacamole,cajun seasoning,quince paste,mexican beer,beef bouillon cube
title: Guacamole Con Carne #1
ingredients: 1 cup guacamole | 2 tablespoons mexican beer | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon red wine | 2 teaspoons cajun seasoning | 2 tablespoons guacamole
instructions: Dump all the ingredients into your crockpot and stir, making sure that everything is mixed together.  Set on lo heat.  Do not open the oven or turn on a gas burner let cook 8 - 10 hours.

title: Easy, Super Tasty,  Spicy Pizza
ingredients: 2 lbs prepared pizza sauce | 2 lbs ground chicken | 2 cups adobo sauce | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 4 slices bacon | 1/2 cup candlenut, pickle slices ( optional )
instructions: Mix together pizza sauce and chicken, and set aside.  Brown pork in skillet in large skillet over medium heat, and then drain.  Mix together taco seasoning and adobo sauce.

title: Laksa (Jalapeno) Spread
ingredients: 1 jalapeno pepper | 1 lime leaves
instructions: Place the rind of the jalapeno pepper on a cheese cloth and bring it down to remove excess moisture from the pith.  Cut the pepper in slices or cubes.

title: Pumpkin Seeds Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups pumpkin seeds, raw | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 teaspoon ground ginger
instructions: Preheat oven to 160 degrees celcius.  Grease an 7 x 7 inch loaf pan, line with baking paper and set aside.  Place pumpkin seeds in a large bowl.  Then add the dry ingredients.  Mix well.  Spread mixture in pan, leaving a 1/4 inch border of crusty italian.  Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 160 degrees celcius, or until well cooked and firm.  Cool in pan for 15 - 20 minutes.  Turn out on rack for a couple of minutes before releasing.  Note, this recipe doubles well for baking as well.  The mix freezes well in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,provolone cheese,cream cheese,coriander leaf,tamari,coconut flour,pork tenderloin
title: Indian Cheese Sambol Tostadas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coconut flour | 1 tablespoon tamari or 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1 tablespoon coconut flour | 1/2 teaspoon coriander leaves | 8 ounces cream cheese | 1/2 lb tenderloin ( or 2 slices pork loin each ) | 2 ounces provolone cheese | 12 ounces chickpeas
instructions: For the tamarind topping, combine the coconut flour, tamari and coriander in small bowl and set aside.  For the beef tambol, melt the cream cheese in a medium sized pan.  Dice the tenderloins/peeled meat.  In a small bowl, combine all of the topping ingredients.  Set aside.  Combine the sambalind topping ingredients in a small food processor and set aside.  Cook the sambalind sauce for about 20 seconds until the mixture becomes a small, crumbly mixture.  Drain.  When the sambalind sauce starts to simmer add the sambalind mixture.  To serve, place the cooked sambalind side by side in a large frying pan.  Top with provolone cheese and chickpeas then the topping topping mixture.  Serve warm.  Note, i serve these with steamed rice or steamed vegies.

title: Beef With Wild Rice (Rachael Ray)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon shallots, minced fresh | 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin steak, 1-inch thick | 2 1/2 cups raspberries, divided | 1 cup green olives or 1 cup black olives, pitted and sliced
instructions: Heat heavy nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Sprinkle shallots over steak and saute 3 minutes, stirring once.  Transfer steak to plate.  Increase heat to high.

title: Quick Curried Chicken Noodle Sandwich
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 2 packages rotini pasta ( or other long, thin noodles ) | 1 can salsa ( i like pace ) | 2 packets of your favorite curry paste | 1 bunch romaine lettuce | 4 kaiser rolls
instructions: Dice chicken into bite sized pieces and sear in a small skillet until golden brown.  You could also dice up some onions and/or green peppers or mix them in with the chicken if you have them.  While chicken is frying in a separate skillet, cook rotini by package directions.  While you're waiting for them to be boiled, chop the veggies and combine in a bowl with the salsa and curry paste.  When the chicken has browned, add to bowl and toss.  The chicken, veggies, and salsa mixture should now be hot, but not boiling.  Slice a baguette into four slices and place one slice of your baguette onto the table with the bottom slice of bread to toast.  Next, place one slice of chicken, veggies, veggies, salsa, etc on the side of the bread.  Put 3 - 4 slices of romaine and 2 - 4 slices of chicken on each piece of bread and enjoy.

title: Clams With Mexican Seasonals
ingredients: 4 lbs fresh baby clams | 2 teaspoons mild mexican oregano
instructions: Prepare fresh clams, and drain them.  To clean clams, remove as much water as possible from each clams, but leave heads and shells very open with a small sharp knife.  Discard anything which is significantly open.  Discard heads or shells that are not tightly closed.  Sprinkle with a little hot mexican seasoning.  If using fresh clams, clean and dry them thoroughly.  Rinse any unopened clams thoroughly.  Pat gently with paper towels.  Pack them into a 3 quart size, stainless steel bowl.  Sprinkle with a little more hot mexican seasoning.  Cover loosely with plastic wrap.  Let sit for 7 to 10 days, rearranging them and rearranging them one more time. .  Warm the remaining 1/2 teaspoon mexican seasoning, and spoon into hot, sterilized jars.  Cover tightly and let sit for 1 week, rearranging and removing the plastic wrap.

title: Taco Conch Filling
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds dried conch ( optional ) | 3/4 cup instant tea, divided | 1 package taco seasoning mix, divided
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add the conch and cook for 3 to 5 minutes, until tender.  Drain.  Cool, discarding any remaining water.  Place the cooked conch in the bowl of a food processor.  Add half the instant tea and half the taco seasoning.  Pulse until the cornmeal texture resembles fine crumbs.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,red snapper fillet,kalamata olive,red chili powder,green cabbage
title: Shakshook Nuka (Ethiopian Snapper)
ingredients: 2 - 3 lbs red snapper fillets ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 1/2 cup fresh kalamata olive, sliced ( or other brine-cured black olives ) | 4 cups thinly sliced green cabbage | 2 -3 tablespoons red chili powder | 1 -2 tablespoon ground cardamom
instructions: Place fish fillets in a large pot.  Sprinkle with kalamata/olive brine.  Add 1 1/2 cups cold water and bring to a boil.  Cover and simmer until fish flakes easily with a fork, about 30 minutes.  Remove fish from heat and chill until very cold, about 2 hours.  Strain fish mixture through a colander into a saucepan.  Return to same pot.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium, and cook, uncovered, until fish flakes easily with a spoon, about 10 minutes.  Remove fish from heat.  Serve fish immediately, pouring sauce over fish.

title: Ouzo Mashed Potatoes With Mango-Ouzo Syrup Recipe
ingredients:
8 russet potatoes, peeled and quartered ( about 1.
    -5 cm cubes ) | 1/2 cup ouzo | 1 1/2 cups brandy ( good ) | 1/2 cup sweet mango powder ( i recommend malibu ) | 1/3 cup ouzo, to drizzle sauce
instructions: Place the pot on the burner over medium heat.  Add the ouzo, brandy, mango powder, and ouzo, stirring to combine.  Heat to boiling and stir in the diced potatoes.  Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer until the potatoes are fork tender, about 30 - 45 minutes.  This syrup goes nicely with grilled fish, chicken, chicken steaks, or roasted veg.

title: Tangerine-Tofu Spread
ingredients: 1 package silken tofu | 1 cup white pepper ( not hot! ) | 1/2 cup tangerine | 1 -2 cup raw green pepper
instructions: Put everything in a food processor or blender.  Blend or blend by hand.  Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,pepperoni,chipotle powder,double cream,rice wine vinegar
title: Roasted Pepperoni Salad
ingredients: 2 cups double cream | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon lemon zest, grated | 1 tablespoon dried chipotle powder | 2 ounces pepperoni, sliced 3/4-inch thick
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350f degrees and position a rack in the center.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  In a small bowl, combine the cream, rice wine vinegar, lemon zest and chipotle powder.  Pour the liquid into a measuring cup.  Drizzle half of the juice over the pepperoni slices to coat.  Arrange the pepperoni slices on the baking sheet and top with remaining cream mixture.  Bake for 20 minutes, then remove from the oven and cool to room temperature.  Serve warm.

title: Potato and Cheese Oyster Bake
ingredients: 420 g frozen potatoes, thawed and well drained | 250 g baby oysters, drained | 1 red capsicum, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons lard, cut into 4 pieces
instructions: Place frozen potatoes in a mixing bowl with the oysters and capsicum and mash them together with the lard.  Season well, if required.  Turn mix into a lightly oiled 8 cup capacity ovenproof dish and dot with a few pieces of oil.  Bake in a moderately hot oven for 25 - 30 minutes, or until golden.

title: Tamari Pasta With Crisp Flat Iron
ingredients: 1 bag rotini pasta | 1 tablespoon tamari, soy flavored sauce ( gluten-free or sodium-free if you want )
instructions: Boil the pasta for 7 minutes or until al dente.  Meanwhile, put the tamari soy sauce and olive oil in a bowl.  Stir to combine, then add the pasta and coat with the dressing, tossing to coat.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,meat,mascarpone cheese,russet potato,lime wedge,black olive,white onion,coriander
title: Italian Sweet Potato and Meat Lasagna
ingredients: 4 large russet potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 lb lean ground meat | 20 large pitted black olives, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped white onion | 1/4 cup chopped fresh coriander | 1/4 cup picked flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 package mascarpone cheese | 1 lime wedge
instructions: Place the potatoes into a large pot and cover with salted water.

Random Ingredients: chutney,mace,corn oil,cajun seasoning,vinegar,chicken breast half,hamburger bun
title: Quick-Fix Chicken and Chutney Sandwich
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1/4 cup chili chutney | 1/4 cup vinegar | 2 teaspoons cajun seasoning | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 2 tablespoons chopped cooked hamburger bun | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Place chicken breasts between 2 sheets of wax paper, and pound with a mallet until slightly flattened and malleable.  Mix chutney, vinegar, cajun seasoning, and corn oil together in a bowl, and toss the chicken with the chutney mixture.  Marinate chicken in the refrigerator for 1 hour.  Heat the corn oil in a skillet over medium heat.  Stir in the hamburger bun and mace.

title: Apple Rice with Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 can chick-peas, drained & rinsed | 1/4 cup apple juice | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon hot sauce ( depending on your heat tolerance ) | 1 1/2 cups quick-cooking brown rice
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 2 quart microwave safe casserole dish, cover& microwave on high for 20 minutes, stir once then microwave on high for additional 5 - 10 minutes or until all ingredients are creamy & tender.

title: Hot Buttered Nests
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tapioca | 1/2 lb shiitake mushroom | 2 tablespoons raspberry jam ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup beef broth
instructions: In the top half of a double boiler add the tapioca.  Cover and simmer until tender.  The shiitake mushrooms, remove stems, slice the caps and place them in the tapioca.  Add broth and return to the boil.  Cook for 3 - 5 minutes.  Remove from heat and stir in the jam.  Serve warm or cold.

title: Spinach Roll - for Vegans!
ingredients: 2 cups mixed spinach leaves | 1 pinch mixed spice | 1 teaspoon cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon sour cream | 1/4 teaspoon chili ( see note ) | 1 teaspoon mayonnaise | cracker | currants
instructions: Wash the spinach well and squeeze out excess water.  Wash in plenty of lukewarm water and dry well.  Mix with all the other ingredients except the cracker.  Roll and line a baking tray or serving dish with the cracker.  Cover with plastic wrap and leave to marinade overnight.  If using fresh spinach, cook the leaves in boiling water for 3 - 4 minutes, this should result in soft mush, if not you can add a little extra water.  Spread spinach puree onto the prepared bread, and roll the bread in the cracker before cutting.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,ketchup,dark sesame oil,yucca root,chicken cutlet,apple juice
title: Spicy Chicken Tandoori
ingredients: 1/4 cup low-fat greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 2 tablespoons apple juice | 12 ounces bone-in chicken cutlets, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/8 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 5 ounces yucca root, peeled, cut in half crosswise, and seeded
instructions: Combine yogurt and next 3 ingredients in a shallow bowl and coat each piece of chicken with yogurt mixture.  Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Dry chicken pieces on both sides.  Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and cook until chicken is no longer pink in center, 15 to 20 minutes.  Arrange chicken on a platter.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,green curry paste,lard,nutritional yeast,wheat flour,beer
title: Vegan Fried Noodles
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon light green curry paste | 1/3 cup beer | 2 tablespoons nutritional yeast | 1/2 lb lard
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions.  Mix in the rest of the ingredients and set aside.  Heat the oil in a large frying pan over medium high heat.  When hot, add the noodles, stir, and cook 2 to 3 minutes, or until golden.

Random Ingredients: green chile pepper,english cucumber,cream mushroom soup,ricotta cheese,cardamom,cajun seasoning,red chili pepper
title: Hot Cucumber Dip
ingredients: 1 english cucumber, peeled and chopped | 2 cups ricotta cheese | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon curry ground cardamom | 1 can chopped green chile peppers, drained | 1 teaspoon chopped red chili pepper
instructions: Place the cucumber, ricotta cheese, cream of mushroom soup, cajun seasoning, curry powder, cardamom, green chile peppers, and red chilies in a large saucepan, and mix thoroughly.  Cook over low heat, stirring frequently, until cheese has melted and everything is well blended and hot.  Chill several hours or overnight before serving over your favorite sweet cookies or fritters.  Serve with toasted french bread slices for dipping.

title: Ceviche (Adopted) with Yellow Turnips (Aka Mashed Yellow Turnips)
ingredients: 2 lbs yellow turnips | 8 ounces pancetta ( thinly sliced, cut into 1/4-inch pieces ) | 16 ounces green chilies ( drained and chopped ) | 2 ounces adobo seasoning ( caldo de la vera, or caldo de mayo, if you like a bit of kick ) | 1/3 cup yuervo or 1/3 cup tequila
instructions: Cut the turnips in half, then into 1/4 thick slices.  Cook the turnip over on your flame grill until they are nice and brown, about 10 minutes.  Add the pancetta to turnip when almost done, and fry over medium heat until it is crispy, about 5 minutes.  Add the chiles, adobo seasoning, and green chiles to turnip and pancetta.
