ingredients: 1 can sweet peas, drained | 2 tablespoons cornstarch paste | 1/2 cup frozen meatballs, thawed | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | fresh raspberry vinegar
instructions: Combine peas, cornstarch paste, and meatballs in a large, shallow dish or ziplock bag.  Shake off any excess cornstarch mixture.  Marinate at least 30 minutes, preferably overnight.  Heat a wok or deep skillet over high heat until very hot.  Add oyster sauce and swirl to coat pan.  Add meat mixture, a few pieces at a time, and stir fry for a few minutes, until meat is cooked.

Random Ingredients: red chile,yeast,swiss cheese,feta cheese,white wine,sea bass fillet,provolone cheese
title: Pan Fried Sea Bass and Provolone
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs sea bass fillets, cut crosswise into 2 by one inch slices ( or a combination of both ) or 1 1/2-2 lbs other white fish fillets, such as halibut, cod or salmon, cut crosswise into 2 by one inch slices ( or a combination of both ) | 1 1/4 cups dry white wine ( or a couple of splashes of white wine or some rum ) | 1 whole fresh red chile | 1 tablespoon instant yeast, dissolved in | 1 3/4 teaspoons warm water ( or an equivalent amount of warm water ) | 1 teaspoon sea bass fillet culture ( or sub fresh fish fillets ) or 1/2-2 cup other white wine ( or a couple of splashes of white wine or an equivalent amount of rum ) | 3 -5 ounces shredded swiss cheese ( or use provolone cheese ) | 1 1/4 - 2 lbs thinly sliced swiss cheese, such as mozzarella, for garnish | 1/2 lb thinly sliced provolone cheese
instructions: Put the fish in a large mixing bowl.  Pour the wine, chile and dissolved yeast onto the fish, turning it over to coat the fish.  Cover and let sit in a warm place for about 1 hour.  After about 1 hour, drain the fish and pat dry with paper towels.  Set aside.  Preheat the broiler over medium high heat.  Line one large ovenproof pan or pizza stone with heavy foil or cornmeal.  Arrange the fish slices on the pan or pizza stone.  Sprinkle the 1 1/4 cup of shredded swiss cheese evenly over the top of each fish.  Spread the white cheese slices on top of each fish.  Place the fish on top of the swiss cheese, then top with the remaining swiss cheese.  Place the foil or cornmeal over the top of the fish and place in the preheated oven.  Broil for 15 minutes, or until the cheese is bubbly and the fish is cooked through and the top is lightly browned.  Remove from the oven and garnish with a sprinkling of both cheeses.

title: Moroccan Onions With Herbs
ingredients: 2 lbs white pearl onions ( the more, the better ) | 1/2 lb raisins | 1/2 bunch fresh cilantro, leaves | 6 sprigs fresh rosemary | 1/2 cup rolled oatmeal | 1/3 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Peel onions and cut into largeish wedges.  Place onions in a large baking dish in one layer.  Strew over and around cilantro and rosemary leaves.  Pour vinegar over onions.  Bake, covered, in the middle of the oven for 1 1/2 hours or until tender and browned.  If onions brown too quickly, cover tightly and continue to bake.  After 30 minutes remove from oven and cool to room temperature.  Stir and serve or store for up to 7 days.  These are great served the next day.

Random Ingredients: dark red kidney bean,salt pepper,file powder,salad green
title: American Grown Salad
ingredients: salad greens | 1/2 can dark red kidney beans | 1 teaspoon file powder | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Bring a pot of water to boil.  Tear greens into bite size pieces, and remove stems and leaves from bean beans.  Rinse with cool water, and toss with about half of the bean mixture.  Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Simple Mexican Hot Masa
ingredients: 1 lb masa harina ( homemade preferred ) or 1 lb flour | 1/2 cup water | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds ( black or yellow or preferred )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together well.  Serve on pita bread and enjoy.  ~the secret to good masa is to mix ingredients well and make a small quantity of each masa in advance.  Note, if masa is to wet the bread, cover with hot water and stir before adding ingredients.  If there is no excess water, cover, refrigerate and use within 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: rye flour,chicken leg,dill weed,bread crumb,black mustard seed,brandy
title: Breaded Whole Chicken Legs With Dill
ingredients: 8 fresh chicken legs, butterflied, skinned, and rinsed | 1/4 cup rye flour, finely ground | 2 tablespoons country-style dry bread crumbs, finely ground | 2 teaspoons black mustard seeds, lightly crushed | 1/2 cup brandy ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried dill weed ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons finely ground red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Place the chicken legs into a large plastic bag and combine with the rye flour, bread crumbs, mustard seeds, brandy, dill weed, and red pepper flakes.  Turn to coat the chicken evenly and thoroughly.  Arrange the chicken in a nonstick skillet over medium heat.  Cook for 45 minutes, basting once with the pan juices.

Random Ingredients: chocolate square,white flour,mexican corn,corn chip,white vinegar,nutmeg,snow pea,mint sprig
title: Minty Corn and Snow Pea Pudding
ingredients: 3/4 cup mexican creamed corn | 1 cup white flour | 2/3 cup white vinegar | 1/2 cup ground nutmeg | 1 1/2 cups mangoes or 1 1/2 cups peaches, chopped | 2 packages snow peas, cut into 2-3 inch pieces | 1/4 cup finely chopped of fresh mint sprigs | white corn chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Put the corn flour in a large bowl.  Make a well in the center.  Add the vinegar, nutmeg, and chives.  Add the corn, mango, and snow peas.  Mix thoroughly by hand, or with a spatula, making sure to scrape the bottom of the bowl.  Don't overmix.  Transfer the pudding mixture to a baking dish.  Sprinkle mexican crema over the top and bake uncovered for 1 hour, until top is browned and firm, and there are bubbles that start to form on the surface.  Let set for about 10 minutes to cool slightly before serving.

title: Mexican Chili Beef
ingredients: 1 lb beef roast, trimmed of all fat | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/4 cup hot chili paste | 1 teaspoon chili paste ( mexican chili powder found in latin supermarkets ) | 1/3 cup fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine beef, balsamic vinegar, and chili.  Bring to a low boil, then reduce heat, and simmer, covered, for at least 30 minutes.  Stir occasionally.  Remove from heat and stir in hot chile.

title: Browned Sprouted Wheat Rinds (Yukon Gold) With Parsley and Chiles
ingredients: 1/4 cup wheat bran | 2 poblano chiles, slit lengthwise | 4 tablespoons dry sherry or 4 tablespoons white wine | 1 teaspoon cooking oil | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Preheat oven to 500°f.  Put wheatbran in a large bowl.  Peel and remove stem ends of poblanos, and finely chop.  Combine the sherry and oil in a small jar with a tightly fitting lid.  Shake until evenly blended, then pour over wheatbran.  Toss well to mix, cover and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours.  Remove seeds from chiles and pat well dry with a paper towel.  Place in a baking pan lined with parchment paper and bake 8 to 10 minutes.  Remove from oven immediately, and let stand until cool.  Stir in the parsley, cover, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.  Use as needed.

title: Easy Tomato-Onion Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh mushrooms | 1/2 cup tomato paste | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1/8 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1/2 teaspoon juniper berries, crushed
instructions: Slice mushrooms thickly.  Bring a large pan of water to a boil, add mushrooms and cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until almost tender and they release their juices.  Do a final squeeze and drain mushrooms.  Pre heat oven to 450 degrees.  Combine tomato paste, sherry, thyme and juniper in a small saucepan and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer for 2 minutes.  Stir mushroom mixture into tomato mixture, taking care not to cook too quickly, otherwise mushrooms will become tough and the sauce might become watery.  Pour into baking dish.  Place mushrooms on top of tomato mixture and transfer to oven.  Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, basting and stirring frequently until mushrooms are browned.

title: Chinese Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce ( dark ) | 1 pork tenderloin
instructions: Pour dark soy into a sealable plastic bag with a star tip.  Add pork tenderloins and shake to coat.  Marinate in the refrigerator at least one hour.  Preheat grill.  Remove pork and discard marinade.  Grill pork over medium heat, turning once, until internal temperature reaches 145 degrees or internal temperature reaches 165 degrees f, about 20 minutes.

title: Quick Shrimp
ingredients: 20 jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 clams or 1 mussel, cleaned
instructions: In a non stick frying pan put in shrimp and clams in the approximate amounts of shrimp and clams/mussels to cover the shrimp/clams in the pan.  Steam until done.  Serve immediately.

title: Snow Pea Bark
ingredients: 500 g snow peas | 200 g dark chocolate, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c line 2 baking trays with baking paper.  Wash and slice the snow peas in half and spread over the foil.  Sprinkle over salt and place on top of the snow peas.  Set aside for 2 hours.  When cool, break into pieces with a knife.  Bake in a preheated oven for 10 - 15 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes.  The crisp top should be dry.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,jalapeno pepper,apricot,fine salt,spanish onion,honey,head iceberg lettuce,plain yogurt
title: Jalapeno and Apricot Salad
ingredients: 3 pounds kielbasa, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 container plain yogurt | 8 large head iceberg lettuce - rinsed, dried and torn into bite-size pieces | 1/2 medium spanish onion, diced | 1/2 head iceberg lettuce - rinsed, dried and torn into bite-size pieces | 4 jalapeno peppers, seeded and minced | 1/4 cup honey | 2 tablespoons fine salt | 1/4 cup chopped dried apricots
instructions: To make croutons, preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place kielbasa in a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Bake in preheated oven until lightly browned and crumbly, about 30 minutes.  Place yogurt in small bowl.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,tilapia fillet,table salt,artichoke heart,barley,hot water
title: Lilthai  Artichoke  &  Barley Crusted Tilapia
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-fat tapioca or 1/2 cup barley | 1 1/2 cups hot water | 2 teaspoons table salt | 1/2 teaspoon crushed cardamom seed | 1 can artichoke hearts, rinsed and drained ( about 2 cups ) | 1 lb tilapia fillet, cut into 5 equal pieces
instructions: In medium saucepan, combine tapioca, hot water, salt, cardamom seeds, and artichoke hearts, and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat.

Random Ingredients: wonton wrapper,tomato paste,flake cereal,red chili,balsamic vinegar
title: Lumpia
ingredients: 2 cans tomato paste | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon dry crushed dried red chili | 1 package flake cereal | 1 package wonton wrappers
instructions: Drain the tomato paste and stir in the balsamic vinegar and chili, mixing well.  Place the biscuit wrappers on a sheet of wax paper and freeze until semi thawed.  Preheat oven to 400°f.  Open one can and squeeze out excess liquid.  Place the dry flakes, dough sides up, on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.  Bake for 12 - 15 minutes, until golden and puffed.  Remove from the oven, and wrap each lumpia in the cereal flakes.  Serve with black tea, vanilla ice cream, or chocolate shavings.  They freeze really well once you put them in the freezer, they should stick together like glue.

Random Ingredients: beer,puff pastry,irish whiskey,active yeast,black cardamom pod
title: Breadmaker Beer Crescents
ingredients: 4 cups flour | 1/4 cup irish whiskey | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 2 whole black cardamom pods, crushed | 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed
instructions: To make dough, in large mixing bowl, stir flour, whiskey, mustard powder, cardamom, and yeast until smooth with an electric mixer.  Cut in half of the puff pastry until each piece is about 2 1/2 inches thick.  Spread equal amounts of dough with beer into 8 even rounds, and place on prepared pan.  Press edges lightly with spoon so each round is level.  Sprinkle with remaining 1 teaspoon of yeast.  Allow dough to rise 30 minutes in a warm location until doubled.  Bake at 400 degrees for 6 to 8 minutes, or until bottom is golden.  Remove from oven, and cool on cooling rack.  Store in a tightly covered container in a cool, dry place for up to 1 month.

Random Ingredients: sirloin,green chilies,carrot,salad leaf,cake flour,bouquet garni,salmon fillet,rice flour
title: Chowder Beef Soup
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs sirloin | 2 lbs salmon fillets or 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken fillets | 2 tablespoons rice flour | 2 cups cooked rice flour | 1 bouquet garni ( see note ) | 10 small mushrooms, halved | 1 can chopped green chilies, well drained | salad leaves
instructions: Remove meat from bones, pat dry and cut into cubes, discarding any fat and fat.  Soak rice flour in 2 cups lukewarm water for 15 minutes, then drain.  Trim off any fat, then sieve the flour water into a bowl.  Add the beef, rice flour, boursin and chilies, reserving liquid.  Pour liquid into a saucepan and bring to boil, skimming any scum from the surface.  Reduce heat and simmer for 2 hours.  Remove the bouquet garni, remove meat from bones and shred meat into pieces.  Wash vegetables well and cut diagonally into 1/2 inch pieces.  Serve soup topped with meat and vegetables.

title: Cashew Crunch
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups raw cashews, unsalted | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce ( or tamari ) | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 2 tablespoons flour | 1/2 cup chopped roasted peanuts, chopped | fresh rosemary, to garnish
instructions: Set aside 1/2 cup of the cashew nuts and reserve the rest for garnish.  Place the rest of the nuts in a large bowl.  Using your hands, roughly crumble up the cashews and add the 2 1/2 cups of the reserved cashew nuts and cashew liquid.  Mix well together.  Place the rest of the cashew nuts in the bowl again and add the dark soy sauce, thyme, and oregano.  Mix well so that everything is incorporated and the nuts are well coated.  Add flour, mix well until it's evenly distributed throughout.  Add the peanuts.  Cover with plastic wrap and place in the refrigerator for about an hour.  Add the rosemary, mix well, and divide into two or three pieces.  Serve.

title: Steamed Hoisin-And-Caesar Salad
ingredients: 2 cups hoisin sauce | 1 cup club soda | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 1 cup dried currant | 2 ounces dried pimiento | 4 cups mixed greens
instructions: In saucepan, combine hoisin sauce 2 cups water or bottled orange juice and club soda and bring to boil.  Remove saucepan from heat, add orange peel, currants and pimento and toss for 2 minutes.  Put greens in individual salad bowls, pour hot sauce over and serve.

title: Quick Mexican Grilled Pork Roast With Bran Beans (Bacon Beans)
ingredients: 1 loaf bacon beans, trimmed and rinsed ( or your own or one large enough to accommodate a heavy roast ) | 2 1/2 lbs boneless pork loin, trimmed of fat and cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces | 2 teaspoons dried fenugreek | 2 tablespoons brandy | 2 ears corn, cleaned, cut in half | 1 cup red beans, cleaned | 1 cup provolone cheese, shredded ( or one large or two smaller deli slices )
instructions: Preheat an 11 by 7 inch baking dish on the middle rack.  Pour enough hot water into the pan to reach halfway up the sides of the bread loaf pan.

title: Aussie Pork Stew
ingredients: 4 tablespoons raisins | 1 1/2 lbs pork loin, well trimmed of fat and cut into 2 inch cubes | 1/2 lb smoked kielbasa, cut into 1/4 inch pieces or 1/2 lb smoked sausage | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 1 can lima beans, drained | 1 large mango, cut into 5 slices | 16 ounces frozen topping, thawed | 1 medium kiwelbasa, peeled and cut into 4 wedges
instructions: In medium saucepan, toast raisins in 1 tablespoon water over low heat, stirring occasionally, until golden, about 3 to 5 minutes.  Add pork and remaining ingredients except kiwelbasa and mango wedges.

Random Ingredients: artificial sweetener,dashi,liquid smoke,cayenne,soy sauce,panko breadcrumb,israeli couscous
title: Japanese-Style Oriental Couscous
ingredients: 1 cup instant dashi | 1/2 tablespoon liquid smoke | 2 teaspoons gochujang artificial sweetener | 2 1/2 teaspoons soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 3/4 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1 1/2 cups oriental-style couscous
instructions: Boil the rice in the dashi until done, then set aside. .  Mix together in a medium bowl, the dashi, sweetener, soy sauce, cayenne, gochujang, and panko.  Put the rice and rice in a bowl, pour in the soy liquid and mix until the rice is moistened.

title: Chinese Salmon (Vietnamese Style)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salmon fillets | soya sauce, to taste | 3 green leaves ( vietnamese style, green parts only ) | 4 slices prosciutto, sliced thinly
instructions: Preheat your oven to 425 degrees f.  Score the salmon fillets in a thin layer to prevent them from curling up while baking.  Lightly spray a baking sheet with nonstick spray.  Place the fillets onto the prepared baking sheet.  Place the baking sheet in your refrigerator to chill.  Place a piece of prosciutto onto a plate with a good pinch of soya.  Sprinkle the salt and a little bit of sate in the pan, then add the salmon.  Sprinkle with more sate and turn the salmon over with the prosciutto.  Let it sit in the pan for about 5 - 10 minutes so it gets a bit crispy on the outside and the salmon is cooked.  Remove from the refrigerator and slice into 8 equal pieces.  Arrange the pieces of salmon on serving plate with a spatula alongside.  Serve and enjoy.

title: Vegetable Noodle Soup With Mango-Cumin Croutons
ingredients: 8 ounces panettone, cubed ( or similar thin cut noodles ) | 8 ounces frozen mixed vegetables, thawed | 1/4 cup sliced sweet olives, drained | 8 ounces diced tomatoes or 8 ounces chopped canned tomatoes | 1 tablespoon ground cumin seed | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 3 quarts cold water | 1 tablespoon crushed pecorino cheese or 1 tablespoon fresh pecorino cheese, grated
instructions: Cook noodles according to package, or use the frozen vegetables for a different variation.  While noodles are cooking, place olives in a small saucepan.  Heat over low heat, stirring until they are soft and fragrant, about 5 minutes.  Set aside to cool.  Combine tomatoes with seasonings in a blender or food processor, pulsing several times until chopped fine.  Add to saucepan and simmer until thick, about 5 minutes.  Add pasta, vegetables and enough water to cover.  Heat through.  Place in serving bowl and sprinkle with a bit of cheese.  Serve with grated fresh pecorino or fresh parmesan cheese for a little extra spice.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,grain white rice,kosher salt,self rising flour,elbow macaroni,lime
title: Pantry Arrabiata
ingredients: 1 package dry red or white rice | 1 cup self-rising flour | 1 cup uncooked elbow macaroni | 1 1/2 cups olive oil | 2 limes, juiced | 1 package kosher salt | 4 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Place the rice and flour in a large bowl, and stir to blend.  Whisk in the 2 cups olive oil, lime juice, and salt.  Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.  Stir in the arrabiata, about 5 minutes, until the batter is thick and the rice is golden brown on the bottom.

title: Curried Cheese Quesadillas
ingredients: 4 ounces cheddar cheese, shredded | 2 ounces bittersweet chocolate | 3 slices canned oranges, zest of, grated | 1 teaspoon hot curry powder | 1 teaspoon cornstarch
instructions: Spray the insides of a skillet with non stick cooking spray and heat over medium heat.  Place 3 tablespoons of the cheese mix into the pan and sprinkle with the zest of the chocolates.  Let it set in the pan around the zest.  Add the curry powder.  Turn the heat back up to medium high until it begins to bubble.  Sprinkle the cornstarch over the top of the curried cheese.  Using a non stick skillet, lightly press the cheese with the back of the spoon until it is just beginning to stick to the sides, about 10 seconds.  Transfer skillet to a plate.  Repeat until all the cheese mixture is used.  Allow cheese mixture to cool slightly before serving with your favorite crackers or toadies.

Random Ingredients: garbanzo bean,kaffir lime leaf,accent seasoning,cardamom,yeast,red chilies,green olive,watermelon
title: Fantastic Mushi
ingredients: 7 -8 ounces watermelon flesh | 1 -2 small red chilies | 1 -2 kaffir lime leaf, crushed | 2 -3 ounces dried garbanzo beans ( chickpeas ) | 1 -3 teaspoon instant yeast | 3 cardamom, capsules crushed to release their aroma ( approximately 2 teaspoons ) | 1 1/2 cups filtered water or 1 1/2 cups bottled water | 1 1/2 teaspoons accent seasoning
instructions: Place all ingredients in a wok or large mixing bowl and mix thoroughly.  Cover with plastic wrap and leave for approximately 5 - 6 hours or overnight.  Remove wrapper from wok and scrape off excess moisture with a sharp knife.  Using damp hands, place a spoonful of filling into the center of a wrapper.  Fold the top of the wrapper over and gently press the edges together. .  Repeat with remaining wrappers and filling.  Allow to cool and set on a tray until needed.  Once set, dust sushi mat with accent to prevent sticking and cut each portion into 3 or 4 smaller squares along the edges of the bamboo mat.  Arrange the square on a tray, cover with plastic wrap and leave at room tempurature until ready to use.  Alternate layers of filling and squares with a small quantity of filling, brushing each with accent on top and wiping off any remaining accent with a napkin.  Allow to marinate for at least 30 minutes before you are ready to serve.  Munch with a spoon and serve.

title: Sauerkraut Pierogi
ingredients:
1 lb sauerkraut | 1/2 lb chopped raw cashews ( approx.
    - ) | 3/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 package frosting
instructions: Drain sauerkraut.  Pour water into a sauce pan.  Add drained sauerkraut to water.  Let sit for about 15 min, then drain.  Mix raw sugar and water until the sugar dissolves.  Pour hot liquid over sauerkraut.  In batches, place handful of drained cheese in a large plastic bag, and pour about a dozen at a time, squishing and squeezing bag around the sauerkraut.  Keep doing this until you have used up all the sauerkraut.  Heat oven to mix dough together.  You will need to spread the dough into an 8 inch round baking dish and bake 20 - 25 minute till golden brown, and puffy.  While baking, place cashew nuts in a bowl.  Cover with boiling water for 1 minute.  Rinse with hot water, and drain well.  Add the cashew nuts to the dough.  Pinch off small handfuls of dough and roll them into long fingers, then roll them again into long fingers again.

title: Beer and Brown Lentil Soup
ingredients: 4 ounces dark beer | 2 cups brown lentils, rinsed and sorted | 1 bunch watercress, chopped | 1/2 cup toasted croutons, to serve | nonstick cooking spray | 1 tablespoon butter, to fry | pepper, to taste
instructions: Pour the beer in a large soup pot, along with lentils.  Dice the watercress, and saute in a non stick frying pan with the butter over medium low heat for 5 minutes or so.  Add watercress and bring to a boil.  Cook over medium heat for 15 minutes, or until thick.  Turn off heat and add croutons.  Serve topped w/fresh cracked pepper.

title: Hot Wine
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh italian parsley, chopped | 1 fluid ounce grand marnier
instructions: Pour the wine into a serving glass.

title: Mustard Noodle Salad With Asparagus Dressing
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 2 teaspoons cumin seeds | 2 tablespoons asparagus ( from frozen asparagus, thawed ) | 1 tablespoon ghee or 1 tablespoon butter | 2 teaspoons anise seed ( optional )
instructions: Cook noodles until tender, rinse well and drain.  In a medium size bowl, combine mustard seeds, cumin seeds and asparagus.  Stir in the mustard mustard seed mixture and stir well.  Dressing, in a medium sized bowl, slowly combine the ghee and the anise seeds.  Gradually add the dressing to the noodles and toss to coat.  Cover and set aside at room temperature for 30 minutes to flavors develop.

title: Green Tomatoes for Faggots or Appetisers
ingredients: 1 kg green tomato | water, to cover the tomatoes
instructions: Heat the oven to 200c/gas cut the tomatoes into thick slices, about 1 cm.  Bake on a baking tray covered with baking paper for around 20 minutes, or until the skin starts to blister on the tomatoes.

title: Bubble and Squeak
ingredients: 3 lbs bob evans irish gold hot dogs ( or your favorite meat ) | 6 slices kraft italian dressing ( kraft zesty italian style ) | 1 1/2 cups dry coriander ( or fresh ground ) | 3 tablespoons lard ( optional ) | 8 slices smoked jarlsberg cheese
instructions: Butterfly the hot dogs.  Wrap a slice of cheese on one end of the hot dog and roll it up and tie with kitchen string to keep closed.  Heat oven to 350 degrees.  Warm the dressing on low heat in covered dutch oven.  When piping hot, poke a hole in the hot dog with a toothpick and stuff with the dressing.

title: Adobo Sauce Roasted Chile Relish (Salsa Bueno)
ingredients: 3 -4 red chilies, roasted, peeled and seeded | 1/4 cup adobo sauce | water, as necessary | 3/4 cup madeira wine
instructions: Put the roasted chilies in a food processor or blender and process until they are a smooth paste.  Put the roasted chilies in a glass jar, pour in enough water to cover them by at least 2 inches, and seal.  Let them soak overnight.  Put the vinegar, in a bowl or cup, or the container you plan to use them into a pot over low heat.  Bring vinegar to a boil, reduce heat, and continue to boil about 30 minutes over moderate heat.  Let cool.  When vinegar is cool, remove stems from chilies and place in food processor.  Add in chile paste and adobo sauce and process until smooth.  Pour this into a clean jar, close, and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: cracker,balsamic vinegar,beef broth,thyme leaf,chuck roast,ice water,barbecue sauce
title: Beef Roast With Chips With Balsamic Vinegar
ingredients: 6 lbs chuck roast | 1 can condensed beef broth | 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves | 3/4 cup barbecue sauce ( i prefer borsamic vinegar ) | crackers ( optional ) | boiled ice ( optional ) or cracked wheat crackers ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees.  Place roast in roasting pan.  Combine all remaining ingredients except crackers in saucepan.  Whisk sauce until smooth.  Pour over roast.  Cover tightly and place in roasting pan.  Roast for 3 hours, basting frequently, or 40 mins for medium.

title: Macadamia Nut Balls
ingredients: 4 ounces walnuts | 1 cup hazelnuts | 4 ounces candied gingerroot, chopped | 3 garlic cloves, chopped | 1 cup cream of mushroom soup | 1 lb of cleaned squid, cleaned | 2 ounces dried macadamia nuts
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together to make the nut balls.  Pour into a buttered, shallow oven proof pan and bake for 20 - 25 minutes in a preheated 350f oven until the top has turned a beautiful light brown.

title: Amarina® French Dressing
ingredients: 2 teaspoons sweet hungarian paprika | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 4 cups ice water
instructions: Blend paprika and celery seed with ice water.  Refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,yellow squash,margarine,blue curacao,beef broth,penne rigate
title: Caribbean Style Steak and Squash Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces penne rigate | 2 teaspoons margarine | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 1/2 lbs skirt steaks or 1 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks, cut into 4 | 1/2 cup low sodium beef broth | 4 slices yellow squash | 6 large lettuce leaves
instructions: Cook pasta in 6 quart dutch oven following package directions.  While pasta is cooking, melt 2 tbls.  Margarine in skillet over medium heat.  Stir in steak and onion.

Random Ingredients: salt,chicken tender,pork,creamy peanut butter,tamarind paste,buttermilk,red chili powder
title: Thai Creamy Peanut Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 500 g chicken tenders, cut into 1-2-inch cubes | 1 kg pork ( leg or shoulder, trimmed of excess fat ) | 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/2 cup buttermilk | salt | 1 small dried red chili powder | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste
instructions: Cut chicken tenders in half, leaving the remaining whole bone in the joints.  Thread the chicken onto 12 bamboo skewers.  Place skewers in a bowl, add the peanut butter, buttermilk, chilli powder, and tamarind paste and mix.  Preheat the grill or oven to 200c/160chc/gas cook chicken for 2 - 3 mins on each side or until well browned.  Serve with steamed jasmine rice and salad.

title: Peachy Pea Cheeseballs
ingredients: 2 cans peas | 1 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 1 cup cheese ( grated, your choice )
instructions: Drain the peas and cut down the center.  Place the peas in a large bowl.  Use a knife to mash the peas up a bit then stir in the dry milk powder.  Roll into balls.  Dip into grated cheese.  Put on a baking sheet and bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 5 - 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: whipping cream,kidney bean,catsup,vital wheat gluten,spanish onion,tamarind paste
title: Creamy Beans With Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup catalina worcestershire sauce | 1/4 cup canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 large spanish onion, thinly sliced | 1 1/2 tablespoons tomato-based tamarind paste | splash catsup ( not catalina � lite ) | 1/4 cup whipping cream or 1/4 cup milk
instructions: Whisk worcestershire sauce, beans, onion, and tamarind paste in small bowl.  Pour into large skillet.

title: Veal Noodle Medallions
ingredients: 2 tablespoons veal fat | 4 ounces thin egg noodles, cooked
instructions: Place the veal fat in a large skillet with a lid and heat over medium heat, stirring to melt.  Add the noodles and cook and stir until the noodles are soft and tender, about 10 minutes.  Stirring constantly, remove the noodles with a slotted spoon.  Add more veal fat if needed.  When most of the fat has solidified, remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: red food coloring,chili powder,olive,red chilies,onion,red shallot
title: Hot and Spicy Chilli Dipping Sauce

Prepare the skewers by threading 3/4 of the tofu onto the skewer, leaving at least 3 inches between each slice of tofu.  Heat a grill or broiler pan set on medium high.  Prepare the grill, then position the pan of meat onto the rack and cook, turning and spraying the pan frequently with vegetable oil, until the lamb is well browned, about 5 minutes.  Meanwhile, toast the cashews in a small dry skillet over medium high heat, stirring constantly, until they are lightly browned, about 5 minutes.  To serve, drizzle a small amount of vegetable oil onto the meat.  Place the skewers on a warm serving platter and sprinkle with the cashews and toasted cashews. instructions: In a mortar or pestle, crush mustard seeds and chilli flakes.  Add all other ingredients.  Using a small ladle, mix in gradually until desired consistency is achieved.

instructions: Combine first five ingredients and refrigerate.  To serve, spread about 2 tbsp enchilada sauce in bottom of 2 quart casserole, top with a little enchilada sauce and some peanuts. .  Repeat for other three layers, beginning with 3rd, layer on top.  Bake at 350 for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Toad in a Hole

instructions: Trim and discard bone from tenderloin.  If using canned peas, use peas, and cook in microwave for about 5 - 7 minutes. Toss with warm cooking oil, salt and pepper to taste.  Brown, and serve.

title: Artichoke and Chia-Seed Pasta
ingredients: 1 box medium pasta, rotini ( or rotini with rotel ) | 14 ounces artichoke hearts, drained ( canned artichokes, drained ) | 1/4 cup chia seeds, toasted | 3 tablespoons unsalted low-fat sour cream ( preferably unsweetened ) | 1 cup buttermilk | 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt ( or to taste )
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water until al dente, 8 - 10 minutes or according to package directions.

title: Smokin' Easy Baked Nuts

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Spread pecans onto a baking sheet, and toast in the preheated oven 5 to 10 minutes, or to desired crispness.  While pecans are toast, spray a baking sheet with non stick cooking spray.  Place an empty pumpernickel or regular cracker into the baking sheet with pecans to toast according to package instructions.  Drizzle about 1/3 cup of barbeque sauce over all of the nuts. title: Navy Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried navy beans | 1 lb salami | fresh thyme sprig
instructions: Sort and rinse beans.  Place the beans in an 8 quarts or larger oven proof skillet or dutch oven.  Cover with water by ¼ inch. Remove the salami from the bones and place in a serving bowl.  Drain the beans and stir in the salami.  Pour the stew over the salami.  Garnish with thyme.

title: Brisket and Salmon
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets, 3-4 oz each | 4 1/2 inches thick | 4 1/2 fluid ounces golden syrup | 4 1/2 fluid ounces margarine or 4 1/2 fluid ounces butter | 4 lbs ladyfingers, cut into 12 portions | 4 heads lox beef brisket, cleaned
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Cut 4 salmon fillets diagonally into individual fillets and place on a tray.  Sprinkle with salt and let sit 20 minutes.  Place the tin foil over the top and fill with cold water and place on the centre rack of the oven.  Bake for 45 minutes.  Heat the golden syrup, margarine and 3 3/4 cup water in a pan and place in a fish basket over a pan of boiling water.  Bring to the boil over medium heat, then cook gently for 5 minutes, until the syrup is reduced and syrupy.  Remove from the heat and cool, then pour over the grilled salmon into a cake dish and set aside.  Arrange a portion of the meat onto each plate.  Spread the golden syrup over the meat and then the lox.  Serve with the biscuits for squeezing over.

title: Sweet (And Tasty!) Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb pasta, penne or 1 lb rotelle, uncooked | 3 tablespoons masa harina ( maize corn flour ) | 3/4 cup brown sugar | 1 teaspoon cornflour ( maize corn cooking liquid ) | 4 -5 cups whipping cream
instructions: Cook pasta in plenty of boiling, salted water until al dente.  In a deep, heavy pot, heat 1½ cups cream and add 3 tablespoons masa harina powder.  Mix thoroughly.  Add brown sugar, cornflour and stir.  In a separate bowl, combine whipping cream with 1 teaspoon of cornflour and pour into cream/tomato/onion mixture.  Mix thoroughly.  Drain pasta and add to cream/tomato mixture.  Heat through.  Serve immediately.

title: Rump Steak and Pasta With Chilli Cheese
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 500 g rump steak | 8 ounces linguine or 8 ounces shell pasta | 1 red capsicum | 500 g velveeta cheese
instructions: Place the steak in a large ziploc bag and add the oyster sauce.  Shake well to coat and marinate for 30 minutes.  Cook the pasta according to the instructions onthe package and set aside in a warm spot.  Heat the grill to high.  Slice the capsicum and set aside.  Cook the steak and remove from the marinade.  Grill the meat for 5 minutes per side or until cooked to your liking.  Remove from the grill and slice, to your liking.  Meanwhile in a saucepan cook the cheese for 3 minutes.  Combine the pasta and capsicums in a large flameproof caserole.  Pour over the cheese.  Return to the grill and cook for another 3 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbling.  Serve over the pasta and steak with a wedge of cucumber, if desired.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,beef tenderloin,breadcrumb,honey dijon mustard
title: Korean Crumbed Beef Tenderloin

instructions: Place tenderloin in a shallow roasting pan that has been coated with cooking spray or a light coating of cooking spray.  Set aside.  Preheat oven to 450°f.  Combine mustard and bread crumbs in a shallow dish, stirring to mix well.  Evenly coat the tenderloin with mustard mixture on both side of the meat.  Roast on a rack that has been in the oven for 30 minutes.  Remove from oven and let rest for 10 minutes.  Transfer to a roasting pan.  Heat remaining mustard and breadcrumb mixture in a nonstick skillet over medium heat for 3 minutes.  Spread mustard mixture onto the rarely cooked side of the tenderloin and continue until sauce is reduced, about another 5 minutes.  Cut tenderloin into 3 thick medallions.

title: German Meat Filling for Danish Pastry
ingredients: 1 lb dry-meat | 1 1/2 cups ground hazelnuts | 1 tablespoon caraway seed
instructions: Combine all ingredients.  Mix well.  Cover and refrigerate for 1/2 to 3 days.  Shape into 2 inch diameter rounds, dip in warm egg white just until browned.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,cream mushroom soup,white sesame seed,thyme,plum,chicken breast half,chicken stock,feta cheese
title: Chicken Souvlaki
ingredients: 4 bone-in chicken breast halves, with skin | 4 plum, skinned, and coarsely chopped | 1 cup reduced-sodium fat-free chicken stock | 1 package crumbled feta cheese | 1 package dry white sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme | 1/2 teaspoon dried orange peel | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler.  Arrange the chicken breasts on a broiler safe baking sheet under the skin, and broil until nicely browned and no longer pink in the center, 2 to 3 minutes per side.  Remove from the oven, and set aside.  Rinse the chicken breasts under a knife, and pat dry with a paper towel.  Chop into 1/2 inch cubes, and set aside.  Stir together the plum crumbles, crumbled cheese, sesame seeds, thyme, and orange peel in a bowl.  Place the chicken in a mixing bowl, and use your hands to squeeze the herb mixture into the chicken.  Stir in the cream of mushroom soup until thoroughly mixed.  Transfer to a glass baking dish, and set aside.  Place the oven safe baking dish in the preheated oven, and broil until the top is browned, about 12 minutes.  Remove from the oven, and serve.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Place the olives in a bowl, toss with the chicken thighs, onion salt, oregano and chili oil.  Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes. Place turkey, tomato and 1/2 of the mexican cheese in a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with the rest of the cheese.  Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.  Serve hot.

title: Sautéed Spicy Tomato and Chile Pepper Fajitas
ingredients: 2 fresh thai chile peppers | 4 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Slice each pepper in half through the stem and remove seeds, membrane, and seeds.  Fill a small saucepan with just enough water to cover the peppers.  Heat to boiling over high heat.  Carefully slide in the chile peppers.  You may need to cover your saucepan with a towel.  Reduce heat to low and cook for 10 to 12 minutes or until peppers are tender and have the texture of a pickled napkin.

title: Fennel and Lima Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups canellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 cups green beans, trimmed and cut into 2-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 tablespoon flagehetti liquid smoke | 1/2 tablespoon chopped fennel seed | 1/4 cup toasted kalamata olive | 1/4 cup kalamata olive ( or more )
instructions: Toss together the beans, green beans, carrot, oil and juice.  Mix in the fennel seed, olives, and olive oil.  Season with the lime juice and margarine.  Best served at room temperature.

title: Spicy Sausage Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1/4 teaspoon black olives ( optional ) | 1/3 cup chunky salsa | 1/4 teaspoon grill seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 12 large hard-shell white button mushrooms
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f.  Break the sausage into small pieces.  Use an 11x7 inch baking dish, or a shallow pan.  In a large bowl, combine the sausage pieces, bread crumbs, celery seed, black olives, salsa, grill seasoning, and chicken bouillon.  Rinse the mushrooms, and carefully remove the stems if too thick.  Spread the mushrooms on a plate.  Stuff the mushrooms with the sausage stuffing, then place them side by side in the baking pan.  Bake on the middle rack of the oven for about 40 minutes.  Bake 20 - 30 min more, until mushrooms are tender.

title: Alton's Grilled Burritos from Scratch
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef roast | 4 tablespoons cooking oil | 12 corn tortillas or 12 whole grain tortillas | 5 tablespoons garlic paste ( or equivalent ) | 1 1/4 cups whole milk ricotta cheese ( or you can use regular ricotta ) or 1 1/4 cups sheep's milk cheese ( or you can use regular ricotta ) | 1 1/4 teaspoons allspice ( or equivalent ) | 1 -3 tablespoon acorn squash ( optional ) or 1 -3 moroccan squash, as desired ( optional )
instructions: Wash the meat very thoroughly, trim off excess fat and cut meat up into strips.  Pour enough oil into a large saute pan to cook the meat with a lid on for a very short, heavy fry.  Cut up the tortillas or whole wheat tortillas into smaller pieces. When meat is well browned, remove the meat to a mixing bowl.  Add the garlic paste and stir until they get fragrant and start browning lightly, about 3 mintues.  In a food processor or blender, mix the ricotta, allspice and acorn squash and if using, a few tablespoons of water if necessary to blend well to a slightly soupy mixture.  Add the meat back into the skillet, stir to combine and set aside.  Wrap the warm tortillas in foil or saran wrap and put in a baking dish which is lined with plastic wrap. I have also baked burritos as a side dish with other dishes we make on a pizza to eat with.

title: Easy Meat Pies

instructions: Heat all ingredients in a non stick pan.  The meat will break down into chunks when heated through, and that's a good sign the margarine gives the sauce a different texture and flavor. Fry in butter over medium heat for about 3 - 5 minutes or until just browned on the outside but still a little pink inside.

instructions: In a small bowl, mix catsup, lemon thyme, parsley, turmeric, bacon grease, and flour.  Pour into a greased 5 to 6 cup slow cooker.  Cover, and cook on high 1 1/2 hours.  Reduce the heat to low.  Cook 10 minutes, or until meat is extremely tender.

Remove meatballs from oven and add to mushroom mixture.

instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees.  Place squash, parsnips, green pepper and rum in a large baking dish.  Cover with foil and bake for 15 minutes.  Remove foil, add marmalade, garam masala and cheese.

title: Italian Barbecue Beef Sandwiches

instructions: Combine first six ingredients in a large non aluminum casserole dish.  Cover and refrigerate 3 hours or overnight.  Bring to room temperature before grilling.  Serve on the side with the reserved meat.

instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water until al dente.  Meanwhile, heat remaining ingredients.  When pasta is just done, drain well.  Stir into the sauce mixture.  Heat for approximately 5 minutes until heated through, stirring occasionally.
