instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water.  Mix in icing sugar and almond paste.  Stir dough well by hand.  Spread on cookie sheet.  Let rise in a warm place for approximately 1 hour, until dough reaches an internal temperature of 37f degrees.  Sprinkle with almond paste and desired amount of icing sugar.

title: Flemish-Canadian Sausage (Pol pate)
ingredients: 1/4 lb lean ground pork loin | 4 fresh sage leaves or 2 teaspoons dried sage | 2 slices dried bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f in a medium nonstick skillet, cook the pork loin, with about ¼ tablespoonfuls of sage, over medium heat, stirring, 3 - 4 minutes, until browned.  Drain.  Break it up into crumbs as necessary, about 3 minutes.  Push the pork into smaller bits with a wooden spoon.  Spread evenly with the crumbs.  Cut each slice of bread crosswise into three triangles about ¼ inch thick.  Place triangles on a baking sheet with some sage hanging over the edge.  Bake 10 - 15 minutes, turning the sausages over when it's completely cooked, until lightly browned.  Let sausage cool, warm, and break into pieces.

title: Potato Chapati (South American)
ingredients: 1 -2 teaspoon potato flakes | 1 cup fresh peas and carrot ( or frozen carrot, thawed ) | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese or 1 cup colby-monterey jack cheese | 2 cups coarsely coarsely chopped salad-size fresh potatoes | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro | 1 1/4 cups coarsely textured semolina or 1 1/4 cups whole wheat flour | lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Combine potato flakes, peas, carrots, cheese, and 1 cup water in a medium bowl.  Mix lightly.  Spoon mixture into lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish.  Sprinkle with more cheese and cover with foil.  Bake for 12 to 14 minutes or until browned and lightly crisp.  Cut into eight squares.  For crusty latkes, preheat oven to 400 degrees.  In shallow bowl, combine remaining 1 cup water with the semolina.  Let stand for 5 minutes, stir, and let stand 5 minutes.  Stir in 1/2 of the chopped cilantro, turn into a greased shallow serving bowl, and sprinkle with remaining cilantro.  Set aside.  Bake for 15 - 18 minutes or until puffed and browned.  Note, you can make a dough by combining 1 1/2 cups of cooked rice with the semolina, then spoon into hot chapati shells.  Top with lettuce.

title: Easy Pizza Salad
ingredients: 1 can of ready made homemade pizza crust | 4 -6 thin strips of your favorite shredded lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 550 degrees.  On the bottom of the pizza crust, place a little bit of the pizza toppings.  Take the left over toppings out and scatter them on top of the pizza crust.  Slice the leftover whole lettuce head into four pieces and place on top.  Bake in the oven for 7 - 9 minutes so the cheese browns.  You can serve this also with a salad on top the toppings would be amazing as well.

title: Ancho-Apricot Smoked Chile Glaze for Bites
ingredients: 4 ancho chiles, small and small | 3 tablespoons dried apricot jam | olive oil
instructions: In a small skillet, toast the chiles over moderately low heat, turning them often, until they become fragrant, 3 to 4 minutes.  Cool, place the chiles in a small food processor and pour in the apricot jam and chiles.  Process or blend until smooth.  Place in a small decorative jar, seal and chill at least 1 day and up to 1 week before use.  Store at room temperature.

title: Tasty Italian Wine Trifle
ingredients: 1 package yellow cake mix | salad greens | 1 bottle red wine | 1 package ladyfingers
instructions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions.  Divid salad greens among 4 serving bowls.  Dollop red wine around the edge of each bowl of salad greens for a finale.

title: Microwave Coconut Miso Bread (Abm)
ingredients: 500 g abm ( raw ) | 1/4 cup dried coconut | 5 g active dry yeast
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in about 75 gram warm water.  Combine the yeast mixture with the coconut and abm.  Put the abm in the microwave for 10 minutes on high power with its lid on.  If the temperature is way too warm, the bread will not stick together.  If an open container has dropped to the touch, let it sit for a couple of minutes.  If it is too dry, let it sit for a few more minutes.  Remove the bread from its microwave.  You will notice that the bread has started breaking down into tiny pebbles.  You may need to add more water if the bread starts to stick to the microwave.  Leave the bread in the microwave for another 2 minutes.  If it doesn't break apart, you could simply add a piece of bread to the microwave, then place in the microwave again for 30 seconds.  Switch off the oven, remove the abm from the microwave and leave for another 3 minutes.

title: Wild Berry Good For Health Drink
ingredients: 750 g strawberries, washed, halved | 500 g sliced mushrooms | 2 -3 serrano peppers | 2 tablespoons walnuts | 1 -2 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1/2 cup orange juice
instructions: Boil all ingrediants until the berries are tender.  Remove from heat and add fruit.  Toss.

title: Aarsi’s Ultimate Fat-Free Refrigerator Filling
ingredients: 1 medium acorn squash ( can use one large acorn squash, but the recipe would not recognize that ingredient ) | 1/3 cup skim milk | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 tablespoon skim milk
instructions: Prepare the acorn squash by first slicing it in half lengthwise, then gently scoop out the seeds to remove any fibers and the beginnings of a shell.  Then slice it into ¼ ½″ inch cubes.  Preheat the oven to 300 degrees.  Pour the 1/3 cup skim milk into a 9x13 pan, being sure to cover the bottom of the pan.  Add the almond extract and mix to blend well.  Add in the asafoetida.  Bake the acorn squash for 90 minutes, or until completely dry.  Add about ½ cup additional skim milk, just enough to keep the mixture moist enough to coat the evaporated milk in a spoon.  Remove the pan from the oven, and let the mixture cool.  Refrigerate until ready to use.  If you’re using skim milk, combine ¾ cup skim milk with the rest of the skim milk in a small saucepan on high heat.  When the milk starts to bubble up around the edge of the pan, whisk in the almond extract and remove from the heat.  If using whole skim milk, set aside and add in the mixture.  When cooled, you should notice that the liquid is starting to run a bit thickened, but there should still be a small amount of liquid remaining but the mixture will not be as thick as milk.

title: Cracker Barrel Covered With a Cheese
ingredients: 24 small radishes, peeled | 1 lb of good quality imitation crabmeat | 1/2 cup of grated parcheese italian | 1/2 cup of grated tasty cheese with a good quality italian flavor | 5 whole white onions, peeled
instructions: Lay one radish on the bottom of the barrel glass just a little larger than the radish.  Sprinkle the bottom half of the glass with the imitation crab meat, italian cheese, white onion, and a whole bunch of the olives.  Repeat for every second glass, until all the radishes and crab is used up.  Pour the rest of the olive oil over the top of the top layer of cheese.  Be sure to cover the top with a lid for extra air to circulate.  Set over the sink and dig in.  Do not eat it until you are 90% of the way down from the inside, it should be gone after an hour.  After an hour or two, allow to sit for a minimum of an hour.

Random Ingredients: celery salt,lasagna noodle,plain yogurt,fruit,cayenne pepper,pecorino cheese,vegetable broth,baking potato
title: Vegan Gnocchi
ingredients: 3 baking potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 -2 pinch cayenne pepper | 1 tablespoon celery salt | 2 cans vegetable broth | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons dried fruit | 1/4 cup grated pecorino cheese | lasagna noodle ( to hold noodles in a single layer, or large casserole dish )
instructions: In a large pot heat the veggie broth until boiling.  Add the baking potato chunks and cayenne pepper.  When the broth comes to a boil reduce heat to medium.  Simmer until the potato chunks are soft when pricked with a fork.  When potatoes are soft drain all but 1/4 cup of the broth.  Stir in the yogurt, fruit, and cheese and mix well.  Place a generous amount of the tomato/gnog sauce in the bottom of a 6 qt casserole dish.  Layer noodles in this order,.  1/2 of the tomato/gnog sauce, 1/2 of the noodles and 1/2 of the potato mixture.  Repeat ending with the cheese on top.  Bake 1 hour at 350 degrees.  Serve with parsley.

title: Earl's Eggplant Sauteed With Herbs
ingredients: 2 eggplants | parsley flakes
instructions: Slice off the eggplant tops with a spoon and carefully scrape out the inside of the eggplant with your hands.  Sprinkle a little bit of papertowels or fresh parsley flakes on the eggplant.  Warm in a small frying pan on medium to medium high heat.  Don't let it get to high or let it get very hot.  When the tops of the eggplant are just starting to turn golden, take them out and add to a small serving plate.  Serve with a green salad.

Random Ingredients: mustard,extra virgin olive oil,mexican oregano,ouzo,romaine lettuce heart,enchilada sauce
title: Enchilada Bites with Honey-Ouzo Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dry mustard | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 3/4 cup prepared enchilada sauce | 1 1/2 cups shredded romaine lettuce hearts | 1 cup ouzo | 1/4 teaspoon mexican oregano, flakes
instructions: Heat mustard in small nonstick skillet over medium heat until slightly darkened.  Transfer to bowl.

title: Endive - Belgian Endive Wrapped in Mascarpone Cheese- Melted Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 cup mascarpone cheese | 2 heads belgian endive, cored and cleaned
instructions: Rinse endive heads under cold water and drain well.  Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper and arrange the endives in one layer.  Sprinkle with a pinch of salt to taste.  Place cheese over the endives and wrap the outside of the wrap with twine.  Seal the ends with another twine.  Cover the wrap with aluminum foil and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.  Remove wrap and place on a baking tray lined with wax paper or plastic.  To make the melted cheese, cut off the ends and discard.  Cut off any remaining cheese from the wrap, about 1/2 inch wide and about 2 inches long.  Gently scrape the inside of the wrap with a spoon so that the melted cheese is completely coated and sticks together.  Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f.  Remove the wrap from the cheese.  Wrap the excess cheese off the endive leaves and reserve for a garnish later.  Arrange the endive leaves on the lined cookie sheet cut side down.  Bake for about 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until the endive is tender and beginning to brown.  Remove the wrap and top with melted cheese.  Return the cookie to the oven for 20 minutes and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: liquid honey,confectioner ' sugar,extra sharp cheddar cheese,ancho chile powder,yellow onion,ginger garlic paste
title: Cheese Paste and Adobut
ingredients: 1 cup extra lean ground round | 1/3 cup yellow onion, finely minced | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons liquid honey | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix well.  Keep refrigerated until serving time.  Keep refrigerated until needed.

title: Prunes & Corn
ingredients: 2 cups fresh corn kernels | 1 1/2 tablespoons prunes or 1 1/2 tablespoons currants | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper | 2 tablespoons cornflour
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium saucepan.  Reduce heat to low.  Cover & simmer gently for 40 minutes.  Remove from heat & cool to room temperature.  Stir before serving.

Random Ingredients: ice water,dark rum,potato starch,turkey,sirloin,white wine,cake flour
title: Tail or Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs ground sirloin | 1/2 lb ground turkey | 2/3 cup potato starch | 3/4 cup cake flour | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1/4 cup white wine | 1/2 cup ice water | 1/2 package frozen potato starch
instructions: Combine dry ingredients.  Make sure the potato starch is moist and in a small bowl combine the ice cold water and 2/3 cup of potato starch for the water.  Form into a ball.  Dip ball in water then dredge in the potato starch.

title: Horseradish Croutons
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 3 tablespoons horseradish
instructions: Slice your loaf lengthwise.  It is important to use a large baking pan which has a good rim because otherwise any slices that are too large will dry out.  It doesn’t have to be perfect, so if you slice it too thinly it may become difficult to slice right through.  But it does not matter now.  Place slices in a paper bag.  Pour horseradish and mix well.  Let the mixture sit at room temperature for a few minutes, then gently take them out. .  Place on a plate and roll, starting on a side.  It is best not to work quickly but you can work quickly if necessary.  Serve them straight from the bag, with crackers for dipping.

title: Couve Gruyere (French Grilled Cheese)
ingredients: 3 cups gruyere cheese ( grated ) | 2 tablespoons half-and-half | 1 lb stewing beef or 1 lb other sirloin steak, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 kiwi fruit ( cut into 1/4 inch thick slices ) | 3 tablespoons rendered chicken fat or 3 tablespoons melted lard
instructions: Preheat grill.  In a small bowl, combine half and half and gruyere until it clumps together.  Add beef cubes, stir until well combined.  Add sliced kiwifruit, tossing to combine.  Brush grill rack with oil.  Grill kiwifruit 3 to 5 minutes, turning frequently until browned.  Spread the gruyere mixture on grill rack, cover, and grill for 10 to 12 minutes or until crust is lightly browned on top.  Turn and grill until crust is lightly browned.  Serve immediately.

title: Baked Eggs
ingredients: 6 eggs | 1/2 cup cornflour | 1/4 cup soft breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 220 degrees celsius.  Crack eggs into a bowl and beat thoroughly.  Add cornflour and breadcrumbs.  Mix to combine.  Place egg mixture in a greased oven proof dish.  Bake for 25 minutes.

title: Lebanese Sausages
ingredients: 8 1/2 lbs jabys hake or 8 1/2 lbs laddies | 1/4 teaspoon mace
instructions: Wash and pat dry the jabys hake or laddies.  Sprinkle with mace.  Tie with muslin, and place in an uncovered roasting pan.  Heat the grill, cover, and broil.  Place meat on the rack, and let it cook for half an hour.  Turn the meat several times during the last fifteen minutes of cooking.

title: Faux Sled Fish and Chips with Apples
ingredients: 1 lamb chop ( about 8 ounces ) | 1 tart apple, such as granny smith, finely diced | 1 banana, cut crosswise into 4 wedges | 2 teaspoons cream of tartar | cooked banana slices, as garnish
instructions: Heat a large, heavy ovenproof frying pan over moderate heat until hot but not smoking, then saute the lamb for 3 minute.  Transfer to a bowl.  Add the apple, banana and cream of tartar to the pan and continue to cook, stirring, for 1 minute.  Add the chops and return the lamb to the pan.  Cover with foil and bake at 400 degrees for 25 minutes, or until hot through and cooked through.  Season to taste.  Serve the fish and chips with a garnish of sliced fruit.

title: Allspice Sambol
ingredients: 5 cups whole wheat flour | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 2 teaspoons ground allspice
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl.  Stir in allspice.  Knead on a floured surface until smooth.  Pat dough out to 1/4 inch thickness.  Cut into desired shapes with cookie cutter and decorate with candied ginger or serranos or cajun symbols.  Heat a heavy skillet and add a tablespoon or so of oil.  Fry the sambol until browned, they will puff up in 15 seconds and then drain.  Cook on a dry grill.

title: Coriander Panini on a Stick
ingredients: 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 1 1/4 cups shredded lettuce leaves | 1 1/4 cups fresh cantaloupe flowers | fresh cherries or sultanas, halved | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1 small ciabatta, halved lengthways, cut into 4 slices | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh coriander leaves
instructions: Toss salad in a mixing bowl with vegetable oil.  Cover, refrigerate and set aside.  Mix remaining salad ingredients in a separate bowl.  Add salad and toss to coat.  Arrange on a serving platter and serve with bread.

title: Quick Peppered Red Bell Pepper Soup
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper ( red bell peppers may be used if bell peppers are not sweet enough ) | 3 cups low sodium vegetable broth | 1/2 ounce dried thyme | 1/2 ounce cinnamon | food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Preheat broiler to medium high and line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and set oven rack to 3 - 4 inches from the heat source.  Cut the bell pepper in two lengthwise slanted slivers.  Place the bell pepper on the prepared baking sheet.  Broil in one layer, turning occasionally, until slightly softened, about 5 minutes.  Transfer the bell pepper to a bowl and set aside.  Pour the broth into a large pot.  Add the thyme, cinnamon and the bell pepper pieces.  Bring to a simmer over medium high heat.  Reduce the heat to medium and simmer until the liquid in the pot and the liquid is reduced by half, about 20 seconds.  Use a slotted spoon to transfer the reduced vegetable broth to a blender and blend with a little of the vegetables.  Return the puree to the pot and keep the soup at a simmer.  Taste and add additional salt if desired.  Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: salt,tomato green chilies,dark chocolate,quinoa,white pepper,egg white,pimiento,salt black pepper
title: Quinoa Stuffed Tomatoes With Chocolate
ingredients: 3 large ripe tomatoes, washed, stem ends trimmed, and sliced 1/4 inch thick | 4 ounces dark chocolate, grated | 4 tablespoons pimientos, finely diced and drained on paper towels | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 2 large egg whites | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper | 1 cup quinoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Butter a 1 1/2 quart baking dish, and arrange the sliced tomatoes in it.  Bake in the preheated oven, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes are tender, 15 to 20 minutes.  In a medium saucepan over low heat, combine the chocolate, pimentos, salt, and peppers.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,american cheese,romaine lettuce,oyster sauce
title: Gourmet Oyster Sauce Salad
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, washed, dried and torn into bite sized pieces | 1 package american cheese, cubed ( cheddar can be substituted ) | 1/2 lb fresh oyster sauce | 2 -4 tablespoons red wine vinegar ( to taste )
instructions: Drain cheese and reserve.  Chop remaining cheese and mix in oyster sauce and vinegar.  Place in refrigerator.  Serve on lettuce leaves.

title: Pickled Beets
ingredients: 12 medium asian beets, scrubbed, stems removed ( about 10 1/2 pounds ) | 3 cups vegetable stock
instructions: Combine the beets, stock, and 1 tablespoon salt and let stand at room temperature 1 hour or refrigerate up to 3 days, stirring from time to time, adjusting the salt and water as needed to prevent acidity.  Arrange beets on a serving platter and sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon salt and 1 teaspoon pepper.  Serve with pickled beets for dipping.

title: Beans Sprouts and Fried Rice
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 package bean sprouts, thawed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Place a paper towel in a glass baking dish to drain grease.  Lightly spray a small amount of oil in a medium skillet.  Cook bean sprouts in oil over medium heat, stirring frequently, about 5 minutes or until crisp tender.  Slide sprouts onto paper towels to cool.  Place cooked bean sprouts in a serving dish.

title: Raspberry Seed Jam With Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 1 cup pure raspberry jam or 1 cup jelly | 3/4 cup sesame seeds
instructions: Place jam in strainer and press dry seeds over.  Let sit while jelly and seeds absorb the jam.  Combine sesame seed and about 3/4 cup water in a pot, bring to boil.  Boil until sesame seeds are soft, about 1 minute.  Remove pan from heat and beat vigorously with a spoon.  Scrape onto a bowl, cool, and cover with plastic wrap.  Refrigerate for at least 3 hours, stirring once every 3 - 4 hours.  Store in air tight container.

title: Ginger and Cannellini Beans (Gingereans)
ingredients: 1 lb cannellini beans, cleaned | 1/2 teaspoon ginger, ground
instructions: Boil beans in water to cover over medium heat for 5 to 7 minutes.  Drain beans.  Place 1 inch of oil in a heavy skillet and set over medium high heat.  When oil begins to shimmer, add 1/4 cup bean paste and stir for a moment, just until the paste darkens in color.  Beans should sizzle once during cooking.  Immediately remove the frying pan from the heat and add the ginger.  Return frying pan to the heat and add bean paste.  Stir until mixture begins turning dark brown, 1 to 2 minutes.  Reduce heat to medium low and cover lightly.  Simmer gently for 20 to 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Transfer pan to a serving dish.

title: Warm Barley Salad
ingredients: 2 cups cooked pearl barley | 1 cup chopped fresh dijon mustard | 1 head chopped bibb lettuce, separated into leaves
instructions: In large serving bowl, combine barley, mustard and lettuce.  Toss to mix.

title: Rustic Polenta
ingredients: 2 large italian plums or 2 large other plum tomatoes, halved | 12 -16 cups polenta, cut into cubes ( all fat is needed for the polenta to be moist but not very dense )
instructions: Combine the tomatoes, halved to form boats, in a large bowl.  Sprinkle generously with salt.  Let stand for at least 2 hours.  Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.  Add 1 cup of polenta and a pinch of salt.  Stir vigorously with a wooden spoon until the polenta comes away from the sides.  Using a large slotted spoon, transfer the polenta to a colander or strainer and let drain until all of the liquid in the bowl is clear.  You may need to add a bit of water at a time.  Scoop the polenta as it is prepared into a colander lined dish and arrange the tomato halves over it.  Use two forks to push polenta through the colander so it is all the way through.  The polenta may be placed in the skillet immediately after it is poured into the skillet with the tomato halves.  Cook, stirring occasionally until the polenta is just lightly browned, about 10 minutes.  Sprinkle with more salt and serve hot or cold.

title: Peanut Butter and Chili Peppers R
ingredients: 250 g creamy peanut butter | 250 g rice flour | 1 -2 teaspoon chile pequins, chopped
instructions: Put peanut butter in a jar and add chillies then shake until it softens.  If it is too thick, add a little water.  Stir until well blended and pour over rice.  You can leave a bit of chillies and the flour in there if you want.  Refrigerate for at least 1 hour to set and serve.

Random Ingredients: guajillo chilies,italian tomato,italian salad dressing mix,plain flour,wheat flour,pizza crust,irish whiskey
title: Guajillo & Garlic Pizza
ingredients: 2 1/2 ounces guajillo chilies | 1 1/2 ounces irish whiskey | 1 tablespoon italian salad dressing mix ( eg sachet ) | 4 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 4 ounces plain flour | 1 1/2 italian tomatoes ( chopped ) | 1 pizza crust
instructions: Cut the chilies into thin slices.  Heat the oil in a pan or wok, until hot but not smoking.  Tip in the chilies and cook for a few seconds until they change color.  Stir in the dressing mix, then the flour.  Stir until it's blended well.  Stir in the tomato.  Spread evenly onto the pizza base you'll have to brush more of the dressing on it with this process.  Spread the guajillo & garlic over this.  Brush on more of the dressing on the pizza.  Bake in the preheated oven at 220 degrees f or 200 degrees c for 15 - 20 minutes or until the bread is golden brown and crispy on the edges.  Leave for 10 minutes before eating.

title: Pasta with Garlic and Herbs
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta ( bowtie pasta or penne ) | 1 teaspoon icing sugar | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | fresh herbs, crushed or chopped, to taste
instructions: Boil the pasta for about 10 minutes, until tender.  Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, combine the icing sugar with a dash of tabasco.  Add the pasta and herbs and toss to coat.  Serve immediately.

title: Cafe Mexicano
ingredients: 50 g cream cheese, cubed | 2 spring onions, finely chopped | 1 cup roasted sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 1/2 cup strong coffee | 1 1/2 cups manicotti
instructions: Boil water for the manicotti and take the pasta out of the water just before the water goes boiling.  Toss with olive oil until coated.  Chop spring onions thinly and fry for a few minutes until they are just starting to soften.  Add cream cheese and heat thoroughly until melted.  Add the sun dried tomatoes and coffee or some salt, to taste.  Stir until it has all warmed through.  Cook pasta drain and mix with cream cheese/cream mixture.  Put in the fridge to set.

title: Homemade Kebabs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted | 1 tablespoon ground savory
instructions: Combine the sesame seeds and savory.  Dry roast the sesame seeds on a non stick rack over a pan of simmering water until golden and fragrant.  About ten to fifteen minutes.  Stir frequently and watch to make sure they don't burn.  Drain onto a tea towel or paper towel, pat dry.  Sprinkle with salt and store in a dry place.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,corn oil,feta,icing sugar,graham cracker crust,white flour,apricot jam,pine nut
title: Greek Pasta Pie
ingredients: 1 package prepared graham cracker crust | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 2 tablespoons white flour | 1 jar spaghetti sauce, warmed | 3/4 cup apricot jam | 1/3 cup pine nuts | 3 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 tablespoon corn oil
instructions: Combine all crust ingredients.  Press into prepared crust.  Blend jam with 3 tbsp of icing sugar.  Bake at 350' 30 - 35 mins or until lightly browned and firm, and set aside.  Combine icing sugar and corn oil.  Heat over low until icing is thick and glaze starts to bubble, stir in remaining glaze.  Spread over cold pasta when cooled.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,white wine,picante sauce,doritos,granny smith apple,green bean,grand marnier
title: Costa Rican Beans
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups cooked green beans | 1 small granny smith apple, grated | 2 tablespoons minced canned tomatoes | 1/4 cup chopped picante sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 1 1/4 cups dry white wine | 4 1/2 teaspoons grand marnier
instructions: Place beans in medium saucepan.  Top with water until just covered, bring to boil over high heat.  Reduce heat to low.  Simmer until beans are tender and bright green, about 20 minutes.  Drain and reserve liquid.  Mash beans.  Place beans, apple, tomato, picante sauce, and soda in a food processor.  Blend until smooth.  Gradually stir the reserved bean liquid into the food processor.  Chill for at least an hour.  Stir the grand marnier into the beans.  Serve imediately.

title: Chipotle and Olive Risotto
ingredients: 3 cups arborio rice | 1 canned chipotle chile, chopped | 1 1/4 pounds russet potatoes, peeled and diced | 1/4 cup finely chopped kalamata olives, or to taste
instructions: Stir rice, chile, and potato together in a saucepan.

title: Fresh Herb and Prune Butter
ingredients: 2 ounces unsalted butter | 10 -12 pitted prunes | 1/2 cup packed fresh basil | 4 fresh basil leaves | 1 pinch saffron or 1 pinch turmeric | 2 ounces fresh parmesan cheese
instructions: Melt the butter over low heat in a small saucepan, add the prunes and cook until they begin to soften and begin to caramelize, about 30 minutes but watch carefully after they turn golden, or prunes may break up a bit while you remove them too quickly.  Drain the prunes, reserving the liquid.  Remove the pits and roughly chop them.  Cut the basil leaves into slivers and set aside.  Cut the basil into small dice and set aside.  Cut the parmesan into small cubes, and set aside.  Melt the butter over low heat in a small saucepan, add the basil and stir for one minute.  Add remaining prunes and the saffron and cook over low heat for 20 - 30 minutes until prunes soften and are tender.  Remove the pan from the heat, stir in the parmesan cheese and serve.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,white breadcrumb,lamb shank,plain flour,radish,buttermilk,hungarian paprika,dill
title: Polish Meatballs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried white breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon dill, fine, chopped | 6 lamb shanks, trimmed ( or 8 lamb chops ) | 6 radishes, finely sliced | 1 celery rib, finely chopped | 1/2 cup plain flour | 100 ml buttermilk ( or skim milk ) | 1 tablespoon sweet hungarian paprika
instructions: Place breadcrumbs in a bowl and mix with dill.  Season with salt and pepper and then the lamb, dill/salt mixture and the radishes.  Roll the meat in flour, and then put in baking paper/parchment and bake at c for 1 hour at 190°c.  Turn the meat over.  Heat gill and then mix in the flour.  Stir in the buttermilk.  Stir over heat until mixture thickens and starts to colour.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Let cool.  Cut meat into bite sized pieces and serve.  Note, the meatballs can be made ahead and frozen in rigid containers.  Cooks note, cooking time depends on the size and amount of skewers employed.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,broad bean,red kidney bean,anchovy paste,couscous,marjoram,red food coloring
title: Red Bean, Broad Bean, and Hazelnut Couscous Salad
ingredients: 5 cups cooked broad bean ( from a tin ) | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram, crushed | 1 teaspoon dried marjoram, crumbled | 10 g dried anchovy paste, coarsely chopped | 3 g red food coloring ( or white food coloring ) | 1 package couscous | 1 teaspoon hazelnuts, roasted ( optional ) | 7 tablespoons roasted red kidney beans, drained and finely chopped
instructions: Combine couscous ingredients in a large mixing bowl, mix well.  Gently fold in anchovies and red food colouring.  Pour into a bowl and sprinkle hazelnuts on top.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chuck roast,tomato juice,mustard green,venison steak etc,wakame,eggplant,red jalapeno chile
title: Sauce of Beef and Eggplant
ingredients: 2 lbs lean boneless chuck roast or 2 lbs pork shoulder | 1 lb fresh eggplant, peeled, and cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/4 cup worakame | 2 fresh red jalapeno chiles, seeded and finely chopped | 1 1/2 cups tomato and clam juice | 2 tablespoons mustard greens | 12 ounces fresh kabocha squash or 12 ounces zucchini, sliced
instructions: Brown meat well on all sides in the wok.  Add the remaining ingredients.

title: Jahmsha (Baharat & Fruit Salad)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons light rum | 1 tablespoon irish cream | 1 -3 green cardamom pod, seeds removed | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh parsley leaves | 1 pinch chili | fresh fruit, sliced thinly ( as desired )
instructions: Dip the fruit in rum and then in sour cream.  Serve with salad spoons sprinkled with chilies and fresh chopped parsley.  Note, if using sour cream, omit the rum.

title: Lime Cakes II
ingredients: 8 medium yellow potatoes, peeled | 1/2 cup fresh lime
instructions: Place potatoes into a large saucepan and cover with lightly salted cold water.  Bring to a boil over high heat and reduce heat to medium low.  Cook until tender, about 15 minutes.  Drain, allow to cool for a few minutes, then smash into a large bowl.  Beat in lime juice until potato mixture is smooth and creamy.  Add more lime juice to taste.

Random Ingredients: fine breadcrumb,red cabbage,serrano chilies,green cardamom pod,poblano chile,phyllo pastry,chicken breast,sole fillet
title: Poblano Chiles Wrapped Fillets
ingredients: 2 green cardamom pods ( use all the pods if preferred ) | 8 poblano chiles, sliced thin | 3 tablespoons garlic-flavored fines dry breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons chopped red cabbage | 1 1/2 lbs sole fillets or 1 1/2 lbs halibut fillets, trimmed, pinbones removed | 8 poblano chile slices, cut in 12 | 6 serrano chilies, sliced thin | 1/2 lb phyllo pastry sheet, thawed | fine dry breadcrumbs, for dredging
instructions: Soak the pods in very hot water to soften, about 10 minutes.  Drain the peels, rinse well with cold water, then drain again.  Toss with the garlic bread Crumbs and set aside.  Rinse each poblano chile, then slit into 3 lenghts and scrape out the seeds.  Place each chile, skin side up, in a small nonstick skillet and cook over medium heat, turning occasionally, until the peppers have lost their blackeness and are slightly charred all over, about 10 minutes.

title: Paneer
ingredients: 1 cup plain greek yogurt | 1 teaspoon craisins ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 3/4 teaspoon allspice | 1/2 cup unseasoned breadcrumbs, divided
instructions: Mix craisins and the asafetida with the yogurt and 1/2 cup of the breadcrumbs in a bowl.  Add remaining ingredients and gently stir to combine.  Shape into balls about 1 1/2 inch in diameter.  Flatten slightly with hand into 6 by 3 inch thick patties.  Grill over an on griddle/broiler setting for 3 to 5 minutes per side, or until cooked through.

title: Baked Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 package dried fettuccine pasta | 3 tart apples - peeled, cored and shredded
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add pasta and apple to the boiling water and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,chili oil,vanilla,liquid smoke,chocolate ice cream,baking potato,vegetable oil,cabbage
title: Chinese Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs red cabbage, shredded | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke | 2 cups shredded red cabbage | 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1 tablespoon chinese chili oil | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 cup shredded unsweetened chocolate ice cream | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder | cabbage, cored and shredded
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the shredded cabbage with the vegetable oil and liquid smoke.  Let sit for 15 minutes while you prepare the topping.  Heat the chinese chili oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Add the cabbage mixture and cook, stirring constantly, until the cabbage is coated with the chili oil, about 5 minutes.  Remove the cooked cabbage from the skillet, and transfer the cabbage to a large bowl.  Cover the bowl with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until ready to use.  When ready to use, stir the baking powder into the cabbage.  Add the topping and mix well.  Serve with additional shredded cabbage on top.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,beef chuck roast,tomato ketchup,beef eye,dark chocolate,egg yolk,fenugreek
title: Beef and Dark Chocolate Meatballs
ingredients: 500 g beef chuck roast, trimmed | 3 egg yolks | 1 can tomatoes with ketchup | 1 cup orange juice | 1/2 cup dark chocolate, chopped | 1 teaspoon ground fenugreek | 4 tablespoons good quality dark chocolate, chunks, chopped
instructions: Place the beef in a plastic bag or large bowl and add all the other ingredients.  Mix well and refrigerate overnight.  Preheat the oven to 160°c.  Divide the resulting meat mixture into 8 portions.  Roll each portion around each piece of dried beef ensuring that they are well sealed.  Place the meatballs on two oiled baking trays.  Bake for 30 - 40 mins, until nicely browned.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,gruyere cheese,cider vinegar,saffron thread,rice wine vinegar,fig,hard egg,white chocolate
title: Eggs in White Chocolate - Fondue With Saffron
ingredients: 3 hard-boiled eggs, peeled, chopped | 200 g gruyere cheese, grated | 1 sprigs of fresh mint, leaves picked | 1 sprigs fresh thyme, leaves picked | 1 pinch bicarbonate of soda | 50 ml rice wine vinegar | 85 ml cider vinegar | 400 g white chocolate, melted | 1 tablespoon saffron thread, ground
instructions: Place the eggs in a bowl and pour boiling water over them.  Leave to stand for about 4 minutes then drain well.  Mash the eggs with a fork.  Stir in the cheese, herbs, bicarb, rice wine vinegar, cider and salt and pepper.  Transfer the mixture to a pan and bring to the boil, stirring constantly.  Simmer gently for 3 - 5 minutes.  Pour into large bowls and leave to cool.  Once cold, stir in the white chocolate and saffron and leave to set.  Once set.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,lemon zest,vegetable bouillon granule
title: Lemon and Cheese Bouillon
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable bouillon granules | 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese | 3 lemons, zest of
instructions: Put the bouillon in a large cup, then sprinkle the ham and cheese over the bouillon.  Add lemon zest.  Crush the lemons with your hands over the top.  It's fun trying to crush the zest too much or you'll have lumps.

Random Ingredients: pork chop,black coffee,salmon fillet,raisin,rye bread,avocado,kidney bean
title: Smoked Salmon & Bean Loaf
ingredients: 2 pork chops, trimmed of fat | 1 tablespoon raisins | 1 teaspoon ground black coffee | 1 avocado - peeled, pitted and sliced | 6 slices rye bread | 4 ounces dried kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 12 ounces smoked salmon fillets, drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Place the pork chops into a greased, shallow, and large baking dish.  Top with raisins and coffee.  Bake for 20 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until the chops are browned and cooked through.  Lay the avocado slices on top of the meat, top with bread slices and beans, and bake for 10 minutes until the bread and beans are warmed through.  Add the salmon to the sandwich, and serve with a spoonful of mashed potato.

title: Sparkling Red Wine
ingredients: 4 cups reduced-sodium red wine | 1 sprig fresh thyme
instructions: Pour the wine into a 4 quart flat bottomed pan.  Add thyme.  Let it reach a simmer to simmer until the wine reduces by 1/3 or less, 1 to 2 hours.  Serve hot from the bottle or ladle over fresh greens.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,pork tenderloin,red food coloring,red curry paste,ladyfinger,saffron strand,cinnamon,cabbage
title: Sweet and Sour Tiramisu
ingredients: 1 lb littleneck cabbage | 1/4 lb thin pork tenderloin, cut into 1/4 x 2 inch strips | 1 packet saffron strands, crushed | 1/8 teaspoon cinnamon | 10 -12 ladyfingers | 1 cup red curry paste, thawed if frozen | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon powdered saffron strand | 1 drop red food coloring
instructions: Cook cabbage in a large pot of boiling salted water.  Meanwhile, place tenderloin in a large zip lock bag with saffron threads and cinnamon and toss to coat.  Add the sausage and toss to coat.  Pour off any excess moisture and let marinate at least 20 minutes at room temperature or refrigerate overnight.  When cabbage is drained, discard marinade and cut crosswise 1/8 to ¾ inch thick.  Reserve marinade.  Separate the ladyfingers into small pieces.  Scoop out excess meat and discard, leaving the remainder of the meat the head.  Reserve 1/2 cup of shredded cabbage and shred the rest, adding only enough as needed to bring the mixture together.  Prepare the sour cream sauce by combining cream of tartar with saffron and food coloring.  When cream of tartar has thickened and become a light amber color, add the green bit of orange blossom if available.  Transfer to a saucepan.  Cook over medium low heat until simmering, stirring frequently to prevent crystals from forming.  Dissolve the cream of tartar in additional 1/2 cup water and add to the sour cream sauce.

Random Ingredients: rice flour,green cardamom pod,burrito flour tortilla,coriander powder,vanilla bean

instructions: Warm burrito size tortillas on low for several minutes on warm oven scale or in a deep fryer, making sure that the burrito size is neither too hot nor too warm to handle. When burritos are done, remove from microwave and put on a microwave safe plate.  Microwave on medium power for 1 minute.  Remove burritos and plate and microwave another 15 seconds or so.  Serve warm with yoghurt and a chilli tea.

title: Oreo Ramen II

instructions: Place one ramen noodle in a bowl.

title: Mexican Green Chile

title: Welsh Beet & Soba Nests

Add the sliced beets& thyme, then return to the heat & cook about 5 minutes stir fry for 1 minute until the beet is tender.  Add the bread & continue to cook 1 - 2 minutes, stirring. title: Caramelized Chuck Roast With a Cheesecake

instructions: Preheat oven to 325 f degrees.  Place the roast in a large roasting pan and sprinkle with the cheese.  Combine the sugar, orange juice concentrate, peppercorns and olive oil and pour this over the roast.  Tuck the peppercorns through the roast.  Bake roast, tightly covered, for 1 hour.  Turn the roast, drizzle the reserved glaze over the roast, and bake for an additional hour and a half to 1 hour and 45 minutes, until a meat thermometer registers 140 f degrees.  Internal temperature of the roast should be at least 160 f f f for medium rare.  Remove the roast and let rest for 10 minutes before slicing.  Transfer to a plate and serve.

instructions: Mix together the ground beef, flour, cabbage, olives, cocoa powder and stock.  Knead to form a dough.  Pat onto pizza pan or a pizza stone lined with several layers of pizza dough.  Sprinkle with salsa and bake at 375f degrees for 12 minutes.  Eat hot or cold.

title: Easy Rice Noodle Salad

instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions.  Place in a large serving bowl.  Add 1/2 teaspoon salt.

title: Cafe Rio Bread - Abm
ingredients: 1/2 head chinese cabbage, shredded | 200 g rice vinegar | 10 -20 grains salt | 1/2 cup ground espresso coffee ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons corn niblets ( optional ) | 4 -5 tablespoons thyme leave ( or whatever spits you can find )
instructions: Heat your oven on 250 degrees.  In a large bowl mix all dry ingriendients together.  Place the cabbage in a large roasting pan.  Pour 1 cup of water into the same pan.  Place the cabbage in the oven.  Bake for about 8 minutes then turn the oven down to 180 degrees. title: Easy Mexican Cheese Pie
ingredients: 12 ounces sharp cheddar cheese ( shredded or sliced, i like to use shredded mild ) | 2 tablespoons picante sauce | 1/4 teaspoon accent seasoning | 1 1/2 cups filling ( for filling, can add up to 1/2 cup more )
instructions: To prepare filling, mix cheese, picante sauce, and accent.  Spread on bottom of pie shell.  Add 1/2 cup of the cheese mixture, over the cheese mixture.  Spread remaining cheese mixture around the filling.  Bake at 375 degrees until cheese is melted.  Let stand at least 15 minutes before cutting.

instructions: Place the lettuce pieces in a large bowl and toss.

title: Nut-Punch German Chocolate Cookies
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces german sweet chocolate, melted | 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour | 1 cup all-purpose flour | 3/4 cup self-rising flour | 2/3 cup walnut halves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  In a large bowl, cream together the 1 1/2 cups of the 1/2 cups of german chocolate and 1 1/2 cups of the all purpose flour.  Add walnut halves in thirds while stirring well with a large fork.  Stir in the remaining 1 1/2 cups of chocolate until well blended.  Gradually add the remaining 1 1/2 cups of flour.  Mix until well blended.  Shape dough into walnut sized balls, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.  Place on a parchment lined baking sheet with 2 long sides.  Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, or until lightly browned.  Remove from oven and set aside on the baking sheet for 5 minutes.  Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, melt remaining 1 cup of german chocolate on the stove over medium low heat until smooth.  Pour melted chocolate onto a plate.  Holding the bottom of a heavy skillet or drinking glass with a large rim, dip each walnut half into melted chocolate, shaking off excess chocolate.  Place back onto waxed paper to cool.  Repeat with remaining cookies.  Store in small airtight container.

title: Roasted Butternut Squash and Gruyere Cheese

instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºf.  Brush squash with a little of the paprika and sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of the maple syrup.  Roast until tender, about 40 minutes.  Remove squash from oven and stir in remaining syrup.  Cool to room temperature.  Meanwhile, melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat.  Add cheese and cook, stirring constantly, until melted, about 2 minutes.  Remove from heat and pour cheese over squash.  Serve immediately.  Serves.

title: Smoked Salmon Mini Frittatas
ingredients: 16 ounces salmon fillets | 8 ounces soymilk | 8 ounces shaved monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend | 1/4 cup miracle whip | 8 ounces sun-dried tomatoes | 4 tablespoons canola oil | 1 teaspoon allspice | 1/8 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Cut salmon into 1 to 1 1/2 thick pieces.  Dress with soy milk, then top with all the shaved cheese.  Drain tomatoes well, reserving a tablespoon of the tomato sauce.  Heat 1 tablespoon canola oil in skillet on medium heat.  Add the sun dried tomatoes and 1 teaspoon allspice.  Cook and stir for 15 seconds, then pour tomato tomato sauce into skillet.  Cook and stir for about 30 seconds, then stir in the grated cheese and ¼ cup of shredded parmesan cheese.  In the frittata pan on the stove top, warm remaining 1 teaspoon olive oil.  When oil is hot, add salmon and marinated tomatoes, then stir gently to warm.  Sprinkle ¼ cup of remaining shredded parmigiano on top of each portion.  Place in an oven safe baking dish, and place in preheated oven.  Bake in preheated 350 degree oven until the cheese topping is lightly browned and the salmon is cooked, about 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Doro Wat (Garlic Loaf)
ingredients: 1 lb cake flour | 4 cloves garlic, smashed | 3 large tomatoes, peeled, seeded and roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425f put about 1/2 lb of the bread flour in a food processor fitted with a steel blade or into a large bowl.  Pulse the garlic and tomatoes in the machine to a paste then add the paste, adding some of the remainder of the flour.  Pulse the mixture until the mixture resembles a paste.  Pour the mixture into the bowl that is already well seasoned, adding more flour only as necessary.  Place the bowl in the oven and raise the heat to 500f.  Butter and flour the loaf pan, and then pour in enough water to come halfway up the sides of the loaf loaf pan.  Bake for about 20 minutes, or until a skewer inserted into the loaf comes out clean but the loaf is not wet.  Cool in the pan.

Random Ingredients: rice wine vinegar,kernel corn,artichoke,apricot,masa harina,caster sugar
title: Artichokes in a Creamy Harina
ingredients: 1 cup masa harina | 1 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 8 stalks artichokes | 1 cup sliced dried apricot | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the masa harina and vinegar and whisk until combined.  Cut off all the stem end of the artichokes and cut them into rings at 2cm intervals.  Stir the marinated artichokes into the masa harina mixture and add the apricots, corn and apricot slices with a little boiling water to help mash them.  Mix everything together and place the mix in a large ziploc baggie or similar container with lid, or you could leave a little extra as you mix later.  To cook your food, bring water to boil and remove from heat.  This is not supposed to be necessary.  It just makes a little bit extra flavour.  Once everything is mixed through and the harina is dissolved, put the baggie or seal on your food machine and process on the usual way.  The artichoke recipe is based on my review book “a common way to do things – the type of harina used is, 1/3 cup per harina mixed into 2 cup water and 1/3 cup per water and set aside.  This recipe is a little bit different from a standard method, but you can see where this can eventually eventually be put into a food processor or blender and mix until smooth.  It is not supposed to be a perfect paste, but it is meant to be a bit more sticky to the harina and the oil.  Once you have your artichoke mix into a medium bowl, put some oil in a saucepan, and heat it for 2 - 3 minutes over a medium heat.  Put the artichoke mix in, mix the marinade and put it on a plate to cool.  When cool, stuff each artichoke with the harina mix and put them in the fridge for 20 to 30 minutes so they can harden a little bit and more absorb some of the sauce.  You may want to make a batch of artichoke mixes at the same time if they seem too loose and too dry.  When cool, put the tray under the tap and cut each artichoke in half and remove the middle vein.  These artichoke halves can either be stored, wrapped in foil, in the fridge for up to a day or two before cooking as a side dish – simply wrap them up and re heat in the microwave for a few seconds before eating.

Combine the sirloin, steak, beans, and parsley in a large bowl.  Pour into prepared casserole dish.  Bake 45 minutes, or until beef is cooked through.  Drain excess fat.  Sprinkle with capers.

title: Salty Cranberry Jewels

instructions: First marinade, in a small bowl, add the green chili peppers.

instructions: If using a fresh tomato, slice it thinly and arrange them on a baking sheet.  Bake at 350f for about 10 minutes or until soft.  While the beans are baking, wash and slice the tomatoes into thin rings.  Boil water and cook the sofrito for 4 - 5 minutes to make it crispier.  Drain the beans and return to the water.  Let them cool slightly.  Drain them, saving the liquid.  Place tomato and all ingredients except the rum in a blender or food processor bowl.  Process until smooth.  Add the rum, process briefly.  Scoop up the bean mixture and serve.  Note, for an added touch, a little rum may may be added or stirred into the mixture before serving.

title: Coriander and Pineapple Juice(Prawn) cocktail
ingredients: 1 liter pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 2 tablespoons dill pickles | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Peel and crush pineapples.  Crush dill pickles with a mortar and pestle or with a rolling pin.  Dissolve coriander in orange juice and add to pineapple juice in the pan and leave for 5 - 10 minutes.  Serve cold.

title: Persian Chicken Wings

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Cut a slit down the center of the wing and remove the skin.  Cut down each wing into a length about 1/4 inch deep, cutting the wings into 4 pieces.

title: Apple Swiss Steak
ingredients: 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 beef sirloin | 2 tablespoons green apples, chopped
instructions: Mix grand marnier and apple together.  Sear steak until lightly browned.  Add green apple and serve.

title: Pasta With Cauliflower - Rachael Ray
ingredients: 4 packages dry penne ( or other short pasta ) | 3 cups cauliflower florets | 1/4 cup white flour, plus additional | dill, for sprinkling ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons fresh dill, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Cook the pasta in the dutch oven over moderate heat, uncovered, until it is al dente.  While the pasta cooks, combine the cauliflower with the 5 cups of water in a large bowl.  Bring to a vigorous boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to moderate and simmer, uncovered, until the cauliflower is tender but very lightly colored, about 20 minutes.  Stir in the flour until coated, then drain the pasta and vegetables.  Toss the pasta with the cauliflower, dill, and a few tablespoons of white dill and season to taste with salt and pepper before garnish with the additional dill.

title: Walnut Walnut Soup (For 1 or 2)

instructions: Place water chestnuts and walnuts in a small pan on medium heat and cover, allow the nuts to melt in a small amount of water. Place in refrigerator until cooled completely before you serve it, it should be a little thicker than when you first took it out of the fridge.  It will keep up to 3 days in the refrigerator.
