ingredients: 8 -10 large white bread rolls | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup red enchilada sauce | 4 ounces hot coffee | 1/2 cup nigella seeds | 1 3/4 cups cooked angel hair pasta
instructions: Set oven to 400 degrees.  Line a jelly roll pan with aluminum foil and lay out the rolls on the foil, cut side down.  Place the remaining ingredients in a blender and puree until very smooth.  Pour 2/3 cup of mixture into the center of each roll.  Fold the top over the mixture and roll up and place in the oven.  Bake for 30 minutes.

title: Walnut Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons walnut pieces | 2 ounces fish stock | 1 red bell pepper, finely diced | 2 eggs, beaten
instructions: Combine the walnuts, fish stock and diced red pepper in a saucepan.  Simmer gently for 5 minutes.  Stir in the eggs.  Chill until serving.

title: Aji Shuku Sari
ingredients: 1 cup sliced fresh papayas | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1/2 shallot, minced | 1 1/4 cups arborio rice | 2 teaspoons canola oil
instructions: Wash the rice in several changes of cold water, then shake the rice so all water drains through the cloth.  Heat 2 teaspoons of canola oil in a wok or a small frying pan over medium heat.  Saute the shallot for 1 minute.  Stir in the rice and saute until it turns opaque, about 2 minutes.  Add aji and stir well.

title: Coconut-Sherry Glazed Onions
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsweetened coconut milk | 1/2 teaspoon herbes de provence | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1 tablespoon sherry wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Pour coconut milk into a small baking dish.  Sprinkle with herbes de provence and cinnamon.  Bake for 30 to 35 minutes.  Remove from oven and top with sherry.

title: Barley and Beef Noodle Vegetable Wrap
ingredients: 12 corn tortillas ( i use the smaller size ) | 12 ounces raw asparagus, trimmed and roughly chopped ( about 3 cups ) | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1/4 cup firmly packed light brown sugar | 1 teaspoon curry | 1 cup packed light brown sugar | 1 bunch fresh parsley, chopped | 12 ounces egg noodles, cooked ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper, and lightly coat with cooking spray.  Place tortillas on the baking sheet and spray with cooking spray until lightly golden, about 2 minutes on each side.  Meanwhile, in a large saucepan, combine asparagus, barley, sugar, curry and parsley.  Heat on medium heat, stirring often, until mixture begins to bubble, about 5 minutes.  Remove from heat and cool for 2 minutes.  Transfer 1/3 cup of the warm noodle mixture to a bowl, leaving 1/3 cup of the liquid in the bowl.  Add the remaining peanut butter and mix well.  Place the noodle mixture, about 1/4 cup at a time, between 2 tortillas.  Fold the tortillas in half and then the ends.  The end result should be a rectangular shape with a thin edge on the top but a thin strip in the middle.  Place the folded burritos on the prepared baking sheet.  Brush the rolls with cooking spray.  Bake until golden brown on all sides, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: broth,pie crust,herb,lemon juice zest,brown sugar,white breadcrumb
title: Traditional British Boiled Herring(Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs fresh herrings | 1 1/2 cups whole white breadcrumbs | 2 teaspoons mixed herbs | 1/2 cup brown sugar, packed | 1 tablespoon lemon juice ( lemons also work ) | 1 tablespoon mixed pulses, finely chopped fresh herbs or 2 teaspoons dried mixed pulses ( chive )
instructions: Rinse the herring and snip it as much along its seams as possible.  Arrange it in an ovenproof pot or roaster.  Add water to cover the fish.  Preheat the oven to 400f or 200°c, gas mark 5 or 190°c.  In a bowl combine the breadcrumbs, lemon peel and chives.  Mix well with a fork.  Pour this into a saucepan, add the sugar and mix well.  Bring to boil over medium heat, stirring, then remove from the heat and leave the pan undisturbed for 15 minutes or until all the juices have settled.  Stir through the lemon juice and spread it around and around the fish.  Arrange the herring skin side down on top of the breadcrumb mixture and bake for 60 to 75 minutes, until the fish is tender but firm.  Serve immediately, or refrigerate if it lasts that long.

title: Tomato Sausage and Tomato Ketchup
ingredients: 450 g tomatoes passata ( or tomato sauce and pulp ) | 120 g tomato paste ( or pureed tomatoes ) | 300 ml whipping cream ( whipping cream )
instructions: Heat oil in a pot, add sausages and stir fry until brown and cooked through.  Remove from pot and keep warm.  Pour tomato passata into the same pot you used to fry the sausages, whisking well.  Add tomato paste and puré for approx two minutes, continue to stir.  Whip whipping cream and pour into the simmering sauce.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and let bubble until slightly thickened.  Do not boil or it will burn serve immediately, sprinkled with smoked paprika.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,cumin seed,squid,bell pepper,mexican cheese,graham cracker,apple
title: Mexican Stuffed Calamari
ingredients: 2 lbs small calamari, tubes | 12 kalamata olives, pitted | 1 package shredded mexican blend cheese | 12 kalamata olives, sliced and chopped | 1 large bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 large apple, peeled, cored, and chopped | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | 8 graham crackers, crushed fine
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Bring 2 quarts of water to a boil in a large dutch oven.  Add 1 pound of Calamari to boiling water.  Cook about 2 minutes.  Drain and cool.  To make the topping, mix the olives, cheese, and chopped bell pepper.  To prepare the calamari, remove the shell from the tentacles and the body part, split down the center to spine, leaving the body part intact.  Place about 1 ounce coin in the hollowed out half of each calamari tube.  Tuck inside the ring.  Arrange the filled calamari tubes in the pan with the skin side down.  Cover the pan tightly with foil.  Bake in the oven 25 to 30 minutes or until the flesh is tender.  Remove from oven and cool.  Using a sharp knife, scrape off the skin from the body and tentacles.  Combine the olive topping with 1 teaspoon of cumin seeds.  Serve on a platter drizzled with remaining topping mixture.

Random Ingredients: red snapper fillet,fenugreek,spanish rice,pasta sauce,vegetable stock,heavy whipping cream,cream
title: Skoulet a la Fontert E Fagioli (Cook Ahead Seafood Soup)
ingredients: 1 lb shrimp or 1 lb red snapper fillet, deveined and sliced 3/4 inch thick ( 450g ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 2 teaspoons fenugreek | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup dry pasta sauce | 3 cups seafood stock ( or seafood broth or your favourite stock ) | 2 tablespoons sour cream | 1 cup long thin strands spanish rice, to serve
instructions: Cover shrimp with cold water and bring to boiling.  Cover, remove from heat and leave for 10 minutes.  Drain well and pat dry.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,extra virgin olive oil,soy sauce
title: Fabulously Easy and Easy Low Fat Spanish Dip
ingredients: 2 ounces plain fat-free spanish olive oil | 1 teaspoon low sodium soy sauce | 7 ounces picante sauce
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together oil, soy sauce and picante sauce.  Dip veggies in mixture and put on a plate covered with a damp paper towel.  Let sit until flavors blend, about 10 - 15 minutes.  Serve with tortilla chips.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,liquid smoke,corn tortilla chip,basil leaf,red potato,orange
title: Mashed Potato Chips
ingredients: 5 -6 small red potatoes, boiled | 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil leaf | 1/4 cup chopped fresh marjoram | 1/4 - 1/2 tablespoon liquid smoke | 1/2 chopped orange | corn tortilla chips
instructions: Remove potatoes from refrigerator.  When cool enough to handle, remove skin and mash potatoes until smooth.  Stir in basil, marjoram, liquid smoke and orange zest.  Season with salt/pepper and mix well.  Garnish with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: salmon,english mustard,red lentil,yellow pepper,black currant,jalapeno pepper
title: Grilled Salmon and Peppers
ingredients: 5 red lentils, rinsed | 1 whole jalapeno pepper, seeded | 1/2 cup red lentil | 1/2 yellow pepper, chopped | 2 teaspoons english mustard | 3 cans salmon, drained
instructions: Prepare grill.  Place red and yellow peppers in a shallow baking dish.  Combine lentils and jalapeno in a large bowl.

title: Buffalo Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings, patted dry | 2 tablespoons margarine | 2 pears, sliced | vegetable shortening ( for cooking )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Spread margarine on the chicken wings and marinate overnight in a mixture of cold water and cornstarch.  Heat shortening in frying pan and brown chicken wings until richly browned on both sides.  Bake 25 minutes or until done.  Turn once during baking.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,kalamata olive,baby spinach,egg,apple cider,half cream
title: Spinach and Bell Pepper Frittata
ingredients: 1/4 cup apple cider | 2 large eggs | 1 cup half-and-half cream ( or milk or soy cream ) | 6 medium kalamata olives ( pitted and coarsely chopped ) | 1/2 cup sweet red bell pepper, cored, seeded & cut into strips | 4 cups baby spinach
instructions: In a medium saute pan, combine apple cider and remaining ingredients.  Cook, over high heat, for about 10 minutes or until almost all of liquid is absorbed.  Scoop half of the spinach into bowl, add remaining spinach, tossing to combine well, and cover to keep warm.  Add olives & toss, coating mixture.  Spoon half of the spinach mixture into a 1 quart casserole or 6 individual serving dishes & bake at 400f until almost set, about 8 - 10 minutes.  Top with frittata & drizzle with olive mixture & remaining olive oil.  Serve immediately.

title: Simple Red Pepper Chips
ingredients: 1/3 lb baking potato, unpeeled | 3 tablespoons red bell peppers, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment.  Cut potatoes lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices.  Bake at 375 f for about 30 minutes, stirring twice, until cooked.  Drain and cool slightly.

title: Guisado De Tomate (Bahama Shish Kabobs)
ingredients: 3 lbs russet potatoes | 2 lbs ham | 1 can tomatoes | 1 teaspoon dried summer savory | 3/4 teaspoon ground thyme | 1/2 teaspoon cognac | 2 bay leaves | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Peel potato and wash in cold, running water to yield 2 or 3 cups of water.  Cut about 1/2 inch slice from top, about 2 or 3 inches down, with cut sides down on a long cutting board and then cut slices in half through the center like you would slicing up a book.  Lay cut pieces across the cut surface of a large shallow metal tin or baking dish.  If using plastic, gently squeeze out excess moisture.  Using a sharp spoon or knife, prick slices several times all over with a sharp knife.  This will allow more flavor to penetrate the potatoes.  In a large bowl, mix potatoes, ham, tomatoes, savory, thyme, cognac and bay leaves.  Refrigerate for several hours or overnight.  Heat grill to 400°f.  When ready to cook, remove potatoes from baking dish and pat dry with paper towels.  With a slotted spoon or spatula, carefully lift out portions of ham and tomatoes onto skewers, placing approximately 1 tablespoon tomato mixture per skewer.  Grill or broil potatoes, turning as necessary until they show no pinking and show grill marks throughout when pierced with a skewer, 2 to 3 minutes per side.  Sprinkle with salt and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: red lentil,baby spinach,pepperoncini pepper,shrimp,mexican chili powder,dashi
title: Shrimp and Red Lentil Shrimp With Shrimp
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red lentils | 1 can red shrimp, drained | 1 tablespoon dashi | 1 teaspoon mexican chili powder | 3 cups baby spinach | pepperoncini pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Combine the red lentils and shrimp in a saucepan with 2 cups water.  Bring to a boil and then reduce to a simmer.  Simmer for 15 minutes.  Rinse the shrimp, return to the pan and cook for 2 more minutes.  Drain the shrimp well and add the shrimp mixture to the pan.  Add the dashi, chili powder, spinach and pepperoncini.  Reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 15 more minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Fried Noodles With Pinto Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried pinto bean | 1/4 cup thai fish sauce | 2 tablespoons soft fresh linguine
instructions: Soak bean overnight.  The next day, rinse the beans.  Cut bean into 1 inch pieces, and drain water, but reserve 1 cup of bean cooking liquid.  Soak the beans in water for 30 minutes, rinse, and cook 1 hour.  Place the noodles in a bowl with reserved cooked bean liquid, and mix well.  Place noodles in a large, deep skillet, and fry over medium high heat for 2 minutes, or until the noodles are golden.  Stir constantly so they do not burn.  Season with fish sauce after removing from heat.  Serve hot.

title: Easy African Green Chili Powder (Aka Green Chile Powder)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons hot green chili powder ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon ground coriander powder ( i've found this in the ethnic aisle of my grocery store ) | 2 tablespoons instant coffee ( chai powder )
instructions: Put all ingredients in a medium frying pan, and toast them over a medium flame until fragrant and well mixed.  Store in freezer till ready to serve.  May need to heat before serving.

title: Moroccan Style Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg flank steaks | 2 tablespoons harissa, spice
instructions: Rinse the steak and dry well.  Put into a ziplock bag.  Add harissa.  Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.  Slice across to desired size.  Grill on a charcoal grill or fry in a pan with a small amount of oil for 4 - 5 minutes on each side, turning every so often until cooked to your liking.

Random Ingredients: emmentaler cheese,sherry wine,walnut,wheat flour,heavy whipping cream,chicken bouillon cube,yogurt
title: Cheese and Nut Pizza for a Crowd
ingredients:
4 cups shredded emmentaler cheese ( about 1/2 of one small wheel.
    - ) or 4 cups edam cheese ( about 1/2 of one small wheel.
    - ) | 1 cup chopped walnuts | 1/3 cup extra-strong low-fat yogurt | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon cube | 1 1/3 cups heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1 tablespoon whole wheat flour, sifted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Combine the first 4 ingredients in a small bowl.  Set aside.  Beat together the yogurt, chicken bouillon, cream and sherry in a small sauce pan.  Add the flour and continue to beat over medium heat until warm and slightly thickened.  Slowly add 1/2 the cream mixture to the cheese mixture and combine.  Spread mixture in an even layer on the baking sheet.  Top with remaining cheeses in a single layer, beginning and ending with the cheeses.  Bake for 20 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Sauces for Rice
ingredients: 1 cup sushi rice, uncooked | 1/4 cup russian salad dressing | 1 teaspoon steak sauce, or to taste
instructions: Place rice, russian dressing, and steak sauce in a bowl.  Mix until thoroughly combined.  Add any extras you wish to flavor the mixture.  Serve immediately.

title: Simple Fried Noodles With Vegetables
ingredients: 1 - lb wok, cut into 2-inch square pieces, about 6 -16 ounces | cooked wide rice noodles, about 4 1/2 to 7 ounces | 1 medium cabbage ( about 4 cups or smaller ) | hot paprika
instructions: Fill 5 to 6 quart wok with water to reach 2 inches up sides of wok.  Heat wok over high heat.  When wok is very hot, add noodles and paprika.  Use chopsticks or slotted spoon to remove noodles from pan.  When noodles give off their steam, remove wok from stove.  Keep warm.  Using chopsticks or slotted spoon or spatula, fry noodles until they are limp, almost translucent and crisp, about 1 to 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,orange jell o,shell pasta,lime zest
title: Sweet and Savory Balsamic Pasta Salad from Cook's Country, Cook's Country
ingredients: 1 package package large shell pasta | 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon finely grated lime zest | 1 teaspoon grated orange jell-o ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain and transfer pasta to a large bowl.  In a small bowl, blend balsamic vinegar, lime zest and orange juice until well mixed.  Pour dressing over pasta and toss until all ingredients are moistened.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,vanilla extract,ketchup,beef bouillon granule,hot pepper sauce,mustard,peanut oil,amaretto
title: Amaretto-Lol (Pepper Sauce for Beef Stew)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 teaspoon mustard | 1 1/2 teaspoons pepper sauce | 1/3 cup crushed amaretto | 1 teaspoon instant beef bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 cup peanut oil | 2 -2 hot peppers or 2 -2 chili peppers, such as jalapeno, habanero or 1/2-2 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Combine ketchup, mustard, pepper sauce, amaretto, bouillon granual, and vanilla.  Store in refrigerator until ready to use.  Shake peanut oil over a flameproof measuring cup.  Place a large skillet atop your stove and turn burner on high.  When your stove begins to smoke, carefully add peppers or chili peppers and the hot oil.  Let the peppers reduce to their original shape about 3 - 4 minutes then add the sauce.  Let simmer 2 - 3 minutes then remove from heat.

title: Curry and and Sausage Sandwich
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 2 teaspoons curry paste or ( 1 cm-thick ) saffron curry powder | 3 ounces andouille sausages, sliced or smoked
instructions: Preheat any oven to 180 deg c/350 deg f/gas lightly butter the inside of a 1lb loaf tin and put the french bread in a tin.  Sprinkle with curry and sausage, close the tin and put in a preheated oven and cook for 20 mins, or until the bread begins to crust and the sausage links start rendering their fat.  Slice and serve with fresh salad, french bread rolls.  Variation, to replace the sausage in the recipe, omit the saffron and add a couple of good squirts of olive oil.  Instead of saffron spice powder, you can simply double up on the spice, adding a generous pinch of each of the indgredients for the spice.

title: Beef, Spinach and Fruit Strudel
ingredients: 500 g beef, thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 4 -6 leaves sage, roughly chopped | 2 pieces crystallized gingerroot, finely grated | 1 teaspoon savory | 150 g spinach leaves, roughly chopped | 8 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed to room temperature | 300 g sirloin, shaved into short strips and cut into strips
instructions: Add the beef, ginger garlic paste, sage, crystallized gingerroot and savory to a non stick frying pan and saute until the meat is brown, about 3 - 5 minutes, then add the spinach and cook for 3 more minutes until all the liquid has evaporated and the spinach is wilted.  Remove from the heat.  Brush 2 sheets of the phyllo with oil and fold in half and brush the other half lightly with the oil.  Take a piece of phyllo pastry about 40cm wide and 4 5cm in diameter, then place a spoonful of the spinach mixture in the middle and use the tip of a sharp knife to make a roll about a quarter inch in diameter.  Lay the rolled pastry on a clean tea towel and place in a microwaveable dish, on full power.  Pierce with 2 2cm acken sticks.  Repeat with the remaining sheets of phyllo and spinach filling.  Heat a small frying pan over medium high heat and spray with oil and cook the meat strips in batches until browned and crisp.

Random Ingredients: french bread,cider vinegar,baby bok choy,watermelon,black mustard seed,kielbasa,arborio rice
title: Warm French Bread Salad
ingredients: 1 french bread, cut into 3/4 inch dice | 1 tablespoon sliced black mustard seeds | 6 cups watermelon, cut into 1 inch cubes | 4 baby bok choy, trimmed and cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 cup arborio rice | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/4 lb sliced kielbasa
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix french bread, mustard seeds, watermelon, bok choy, and arborio.  In dressing bowl, whisk together vinegar and kielbasa.  Pour over salad.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Serve immediately.

title: Quinoa and Basil
ingredients: 2 cups quinoa | 1 cup shredded basil
instructions: Rinse quinoa well, removing any damaged grains or stones.  Combine quinoa, basil, and soy or creole seasoning in saucepan.  Cook over medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring frequently so the seasoning doesn't stick to the mushy grains.  Cover tightly, and simmer 10 to 15 minutes, or until liquid is absorbed.

title: Spiced Strawberry Jam
ingredients: 12 -16 ounces fresh strawberries, stemmed | 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon cumin seed ( optional )
instructions: Combine the flour, cumin seeds and cayenne pepper in a large bowl.  Add the strawberries and knead by hand until very smooth.  Roll the dough into two balls, wrap each ball in plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.  Line a jelly roll pan with parchment paper.  Cut each ball into 1/2 inch wide slabs, and using a sharp knife, scrape the slabs into the paper.  Repeat for the remaining balls.  Bring the jelly roll pan of water to boil, and add the frozen balls.  Cook for 2 minutes, remove when they have begun to puff up and are floating.  Drain them on absorbent paper.  Serve warm.  Store covered at room temperature.  Freezes well.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,russet potato,pam cooking spray
title: Potatoes & Crisp
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled | pam cooking spray | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the potatoes, add enough cold water to cover and toss to combine.  When the mixture reaches a boil, reduce the heat to medium and continue to cook over a medium heat for about 50 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.  Stir several times while the potatoes are cooking.  When the potatoes are tender, drain them in a colander and place them in a bowl to cool slightly.  Spray a large baking sheet with pam.  Cut the potatoes from the skins into rounds.

Random Ingredients: shortening,pizza crust,asparagus,beef broth,lime juice,part mozzarella cheese,spanish onion,corn
title: Beef and Asparagus Pizza
ingredients: 1 recipe pizza crust | 1 teaspoon oil, such as canola or salad oil ( for cooking ) | 1/2 cup beef broth | 1/2 lb asparagus, trimmed and cut crosswise into 1-inch pieces | 1/2 cup sliced spanish onion, separated into rings | 1 1/2 cups frozen cut asparagus, thawed and well-drained | 1/4 cup fresh lime juice, lightly packed | 8 ounces shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f.  Line baking sheet with parchment paper.  Press pizza crust crust onto baking sheet and lightly with nonstick cooking spray.  Brush crust all over with oil.  Transfer crust to baking sheet and sprinkle crust with oil.  Bake until crust is golden brown, about 8 minutes.  Combine beef consommé, asparagus and onion in medium saucepan over medium heat.  Cook, stirring frequently, until asparagus is crisp tender and most of liquid is absorbed, 4 - 5 minutes.  Add broth.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,black bean,dill,fruit,hot pepper,onion flake,garlic powder,bean sprout
title: Coconut Black Bean Sprouts & Diced Fruit
ingredients: 1 medium onion, chopped | 5 stalks fresh dill or 2 teaspoons dried dill | 3 teaspoons minced garlic powder | 1 -2 teaspoon dried fruit | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper | 1 can coconut milk, fat free if desired | 1 can black beans | 1 can mixed sprouts
instructions: In a large saucepan or pot saute onion and dills in oil just until tender.  Add hot pepper & garlic powder and stir until well mixed.  Add undrained coconut milk, 1/2 cup water and beans.  Stir and simmer until tender, about 15 - 20 minutes.  Add chopped fresh fruit during the last 5 minuets, just until heated through.

title: Chocolate Short Ribs
ingredients: 1/2 cup glace cherries, chopped | 1/4 cup capers, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup semi-sweet chocolate syrup | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 tablespoons beef short ribs, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons crispy almond marzipan
instructions: Mix cherries, capers, chocolate syrup, oil, and short ribs in a bowl.  Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 3 hours, or overnight.  Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil the grate.  Mix marzipan with some of the reserved marzipan mixture, and spread evenly over the top of the short Ribs.  Cover the grill, and cook for about 8 minutes, or to desired doneness, turning once.  Repeat with remaining short ribs to serve.

title: Chilli Prawns for Two
ingredients: 20 large prawns | 1 1/2 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 1 small red capsicum, seeded and chopped
instructions: Toss prawns in cajun seasoning.  In a large frying pan, heat 1 tbsp oil over medium high heat.  Add prawns and cook for two minutes.  Increase heat to high, stirring frequently until prawns turn a deep pink colour.  Add capsicum and cook for another two minutes, or until prawns are pink and capsicum softens.  Serve immediately.

title: Baked Apple Squares
ingredients: 2 bags frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed | 1 lb fresh pumpkin, peeled and cubed or 1 lb fresh winter squash, peeled and cubed | 1 1/2 cups blue cheese, crumbled | 2/3 cup fresh apple juice | 1 teaspoon fresh rosemary or 1 teaspoon dried rosemary, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Preheat oven 400°.

title: Iraqi Beef and Rings
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef | 12 tablespoons cake flour | 1 tablespoon cumin powder
instructions: Trim fat from meat.  Cut into very thin rings.  Place on greased baking sheets.  Combine remaining ingredients in a small bowl.  Bread coating sprinkle on rings while coating.  Bake in a 350f oven 50 minutes.  Slice and serve hot.

title: Sweet Italian Sausages and Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup mixed fresh vegetables ( peas, carrots and zucchini are great ) | 1/4 cup dried mixed berries ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1 tablespoon dried basil | 1/2 teaspoon white pepper ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon freshly-ground blackened bay leaf | 1 lb sweet italian sausage ( or other dark-meat mixture that has been removed from sausage casings ) | syrup ( optional ) or grape preserves, for serving ( optional )
instructions: Prick sausage with a fork, or place in a skillet.  Bake at 325°f for 20 to 22 minutes.  Place the mixed veggies in a large pan or crockpot.  Pour over enough water to just cover.  Add molasses, basil, white pepper, black and cayenne pepper.  If you wish, you may season this dish with a little paprika or seasoning salt.  Stir to mix.  Set the sausage to cook and serve warm.  If preferred, serve with a dollop of whipped hot syrup, or a drizzle of syrup/milk.  Great with buns and a crisp green salad.

title: Pork Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs lean pork, cubed | 1 cup dry white wine | 1 can tomato puree | 2 tablespoons unsweetened applesauce ( any flavor ) | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 10 buns, halved
instructions: Put the pork in a large saucepan along with the white wine, tomato purée, applesauce and red wine. .  Bring to low boil.  Once simmering you can skim off the fat.  When the pork is tender, add the buns and heat through.  Serve with hot, cooked rice.

title: Plum Burgers
ingredients: 1 can plums ( in juices, i prefer progresso brand ) | 6 tablespoons coffee liqueur | 6 -8 slices hamburger buns ( toasted or toasted or gluten-free, depending on your appetite ) | wine ( optional )
instructions: Slice plums in half and remove pit and discard.  Place plums on a slice of toasted or gluten-free bun and top with 2 tablespoons of coffee liqueur, 1 tablespoon of chopped chipped plum and 1 or 2 teaspoons of any favorite toppings.  If desired, serve with wine for a beverage.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,almond extract,panir,cauliflower head,cinnamon,worcestershire sauce,mozzarella cheese,basil
title: Baked Stuffed Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower head | 3/4 lb panir | 1/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons sliced almonds | 1 tablespoon minced serrano pepper | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon basil | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Preheat oven with rack in middle of oven and turn on to 200 degrees.  Wrap head of cauliflower in foil and steam at high heat for 12 minutes.  Peel away skin then cut small florets from the center.  Remove the florets, cut top side up on the cutting board and use a sharp knife to cut through into 2 inch segments, removing all the inner core.  Then gently scoop out the cauliflower from each shell and discard.  Cook the cauliflower for about 10 minutes until just starting to soften.  Drain in colander and remove the stalks with tongs or melon baller.  Remove the cauliflower from the pan and scoop out all the juices.  Set aside.  To make the cheese filling, mix the cheese, almonds, serrano pepper, worcestershire sauce, cinnamon, and basil in a mixing bowl.  To assemble, place equal amounts of filling in the stem cavity of the cauliflower and set aside.  Place 1/3 of the cheese mixture in the center of the cauliflower.  Roll the stuffed cauliflower in the mixture, securing with a tooth pick.  Serve immediately or refrigerate for several hours.

title: Kosher Salt - toasted crust bread from Provence
ingredients: 2 slices bread, crust removed | 1 tablespoon tomato paste ( kounoupith )
instructions: Place a sheet of plastic wrap, 1 side, on your work surface.  Place the tomato paste on the plastic wrap.  Cut a slit into the top of each slice of bread.  Sprinkle with kosher salt.  Take a piece of the plastic wrap and make a loop on top of the slice of bread and press out air bubbles.  Turn the bag with the bread back down once and press out excess air bubbles.  Repeat steps 6 - 8 until you've used up the rest of the bread, making 6 pieces of unbuttered bread.

Random Ingredients: fusion liqueur,dark chocolate,baby bok choy,green cabbage,quinoa,barbeque sauce
title: Crunchy Quinoa Slop
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, uncooked, rinsed and drained | 1 bottle barbeque sauce | 1 1/2 cups baby bok choy | 1 green cabbage, cut into 2 inch lengths | 2 tablespoons light-colored fusion liqueur ( optional ) | 6 ounces dark chocolate, chopped ( or 70 % cocoa solids plus more, for drizzle )
instructions: Place quinoa, barbeque sauce and bok choy in a 4 quart sauce pan.  Cover and bring to a boil over medium high heat.  Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 25 minutes or until vegetables are tender and liquid has become syrupy.  Remove from heat.  Stir in fusion and chocolate.  Cover and set aside.

title: Chilli Gravy (For Turkey)
ingredients: 4 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 cup vegetable stock ( or water ) | 4 dried red chilies | 1 teaspoon caraway
instructions: Mix flour, salt and caraway.  Add stock and bring to boil.  Add red chillies.  Simmer on low medium for 20 - 30 minutes.  Serve with roast pork.

title: Chile Cornflour Parsnip Muffins
ingredients: 3 lbs parsnips, peeled, quartered lengthwise & thinly sliced | 1 cup dark raisin | 3 chilies, chopped | 4 tablespoons cornflour | 1 large egg, beaten | 1/2 teaspoon grated nutmeg | 1/8 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c.  Line a 2 litre lrg mixing bowl with greaseproof/greaseproof paper & line with the greaseproof paper.  Place the parsnips in the bowl and toss to coat thoroughly in the cornflour.  Place the raisons in a microwave safe bowl & heat in the microwave on high for 3 min. , shaking the bowl.  Stir the mince into the bowl along with the chilis.  Pour into the lined lrg bowl & level the top if desired.  Combine the egg w/the nutmeg, 1/2 cup of the parsley, & salt in a small bowl & beat until well combined.  With clean beaters, gently fold this mixture into the mince mixture along with the rest of the parsley.  Spoon into prepared lrg baking dish.  Level the top of the mince mixture by pressing down lightly.  Sprinkle w/the rest of the parsley.  Bake approx 25 min till set.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  In a medium baking dish, add rice, fenugreek, blueberries, bell pepper and rum.  Sprinkle with sumac.  Bake at 350 f for 20 minutes, or until rice begins to brown, stir after 20 minutes.

title: Kheeb's Karwari Burger
ingredients: 200 g pancetta | 4 tablespoons margarine | 1 1/2 teaspoons ketchup | 1 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/4 teaspoon margarine
instructions: Place the margarine in an 8 inch pan and turn on low heat and cook until it has light brown colour.  Then turn off the burner.  Cut the pancetta into four cm segments.  Place into a medium pan and let it cook until its dark color, this will take about an hour.  Once it’s dark and dark again, remove from heat and let it soak the excess water. Add the margarine to the oil and turn heat up to medium.  If you notice the bottom of the pancetta’s ketchup to be greasy add more butter and then when it’s bubbling, turn the heat up to medium high, fry the pancetta until it becomes light brown color.

title: Kielbasa, Broccoli and Cabbage (Paleo) Croquettes

instructions: Combine 1/2 pound kielbasa, cabbage, broccoli, raisins and half and half in a bowl and mix well using your hands.  Shape into six oval patties, about 1 3/4 inches in diameter.  Coat lightly in bread crumbs and press into the patties to coat evenly.  Chill for 2 hours, or overnight.  Bake at 400°f for 15 minutes, turning once, then reduce temperature to 400°f and continue cooking until just cooked through.  Serve warm.

title: Apple Rice Coca-Cola

instructions: Put the ginger, cocoa and apple juice in a blender and blend till smooth.  Put the rice, ground nuts, baking soda, and ground nut pieces in a pan.  Pour the blended milk mixture into the pan and stir well.  Bake, covered, at 190 degrees for 2 hours.  Cool before storing.

Cover the duck with aluminum foil and put the cabbage wedges onto the foil.  Heat a small amount of butter in a frying pan, then put the duck into the pan.  Fry the duck over the heat until browned on both sides.  Take out and put on absorbent paper to absorb the grease.  Serve with cream.  Variant with mustard.

instructions: Cook the fettuccini according to package directions.  Drain.  While the fettuccini is cooking, make the sauce.  Place the marinara sauce in a saucepan.  Add a dash of salt if the sauce is not already thick enough.  Toss the sauce with the drained fettuccini.  Serve and enjoy.

title: Kielbasa

title: Creamed Potatoes and Jam

If making with jam, chill for several hours before storing in refrigerator.  Makes 8 servings.  Variation, use jam instead of puree and/or whole wheat flour.

title: Souffritto

instructions: In a deep skillet or dutch oven, bring half the water to a boil.  Add rice and cook until soft and fragrant, about 15 minutes.  Add half the brie and cook until it begins to melt. title: Easy Key Lime Pie
ingredients: 1 pie shell | 1 1/2 cups shredded frozen puff pastry | 1/3 cup plain flour | 1/3 cup white sugar | 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon butter | 1 teaspoon lime wedge, if using, optional
instructions: Set oven to 400 degrees f.  Prepare pie shell according to the instructions on the pie shell box.  Remove pastry sheet from bowl and set aside.  Combine the flour, sugar, margarine, and lime wedge.  Add the flour mixture to the margarine mixture and mix until you have a dough like consistency.  You may need to adjust the amount of flour depending on how dough is too dry.  Divide into the half and half and divide again into half.  Pat each half into a circle about 1/8 inch thick, using a pastry brush.  Cut one section into a circle and spread the half with your favourite red glaze.  Place one of the pie crusts onto this and cover.  Brush glaze over pies and top with second pie crust.  Bake at 400 for about 15 minutes, or until crust is golden brown.

title: Swiss Chard With Berry Compote
ingredients: 2 bunches swiss chard, thick stems coarsely chopped | 1/4 lb dried berry, preferably dark, such as mexican red such as calabaza | 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: In small pan of simmering salted water, cook chard just until tender, about 2 minutes.  Drain, reserving 1/4 cup cooking liquid.

title: Tippy Toffee for Frying
ingredients: 1/4 cup real butter | 2 tablespoons grilling seasoning, or to taste | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar
instructions: Using a brush, coat the underside of a 12x18 inch pan with butter or margarine.  Sprinkle the grilling seasoning directly over the butter and butter.  Make sure it gets to the same size as the pan.  Add the vanilla sugar to the top of butter and sprinkle with a bit more than half of the grilling spice.  Drizzle the rest of the cheese on top.  This will get rid of any extra grilling spice.  Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes.  Remove the foil and bake another 20 minutes.  Remove from oven and drizzle the remaining butter on top until completely melted.  Let sit 5 minutes before cutting into squares.

title: Stoup Broccoli - Okra?
ingredients: 2 1/2 cm fresh okra | 4 medium celery ribs ( cut into 3 cm lengths ) | 4 tablespoons soup starter ( or vegetable broth ) | 3 eggs
instructions: Cut the okra into 5 cm lengths, removing the woody centre.  Boil the okra in water for 8 - 10 mins, then drain and set aside.  Blanch 2 - 3 tbsp of okra for 10 mins, then drain and return to the pan.  Blanch the celery in the same water for 10 mins, then drain.  Add a tbsp of starter to the pan and sauté 5 - 6 mins on a medium heat.  Crack an egg into a bowl and beat briskly for 10sec.  Break off the egg and set aside.  Repeat with 2 tbsp of starter and 3 tbsp of okra, then pour them into the pan and fry for another 2 - 3 mins, stirring constantly.  Pour over the okra.  Combine with the stock and cook over medium heat with the eggs.  Enjoy.

title: Easy Blue Cheese Rice and Figs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce | 8 ounces blue cheese, coarsely cut | 1 cup basmati rice, cooked | 3/4 cup chopped fresh figs | 1 medium fresh red pepper, chopped
instructions: Prepare couscous according to package directions and set aside.  In a bowl, mix the cheeses with the fig's and red peppers.  When the couscous is cooked, stir it into the cheese mixture along with the cooked couscous.  Serve chilled.

title: Creamy Mushroom Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 lb fresh porcini mushrooms, stems removed ( or reconstituted mushrooms, if reconstituted mushrooms are not available ) | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 32 fluid ounces heavy cream ( or to taste ) | 1/2 cup dried currant
instructions: Slice mushrooms in half and pour 1 cup of the liquid from the cans in the bottom of a large bowl.  Dip mushrooms into liquid and place them in the bowl with the wine vinegar.  Cover and shake well to coat mushrooms.  Refrigerate 4 hours, stirring periodically.  Just before serving, stir the currants into cream.  Note, this goes quite well with grilled or broiled chicken or veal.  I have made it even simpler by using vegetable or beef flavored, not watermelon instead of mushrooms.  I have made this in a mushroom porcini maker and it turned out great.

title: Hot Pepper and Chilies
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dried hot red chili peppers | 1/2 lb fresh hot red chili pepper | 24 basil leaves
instructions: Preheat your broiler and position rack 6 inches from the heat.  Spray a broiler pan with cooking spray.  Stir the red chili peppers into the hot peppers and spread them out evenly.  Place the basil leaves, one side of each, on a cutting board.  With a knife or other knife, cut the hot peppers into thin strips.  Slice them into thin slices and stack them in a colander set over a bowl covered with the towel.  Repeat with the basil.  Place the hot peppers in a single layer on a broiler pan or baking sheet.  Broil them until they are slightly charred and blistered.  Turn them over and broil them for 3 minutes more.  Turn off your broiler and leave the peppers on the baking sheet for 5 minutes.  Serve immediately.

instructions: Bring the vinegar and blueberries to a simmer in a small saucepan.  Simmer gently until the blueberries start to pop. title: Roasted Green Beans
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh green beans, trimmed | 1 medium baking potato, unpeeled and cut into 1/2-inch dice
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°.  Combine beans, potato, ½ teaspoon salt and ¼ cup water in a 3 quart shallow baking pan, drizzle with vegetable oil and sprinkle with remaining ¼ teaspoon salt.  Bake until potatoes are crisp tender, about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,white bean,italian sausage,sirloin,no salt tomato sauce
title: Italian Sausage Casserole
ingredients: 3 sirloin, trimmed and thinly sliced | 1 1/2 lbs sweet italian sausage ( your favorite brand, see note in description ) or 1 1/2 lbs kielbasa, diced ( your favorite brand, see note in description ) | 2 cans no-salt-added tomato sauce ( see note in description ) | 2 cans no-salt-added white beans, drained ( see note in description ) | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce
instructions: Note, tomato sauce can be substituted either canned or fresh.  Heat oven to 325 degrees.  Mix sausage slices with tomato sauce.  Combine all ingredients above and transfer into ungreased 2 deep casserole.  Bake 1 hour until browned.

Random Ingredients: apricot,olive,green bean,toast,cardamom pod,wonton wrapper,dark soy sauce
title: Aarti Recipe (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 15 dried apricots | 300 g green beans, chopped diagonally | 1/3 cup dried figs, chopped | 3 teaspoons olive | 2 teaspoons dark soy sauce | 5 cardamom pods | wonton wrapper, for sandwich
instructions: Boil the beans till soft, adding more water if necessary, then cook longer, till soft.  Cool the beans and mix with the fig's.  Using the back of a fork, press the seeds of the cardamom pods in to the beans and figs to make seeds.  Chop the figs finely, and mix with the green beans.  Add a pinch of dark soy sauce, mix well.  Brush the edges of the wonton wrappers with oil, and make with a small spoonful of the filling mixture.  Wet edges with water, then fold one corner over the filling.  Seal the edges with your finger.  Place the wontons, flat side up, on a baking pan.  Brush the outside with oil on both sides to make sure it is well browned.  Bake at 220c for about 10 - 15 minutes, or the bottoms are golden.  Serve hot with soy sauce, or sweet and sour chutney.

title: A Different Gratin With Canadian Bacon
ingredients: 1 ounce canadian bacon ( i use canadian bacon ) | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 teaspoon canadian green olives, minced | 1 large rutabaga | 1 cup double cream
instructions: Cut rutabaga into 1 inch cubes.  Cook bacon in medium skillet until crisp & browned, about 15 - 20 minutes.  Remove bacon from skillet & place on paper towel lined plate.  Reserve the fat from the skillet & add olive oil to the drippings.  Cut rutabaga into 1/2 inch cubes.  Place rutabaga in skillet & sear on low heat until browned & tender, 2 - 6 minutes.  Add the butter, browned bacon and green olives & mix well.  Pour cream over & stir.  Cover & refrigerate until ready to serve.  Best with french bread or toast.

title: Linguine With Linguini and Maple Syrup
ingredients: 1 package capellini | 1/2 cup maple syrup | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh onions | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Cook capellini in boiling water according to package directions.  Drain and rinse with cold water before returning to pot.  Stir maple syrup, brown sugar, onions and hot cooked pasta into pot.  Cover and cook over gentle heat until heated through.  Stir in parsley.

title: Custard Sauce for Spring Rolls
ingredients: 1 pint homemade prepared low-fat custard | 1 clove crushed garlic or 1 tablespoon garlic powder, to taste
instructions: Mix in a bowl.  Cover with plastic wrap, and refridgerate overnight.

Random Ingredients: black bean,berry,ham hock,artichoke heart,turmeric powder,baking soda,chickpea,kaffir lime leaf
title: Mexican Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dried black beans, soaked overnight and allowed to dry and become very clean | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 ham hock | 3 kaffir lime leaves, torn ( optional ) | 4 artichoke hearts, halved | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 3 -4 tablespoons berries, preferably berries, or 3 -4 tablespoons spinach, rinsed and dried, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f mix beans in a large dutch oven over medium high heat.  Heat ham hock and kaffir lime leaves in large pan for 3 - 4 minutes.  Remove ham hock and kale leaf from pan.  Combine beans, chickpeas, chickpeas, and artichokes in a large dutch oven.  Mix turmeric/olive oil and baking soda in a small bowl, then stir into beans mixture and bring to a boil.  Cover and bake for 75 minutes or until beans are tender, stirring every 20 - 25 minutes.  Add additional seasoning and fresh fruit before serving.  I served this with mexican rice, hot guacamole, and sour cream.

title: Coronation Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg chicken mince | 150 ml vegetable stock | 1 egg | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 4 leaveslettuce | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds or 1 teaspoon honey
instructions: Place chicken, stock, egg, worcestershire sauce and sesame seeds in blender and blend to a smooth paste.  Place in crockpot or roasting tray in a single layer.  Add lettuce and stir to combine.  Cook on high for 1 hour.  Serve with steamed cabbage and steamed potatoes.

title: Chili Risotto With Zucchini
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 4 teaspoons vodka | 4 small zucchini, very finely chopped | 1 red chile, seeded and finely ground | 3/4 cup extra low sodium beef stock, made from 2 1/2 cubes | 4 1/2 ounces chickpeas, rinsed and well drained | 3 ounces short-grain rice
instructions: Combine the mustard and vodka in a small, non aluminium pan and heat over moderate heat until the mustard bubbles until lightly coloured.  Increase the heat to moderately high and add the zucchini, chili and stock.  Stir through the mustard, simmer for 3 - 5 minutes, until the zucchini is very tender and the stock is absorbed.  Stir in the chickpeas and rice, taste and adjust seasoning.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,asparagus spear,onion flake,lamb shank,colby monterey jack cheese
title: Grilled Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 4 lamb shanks | 8 ounces colby-monterey jack cheese | 4 ounces asparagus spears | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1/4 teaspoon onion flakes
instructions: Spray heavy skillet with non stick cooking spray, heat to medium.  Add onions and cook until light golden brown.  Remove from skillet and set aside.  Put meat in skillet and cook over medium heat.  Spread on cheese slices and place asparagus on top.  Drizzle cream over the asparagus while it bakes.  Cover.  Cook for 5 minutes over medium heat.  After 5 minutes, place covered skillet under grill for 5 minutes.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,peanut butter,rice wine vinegar,egg noodle
title: Chinese Noodles
ingredients: 1 bunch celery & rib | 1 tablespoon peanut butter ( or more ) | 1 teaspoon rice wine vinegar | 12 ounces egg noodles ( i use barilla )
instructions: Put the celery in a microwave safe bowl and cover with boiling water for about three minutes or until tender.  Using a slotted spoon, remove the celery and place it in a colander over a bowl.  Add the peanut butter, vinegar and half the noodles to the boiling water and then drain.  Return the drained vegetables to the bowl with the peanut butter mixture and add the remaining noodles.  Toss to thoroughly combine and serve.

title: Grilled Pork Loin
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds pork loin | 2 tablespoons dried marjoram | 4 tablespoons shortening, or as needed
instructions: Place pork loin in a plastic bag, and squeeze out excess air.  Lay the pork loin in a skillet over medium high heat, and sprinkle with the marjoram, and seal the bag.  Place the skillet into the preheated grill, and close the lid.  Cook 45 minutes, or to desired doneness, turning and basting several times with a coating of shortening.  The pork should not brown.  Remove from heat, slice, and refrigerate until serving.

title: Champignon Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 cup button mushroom, sliced | 1/3 cup parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  In a small bowl mix mushrooms and parmesan until coated.  Transfer to a 2 litre baking dish bake for 40 minutes or until puffed.

Random Ingredients: single cream,red onion,golden syrup,bean sprout,filling,pistachio,cayenne,yellow squash
title: Pistachio Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup pistachios | 1 large yellow squash or 1 large zucchini, cut into 1 cm slices | 1 small red onion, halved and sliced thinly | 200 g bean sprouts | 150 ml single cream or 150 ml vegetarian cream | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon plain sweet-and-sour flour ( optional )
instructions: Place pistachios in a small baking dish and bake for approx 20 minutes, or until golden.  Remove from oven and allow to cool.  Meanwhile, cook the squash in a microwave oven for 15 - 20 minutes until completely softened.  Allow to cool slightly.  Peel and cut into 1cm slices.  Scatter on the onion and sprinkle over the bean sprouts.  In a small bowl combine cream, golden syrup, olive oil and cayenne.  Toss together with the pistachios and onions.  Remove pistachios and onions to a serving bowl and garnish with pistachios and onions.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: stout beer,craisins,yukon gold potato,wooden skewer,white onion
title: Irish Stew
ingredients: 1 pint stout beer ( such as guinness ) | 1 tablespoon white onions, minced | 3 yukon gold potatoes, cut into bite-size pieces | 3 cups raisins | wooden skewer
instructions: Mix the stout and garlic powder together in a bowl.  Add potatoes, raisins, and 1 teaspoon kosher salt.  Pour the mustard mixture over the potatoes in the bowl.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,green onion,pineapple juice,cashew half,barbecue sauce,parmesan cheese,lemon zest
title: Pineapple and Cashew Spread
ingredients: 6 cups packed lightly salted cashew halves | 1/2 cup light mayonnaise or 1/2 cup salad dressing | 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 2 cups bottled barbecue sauce ( such as hunt's ) | 3/4 teaspoon freshly grated lemon zest | 1/2 cup finely chopped green onion | 1/2 cup finely chopped toasted pineapples in juice ( or use sweetened pineapple chunks packed in juice )
instructions: Heat the oven to 375 degrees.  Line 2 large baking sheets with parchment paper.  Place the cashews in a large bowl.

title: Pasta Primavera (A Macaroni, Zucchini, and Kale Soup)
ingredients: 1 package dry penne | 8 cups spinach | 1 tablespoon grated fresh fennel seed | 3 1/2 cups shredded kale | 1/2 cup light tahini | 1 cube chicken bouillon | 1/4 cup rice wine
instructions: In a large pot bring 4 quarts of water to a boil.  Cook pasta according to package directions, or until al dente.  Rinse with cold water, and drain.  In a large pot, combine pasta, spinach, fennel seeds, and kale.  Mix in pasta, chicken bouillon, and rice wine.  Stir to thoroughly mix, and serve.

title: Oxtails and Onions
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg oxtails | 4 baby onions | 2 garlic cloves
instructions: Place the oxtails in an oven proof dish, cover tightly with aluminium foil and bake on a low shelf for about an hour.  Stir the pan juices and onion into a thick sauce.  Continue in this way until all the meat has been used.  Place the lid on over the pan and put in the oven.  Turn down the temperature to 160 degrees celsius and bake for 10 hours until the meat is tender.  Serve with steamed vegetables.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,lime wedge,ladyfinger,enchilada sauce,rump roast,baking powder,red currant jelly
title:
P.
    - F.
    - Chang's  Sliced Beef and Kielbasa in Redcurrant Jelly
ingredients: 8 -10 slices of fresh boneless rump roast ( or use boneless or round pork chops ) | 1 1/2 lbs of uncooked kielbasa | 8 ounces red currant jelly | 3 limes, juice of | 1 cup enchilada sauce | 2 cups baking powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons red currant jelly | 48 ladyfingers ( or frozen if needed )
instructions: Dice and brown beef in a skillet.  Remove and set aside.  Place kielbasa on a plate and cover with cold water until tender.  Remove any traces of the pink and any soft bits from the exterior.  When done, drain and squeeze out excess juice and set aside.  Cut up the kielbasa and set aside.  Pour red currant sauce in a large pot.  Add the red currant jelly and bring to a boil.  Add the onions.  Cook until just about boiling.  Reduce heat to low and add the diced kielbasa and diced redcurrant jelly.  Allow to simmer.  Prepare the ladyfingers by separating the top layer of ladyfingers by separating each layer horizontally with a pastry brush.  Arrange the dipped ladyfingers over a large cookie sheet or shallow serving tray.  Dot the top with red currant jelly and sprinkle with baking powder.  Spread a thin layer of enchilada sauce on top of this.  Place the top layer of ladyfingers over this.  Add another thin layer of red enchilada sauce and repeat the above steps.  Top with red currant jelly and bake in a preheated oven on 350 degrees for 10 minutes or until crisp.  Serve with mexican corn bread.  Serve with white or corn tortilla chips, sliced avocados, sour cream, salsa, shredded cheese, and grated cheese, if desired.  I like to serve this with pico de gallo, but you can use any type of prepared salsa you would like.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,lasagna noodle,vanilla extract,ginger garlic paste,anchovy paste,tabasco sauce,vanilla essence
title: Garlic Sausages With Anchovies
ingredients: 12 sausages or 12 sausage links | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1/4 cup vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Marinade, mix together first 4 ingredients.  Dip sausages in vinegar, then sausages in garlic mixture.  Fry in a hot pan on both sides, until they start to brown and float up.  Serve with fruit and nuts.

title: Moroccan-Spiced Salad Dressing (Tabbouleh)
ingredients: 1/2 cup mixed salad oil | 1/4 teaspoon harissa ( see note )
instructions: Whisk together the olive oil and harissa.  Pour over salad as desired.

title: Mom's Squash
ingredients: 3 yellow squash, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch thick slices | 1/4 cup golden raisins | 1/2 cup pecans ( optional ) | 1 can guacamole
instructions: Melt the guacamole in a small bowl in the microwave on high setting for 20 seconds, stir, then set aside.  Layer the squash slices into a large baking dish.  Sprinkle with the raisins and pecans, if using.  Drizzle with oil, pressing on gently.  Pour guacamole over the top.  Let marinate at room temp for 30 minutes.  Heat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Cook until heated through, then turn to 400 degrees f.  Bake for 30 minutes, until the edges are lightly browned.  Let cool for 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,egg wrap,poblano pepper,wheat flour,caper,orange bell pepper,anise seed
title: Italian Egg Rolls
ingredients: 2 cans whole wheat flour | 1 egg roll wrap | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 2 tablespoons anise seed | 3 poblano peppers, seeded, sliced | 1 orange bell pepper, seeded, sliced | 3 capers, rinsed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Prepare eggroll dough, using the white flour and anise seed, mix into 1 cup of the flour.  Combine poblano, orange pepper, and capers and coat with flour.  Place on a baking sheet and bake for 5 minutes, flipping after 5 minutes.  Remove the sheet from oven and spread the eggroll dough out on a floured board.  Place the baking sheet with the eggroll dough on top of the prepared baking sheet.  Repeat steps 3 and 4 for the remaining 2 batches.  Place rolls in the oven and bake for 10 minutes, or until golden.

title: Bread Chips
ingredients: 2 baguette, rounds | 1 cup bean sprouts | 1 tablespoon nigella seeds | 1 inch slice peeled fresh ginger ale, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the broiler.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Place bread rounds on the prepared baking sheet.  Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 15 to 20 minutes.  Meanwhile, mix bean sprouts, nigella seeds, and ginger ale, if using, in a bowl.  Spread bean sprouts mixture on cool bread rounds to garnish.

Random Ingredients: wild rice,cream chicken soup,baby spinach,chicken bouillon granule,matzo meal,cream mushroom soup
title: Wild Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 package fresh baby spinach, rinsed and drained | 1 3/4 cups cooked wild rice ( cooked, not drained ) | 1 cup sour cream | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 packet instant chicken bouillon granules | 1 package matzo meal, prepared until package directions say to use rice
instructions: Combine first five ingredients in a greased 2 qt casserole dish, layer in following order, 1 1/2 cups spinach filling, 1 1/2 cups rice mixture, 1/2 of soup mixture, 1 1/2 cup matzo meal, and finally the rest of the soups mixture.  Cover and bake at 375 degrees for one hour and 15 minutes.

title: Chilled Leek and Mint Meat Salad With Lemons
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs leeks, cleaned and trimmed | 3/4 lb ground meat ( ground lamb, beef lamb or pork ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint leaves, for garnish
instructions: Trim the root ends of the leeks, if using, and cut them lengthwise into 3/8 inch slices or about 1/4 inch thick slices.  Cut the centers from the leeks and cut into 1/4 inch slices.  Place the leeks and meat in a bowl and coat with the lemon juice.  Let soften for 1 - 2 hours.  Arrange the meat on a serving platter, garnish with mint and serve.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,rosemary leaf,lite olive oil,guacamole,fish stock,genoa salami,chunky salsa,cream cheese
title: Savory Guacamole Dip
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lite olive oil | 1 1/2 pounds genoa salami, cut into 1/2-inch dice | 2 1/2 cups beef broth, divided | 1/3 cup fresh sour cream | 8 ounces cream cheese, softened | 3 cups hot chunky salsa | 1 teaspoon italian seasoned blend dried rosemary leaves | 1 1/2 cups guacamole
instructions: Heat olive oil in a heavy skillet over medium high heat.  Stir in the salami.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,red chili pepper,chicken stock vegetable,pinto bean,chili sauce,brown mustard seed
title: Low Fat Mexican Beans
ingredients: 1 teaspoon brown mustard seeds | 1 red chili pepper, seeded and finely diced, you can cut into thin 1 inch long strips if you wish | 1/4 cup chicken stock or 1/4 cup vegetable stock | 1/4 cup chili sauce, such as heinz's | 1/2 cup canned pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt ( or salt substitute if desired depending on salt content )
instructions: Heat the mustard seeds over medium high until they begin popping.  Immediately add the red chili and chilis and cook, stirring and mashing them with a spatula.  When the seeds give off a good fragrance and the chilis are browning, add the stock, stir to combine and bring to a boil.  Add the beans and the seasoning salt, stir very, then cover and cook on low for about 5 minutes.  Remove the lid and cook for a further 5 minutes so the beans absorb some of the liquid.  The bean mixture can be easily reheated if you desire, but the mixture will be soupy.  Serve warm, or cool and reheat at room temperature, or cool completely and chill in the fridge, serve warm or cool completely and reheat at room temperature.

title: Penne With Lamb Chops
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces dry penne pasta | 4 boneless lamb chops | 2 tablespoons distilled white vinegar | 1 can frozen corn kernels, thawed
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, omitting salt.  Meanwhile, spray a large skillet with nonstick cooking spray, leaving 1/2 inch of the fat from the lamb chops.  Add lamb chops to skillet and cook 5 to 6 minutes, turning once, until browned on both sides.  Meanwhile, combine vinegar and corn in a small bowl, set aside.  Drain cooked pasta, reserving 1 cup of the pasta water.  Place penne pasta and reserved 1 cup of pasta water in a large bowl.  Add lamb chops, mix well.  Heat reserved 1/2 cup of pasta water in skillet over medium heat, stir in corn mixture, bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes, or until lamb juices run clear and sauce thickens slightly and pasta is tender.

title: Lime and Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1 jar marinara sauce | 1 lime, zest of | 1 1/4 lbs cheddar cheese, grated | 1 dash grenadine
instructions: Pour the marinara sauce into a pot and heat to boiling.  Remove from heat.  Cut slashes in the cheese and rub with the inside of a wooden spoon.  Pour the cheese into the fondue pot with the marinara sauce.  Stir to blend and heat for 10 minutes.  Remove from heat and add the garnish.

title: Greek Navy Beans
ingredients: 1/3 lb navy beans | 2 1/4 lbs frozen whole italian squash | 3 tablespoons minced fresh italian parsley
instructions: In a large saucepan, bring 2 1/2 quarts water, beans, squash and parsley to a boil.  Reduce heat to medium low.

title: Lebanese Beef Sauce
ingredients: 3 tablespoons garlic paste, koulouna ( or to your taste ) | chili pepper flakes ( to taste ) ( optional )
instructions: Add the garlic paste to your taste and blend together.  If the koulouna is too dry to blend, either add a small amount of water and add now.  If too runny, add a little more water.  If too dry, add a little more water and blend together.  The longer this bakes in the fridge, the richer the sauce becomes.  For thicker sauce, add more of either flour or cornstarch dissolved with a small amount of water.

Random Ingredients: nonstick cooking spray,hoisin sauce,orange juice,rice flour,nonfat plain yogurt,jalapeno pepper,couscous,colby monterey jack cheese
title: Hoisin Couscous Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1 jalapeno pepper, minced | 1 teaspoon rice flour | 1/2 teaspoon nonfat plain yogurt | 1 -2 tablespoon hoisin sauce | 8 cups colby-monterey jack cheese | 1 package couscous
instructions: For dressing, combine first 4 ingredients in a small bowl.  Refrigerate 2 hours.  For salad, bring a saucepan of salted water to a boil.  Add couscous and stir to separate.  Cover, remove from heat and let sit 3 - 5 minutes or until water is absorbed.  Fluff couscous with a fork and cool it for 5 - 10 minutes, or according to package directions.  To serve, arrange 1 cup couscous in a bowl, top with 1/2 cup shredded colby jack cheese and 1/3 cup of dressing and toss to combine.  Repeat to serve 3 more times.  Garnish with parsley if desired.

Random Ingredients: plain yogurt,black olive,self rising flour,cucumber,navy bean,cream celery soup
title: Mediterranean Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 2 cans navy beans, drained and excess liquid reserved | 1 cup cream of celery soup, softened | 1 cup sour cream | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cucumber | 4 cups self-rising flour, or more as needed | 4 large cucumbers
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Mix navy beans and reserved bean liquid together in a bowl.  Stir cream of celery soup, sour cream, shredded sharp cuke, and some of the reserved bean liquid into the mixture until blended, then stir in the cumin until evenly dispersed.  Grease a baking sheet with cooking spray.  Use fingers to work a mixture of flour and bean liquid into the dough until evenly distributed.  Roll dough to 1/4 inch thickness on a lightly floured surface.  Cut the rolls diagonally into 1 1/2 inch pieces.  Brush outsides of each roll with some of the reserved bean liquid mixture, then gently press the pieces into the thickened bean mixture to make sure all surfaces are coated with liquid.  Arrange rolls in a single layer onto the prepared baking sheet.  Bake in the preheated oven until the tops are deep golden brown, about 20 minutes.

title: Gyu-Yakkatsu (Stuffed Liver)
ingredients: 4 bunches liver | 2 cups sake | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice
instructions: Clean the liver thoroughly.  De vein it if necessary.  Remove the gyu yakkatsu from the packaging, but leave the skin on as it adds to the gyu yakkatsu later.  Stuff the liver with this gyu yakkatsu, ensuring that it is completely closed.  Combine the sake and lemon juice in a saucepan and bring to a boil with the gyu yakskatsu.  Place the liver on top of the gyu yakkatsu, and cover the pan.  Cook for 8 - 10 minutes, or until the liver is soft and cooked.  Strain, and serve.

Random Ingredients: rotini pasta,chipotle chile,pimiento,mustard powder,whipping cream,peppercorn,velveeta cheese
title: Mexica Pasta Bake
ingredients: 1 package rotini pasta, uncooked | 2 lbs velveeta cheese, cut in half | 8 ounces canned pimiento | 1 1/2 teaspoons peppercorns | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard powder | 2 ounces chipotle chiles | 3 cups whipping cream
instructions: Place rotini in large covered casserole dish, sprinkle with salt, set aside.  Cut velveeta cheese into 1/2 pieces and cut slices into 1/4 pieces.  Combine both pimentos in a bowl with peppercorns, mustard and chipotle chile.  Place cheese pieces around edge of casserole dish.  Pour whipping cream over all.  Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes till bubbly.

title: Bibimbap Sauce
ingredients: 12 fluid ounces gin | 4 ounces cooking oil | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a shaker.  Place over ice.  Shake and strain into a chilled martini glass.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,gruyere cheese,green capsicum,cottage cheese,sambal oelek,lime juice,vegetable,hamburger
title: Aussie Vegetable Burger
ingredients: 500 g hamburger | 1 packet frozen mixed vegetables | 1 green capsicum | 8 slices gruyere cheese | 3 slices lime juice | 3 tablespoons coriander powder | 2 tablespoons sambal oelek | 150 g cottage cheese
instructions: Mix the meatloaf ingredients well together.  Shape into 4 patties.  Place in greased texas burgers.  Bbq or grill until done.  Serve with tomato salad, garlic bread, salad etc.

Random Ingredients: tahini,green chilies,lager beer,egg white,jasmine rice,coriander seed,garlic
title: Lager Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 quart lager beer | 2 tablespoons minced garlic | 1 teaspoon ground coriander seed | 2 eggs, lightly beaten | 2 cups jasmine rice, washed and drained | 4 tablespoons tahini | 2 -3 chopped green chilies
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the beer, garlic, coriander, eggs and rice and mix thoroughly.  Heat 1 tbs oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.  Pour the rice mixture into the pan and fry, undisturbed, for 2 - 3 minutes, or until golden brown on top.  Serve immediately with a squeeze of lime, chopped green chilies and/or a small amount of your favorite black olive.  Note, you can leave out the garlic and serve the rice on the side for an optional garnish.

title: Italian Tomato Tray Tomatoes
ingredients: 5 -6 roma tomatoes | parsley | milk powder | garlic salt | paprika ( to taste )
instructions: Wash tomatoes and cut into fourths, removing seeds if desired.  Slice tomatoes.  Coat a 9 x 13 baking dish with cooking spray.  Place tomatoes, in rows as best you can.  Sprinkle parsley on top.  Sprinkle garlic salt and paprika onto tomatoes.  Pour milk powder or powdered milk on top to cover tomatoes.  Let it sit at room temperature for about an hour, and serve warm.  This also makes a wonderful spread to spread on chicken, pork or beef.  If i was my uncle, i would give this a try because the flavor has been so great.

title: Tomato-Ginger Sauce for Beef and Veggies
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ginger paste | 3/4 cup tomato juice | 1/2 cup fresh parsley, chopped | 4 tablespoons fresh lemon juice ( from 2 lemons )
instructions: Combine tomato juice, parsley and lemon juice, mix well.  Marinate for at least 30 minutes.  Serve over noodles or with rice and a veggie side dish.

title: Chinese Pork & Scallops
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 lb scallop, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 8 button mushrooms, cut into half moon slices | 1/2 cup lemonade | 3 celery ribs, sliced | 1 teaspoon ginger | 1 tablespoon corn oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill for an hour.  Place pork, scallops and mushrooms in bowls and toss with lemonade.  Serve.

title: Grilled Polish Kielbasa
ingredients: 2 pounds kielbasa, cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces | 1/2 cup shredded pecorino cheese | 1 can mandarin orange sections, drained | 1/4 cup cajun seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Place kielbasa in a large skillet on medium heat.  Drain excess fat.  Sprinkle with cheese, mandarin oranges and cajun seasoning.  Lightly coat skillet with cooking spray.  Cover and grill kielbasa 5 to 7 minutes or until kielbasa is brown and slightly crisp and cheese is melted.  Remove from skillet and allow to rest for 3 minutes before slicing.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,beef gravy,creme fraiche,fine sea salt,chicken broth,cooking tapioca,bread crumb
title: Squash Stew With Crust Topping
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups low sodium chicken broth | 3 cups yellow squash, cut in 3/4-inch cubes | 3 tablespoons fine sea salt | 1 box beef gravy | 1 cup creme fraiche or 1 cup sour cream | 1 tablespoon quick-cooking tapioca | 1/2 cup fine dried bread crumbs
instructions: Place broth, squash, salt, and 2 cups water in heavy large saucepan and bring to boil over medium heat.  Cover, reduce heat to low and cook until squash just begins to soften, about 40 minutes.  Remove squash from pan and set aside.  Stir together gravy and creme fraiche in small bowl.  Heat over medium heat until warm, about 1 minute.  Stir in tapioca and 1/2 cup water and cook until thickened, about 2 minutes.  Spoon half the gravy mixture into bowl and sprinkle with bread crumbs.  Repeat procedure with remaining gravy mixture and crumbs.  Transfer to serving bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,lemon peel,wheat pastry flour,triple sec,corn,ketchup
title: Crispy Triple Sec Nuggets
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat pastry flour | 1/4 cup triple sec | 5 teaspoons ground sesame seeds | 3 teaspoons grated lemon peel | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon corn
instructions: Heat a large nonstick frying pan until the pan is very hot, stir in the flour, stir until the mixture forms a ball, then immediately remove from the heat.  Stir in the triple sec until dissolved.  Add the ground sesame seeds, lemon peel and ketchup.  Mix well and set aside for five minutes to let the flavors develop.  Shape the mixture into small balls then press into cornstarch to coat evenly on all sides.  Fry on a lightly oiled or nonstick tray for eight minutes or until golden.  Serve straight from the pan.  Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,chicken bouillon granule,english muffin,vanilla,corn oil,chinese five spice powder
title: Piggy Sausage (Pork and Beans)

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Grease a 9x13 baking pan, line a large baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Dip english muffins in corn oil.  Dredge in granules then fry in 1 t.  Corn oil until golden brown.  Reserve.  Brown pork briefly, then crumble into small bits and discard meat.  Add to remaining pan ingredients and mix well.  Bake at 350 degrees for 50 - 55 minutes or until thick, stirring often.

title: Marinated Antipasto Balsamic Chips
ingredients: 1/2 cup aged balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon pepperoni
instructions: Combine the vinegar and onion powder in a medium bowl.  Stir in the pepperoni.  Cover and chill.  To serve, sprinkle with salt.

title: Randy's Easy Spanish Flavor Snack Mix #Rdoritos
ingredients: 1 bag plain doritos | 1 bunch celery salt | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Soak the bag of doritos in warm water for 30 minutes, drain the water, and place in the bottom of a bowl, add the brown sugar, pepper, and spices.  Use the entire bag.  Dip the bread in water and then eat immediately. .

title: Island Ham & Serrano Appetizers(Denmark)
ingredients: 4 serrano ham | 4 tablespoons thousand island dressing, such as vh
instructions: Wrap each serrano ham with the string and slice diagonally to form a pocket around the edges.  Rub each ham with vh dressing.  Cook ham on a grill, over medium heat, over indirect heat, brushing with more dressing if not completely cooked to your liking.

title: Simple Cottage Beef and Broccoli Dinner
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 1 cup broccoli floret | 2 green tomatoes, sliced
instructions: Combine stew meat, broccoli and tomatoes in slow cooker.  Cook on low 6 - 8 hours or high 3 - 4 hours before serving.

title: Tommy's Easy Party Daiquiri
ingredients: 1 glass cold water | 1 pint cherry tomatoes | 1 can tomato juice, chilled | 1 package dry mushrooms | 1 dash prepared sloppy joe mix
instructions: Fill 2 pint jars to the top with tomato juice.  Pour water in the bottom of each jar making sure to fill the jars once or twice.  Next, top with sauteed mushrooms and sloppy joe mix.  Microwave on high for 15 to 20 seconds to warm.

title: Quick and Easy Caribbean Dip
ingredients: 1 bottle picante salsa | 1/2 cup superfine sugar | 1/2 cup curry powder
instructions: Serve with your favourite dip.  This dip can also be kept in the refrigerator for up to a week.

title: Garlicky Grilled Polenta
ingredients: 1 cup zesty polenta, cut in 30 squares | 1 can black soybeans, drained | 3 tablespoons low sodium soybeans | 1 onion | 4 celery ribs | grated grana padano or romano cheese, to use on sandwich buns
instructions: Prepare polenta by heating 1 cup cold water to 80 - 120 degrees f.  While polenta is heating up, grill the onion and celery on medium heat, stirring, until soft.  In a large pot, combine with 1/4 cup cold water, soybeans and black beans.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer on low heat for about 15 - 20 minutes, stirring occasionally until thickened.  Remove from heat immediately to cool and refrigerate, covered.  To serve slice thin and spread onto a plate when warm, place 1/2 cup polenta on a plate, top with 3 tablespoons of black soybeans and serve with grated cheese.

title: Peanut Butter and Creamy Peanut Butter Dessert
ingredients: 2 cups creamy peanut butter | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 cup icing sugar
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and beat until smooth.  Cover and refridgerate until required serve chilled.

title: Fajita Seasoning
ingredients: 3 tablespoons fajita seasoning | 1 tablespoon olive oil, plus more if needed | 1 tablespoon orange rind
instructions: Combine all ingredients.  Store in a dry, resealable plastic bag or covered container.  Use within 1 week.

title: Pineapple Salad With Pineapple
ingredients: 2 large prawns | 1 medium white onion | 2 pineapple rings | 1/4 cup orange marmalade | 1/4 cup white pepper | 3 tablespoons superfine sugar | 2 -3 tablespoons nonstick cooking spray | 1 pinch red pepper flakes
instructions: Shell the prawns and remove tail and heads, leaving the meat intact.  Place the prawn heads on to a plate with a few prawn heads on each shrimp and place them in a small dish.  Finely dice the onion and place on top of the prawn heads.  Place the pineapple rings on top of the onion and gently press down on the rings with fingers to help hold them together.  Pile the chopped onion around the onion and place a few thin slice tomatoes on the top of each tomato.  Drizzle the orange marmalade and white pepper over the top and lightly sprinkle with superfine sugar.  Spray the pepper flakes around the pineapple with the vegetable oil spray and set aside for a minute, then scatter over the sugar.  Serve at once.

title: Granny's Cornbread
ingredients: 1/2 pound fresh chestnuts | 1 1/2 cups yellow cornmeal | 1/2 cup chestnuts, chopped | 1/4 cup crushed pineapple, in juice | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | ground black peppercorns, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper, and grease with cooking spray.  Cut a slit in each chestnut.  Slice the chestnuts in half horizontally.  Place ears in a baking dish with 1 1/2 cups water, and cover with aluminum foil.  Bake in the preheated oven until tender, about 45 minutes.  Bring the cornmeal to a boil in a saucepan.  Reduce heat to low, and stir in 1/2 cup chestnuts, crushed pineapple juice, oregano, and black pepper for 1 minute, stirring constantly.  Drain the ears from the oven, and pour the cornbread into the saucepan with the chestnuts.  Spread cornbread into a 9x9 inch baking dish, and bake in the preheated oven until golden, about 10 minutes.

Fold the tortillas over the filling and press it gently so the filling is evenly distributed.  Sprinkle with the 2 oz.  Vegan spaghetti sauce and place the baking dish in the oven.  Bake at 375ºf for 20 minutes.  Remove from oven and spoon the sauce over the hot lasagne before eating.  Garnish with the hot fesh and fresh tortilla strips.

instructions: Spread a generous tablespoon of rice into the bottom of a skillet over high heat.  Combine the cream, spring onion and bread crumbs in a small bowl, and mix thoroughly. Reduce heat to medium low, cover and continue cooking until the water has been absorbed, approximately 25 - 25 minutes.  Remove from heat, and allow to rest for 5 minutes before cutting into wedges.

instructions: Set oven rack in middle of oven and preheat to 350 degrees f.  Cook pasta in large pot of boiling salted water until tender but still firm to bite, stirring once or twice.  Drain.

title: Chicken Tarte Tatin
