instructions: Remove skin from chicken tenders.  Separate tenders.  Cut tenders in half.  Pour 1 tsp vanilla bean pulp into each piece.  Sprinkle with salt.  Let stand 10 minutes.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Arrange chicken tenders in a single layer and place on pan or cookie sheet.  Bake for 10 minutes, turn and bake 5 more minutes, stir, bake an additional 5 minutes or until chicken is just cooked through.

title: Chef Bevski's Hominy Pie
ingredients: 1 can white hominy | 1 cup cooked broccoli rabe | 1 brown bread, crumbled | 2 ounces ketchup | 3 ounces dark chocolate, melted
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put into an oven proof 9 pan.  Pre heat oven to 325 degrees.  Bake for 1 hour or until filling is bubbly and golden brown.  Garnish with a little shaved coriander.

title: Spicy Baked Scones
ingredients: 4 cups self-rising flour | 2 teaspoons green chili peppers, chopped ( can be replaced with jalapeno, chipotle and/or or chile sauce depending on your taste ) | 2 ounces carrots, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f rub the flour with the chopped green chiles as well as the chili pepper.  Make a well in the centre of the flour and stir in the carrot.  Make into a firm, smooth batter with the back of a spoon.  Lightly spray an 8inch pizza tray with cooking spray and carefully pour in the batter.  Bake on the middle shelf of your oven for about 15 minutes or until golden.  Serve with salsa and sour cream if desired.

title: Sweet Pot Pie
ingredients: 2 pie crusts, rolled | 100 g shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 cup frozen whole kernel corn | 7 fluid ounces double cream
instructions: Roll out your first piece of pastry then lay it out on your board.  Spread the mushroom slices on the bottom of your pastry then lay your half of the pastry on top.  Dot it with milk then spoon your cream on top.  Fold in the left and right edges making sure the pie crust is completely covered.  Place the pie onto a plate and brush the top with milk or water.  Bake in a preheated oven for 20 minutes.

title: Kebabs - Ethiopian Beef and Bean Stew
ingredients: 1/2 lb dried black-eyed peas ( kimchee ) | 2 lbs beef chuck, trimmed and cut into 1 x 1/4 inch slices | 2 large radishes, sliced thinly
instructions: Cover the kimchee meat with water and soak overnight.  Drain liquid from kimchee.  Combine contents of soaked kimchee and liquid and boil to cover 1 1/2 inches from the top.  Cover and simmer 2 hours, or until the meat is very tender.  Skim fat and discard.  Remove meat and discard any fat.  Serve over injera, dolmades or pita triangles.  Variation, serve with safot chukha, a lentil relish, tomato ketchup or a spicy chutney made from a mixture of lemon pepper and coriander seeds mixed with sesame.  Variation, add 1 tbls.  Sakharic acid to the soaking liquid for a refreshing taste and color.  To change the flavor of this dish, replace the kimchee with small pieces of dried red kidney beans, soaked in cold water until soft and easy to peel, then cut out the ends.  If using dolmades, soak overnight in cold water to soften them.  Then trim off any strings or stones before cooking the meat.  Then cut the meat into 1 inch cubes.  Serve with injera, lentil relish, tomato ketchup or spicy chutney.  Variation, replace the meat with any of the following, goat meat, or shrimp meat, or chicken meat.

Top lamb mixture with cheese, apple, bell pepper and green beans.  Arrange in an overlapping lattice pattern.  Bake 35 minutes or until bubbly and top is golden.

title: Ouzo Dip

instructions: Mix all in a small bowl.  Serve cool, or room temperature.

Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, then turn the oven temperature up to 400 degrees f, and cook for 15 more minutes.  Check the drumettes to see when the juices run clear.

instructions: Mix kidney beans, lemon juice, orange juice, and white sugar together until combined.  Store in refrigerator.

instructions: Combine all ingredients except frozen strawberries in 4 qt casserole.  Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours or until set.  Drain ingredients.  Stir into mixture.  Cover and cook on low heat 5 minutes or until bubbly.

Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Bake uncovered until golden brown and edges are puffed up, 35 to 40 minutes.  Cut into thirds diagonally and serve while hot.

instructions: Whisk lime juice, vinegar and hot dogs in bowl.  Sprinkle anchovie over top.

title: Mango Potatoes with Fried Crimini Mushrooms

instructions: Place the floury potato in the center of a cutting board and cut it in half lengthwise.  Cut a slit on the top of the potato without cutting all the way through.  The way the floury potato is usually sold is with it cut perpendicular to the cutting board, just slightly past the base of the potato and the potato. Rinse off the excess moisture out of the mushrooms and pat dry.  Heat the oil in a deep large skillet on medium high or very high heat.  Drain the mushrooms, reserving liquor, then add the mushrooms to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, until they become dark and crusty, about 10 minutes.  Remove the mushrooms and keep warm.  Reduce heat to low and add the rice wine and mango powder and stir until mixed.  Return mushroom slices to skillet and cook until the liquid reduces by half, about 4 minutes.  Remove from heat and serve immediately.

title: New Potatoes With Dijon Mustard

instructions: Wash and halve the new potatoes lengthwise.  Set aside in a large pot and cover with very cold water.  Bring to a boil over high heat.  When the water comes to a boil, then reduce heat to a low simmer and maintain the simmer.  Scrub the potatoes with a stiff brush and place in a large bowl.  Cover with plastic wrap and let stand until completely cool, about 10 minutes.  Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f.  Cut a slit in each potato about 1/2 inch deep. Pour off the excess oil if they become too dark.  Remove from heat.  Place the bowl with the cooked wedges over a bowl or use a spoon to toss the potatoes, toasted sesame seeds, and sugar.  Taste and adjust seasoning before eating. .

Garnish with fresh mint.

title: Spicy Thai Barbecue Sauce

instructions: Remove the chicken from the sauce, and pat dry.  Save the liquid from 1 can.  You want to use 1 cup of this mix.  In a gallon sized zipper lock bag, put the chicken with liquid, the remaining cup of stock and the cayenne pepper in to the bag.  Seal tightly.  Marinate overnight in the refrigerator. You may set aside some of the remaining liquid in the bag right before you serve the sauce to use as a dipping sauce for ribs, chicken wings etc.  Serve over cooked egg noodles, fried rice or noodles.

Divide among heated plates & top eveything with parmesan cheese.

title: Mussel-Green Beans Bake (Australian)

instructions: Boil the beans in salted water until they are just tender, not mushy.  Drain.  Put in a bowl and cover with a little hot soda water. When cool a little put through a food processor, or the blade of a table knife.  Put them through a sieve and take out all the mussels either through the sieve or through a sieve, you have to scrape away all the shells.  Put the mussels through a sieve. instructions:
Name:- ##
 Egyptian Sea Bass 
 
## Ingredients ##
 1/8 teaspoon sesame oil, maybe a bit more, depends on how much fat you have.  This is to crisp the skin while it preheats.  It will be very spicy so don't get discouraged.  It will certainly smell sweet, but the fragrance will mellow out considerably later.  I find this method to be pretty effective.  Rinse off any residue from the meat and pat dry with paper towels.  Cut the fillets into 1/4 inch wide by 2 inch chunks.  Brush the fish with sesame oil and season generously with kosher salt and pepper.  Let it sit in the refrigerator for a couple of hours.  At the time of cooking, make sure the fish is drying properly.  If it is in a bit salty, blot it again with paper towels.  If it is not, use more sesame oil this time.  Otherwise, this can be done in the pressure cooker.  When it starts to darken a little, move off the heat for a minute or so.  It's important for the fish to be slightly browned outside of the shell.  Do not move it when the fish begins to darken.  Do not worry if it is not yet burned outside, this is normal.  Sprinkle the fish with kosher salt now.  Let it sit in the refrigerator at least 1 hour or for about 4 hours.  The food should now be mostly dry.  You can use some kitchen shears to make croutons or a flat bread.  If you have the time, let it sit at room temperature for about 10 minutes so it will sweat out a little bit without burning itself.  The crust should brown on the top and bottom, but not burnt.  It's likely that some of the oil will float.  If it does, it is too intense.  At first the anchovy may pop out, but that's okay.  The goal is to moisten the fish lightly to help absorb any remaining oil.  It will get pretty salty at first, but this way the flavors will be well developed.  The goal is to help keep this moist, but also to help keep the anchovy from burning as it sets.  If you have a cast iron skillet, this will be a pain.  Heat a large skillet or ridged grill pan over medium high heat.  Brush the fish with oil, and season heavily with salt.  Cook for about 4 to 5 minutes per side, depending on the thickness of the fillets.  Remove the fish from the grill to a warm serving platter.  Slice into fingers/discs and serve.  Spoon some of the anchovy and olive oil on top.  If you wish, drizzle a bit more olive oil on the fish.

instructions: In a large saute pan, heat oil.  Sprinkle pork with salt and pepper.  Add pork, in batches, and cook until no longer pink and juices run clear, 15 - 20 minutes.  When meat is almost cooked through, remove from heat.  Meanwhile, in a medium mixing bowl, toss zucchini with icecream.  Cut crosswise into quarters.  Grill zucchini over hot coals 2 minutes.  Turn and cook about 30 seconds longer or until zucchini turns pale gold.  Transfer zucchini with toasted ice cream and lime quarters.

title: Ginger Black Eyed Peas With Lazy Girlfingers
ingredients: 14 ounces sliced black-eyed peas | 18 ladyfingers | 16 ounces peanut butter | 1/4 cup ginger, minced
instructions: In a saucepan, add black eyed peas and enough water to cover.  Cook the peas, covered, over medium heat for 15 minutes or until beans are tender but not mushy.  While the pot, soak ladyfingers according to package directions.  Heat peanut butter in a wok over medium high heat and stir.  When it is hot, add black eyed peas.  Stir and toss continuously until all butter has been absorbed by the peas.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: hot italian sausage,green chili pepper,tabasco sauce,provolone cheese,cumin powder,cremini mushroom
title: Spicy Spicy Cremini Mushrooms
ingredients: 10 -12 cremini mushrooms, cleaned and chopped | 1/8 cup hot italian sausage ( can use extra lean ) | 1/8 cup green chili pepper | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce | 1 1/2 cups provolone cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f in a fry pan, heat all the spices and sausage.  Stir fry mushrooms until they turn to mush.  Add the mushroom mixture and cheese and stir to mix.  Add hot pepper slices to mix.  Turn to oven and cook for about 10 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,rotini pasta,nutritional yeast,lime wedge,yellow cake mix,eggplant,orange blossom water,vermicelli
title: Vegan Marinated Eggplant and Pasta
ingredients: 3 lbs eggplants ( use large eggplants ) | 3/4 lb vermicelli ( soaked for 1 hour in iced water ) | 24 ounces tri colored rotini pasta ( drained ) | 2 1/2 cups low-fat rotini pasta ( i like to use rotini ) | 2 packages yellow cake mix ( the cake mix is gluten-free and low-fat ) | 2 packages lime wedges | 2 tablespoons orange blossom water | 1/4 cup nutritional yeast | 1 tablespoon garlic powder
instructions: In a dutch oven, cut eggplants into 1/4 inch slices and spray with non stick cooking spray.  Cover and place in water with 2 tablespoons kosher salt until they are soft about 3 - 4 hours, turn them every so often.  Remove from water and set aside to drain off liquid.  About 3/4 hour before dinner, rinse the eggplant with cold water, remove the water and pat dry with paper kitchen towels.  In a large bowl, add cooked and drained cooked eggplant, pasta, rotini, cake mix and the 1 1/2 cups cold water.  Mix well.  In a small bowl, stir in the lime wedges, orange blossom water and garlic powder.  Transfer mixture to a 9x13 glass dish, cover and refrigerate at least 24 hours, but not overnight.  Bake covered at 425 for about 40 minutes.  Serve with warm buttered bread, garnish with additional yogurt if desired.

title: Sweet-And-Savory Vegetable Beef
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 lb bacon, sliced into 1-inch strips or 1/2-1 lb ground turkey, lean or lean | 1/2 medium-large sweet bell pepper, halved, seeded, cut into 1-inch strips or 1/2-1/2 cup sweet baby bell pepper, cut into 1-inch strips | 2 medium broccoli, stalks diagonally cut lengthwise into 1-inch florets | 3/4 cup suet, very finely chopped or 3/4 cup margarine | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300.  Mix the bacon& seasonings together in a 9 x13 inch baking dish, cooking bacon until it starts to crisp, about 5 minutes in a large nonstick frying pan, stirring often.  Remove as much bacon fat as possible from the pan, leaving about 2 tablespoons.  With a slotted spoon, remove the crisp bacon and drain on paper towels, leaving 2 tablespoons of bacon fat in the pan.  Drain off all but just enough bacon fat to make 2 tablespoons of bacon fat remaining from the pan.  Stir fry until it starts to caramelize, about 2 minutes.  Using a slotted spoon, transfer the fried bacon to a bowl.  Add the bell peppers, broccoli& suet.  Pour the reserved bacon fat& seasonings into the pan, scraping the bottom and sides of the pan with a wooden spoon.  Stir fry until the broccoli is just tender crisp, about 2 minutes.  Drain most of the residual fat from the pan, then add the sesame oil, mustard& bacon.  Stir fry until heated through, 1 to 2 minutes, and then pour onto the vegetables, mixing with the reserved bacon fat.  Transfer to a warm oven and bake until the sauce thickens, about 10 minutes.

title: Basic Thai Lemongrass and Rice Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb rice noodles | 4 lemongrass, root ends chopped ( about 2 inches long ) | 1/2 cup molasses
instructions: In a large pot bring 1 quarts of water to a boil.  Trim the lemongrass and cut into 3 inch lengths, removing the hard outer leaves.  Remove rind and set aside.  Add molasses to boiling water and bring to a rolling boil.  Add rice noodles, and boil for 5 minutes only, or until noodles are tender and slightly chewy, stirring frequently so they do not stick together.  Drain noodles right away in a colander.  Place noodles in bowl with lemongrass and season with salt and pepper.  Pour hot molasses mixture over noodles, and toss gently to coat.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,black eyed pea,vodka,swiss chard,cilantro,tomato
title: Swiss Chard and Black-Eyed Peas (Tapas)
ingredients: 1 bunch flat-leaf italian parsley, leaves only, chopped | 1 bunch fresh cilantro, leaves only, chopped | 2 cans chopped tomatoes | 1 can black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 1 fluid ounce vodka | 1 bunch swiss chard, stalks trimmed, leaves only
instructions: In a blender or food processor, whir together parsley, cilantro, tomatoes, beans, vodka, and chard until smooth.  Place chard on a serving platter or bowl.  Drizzle chard and tomato mixture over chard.

title: Lebanese Five-rib
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon fennel seed | 2 lbs celery ribs, trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Combine the fennel seeds, and celery.  Stir the seeds into the celery and bring to a boil.  Pour into a square foil lined baking pan.  Bake 45 min, or until the fennel is toasted and is beginning to brown.  Allow to cool to room temperature.  Heat remaining pan juices till reduced by half.  Pour over ribs and serve.

title: Zucchini Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 kg stewing beef | 5 red chili powder | 6 zucchini | 200 g eggplants | 2 teaspoons red chili powder
instructions: Put 3 tbsp red chili powder in oil.  Add meat and brown well.  Cut 2 eggplants.  Remove.  Cut zucchini into large square, 5 cm diagonal slices.  Heat rest of red chilly powder in wok.  Add meat.  Add eggplants and 3 tbsp of red chili powder in.  Add 2 cups of water to it.  Cover and simmer for 1 hour.  Turn meat if it's not tender yet.  Cook the stew for 30 minutes more.  Garnish with chopped coriander leaves, paratha, fried crindons or other things.  Serve hot with plain yoghurt.  Enjoy.

title: Mini Meat Pies
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1/2 cup meat, minced
instructions: Thaw pastry sheets on a baking sheet 15 - 20 minutes.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Divide pastry into 8 equal pieces.  Divide each piece in half.  On a lightly floured board, roll half the pastry out to about 1/4 inch thickness.  Cut out 24 rounds with a 2 inch diameter heart shaped cutter.  Place each circle on a lightly greased oven tray.  Top with half and 1 inch of the minced meat.  Roll out the remaining pastry.  Place in a 12x12 inch baking dish, or 6 smaller size paper muffin cups.  Sprinkle top with remaining meat.  Bake in centre of oven 10 - 12 minutes or until topping is slightly brown.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,provolone cheese,jalapeno chile,white pepper,white miso,cabbage leaf,lamb
title: Mi-Lati's Fennel and Cheese Lamb Rolls
ingredients: 1 pound ground lamb | 1 tablespoon white miso | 2 teaspoons dried fennel seeds | 4 jalapeno chiles, seeded and minced | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 2 1/2 cups shredded cabbage leaves | 4 slices provolone cheese, or to taste
instructions: Preheat a grill for high heat.  Lightly spray a cast iron skillet with cooking spray.  Cook lamb in its hot, nonstick skillet until the meat is browned, breaking up clumps as it cooks, about 5 minutes.  Stir miso into the skillet until dissolved.

title: Broth for Salad Dressing(Rita)
ingredients: 1 cup broth | 1/3 cup brown sugar | 1/3 cup walnuts, finely chopped | 1 sprig fresh dill | 1 sprig fresh basil | 2 sprigs fresh dill
instructions: Pour broth into a heavy saucepan over low heat.  Stir in brown sugar, walnuts, dill, and basil.  Bring to a boil, stirring gently.  Remove from heat.  Let stand 10 minutes.  Pour dressing into a serving bowl and add basil leaves.  Serve hot.

title: Cherry Raita
ingredients: 750 g fresh currants | 1 liter white wine | 250 g currants | 250 g yogurt | 250 g cherries ( in the jar )
instructions: Wash, dry, and chop the cherries.  Place in a pan with the currants, the currants and the yogurt.  Simmer, covered, on low heat for at least 2 hours.  When ready to serve, stir well.

title: Summer Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup uncooked jicama, cut in 1/4 inch cubes | 4 ounces roasted jicama, chopped | 2 teaspoons rose water | 2 teaspoons turmeric | 1/2 cup blueberries | 1/2 cup chopped water chestnut | 1/4 cup pico de gallo ( salsa fresca ) | 1/4 cup plain yogurt
instructions: Combine all the ingredients togther and serve on a bed of sliced fresh cress.  Serve with a fresh salad.

title: Peach and mint Grilled Bread
ingredients: 2 ripe peaches, halved and pitted | 4 cups mixed varieties italian bread, sliced | 1 red capsicum, cored, deseeded, finely sliced | fresh mint sprig, to serve
instructions: Place the peaches, bread and capsicum in a large bowl and pour over 2 1/2 cups cold water.  Cover and stand for 3 - 4 hours or until the bread is completely dry.  Meanwhile, heat a grill pan or griddle.  Cook the bread for about 5 minutes on each side, or until crisp and golden.  Spread with a little oil and scatter with mint leaves.

Random Ingredients: self rising cornmeal,chocolate chip,flat leaf italian parsley,berry,filling,rock salt,beet
title: Aeblekage (Swiss Beet Rings)
ingredients: 8 ounces mixed beets, shredded ( i would put 2 bunches ) | 1/2 - 1 cup strawberry jam or 1/2-1 cup blueberry jam | 1 tablespoon finely chopped flat-leaf italian parsley | 1 cup self-rising cornmeal | 1 pinch rock salt or 1 pinch other coarse salt | 8 ounces chocolate chips | filling
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f.  Put beet in a pot of salted water and bring to a boil over medium high heat for 3 - 5 minutes until just tender.  Drain and mash until creamy.  Add next 4 ingredients and mix.  Roll dough into thin ring shapes about 2 1/2 wide and 9 long.  Coat with a mixture of chocolate, jam, or preserves.  Fry until golden brown on all sides.

Random Ingredients: lime,tortilla,chicken bouillon cube,salt water,wild rice,flour,graham cracker crumb
title: Wild Rice and Queso Blanco
ingredients: 1 package wild rice | 2 1/2 tablespoons flour | 2 1/2 tablespoons salt water | 1/8 teaspoon chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 ounce graham cracker crumbs | 1 lime, cut into wedges | tortilla ( optional )
instructions: Combine rice and 1 1/2 cups of water.  Cook, covered, over low heat for 20 minutes or until al dente.  While rice is cooking, combine flour, salt, and half the crumbs that have been sprinkled over rice and mix well.  Dunk rice into flour mixture.  Dunk the lime wedges into rice.  The tortilla would be best if you roll it in a towel to remove excess flour or moisture.  Once rice is finished cooking, wrap in saran wrap and refrigerate for 2 hours.  Serve with salsa and garnish with remaining crumbs.

title: Crazy Cod
ingredients: 32 ounces smoked cod, drained and flaked | 2 cans of petite crushed corn, drained | 1 package frozen peas and carrot, thawed | 1 1/2 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 cup macadamia nuts or 1 cup pine nuts, toasted | 2 packages of cranberry juice or 2 boxes frozen cranberry flavored juice
instructions: Pour all ingredients into pan of boiling water, cover and simmer for 15 - 20 minutes on med low.  Serve with warm crusty italian bread.  Enjoy.

title: Lentils and Leeks
ingredients: 1 pound red lentils | 4 leeks, trimmed and halved | 1/4 cup ginger garlic paste | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar
instructions: Place lentils in a large pot, and cover with water.  Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until lentils are tender but still firm, 20 to 25 minutes.  Place leeks in a heavy skillet with the ginger garlic paste.  Cook over medium heat until tender, about 8 minutes.  Stir mixture into lentils until coated with ginger garlic paste.  Continue cooking about 10 minutes, until desired consistency has been achieved.  Let cool before serving.

title: Nara's  Italian  Vegetable Beans & Cabbage
ingredients: 1 lb fresh red beans | 1 head cabbage, shredded | 1/4 cup olive oil | 2 bay leaves | pepper
instructions: In a medium sized pot add olive oil and bay leaves over med high heat.  Add the bay leaves.  Cook cabbage and beans until the cabbage begins to soften, about five minutes.  Lower the heat and add cabbage and beans.  Cook a few minutes more, then serve.

title: Shrimp and Green Pepper Sandwich
ingredients: 8 -12 medium shrimp, peeled and deveined | 8 ounces sour cream | 1/2 cup sliced spanish onion, finely chopped | 2 cups fresh mushrooms, cut into bite size pieces | 8 hoagie rolls
instructions: Place shrimp in a bowl with sour cream.  Stir together onions, mushrooms, and shrimp until coated.  Layer hoagies with shrimp mixture and cheese on the roll.

title: Spiced Oatmeal
ingredients: 2 cups quick-cooking oats | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 2/3 cup coriander seed, crushed | 2 tablespoons cashews, toasted and chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f mix together the oats, brown sugar and coriander seeds.  Add cashews and mix to combine.  Spread mixture on an oven tray and bake for 15 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes.

title: Caramelized Walnuts, Asian Style
ingredients: 200 g walnuts, coarsely chopped | 3/4 cup peanut oil, or as needed
instructions: Toss walnuts, peanut oil, and sugar together in a bowl until evenly coated.  Cool to room temperature before using, and store airtight in the refrigerator.

title: Filipino Pork Cabbage (Capsicum)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground lean pork | 4 teaspoons minced ginger | 12 cups roughly chopped savoy cabbage | 4 teaspoons grand marnier | 8 teaspoons salt | 1/2 cup beer | 8 cups crushed corn flakes | ice cube, as needed
instructions: In a large pot, over medium heat, brown the ground pork with ginger until it is thoroughly cooked through.  Add the cabbage and stir fry about 5 minutes or until cabbage is softened.  Add the spices, beer and ice.  Stir thoroughly.  It may need to be heated through, but do not bring to boiling.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing,jalapeno pepper,graham cracker crumb,prosciutto,malt vinegar,creamy peanut butter
title: Peanut butter and Jalapeno Dip
ingredients: 1/4 cup creamy peanut butter | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 2 tablespoons italian salad dressing | 2 cups crispy thinly sliced prosciutto | 1/2 cup chopped seeded jalapeno pepper | 1/2 cup crispy stone-ground graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Whisk together the peanut butter, vinegar, dressing, prosciutto ham, jalapeno pepper, and graham cracker crumbs until well blended.  Cover top of dip with shredded cheese.  Serve warm.

title: Chinese Beef Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb skirt steak | 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 8 ounces egg noodles
instructions: Remove the fat from the steak and trim off any sinew and cut into strips or thin bite sized pieces.  Place the steak in a pot of hot water for about 15 minutes, until it's cooked, tender and slightly firm.  Mix in the ginger garlic paste stir to remove any bits of egg yolk until well blended.  Add noodles and cook to just a boil.  Remove from heat, cover and let sit for 5 minutes while noodles cook.  Serve over cooked rice with salad greens.  Also wonderful with steamed baby carrots and red cabbage.

title: Frijoles Borrachitos (Frijoles Borracho)
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans | 1 teaspoon clear honey | 2 tablespoons dry breadcrumbs | sunflower oil ( for deep frying )
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, add the beans and mash thoroughly with a wooden spoon.  Add the honey and breadcrumbs and mix well.  Shape the mixture into little balls the size of a small cherry or star.  Heat oil to 180c / 375f degrees and fry the frijoles until golden brown.  Serve warm with a salsa fresca sauce.

title: Tortilla Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat | 1 bag tortilla chips | 8 cherry tomatoes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 275 degrees.  Put stew meat in a baking dish and top with tortilla chips, tomatoes and some pepper if desired.

title: Vegan Crock Pot Robusto
ingredients: 1 can hearts of palm, drained | 12 ounces mixed cremini mushrooms, sliced | 4 ounces french dressing | 1 box rigatoni pasta, uncooked
instructions: Combine the first 5 ingredients in crock pot.  Cook on low for 4 hours.  At end of 4 hours, add pasta and stir.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: orange juice zest,chocolate candy bar,chunky salsa,mustard
title: Chunky Mexican Hot Chocolate Bar
ingredients: 4 large chocolate candy bars, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons dry mustard | 2 teaspoons orange juice ( or another citrus-flavored juice ) | 1 container hot chunky salsa
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Combine first 3 ingredients in a small bowl.  Stir in salsa.  Pour into 2 1/2 cup mugs.  Spray a 2 1/2 quart round cake pan with cooking spray.  Place in preheated oven.  Bake 18 to 20 minutes or until filling is light brown and chocolate is set.

title: Mexican Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 lb velveeta mexican cheese | 2 roma tomatoes, diced | 2 teaspoons vinegar
instructions: Put grated cheese in a microwave safe bowl.  Microwave roma tomatoes in 1/2 cup of hot water until soft.  Dry tomatoes on paper towels, about 20 seconds, and chop coarsely.  Microwave onion in 1/2 cup of hot water for about 30 seconds.  Drain tomatoes, and mash with fork.  Set aside.  When cheese is completely melted and creamy, stir in tomatoes.  Pour into a 9 pie plate.  Melt the velveeta.  Stir a few times while heating up.  Once cheese is well blended, stir in vinegar.  Keep stirring until mixture is creamy.

Random Ingredients: port wine,vegetable broth,chicken breast,beef brisket,guacamole,caster sugar,ice cube
title: Casadia's Famous Spiced Chicken Cacciatore
ingredients: 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 1/2 lbs boneless chicken breasts, cut into chunks | 2 teaspoons vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons port wine | ice cube | guacamole | crushed ice cubes
instructions: Soak the casawa wooden skewers in cold water for 15 minutes.  Preheat your grill pan on your medium heat.  Dry fry the chicken pieces until golden and crispy.  Add the broth, port and sugar to the pan.  Add the chopped chicken.  Simmer on medium for a few minutes.  Add crushed ice cubes to your preference.  Serve with your preferred accompaniments.  Also a salad would be a nice touch.

Random Ingredients: grape,bow tie pasta,yellow cake mix,jalapeno chile,cheese,savoy cabbage,fish sauce
title: Cheese Wrapped Cabbage With Grape Nests
ingredients: 1 box bow tie ( farfel ) pasta or ( 16 ounce ) box ziti pasta | 24 grape or cherry tomatoes | 3 cups cheese, any kind, chopped | 1 -2 jalapeno chile, minced ( adjust for heat level ) | 1 packet yellow cake mix | 1 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions in salted water till tender.  Drain.  Remove 1/2 cup of the pasta water.  Rinse and drain the pasta.  Stir the grape tomatoes, cheese, jalapeno, and fish sauce in with the pasta.  Spread over each serving plate with a tablespoon or so of the pasta mixture.  Note, if you like your salad crispy, add 1 - 2 tablespoons of cornstarch to the pasta water, then add to the dish just before serving. .  It helps to have the vegetables laid on the salad for the best flavor, not actually piled on top of the cheese.

title: Penne in Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 lb penne | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 3 cups prepared pizza sauce | 3 cups ice water
instructions: Cook pasta.  Drain and cool.  Combine vinegar, salt and water in a large bowl, stirring well.  Add pasta and stir until well coated.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,chive,chicken stock cube,pork loin chop,catsup,vanilla extract,dark chocolate
title: Chocolate Pork Chops
ingredients: 3 lbs pork loin chops, cut into thick slices | 1/2 cup chicken stock cube | 2 cups catsup, divided | 1/2 cup dark chocolate, chopped roughly | 1/4 cup chives, chopped | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/4 cup maraschino cherry, halved
instructions: Place pork in a pan with 1/2 cup stock cubes.  Pour catsup over and set aside.  Combine remaining stock cubes, the chocolate, chives and vanilla in a saucepan and heat gently for about 2 minutes.  Stir in reserved meat and pour over pork mixture in pan.  Cook very gently for about 1 hour or until meat is very tender and glaze is thickened, stirring occasionally.  Serve with sauce poured over them and top with cherry halves.

title: Lucky Leprechaun Shortbread  (Copycat Recipe)
ingredients:
3/4 cup unsalted butter, softened | 1 1/2 cups white flour | 1/2 teaspoon instant chicken-style poultry seasoning, dissolved in 1 tblsp.
    - cold water | 2 tablespoons low-sodium instant vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon dried dill
instructions: In a medium mixer bowl, using a hand held mixer cream together butter and flour until smooth.  Beat in remaining ingredients, using 1 1/2 tsp of the chicken style seasoning for each ingredient.  Do not overmix.  Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface.  Pat into a 9 inch thick circle.  Using a 2½ or 4 inch round cutter, cut the round into 3/4 inch squares. .  Place 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet, bake until firm and lightly golden, about 15 to 18 minutes.  Cool.

Random Ingredients: shallot,rice noodle,ranch dip mix,red curry paste
title: Thai Red Curry Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package dried rice noodles | 1 package dry ranch dip mix | 1/2 cup red curry paste | 1 shallots, chopped
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

title: Malaysian Beef Satay
ingredients: 500 g skirt steaks | 1/2 tablespoon asafoetida powder | 2 long red chilies | 250 ml cream
instructions: Cut the steak into thin slices.  Mix ingredients and marinade steak for 15 - 20 minutes.  Thread the meat onto metal skewers and barbecue.  Grill until done serve with dipping sauce.

title: Healthy Shells in Palm  (Nigerian)
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat pasta shells ( nam pla ) | 2 cups palm sugar, grated ( or sub brown sugar ) | 1 1/2 lbs corn tortillas, cut in triangles
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water with palm sugar until tender but firm in center.  Drain and set aside.  Fry corn tortillas in a frying pan over medium heat until golden.  Drain on paper towels.  Toss pasta with all the ingredients except tortillas, tossing gently.  Season to taste with salt.

title: French Onion (Microwave)
ingredients: 3/4 cup finely chopped medium-sized white onions or 3/4 cup finely chopped medium-sized red onion | 3 cups coarsely grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a 4 quart, microwave safe dish.  Cover and cook on high power setting for 20 minutes.  Remove lid and cook on high power for 5 more minutes or until mixture is bubbly and lightly browned.  Allow to cool slightly.

Random Ingredients: basil,pasta noodle,cherry,hot water,pastry crust pie,rom tomato,mung bean
title: Tomato Tomato & Mung Bean Sauce Napoleons
ingredients: 1 pre-made pastry for a 9 inch single crust pie | 1/2 cup hot water | 1 jar mung beans ( drained weight ) | 1 cup pastry shells | 1 roma tomato ( diced ) | 1 basil ( small wedge, leaves picked from stems ) | 1 large cherry ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Roll out one pastry sheet for 10 in circles lightly flouring the edges.  Sprinkle the pastry with flour and refrigerate.  Roll out the other pastry sheet, and cut the rest in circles.  Add filling to both pastry sheets and fold to make one large, overlapping each other.  Cut out the four long sides to form the edge of a star, place stars in and pinch the edges closed with a fork.  In a 9 x 13 dish, bake for 20 - 25 minutes, until bottom is golden, and top is golden, remove from oven and garnish with tomato.  Enjoy with your favourite veggies.

title: Cranberry Sweet Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 - 1 cup dried cranberries | 3/4 cup green pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup celery salt | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, grated | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 3 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients and heat until hot.  Mix well and serve over cooked turkey, chicken or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: egg wash,chicken breast half,lemon zest,chicken bouillon granule,red kidney bean,sea salt
title: Quick and Easy Chicken Jollof
ingredients: 1 1/4 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest | 1/2 cup egg wash | 2 tablespoons chicken breast halves, cooked and chopped | 1 tablespoon red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Stir the bouillon granules, lemon peel, and egg wash in a large bowl.  Add the chicken, kidney beans, and sea salt and mix with a fork.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours stirring occasionally.  Remove the pickling liquid from the refrigerator at least 30 minutes before cooking to give a slightly translucent jell of flavor.

title: Prawn Linguine
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs medium prawns, shelled ( raw if possible and deveined ) | 3/4 cup sugar | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 4 tablespoons freshly grated fresh orange peel | 1/3 cup dark molasses | 8 tablespoons minced fresh red preserved ginger
instructions: Bring 4 cups water to a boil in a 5 quart pan and add the prawns.  Return to a boil, reduce the heat to low, cover and simmer for 3 minutes.  Remove the pan from the heat and leave the prawns to cool before using in a recipe.  Combine the prawns with the sugar and vinegar in a saucepan.  Cover and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes, until syrupy.  Remove from heat and set aside.  Combine the orange peel, molasses, remaining 1/4 cup sugar and remaining orange peel in a small saucepan and cook over moderate heat, stirring, until the sugar is dissolved.  Bring to a boil and simmer, uncovered, stirring frequently, for 4 to 5 minutes.  Pour the syrup over the prawns and simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, for 30 minutes.  Ladle 1 cup of the simmering syrup into a small bowl and reserve for serving.  Stir in the ginger and serve the hot prawns sprinkled with the syrup and accompanied with plenty of warm buttered noodles.

title: Baked Norwegian Fish and Chips
ingredients: 14 ounces salmon fillets | 8 ounces fresh shrimp | 1 tablespoon garlic paste ( for the fish ) | 3/4 cup low sodium broth | 1 yellow pepper, seeded and sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees.  Coat a baking sheet with nonstick spray.  Cut the fish into 8 pieces.  Arrange the fish on a baking sheet.  Sprinkle with fish fillets, shrimp, garlic paste, and pepper.  Sprinkle with additional salt and pepper.  Mix together and place on the baking sheet.  Bake for 15 minutes.  The fish should flake easily.

title: Unforgettable Raspberry Pastries
ingredients: 18 frozen crescent rolls | honey | mint leaf | julio rice syrup | fresh raspberry blossoms ( optional ) or any fresh raspberry syrup ( optional )
instructions: Lay out a few sheets of plastic wrap, lightly draping to prevent breaking the rolls up further.  Using a biscuit cutter or the very end of a large knife, cut out a circle from each pastry sheet.  Set aside.  Heat the oven to 400°f place the rolls on a sheet of parchment paper and bake for 10 minutes.  Remove from the oven, and cool for a moment before removing the paper.  Turn the rolls over, and place 2 or 3 small dallions of mint on one side.  Roll the pastry up around the mint and the dallions, and place a few sprigs of rice syrup on the top.  Return to the oven for 15 more minutes.  Remove to a plate.  To serve, arrange the pastries on a platter, and drizzle with a little honey or raspberry syrup.

title: Smoked Salmon With Cointreau Sauce
ingredients: 24 ounces salmon fillets | 2 tablespoons cointreau | 1/4 cup cointreau | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 teaspoon sugar
instructions: Remove skin from fish and wash.  Cut fillets into 8 slices.  Heat oil in a roasting pan set over medium high heat.  When oil is hot, place salmon into pan, brown on both sides and cook for 10 minute.  Place remaining ingredients in a blender, add fish and blend well.  Arrange fish on plate and surround with sauce.

Random Ingredients: new potato,lasagna noodle,garbanzo bean,egg white,chocolate hazelnut nutella,rosemary,gouda cheese
title: Gouda and Ghanna (Lidia's Classic Mardi Gras Style Lasagna)
ingredients: 1 jar whole garbanzo beans | 4 pounds new potatoes - peeled, thinly sliced | 1/3 cup chopped fresh rosemary | 6 egg whites | 4 packages lasagna noodles | 2 cups melted chocolate hazelnutella | 1 cup shredded gouda cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Cook and stir garbanzos in a large pot with 2 cups water and 3 chopped rosemary in the microwave on high, stirring frequently, until garbanzos are tender and liquid has been absorbed, about 10 minutes.  Cool to room temperature and mash with a potato masher.  Discard potato skins and rosemary.  Mix egg whites in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a whip attachment until foamy, about 5 minutes.  Beat in remaining 1/3 c of chopped rosemary to help thin the mixture.  Season with salt and pepper.  Arrange a layer of mashed garbanzo mixture and a drizzle of melted chocolate hazelnutella in the prepared baking dish.  Repeat layers, ending with melted hazelnutella.  Bake in preheated oven until cheese is browned and bubbling, about 45 to 55 minutes.  Cut into wedges and serve.

ingredients: toothpicks | 1 package firm tofu | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 package kielbasa sausage, casings removed | 1 package dry flat rice noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Place the tofu on a baking sheet.  Rub it with a small amount of olive oil.  Bake 20 to 30 minutes.  Turn the tofu over, and bake an additional 10 minutes.  Bake until browned.  Reserve the oil in cooking pan.  Place the kidney beans in a medium saucepan, and fill with water.  Bring to a boil.  Turn off the heat, and set aside for 5 minutes or so.  Meanwhile, place the kielbasa over medium heat in the reserved oil.  Cook until the sausage begins to brown.  Drain and tear into chunks.  Remove the bacon from heat, and set aside.  Bring another pan of water to a boil.  Break the rice noodles in half until only the package is broken apart. Arrange in a single layer on a baking sheet.  Bake 20 minutes in the preheated oven, then top with the sauteed kielbasa, and bake 5 minutes more.  Serve hot.

title: Banana & Oyster Surprise

instructions: Mix sweet chili sauce with the oysters.  Place all ingredients in a casserole dish sprayed with olive oil cooking spray, and toss over high heat until heated through.  Serve warm or chilled.

title: Garlicky Cranberry Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup cranberry juice | 1/3 cup pernod | 2 teaspoons dried pernod | 1 small bell pepper, chopped
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together 1 cup cranberry juice, pernod and 1 teaspoon dried Pernod.  Transfer to a 2 cup glass measuring cup.

Random Ingredients: allspice berry,green chile pepper,anchovy,almond,plain yogurt,spaghetti sauce,chicken breast
title: Yogurt Spaghetti
ingredients: 1/2 cup light brown sugar | 1 1/2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breasts, cut into 2 inch pieces | 4 anchovies, broken into pieces | 6 whole allspice berries, crushed | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 package spaghetti sauce | 10 blanched almonds, sliced
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, mix together the brown sugar, chicken, anchovies, allspice berries, and yogurt.  Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and heat to low. Cover, and refrigerate for 2 to 6 hours.  Remove chicken from refrigerator, and bake in the preheated oven 30 to 35 minutes, or until cooked through.

title: Tuna and Spinach Salad

instructions: Cut the tuna into 1 cubes.  Mix the tamari, sherry, and vinegar in a small bowl.  Add the tuna and stir until well incorporated.  If the dressing tastes too bitter, add a little sugar to balance it out a bit.  Add the mixed vegetables and baby spinach, toss, and serve.

title: Sticks for a Dead Fish
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked fresh fish, cut in 4 pieces | sliced green bell pepper | sliced yellow pepper | 1 slice honey-roasted hamburger bun, buttered | 8 slices rye bread | mayonnaise or horseradish, sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to broil or 550 degrees.  Arrange fish in a single layer on a broiling pan or rack. Place the bread on a baking sheet toasted with garlic butter and broil until bread is toasted but not burning, about 6 - 8 minutes.  Remove from oven and spread the toasted side with the mayonnaise or horseradish sauce.  Continue broiling until fish is done, about 3 - 5 minutes more.  To serve, place fish on individual toast slices.  Garnish with peppers and sliced ham.  Serve with a side of mayonnaise or horseradish sauce.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,ice cream,bread,lamb,salsa,dill,leek,wheat pastry flour
title: Moroccan Lamb Pie
ingredients: 1 whole wheat pastry flour | 6 ounces ground lamb | 1 leek, sliced | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 tablespoons fresh dill, chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh salsa | 4 ounces fresh bread, cut into cubes | ice cream ( optional ) or crushed ice cream ( optional )
instructions: Place the flour in a large mixing bowl, add the lamb mince and stir.  Season well with salt and pepper.  Place in the refrigerator for about 15 minutes or to your own preference in the fridge.  For the sauce.  Cook the leek in a pan with a splash of water on the medium heat until softened.  Sprinkle over the soy sauce and add the dried dill.  Stir over heat for a couple of minutes until everything is well mixed.  Place this mixture in a bowl then return to the fridge.  For the pie. title: Beef Chili Recipe
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies, undrained | 1 can red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mint leaves | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Heat and stir fry beef in a large saucepan over medium heat until browned.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,mango juice,wheat pita bread,icing sugar,tarragon leaf,maple syrup,farfalle pasta,trout
title: Sweet-And-Sour Smoked Trout With Farfalle Pasta
ingredients: 350 g smoked trout, in 2 cm slices | 1/3 cup maple syrup ( for the maple toast, see note ) | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 2 tablespoons mango juice ( or a blend of about 1/2 and 1/2 ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 8 8 whole wheat pita bread or 8 whole grain pita bread | 100 g dried farfalle pasta ( or other pastas ) | 1/4 cup fresh tarragon leaves, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 210c/450f/gas line an ovenproof dish with foil.  Arrange the smoked trout, cut side down, on the prepared dish. Drain and put aside.  When the farfalle has been cooking for 20 minutes, remove from the oven and drain thoroughly.  Meanwhile, toast the pita breads under a grill for 1 minute, or until slightly crisp.  Cut each in half.  Spoon the farfalle into a warm serving bowl and drizzle just enough of the maple syrup to coat.  Add the farfalle, tarragon, and the maple flavored marmalade sauce.  Toss together. Note, the smoked trout usually keeps for a few days at room temperature but if you can find it, you can use a good smoked smoked ham.

title: Eggs, Coleslaw and Beans - Crockpot

instructions: Mix all ingredients together and cook on high for 2 hours.

title: Shish Kabob

instructions: Place pears and potatoes in a bowl of cold water.  Let sit for 5 minutes.  Drain and pat dry.  Cut into 2 inch pieces.  Heat a small nonstick skillet over medium high heat. title: Easy Balsamic Onion Dressing

title: The Best Beef Stew Ever!

instructions: Combine beef and soup base in crockpot or roasting pan.  Cover and cook on low heat setting for up to 6 - 8 hours, or until meat is tender.  Stir in gin or romano cheese while warm.

title: Spicy Cherry BBQ Sauce
ingredients: 1 pint cherry | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1/2 teaspoon oregano or 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Pour ingredients into a jar with a tight fitting lid and shake away extra air bubbles.

title: Ginger and Oil Free Spiced Truffled Orange Peel
ingredients: 300 g dark sweet chili sauce, such as thai kitchen brand, about 3/4 cup | 1/2 cup treacle or 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 1 tablespoon ginger, fine chopped | 2 tablespoons tarragon vinegar | 2 tablespoons vodka ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons orange peel, finely shredded | 1 tablespoon ghee, melted
instructions: Combine first four ingredients and then transfer to a small bowl.  Stir in the alcohol and set aside.  Rinse oranges well with cold water and dry on paper towel.  Using a vegetable peeler or sharp knife, remove the orange peel by gently running a sharp knife or scissors through the peel with a thin bladed knife. When hot, stir, then pour over orange pieces and sprinkle with cheese.

title: Lemongrass Roasted Turnips

instructions: Prepare grill or broiler rack and brush grate with vegetable oil.  Place half of turnip slices on grill or broiler rack and cover with cover.  Let turnip cook approximately 5 minutes, turning, until lightly charred on bottom.  Turnip will shrink back into quarters.  Remove turnip to cool to room temperature.  Reserve turnip flesh broth and puree half of all the reserved juices separately.  Return mixture to pan with remaining ingredients.  Bring to boil over medium high heat, stirring often.  Reduce heat to simmer and add reserved turnip skin juices.  Simmer till the turnip is just done, approximately 20 minutes.  Serve warm.

title: Easy Curried Veggies

instructions: Place the frozen veggies in a dutch oven or other stew pot.  Sprinkle with the curry paste.  Add a little water, stir to combine and set aside. If making a larger quantity of veggies, mix the potatoes, adding a little water if needed.  Garnish with dill if using, serve hot or cold.  Enjoy.

title: Bread Machine Braid Rolls

Remove from pans and cool on wire racks.

instructions: Place potatoes into a small saucepan covered by water.  Cover and bring to a boil over high heat.  Reduce heat and simmer until tender enough to pierce with a fork, 20 to 25 minutes. In a medium saucepan over medium high heat, melt the beef bouillon cubes.  Stir in the tumeric.

title: Black Beans and Whole Grain

instructions: Soak beans in hot water overnight.  Drain, and rinse well.  Return the beans to the pot, add water to cover completely.  Bring to a boil, and simmer 1 hour, or until beans are tender.

instructions: Place the chickpeas in a large saucepan, add enough water to cover them by two inches.  Bring the water to a boil, add the green onion and cook till they are tender.  About 15 minutes. title: Chili-Parmesan Rice With Turnips

instructions: Over medium heat, warm the salsa, stirring it up and getting hot with each stirring.  If the salsa is thin, add a little water. title: Homemade Meat Stock

title: Fried Fruit

Transfer to serving bowl and garnish with the green chilie slices.

title: Thai Basil Rolls

instructions: Mix fish sauce and lettuce leaf to blend.  Spread 1 t.  Of mixture on each leaf, roll up tightly and serve.

instructions: Lay brisket in roasting pan.  Place fat side up on rack in roasting pan.  Cook 1 hour at drain any accumulated juices.

title: Apple and Smoked Salmon Chowder

title: Nam Prik Num (Fennel With Nam Pla)

When soup is done and mixture is warm, blend a hand blender or food processor with about half of the soup, or add as much of the remaining soup to give a chunky consistency to the soup.  Serve immediately.

title: Swiss Cheese Ball

instructions: Mix cheese with lard.  Puff up ball with finger and roll in salt.  Chill until serving.

title: Spanish Spiced Red Wine

instructions: Pour the bottle of wine into a medium heatproof bowl.  Heat oil in a saucepan over medium high heat.  When hot, add chili powder, and wait for a minute to sizzle.  Slowly pour the wine over the chili powder, and stir to combine.  The bottle of wine will release its own alcohol and keep it at a full boil.  Immediately remove the pan from the heat so the alcohol can be absorbed into the wine.

title: Blueberry- Herring Skewers and Baked Fish

instructions: Heat a grill to high.  Add 1/2 cup or more of water.  Place the aniseeds on the grill and toast, shaking the pan occasionally to crack them away from the hot surface.
