instructions: Line a platter with parchment paper, shiny side down, as this will help it double cheese sauce later.  Place french haricots vert and olives in alternate layers, alternating them on the parchment paper.  Sprinkle with raisins, cumin, and sesame oil.  Pour chacha's over the olives and raisins.  Chacha's will be in a paper cone shape.  To test, slice small with a paring knife, if it crackles, it is ready.  If it cracks immediately, it is ready.  It is best eaten right away.  Serve with a side of sour cream or mayo.

Random Ingredients: avocado,coffee,colby monterey jack cheese,mango chutney,white flour
title: Avocado Burritto
ingredients: 2 large avocados | 4 1/2 cups white flour, divided | 10 ounces colby-monterey jack cheese, grated ( about 2 cups ) | 1/4 cup mango chutney | 2 tablespoons coffee
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400°f.  Peel the avocado and cut each half into 8 slices.  In a bowl, mash the avocado with a fork.  In another bowl, mix 1/2 cup flour with 1/4 cup of grated cheese, mango chutney, and coffee until the mixture is moist.  Stir into the avocado mixture.  Divide the dough into 18 portions, shaping each into a round shape.  Press a circle of parchment paper and parchment onto the surface of each piece of dough.  Cover the dough with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours.  Line 2 large baking sheets with parchment paper.  Working on the parchment, roll out each round of dough into a cylinder about 1/8 inch thick.  Transfer the chilled dough to a work surface and roll each piece into a long cylinder shape with the long ends tucked over.  Transfer cylinder to the baking sheet.  Repeat with the remaining pieces of dough and refrigerate until ready to serve.  Cook's note,.  Each recipe makes about 6 burritto.  Cook's note,.  Spoon off excess fat from the surface of each burritto.  If you make another burritto, you need to use an extra 2 tbsp oil.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,bell pepper,cheddar cheese
title: Italian Cheddar Dip
ingredients: 1 package dry italian-style salad dressing mix | 1 package cheddar cheese | 1 bell pepper, diced
instructions: Combine all ingredients.  Cover and chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: part mozzarella cheese,beef bouillon cube,self rising flour,pimiento,beef,coriander leaf
title: Cheese and Pepper Rolls (No Meat Filling)
ingredients: 500 g finely minced beef | 1/3 cup low-fat sour cream or 1/3 cup lowfat yogurt | 1/3 cup coriander leaves | 250 g shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese ( i use a 50/50 blend ) | 1 beef bouillon cube ( optional ) | 4 teaspoons unbleached self-rising flour | 3 -6 thinly sliced pimientos
instructions: Place the minced beef in a microwave safe bowl.  Add the sour cream or yogurt, coriander and half the mozzarella and mix well or alternatively pulse it in a food processor.  Pour into a large bowl.  Dissolve the beef bouillon cube in the remaining 1/4 cup of milk or water.  Add the flour and beef broth to the milk and mix well. .  Stir in the flour until you have a soft dropping consistency.  You may need to add more liquid, but be careful because it may be extremely thick.  Wet hands and shape mixture into oval shaped rolls or a flat bread.  Place them on a microwave proof plate and cover with a damp paper towel.  Microwave on high for 10 minutes or until the mozzarella is melted, stirring every now and then.  Serve with pickled onion and red pepper halves, a spicy salad and refried beans.

Random Ingredients: catsup,lemon peel,cider vinegar,chicken meat,ricotta cheese,wonton wrapper
title: Baked Ricotta Won Tons
ingredients: 24 wonton wrappers | 1/4 cup catsup | 1 1/2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon lemon peel, grated | 1 package ricotta cheese | 2 lbs chicken meat, cooked and shredded
instructions: Combine catsup, vinegar, and peel.  Arrange won ton wrappers on a baking sheet.  Mix ricotta cheese with catsup mixture just until blended.  Spoon approximately ¾ cup filling in center of each won ton wrapper.  Moisten edges with water dipped.  Fold over and crimp edges with fingers.  Bake in a 375° f oven for 15 minutes.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,yellow cake mix,nonstick cooking spray,vegetable stock,white bean
title: Easy White Bean and Nachos
ingredients: 12 small mushrooms ( about 1lb, or any desired size ) | 1 package yellow cake mix ( i have been known to use 2 packages of regular pound cake mix ) | 15 ounces white beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 2 3/4 cups vegetable stock ( or half a cup of water ) | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Soak mushrooms in 1/4 cup of water or stock for 20 minutes to soften.  Meanwhile spray both sides of each mushroom with the cooking spray, then cut the caps in half and sprinkle with salt.  Preheat oven to 400°f.  Combine the bean, mushroom water and beef stock in a large mixing bowl, stirring to blend well.  Add the cake mix and mix well.  Spoon half of the bean mixture into a greased 9 inch square baking dish.  Sprinkle remaining bean mixture on top of bean mixture.  Spoon remaining bean mixture over bean mixture.  Sprinkle top with remaining bread mix.  Bake at 400°f for 25 to 30 minutes, or until cake is golden and top is crisp.

title: Torshi-Kraut
ingredients: 1/2 loaf pearl barley | 8 cups vegetable stock | 1 can sauerkraut | chopped hot peppers ( optional )
instructions: Soak the barley in a cloth cloth overnight.  It will swell from the soaking.  Put the stock with the water and salt to boil in a pan.  Add the barley and bring to the boil once it begins to boil again add sauerkraut, stir, then simmer uncovered for about 20 minute then serve.

title: Cashew Stuffed Pizza Crust
ingredients: 1 cup cashews | 1 packet frozen peas | 1 chili | 1/4 cup leftover meat or 1/4 cup shredded chicken | 2 canned pizza crust ( we used homemade ) | 2 cups marinara sauce
instructions: Mix, peanuts, chilli, meat or shredded chicken, and two tbsp of the marinara sauce.  Pinch out the centre of each pizza base and spoon filling into the centre.  Replace the top and leave to rise.  Brush tops with remaining sauce.  Bake at 190c for 25 - 30 mins until crust is golden brown and filling is cooked. .

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,coffee,double cream,rye bread,cheddar cheese,pinto bean,kalamata olive,pizza dough
title: Cheesy Apple Pizza With Roasted Garlic Cheese and Olive Crust
ingredients: 1 pizza dough | 300 g cheddar cheese, shredded | 100 g kefalotyri beans or 100 g pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 100 g red peppers or 100 g green peppers, finely chopped | 1 granny smith apple, peeled, cored and finely chopped | 10 kalamata olives, halved | 3 tablespoons coffee or 3 tablespoons water | 1 tablespoon double cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/400f/gas lightly butter a round 19 x 29cm baking dish.  Roll out dough to about 14mm thickness.  Cover with baking paper and a damp cloth towel, leaving a 3cm rim around the rim.  Arrange cheese, beans, red pepper, apple and olives on a work surface.  Cut pizza into quarters, leaving a 1cm border at the top.  Cover with cheese mix.  Roll out 2 portions of dough on a lightly floured surface.  Gently roll out extra dough, then cut into 12 triangles.  Press triangles down to seal and make 3 small pleats.  Place on the baking paper lined surface and brush with coffee or water.  Cover with baking paper and a damp cloth towel and bake 20 minutes or until dough is cooked and puffed.  Remove from oven, place on a wire rack and keep warm.  Warm cream in a small saucepan.  When warm, brush on pizza.  Sprinkle with garlic herb seasoning and serve straight away.

title: Thai Sweet Soup
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable stock | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 2 tablespoons shaoxing wine ( sweet rice wine )
instructions: Bring vegetable stock and tumeric to boil in a saucepan.  Slowly add shrimp and simmer 5 minutes.  Strain stock through a fine sieve, discarding solids.  Transfer stock with shrimp to a saucepan and heat.  Add sherry.

title: Vanilla Bean Ice Cream (Lighter Than Vanilla!)
ingredients: 1/2 cup sweetened condensed milk ( kikkoman sweetened condensed milk can also be used ) | 4 1/2 tablespoons vanilla beans, split lengthwise
instructions: Blend condensed milk, split vanilla, and vanilla bean with an immersion blender until thick and creamy.

title: Apple Kulfi (Sweetened Apples With Cherries)
ingredients: 6 firm tart cherries ( or 6 pears ) | 2 medium apples, like granny smith, pith, and rind, about 1 quart peeled, cored and cut into 1/4 inch slices ( about 4 pounds total ) | 2 green cardamom pods, cracked | 1/2 cup dried maraschino cherries, or 1/2 cup dried red cherries, of your choice
instructions: Combine cherries, apples, cardom pods, and the 1/2 cup dried cherries in a bowl.  Using your hands or your hands, rub the fruit with the spice mixture.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or up to half a day.  Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f.  Transfer the kulfi to a rimmed, shallow baking pan and coat the surface evenly with some of the remaining dried cherries.  Bake the kulfi in the preheated oven until almost dry, 50 to 60 minutes.  Remove from the oven and serve immediately from the pan.  Store, covered, at room temperature.

title: Pistachio-Cheese Sosaties
ingredients: 8 bamboo skewers | 2 cups chopped pistachios | 2 tablespoons sifted grated gruyere cheese | 1 dash worcestershire sauce | 1 dash mustard seeds | 1 dash ground almond
instructions: Place nuts in a food processor with the grated cheese and worcestershire sauce and pulse until coarsely ground.  Season with salt and pepper, then add mustard seeds.  Form into a small patty, using a drizzle of oil and spread on a cold, dry skillet over medium heat.  Cook until lightly browned, pressing down on the patty if the patty becomes too dry, then flip.  Cook for 2 more minutes on the second side, then move the patty to a warm plate.  Remove bread from the oven, then allow to sit 15 minutes to cool to room temp before cutting into 8 wedges.  Serve at room temperature.

title: Faux Tuna Salad
ingredients: 3 -4 cups packed lettuce | 2 -4 small cucumbers | 1/2 jar diced pimientos, drained, may be drained again if desired
instructions: Place lettuce in a serving bowl.  Dice cucumbers, add to bowl.  Add pimentos and mix well.  Add tuna, toss and refrigerate until ready to serve.  Note, prep time does not reflect chill time.

Random Ingredients: lemongrass,monterey jack cheddar cheese,ginger garlic paste,red chilies,mandarin orange,plum tomato,red pepper
title: Mongolian Grilled Cheese (Gourmet)
ingredients: 2 red chilies, chopped | 1 tablespoon lemongrass, chopped | 6 plums, halved lengthwise and chopped | 2 mandarin oranges, chopped | 1 red pepper, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 cup monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend, shredded
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine the chilies, lemon grass, plums, oranges, red pepper, ginger garlic paste and the monterey jack and cheddar until well mixed.  Cover and blend or process to desired smoothness.  Transfer the mixture to a shallow dish.  Cover and chill for 1 hour before serving.  Serve and enjoy.

title: Classic Vietnamese Style Herb Crusted Fish- Wings
ingredients: 1 cup flat leaf parsley, lightly packed and very finely chopped ( may use cilantro ) | 1 1 lb firm white fish fillet ( such fish such as halibut, cod, sole, catfish, or sole )
instructions: Combine parsley and chopped fish.  Coat fish with herb mixture.  Sprinkle lightly with pepper.  Cover and refrigerate at least 6 hours, but no longer than 8 hours.  Drain well before continuing.

title: Apple Oaty
ingredients: 3 cups old fashioned oats ( not quick cooking ) | 2 cups apples, peeled, cored and chopped ( i prefer granny smith )
instructions: Place chopped apples in large bowl and stir in oaty and 1/2 cup water.

title: Fondue Withcamembert or Camembert Cheese
ingredients: 500 g camembert cheese or 500 g romano cheese | 1 teaspoon coarse grain mustard
instructions: In a medium pan over a low heat, slowly melt the cheese.  Keep stirring with a wooden spoon until completely smooth and creamy.  While continuing to stir, gradually add mustard and mix well.  Continue simmering on high heat for 2 minutes to allow cheese to slightly bubble.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,hot chili pepper,lobster meat,creme fraiche,raisin,linguine,taco seasoning mix,sage
title: Fried Lobster and Crab
ingredients: 2 tablespoons creme fraiche ( light mayo can be used ) | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh sage | 1/2 teaspoon dried hot chili pepper | 2 ounces taco seasoning mix ( i use `` wild ground '' brand ) | 12 ounces linguine | 1 lb crab meat or 1 lb lobster meat, sliced ( about 2 to 3 per person ) | 1 cup craisins
instructions: Mix creme fraiche, soya sauce, chili, salt and oregano.  In large frying pan, begin to add a teaspoon of oil to coat the bottom.  After 2 minutes, place shrimp in the oil.  Add crab in a single layer in the frying pan.  Cook until the crab is just pink throughout.  Do not overcrowd pan.  Serve hot.  When crab is pink, add craisins and mix.  Serve warm with linguine.

title: Hot Ginger Lime Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup fresh gingerroot, finely grated | 4 large egg yolks | 3 tablespoons canned jalapeno peppers, finely chopped | lime wedge
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk egg yolks with ginger, jalapenos and lime juice until well blended.  Spoon mixture into sterilized jars and cover with a cloth.  Process in a boiling water canner for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: nonstick cooking spray,dill weed,red cabbage,lime,chicken breast,asafoetida powder,zucchini
title: Asafetida Chicken and Vegetables
ingredients:
1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( or 1/4 tsp.
    - chili powder ) | 1 green zucchini or 1 red bell pepper, seeded and cut diagonally into strips | 1 small red cabbage, shredded | 4 tablespoons nonstick cooking spray | 1 1/2 cups uncooked boneless skinless chicken breasts, cubed | 1 tablespoon dried dill weed ( optional ) | 1 medium zucchini, sliced diagonally | 1/4 cup fresh lime, cut into wedges
instructions: In small bowl, stir asafetida with 1/4 cup water.  Set aside.  Combine green, bell pepper, cabbage and 1 t.  Reserved asafoetida mixture.  Spray medium nonstick skillet with 1 t.  Lime juice and heat over medium high heat.  Add chicken and 1 t.  Lime.

title: Raspberry and Coconut Sorbet
ingredients: 8 ounces raspberries, hulled | 1 1/2 cups coconut, shredded
instructions: Place raspberries and coconut in blender and blend until very smooth.  Transfer to bowl and freeze until firm.  Transfer to ice cream maker and freeze according to manufacturer's instructions.  Once firm, scoop out and place on rimmed baking sheet.  Freeze until set.

title: Quick Mocktail
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 1 tablespoon lemon extract | 1 tablespoon lemon pepper seasoning
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and spread into a 10 cup glass.  Refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: date,whipping cream,fenugreek seed,olive,spaghetti,italian parsley,rice wine,oyster sauce
title: Sweet and Sour Spaghetti (Gluten Free, Vegetarian)
ingredients: 300 g sweet noodles ( spaghetti, linguine ) | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds or 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 125 g pitted dates | 200 ml light whipping cream | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | italian parsley or fresh chives, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: Boil water in a large pan.  Meanwhile, heat a frying pan over medium temperature and add the olive oil.  When it is beginning to shimmer on the bottom, add the fenugreek or fennel seeds.  Add the fenugreek until soft, approximately a minute.  Add the dates and stir for 3 minutes, then add the cream and cook until the cream begins to thicken.  Reduce the heat to low, cover with a lid or foil, and wait 20 minutes.  Meanwhile, in a large pot of salted boiling water add the uncooked spaghetti.  Cook, stirring, until tender, about 8 minutes.  To serve, drain pasta, reserving a little of the cooking water.  Add spaghetti to sauce and mix well.  Taste and add salt if it has required.  Garnish with fresh herbs, if using.

title: Tropical Chickpea Flour Bread
ingredients: 1 kg chickpea flour | 500 g firm white bread, crusts trimmed | 200 g leeks | 1 head lettuce leaf | 1/3 cup light muscovado sugar ( or brown sugar )
instructions: Combine the flour and seasonings in a large bowl.  Cut in the leeks until the leeks are coated with flour.  Stir in half the loaf of bread and knead into a rough dough, adding more bread if necessary.  Cover and leave to rest in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes.  Heat a griddle or griddle pan over medium high heat.  Form the dough into a flat disc, about 6cm in diameter.  Turn over and put the other half of the dough into the griddle for 1 - 2 minutes until lightly browned.  Spread with half the muscovado and top with the leeks.  Return to low heat.  Cover and cook for 2 - 3 minutes to bubble the top.  Remove from heat and slice into 8 slices each.  Serve on a plate with the remaining bread.

Random Ingredients: steak,french baguette,cream chicken soup,flat leaf parsley,iceberg lettuce
title: French Burger Melt
ingredients: 1 french baguette | 3 cups iceberg lettuce, thinly sliced | 3 cups steak | french soup or cream of chicken soup, warmed | flat leaf parsley ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f.  Cut out the bread from the baguette into long, flat slices about 3/4 inch wide and 1 1/2 inches long.  Arrange on a baking sheet, lightly buttered side down.  Cover with plastic wrap and place in the oven for 5 - 10 minutes or until lightly toasted.  Remove from the oven and allow to cool.  Meanwhile, remove the crusts from the french baguette slices, and then cut the bread into 1/4 inch slices, about 1 1/2 inches long, cutting around the edges if needed.  Brush each slice of bread with warm soup or cream of chicken soup.  Place a lettuce slice on a slice of bread and arrange a generous helping of steak on top of the lettuce.  Garnish with parsley if desired.  Serve at once.

title: Key Lime Syrup
ingredients: 1 cup key lime | 1 teaspoon powdered syrup ( to taste )
instructions: Pour lime juice into clean glass jar filled with ice cubes.  Add key lime and powdered syrup, then top with sugar.  Refrigerate for up to 24 hours.

title: Alfredo
ingredients: 1 package frozen spinach, thawed and drained | 1 pound lean ground beef
instructions: In a large stock pot over medium heat, saute spinach with ground beef until meat is no longer pink.  Drain off any excess liquid and stir in cooked spinach.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,sazon goya,chipotle pepper,mini marshmallow,ricotta cheese,salami,tea
title: Mushroom Smoked Cheese With Chipotle and Turkey Salami and Roasted Apples
ingredients: 1 cup mini marshmallows | 1/4 teaspoon sazon goya | 4 mini tart apples | 8 ounces smoked turkey salami, thinly sliced | 1/4 lb mini marshmallows | 2 ounces salami, chopped | 1/2 cup ricotta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f line a baking sheet with foil and spray with nonstick cooking spray.  In a small bowl, combine marshmallows, sazon and apple.  Place apples on prepared baking sheet.

title: Alu Baildi(Tunisian Eggplant Spread)
ingredients: 2 lbs sliced eggplant | 1 cup chopped onion | 1 cup chopped cucumber | 2 tablespoons ghee or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Mix the chopped vegetables and spices together in a saucepan and cover.  Add oil and stir fry until the vegetables are coated in oil.  Cook over medium heat until vegetables are tender.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Caramelized Oranges
ingredients: 12 yellow or orange ripe oranges | 16 dry white wine bottles | 12 orange wedges
instructions: Gently peel oranges using a sharp knife or fine grater, removing any large pulp with grater or the peel.  Cut off the hard rinds using a paring knife.  Cut the peel into thin slices 1/4 deep.  Arrange oranges on a platter or platter with the slices cut side up.  Add the wine bottles to the oranges, then arrange oranges on top of oranges.  If you feel a need to refrigerate them over night, let them settle in the marinating dish, then store them in refrigerator.  They may last for up to 2 years.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,creamy peanut butter,blue cheese,cumin,caper,celery rib
title: Buffalo Bleu Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 celery rib, chopped | 1 garlic clove, crushed | 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter | 2 tablespoons capers, drained | 2 teaspoons cumin | 1/4 lb blue cheese, crumbled
instructions: Microwave celery, garlic and peanut butter in bowl on high for 1 minute or until smooth.  Stir in remaining ingredients until combined.  Serve with chicken, turkey or shrimp, and fresh vegetables.

Random Ingredients: mushroom cap,grain rice,lasagna noodle,lime juice,french bread
title: Lime and Mushroom Rollups
ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles | 7 1/2 ounces mushroom caps | 1/4 cup lime juice | 2 tablespoons long grain rice | 2 tablespoons shredded french bread
instructions: Cook noodles until al dente.  Rinse lightly, drain and set aside.  Cut off the tops of the mushrooms and cut each cap into three pieces.  Place a teaspoon or so of noodles in the centre of each sheet of cheesecloth.  Divide each mushroom, along with the lime juice all over.  Fold the cheesecloth up around the mushroom caps to encase the juice.  Twist the ends of the cheesecloth, and set each end, seam side down, in a deep dish.  Cover.  In a small bowl, combine the rice and bread crumbs, sprinkle evenly over the mushrooms.  Sprinkle with the bread crumbs.  Let sit for 5 minutes to absorb the juice of the mushroom caps.

title: Aubergine
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant | 1 tablespoon hot sauce | 1 teaspoon orange zest | 1 unbaked deep dish pie shell
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Peel eggplant and cut into 2 inch cubes.  Place in a casserole dish.  Cover with hot sauce and orange zest, then place in oven.  Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes.  Uncover, and bake for an additional 45 minutes.  Serve with french fries.

title: Lime-Lime Beef
ingredients: 800 g sirloin | 1 lime, juice of | 150 g icing sugar
instructions: Trim the meat and make it very thin.  Slice the meat thinly and rub with lime juice and icing sugar to taste.  Cook in a hot oven for about 25 min then cook until beef is tender.  Serve with fresh coriander.

title: Ricotta and Lettuce Biscuits
ingredients: 2 cups drained ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 3 -4 slices shredded lettuce | 2 tablespoons shortening or 2 tablespoons butter, cut into small cubes
instructions: Place ricotta in a bowl.  Add baking soda.  Add enough water to combine.  Add cheese and mix together.  Add more water to make a thick but rather firm dough.  Form into 4 even sized biscuits.  Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Drain the biscuits and press the dough into a 10 inch round tin.  Bake on a cookie sheet with the oven rack about 12 minutes.  Remove biscuits from oven.  Carefully remove the biscuit from the tin.  Put a dollop of yoghurt or vanilla yogurt on top.  Return biscuits to the oven, bake 10 to 15 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: chicken,taco seasoning,buttermilk,tart apple,lime wedge,cocoa,peanut oil,rice wine
title: Apple Mexi Chicken
ingredients: 12 ounces whole chickens, cut into 8 pieces | 1 1/2 ounces taco seasoning ( or substitute equivalent ) or 1 1/2 ounces other seasoning | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 16 fluid ounces buttermilk | 1/3 cup dry rice wine | crushed tomatoes ( optional ) or diced fresh tomato ( optional ) | 1 large tart apple, such as fuji, peeled, cored and cut into 1/4-inch slices ( optional ) | coarse cocoa ( optional ) or mexican blend cheese ( optional ) | lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Season chicken with taco seasoning.  Brush with oil or margarine.  Heat oil in a 4 - 5 qt.  Casserole over medium heat.  Add chicken.

Random Ingredients: hoisin sauce,dark beer,tahini,mango chutney,parsley leaf,jicama,yellow onion
title: Prawns (Shrimp) with Jamaican Sambal Honey
ingredients: 4 -5 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 1/4 cup chopped parsley leaves | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 1/2 cups diced yellow onions | 1 1/2 cups diced jicama | 1/2 cup hoisin sauce | 1 1/2 cups dark beer
instructions: Whisk together all ingredients and set aside.  Heat 1 - 2 tbsp olive oil in frying pan and add the shrimp and marinate.

Random Ingredients: rose water,maple syrup,golden brown sugar,hot italian sausage,self raising flour
title: Sweet Italian Sausages & Maple Syrup Cake
ingredients: 4 links hot italian sausage | 2 cups pure maple syrup | 2 cups maple syrup ( for glaze ) | 1 teaspoon rose water | 1 1/2 cups self-raising flour | 1 tablespoon golden brown sugar
instructions: Place everything in a pan and stir until well mixed and well blended.  Place the wholemeal flour in a bowl and mix well.  Grease a 6 cup sandwich tin and line the base and sides with a circle of waxed paper.  Preheat oven to 150 degrees celsius.  Place the hot italian sausage links in the tin holding the casings under the sausage and roll each sausage into a log.  Bake in the oven for 1 1/2 hours test for doneness, if necessary insert a skewer through a thick skewer if it comes out clean and cooked through drain excess grease.  While still warm, gently brush the baked sausages with the maple syrup.  Remove the bread from the oven, leave it to cool and slice on thick slices with scissors, arrange the slices on serving platters and pour the maple mixture over them.

title: Gratineed English Sirloin
ingredients: 2 1/2 ounces currants ( dried cranberries ) | 5 tablespoons dried mixed fruit | 2 1/2 teaspoons baking powder, with baking powder | 6 lbs beef chuck | 4 -5 lbs beef brisket | 12 skewers
instructions: Soak the currants in warm water for 15 minutes.  Combine the mixed fruit, baking powder and the 2 1/2 lbs of beef in a plastic bag, add about 3 tbsp of the beef cooking liquid to the bag and toss until well coated and the meat is evenly covered.  Refrigerate overnight to marinate the meat.  Preheat the grill and place oak skewers on the rack.  Thread meat onto skewers.  Grill the meat until it is well browned and the outside is crisp.  If the meat gets any crusty on the outside it is done.  If you like the sauce a little bit thinner it may be done as before.  This does not keep well refrigerated for 2 days.

Random Ingredients: summer squash,chocolate,thai red curry paste,rosemary leaf
title: Chilli Squash With Thai Red Curry
ingredients: 1 1/2 inches cubes semi-sweet chocolate | 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh rosemary leaves ( optional ) | 1 lb summer squash, washed, ends trimmed and cut into 1/4-inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Combine chocolate, curry paste and 3 tablespoons rosemary in medium size bowl and stir until well mixed.  Spray 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish with cooking cooking spray.  Add half of the squash and 1/2 teaspoon salt to bowl and stir to coat squash completely with curry paste and sugar.  Spread 1/2 of chocolate mixture evenly over squash and sprinkle with remaining squash.  Make indentation in top of squash with sharp knife.  Repeat with remaining squash and sprinkle with remaining chocolate mixture.  Bake until heated through and beginning to brown, about 20 minutes.  Let stand 10 minute, remove and discard rosemary sprigs.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,lemon wedge,vegetable,yellow squash,phyllo pastry,green pepper,lasagna
title: Thai Vegetables
ingredients: 8 whole green peppers ( or red ) | 4 medium yam | 12 sheets fresh lasagna sheets | 1 lb frozen vegetables or 1 lb fresh veggie | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 lb frozen phyllo pastry or ( 9 inch ) package frozen phyllo pastry
instructions: Slice peppers and yam in strips lengthwise and set aside.  Cook phyllo sheets for 8 minutes and cut in half lengthwise.  Lay phyllo sheets out crosswise on a cutting board, brush 2 strips with olive oil and stack on paper towel.  Cut yams and zucchini on the diagonal into 1/4 strips.  Chop broccoli, cauliflower, and celery on the diagonal.  Heat a nonstick skillet over high heat.  Add peppers, scallions, oyster sauce, and vegetables.  Cook until vegetables are just beginning to brown.  Brush a large, shallow casserole dish with olive oil and lay 8 phyllo strips in it, brushing each with olive oil.  Lay another 8 phyllo sheets over them and brush generously with oil.  Place 2 tablespoons or less of veggies in a layer over phyllo sheets, then top with 2 more tablespoons of vegetables and 2 more phyllo sheets, brushing each sheet with olive oil.  Top with 1 more layered phyllo sheet, brushing with olive oil.  Repeat layering, ending with 3 phyllo sheets, brushing each with olive oil.  Place remaining vegetables on top of phyllo in circular rows, making sure that all 3 are facing the same direction.  Place a sheet of phyllo over all, cut a slit in top.  Repeat with remaining 2 phyllo, cut a slit in the top, and finally cut up the pieces.  Pour remaining oil around the vegetables.  Let sit 45 minutes to an hour.  Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Bake until golden brown approximately 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,tomato ketchup,star anise,green bell pepper
title: Aromatic Chili and Green Peppers
ingredients: 8 -10 large green bell peppers, washed, seeded and cut into strips | 1 can tomato ketchup | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 2 star anise
instructions: Heat the oil in a large heavy based saucepan.  When it is heated, add in the star anise and fry till dark brown, 1 - 2 minutes.  Immediately add the bell pepper strips and fry for a few minutes until they turn crisp and aromatic.  Stir in the ketchup and fry for 3 - 4 minutes.  Serve hot with steamed rice.

title:
Spanish Brat and Tomatoes, Empanizios En Salsa.
    -.
    -.
    -and Potatoes Too!
ingredients: 1 frozen puff pastry ( defrosted according to package directions ) | 6 -10 fresh bratwursts, sliced into very thin slices ( i prefer johnsonville ) | 1 can stewed tomatoes with green chiles
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Remove and lightly oil a 9 pie pan or souffle dish.  Put the defrosted frozen puff pastry onto a clean dry surface.  Sprinkle the bratwurst slices evenly over the pastry.  Then spread the stewed tomatoes on top of the brats.  Put in the microwave for approximately 10 minutes, allowing them to spread evenly.  Cook for an additional 9 - 10 minutes.  You can even transfer the contents to a large bowl and gently fold the contents over using a spoon to get all the juices out.  Spread the entire contents on the puff pastry.  Bake for 30 - 40 minutes, or until the pastry is crisp and the top is golden brown.  Let sit for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Moroccan White Bean Ice Cream
ingredients: 400 g cannellini beans ( small red ones ) | 350 ml double cream | 1 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ginger, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon mixed spice
instructions: Scrain cannelini beans and soak in water overnight, then transfer beans to a saucepan and add cream simmer for 5 minutes or until it begins to thicken slightly.  Add 1/2 tsp of mixed spice to hot cream and stir to combine, then transfer cream to a bowl and stir in 1/4 tsp of mixed spice cover bowl and return liquid mixture to pan stirring to combine and cook for 10 minutes, without stirring, until mixture coats a spoon.  Transfer cream to an ice cream maker and follow manufacturer's instructions.  Transfer cream to a plate and chill 4 hours or overnight in the freezer, until set.

title: Sopa Pino - Sweet Onion, Chipotle and Ginger Stuffed Buns
ingredients: 200 g ladyfingers | 6 cups of coarsely chopped white bread | 250 ml hot stock ( i used a good brand ) | 3 chipotle peppers | fresh ginger ( optional )
instructions: Take the ladyfingers out of the fridge for at least 15 - 20 minutes prior to filling.  They are easiest and will not stick to your fingers.  Put all ingredients into a saucepan except pepper and ginger over a medium heat, mix together and simmer for 10 - 15 minutes.  Remove ginger from heat and stir in pepper.  Fill each square with a tablespoon of meat mixture, then a few of the egg whites.  Put under a grill, broiler or light a fan/convection grill.  Serve immediately.

title: Tasty Mexican Quinoa - Vegan or Enriched
ingredients: 2 cups rice ( long grain or jasmine ) | 2 -3 cups chicken bouillon | 1 lb ground lean pork
instructions: The day before, brown ground meat.  When ground meat is done, add 1 cup of rice or cooked quinoa to the meat and allow to cool. .  You could also use quinoa, chickpeas or other grains to add at the beep to keep moisture from getting low.  The meat will get cooked, but it won't be hard.  When meat and rice are cool enough to handle, mix them in a blender or food processor.  Continue to process until the rice has been completely mixed in.  Add the 2 - 3 cups of chicken base, and process on low on high about 30 seconds or so, just so it all starts to mix.  Put the mixture into a bowl, and allow to chill overnight in the refrigerator.  You don't have to refrigerate this mixture, it can be eaten right away.

title: Wild Rice, and Peanuts
ingredients: 1 cup wild rice, rinse and drained | 1 cup fresh ground mixed herbs ( parsley, thyme, sage and oregano ) | 2 cups chopped walla walla onions or 2 cups other onion | 1/4 cup chopped unsalted dry roasted peanuts | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 pinch cayenne
instructions: Cook wild rice according to package directions, drain and set aside.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Combine the wild rice, mixed herbs, onion, peanuts, salt and cayenne.

title: Sesame-Seed Marinated Shrimps
ingredients: 3 -4 ripe plantains, peeled and cut in strips | 3 -4 cauliflower florets, cut into strips | 1 1/2 lbs minced meat | 1 jar roasted sesame seeds | 1/3 cup toasted sesame seeds | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan.  Stir to combine.  Cover and place over medium high heat until heated through.

title: Gujarati Magic

instructions: Put the mango, parsley and sesame oil into a blender.  Add the carrots and pulse a few times.  Season with the salt and serve with plenty of icing sugar.  Serve cold or at room temperature with plain white breads or crackers.

title: Chicken Tofu Skillet

instructions: In a pot over high heat, combine the chicken bouillon and onion.  Toss in the carrots, and bring to a boil.  Lower heat, and simmer uncovered for 10 to 15 minutes.  In a separate skillet over medium high heat, place 3 ounces of the tofu in the liquid and mash it into the liquid until well blended.  Stir in the tofu mixture.  Cook and stir until the bottom has turned into a dark, golden brown, about 5 minutes.

title: Char Siu Cakes

instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.  Chill for one hour.  Form mixture into six patties about 1/2 inch thick and freeze until firm and cold, about 3 hours in freezer, turning once.  Keep frozen patties covered in freezer until ready to use.  Makes about 24 patties.

title: Spicy Dill and Squash
ingredients: 1 yellow squash | 3 -5 sprigs fresh dill
instructions: Cut off the yellow squash's stalk, and scrape the peel with a spoon to remove any white or yellow particles.  Cut the squash in half lengthwise, and use two or three sprigs to spear the sprouts.  Heat a wok over medium heat.  Add a little vegetable oil and swirl lightly to coat the surface.  Add a pinch of salt.

title: Giada De Laurentiis' Chocolate Olive Medley
ingredients: 12 ounces bar chocolate ( high quality, if possible ) or 12 ounces semisweet chocolate, melted | 12 kalamata olives, pitted and coarsely chopped
instructions: Place half the chocolate in a heatproof bowl.  Sprinkle with half the olives, and half the other chocolate.  Repeat with remaining olives, sprinkling evenly.  Cover and refrigerate until chocolate is firm and mixture is creamy, about 7 hours.

title: The Best Cilantro Relish (Kitchen Kouture)
ingredients: 1 bunch cilantro stems, stems coarsely chopped ( leaves only ) | seasoning salt, to taste

title: Italian Style Beef Roll-Ups
ingredients: 4 ounces prosciutto di parma, sliced thin | 3 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 package fresh ricotta cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons fajita seasoning mix | 1/3 cup low sodium beef broth | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a heavy medium skillet over medium heat. title: Steamed Fennel

instructions: Put the spaghetti sauce in a microwave dish.  Cover with waxed paper and microwave for 45 to 60 seconds.  Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 375 degrees f.  Mix about 1/4 cup of corn oil with about a teaspoon of cold water in a measuring cup.  Use to pour the spaghetti sauce into a gravy boat or on a tray to serve with the spaghetti.

title: Aparagus, Red Capsicum and Banana Salad Withicing Sugar
ingredients: 1 large red shallot, thinly sliced | 4 medium asparagus, ends tipped, sliced lengthwise | 1 banana, sliced into 12 wedges | 3 tablespoons icing sugar, for dusting
instructions: Preheat the grill to high.  Grease a shallow ovenproof 2 quart casserols or baking dish with olive oil.  Add the shallot and cook over medium heat until softened, about 5 minutes.  Add the asparagus and cook until lightly caramelised on both sides.  Transfer to a bowl and toss with the banana, then season.  Transfer to an ovenproof serving dish and sprinkle with icing sugar.  Cook under the grill until golden brown, about 3 minutes.  Allow to cool for about 10 minutes before releasing from the oven.  Cut into 8 slices.

title: Hot Mexican Ziti
ingredients: 8 ounces ziti pasta | 16 ounces campbell's tomato soup | 1 -2 canned chili pepper | 4 -8 ounces cilantro | 8 -10 ice cubes
instructions: Cook ziti in rapidly boiling water until it is al dente.  Drain and set aside to cool.  Combine soup, peppers and cilantro in a medium bowl with half of the cold water.  Add ziti and cool.  Pour soup mixture into a casserole dish and add 2 - 3 ice cubes.  Cover and refrigerate the next day for flavors to combine.

title: Caper Lime Soup

title: Cauliflower Fritters
ingredients: 1 russet potato, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 3 medium sweet mixed fruit, such as applesauce or 3 medium peaches, peeled, halved cored, cut crosswise in half | 1 small cauliflower, cut into florets | sherry, to taste | 1 medium onion salt, to taste | 6 tablespoons dry italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup torn italian breadcrumbs
instructions: Place potato, fruit and cauliflower in large pot, add enough cold water to cover.  Bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer until tender but firm, about 15 to 20 minutes.  Drain and let cool slightly.  Meanwhile, preheat saute pan over medium heat until hot.  Add onion salt, 1/2 cup bread crumbs and 1 teaspoon cinnamon.  Stir until bread crumbs look toasted, 1 to 2 minutes.  Drain potatoes, toss with bread crumb mixture and mix well.  Roll in crumbs and refrigerate until ready to serve, 8 - 10 minutes. title: Chocolate Buns
ingredients: 24 wonton wrappers | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 12 ounces semisweet chocolate, chopped
instructions: Line the won ton wrappers with parchment paper.  Melt the chocolate in a bowl over barely simmering water.  Pour warm chocolate into a sieve over a bowl and tilt the chocolate and vinegar through the bowl.  Using a pastry brush, brush off any chocolate residue left from the chocolate.  Working with one won ton wrapper at a time, coat a work surface with oil and place a tablespoon of the chocolate mixture into the center of the won ton wrapper.  Moisten the edges with water to seal.  Place the buns on a baking sheet and let stand in a cool place 10 minutes.  Invert each square over its waxed paper in a metal basket and peel off the paper.  Repeat with the remaining wrappers.  Melt the chocolate and vinegar in a saucepan over low heat.  When the mixture is almost melted, transfer it to a pastry bag fitted with a 1 star tip.  Hold the tip of the bag up to the tip of your finger and, using your thumb, make finger marks all over the chocolate.  Let cool for 20 minutes.  Remove the chocolate from the parchment paper bag.  When cool, slice into 1/2 inch squares or triangles.  Makes 8 buns.

title: Wasabi Snow Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon wasabi | 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar | 1 1/4 lbs snow peas
instructions: Mix in a bowl, add wasabi paste and stir.  Serve on the side of salad.

title: Spicy Scallop, Quinoa and Cauliflower Enchilada Rice
ingredients: 1 package quinoa, soaked for an hour under water | 1 can red enchilada sauce ( i like hatch brand ) | 1 bay scallop ( canned or frozen ) | 2 cups cauliflower florets | 2 cups water-packed short-grain white rice | 1/3 cup diced apple ( i prefer golden delicious sliced and i use cortland organic )
instructions: In a big saucepan, add 1/2 cup of water and add your rice.  Bring to low boil.  Once it starts to boil, cover and turn down to medium low or low heat and let cook for 20 - 25 minutes.  Once the rice is finished cooking, remove it from the burner and drain excess water and set aside.  Rinse and pat dry the scallops, cutting them in half if they are larger.  In a medium saute pan, add enchilada sauce and saute the scallops about 2 minutes until they just start to turn opaque.  Add in your cauliflower, cover and cook for 2 more minutes.  Add back your quinoa and mix everything.  Cover and simmer on medium heat while the water is coming to boil.  When the water comes to boil, add in your rice and reduce the heat to low or medium low.  Allow the rice to cook another 10 - 15 minutes or until the water is absorbed and the rice has fully cooked but is still somewhat fluffier.  Garnish with diced apple.  I like to add a little more red sauce and/or chopped cilantro.  Serve with sour cream or guacamole if desired.

Pour beef mixture evenly over the top.  Cover.  Cook on high pressure for 10 minutes at medium pressure.  Turn.  Cook on low for 4 hours.

title: Indian Spiced Rigatoni With Fajita Dipping Sauce

instructions: In a large pot bring 3 cups water to a boil.  Meanwhile in a small bowl, dissolve the yeast in the warm water.  Let stand a minute or two.  Add the yeast/water mixture into the pot containing the broth and 1 tsp of the fajita seasoning mix.  Let set, stirring once or twice.  Add 1 teaspoon of the cinnamon, the masala, and 1/2 tsp of the mace.  Return to a boil and stir in the rigatoni.  Turn down the heat to low and cover the pot.  Let cook 25 - 25 minutes, until the rigatoni is tender and the sauce is nice and thickened.  Remove from heat and stir in the remaining mace and cinnamon.

title: Scented Mushrooms

instructions: Blend all ingredients in a blender or food processor.  The mixture should remain smooth.  Heat a non stick pan over medium low heat.  Coat the bottom of the pan with oil to prevent the mushrooms from sticking.  Remove from heat.  Place half of the mushrooms in the pan.  Spread the remaining mushrooms over the mushrooms.  Sprinkle with salt.  Cover.  Cook on high heat, stirring continuously, for 3 minutes.  Reduce heat to low or medium low.  Cook until the mushrooms are tender.

title: Cheesy Sticks

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375ºf.  Insert the cheese slices into a piece of parchment paper or waxed paper lined baking sheet.  Stick the anise seeds all around the cheese and spread evenly.  Bake for 10 to 15 minutes.  Let cool to room temperature.

title: Creamy Cuban Rice Bread
ingredients: 6 cups white basmati rice or 6 cups brown rice, uncooked | 1 tablespoon dry yeast | 2 teaspoons garlic salt ( to taste ) | 1 pint plum tomato, canned drained ( discard the juice ) | 1/2 cup dry lentils, rinsed and picked over | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro stem ( optional ) | 2 large ripe bananas, 1/4 inch thick slices ( optional )
instructions: Soak the rice overnight in enough cold water so that it is not quite wet.  Drain well.  In a large mixing bowl, mix the rice, yeast, and garlic salt. Allow to sit at room temperature for about 1 hour or longer.  Stir to mix.  Grease a loaf pan.  Add some of the bread mixture to the loaf pan and spread around.  Add more rice, or as much as you think is needed to cover the entire top of the loaf pan.  The dough will be moist and you should not need to sprinkle extra.  Place in a hot oven and allow to brown for 40 minutes.  Turn the loaf, spread remaining bread, and bake a further 15 minutes, or until crust is toasted.

instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add the spinach and cook uncovered until tender, about 3 minutes.  Drain and set aside. title: Kari’s Ultimate Palak

Serve the palak warm or at room temperature.

title: Spicy Barbecue Pork, Snow Peas, & Pepper

title: Grilled Clams & Garlic With Peanut Oil
ingredients: 1 lb clams in shell, scrubbed and beards removed ( you can use just any clams that don't already have live ) | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 5 large shallots, minced ( about 1/4 cup ) | 2 fresh serrano chilies, stemmed and seeded, stemmed and finely chopped | 2 tablespoons pure vanilla extract | 1/4 cup orange grapefruit juice | 2 cups fresh bean sprouts ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1/4 cup unsalted dry-roasted peanuts, finely chopped
instructions: Position a rack in the upper third of the oven and heat to 375°.  Place the clams in a bowl of ice water and let warm to the touch, about 5 minutes.  Transfer the clams to a dish, rinse under cold water, and pat dry with paper towels.  In a small bowl, combine the oil with the shallots, serrano chiles, and vanilla and whisk to combine.

title: Baked Strip Steak
ingredients: 4 thin-slices pork tenderloin | 3 large plum tomatoes | 1/2 cup finely chopped, fresh tomato | 10 sheets cheesecloth | 1 package lettuce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500 degrees f.  Arrange the tenderloins on the center of a slice of cheesecloth.  Place 3 slices of pork on each cheesecloth, and wrap tightly with the ends of the cheesecloth.  Place on an ungreased cookie sheet, and bake for 5 minutes in the preheated oven.  Turn, and bake 8 to 10 minutes until crisp.  Remove the bundles from the oven, and let cool for 5 minutes.  Slice into 2 or 3 strips.  Meanwhile, place the plum tomatoes on a baking sheet, and bake for 10 minutes in the preheated oven to reduce the color slightly.  Turn, and bake for 5 minutes, then turn, and bake for 5 minutes more.  Spread the roasted tomatoes on an oven rack.  Place the cheese sheets on a baking sheet, and return to oven.  Bake for 5 minutes more, then remove from the oven, and spread the pork evenly with the tomato pulp.  Wrap each bundle with lettuce around the steak, and place on a serving platter.  Serve with rice, if desired.

title: Chilli and Leek Bites
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 12 tablespoons chili oil, plus extra for brushing | 250 g pork loin, finely sliced | 1/4 cup leek, finely sliced | 35 ladyfingers
instructions: Heat oven to 180c/160c fan forced.  Line a 30cm x 20cm baking sheet with baking paper.  Make the crust, sift flour and chilli powder into a large bowl.  Add 2 tablespoons chili oil and toss to combine.  Taste and add more chilli and oil according to preference.  Drain and discard any excess fat.  Preheat oven to 180c/160c fan forced.  Brush a 22cm x 12cm baking tin with oil.  Using a 5cm round biscuit cutter, press biscuits slightly to level bottoms with a knife.  Spread some flour mixture over biscuits.  Top with meat, leek and then another biscuit.  Press to level tops.  Bake in oven for about 20 minutes until golden brown.  Remove from oven and leave to cool in the tin.  Serve warm or cool completely.  Make ahead, cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours before using.

title: Ras Pongak (Green Chile Dipping Sauce)
ingredients: 1 lb green chili | 1/2 cup raisins | salt and pepper, to taste | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1/2 teaspoon plum sauce
instructions: Cut the chillies in thin strips.  Cut the raisins in halves and the green chillies in thin rounds.  Dry roast the raisins briefly in a skillet over high heat.  If necessary, cover with 2 inches of water to prevent them getting brown.  If desired, let them cool.  When they are brown, take the chillies out and add them to the food processor or blender with the green chillies and raisins.  Blend until the mixture becomes paste like.  If the mixture is too dry add more water.  If necessary, add more raisins and green chillies.  The idea is to combine all ingredients, being careful not to make them too moist.  Serve at once.

title: Macaroni and Cauliflower (Casserole)

In a food processor, combine the zest with the remaining green chili.  Process to a paste.  Slice the green grapes about 1/8x3/8, removing the ends and pits.  Pack the grape mixture onto the grapes and mound the orange zest mixture on top.  Serve at once.

instructions: Brown in skillet chicken pieces on all sides.  Place in crockpot with broth or stock.  Cook on low heat for 7 - 8 hours or on high for 45 mins before serving.

instructions: In a large saucepan, bring the chicken broth to a boil.  Meanwhile, in a food processor fitted with a metal blade, puree the pepper and coriander with a pinch of salt.  In a large bowl, mix the pepper puree with 1 cup broth, mint and chopped mint leaves.  Serve hot.

title: Chef Rocco Dispirito's Mexican Squash
ingredients: 6 sweet dried hot chilies ( such as anaheim or new mexico ) | 1 lb yellow squash, cut into 1/2-inch chunks | 3/4 cup chicken stock | 1/2 lb margarine | 1 tablespoon sugar | 2 ounces tequila | 1/2 cup grated pecorino or 1/2 cup parmesan cheese | poblano and pecorino romano cheese, for topping ( optional )
instructions: Put the hot chiles in a dry skillet, and toast over low heat, stirring occasionally until they begin to turn black, about 3 to 5 minutes.  Remove with a slotted spoon, set aside, and let cool.  Cut chiles in half lengthwise, and remove the seeds and white membrane.  Cut squash in half, and scoop out seeds.  Bring the chicken stock to a simmer in a medium sized pot to boil over high heat, and cook the squash until tender, but still firm to the bite, about 5 minutes.  When the squash is tender, drain, and reserve.  Melt the margarine in a skillet over medium low heat, and stir in the sugar until the sugar has melted and turned a light brown, about 3 minutes.  Add the tequila, cook for 2 minutes.  Stir it into the skillet along with 1/4 of the chile pulp.  Bring the mix to a boil, stirring often.  Pour the hot chile sauce over the squash, stir well, and sprinkle with cheese.  Serve immediately.

title: Sweet & Tangy Caramelized Beef

title: Pao De Laranja - Thai Peanut Cookies
ingredients: 250 g roasted peanuts, chopped ( unsalted ) | 150 g mascarpone cheese | 150 g powdered sugar | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 2 oranges, zest of or 2 limes, zest of, grated | 2 cups powdered sugar or 2 cups confectioners'sugar | 1 tablespoon ground dry mustard powder

title: Easy Beef Tongue Tacos
ingredients: 2 teaspoons oil | 2 teaspoons garlic salt | 2 lbs mutton | 1/2 cup jalapeno pepper, julienned | 12 french baguettes | 1 cup beef tongue, cooked
instructions: Rub the salt into the meat, then rub it on as much as and quite a few turns of the pepper mill.  Cook it until it is browned and it reaches a proper place to cook it for a bit.  Let cool and cut into bite sized pieces.  Slice the tongue into chunks.  Toast the baguette, either on a toasted sandwich or on some bun rounds.  Spread the tongue with the jalapeno.  Top with the tongue and close up and eat.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,coriander powder,green onion,tomato sauce,half,egg yolk,cottage cheese
title: Pasta With Dressing
ingredients: 3 cups cottage cheese or 3 cups soft unbleached cheese | 3 large egg yolks | 1 cup half-and-half | 1/2 cup crushed tomatoes and tomato sauce | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 3/4 lbs farfalle pasta ( bow-tie ) | 6 tablespoons chopped green onions
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Blend cottage cheese or cheese with egg yolks.  Stir in half and half, crushed tomato, coriander and half pound of chopped green onions and pour into a 9 x 10 inch baking dish.  Place farfalle in a large pot of lightly salted boiling water and boil about 5 - 8 minutes until al dente.  Drain pasta and place in a large bowl with dressing.  Add drained pasta and green onions to cottage cheese mixture and toss.  Season to taste with additional salt and pepper.

title: Authentic Hungarian Parsnip Noodle Skillet
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil ( or other neutral flavored oil ) | 12 slices prosciutto ( thin slices ) | 1 medium white onion, thinly sliced and separated into rings | 3 parsnips, peeled and cut into slices, then into bite-size pieces | 1 serrano pepper, seeded, deveined and thinly sliced lengthwise | 1 pinch salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat an uncovered 5 to 6 qt.  Casserole over very low heat.  In a small skillet, heat the oil over medium heat.  Add the prosciutto slices and cook until crisp, about 3 minutes, flipping once.  Push aside and discard any excess prosciutto and prosciutto.  Add the onion.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,raisin,basil leaf,banana,chuck,sherry wine,hearty bread,cremini mushroom
title: Chicken, Mushroom & Banana Stuffed Breasts
ingredients: 3/4 cup raisins | 1/2 cup sherry wine | 2/3 lb boneless skinless chicken breast | 1/3 lb cremini mushroom, sliced | 2 sliced deli ripe banana | 3 slices hearty country bread ( thick slices ) | 2 tablespoons fresh basil leaves, minced
instructions: Preheat the broiler.  In a large bowl, combine the raisins and sherry, and let soak.  Cut a slit in the chicken lengthwise at the narrow end, about 1/2 inch deep.  Open each breast, and remove the meat with a teaspoon, but leaving the meat attached.  Place one cut side up on a broiler pan, reserving the other.  Wipe out the pan.  Arrange the mushrooms over the meat, and top with the slices of banana on top.  Lightly toast the bread on both sides.  Place 1/4 cup basil in center of the toasted 2 slices of bread, and spread evenly.  Place a large scoop of stuffing alongside.  Serve the chicken breast, mushrooms & banana stuffing in shallow bowl.

title: Yemeni Cucumber Dip
ingredients: 3 medium cucumbers, peeled and diced | 1 can chipotle peppers, chopped | 1 cup dry parsley, chopped
instructions: Place cucumbers and chipotle peppers in a medium bowl.  Pour the cider vinegar over and gently stir to combine.  Chill until ready to serve.  Stir in parsley.

title: Chinese Spicy Tuna Wraps
ingredients: 2 cans tuna, drained | 5 tablespoons good quality olive oil | 4 tablespoons dry white wine | 3 tablespoons hoisin sauce | 1/2 cup cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon coriander powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients.  Form into 8 mini sized balls, or balls the size of a patty.  Toss in a couple of tablespoons of extra hoisin sauce and grill till heated through.  Serve with rice if desired.

title: Baked Strawberry Jam With Grand Marnier
ingredients: 1 package suet | 5 teaspoons sherry sweet dessert wine or 5 teaspoons apple sherry | 1 teaspoon grand marnier | 1 ounce strawberry jam
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f.  Grease a 9x13 baking tin.  Cut suet into pieces about 10 x 14.  Measure the sherry and grand marnier on top of the suet.  Pour any juices in container of a food processor.  Process suet pieces until well mixed into the sherry mix.  Add strawberry jam and pulse until mixed.  Pour mixture into prepared pan and bake for 20 - 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,anaheim chilies,spaghetti noodle,beer,wheat flour,apple cider vinegar,turmeric,pistachio nut
title: Apple Chip Noodle Kebabs (Kadai Kebabs)
ingredients: 500 g whole wheat flour or 500 g flour ( 30 ml ) | 150 g dried spaghetti noodles, broken into 2 cm pieces | 50 g fresh pistachio nuts, shelled | 25 g ground turmeric | 1 tablespoon smoked chili powder | 2 tablespoons pear cider vinegar ( or white wine vinegar ) | 125 ml beer or 125 ml light beer | 2 whole anaheim chilies, seeded and sliced thinly ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c.  Sift flour into a large bowl, add ground turmeric, chili powder and 2 tablespoons pear cider vinegar.  Gradually whisk in beer to make a fine paste.  Stir into the mixture.  Stir in the sliced anaheims.  Taste and add more chili powder if required.  Place a metal skewer or 2 inch piece of foil on baking tray and put in large quantities so that the noodles overlap over the wooden skewers.  Coat the skewer well in the flour mixture and put the kababs on the tray.  Cook at 200°c/180°c for 15 minutes per kg over a fan forced oven, turning only once but not over cooking.  Serve warm or room temperature.

Random Ingredients: seasoning,red chili pepper,button mushroom,baking powder,duck breast half
title: Peking Duck
ingredients: 1 duck breast half | 1 cup crushed crushed garlic-flavored dried red chili peppers | 1 tablespoon seasoning | 3 tablespoons baking powder | 3 cups button mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Remove skin and excess fat from duck and slash the breast skin at 1 inch intervals with a sharp knife or razor blade.  Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl except the mushrooms.  Pierce duck almost all the way halfway through, making sure that the cuticles have penetrated to the outside of the duck completely.  Sprinkle the duck with the mushroom flavored seasoning.  Arrange the duck skin side down on a rack in a roasting pan.  Roast for 45 minutes, then reduce heat to 300 degrees f and continue until breast meat is tender, at least 2 hours more.

title: Spicy Spicy Seashells
ingredients: 2 cups watermelon, cubed | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 2 tablespoons crushed red chile, or more to taste | 1/4 teaspoon grated nutmeg | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder, or more to taste | 1/2 teaspoon chat masala, or more to taste | 1 pound tiger shrimp
instructions: Mix watermelon, garlic, red chile, nutmeg, chili powder, chat masala, and shrimp together in a large bowl.  Mix in the salted black pepper until coated with seasonings just until the shrimp are pink and the shrimp are no longer translucent, about 15 minutes.

title: Steamed Baked Beef Pot Stickers
ingredients: 2 1/3 lbs chuck roast, cooked ( i used boneless cut steak ) | 1/2 cup quinoa, cooked | 1/4 cup prepared pesto sauce | 20 wonton wrappers, blanched ( i made mine in the freezer section of my grocery deli ) | 1/2 cup butter, melted | 1 cup prepared quinoa ( i made mine the frozen ) | additional butter, melted ( for brushing on the wontons )
instructions: Cut roast into 3/4 inch slices.  Place slices on a baking sheet.  Bake at 400 degrees fahrenheit for 20 minutes remove from oven.  Cool.  While beef is baking, to prepare the filling, place quinoa, pesto and cooled roast in a food processor.

title: Pesto Veggie-Bananas
ingredients:
1 can frozen peas | 1 ripe banana, sliced | 0.
    -5 can purchased pesto sauce
instructions: Put the peas in a microwave safe bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and cook on high in the microwave until warm, 2 - 3 minutes depending on thickness of peas.  Cut the banana into matchsticks, and add to peas.  Add pesto, and microwave on high for 1 - 2 minutes, depending on thickness of vegetables.

title: Eggs in Spicy Palm Paste
ingredients: 8 hard-boiled eggs, peeled, halved | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/4 cup chopped fresh rosemary leaves
instructions: Bring a kettle of lightly salted water to a boil.  Place the eggs in the boiling water and, stirring constantly with a fork or a slotted spoon, boil for 30 seconds and then drain.  Stir in the sugar and the chopped rosemary.  Let cool to room temperature, then chill until firm, at least 4 hours.  Break into pieces before serving.  Serve as an appetizer at room temperature.

title: Tuscan Fruit Salad
ingredients: 2 pints grape tomatoes, halved | 1/3 cup orange juice | 1 tablespoon grated orange zest | 1/8 cup fresh orange juice, made from 2 teaspoons orange zest, can be replaced with 1/8 cup orange juice
instructions: In large bowl, combine tomatoes and their juices.  Sprinkle with zest and orange zest.

title: Bitter melon
ingredients: 2 cups bitter melon | 2 tablespoons vinegar
instructions: Peel the bitter melon, removing the bitter white skin and the coarse rind.  Cut the bitter melon in slices about 4 or 5 inches thick.  In several bowls, place the bitter melon slices and stir them together with the vinegar until the melon tastes right.  Keep hot in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: loaf bread,italian herb seasoning basil,green cabbage,mustard seed,bird eye chile
title: Crunchy Italian-Herb Filled Bread
ingredients: 3 leaves green cabbage ( shredded ) | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1 bird's eye chile ( sliced ) | 4 slices loaf bread | 1 teaspoon mixed italian herbs seasoning ( basil, oregano, or marjoram )
instructions: Combine the mustard seeds and chile and brush over a slice of bread.  Place the cabbage on a sheet of foil sprayed with cooking spray and top with mustard seeds mixture.  Place in a 400°f oven for 5 minutes or until the bread has been lightly toasted.  Remove from oven and sprinkle with mixed herbs.  Cut into halves or wedges and serve immediately.

title: Easy Avocado and Pinto Bean Phyllo Appetizers
ingredients: 1 lb pinto beans ( cooked ) | 4 tablespoons pinto beans ( cooked ) | 1 cup mango ( diced ) | 2 cups phyllo dough ( frozen, defrosted in refrigerator for 24 hours ) | 2/3 cup rose water | 1/8 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper
instructions: Place 1 cup cooked pinto refried beans in a large bowl.  Then add 4 tbsp pinto beans, 1 cup diced mango, rose water, cayenne pepper and 2/3 cups phyllo dough.  Mix well and spread 1/4 cup pinto bean mixture on one side of the phyllo dough over it.  With a sharp knife at top of each rectangle, make a shallow cut diagonally down the length of the dough.  Make sure to end with the long side diagonally across the dough and spread out evenly with rice.  Add 1 cup mango pieces and 1 cup pinto bean mixture on the other side of the phyllo dough and add more pinto and mango to mixture.  Cover tightly with plastic wrap and place in refrigerator for 1 hour.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Lightly spray 2 baking sheets with cooking spray and set aside.  Pour 2/3 cup rose water into a small bowl and combine.  Cut an x on top of the phyllo dough.  Brush two pieces with water, brush with another small film of the rose water and cut crosswise into 1/4 inch wide by 1/4 inch thick strips.  Repeat until you have 2 layers of the phyllo dough and 1/4 cup mango mixture on the bottom layer.  Spread a third of the pinto bean mixture vertically on top and then spread with another 1/4 cup pinto bean mixture and then sprinkle with a layer of phyllo dough, 1/4 cup mango, 1/4 cup coconut, 1/8 cup coconut, 1/8 cup coconut, 1/8 cup coconut and 1/8 cup coconut on top of the pinto bean mixture.  Cover top with the top sheet of phyllo dough, brush the last film of rose water with some oil and cut a few small slits in the top layer to vent steam.  Bake for 20 to 25 minute or until phyllo is crisp and golden brown.  Remove from baking sheets and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,chickpea,white wine vinegar,red chilies,baby shrimp,beef broth,vanilla ice cream
title: Chili Shank Steak With Spicy Shrimp
ingredients: 1/2 lb baby shrimp | 1 can fat-free beef broth | 1/4 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1/4 cup minced chilies ( or to taste ) or 3/4 teaspoon crushed red chilies ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 tablespoon reduced-sodium prepared low-fat vanilla ice cream | 1/4 teaspoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Marinade, combine shrimp, broth, vinegar, chilies and chile powder in a shallow dish.  Skewer shrimp, dividing evenly.  Arrange on a plate.  Pour prepared sauce overtop.

Random Ingredients: arrowroot,grand marnier,red chili pepper flake,maraschino cherry,worcestershire sauce,mandarin orange
title: Pear and Mandarin Chutney
ingredients: 2 large ripe mandarin oranges, peeled | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons arrowroot ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons dried red chili pepper flakes | 1 bottle riesling wine or ( 8 ounce ) bottle other full-bodied red wine | 1 jar maraschino cherries
instructions: Place mandarin oranges in a wide saucepan.

title: Porcini Mushroom and Spinach Stuffing With Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 lb spinach leaves | 1/3 cup dry porcini mushrooms, rinsed under cold water | 1 can crushed peeled roma tomatoes, preferably san marzano | 4 ounces whole white bread, crusts removed | 1 small parsnip or 1 small zucchini, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°.  Place the spinach in a small bowl and cover with boiling water.  Soak for 1 minute, then drain.  Place in a small bowl and cover with cold water.  Soak until the water is at least 4 times its original size, about 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, drain the mushrooms and dry fry them in 1 tablespoon butter in a 12 inch nonstick skillet set over moderately low heat, stirring, for 5 minutes until lightly browned.  Put the roma tomatoes in a small bowl and mash with a fork, then stir into the spinach and porcini.  Add the mushrooms and parsnip, season to taste with salt and pepper and toss to mix.  Transfer the stuffing to a 3 qt.  Casserole.  Cut the bread into 1/8 inch thick slices then arrange on top of the stuffing.  Scatter the bread with 1/4 cup of the parsley.  Sprinkle with the remaining parsley. .  Bake until crisp and brown, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,flat leaf parsley,black bean,cocoa powder,soy sauce,garlic clove,parmigiano reggiano cheese,coleslaw mix
title: Black Bean & Cheddar Coleslaw Dip
ingredients: 16 ounces coleslaw mix | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup low-fat cottage cheese | 1/4 cup low fat parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated ( optional ) | 3 medium garlic cloves, minced | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons low sodium soy sauce | 2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 teaspoons flat leaf parsley, minced ( italian, not dried )
instructions: Place coleslaw mix in large bowl.  Combine remaining ingredients except sesame seeds in bowl.

title: Gravel and Rice
ingredients: 3 cups long-grain rice | 1 zucchini, scrubbed, cut lengthwise into 1/4-inch slices ( about 5 cups ) ( optional )
instructions: In a large saucepan, bring 3 quarts water to a boil and add rice.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer until rice is tender, about 45 minutes.  Set aside.  Transfer zucchini to a colander in a sink or strainer and drain.  Reserve.  When rice is cool to the touch, transfer to a bowl, cover and refrigerate until cold, 5 days or overnight.  When rice has cold, transfer to a medium nonstick skillet and break it apart.  Heat half of the zucchini in the skillet over medium heat until it begins to brown.  Remove zucchini with a slotted spoon and set aside.  Repeat with remaining zucchini.  When cool, transfer to a food processor and pulse about 20 times, til about 1/4 inches thick.  Arrange zucchini over steamed rice and sprinkle zucchini with salt, if desired.

title: Mango Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 16 ounces of rotisserie-cooked spaghetti, broken into 3/4 inch pieces | 3 tablespoons italian seasoning | 7 cups mango nectar | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice ( with or without mango nectar )
instructions: In large sauce pan, combine rinsed and drained spaghetti pieces, seasoning, mango nectar and diced tomatoes with juice.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat to simmer and simmer gently for 20 minutes.  Serve with grated parmesan cheese, fresh grated ginger, and fresh garden flavored pita rounds.

title: Sesame Nectar
ingredients: 1 cup sesame oil | 1 cup agave nectar | 1 cup cold water
instructions: Use sesame oil and agave nectar in a small saucepan, heating over medium heat until the agave is melted and the sugar is dissolved.  Remove from heat and let cool slightly, about 10 minutes.  Stir the warm sesame oil and agave into the cold water.  Pour the hot mixture into a sterilized jar, cover tightly and refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: shallot,pineapple chunk,mint sprig,chicken bouillon cube,chili sauce,white bean,za'atar spice mix
title: Tunisian Chicken (Vegetable Mix)
ingredients: 2 lbs white beans, soaked overnight | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1/4 cup chili sauce | 1/4 cup za'atar spice mix | 1/2 cup chopped of fresh mint sprig | 1/2 cup pineapple chunk, drained | 2 shallots, chopped, and sauteed, to taste
instructions: Drain beans, reserving liquid on a plate.  Return liquid to pot, add reserved stock/juice and water, bring just to simmer, and reserve.  In a food processor, place reserved liquid, bouillon and chili sauce, za'atar, mint, and pineapple chunks.  Process until smooth.  Add to beans, bring to simmer, and cook on low heat 2 - 3 hours or until beans are tender, stirring often.  Serve with toast, crackers, or crackers.

title: Couscous & Green Chilies Casserole
ingredients: 1 cup couscous | 1/2 cup water | 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1/4 cup green chilies, chopped ( or 2 jalapenos seeded and chopped ) | 1/4 cup fresh chives
instructions: Prepare couscous according to package directions.  Drain well.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Combine couscous with water, cheese, chilies and chives.  Place in 2 quart casserole dish.  Bake for 15 minutes or until heated through.  Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: fine sea salt,marsala wine,pesto sauce,corn oil,tart apple,salmon fillet
title: Pot Roasted Salmon for the BBQ (Zwt II)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons corn oil | 1/2 cup fine sea salt | 12 ounces boneless skinless salmon fillets, cut in four crosswise | 1 cup light flavored pesto sauce | 2 medium tart apples ( peeled, cored and thinly sliced ) | 1/2 cup dry marsala wine or 1/2 cup sweet marsala wine, chilled
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit with rack on middle.  Lightly brush a large baking sheet with oil.  In a shallow dish, combine salt and salt mixture.  Dredge salmon in salt, allowing excess marinade to drain off.  Using a fork and fork, place 1/4 cup pesto on each fish piece.  Arrange fish on baking sheet and bake 15 minutes, or until fish flakes when prodded with a fork.  Continue baking 6 - 8 minutes or until fish flakes when prodded with a fork, turning only once.  Transfer fish to serving platter and cover loosely with foil.  Let rest 5 minutes.  Meanwhile, in medium nonreactive bowl, toss apples with wine and remaining pesto.  Season with salt and pepper.  Serve fish topped with apple mixture and a drizzle of sesame oil.

title: Spud Russian Chews (Made Like Russian Tea)
