Random Ingredients: peppercorn,jaggery,broad egg noodle,beef stew meat,vegan sugar
title: Methi's Beef Kebabs (Tengali)
ingredients: 1 lb beef stew meat, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 10 green peppercorns, cracked open then crushed using mortar and pestle | 2 teaspoons vegan sugar | 2 1/2 tablespoons jaggery | 1 lb broad egg noodles, cooked
instructions: Marinate the meat and the spices in this mix for at least 40 minutes or longer.  Heat the grill.  Thread the meat on the metal skewers.  Grill them about 5 minutes each side until very dark brown.  Turn once and cook another 2 - 3 minutes.  Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: tea,red onion,pepperoni,sherry wine,white wine vinegar,bailey irish cream,herb,rice
title: Irish Party Wine Salad
ingredients: 2 cups white wine vinegar | 3/4 cup sherry wine | 2/3 cup strong tea | 1/4 cup instant minced herbs | 12 ounces pepperoni, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup red onion, very thinly sliced and separated into rings | 1 1/3 cups rice, cooked | 2 tablespoons herbs, chopped
instructions: Add all ingredients to a blender.  Cover and blend until fully mixed.  Chill overnight or until ready to serve.  Add to a salad bowl, sprinkle with chopped herbs, and serve.

title: My Favorite Ham & Cheese Soup
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs ham | 2 cups milk
instructions: Boil ham in 2 1/2 cups of milk, when almost falling off the bone.  Remove ham from simmer, and place on a greased pan.  Pour remaining milk on top, making sure that it covers the ham entirely.  Bake in a preheated 425 degree oven for 40 minutes.  Serve while warm with fresh bread.

title: Red Beans
ingredients: 1/4 lb dried red beans | 5 tablespoons whipping cream | 1 bay leaf | 1 package frozen puff pastry, defrosted
instructions: Soak red beans overnight, then place beans on foil lined baking sheet with parchment paper.  Bring to boiling in large pot with bay leaf and simmer for about 1 1/2 hours, or until beans are tender.  Remove bay leaf and strain beans through sieve, reserving 2 cups of beans cooking liquid.  Puree cooled beans with reserved cooking liquid, and stir in cream.  Roll out the pastry on a floured board until it is the width of your 9 inch pan, and cut out 24 squares.  Arrange the dough squares on the bottom of the pan, then pour bean mixture over top.  Bake at 400 degrees f for 10 minutes, then brush with cream.

title: Pineapple Mango Ginger
ingredients: 1 ripe mango, peeled, diced | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, peeled, minced | 1/4 cup pineapple juice
instructions: Place the mango in a blender with the ginger, pineapple juice and pineapple juice.  Blend until desired consistency is achieved.

title: Tortilla Espanola Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces | 15 ounces chunky salsa
instructions: Divide each salad bowl into 6 portions.  Add a dollop of salsa and serve.

title: Japanese White Russian Tea
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon instant coffee, powder | 1/4 cup water chestnut, cut up | 1/4 teaspoon powdered top beef fat ( optional )
instructions: Pour boiling water over the water chestnuts until water has completely absorbed.  Stir in the cooled instant coffee powder and cool to room temperature.  Put into an airtight container and use in place of milk of choice.

title: Homemade Red Potatoes & Fries
ingredients: 1 kg red potatoes | 2 cups mexican style processed cheese and flour mix
instructions: Wash the potatoes thoroughly under cold water.  Drain all excess water.  Heat a griddle.  If using a frying pan, put it on the grill.  If using a non stick pan, put that on the griddle, close the lid, and turn the pan regularly over a fairly low heat.  Test potatoes with a fork which should show no resistance when it is cooked.  You should see small resistance in the potato before the potatoes appear to be fully cooked but still holding their shape, about 5 minutes.  While you are stirring the potatoes, put up on a large table or table plate.  Stir in the cheese until the mixture is smooth and white in texture, about 1½ minutes over low heat, stirring constantly until it has melted but is still slightly warm.  Turn off the heat.  Drain the potatoes and spread on the serving platter, or on serving plates.  Serve immediately, or cover and refrigerate until needed.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,part ricotta cheese,celery rib,vegetable oil cooking spray,coriander seed,parsley,chicken bouillon cube,cream cheese
title: Creamy Low Carb Ricotta Fettuccine
ingredients: 12 ounces part-skim ricotta cheese | 4 ounces fat free cream cheese, room temperature | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped | 1 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon celery rib, finely chopped | 1/2 chicken bouillon cube, crushed | 1 1/2 cups vegetable oil or 1 1/2 cups cooking spray | olive oil ( for skillet )
instructions: Mix first 11 ingredients in a container with a lid.  Put lid on container and shake vigorously.  Let sit 30 minutes.  Meanwhile, heat up 1 1/4 cups oil until a deep fry thermometer reads 350 degrees or until bubbles start to form in the oil.  Drop the fettuccine by the tablespoon full into oil.  The oil should not smoke and they should float.  Fry until crisp, 3 - 4 minutes.  Do not cook too long and they will be dry.  Drain on paper towels and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,splenda sugar substitute,mustard,sugar,dark sesame oil
title: Easy Oriental Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup splenda sugar substitute | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 2 1/2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 2 teaspoons dry mustard | 1 teaspoon sugar
instructions: Combine in small bowl.  Sauce, prepare 1/2 cup dipping sauce.  Bring dipping sauce to boil, reduce heat and simmer.  Yield, about 1 cup of dipping sauce.

title: Poblano and Honey Glazed Chops With Ham & Kumra
ingredients: 2 bunches kumara, halved | 6 thin halved bell peppers ( red, yellow ) | 2 -3 pieces fresh gingerroot | 1/4 lb deli ham | 1/2 - 3/4 ounce unsalted butter | pepperoni ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven 400 degrees.  Place kumara and ham in a large roasting pan or baking dish.  Spray with pam.  Cut the bell peppers in half and place on top.  Sprinkle garlic over the bell peppers.  Top with ginger and cover with foil.  Bake for 15 minutes in 400 degree oven.  Remove the foil and bake another 10 minute or until peppers are tender.  Remove from oven and place on cutting board.  Tear off 2 or 3 strips of ginger using a sharp knife and cut each in half lengthwise.  Sprinkle with pepperoni if desired.  Carve, if desired remove the ham from the ham pieces.  Slice the ham across the middle and into thin slices.  Return the ham and slices to the pan and place under broiler turning occasionally.  This should give the glaze a crunchy finish.

Random Ingredients: chickpea flour,goat cheese,celery rib,beef stew meat
title: Beef & Bean Patties
ingredients: 1 package ground beef stew meat | 1 1/2 cups canned chickpeas flour ( besan ) | 2 celery ribs, very thinly sliced | 1/3 cup goat cheese, crumbled
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat.  Mix ground beef, chickpea flour, celery and goat cheese together.  Roll into balls or patties as desired.  Cook patties 3 - 5 minutes per side.

title: Salmon and Artichoke Potatoes
ingredients:
2 tablespoons chopped red onions | 40 g cocoa | 800 g smoked salmon, cut into 3 cm cubes | 1 tablespoon red onion, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon dried artichoke heart, finely chopped | 1 bunch watercress, leaves only, torn ( approx.
    - 8oz ) | 2 large baking potatoes, quartered and cut into 1 cm wedges | 3 tablespoons reduced-fat mayonnaise | 60 g reduced-fat mayonnaise | 125 g escarole, leaves only
instructions: Place onions and 2 tablespoons cocoa in a shallow dish and set aside for 5 minutes until the onions are softened.  Place salmon, onion, artichoke, remaining 2 tablespoons cocoa, oil and watercress in a large bowl and season.  Toss to combine.  Add the potatoes and gently stir around to coat with the marinade.  Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours.  Preheat the oven to 425°f line a large baking tray with foil and place the potatoes in the middle.  Bake in the oven for 45 minutes or until tender and golden.  Meanwhile, blend the reduced fat mayonnaise, reduced fat mayonnaise and 2 tablespoons cocoa.  Add the escarole in a handful, mixing evenly.  Serve the potato salad topped with the salmon mixture and remaining tablespoon of cocoa.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,miso,graham cracker crumb,green prawn,clear honey
title: Easy Honey Prawns (Shrimp) With Oregano
ingredients: 4 large green prawns | 4 ounces fresh oregano leaves | 8 ounces graham cracker crumbs or 8 ounces graham cracker crumbs | 2 teaspoons clear honey or 2 teaspoons molasses | 2 teaspoons miso
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f.  Peel and devein prawns, leaving peel on.  In a shallow dish mix mroe oregano, cracker crumbs, honey, and miso, mix well.  Press prawn mixture into prawns in ungreased oven dish.  Bake approximately 25 minutes or until tender and lightly browned.  Serve warm over pasta.

Random Ingredients: garbanzo bean,oregano,icing sugar,chicken bouillon cube,sun tomato paste,salmon fillet,lavender flower
title: Avgolemono (Greek Chicken and Salad)
ingredients: 500 g boneless skinless salmon fillets | 150 g garbanzo beans, blanched in water for 5 minutes | 1 cup sun-dried tomato paste | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 1 tablespoon dried lavender flowers ( or 1 tsp of each ) | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1 chicken bouillon cube or 1 beef bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons minced sun-dried tomatoes ( oil free )

ingredients: 2 tablespoons potato starch | 1 pound veal, cut into chunks | 1 1/2 containers meaty instant fried potatoes ( such as vh ) | 4 cloves kaffir lime leaves | 1 pound fresh basil | oil for frying
instructions: In a large bowl combine potato starch with ground veal and knead for 2 minutes or until mixture is firm.  Dough can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.  Heat 1 cup water, or as needed, in a large pot to cover the meat.  Bring to a boil.  Add the potato flour and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly to prevent sticking, until mixture is dark golden brown, about 10 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Meanwhile, make fried noodles, place potatoes in a saucepan with enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil.

title: Aubergines in brandy
ingredients: 6 medium aubergines | 2 1/4 cups of uncooked sweet potato starch | 1 1/4 cups brown rice flour ( available in asian markets ) | 12 tablespoons brandy | 1 3/4 cups mirin ( japanese sweet sake or rice cooking wine ) | 2 ounces of saskatoon berries in brandy | additional brandy ( optional )
instructions: Peel aubergines and cut into 2 long pieces lengthwise.  Using a mandolin make a cut in each piece of aubergine lengthwise so that the strips can be cut into thin strips.  Combine the starch and brandy, and set aside.  Place sweet potato starch in a bowl.  Toss the saskatoon berries with brandy and set aside.  Dip the cut aubergine strips into the starch on both sides and coat with the seasoned flour.  Heat a wok over high heat until smoking.  Deep fry the coated aubergine strips in batches, until the strips are browned, about 3 minutes per batch.  Drain on paper towels and serve immediately with saskatoon and brandy dipping sauce.

title: Spanish Tapenade
ingredients: 1/4 cup tarragon vinegar | 12 spanish olives
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the tarragon vinegar and olives.  Pour over your choice of vegetables.

Random Ingredients: green onion,coriander leaf,escarole,coconut milk,jiffy corn muffin mix,pear
title: Jiffy Salad With Grilled Pear & Escarole
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coconut milk | 1 package jiffy corn muffin mix | 1 jar chopped pears, drained | 1/2 cup thinly sliced green onion | 1/2 cup chopped fresh coriander leaves | 1 green onion, chopped | 1 cup grated, reduced fat sharp reduced-fat cheddar cheese or 1 cup grated asian style cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f.  Combine coconut milk and corn muffin mix in a medium bowl.

title: Nigerian Papaya
ingredients: 5 medium papayas | pepper, enough to coat the papaya
instructions: Pre heat oven to 450°f.  Place papaya on baking paper in a roasting pan.  Pepper generously on both sides.  Place on hot grill over medium high heat and cook for 20 minutes.  Reduce temperature to 150°f.  Wrap in foil, wait 25 minutes, then place in refrigerator for several hours.  After baking, peel off papaya skins and transfer papaya to an electric grill or in large heavy duty paper baking tray.  When you are ready to cook papaya, place papaya in a pre heated oven, then bake for 5 to 30 minutes or until the skin is a bit crispy and soft.  Allow to cool completely.  Serve with a fresh fruit salad or cool fresh fruit compote.

title: Chocolate Grape Ice-Cream
ingredients: 1 lb green giant grapes, cut in half | 2 ounces parfait chocolate morsel ( if not using regular, use another good-quality chocolate morsel ) | cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 300of.  Lightly butter a 4 lb loaf pan.  Arrange grapes in the pan alternating with the parfait, drizzle with the chocolate and a generous pinch of cayenne.  Bake covered, 1 hour and 20 minutes.  Let cool completely in pan, then transfer to delivery freezer bags.

title: Ancho Chile French Fries
ingredients: 6 french sticks | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1 tablespoon chile puree ( chipotle chile in adobe sauce )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Arrange french sticks in a single layer on a baking sheet.  Toast french sticks in oven for 20 minutes.  Spray pan with cooking spray.  Turn sticks over and spray with cooking spray.  Spray again again.  Allow french sticks to cool for about 30 seconds.  Turn out french sticks on a plate and sprinkle with onion powder.  Place chile puree in a glass or ceramic bowl and pour over french sticks just before serving.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,red pasta sauce,apple juice,white wine,cauliflower,parsley
title: Cauliflower in Wine, Apple & Italian Seasoning Pasta - Cook's Il
ingredients: 3 medium cauliflower, cut into florets ( i use the stems and heads, just break up any larger ) | 1 bottle red pasta sauce, i like newman's own old fashioned house red, but any will do ) | 3/4 cup apple juice | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning
instructions: Separate cauliflower into florets using a sharp spoon or potato peeler.  Place in a pot of boiling water and reduce heat to medium for 6 - 8 minutes or until barely tender.  Drain and rinse under cold water, drain again and pat dry with paper towels.  In 6 qt slow cooker combine cauliflower pieces and jar of red pasta sauce, apple juice, wine, parsley, and italian seasoning.  Mix well and place in slow cooker.  Cover and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours or until cauliflower is tender.

title: Stir-Fried Snow Peas and Snow Peas
ingredients: 15 ounces snow peas, trimmed | 3 teaspoons fish sauce | 1 tablespoon water
instructions: Cut snow peas in half lengthways.  Place in a bowl and pour on fish sauce and water.  Stir well, adding more water if needed to absorb.  Serve immediately.

title: Pecan-Crusted Pork Loin With Carrots, Corn and Lime
ingredients: 6 lbs pork loin, trimmed of fat ( i use loin ) | 2 2/3 lbs carrots ( i use yellow or use red ) or 2 2/3 lbs zucchini ( i use yellow or use red ) | 1 cup pecans | 12 corn on the cob | 1 large lime wedge | 1 cup prepared horseradish, drained | 2 tablespoons dry aged ground peppercorn
instructions: Cut the pork in to 2 x 1 1/2 x 1/2 inch cubes.  Preheat oven to 300°f.  Place the pork in a non reactive baking pan, and sprinkle lightly with salt.  Bake at 300°f for about 3 hours or until a meat thermometer registers 180f.  While the meat is cooking, toast the pecans in a dry skillet, turning often, until golden brown, turning once.  Set aside.  Pull the roast out of the oven, and place on a cutting board and cut into cubes.  Place the carrots in a large skillet or roasting pan.  Pour in the 1 cup water from the pan and bring to a boil.  Turn down the heat and cover the pan or roasting pan.  Simmer over low heat about 30 minutes or until fork tender.  Drain the vegetables, reserving the liquid, and set aside.  Cut the meat into 1 1/2 strips.  Set aside.  When all of the liquid has cooked away, add the pecans and cook over medium heat until the liquid is slightly reduced and the nuts are lightly browned.  Stir in the pork, corn cobs, lime juice and horseradish.  Cover loosely and let stand for 30 minutes.  Place the pork in a deep, heavy, heavy oven proof dish.  Cover with foil, and bake in a 325°f oven for about one hour.  Remove from the oven.  Increase the heat to 325°f, and bake until the pork is very tender, about 40 minutes, turning and basting frequently with the pan liquid.  Remove from the oven and allow to rest at least 10 minutes before serving.

title: Chargrilled Asparagus and Mango Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste ( pulson's is a good brand ) | 1 tablespoon dried mango ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried orange peel, coarsely chopped | 1/3 cup fresh parsley leaves, very finely chopped | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon dried chipotle powder or 1/2-3/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs asparagus, trimmed
instructions: Combine all the ingredients except asparagus and keep in a warm place.  Cook the asparagus until very tender, 3 to 4 minutes depending on thickness.  Drain and rinse under cold running water and drain again.  Toss with the mint and serve.

Random Ingredients: red food coloring,parmigiano reggiano cheese,date,self rising flour,tarragon vinegar,angel hair pasta,chipotle powder
title: A Different Macaroni Grill Crunch!
ingredients: 2 packages angel hair pasta | 1/3 cup tarragon vinegar or 1/3 cup white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup extra-virgin olive oil | 1/3 cup red food coloring ( not necessary ) | 2 tablespoons ground chipotle powder | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon ( optional ) | 2 cups grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese or 2 cups grated romano cheese
instructions: In a pot of boiling water, cook angel hair until just tender but still al dente.

title: Sweet and Sour Pork Roast - Loomanshaxe
ingredients: 1 -3 kg bone-in pork loin roast | 1 -500 ml vegetable juice ( depending on how juicy you like it ) | 1 shallot, chopped up if you like it extra hot ( if you like the flavour ) | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 -800 g shallots, peeled
instructions: Trim off any excess fat and then bone and using a sharp knife, cut up pork roast into 6 to 7 cm dice if you don't have any bones on hand.  Mix together the vegetable juice, shallot and cornflour.  Bring the stock and the mixture to a boil.  Add the pork and stir.  Cover with lid and reduce heat to low.  Simmer for 30 minutes, check the liquid content and adjust seasonings if necessary.  Remove the meat from the pot and take off all jewetes, keeping the stock and meat separately.  Poke the sliced shallots into the warm chicken and shallots, pour off any excess liquid stock/water and place the stock and pork back into the sauce.  Replace the lid and cook until pork is completely cooked and the shallots are soft.  If you don't have any bones on hand, cook to your liking.  Serve with lots of cooked bread.

Random Ingredients: irish whiskey,sea salt,italian bread,berry cranberry sauce
title: Irish Bread & Cranberry Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup frozen mixed berries ( craisins, cranberries, dried fruit or other dried fruit of your choice ) | 1/2 cup irish whiskey ( or other flavor ) | 1/2 cup commercial dried mixed berries ( craisins, cranberries, dried fruit or other dried fruit of your choice ) | sea salt ( optional, but remember to use sparingly, it will thicken as it cools )
instructions: Combine the frozen berries and whiskey in 1/2 cup measuring cup or small bowl.  Season with salt.  Spoon 1/2 cup of the berries mixture into each serving bowl and spoon cranberry sauce over.

title: Quick English Dip
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas ( drained ) | 3 ounces salami ( finely chopped ) | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1 teaspoon hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients.

Random Ingredients: gruyere cheese,thyme,ricotta cheese,pasta,apricot jam,garlic powder,graham cracker crumb
title: Easy Cheesy Apricot Parmesan Crust Pasta
ingredients: 36 inches graham cracker crumbs | 3/4 cup ricotta cheese | 3/4 cup thinly sliced gruyere cheese | 3/4 cup apricot jam | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme | 2 cloves garlic powder ( yes, 3 ) | 14 ounces large pasta
instructions: In a medium bowl add the ricotta cheese, gruyere cheese, jam, thyme, and garlic powder to the ricotta and spread it evenly in a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Cook the pasta in lightly salted water according to package directions while the oven heats up.  Spoon a layer of pasta into a warm baking dish and top with a layer of cheese mixture.  Repeat for one more layer of cheese mixture.  Bake in pre heated oven for 10 minutes or until the casserole is bubbling.  Serve warm.

title: Hokkien - Cold Noodle Salad
ingredients: 500 g round rice noodles ( i use long thin ones such as cellophane ) | 1 bunch green beans ( or a mixture of both ) or ( 500 g ) green beans ( or a mixture of both ) | 1 tablespoon coriander seed or 1 teaspoon coriander, crushed | 2 eggs ( optional ) | 3/4 cup apple cider ( optional )
instructions: Drain the noodles well.  Rinse well with cold water and drain again.  Thickness will depend on the width of your noodles.  Slice the green beans roughly and add in to a bowl with the noodles.  If the dish is dry, add some more water, this will prevent sticking.  Cover and marinate overnight.  If not, stir well with wooden spoon or other object to ensure noodles are covered evenly.  Break the eggs into a bowl and stir until yolks are runny, then whisk in a little of the cider.  Pour the egg/cider mixture over the noodle mixture and stir to combine.  Cover with plastic wrap and leave to marinate for at least an hour or overnight, stirring now and then.  Dish is done when the egg has set.  Note, if you have any noodles left over make little nests in the noodles before adding the egg mixture, this will give the noodles more crunch than when cooked, but will not make them crunchy if left to sit in salad.

Random Ingredients: steak,apricot jam,onion soup mix,clear honey,chili oil,red chile pepper,pork
title: The Best Steak Rolls in the World!!!!
ingredients: 1 lb top round steak, cut into small cubes | 1 lb lean pork, diced | 1 can apricot jam | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 2 teaspoons chili oil ( optional ) | 1 small red chile pepper, cut into rings
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Place the meat and jam into a medium bowl and mix well.  Place the onion soup mix, honey, and chili oil into a small bowl.  Add the onion soup mix to the meat, mix well to combine.  Roll the meat mixture in the jam mix and arrange in a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Bake in the preheated oven for 50 minutes.  Remove from oven and brush with some of the remaining sauce.  Allow meat to cool.

title: Prawn Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1/2 cup oil ( i like the oil-cured black olive oil ) | 2/3 cup prawns, cleaned and shelled | 1 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Put the rice, prawns, salt and pepper in a bowl and mix well.  Set aside to sit for 10 minutes.  Heat oil in a pan, put the mixture into oil and cook on high heat for 5 to 7 minutes, flip and cook 5 to 7 more times, until the mixture turns opaque.  Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Easy Garlic Beef With Cheese (Sandwich)
ingredients: 1 sirloin tip steak, cubed | 1 1/2 cups aged cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Place sirloin tip steak in the center of a piece of parchment paper.  Spread cheese over beef.  Bake at 450 degrees f for 5 minutes.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,purpose flour,green pepper,sriracha hot sauce,feta cheese,pernod
title: Spicy Feta Sauce
ingredients: 8 ounces italian sausage, cooked & coarsely chopped | 1 green pepper, chopped | 1 jar pernod or ( 12 ounce ) jar pernod | 1 tablespoon sriracha hot sauce | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Combine sausage, green pepper, pernod, sriracha and flour in large nonstick skillet.  Stir over medium heat until well blended and sauce is thickened, about 3 minutes.  Stir in cheese.  Heat to boiling.

title: Easy Spaghetti II
ingredients: 1 pound kalamata olives | 1 can sliced water chestnuts | 1 1/2 cups water | 1 package farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta
instructions: Place olives, water chestnuts and dried spaghetti in a large pot.  Bring to a boil over medium high heat, stirring often.  Cover and reduce heat to low.  Simmer 25 minutes.  While noodles are cooking, drain oil from skillet.  Pour olive oil into skillet.

title: Ethiopian Spicy Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb red bell pepper, diced | 1/2 cup self rising flour, plus | 1/2 cup self-rising flour
instructions: Place bell pepper in pan with 1/2 cup of water.  Boil.  Cover and cook over low heat 8 - 10 minutes or until water is clear.  Do not overcook.  Remove bell pepper and cool.  When cool, remove peel from skins and dice.  Set aside. .  Place 1/2 cup of self rising flour in a medium mixing bowl and mix thoroughly.  Place bell pepper in the flour, add 1/2 cup of water and mix using a fork.  When mixture forms small clumps, add 1/2 cup of flour.  Stir well.  Turn dough out on a lightly floured surface.  Form into 2 balls.  Wrap in waxed paper and place in refrigerator 1 - 2 hours or overnight.  Prepare peppercorns, drain 1/2 cup of boiling water from the pan and drop a few at a time into the boiling water.  Cover and remove from heat before adding another teaspoonful of flour.  If you have a strainer inside, use a spoon to squeeze out as much water from the peppers as possible.  Add 1/2 cup of water to the skillet.  Add 1/2 cup of chopped pepper and 2 tablespoons of flour.  Mix well and bring to boil.  Cover and cook over low heat for 10 minutes.  Do not uncover the lid during the 5 minutes.

title: Shrimp Scampi
ingredients: 20 large shrimp, cleaned | 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon prepared horseradish ( optional )
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a heavy 12 inch skillet over medium high heat.  Add shrimp.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,dressing,american cheese,tequila,parmigiano reggiano cheese,taco seasoning mix
title: Taquito Margaritas
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups shaved american cheese | 1 1/4 ounces tequila | 2 tablespoons grated parmigiano reggiano cheese | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seeds, crushed | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh italian cheese blend
instructions: Mix together the cheese, tequila, parmigiano reggiano, taco seasoning, cardamom, and italian cheese.  Dip the meat in the mixture and place in the bottom of a medium glass margarita glass.  Cover with the tequila mixture.  Refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: curry paste,eggplant,wine,lasagna noodle,green onion,egg yolk,buckwheat flour
title: Eggplant Lasagna
ingredients: 1 eggplant, cut into 2-inch chunks | 6 green onions ( green tops ) | 3 1/2 cups buckwheat flour, divided | 1/2 cup wine or 1/2 cup chicken broth | 1 tablespoon curry paste or 1 teaspoon curry powder | 1 egg yolk | 1 package lasagna noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: In large bowl, combine eggplant, 1 cup green onions, buckwheat flour, wine or chicken broth and curry paste or powder.  Beat egg yolk with remaining egg until foamy then stir into egg mixture, until smooth.  Spread 1/2 cup of the sauce in the bottom of a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking pan.  Lay noodles in a single layer on top of sauce, overlapping if necessary.  Spread 1/3 cup sauce into prepared pan.  Spread eggplant mixture evenly over noodles.  Spread remaining sauce on top of eggplant and noodle mixture.  Sprinkle remaining 1 cup green onions over sauce.  Preheat oven to 350°f bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned and hot.

title: Baked Brie Cheese
ingredients: 1 wheel m & m's choclooped brie cheese | 1 tablespoon potato starch ( corn starch can also be used if you prefer ) | 1/2 cup milk chocolate ( such as ghirardelli )
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the chocolate and potato starch.  Set aside.  Using a knife or melonballer, crush the wheel of brie cheese into small chunks then stir them into the chocolate.  Stir until the chocolate has melted.  Pour into an 8 inch square casserole dish or shallow casserole dish.  Bake in a 350 degree f oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until the top layer is browned, bubbly and the center is firm to the touch.  Cut into slices and serve warm with your favourite dessert.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,self raising flour,canadian bacon,sauerkraut
title: The Reindeer and Sauerkraut Pies
ingredients: 250 g self-raising flour, plus extra extra for dusting | 150 g dark brown sugar | 100 g sauerkraut, drained | 4 slices canadian bacon, roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c and line 2 x 12 hole mini muffin pans with baking paper, allowing room for the dough to rise.  Combine the flour, sugar, sauerkraut, bacon and half the excess flour or milk in a bowl, then gently stir into the mixture until just combined.  Spoon the dough into the prepared muffin pans and bake in the preheated oven for 15 - 20 minutes until golden and risen.  Remove from the oven and cool on a wire rack.

Random Ingredients: andouille sausage,bourbon whiskey,whipping cream,wine,swiss cheese,coconut cream,bell pepper,lemon juice zest
title: Andouille-Andouille Sausage
ingredients: 6 ounces swiss cheese, shredded ( more as needed ) | 2 tablespoons bourbon whiskey ( more as needed ) | 1 teaspoon lemon juice ( zest ) | 1 lb andouille sausages, hot | 1 cup sweet wine or 1 cup dry sherry, divided | 1/2 cup light cream | 1 cup smoked coconut cream, flaked | 4 bell peppers, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f.  Mix together the swiss cheese, bourbon, lemon juice, and zest in a bowl except for the bacon.  Cut the sausages into 1 inch slices.  Layer the hot sausages and sausage in a baking pan.  Pour the wine over.

Random Ingredients: amarula cream liqueur,cream mushroom soup,cherry,mayonnaise,milk powder
title: Cherry Cream Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1 can condensed milk powder | 1 jar dried cherries, drained | 1 1/2 fluid ounces amarula cream liqueur
instructions: Mix cream of mushroom soup, mayonnaise, milk powder and cherries together in a blender.  Blend until smooth.  Transfer mixture to the bowl of a mixer, and mix on low for 2 to 3 minutes or until well blended.  Cover, and refrigerate 10 minutes to soften.  Stir in amarula cream and pulse on medium speed for 2 minutes.  Serve in a bowl.

title: Sake Teriyaki Marinade
ingredients: 1/4 cup teriyaki sauce | 3 tablespoons brown sugar | 2 tablespoons capers, drained | 2 tablespoons fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Stir teriyaki sauce, brown sugar, capers, and black pepper together in a bowl.  Marinate steaks in sauce for 3 hours in fridge.  Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Transfer steaks to prepared baking pan.

title: Quick 'n' Easy One-Dish Baked Salami
ingredients: 2 cups sweet roasted sweet salami, julienned | 3/4 cup mayonnaise, or as needed | 2 cans marinara sauce | 1 dash mustard powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Spread salami out on a baking sheet.  Sprinkle with dijon mustard powder, and bake in preheated oven until the edges are golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes.  Spread mayonnaise over salami.  Pour marinara sauce over salami, and bake uncovered in the preheated oven until the sauce has thickened, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: oil,tarragon,white bean,chuck,pear,self rising flour,dark sesame oil
title: Beef and Pear Burgers
ingredients: 500 g lean ground chuck | 2 teaspoons finely chopped fresh tarragon | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 250 g frozen peas and pears | 2 slices fresh bread | 1 cup self rising flour | oil, for shallow frying
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the burger ingredients.  Form into 4 patties with 1cm thickness.  Dredge in flour, shaking off excess.  Heat the oil in a griddle or frying pan on high.  Cook 3 patties at a time for 2 minutes each side or until evenly browned.  Serve with salsa.

title: Sugar Skulls - for the Eyes of Maccheron!(Made by Maccheroncinis
ingredients: 20 heads mace, divided | 3 tablespoons white sugar | 6 tablespoons grand marnier ( optional )
instructions: Place 1 mace head in the top third of a kitchen towel and rub together with the palm of your hand to bruise the mace and remove the mace as much as possible.  Place the remaining mace on a plate and sprinkle with the sugar and grand marnier.  Roll the mace in the sugar until it is coated and rub the outside of the mace with mace.  Place on an oiled baking sheet, cover with plastic wrap, and set aside to macerate.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Unwrap the mace, and place 2 or 3 mace mace sticks on the mace.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until puffed and lightly browned.  Serve warm.

title: Bavarian Thyme Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 pint double cream | 1 small bunch fresh thyme leave
instructions: Heat oven to 150° celsius line a baking sheet with non stick baking paper.  Heat the cream in a pot set over a medium heat.  When it starts boiling, remove from heat and leave to cool.  Whip the cream until stiff peaks form.  To fold through the creamy thyme leaves and pour into an ice cream maker in the suggested measures.  Bake for 12 - 15 minutes until golden and firm to the touch.  Pile on a large platter and refrigerate for several hours or until completely cold.

title: Grilled Tuna Panini (Antivianis)
ingredients: 2 -3 canned tuna | 1 green bell pepper ( sliced thinly ) | 2 slices rye bread ( thinly sliced ) | 1 tablespoon coffee or 1 tablespoon milk | 2 slices crisp steamed salami ( cut into thick strips )
instructions: Drain fat from tuna and rinse with cold water.  If possible, use only a light tasting oil.  Drain tuna well and break into chunks.  Place tuna chunks and pepper slices on a piece of bread or bun.  Top with coffee or milk and top with a second piece of bread.  I like a touch of salt.

Random Ingredients: lager beer,ginger,soy sauce,golden syrup,snow pea,mirin,fruit,baby spinach
title: Noble House Japanese Spinach With Aniseed Candied Ginger & Snow Peas
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh baby spinach | 12 baby snow peas | 1/2 cup sugar | 1/2 cup mirin | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 3 teaspoons golden syrup | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh ginger | 3 tablespoons lager beer
instructions: Blanch spinach in boiling water for 2 minutes.  Drain and cool slightly.  Snip stems carefully, removing tough center leaves.  In a dry noncorrosive skillet, combine sugar, mirin, soy sauce, and golden syrup and cook over medium heat for 2 minutes, stirring constantly, making sure sugar dissolves.  Add ginger and cook until fragrant, 1 minute longer.  Remove skillet from heat and add beer and remove from heat.  Stir in ginger.  Add spinach.  Stir until evenly coated.  Spread mixture over 1 piece of parchment paper placed on baking sheet.  Place in refrigerator and chill for 2 to 2 hours, tossing every 15 minutes to remove all excess moisture.  Stir and serve.

title: Cabbage Rolls - Lahanorizo
ingredients: 2 heads cabbage, outer leaves removed, cored and chopped | 1/2 cup dried italian breadcrumbs
instructions: Place cabbage in a large pot of salted boiling water.  Cover and reduce heat to medium.  Cook until tender, about 5 to 8 minutes.  Drain thoroughly.  In a small bowl, combine bread crumbs and 1/2 cup water.  Dredge cabbage with bread crumb mixture.  Heat a large skillet over medium heat.  Cook cabbage in hot skillet 4 to 5 minutes.  Remove leaves from water.  Place cabbage on a large baking sheet with sides, or on waxed paper.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,pine nut,crescent,chicken breast fillet,ranch salad dressing
title: Roasted Chicken Crescents
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast fillets | 1 cup ranch-style salad dressing | 2 cans crescent rolls | 1/2 cup basil leaves, rinsed and dried | 2 tablespoons pine nuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Place chicken in a large roasting pan and coat all over with salad dressing.  Bake chicken for 25 - 30 minutes or until done.  Remove from oven.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,tahini paste,corn tortilla strip,salad green,fennel seed,sea salt,mayonnaise,annatto seed
title: Mexican Tortilla Side Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons mayonnaise | 1 1/2 teaspoons tahini paste | 1 1/4 teaspoons agave nectar ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons agave nectar ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 24 large corn tortilla strips
instructions: Whisk together the mayonnaise, tahini, agave nectar, fennel seed, and salt in a bowl until smooth, about 30 seconds.  Set aside 1 tablespoon of the mayonnaise and whisk the rest into the dressing in a small bowl.  Dredge each tortilla strips in the reserved mayonnaise until coated.  Arrange the tortillas on a plate.

Random Ingredients: string bean,kaffir lime leaf,chicken meat,peach,bulk italian sausage
title: Italian Sausage with Peaches
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 1 bag frozen string beans, thawed | 2 large firm fresh peaches, peeled, seeded and cut into wedges | 6 kaffir lime leaves, cut into thin slices | 1 can sliced peaches, drained
instructions: Cook sausage in 10 inch skillet over medium heat, stirring to crumble.  Remove sausage from skillet and set aside.

title: Prawn (Shrimp) Raita with Milk and Fritters
ingredients: 2 cups skim milk | 2 1/2 ounces wheat germ | 4 ounces dried shrimp ( optional ) | 2 dried chipotle chile peppers, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek leaves ( optional ) | 3/4 cup soymilk, room temperature ( optional )
instructions: Make sure the bread crumbs are well soaked in the milk.  Heat the pan on medium/low.  When hot, add the grated coconut and fenugreek stalks in a little bit of milk to keep them from sticking to the bottom.  When both sides are golden, take the pan out of the burner.  Poke one small hole in each raita with a skewer.  Add the prawns to the pan and stir them around in the coconut.  Turn over the prawns.  If your prawns are too large, you can leave any residual oil in the pan.  Stir the spices around the prawns.  Pour the milk over the prawns.  Let it simmer for 2 minutes, add soymilk, cover tightly, and cook for 7 minutes.  Let the prawns rest for about 2 minutes, take out the prawns, and serve in a bowl with plain yogurt or chutney.

Random Ingredients: shiitake mushroom,onion flake,tahini,red kidney bean,baking potato,chicken bouillon,cold water,eggplant
title: Eggplant and Shiitake Hash Browns
ingredients: 1 lb small eggplant ( about 6 ) | 32 ounces small shiitake mushrooms, wiped debearded | 2 medium baking potatoes, unpeeled and cut into chunks ( about 3/4 lb ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 2/3 cup tahini | 3/4 cup cold water | 2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant dried onion flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Cut eggplant into 1/4 inch thick slices.  Heat ovenproof skillet with spray misted cooking spray over medium high heat until hot, about 2 minutes.  Add eggplant and mushrooms and saute for 3 minutes or until eggplant is browned.  Add potatoes, onion, tahini, water, and chicken seasonings.  Heat to boiling over high heat.  Reduce heat to low and cover skillet with lid for 15 minutes or until potatoes are just soft.  Add eggplant, mushrooms, and 2 tablespoons broth.  Cover and cook on lowest heat about 45 minutes or until potatoes are tender and liquid is absorbed.  Alternatively, you can bake at 275 degrees for about 50 minutes then lower oven temperature and bake for about 20 minutes.  Stir pan contents occasionally while baking. .

title: Sausage and Pineapple Skewers(Bahama Mama Style)
ingredients: 150 g sausages, cut into 2 equal portions | 75 g pineapples, diced finely or 75 g sweet potatoes, peeled and diced finely | 1 small red chilies, finely chopped or 1 small jalapeno, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh maraschino cherry, chopped finely or 1 teaspoon dried cherries | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons yellow peppers, diced finely | skewers
instructions: Soak skewers in water for 30 minutes, then thread skewers on skewers.  Place all remaining ingredients to a food processor.  Process until very smooth and almost dry.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,rustic loaf italian bread,aubergine,coriander leaf
title: Aubergine Grilled Skewers
ingredients: 2 medium aubergines, peeled and cut lengthwise | 4 ounces curry powder | 8 slices rustic-style loaf crusty italian bread | coriander leaves or fresh parsley sprigs
instructions: Place sliced aubergines between 2 sheets of plastic wrap on a wire rack set over a shallow bowl.  Using a meat mallet or other rolling pin, flatten and flatten the slices to 1/4 inch thickness.  Sprinkle curry powder evenly over cut surfaces of bread, and place 8 slices of bread on top of curry powder, pressing in lightly so that slices adhere to the curry powder.  Wrap each of the soaked pieces of bread with 2 slices of cheese.  Lightly spray grill rack with oil.  Place soaked bread on grill rack, and using the handle of a wooden spoon, press a few of the slices into the hot oil.  Turn slices over, and repeat with remaining slices.  Allow skewers to heat through and firm up slightly for 1 or 2 minutes on each side, or until cheese is melted and bread is hot.  Remove from grill, and sprinkle with coriander or parsley and serve at once.

title: Rice Noodle Slice - Noodle Mix
ingredients: 1 packet rice noodles | 1 cup almond paste | 1 corn on the cob | royal icing or similar icing
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c.  Grease a 20cm x 14cm slice pan and line with baking paper, allowing the paper to extend about 2 centimeters above the sides of the pan.  Bring a pan of lightly salted water to the boil and add the rice noodles.  When the noodles are just beginning to soften, drain and toss in a bowl.  Add the almond paste and corn.  Mix together gently until the pasta is coated in the almond paste.  Spoon evenly in the prepared pan and sprinkle with a little more icing.  Chill the slices for 20 minutes before slicing into squares or bars.  Store in an airtight container for 1 week or freeze for up to 3 months.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,peanut oil,spring onion,canola oil,chinese five spice powder
title: Chinese Fried Nuts
ingredients: 250 g uncooked ground dried quinoa | 6 spring onions, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon canola oil | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1/2 teaspoon chinese five spice powder
instructions: Place the quinoa in a medium bowl and pour over about 1 1/2 cups cold water.  Leave to soak and rinse, then drain well.  Dry well and transfer to a bowl, add the spring onion, canola oil and the 5 spice powder.

title: Baked Irish Lettuce & Potato
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta ( bowtie with or without shells ) | 1 large potato ( cut into 8 wedges ) | 8 ladyfingers | 1 pint cherry ( quartered )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325f degrees.  Boil farfalle pasta according to directions on package.  Meanwhile, heat a medium skillet on medium.  Dice potato into 1/2 inch pieces.  Arrange ladyfingers in the bottom of a casserole dish.  Sprinkle potatoes over the potatoes.  Arrange stuffed ladyfingers around potatoes.  Dot the whole top with cherries.  Bake uncovered for 45 - 50 minutes.  Serve warm.

title: Oregano, Pineapple, Mint, and Pepper Cracker Crackers
ingredients: 1 package saltine crackers | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mint leaves | 2 grated cups chocolate | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Pour crackers into a 9x13 inch baking dish, and smooth and evenly spread crackers.  Spread the pineapple chunks evenly over the crackers.  Sprinkle the mint, grated chocolate, oregano, and freshly ground black pepper evenly over the pineapple and crackers.  Bake in the preheated oven until the topping is bubbly and the chocolate has melted, about 25 minutes.

title: Sauerkraut With Peanut Butter
ingredients: 1 cup sauerkraut, drained | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 serrano chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon parsley or 1/2 teaspoon cilantro | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Combine all ingredients except for the sauerkraut in a microwave safe bowl.  Microwave on high setting, stirring once, to warm through, about 1 minute.  Pour sauerkraut into a small bowl.

title: Green Pea Soup
ingredients: 1 lb green pea | 1/2 lb broccoli rabe, fresh ( can be found at farmers markets, if it can't get them pre-cut )
instructions: Place a large pot of water on the stove.  Place the broccoli rabe in the pot, cook for 3/4 hour on medium heat until water is almost evaporated.  Remove rabe to soup bowls.  Add peas to the soup bowls and boil for 10 minutes.

title: Barefoot Contessa's Famous Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained | 1 can beef broth
instructions: Pour chickpeas into a bowl, adding beef broth.  Let stand for at least 12 hours or over night at least.  Strain, discard juice.  Place mixture into heavy pan or crock and cook on high heat for 5 minutes, stirring constantly, until liquid thickens to desired thickness.  Remove from heat.

title: Pecorino Cheese Soup With Raw Food
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pecorino cheese, grated | 1/2 cup agave nectar | 1/4 cup chicken bouillon or 1/4 cup chicken broth | grated pecorino cheese, for garnish, optional garnish, or more to garnish
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a blender.  Puree until almost smooth, then pour into sauceboat or soup mugs, or glasses.  Serve in soup mugs or glasses.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,italian herb,baking powder,salt pepper
title: Homemade Adobo Baking Powder Spice
ingredients: 3 cups packed italian herbs | 4 teaspoons baking powder | 1 tablespoon ground dried ancho chile powder | salt and pepper to taste ( optional )
instructions: In a clean coffee or spice mill, place the mixed ingredients.  Blend into a fine powder.  Store in a tightly covered container.

title: American Kitchen Classic Best Barley Burgers #5FIX
ingredients: 1 cup barley | 1 1/2 cups frozen blueberries | 1/3 cup ketchup | 1/3 cup apple cider | 1 cup liquid smoke | 1/2 cup oyster sauce
instructions: In a large bowl, combine barley, blueberries, ketchup, cider, liquid smoke, and oyster sauce.  Mix well.  Form into 4 patties.  Heat on medium grill until they become firm and cooked through.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast fillet,mustard seed,ginger,lemon zest,parsley flake,mango chutney,lasagna noodle
title: Cousin Aloo  (Chicken and mango in a Nut)
ingredients: 500 g chicken breast fillets | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard seeds | fresh parsley flakes, to taste | fresh ginger, grated to taste ( see note ) | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon zest | mango chutney, to taste | lasagna noodle, to serve
instructions: Cut the chicken into strips or bite size pieces.  Mix together the mustard seeds, parsley and ginger.  Coat the chicken in the mustard mixture.  Spray a non stick frying pan with a little cooking oil or a light olive oil, add the chicken and cook over low heat for about 5 minutes.  Add mango chutney and stir in until heated through.  Lay one cup of noodles in the bottom of a medium size serving dish, spread with a layer of chicken.  Spoon over the mango/chutney mixture and top with a layer of noodles.  Repeat until all the mixture has been used up.  Place a large piece of foil on top, fold over the foil, crimping the edges firmly.  Wrap in foil/foil, refrigerate until needed.  Notes, to test whether the cousin aloo is cooked or not according to the directions, cut the chicken into strips / bite sized pieces.  If it gets not cooked, the cousin is ready.  If it cooks too soon, it gets too dry.  Add more fresh herbs, if desired.  Note, if it is too dry add a little water to get to right consistency.  Serve with lots of yoghurt, cream, fresh fruit and/or fresh parsley.  Note, if you're going to eat this right away, place in the refrigerator for a couple of hours if it starts to dry out then you can re heat if needed.  Serve with fresh, crusty bread.

title: French Canadian French Dressing
ingredients: 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 teaspoon parsley | 1 teaspoon oregano leaves
instructions: In a small bowl stir together catsup, parsley and oregano.  Chill until serving.

title: Phyllo Salad-Thai Style
ingredients: 5 -6 sheets phyllo pastry ( phyllo sheets ) | 10 small pears ( small firm ) | 1 small eggplant | 3 -5 green chilies | 1 bunch fresh mint | 1 bunch fresh radish ( red-ripe with green tops )
instructions: The day before, slice the pear and eggplant to about a half inch or an inch thick.  Chop mint and radishes and combine with the green chilies.  Cut phyllo pastry into 2 inch square squares.  Place 2 triangles on a large flat surface place 2 tablespoons of the chopped ingredients in the middle of the cut phyllo.  Then wrap the bottom triangle with the 2nd triangles and the amount of filling, like you are making pesto.  Repeat with other 2 triangles until you make all 3 triangles.  Fold the phyllo up around the filling making certain it is completely covered.  Place on a cookie sheet covered with foil and bake in a 300 degree oven for about 35 to 45 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,sesame seed,flour,whipping cream,almond extract
title: Scrambled Tea Nuts (With Almonds)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons flour | 1/4 cup whipping cream | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Toss together almonds and sesame seeds and sprinkle flour over the top.  In a large skillet over medium heat toast 1 tbsp sesame seeds about 1 minute until light golden color.  Add cream and soy sauce and heat over medium heat until mixture boils and thickens.  Remove from heat and blend in almond extract.  Serve immediately.

title: Japanese White Pancake
ingredients: 1 cup hot red pepper flakes | 1 cup white whole wheat flour | 3 tablespoons mirin ( japanese sweet wine )
instructions: Combine the pepper flakes and flour.  Stir in the mirin and heat in a skillet or crepe pan to make a thin batter.  Drop a few at a time into the batter, and flip to cook on the other side.  Serve hot with soy sauce as a thin dipping sauce.

title: Date Party Kebabs
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh dates, pitted, halved pitted and chopped fine | 1 cup grated cabheddar cheese | 1/4 cup chopped orange zest | 2 cans beef consomme, low sodium, low fat, low sodium | 8 12 inch wooden skewers or 8 12 inch bamboo skewers, soaked in water until soft
instructions: Combine the dates and cheese in a bowl.  Place about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the date cheese mixture evenly over the top and roll the skewer in the dates to coat. title: Baked German Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 1 package baker's original german chocolate | 25 g muenster cheese, cut into 24 chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f melt the chocolate in a double boiler over simmering water.  Remove from heat and add the nut and cheese.

title: Black Bean Soup

instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Rinse and drain black beans, sweet potato and watermelon.  In a large bowl, combine black beans, sweet potato, watermelon, cream, grapeseed sour cream, paprika and vanilla.  Stir well and transfer to a greased shallow baking dish.  Bake 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: oyster,cream,plain yogurt,pizza dough,cardamom seed,salt pepper,white peppercorn
title: Kulfi Rolls - Oysters With Yogurt

Dice all of the ingredients into smaller pieces and set aside.  Roll the dough out between a sheet of parchment paper until a 5 centimeters thick rectangle.  Spoon half of the yogurt into a shallow dish and set aside.  Place some of the oysters into the middle of the dough, making sure they get submerged into the yoghurt.  Roll out the remaining dough into a rectangular shape.  Cut in three to 5 mm thick slices each depending on how much dough you are rolling out.  Cut rolls in half so they make long, even, narrow, square strips and then cut at the diagonal into strips.  Take a small dish and put up a little dollop of yoghurt in the middle of the pastry strips to seal.  Repeat with the rest of the pastry and the oysters.  Place on a baking tray lined with greaseproof paper until all rolls are arranged.  Sprinkle with pepper and top with some more yoghurt or sour cream.  Bake in a 190 degree celcium oven for ten minutes or until golden brown.  Let cool on a rack.

title: Dill Swiss Roll

instructions: Cut each ciabatta roll in half crosswise using a serrated glass or serrated knife.  Slice each half into 4 strips crosswise.  Spread 1 can of condensed soup on cut ciabatta pieces. Remove ciabatta roll from oven and discard but don't tear bread apart.  Unwrap and place on platter covered with waxed paper paper towels.  To serve, sprinkle with fresh dill and serve immediately.  Store leftover ciabatta can in refrigerator and reheat on the stove top.  Serve with crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: mandarin orange,kalamata olive,bean sprout,monterey jack cheese,tea,mayonnaise
title: Nestle Party Platter

instructions: Arrange orange slices on chilled platter, side by side.  In a small bowl mix 1/4 cup of the brewed tea with the mayo.  Sprinkle grated cheese evenly all over oranges.  Spoon the orange mayo mixture over the orange and sprinkle with mandarin oranges.  Chill at least 2 hours before serving.  Serve with pita chips.

title: Roasted Yellow Bell Peppers
ingredients: 3 lbs yellow bell peppers | 1/4 cup flax seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Wash the peppers and remove the stems with the tip of a sharp knife.  Cut down the center of each so the peppers stay intact. When you remove the pepper skins, you can scrape out the flesh, then chop out the seeds with a spoon.  Set peppers aside and let cool.  Grind the peels in a grinder until fine.  You can use a coffee grinder, food processor or spice mill.  Grind all of the pepper pulp and the roasted peppers into a fine paste.  You will know that the skins are done if the tops are a little cracked.  Place mixture into a container and let rest at least 1 - 2 hours in a dark place.  Serve.

instructions: Slice the poblanos lengthwise.  Place in a bowl of water and soak until soft.  Do not soak the seeds.  Cut the turnips and poblano chiles in half. Set on a wire rack in the refrigerator until serving time.  You can also bake these at 400 for 15 minutes until bubbly.  Serve with your choice of fillings.

instructions: Make sure you have enough head cauliflower for this, and then cut cauliflower in to florets using a mandolin or a large food processor.  Place the florets in a microwave safe bowl. Dip ladyfingers in the taco sauce to coat & arrange around the base of the cauliflower/florets.  Enjoy.

title: Creamy Coconut Chicken

instructions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions.  Cool completely, remove lid and chill for 4 hours or overnight.  Cut asparagus into thirds. instructions: Brown veal.  While veal is browning, mix together peanut butter, beans, brown rice, almonds and celery. instructions: Combine buttermilk, espresso powder and lemon peel in jug.  Serve sauce with mincemeat.  Refrigerate for 1 hour or longer.  Serve with meat or rice.

title: Amaretto Pea Salad

instructions: Combine all ingredients except amaretto and vinegar.  Cover and chill until serving.

instructions: Boil the yucca root in salted water until tender.  Drain.  Blend yucca root and yucca root water in a blender or food processor.  Blend until smooth.  Place cooked yucca root mixture into a baking mold.  Stir cornmeal through chives and vanilla extract.  Sprinkle sugar on top.  Bake at 325 f for about 50 minutes.

title: Sauteed Eggs & Broccoli
ingredients: 4 -6 cups fresh broccoli, steamed and chilled | 1 -2 tablespoon virgin olive oil | 1 cup hot white rice | 1 1/2 cups water, steamed until steaming and cold
instructions: Steam the broccoli in a steamer basket until tender.  Set aside and keep warm.  Pour the olive oil in the steaming basket holding the hot broccoli into a small saucepan.

title: Lentils, Peas, and Provolone Appetizers

instructions: Bring large pot of water to boil.

instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl, mix well.  Place 1 cracker on a cutting board and spread a thin layer of filling, 2 inches from edge of cracker. instructions: Place a tortilla on a warm platter, add some of the dollop of cream and top with chopped white onions.  Sprinkle with a little more chopped onions or shredded cheese. instructions: Trim excess fat from steak, cut steak into very thin slices, cover with cold water and cover with cold water.  Bring to a boil and reduce heat to low. instructions: Combine all ingredients in bowl and mix well with spoon.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour for best results.  Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes prior to forming to shells.  Bring to boil on stove top.  Bake 5 minutes or until shells are crisp.  Stir.

title: Korean Pepper and Cabbage

instructions: Put the cabbage and bell pepper in a large pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil.  Cover and reduce heat to low.  Simmer until vegetables are very tender, about 1 hour.  Drain and serve at once.

instructions: Marinate, combine all ingredients except chicken and pears in a large bowl.  Add chicken.  Add pears.  Cover and let stand 1 hour or longer.  Arrange chicken on a rimmed baking sheet. instructions: In a medium bowl, combine cheese, margarine, white vinegar, garlic salt, and ancho chili powder.  Cover and chill in the refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours. title: Toasted Eggs with Mirin

instructions: Separate the yolks from the whites and whisk with an immersion blender.  Whisk the yolks in a pan until pale.  Scramble the whites until they start to curl, but not as stiff as you would for whites.  Fold omelets into the scrambled egg whites in a circular motion.  Pour a little of the mirin into a bowl and sprinkle with additional mirin, to taste.  Serve hot but they don't taste as good if they reheat over medium low heat.

title: Dills-Ovos-Os-Kathmandu

instructions: Place pork and ground beef in a large nonstick skillet and brown over medium high heat, breaking up large chunks as it cooks, until no longer pink. Remove from heat, spread out and cool, pressing on the remaining dill in the pan to remove any excess moisture.  Spread the pork mixture evenly over 1 side of a lettuce leaf and arrange the sliced chicken on top.  Sprinkle with pepper to taste, then the remaining 3 tablespoons prepared dill.  Wrap lettuce leaf in plastic wrap and place on a tray, refrigerate for 15 minutes.

instructions: In large bowl, stir together mushrooms, 2 tablespoons of the oregano and the basil.

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Add vegetables and 1/4 cup enchilada sauce.
