ingredients: 2 lbs chicken breasts or 2 lbs potatoes, cut into quarters lengthwise and halved, skins on | 1 can green olives, sliced with pimiento ( or other pimiento flavor, such as ancho or souse ) | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1 teaspoon caraway seeds ( optional ) | 1/2 cup flour
instructions: Place chicken and potatoes into crockpot.  Sprinkle with olive, chicken bouillion, garlic, caraway seeds if using, and 1/2 cup of water.  Drain olives well and spread all over chicken.  Add the green olives.  Set crockpot on high for 4 hours, then switch to low.  Let cook for at least 4 hours.  At end of 4 hours, stir the flour over the chicken and potatoes.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,dill,baby spinach,water chestnut,graham cracker crumb,hot dog
title: Super Easy Party Wings
ingredients: 4 cups chicken wings | 1 can water chestnuts, cut up and drained | 1 package baby spinach | 1 package graham cracker crumbs | 2 tablespoons fresh dill, chopped | hot dogs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place the wings in a 9 x 13 inch pan.  Place beans and water chestnuts in a large skillet over medium high heat.  Heat and stir until hot.  Pour hot bean mixture over the wings.  Sprinkle the spinach over the top in a large layer.  Top with crumbs and dill.  Bake at 400 degrees f for 50 to 65 minutes.  Remove from oven and sprinkle with hot dogs.

title: Mexican Apple Pie Crust
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups ice | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: Place ice and cumin into a freezer bag.

title: Baked Coconut Baked Beans and Peas
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups coconut | 1/2 cup nonstick cooking spray | 1 can white beans, drained and rinsed | 3/4 cup canned white bean sprouts | 1/4 cup mirin ( sweet rice wine, if you prefer ) | 1 tablespoon dried roasted seaweed or 1 tablespoon dired roasted chiffonade
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f spray cookie sheet with veggie or olive oil cooking spray.  Combine all ingredients in a small baking dish.  Bake beans and peas for 15 minutes.  Remove from oven and stir.  Sprinkle with dried seaweed or chiffonade.

title: Balsamic Jelly
ingredients: 800 g harissa | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 5 -6 teaspoons five-spice powder
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: citron,lemon,saffron,pecorino romano cheese,sirloin,thai red curry paste,caster sugar,black cardamom pod
title: Spiced Beef Skewers With Pecorino and Pecorino
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh citron, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons lemon rind, finely grated | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 teaspoon saffron, soaked in | 2 tablespoons boiling hot water | 1 black cardamom pod, crushed | 600 g sirloin, cut into small cubes | 8 toothpicks | freshly grated pecorino romano cheese, to serve
instructions: Combine the zest, sugar, zest, lemon rind, sugar, saffron water and cardamom in a small bowl and mix well.  Add the sirloin and turn to coat.  Pour half the spice mix into a shallow baking dish.  Drain and arrange the beef on top.  Coat with remaining paste.  Refrigerate for 2 hours.  Thread meat onto skewers.  Bake in moderately hot oven for 25 minutes.  Serve with remaining spice mix and freshly grated pecorino romano.

title: Gnocchi (Pasta With Sauce
ingredients: 1 can pasta sauce, can be bought as spaghetti sauce or use 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce for a thicker sauce ) | 1 teaspoon nutmeg | 1 can miniature marshmallows | 2 tablespoons white flour | 1/4 cup white flour | 2 teaspoons paprika | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt | 5 -7 sandwich buns, split ( toasted if desired ) | parsley ( optional ) | marshmallows ( optional )
instructions: Pour half a cup of sauce in a medium saucepan, stirring to blend well with a whisk.  Put a small frying pan on medium heat and warm up 1 tb.  Of the nutmeg in it.  Lightly sprinkle 1/2 cup of the white flour over the sauce.  Dip each sandwich bun into the flour.  Brown each piece of bread in the hot oil just until it is lightly browned on both sides.  Drain off any grease once browned.  Set aside on paper towels.  When sauce has simmered for 15 - 20 minutes, stir in the marshmallows and let the mixture simmer.  Toss with noodles or with bread, serve as is, top with a few sprinkles of parsley and grated nutmeg if desired.

title: Spanish-Style Quinoa
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked quinoa | 3/4 teaspoon rock salt ( or kosher salt ) | 1 mexican-style stewed tomatoes with jalapeno peppers | 4 slices prosciutto or 4 slices country ham, cut into strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f.  Rinse the quinoa thoroughly and drain well.  Mix the quinoa and rock salt in a baking dish, and spread evenly.  Place the tomatoes and ham on top of the quinoa, and then cover the dish with aluminum foil.  Bake until the quinoa is dry, 25 - 30 minutes.  Let the quinoa rest, covered, for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Chutney Sausages with Filled Rye Bread
ingredients: 1 pound hot pork sausage | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 2 tablespoons unsalted dry-roasted peanuts | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 2 tablespoons chopped hazelnuts | 1/2 cup chutney | 1/4 cup shredded kefalotiri
instructions: Heat a lightly oiled griddle over medium heat.  Brush the hot sausages with oil, sprinkle with salt.  Grill, turning once, until fully cooked and well browned, about 10 minutes.  Remove the sausages from the pan and set aside.  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Place 1/2 cup of chopped hazelnuts in the bowl of a coffee grinder.  Add 3/4 cup of the chutney, 2 tablespoon of peanut butter, 1 tablespoon of the hot sausage and 1/4 cup of the kefalotiri.  Blend until smooth.  Spread the mixture over 1 loaf of bread.  Top with 1/4 cup of the reserved sausages.  Roll the bread snugly around the sausages.  Slide the loaf onto a baking sheet, making sure it is well apart.  Brush the remaining 1 tablespoon of peanut butter over the top.  Sprinkle with remaining kefalotiri.  Bake in the preheated oven until the sausages are browned and crusty, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Peppered Cornflour Tons
ingredients: 8 ounces wonton skins | 4 ounces cornflour | 2 tablespoons finely chopped parsnips | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds | 1 teaspoon amaretto | 2 egg yolks, beaten | 1 tablespoon fresh coriander seeds, finely chopped
instructions: Cut the wonton skins into 8 pieces.

title: Torshi - Turkish Zucchini
ingredients: 2 medium zucchini, about 2lb | 1 cup canola oil
instructions: Cut zucchini lengthwise into ¾ inch wide slices on the peel using a knife that will cut to the length you are not using.  Cut slices diagonally across the width of the peel with a vegetable peeler, using sharp knife so the cuts are not broken.  Place zucchini in a bowl and cover with cold water.  Let sit for 20 minutes, then drain.  Rinse and remove peel from water with fingers.  Pat dry then drain excess water.  Heat canola oil in a large, shallow frying pan or skillet over moderate heat until almost smoking and cook zucchini for 12 minutes or until slightly deep in colour and beginning to crisp up then transfer to a paper towel lined plate and sprinkle with salt to draw out excess oil.  Cut into quarters then thinly slice.  Serve warm or cold.

title: Gourmet Chicken Paillards and Lima Beans (Javiolli)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken legs | 1 cup chicken stock | 2 teaspoons rice vinegar | 1 1/2 lbs escarole, thinly sliced, washed well and dried | 1 1/2 lbs lima beans or 1 1/2 lbs mixed pulses
instructions: Combine everything together in a large heavy pan.  Cover and place in a 350 degree oven until meat is falling off the bone.  Remove meat and remove the leaves carefully and pat dry.  Return to the pot, cook for one hour more over medium low heat, stirring frequently.  Discard the bones.  Serve.

title: Beer and Pepper Fondue
ingredients: 16 fluid ounces dark beer | 2 -3 lbs green peppers, sliced
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the peppers into slow cooker or fondue pot.  Cover and set heat to low.  Cook for 3 hours.  Drain peppers in sauce.  Serve with warm rolls or crackers.

title: Zesty Grilled Linguine With Peppers and Pepito Pimentos
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 1 fennel bulb, trimmed and thinly sliced vertically | 1 jar sliced pimientos, such as nicoise or vietnamese-variety | 1 lime | 1/2 cup finely chopped pimiento | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Fill a large skillet with enough water to barely cover the bottom of the pan.  Bring to a boil.  Drop in linguine and cook until al dente, about 8 to 10 minutes.  Drain.  Combine fennel, 1/2 of the pimentos and the juice from 1/2 of the lime, pimento, mace and remaining lime in a large bowl.  Toss with pasta to coat.  Grill, covered, over medium heat for 6 to 7 minutes or until puffed and heated through.  Serve immediately.

title: Caribbean Rum
ingredients: 2 tablespoons paprika | 1 1/2 ounces coconut rum ( or other tropical rum )
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a mug.  Serve in an old fashioned glass.

title: Gruyere Mushrooms With Shrimp
ingredients: 24 fresh mushrooms, cleaned and trimmed ( about 2lb in weight ) | 2 lbs raw large shrimp, shelled | 1/2 cup freshly grated gruyere cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Insert a sliver of the zest of a paring knife into the bottom of each mushroom and remove the stems.  Cut the mushrooms into even pieces and then cut each strip crosswise into 1/4 wide strips.  In a large ovenproof skillet, place the shrimp and cook over high heat, with most of the water being absorbed, until the shrimp turn pink, about 4 to 6 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Sprinkle the shrimp with salt and pepper and arrange the mushrooms over the shrimp.  Sprinkle with the gruyere and drizzle on the remaining 1/4 cup of water, tossing the shrimp around.  Bake in a 400 degree f oven for 20 minutes, or until the shrimp are pink and have released their liquid.  Serve at once.

title: Curry Fruit and Chicken Legs
ingredients: 1/3 cup shortening | 2 1/2 cups diced watermelon | 2 1/2 teaspoons curry powder | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme | 6 chicken leg quarters | 1 tablespoon chopped chives
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Melt the shortening in a microwave safe bowl in the microwave, stirring twice, until it is pastel colored and foamy.  Mix in the watermelon, curry powder, and thyme.  Arrange the chicken legs in a single layer in the baking sheet, and pour the melted shortening mixture over them.  Cover, and bake for about 20 minutes, basting every 10 minutes, until chicken is tender.  Sprinkle chicken with chives, and continue baking until chicken is thoroughly cooked.

title: Artichoke Appetizer
ingredients: 1 container marinated artichoke hearts, packed, drained and chopped | 3 tablespoons tahini | 1/2 cup apple cider or 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 5 cups lettuce
instructions: Toss first 3 ingredients together in bowl or ziploc bag.  Serve on bed of lettuce.

Random Ingredients: red onion,cold water,coconut milk,asparagus,mushroom,apple schnapps,cream half,peanut oil
title: Asparagus, Apples, & Mushrooms With Creamy Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs asparagus, woody ends snapped off ( about 2 bunches ) | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 medium red onion, sliced ( use yellow if you have it ) | 3 cups sliced fresh mushrooms ( i use button ) | 1/4 cup low-fat sour cream ( i use light, but i use milk ) | 1/2 cup reduced-fat coconut milk | 1 tablespoon apple schnapps ( recommend applejack ) | 1/2 cup cold water
instructions: If using asparagus, cut off woody ends and snap off asparagus tips.  Trim asparagus tips if needed and discard tough strings.  If using packaged asparagus, cut off woody ends and cut on the diagonal into 2 pieces.  Heat oil in a 3 qt.  Saucepan over medium high heat.  Add onion and cook stirring frequently until softened, about 2 minutes.  Add asparagus and mushrooms and stir 2 minutes more.  Stir in sour cream, coconut milk, schnapps, and water.  Cover and cook stirring 2 minutes until heated through.  Season to taste with salt& pepper.  Serve garnished with sliced tomatoes and cucumbers or green peppers.  Optional toppings, i like hot sauce.  1/2 1 tablespoon fresh grated carrot or 1 teaspoon dried shredded carrot.

Random Ingredients: jasmine rice,flour tortilla,chile powder,cannellini bean,coconut oil
title: Tortillas
ingredients: 1/2 cup shredded coconut | 1 can cannellini beans | 1/2 cup jasmine rice | 1 tablespoon chili powder | 20 flour tortillas | coconut oil for frying
instructions: In a large skillet, over medium heat, mix together the coconut beans with the rice.  Place tortillas in the skillet, then quickly and quickly fry them until slightly charred.  Place them in a paper towel, and sprinkle them with salt.  In a separate skillet, heat some coconut oil and add the chili powder.  Place the tortillas in, and cover with the lid.  Cook for 4 to 5 minutes or till soft.  Remove from heat, and sprinkle with the chile powder, then serve hot.

Random Ingredients: green chili,white hominy,green bell pepper,anchovy,plain yogurt
title: Paleo Popper
ingredients: 1 cup chopped green bell pepper | 1 can white hominy, drained | 7 ounces canned anchovies, drained | 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt | 1 medium green chili, chopped
instructions: Cook the peppers, hominy, anchovies and yogurt over medium heat for about 10 minutes or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: peanut,cake flour,radish,orange sherbet,oil,green cardamom pod,milk ricotta cheese,basmati rice
title: Orange Rice Salad With Rice Crackers
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice | 1/3 cup confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons cake flour | 1 cup milk ricotta cheese or cottage cheese | 3 green cardamom pods | 1/4 cup chopped peanuts | 16 slices orange sherbet, softened | 1 tablespoon oil ( for frying )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions.  Cool.  Drain.  Place rice in a large bowl.  Stir in confectioners' sugar, cake flour, and milk ricotta cheese or cottage cheese.  Toss with noodles, chopped peanuts, and cardamom pods until evenly coated.  Heat oil in a 12 inch nonstick skillet.  Add rice mixture to hot oil and cook until rice turns golden, about 3 minutes.  Transfer to a large salad platter and serve.  Variation, replace orange sherbet with 1 cup of orange juice.  Orange sherbet can be made by substituting 1/2 cup of orange juice, 1/2 cup orange blossom water, or 1/2 cup of sugar syrup for 1 cup of orange juice.

title: Aarti’s Ultimate Nuts
ingredients: 500 g polenta, for every tube | 250 g yoghurt | 150 g walnuts | 50 g guar gum
instructions: Cut the polenta into 2” segments on the diagonal.  Put all of the ingredients in a blender and mix on high speed until everything is moist and smooth.  Refrigerate for 30 minutes.  Use immediately.  Nutty nut walnut variation, you can put in toasted ground nuts, chopped pistachios and raisins.  Some popular variation is to add a little walnut oil.  Also, you can add a pinch of cinnamon.

Random Ingredients: french bread,lime wedge,parmigiano reggiano cheese,pecan,allspice,tequila,green bean
title: Lime Pecan Cheese-Green Beans Bruschetta
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh green beans, trimmed and cut diagonally into 1/2-inch-thick slices | 6 ounces ripe pecans, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup coarsely grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 loaf french bread, cut diagonally in 1/2-inch-thick slices ( baguette preferably ) | 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 3 tablespoons tequila
instructions: Combine green beans and sliced pecans in food processor.  Add parmigiano reggiano cheese, allspice and process until cheese is thoroughly combined.  Arrange bread on baking sheet.  Brush generously with lime juice and top with parmigiano reggiano cheese mixture.  Bake in 300° oven until bread is toasted and cheese is melted.  Serve immediately.

title: Naubergine's Kenyan Yellow Rice
ingredients: 80 g tea bags ( loose tea powder ) | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 chicken stock cube | 1 teaspoon cumin, ground
instructions: Empty all of the ingredients in the pot and mix well.  Cover and cook for 20 minutes.  Fluff up with fork and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken,artichoke heart,feta cheese,taco seasoning,garlic powder,confectioner sugar
title: Chicken Flautas
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, cut into pieces | 4 cloves garlic powder | 2 containers fajita style cheese | 1 can anchovy-flavored artichoke hearts, drained, reserving 1/2 cup liquid to coat | 1 packet taco seasoning | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Toss the chicken pieces with garlic powder, and place in a shallow pan.  Bake at 350 degrees f for about 35 minutes, or until juices run clear.  Rinse artichoke hearts and cut into pieces, and place in a deep bowl.  Pour the reserved artichoke liquid over the artichoke hearts, and place in the refrigerator for several hours.  Spread the taco seasoning on the chicken, and place in an oven.  Bake for 20 minutes, or until hot.  Dust with confectioners' sugar while still hot.

title: Beef and Leek
ingredients: 4 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | 4 leeks, sliced | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 2 cups brown rice
instructions: Place beef and leeks in dutch oven or heavy skillet.  Add water to cover.  Stir in lemon juice.  Cover and simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours, basting every 30 minutes.  Stir in rice.  Cover and cook 30 minutes longer.

title: Perfect Roast Beef
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs roast beef ( about 4-6 lbs total weight ) | salt
instructions: Make sure this is done in a crock or smoker.  Place roast meat in large baking dish or covered crockpot, making sure most of the liquid comes out.  Sprinkle with salt.  Cover and return to crock.  Cover and allow to cook on high for 8 - 9 hours, or medium for 3 - 4 hours.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,kaffir lime leaf,rye bread pumpernickel,snow pea,caper
title: Veggie Snack Sandwiches With Capers
ingredients: 2 slices rye bread ( i use pumpernickel bread which is the kind you find toasted, but anything decent like rye or rye bread will do ) | 2 ounces kraft irish sandwich pickls | 3 ounces snow peas, cut into 2 lengths and rinsed | 2 tablespoons small capers | 1 tablespoon apple juice
instructions: Spread a piece of nori with apple juice, or leave as it is without, you can mix this up to make a sandwich with it if you so like.  The pickles make a great pickle sandwich later, so when you slice them up you get to work on the sandwich while it's still hot, so the sandwich doesn't burn during cooking.  Spread a small pat of capers on each slice of bread and put 3 or 4 pieces on top of each capers.  Wrap the sandwich in the nori, and pop into the oven for a few minutes to heat up, then take out when you are ready to eat.  You may now serve the sandwich in a bag, if so, they go right to the next step.  This recipe doubles up as many as you enjoy.

title: Spinach and Asparagus With Coffee
ingredients: 1 bunch asparagus, trimmed | 2 tablespoons strong brewed coffee | fresh spinach leaves, for garnish
instructions: Bring a medium size pot of water to a boil and add asparagus.  Cover and simmer until tender, 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Beef, Mushroom, and Hazelnut Stir Fry
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground beef | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground chiles | 2 ounces shiitake mushrooms, stemmed, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup salsa | 1 cup coconut milk ( or cream ) | 1/3 cup hazelnuts, toasted and coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine beef, chilies, mushrooms, and salsa in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: ginger,rice vinegar,apple,plain flour,creamy peanut butter,maple syrup,stout beer,cardamom seed
title: Rice Vinegar Stuffed Apples
ingredients: 3 firm apples | 1/4 cup unsalted creamy peanut butter ( light is fine ) | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 teaspoon maple syrup | 3 tablespoons smooth plain flour | 2 teaspoons ginger, minced | 1 teaspoon cardamom seeds, crushed | 1 1/2 tablespoons maple syrup | 4 drops clear stout beer, like guinness | 1 teaspoon rice vinegar
instructions: Peel, core and slice apples in half lengthways, then finely dice the quarters.  Mash peanuts, maple syrup and flour with a fork.  Stir in the ginger, cardamom and maple syrup.  Fill the apples with the mixture, placing them half covered in cling film so they don't fall out of the apple shell.  Push the wedge of apple to one side of the dish to leave a little space around the apples.  Place a small spoonful of the peanut butter mixture onto the empty side of the dish and gently push it in with your finger.  Repeat with the other apples and mixture.  Cover with cling film and place in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours, but not more than 24 hours.  The peanut butter mixture can now be frozen solid for up to 2 weeks.  To make the glaze and pour some of the glaze over the apples and let them sit for 15 minutes.  Sprinkle the remaining glaze over the apples and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: napa cabbage,cranberry sauce,plum,lemon balm,chicken wing,salt pork
title: Chicken Wings with Plum Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings | 2 plums, quartered | 1 head napa cabbage | 1/2 lb salt pork | 1 jar lemon balm | 3/4 cup cranberry sauce
instructions: Cut heads and greens separate into individual leaves.  Remove and discard leaves.  Cut leaves crosswise into halves in half, then split cross wise into 6 sections.  Cut each half in half again so that leaves separate from each other to form 6 pieces.  Set aside.  Remove seeds from plums, slice plum into 12 wedges and set aside.  Cut cabbage into 12 wedges and set each wedge aside.  Cut salt pork into 12 slices.  Set aside.  Rinse chicken pieces under cold water to clear of sand.  Pat dry with paper towel, cut into 6 pieces each.  Pat dry with new towel.  Season each chicken pieces with the salt, pepper and lemon balm.  Wrap each piece with a slice of salt pork pressing in to ensure that salt and pepper mixture sticks.  Set chicken aside.  Heat a large skillet or deep fryer to 375 degrees f.  Place a chicken wing at a time into the oil or fryer and fry until brown.  Remove from oil and place on paper napkins to drain excess oil.  Reserve cooking oil in skillet or deep fryer.  Place plums in skillet and turn over when golden brown.  Remove from skillet and wipe out skillet.  Place cabbage wedges on top of plums.  Place one chicken wing on top of each wedge of plums and roll up.  Place all rolls side by side in a baking dish, then pour remaining cooking oil onto the baking dish.  Cover tightly and bake in a preheated 375 degree oven for 1 hour and 40 minutes or until meat is cooked through.  Add water and cranberry sauce to pan juices.  Bring to a boil.

title: Scottish Crispy Bread on the Cob
ingredients: 3/4 cup light brown sugar | 150 g light ketchup | 2 tablespoons chicken stock cubes | 1 teaspoon grated gingerroot | 1/2 capsicum, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons rye flour
instructions: Put the sugar, ketchup and stock into a saucepan and place over a moderate heat until the liquids are bubbling and the ginger and capsicum are aromatic and beginning to soften but not brown.  Reduce the heat and simmer until the liquid comes to a simmer.  Stir through the rye flour and add to the honey/soup.  Stir well and set aside to cool.  You can do this by putting into a plastic bag the flour, sugar and soy flour to taste and shaking it around until well incorporated, set aside and leave to cool.  Or refrigerate until needed.  Brush a grill with oil and set to medium high.  Preheat and line a foil lined grill tray with baking beans.  Remove the bread from the fridge and roughly chop.  Brush the inside of the baked bread with any excess oil and place on the tray with the baking beans on it.  Brush the tops with more oil as well as season and grill for 2 - 4 minutes until golden and crisp.  Turn and bake on the remaining shelf to crisp and golden in colour.  Cool and serve.

title: Spinach & Beef Meatballs
ingredients: 1 pound hamburger | 3/4 cup currants | 1 egg yolk | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 3/4 cup fresh spinach | 1/4 teaspoon mixed spice | shredded mozzarella cheese ( optional )
instructions: Set oven rack 3 to 4 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler.  Heat a large skillet over medium high heat.  Cook and stir the hamburger 1 to 2 minutes, breaking the crumbles into small pieces with a spoon.  Drain all but 1 tablespoon of the meat juices remaining in the skillet.  Stir in the currants, egg yolk, red pepper flakes, and spinach.  Cook and stir for 1 to 2 minutes, until the spinach is wilted and is tender.  Stir in the mixed spice.  Roll the mixture into 1 inch balls, and place on a baking sheet lined with aluminum foil.  Broil 1 to 2 minutes, until golden brown.

title: The Best Chocolate Baba Balls
ingredients: 1 eggplant | 2 tablespoons instant cocoa
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f.  Place the eggplant in a large pot of lightly salted water and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to low and simmer the eggplant until tender, about 30 minutes.  Drain and leave to cool for 5 minutes.  Peel the skin off and coarsely chop the pulp.  In a medium bowl, mix the ground pulp, eggplant, instant cocoa and salt.  Roll dough into 1 inch balls.  Place balls onto aluminum foil lined pans and bake about 25 minutes in the preheated oven.

Random Ingredients: caper,anise seed,tart apple,grand marnier,chicken wing,green enchilada sauce,white bread,corn tortilla
title: French Toast Casserole
ingredients: 2 cups grated peeled and cored small tart apples | 1 tablespoon drained capers | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 12 bread | 2 dozen cooked chicken wings | 12 corn tortillas, cut into 3-inch squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Lightly spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray.  Sprinkle apples and capers evenly in bottom of dish.  Blend enchilada sauce, grand marnier and anise seeds in a blender or food processor and spread over apples.  Arrange 4 bread squares over sauce mixture.

title: Homemade Powdered Milk
ingredients: 450 g raw milk | 3 -5 tablespoons bread improver, plus some extra bread for dusting
instructions: Please note, the bread must be at room temperature to ensure the whey does not solidify.  If the whey does not solidify, you may need to add a little water.  The bread must dry out a bit at this point.  Place the whey, in a large, wide, straight sided bowl.  Sprinkle 100g bread improver evenly over the surface of the milk.  The surface should be clear, and ideally around the edges.  Leave for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Place the bread in the bowl, using a spoon, a cloth or your hands, and push down with the back of the spoon and absorb any excess water.  Leave for another 45 minutes, or until all the whey has drained out of the liquid.  Leave at room temperature, stirring from time to time, until it has thickened slightly, about a day, then leave to set.  After 30 minutes, it should give away all the extra bread.  To use, simply sprinkle a little flour on the surface of the curds and mix together with a spoon, until it has absorbed the moisture.  Transfer the whey to a clean tea towel or tea towel, and roll out between damp tea towels.  Place in a clean container and leave to set.  At this point, you can store it in an airtight jar, or you can freeze it in one or two thirds.  The whey can be eaten now or it can be frozen for up to another month.

title: Spicy Yellow Squash Stir-Fry
ingredients: 2 lbs yellow squash, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 tablespoons red curry paste, i prefer red | 2 tablespoons shortening
instructions: In a large frypan combine squash, curry paste, and shortening.  Fry until squash is tender and curry is beginning to stick.  Serve over cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,herb,beef chuck,kalamata olive,veal,white balsamic vinegar
title: Kalamata and Veal Kebabs
ingredients: 5 lbs boneless veal, cut 3/4 inch cubes | 1/2 lb veal or 1/2 lb rib eye steak, cut into 2-inch strips | 1/2 lb fresh white balsamic vinegar | 1 cup vegetable oil | 1/4 cup mixed fresh herbs, chopped | 1/2 lb kalamata olive, cut in half lengthwise
instructions: Toss all the ingredients with a fork and allow to marinate at least 1 hour.  Toss the vegetables with the olive oil and allow to sit for 20 minutes before serving.

title: Pasta With Tofu, Caramelized Tofu, and Cheese
ingredients: 1 package tofu | 12 ounces farfalle pasta ( bowtie pasta ) | 1/2 cup dry white wine | 1 tablespoon yellow mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon dry white wine | 1 tablespoon yellow mustard seeds | 1/4 cup cheddar, shredded
instructions: Cut tofu into thin slices.  Heat 1/2 cup water to boiling in a large pot.  Cook pasta in boiling water until tender but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.  Drain.  Meanwhile, in a small skillet, heat 1/4 cup dry white wine and 1 tablespoon yellow mustard seeds over medium heat until the wine evaporates, about 3 seconds.  Stir in noodles and 1/4 pound of shaved tofu.  Cover and remove from heat.  Let stand noodles warm and absorb flavors, about 2 minute.  Sprinkle with mustard seeds and cheddar.

title: Sweet and Sour Red Cabbage-Turkey
ingredients: 4 cups thinly-sliced red cabbage ( about 1/2 of a medium head ) | 1 cup sweet and sour hot sauce | 1/2 cup tahini | 1/2 cup bakers baking cocoa | 1 1/2 lbs lean ground turkey ( preferably very lean )
instructions: Bring first 3 ingredients to a boil in a 2 qt.  Bowl, stirring until the sugar dissolves.  Reduce heat to simmer and simmer, stirring often, until cabbage is tender and mixture has reduced to 1 cup, about 10 minutes.  Stir in sweet and sour hot sauce,.  Cook and stir 1 minute longer.  Cool, then stir in baking cocoa.  Spoon cabbage mixture into a buttered 8 by 8 x2 baking dish.  Preheat the oven to 350°f.  Bake the turkey uncovered for about 25 - 30 minutes, or until hot and cooked through.  Serve with cabbage mixture.

title: Coconut Asparagus Rice
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, uncooked | 12 spears asparagus, trimmed | 1/3 cup light cream of coconut ( or coconut extract ) | 1/2 cup bottled pasta sauce, your favourite
instructions: Cook rice, asparagus and cream of coconut on stovetop, covered, about 18 - 25 minutes, stirring frequently until rice is tender and asparagus is crisp tender.

Random Ingredients: pizza sauce,rom tomato,star anise,white mustard seed,limoncello,cilantro stem
title: Tomato Salsa
ingredients: 4 roma tomatoes, diced | 2 tablespoons minced fresh cilantro stems | 2 tablespoons finely minced fresh limoncello | 1 2/3 teaspoons coarse white mustard seeds | 3/4 teaspoon crushed star anise | 1 bottle pizza sauce

title: Tofu Burrito
ingredients: 2/3 cup peanut butter | 4 ounces sliced tofu | 1 jar mild picante sauce
instructions: Melt peanut butter in a small skillet over medium heat.  Stir in tofu, and cook until browned.  Spoon about 2 tablespoons of the picante sauce onto a plate, and lay a piece of tofu onto top, overlapping slightly.  Roll the tortilla into a burrito shape, and wrap in plastic wrap.  Repeat with remaining burritos.  Cut vegetables around the tofu, and serve at once.

title: Mexican Asparagus Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh asparagus, peeled, cut in 3-inch lengths | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots ( drained or julienned, if desired ) | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 1/4 cup vinegar | 1/4 cup cornstarch | 3/4 cup thick fat-free half-and-half
instructions: Set oven to 350°.  Grease casserole dish.  In a large bowl, toss asparagus and bamboo shoots, then season with taco seasoning mix and vinegar.  In a small bowl, mash together cornstarch, fat free half and half, until it has the consistency of thick cream.  Stir into mixture in pan just until it begins to thicken and begins to set the asparagus.  Transfer to prepared casserole dish.  Bake for 40 minutes.

title: Spicy Broccoli Puree

instructions: Remove woody outer leaves from broccoli stems, and cut in half lengthwise.  Remove stems, reserving remaining 1/2 inch of remaining leafy green tops.  Wrap the cloves in cheesecloth and secure with kitchen twine or kitchen twine.  Bring 2 quarts of water to boil in large pot.  Place 1 chile in water.

title: Olive Garden Sangria

instructions: Combine ice, cabbage, celery seed, sultanas, sausage and cointre together.  Slice kielbasa at a slight angle and place in a glass pitcher.  Add soda.  Just before serving stir through lettuce, ladle over ice.

title: Easy Herring Lasagna
ingredients: 2 jars prepared double crust lasagna noodles | 8 ounces extra lean ground beef | 1 tablespoon mirin | 8 ounces peeled and thinly sliced apples | 1 tablespoon chopped celery | 1 tablespoon chopped pitted plum, drained, optional
instructions: Preheat an oven to 375 degrees f.  Pour half of the prepared tomato sauce onto each sheet of lasagna noodles, and top with ground beef, mirin, apples, celery, and plum, if using.  Roll into a tight cylindrical shape, and pinch ends together.  Arrange in a 9x13 inch baking dish, and cover loosely with aluminum foil.  Bake in preheated oven until the sauce is bubbling and the cheese is bubbling, about 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Chinese Spicy Chile Eggs
ingredients: 1 large hard boiled egg, peel left as it, finely julienned | 1 red chili peppers, finely julienned
instructions: In a hot frying pan, place chili pepper and egg and lightly fry until egg turns colour.  This should take 3 - 5 minutes before egg is finished cooking.  Serve immediately.

title: Spicy Vegetable and Noodle Lasagne

Heat oven to 350°f arrange lasagne on 3 baking sheets lined with parchment paper.  Brush with a little lard or oil.  Top with about 1/2 cup of the vegetables.

title: Chicken, Chunk and Almond Soup

instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a stockpot over a high heat.  Add the swordfish or rump steak, and gently fry for 5 minutes.  Reduce the heat to low and add the thyme sprigs. title: Black-Eyed Pea and Artichoke Tacos
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil | 14 ounces artichokes, quartered | 12 large frozen artichoke slices | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 1/2 cups romaine lettuce | 16 6-inch flour tortillas
instructions: Heat 2 tbls oil in a frying pan over highest heat.  Scrape bottom of pan with spatula to remove film and add 8oz artichokes.  Let brown lightly for 10 minutes and then remove. Shake together and set aside.  Heat tortillas in oil on medium heat just until warm.  Remove from pot and place on a plate.  Serve with salad and salsa.

title: Sauteed Rice
ingredients:
1 1/4 cups brown rice, dry | 1 tablespoon peanut oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 2 cloves garlic, minced ( i use 1-2 tsp.
    - ) | 1 dash of ground nutmeg | 1 dash capers, dried or 1 dash cayenne pepper
instructions: Rinse rice well under hot water and drain completely.  Heat oil in a medium saute pan on medium heat.  When hot, add garlic stirring constantly, let garlic cook 1 minute.  Add rice and stir to coat.  Add nutmeg and hot capers.  Stir until the spices are absorbed by the rice, stir and cover. title: Stuffed Green Chilies
ingredients: 6 medium pablano-style green chilies | 2 cups crumbled feta-style cheese | 1/4 cup diced pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Trim the stems off the chilies, and then slit them open about one third of the way down the length of the chilies.  Remove the seeds and membrane, leaving about 1 1/2 inch of flesh inside the slit.  In a bowl, mix together the cheese and pecorino romano cheese.  Fill the chilies with cheese mixture.  Arrange on a baking sheet.  Bake for 20 minutes, or until sauce bubbles and the cheese is melted and slightly browned.

title: Pineapple Radish and Manchego Salad
ingredients: 3 small large pink swiss radishes ( about 20 ) | 4 cups unsweetened pineapple juice | 2/3 cup grated manchego cheese | 1 teaspoon finely chopped of fresh mint leaves | 2 cups hot stock
instructions: Using a mandolin, slice the radish thin.  Cut radish in half, then cut across into ½ inch thick slices.  Place radishes and 1/2 cup each of the pineapple juice and cheese in a bowl.  Mound radish slices onto radish and cheese in a serving bowl.  Add the mint and remaining pineapple juice.  Stir in the hot stock.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: snow pea,zucchini,portabella mushroom,tomato green chilies,pastry crust pie,mexican beer,cardamom pod
title: Pierogi Pizza
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs frozen ravioli or 1 1/2 lbs thin-cut packaged fresh snow peas | 1 cup zucchini | 1/2 cup portabella mushroom | 1 can tomatoes and green chilies | 1 pint mexican beer | 1 teaspoon cardamom pod | 1 pastry for a 9 pie crust
instructions: In the freezer, prepare ravioli according to package directions.  Drain, and set aside.  If using frozen peas, thaw a bit, and press them well with a potato masher to help mash.  In a large skillet, heat beer and bring to a boil.  Add zucchini with liquid mixture, mushrooms, and tomatoes, and simmer for 12 minutes.  If using frozen peas, thaw at least 4 hours.  Preheat oven to 450°f.  Remove ravioli from freezer, and pat dry.  Pour sauce into a 9x13 glass baking dish, and spread to cover the bottom.  Place ravioli on sauce.  Top with second layer of ravioli, and spoon remaining sauce equally over the top.  Sprinkle with cardamom, and bake for 15 - 20 minutes, or until the crust is browned.

Random Ingredients: oil,cayenne pepper,ginger juice,sandwich bread,yam,shell pasta,anchovy fillet,rump roast
title: Stuffed Yams With Sosaties and Anchovies
ingredients:
12 small baby yams | 12 small rump roast or 12 small pompano anchovies ( 3 pcs.
    - if in bulk ) | 2 tablespoons oil | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger juice | 1 pinch cayenne pepper ( to taste ) | 3 -4 slices sandwich bread | 2 tablespoons anchovies fillets | 12 pieces crusty bread
instructions: Cut a round hat top corner off of each yam.  Roughly slice off 1/2 from each end of the yam.  Tie the ends of the yams together with kitchen string to form a circle 2 inch in diameter.  Heat 1 tbsp oil in a 12 fry pan over high heat.  Sear the yams for 10 - 15 minutes on each side until a rich golden crust forms.  Remove the yams from the pan.  Add 1 tbsp oil to the fry pan and cook the ginger juice and cayenne for 5 minutes.  Season with salt.  Pour in the marinade and cook, stirring, for 2 - 3 minutes, then set aside to cool.  Cut off their shells so that the yams will fit in the moulds of your moulds.  Take 4 shell cases, fill with a small pat of stuffing.  Place the yams on a plate and place the second shell on top and cover with foil to keep warm.  Preheat oven 200c / 400f / gas heat remaining oil in a 12 frying pan over medium heat and brown the meat for about 20 minutes, then remove and reserve.  Add a little oil to the pan, scraping away any bits from the bottom of the pan.  Add anchovies and cook for 1 - 2 minutes, until they turn golden.  Spread the anchovy pieces on the yams and bake at 200c/ 400f/ gas for about 10 minutes, until they are nicely browned.  Drain the yams and serve.

title: Salmon Sushi Roll
ingredients: 7 ounces salmon fillets | 1 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup dry red wine | 1 sheet nori, cut into 1 inch squares | 1 pound fresh asparagus, trimmed
instructions: Wash salmon in cold water.  Remove any bones and scales.  Cut into 1/2 inch pieces.  Combine the flour and red wine in a large resealable plastic bag.  Place the salmon, skin side up, into the bag.  Squeeze out any excess air.  Divide the flour and red wine mixture into 4 portions and put each portion in the center of the cooked salmon pieces.  Wrap each piece completely with nori squares, leaving 1 inch around each piece of nori.  Wet the edge of each roll with water and place water in a bamboo sushi rolling steamer.  Cover and bring to a boil over high heat.  Reduce heat to low and cook until the salmon is opaque but easily flaked, about 20 minutes.  Turn the salmon over halfway through cooking, remove from the steamer, and cut in half diagonally, to make 12 pieces.  Arrange the pieces on bamboo skewers.  If using bamboo skewers, soak at room temperature for 10 minutes before using.  Wrap the rolls tightly with the nori and refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Melon-Guacamole Hummus
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups soymilk, divided | 1 cup guacamole | 1 cup guacamole | 3/4 cup diced, cooked garbanzo beans | 1 large guacamole | 1/4 cup diced, cooked honeydew melon
instructions: In a food processor, mix 2/3 cup soymilk, 1 cup guacamole, 3/4 cup guacamole, and 2 tablespoons guacamole until smooth.  Stir 1/4 cup guacamole into the other 3/3 cup of soymilk.  Pour mixture into a serving dish.  Top with diced garbanzo beans, and cover with remaining guacamole.  Serve warm.

title: Roasted Beetroot - 1/4 Chai
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 4 large beets, medium, scrubbed
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f lightly oil a medium sized non stick roasting pan.  Toast coriander seeds in 1 tablespoon of hot water, swirling until fragrant.  Grind seeds in food mill in small batches to fine powder.  Toss beetroot in a bowl with 2 teaspoons of roasted coriander.  Spread evenly on prepared baking pan.  Roast until beets have collapsed and are tender and beginning to brown around the edges, about an hour and 15 minutes, tossing and rotating pan frequently.  Tent and cool before serving.  You could also serve the roasted beetroot with roasted jasmine tea.

instructions: Put lettuce in a large bowl.  Mix corn, green cabbage, ham, caesar salad dressing, and vanilla sugar, and pour over the lettuce.

Add cabbage, potatoes, bamboo shoots, tomatoes, and cilantro.  Simmer at least 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender.  Garnish with cilantro sprigs.

instructions: Combine the peach and white wine vinegar in a medium bowl and mix well.  Cover with plastic wrap and set aside at room temperature for 30 minutes.  Strain dressing through a sieve placed over a bowl and discard the skins.  Chill until ready to use.

instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the soup, garlic salt, currants, and fenugreek.  The soup is ready to serve.

title: Eggs Butcher Style
ingredients:
6 large egg-free eggs ( aprox.
    - size ) | 1/2 cup tomato juice | 1 -2 chopped green chili ( or 1/2 c.
    - red hot green chili chopped )
instructions: Beat egg free egg and tomato juice and chili together till smooth.  Heat a nonstick pan over low to medium low heat and coat with nonstick spray. Remove egg from pan onto a plate.  You can keep warm in a low oven.  Eat warm or cold as preferred.

title: Spicy Macaroni
ingredients: 1 package macaroni | 1 can diced green bell peppers, drained | 1 can yellow peppers, drained | 1/2 cup sliced green onions | 1 tablespoon gram flour or 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 3/4 - 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom seed
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.  Drain and rinse thoroughly with cold water to cool.  Toss all ingredients except macaroni in a large skillet.  Cover and cook over med heat until vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally.  Toss with cooked pasta and serve warm, or as a topping for your favorite breakfast dish.

title: Easy Baklava
ingredients: 8 sheets phyllo pastry in sheets ( or 24 sheets ) | 8 -10 tablespoons ice cream | 1 cup maraschino cherry, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon ginger powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Place a sheet of filo on a cookie sheet, shiny side down.  Using an ice cream scoop or teaspoon, scoop out about 2 tablespoons of ice cream from the container.  Place cherry on sheet, then lightly brush top of pastry with a little warm water.  Place 3 sheets of phyllo in a single layer on the cookie sheet.  Brush top sheet with cold water.  Repeat until you have 12 sheets of phyllo and 10 sheets of phyllo or 24 sheets of phyllo.  Spoon ice cream into the center of the phyllo sheets.  Top with another row of phyllo or phyllo sheets, brushing each one with water.  Starting from a long side, place 4 - 6 ice cream/cherries, cut side down, over the pastry.  Fold the sides over the ice cream and cherry.  Press edges to seal.  You can use a spoon to gently push a few air pockets into the pastry until it looks neat and shaped.  Bake in oven for 40 minutes to an hour, till golden brown.  When done, place on a cutting board and enjoy.

title: Curried Chiles
ingredients: 6 large poblano chiles | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 2 eggs | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh chives | 1/3 cup orange juice | 2 tablespoons distilled white vinegar | 2 tablespoons chicken broth
instructions: Heat a grill pan or grill pan over medium high heat.  Place chiles on the grill and grill, turning frequently, until charred, about 5 minutes.  Transfer to a bowl and cover with plastic wrap.  Allow chiles to steam until mostly cool, about 15 minutes.  Remove chiles from the plastic and peel, removing seeds, ribs, and seeds.  Cut them in half, lengthwise, then in half again crosswise.  Place chiles in a food processor with curry powder, eggs, half and half, chives, orange juice, vinegar, and broth.  Process until just blended, scraping down sides of bowl occasionally.  Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Pour in the chile mixture and cook, stirring, until heated through, about 2 minutes.

title: Tessa's Spanakopita
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed | 4 shallots or 2 onions, chopped | 4 cardamom seeds | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon cardamom, ground | 1/2 - 1 cup fresh whipped topping ( for topping if desired ) ( optional )
instructions: If using onion or shallots with the insides, make sure to chop them first before cooking.  Preheat oven to 425 degrees.  Spray a cookie sheet with pam or oil.  Roll the puff pastry out on lightly floured work surface.  Cut into 2 circles about 10 inches square, brush each circle with oil or butter.  If desired, press each circle of dough into a circle with hands until thin enough for spreading on top.  Using the tines of a fork, prick each circle of dough and push the center slightly toward the outside edge so that it stays sealed.  On the cookie sheet, spread filling until it just covers the edges of the circle.  Gently press the edges of the dough together.  If desired, brush with more oil or butter and sprinkle with cardamom seeds, crushed cardamom or other ground spices.  Cut each circle in half so that once every cut circle is covered, make several smaller cutouts.  Place dough cutouts in a small casserole dish and bake in 425 or 450 degree oven, turning and heating 1 or 2 minutes or until the edges are golden brown and crust just begins to brown.

title: Baked Mexican Pizza(Pizza)
ingredients: 1/4 cup instant dried yeast | 3 1/4 cups flour, approximate | 10 ounces spaghetti, your favourite kind | 1 can green beans, sliced, drained, rinsed a bit | 10 ounces chicken bouillon granules, granules ( equivalent ) | corn chips ( optional )
instructions: Soak beans for 30 minutes in water to soften, and cut them in half if large.  In a large mixing bowl, combine the drained beans, and a little bit of the chicken bouillon, to make a paste.  Add the flour, and make a well in the center of the batter.  Dissolve one egg, and the rest of the bouillon in about 30 cups cold water.  While the water is coming to a boil, dissolve the yeast in the rest of the water, and set aside.  Add oil that you have already dissolved into the water, and heat it on the stove.  If the oil is not hot enough, the yeast will begin to form a frothy mess in the center.  Pour the yeast water into the flour, and beat vigorously and quickly with a wooden spoon.  Add all the remaining ingredients except the corn chips, and continue beating until the batter is very smooth and creamy.  Dip the corn chips in the batter, and allow excess water to run back into the bowl.  This is optional, but makes the dough more fleshed out.  Allow dough to rise for 30 minutes, until it has doubled in size.  If you have the dough to wait, it's already doubled.  When it rises again, turn it out onto a baking/sandwich sheet, and add some more crushed corn chips in, about 2 tablespoons per pizza.  If more toppings go into the oven, bake the pan for 15 minutes at 400, or until browned on top.  It doesn't rise very long, and you may have to add more liquid or water.  You don't want to go over the edge of the pan.  If you bake it at 450, it will only be a couple of minutes before the toppings will be done.  The pizza will get a nice crust, and the top will be nice and crisp.  If it has to wait a few minutes before you place it on the baking sheet, be sure to cover it with wax paper, and carefully transfer the pizza to foil, or a cookie sheet, in the oven.

title: Spiced Swiss Chard With Arugula.

instructions: Steam the kale and arugula in salted boiling water for 5 - 7 mins or until tender.  Meanwhile fry the capsicum and chile powder in a tbsp of oil until soft.  Remove the lid and allow the mixture to cool slightly.  Preheat oven to 200c/180c fan.  Combine the breadcrumbs and semolina in a bowl, mix well.  Add the breadcrumb mix and knead well.  Lightly press some of the breadcrumb mix onto the tops of the stalks of the chard, leaving about 1 1/2cm clear around the edges.  Place the stalk on a baking tray and add a drizzle of oil.  Bake for 10 minutes until tender, crisp and brown.  If the breadcrumb mixture starts to colour too quickly, cover with a plate to avoid burning your hands.  If you want, you can remove the leaves for a few minutes to get rid of any excess moisture.  You can place the chard in a serving plate, then top with the swiss chard, capsicum, rocket, chopped green onions and chives.  Serve.

title: Grilled Beef Salpicao
ingredients: 1 sesame oil, or as needed | 1 pound lean filet mignon ( very thin slices ) | 6 dashes liquid smoke, or to taste
instructions: Heat a grill to medium heat.  Brush sesame oil onto both sides of the mignon slices.

title: Lemon Pepper Mayo Tortilla
ingredients: 6 large tortillas, cut into 1-1/2-inch strips | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1 dash chili oil ( optional )
instructions: Arrange the tortilla strips on a baking sheet.  Pour enough lemon pepper mayonnaise to cover the tortilla and bake at 450 degrees f until beginning to brown, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Shrimp Bruschetta
ingredients: 1 loaf italian bread | 1 jar shrimp | 1 slice sourdough bread | 1 lb pecans | 1/4 cup chopped pecans | 1 teaspoon tarragon | 4 tablespoons olive oil | 1/8 teaspoon vanilla | 20 jumbo jumbo shrimp, peeled
instructions: First, pre heat your oven 400 degrees f.  Cut the loaf into 1/2 thick slices, but not all the way through.  Remove the crusts from the bread, leaving 1/4 of the bread still attached.  Cut the loaf into 1 pieces, and set aside.  Remove the shrimp from your shells, and set aside also.  Pull out the shrimp meat, put the shrimp aside.  Drain the shrimp shells of any excess oil, and set aside.  Toast your pecan nuts, and set aside.  Add your shrimp to the bread mixture.  Next, toast your sourdough bread.  Take your bread out of your oven, and toast your shrimp.  Take your shrimp out of your oven, and take your bread and shrimp out of the oven.  Put your shrimp on top of the other bread in the loaf.  After that, sprinkle the nut and chopped pecans on top of the shrimp, and then drizzle your olive oil onto the bread, but don't let the oil get entirely into the bread.  Put back in oven for 15 minutes, until bread is golden.  Remove from oven and let cool in the oven for 15 minutes on a wire rack.  Serve it warm.

title: Pesto-Wrapped Salmon
ingredients: 1 cup loosely packed fresh pesto sauce | 1 1/2 cups cubed cooked salmon | 1 package frozen broccoli, rinsed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Arrange the salmon and broccoli in a large baking dish or roasting pan.  Pour the pesto over all, and mix gently to coat.  Bake 15 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the salmon is easily flaked with a fork.  Serve immediately.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,cardamom,coconut,tomato green chilies,eggplant,pumpkin puree,caper,rice noodle
title: Coconut Noodle Samosas
ingredients: 2 eggplants, sliced into half-moons | 2 cans pumpkin puree | 1 can tomato and green chilies | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons cardamoms | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 tablespoons drained capers | 1 lb rice noodles, cooked | 1/4 cup drained grated coconut
instructions: Arrange the eggplant slices in a single layer in two 13x9x2 inch baking dishes.  Mix together the pumpkin filling and tomato chilies.  Spoon over eggplant.  In a small bowl, stir together ginger garlic paste, cardamom, and cardamom seeds.  Spread over top of dish.  Sprinkle with capers and cilantro.  Bake at 350°f on a baking sheet for 45 minutes.  Uncover and bake about 15 minutes longer, until slightly golden.  Cool slightly.  Serve with cooked noodles and drizzle coconut sauce.

Random Ingredients: lobster tail,red chili pepper,oil,french vanilla coffee creamer,milk chocolate
title: Lobster Delight
ingredients: 24 large lobster tails | 2 tablespoons french vanilla instant coffee creamer | 1 fluid ounce milk chocolate, chopped | oil | 4 -5 small fresh red chili peppers, halved ( to taste )
instructions: If lobster tails are big you may want to cut them in half lengthwise and to cut back on the backbones.  In a small bowl mix the creamer and pepper, set aside.  In a separate bowl place milk chocolate and microwave until melted.  Add to melted chocolate and stir.  Set aside.  In a hot non stick skillet or tostada pan over gentle high heat add a few drops of oil to coat the bottom and sides.  Add a few prawns/lobster tail pieces and gently turn lobster in this order, shrimp, and lobster, etc.  Cook for 5 minutes or until lobster is almost cooked.  Add green chile pepper halves to top and serve with jasmin bread to dip in melted chocolate.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,thyme,stove stuffing mix,rice wine,self rising flour,green cardamom pod,ranch dressing
title: French Onion Stuffed Pot Stomach
ingredients: 12 large raw stove top stuffing mix ( store-bought ) | 1 cup caster sugar | 1 cup mixed green cardamom pods ( about 2 pods ) | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme ( about 3/4 cup ) | 2 tablespoons fresh-made ranch dressing ( use your own, store-bought is best ) | 2 tablespoons rice wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 cup self-rising flour, plus extra for dusting
instructions: Prick the bottoms of the 12 large tentacles with a skewer or better yet a toothpick to help hold together while baking.  Scoop out the centers leaving about ½ inch of the stuffing room.  Stuff each with 2 tbsp stuffing mix, then set aside.  Place the sugar, cardamom pods, thyme & 1/2 tsp of ranch dressing in a bowl & mix well until the sugar is dissolved.  Add the remaining mustard, cover & chill the mixture in the fridge for at least 1 hour, up to 4 hours to allow the flavours to develop.  Meanwhile, heat a ridged frying pan over a medium heat.  Dust 1 cup flour into the pan & tip in the remaining dry ingredients & shake around until the flour has absorbed the oil.  Stir the mixture, adding more flour if it becomes dry.  Keep stirring until the mixture is a nice paste like consistency.  Turn off the heat & add the reserved stuffing mixture.  Spoon the filling into the prepared tentacles & set aside.  Preheat the oven to 200c/140c fan forced / gas mark dust the remaining 1 cup flour on a tray.  Roll the stuffed tentacles in the flour & lay them on the tray in a single layer, being careful not to pierce the tops or they will cook over the barbecue.  Bake for 50 - 60 min or until the tops are nicely browned & the filling has set.  Serve warm with cream or ice cream.

title: Sweet Potato Sweet
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornmeal | 3 tablespoons cornmeal | 1/2 cup white flour | 1/4 teaspoon black peppercorns | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne ( optional ) | 1 large sweet potato, peeled and cut into bite-size chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  In a medium mixing bowl, combine cornmeal, cornmeal, peppercorns and cayenne.  Add sweet potato pieces and toss to coat.  Transfer sweet potato mixture to a lightly oiled baking sheet to bake at 375 degrees f for 20 minutes or until fork tender.

title: Spiced Cream Cheese Dip (Dorie Greenspan)
ingredients: 500 g cream cheese | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander seeds | 2 tablespoons cracked pepper
instructions: In a small pan cook the coriander seeds with the pepper until the oil floats on the top.  Take off the heat and leave aside to cool.  Add the cream cheese to a food processor and process until smooth and creamy, adding more cream if too thick.  Add the coriander and process once again until just combined.  The dip is ready to chill thoroughly for about 1 hour or until firm.  Serve on your favourite breaded veggies, such as fresh fruit, fresh breads or crackers.

title: Vanilla Bean Cream Soup With Coconut and Coconut
ingredients: 2 cans cream of chicken soup | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour or 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/2 cup shredded coconut
instructions: Open the can of cream of chicken soup in the can.  The soup can help the split vanilla bean release it's flavor as it sits.  If you need just a few drops of coconut extract, the stock can be made up to 1 day ahead so the flavors have a chance to infuse the soup.  Pour the soup into a large stock bowl and pour the vanilla bean pod inside.  Mix the flour or cornstarch in a small bowl.  Sprinkle a few drops of coconut extract or coconut extract on top.  Pour the dissolved mixture over the soup.  Refrigerate the soup for up to 2 hours, or overnight.  Discard the vanilla bean pod.  Reheat gently so the flavors don't mingle.  Serve warm, with shredded coconut on the side.

Random Ingredients: malt vinegar,black mustard seed,limeade concentrate,macadamia nut,cauliflower,veal,balsamic vinegar
title: Veal With Macadamia Nuts and Mustard
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground veal | 1/2 lb ground veal | 1/4 cup malt vinegar | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 can prepared prepared limeade concentrate | 1 teaspoon black mustard seeds | 1 cup cauliflower, finely chopped | 1/2 cup macadamia nuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place the ground meats into a frying pan.  Add all of the ingredients except for the cauliflower and nuts.  When the meat is cooked, add chopped cauliflower and nuts.  Cook until all of the vegetables are mixed in.

ingredients: 14 ounces no-salt-added whole tomatoes | 7 ounces canned diced green chilies | 10 2/3 ounces light cream | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1/4 cup sweet marsala wine
instructions: Pulse tomatoes and chilies in food processor until finely chopped, about 8 pulses.  Add cream, five spice powder and wine.  Mix well.  Spoon 1/2 cup of sauce into 1 cup tortilla and roll enchilada.  Roll up and place seam side down in casserole.  Pour any remaining sauce over enchiladas.  Cover tightly with aluminum foil, and place in heated 375°f oven for about 20 minutes.  Uncover.  Simmer, stirring often, for 7 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: italian dressing,vanilla extract,lamb rib chop,american cheese,veal,parmesan cheese

instructions: In a slow cooker, stir together lamb, veal, and italian dressing.

title: Lard and Sage Noodles

instructions: Combine 2 tablespoons of the sage and the remaining 1/8 cup of sage in a mortar with a rolling pin.  Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of sage and mix well.  Spread the butter evenly over the beef and sprinkle generously with the remaining 1/2 teaspoon dried sage.  Refrigerate the meat, loosely covered, for at least 1 hour.  Bring to room temperature before using.

title: Frislin' Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken legs | 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 2 tablespoons whole white flour | 1 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Wash the chicken legs, removing any excess fat.  Place the chicken legs in a large saucepan or pressure cooker.  Sprinkle with garlic.  Pour on enough water to cover the chicken.  Put the pan or pressure cooker on medium high heat.  Reduce the heat to low and cover.  Cook for 3 hours, or until the chicken legs are tender.  Turn off the heat.  Let the chicken cool and refrigerate overnight.  Remove the legs from the fridge and place in a single layer on a baking paper lined tray or tray.  Place into a refrigerator.  Pour enough cold water over the legs to cover and refrigerate overnight.  The next day, drain the legs from the water and discard the skin.  Discard the skin.  Rinse with cold water.  Slice or shred the legs into thin strips.  Place back into the refrigerator.  Turn off the heat.  When ready to serve, let the chicken sit in the refrigerator until it's completely chilled.  This will help mellow the taste of the sauce.  Serve with rice and salad.

title: Beef and Barley Wraps (Gourmet Crock Pot)

instructions: Slice the roast in thin slivers, cutting about 3/4 inch long.  Cut the mushroom in half and chop the caps.  Place all ingredients, except the lettuce and portabella mushrooms and the beef, in a slow cooker and stir to mix well.  Cover and cook on low for about 6 hours or on high for 4 hours.  After about 1 hour, stir in some water.  The end, remove the meat and mushrooms and serve.  As a side or filling dish, place some lettuce leaves on a plate and spread some of the beef and barley mixture on top.  Sprinkle on some mushrooms too.

title: Mock Bull's Eye Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup worcestershire sauce | 5 -6 tablespoons seasoning
instructions: Combine all ingredients and chill for at least 1 hour before using.

Whisk the lemon pepper seasoning and liquid smoke together in a bowl.  Stir in the anchovies.  Place the mashed avocados in a bowl, and toss with the sauce.  Stir in the grand marnier.

title: Spring Rolls

instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c.  In a medium bowl combine spring roll wraps with onion and roast beef.

title: Easy Chile Rellenos
ingredients: 1 lb american cheese, grated ( cheddar, swiss or any cheese of your choice ) | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 1/4 cup plain flour | 1/2 cup fresh lemon lime beverage ( i 'b a gourmet dieter ', it's cheap stuff ) | 2 -3 poblano chiles ( red and or or or orange )
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 deg celsius.  Using a pastry bag fitted with a plain pastry tip, poke holes in the cheese all over leaving a 2cm thick border.  Pour in the sesame seeds and coat the cheese lightly.  Dissolve the sugar in the lime juice, pour this over the cheese and leave to sit for 20 - 30 minutes.  Turn on oven to 200 deg celsius.  Line baking trays with baking paper and spoon the cheese into the tray.  Bake the cheese for about 15 - 20 minutes until just lightly golden brown and melted.  Remove from oven and cool slightly on the trays.  Place chili in an oven to heat through.  Meanwhile, in a small frying pan or griddle, toast the sesame seeds over a medium heat for a few minutes.  Stir frequently to prevent burning.  Remove from the heat and spread lightly with a paper towel.  When cool, remove seeds from the oven and place the chilies on the baking paper.  Bake for about 10 minutes until soft but not brown.  Cool.  Once cool, remove the stem and seeds and dice.  Use a spoon to divide the mixture into portions.  Dip chilies in the sesame seeds and serve.  Can also be served with salsa, refried beans and fresh fruit.

title: Fish Fillet with Gouda Cheese
ingredients: 800 g fish fillets | 2 tablespoons gouda cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/400f/gas put the fish in a oven proof dish.  Sprinkle over the cheese.  Place in the preheated oven for 10 - 15 minutes, until the fish flakes easily and the cheese starts to bubble.  Serve with a green salad, if you like.

title: Chill Sticky Fajitas Chicken Breast and Sausage for Two

Cut each strip into two strips and thread onto 2 metal skewers.  Cook in a slow cooker on high uncovered for 10 minutes after the 10 minutes.  Remove and allow them to cool slightly.  Serve the grilled or grilled sausage pieces hot along with the cherry roasted vegies.

title: Baked Beans With Cashews

instructions: Preheat the oven to 170c, 400f or gas mark toast the cashew nuts and red pepper together for 5 minutes, or until slightly coloured.  Remove and allow to cool.  Cut the bread into 2cm squares.  Tear the cashews into large pieces, and roughly break apart in a food processor.  Stir the cashew mixture into the bread and combine.  Spread the bean mix into a round or square baking tin, and add the sweet baked beans.  Sprinkle over the ground curry powder and stir.  Bake at 170c or 400f for 25 - 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

instructions: Cut steak into thin, thin slices, sprinkle with 1 packet of onion soup mix, 1 tsp lemon grass.  Combine 1/4 of onion soup mix and 1/2 of anaheim chilies in slow cooker.  Place beef and onion rings in slow cooker.  Sprinkle with remaining onion soup mix and fennel powder, then top with remaining anaheim chilies.  Cover, cook on low for 7 hours or on high for 4 - 6 hours until steak is tender.

title: Pea Podsicles

instructions: Drain peas and onion thoroughly in a colander.  Place onion in a small heavy saucepan with a tight fitting lid.  Add enough cold water to cover the onion and bring to boil over high heat.  Add peas and return to boil.  Cook for 3 - 4 minutes, until just heated through.  Remove peas from heat and stir in sherbert and tabasco.  Cover and chill, uncovered, until cool, at least 1 hour.  Drop peas into ice cube tray.  Freeze to your liking.

Spoon over the orange zest mixture, cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes.  Preheat oven to 400°f.  Remove salmon from marinade and arrange on the foil lined baking tray.  Bake until just cooked, 12 - 15 minutes.  Let cool slightly.

Add the spring onion, curry paste and cabbage.  Toss until well coated.  Arrange on pizza peel and bake in oven 10 minute or until bubbly.  Cut into 4 triangles.

title: Fiesta Duck

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Season duck with salt and pepper.  Arrange skin side down in oven safe baking pan.  Bake for 35 minutes, then remove from oven and set aside. Return to oven, bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until warmed through.  Serve with tortillas, salsa, and salad of your choice.

title: Mushrooms With Wine Vinegar

instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a large frying pan over a moderate heat.  Add the mushrooms and cook until they're just tender.  Remove from the heat, add the vinegar and mix well.  Pour the mushrooms and vinegar into a bowl and season, adding more salt to taste.  Serve.

Repeat with other ingredients until all cheese is used up and bacon has been used up.  Spread reserved cheese on top, and allow to cool to room temperature.  Cut into wedges, and serve.

title: Beef Burger
ingredients: 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 teaspoon dry mustard powder | 1 can diced green chile peppers | 1 1/3 cups fine dry breadcrumbs | 8 teaspoons dry pecans, chopped | 1 1/4 lbs top sirloin steaks, cut in 1/2-inch thick slices | 1 can refrigerated original rolls, room temperature
instructions: Preheat the broiler or grill.  Lightly grease a medium baking pan.  In a medium bowl, mix together the baking powder, mustard and chili peppers.  Combine the bread crumbs and pecans in a medium bowl.  Dredge the beef slices in the bread crumb mixture then press in the pecans.  Lightly oil the broiler or grill and place the beef slices on the baking pan.  Broil or grill for about 15 minutes, turning once, or until slightly charred.  To store, wrap the burgers in foil and either place in a plastic bag for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 3 months.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,coriander powder,rye bread,asparagus,hot red pepper flake,bell pepper,navy bean
title: Swedish Cold Bread & Veggies(Vegan)
ingredients: 1 loaf rye bread ( white or wheat for those of you who like spicier bread for a change i use pepperidge farm ) | 2 tablespoons graham cracker crumbs | 2 tablespoons roasted sweet bell peppers, drained ( in a jar ) | 1/2 teaspoon hot red pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 1 can navy beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 1/2 small swedish asparagus, trimmed and chopped
instructions: Cut the bread into 8 slices and lightly butter the slice.  Place a layer of the cold bread into the pan, top with the cracker crumbs, then the bell peppers, red pepper flakes and coriander powders to taste.  Top with a layer of beans and sprinkle with the swedish asparagus.  Cover with remaining bread slices and cut in cubes, or form into 4 squares.  Cut in squares for vegan use.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,green lentil,kalamata olive,red chilies
title: Green Lentil and Chilies
ingredients: 1 lb green lentil | 1 1/2 cups freshly crushed red chilies | 1/2 cup finely grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 20 kalamata olives
instructions: Place the lentils in a strainer and rinse, then set aside while washing the chilies well.  In a large skillet, melt the parmigiano/reggiano cheese over medium heat.  Add the chilies and cook for 10 seconds, stirring constantly, and then remove from heat.  Let the chilies cool, then place them in a food processor and pulse a few times, just enough to make them a little chunky.  Stir in the chilies and the olives, then transfer everything into a large serving dish and cover tightly with foil.  Set it aside to allow the flavors to blend.  These are great served with garlic bread and/or a green salad.

title: Acorn Squash and Homemade Cheese Dip - Vegan

instructions: Mix all the filling ingredients in medium bowl.  Sauce, place coconut milk in a bowl and mix in a pinch of salt.  Add the other ingredients until well blended – dip is ready to eat enjoy with your favorite vegies or crock pot roasted veggies.

title: Spanish Poached Eggs
ingredients: 10 large pimiento, washed, trimmed and halved
instructions: Bring a kettle of water to a boil and add the pimentos.  Place the halved hard boiled eggs in the water and boil for about 5 minutes.  Remove the halved eggs and cool under running water, shaking the pan to insure even coloring.  This will prevent the eggs from browning.  When cooled, serve on a pool of butter or chorizo with a dash of mayonnaise or other dijon mustard.

title: Cuban Sherry Punch
ingredients:
2 cups lime wedges | 2 cups sherry wine | 1 cup dark rum ( such as st.
    - james )
instructions: Squeeze lime and discard the pulp.  Pour all juice over the crushed lime.  Stir in wine and rum and mix well, then refrigerate at least 1 hour for the flavors to combine.

title: French Bread Pizza

instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f.  Place bread pieces in a shallow baking dish.  In a small bowl, mix 1/2 cup barbeque sauce and tomato paste.  Spread bread evenly with onion and basil mixture.  Bake for 10 minutes, or until bread is golden with browned crumbs.

title: Oops - Canadian Moose Pulled Pork
ingredients: 1 3/4 kg pork fillets | 250 g molasses | 100 -150 ml heavy cream | 2 slices whole wheat bread
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180°c place pork in a 13x9 casserole dish.  Combine molasses and cream in a small bowl and pour over pork.  Bake covered for 1 hour.  Turn off oven and leave in for 1 hour uncovered.  Cut up bread and serve with pork.

title: Mushroom Beef Skillet
ingredients: 1 lb lean boneless sirloin steak, cut in 2-inch strips | 1/2 medium cabbage, cored | 3/4 cup dried white mushrooms | 1/2 medium green pepper, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon dried mexican oregano | 3/4 teaspoon table salt | 1/4 ounce sliced black mushroom, drained
instructions: Cut beef crosswise into thin 2 slices.  Combine cabbage, mushrooms, pepper, oregano and salt.  Place beef slices on work surface.  Sprinkle with salt.  Starting at long end, roll up steak slices starting at long end.

title: Alsatian-Style Ground Beef With Szechuan Potato and Peanuts
ingredients: 1/2 cup peanut butter or 1/2 cup natural crunchy peanut butter | 2 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter ) | 3 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into 1 pieces, preferably extra lean | 1 cup raw sauerkraut, rinsed and well drained | 3 cups vegetable stock | 1 large baking potato, peeled and cut into 2-inch chunks | 1/4 cup canned black beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: In a 3 to 4 quart heavy frypan, melt peanut butter or peanut butter over moderate heat.  Cook, stirring occasionally, until it is reduced to 3 tablespoons, about 3 minutes.  Stir in the ghee.  Add beef and cook over moderately high heat, breaking up lumps with a wooden spoon, until browned on all sides, 4 to 5 minutes.  With a slotted spoon, transfer beef to a plate.

title: Tuscany Meatball Sauce

instructions: In large bowl or food storage bag, combine pork, sage, sugar, mint and 2 cans enchilada sauce.  Gently mix to combine.  Divide into freezer meatballs.  Roll each one individually in the sprigs of mint.  Place in an oiled 9x13 inch baking dish and place in freezer for about 40 minutes, turning as needed.  If time permits, uncover meatballs and return to freezer.  Preheat oven to in medium skillet, combine remaining enchilada sauce canning sauce and enough water to cook meatballs separately.  Remove meatballs from the freezer.  Remove stems and discard.

title: Korean Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup bottled sweet salsa | 1/4 cup mirin
instructions: Mix salsa and mirin together in a small bowl.

title: Sweet & Sour Chicken (or Broccoli)

instructions: Place chicken in a dish with the cornflour, vinegar, garlic and salt and pepper and mix well.  Pour in enough warm water to just cover.  Leave to stand, covered, overnight.  Do not drain off the marinade, heat the oven to 200c/400f/gas remove chicken from the fridge 30 minutes before cooking.  Toss the chicken with the cornflour mixture and brown in the hot oven. Random Ingredients: sherry wine vinegar,mint sprig,four bean mix,snow pea
title: Seared Snow Peas With Six Bean Curds
ingredients: 24 ounces four bean dip mix | 1/2 cup sherry wine vinegar | 1/4 - 1/2 cup fresh mint sprig | 2 1/2 lbs snow peas, trimmed

Fill a 6 qt pan 1/2 with water and place over high heat.  Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer and cook 6 - 8 minutes, or until the snow peas are softened and have just begun to curl around the edge.  Remove from heat and add the snow peas to the bean curd mixture.  Cover and chill at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Spanish-Style Breakfast Wraps

instructions: Spread tortillas with the hazelnuts.  Divide the soppressata, strawberries, mushrooms, jelly, and anchovies between the 4 tortillas.  Roll up each burrito.

instructions: Place barley in large bowl.  Cover tightly with several inches of boiling water.

title: Spanish Beef and Gruyere Sandwich
ingredients: 3 lbs sirloin steaks, cut into large strips ( i use tips from two loin steaks ) | 2 tablespoons ginger powder ( i use fresh ) | 2 large bell peppers ( any color will do ) | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1 pint italian plum tomatoes ( drained ) | 2 teaspoons vanilla beans, split ( dried ) | 1 1/2 lbs gruyere ( cut into thin slices, best you can find ) or 1 1/2 lbs swiss cheese, sliced ( cut into thin slices, best you can find ) | 1 quart canned italian-style tomatoes ( drained )
instructions: Place beef strips in a ziploc bag.  Mash the ginger into a paste with a pinch of sugar.  Place spice paste in a heavy non reactive pan on low heat, and mix in remaining ginger paste, peppers, salsa, and tomatoes.  Cover and cook at a steady simmer for 30 minutes or so, stirring and mashing tomatoes with a spoon.  Add the shredded gruyere and tomato sauce.  Heat mixture and serve over hot crusty italian bread.

title: Grammy's Baked Ham
ingredients: 2 lbs ham | 2 cups extra fine dry breadcrumbs | 1 cup golden raisin
instructions: Place ham in a casserole dish or roasting pan, or line a 4 x 3 inch baking pan with aluminum foil.  Sprinkle bread crumbs on ham, then sprinkle raisins on top of bread and then drizzle with 2 tablespoons of olive oil or butter.  Stir bread crumbs into olive oil or butter.  Bake at 325 degrees fahrenheit for 45 minutes or about 50 minutes, depending on your oven.  Cool ham completely before cutting.

title: Black Forest Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 8 fresh tomatoes | 1 tablespoon flour, mixed with | 1 teaspoon chili paste or 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 package cherry tomatoes | 1 tablespoon dried thyme sprigs | 1 tablespoon dried kahlua | 1 tablespoon chili seasoning mix
instructions: Cut a slit down each tomato to create a cup with an opening about 4 inches long.  Remove seeds and pulp and discard.  Combine chilli paste, cherry tomatoes, thyme, kahlua, and chili seasoning mix in a small bowl.  Spoon tomatoes into tomatoes, leaving about 1 inch of the tomato pulp on the tops.  Wash tomatoes under water.  Cover tomatoes and leave at room temperature until cold, at least half an hour.  Transfer tomatoes to a serving dish.  Garnish with remaining fresh thyme.

title: Taste of Islands
ingredients: 32 spring roll wrappers | 1 container vanilla yogurt | 3 tablespoons tamari | 1 pineapple, sliced | 1/4 cup cilantro, chopped and loosely packed | coarse sea salt
instructions: Thoroughly mix the tamari and sea salt in a bowl.  Dip one wrapper at a time in the tamari and salt mixture until all of the mixture is covered.  Lay the wrapper flat on a flat surface.  Using your palm, press the dough around the filling inside the wrapper.  Cut a small slit in the center of each dough loaf.  Place the stuffed dough loaves onto a plate.  Chill overnight.  Carefully unwrap the loaves and place on baking sheets lined with parchment or wax paper and bake at 375f degrees for 15 minutes.  Cool slightly and slice each roll into small triangles about 3 thick.  Allow to cool and serve, or store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: mint,chicken wing,onion flake,chicken part,fish sauce,white sugar,salad dressing
title: Crispy Thai Honeyed Chicken Wings
ingredients: 8 chicken wings | 1/2 cup salad dressing | 1/2 cup fish sauce | 1/2 cup chopped dried onion flakes | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1 teaspoon dried mint | 1 teaspoon chopped dried mint
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Place the wings in a large bowl.  Whisk together the salad dressing, fish sauce, onion flakes, sugar, dried mint, and dried mint in a small bowl.

title: Grilled Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 ounce focaccia bread, cut into 1/4's | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 ounce pepperoni, sliced
instructions: Arrange focaccia bread on two flat work surfaces and place pepperoni slices on top of bread.  Top with mustardy mustard.  Cover with additional mustard.  Serve.

title: Bergie's Tomato Relish
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 2 -3 tablespoons tomato puree or 2 -3 tablespoons passata | 1 1/4 cups cider vinegar or 1 1/4 cups balsamic vinegar
instructions: In the bottom of the saucepan or a heavy bottomed frying pan, combine all ingredients and bring to boil.  Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.  Pour the tomato relish into a blender, and puree until smooth.  Pour into a container, and refrigerate at least 1 week.
