title: Rigatoni with Goat Cheese Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 package graham cracker crumbs | 12 ounces rigatoni pasta | 1/2 cup goat cheese | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can sliced asparagus, drained | 1/2 cup light cream or 1/2 cup heavy cream | 12 ounces fresh blueberries or 12 ounces frozen blueberries | chocolate syrup ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Prepare graham cracker crumbs as directed on package.  Prepare rigatoni as directed on package.  In medium baking dish, spoon ½ can of goat cheese into the bottom of a 9 x 13 inch glass baking dish.  Spread into a rectangular shape.  In a large bowl, mix soup, asparagus, cream, and blueberries.  Pour over cheese and sprinkle with graham cracker crumbs.  Bake for 35 minutes or until heated through.  Serve with additional chocolate syrup.

title: Cheesy Stout Beer
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/3 cup mexican blend cheese | 3 tablespoons stout beer
instructions: Pour cheese into a crock pot.  Pour stout over the cheese, being careful not to leave air pockets.  Cook on high 3 - 4 minutes, if using crockpot, until the mixture has a good consistency.  Do not over cook as the cheese will become so chewy.  When done, let stand 5 minutes, and serve on toast.

title: Beef Empanadas ( Empanadas)
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 5 sheets frozen puff pastry | 1 cup molasses | 3 egg whites | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | jalapeno ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Trim beef of any fat that clings to the meat and cut into 1/4 inch pieces.  Place half of the meat in an ovenproof skillet and brown quickly on all sides, set aside.  Place the remaining meat along with the molasses in a medium bowl and mix well.  Roll out one sheet of pastry to a 9 inch circle.  Using a round or square cookie cutter, cut out rounds from the pastry, if desired, and place in the freezer for 10 - 15 minutes.  Roll out the second sheet of pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch, place on top of meat in skillet and use your fingers to make sure the pastry is flat on the bottom and slightly moist on top.  Brush each empanada with some molasses/meat mixture and fold the pastry on the top.  Transfer the empanadas to a baking sheet and bake in preheated oven for 45 - 50 minute or until pastry is browned and meat is tender.  Serve hot or slightly warm.  Serve with spanish rice, beans, refried beans, tortillas and/or salsa.

title: Italian Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 4 cups italian or french-style bread crumbs | 1 cup dried currants | 1/2 cup tahini | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  In a large bowl, mix together the bread crumbs, currants and tahini.  Sift the baking powder and garlic salt into a separate bowl.  Add bread crumb mixture to wet ingredients and mix.  Dump a few pieces onto a baking sheet and press into the center.  Bake at 450 degrees f for about 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Shrimp and Asparagus With Ham
ingredients: 16 ounces fresh shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 lb fresh asparagus, tough ends removed | 1 piece ginger root, peeled, sliced | 3 ounces smoked ham, chopped | 3 ounces ricotta cheese | 2 tomatoes, chopped | 16 ounces canned corn niblets, drained
instructions: Prepare the shrimp by dropping them onto a pan of lightly salted water, stirring once and then discarding any broken shellfish or other material in which the shrimp was cooked.  Boil the shrimp for 8 minutes or until the shrimp are cooked and she is bright orange in color.  Drain the shrimp onto a paper bag to leave behind the sand and impurities that have lodged in the shrimp.  Cut the asparagus into rounds about 2 inches by 1/2 inch thick.  Chop the ginger and ham, depending on size, and set aside.  Combine the ricotta and tomatoes in a small bowl.  Spoon the tomato mixture into a small dish and cover with the ricotta and ginger mixture.  Skewer the shrimp onto the asparagus, starting on the tip of the shrimp nearest to you, and ending with the asparagus.  Skewer the shrimp onto cocktail skewers.  Grill over medium heat for 6 minutes, turning with tongs until cooked through.  Serve asap.

title: Auntie Lori's Italian Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 cans apple juice | pepperoni rounds | 2 tablespoons vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Spray or butter a 9x13 inch baking pan.  In a bowl, mix apple juice, pepperoni, and vanilla essence.  Mix in the eggplant, mixing gently with a spoon.  Stir in the cooked vegetables.  Bake at 400 degrees f for 35 minutes, or until heated through.

title: Quick and Easy Algerian Onion Mix
ingredients: 4 large yellow onions, thinly slivered | 1 package ras el hanout spice mix
instructions: Mix all ingredients in the bowl of a food processor or blender.  If making a burghul mix, put on low and mix till you get good and soft bread dough.

title: Cider Flavored Cabbage
ingredients: 1 bottle thai sweetened condensed cream of celery soup | 1/2 cup light coconut juice | 2 tablespoons dark corn syrup ( cornstarch will work just fine ) | 1 -2 teaspoon vanilla | 1 1/2 cups packed english cabbage, shredded | 1 cup frozen or fresh cranberries, chopped
instructions: In a small bowl, mix sweetened condensed soup, light coconut juice, dark corn syrup, and vanilla until well blended.  Add cabbage, and mix until evenly coated.  Refrigerate at least 4 hours, to allow flavors to blend.  Pour into glasses, top with cranberries, and serve.

title: Quickly Sausages
ingredients: 225 g cooked crabmeat | 1 spring onion, finely diced
instructions: Take a hot, lightly oiled frying pan.  Pour a little of the crumbs onto the pan.  When the crumbs start to turn golden brown, scatter on the spring onion, then add the crab meat.  Season with salt and pepper and cook until heated all the way through.

title: Beans & Pork in Stout
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground pork | 1 cup white hominy | 1 can white hominy | 2 ancho chilies, pods ( deveined ) | 1 cup frozen peas | 12 fresh california tarts of shell pasta | 1/4 cup tortilla
instructions: Preheat oven to brown pork in large pot drain.  Combine all ingredients in large pot.  Drain rinsed and rinsed canned rinsed and rinsed green lentils.  Bring to boil on stove top over medium heat, stirring often until mixture starts to thicken.  Remove from heat and drain.  Stir in shell pasta.  Place tarts of shell pasta around side of pot.  Cover and bake for 2 hours.  Top each serving with your favorite toppings.

Random Ingredients: caster sugar,red chili powder,lemon zest,cane sugar,peach,salsa,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Roasted Peach Salad
ingredients: 250 g peaches, quartered and pitted | 1 tablespoon flat-leaf italian parsley, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, freshly grated | 1 teaspoon caster sugar | 1/4 teaspoon ground red chili powder | 300 ml mild salsa or 300 ml bottled chilli sauce | 1 tablespoon cane sugar, extra
instructions: Preheat the oven to 120c/gas mark lightly grease a shallow ovenproof dish with oil, then line the dish with baking paper.  Using a sharp knife, carefully slice the peeled peaches in half.  Remove the pits of the peaches, then roughly chop the flesh using a mandolin.  Place in a bowl and toss together with the parsley, caster sugar, lemon zest, extra sugar and chilli.  Place the peaches in an ovenproof dish.  Roast the peaches for 20 minutes, then stir to just mix.  Remove from the oven and pour over the salsa and sprinkle with the grated celtic/caster sugar.  Return to the oven for a further 10 minutes or until the syrup is caramelised and the peaches are cooked through.  To serve, scatter over the warm syrup to taste.

title: Baked Fish With Gravlax
ingredients: 1 yellow white fish fillet | 2 tablespoons light corn syrup | sweet corn syrup, for dipping
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f.  Trim all bones and excess skin from the fish using a very sharp knife, cutting down the side of each piece carefully so as to leave a thick shell.  Tear open out the flesh from the cavity.  Place both breast halves with the flesh between sheets of foil, placing them snugly together, and spread the flesh with a thin layer of sweetcorn syrup.  Place the fish on a lightly oiled baking tray, and bake in the oven for 25 - 30 minutes or until slightly crisp and golden brown.  Serve with plenty of crusty french bread and crusty sourdough bread from the refrigerator.  Serves.

Random Ingredients: hot red chili pepper,pear,celery rib,hot paprika,tagliatelle pasta noodle,heavy whipping cream,icing sugar
title: Pear Pasta With Sherry Paprika Cream
ingredients: 1 package tagliatelle pasta noodles | 1 fresh small hot red chili pepper, seeded & finely chopped | 1 large firm ripe pear, peeled, cored & finely chopped | 1 celery rib, finely chopped | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup icing sugar | sweet hot paprika or red hot chili pepper, to serve
instructions: Break noodles into 2 serving bowls, cover with boiling water and let stand for 2 minutes, then drain.  In a frying pan or wok, heat chilli paste, pear& celery on medium heat until fragrant.  Add cream and allow to boil until syrupy.  Stir in drained noodles and icing sugar& serve topped with paprika, pepper & chilli.

title: Couscous Cantina (White Rice and Rice)
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice | 3 cups mineral water ( such as muscat ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon | 1/2 cup maraschino cherry, cut in half | lettuce
instructions: In a medium saucepan, add the water and bouillon to rice.  Bring to a boil over high heat, and then reduce to a simmer.  Cover and cook for 12 minutes, or until all of the water is absorbed.  Let cool on a pan set on top of the stove.  Remove bouillon and reserve.  Fluff the rice with a fork and garnish with the reserved bouillon.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,chicken breast,ham,corn syrup,oyster sauce,red wine,jicama
title: Jicama Stir-Fry Chicken
ingredients: 10 -12 chicken breasts | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 12 slices boiled ham | 12 slices jicama | 8 pieces corn syrup ( dark ) | 3 4 tablespoons oyster sauce ( dark ) or 4 tablespoons molasses ( dark-tasting ) | 1 cup dry red wine
instructions: Trim the chicken breasts and cut into thirds on the diagonal, slicing across the grain into thin strips.  Season all the chicken pieces evenly with salt and pepper, and then use a fork to poke through the meat with a skewer.  Place the ham and jicama slices on a cutting board and sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Cut into strips 1 inch wide and 1 inch long.  Cut 1 slice of the ham and jicama into very thin strips, and place on paper towels to drain excess water from the shrimp.  Add a couple drops of corn syrup to the water for a glaze, if you like, or use more to thin the sauce if you want it to be very thin.  Place the chicken strips in a large skillet or wok over high heat and let them fry in the hot pan with the ham and jicama until they are crisp and beginning to lose their shape on the outside, stirring often.  Remove the shrimp with a slotted spoon and drain.  Add another teaspoon or so of corn syrup to the pan, and shake to combine.  Add the remaining 4 ingredients and stir to combine.  Serve immediately.

title: Garbage (Potatoes Stuffed)
ingredients: 600 g chorizo sausage, sliced | 600 g small parsnips, diced | 2 medium prawns, cooked | 1 1/2 cups cream cheese with garlic and herbs | 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts ( optional )
instructions: Mix the chorizo and parsnips in a large bowl with the prawns and mix well.  Shape the mixture into 2cm balls.  Make a small indentation in the centre, place a tbsp of the cream cheese, the lemon zest and the walnuts into each one.  Fill with stuffing.

title: Oven-Roasted Poached Peppers in the Style of Your Choice
ingredients: 1 bell pepper, medium | 1/2 cup beer | 2 tablespoons brandy ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1/8 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/8 teaspoon vanilla bean ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups polenta, cut into 1 inch cubes
instructions: Preheat your oven's broiler and set the oven rack at about 6 inches from the heat source.  Cut bell pepper into 1/4 slices vertically and arrange them in a single layer on a foil lined baking sheet.  Place pan on the preheated oven, and broil until blackened in spots, about 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Grilled Sausages
ingredients: 6 thick cut sausages ( johnsonville traditional is best, but colby would make your favorite or try boursin cheese ) | 1 habanero pepper | 1 tablespoon kosher salt
instructions: First, make your barbecue grill.  When heated, carefully place sausages on the grill, close the cover, and let cook about 10 minutes.  During this time the sausages should be slightly browned, but still with some pink inside.  With a slotted spoon, loosen the sausage from the grill and rub it with habanero pepper and kosher salt thoroughly.  Allow it to cool off, then slit the sausages open.  Place the warmed sausages on a platter and pour the boursin cheese on top.  Note, use serrated habanero pepper.  If using Boursin cheese, remove seeds.  Cut the sausage into 1 inch slices from the inside of the sausages to make a smaller sausage that can be cooked.  Grill sausages 6 at a time over indirect medium heat 3 - 4 minutes a side or until brown and crisp on the outside.  Place sausages on a plate, allow to cool and absorb excess fat.  Serve with barbeque sauce.

title: Bay Scallops With Parsley
ingredients: 24 bay scallops | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, finely snipped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees.  Prepare the bay scallops by rubbing each side in a single layer with the flat of a large knife.  Remove the scallops to a roasting tin or baking sheet with a lip. .  Pour boiling water into a small pot that will fit about 14 scallops on the sheet.  Place the scallops in the pan and sprinkle each side with the parsley, shaking off any excess.  Place the scallops onto the hot sheet of aluminum foil, leaving at least 6 inches of space between them.  Wrap the tops of the scallops tightly with the aluminum foil.  Roast the scallops in the middle of the oven for 6 to 8 minutes, or until they turn black and the scallops are just cooked through.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,pine nut,ziti pasta,kraft greek salad dressing,stiffly egg white,pinto bean,jalapeno pepper
title: Ziti With Salsa & Beans
ingredients: 6 cups ziti pasta, uncooked | 1 can pinto beans, undrained | 1/2 cup light cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup kraft greek salad dressing | jalapeno pepper, minced | 1/2 cup toasted pine nuts
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, remove & drain.  Add pinto beans, soup, dressing, pepper & pine nuts to pasta and toss well.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,cooking sherry,italian sausage,pepperoni,green chilies,corn chip,red wine vinegar,turnip
title: Italian Sausage and Turnip
ingredients: 1 lb mild italian sausage | 1 package frozen turnips, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 2 green chilies, seeded and chopped | 1/4 cup quick-cooking sherry | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 4 tablespoons greek yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon pepper | 3/4 cup corn chips or 3/4 cup tortilla chips
instructions: In a large skillet, cook sausage over medium high heat until no longer pink, about 7 minutes.  Add turnips and green chiles.

title: Homemade Breadsticks

instructions: Mix the flour with the chives.  Form the mixture into smooth balls and roll each in flour.  Place on a baking sheet lined with baking paper.  Leave to rest somewhere cool for 30 minutes.  Preheat oven to 220 degrees c.  Bake the bread sticks in batches.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,brown sugar,puff pastry,peppercorn,beet,taco sauce,swiss cheese
title: Bake Stuffed Beet
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | 2 tablespoons peppercorns, crushed | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 3/4 cup shredded swiss cheese | 3/4 cup shredded swiss cheese | 1 1/2 cups taco sauce | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f.  In a bowl, stir together the peppercorns, sugar, swiss cheese, taco sauce, and parmigiano reggiano cheese until the mixture is well blended.  Slice the top off the cooled pastry and remove the strings, leaving a 1/4 inch headspace.  Fill each pastry cavity with 1 rounded tablespoon of mixture.  Place a pinch of the mixture at one end of each pastry horn and fold the two sides over to form a tight, pinched spiral.  Place the stuffed ears on a roasting rack, and drizzle the tops with remaining olive oil.  Bake for 2 hours in the preheated oven, or until the beets are tender and bubbling.  Allow to cool on a rack.

title: Classic Lamb Chops
ingredients: 1 kg lamb meat | 250 g lean pork shoulder | 6 teaspoons dried tarragon | 80 -100 g granulated sugar
instructions: Peal the lamb meat.  Cut off the excess fat and any undesirable portion of the meat you may have.  Trim the fat at each stage and cut away as many portions of the fat as possible.  Cut the meat into 1 inch thick slices and pat dry with kitchen paper.  Place meat in the freezer for about 30 minutes.  Cut the pork in to half inch sized pieces and place on a foil lined baking sheet.  Sprinkle the pork with dried tarragon.  Bake in oven at 180c for about 1 hour, turning the meat every 15 minutes.  It should look slightly crispy.  To check the meat should be cooked by piercing its thickest part with a sharp sharp knife it should not be pink.  When done, pour off excess water to remove any of the bitter juices.  Combine 1/2 teaspoon of sugar with 2 tablespoons water, and add 1 teaspoon of the tarragon syrup to this mixture.  Pour this mixture over the meat and continue cooking and stirring for another 5 to 10 minutes until the meat is cooked and glazed.  Transfer the meat to a serving platter and keep hot.  Sauce.  Mix 1 - 2 tablespoons of granulated sugar and 3 tablespoons of water in a bowl and mix well to make a smooth paste.  Heat the remaining 1 teaspoon of tarragon syrup in a frying pan and add the meat.  Saute over low heat until cooked through.  Serve with a salad and bread.

title: Low Fat Marsala Milk Pudding
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups nonfat dry milk powder | 3/4 cup dry marsala wine, such as creme de marsala
instructions: In a double boiler, combine the milk powder and marsala and place over medium heat.  When the milk mixture begins to simmer, remove from heat.  Add the nonfat dry milk and stir.  Cover with a damp cloth and set aside to completely set.  When the puddings have set, set aside for about 30 minutes to set.

title: Gingery Rum Sauce
ingredients: 6 ounces good strong white rum, such as myers's | 6 ounces kahlua | 2 -3 drops fresh ginger powder ( to taste ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper | fresh chives, chopped for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a jar with a tight fitting lid with a screw top lid or tight fitting lid and shake to combine.  Heat up your broiler, setting rack about 6 inches below the heat source.  When hot enough, transfer to the oven and broil until lightly golden, stirring once halfway through.  Garnish with fresh chives if desired.

title: Mango Rice Balls, Mexican Style
ingredients: 1 lb mangoes, peeled, cut into 1 inch chunks, juice reserved | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs or 1 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1 cup rice, uncooked ( can use brown rice ) | 3 fresh tortilla chips ( optional ) | 2 slices prosciutto, julienne ( optional )
instructions: Cook rice in enough water to cover, with 1 tbsp juice if using brown rice, over moderate heat.  When the rice is cooked, drain it, add more of the juice if necessary, and if the rice is too dry, add 1/2 cup more of water in increments until the moisture is absorbed.  While rice is cooking, pulse the mango chunks in a food processor until very finely chopped.  Mash the mango until it is very smooth.  Mix panko and spices in a large bowl.  Add remaining ingredients, except for chips, and mix them well.  If needed, add more panko, spice, or water.  The mixture should be firm and smooth.  If you need to firm it completely, mix the rice in with the mango.  Using wet hands, roll the mixture into walnut sized balls.  Roll them in the panko mixture until completely coated.  Place on a large baking pan, or place a smaller pan on top when desired.  If desired, lightly flatten the tops of the balls slightly with a rolling pin.  Bake until lightly browned, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: french bread,mascarpone cheese,chicken thigh,cantaloupe,green pepper,apple cider vinegar,avocado,dark rum
title: Caribbean Chicken Pizza With Mascarpone
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1/2 cup dark rum | 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 1 french bread, sliced | 1 package mascarpone cheese | 1 ripe avocado, thinly sliced | 1 green pepper, cored and thinly sliced | 1 can cantaloupes, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees.  Place chicken thighs in the bottom of a lightly oiled 9 inch springform pan.  Combine rum, vinegar and 1/2 teaspoons salt and pepper.  Add chicken and marinate at room temperature until tender, at least 3 hours and up to 1 hour.  Place bread on a wire rack placed on a baking sheet and bake until golden, about 5 minutes.  Remove from oven and cover with plastic wrap.  Meanwhile, warm the mascarpone until soft.  Spread cheese on top of chicken, then spread with the mascarpone and sliced avocado.  Return to oven and bake until cheese is melted, about 5 to 10 minutes.  Remove from oven and sprinkle with green pepper and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: leek,pork roast,bay leaf,italian herb,kiwi fruit,mustard,pearl barley,vanilla wafer
title: Irish Pork Barley Soup
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs pork roast | 3 medium leeks, washed and halved and sliced thin ( white and light green parts only ) | 2 tablespoons fresh grated peeled fresh kiwi fruit | 2 bottles italian herb marmalade ( such as mccormick's bristol cream or similar ) | 1 medium pkg pearl barley | 1 large bay leaf | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard | 1 teaspoon dried italian herb blend ( such as mccormick's bristol cream substitute )
instructions: Place roast in large pot or dutch oven pot or crock.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper, add enough water to just cover and bring to boil on high.  Reduce heat to medium low, cover and simmer for 1 hour.  Remove roast and reserve liquid.  When water is clear, stir in all ingredients and simmer covered for about 45 minutes.  Do not remove the lid until final 10 minutes of cooking.  Remove meat to serving platter and serve in soup bowls and garnish with a kiwi fruit slice on the side.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,mustard,garam masala powder,panko breadcrumb,saffron strand,nonfat milk,white wine vinegar,mascarpone
title: Easy Homemade Saffron-Garam Masala Balls
ingredients: 8 saffron strands | 3/4 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup nonfat milk | 1/4 teaspoon prepared mustard | 1/4 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup dry nonfat milk | 1/3 cup mascarpone | 2 1/2 - 3 teaspoons garam masala powder | 1/2 teaspoon lemon juice
instructions: Soak the saffron strands in wine vinegar for 20 - 25 minutes.  Drain, discard the soaking liquid or save for later use.  Dissolve the saffron in 1/2 cup nonfat milk in a small saucepan.  Place over low heat and allow to simmer, stirring occasionally until reduced and slightly thickened.  Remove from heat and set aside to cool, stirring frequently, until warm enough to handle.  Pour cooled milk mixture into a bowl and add the cooked saffron.  Add mustard, bread crumbs, milk& mascarpone.  Mix well to make a dry paste.  Add in the cooled saffron milk mixture, garam masala powder & lemon juice.  Mix well, cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours, or overnight, stirring frequently until mixture becomes firm.  If using a blender, place all ingredients through a meat grinder, or you can using a hand held blender.  You should get a fine texture, and this recipe can be prepared and refrigerated for up to 7 days.

title: Puff Pastry Sambusas
ingredients: 1 package puff pastry ( i use the low fat variety, but i've found it works out well with just less fat ) | 1/2 cup milk | 1 tablespoon lite olive oil or 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil | louisiana cracker ( optional )
instructions: Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  On a clean counter lay flat the pastry sheets onto the cookie sheet.  The dough should just coat the work surface with a little bit of water, then gently flip the sheets into the baking sheet.  It will spread out to 1/8 thick.  When its about 1/8 thick place it on the middle of the cookie sheet.  In a 1 quart sauce pan, add olive oil, milk, and crackers and mix with a wire whisk.  Heat until boiling.  Pour slowly over the puff pastry to coat it evenly, and let cool for about 10 minutes.  Cut puff pastry into 3 or 4 sections.  Place one side on a clean counter and slice until you've cut the 2 sections into thin, straight slices.  Place a slice on top of another, and then a slice or two on top of that.  You should have a thin layered cookie with no gaps, but at least you can make your bread prints on top of each other.  Press edges of pastry together with your fingers to seal and cut.  It won't be easy on each side, but it should be.  Put a few puffs on the cookie sheet and brush the tops with a little milk.  Bake in preheated oven until golden brown.  About 10 to 12 minutes depending on your oven, but check for doneness at 10 minutes.  The samusas are perfect either way.

title: Quick and Easy Panna Colada With Fresh Cranberries
ingredients: 1 cup fresh cranberry sauce | 4 cups chicken stock
instructions: Pour the chicken stock into a blender and puree until smooth until smooth and creamy.  Add more stock if necessary.  Pour the pureed chicken into a casserole dish and add the cranberry sauce.

Random Ingredients: topping,celery,cheesecloth,lemon juice zest,cream tartar,pecorino romano cheese,parsley leaf
title: Celery and Cheese Logs
ingredients: 12 -16 slices cheesecloth | 1/2 cup fresh parsley leaves or 1/2 cup fresh cilantro | 1 1/2 lbs cleaned celery ( leaves and ribs ) | 8 ounces grated pecorino romano cheese | 2/3 cup cream of tartar | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice ( from 2-3 lemons ) | chopped fresh parsley leaves
instructions: The night before serving, remove cheesecloth from the cheesecloth, place in the freezer for 1 hour to completely ripen it up.  When ready to serve, drain the juice from the lemon rind and set it aside in a small saucepan over medium heat.  Add celery leaves and cook, just until tender but tender, 1 or 2 minutes.  Remove from the heat.  Drain.  Add 1 1/2 cups of the parsley, cream of tartar and lemon juice to the vegetable mixture in the cheesecloth and mix well.  The vegetables must cool off.  Drain the cheesecloth from the cheesecloth, place on a chopping board and cut into four equal pieces.  Take pieces one at a time and slice one along the long side of another rectangle, then cut into four equal pieces.  On a serving platter with a large slice of cheese, spread half of the softened cheese on top of the cheese.  Carefully lay four parsley leaves in a mound over this mound of cheese and spread the remaining filling on top of the cheese.  Roll the cheese loosely into a log.  Cut the ends off the cheesecloth rolls, and arrange in a wide shallow bowl, or wrap in foil.  Serve one log at a time.

Random Ingredients: pepper flake,thyme leaf,fine noodle,soy sauce,phyllo dough,white cabbage,tomato soup,baby carrot
title: Easy Tomato Bourekia (Vegetable Phyllo Pie)
ingredients: 2 packages frozen chopped vegetables, thawed | 1 can tomato soup | 1/2 cup finely chopped white cabbage | 1/4 cup shredded fresh baby carrots | 1 leaf white cabbage, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon low sodium soy sauce | 1 package fine dry noodles | 1/2 cup shredded soy sauce | 12 sheets phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f.  Place thawed vegetables and tomato soup in a saucepan.  Over medium heat, cook and stir until vegetables are soft, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,chipotle mayonnaise,sesame oil,peanut oil,bell pepper,chervil,spring onion
title: Beef Sesame Salad
ingredients: 3 lbs beef tenderloin | 1/4 cup sesame oil | 2 tablespoons spring onions, finely chopped | 2 large peppers, chopped | 1/2 cup cherryvil, finely chopped | 1/2 cup roasted peanuts, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle mayonnaise
instructions: Trim the beef of all sinew and any membrane and slice at a 45 degree angle.  Heat the oil in a very hot pan and sear the beef on all sides.  Remove to a warm dish and put aside.  In the same oil brown the spring onions at a medium temperature for a couple of minutes until caramelised.  Add the peppers, onions, and cherryvil.  Toss and cook for a couple of minutes until all the vegetables are coated with oil.  Return the beef to the pan and cook at a medium temperature until it's cooked to your liking.  Season with the sesame oil and leave to rest for a few moments.  Transfer to a serving bowl and decorate with the cherryvil.

title: Italian Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 envelope italian salad dressing mix | 1/4 cup packed fresh basil leaf | 1/4 cup fresh basil leaf, stems removed
instructions: In a small bowl, blend well.  Pour over basil in a large container.  Cover, and refrigerate at least 1 hour or overnight.  Serve over pasta of your choice.

title: Spaghetti Gravy
ingredients: 1 packet brown and serve hot gravy mix | 1 can mushroom gravy mix
instructions: Empty gravy mix into a large frying pan.  Dump water in if needed, and fry the mushrooms to desired 'doneness'.  Serve on top of the spaghetti.

title: Chili Oil (Hot)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs unpeeled szechuan peppercorns | 1 cup ice | 1/4 cup tomato juice | 4 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Crush peppercorns with rolling pin or cleaver.  Mix ice, tomato juice and crushed peppercorns in saucepan over medium heat.  Bring to boil, stir, and simmer 10 minutes.  Cool, strain into pitcher and refrigerate for at least four hours for flavours to mingle.  Serve over ice.

title: Sebq Au Tahin
ingredients: 1 small cucumber, diced ( about 1/3 cup ) | olive oil or butter | liquid smoke ( optional )
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a small bowl.  Toss to mix.  Note, i have found that the cucumber doesn't turn brown enough either.  It should be limp and slightly soft.  The amount of liquid smoke depends on what you are using though, to be sure.

title: Dolmades (Oda Pie)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons gochujang gochujang korean rice cakes | 10 ounces leftover korean barbecue beef roast ( with juice ) | 4 ounces pastitsio skordalia original gravies | 1 ounce fresh oregano | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon allspice | 1 -3 tablespoon dried oregano | 1/2 - 1 apple ( optional )
instructions: Cut beef roast into 1 inch cubes, and set aside.  If using meat from leftover barbeque, you can chop into smaller pieces about 3 inches long, about 1 inch long and 1/2 inch wide.  Place 1 teaspoon gravy and any other optional ingredients on cutting board.  Cut carrot into bite sized wedges, and place carrot pieces on meat.  Place meat on cutting board, and use your fingers to scrape away the residue.  If desired, add 1 tablespoon korean bbq sauce to meat.  This also tastes great on a side dish with dolmades, such as kimchi or kimchi.  Once meat is cool enough to handle, put a portion into a bowl, then cover with the prepared gravies, and mix.  If desired, you can cover meat with a piece of aluminum foil.  Dip carrot wedges in cheese cloth, then coat liberally with the gravies on meat.  You can leave some cheese cloth strips as a protective layer if desired.

Random Ingredients: anaheim chile pepper,lasagna noodle,cardamom,cilantro,white chocolate,oriental sesame oil,golden syrup
title: Spicy White Chiles and Cilantro Lasagna
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oriental sesame oil | 3 anaheim chile peppers, seeded and chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons golden syrup | 12 lasagna noodles | 1 1/2 white chocolate, grated | chopped fresh cilantro | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Heat oil in a saucepan over medium heat.  Add chiles and golden syrup.

Random Ingredients: chive,gruyere cheese,lime juice,banana pepper,green bell pepper
title: Gruyere-Style Bananas
ingredients: 6 tablespoons lime juice | 6 large ripe bananas, peeled | 6 tablespoons grated gruyere cheese | 3 tablespoons finely chopped green bell pepper | 3 tablespoons finely chopped fresh chives
instructions: Pour lime juice into a shallow 2 cup serving dish.  Arrange bananas on top of lime juice.  Sprinkle gruyere cheese and green bell pepper evenly over bananas.  Sprinkle chives over top of everything.  Chill in the refrigerator 1 - 2 hours to develop flavor.

title: Tarragon Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1 can whole chili | 2 teaspoons tarragon | 1/3 cup flour
instructions: Combine chili, tarragon and flour and marinate chicken for at least two hours in refrigerator.  Grill or broil until brown.  Serve plain or with a side of salad.

Random Ingredients: bay leaf powder,tomato basil garlic oregano,mango chutney,green chile pepper,bacon dripping,caster sugar,creme fraiche
title: Tarte (Cheese and Mango Pancakes)
ingredients: 6 slices bacon drippings | 4 teaspoons mango chutney | 4 teaspoons creme fraiche | 1/2 teaspoon bay leaf powder | 1 cup tomatoes basil and garlic and oregano, finely chopped together | 1/2 teaspoon caster sugar | 1/8 teaspoon green chile pepper, finely chopped
instructions: In a large frying pan, cook the bacon on both sides until crisp.

title: Easy Crusted Pork Roast
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 3-5 to 6 ribs | 2 tablespoons parsley ( fresh or dried )
instructions: Place a rack 1 deep in a large baking pan and cover the rack with foil.  Remove the pork neck end from the underside of the ribs and trim any excess fat off the meat.  Cut the meat into 1 1/2 or 2 - 3 inch pieces.  Spread the meat and its contents over the pan, being careful not to dislodge the strings on the meat.  Drizzle generously with plenty of bread crumbs, salt, and minced fresh parsley.  Place the pan in an oven preheated to 475 degrees f for 20 to 30 minutes or until the internal register reads 1/2 to 1 inch thick.  Turn off the oven.  Using tongs or two dinner spoons, lift the meat out of the pan and place onto a rack to finish cooking the crumbs.  Allow to sit 1 to 2 minutes before slicing in to 2 or 3 portions.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,veal,curry paste,mustard powder,taco seasoning mix,brown bean sauce,dijon mustard,porridge oat
title: Vegetarian Mums on the Grill
ingredients: 500 g finely chopped veal | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 1 packet mustard powder | 2 tablespoons prepared mustard mustard | 500 g chopped porridge oats | 2 -3 tablespoons curry paste ( you 'll have to taste with the first one ) | 250 g thick & chunky brown bean sauce | 200 g chocolate, grated
instructions: Prep ingredients in a medium microwave safe bowl and cook on high power for 10 minutes or until meat is tender.  Let cool for 5 mins and then roughly chop meat and mix with seasoning.  Meanwhile, toast oats in a dry large frypan or griddle pan until golden brown and fragrant.  Set aside.  Combine bean sauce and mustard powder in a small microwave safe bowl and cook on high power for five minutes.  Combine drained oats and curry paste in a bowl and mix well.  Spread meat mixture over the base of a griddle pan/griddle pan.  Place griddle pan on the hob and cover until the top is just beginning to darken.  Spread over some of the warmed bean sauce mix.  Cover with the lid and cook for 3 mins or until meat is glazed and heated through.  Allow to cool for 5 mins and transfer to an oil free serving dish.  Spread the remaining bean sauce mix on the meat mixture with spatula and serve topped with the chocolate.

title: Zesty Italian Tomato Salad
ingredients: 2 large plum tomatoes, cut into strips | 2/3 cup fat-free italian dressing | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes, drained | 1/3 cup zesty fat free italian dressing, such as zesty italian dip
instructions: Toss together tomatoes, 2/3 cup reduced fat italian dressing, stewed tomatoes, and zesty italian dressing.  Cover and refrigerate, stirring occasionally, up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: miso,brown rice,red wine,noodle,creamy peanut butter,white wine vinegar,cumin
title: Spicy Noodles With Noodles
ingredients: 3 tablespoons miso | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup sweet white wine | 1 teaspoon white cumin | 1 1/2 cups brown rice | 1 can creamy peanut butter | 1 tablespoon miso | cumin | noodles
instructions: Bring a medium saucepan of water with 1 tablespoon of miso and white wine vinegar to a boil and add noodles.  Return to boil and cook for 5 minutes, or until noodles are done to your liking.  Drain.  In a small bowl, stir together peanut butter, 1 tablespoon of miso, and 1 tablespoon of white wine vinegar.  Set aside.  Toss noodles with the sauce and add the remaining miso, white wine, white cumin, and the remaining white wine vinegar.  Serve immediately.  Sprinkle with cumin and more miso if desired.

title: Algerian Macaroni
ingredients: 2 eggplants | sea salt | 1/2 cup cornflour | cornflour | 1 teaspoon salt | 8 -10 medium olives ( optional ) | 1 box cellophane noodles ( or cellophane noodles )
instructions: Skin eggplants.  I wash mine in cool hot water.  I then slice them in thin rounds in a row.  In a large bowl blend cornflour and salt till there are no lumps.  Dip eggplant slices in cornflour mixed with eggflour, then in eggflour, then in eggflour again.  Then in eggflour salt mixture add a few olives, if using.  The olives should be placed at the same time and not touching.  Place on oiled griddle pan and turn over when golden brown on the underside.

title: Aristi (Aristi) Salad (Antiguan)
ingredients: 1 radicchio, cut into pieces | 1 teaspoon saffron | 6 ounces firm tofu, thinly sliced | 5 -6 leaves fresh thin bacon ( can be purchased at latin american stores or you can substitute a mix of ham and butter ) | 1 pinch black mustard seeds ( to taste )
instructions: Rinse your radicchio and trim away the ends.  Tear off a small amount of the base from the leaves and slice into pieces about 1/2 inch long with a sharp knife.  Toss all of the ingredients together in a salad bowl.  Set aside.  Bring a large pot of salted water to boil, and add a pinch of salt.  Add the saffron and toast the mustard seeds in the pot for 1 to 2 minutes or until the mustard begins to brown and the seeds have begun to pop.  Drain the seeds and return to the pot.  Add the tofu and cook over low heat for one or two minutes, stirring, until the oil separates from the saffron and starts to crisp.  If the tofu is done to your liking, add another tablespoon of oil and stir fry briefly, adding only as much water as needed to absorb the excess moisture.  This will take about one minute or two just to cook the excess moisture.  Toss well over moderate heat so the mustard seeds do not burn and toast.

title: Chile Colorado
ingredients: 1 lamb | 4 cans chopped clams with juice | 16 ounces cocoa | shredded lettuce
instructions: Chop meat into bite sized pieces.  Combine the clams, minced clams with juice and cocoa.  Bring to boil.  Put shredded lettuce in with the meat.  Mix.  You can also add shredded red cabbage or green beans before serving.  If you like, serve in a flour tortillas with tortilla chips as a topping for salad.

title: Marinated Beef Steak
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk | 2 kg beef steaks
instructions: Mix soymilk to 100ml boiling water.  Stir until the boiling water has boiled off.  Put the steaks in a shallow pan, cover tightly and let marinate in the fridge for 3 days.  Heat bbq to high.  Drain beef steaks, and remove steaks from marinade.  Place meat on the marinade, turning once.  Place the steaks in a shallow pan, cover & cook for 15 - 20 mins or until cooked to your liking.

title: Nana's Yellow Onion Relish
ingredients: 4 medium yellow onions ( chopped into small pieces ) | 5 tablespoons dried mixed peppercorns | 3 whole cloves
instructions: Place all the ingredients, except the dried fruit, in a non reactive container.  Cover and store in the refridgerator for a minimum of 24 hours.  Strain and use to stuff your favorite indian style bread.

title: Grilled Chorizo and Raspberry Skewers
ingredients: 4 pieces fresh raspberries | 4 pieces chorizo sausage | 2 scallions, chopped | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 2 tablespoons caraway seeds | 1 1/2 cups marsala wine | 1/2 cup fresh raspberry | 1 large piece kielbasa, halved lengthwise and sliced into 1/4 inch half-moons
instructions: Cut the raspberries in half, remove the rind, and cut any remaining fruit into 6 - 8 ramekins.  Wrap the sausage links around skewers, and place skewers on the grill.  Grill, brushing occasionally with the pan juices, over medium high heat until the sausage is cooked through, and the fruit is very tender and lightly caramelized, about 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, combine the coriander, caraway seeds, marsala, and raspberries in a medium bowl.  When the meat is cooked through, remove it from the grill and add the raspberries and kielbasa.  Let stand about 5 minutes to warm the berries.

title: Andre' Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long grain rice | 2 fluid ounces vodka | 1 fluid ounce dark rum | 1 fennel, stalk minced
instructions: Boil the rice in lightly salted water for 20 minutes.  Drain the rice and reserve it.  Mash it and discard the fennel stalk.  Stir in the remaining ingredients.  Serve hot.

title: Tabbouleh
ingredients: 1/4 cup yoghurt | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 4 cups grape tomatoes, halved
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients except the grape tomatoes together except the tomatoes and the grapes in a bowl.  Add the grapes and gently stir well so all are evenly distributed.  Place the grape tomatoes into the dish, cover and set aside in the fridge for an hour 2 hours, before serving.

Random Ingredients: rose water,fine salt,tomato basil oregano garlic
title: Tomato Basil and Rose Water Scented Roasted Tomatoes
ingredients: 3 lbs medium-size tomatoes ( about 12 medium tomatoes ) | 2/3 cup fine salt | 10 teaspoons dried rose water ( or more, if more intense flavor is desired )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400°f.  Place tomatoes in a single layer in a shallow baking dish.  Sprinkle with 3/4 cup fine salt.  Bake, uncovered, on top rack 15 minutes and 20 minutes, until tops darken and crackling.  Immediately transfer tomatoes to a medium bowl and pour in enough water to completely cover tomatoes.  Let stand at least 20 minutes.  Drain and discard skins.  Rinse and drain again, pressing on tomatoes with hands or a towel to remove excess moisture.  Spread tomatoes on a large sheet pan lined with parchment paper.  Bake about 25 minutes or until tomatoes are tender and deep golden brown and liquid is absorbed.  Transfer to a covered dish and let cool to room temperature on baking sheet, about 1 hour.  Transfer tomatoes to a bowl and mix to combine.  Season with more fine salt and rose water and serve.

title: Simple Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup minced pecorino romano cheese | 1 1/2 cups bottled chili garlic sauce
instructions: Pour the cheese into a small bowl and set aside.  Stir the chili sauce into the cheese.  Tear away some of the rind from the pecorino romano cheese.  Add the rind and cheese to the cheese mixture and stir until the cheese has melted.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: macadamia,green enchilada sauce,part mozzarella cheese,cotija cheese,liquid smoke flavoring
title: Easy Microwave Macadamia Dip
ingredients: 2 pounds macadamia pieces, husked and coarsely chopped | 2 cans green enchilada sauce | 1 1/2 cups grated cotija cheese | 1 1/2 teaspoons liquid smoke flavoring | 1 1/2 cups shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Place the macadamia nuts in a microwave safe bowl.  Cook in the microwave until lightly browned, about 1 minute per side.  Transfer the macadamia nuts to a microwave safe bowl and cover the bowl with a lid to keep warm.  Heat 2 cups cheese in the microwave for 5 minutes, stirring every 30 seconds.  Stir in the liquid smoke flavoring.  Stir in the remaining 1 1/2 cups cheese.  Microwave on high 1 hour, or until melted and smooth.  Stir until smooth.  Serve warm.

title: Baked Molasses Beef and Buns on the Grill
ingredients: 2 tablespoons molasses | 2 tablespoons toasted sesame seeds ( see description ) | 4 hamburger buns or 4 sandwich buns, toasted with toasted sesame seeds
instructions: Combine molasses and sesame seeds and smear with molasses mixture.  Brush a grill pan with oil and sear the meat until nicely browned and succulent.  Remove meat from grill, cover with foil, and set aside to rest while making the buns.  Serve as the starter for the grill, place two buns on a flat bread, split and spread with the molasses mixture.  Sprinkle with sesame seeds.

Random Ingredients: saffron,kosher dill pickle,gruyere cheese,margarine,saffron thread,tart apple,onion salt
title: Quiche Lorraine's Cheese Tartlet (French)
ingredients: 12 tart apples, pared, cored, chopped into about 1-inch chunks | 1 pinch saffron | 1 pinch kosher dill pickle, chopped in a food chopper | kosher butter, for brushing | 1 ounce gruyere cheese, grated | 1/4 teaspoon saffron threads | 1/4 cup margarine
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f.  Line a small loaf pan with parchment paper.  Toss the apples with 1 tsp.  Saffron, pickle, kosher butter, cheese, saffron, sugar and 1/4 tsp.  Pinch of kosher salt.  Lay half the tartlet on the parchment.  Sprinkle with more salt and sprinkle the remaining dill pickle on top.  Spread half the margarine onto the bottom and up the sides of tartlet.  Cover with the other half of the tartlet, drizzle with remaining margarine and cut off a piece of parchment paper.  With a sharp knife, make slits into the crust and place tartlet on top of the parchment paper.  Bake 15 - 20 minutes, until golden in colour and puffed.  Serve warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: cod,banana liqueur,egg,jalapeno pepper,hormel chili without bean,button mushroom,baking soda,beef steak
title: Beef, Chilli and Mushroom Jaffle
ingredients: 4 jalapeno peppers, sliced | 2 cups sliced button mushrooms | 4 beef steaks, cut into pieces | 1/2 cup banana liqueur | 1 bunch haero bell pepper | 3 large eggs, lightly beaten | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 8 ounces cod, cooked and flaked

Random Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil,purpose flour,glutinous rice,spring onion,prosciutto,monterey jack cheese,spanish onion,ravioli
title: Ravioli With Onions and Cheese
ingredients: 4 ounces fresh ravioli or 4 ounces frozen ravioli, thawed | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 small spanish onion, chopped | 4 ounces thinly sliced prosciutto, chopped | 2 spring onions, chopped and separated | 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour | 1 cup glutinous rice, rinsed ( glutinous rice if unavailable, see note ) | 16 ounces grated monterey jack cheese ( preferably imported )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f.  Cook raviolis according to package directions.

title:
Red Potato Hash.
    -
ingredients: 1 medium onion, sliced thin | 2 medium red potatoes, peeled, sliced into thin wedges | 1 apple, peeled, cored, and sliced thin | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 3 tablespoons sour cream | 2 teaspoons cocoa powder
instructions: In a medium skillet, heat the onion and salt over medium high heat.  Cook until the onions are tender.  Add the potatoes, apple, soup mix, sour cream and cocoa.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,rotel tomato,spaghetti sauce,halibut fillet,ketchup,green chilies,clam,apricot
title: Spicy Baked Fish
ingredients: 1/2 cup ketchup | 1/2 cup heinz & reg ; original tomato chili sauce | 3/4 cup canned rotel tomatoes | 1 can chopped green chilies, drained | 1/3 cup dried apricot, finely chopped | 6 ounces halibut fillets | 1/4 cup basil leaves | 1/4 cup bottled barilla original spaghetti sauce
instructions: Combine ketchup, tomato sauce, rotel, green chiles, apricots, and halibut in 9x13x2 inch glass baking dish and bake, uncovered, at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 15 minutes.  Remove dish from oven, sprinkle with basil and cover with spaghetti sauce.  Bake for 5 minutes or until hot.

title: Cranberry Lentil Salad
ingredients: 200 g french lentils | 400 g mixed dried fruit ( eg currants, mango, fig and papaya ) | 1 tablespoon english mustard | 1 tablespoon dried cranberries ( optional )
instructions: In a large jug or pot, cover the lentils with plenty of simmering water.  Bring to a boil, then turn down to a simmer and cook for about 15 minutes until all the liquid has absorbed and the lentils are cooked but still well firm.  This takes about 15 - 20 minutes.  Pour in the mixed dried fruits and leave until cool.  When the lentils are to your liking, drain off the liquid and add the rest of the ingredients and mix well.  This goes so if you want more salad, you can add a little milk or stock or water to thin it out a little.

title: Sneaky Chocolate Pie II
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 3/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  In a medium bowl, mix graham cracker crumbs and cocoa with a fork until well blended.  Press onto the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Bake for about 30 minutes in the preheated oven.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,hamburger,dark chocolate,cilantro,italian bread,spring onion,red food coloring
title: Crock Pot Creamy Italian Sandwiches
ingredients: 8 ounces cream of chicken soup | 1 lb hamburger | 4 spring onions | 1 lb shredded italian bread | 1/4 cup chopped cilantro | 1/8 cup grated dark chocolate | 1 dash red food coloring
instructions: In a crock pot combine soup, hamburger, spring onions, bread, cilantro, chocolate, and food coloring.  Cover and cook on high for 2 hours or low for 4 - 6 hours.  Stir before serving for a wonderful lunch.

title: Feta Cheese Spread (Cheese Filling)
ingredients: 150 g feta cheese | 3 tablespoons cornstarch, divided | 2 eggs | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Put feta cheese through strainer.  Crush with fork.  Add all the other ingriend.  Add the cornstarch and 1/4 cup boiling water.  Cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.  Serve with your favourite sandwich bread.

title: Quick and Easy Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley, or as needed | 1 large zucchini, diced | 2 green chile peppers, diced, or more to taste | 1 can evaporated milk, or more as needed | 1 tea bag
instructions: Combine pearl barley, zucchini, green chile peppers, evaporated milk, and tea bag in a soup pot.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,italian herb,linguine,beef bouillon cube,barley,mustard seed,dark brown sugar
title: Baked Salmon Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salmon fillets | 12 ounces linguine | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 tablespoon dried italian herb | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon barley
instructions: Place salmon in baking pan.  Bake at 400°f for 20 - 25 minutes or until done.  Mix the rest of the ingredients and pour over salmon, mix well.  Bake for another 10 minutes.  Serve with cooked linguine or penne pasta.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,apple,lime juice,part mozzarella cheese,sesame seed
title: Apple and Lime Soup
ingredients: 1 apple, unpeeled, cored and grated | 1 cup vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 2 -3 tablespoons all-purpose dried breadcrumbs or 2 -3 tablespoons shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan, stirring to combine and heat thoroughly.  Just before serving, sprinkle with the cheese.

title: Frozen Pancetta
ingredients: 6 tablespoons pancetta, diced | 4 -6 green cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: Heat frying pan on medium heat.  When pan is hot, add diced pancetta.

title: Easy Filled Veal Rolls
ingredients: 3 ounces dried apricots | 1/2 lb ground veal | 1/4 cup whole milk ricotta cheese
instructions: Chop apricots very fine and place in a small saucepan.  Cover with water and place over medium heat.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes or until apricots are soft.  Drain and reserve.  Combine ground veal with apricots and ricotta cheese in a bowl.  Place one portion of filling on each roll.  Roll each one in the mixture, securing ends with toothpicks if desired.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,lasagna noodle,green chili pepper,orange peel,golden raisin
title: Easy Chewy Orange and Chili Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles | 1 can diced green chili peppers, drained | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/4 cup finely grated orange peel | 2 fresh red chilies, chopped
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions, drain.  Place all remaining ingredients in the bowl of a food processor and process until smooth.  Spoon a little sauce over noodles and mix well.  Spread mixture evenly in the bottom of a 9 x 13 baking dish.  Bake at 350 degrees for about 15 minutes or until hot.

title: Keralan Spiced Rice
ingredients: 1 package long grain rice ( rice-aroma rice-aroma recommended ) | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 teaspoon finely grated gingerroot | 1 green cardamom, seed | 2 -3 capers | 1 tablespoon ketchup | pepper
instructions: Rinse rice a couple of times until water runs clear.  Then rinse in a collander until the rinse water goes clear.  Drain well in a colander and then refrigerate for at least an hour.  Prepare the cream of mushroom soup according to directions on the can.  You may put a small amount of the soup in a measuring cup, if desired, to measure for the liquid when it is ready.  When it is almost all liquid evaporated, add the rest, stir well.  You may need to add more ketchup if it is too thick and clumpy for you.  Taste the soup now for taste.  If it has enough of the soup flavor, you may add more of the soup or less of the amount of soup that you desired.  Serve with croutons brushed with a bit of oil, if desires.  Note the recipe seems to vary depending on the water content of the rice aromans and what sort of water you use.  I've found that sometimes about 3/4 cup of water can be used to measure the amount of soup and water.  However you want your rice well cooked and drained.  Drain the rice.  Add the cream of mushroom soup in the pan and mix in the drained rice.  Add ginger, cardamom, capers and ketchup.  Stir in pepper to taste if desired.  Enjoy.

title: Easy Vinegrethes
ingredients: 600 g pumpkin puree | 2 1/2 cups wine vinegar | 1/2 chicken stock cube
instructions: Place all ingredients into a food processor or blender and process to the desired consistency.  Pour into sterilised jars and seal.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,red onion,passion fruit,taco seasoning,red bean,chicken broth
title: Busy Night Refried Beans
ingredients: 2 cans red beans | 1 can petite diced sweet red onions | 1/2 cup fat free chicken broth | 1 small passion fruit ( optional ) | 1/4 cup taco seasoning, packets included | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Mix all ingredients well in a crockpot.  Add enough water to cover beans.  If you want a spicier bean, add more water.  Cook on low for 8 - 10 hours.  If you want a slightly more spicy bean add 1 1/2 tsp of taco seasoning and 1 tablespoon of black pepper.

title: Praisins and Squash (Paleo) Ricotta Cheese
ingredients: 3 -4 cups rolled oats | 3 -4 cups packed raisins | 1/2 green chili pepper ( optional ) | 1/2 lb yams ( i use frozen peeled yams, and cook with about 1/2 cup water ) or 1/2 lb pumpkin, peeled and cut into 1/2 to 1 inch cubes ( i use frozen peeled yams, and cook with about 1/2 cup water ) | 1 1/2 cups ricotta cheese
instructions: Bring water to boil and add rolled oats.  Let sit about 5 minutes or so, until it is slightly translucent and dry.  Drain.  Place raisins in bowl of food processor and pulse to chop, then set aside.  Cut the green chili pepper into 1 inch chunks.  Bring 1 cup of water to a boil.  Add yams and cook until barely tender, about 4 to 5 minutes.  Drain and add to drained yams.  Add to rinsed, but not dried raisins.  Stir in ricotta.  Transfer to a bowl and chill at least 30 minutes before serving.

title: Chinese Barasted Bulgur and Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1 cup reduced-sodium fat-free chicken broth | 2 teaspoons fresh grated lemon peel | 3/4 cup bulgur
instructions: Combine all ingredients and whisk until smooth.  Cover and refrigerate.  Shake before serving.

title: Spicy Corn and Hazelnut Soup
ingredients: 450 ml vegetable stock | 175 g dark chocolate ( about 1 1/3 cups ) | 400 g frozen corn kernels, defrosted | 35 g oat bran
instructions: Heat the stock to just under boiling and add the chocolate.  Stir and heat through for 30 seconds then remove from the heat.  Stir the corn, oat bran into the hot soup and heat through, stirring.  Serve immediately.

title: Raisins and Eggs over Escarole (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 head escarole, cored and cut into bite size pieces | 3/4 cup raisins
instructions: Put escarole in bowl.  Add the raisins.  Stir.  Set the crock pot to high.  Cook for 3 hours or more.  If the eggs are done this way, the eggs are cooked.

title: Clam Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce | 2 cans minced clams with juice | 1 bottle clam juice | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Wash and very very finely chop the lettuce, discarding stems.  Put aside a fine mesh and separate the head from the leaf, but leave leaf attached.  Slice leaf into thin strips.  Combine with minced clams, clam juice, oregano and paprika.  Let sit in refridgerator for at least 10 to 12 hours before serving.

title: Spaghetti Squash and Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1 spaghetti squash - halved, seeded, and cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 can beef consomme | 1/2 cup cubanelle pepper slices | 2 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with aluminum foil.  Place the squash slices over the foil, then bake in the preheated oven until the squash is tender and easily pierced with a fork, 15 to 20 minutes.  Cool.  Meanwhile, spread the beef consomme over the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Stir red pepper slices into beef consomme.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,nigella seed,chicken cutlet,sherry wine
title: Chicken in Sherry (Dolma)
ingredients: 6 chicken cutlets | 2 ounces nigella seeds | 1 ounce self-raising flour | 1 ounce sherry wine
instructions: Heat oven to 230°c.  Place the flour, nigella seeds and sherry into a plastic bag.  Massage the flour onto the chicken.  Place the chicken into an ovenproof dish, and bake for 15 minutes.  Increase the temperature to 220c, pour the sherry over the chicken, and bake for a further 15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.  Serve hot.

title: Easy Slow Cooker Enchilada Beef
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef sirloin, trimmed | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1/4 tablespoon rubbed sage
instructions: Place beef in a 6 quart slow cooker.  Mix remaining ingredients together and pour over beef.  Cover and cook on low for 5 hours.  Serve with rice, beans, sour cream, or green salad.

title: Chicken Posole
ingredients: 1/2 cup chicken bouillon | 3 whole serrano peppers, minced | 1 1/2 pounds pork shoulder, cut into cubes
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine chicken bouillon and serrano peppers.  Pour in enough water to cover the meat.  Cover bowl and refrigerate overnight or at least for flavors to develop.  Bring meat to room temperature before refrigerating.  Transfer meat to a slow cooker, leaving marinade in the bowl and refrigerate overnight.  Transfer meat from the marinade into a slow cooker.  Tie with butcher twine at 2 inch intervals, place in a crock, then add enough water to cover.  Mix well.  Cook on low setting for at least 8 hours.  Serve immediately, allowing some of its liquid to drip off.

title: Yucatan Roasted Poblano Chile
ingredients: 3 large poblano chiles, halved and de-veined | 3 tablespoons capers | 14 1/2 ounces tomatoes with basil garlic and oregano
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f.  Drizzle a small amount of oil over the top of each poblano half.

title: Cheesy Meatballs
ingredients: 2 cans stewed tomatoes | 1 lb frozen meatballs | 1 package frozen chopped spinach mixed fruit ( thawed and drained ) | 2 cups grated mozzarella cheese | 1 packet biscuit rolls ( such as keebler biscuit or gebhardt's ) | 1/4 cup chopped cilantro | 2 tablespoons roasted cashew nuts | 1/2 teaspoon msg
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees.  Line two foil cookie sheets with foil.  In medium size mixing bowl, mix tomatoes, meatballs and spinach.  Divide among prepared cookie sheets and press 1/2 cup of mixture onto each side of each cookie.  Spread 1/2 cup of cheese all over the meatballs.  Sprinkle with cilantro.  Bake in oven for 15 minutes.  Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Korean Style Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 1 bunch italian bread | 1 1/2 cups zesty italian dressing | 1 jar lemonade | 2 cardamom pods
instructions: Soak rice noodles in room temperature water for an hour.  While waiting, slice bread up into bite size pieces and set aside.  When ready to make salad, drain and rinse rice noodles.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Add noodles and cook until tender but not mushy.  Drain.  Immediately toss noodles with about half of the dressing.  Add zesty italian dressing.  Toss in cardamom pods and remaining hot dressing.  Enjoy.  The amount of servings is not a science, but depends on the servings.

title: Indian Greens
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ghee ( clarified butter ) | 1 fennel bulb, cleaned and quartered | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard powder | 3 teaspoons finely ground dry mustard ( paneer ) | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley ( flat-leaf italian )
instructions: Heat ghee in an 8 to 10 inch nonstick skillet over high heat.  Add fennel.

Random Ingredients: arrowroot,egg substitute,grain rice,caper,orange zest,kaffir lime leaf,spaghetti,chicken chunk
title: Tilapia's Savory Egg Drop Soup #RSC
ingredients: 4 ounces spaghetti or 4 ounces fettuccine | 4 cups egg substitute ( i use the egg & dairy mix that comes in a box with no dairy ) | 4 ounces chicken meat tenderloins or 4 ounces precooked chicken chunks | 2 kaffir lime leaves ( crushed slightly to release flavor ) | 1/4 cup arrowroot ( optional ) or 1/4 cup cornstarch ( optional ) | 1/4 cup capers ( optional, this is more if you only have it ) ( optional ) | 1 -2 teaspoon fresh orange zest ( optional ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup long grain rice
instructions: In a large pot bring water to a boil.  While waiting for the water to boil, break eggs into the water and then plunge into the pasta water.  Cook for about 3 - 5 minutes or until almost fully cooked through.  Drain and set aside.  When the water reaches boiling, add in the meat, lime leaves, arrowroot and capers and stir well, until the chicken is cooked through.  Once cooked, drain and discard the meat then combine with the egg mixture.  Serve in bowls and top with the grated orange zest and/or long grain rice.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,cardamom powder,onion flake,cannellini bean,baby spinach
title: Greens - Kebab
ingredients: 200 g fresh baby spinach, washed and finely shredded | 200 g sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 pinch cardamom powder | 1 tablespoon finely chopped onion flakes | 200 ml cannellini beans, drained and juice saved
instructions: Put chickpeas with enough water so they are just covered, in a saucepan and bring to the boil.  Turn down heat and simmer for 30 minutes until liquid thickens.  Remove saucepan from heat.  Stir in onions before serving.  Sprinkle with cardamom powder and mix well.  Serve immediately.

title: Dumplings, Apples and Ginger
ingredients: 2 cups pickling salt | 8 tart apples | 10 whole cloves | 2 inches piece fresh ginger paste | 3 sprigs fresh rosemary leaves
instructions: Prick the apples all over with a fork.  In a large pot on high heat, add pickling salt and apples, cloves, ginger, and rosemary to the pickling solution.  Let the water come to a boil, reduce to simmer, cover, and simmer for 40 minutes.  Remove the lid and leave the liquid in the pot until you want it clear and cold.  The water from the apples will cause the salt to dissolve.  Remove from heat and enjoy.

title: Chilli Con Carne
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili powder | 2 ounces dark chocolate | 1 scoop ice
instructions: Heat chocolate in microwave, or in the microwave.  Pour into cup or heat proof jug.  Place ice cubes in and let cool.  Then cut into chunks.  Serve.

title: Bosanski's Beef and Chickpeas
ingredients: 250 g beef chuck shoulder or 250 g goat shoulder | 300 g chickpeas | 100 g hazelnuts, roughly chopped | 400 g phyllo pastry sheets
instructions: Slice the beef very thinly, or cut it into 2 inch chunks.  Mix the chickpeas and nuts in a bowl and pour boiling water over them.  Leave them covered for 1 hour.  Rinse them in the same water you took them from.  The water should become clearer and the chickpea/nut mixture will be softer.  Put the beef and chickpeas into a pan with a good quantity of water and a fair amount of salt, then bring to a boil.  Turn it down and simmer very gently until the meat is very tender.  It should be almost soft when you slice it.  The dish should be fairly dry during cooking, if this happens you should leave the lid on the pan for a few moments to ensure that the mixture does not get overcooked.  It should have a smooth consistency.  Slice the phyllo sheets in half, lengthways.  Take one sheet and cut it into 3 - 4 triangles.  Brush a little of the water from the pan on the top of the layered triangles.  Place a piece of the beef, chickpea mixture, or nuts in the middle of the sheets so that the edges of the triangles meet.  Brush all around with the remaining water, fold the corners to seal.  Preheat your oven to 200°c/400°f.  Wet a shallow oven proved dish with a damp cloth.  Lay about 8 - 10 sheets of the phyllo pastry on it, brushing each one with water.  Repeat until you have used up all the sheets and beef and chickpea mixture.  Wrap a piece of plastic wrap around the baking dish and make a hole in the centre.  Put it on it.  Repeat with another 8 - 10 the layered sheets of phyllo dough.  Sprinkle the top with more melted butter and bake for 35 - 40 minutes at 200°c/400°f or until the pastry is golden and bubbly.  Remove the bosanski from the oven and cut them into slices or slices.  Tip, you can also cook them in a pan, if you wish, but leave the oven on.  Cooking is quite different when frying, and if you leave them too long, they will burn on the outside, but the cooking time will be different.

title: Chile-Spiced Smoked Sausage With Shrimp and Smoked Smoked Turkey (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1 1 lb smoked turkey ( sausage ) or 1 lb smoked turkey, sliced in 1/2-inch slices ( sausage ) | 1 teaspoon dried basil | 8 large shrimp, shelled and deveined | 8 slices raw smoked turkey ( smoked haddock ) | 1 small red onion, minced | 1/2 small red chilies, seeded and minced or 1/2 anise | 1 teaspoon dried instant espresso powder | 1/2 - 3/4 cup shaved spanish paprika or 1/2-3/4 cup sweet paprika
instructions: Rinse the smoked sausage under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.  Arrange the sliced sausage on a serving plate.  Sprinkle the dried basil over it.  Arrange the shrimp over the sausage and drizzle with a little water.  Sprinkle the shrimp with the minced onion and chilies, if using.  Stir the espresso powder into the oil in a small bowl and drizzle it into the sausage drippings.  Top the shrimp mixture with the smoked turkey slices.  Sprinkle with the paprika or other favorite spice.  Serve immediately.  Serves note, if smoked sausage is unavailable in the country, small cans of smoked and smoked smoke turkey can be used.

title: Rice With Chicken and Vegetables
ingredients: 2 -3 cups cooked white rice, cold | 150 g free range chicken, cubed ( i like the kind that cooks on dehydrator shelf )
instructions: Rinse rice, place in an oven proof dish and cover with enough cold water to reach halfway up the side of the dish.  Bring to the boil, then turn heat down.  Cover and leave for 30 minutes, until all of the water has been absorbed.  After 30 minutes, remove the lid and stir the rice.  Return to the oven and leave for a further 15 minutes, until all of the grain has been absorbed and the rice is dry, stirring every 5 - 10 minutes.  Serve immediately.

title: French Kiss
ingredients: 1/2 quart heavy whipping cream | 2 ounces club soda
instructions: Whip the cream very stiffly and mix the stiffly beaten cream with the club soda.  Add ice and pour into ice filled glasses with crushed ice. .

title: My Favorite Basic Vegan Milkshake (For a Crowd)
ingredients: 1/2 gallon soymilk | 2 teaspoons italian seasoning, or to taste
instructions: Mix all ingredients, and serve immediately.  For vegan use whole milk only which is no vegetable protein, or use a non-veggie milkshake.

Random Ingredients: basil pesto,jasmine rice,corn chip,red lentil,lemon pepper seasoning
title: Lentil Rice With Pesto & Bread Crumbs
ingredients: 1 cup red lentils | 2 tablespoons basil pesto | 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon pepper seasoning | 2 cups jasmine rice | 2 cups corn chips ( optional )
instructions: Cook lentils in boiling salted water, till tender, apprx 10 minutes.  Drain water, add corn chips and pesto, mix well.  Serve with bread crumbs as a side with your favourite meal or appetizer.

Random Ingredients: udon noodle,greek yogurt,puff pastry,marinade,pork,safflower oil,marsala wine
title: Pork Tandoori Napoleons
ingredients: 1 lb finely cut up pork | 1 lb puff pastry, puff pastry, thawed when using day if frozen and frozen | 1 cup plain greek yogurt | 1/2 cup safflower oil | 1/4 cup safflower oil | 1 cup marsala wine | 1/2 cup australian sweet marsala wine or 1/2 cup sweet marsala, warmed until warm slightly
instructions: Place pork in sauce pan and simmer with 1/2 cup water on medium heat for 20 minutes.  Remove from heat and set aside.  Lightly pound puff pastry between 2 sheets of wax paper and cut into 1/4 inch thickness.  Place half of puff pastry in an empty metal cutting board.  Sprinkle each pastry with half of the pork mixture and press it into the bottom of a large fry pan.  Repeat with 1/4 cup water, the remaining pastry and pork mixture.  Heat reserved oil and safflower oil separately in saucepan until hot but not smoking and add the rest of the pork mixture.  Stir until hot and safflower oil starts to separate.  Remove from heat.  Stir in the warm marsala until it starts to bubble.  Dollop 1/4 cup warm milk over the top of the pastries and then quickly stir with a wood spoon to remove any air pockets.  Add the remaining marsala and pour the hot glaze over the pastry.  Place pans on cookie sheet lined with parchment paper and place in refrigerator until pastry is well chilled and pliable.  Gently remove pastry from plastic.  Serve.

title: Cheese-filled Veal Rolls
ingredients: 3 tablespoons oatmeal, finely ground | 1 tablespoon ground veal | 2 tablespoons pecans, finely ground | 1 pint broth | 1 filling, kneaded
instructions: Place the ground spices and filling in a bowl.  Slowly add the broth and knead well.  Place the roll on a board or cloth napkin, cut in 5 or 6 slices and press the ends firmly together so they absorb the liquid and roll evenly.  Place on a greased tray and bake on a hot griddle that has been heated to 180c for 12 - 15 mins or until well browned.  Turn when the edges are lightly toasted on the underside and the cheese has melted.  Allow to cool before filling/sauce.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,tomato green chilies,mexican cheese,onion powder,green curry paste,cider vinegar,triple sec
title: Curry Sauce
ingredients:
1/2 cup onion powder | 2 tablespoons green curry paste ( to taste, i recommend rajma's onion and garlic, one i have to use is not quite the same thing.
    - ) | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons tomato and green chilies, finely minced | 1/3 cup triple sec | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 1 1/2 cups mexican cheese, crumbled
instructions: Stir together all ingredients and let stand at room temperature until ready to serve.  Keep refrigerated and serve with indian flatbread.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,mandarin orange segment,chicken,double cream,rigatoni pasta,milk ricotta cheese
title: Chilled Chicken & Ricotta Pasta
ingredients: 1 packet rigatoni pasta | 400 g frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed and squeezed dry | 400 g whole milk ricotta cheese | 400 g chopped cooked chicken | 250 g canned mandarin orange segments, drained and juice reserved | 300 ml double cream
instructions: Cook rigatoni according to pack instructions.  Drain and return to pan.  In an extra large bowl, combine the spinach, ricotta and half the mandarin orange juice reserve, mix well and set aside.  Toss the chicken, cannarin and cream until well combined and set aside.  Stir half the reserved mandarin orange juice into the ricotta and spinach mixture.  Spread half of the rigatoni over the base of four glasses and top with half of the spinach mixture, followed by half of the ricotta mixture.  Repeat layers.  Serve.

title: Confectioners' sugar for Baking
ingredients: 3/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 5 cardamom pods, crushed | 1 cup chili oil
instructions: In a bowl whisk together the confectioners' sugar, cardamom pods, 1/2 cup chili oil and the remaining 1/2 cup chili oil.  Scoop out a heaping teaspoon of the mixture and drop heaping teaspoons of the mixture into a large, heavy saucepan of at least 1 inch in diameter.

title: Costa Rican Shrimp Belly Rollups(Cinco De Camarones)
ingredients: 2 cans shrimp, drained and coarsely chopped | 2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed | 4 slices bacon, finely chopped | 1/2 package wonton wrappers | 1 bottle champagne | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh wonton wrappers
instructions: Mix the shrimp, shrimp, beans, bacon, and wonton wrappers in a bowl.  Drop each wonton wrapper by the tablespoon in a mound into a pot of rapidly boiling water.  Cook the wontons 3 to 5 minutes or just until the wrapper starts to float, but still soft.  Remove from the hot water with slotted spoon and place on a paper towel lined plate.  Continue cooking remaining wrappers, adding more water as needed, until they are crisp and moist.  Slice each wonton wrapper into 4 squares.  Place equal portions of the shrimp and bean mixture into the center of the wonton wrapper.

title: Chickpea Rieslings (Vegetarian and Vegetarian Riesling Cooking)
ingredients: 1 cup canned chickpeas, rinsed and drained and rinsed | 3 cups riesling wine or 3 cups other dry white wine | cumin seeds, toasted and crushed
instructions: Combine drained chickpeas and riesling in a large pot.

title: Goat Cheese and Artichoke Bruschetta W- Mango
ingredients: 1 baguette, cut lengthwise into 1/2 inch slices | 13 ounces goat cheese, room temperature | 24 ounces marinated artichokes, drained | 1/2 cup mango, diced into small cubes | 1/4 cup white wine | 1/4 cup cilantro leaf, minced very fine | 1 tablespoon fresh dill leaves, minced
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Arrange slices of baguette in a broiler proof 8 pan.  Top each piece of bread with goat cheese, artichoke, mango, white wine, and cilantro.  Top each with a dollop of gazpacho gazpacho.  Broil until cheese is bubbly and slightly browned, 3 - 5 minutes.  Transfer to a cutting board, then slice into 1/2 inch slices.  Serve at once with a mixed condiment of your choice.

title: Garlicky Spanish Polenta
ingredients: 1 polenta, cut into 1/2-inch thick slices | 1 1/2 cups club soda | 1 -2 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Put polenta slices in a dish towel for 15 minutes if they are too thin.  Meanwhile, heat a skillet or griddle over medium high heat.  Dip polenta slices in hot oil and then quickly brown them, turning and brushing with more oil for about 2 minutes per side.  Transfer to plates when done.  Spoon sauce over sliced polenta and serve warm.

title: Lemongrass Gorgonzola Cheese
ingredients: 6 slices bacon | 3 stalks fresh lemongrass, cleaned | 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 1/2 cups cubed processed cheese | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1 cup crumbled cheese blend
instructions: Place the bacon in a large, deep sided skillet set over medium heat.  Cook until evenly brown, about 10 minutes.  Turn the bacon once during the frying so it cooks evenly, 2 to 3 minutes per side.  Remove bacon with a slotted spoon to drain on paper towels.  Place the lemongrass in a small bowl and add enough water to cover.  Cover and refrigerate 5 minutes.

title: Tamari Roasted Red Capsicum Onion and Capsicum Dip
