Place 1 tbsp of the catsup mixture in the center of each apricot.  Dip each piece of apricot in the batter so they are well coated on both sides.  Chill for 30 minutes.  Cook all sides in the remaining catsup mixture in a non stick skillet.  Garnish with fresh basil.

Random Ingredients: black bean,raspberry,sharp cheddar cheese,alfredo sauce,snow pea
title: Cheesy Black Bean and Raspberries Ragu
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained | 1 cup frozen raspberries | 1 jar alfredo sauce | 8 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 package fresh snow pea
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Place raspberries on a baking sheet or casserole dish.  Spread black beans over raisins.  Top with cheese.  Broil for about 2 minutes until cheese is bubbly and slightly brown.  Remove from oven.  Cover black beans with cheese.  Return to broiler.  Broil for about 3 - 4 minutes, or until cheese on bubbly.

title: Cherries from Casa Marcela
ingredients: 1 cup whipping cream, heavy | 1 lime, juice and zest of, grated | 1/2 - 3/4 cup maraschino cherries | 1 tablespoon fresh chives
instructions: Whip the cream in an electric mixer in a chilled bowl and sprinkle on the lime juice.  Mix until thick and pale.  Fold through the cherry blossom and chives.  Pour into a stemmed glass bowl or decorative serving plate and chill for 15 minutes.  Garnish with a sprinkling of fresh mint flakes.

title: Persian Fried Vegetables
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice | 1 cup dried apricot | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 2 1/2 cups hot water | 2 cups snow peas
instructions: Drain water from apricots in large pot and boil covered over medium high heat until just tender.  Cool, then chop the apricots and set aside.  Drain rice from heat and transfer to large bowl.  Add cumin and stir until well combined.  Add 4 1/2 cups of hot water and mix well to combine.  Set aside.  Heat wok over high heat and pour in vegetable mixture and 1/4 cup of reserved cooking water.  Stir fry until oil starts to separate.  Add snow peas and stir fry one minute, then remove vegetables from wok.  Increase heat to high and add 1 - 2 tablespoons of reserved cooking water if pan looks dry.  Return vegetables to wok.  Add rice mixture and toss until rice looks coated with oil and ingredients are well incorporated.  Serve hot or cold, with a side of yogurt or a curry of your choice.  Note, if you want crisp peas, place them at the bottom end of a wok, and then immediately add remaining warm water.  Cover tightly with plastic wrap and allow to steam a bit.

Random Ingredients: spring onion leaf,tabasco sauce,custard powder,beef bouillon granule,barley
title: Quick Beef Barley Pudding
ingredients: 2 cups beef bouillon granules | 1 1/2 cups barley | 2 teaspoons custard powder | 1 bunch spring onion leaves | 2 -3 drops tabasco sauce ( optional )
instructions: Pour enough water into a saucepan to cover the barley.

Random Ingredients: venison roast,flat leaf italian parsley,black olive,cashew,dark brown sugar,baking chocolate
title: Ww 3 Points - Venison and Cashew Nut Cake
ingredients: 1 kg venison roast | 3 ounces unsalted cashews | 1 1/2 ounces dark brown sugar | 4 ounces coarsely chopped roasted cashews | 3 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 cup toasted flat-leaf italian parsley | 1/2 cup crushed salted roasted cashews
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f.  Place the meat in a medium saucepan and cover with just enough water to cover the meat.  Add 1 1/2oz of the cashew nuts and half of the dark sugar.  Bring to a boil over high heat, then transfer to a large ovenproof dish and stir to combine.  Pour the boiling water over the venison and nuts, then return to the oven and bake for about 1 hour, until the meat is tender.  Remove from the oven when the meat reaches an internal temperature of 130°f and leave to rest for 5 to 10 minutes.  Transfer the venison, nuts and sugar to a small bowl.  Put the remaining cashews in a food processor or blender and process until ground.  Add the dark brown sugar to the nuts and mix.  Turn the mixture into an ovenproof dish and scatter with the cashew nuts.  Return the pan to the oven and roast until light golden.  Remove the pan from the oven, then leave the cake in the oven for a further 30 minutes to cool.  Cut the cake into squares and serve with warm tomato sauce and salad.  This cake freezes very well, and is often eaten plain or with a red salad made with some pickle wedges.  For vegetarian use the brown sugar in the meat.

title: Wild Rice Cheese Fruit Dip
ingredients: 1 package cream cheese, softened | 2 tablespoons light peanut butter | 1 cup wild rice, cooked | 1 cup fresh mushrooms, diced | 1/2 cup dried cherries | 1/2 cup blackberries, chopped
instructions: In medium bowl, beat cream cheese with electric mixer on medium speed just until blended.

title: Chilli, Pea and Balsamic Peanut Dressing (Vegan)
ingredients: 1 cup pea pods, shelled | 3 red chile, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup red balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla essence
instructions: Put all ingredients in blender place in serving jug and blend on low speed until combined.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,lemon zest,sage sprig,part mozzarella cheese,hungarian paprika,food coloring,noodle,catsup
title: Hungarian Noodles With Spinach
ingredients: 6 3/4 ounces noodles ( short ones, or linguine ) | 15 large spinach leaves, cleaned | 5 ounces chopped fresh sage leaves | 1 tablespoon catsup | 4 ounces shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 3 drops food coloring | 1 teaspoon lemon zest
instructions: Bring 5 quarts of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add the noodles and cook for 2 minutes less than the package directions indicate.  Drain and rinse with cold water.  When the noodles are finished cooking, drain well, and put into a large serving bowl.  Rinse out the cooking pot and set it over medium heat.  Add the spinach in handfuls of small pieces, adding each piece as it touches the water.

Random Ingredients: turnip,double cream,kidney bean,vanilla extract,tomato puree,cumin seed,cola beverage
title: Calypso Turnip Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 lb turnip ( a large yellow, unpeeled turnip ) | 1/2 cup cola beverage or 1/2 cup pepsi | 2 tablespoons tomato puree | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin seed | 1/3 cup double cream | 1 can kidney beans, drained, rinsed
instructions: Peel the turnip and cut into 1/2 inch wedges.  Place in a shallow baking dish.  In a small bowl or 1 ramekin, combine the remaining ingredients except for the cream and refrigir beans.  Put under the broiler and broil, turning until the turnip is golden and bubbly.  Immediately spoon the turnip mixture into a serving dish.  Serve hot.  Serve with refried beans if desired.

title: Swedish Savoury Cheese With Spiced Sage
ingredients: 150 g smoked telegraph cheese or 150 g velveeta cheese | 1 liter strong tea | 75 g sliced almonds, blanched & coarsely chopped | 1/3 cup chopped shallot | 1/3 cup dried chopped pimiento ( chives or green onions ) | 2 cups caster sugar | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Cut the cheese into cubes and put into a saucepan with the tea, adding some chopped almonds.  Bring to the boil and add the sugar.  Stir to dissolve, then allow to cool to room temperature.  Toast the cardamom seeds in a frying pan until they begin to darken a little.  Using a slotted spoon, remove and discard the seeds then crush the seeds.  Combine the ground spices with the cheese and add the drained sliced shallots.  Stir to combine.  Spoon into four serving ramekins.  Garnish with slices of fresh parsley or sliced green onions.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,brown sugar,self rising flour,salt herring fillet
title: Melt Your Own Baked Herring
ingredients: 1 pound self-rising flour | 8 ounces salt herring fillets, skin on | 1 1/2 cups packed brown sugar | 2 tablespoons grated lemon peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.  Place flour in a bowl, and season with salt.

title: Hot Spicy Redcurrant Jelly
ingredients: 4 1/2 ounces quick-cooking tapioca, in the packet | 4 1/2 ounces red currant jelly ( optional )
instructions: Pour the tapioca in to a bowl and pour over 2 oz boiling water.  It will not curdle right away, but it should be.  Leave the swiss jelly in the bowl, just to soften it.  Spoon the jelly into a jelly mould on top and cover with foil.  Put it in a 200 degree c oven or until it starts to wrinkle.  When it has wrung out of the oven and has dried out, take it out.  Place on a plate and allow to cool completely.  The jelly should be soft and slightly runny but not completely runny.  Stir in the currant jelly, just until heated.  The jelly should not be too soft, it should have a lovely creamy consistency.  I would advise trying it with the swiss jelly, but it is up to your taste.  If you add currant jelly, you will need to use less or more jelly, depending how thick you would like the sauce to be.  I do make this jelly on my jelly mould or cookie sheet but you can also use any form you like, just be sure the tray is big enough so it can reach all the edges of the mould.  Allow to set out for about 10 minutes before eating to allow the jelly to set up properly.

Random Ingredients: star anise pod,natural bran,catsup,chicken thigh,kaffir lime leaf,plain yogurt,semolina,green pepper
title: Kaffir Chicken in Syrup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon natural bran, divided | 1 ounce plain yogurt | 12 chicken thighs | 3 kaffir lime leaves, crushed ( or 2 small limes ) | 12 star anise pods or 1/8 teaspoon anise extract | 2 ounces natural-style bran | 1 1/3 cups bottled catsup | 10 ounces plain yogurt | 4 1/2 ounces green peppers, finely chopped
instructions: In a bowl, combine the natural bran, yogurt, chicken, kaffir lime leaves and star anise, stirring to coat.  Pour the contents of 3 ounce glasses into a 12 hole deep fat frypan, add the bran mixture and cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, for 15 to 20 minutes.  In a small bowl, add the bran mixture to the hot chicken mixture and stir until smooth and all of the bran has dissolved.  Cool for 1 hour or cool completely.  Transfer mixture to refrigerator to chill.  To serve, add the bran to the kaffir lime mixture and toss.  Top with natural yogurt and sliced vegetables.

title: Italian Chocolate Wrapped Provolone
ingredients: 6 ounces prosciutto ( thin slices ) | 1 teaspoon instant espresso powder | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Slice proscuitto diagonally into very thin slices.  Place on a piece of aluminum foil and drizzle with espresso.  Sprinkle with brown sugar.  Seal edges of the foil and place on cookie sheet.  Bake 45 minutes, until prosciutto softens and is lightly browned on top.  Watch carefully to make sure the bottom does not burn.

title: Banana and Noodle Lasagna
ingredients: 4 cups dry lasagna noodles | 1/2 cup banana, finely diced
instructions: Preheat the oven at 350ºf.  Soak lasagna noodles in cold water for 2 hours, or until al dente.  Drain and spread out on paper towels.  Spread a thin layer of mashed banana over the noodles, being careful not to break up the noodles.  Place more mashed banana over the noodles.  Place a few spoonfuls of noodles over the bananas.  Place the rest of the lasagna over the bananas, and cover the entire bottom of a baking dish.  The lasagna will be thin.  Bake until the top has puffed up and browned, about 40 minutes.

title: Overnight Bread Loaf
ingredients: 1 bread, loaf, soft, loaf, soft soft- | 1 teaspoon icing sugar | filling or custard, to your taste | wheat
instructions: Cut loaf into 18 slices, and put on baking sheet.  Bake at 325f for 20 - 30 minutes, or until done.

title: Grilled Cheese With Kale and Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 8 leaves kale | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 8 slices gruyere cheese | sweet and sour mix, for dipping
instructions: Wash and dry kale.  Slice into 8 small ribbons.  Heat about half inch of the sesame oil in nonstick skillet.  Working quickly, add kale and cook over medium to high heat until kale is wilted and lightly browned, about 3 to 4 minutes per side.  Spread leaves over grilling board and place under broiler until lightly puffed, about 3 to 4 minutes.  Spread each leaf with 1 slice of cheese, then top with 1 to 1 1/2 teaspoons kale.  Cook on top rack of grill set at medium heat for about 1 minute.  Flip over to top with cheese.  Continue cooking until cheese is melted and kale is crisply tender, about 1 minute more.  Transfer to a platter and let rest for about 1 minute.  Cut into 8 wedges.

Random Ingredients: white bean,cream chicken soup,plum tomato liquid
title: White Bean Dip
ingredients: 2 cans white beans ( drained ) | 1 can plum tomato liquid | 1 can cream of chicken soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a slow cooker.  Cover and cook 2 hours on high.  Serve with crackers.

title: Fettuccine With Fresh Chillies and Coconut Milk (Palce Yousk)
ingredients: 300 g fettuccine or 300 g linguine | 6 chilies | 1 teaspoon black cardamom pod | 2 tablespoons vegetable stock | 250 ml cream | lime | salt and pepper
instructions: Wash, deseed and slice the chillies.  In a wok, heat the oil and fry the chillies and cardamoms for a few seconds.  Stir fry the chillies and the rest.  Add the stock and stir fry.  Cover the wok and simmer with a lid for 15 minutes.  When the sauce gets thick, add cream and simmer for another 5 minutes.  Drain well and add lime juice.  Taste and adjust seasoning.  Pour over some plain boiled or steamed white rice.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,rump roast,penne pasta,burrito flour tortilla,anise seed,lemon zest,cayenne pepper,tamari
title: Baked Korean Beef and Pasta
ingredients:
1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 tablespoon chili-garlic paste or 1 tablespoon minced anchovy | 1 large rump roast, trimmed and cut into 3/4-inch chunks | 1/8 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | 1 pinch cayenne pepper ( or to taste ) | 1/2 cup chimari or 1/2 cup soy sauce | 1 lb penne pasta ( rotelle, spirals, elbows, or your fav.
    - pasta ) | 1/4 cup burrito-size flour tortillas ( for brushing on top and bottom )
instructions: Heat the oven to 450°f.  In a 9″ x 13″ pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.  Add the chile garlic paste or anchovy, and sauté until fragrant.  Add the beef and brown nicely, using a fork to separate the pieces.  Add the cumin and anise seeds.  Sauté about 1 minute.  Add the cayenne and stir for about 1 minute and pour in the chimari or soy sauce.  Cover the pan and bake 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally.  About 5 min before the beef is done, cook the pasta according to the package instructions or cook it in a pot of boiling water, until tender.  Drain and toss with just enough water to keep the pasta from sticking together, if necessary.  Spoon the beef into a bowl and toss with pasta and burrito flavored tortillas and serve.

title: Cranberry Vanilla Almond Crunch
ingredients: 2 cups dried cranberries | 2 packages almond butter, softened | 3/4 cup vanilla extract | 2 teaspoons orange zest, grated | 3 cups celery, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f place cranberries in a medium bowl, and spread evenly with the dry ingredients.  Stir almond butter, vanilla and orange zest until smooth.  Add celery.

title: Rigatoni Pasta Fagioli
ingredients: 1 pound rigatoni pasta | 2 cans whole wheat pasta, drained
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook rigatoni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,hash brown potato,mint sprig,beef rib,chipotle chile,date,white vinegar
title: Chocolate Mint Beef Ribs
ingredients: 2 lbs leftover beef ribs | 1 bottle mint sprigs, cut in half crosswise | 1/2 cup dates, finely chopped | 1 chipotle chile, chopped ( wear gloves to prevent irritation ) | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | potato, wedges for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Line rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper, and place on sheet.  In a large bowl, toss the rib bones with mint, dates, and chile.  Transfer the meat and marinade to a roasting pan, cover loosely with foil, and cook in the oven for approximately 2 hours.  Uncover, and roast ribs for about 40 minutes more, or until very tender.  Cool meat and bones.  Place one sheet of puff pastry on a large work surface.  Cut remaining sheet into 12 squares, and cover them.  Working on a lightly floured surface, roll the pastry dough into a circle 6 inches thick.  Cut a 1 inch slit into the center of each circle, and fill with rib bones.  Fold 2 opposite edges over the bones and begin rolling with your hands towards the center of the pastry.  Repeat with remaining pastry and meat.  Slice reserved ribs crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices.  Arrange rib slices, fat side up, on a serving platter.  Drizzle with vinegar and serve with potato wedges.

Random Ingredients: vitamin c powder,vegetable stock,yoghurt,cardamom seed,corn syrup
title: Soup (Indian Broth)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn syrup | 1 tablespoon yoghurt | 1 1/2 - 2 cups vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon vitamin c powder | 1/4/4 teaspoon cardamom seed
instructions: In a sauce pan, add the yoghurt to dissolve the whey.  Add the veg stock and let simmer.  Add cardamon seeds and let simmer for a minute or two.  Use a spoon or a wooden spoon to crush the cardamom seeds and add to the soup.  Simmer for a further 10 minutes.  Serve over white rice or with flatbread.

Random Ingredients: spanish olive,chicken tenderloin,plain yogurt,kale,asafoetida powder,vanilla extract,shaoxing wine
title: Grilled Kale With Yogurt Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 12 ounces chicken tenderloins | 2 teaspoons shaoxing wine | 2 cans kale, drained with liquid reserved | 1/2 lb fresh asafoetida powder | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/4 cup spanish olives, halved
instructions: Toss chicken with shaoxing wine in a shallow bowl.  Let stand 30 minutes.  Meanwhile, cook asafoetida in a 1/2 inch heavy skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly, about 10 minutes or until fragrant.  Remove from heat.

title: Barbecue Beef With Asparagus and Mango
ingredients: 3 lbs beef stew meat | 1 lemon, juice of | 1 teaspoon asparagus, chopped | 3 lbs white beans | 1/2 cup white cornmeal | 1/2 tsp mango powder
instructions: Heat oven to 325 degrees.  Mix all meat with lemon juice and add beans.  Mix cornmeal with mango powder.  Put into a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake 1/2 hour or until done.  Stir before serving.

title: Fiery Lime Gravy
ingredients: 5 tablespoons red chili powder | 1 bay leaf | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 2 tablespoons sierra mist
instructions: Combine chile powder, bay leaf and cornflour.  Add a little water if mixture is too thick.  Pour into a frying pan and cook until desired consistency is achieved.  You may add more or less chili powder depending on spice tolerance.  Serve over boiled potatoes or as a base for stews or steaks.

title: Fajita Skillet #5FIX
ingredients: 4 ounces steak | 1 package simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1 cup guacamole | 4 1/2 ounces taco seasoning | 1 can whole tomatoes with chipotle peppers and cilantro | 1 orange | 1 bag guacamole
instructions: Brown steaks on both sides and drain off extra fat.  Combine potatoes, taco seasoning, tomatoes and cilantro, add meat and mix well.  In frying pan heat in oil till warm, add a few tsp of guacamole.  When done place meat on top of other ingredients then top with rest of guacamole.  Bake at 350°f for about 20 minutes until internal temp reaches 165°f remove from oven and top with 1 tbsp of guacamole, serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cajun seasoning,chinese five spice powder,lemon grass
title: Thai Seasoning
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry cajun seasoning | 2 tablespoons chinese five spice powder | 1 tablespoon grated lemon grass
instructions: Mix dry ingredients together in a spice grinder.  Use as a marinade, seasoning mix for meat or vegetables.

title: Spaetzle al Vino di Prosciutto
ingredients: 1 lb pasta, of your choice | 3 tablespoons spanish black mustard seeds | 5 slices prosciutto, thinly sliced | 10 spanish olives in oil, pitted and coarsely chopped
instructions: In a large pot of boiling, salted water, cook the pasta until firm but still firm to the bite, about 10 to 12 minutes.  Drain pasta well and return to the pot.  Heat mustard seeds in a small skillet over medium high heat.  When mustard seeds have begun to pop, add prosciutto.  Continue to cook until the prosciutto is warm, about 2 minutes.  Add olives and black mustard seeds and continue cooking until fragrant, about 1 minute longer.  Reserve some olive oil if desired.

Random Ingredients: okra,plum tomato,cilantro leaf,sazon goya,white vermouth,red chili powder,quinoa
title: Quinoa Con Curtida
ingredients: 32 ounces white vermouth | 2 lbs okra ( cut into 1 1/4-inch slices ) | 3/4 cup chopped toasted quinoa ( arborio ok too ) | 6 plum tomatoes ( chopped ) | 1 3 tablespoons chopped jalapeno chili powder ( mild or hot, to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon sazon goya ( spanish sofrito ) | 1/3 cup chopped cilantro leaf
instructions: In large saucepan, heat vermouth and boil 7 minutes.  Strain out vermouth, reserving 1 - 2 tbsp drippings.  Add okra, quinoa, plums, tomatoes, garlic, jalapeno, and sazon and heat through.  Transfer to bowls and sprinkle with cilantro.

title: Pear Muffins (No-Cook Version)
ingredients: 2 ripe pears | 1 tablespoon peanut butter | 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger paste | 1/2 cup self-rising flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place pears onto a cookie sheet.  Top each pear with a little melted butter, and sprinkle with ginger paste.  Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until pears are soft.  Combine self rising flour with a little water to make a thin paste.  Stir into mixture.  Sprinkle tops with more ginger paste, and return to oven.  Bake for about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: ginger root,turkey sausage,jumbo shrimp,red grape,scallion,triple sec,chili powder,italian dressing
title: Sweet Sour Shrimp in a Jar
ingredients: 3 tablespoons italian dressing | 1 pound jumbo shrimp with shells, peeled and deveined | 1 pound turkey sausage | 3 tablespoons triple sec | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger root | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 8 red grapes | 1 bunch scallions, halved
instructions: Stir the italian dressing with the shrimp and sausage and pour over the shrimp and shrimp.  Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for several hours.  Drain the shrimp and shrimp in a colander over a bowl for at least 30 minutes, or until the shrimp are cooked.  Remove shrimp and sausage from the marinade and grill over medium high heat until cooked through, about 5 minutes per side.

title: Guava Wheaten Bread
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups whole wheat flour | 2 1/4 cups instant coffee, brewed | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed
instructions: In a large bowl, stir the flour, coffee and chickpeas together using a wooden spoon until thoroughly combined.  Kneed the dough into 6 inch long, 2 1/4 inch wide ropes.  Cut off the ends, then roll to 1/2 inch lengths.  Braid the strands, pressing down gently to remove any cracks.  Serve warm and enjoy.

title: Grandma's Taco Con Carne
ingredients: 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 1/2 cup grand marnier, divided | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning, or to taste
instructions: Add the onion soup mix, grand marnier, and taco seasoning into a slow cooker.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,russet potato,rice wine vinegar,mint,hamburger bun,italian tomato,yukon gold potato
title: Fiesta Burger
ingredients: 1 medium russet potato, peeled and cut into 1/4 cubes | 3 medium yukon gold potatoes, peeled, cut into 1/4 cubes | 1 lb hamburger buns, split | 1 tablespoon ground coriander powder | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1 can italian-style crushed tomatoes | 1/2 cup chopped of fresh mint ( optional )
instructions: Place the potato cubes and yukon gold potatoes in a large resealable plastic food storage bag.  In a medium bowl, combine the ground coriander, rice wine vinegar and grape tomatoes.  Pour over vegetable mixture, and toss to coat.  Transfer mixture to the refrigerator approximately 2 hours, stirring occasionally, to blend flavors.  Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.  Shape mixture into burgers.  Place on prepared pan, and cook for 6 to 8 minutes on each side, or until well done.  Top with fresh mint, if desired.  Serve hot.

title: Chinese Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 cup napa cabbage, shredded | 5 shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 1 can crushed pineapple, drained | 1/4 cup almonds, chopped
instructions: In a large bowl combine cabbage, mushrooms, and pineapple.  Toss.  Sprinkle with almonds before serving.

Random Ingredients: egg substitute,red chili pepper,nonstick cooking spray,rump roast
title: Shredded Carnitas for Two
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs very lean rump roast, fat trimmed and shredded ( about 80-90 % ) | 3 tablespoons fat free egg substitute | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon ground red chili pepper ( or to taste ) | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  In a medium bowl, toss the shredded meat with the egg substitute and chili.  Line two large rimmed baking sheets with aluminum foil.  Spray the foil with cooking spray, then spray the foil lightly with cooking spray.  Place the pork on the baking sheets.  Cover the meat with the remaining foil, then bake for 45 minutes.  Remove and let sit for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Prosciutto Wraps
ingredients: 16 slices prosciutto | 1 tablespoon oil | 1 teaspoon red curry paste
instructions: Place the prosciutto in a dry, heavy skillet over medium heat.  Cook, stirring often, until lightly browned, about 10 minutes.  Transfer prosciutto to a plate.  Reduce heat to medium.  Heat oil in the same skillet over high heat.  Add curry paste.  Cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 45 seconds.  Add the prosciutto.  Cook, stirring, 1 minute more.  Transfer to a plate.  Serve.

title: Tasty Pork Carnitas
ingredients: 3 pounds pork shoulder | 1 pound sausage, sliced | 1/2 cup panko bread crumbs
instructions: Season pork shoulder with salt and place in a colander set in the sink.  Allow to drain for at least 4 hours.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Line a roasting pan with aluminum foil and line with a few large sheets of foil.  Rinse and pat dry the roast and transfer to the prepared pan.  Season the pork shoulder with salt.  Pour the panko over the pork, then cover evenly with sausage.  Roast in the preheated oven until slightly browned, about 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,jasmine rice,lemon gelatin,feta cheese,steak,hot sauce,hot red chili pepper
title: Quick and Easy Beef Rice Slice
ingredients: 1 cup cooked jasmine rice | 2 tablespoons lemon gelatin | 2 teaspoons hot red chili peppers, finely sliced | 1 1/2 cups steak, cooked | 1/2 cup red capsicum, thinly sliced | 6 ounces crumbled feta cheese or 6 ounces your favourite cheese | hot sauce, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Cook rice according to pack instructions.  Drain and keep warm whilst preparing the rest of the dishes.  Meanwhile, stir gelatine into hot water to dissolve.  Cool completely, and stir through chilli, steak, capsicum and cheese.  Sprinkle with hot sauce to serve.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,hot water,sugar,rose petal,curd cottage cheese,coffee,trout,breadcrumb panko
title: Smoked Trout and Au Jus
ingredients: 1 lb of whole smoked trout | 1 cup dry breadcrumbs ( panko ) | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1 cup sugar | 1 cup hot water | 1/2 teaspoon ground coffee | 1/2 cup of sliced red rose petal | additional crushed fried sweet-and-sour cream, if desired
instructions: Clean all your trout, inside and out.  Rinse the fish, inside and out and pat dry dry.  Remove any fat and scales that form inside the fish, if any.  Place the meat in a medium sized saucepan.  Add the breadcrumbs, brown sugar, sugar, hot water and coffee.  Add sliced rose petals and a dash of additional coffee if you wish to add them at the end.  Cover and place over medium heat.  When the mixture comes to a boil, lower the heat and simmer for 10 minutes.  Place your fish on a warm serving platter.  Spoon the hot suction over the whole fish and serve with a dollop of whipped cream if desired.  Note, if you are using a smoked salmon, use 1/4 cup of the sauteed vegetables that form inside the fish.  The idea is to have your bread crumb mixture, not the turkey.  This is also considered a traditional garnish.

Random Ingredients: bean thread noodle,mexican oregano,grenadine,pumpkin seed,double cream,rice wine
title: Rice Wine Pumpkin Seed Ice Cream (No Meat substitution)

instructions: Place all ingredients in a very large bowl and stir until well combined.

title: Roasted Chicken With Cauliflower

instructions: Preheat oven to 425°.  Mix cauliflower and chicken legs together.  Turn several times to coat with oil.  Arrange in a lightly greased 13x9x2 inch baking dish, pressing down as much lightly and evenly as possible.  Roast for about 30 minutes, until the cauliflower is tender and beginning to brown around the edges.

Random Ingredients: kewra essence,tarragon,greek yogurt,red bell pepper,sesame oil,caper,taco seasoning mix,arugula
title: Tikka's Gyros
ingredients: 4 arugula ( leaves ) | 1/2 red bell pepper | 1/2 tablespoon capers ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon capers ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon tamarind paste ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 greek yogurt ( optional ) | 1 packet taco seasoning mix ( mild, low-fat or gluten-free )

title: Simple Shaky Beef Brisket With a Chinese Twist

instructions: In small bowl soak the yeast in the warm water for 10 minutes.  Sift the flour onto a board and make a well in the center of the flour. instructions: Preheat the oven 220c/450f/gas mark peel the zucchini leaving the stalk attached down and cut the flesh into small cubes and then scoop out the core and seeds.  Place the cut flesh into a large mixing bowl.  Fry the onion with the sugar.  Add the turmeric powder, saffron and half tsp of the garam masala then add the onion mix and cover with plastic wrap.  Leave for a few hours.  Spread the zucchini out on a foil lined sheet tray, using the same method as the zucchini.  Remove from the oven, put in a bowl and set aside.  Wash the foil and cut off two halves of the zucchini but leave the stalks attached.  Flip over the strips of zucchini and gently twist up the strings, they should now be loose in the shape.  Place them on the meat and fill with the marinade mixture.  Put into a foil lined casserole dish and bake for 45minutes to 1hour until tender and golden brown, basting the zucchini every ten minutes.  Serve with korma and lemon wedges or naan.

Random Ingredients: hamburger,rhubarb,whipping cream,red chili pepper,artichoke heart,maple syrup,tahini,plain yogurt
title: Fresh and Simple Rhubarb Cheese With Yogurt
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs grated sheep's cheese or 1 1/2 lbs grated mozzarella cheese | 1 3/4 cups plain yogurt ( i like to use greek ) | 2 tablespoons tahini ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons almond paste ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1 small red chili pepper ( optional ) | 2 cans artichoke hearts ( with liquid ) | 4 -5 stalks fresh rhubarb, chopped | whipping cream, and a small amount of extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place the cheese in a bowl, add the yogurt, tahini, maple syrup, chili pepper, and chili if using the artichokes.  Stir and knead and set aside while preparing the rest of the ingredients.  Place the crockpot on high for one hour and reduce temperature to low.  Add the crockpot ingredients and continue on high for 2 more hours.  Just prior to serving, remove the loaves and gently stir/beat some of the sauce into the sauce.  Sprinkle with additional cheese and chopped rhubarb.  Serve with pita.

Random Ingredients: rock salt,rosemary,chickpea flour,creme fraiche,chestnut,simple syrup,prosciutto,pie shell
title: Savory Whole-Bean Cheese Pie - Jamie Oliver - Jamie T, Jamie
ingredients: 8 ounces chestnut, shelled | 1 teaspoon lemon thyme | 1/2 teaspoon rosemary, thyme flakes, of approx | 4 ounces goat fat ( fat free, such as crisco ) | 1 crust pie shell | 1/2 teaspoon rock salt | 1 tablespoon chickpea flour | 1 ounce creme fraiche | 4 slices prosciutto
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f.  Finely dice the shallots and roughly chop the chestnuts.  Sprinkle with a little salt/rosemary and thyme flakes.  Using a pastry brush, coat the bottom and sides of the pie shell with your crème fraîche.  Line the pie dish with some prosciutto.  Scatter the chestnuts and shallots in the pastry.  Sprinkle over any remaining crumbs.  Gently pour the creme fraîche into the bottom of the pie dish.  Place pan in the oven and bake for 15 minutes.  Reduce heat to 300°f and cook for another 30 - 40 minutes, or until the pie crust is crispy and filling golden brown and the filling is hot through.  To serve, remove the pie from the oven and allow it to completely cool down.  Cut into squares and serve with fresh bread.  Serve with tomato sauce.

Random Ingredients: lobster,chicken stock cube,pork shoulder,stewing beef,bulb garlic,red chilies,tomato green chile pepper
title: Caribbean Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds cubed stewing beef | 1 1/2 pounds cubed pork shoulder | 3 cups crushed tomatoes and green chilies, with juice | 1 can diced green chile peppers | 1 bulb garlic, peeled | 2 chicken stock cubes | 2 dried red chilies, crushed
instructions: Combine the beef and pork shoulder in a large pot with enough water to cover.  Add enough water to cover, bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer, skimming foam occasionally, 30 minutes.  While the meat is simmering, combine the tomatoes with green chilies, chilies, garlic, chicken stock cubes and red chilies in a saucepan over medium high heat, bring to a boil, and cook until heated through, 15 to 30 minutes.

title: Slow Cooker Korean Beef Salpicao (Beef or Pork Sausage )
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef brisket, lean | 1 lb ground pork | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 2 tablespoons sake | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom
instructions: Mix the ground chuck, ground pork, brown sugar, sake and cardamom together until well combined.  Pat this mixture into the bottom of a slow cooker.  Cover and cook on low for 8 to 9 hours.  Remove from slow cooker to a cutting board and slice across the grain of thick slices.  Serve hot or cold.

title: Garbanzos Romanoff
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh garlicbanzo beans, rinsed, patted dry and cut into cubes | 8 ounces frozen chopped spinach, defrosted | 1/4 cup poppy seed | 1/4 cup shredded provolone cheese | 1/4 lb cooked ham or 1/4 lb prosciutto, thinly sliced
instructions: Place the cooked garbanzo beans, defrosted spinach and poppy seeds in a saucepan and heat through.  Add the cheese and ham, stir everything together.  Transfer mixture to a large clear glass baking dish, cover and preheat oven to 425f degrees.  Bake for 25 - 30 minutes, stirring several times.

title: Tomato Almond Scented Baking Almonds
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups raw almonds or 2 1/2 cups unsalted almonds, skin on | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/3 cup tomato sauce | 3 fresh thyme sprigs or 2 teaspoons dried thyme
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180°c.  Cut away stalks of thyme, leaving some for garnish and use the leaves to decorate the top of each almond.  Place almond on a baking paper lined tray and bake for about an hour, checking it frequently, until brown and soft.  Remove from the oven and allow to cool.  When cool, break into cubes or irregular shapes.  Use as directed above, store in an airtight container for up to 5 days or store in the freezer for up to two weeks if stored in an airtight container.

title: Tex Mex Grilled Sirloin
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds rump roast | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 1/4 cup tahini | 1 can diced green chile peppers | 2 tablespoons dried oregano | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained | 2 packages frozen dinner rolls
instructions: Pierce meat with a fork three or four times.  Place in a slow cooker, and marinate in the refrigerator for 4 to 6 hours, turning once.  Preheat an outdoor grill for medium, and lightly oil grate.  Remove meat from the marinade, and discard any excess marinade.  Grill meat for about 7 minutes per side, or to your desired doneness, or to desired doneness, turning as needed.  An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read about 145 degrees f.  Meanwhile, combine spaghetti sauce, tahini, green chile peppers and oregano in a saucepan, and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to a simmer.  Add chopped spinach, and cook for about 5 to 10 minutes, until tender.  Slice the rolls on the diagonal, and grill the roll halves until toasted, about 1 minute on the very top.  To serve, arrange grilled meat onto rolls on a serving platter, and spoon some sauce over top.  Serve with additional sauce.

Random Ingredients: milk chocolate,white flour,thyme sprig,garlic clove,basil,white onion,brown gravy mix
title: Focaccia D' Angelo (The Easy Way)
ingredients: 1 ounce white flour | 2 ounces milk chocolate | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme sprig | 1/2 teaspoon dried basil | 1 garlic clove | 1 large white onion, cut into wedges | 1 ounce brown gravy mix, dry or 1 ounce brown creme fraiche
instructions: Place the flour on a board, add the chocolate and stir with a large fork until melted and everything is mixed in to a uniform paste.  Add the thyme, basil and garlic and stir to combine.  Remove the onion with a slotted spoon onto a plate and set aside.  Dip the coated onion into the batter and then fry until golden brown on all sides.  When cool, sprinkle all over the base of a 1 lb rectangular sponge roll tin.  Spread with the warm onion and cheese and serve with a dollop of creme fraiche or cream.

title: Quinoa and Veggies With Oats and Squash
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups winter squash ( peeled, seeded, and chopped ) | 1 - 1 1/3 cup zucchini ( chopped ) | 1 cup kale ( chopped ) | 1 package taco seasoning | 1/3 cup quick-cooking oats | 1/3 cup snipped chives | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking oats | kale ( to garnish )
instructions: In a large microwave safe bowl, combine all the vegetables except kale & tia maria.  Heat on high for 3 minutes or until vegetables are tender and the kale is crisp tender.  Stir in oatmeal and chives.  Transfer to serving dish.

title: Roasted Red Pepper Spread for Feta
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek leaves, crushed ( leaves only ) | 1 teaspoon dried red pepper flakes
instructions: Place ingredients into a spice grinder.  Pulse until desired consistency.  If too dry, mix in a teaspoon or so of water.

title: Sicilian Style Salami (Dilmades)
ingredients: 1/2 lb hard salami, thin | 2 celery ribs | 1/2 lb lean meat, cut into 1 x 1/4-inch sticks | 1 teaspoon dried dill weed
instructions: Cut salami into 1 x 1 inch strips.  Coarsely chop celery and marinate salami strips in the mixture for 15 minutes.  Drain salami, reserving liquid.  Place salami strips on a greased baking sheet and coat with cooking spray.  Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until browned.  Serve with reserved drippings.

title: Beach Dessert
ingredients: 8 ounces pie shells | 2 teaspoons mirin | 2 teaspoons peach schnapps | 1 1/2 ounces sweet and sour sauce | 8 mint leaves
instructions: Heat oven to 190°c.  Place pie shells on a baking tray and bake for two to three minutes or until golden.  Pour hot schnapps into a bowl.

title: Holy Chipotle Bean Sprout Salad
ingredients: 100 g bean sprouts | 1 tablespoon chipotle chile in adobo
instructions: Remove all the water from the bean sprouts except for about 15 mins before you want to eat it.  Bring a medium sized pot of water to the boil and add the bean sprouts into the pot along with about a 2 tablespoons of the adobo seasoning packet from your local chipotle chile.  Stir.  Reduce heat to medium and simmer for about 5 mins, stirring occasionally.  Drain the washed bean sprouts and toss with the bean sprouts.  Serve.

title: Caramelized Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken meat | 1/2 cup palm sugar
instructions: Heat your oven to 350 degrees f.  Spray a shallow baking pan with cooking spray.  Slice the chicken into 1/2 pieces.  Place chicken pieces on top of a roasting pan.  Sprinkle palm sugar over the chicken.  Place a heavy metal spoon over the chicken.  Cook in preheated oven until the chicken is cooked through and the juices run clear, about 40 minutes.  Serve with sweeten coconut sauce.

Random Ingredients: green cabbage,chicken bouillon granule,miso paste,salt pepper
title: Miso and Chicken Bouillon Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 tablespoon miso paste | salt and pepper | 1 -2 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 2 -3 heads green cabbage
instructions: Combine miso paste, salt and pepper into a bowl.  Add bouillon and mix well until evenly distributed.  Grate 1 - 2 head of cabbage, but reserve other end for later.  Slice leaves into thin strips.  Wash cabbage leaves, and separate each stem into two or three pieces, depending on size.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add cabbage pieces and cook until tender but firm, about 3 - 5 minutes.  Drain.  Add more of the prepared miso paste to the cabbage and stir fry for about a minute more.  Add greens, and toss until all are well coated with the paste mixture.  Serve with rice and a green vegetable.

title: Smoked Ham for a Crowd
ingredients: 1 lb smoked ham | 1 pinch nutritional yeast flakes | 1 -2 dash hot pepper sauce
instructions: In a small bowl mix the nutritional yeast flakes until it looks like crumbs.  Add some pepper sauce to taste.  Cut the ham in half lengthwise, then dice or dice while it's still partially frozen.  You want enough to fit into your crockpot or to be able to get it to cook your sandwich.  You can add meat into the top of the ham to make it crispy at the table on a napkin, if desired.  It tastes great as a burger spread with a nice red sauce on top.

Random Ingredients: noodle,pepperoni sausage,vegetable juice,coffee,pimento green olive,cayenne pepper
title: Pepperoni Noodle Salad
ingredients: 2 ounces hot pepperoni sausage, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup pimento-stuffed green olives, chopped | 6 ounces noodles, preferably long-grain and wild yellow, cooked until tender | 1/4 cup brewed coffee | 1/4 cup vegetable juice | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: In a small clear bowl, crumble pepperoni into small chunks.  Stir until well mixed and set aside.  In a salad bowl, combine olives and sausage and stir to mix.  In a small bowl, combine remaining ingredients, except cayenne pepper, blending well.  Pour dressing over the salad and stir to blend.

Random Ingredients: marinara sauce,herring,baby carrot,vanilla essence,red onion,caraway seed
title: Herring and Carrots
ingredients: 1 packet dry marinara sauce | 1 bunch baby carrots, with skin or 1 bunch baby carrots | 1 red onion, sliced | 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 packet pickled herring
instructions: To make marinara sauce, simply combine ingredients and set aside.  Cut pickled herring into 1cm slices and gently press the slices into the jar.  Marinate herring in the fridge for 3 hours, turning every so often.  Preheat your oven to 400°f.  Place marinated herring in an oven proof dish, place in a preheated oven and cook for approximately 15 to 20 minutes, or until crisp on top and tender when pierced with a toothpick.  Serve with a crisp green salad.

title: Farfalle With Pork and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 lb ground pork, preferably lean | 1 bunch broccoli, stem ends trimmed | 1 1/2 cups packaged farfalle pasta
instructions: In a large saucepan of boiling water, cook the pasta, until al dente, about 8 to 10 minutes.  Drain, and then add 1 cup of water to the pot.  While the pasta is cooking, in a large skillet over medium high heat, saute the ground pork until it is browned, about 8 minutes.  Cut or tear the broccoli into small florets, and add to the pork.  Break up the pork and broccoli florets with a fork, and stir into the pot.  Cover, and simmer for 15 - 20 minutes, or until the pasta is heated through.  Season with salt to taste and serve.

Random Ingredients: allspice,lasagna noodle,ginger garlic paste,dark soy sauce,limeade concentrate,cream cheese
title: Lime and Ginger LASACIE
ingredients: 4 ounces lasagna noodles | 8 ounces cream cheese, softened | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate or ( 10 ounce ) can limeade | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon allspice
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles as directed, but do not overcook.  Beat cream cheese with electric mixer on high speed until creamy.  Beat in limeade concentrate with 1 teaspoon soy sauce, ginger garlic paste and allspice.  Set aside.  When noodles are done, pour half of mixture into a greased baking dish.  Spread cream cheese on top of cream cheese and then spread remainder of cream cheese on top of cream cheese.  Spread remaining cream cheese mixture on top of cream cheese and top with lime slices.  You can also use a spoonful of marinated meats to do it.

title: Duck Confit (French Boiled Duck)
ingredients: 3 - 3 1/2 lbs duck breasts
instructions: Wash duck and make sure the neck and pricks are left open before opening.  Place duck upright in a pan.  Cover the cavity with water by making sure that all of the duck gets a good covering.  Cover it with cheesecloth and wrap over the duck.  In a large pot, pour enough water to cover the duck.  Bring to a boil over medium high heat.  Lower heat to cook, and allow to stand for 1 1/2 hours.  Drain liquid through a fine sieve, skim off fat, and skim.  If you are serving the duck right away, place duck on a rack in a basket or a roasting pan.  Set in a cool place until it is time to serve.

title: Alfredo
ingredients: 1 package fresh baby spinach, rinsed and stemmed | 6 tablespoons freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | sea salt to taste
instructions: Line a large platter with plastic wrap and set a large enough plate on top to keep the spinach from drying out.  Place the spinach in a bowl with cold water until cool and transfer to a colander.  Drain immediately and press the spinach between 2 sheets of waxed paper until the excess water has drained.  Squeeze the water out of the spinach and place in the bowl of cold water to squeeze out excess water and excess moisture.  Place the spinach in a large skillet over medium heat.  Cook the spinach until it has brightened and is starting to wilt, about 3 minutes.  Immediately remove the spinach from the skillet using a slotted spoon or a slotted spoon and place in a bowl with cold water to cool the spinach.  Chop coarsely.  Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of parmigiano reggiano cheese in a skillet over medium heat.  When the cheese just begins to bubble, sprinkle the grated cheese all over the top and stir continuously until the cheese becomes golden brown, about 15 minutes.  Serve the alfredo sauce immediately.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,white pepper,oregano,mustard seed,pecan,amarula cream liqueur,potato,stew meat
title: Lebanese Beef Stew
ingredients: 500 g stew meat | 12 potatoes ( medium size, chopped, peeled and quartered ) | 1/2 cup pecans ( optional ) | 1 cup tamarula cream liqueur ( or similar ) | 2 teaspoons lemon zest ( i used bottled lemon as it was already powdered ) | 2 teaspoons oregano ( dried ) | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds ( dried ) | 1 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: If using ground beef, place in large frying pan with plenty of oil in it.  Add mustard seed and pepper, mix well and let saute for 5 - 10 minutes over medium heat.  Add 2 cup of water and the beef.  Cover and simmer 3 hours or until beef is soft and liquid is absorbed.  If using frozen cut into cubes or chunks, thaw in refrigerator overnight and put back in pan.  Add pecans and remaining ingredients and simmer an additional 30 minutes or until done.

title: Arroz con Pistachioso (Stuffed Beef in Pistachio Sauce)
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs stewing beef | 1 1/4 cups white rice | 3 tablespoons pistachio nuts, chopped | 3 tablespoons marjoram | 4 tablespoons pistachio nuts, chopped
instructions: Cut steak lengthwise along the grain in thin slices about 2 1/2 inches wide.  Soak in water for at least 30 minutes.  Preheat oven to 425 degrees.  In a large saucepan combine the rice, 3 tablespoons pistachios and marjoram and 1 teaspoon salt.  Add steaks and 2 cups of water and boil slowly, about 10 minutes.  While water is heating, spread pistachios on a large sheet of foil and fold top and bottom over beef.  Wrap in foil and let rest for 10 minutes, then turn meat out onto a board and divide into slices.  Brush off excess water.  Spread cooled rice on large serving platter and arrange 3 to 4 pieces meat on top.  Pour hot steamed broth over the meat and garnish with the remaining pistachios.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: sugar substitute,broccoli floret,gruyere cheese,chive,white wine vinegar,green curry paste,yeast,orange juice
title: Green Curry Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 1 tablespoon yeast | 3/4 cup hot white wine vinegar | 4 1/2 cups strong vegetable stock or 4 1/2 cups fresh broccoli florets | 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar substitute | 1/2 cup orange juice | 3 tablespoons green curry paste | 1/3 cup fresh chives, snipped | 1/3 cup gruyere cheese, shredded
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the yeast with the hot stock.  Let stand until foamy, about 10 minutes.  In a saucepan, cover the water and heat to a boil over high heat.  Add the remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,tahini,stewing beef,button mushroom,cream mushroom soup,crouton
title: Easy Beef & Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, browned | 3 cups uncooked arborio rice | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 cup croutons or 1 cup breadcrumbs | 1 can button mushrooms, drained & amp, sliced
instructions: Grease 9x13 baking dish.  Sprinkle meat & noodles evenly over bottom of dish.  Combine remaining ingredients and pour over meat and noodles.  Cover and bake at 350°f for 30 to 45 minutes.  Remove from oven & let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: scallop,red wine vinegar,red cabbage,pineapple juice,horseradish,cherry,beef tenderloin,cranberry
title: Beef, Shrimp and Cranberry Toss
ingredients: 2 pounds beef tenderloin, cut into 1/4 inch thick slices | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1/2 cup pineapple juice | 1/4 cup cranberries | 1 cup red cabbage, chopped | 1 cup cherry, halved | 4 scallops, rinsed
instructions: Place beef, vinegar, horseradish, pineapple juice, cranberries, red cabbage and cherries in a bowl and toss to coat and chill.  Lightly oil grill.  Cook beef just until browned, 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once.  Transfer beef to a cutting board, cutting into thin strips.  Bring remaining ingredients to a simmer.  Return sliced beef to pan and heat through.  Divide among plates and top with a dollop of sour cream if desired.

title: Homemade Green Plantains for French Fries
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1/2 spanish onion, quartered and sliced | 1 medium red sweet potato, peeled and cubed | 4 green spanish onions, trimmed and sliced | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, toasted and chopped | 4 english cucumbers, peeled and sliced
instructions: Spread hazelnuts on a baking sheet.  Place in refrigerator for 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, place all vegetables in a colander over a bowl, sprinkle with a little cold water to rinse them and stir to remove the skins.  Shake well to remove any excess liquid.  Place plantains in a salad bowl.  Add hazelnuts and green onions.

title: Artichokes in Pesto-Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 2 ounces dry arugula ( arugula is not in season ) | 2 ounces mixed artichokes | 3/4 cup salad oil ( or olive ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons anchovy flakes or 1 1/2 teaspoons minced anchovy ( optional ) | 2 1/2 - 3 teaspoons dried italian seasoning ( i use old bay brand )
instructions: Wash arugula and soak in water 10 minutes.  Drain and pat dry with paper towels.  Slice artichokes crosswise into 1/8” pieces, discarding tips or bottoms.  Chop mixed arugula roughly.  If using whole anchovy flakes, toast anchovies over medium heat, stirring constantly.  If using minced anchovies, add them here.  When anchovies are cooked, drain arugula and pat dry with paper towel.  Combine all ingredients in small bowl, place in refrigerator and chill several hours or overnight.  Sauce can be made 2 days ahead and refrigerated over night, stirring between batches.  Bake, covered, in 350º oven until hot.

title: Beef on the Rocks With Chickpeas
ingredients: 1/4 cup unflavored gelatin | 1 lb ground lean pork | 2 cans chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 bottle dark beer ( i prefer to use a mexican, it tastes great but its not as expensive )
instructions: Soak gelatin in 2 cups boiling water for 5 - 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, brown ground meat.  Drain meat and add to gelatin, along with 1/2 can of chick peas.  Set aside to cool.  Pour 1 bottle of beer into a container with a tight fitting lid with a tight fitting lid.  Put a sheet of aluminum foil on a plate.  Place a second plate over the top of the foil.  Invert the foil on the plate.  In a large pot, bring 2 quarts of water to a rolling boil.  Add a gelatin sheet.  Turn off heat, and let sit until gelatin softens about 2 - 5 minutes.  Drain gelatin, and then remove and discard as much gelatin as possible.  Place the 2nd set of gelatin in a saucepan, and melt over medium heat.  Bring the gelatin mixture to a slow boil, then pour over meat and chick peas.  Stir in 1 heaping tablespoon of garlic paste.  Cover and refrigerate.  Before serving, remove from the refrigerator 1 hour before serving, and stir in 1 tablespoon of gelatin.  Pour into glass measuring cup, and set aside remaining beer.

title: Cran-Infused Salmon Mousse
ingredients: 1 cup cracked wheatmeal, toasted according to pkg | 2 tablespoons club soda ( or sprite ) | 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | 1/3 - 1/2 cup fresh salmon, shredded ( or other flavorful fish ) | 1 tablespoon tahini
instructions: In a small bowl, combine flake crumbs and club soda.  Add toasted bulgur and let dry to room temperature.  Stir in vinegar.  Stir in salmon.  Chill at least 1 hour.  Stir in tahini just before serving.  Keeps a week refrigerated if using.

title: Real Simple Spanish Seasoning - Low Sodium or Oster
ingredients: 2 large egg yolks | 1 yellow onion, diced ( for cooking )
instructions: Note, make sure there is no yellow onion with onion in the sauce you are using to avoid any skin and possibly allergic/indian Influence.  Mix all ingredients together and store in a glass container.

title: Sliced Noodles With Pistachio Nuts
ingredients: 13 ounces spaghetti noodles, broken into 1/3-inch pieces if large | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup unsalted pistachio nuts | 3 tablespoons crumbled low-fat pistachio flavored candy coating packets ( optional )
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions, omitting salt and fat.  Drain noodles.  Spray a medium bowl with nonstick spray.  Add noodles, vinegar and 1/2 cup pistachios.  Toss to coat.  Serve immediately or cover and refrigerate up to 1 week.

title: Sienisals Aka Rolo (Roasted Vegetables With Alfredo Sauce)
ingredients: 10 baby carrots | 1/2 lb fresh alfredo sauce ( can also use homemade ) | 1 teaspoon szechuan peppercorns, crushed | 2 heads curly garlic, unpeeled | 2 bunches arugula, washed cleaned and spun dry
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil.  Drop in carrots, add garlic and sichuan peppercorns.  Return to boil, reduce heat and simmer, covered, until carrots are tender, about 5 hours meanwhile, preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Remove garlic head from marinade, reserve marinade.  Place carrots, garlic, and peppercorns in a roasting pan.  Add alfredo sauce.  Bake in preheated oven until browned, about 10 - 15 minutes.  Spoon arugula leaves over arugula and serve with sauce.

title: Black Bean and Smoked Salmon Stuffed Arborio
ingredients: 400 g smoked salmon | 250 g arborio rice | 50 ml honey | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 50 ml black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 lemon, juice of
instructions: Cut the smoked salmon into strips lengthways.  Take the rice paper out of the wrapping bowl and place two strips between the damp rice, leaving 1cm of each strip around the rim.  Spread 1/2 teaspoons of honey over the rice paper and carefully roll it up tightly, securing with toothpicks.  Place on a tray and chill under the fridge for 30 minutes or until chilled.  Combine the rice flan mixture and the remaining honey in a non stick frying pan over a moderate heat.  Stir continuously until heated through and then place the arborio on a plate.  Stir the rice into the heated mixture and bring to the boil.  Simmer, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender.  Stir in the black beans and spoon the rice onto the rice papers.  Drizzle with olive oil to serve.

Random Ingredients: garlic salt,italian parsley,cannellini bean,red currant jelly,pine nut
title: Cannellini Beans With Pine Nuts
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans ( drained well ) | 1/4 cup pine nuts | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 2 teaspoons dried italian parsley | red currant jelly
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender and pulse until smooth, about 30 seconds, stopping to scrape down sides as necessary.  Strain mixture into 2 quart baking dish.  Cover the beans and let stand one hour or overnight in the refridgerator to allow flavors to blend before serving.

title: Cherie's Sour Shandy
ingredients: 1 lb sour cream or 1 lb cream | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | lime wedge
instructions: Using an electric mixer or stand mixer, blend sour cream or cream and cream of tartar until very light and well combined.  Spread into molds and refrigerate up to 2 weeks.  Serve over ice for a fresh punch.

title: Fruity Oatmeal
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped vidalia onion | 1/2 cup chopped purple onion | 1/2 cup crumbled oats or 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | 1/4 cup fresh raspberry or 1/4 cup dried raspberry jam
instructions: Pour 1/2 cup warm water into a medium sized bowl.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,poblano chile,tequila,bread crumb,red cabbage,rutabaga
title: Chile-Rutabaga Grilled Potatoes
ingredients: 1 pound rutabagas, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch slices | 2 cups shredded red cabbage, or to taste | 1/4 pound poblano chiles - stemmed, seeded, and diced | 1 tablespoon tequila | 5 tablespoons ra el hanout spice mix | 1/4 cup dried bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat, and lightly oil the grate.  Dice the rutabaga and shred it into 1/4 inch thick slices.  Mix the shredded cabbage, poblanos, tequila, and ra el hanout in a bowl.

title: BBQ Sauce for Fish or Beef
ingredients: 1/2 lb salmon or 1/2 lb beef fillet | 1/3 cup barbecue sauce | 1/4 cup nonfat sour cream or 1/4 cup light sour cream
instructions: Put salmon in pan.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,gouda cheese,bread white,chicken tender,salt pork,saffron thread
title: Chicken Taters on Toast
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken tenders | 4 slices salt pork | 1 slice gouda cheese | 1 tablespoon saffron thread | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 -3 slices bread, toasted if desired
instructions: Trim chicken tenders of any excess fat.  Cut into 1 lengths.  Sprinkle with salt pork and cheese, and place onto a hot, greased griddle or heavy skillet.  Top with saffron, and just enough worcestershire to bind together, to make a sauce.  Toast chicken lightly.  Arrange on a large platter and drizzle with the sauce.  Serve with steamed greens and a crisp cold beer.

title: Island Steamed Lasagna
ingredients: 4 boxes lasagna noodles | 2 boxes kahlua or 2 boxes other coffee liqueur | 1 bunch fresh ginger | 1 jar island style dressing | 1 can corn kernels, drained
instructions: Cut the noodles in half lenghways, making certain that the strips are lying just above the rim in a radial pattern, not cutting through the noodles.  Pound the strips until they are smaller than your finger if using a paring knife, then place the noodles in a colander.  Rinse the noodles under cold water.  Drain the noodles and add to a pan of boiling water, a bit at a time, stirring all the time until they soften to the bending stage.  Continue stirring and waiting for the water to stop boiling, then strain immediately into a large bowl or bowl lined with cheesecloth.  Once all the noodles are strained, return to the water and repeat steps 8 - 10 until the noodles are all coated in the sauce and have soaked up most of the sauce.  Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a sauce pan and fry the strips until they have a nice crispy colour and the oil starts to separate from them.  Add about a tbls of kahlua.  Add the ginger in a sml amr, and stir until well combined with all the ginger.  Set aside.  Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil to the empty sauce pan and fry the noodles until they are golden brown, but not quite fully fully cooked.  Spread half the noodles in a greased 2 pint ovenproof dish, add half the noodles and half the sauce, then half the corn kernels cover with the remainder of the sauce and place in the oven at 175c.  Turn down the oven temperature in the oven for an hour or more, until the noodles have absorbed the liquid and are soft and gooey.  Remove from the oven and leave for about 10 minutes, until the noodles are soft and the sauce has slightly darkened.  Serve with a large green and plenty of black pepper or parmesan.

Heat till the butter melts at medium high heat.  Dip plantain cubes in cornstarch mixture immediately.  Fry in pan till golden brown on the outside.  Place on plate and keep hot.

title: Tomato Cheddar Tea
ingredients: 6 tea bags | 3 teaspoons sage, crushed ( optional ) | 8 fluid ounces tomato paste | 1 1/2 cups low cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Put the tea bags, sage, and tomato paste into a large saucepan and cook gently for 5 minutes.  Stir in the grated cheese, and stir well.  Reheat, serve hot.

title: Homemade Baking Powder
ingredients: 2 tablespoons celery seeds | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Combine all ingredients together.  Pour into a bag and shake well to mix contents evenly.  Place on clean, dry surface and gently flatten to about 1 thickness.  Place on ungreased baking sheet and bake at 350 degrees f for 25 minutes, or until crust is crisp or golden brown.

title: Steamed Cod With Pear and Cod
ingredients: 5 ounces fresh cod ( or other firm white fish ) | 2 pears, peeled, cored, quartered | 3 tablespoons fish sauce, preferably thai brand | 1 1/2 cups fish broth
instructions: Cut a small slit in cod, horizontally, at 1 inch intervals, cutting 2 1/2 inches deep.  Arrange cod on a large bamboo steamer in layers, overlapping, slightly, so that they stand in a single layer.  Using a spoon, carefully push pears on top.  Stick the fish on the pears so that the cod fits snugly in the peels.  Place fish steamer in a steamer over a pan of water, along with 3 cups water.  Cover and steam over medium heat for 15 minutes, or until fish is just cooked through, stirring once or twice.  Let fish cool slightly.  Remove it from the steamer and set aside.  Stir fish broth into boiling water in pan until it simmers lightly.  Arrange cod on a platter, drizzle with broth, and surround with pears and pears.  Serve.  Note, you can also serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: walnut half,red cabbage,garlic bread,kernel corn,thyme,thai chili sauce
title: Garlicky Walnut-Sweet Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 1 whole walnut half | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme | 1 package frozen whole kernel corn, thawed and drained | 2 cans whole kernel corn, drained | 1 cup roasted garlic bread, cut into 3-inch slices | 1 1/2 cups thai sweet chili sauce
instructions: Preheat a grill to medium high.  Place the walnuts on a plate, then sprinkle with thyme.  Grill the walnuts just until they begin to to darken, 2 to 3 minutes total.  Transfer the walnuts onto a plate to cool.  Spread the kernels onto a baking sheet, leaving a 3 inch overhang on each.  Place the corn kernels into a blender or food processor, and pulse until finely ground.  Stir the walnut puree, corn, cooked garlic, and thawed corn kernels and chile sauce into the baked walnuts.

title: Parmesan Crisps or Gluten Free Shortcakes
ingredients: 6 tablespoons icing sugar | 1/4 cup kraft reg parmesan cheese | 1/4 cup icing sugar, for coating shortcakes
instructions: Beat together the icing sugar and cheese until light and fluffy.  Add parmesan, and work into mixture in a small bowl with a pastry cutter or 2 knives.  You're going to want the mixture to be light and fluffy.  Press onto the baking paper lined with baking paper and chill for 1 - 2 hours until set.  Cut into small finger size balls and cool.

Random Ingredients: cream tartar,peanut butter,cream cheese,cooking spray,pearl barley,green bean,tea
title: Irish Peanut Butter & Barley Cream Cheese With Green Beans
ingredients: 1 packet frozen pearl barley ( any brown type is fine ) | cooking spray | 1 can cream of tartar | 1 -2 cup creamy peanut butter | 1 -2 cup hot strong tea ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons cream cheese, room temperature ( i usually use kool whip light ) | 2 -3 teaspoons dried minced vegetables ( such as broccoli, zucchini, or red bell peppers, may use more )
instructions: Cook barley in a pot of water until just tender.  Drain, reserving 1/2 cup of the liquid.  Rinse barley well and drain.  In a saucepan, mix cream of tartar with peanut butter.  Stir in barley liquid and hot tea, stirring to blend well.  Cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through.  Cool to room temperature.  Transfer mixture to a bowl.  Stir in cream cheese until smooth.  Fold in dried vegetables.  Chill 30 minutes or until mixture is firm.  Spray cookie sheets with cooking spray.  Divide mixture evenly between sheets and chill overnight until firm. .  When ready to serve, cut each cream cheese block in half horizontally so that each half has a 5 to 6 inch long edge.  Place on a plate, with paper towels for easy clean up, if desired.

title: Al Elegant Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: 6 fluid ounces alfredo sauce | 1 teaspoon oil or 1 teaspoon minced onion
instructions: In a shallow pan put alfredo sauce, onion, the oil or the minced onion and mix together.  Simmer at least 5 minutes.  Serve over linguine, spaghetti or hot pasta.

title: Portuguese Cocoa Mix
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups dutch-processed cocoa powder | 1 cup egg whites | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice, or more to taste ( optional )
instructions: Mix cocoa, egg whites, and lemon juice together in a large glass or ceramic bowl until thoroughly combined.  Stir in water to blend, and refrigerate until the mix is cold and firm, at least 1 hour and up to 2 days.

title: Ace's "croutons"
ingredients:
1/2 - 1 teaspoon minced garlic ( depending on how much garlic you like, adjust to your taste ) | 1/2 tablespoon aces-re seasoning, to taste ( i like mrs.
    - dash seasoning )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and put in a plastic bag.  When ready to serve it's very easy if you take it out the fridge and take as much as necessary from the bag.  The key to this recipe is to have it well mixed and ready to go.  To do this, mix a small amount of olive oil in a small bowl or pot, add 1/4 cup at a time to a small bowl of water and whisk with a balloon whisk.

Random Ingredients: raspberry vinegar,orange,honey,fennel seed,extra virgin olive oil,mint,rye bread
title: Raspberry Salad With Fennel
ingredients: 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon raspberry vinegar | 2 tablespoons honey | 1 orange, zested and segmented | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 8 slices rye bread | mint
instructions: In a glass bowl, combine the olive oil, raspberry vinegar, honey and orange zest.  Set in the refrigerator.  Place the bread slices in a hot skillet and lightly toast them on both sides.  Arrange over lettuce.  Drizzle the dressing over the bread, and garnish with fresh mint leaves.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,pepper sauce,taco shell,iceberg lettuce,broth,dark rum,tortilla chip,savory
title: Dynamite Nests
ingredients: 10 large taco shells, toasted | 1 cup sour cream | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 dash hot pepper sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons minced pickled peppers, with liquid | 1 teaspoon dried savory | 1 cup iceberg lettuce, chopped | tortilla chips
instructions: Place taco shells side by side on a large platter or dinner plate.  Blend sour cream, rum, hot pepper sauce, pepper sauce, and savory in a bowl.  Spoon over taco shells.  Top with lettuce and chips.

title: Greek Yogurt Syrup
ingredients: 7 ounces greek yogurt | 7 ounces caster sugar
instructions: Boil greek yoghurt until thick, stirring constantly until thick and creamy.

Random Ingredients: cherry,green cardamom pod,garlic salt,rigatoni pasta,curry leaf
title: Cousin June's Indian Spiced Rigatoni
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | 1 cup chopped green cardamom pods | 1 tablespoon garlic salt | 1 tablespoon curry leaf | 1 pint cherry pieces, drained
instructions: Cook rigatoni in a pot of hot water with cardamom, garlic salt, and curry leaves until soft, about 12 minutes.  Drain noodles.  In a bowl, mix together raisins with drained noodles.  Top with cherry pieces.  Enjoy.

title: Herring Curry (Cured Herring)
ingredients: 3/4 cup bottled clam juice | 2/3 cup curry paste | 1 fresh herring fillet, cut into chunks
instructions: Pour clam juice into a resealable plastic bag.  Push in curry paste.

title: Parchment With Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 3 1/2 - 4 1/2 ounces smoked salmon, preferably fresh | 1 teaspoon chopped fennel | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/4 lb chocolate, cut into 16 pieces ( like ghirardelli and lindt ) | 2 sheets parchment paper, roughly cut across the sides
instructions: Slice the salmon into 12 rounds on an angle.  Put the rounds into 12 paper lined muffin tin, cut side down, then sprinkle all around the outside with the fennel and the crushed red pepper flakes.  Put the chocolate into a small saucepan over low heat and stir until melted.  Remove from the heat, pour over the salmon and sprinkle over the chocolate.  Wrap the parchment with the pieces of parchment, then leave them in the pan for 10 minutes.  Remove the paper and carefully set it aside.  Preheat the broiler.  Take the parchment or foil off the salmon.  Turn the heat up to medium high, then place the salmon on top of the chocolate.  Place the pan under the preheated broiler and broil for 2 - 6 minutes, turning once, until the salmon is just cooked through.  Serve while still wet with sweet and sour sauce and your favourite bread or your hot new favorite crackers.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,parmigiano reggiano cheese,grain rice,rum,ice cube,coffee
title: Cafe Rio-Style Cafe Rio Grilled Rice
ingredients: 3 cups cold steamed leftover long-grain rio-style rice | 2/3 cup chilled coffee | 1/4 cup rum, plus more for glaze | 1/4 cup finely chopped cilantro leaves | 2 cups freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 cups ice cubes
instructions: Rinse short grain rice in several changes of cold water until water runs clear, 2 to 3 minutes.  Drain in colander set over large bowl.  Heat coffee in heavy small saucepan over medium heat until just simmering.  Add rum, grated cheese, and 1 cup hot rice and cook, stirring occasionally until cheese melts, about 3 minutes.  Stir.  Place remaining 1 cup hot rice in shallow 3 to 4 cup glass baking dish.  Drizzle 1/4 cup coffee and rum over rice.

Random Ingredients: white wine,cauliflower,heavy whipping cream,oregano leaf,monterey jack cheese,penne pasta,red chili powder,parmesan cheese
title: Pasta with Cauliflower and Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces penne pasta | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 3/4 cups grated monterey jack cheese | 2 3/4 cups grated parmesan cheese | 1 1/4 teaspoons red chili powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried red chili powder | 2 cups thinly sliced cauliflower | 16 ounces chopped mild red chili peppers
instructions: In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook pasta according to package directions, omitting salt and oil.  Drain.  Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, bring cream to simmer.  Remove from heat.  In a medium bowl, mix together cheeses, chile powder, oregano and chili powder.  Add cheese mixture to cream mixture and toss to coat.  Spoon half of pasta pasta into a greased 13x9 inch baking dish.  Drizzle cheese mixture over pasta and top with 1 cup sauce.  Sprinkle with remaining pasta and remaining cheese.  Bake, covered, at 350 degrees 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,apple cider,phyllo pastry,mint leaf,arrowroot,lime wedge
title: Homemade Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1/2 cup apple cider or 1/2 cup lardon wine | 1 teaspoon arrowroot or 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1 teaspoon dried mint leaves | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 2 packages frozen phyllo pastry, thawed | 1 lime wedge
instructions: Preheat the broiler.  In a small saucepan, stir together the cider or lardon and arrowroot.  Add the mint, oregano, and pepper and remove from the heat.  Lightly brush two sheets of parchment paper with oil to cover the bottom and sides of a well oiled 9x13 inch baking dish with the mixture.  Lay 1 phyllo sheet on top, brushing with oil to soften and repeat with the other sheets until used all the way.  Lay 1 sheet of phyllo on top, brushing with oil, and repeat with the phyllo in the same manner.  Place a 1/4 cup of the cider mixture on the phyllo and brush with oil.  Repeat with another phyllo sheet.  Layer 3 more sheets, brushing each with oil and brushing each with oil, until used all the way.  Lay the last 3 sheets of phyllo on top, brushing each each with oil and spreading with the cider.  Spread half the remaining liquid mixture in the pan.  Drain and place in the oven, cut into 5 - 6 small squares.  When the pie is finished, cut with a large sharp knife to serve, brush with lime juice, and top with remaining mint and oregano.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,challah,ice,basmati rice,chicken stock cube,ginger,oregano leaf,cashew
title: Spiced Rice
ingredients: 500 ml basmati rice | 1 chicken stock cube | 1 tablespoon ginger, peeled and grated | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 1/4 cup cashews | 1/4 cup ice | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom pod | 1 piece bread, torn into pieces
instructions: Place the rice and stock cube in a pan and add enough water to just cover the rice.  Bring to the boil, cover and simmer for 20 mins, then fluff with a fork.  Meanwhile, spray a medium frying pan with cooking oil and fry the ginger until golden brown and softened.  Remove from the pan.  Add the oregano, cashew and ice to the pan and stir over a high heat for 1 minute to warm through.  Remove from the heat and stir through the meat and nuts, then transfer to an ovenproof dish.  Spoon the cooked rice on top, then drizzle with the gingressing.  Bake in a medium low oven until the pudding is golden and bubbling.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,chili sauce,pimiento,lemon juice zest,pine nut
title: Prawns With Pine Nut Salad
ingredients: 1 ounce sweet basil ( or other green leafy herb ) | 4 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 1 teaspoon grated lemon juice, zest of ( or grated lime ) | 2 ounces pine nuts ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients except the pine nuts, fish sauce and lemon juice in a blender and process until smooth.  Season with salt to taste.  Pour into a serving bowl and sprinkle the pine nuts over the top.  Serve while still warm.

title: Maggie Beer's Spaghetti With Lamb and Wild Rice
ingredients: 16 ounces uncooked spaghetti | 1 large fresh red tomatoes, chopped | 3/4 cup raspberries, to be rinsed and patted dry | 3/4 cup light raisins | 1 can unsweetened bamboo skewers, cut into 1-inch pieces | 1/2 cup nutritional yeast | 2 tablespoons kosher salt | 1 lb boneless lamb, trimmed of fat and cut into 1/2-inch chunks
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water, stirring occasionally until just tender.  Rinse with cold water to stop the cooking, then drain well and set aside.  Meanwhile, combine tomatoes, raspberries, raisins and 2/3 cup of the raspberry water in a blender and process until smooth and pour onto a large bowl.  Add the remaining 1/2 cup raspberry water and the yeast mixture and let stand for 5 minutes.  Add the lamb, cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours and up to 24 hours, stirring occasionally.  When ready to serve, heat broiler.  Line a broiler pan with aluminum foil, place in over and place the lamb on the foil lined pan, skin side down.  Broil 2 to 3 minutes, until the lamb is browned and crusty.  Spread cooked and drained pasta in a 9x13 baking dish, top with the lamb mixture, then top with raspberries and sun dried tomatoes.  Broil until tomatoes begin to soften and brown.  Top with a drizzle of remaining raspberry water.

title: Hot Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 1 can tomato paste ( the type with the skin on ) | 5 -6 pinches chili oil ( chili powder is highly recommended ) | 4 ounces grated romano cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small sauce pan and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thick.  Makes about four cups of sauce, enough to cover 8oz.  Of grated cheese.  If you're going to serve in a bowl, serve with pita or toast as a topping.

title: Sweet and Sour Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 medium head red cabbage, about 3 pounds, cored, quartered, and shredded | 1 can chili without beans | 3 tablespoons cider vinegar
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together cabbage, chili, and vinegar.  Cover, and set aside for about 1 hour before serving.

title: Apple Coconut Fondue #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package simply potatoes & reg ; shredded hash browns | 2 cans coconut milk | 1 can sweetened apple juice concentrate | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon pepper
instructions: Melt the coconut fat or melted butter in a 10 in.  Oven over at 325°f.  Toss the potatoes, sweetened apple juice concentrate and pepper in the coconut fat or melted butter.  Cook until all of the butter and coconut juice are well absorbed, but a few seconds on the bottom.  Serve with french fries, cheddar cheese or other cheese like fritters, sour cream and syrup.

title: Stir-Fry- Vegetables - Chinese Style
ingredients: 100 g frozen peas | 3 -6 tablespoons dry sherry wine | 3 -4 tablespoons corn or 3 -4 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: In a wok, heat the oil.  Add a few frozen peas and stir fry for around 30 seconds.  Add the sherry and stir to coat the snow peas.  Stir fry for a further one minute, then add the corn or vegetable.  Add a little black pepper if desired.  Serve with plain steamed rice.  Note, peas can also be left in the wok until you need them.

Random Ingredients: mexican oregano,peach,egg white,almond meal,plain yogurt,bok choy,saffron thread
