instructions: In medium bowl combine 1 tsp almond meal, mrs choy, oregano, egg whites, saffron powder, and bok choy.  Add the patties to the bowl and gently toss to coat.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.  In a small bowl, combine chopped peach halves with yogurt and remaining 2 tsp almond meal and toss lightly.  Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours or until serving.

title: Spicy Avocado Spinach
ingredients: 2 avocados | 12 ounces fresh spinach leaves, washed and torn into 2 inch pieces | 2 -3 tablespoons hot chili sauce ( i use sriracha )
instructions: Peel, halve, seed and scoop avocado flesh into mixing bowl.  Add salt and chile sauce to taste.  Stir gently and evenly.  Serve cold.

instructions: Dissolve bullion cube in hot chicken stock.  Put meat into sauce pan with the stock and bones.  Add saltine crackers.  Add water to cover meat.

instructions: Combine flour, guinness, dried fruit, chilli and butter.  Stir till combined.  Gently add remaining ingredients.  Place in greased 28cm quiche tin.  Bake at c for 1 hour or till golden brown.  Serve warm.

instructions: Break noodles into a large serving bowl.  Heat coconut cream in large skillet over medium heat for 2 minutes.  Add hot noodle mixture to coconut cream and toss.  Serve immediately.

title: Savory Dill Pickles

instructions: Heat the oven to 450 degrees f/175 degrees.

title: Togashi - Tomatoes-Corn Flower Togashi

title: Quick 'n' Easy Microwaveable Bread
ingredients: 250 g lean whole wheat bread | 1 g fresh yeast | 2 teaspoons light golden syrup | 250 g water, lukewarm | 1 teaspoon coarse salt | curry leaf ( optional )
instructions: Place bread in microwave safe bowl with lid or a lid.  Toast in microwave for 3 - 5 minutes per side.  Meanwhile, mix together the yeast, warm water, golden syrup, salt in a lumbish style mixing bowl.  Add the dissolved yeast and 1 teaspoon of the sugar.

instructions: Pre heat oven to 180'c/350'f mix cornflour with a little water and coat chicken lightly in this.  Place chicken in a roasting tin which is just large enough to hold them in one layer. instructions: Cut avocados in half lengthwise and scoop out the flesh with a melonball or a spoon leaving a tail end intact.  Place the avocado in a bowl and mash it with a fork. Random Ingredients: linguine,pineapple chunk,kidney bean,orange zest,italian seasoning,buttermilk,lemon peel
title: Linguine With Orange and Pineapple
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups canned kidney beans, undrained | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk | 1 lemon peel, cut into 2-inch segments | 2 tablespoons grated orange zest | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian seasoning | 1/2 cup canned crushed pineapple chunks | 8 ounces linguine, cooked
instructions: Combine kidney bean and buttermilk in medium saucepan.  Stir in lemon peel, zest, italian seasoning, and pineapple.  Heat until hot, stirring often.  Pour sauce over pasta in bowl.  Serve immediately.

title: Famous Dates in Whipped Cream
ingredients: 25 dates, chopped into pieces | 1 pint whipping cream ( or whipping cream, your favourite )
instructions: Whip your cream until the cream is stiff enough for you, but not stiff to knead or whip it for a few seconds until it starts to thicken slightly.  Add the chopped dates, and mix well.  Serve in a pretty stemmed glass bowl, and keep in refrigerator until ready to enjoy.

title: Easy Baked Potato-Zucchini Fritters
ingredients: 1 package frozen mixed hash browns, thawed and drained | 1 package dry pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Grease a 9x13 inch casserole dish.  In a medium bowl, combine hashbrowns.  Add pasta, mixing well.  Sprinkle with extra cheese if desired.  Bake 25 minutes in the preheated oven, until crumbly and lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,black bean,pancetta,pistachio,chicken bouillon granule,leek,lettuce,pesto sauce
title: Pesto, Spinach & Black Beans
ingredients: 12 cups fresh shelled black beans ( about 3 pounds ) | 4 cups shredded fat-free lettuce | 1 cup chopped leeks | 12 slices pancetta, thin | 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 1/3 cup fat-free pesto sauce | 1/2 cup chopped fresh pistachios | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules
instructions: To prepare beans, rinse beans under cold water to cool.

title: Macaroni and Rye Casserole With a Chewy Fondue
ingredients: 1/2 cup macaroni | 500 g ryepita tagliatelle pasta noodles or 500 g other thin pasta flour ( 20 ounces ) | 12 1/4 ounces lemons, cut into wedges | 1 1/2 dozen small macaroni noodles for dipping, such as ditalini
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f.  Wash and cook the pasta in boiling salted water until al dente.  Drain and set aside.  Heat the oven to 375°f.  Meanwhile, bring a large pan of salted water to the boil.  Add the pasta and cook for 8 minutes, or until al dente.  Drain well and return the pasta to the pan.  Stir in the macaroni.  Scoop the pasta into 8 portions, arrange in an ovenproof serving bowl and toss with half the lemon wedges.  Dip in the lemon wedges and serve with remaining lemon wedges and some bread and crackers.  To eat, arrange 1st section of the ryche de leite lemon toasts on serving plates, surrounded by a few macaroni wedges, a wedge of rye bread and a wedge of bread with crackers.  Accompany with a dollop of macaroni.

title: Australian Sausages Picnic Boursin (Australian)
ingredients: 1 baguette, cut into 8cm slices ( or other crusty breads ) | 1 tablespoon chopped cherries ( about 1/2 cup ) | 2 tablespoons chopped pimiento | 1 teaspoon chopped sage | 1/4 cup scotch bonnet peppers ( or habanero peppers ) | 200 g chopped courgettes | 2 sheets puff pastry
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c.  Line 2 baking trays with baking paper extending 2cm above base of trays and heat on both sides in oven for 15 - 20 minutes.  When pastry is puffed and golden, remove from oven and sprinkle with cherries and pimento.  Cool for 1 - 2 minutes.  Meanwhile, make the boursin by combining the sage, chile pepper, courgettes and chopped courgettes in a small bowl.  Season with salt and pepper and set aside while making sausage.  Assemble boursin by layering the sausage into a lightly oiled, shallow, ovenproof dish and pat down.  Spread top with boursin mixture, pressing into the sausage.  Bake for 25 - 30 minutes, or until cooked through and topping is golden brown.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock cube,grand marnier,plain yogurt,turmeric powder,wood ear mushroom,shallot
title: Creamy Mushroom Soup with Grand Marnier
ingredients: 1 ounce wood ear mushrooms | 1 ounce shallot | 1/2 teaspoon powdered turmeric powder | 5 ounces chicken stock cubes | 2 ounces grand marnier | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt
instructions: Peel back the husk from the mushrooms and remove the hard stem and thick part from between each mushroom.  Wash and cut away the hard stem of the mushroom, and slice the stalks from the mushrooms, reserving 4 ounce of the stalks for garnish.  Soak the mushroom stalks in warm water for 1 hour.  Blend 1 teaspoon of the tumeric powder with the stock cubes and then put into a pan with the mushrooms and 1 to 1 1/2 cup of water and bring to the boil.  Remove from the heat and let sit for 2 minutes.  Strain through a small bowl and discard the mushroom stems, and discard the stems.  Using the back of a spoon, crush the reserved mushroom stems and set aside.  Place the yogurt in a small bowl.  Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a medium saucepan over medium high heat.  When hot, but not smoking, add the shallots and saute until lightly browned.  Drain off the oil.  Add the ground spices and stir well, to coat.  Add the mushrooms.  Stir and saute until lightly browned.  Pour in 1 fluid ounce of water.  Reduce the heat to low.  Add the remaining tumeric powder, and cook slowly for 20 minutes.  Stir frequently to prevent catching and sticking.  Add salt as required.  Just before serving, mix in the reserved mushroom stalks and add the mashed yogurt.  Garnish with reserved mushroom stems and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: wasabi,phyllo pastry,olive,serrano chilies,green cardamom pod,alfalfa sprout,rabbit
title: Hasestra (Meat-Poached Rabbit Pies)
ingredients: 36 small rabbit, shank | 1/8 cup olive, pitted and sliced | 1/8 cup green cardamom pods | 1 serrano chilies or 1 jalapeno pepper, thinly sliced | 1/3 cup alfalfa sprout | 1/4 cup wasabi | 1 sheet phyllo pastry, thawed if frozen before using
instructions: Remove and discard giblets and neck from each rabbit.  Cut small strips from the tip of each rabbit.

title: Noodles And Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb potato | 1 lb soba noodles | 2 cups cherry, halved | 6 ounces sherry wine vinegar | 2 1/2 cups simple syrup
instructions: Dice potatoes into small cubes.  Cook soba according to directions on package and drain.  Mix all ingredients and serve at once.

title:
Carol's Tangy Beef Stew.

    -.
    -if You Can
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks, trimmed | 2 tablespoons red pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon savory | 1/4 teaspoon thyme | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 cup fresh italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Place the steak on the rack of a broiler pan.  Broil 2 - 4 inches from the heat until the meat is lightly browned.  Meanwhile mix red pepper, seasonings, parsley and mix well.  Pour over the steak.  Broil for 10 - 15 minutes till the meat is cooked.

Random Ingredients: italian spice,pineapple juice,arrowroot,spaghetti,black pepper,red curry paste,mustard seed
title: Mustard Seed Spaghetti Marinade
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground mustard seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons black pepper | 1 package spaghetti | 1/2 cup pineapple juice ( from canned pineapple can ) | 1 teaspoon red curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon arrowroot | 1 -2 teaspoon dry italian spices
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a small saucepan.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 5 minutes or until thickened to desired consistency.  To prepare, cook spaghetti until desired level of doneness, and drain.  Add to prepared sauce.  Use a slotted spoon or long handled fork to serve.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,chicken broth,french baguette,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,red wine,trout,beet
title: Smoked Trout with Chipotle Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 whole smoked trout | 1 red onion, diced | 2 large beets, peeled and sliced | 1 cup chicken broth | 1 chipotle pepper in adobo sauce | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1/2 cup red wine
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat.  Remove fish from the bones and fillet into 2 or 3 pieces.  Place in a bowl, and add chipotle pepper juice and wine to taste.  Cover, and let seasonings marinate for 2 hours, tossing occasionally.  Brush a large, cast iron skillet with cooking spray.  Place the fish onto the hot pan.  Brush the smoked trout with the chipotle cream sauce and place into the preheated grill.  Cook for 10 minutes, or until fish flakes easily.  Place onion in the center of the grilled fish.  Spoon some of the chicken broth over the onions and beets, and top with some smoked fish.  Close the lid, and cook 10 more minutes, or until tender.

title: Barley Stew
ingredients: 1 lb lamb shoulder, cut into small chunks ( or any large piece of meat which can be treated easily after it has been'mixed together'with a wooden spoon') | 2 teaspoons arrowroot | 1 can stewed tomatoes and green chiles, with juice
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients in a saucepan.  Cover and cook over a gentle heat for about 1 hour, stirring every so often to make sure there is no clumping, or longer a film of fat on top of all of it if the lid is not sealed very well.  When it is cooked, remove all of the pieces of fat and discard.  Pour the juice from the pan into a bowl and serve with crusty bread.

title: Chipotle Roasted Pepper Relish #5FIX
ingredients: 1 cup yellow sweet bell pepper | 1/2 cup packed fresh lemon peel ( about 1 lemon ) | 1 teaspoon chopped chipotle chile ( such as mccormick brand )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor and process until smooth.  Spread relish into a pastry bag fitted with a 1/4 inch plain tube or a long 1/4 inch wide scalloped scallion.  Microwave on high for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes, or just until hot.  Transfer to a serving dish.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: wood ear mushroom,chicken stock vegetable,parmesan cheese,chili,kitchen bouquet,yellow zucchini
title: Grilled Yellow Zucchini With Chilli and Pesto
ingredients: 3 cups chicken stock or 3 cups vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon kitchen bouquet | 1/2 whole yellow zucchini, chopped into chunks | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh chili, seeded | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh flat wood ear mushrooms | 3 pinches chopped fresh parmesan cheese
instructions: Blanch the sliced zucchini in boiling water for 10 seconds and drain immediately.  Heat a little oil in a non stick pan or wok, and sauté the chopped chilies over a medium heat for 15 - 20 seconds and remove from the heat, then stir in the chopped zucchini.  Put the stock, kitchen bouquet and chilli into the pan and put on a high heat.  Add the sliced zucchini and stir to coat.  Turn down the heat a little and season with salt and pepper.  Leave for 10 minutes.  Turn up the heat again a little and add fresh chilli and the parmesan, stir well and serve immediately.

title: Thai Peanut Dip
ingredients:
1 cup quick oatmeal | 1 tablespoon tamari or 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon red curry paste | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 1/3 cup tamari | 1 (.
    -25 ounce ) envelope dried yeast
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f.  In a medium bowl, mix together the quick oats, tamari, curry paste and sugar until smooth.  Dissolve yeast in 1/3 cup of tamari.  Stir the tamari into the bread mixture.  Turn onto a floured surface and knead for about 5 minutes.  Form the dough into a round shape.  Place in a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish.  Cover with a cloth or plastic wrap, and leave to rise.  Bake for 40 minutes in the preheated oven.  Allow to cool on a wire rack.  Cut into wedges.  The dip can be stored in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,pig foot,sea salt,cabernet sauvignon wine
title: Thai Hot Pot
ingredients: 3 lbs pigs feet, scrubbed | 1 tablespoon sea salt | 1 teaspoon curry paste | 1/2 cup cabernet sauvignon wine ( sherry )
instructions: Make sure you cut into thirds or you will have a pig head with one fat and one fat.  Score the top of the pig, about 1/16 inch deep.  Sprinkle the fillet with salt, then wrap in paper towels and squeeze out as much moisture as possible.  Use your fingers to poke holes on the meat.  Place meat into a large pot with about 1/2 inch of water.  Bring water to a boil over high heat.  When the water comes to a boil, quickly remove the meat with a slotted spoon.  Cover and lower heat to the lowest point the water will float.  Cook for 20 minutes.  Drain and let the meat set before serving, covered, over very low heat.  Serve with a variety of condiments including the papadum and sherry sauce for dipping.

Random Ingredients: hot sauce,golden raisin,yellow pepper,salad,taco seasoning mix,chicken bouillon powder,corn oil
title: Chilled Taco Salad
ingredients: 1 large yellow pepper, cut in thin strips ( i use just one medium ) | 1 small red peppers or 1 small orange pepper, cut in strips ( i use just one medium ) | 1 package taco seasoning mix | 3 tablespoons chicken bouillon powder | 3 tablespoons corn oil | 1/2 cup golden raisin or 1/2 cup dates, chopped ( i also like to add the chopped up fresh fruit for added added richness ) | hot sauce ( optional )
instructions: Prepare all your ingredients.  After all your ingredients are done, toss in your spices.  Garnish with some hot sauce or more if desired.

title: Mock Beef Jerky (Spice)
ingredients: 2 habanero peppers, stemmed seeded and deveined ( wear gloves ) | 5 cups chunky salsa
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil.  Cook the chili peppers until they begin to pop, about 30 seconds.  Immediately remove the chili peppers and drain.  Skin and devein the chili peppers.

title: Mexican Quinoa Burritos With Jalapenos and Queses
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 1 chicken bouillon | 1 cup shredded cheese | 4 medium pickled jalapenos | 1/4 cup cocoa | tortilla
instructions: Bring broth to a boil in a pot.  Drop the quinoa into the broth, and add 2 tablespoons of the dissolved chicken bouillon.  Add the jalapenos and allow to boil for a minute.  Reduce heat, and cover.  Allow the quinoa to cook and rest a few minutes before topping up, to let the heat of the quinoa and broth mingle.  Top with cheese and jalapenos and drizzle the remaining cocoa over the top and serve in warm tortillas with a side of sour cream to make it a bit more substantial.  You can also add jalapenos and cream cheese to the quinoa.  Enjoy.

title: Cilantro Walnut Fondue
ingredients: 1/4 cup walnuts | 3 -5 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, finely chopped or 1/4 teaspoon dried cilantro flakes | 1 ounce sourdough starter ( see note in directions ) | 1 dash ground cloves | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla ( see note in directions )
instructions: Soak walnuts.  Drain well.  Combine remaining ingredients into fondue pot.  Heat on high heat until bubbly.  Remove from heat and stir or stir until combined.  Ladle into serving bowl and sprinkle with toasted nuts.  Note, you may need to adjust flavor of dough after adding the rest of the ingredients.  Note, this recipe can be made 2 days ahead on cookie sheets to make overnight pretzels and store in airtight container.

title: Aussie Pickled Watermelon or Kiwi Watermelon
ingredients: 1 kg watermelon | 1 -2 kg pickledger meat | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon whole cloves
instructions: Cut several small slits in the pickling watermelon to remove the seeds.  Leave the whole thing inside.  Place the pickling ingredients in a non reactive container and pour in enough cold water to cover and soak overnight.  The following day, drain the pickling liquid and put it in a pan and bring to a boil.  The amount of time this will take will cut the watermelon down to 1 1/2 times it is larger.  Simmer till the watermelon is soft.  Remove from heat and leave till cool to the touch.  Once cool, peel off and discard the thick skinned outside of the pickling liquid.  Strain in a sieve, reserving liquid, and refrigerate until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: razor clam,red potato,wide noodle,port wine,red chili pepper,granny smith apple
title: Clams Portuguese Style
ingredients:
2 lbs fresh whole fish, halibut, or 2 lbs red snapper | 12 dried red chili peppers | 1 cup port wine | 1/4 cup red chili pepper | 8 medium red potatoes ( about 10 medium size, peeled, halved and sliced into 1/4 inch thick slices ) | 1 1/2 lbs red potatoes, halved and cut into 1/4 inch thick round slices | 4 ounces uncooked wide noodles, or 1 1/2 cups pkg.
    - of any quick cooking pasta
instructions: Place fish in a 12 inch saute pan, or shallow pot.  Pour port over fish, and bring to a boil over high heat.  Add chiles, and let reduce and reduce, approximately 5 to 7 minutes or until chiles are fragrant.  Add cut up potatoes and continue the boiling until potatoes are very tender.  Remove from heat and drain.  Transfer fish and potatoes to a clean bowl, and combine with remaining ingredients, except noodle and pasta.  Cover and let rest 1 to 10 minutes before serving, for flavors to blend.  Serve immediately.

title: Pecan Roasted Pecans
ingredients: 1 cup chopped pecans | 1/3 cup sweet marsala wine | 1 1/2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f.  Whisk the pecans, marsala wine, cornstarch, and cream of tartar together in a bowl until combined.  Season with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,mustard,vegetable,dark sesame oil,baking soda,brown rice,balsamic vinegar,golden raisin
title: Vegetarian Balsamic and Raisin Crouton
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables ( carrots, cauliflower, broccoli, and onion ) | 1 cup raw converted vegetables ( broccoli, zucchini, and onion ) | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 4 tablespoons prepared mustard | 1 pinch baking soda | 4 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 1/4 cup brown rice ( not instant )
instructions: Cook vegetables according to package directions.  Drain and allow to cool slightly before slicing and serving.  To make the dressing, combine the mustard, vinegar, oil and sesame oil in a jar with a screw top lid.  Shake vigorously before using on vegetables.  To prepare croutons, place rice and raisins in a bowl and place croutons in marinade.  Place bag of mixed veggies at the top of cereal and toss lightly in dressing.  Serve on a big platter.

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,corn tortilla chip,dijon mustard,white bread,head romaine lettuce
title: Tortilla Chip Salad
ingredients: 2 cups fresh corn tortilla chips, broken into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 medium head romaine lettuce - rinsed, dried and thinly sliced | 1 red cabbage, shredded | 1 loaf white bread, toasted and cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 cup dijon-style mustard
instructions: Place the tortilla chips in a large salad bowl, add the lettuce, cabbage and bread.  Add mustard and mustard and mix well.

title: Chok-Go-Kao
ingredients: 4 cups kosher daikon radishes, peeled and thinly sliced | 2 cups dark chocolate
instructions: Heat a heavy skillet over medium high heat until melted and starting to shimmer.  Sprinkle radish slices with salt, being sure to move the radish slices around to coat the entire bottom of the skillet.  Cook until the radish slices are lightly and evenly browned.  Drain any excess liquid from the skillet.  Remove from heat and let cool.  When cool, transfer radish pieces to a paper towel lined plate and sprinkle with dark chocolate.

Random Ingredients: lemon zest,kielbasa,ginger root,pine nut,ginger paste,ice cube,pepper sauce
title: Stuffed Sausages
ingredients: 1 pound kielbasa, casings removed | 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon zest, grated | 4 tablespoons ginger paste | 3 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 tablespoon hot pepper sauce | 3 tablespoons ground all-purpose flour | 2 cups ice cubes | 1 teaspoon crushed peanuts ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Place sausage casings between two sheets of plastic wrap.

title: Mexican Chocolate Shortbread
ingredients: 1 cup mini chocolate chips | 1/2 cup currants
instructions: Preheat oven to 350f degrees.  Lightly grease a 10 inch by 11 inch glass or metal pan.  In an electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, beat chocolate chips and currants at medium speed until fluffy and creamy, about 2 minutes.  Pour into prepared pan and spread evenly.  With the flat beater, mix in shortbread until just combined, 1 to 2 minutes.  Turn out onto a pastry cloth sprinkled with confectioners' sugar.  With a sharp knife, cut into small squares and cool thoroughly, about 3 minutes.  Chill until serving.

title: Chow Yuk Gooodles
ingredients: 1 red onion, finely chopped | 2 cups neufchatel cheese, room temperature | 2 cans chopped water chestnuts, liquid reserved | 1 can v8 vegetable broth | 1 1/2 cups chopped dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Place onion and cheese in a large bowl.  Pour enough v8 juice to cover the cheese.  Stir to mix, and add enough reserved liquid to make the mixture moist.  Remove 1/2 cup, and stir into cheese mixture.  Stir in nuts.  Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Baked Sweet Potato Chips
ingredients: 2 lbs sweet potatoes | butter ( for frying ) | adobo seasoning
instructions: Cut the sweet potatoes into 1 1/2 inch chunks.  Cook in boiling water for 15 minutes or until fork tender.  Drain well.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Butter a 9x13 inch pan.  Place the sweet potatoes in a single layer in the pan.  Sprinkle each layer with about 1/4 of the adobo seasoning.  Pour coconut milk over the potatoes and stir just until all dry ingredients are mixed in with the coconut milk.  Do not leave any remaining adobo seasoning.  Bake for 30 minutes or until nicely browned and crisp.

title: Chili Nachos
ingredients: 3 ounces chipotle bittersweet chocolate, coarsely chopped | 3 cans chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1 can pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can sweet chili sauce ( such as jake & amos ) | 1/2 cup whiskey | 3 dill pickle slices ( optional )
instructions: In a deep saucepan melt chocolate over hot water.  Stir until smooth, about 5 minutes.  Drain chickpeas and pinto beans very well.  Stir in chili sauce, whiskey, and dill pickle slices.  Heat nachos over medium heat until hot.

title: Greek Salad II
ingredients: 1 container plain soy yogurt | 1 jar gorgonzola, crumbled | 1/2 teaspoon dried mint leaves, crushed | 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 1/2 teaspoon paprika
instructions: In a mixing bowl, mix the yogurt, gorgonzola and mint until well blended.  In a small bowl, stir the tomato paste with paprika.  Pour the yogurt mixture over the gorgonzola mixture and gently stir so that flavors coat the cheese slightly.  Chill in the refrigerator about 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: tamarind juice,bok choy,vegetable broth,graham cracker crumb,red wine vinegar,hard egg,chicken wing,strawberry
title: Tamarind Chicken
ingredients: 2 cans chicken wings, drained | 1 liter vegetable broth | 1 cup choy | 1 cup bok choy | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 8 ounces frozen strawberries, thawed | 4 teaspoons chopped firm ripe unsweetened peanut butter | 3 hard-boiled eggs, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  In a dutch oven combine chicken wings, vegetable broth, choy, bok choy, vinegar, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.

Random Ingredients: banana,dill weed,pizza sauce,beer,vanilla extract,mango chutney,baby spinach,lime wedge
title: Smokin' Hot Greek Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 can pizza sauce, any flavor | 1 cup beer ( dark, medium or light is fine ) | 1 box fresh baby spinach | 1 mango chutney ( the real stuff ) | 1 medium banana | 1 teaspoon lime wedge ( optional ) | dill weed ( as much as you like ) or mint ( as much as you like )
instructions: Mix everything together in a big bowl.  Serve with pita chips and enjoy.

title: Spicy Penne Pasta Bake
ingredients: 4 ounces dry penne | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 15 -20 slices pepperoni ( thin slices, i tend to use 2 or 3, but i think it's a matter of taste and that's how i've been told ) | 1 cup hazelnuts, roasted, unsalted | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 1/2 teaspoon mixed spice, spice | 1/2 cup dried dill weed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Cook pasta and drain.  While pasta is cooking, preheat the cajun seasoning in a small skillet over medium high heat.  When it begins to turn golden, stir in pepperoni, and nuts.  Continue to cook, stirring occasionally until nuts are well infused with spices and begin to lightly turn golden and crisp.  While cooking, pour cream into a microwave safe bowl, and microwave, covered, on high for about 40 seconds to warm cream.  This will thicken slightly, but don't let boil.  Stir hot cream into skillet to coat pasta.  Add spice mix and mix well.  Pour pasta mixture into a greased 8 x8 baking pan and bake in middle of oven for 5 minutes, covered, on lower middle rack of oven.  Remove from oven, and pour roasted hazelnuts and heavy cream over pasta.  Return to oven, bake covered for a further 10 minutes, or until cream is absorbed.  Do not let burn.

title: German Mustard Chicken
ingredients: 8 chicken thighs or 8 drumsticks | 1/2 cup german mustard ( i use a light dijon mustard )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 375 degrees.  Place chicken in a baking dish that has been coated with cooking spray.  In a bowl mash the mustard into the mustard until evenly mixed.  Pour the mustard over the chicken to coat.  Bake for 45 minutes, basting every 15 minutes with sauce.  If desired, bake for a few minutes longer.

title: Vegetable Stock
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 4 -6 thyme sprigs, leaves picked from stems | 900 ml vegetable stock, low sodium
instructions: Heat oil in pan over medium heat.  Add thyme and fry, stirring often, until golden.  Remove thyme leaves from pan and pour stock through a sieve.  Add to pan with a pinch of salt and simmer 30 minutes.  Add more stock if necessary to loosen.

Random Ingredients: arborio rice,red bell pepper,corn niblets,vegetable stock
title: Risotto Primavera
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable stock | 1 packet frozen corn niblets | 1 large red bell pepper, seeded and chopped | 6 tablespoons arborio rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c.  Bring the vegetable stock to the boil in a large saucepan, add the corn and bring back to the boil before stirring in the bell pepper.  Cook for 1 minute, then drain, shaking the corn off the cob and transfer the mixture to a large bowl.  Add the rice and toss well to coat all the grains with oil.  Tip everything into an ovenproof dish, pour over just enough hot water to come halfway up the side of the dish and put in the oven for 10 minutes, until just starting to turn golden.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,red chile pepper,dark beer,basmati rice,bean,sherry
title: Bean-Squash and Rice
ingredients: 1/4 cup dark beer | 1/4 cup dry sherry | 1 pound yellow squash, diced | 1 pinch dry crushed red chile pepper | 1 1/2 cups basmati rice | 1 can bean ( with liquid )
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the dark beer, sherry and squash.  Cover and refrigerate.  In a large saucepan or dutch oven, cook rice until tender.  Drain off excess liquid, reserving 1 cup of the liquid.  Add the reserved liquid and drained soaked squash and chile pepper.  Simmer covered until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender about 20 minutes.  Stir frequently with a fork.  Serve over cooked rice.

title: Melting Puffs
ingredients: 1/2 cup cornmeal | 2 jars pimientos with green peppers ( drained ) | 2 tablespoons mango chutney | 1 cup chilled grilled beet ( chopped )
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees.

title: Safflower Rice
ingredients: 1 cup glutinous whole grain white rice ( sushi rice ) | 1 1/2 cups safflower oil
instructions: Rinse the rice well by running under running water.  Let it soak in a colander for 10 minutes to get rid of any extra moisture.  Drain it.  Heat a cast iron pan to a medium heat.  Pour a small amount of oil into the pan, then add the rice.  Fry the rice until light brown, then pour safflower oil into the pan.  It will start to sizzle. .  Add 1 cup of water, stir, cover pan and reduce heat to low.  Simmer for 20 minutes or until water is absorbed.

Random Ingredients: red enchilada sauce,cream,pork shoulder,jalapeno,lemon peel,yellow bell pepper
title: Lemony Carnitas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder or 1 1/2 lbs pork butt, cut into 1 1/2 to 2 inch cubes | 1 cup yellow bell pepper, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 jalapenos, cut into rounds | 1/4 cup fresh lemon peel | 1 cup light sour cream | 1 bag fresh cinco red enchilada sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crockpot and stir thoroughly until well combined.  Cover and cook on low for 4 hours or until meat is tender and cooked through.  Serve with tortillas, mexican rice and cheese on the side.  Or serve warm in a bolillo, tortilla or taco shell.

title: Nikuwa
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dashi stock | 6 ounces fresh mint leaves
instructions: Heat the dashi.  Chop in small batches and serve warm with a little of the strained dashi on top.  Variation, you can add dashi to small tea cup, add hot water, then stir, strain the dashi into the bowl with the mint and then serve.

Random Ingredients: pig foot,red cabbage,tamari,pasta,five spice powder,fettuccini noodle
title: Slow Cooker Five-Spice
ingredients: 1 package fettuccini noodles | 12 ounces cut-up pecorino-style fettuccini noodles | 1/4 cup five-spice powder | 12 cups red cabbage, coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup tamari | 1 cup shaved pork neck bones or 1 cup pinto beans, rinsed
instructions: Mix together the fettuccini ingredients, placing a few handfuls on top of each other to squeeze out excess moisture.  Place the dry fettuccini in the crock of a slow cooker.  Pour the tamari into the pot.

Random Ingredients: jamaican jerk spice,chocolate ice cream,kernel corn,strawberry,yeast cake
title: Baked Jamaican Strawberry Dessert

instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f.  Place all ingredients in a large bowl and mix them up as you do with your hands.  You don’t need to knead the mixture, but shape it into a sausage shape about 1” thick.  Bake on baking sheet for 25 minutes or until the top is browned and sticky.

title: Baked Cod
ingredients: 3 lbs cod | 2 1/2 teaspoons salt | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1/2 cup crisco & reg ; butter, room temperature | 2 teaspoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: Wash cod in cold water, cut off the scales, and cut the fish into 1/2 strips.  Combine salt and 1/2 c water in a large resealable bag.  Place fish in the bag and shake to coat the fish.  Sprinkle the coriander seeds all over.  In a large oven proof skillet or frypan, heat crisco & butter over medium heat until butter foams.  Place the fish in the skillet, sprinkle with confectioner's sugar, and bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven, uncovered, for 40 minutes.  Remove from oven, let cool slightly, and enjoy.  Variations.

title: Creamy Tahini Dip
ingredients: 1/2 - 3/4 cup tahini ( to taste ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup mango chutney | 1/2 cup feta, crumbled
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl and either serve immediately or leave it overnight.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,caramel,lettuce leaf,marinara sauce pasta,orecchiette,italian cheese
title: Spaghetti and Tortellini Salad With Caramel Dressing
ingredients: 250 g spaghetti sauce | 50 g marinara sauce or 50 g other sauce | 80 g shredded italian cheese blend | 1 cooked spiral pasta ( i like a whole grain, but you can make your own recipe ) | sliced thinly toasted caramels | 1 head of shredded lettuce leaf or 5 heads of lettuce
instructions: Boil spaghetti and marinara sauce in separate sauce pans.  Toss salad with cheeses and let sit while you fry tortellini.  Once heated, toss in pasta and pile on the salad.  Serve with your favorite salad dressing.  Enjoy.

title: Gourmet Apricot Bruschetta
ingredients: 1 cup fresh apricots ( or substitute fruit ) | 4 slices rustic bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f place the apricots in a dry skillet over medium heat.  Turn the heat down to low, cover the pan and cook until tender and soft, about 15 minutes.  Remove the cover and continue cooking until all of the fruit is tender and the gorgonzola is melted.  Spread the hot gorgonzola and the fruit mixture onto the bread slices and serve.

Random Ingredients: dark beer,beef bouillon granule,hot green chili pepper
title: Beer Marinade for Beef
ingredients: 1 can dark beer | 1 hot green chili pepper ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons beef bouillon granules
instructions: Pour the beer over the hot and peppery chile in a shallow glass dish or plastic container.  Add the bouillon granules.  Stir to mix.  Cover.

title: Real Mexican Beer Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup beer ( your favorite ) | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to in a bowl, combine the beer, bread crumb crumbs and melted butter together.  Add some salt or grated cheese to the mixture and mix well.  Pour into an 8x8 pan.  Bake for about 25 minutes, until crust is crisp and crusty.  Variation, this bread works better on a slice of bread such as a lo mexita.  This bread can also be baked in my other favorite way.

Random Ingredients: camembert cheese,mint leaf,baking powder,dark sesame oil
title: Baked Camembert and Mint Jalebi
ingredients: 2 cups lightly packed fresh mint leaves | 1 teaspoon ground baking powder | 10 ounces camembert cheese | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Place 1/4 cup of the mint leaves into the bowl of a food processor.  Add the baking powder and gradually add the cheese.  Pulse until smooth.  Transfer to a small bowl.  Add the sesame oil and toss to combine.  Spread the mixture on the lined baking sheet.  Sprinkle on the remaining mint.  Bake for 15 to 18 minutes.

title: Cucumber and Pepper Salad
ingredients: 1 lebanese cucumber | 1 yellow bell pepper | 1 jar marinara sauce ( homemade or store-bought, i don't recommend the bottled stuff )
instructions: Wash and pierce the cucumber and bell pepper in several places.  Place the cucumber and bell pepper on a cutting board and slice into 1/4 inch thick strips.  Arrange the strips on a serving platter and top with the prepared sauce.  Serve immediately or cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for later use.  Variation, if desired, you may slice the cucumber and pepper into 1/4 inch thick, half rings.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,apricot jam,gruyere cheese,yukon gold potato,seitan,hard egg,mustard powder
title: Gruyere and Potato Rosti
ingredients: 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled | 4 teaspoons salt | 4 ounces dry smoked seitan | 4 teaspoons mustard powder | 4 ounces gruyere cheese, shredded | 2 cups corn oil | 2 hard-boiled eggs, sliced
instructions: Scrub potatoes and cut into chunks.  Place in a large pan of cold water, and bring to a boil.  Cook for 10 minutes, until tender.  Drain, cool, and chop into bite sized pieces.  Place seitan in a skillet with a drizzle of oil and mustard powder.  Cook over medium heat until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.  Place potatoes in a large bowl or roaster, and add remaining ingredients.  Mix well, and place in a preheated oven at 300 degrees f for 25 to 30 minutes to set crust.  This can be served warm, or cold, as an accompaniment to stews, or on its own as an accompaniment to rice or soup.  Also it will coat the top of the steaks.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,cherry pie filling,green olive,soy sauce,green banana,xanthan gum,water chestnut
title: Beef Tenderloin With Green Fruit Fillings and Soy Sauce
ingredients: 5 lbs beef tenderloin | 1/2 cup soy sauce | 3 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 tablespoons xanthan gum | 8 ounces green olives, sliced | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1 can cherry pie filling | 2 -3 green bananas | 6 cups water
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Combine meat, soy sauce, cornstarch, and xanthan gum.  Score entire surface of meat, 3/4 of the way through.  Place 1/2 tbls of the mixture on each side of meat cut into 2 pieces, each piece 3/4 of the way through.  Place on a rack in roasting pan.  Reserve remaining mixture for sauce and fillings.  Combine remaining 8 oz.  Of olives with water chestnuts, pour over meat cover with foil.  Roast for 5 hours.  Check internal temperature of meat, 90 degrees, when done remove from oven, remove foil, and allow to rest for 15 minutes prior to serving.

title: Quinoa-Amaranth Pilaf
ingredients: 2 cups quinoa | 2 tablespoons amaranth almond paste ( or almond pure ) | 2 tablespoons freshly grated parmesan cheese | 2 teaspoons tamari, to taste
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package directions, then drain.  While quinoa is cooking, toast almond paste in a small skillet over medium heat for about 5 minutes until fragrant.  Sprinkle 1 teaspoon of tamari over quinoa.  Pour the amaranth mixture over the hot quinoa and toss to coat, then serve sprinkled with toasted almonds.  If you don't plan on eating these pilaf with your meal, i would be extremely cautious with the amaranth/egg substitute.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese spread,yeast,mustard powder,tarragon vinegar,queso anejo,alfredo sauce
title: Sourdough Starter for Mushroom Cottage
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream cheese spread | 2 tablespoons dry mustard powder | 2 tablespoons tarragon vinegar | 1 package yeast | 4 cups bread, pieces | 12 ounces alfredo sauce
instructions: Mix sour cream cheese spread, mustard powder, and vinegar until well mixed.  Set aside.  Combine yeast and bread in a large bowl and let rise til bubbly.  When yeast is bubbly, add bread, then alfredo sauce to dough and mix.  Put on floured surface.  Knead until soft and elastic.  Cover and let rise in a warm place til doubled, about 1 1/2 hours.  Punch down dough and flatten on floured surface.  Divide into 16 equal portions, then roll into balls.  Cover dough balls and let rise for 45 minutes.  Preheat oven to 350°f bake at 350 f about 25 - 30 for 15 minutes.

title: Salsa-Stuffed Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice | 1 lb fresh pumpkin ( or other winter squash ) | 1 tablespoon dark sweet soy sauce | 2 tablespoons very strong coffee or 2 tablespoons coffee-flavored brewed tea, heated | yummy dark soy sauce ( optional )
instructions: Wash the rice and slice it in half.  Make sure it is dry.  Put your rice, pumpkin or squash in a deep mixing bowl and cut a slit down the center side of the rice and scrape out the seeds.  You can also go on cutting the squash down the center and cut the fruit into long thin slices.  Add the rice to the bowl with the seeds and mix well.  Add the other ingredients and combine.  Cover and put in the fridge for 1 hour.  Unwrap and stuff a good size cavity with rice mixture, if using.  Wrap a piece of cheese cloth around the top of the stuffing with a large pinch of cheese.  You want the cloth to capture the steam during cooking.  When ready to bake, pre heat oven to 350 degrees.  After 1 hour, put your stuffed chicken into a baking box with the lid, close the lid, and add about a teaspoon or two of soy sauce to the top of the chicken.  Bake in oven for 45 minutes.  Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,black pepper,red pepper flake,buttermilk,vanilla essence,pepper,blueberry
title: Blueberry, Vanilla, Pepper Overnight Wings!
ingredients: 500 g chicken wings, separated | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1/4 cup blueberries | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Line 2 large baking trays with foil, and spray with nonstick cooking spray.  Remove chicken wing tips from wings and place in a large bowl.  Sprinkle with the crushed pepper flakes and ground black pepper.  Using your hands, rub the chicken and buttermilk in until smooth.  In a small bowl, mix together the vanilla, pepper and red pepper flakes.  Stir in the vanilla mixture until coated.  Spoon this mixture onto the prepared trays, then spread evenly.  Sprinkle the blueberries over the top, then use the back of a spoon to lightly pat down the blueberries as well as the edges of the tray.  Make sure that the tray is not too close to the tray.  Place the oven on a middle rack and bake for about 40 minutes, or until the wings are firm.  Let the tray cool slightly before handling, as it loosens up the flavour.  Cut into quarters and serve.

Random Ingredients: orzo pasta,lemon zest,egg wrapper,fuji apple,seasoning salt,harissa
title: Moroccan Apple and Noodle Ravioli
ingredients: 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest | 8 ounces uncooked orzo pasta | 2 eggs, lightly beaten | 3/4 cup shredded koshihiki-style tofuji apple ( about 1 block ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons harissa, or to taste | 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: In a medium saucepan of boiling salted water, cook orzo until almost tender, about 10 minutes.  Drain, and rinse under cold water.  Set aside.  In a large bowl, combine eggs with zest.  Add orzo, tofu, harissa, and seasoned salt.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,chili powder,wasabi paste,butter,swiss cheese,iceberg lettuce,cream chicken soup,chocolate square
title: Creamy Yummy Swiss Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs swiss cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 1 package shell pasta, cooked | 4 tablespoons butter, melted | 4 tablespoons sour cream or 4 tablespoons plain yogurt | 4 chocolate squares, melted
instructions: In large bowl mix cheese, soup, mayonnaise, and chili powder.  In a second bowl, combine pasta, melted butter, and sour cream.  Add to cheese mixture.  Stir thoroughly.  Dip each macaroni shell into melted butter and arrange on cookie sheet.  Sprinkle half of cheese mixture over each shell.  Spoon chili cheese mixture over cheese top.  Sprinkle with remaining cheese.  Bake at 375 degrees for 20 minutes.

title: Nuoc Cham (Thai Fish Cakes)
ingredients: 4 small fresh radishes, rinsed, drained, and cut into 1/2-inch dice | 2 tablespoons fresh fish sauce | 3 tablespoons egg substitute | 1/2 cup olive oil
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the radish slices and fish sauce.  Add the egg substitute and mix gently.  Heat the olive oil in a skillet over high heat.  Form the cattier mixture into patties.  When hot, carefully lower one pattie at a time into the hot oil.  Cook until the fish turns opaque in the center, about 4 minutes per side.

title: Cashew Nut and Chestnut Salad
ingredients: 1 medium vidalia onion | 500 g hominy ( canned ) | 1 cup dry chestnuts ( soaked until soft ) | 1 small red capsicum ( diced ) | 1 cup mixed roasted cashew nuts | 1/8 teaspoon sea salt | 1/8 teaspoon catsup
instructions: Wash the onion slightly and dry.  Cut into half and slice across into thin half rings.  Place in a large bowl and sprinkle on salt.  Allow to drain.  Bring the hominy and salted water to the boil then add the onions, capsicum, chestnuts and cashews.  Reduce heat and simmer gently for 30 minutes.  Allow to stand for a further ten minutes then remove from heat and stir in the sea salt and catsup.  Pour the hot dressing into the bowl and mix thoroughly.  Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: vanilla bean,mandarin orange segment,rice cereal,navy bean
title: Pecan Pizzas
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried navy beans, soaked overnight and rinsed | 11 ounces mandarin orange segments | 11 ounces rice cereal, puffed ( about 20 to 25 per cereal ) | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise, seeds scraped
instructions: Place soaked beans, orange mandarin segments into large bowl or quart jars.  Drain undrained navy beans, reserving liquid.  In saucepan of boiling water, bring navy beans with seeds to boiling over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: oregano,allspice berry,lime juice zest,pearl barley,golden syrup,pink grapefruit,peach
title: Barley and Peach Kabobs
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley | 2 cups pearl barley | 1/4 cup pale golden syrup | 6 tablespoons lime juice and zest | 2 1/4 cups peeled diced peaches | 1 pink grapefruit, peel and pulp coarsely chopped | 12 allspice berries, whole
instructions: Soak pearl barley in a large bowl of hot water until tender, about 30 minutes.  Drain.  Combine barley, pearl barley, golden syrup, lime peel, peaches, and grapefruit in a large ceramic baking dish.  Stir in allspice berries.  Cover tightly.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin steak,mint leaf,ladyfinger,hot sauce,part mozzarella cheese,banana,pesto sauce,russet potato
title: Pan Seared Beef With Banana, Strawberry, and Mint Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin steak, thin cut | 2 russet potatoes, medium size, peeled, diced | 1/4 cup prepared pesto sauce, prepared | 1 bunch mint leaf | 1 lb banana | 1/2 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, sliced | hot sauce ( optional ) | 1 cup fresh mint leaves | 1 small bunch fresh mint leaves
instructions: Set up your grill or oven to 550 degrees f.  Lightly oil the inside of your grill pan.  Place diced potatoes on a plate or baking sheet, and place potatoes on a tray.  Spray a small piece of aluminum foil onto the top of the potatoes to prevent them from sticking to each other.  Place a cutting board over the potatoes, and weigh them down with something heavy to keep them submerged while you grill or bake them.  Put your grill pan over medium heat.  Place your sirloin steak in the pan, and slice across the grain into very thin slices.  Remove meat from the pan if desired.  Spread thinly sliced beef across the sliced meat.  Dot with pesto sauce.  Add diced, peeled potato, and sliced mint leaves.  Drizzle with hot sauce, if using, and top with mozzarella cheese, and fresh mint leaves.  Serve with fresh bread and a large green salad.

Random Ingredients: peach,artichoke heart,vanilla extract,italian turkey sausage,baking cocoa,blueberry,shiitake mushroom
title: Chocolate Italian Sausage Bake
ingredients: 1 package mild italian turkey sausage, casings removed | 2 cans artichoke hearts, drained and sliced | 1 can pitted sliced peaches, drained and halved | 1 cup fresh shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 2 tablespoons baking cocoa, divided | 1 package frozen blueberries
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Generously spray a 9x13 inch casserole dish with cooking spray.  Heat a large skillet over medium high heat and cook and stir the sausage until crumbly, evenly browned, and evenly browned.  Remove the sausage and artichoke hearts from the skillet, reserving the drippings in the skillet, and return them to the skillet.  Stir the chik into the sausage in the skillet until coated.  Stir in the peaches, mushrooms, and saute for 20 minutes, until the mushrooms are softened.  Stir in the vanilla and 3/4 cup of cocoa.  Remove the sausage mixture from heat and stir in the berries.  Spoon everything over the prepared casserole.  Sprinkle with remaining cocoa.  Bake for 45 minutes in the preheated oven until center is bubbly and the sausage is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: clam juice,coriander seed,philadelphia cream cheese,canola oil,golden syrup,pineapple chunk,corn
title: Chilli Canapes With Clam Chutney
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coriander seed, crushed | 1 package philadelphia cream cheese, softened | 20 ounces clams with juice, drained | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1/3 cup crushed pineapple chunk | 10 ounces corn | 1/4 cup crushed pineapple chunk ( juice reserved for canapes )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  In a small skillet cook coriander seeds in hot oil until toasted and a shade darker, about 3 minutes.  Stir in cream cheese until blended.  Stir in clam juice, golden syrup, crushed pineapple, 1/4 cup reserved clam juice and crushed pineapple chunk.  Mix thoroughly.  Spoon into small baking dish.  Bake 45 to 50 minutes until bubbly and heated through.  Remove from oven, top with chopped pineapple and corn slices.

Random Ingredients: escarole,chili oil,malt vinegar,black olive,tomato green chile pepper
title: Sizzlin' Hot Mexican Caviar
ingredients: 1 pound chopped, romaine lettuce- rinsed and crisped escarole | 2 cans stewed tomatoes and green chile peppers | 1 pound chopped, cooked black olives | 1 package dry sizzlin' hot chili oil | 3 tablespoons malt vinegar
instructions: Mix together the green chile peppers, tomatoes and olives and set aside.  Combine the hot chili oil and malt vinegar and stir into the hot vinegar.  Add the cilantro and toss.  Serve over your favorite greens.

title: Sushi Balls (Pasteles- Asparagi Alla Telefono)
ingredients: 100 g white flour, sifted | 100 g reduced-fat feta cheese ( a 1/8-inch diameter block ) | 10 sheets white flour | 75 g jam ( a 50/50 mix of jam ) | 500 g asparagus ( about 1 1/2-2 inches long ) | 3 1/4 cups extra dark chocolate
instructions: Sushi ball dough, place flour in a bowl and combine in another bowl the cheese, salt and white flour.  Knead the mixture, adding the additional flour, 1 cup water if need be.  Divide dough into 5 parts and place on the countertop or on a tray which is dusted with cornstarch until they are about the size of a small lemon.  Roll out each part until about 1/8” thick and line a baking sheet with foil.  Spread 1 tbsp of the jam on the dough and roll up, jelly side down, jelly side up.  Make sure the outside is not over rolled.  Place seam side down on the foil or cornstarch covered tray.  Repeat with the rest of the dough.  Heat oven to 220 degrees centigrade degrees.  Line the tray with the asparagus and bake asparagus till tender.

title: Rice and Sausage With Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups jasmine rice ( or regular as you like it ) | 1 kg italian sausage | 1 large green beans | 2 -3 dried chilies | 1 tablespoon corn oil ( or peanut oil ) | 2 tablespoons tapioca
instructions: Slice or tear your sausage if you like it vegetarian.  Slice the green beans if you like them.  Fry the sausage in the oil.  Cut the chili peppers into thin stripes and add them to the oil now heat up and saute for 5 minutes put rice in the pot then the rest of the ingredients except for the tapioca, stir and bring to boil then turn down to medium low.  Simmer for 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,butter,guacamole,poblano pepper,chicken bouillon cube,beef broth
title: Chile Colorado
ingredients:
1 poblano pepper, diced | 1 can reduced-sodium beef broth ( or 2 cups beef bouillon, made according to package directions ) | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted and divided | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 2 chicken bouillon cubes ( or 2 tbsp.
    - dissolved bouillon in 1 cup boiling water ) | guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f.  Lightly butter a 2 quart baking dish or roasting pan.  Line baking dish with foil.  Combine poblano and beef broth in a blender.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,raisin,cream coconut,garbanzo bean flour,oregano leaf,hard egg,peach
title: Banana Bean Pancakes - Palapa Indian Style
ingredients:
2 medium ripe peaches, peeled and cut up | 1 can garbanzo beans flour, such as dr.
    - watkins | 1 cup basmati rice, washed and drained | 1 cup cream of coconut | 1/2 cup raisins | 2 small hard-boiled eggs, peeled and quartered | 1/8 teaspoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f line cookie sheet with parchment paper.  Stir all ingredients except eggs and oregano until smooth.  Stir in 2 eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Spread 3 to 4 tablespoons of filling on each cookie sheet.  Bake for about 8 to 10 minutes or until puffed and golden.  Serve hot.

title: Hot Roasted Salsa
ingredients: 4 ounces canned fire-roasted tomatoes | 1 red onion, diced
instructions: Heat the canned tomatoes in a medium pan in a bit of water for a few minutes to soften a little bit.  Dice red onion.  Serve with grilled steak or meat.

title: Prawns In Pepper Pepper (Prawn) Masala
ingredients: 1 kg prawns | 1 tablespoon pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder
instructions: Shell the prawns and remove the tail.  Devein the shrimp and set aside.  Combine the pepper flakes with the cardamom powder in a bowl and take the prawns from the shells.  In a large pan with boiling water, blanch the prawns for 2 minutes then remove them from the pan.  In a dry pan, dry fry the prawns in hot oil for just one minute then remove them from the pan.  In a clean pan, fry the prawns in the oil for 1 minute.  Drain the prawns out of the water.  Pour the hot pepper into a pan with the shrimp in it.  Cook for 2 minutes.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,cooking oat,white peppercorn,chili sauce,chunky salsa,pecan,filet mignon steak
title: Grilled Beef Roll Ups
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups chunky salsa | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1/8 cup chili sauce ( i use mrs.
    - dash ) | 2 -4 tablespoons quick-cooking oats | 1/8 cup chopped pecans | 8 slices filet mignon steaks | white peppercorns, crushed
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high.  Lightly coat the tops or the rims of four 4 inch sheets of heavy duty aluminum foil.  Mix together the salsa, brown sugar, chili sauce, oats, pecans and pour 2/3 cup of the salsa over the steaks.  Arrange the steaks on top of the sauce, covering the steaks completely.  If desired, drizzle with additional sauce.  Sprinkle a little crushed peppercorns on top of each steak.  Grill the steaks 5 - 8 inches from the heat for 12 to 15 minutes or until they are cooked through and the sauce is bubbly.  Transfer to a cutting board and let stand for 3 to 5 minutes, then slice.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: beef roast,italian plum tomato,red chili pepper,amarula cream liqueur,filet mignon,fennel seed
title: Pan-Roasted Beef With Italian Plums
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef roast | 2 1/2 tablespoons fennel seeds, crushed | 1/4 cup amarula cream liqueur or 1/4 cup grand marnier | 1 can italian plum tomatoes, drained and chopped ( hunts ) | 1 fresh red chili pepper, stemmed, seeded and chopped | 4 -6 -8 ounces filets mignon, sliced | 1 tablespoon fennel seed
instructions: Place beef in a 3 1/2 quart slow cooker.  Sprinkle with 1 1/2 tablespoons fennel seeds and 1/4 cup amarula liqueur or grand marnier.  Top with diced tomatoes, chile, and about 1/3 cup of water.  Insert meat thermometer into center if necessary.  Cover and cook on low for 5 to 6 hours or on high for 5 to 6 hours, or until meat is tender when pierced with a fork and juices run clear.  Transfer meat to a warm platter.  Shred to serve, discard fat.  Cool slightly.  Combine remaining 1/2 tablespoon fennel seeds with water.  Dissolve 1 tablespoon fennel seed in 1 tablespoon amarula cream liqueur.  Combine 1 tablespoon fennel seeds with about an inch of water in a small saucepan.  Set over medium heat.  Bring to a boil, stirring to prevent sticking.  Continue cooking for 2 minutes or until fennel begins to brown.  Add enough water to saucepan to yield about 1/2 inch of liquid remaining in pan.  Cook, stirring constantly for several minutes, until mixture starts to bubble.  Transfer saucepan with liquid to a blender or food processor.  Add 1 tablespoon fennel seed powder.  Blend or process sauce until smooth.  Pour sauce over meat and simmer for 15 minutes or until meat reheths easily.  Serve with meat and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,garlic,green chili pepper,green onion,chipotle chile adobo,pork loin chop,italian dressing,mustard seed
title: Chipotle Pork Chops
ingredients: 1/2 cup light italian dressing | 1/2 green chili pepper, cut in half lengthwise and thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon chipotle chile in adobo, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon coarsely crushed garlic | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seed | 1/4 cup chopped green onion | 1/4 cup low-fat sour cream or 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon ( optional )
instructions: Combine salad dressing ingredients in a large zip top plastic bag and shake well.  Add the pork and marinade in bag and toss to coat.  Refrigerate for at least 2 hours.  Combine sour cream, chiles, and garlic in a small bowl.

title: Low Fat Spiced Sweetcorn & Herb Filling
ingredients: 500 g whole low-fat guacamole | 2 teaspoons yeast | 2 pints spring onions | 400 g corn | 1 1/2 teaspoons spices, mixed ( or more to taste ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground nutmeg
instructions: Add the guacamole and mix well.  Leave the mixture in the fridge for 1 - 2 hours or in the fridge for overnight.  Soften the corn and roughly chop.  Chop the spring onions and fry in a little butter or oil until golden brown.  Add to the guacamole and stir through.  Add the spices, and mix through with the corn and spring onions.  If it becomes too thick to your liking, add a little water to achieve your own preferred consistency.  Spread on toasted bread, spread with a butter spread or the spread of your choice, or on toast.

title: Flank Steak Wrap
ingredients: 2 whole wheat tortillas | 1 lb thin-sliced rump steak
instructions: Cook the steak by your preferred method.  Use a 12 inch flat bottom grill that has been heated to just about 325°f.  Place the tortilla on a flat surface and spread it evenly with one quarter of the steak.  Top with the remaining steak, making sure each has been covered.  Wrap the wrap around the meat, securing with a toothpick or kitchen twine if necessary.  Brush the wrap with some of the remaining non stick cooking oil if needed.  Wrap tightly in aluminum foil and place in warm oven to warm up before serving.

Random Ingredients: mango,pita bread,red pepper,mostaccioli pasta,italian parsley,turmeric powder,sherry wine
title: Maccheroni
ingredients: 1 package mostaccioli pasta or ( 16 ounce ) package elbow macaroni noodles | 8 ounces diced roasted red peppers ( from a jar ) | 8 ounces roasted mango | 1/2 cup chopped sweet smoked papaya or 1/2 cup shredded coconut, lightly packed in water | 2 1/2 tablespoons sherry wine | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground turmeric powder | 1 handful fresh italian parsley, for garnishing ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f.  Cook pasta according to package directions.  While pasta is cooking, set aside.  Rinse the mango and peppers well and cut them into very thin slices.  Dice papaya or coconut into small cubes if you prefer.  Stir all of the ingredients, except the parsley, in a large casserole or heavy baking dish.  Cover and bake for 20 minutes.  Toss with warm italian parsley, if desired, and serve.

Random Ingredients: sugar,green capsicum,chicken broth,red kidney bean,tofu,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,oyster sauce,green olive
title: Tofu Chili
ingredients:
2 ounces firm tofu | 0.
    -5 can red kidney beans | 1 can chopped green olives, drained | 1/2 green capsicum, thinly sliced with the base removed | 1 chipotle pepper in adobo sauce | 1 tablespoon sugar | 2 tablespoons chicken broth or 2 tablespoons chicken stock | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Chop tofu, beans and red capsicum very finely, and set aside.  Heat the broiler.  In a large saucepan, mix together the remaining ingredients, except the tofu and the broth, and bring to a boil.  Add tofu mixture and cook for five minutes, stirring over moderate low until the mixture coats the back of a spoon.  Serve in heated bowls.

title: Sweet Spicy Bean Salad
ingredients:
1/2 lb green string bean, trimmed | 1/4 lb pumpkin puree ( not pumpkin pie filling ) | 1/2 cup fresh spinach | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves ( or crushed fresh garlic ) | 2 teaspoons lemon rind, grated ( or 1 t.
    - lime juice ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried tablespoonlemon verbena leaves | 1 cup warm ranch dressing
instructions: In a bowl, toss the green beans, pumpkin, spinach, cloves, lemon rind, and mint.  Stir in the dressing to combine.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight.  Serve chilled.

title: Baked Ham and Rice With Sausages and Cheese
ingredients: 2 cups long-grain rice ( not instant ) | 4 ounces deli ham, thinly sliced | 2 ounces unsmoked deli ham, thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon mace
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit.  Spray a 9 x 4 x 1 loaf pan with cooking spray.  In a large, shallow roasting pan combine the rice, the ham, the deli ham, the mace and the cooked ham.  Arrange the sausage, ham and cheese together in a single layer and bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes, or until thoroughly heated through and beginning to brown.

title: Ginger Potatoes
ingredients: 3 large baking potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced | 6 slices fresh ginger root | 1 1/2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/4 cup crushed pickling spices
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Butter a 2 or 3 quart baking dish.  Place potatoes into a large pot and fill with water to cover.  Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes.  Drain, and set aside to cool.  Place the ginger slices in a mortar with the vinegar and crushed pickling spices.  Stir until combined and add to potatoes.  Mix well until potatoes are evenly coated with marinade.  Cover and refrigerate for 3 days, stirring occasionally, before serving.  To eat the potatoes cold, place in a covered pan and bake in preheated oven for 1 hour.

title: Hawaiian Spiced Hot Sauce With Rice Vinegar
ingredients: 1/2 cup honey | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/4 cup hot sauce | 3 -4 maraschino cherries, cut into thirds
instructions: In a small bowl combine all ingredients and mix thoroughly.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 - 4 hours.  Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes before serving.  Serve with rice vinegar mixed with maraschino cherries.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,tomato,red potato,chicken bouillon cube,rigatoni pasta,golden raisin,asiago cheese,pork chop
title: Sicilian Pork, Potato and Raisin Stew
ingredients: 2 pork chops, stew | 1 package rigatoni pasta | 3 tablespoons butter in pan, melted | 1 jar sun-dried tomatoes, packed in oil, drained | 13 1/2 ounces canned tomatoes, drained, cut up | 6 red potatoes, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 3 chicken bouillon cubes | 5 ounces asiago cheese, shredded | 1/3 cup golden raisin, coarsely chopped
instructions: Brown meat and drain fat.  Set meat aside.  In small bowl, combine all ingredients except raisins and pasta.  Bring to boil, cover and simmer for 25 minutes or until pasta is tender.  Add meat and raisins and simmer 30 minutes more.  Serve with grated cheese and sour cream.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,green,orange blossom water,alfredo sauce,arrowroot,pear,white fish
title: Faux Pear and Orange Soup
ingredients: 15 ounces alfredo sauce | 3 red pears | 15 ounces white fish | 3 ounces onions soup mix | 2 tablespoons arrowroot ( dissolved in 7/4 tsp water ) | 2 tablespoons orange blossom water | 1 lb green beans ( optional )
instructions: Cut pears into quarters and remove the stems.  Cut the green beans into 2 inch segments.  Bring 6 cups of water to boil.  Add arrowroot mixture and boil for 1 minute.  Cut fish into 2 inch pieces, and add to the soup.  Add orange blossom water and continue to boil for 2 minutes.  Add the green beans and serve.

title: Herbal Herb Mix
ingredients: 1 cup dried mint, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: In large bowl combine mint and lemon juice cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight.  For stronger mint flavor combine 2 tsps.  Dried mint in double secre of cold water.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,caraway seed,sesame seed,wheat bran,zucchini,olive,grand marnier,corn flake
title: French Beef With Caramelized Zucchini
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs stewing beef ( cut into 3/4 by 1/8 inch strips ) | 1 tablespoon corn flakes | 1 tablespoon caraway seed | 3 tablespoons whole wheat bran | 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1/3 lb zucchini ( cut into 6 pieces lengthwise cut slices ) | 3 tablespoons grand marnier or 3 tablespoons other dry white balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons unpasted sliced ripe olives
instructions: Remove any excess sodium from the beef.  In a bowl mix the beef, corn flakes, caraway seeds, bran, and sesame seeds.  Arrange the zucchini, a layer at a time, in a single layer in a 13 x 9 x 2 inch roasting pan.  Cover with the beef.  Marinate in the refrigerator, uncovered, for at least 4 hours and up to 8 hours.  After 4 hours of marination, bring the contents of the pan to a boil.  Cover, reduce heat, and simmer 2 hours, uncovered.  Stir occasionally.  Add the grand marnier.  Cook 1 hour longer or until thickened.  Remove from heat, sprinkle olives on top and serve.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,chicken bouillon cube,molasses,beef tenderloin,cherry tomato,hamburger,green onion,cornstarch
title: Cherry Tomatoes - Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 4 ounces fresh tomato | 2 ounces thinly sliced green onions | 1/2 teaspoon light molasses | 1 beef tenderloin, trimmed, tied with kitchen string | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 teaspoon red curry paste | 4 ounces cherry tomatoes, halved | 2 teaspoons cornstarch
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°.  Slice tomato into thin slivers and place in a small baking dish.  Scatter onions on tomato.  Combine other ingredients in a large bowl, add meat and toss until all meat is coated with sauce.  Pour evenly over onions.  Cover dish with foil.  Bake, turning once, for 30 minutes.  Remove meat, uncover, and bake for another 10 minutes, or until meat thermometer reaches 160f.

title: Leek and Leek Salad
ingredients: 2 leeks | salt and black pepper
instructions: Wash the leeks thoroughly, removing both the white and middle layers.  Slice the leeks widthy and place the slice between the layers of paper towel.  Using a vegetable peeler or knife remove the dark green portion of the leek, and cut the leek into very thin slices.  Sprinkle the slices with salt and pepper and place in a salad bowl.  Toss it all together, and serve warm.

title: Spicy Garlic Kielbasa
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs pork loin roast | 8 -10 baking potatoes, peeled ( or a combination of them ) | 1 lb kielbasa ( or use 1/2 of each ) or 1/2 of each sausage ( or use 1/2 of each ) | 1 jar marinara sauce ( you can use your own or jarred ) | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, grated ( or 1/2 fresh grated gingerroot )
instructions: Put roast in a large roaster or dutch oven large enough to fit the meat.  Cover with water 3/4 over roast.  Add 1/2 of jar of marinara sauce and 2 of grated gingerroot.  Cover and bake at 350 degrees oven for 1 hour per pound.  Add remainder of jar of sauce and bring to a boil.  Turn off oven, cover and leave roast in oven for 3 hours.  Take roast out from oven and let stand for 15 minutes before carving or shredding.  Return shredded meat to the juices in the pan.  Taste for seasoning, and serve over noodles and/or egg noodles.  Note, the amount of potato depends on how thinly sliced the meat used.  One slice of kielbasa will yield 2 loaves.

Random Ingredients: watermelon,herbes de provence,sauce,peanut oil vegetable,white fish fillet,ice
title: Watermelon, Sea Bass and Fish Skewers
ingredients: 1 large watermelon, peeled | 1/2 cup water | 3 tablespoons hot sauce | 2 tablespoons herbes de provence | 4 white fish fillets, about 5 oz and 1 inch thick | 2 teaspoons minced, fresh garlic | 2 cups ice
instructions: Cut the watermelon into 3/4 inch pieces and cut into 1 inch chunks.  Place in a medium bowl and add the water, hot sauce, herbes de provence, and salt.  Combine well and set aside.  In a medium bowl, rub the fish fillets with the garlic.  Place 1/2 cup ice in the freezer to freeze, about 20 minutes.  Drain the fish fillets on a cutting board.  Add the fish fillets to the bowl with the water mixture and toss to coat.  Divide the marinade between two long skewers and transfer it to a baking sheet lined with wax paper.  Reserve the remaining marinade.  Thread 1 pieces of fish onto the skewers and place them in one layer on the marinade.  Cover with plastic wrap or aluminum foil and freeze overnight.  Heat a grill or grill pan on the stovetop over medium high heat.  Remove the fillets from the marinade.  Place the fish on the foil or foil skewer and grill 4 to 5 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and cooked through.  Let cool before serving.

title: Spiced Bourbon Glaze (Glaze)
ingredients: 1/2 ounce gingerroot, crushed | 1 ounce bourbon | 1/2 ounce fresh gingerroot, sliced | 1/2 ounce cornflour | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: Combine the ginger, bourbon and gingerroot and leave overnight.  Next day, mix the cornflour, cloves and the remaining marinade together and then brush on to the glaze.  Place in a dry glass bottle.

title: Easy Yellow Squash and Squash "salad"
ingredients: 7 -8 medium yellow squash | 3 stalks celery seeds | 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/4 cup icing sugar | 1 teaspoon hot sauce | 1 cup dry white wine | 1 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Peel squash and place in bowl and smash.  Add all other ingredients and mix.  Bake at 350 degrees in 350°f oven for about 1 hour or until knife comes out clean and top is golden.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,sharp cheddar cheese,almond milk,meat,onion soup mix,cumin,baby spinach
title: Swiss Cheese Spinach Bake (Oamc)
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs deli-style diced ham | 2 lbs fresh baby spinach | 14 1/2 fluid ounces low fat milk ( may use skim at room temperature ) | 1 envelope onion soup mix, divided | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 2 cups shredded swiss cheese | 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees.  Spray 2 quart casserole dish with non stick cooking spray.  In food processor add ham, spinach and 3 tablespoons soup mix to processor and process until thoroughly combined.  Stir 2 tbsp soup mix into ham mixture and spread evenly into casserole dish.  In a small bowl, blend 3/4 cup of swiss cheese with the remaining 3/4 cup soup mix until blended.  Sprinkle mixture evenly over ham, then sprinkle evenly with cheese mixture.  Sprinkle with remaining swiss cheese, then bake uncovered 10 minutes, or until bubbly and beginning to turn golden brown.  Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Beetroot Puree-Cottage With Red Pepper
ingredients: 1 lb beetroot ( or 2 lbs if using smaller beetroot ) | 1 cup part-skim ricotta cheese | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper
instructions: Wash the beetroot and trim the root ends.  Cut the beetroot into thin slices about 1/4 thick.  If you find it hard, you can use a knife to cut them to about 1/4 squares.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Meanwhile, rinse the beetroot slices and pat dry with a paper towel.  Heat 1 t butter in a medium sized frying pan and place the beetroot in the pan.  Cook on medium high heat, stirring often and turning around constantly with tongs, until the beetroot is soft when sliced, about 10 minutes.  Add 1 cup part skim ricotta, 1/4 tsp crushed red pepper and stir to mix.  Simmer and stir another 30 seconds.  Serve over cooked spaghetti or pasta of your choice, making sure to keep the pan on the heat and stirring until everything is hot and creamy.

title: Amazing and Easy Beef Noodle Bowls (Baked)
ingredients: 1 box spaghetti | 14 1/2 ounces low-sodium petite-dry roast turkey from a gravy made by imagine | 1 jar buffalo, nuggets
instructions: Preheat oven to brown bagged spaghetti in a large pot of boiling water until al dente, about 10 minutes per package instructions.  Pour enough of the turkey broth to cover the bottom of a 2 quart casserole dish completely.  Lay turkey nuggets on top of the noodles in the casserole.  Pour remaining broth on top of nuggets.  Cover dish tightly with foil, tenting the sides against the heat, just to heat through.  You may need to break the foil a few times to get it to work.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,basil leaf,rib eye steak,grain rice,pork loin roast,ciabatta,mirin,herb
title: Steak and Rice Sandwich with Herbs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra light mirin | 600 g boneless rib-eye steaks, sliced | 6 slices ciabatta | 6 slices rye bread | 60 g fresh mushrooms, cut in half | 1 bunch fresh basil leaves, cut into ribbons | 2 teaspoons dried mixed herbs | 500 g pork loin roast, sliced
instructions: Heat a large non stick pan over a high heat.  Add the mirin, season and bring to the boil.  Add the steaks, reduce the heat and cook for 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, place the coiled bread on the tray and place in the freezer for 10 minutes.  While the steaks are poaching, place the mushrooms and herbs in a bowl and season with black pepper.  Place the sliced meat on four slices of the bread and top with the mushroom mixture.  Top the sandwich with the toasted sandwich bread, drizzle with the remaining mirin and grill for 5 minutes until crispy and golden.

title: Tomato Pork Curry
ingredients: 400 g diced tomatoes and tomatillos | 150 -180 g finely chopped tomatillos | 1 teaspoon green curry paste | 2 teaspoons malt vinegar or 2 teaspoons cider vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 1 sprig celery | 1 teaspoon finely chopped celery, optional
instructions: Blend all the ingredients in a blender with salt/cane fat until the chunky consistancy is achieved.  Heat a little oil in a heavy based saucepan.  Add the diced tomatoes and tomatillo/tomato sauce mixture.  Bring to the boil.  Boil gently for 15/20 minutes.  Serve with steamed basmati rice, fried basmati noodles or brown rice, or chapati.  Note, if you want to make in advance, place chopped meat of your choice in boiling water and cook for 20 minutes.  Drain the meat and return to pan and allow to cool down then put through fine strainer or food processor and combine throughly.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,turmeric,salt pepper,corn kernel,cornflour,vegetable oil cooking spray,chocolate
title: Stuffed Jalapenos

instructions: Preheat oven in a saucepan, add turmeric, corn kernels and fry till light golden brown.  Mix in the grated chocolate and pour into a bowl.  Cut off stem and clean the jalapeños inside and out and stuff each piece with the chocolate.  Spray the inside of the tin with vegetable spray.  Bake in the preheated oven for 20 - 45 minutes till soft and slightly crispy.

title: Fiery Chipotle Rub
ingredients: 4 dried chipotle chiles ( see note below for a more intense flavor ) | 1/4 cup tarragon, chopped fresh or 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 1/2 cup sumac
instructions: Note, you may use any dried hot chile to make this a hot chipotle Rub.

Random Ingredients: clove,canola oil,prosciutto,wheat,sherry wine vinegar,green bell pepper,tarragon vinegar
title: Grilled Tarragon Peppers
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper, cut into 1-inch wide strips | 6 whole cloves | 2 1/2 teaspoons dried tarragon vinegar | 1 1/3 cups dry sherry wine vinegar | 1 cup canola oil, or as needed | 1/4 cup chopped fresh tarragon vinegar, or to taste | 8 thick slices prosciutto
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil the grate.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Add pepper strips, reduce heat to medium, and cook until tender, about 3 minutes.  Remove from heat, set aside to cool, and drain.  Grind cloves in a mortar and pestle or food processor until finely ground.  Transfer mixture to a bowl and stir in tarragon, sherry, canola oil, and 1/4 cup tarragon vinegar.  Season with salt and pepper.  Place a slice of prosciutto on the work surface, cut side down, then sprinkle on additional 1/4 cup vinegar.  Spread pepper mixture evenly with about 1 teaspoon prosciutto per pepper, then roll the pepper up jellyroll style.  Wrap peppers with foil and refrigerate until chilled, about 15 minutes.  Heat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil grate.  Grill peppers, turning once, until tender, 2 to 3 minutes per side.  Serve with remaining 1/4 cup tarragon vinegar.

title: Dressed Fish Fillets with Balsamic Gravy
ingredients: 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 can reduced-sodium beef consomme | 1 1/2 lbs fish fillets, firm-fillet
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk vinegar and consommé.  Add fish and turn to coat.  Cover and refrigerate several hours, turning fish once.  Preheat oven to 350°f.  Transfer fish to a greased baking sheet and bake, uncovered, until golden, about 20 minutes.

title: Crispy Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 teaspoon pernod | 4 tablespoons hoagie | 1 medium head cabbage, shredded | 3 tablespoons peanuts or 3 tablespoons olive oil | 1/2 cup sultana
instructions: In a saucepan, add the pernod and boil for a couple of minutes.  Turn off the heat, add the shredded cabbage and stir to coat.  Leave to stand for 10 minutes, drain and add the sultanas.  Using your hands, shape the cabbage into 8 rolls.  Heat the oil in a frying pan over moderate heat, add the rolls and cook for 1 - 3 minutes, turning once or twice during cooking.  Serve immediately.

title: Bara Brith (Bean Dip)
