400 g pinto beans, drained & rinsed | 1 tablespoon tomato ketchup | 2 teaspoons soft blue cheese | 1 teaspoon breadcrumbs or 1 teaspoon crumbled blue cheese | 300 g hot italian sausages or 300 g kielbasa, chopped | 1 large shallot, chopped | fresh herb, of your choice, shredded ( your favourite mustard oil, basil, oregano etc.
    -, a combination would also be nice ) | 1 tablespoon dry sherry
instructions: Preheat oven to 120°c spread the pinto beans evenly on a lightly oiled baking tray.

title: Tzatziki (Anchovy Sauce)
ingredients: 2 cups strained beef broth | 5 tablespoons low-fat yogurt | 1 teaspoon ground ancho chiles | 2 teaspoons dried ancho chiles | 4 cups thinly sliced napa cabbage | 2 tablespoons fresh mint leaves, chopped
instructions: Combine the broth, yogurt and chiles in a small bowl.  Cover and chill for 5 hours or overnight.  Meanwhile, stir fry the cabbage in 2 tablespoon oil until tender.  Serve with chile mixture.

title: Cajun Rice and Bacon for Two
ingredients: 1 lb bacon, cut in 1-inch pieces | 2 cups basmati rice | 1 teaspoon dried parsley | 12 ounces frozen chopped topping, thawed and undiluted | 1/2 teaspoon old bay seasoning
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  In a large skillet, cook the bacon over medium high heat until crisp.  Drain on paper towels and transfer to a baking sheet.  Bake for 10 minutes then remove the bacon and set aside.  In the same skillet, cook the rice and parsley over medium heat until the rice is light brown.  Remove from heat and stir in the bacon.  In a medium bowl, combine the topping ingredients.

title: Indian Curryfish W-Poached Almonds
ingredients: 1 lb lean fish fillet ( such as cod, halibut, haddock ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 tablespoons curry powder | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 2 teaspoons sugar | 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced
instructions: Place the fish fillets in a medium size mixing bowl.

title: Jow (Stir Fried Pork Tenderloins)
ingredients: 1 pound pork tenderloins, sliced crosswise | 4 slices fresh ginger root | 1/2 teaspoon ground nut, or as needed
instructions: Heat a large, heavy skillet over medium high heat.  Cook and stir pork slices in the hot skillet until lightly browned, 1 to 2 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: espresso powder,ginger garlic paste,italian parsley,anise seed,deli roast beef,sirloin steak,garlic clove
title: Spicy Espresso Marinated Beef
ingredients: 3 tablespoons olive oil or 3 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 teaspoon ground ginger-garlic paste | 1 lb sirloin steak, cubed in large chunks | 6 ounces italian classics fresh shaved roast beef or 6 ounces deli ham, sliced | 1/2 tablespoon ground anise seed | 1/2 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1 garlic clove, minced | 1 cup fresh italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Combine olive with ginger garlic paste in a medium dish.  Add beef in layers into dish.  Sprinkle with anise seed and anise seed, then garlic and parsley.  Let stand 15 minutes.  Pre heat oven to 375 degrees f.  Bake for 2 hours or until internal temperature reaches 130 degrees f at the thickest part of an internal meat thermometer.

title: Quick BBQ Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat | 1 lb chuck | 1 jar presliced cremini mushrooms ( i use regular mushrooms, but use more if they are large ) | 3 cups of crumbled feta cheese | 3 cucumbers ( i used the entire 4 small cucumbers as it was bid ) | 1 lemon, juice of | 1 cup hoisin sauce | 1 teaspoon lemon, rind of ( optional )
instructions: Cut stew meat up into 1 inch cubes, or cut chuck into shreds, if not using chuck chunks.  Cut cucumbers in half lengthwise and then crosswise into thin strips.  Toss the meat with all the ingredients for a half hour.  We served this with red wine rice and fresh veggies.  This goes great with a salad, as well.  Note, recipe for the beef salad can be stored up to 6 days, refrigerated.  You can cook these in a crock pot, or you can transfer the ingredients to a crock pot to cook on low.  Note, if doing this to your own crock pot add the beef and veggies.  If you have bought stew meat cubes, that will not work as long since the meat is in small cubes.  Do not discard any of the beef juices after cooking them.  You can also add them a bit during the cooking process if the beef is dried out and then you have to cook it long.

title: Spicy Kimchi
ingredients: 500 g head green cabbage | 4 -5 small dried red chilies | 5 -6 cardamom pods | 3 tablespoons dry mustard ( i use 1 tsp )
instructions: Wash and core the cabbage, leaving the stalk intact.  Remove all the brown outer white stalk except for a few at one end, taking care not to tear it with your fingers.  Put the pieces in a small saucepan of boiling water.  Remove the boiling water and add the red chillies and dried cardami pods.  Cover and bring to the boil.  Simmer for an additional 5 minutes then drain.  Meanwhile, heat a wok over medium heat.  When it is very hot, add about 3 tablespoons of mustard oil and heat until it is very hot.  Stir fry the cabbage 4 - 5 minutes until it changes colour, wilting it a little from time to time.  Add another tablespoon of mustard oil.  Cook, stirring occasionally, for 3 - 4 minutes, or until almost dry and aromatic.  Add the cabbage mixture and stir to coat.  Cover and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the kimchi is hot.

Random Ingredients: colby monterey jack cheese,pineapple,red kidney bean,caraway seed
title: Hawaiian Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans | 1 can crushed pineapple | 2 teaspoons caraway seeds | 1 package shredded colby-monterey jack cheese
instructions: Drain kidney beans and pineapple.  Mix together beans, pineapple and caraway seeds in a shallow serving dish.  Top with cheese.  Sprinkle with more cheese on top of cheese.

title: Czechoslovakian Pork Chops
ingredients: 1/2 cup cake flour | 2 lbs beef chuck roast, trimmed | 8 ounces pork, cooked, diced | 1/4 - 1/2 cup canned whole green chilies, drained & chopped | 1/4 cup fresh dill, chopped | 2 tablespoons canned diced corn on the cob
instructions: Pound beef.

title: Quinoa With Rigatoni and Eggs
ingredients: 100 g rigatoni pasta | 300 g quinoa
instructions: Cook the rigatoni in a large pan of boiling water until al dente.  Meanwhile break up the quinoa with your hands.  Pour 2 - 3 tbsps of water and 2tsp of turkish salt into a large pan.  As soon as the water starts to boil lower the heat and simmer for 8 - 10 min.  Toss the quinoa with the quinoa and eggs.  When ready to eat add more water if it looks dry then add more quinoa.

Random Ingredients: white chocolate,red pepper flake,celery heart,apple,rye bread
title: The New York Times Best Ever Chocolate Fondue!
ingredients: 1/4 cup diced celery heart | 1/4 cup diced apple | 1/4 cup white chocolate, shredded | 2 teaspoons red pepper flakes | 1/4 cup rye bread, crushed ( use the dark crust in your recipe for this! )
instructions: In a small skillet over medium low heat, cook the celery heart, apple, red pepper flakes, and cheese until melted together, 2 minutes.  Transfer mixture to fondue pot or crockpot and stir in crumbled rye bread to coat.  Note, if you do not use rye bread, use regular croutons and crush some in the fondue pot with the side of the spoon.  Be sure not to use rye bread that is soft and crumbly like chocolate.  Transfer fondue to a bowl and add additional white chocolate to coat.

title: Baked-Garlicky Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 yellow sweet peppers | 2 tablespoons pork fat | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with foil.  Cut 2 or 3 slits across the tops of the peppers and insert 1 or 2 slivers of pork fat into each slit.  In a small bowl, stir together the baking soda and remaining 2 tablespoons of pork fat.  Add to the peppers and vegetables, a few drops of water, and stir.  Arrange the pork chops on the baking sheet and sprinkle the top with the baking soda mixture.  Bake at 450 degrees f for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the pork is brown and juices are no longer visible.

title: Tunnbrods
ingredients: 100 g baking potatoes | 150 g chopped green chilies | 300 -300 ml double cream
instructions: Peel and dice the potatoes.  Boil in salted water until tender and all the water had.  Drain.  Add the potato, chilies and cream.  Mix well then chill for 2 hours or overnight.

title: Mountain Rice with Peaches and Cream
ingredients: 2 cups regular white rice, short grain or 1 cup basmati rice | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 2 cups heavy cream or 2 cups whipping cream | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 1 1/2 tablespoons amaretto or 1 1/2 tablespoons other orange liqueur | 1 cup diced seeded peeled cucumber | 1 cup drained drained pinto beans or 1 cup drained kidney beans | 2 tablespoons sultanas | 1 tablespoon finely diced seeded peeled cucumber
instructions: Make the rice, in a medium saucepan, combine the rice and water to cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.  Stir and reduce the heat to medium.  Simmer the rice, covered, stirring occasionally, until just tender, about 20 minutes.  Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.  Remove the cooked rice and let cool slightly.  Meanwhile, in a medium saucepan, combine the creams and bring to a boil.  Reduce the heat to low and pour the hot cream over the creams.  Stir to blend and heat just until warmed through.  Remove from the heat and stir in the stock and amaretto.  Stir in the rice and cucumber, and transfer to a serving bowl.  Cover and refrigerate until dinner time.  To serve, stir in the sultanas and cucumbers just before serving.

title: Mexican Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1/2 teaspoon coarsely crushed dried onion flakes | 1/4 cup quick-cooking converted long-grain white rice | 1/4 package fresh baby spinach, cleaned and chopped | 1 small tomatillo, diced | 1/8 teaspoon ground black peppercorns | 1/8 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 1 tablespoon amaretto | 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black peppercorns | 1 tablespoon amaretto
instructions: In a skillet over medium high heat, cook and stir the onion flakes in the oil until aromatic, about 1 minute.  Add the rice and cook for a minute or two.  Stir in the spinach, tomatillo, black pepper, poultry seasoning, and amaretto.

title: Wasabi Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons wasabi paste ( or kombu seaweed ) | 2 tablespoons white onions, grated ( about 4 tablespoons ) | 1 teaspoon fresh white onion, grated ( about 1/2 cup ) | 3 tablespoons brandy ( about 1/2 ounce ) ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon muesli ( optional )
instructions: Combine wasabi paste and grated white onion in microwave safe bowl.  Microwave for 35 seconds.  Stir to combine.  Microwave for another 45 seconds or so on high.  If not using muesli, stir before continuing and let set for 15 - 30 seconds, adjusting power after 1 minute if desired.  Stir until heated through.  This is excellent with fish, chicken, pork or tofu dishes.

title: Easy English Style Hamburger
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley ( or 1 teaspoon dried parsley flakes )
instructions: Shape the mixture into 4 oblong patties about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.  Place the patties in a baking dish that is half filled with hot nonstick cooking spray.  Place the baking dish over medium heat and cook each side for about 7 minutes, or so for a meatier, crmering.  Serve warm with parsley, if desired.

title: Tahini-Spiced Lamb Shank and Zucchini
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 tablespoon sugar syrup | 3 lbs lamb shank | 2 medium zucchini, cut into 1/2-inch slices
instructions: Combine tahini, sugar syrup and 3 teaspoons cold water in a large nonreactive bowl.  Add lamb and toss to coat.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Heat coals or gas grill.  Remove lamb from marinade and place in a roasting pan.  Grill over moderately high heat, turning once, 10 to 15 minutes for medium rare lamb, 15 to 20 minutes for medium.  Transfer to cutting board.

instructions: Bring a large pan of salted water to a boil.  Pour in the pasta and cook until al dente.

title: Chinese Beef Skewers
ingredients: 1/4 cup sesame oil | 1/4 cup peanut oil | 1 tablespoon minced garlic | 1 tablespoon minced seeded fresh ginger | 1 tablespoon dry mustard seeds | 2 lbs sirloin, sirloin tip steak, thinly sliced | 1 spanish onion, thinly sliced
instructions: In a glass or stainless steel bowl mix all of the ingredients together.  Let sit to let flavors meld in the refrigerator.  This will keep for up to 2 weeks refrigerated or frozen in an airtight container.

title: Swiss Cheese and Corn Au Gratin
ingredients: 4 slices swiss cheese | 4 tablespoons double cream | 1 can white shoepeg corn
instructions: Butter a 9 x 9 baking dish.  Mix swiss cheese and corn together.  Heat cream on a sauté pan.  Add corn and continue heating on a medium fire.  Once cream mix begins to stiffen, drizzle cream mix over cheese and corn mixture.  Continue cooking and stirring until thickened and bubbly.  When it starts to bubble, remove from heat.  When serving, let set for about 20 minutes.  Cut into squares and serve.

ingredients: 1 lb veal, cut into strips about 1/2 inch x1 1/2 inch | vegetable oil or shortening | 3/4 cup bell pepper, sliced into strips ( any green pepper is fine ) | 2 tablespoons kaffir lime leaves ( optional, i don't add these ) | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder | salt substitute
instructions: Trim and discard any excess fat or gristle from veggies.  Pound veggies with mallet or rolling pin to about 1/4 inch or thinner.  Combine the oil, spices.  Toss veggies with chili oil mixture and grill veal over low heat for about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,grape leaf,breadcrumb,raspberry,dark beer,lipton secret onion soup mix,poultry seasoning,apple juice
title: Poppyseed Strudels
ingredients: 1 cup frozen spinach leaves | 1/4 cup grape leaves, thawed | 4 tablespoons dark beer ( optional ) | 1 envelope lipton recipe secrets onion soup mix | 1 1/2 cups fresh breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup apple juice | 2 tablespoons fresh raspberry jam or 2 tablespoons raspberry preserves ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons dried parsley, or desired amount ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Place spinach in a bowl.  Pour in the beer, then stir in the onion soup mix, bread crumbs, apple juice, and jam or preserves.  Lightly coat each strudel with cooking spray.  Spray one baking sheet with cooking lye.  Transfer the coated strudels to the baking sheet.  Sprinkle with dried parsley, if desired.  Bake the strudels for 40 to 45 minutes, until the stuffing is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: pancetta,dark rum,chicken stock vegetable,arborio rice,mango chutney,port wine,cabbage,serrano pepper
title: Mango Chutney Risotto
ingredients: 8 ounces pancetta, roughly chopped | 3 cups chicken stock or 3 cups vegetable stock | 2 tablespoons mullibarra rice ( about 2 ounces ) | 2 teaspoons dark rum ( or other dark rum ) | 1 small piece arborio rice | 1 -2 serrano pepper, minced | finely shredded cabbage ( optional ) | mango chutney ( optional )
instructions: In a saucepan, cook pancetta over medium heat, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.  Add chicken stock or stock, rum, rice, and serrano pepper and bring mixture to a boil.  Cover pan and reduce heat to low, then simmer until liquid is absorbed, about 15 minutes.  Fluff rice with fork and remove from heat.  Do not rinse off any extra fat or extra water.  Place 1/3 of the rice in large, deep bowl.  Ladle 1/4 cup of hot stock into bowl, then stir in rice.  Using a rubber spatula or wooden spoon, gently mix until rice is evenly coated with stock and a slightly grainy texture is formed, about 1 minute.  Add more stock, if the rice is dry, 1 1/2 2 tablespoons at a time, stirring until all rice is absorbed and mixture is creamy.  Continue to stir.  You can make the risotto ahead and refrigerate the rice, or put it into a covered container and refrigerate until ready to use.  Remove rice mixture from refrigerator and keep warm, but do not discard it.  Stir chutney and shredded cabbage into risotto.  Serve with fruit and mango chutney if desired.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,red chili powder,radish,spring onion,rose water,pear,artichoke heart,almond extract
title: Pear Artichoke Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ripe pears | 1 teaspoon red chili powder ( not chili powder but ground red pepper flakes if you don't like spice ) | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 spring onion, grated | 1/2 cup fresh rose petals, chopped or 1/2 cup red onion, chopped | 2 tablespoons roasted artichoke hearts ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 2 -4 tablespoons rose water
instructions: Prepare the pear artichoke hearts by trimming and blanching in boiling water for a few seconds then shocking in ice cold water for one minute or until the pit is very cold.  Do not peel and de pit the artichokes if they are too large, or they will lose their shape.  If they are smaller, slice in half and then remove the skin with a sharp knife.  When they are all removed, you should have about 1 pound of apple artichokes in all.  The artichokes should be roughly chopped.  Place into a large salad bowl.  Add all of the spices.  Toss and add a cup of fresh mint or cilantro along with the finely grated spring onions, artichokes, or roasted artichokes.  Add almond extract and rose water to taste.  Mix.  Pour over the pear artichoke hearts and toss.  Enjoy.

title: Beer-Glazed Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 2 cups finely chopped coleslaw mix ( mix of shredded cabbage and green cabbage ) | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard seeds | 2 cans beer | 1/2 cup quinoa, rinsed well and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Spray 2 large baking sheets with oil cooking spray.  Combine all ingredients into a large bowl.  Spread one heaping spoonful of the coleslaw mixture onto sheets.  Spread soup mixture over each cabbage/green cabbage, leaving a 1/4 inch border around the edge.  Bake, covered for 45 minutes.  Uncover and bake for an additional 30 minutes so the bottom becomes crunchier.  Remove from oven, slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: turmeric,ice,snow pea,spaghetti squash,pork shoulder,ginger paste,farfalle pasta,pine nut
title: Spaghetti Squash and Pork in Parsley
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti squash, halved lengthwise then thinly sliced | 1/4 lb lean pork shoulder | 1 3/4 teaspoons ginger paste | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted | 2 1/2 tablespoons toasted pine nuts ( about 1 ounce ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons fresh ginger paste | 1 1/2 tablespoons turmeric | 1/2 cup spanish dry farfalle pasta | crushed ice | 1 lb snow peas
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain.  Cover with boiling water and let sit 30 minutes or until pasta is al dente.  In a non stick skillet over low heat, fry pork in 2 t.  Gravy, stirring and breaking up with a wooden spoon, for 5 minutes or until cooked halfway through.  Add ginger and pine nuts.  Cook for 1 minute or until golden.  Reserve drippings.  Heat skillet over medium heat.  Add remaining olive oil and mushrooms and cook for 3 minutes with sahites.  Add cooked pasta and remaining sugar and continue cooking on low heat for 3 minutes or until sauce begins to bubble.  Stir in crushed ice.  Cover and cook on high heat for 2 minutes or until water has evaporated.  Add snow peas.  Cook until snow peas are tender crisp.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: bouillon cube,garam masala,tortilla chip,sesame oil,romaine lettuce,saffron,pecorino romano cheese
title: Sharlie's Special and Savory
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 6 bouillon cubes | 1/2 head romaine lettuce, separated into leaves ( i like to use a large head and cut up a small hand-full ) | 1/3 - 1/3 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese or 1/3-1/2 cup asiago cheese | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala | 1/8 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Put sesame oil in a large skillet and place the whole head of romaine lettuce in the pan, cooking it over fairly low heat.  After you've started to smell that beautiful fragrance to the romaine, add the garlic and saffron, stirring to blend.  When the garlic starts to bubble, stir the garlic into the sesame oil and cook the garlic until it is browned, but still smells wonderful, about 2 minutes.  At this point you may want to put the pan under a broiler for a few minutes to toast the cheese, but be careful not to burn.  Sprinkle half of the grated cheese over the sesame oil.  Turn on the broiler and turn off the heat.  Pour the sesame oil into a 9 x 13 inch pan and place the whole head of romaine lettuce into the pan on top.  You may wish to place the entire head on each end of the pan.  Pour in just enough sesame oil to cover the lettuce.  Add about 1/4 teaspoon of garam masala and 1/8 teaspoon of saffron.  Turn the romaine lettuce into the sesame oil and stir gently to mix.  Top with the reserved grated cheese.  Note, this salad can be prepared ahead and made the day before, just make sure it is served immediately, as the lettuce will wilt too much.  Just sprinkle with more parmesan or more sesame oil as you go.

title: Super Easy Chunky Enchiladas Verde
ingredients: 1 can red enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons minced fresh cilantro
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Drain the enchilada sauce in a small strainer over a measuring cup and set aside.  Combine the cream and cilantro in a small bowl.  Set aside.  Fill a 9x9 inch glass baking dish with enchilada sauce.  Using a spoon, evenly coat the bottom of the dish with half of the cream mixture.  Lay the enchilada enchilada in the dish.  Pour the remaining cream mixture over the enchilada sauce.  Gently fold the enchilada and cream mixture in until completely covered.  Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until bubbly and the tops are golden brown.

title: Bud Leves
ingredients: 350 g white cabbage, shredded | 500 g capsicums, de-seeded and sliced | 1 teaspoon juniper berries
instructions: Place the cabbage in a wok/pan with 1 t water.  Put in the juniper and the capsicum and bring to the boil.  Cover and simmer for at least 5 - 10 min.  Add more water if it starts to dry out.  When the cabbage is cooked, put a heat diffuser under the wok, then scatter the juniper into it.  Serve as is.

title: Green Lentil Sprouts or Lentils
ingredients: 1 lb green lentil | 1/2 teaspoon salt substitute
instructions: Wash and pare the lentils and wash in several changes of water.  Set aside.  In a colander, shake dry lentils and remove any grits that float to the top.  Cook over high heat until the water returns to a boil, then reduce to medium low and simmer, uncovered, for 10 or 15 minutes until soft.  Drain and rinse well in cold water.  Remove the sprouts/nests and add to the lentils and stir with a fork or your hands until coated and heated through, adding salt substitute if necessary.

title: A Fantastic Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, broken into flowerets | 2 ounces dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons cocoa
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to the boil.  Place the sugar in a wide pan.  Heat over a low heat, stirring, for 10 minutes, or until it melts.  Stir in the cocoa.  Add the cauliflower, stir, and simmer over very low heat, stirring now and then.  Add water until it boils steadily, then simmer until the cauliflower is very tender.  Serve immediately.

title: Lemon Grass Spring Rolls
ingredients: 12 fluid ounces egg roll wrap | 1 cup mixed fruit, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon grass, minced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375f, and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  In a small bowl, combine the lemon grass, and mix with the minced lemon grass until well mixed.  Add it to the beaten egg roll wrap, and spread it out onto the parchment, leaving about 1 inch from the edge.  Fold a long side of the wrap over the filling to form a sealed roll.

title: Creamy Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 pound pork tenderloins
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f.  Grease a 9x13 inch baking pan.  Heat butter, cream of chicken soup, and pork tenderloins in a skillet over medium heat.  Place tenderloins in the baking pan, and baste with the butter cream soup mixture.  Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until tender and browned on the top.

title: Mustard Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs | 10 new potatoes | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard powder | 3 tablespoons soya sauce
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200 degrees centigrade.  Cut the potatoes in half lengthways and then into 8 equal wedges.  Make several slashes across the chicken thighs and place on a tray, making a 'well' in each piece.  Mix the mustard powder and soya sauce in a small bowl and brush over the chicken.  Place the potatoes on a clean tea towel and press gently so they become coated with the mixture.  Bake for 40 minutes, until chicken is cooked through and tender.

Random Ingredients: turmeric powder,cayenne pepper,cheese,swiss cheese,olive oil cooking spray
title: Easy Cheese and Quesadillas
ingredients: olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 4 slices low-fat swiss cheese | 1/4 cup shredded low-fat swiss cheese | 1 pinch cayenne pepper
instructions: Spray your non stick skillet with the olive oil and heat on medium high.  When the skillet is warmed up add a layer of cheese and continue the layers until you can see cheese is melted and the entire dish is coated with the oil.  Add the turmeric and pinch of cayenne pepper.  Top with the remaining cheese.  When you place second layer in your skillet, remove the skillet from heat.  Cut into wedges and serve family style.

title: Thai Beef and Rutabaga
ingredients: 2 rutabagas, cut into 2 inch cubes | 6 green peppercorns, crushed | 1 can meatless spaghetti sauce | 1 bunch fresh cilantro, chopped | 1 small white onion, chopped
instructions: Place rutabagas and green peppercorns in a glass baking dish, and toss with spaghetti sauce and cilantro.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours.

title: Pickled Onions
ingredients: 1 cup onion, peeled | 1 cup fresh currants | 1/2 cup rice wine vinegar
instructions: Thoroughly wash onions.  Rinse and drain.  Place onions in a colander in a deep bowl.  Cover generously with cold water and let soak in the refrigerator overnight.  Drain.  Drain onions through a sieve set over a bowl.  Chill for 1 hour.  Place drained onions in a nonreactive bowl.  Pour rice wine vinegar over onions and allow to drain in a cool, dry place until vinegar has drained into a small bowl, approximately 45 minutes.

title:
Wild Rice With Shellfish.
    -
ingredients: 1 lb extra-large shrimp, cleaned | 2 bags wild rice, rinsed, drained
instructions: Cook shrimp in boiling water according to package directions about 3 minutes each side or until opaque.  Meanwhile in large, shallow pan, combine all ingredients and bring to boil.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes.  Flame with fork.

title: Crockpot Norwegian Home Fries #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package russet potatoes | 3 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Cut fries into fries, then place in 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker.  Mix parsley and 1 1/2 cups water together.  Pour over hot fries.  Cover and cook on low setting for 7 hours.

title: Ace's White Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1 pound dry white beans | 1 teaspoon light rice flour | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed, or to taste | 4 romaine lettuce, or to taste | 4 sprigs romaine lettuce
instructions: Rinse the beans under cold water until there is no more water.  Place the beans and rice flour into a medium bowl, and mash with a fork.  Place the anise seed in a small skillet over medium low heat.  Cook and stir until fragrant, about 30 seconds.  Place the rinsed and drained beans into a large bowl, and stir in about 1 cup of the hot bean mix.  Fill a large pot with lightly salted water, and bring to a rolling boil.  Once the water is boiling, stir in the remaining hot bean mix.  Return to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until the rice is tender, and the anise is fragrant, about 25 minutes.  Toss in the romaine and serve.

Random Ingredients: banana,coconut powder,ginger root,pepper,flour,orange zest,red chili pod
title: Coconut Banana Pepper Pancakes
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh coconut powder | 1/2 teaspoon ginger root, minced | 1/4 teaspoon red chili pods, minced | 1/2 cup banana, peeled and sliced | 1 teaspoon fresh orange zest, minced | 1/8 teaspoon pepper | 1 tablespoon flour
instructions: Blend coconut powder, ginger root, red chili, banana, orange zest, and pepper together in a bowl with the flour to form a batter.  Heat a skillet with a little oil or cooking spray over medium high heat.  Add batter to the skillet and cook 15 to 20 seconds, until a pancake forms.  Cover and cook an additional 5 minutes.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,rum,vegetable oil cooking spray,chicken wing,banana,ramen noodle,orecchiette
title: Hot Banana Ramen
ingredients: 2 bags ramen noodles, soaked in water overnight | 2 1/2 lbs chicken wings, cut to size | 12 ounces vietnamese banana, sliced into thin wedges | 1 cup self rising flour or 1 cup cornmeal | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 tablespoon rum ( optional ) | 2 -3 cups brewed coffee or 2 -3 cups irish stout beer ( optional )
instructions: Place noodles out in large bowl, cover with hot tap water and allow to soak for 40 minutes.  Rinse with cold water and drain.  Place chicken wings in a large non stick skillet.

title: Pecan Cheese
ingredients: 3 cups pecan halves, coarsely ground | 3 large eggs, lightly beaten | 1 1/2 cups cornmeal
instructions: Preheat oven to 350° f.  Place pecans in a 9x12 dish that has been sprayed with cooking spray and lightly flour it.  Beat together eggs and cornmeal.  Stir in pecan mixture.  Pour into a single layer in the pan or the sides of a 9x13 pan.  Bake uncovered for 50 - 60 minutes, or until golden.  Serve hot, warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,spam,bean,pork sausage,cabbage,italian seasoning,apricot jam,self rising flour
title: Cabbage and Spam Hash
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pinto beans, cooked | 1 1/2 cups cabbage, shredded | 1 package pork sausage | 1 package smoked cabbage, cut into small squares | 3/4 cup self rising flour | 3 tablespoons apricot jam | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Mix all ingredients together except the flour and jam in a large bowl.  Roll mixture into 1/2 inch balls.  Place on an ungreased baking sheet and bake on middle rack for 20 - 25 minutes.  Meanwhile preheat oven to 200 degrees.  Spread the jam on the balls and place balls on top of the jam sprinkled with italian seasoning.

Random Ingredients: spice,bicarbonate soda,black pepper,spaghetti sauce,whipping cream,red cabbage,thai basil
title: Spicy Orange Spaghetti (Cabbage)
ingredients: 500 ml whipping cream | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 1/4 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 1/2 teaspoon red cabbage, shredded | spaghetti sauce | fresh thai basil ( to garnish )
instructions: Whip the cream, add all the other ingredients and whip again.  Place in bowl and refrigerate overnight before serving.  Garnish with basil.

title: Makrout - Green Cardamom Tea
ingredients:
1 fresh green cardamom pod | 1 tablespoon green cardamom ( for intense taste, otherwise, use 1 tbsp.
    - dried ground cardi )
instructions: Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil, and add the black cardamom pods.  When they're about half of their size, remove them from the water with a slotted spoon and throw into the hot water.  Turn off the heat, and steep for 10 minutes.  Discard the black cardamom pods and serve straight away with ice cream.  Tips, stir very lightly with a fork to help loosen the spices if needed.  Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator, and use at your discretion.

title: Salsa Romaine, Green Chile and Green Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 can green chilies, finely chopped | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs ( japanese bread crumbs ) | 2 heads romaine lettuce
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Combine the chilies and panko in a plastic bag.  Dip one end of the romaine lettuce head in the salsa and place on a baking sheet.  Place the remaining romaine lettuce in a shallow baking dish.  Bake for 2 minutes.  Remove the romaino from the oven and drain any excess liquid.  Drizzle the romaine with a little of the sauce and serve.

title: Aloupe (Melon Balls)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs cantaloupe, peeled, seeded and cut into 1/4 inch pieces | breadcrumbs
instructions: Put melon pieces into a colander and rinse under cold water until all surfaces are covered with sand.  Place the melon pieces in to a colander with the bread crumbs so they will not sink to your fingers while holding something heavy on your hands.  Toss lightly with hands until the mixture is well mixed.  Roll each melon ball in the bread crumbs until coated evenly in crumbs.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,provolone cheese,linguine,port wine,white flour,green chilies,onion soup mix
title: Mexican White Pie
ingredients: 1 package linguine ( shells work too ) | 1 package onion soup mix | 10 ounces canned green chilies, chopped | 2 lbs provolone cheese ( grated on a food process ) | red bell pepper | port wine ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon white flour
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water until al dente.  Drain and set aside.  While pasta is cooking, mix bell pepper and chilies in large bowl.  When pasta is done, mix peppers and chilies in a dish with a little flour or cornstarch mixture.  Add some of reserved pasta cooking water with soup mix.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,french bread,cherry,orange juice,ketchup,vanilla pod,green cabbage
title: French Bread With Pecans and Cabbage
ingredients: 12 slices french bread | corn oil | 1 vanilla pod ( scraped and scraped ) | 1 kg green cabbage ( shredded ) | 1 liter red cherry ( cut in half, left whole, discard the core ) | 1 1/2 liters orange juice or 1 1/2 liters white wine vinegar | ketchup, for drizzling
instructions: Heat oil in a deep casserole pan.  Carefully place the bread slices in and fry on each side until brown on both sides.  Remove from the dish.  Place the oil in a clean casserole dish again.  Place the vanilla pods in the oil and fry slowly, stirring and turning them over constantly, until the vanilla turns golden brown.  Remove from fire.  Place the cabbage in the casserole.  Add the orange juice to the casserole then add the cherry.  Stir together.  Cover tightly and return to the oven for 90 minutes at 90/55°c remove the cover and mix in ketchup and continue to cook for 3 - 5 minutes.  Serve with a sprinkling of coloured sugar or lemon syrup.

title: Fenugreek( Indian Spiced Barbecue Sauce)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coriander seeds, crushed | 1 1/2 teaspoons fenugreek seeds, crushed | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/4 cup catsup
instructions: Combine coriander, fenugreek and cayenne pepper in a glass jar.  Shake well and let sit at room temperature.  Use as required.

title: Quick Homemade Creamy Chicken Goulash
ingredients: 2 tablespoons garlic powder | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon cube | 1 cup whipping cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender or food processor, and process until smooth.  Keep warm in a bowl over simmering water.  Taste, and add more garlic powder according to taste.

title: Baby Onions
ingredients: 20 -25 large baby onions | 5 sprigs fresh baby, cleaned of all foreign matter and well trimmed of all fat
instructions: Separate the onions.  Wash well and place the onions on paper towels to soak up any excess moisture.  Place the onions in a large saucepan which has previously been lightly greased.  Pour the water over the onions to just cover them.  Bring water to a boil over high heat.

title: Raspberry Chicken
ingredients: 2 quarts hot, not boiling chicken broth | 1 1/2 cups fresh raspberries or 1 1/2 cups frozen raspberries
instructions: Place the raspberries in the slow cooker on top of the chicken broth.  Cover and cook for 6 hours on high setting or at the low setting on your slow cooker.

title: Cajun Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 1 boneless, skinless pork shoulder | 1 tablespoon chopped hot pepper | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 4 skinless chicken breast halves, cut into chunks
instructions: Place pork shoulder, hot pepper, ketchup, and chicken breast halves in a resealable plastic bag.  Seal and massage marinade into meat while shaking to coat well.  Allow marinade to marinate in refrigerator for at least 1 hour.  Preheat grill for medium heat.  Lightly oil the grate.  Discard marinade.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,pinto bean,chili flake,italian breadcrumb,pork chop
title: Puerto Rican Pork Chops (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 4 lbs pork chops, bone in | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 cup pinto beans ( canned ) | 1 teaspoon dried chili flakes | 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes
instructions: Combine breadcrumbs, beans, chili flakes and chili flakes in a mixing bowl.  Place chops in crock pot.  Sprinkle evenly with bread mixture.  Pour over water.  Cover crock pot.  Cook on low for 9 - 12 hours.  Remove all the bones and shred.  Return to crock pot, top with shredded cheese and stir.  Serve with rice.  Variation.

title: Asparagus Hummus (Labdella)
ingredients: 16 ounces fresh asparagus ( about 2 bunches ) | 14 ounces can chickpeas | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1 bunch thyme sprig | 1 whole celery ( about 10 stalks )
instructions: Snap off ends of asparagus, discard ends and cut into 1 1/2 wide sticks and put them in a colander of cold water.  Turn over gently and repeat a few times to remove asparagus with clean fingers, until the tips are clear.  In a blender combine asparagus, chickpeas, mustard seeds and thyme.  Blend until smooth.  Transfer to a bowl and fold in celery.  Refrigerate 1 hour to develop flavours and texture.  Serve with flatbread as the dip or on sandwiches.

Random Ingredients: adobo seasoning,grand marnier,italian herb seasoning,broccoli,onion soup mix
title: Broccoli Florentine
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli | 1 packet onion soup mix | 1/8 teaspoon italian herb seasoning | 1 dash hot adobo seasoning | 1 dash grand marnier ( optional )
instructions: Separate broccoli into florets, and steam until tender.  Put broccoli into a ziploc bag with soup, and add hot herbs, adobo.  Squish bag to mix well.  Add bag to microwave for a minute to warm.  Add grand marnier, or serve into cups.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,french bread,dill weed,elbow macaroni,swiss cheese,sherry wine,cornflour
title: Macaroni and Swiss Cheese Welsh Rarebit
ingredients: 200 g elbow macaroni ( a pre-made type ) | 250 g swiss cheese, grated ( a pre-made variety of grated cheese ) | 1 cup swiss cheese, grated, can use grated gruyere | 1 teaspoon cilantro or 1 teaspoon dill weed | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 tablespoon sherry wine or 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon cornflour
instructions: Combine the swiss cheese, swiss cheese and cilantro in a bowl and beat well in a separate bowl that has a lid.  Add the rest of the ingredients and beat again with a spoon until everything is well mixed.  Pour into a small microwavable bowl and top with the lid or the lid with cling film, microwave on high 7 minutes.  Turn the heat off and leave in in the bowl for another 10 minutes while it cools down.  Note, if you have cooked elbow macaroni for 10 minutes, do not open them until the time to do this in the microwave because if you do, they will still cook after 10 minutes.  They will be soft and mushy, but still a little crisp after cooling down.  Once cooled, slice into 8 even pieces, sprinkle with a little freshly ground black pepper and serve with a salad of chopped spring onion and mustard greens and a nice loaf of crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,ginger juice,plain flour,parmesan cheese
title: Easy Microwave English Parmesan Salad Dressing
ingredients: 125 ml parmesan cheese, good quality | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon grated fresh ginger juice | 1 teaspoon plain flour
instructions: Mix all ingredients and store in the fridge for 1/2 hour before using to stir in the dressing for best results.

title: Quick and Easy Sautéed Grape Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 tomatoes | 2 cups grape tomatoes, halved and sliced ( or any other kind of tomatoes ) | 1/2 cup roasted peanuts, chopped ( or walnuts ) | 1/2 cup vegetable bouillon, with some water ( or any other stock or seasoning you like )
instructions: Heat frying pan on stove top.  While frying tomatoes, place all ingredients in the blender or food processor.  Process on high until tomatoes have a nice smooth mixture, stopping often to scrape down the sides.  Pour tomato mixture into a shallow platter.  Garnish with chopped walnuts or a sprinkle of paprika.

title: Greek Olives (Tapenade) Dip
ingredients: 3/4 cup drained greek olives | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 2 tablespoons tomato paste
instructions: In a blender, mix olives, garlic salt, tomato paste, and 1 tablespoons water.  Use a fork to blend ingredients into a smooth paste.  Refrigerate before serving.

title: Roasted Peach and Pesto
ingredients: 1 -12 plump small fresh peaches or 1 -12 large fresh peach, washed, peeled and halved | 1/2 bunch flat leaf parsley, washed | 1 pinch sea salt | 1/4 - 1/2 cup fresh grated parmesan cheese ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Arrange the peaches on a baking sheet and brush with a little olive oil.  Sprinkle with salt.  Bake for about 15 - 30 minutes or until fruit is tender and golden.  About 10 minutes before removing from oven, toast the parsley under the tap until just starting to brown, about a minute or two, taking care not to burn them.  Remove from heat and stir in the parmesan.  Note, if using a peaches they are more likely to fall apart.  Remove the peaches from oven and let stand 5 minutes.  Using a vegetable peeler, peel off the peel and then cut a thin slice from the peel off of the top if it is not easily removed.  You should have about 8 slices, about 1 ounce each.  The idea is to have a layer of fruit, but not a layer of peaches.  Drizzle with pesto.

Random Ingredients: poultry seasoning,lettuce leaf,green pepper,brown rice,thyme sprig,basil leaf,icing sugar,caster sugar
title: Lettuce Wrapped Green and Red Bell Pepper With Rice
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 2 large lettuce leaves | 2 tablespoons basil leaves, finely shredded basil or 2 tablespoons savory sprigs | 1/4 cup green pepper, julienned | 2 tablespoons roasted green sweet pepper, julienned | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning or 1 teaspoon salt | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 1/4 cup fresh thyme sprig, plus extra | fresh basil leaf, for garnish
instructions: Set the oven to 350°c.  Line the base and side of a baking tray with a baking paper.  Cut the bell pepper in half lengthways, then cut each half crossways into 3 pieces.  Cut each piece on the bias into about 4 long strips.  Put the pieces on the lined tray, cut side down.  Sprinkle with the icing sugar and bake for 4 minutes, until just starting to soften.  Meanwhile, place the lettuce leaves on a serving plate, then set aside.  Scatter the basil, sweet pepper and green pepper over the leaves, then drizzle with the roasted sweet pepper and poultry seasoning.  Roll up the leaves, garnish with thyme and roll them up.

Random Ingredients: red kidney bean,olive,pearl barley,fruit,panko bread crumb,oatmeal,adobo seasoning,grain rice
title: Mixed Bean and Rice Salad
ingredients: 225 g pearl barley | 115 g red kidney beans | 115 g dried mixed fruit | 2 tablespoons oatmeal | 2 tablespoons panko bread crumbs, plus more for dusting ( breadcrumbs ) | 1 tablespoon fresh mixed fruit ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon olive, slivered ( optional ) | adobo seasoning ( optional )

title: Vietnamese Steamed Zucchini

ingredients: 14 ounces mixed fresh fruit, any kind | 2 tablespoons raspberry jam | 1 large granny smith apple | 1/4 cup tomato juice | 1/3 cup half-and-half cream | 8 ounces cooked meatballs | fresh thyme sprig
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Place mixed fruit in a large bowl.  Spread jam over fruits and toss.  Place apple in a pie plate lined with parchment paper.  Cut apples into bite sized pieces.  Dot with juice.  Pour half and half over mixture.  Dredge meatballs in plum/cherry syrup.  Arrange meatballs in a single layer over jam.  Broil until lightly browned on all sides, about 12 minutes.

instructions: Place grated beets into a large saucepan, and cover with cold water.  Bring to a boil, then lower heat and simmer gently until tender, about 1 hour.  Remove and let cool.  Drain well and coarsely grate.  Place grated beets, dill, chilies, cardamom, cayenne, cayenne pepper and 8 ounces of the bread crumbs in a food processor, and process until mixture forms a fine crumb like consistency.  Spoon into a bowl, cover and refrigerate.  Preheat oven to 400°f line a baking sheet with parchment paper and lightly spray lightly with vegetable oil or shortening.  Knead dough briefly on dry work surface, then roll to about 1/8 inch thickness.  Cut the dough in half, then cut the halves in half again.  Transfer half to a bowl, cover and refrigerate. Brush the top of each tortilla with oil, then sprinkle with bread crumbs, about 3 tablespoons a time, or until the bread crumbs have been absorbed.  Bake on the baking sheet until golden, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: nicoise olive,chinese hot mustard,monterey jack cheese,saffron thread,nonfat milk,red pepper flake,monterey jack cheddar cheese
title: Saffron  Cheese Souffle

instructions: Place milk and saffron in a small bowl and set aside.  In a separate saucepan, combine dry milk, hot mustard, 1/2 cup of cheddar cheese and pepper flakes. Place saffron mixture in a 1 quart ramekin dish.  Pour mixture and 1 cup of monterey jack and cheddar blend into the pan.  Cover with aluminum foil and bake in a preheated 350 degrees f oven for 15 to 20 minutes.  Sprinkle top with remaining 1/2 cup of shredded cheeses and bake uncovered. Random Ingredients: navy bean,anise seed,enchilada sauce,madeira wine,corn flake,rice vinegar,chive,golden syrup
title: Aniseed Chive N Beans
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dry anchovy | 6 -10 tablespoons corn flakes | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1/2 cup red anise seed | 4 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 can navy beans, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon fresh chives, chopped
instructions: In a small bowl, combine anchovies, corn flakes, rice vinegar, aniseed, and golden syrup.  Set aside.  In another small bowl, stir water and enchilada sauce to blend.  In a 2 qt saucepan, heat a few tablespoons of water.  When it comes to a boil, add onions and lower the heat to med.  Cook until onions are clear.  Add remaining sauce ingredients and bring to a boil.  Serve over white rice with lots of sauce.

title: Apricot Cream
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk | 1/2 cup apricot preserves
instructions: In a blender, mix the soy milk, apricot preserves and blender's contents, 1 or 2 tablespoons at a time, until the apricot preserves are fully incorporated into the mixture.

title: Cod Baked with Chili
ingredients: 2 tablespoons chili flakes | 2 cod fish fillets | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c/425°f.  Sprinkle the chili flakes over the fillets in a non stick ovenproof dish.  Place the dish in the oven as the oven preheats and bake for 15 to 20 minutes.  Brush the fish with a little of the chili oil.  Sprinkle with nutmeg and return to the oven. Squeeze a few drops of fresh chili juice over the fish.

Random Ingredients: raisin,cinnamon bark,beef broth,onion powder,hamburger bun sesame seed,green olive,beef stew meat
title: Spiced Beef on Toasted Buns
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat, cut in 1/2 `` cubes | 2 tablespoons raisins, dried | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cinnamon bark | 1 1/2 teaspoons onion powder | 2 tablespoons green olives | 1 can condensed beef broth | 4 -8 split beef buns with sesame seeds
instructions: Note, these may be prepared in advance, but be warned that this makes the beef very tender.  When ready to serve, preheat oven to 300 f. Stir in beef broth and olives.  Cover and bake in oven about 3 hours.  Remove from oven and allow to stand for 15 minutes.  Stir to loosen meat.  Serve over egg noodles, rice or mashed potatoes.  Note, this may be prepared and frozen.  To bake, bake uncovered at 300 f for about 1 hour.  This can be prepared in advance, but be warned that the meat is very tender.  If you froze this, heat on to 300 f for 3 hours or until beef is tender, turning and tossing every 15 minutes.  It may be reheated as needed.

title: Homemade Cholay

instructions: Cut meat into 1 inch chunks.  Cut peppers in half through the core into 1 inch lengths using 2 - 3 long thin strips of red chilies. instructions: Simmer diced tomatoes with juice, miso paste, chopped onion seeds, dried chilies and spaghetti sauce in a large pot over medium high heat until thick, about 30 minutes. title: Creamy Swiss Steak With Baby Spinach
ingredients: 3/4 lb swiss steak, cut 1/2-inch thick | 10 ounces fresh baby spinach | 1/2 cup creme de cacao, original | 3 tablespoons dried parsley flakes | 1 tablespoon dried lemon peel | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary, crushed
instructions: Cut steak diagonally into slices 1/4 to 1/2 inch thick.  Wash the leaves well, pat dry and cut in half.  Arrange in a shallow 2 quart baking dish.  In 2 batches, mix the spinach, crème de cacao with the dried parsley, lemon peel, turmeric, rosemary and the remaining 2 tbsp creme de cacao.

title: Indonesian Cod and Cucumber-Wrapped Wontons

title: Crispy Lime Beef
ingredients: 1 medium ripe beef | 8 ounces dried dates, pitted | 4 -6 kaffir lime leaves, crushed | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Slice the beef into strips, retaining the bone.  Place the dates into a microwave safe bowl.  Cover with boiling water and microwave on high for 15 minutes. title: Garlicky White Wine Balls (Porchetta es Veronique)
ingredients: 1 cup unbleached white wine | 2 tablespoons arrowroot | 2 tablespoons fresh italian parsley ( packed ) or 2 tablespoons chopped parsley ( packed ) | chopped fresh italian parsley ( to garnish )
instructions: Put wine, arrowroot and 1 tbsp parsley in a sauce pan.  Heat over medium high heat until boiling. title: Italian Fried Hotpot (Dairy)

instructions: Melt ditto of margarine in a pan on low medium heat. .  Then combine the stock cube & seasoning salt & pepper & mix until dissolved.  Then add the oil & chicken stock cube mixture. Random Ingredients: corn,cream,sharp cheddar cheese,ketchup,butter margarine,pam cooking spray,fine bread crumb
title: Swiss Corn Casserole

instructions: In a small bowl, combine melted butter and the bread crumbs.  Stir in ketchup and corn.  In a 1 1/2 quart casserole dish mix sour cream and cheese.  In a medium size bowl stir corn mixture and then spoon over sour cream mixture.  Top with remaining cheese and lightly sprinkle with reserved crumbs.  Cover and bake casserole in a 350 oven for 50 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Chinese Blacken Goose
ingredients: 1 blackened chinese sausage | 2 tablespoons blue curacao | 1 can water chestnuts, sliced for garnish | 3/4 cup apricot, sliced for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Remove casing from sausage, and remove excess fat from the sausage. In a greased casserole dish, layer the sausage, then the blackened bean and apricots.  Sprinkle blue curacao and water chestnuts on top, and dot with a little olive oil or bbq sauce, and place in preheated oven.  Bake for about 45 minutes, or until cooked through, and a bit golden brown.

title: Beef, Bacon Filled Vegetables, and Yoghurt
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 3 -4 tablespoons fresh minced garlic powder | 1 - 1 1/2 cup mixed vegetables, sliced | 4 tablespoons prepared rice wine
instructions: In a large skillet, brown the hamburger with the garlic powder.  When the meat is no longer pink inside, add the rice wine vinegar and mix well.  Scoop a little yogurt into each of the 4 bowls and top with a generous serving of meat, vegetables, and yogurt mixture.  Serve with pita or crusty bread.

title: Quick Rum Sauce

title: Gale Wrapped Tortillas

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Wrap the tortillas in foil or parchment paper and heat in a medium oven for 3 minutes to soften. Melt the butter in a small saucepan or microwave safe dish over medium heat and cook the jalapeno until softened and fragrant, stirring to keep the chunky pieces from sticking.  Add the cream mixture to the tortillas.  Sprinkle with the remaining parmesan cheese.

title: Potatoes With Salsa Verde (Cook's Illustrated)
ingredients: 1 medium red potato | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon finely minced serrano peppers
instructions: Cut a small thin slice from the bottom of the potato to remove the flesh and discard.  Cut potato into 1/8 thick slices and place on a cookie sheet sprinkled with salt.  If using a small pot, heat 1 to 1 1/2 inch of water to boiling over high heat.  Carefully transfer potato slices to pan and place under hot water for 1 to 2 minutes or until tender.  Alternatively, heat 2 inch depth of oil in a 4 to 6 inch nonstick skillet over moderate heat.  Carefully transfer slices with a slotted spoon to a paper towel lined baking sheet and drain.  When cool, arrange slices on a serving platter and spoon salsa verde over top.  Serve at once, or store in an airtight container.

title: Aussie Style Apple Salad
ingredients: 30 g green capsicum, seeds removed cut into thin strips | 1 small lime, juice of | 120 g tart apples, chopped
instructions: Toss apples with lime juice to remove excess moisture.  Toss with apple and capsicum strips.

title: Gator Terri's Mixti Kebabs

instructions: In a glass container, sprinkle about 1/2 oz of unflavored gelatin on the bottom and sides of the container.  Next, pour enough boiling water to come halfway up the side of the container.  When water is at a full boil, dissolve the gelatin in the boiling water.  Reserve 1 cup of the water in a jar.  This should be enough to soften 3oz of the tomatoes.  Remove the gelatin from the water.  Combine the remaining gelatin with the diced tomatoes.  Stir in the curry powder.  Squeeze lime juice over the tomatoes.  Stir until the mixture is completely well mixed.  Pour tomato mixture into the gelatin, mix well.  Chill for 2 - 6 hours.  Cut into 1 inch cubes.  Serve.

title: Basmati Rice With Molasses
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, rinsed | 1 cup molasses | 4 -5 tablespoons pimms ( see note # 1 )
instructions: Rinse the rice in a strainer until water runs clear.  Cover & refrigerate rice for 20 minutes.  Rinse rice under cold water to cool slightly, drain well, then drain again.  Combine 1/2 cup of the molasses and the rice, and stir well.  Heat remaining 1/2 cup molasses over medium low heat until it begins to amber, stirring frequently.  Immediately stir in the rice.  If your molasses is quite dark, you may need a little more of it.  Immediately spread pilaf on your rice.  Place in a dry pan.

title: Cheesy Pizza with Pecorino and Mozzarella Cheese

title: Faux Duck in Phyllo Rolls

instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Place duck legs in a large baking dish, and cover with sliced strawberries.  Drizzle with orange juice. Remove the duck legs from the saucepan and place in separate, resealable plastic bags, or containers.  Allow to cool for 5 to 10 minutes, then remove meat.  When cool, shred or coarsely chop.

title: Super Simple Spinach

instructions: Remove the stems from each leaf, and wash thoroughly.  In a large skillet, saute the spinach in the tomato juice for about 3 minutes to wilt.  Serve hot.

title: Green Chili Stuffed Strawberries

Combine the rice and cornstarch in a saucepan over high heat, stirring constantly until the cornstarch has completely dissolved. When ready to serve, divide the strawberry mixture among 6 serving bowls, then top with the reserved pistachios and serve with a green or red chili.  Enjoy.

title: Roasted Grapefruit

Serve immediately, garnish with a sprinkling of rock salt.

title: Crazy Chocolate Chips

When smooth, about 5 minutes watch carefully, it doesn't take long, and then remove from the heat.  Let the chocolate, then stir in just enough water to melt the chocolate and let the chips melt and harden a bit of slightly.  You could also use a slotted spoon to dip the chips in melted chocolate.  Let stand until the chocolate is firm, then dip in more chocolate to coat.

title: Hot Potatoes

instructions: Boil potatoes till they just start to get tender.  Drain potatoes and transfer to medium bowl.  Slice potatoes, and combine with pears, mushrooms, ketchup, and spices.  Serve hot.

title: Aifes: Rocky, Fluffy and Fragrant Phyllo Pastries
ingredients: 1/4 cup ginger paste | 1/4 cup fennel | 1 pinch salt | 1 pinch instant espresso powder | 1 lb wild rice ( i like jasmin ) | 1 lb phyllo pastry
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees.  In a food processor combine ginger paste, fennel, salt, espresso and water.  Mix well.
