title: Sherry Green Onion Salsa
ingredients: 1 bunch green onion | 1 1/2 cups sweet chili peppers, roasted ( jalapeno ) or 1 1/2 cups chopped fresh hot pepper ( jalapeno )
instructions: Place chilies on a cutting board, cut side up.  Use a sharp knife and slice off the thin slice from the green onion.  Place onions in a bowl and pour boiling water over them just enough to cover.  Let stand 10 minutes then drain liquid.  Place chilies and green onions with liquid in the blender with enough liquid to blend.  Scrape out puree into a saucepan and simmer, uncovered, over medium heat, stirring occasionally, for 15 to 20 minutes until onions are tender but not mushy.

title: Spanish Style Veggies
ingredients: 1 package frozen mixed vegetables | 1 large spanish onion
instructions: Cook frozen vegetables with onion, according to package directions.  Remove from heat and add to cooked veggies.  Serve warm.

title: Smoked Salmon Beer Soda
ingredients: 6 ounces fresh smoked salmon | 3 tablespoons miso | 1 cup beer | fresh cracker | cracker | mace
instructions: Heat the baking soda in a tall, glassy saucer.  Mix the miso in with the beer.  Smear about 1/2 cup of the beer onto the cracker and sprinkle with a pinch of grated mace.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,chili paste,salmon,onion soup mix,olive oil,cooking spray,bouillon cube
title: Easy Baked Salmon
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon dried chili paste ( i used an a1 sauce ) | 2 beef stock cubes ( knorr beef cube works well and we like them in meat ) | 1 package frozen boneless salmon, defrosted and deboned ( i used the costco packs ) | 1 box mexican blend cheese | 1 bouillon cube ( i used about 2-5 )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f.  In a bowl, mix together onion soup mix and chili paste.  Cut salmon into 2x1/3inch pieces and set aside.  Using cooking spray in a large baking dish, coat bottom with cooking spray.  Arrange salmon pieces evenly over the bottom of dish.  Spread soup mixture evenly over salmon pieces.  Arrange the cheese over the soup mixture.  Distribute remaining ingredients evenly over the cheese.  Cover baking dish tightly with foil.  Bake in preheated oven until heated through and the cheese is melted and bubbly.  Allow to sit for 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,pineapple,beef bouillon cube,rib celery,gingerroot,rice krispies
title: Wet Ribs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons light dark rum | 3 beef bouillon cubes | 1/4 - 1/2 inch gingerroot, peeled and crushed | 1 can crushed pineapple, drained | 4 cups steamed rice krispies | 3 tablespoons crushed pineapple ( optional )
instructions: Pour dark rum into a sauce pan, place over medium heat.  Add ribs, ginger, and crushed pineapple.  Cover and simmer for 7 - 10 minutes, until ribs are tender.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,cold water,canadian bacon,soymilk,cajun seasoning
title: Low Fat Creamy Cajun Broth
ingredients: 1 bunch green chili pepper, trimmed of seeds, washed | 2 inches piece canadian bacon, chopped | 3 tablespoons low-sodium soy milk | 1 cup cold water | 1 tablespoon canadian cajun seasoning
instructions: Toast finely the chilies, making sure the stems are removed by using a grill lighter, as you do so.  Remove all but the chilies only after it turns very lightly black.  Turn off heat and wrap chilies in a tea towel.  Let sit for a few minutes.  Peel away the black and green stems, if desired.  Cut away the ribs and seeds.  Place chilies in saucepan with canadian bacon and a little bit of water to cover.

title: Crazy Tweaky Gorgonzola Wraps
ingredients: 20 gorgonzola, crumbled | 15 g blue curacao | 15 g kalamata olives, chopped | 15 g macadamia nuts, crushed into pieces | 15 g fresh coconut flakes, chopped
instructions: Take your nuts, and roll out evenly into a circle.  Spread all the cheese over the circle and roll up like a burrito then take a spoon and put the nuts onto the bread using the spoon to help keep the mix stick together.  After about 30 seconds the nuts should be toasted, so take a knife or pizza knife and place them a couple of minutes later into the microwave for a crisper taste.  Cut into wedges and serve with a nice spicy red curd.

Random Ingredients: green chile pepper,sumac,canola oil,graham cracker crumb
title: Green Chile Cheesecakes
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 can chopped green chile peppers ( drained and mashed ) | 1/2 cup canola oil | 1/2 teaspoon ground sumac ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or spray with cooking spray.  In a medium bowl combine graham cracker crumbs, chilies, oil, and sumac or chilli powder.  Spoon into prepared baking sheet.  Bake 10 - 15 minutes, or until lightly browned and slightly firm to the touch.  Cut into squares while warm.

title: Creamy Mango Risotto
ingredients: 1/2 cup carnaroli rice | 3 cups nonfat milk | 1/2 mango, peeled and diced | 2 teaspoons ground cumin | 1 container 2 % cottage cheese, warmed
instructions: Place 1/2 cup of the carnaroli in a small bowl and sprinkle with 1 1/2 teaspoons of the cumin.  Set aside.  In a large bowl, combine remaining 1/2 cup of carnaroli, sugar and 1/2 teaspoons cumin.  Stir to combine and set aside.  In a 3 3/4 cup pot, heat 1 1/2 cups of milk to just below boiling over high heat.  Drain the rice, reserving 3/4 cup of the cooked milk.  Stir the rice into the reserved 1 1/2 cups of milk, then add the mango and 3/4 teaspoon of the cumin.  Cover and heat to boiling over high heat.  Reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring as needed, for 20 minutes, or until the mixture is creamy and creamy and the rice is cooked but still slightly firm in texture.  Remove from heat.  When creamy, stir in 2 cups of the cooked reserved milk and 2 tablespoons of the reserved carnaroli.  Cool, stirring frequently, and spread the risotto mixture in a 3 quart casserole dish or a deep 3 1/2 to 4 quart casserole dish.  Cover and chill 2 hours or overnight.  In a small bowl, combine remaining 1/4 cup of carnaroli with the cottage cheese and blend lightly.  Spoon cottage cheese mixture over rice and cheese.  Cover with plastic wrap and chill, loosely covered, until ready to serve.  To serve, stir before serving with chopped fresh fruit and a dollop of plain or toasted coconut yogurt.

Random Ingredients: loaf ciabatta,cooking apple,red wine,shortening,italian parsley,mustard seed,gruyere cheese,confectioner sugar
title: Ciabatta and Gratinees
ingredients: 2 cups sweet red wine | 1/4 cup shortening | 6 whole grain rolls or 6 bread rolls, split lengthwise | 1/2 cup grated gruyere cheese | 1 package grated italian parsley | 3 cups thinly sliced cooking apples | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Brush each cut surface with 1 tablespoon shortening.  Arrange rolls cut side up, on a baking sheet.  Bake rolls in the preheated oven until lightly toasted about 10 minutes.  Remove from oven.

Random Ingredients: red miso,chipotle paste,dark chocolate,italian dressing,chicken wing,milk,kaffir lime leaf
title: Chili Wings (Aka Chicken Wings)
ingredients: 1/2 cup kaffir lime leaf, chopped ( use fresh lime leaf ) | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle paste | 1 tablespoon dark chocolate, chopped ( sweet, or chocolate, use either unsweetened or dry cocoa ) | 4 lbs chicken wings, tips removed | 1/2 pint heavy cream light or 1/2 pint milk | 1 tablespoon milk | 1 tablespoon good italian dressing ( or your favourite dressing )
instructions: Pour the kaffir lime leaves, chiles and chocolate into a bowl.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 45 - 60 minutes or to chill a little.  Meanwhile, heat the cream to boiling and remove from heat.  Cool.  Meanwhile trim the wings, removing the tips, discarding the wings.  Add the wings to the bowl with the cream.  Melt the chocolate and milk stirring until melted.  Pour on top of the chicken and stir gently.  Drizzle with the s&p.  Leave in refrigerator to set.  Just before serving, add extra dressing.

title: Polish Holiday Grilled Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 large orange bell peppers or 1 large yellow bell pepper | 1 bag cremini mushrooms
instructions: Rinse the mushrooms and remove stems and stems from the caps if using, otherwise, use a plastic bag.  If using the yellow bell pepper, cut into 3 inch wide strips.  Trim the ends of the mushrooms if using the yellow bell pepper.  If using a regular mushroom cut the body part of the mushrooms up into the mushrooms.  Place the cut mushrooms in the plastic bag, close the bag and shake to mix in the peppers.  Close the bag and store in a cool place for up to 6 weeks, shaking the pan occasionally.  The mixture may be covered and refrigerated at this point, and the mushrooms will be ready to be grilled as soon as they are done.

title: Shrimp, Beans and White Wine Salad
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans | 1 cup white wine | 24 salad shrimp, peeled
instructions: Drain the beans and put them in a food processor.  Pour in wine and process until mixture turns into a paste, about 10 minutes.  Season with salt and pepper to taste.  Pour into a bowl and serve alongside salads.

title: Red Curry Basted Spinach with Cheese
ingredients: 3/4 cup nonfat milk | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 4 ounces havarti cheese, diced | 4 fresh buns, toasted
instructions: In a nonstick skillet over medium heat, combine milk with curry paste.  Bring to a simmer.  Gently stir in cheeses.  Spoon mixture into toasted bun halves.

title: Gruyere Cheese Balls (Pumpernickel Kugel)
ingredients: 5 pounds gruyere cheese | 1 1/2 ounces dried chervil, chopped or to taste | 1 1/2 ounces golden raisins
instructions: Cut the gruyere cheese into 1/2 inch cubes.  Combine the shredded gruyere cheese, dried chervil and raisins in a large bowl.  Stir in the chervil mixture.  Shape into walnut sized balls and refrigerate until chilled, about 2 hours.  Place the chilled kugel in the refrigerator for up to 2 days.  Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Transfer chilled kugel to a baking sheet.  Using your hands, smooth out any grating on the surface.  Bake in the preheated oven for 5 to 5 hours, or until the center is firm and dry.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: salmon,pepper,monterey jack pepper cheese,vodka,green lentil,cocoa,red miso,dark sesame oil
title: Lengua and Salmon Skewers
ingredients: 500 g split green lentils or 500 g split red lentils, rinsed and drained | 200 g smoked salmon, cut into 1/8-inch dice | 200 g monterey jack pepper cheese, cut into 16 cubes | 150 g red miso | 50 ml red miso | 50 ml vodka | 2 ml white sesame oil | 1 teaspoon cocoa
instructions: Soak the chinese noodles in hot water for around 20 minutes.  Drain.  Soak the chinese noodles in boiling water for 5 minutes.  Dry the noodles under running water.  Dry them under running water.  Chop into small pieces as above.  Soak the chinese noodles for 15 minutes in boiling water.  In a microwave safe bowl add the chinese noodles, the salmon, cheese, red miso and white sesame oil.  Mix well.  Dry the noodles under running water.  Using the back of a spoon or your hands wet the drained green and pink stuff in the noodles, being careful not to lose the excess moisture.  Stir in half the cocoa.  Skewer the noodles and the other half the cocoa and cayenne pepper mixture on your bamboo skewers or toothpicks.  If your guest like them to add some extra spice, sprinkle the rest of the cayenne pepper over them.  Let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.  This dish goes beautifully with rice or noodles.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,orange juice zest,spinach leaf,double cream,plain yogurt,cooking oat
title: Spinach With Raita
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed | 1 cup plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons double cream | 1 teaspoon orange juice and zest, grated | chopped fresh italian parsley | 2 1/2 cups quick-cooking oats
instructions: Place the spinach, yogurt, cream, orange zest and 1/2 of the fresh parsley in a large saucepan.  Cover and cook over low heat for 5 minutes or until the mixture is hot.  Stir and cook for 2 minutes or until the oats are lightly toasted and the spinach is hot.  Stir the hot raita into the warm spinach mixture.  Divide among serving bowls and top with remaining parsley.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: celery,skewer,ziti pasta,topping,tomato green chilies,italian bread crumb,margarine,onion powder
title: Italian Kook Bread
ingredients: 1 package dried ziti pasta | 1 stalk celery, chopped | 2 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies | 6 pieces italian seasoned bread crumbs | 1/3 cup margarine | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/2 teaspoon celery powder | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1 container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add and cook the ziti pasta, uncovered, until al dente, about 8 minutes.  Drain and return to the pot.  Meanwhile, melt the margarine in a large skillet, and cook the celery, stirring occasionally, until crisp tender, about 10 minutes.  Stir in the diced tomatoes with green chilies, and cook until heated through.  Place the bread crumbs into a shallow dish.  Mix the margarine, onion powder, celery powder, and onion powder into the prepared ziti in the skillet.  Dip one piece of stuffed bread in the melted margarine, then into the bread crumbs.  Fry each piece of bread in the heated soup until browned on each side and the bread crumbs are toasted.  Repeat or sprinkle the soup with crumbs a few at a time.

title: Blueberry & Yogurt Dessert
ingredients: 180 g low-fat plain yogurt | 75 g berries | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 2 teaspoons cumin powder
instructions: Mix baking soda and yogurt.  Add all ingredients except berries.  Pour into a shallow glass dish and leave for at least half an hour in the fridge until the mixture has set.  If you wish to serve it as an appetiser, serve this with boiled new potatoes and a green vegetables.  Enjoy.

title: Baked Sirloin & Rice
ingredients: 4 boneless beef top sirloin, 1-inch thick | 2 cups seasoned rice wine or 2 cups japanese sake | 1/2 cup chili powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f.  Use a sharp knife to cut a 1/2 inch deep pocket into the surface and deep fry in hot rice oil for 2 minutes.  Remove the meat and drain.  In the same hot oil, saute the rice wine, chili powder, 5 - 6 tablespoons of the manzanilla marinade and the meat for 10 minutes or until the meat is done.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,rice noodle,walnut oil,dashi stock,red curry paste,lamb chop,ginger garlic paste
title: Mongolian Lamb Chops With Raisins and Spices (Lamb Curry)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon walnut oil | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 12 lamb chops, about 1 1/2 x 4 1/2 inches ( can sub prosciutto ) | 1 tablespoon dashi stock | 1 1/2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 2 cups cooked rice noodles
instructions: Heat the walnut oil in a large pan or wok on medium heat.  Place the lamb chops in the pan and cook until it turns white, about 3 minutes per side.  Turn the chops over and add the ginger garlic paste and stock to the pan.  Simmer for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Add the red curry paste, stirring well, and simmer for five minutes.  Remove from heat and let sit for 5 minutes.  Add the raisins and stir to incorporate.  The raisins and curry paste will swell and darken the chops slightly on top.  Serve with hot rice noodles.

Random Ingredients: bibb lettuce,spinach leaf,allspice,cream chicken soup,kale,red apple
title: Spinach and Apple Kale Salad
ingredients: 2 heads bibb lettuce, shredded | 2 bunches fresh spinach leaves | 1 medium red apple, cut into bite size pieces | 1 can cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 1 head kale, julienned
instructions: Wash the greens and spin dry.  Chop the spinach.  Core the apple and slice thin across the length of the spinach leaves.  In a salad bowl, combine the spinach, sliced apple, cream of chicken soup, and allspice.  Gently fold in the bibb lettuce and kale.  Taste and add more seasoning if necessary.

Random Ingredients: pumpkin seed,milk chocolate chip,garlic,poultry seasoning,pork back rib,bell pepper
title: Chinese Style Peppers
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs pork back ribs | 1 1/8 cups milk chocolate chips, divided | 1 tablespoon garlic, minced | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning | 1 teaspoon pumpkin seeds | 1 small sweet bell pepper, diced
instructions: Trim excess fat from ribs and cut into 1 inch cubes.  Combine remaining ingredients together in a large bowl.  Add meat and stir well to coat.  Cover and marinate for at least 6 hours or overnight.  Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Place meat in a large baking pan.  Bake in oven for 50 - 55 minutes, or until done.

title: Chocolate & Sherry Sandwich With Pepper Jelly
ingredients: 2 thick slices whole wheat bread | 1 tablespoon chocolate syrup | 2 teaspoons red thai chiles, chopped | 1 tablespoon sweet sherry
instructions: Spread one side of each slice of bread with chocolate syrup.  Add chopped chiles and stir well.  Spread sherry on top.  Roll up.  Chill until needed.  You can put these on top of your choice.

title: Hot Nuts - Old Fashioned Recipe!
ingredients: 1 cup hot water | 6 tablespoons icing sugar | 4 1/2 cups whole wheat flour | 4 1/4 cups icing sugar | 1/4 - 1/2 cup double cream ( or to taste )
instructions: Dissolve icing sugar in hot water in a bowl.  Sift flour with icing sugar, then fold in flour mixture.  Divide into 25 pieces and roll out into a flat circle.  Use 2 biscuit rings or a round to form round shapes.  Place on a greased griddle and turn over once so that all sides are lightly browned.  Continue cooking until golden on all sides.

title: Chilled Cilantro Chutney
ingredients: 4 green chilies, chopped | 1 cup cilantro leaf, chopped | 1 cup fresh oats | 1/4 cup black pepper
instructions: Toss all ingredients together in a bowl.  Let cure for several hours or overnight.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce leaf,herb,escarole,cream chicken soup,bell pepper,black pepper,cornflour,romano cheese
title: Low Fat Escarole Salad
ingredients: 4 -5 heads romaine lettuce leaves | 1/4 cup cornflour | 1/2 cup cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup finely grated low-fat romano cheese or 1/2 cup asiago cheese | fresh black pepper ( to taste ) | 4 -5 tablespoons low-fat sour cream | 1/4 cup chopped fresh herb ( to taste ) | 1/2 - 3/4 cup finely chopped bell pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Cut the leaves off the romaine and cut into thick, ribbons.

title: Noodle with Cream and Chili
ingredients: 1 package rice noodles | 1 container heavy cream, divided | 7 tablespoons chili oil | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk
instructions: Place noodles in a bowl and cover with a large quantity of warm water.  Let soak for 1 hour.  Put a large pot of water on to boil to prepare the noodles.  Add rice noodles to boiling water.  Cook about 1 minute less than the package directions instructs us, so they just start to soften.  Put the noodles in a colander and drain the noodles until no more water remains.  Cut in half and set aside.  In a heavy saucepan, heat chile oil over medium heat.  Add 1 cup cream and stir until the cream starts to bubble.  Add drained noodles and cook over medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes.  Add 2 - 3 tablespoons of cream to the noodles and stir.  Cook 1 more minute.  Then pour over the remaining cream and stir.  Serve hot.

title: French Vanilla Cheese With Caramelized American Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 cup real pure maple syrup | 15 slices american cheese ( to taste ) | 3 1/2 teaspoons real pure maple syrup | 1/2 vanilla bean, split ( split again )
instructions: Add the 1/2 cup real pure maple syrup to a double boiler with at least a cup of hot water.  If you have not done this, just heat the maple syrup until the temperature starts to drop to the boil.  Meanwhile, cut the cheese slices in half.  Remove the strings of vanilla seeds with a melon baller.  Remove the vanilla seeds with a fine sieve or a garlic press.  Drain the cheese and shake off some of the excess water then put them into the bowl of your double boiler over medium high heat.  Add 2 teaspoons of real pure maple syrup.  Stir the maple mixture continuously with a wooden spoon to dissolve it.  When the syrup starts to boil, remove from heat and stir in the vanilla bean.  The finished cheese should be smooth and creamy.  It will take a couple of minutes to melt the cheese.  If it becomes too stiff to stir, add a 1/2 teaspoon of real pure maple syrup at a time.  As long as it is smooth and creamy, you can stir it into the cheese.  The cheese should not be melted too thick but smooth and creamy.  When you are ready to serve, you can spread the cheese with either a wooden spoon or your hands.  For a nice cheesy and soft cheese filling, try making it in the microwave for 1 minute or so and stirring until creamy and slightly crispy.  It should spread out easily, although if it does, add some sugar or cream, a little milk or egg milk, etc.  I usually add about 6 - 8 teaspoons of creamy maple syrup to the melted butter before blending to get it smooth and smooth.

title: Enchilada Sauce with Cashews
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef | 1/2 cup roasted cashews | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 2 cups prepared enchilada sauce
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add beef and cook until no longer pink, about 10 minutes.  Drain and set aside.  Stir cashews into the ground beef.  Season with anise seed.  Mix in a jar of enchilada sauce.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,maraschino cherry,heavy whipping cream,orange blossom water
title: Lime Mousse
ingredients: 12 ounces heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon fresh orange blossom water | 1/2 lime wedge | 1 maraschino cherry
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the whipping cream and orange blossom water.  Beat just until soft peaks form.  In a large glass or decorative bowl, add a small amount of the cream mixture and whip until mousse is creamy.  Remove half the mousse to another small bowl, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate in a cool place for 1 to 2 hours.  Garnish with a small lime wedge and a maraschino cherry.

title: Al-Batena
ingredients: 500 g beef mince | 3 red cabbage, sliced thinly | 2 chilies, chopped finely | 1 teaspoon dill weed | 1 teaspoon marjoram leaves or 1 teaspoon oregano leaves | 1 teaspoon harissa
instructions: Combine all ingredients.  Grill over medium heat for around 15 - 20 minutes until cooked.

title: Easy Okra and Chocolate Samosas
ingredients: 1 package chocolate pudding mix | 1 package sugar | 1 box egg roll wraps | 1/2 cup milk | 2 cups frozen okra, thawed | 3 ounces semisweet chocolate pieces, melted | 4 tablespoons nuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  In a large bowl, with an electric mixer, combine pudding mix, sugar, and milk.  Mix well.  Pinch off a piece of okra per wrap, and stuff this into each wrap.  Fold wrap around the okra, and secure with a toothpick.  Place on a baking sheet, and brush with melted chocolate.  Sprinkle with nuts.

Random Ingredients: red enchilada sauce,bamboo shoot,cayenne,monterey jack cheese,green chilies
title: Green Chile enchiladas
ingredients: 2 cans chopped green chilies | 4 cans red enchilada sauce | 12 ounces monterey jack cheese, shredded | cayenne ( optional ) | 1 can bamboo shoots, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Mix all ingredients together in a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.  Bake 20 minutes.  Uncover and bake an additional 10 minutes.  Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,elbow macaroni,shrimp,potato,penne pasta,pepperoni,corn flake,ice cube
title: Shrimp and Macaroni Pie
ingredients: 1 package penne pasta | 12 ounces small shrimp, raw, peeled | 1 lb potato, peeled and cut into thin strips | 8 ounces frozen peeled potatoes, thawed | 8 ounces frozen pea pods, thawed | 8 ounces pepperoni, sliced | 15 sheets frozen phyllo pastry | 3 cups crushed corn flakes | 2 cups crushed ice cubes
instructions: Prepare pasta according to package directions.  Meanwhile, in large saucepan, cook shrimp over medium high heat 3 minutes.  Remove shrimp from heat and set aside.  Drain fat from shrimp.  Add potatoes, shrimp, pepperoni, frozen veggies, and shrimp mixture to potatoes and stir to mix well.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  To assemble 4 pie plates, cover bottom of each pie plate with 1/4 cup crushed corn flakes.  Cover top with 1/4 cup crushed corn flakes.  Arrange 4 sheets of phyllo in overlapping lines with 1 border on the outside.  In a pie dish sprayed with nonstick cooking spray, layer sheets of phyllo in, overlapping lines.  Cover phyllo with remaining phyllo sheets.  Fold phyllo dough in half and pinch to separate.  Tuck excess dough in corners, creating a seam to seal dish.  Dot phyllo sheet with cooking spray.  Bake 10 minutes.  Remove from oven and top with 1 cup crushed cornflakes.  Return to oven for 4 minutes, or until cheese is melted and golden.  Allow to sit 5 minutes before serving.

title: Tunisian Fried Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 1/4 cup salad oil | 3 cans creamed corn for frying
instructions: Heat oil for frying in a medium sized frying pan.  Carefully stir in corn until thoroughly mixed together.  Dip each piece of tortilla into the oil and fry until golden brown.  Sprinkle tortilla chips with your favourite foods.

Random Ingredients: black dal,brown onion,heavy whipping cream,cider vinegar,vegetable oil,cashew,nectarine,rye bread
title: Black Jaffle With Nectarines, Cappuccino, Black Onion and Cashews
ingredients: 12 slices rye bread, cut from crust about 1-inch thick | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 3 tablespoons light brown onions, finely chopped or 1/3 cup finely chopped yellow onion | 2 tablespoons cashews, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons black dal, roasted, chopped or 1 1/2 tablespoons black gram dal | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons cider vinegar | 1 1/4 cups black pitted nectarines, peeled, halved lengthwise, seeded, drained
instructions: Arrange bread slices on an ungreased metal baking sheet,.  Using 1 tablespoon for each bread slice, toss to coat evenly.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.  Add onion, nuts and dal.  Cook, stirring, 5 mins 2 minutes, until onions and nuts are golden about 1 minute add cream, vinegar, and vinegar.  Increase heat to high and bring to a boil.  Boil over high heat 5 minutes until liquid is reduced by half.  Arrange bread pieces on serving platter and pour hot jelly mixture over.  Serve hot.

title: Creamy Mushroom Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 2 tablespoons plain yogurt, or to taste
instructions: Mix cream of mushroom soup, yogurt, and vegetable juice cocktail sauce together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: banana,baby carrot,pizza dough,french bread,sugar snap pea,balsamic vinegar
title: Sweet Banana Stromboli
ingredients: 8 slices crusty french bread | 4 medium bananas, sliced | 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 package baby carrots | 1 box frozen sugar snap peas, thawed | 1 package refrigerated pizza dough
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Spread 1 tablespoon of balsamic vinegar on one side of one bread slice.  Layer 1/4 of the sliced bananas over the vinegar.  Layer 2 tablespoons of baby carrots over the carrots.  Top with another slice of bread and a final slice of bread.  Repeat with another slice of bread to make two bread sandwiches.  Place on baking sheet coated with cooking spray.  Bake 25 minutes then brush with remaining balsamic vinegar.

title: Zucchini in Brown Sauce - Sweden
ingredients: 2 zucchini, sliced | 1 can hamburger, drained | 1/2 - 1 tablespoon dill weed ( or a little cayenne pepper ) | 1/8 teaspoon vanilla | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dark brown sugar
instructions: Place zucchini on a microwave safe baking tray.  Add rest of ingredients and put in microwave on high for about five minutes depending on how hungry you are and how tender your zucchini is.  Let cool slightly, then serve or store it on the counter.

title: Shredded Vegetables for 2
ingredients: 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 cup baby carrots | 2 tablespoons finely shredded lettuce | 1 hard-boiled egg, peeled and chopped | 1 tablespoon finely chopped pistachios ( or almonds )
instructions: Combine all ingredients.  Stir to blend, and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight to develop flavor.  This recipe can also be made the night before, making in advance.

title: Nuked Falafel from Company Guy
ingredients: 8 ounces garbanzo beans | 4 slices bacon
instructions: Put all the ingredients in a food processor and pulse until smooth, stopping frequently to scrape down the sides.  You want to keep it short at the end of the cooking but not dried out.  Transfer to a bowl and crumble the bacon into the top.

title: Lime Noodles With Fennel
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 7 ounces angel hair pasta, uncooked | 1 medium lime
instructions: Place the fennel in a small saute pan & toast over low heat 2 minutes until fragrant.  Transfer to a small bowl & set aside for 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, bring a medium pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add the pasta & cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Spinach in White Wine
ingredients: 16 ounces bag of baby spinach leaves | 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar
instructions: Place spinach in a pot of water with a lid over medium heat for about 5 minutes.  Stir to keep from sticking and to ensure even cooking.  Add vinegar and mix well.  When spinach tastes cooked, it should be just slightly wilted.  Transfer to serving bowl or platter.  Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,rigatoni pasta,basil leaf,chicken bouillon,chinese mushroom,ranch dressing mix,bulk italian sausage,black bean
title: Chinese Chicken and Sausage Rigatoni
ingredients: 1 box rigatoni pasta | 1 1/2 lbs chinese chinese sausage | 1 package sweet bulk italian sausage ( recommended kraft brand ) | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 1 packet ranch dressing mix | 2 teaspoons almond extract | 8 ounces chinese mushrooms, sliced | 15 basil leaves, roughly torn
instructions: In a large pot of boiling, salted water, cook pasta until al dente, rinse in cold water and drain.  Cook sausage in a skillet over medium heat until browned, add chicken bouillon, mix in sausage, cooked pasta and italian dressing mix.  Mix in mushrooms, basil, pasta will be a bit drier than usual.

title: Easy  Chicken and Beef Jerky
ingredients: 3 -6 chicken breasts, cut into small cubes or 3 -6 lb beef top round steak | 1 head garlic, crushed or chopped | 1 cup hot chili pepper flakes or 1 cup chili powder | 2 1/2 cups thawed jerky spice bag
instructions: Cut top or tender part off each beef steak.  Open pods.  Place in large plastic bag with garlic.  Fill with chili flakes.

Random Ingredients: red onion,raisin,fig,hard egg,head cabbage,bean sprout,port wine,hominy
title: Colombian Baked Bean Cabbage Soup With Fig and Bread
ingredients: 2 slices country-style bread, torn into chunks and toasted | 2 cups rinsed drained canned beans and sprouts | 1/2 large head cabbage, cored and cut into 8 wedges | 2 large red onions, peeled and cut into wedges | 3 -4 small dried figs, soaked in hot water for 15 minutes and blanched and halved | 1 can hominy, drained | 1/2 cup port wine | 1 small head of cabbage, cored, trimmed, and cut into 8 wedges | 5 hard-boiled eggs | 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f in large bowl toss together bean and sprouts.  Cover and refrigerate while preparing bread to make soup.  Bake bread in oven until crust is dried and crisp.  Cut bread into 1 cubes and transfer to bowl of cold water.  Press into cracker crumbs and toss with beans and sprouts.  Cover and refrigerate.  Arrange cabbage wedges on baking sheet and bake until lightly browned, about 15 minutes, or until lightly wilted.  Remove from heat.  Place an ovenproof soup or soup pot on stovetop over medium heat and add 2 cups water.  Bring to a boil and reduce heat to low.  Cover and simmer until cabbage is softened and soup is thickened, about 10 minutes.  Add more water as needed to prevent soup from becoming dry.  If soup becomes too thick, stir in a little hot water, if its too thin, stir in more water.  Stir drained cooked figs into soup and simmer 5 minutes.  Remove soup from heat.  While simmering, prepare filling and bread.  Divide the drained hominy among 8 serving bowls.  Place 1/3 of onion wedges and 1/5 of figs in a separate pie plate or platter.  Spread hot bean mixture around onion and figs.  Place 1/4 of the columbed cabbage on filling, top with 1/4 of the remaining onion wedges.  Add half of the bread cubes.  Add 1/2 of the filling.  Repeat topping and then top with remaining bread cubes.

title: Quick and Easy Microwave Green Beans And Coconut
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, trimmed | 1/2 cup shredded white american cheese | 1/2 teaspoon coconut extract | 1 bay leaf
instructions: Place all ingredients in a microwave safe casserole dish with lid & cover.  Microwave on high heat for 30 seconds or until beans are just tender but still have some bite.

title: Baked Spicy Raisin and Almond Samosas
ingredients: 20 -25 medium size golden raisins | 1/3 cup finely chopped mild jalapeno chiles | 8 ounces sweet mix | 1/4 cup slivered toasted sliced almonds | 1 tablespoon cumin seed | cayenne
instructions: Set oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit.  If you have an oven rack this is okay.  Toss raisins and chopped jalapeños with almonds in a small bowl.  Spread the raisins out on a large baking sheet.  Sprinkle with cinnamon and cumin seeds and top with mixture.  Put in the preheated oven.  Watch and bake until raisins are toasted they should not be dry and should have a slightly reddish toasted color. .  Transfer baking sheet to rack and leave for 10 minutes.  Flip the samosas after 10 minutes.  This is not a done thing take them out of the oven and let cool for 10 minutes.  Transfer samosas to air tight container and store in air tight container.

Random Ingredients: garlic chive,saffron strand,vegetable oil,chunky salsa,ladyfinger,baby spinach
title: Spinach & Saffron Sprinkle Creamy Saffron Tiramisu
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1 1/2 ounces baby spinach, rinsed, dried, and chopped ( about 3 1/2 cups, loosely packed ) | 1/2 teaspoon saffron strand, crumbled | 1/4 cup chunky salsa, such as pace | 1/2 cup chopped fresh chives, plus 3/4 cup fresh | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh garlic chives ( about 3/4 cup ) | 20 large ladyfingers
instructions: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet set over moderate heat.  Add spinach, and saute until spinach is wilted, about 2 minutes.  Stir in saffron and salsa until wilted.  Transfer spinach to bowl, and stir in chives.  Cover and set aside to marinate, stirring occasionally, until ready to use, about 5 hours.  While still warm, make tiramisu by mixing 3/4 cup papaya with 1/3 cup warm water in a small bowl until well blended and frothy. .  Remove and discard papaya from papaya water with a slotted spoon, reserving syrup, and spread papaya in the bottom of a 10x16 inch glass baking dish.  Cover with a layer of ladyfingers, and spread with 2/3 cup salsa.  Repeat layering, pressing down, and pressing down to compact the ladyfingers.  Pour reserved syrup over tiramisu, and sprinkle papaya evenly over the syrup.  Cover, and refrigerate tiramisu until chilled, at least 3 hours, and up to 1 day.  When ready to serve, prepare tiramisu in advance, by drizzling reserved syrup from a small jar into a small bowl.  Garnish tiramisu with fresh chives.

title: Real Simple and Delicious Barley Beans
ingredients: 3 tablespoons barley | 3/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1 can pinto beans, drained | 1/4 cup port wine
instructions: Saute the barley and red wine vinegar in a non stick skillet.  Add the pinto beans and port and cook until warmed through.  Serve.

title: Catfish & Apricot Brandy Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans ( undrained ) | 1 can white beans ( undrained ) | 1 can catfish fillets | 1/8 cup apricot brandy
instructions: Combine beans, fish, and brandy in a large bowl.

title: Baked Cornish Game Hens
ingredients: 6 cornish hens, split ( with hock ) | 1/4 cup oatmeal | 1/2 cup rolled oats | 3/4 cup wheat flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit.  Remove hens from casings and place in a baking dish.  Place 3/4 cup oatmeal and 3/4 cup rolled oats into a tea ball jar and shake until combined.  Combine the flour and remaining oatmeal.  Spread mixture over hens and bake for 20 minutes or until done.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,drambuie,saffron strand,canning salt,black pepper,black soy sauce,yellow pepper
title: Beef Tenderloin With Saffron Saffron Pepper & Soy Sauce
ingredients: 1 whole beef tenderloin | 1/2 tablespoon saffron strand, crushed, or more to taste | 1/2 tablespoon light soy sauce | 1/2 tablespoon dijon-style black soy sauce | 2 1/2 teaspoons instant saffron strands | white pepper to taste | 1/8 teaspoon black pepper | 2 teaspoons canning salt | 6 1/2 teaspoons yellow sweet peppers, coarsely chopped ( jalapeno-like )
instructions: Cut top and back of each beef tenderloin lengthwise so that it can sit upright on its side.  Trim excess fat, trim silverskin, and cut the tenderloin lengthwise into 6 slices, then pound each slice to an even thickness of 1/4 inch.  In a small bowl, combine saffron strands, light soy sauce, dijon style black soy sauce, and saffron powder.  Stir to mix, and keep warm.  Place yellow sweet pepper in a shallow bowl.  Place a beef slice between two sheets of wax paper, and pound with a meat mallet until flat and even.  Make sure the steak has a fair amount of thickness after pounding, since the sweet pepper slices can be easily penetrated by any steak.  Place a piece of black pepper on one end of a slice of beef, brush with the saffron mixture, and wrap tightly with the wax paper.  Secure steak with several toothpicks if necessary, and refrigerate for 2 hours.  In a large stockpot, bring 3 cups of water to a boil, and pour in the beef slices.  Return to a boil, cover, and cook for 15 to 20 minutes.  Turn once, and cook for 10 to 15 minutes.  After removing meat to a platter, cut in 1 inch squares, drizzle with 1 teaspoon saffron sherry and 1 teaspoon of soy sauce, and toss to coat.  Cover again, and leave to rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Cucumber and Cucumber Enchiladas
ingredients: 12 flour tortillas | 1 pound cucumbers, sliced, peeled or unpeeled
instructions: Set out 12 tortillas by laying a few at a time on a plate.  The tortillas need to be pliable and pliable.  The easiest way to pliable tortillas is to put a few pieces of plastic wrap along the middle of each tortilla, fold the tortillas over, then wrap the top with a few more tortillas, twisting the ends to tighten.  Heat a few tablespoons of oil in a skillet over medium heat.  Fry the rolled out tortillas until golden brown, flipping once.  Cut into wedges and serve immediately with salsa and sour cream for dipping.

Random Ingredients: bulb garlic,active yeast,lemon zest,sea salt pepper,barley,vinegar,velveeta cheese,mint
title: Barley Stuffed Garlic Roast
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups raw barley ( or quick cooking barley ) | 7 -8 cloves roasted garlic, rinsed | 1 1/2 cups velveeta cheese ( or other creamy cheese, cut into 1/2 inch cubes ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon zest ( finely grated ) | 1 teaspoon dried mint | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice ( or use white lemon juice ) | 1/8 teaspoon sea salt | 1 teaspoon unbleached cane sugar or 1 teaspoon raw sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f place garlic on a cutting board or in the cavity of a foil roaster.  With the tip of a sharp knife or a paring knife, gently slash the top of garlic with slicing marks several inches width.  Place on baking sheet.  Roast in oven 15 minutes, or until beginning to brown around the edges.  Remove from oven.  When ready to serve, cut a slit into center and carefully stuff the roasted garlic.  In a medium bowl, combine the cheese, lemon zest, mint, lemon juice, sea salt, raw sugar and caraway seeds.  Mix well.  When cool enough to handle, spoon filling into the slit in the halved roasted garlic.  Tuck the inside of the garlic tightly around the bread so that moisture can drain out.  To eat, let the loaf rest in the residual oven for 10 - 15 minutes and cut out loaf using scissors or a knife.

title: Beer Battered Flatbread
ingredients: 2 cups whole grain rye flour, or | 1 1/2 cups rye flour, or | 1 1/2 cups low-fat rye flour | 1/4 cup nutritional yeast ( optional ) | 12 ounces low-sodium beer or 12 ounces beer | cooking spray
instructions: Place wheat gluten in a large bowl or food processor and add beer.  Process until mixture is fairly smooth.  Add extra flour for a thinner and workier texture.  If you are adding your gluten, process a little longer.  Turn dough out onto a floured surface and knead until mixture forms into a smooth ball.  If you are using a food processor, knead in gluten.  Cover dough with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Spray dough with cooking spray.  Divide dough into six pieces and flatten each piece to a round about 2/3 inch thick.  Place round onto a floured pizza peel, cut several slits in the top of the loaf with a sharp knife, and sprinkle with some of the remaining nutritional yeast.  Place the floured pizza on the preheated sheet.  Flour your hands and roll the dough with hands so the dough is coated.  If you do this, just roll the dough and cut more dough.  Spread with the beer or cheese sauce while it is still hot and bake, or place it in a 400 degree oven for 15 to 20 minutes, until crust is browned.

Random Ingredients: vanilla pudding mix,fish fillet,guacamole,worcestershire sauce,sage leaf,chinese noodle,mace
title: Popsicles
ingredients: 1 package vanilla pudding mix | 3/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 3/4 cup chopped fresh sage leaves | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 2 lbs fish fillets, cut into bite-size pieces | guacamole | chinese noodles
instructions: Prepare instant vanilla pudding according to package directions.  Stir worcestershire sauce, sage, mace, and fish into pudding.  Fill 2 1/2 cup measuring cups halfway with guacamole.  Line a cookie sheet with foil.  Drop 6 popsicle sticks into cheesecloth, place on cookie sheet, and freeze for at least 1 hour.  Unwrap and carefully peel away foil.  Microwave frozen sticks on high 1 - 1 1/2 minutes, or until hot.  Serve with guacamole and noodles.

title: Stir Fried Broccoli
ingredients: 2 cups broccoli | 1 -2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 2 tablespoons ghee or 2 tablespoons butter | 8 ounces tomato sauce | 3 tablespoons fish stock ( or stock cubes )
instructions: Cut and peel broccoli stalk, then cut into florets.  Place in a glass bowl, add turmeric, nutmeg, and ginger.  Mix all together.  Heat ghee or butter in a wok, add tomatoes and stir fry till they begin to soften, then add to the mixture.  Add fish stock and stir fry over high heat till it evaporates.  Turn off heat.  Add tomato mix to the wok.  Cover and serve.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,green bell pepper,hot chili pepper,garlic powder
title: Stir Fried Green Bell Peppers and Garlic in Chili Oil
ingredients: 1 small green bell pepper, finely chopped | 2 cloves garlic powder | 2 tablespoons fresh hot chili peppers, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons fresh red chili peppers, finely chopped | 1/2 cup chili oil or 1/2 cup other neutral flavored oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients together and mix well.  Heat oil in a small pan or deep fryer until hot but not smoking.  This is good served with fish or shrimp.  This is also good for chicken or shrimp.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,stewing beef,egg white,chicken bouillon powder,brown mustard seed
title: Crispy Yorkshire Pudding II
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs stewing beef | 3 teaspoons lemon juice | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon powder | 2 tablespoons brown mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons egg whites
instructions: Cut beef into 2 inch cubes.  Put cubes into microwave safe bowl, add lemon juice, chicken powder, mustard seeds and egg whites.  Microwave on high 3 minutes at a time stirring every 30 seconds until thickened into a creamy sauce.

Random Ingredients: heart palm,lasagna noodle,mascarpone cheese,squid,black peppercorn,fennel seed,baking potato,tortilla
title: Calamari and Seafood Lasagne
ingredients: 2 lbs baking potatoes, peeled and quartered | 8 ounces marinated squid, cleaned, cleaned and cut into pieces about 1/2 inch wide, about 1-inch long and 1/2 inch pieces | 1 lb small heart of palm, cleaned and cut into chunks about 1/2 cup | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon whole black peppercorn, lightly crushed | 9 large cooked lasagna noodles | 8 ounces mascarpone cheese, cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 12 corn tortillas
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f.  Place the baking potatoes in a dutch oven or dutch oven over medium heat.  Cover with water, bring to a boil, reduce the heat, and cook until tender, about 15 minutes.  Drain, cool to room temperature, and carefully scoop out the centers of the potatoes and then coarsely mash with a potato masher.  Transfer to a bowl and mix with squid, hearts of palm, fennel seeds, and peppercorns.  Spread 1/3 of the filling evenly over the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish, and arrange 1/3 of the noodles over the filling.  Cover with 1/3 of the filling and 3/3 of the crumb sauce.  Repeat layering, ending with the remaining crumbs and sauce.  Bake in the hot oven until lightly browned around the edges, 40 minutes to 1 hour, basting several times with any leftover filling while baking.  Meanwhile, make the tomato sauce.  To serve, place the tomato sauce in a small bowl and allow to stand, covered for a few minutes.  Serve the lasagne in a wide shallow bowl, top with tomato sauce, and garnish with corn tortilla strips, chopped green onions and sprigs of fresh parsley.

Random Ingredients: orange blossom water,marshmallow creme,red capsicum,chicken wing
title: Easy Chicken Drumsticks
ingredients: 1 can chicken wings, with skinned | 1/4 red capsicum, in chunks | 1/4 cup chocolate marshmallow creme | 1/4 cup orange blossom water
instructions: First take the chicken out of the fridge.  Place the wings in a microwave safe dish, skin side down.  Cover and heat on high until just starting to blacken a little.  Meanwhile, take red capsicum from microwave and cut it into chunks, set aside.  Add the chicken to the pan and add the chopped red capsicum, creme and 2 tablespoons orange blossom water.  Toss well.  Take lid off and cook for 2 minutes.  Serve immediately.  Note, chicken drumsticks may break apart if there isn't enough liquid to absorb.  You may need to add another 2 tablespoons of orange blossom water.  The chicken makes a nice presentation when served with fresh fruit, yoghurt, or yoghurt mixed with some chopped, crushed nuts as a garnish.  This dish goes well with fruit, and also goes well with chicken sticks, or vegetables.

title: Icelandic Bread Fingers
ingredients: 1 lb pumpernickel bread | 6 cups ice, crushed | chili oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Cut the pumpernickel into fingers about 1 thick or thinner.  Place the ice in a large bowl.  Dip into the ice in the ice.  Dip hands in the ice so as to form fingers that are about 1/4 thick.  Press enough ice into the ice to make it drip off the fingers and make them easy to handle.  Roll in the powdered chili oil.

title: Pumpkin Seeds (Mace)
ingredients: 500 raw pumpkin seeds, in pods | 2 1/2 cups caster sugar | ground mace
instructions: Place the seeds with the sugar and a little more water into a large frying pan.  Cook for about 25 - 30 minutes until the sugar dissolves.  When soft and well mixed.

title: Frijoles Charros-Style Beans
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 tablespoons shortening | 2 1/2 teaspoons bread machine yeast
instructions: Select the bread setting.  Stir the beans, shortening, and yeast together in a medium bowl until thoroughly combined.  Dump into the bread machine bucket that is lined with a lid.

title: The Most Famous Rosemary Chocolate
ingredients: 100 g dark chocolate | 2 sprigs fresh rosemary ( or 1 tsp dried )
instructions: Cut the chocolate squares into small pieces and melt them together with the rosemary stirring every so often until they have almost melted and have a consistency of melted ice.  Once all of the ingredients have blended and cooled off slightly pour them into a piping bag and pipe them into a long strip of piping bag in a star shaped shape or star shaped twist.  Wiggle the bag a few times to ensure it covers the entire baking tin.  Bake the semi cool chocolate strips in an oven until dark.

title: Beef & Macaroni
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground round | 1 cup elbow macaroni, cooked | 3 tablespoons white vinegar | 1/2 cup steak, shredded
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit.  Heat a nonstick, large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Sprinkle beef with salt and pepper and cook for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.  Stir in the macaroni and vinegar, lower the heat.  Cover and cook for 5 minutes or until heated through.  Place the beef mixture on a parchment or aluminum foil lined baking sheet.  Bake for 20 minutes or until heated through.  Stir to blend the meat juices and serve.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,red enchilada sauce,flour,caper,egg noodle
title: Egg Noodle Puttanesca
ingredients: 8 -10 ounces egg noodles | 1 tablespoon capers | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1/2 - 3/4 cup red enchilada sauce ( see recipe note ) | 4 tablespoons flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Boil water for egg noodles and set aside.  Add 1 tbs of capers and lemon juice to water and soak until white and tender, about 20 minutes or so.  Drain noodles with a slotted spoon so that the water does not drop.  In a 9x13 shallow roasting pan, mix 1 tbs of capers with 3 tbs of red enchilada sauce.  Stir to coat the pieces.  Coat with 1 tbs of flour if desired.  Place noodle in pan and toss to coat evenly.  Spread with remaining sauce.  Sprinkle with remaining capers, lemon zest and green onion.  Bake until slightly browned, about 50 - 60 minutes.  Note, if adding the sauce to the noodles rather than the noodles, use the reserved 1 tbs of capers as garnish instead of the lemon juice mixture.

title: Green Beans and Eggs (French Breakfast)
ingredients: 6 eggs | 1 can green beans, drain | 3/4 cup marinara sauce | 1 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Beat eggs well.  In a small frying pan, add beans.  Add mustard powder and cook 5 minutes.  Mix all in large frying pan until egg mixture starts to set.

title: Mexican Crispy Tortillas (Paprika)
ingredients: 3/4 teaspoon taco-flavored flour tortilla | paprika
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f.  Heat tortilla in a skillet on medium heat until golden brown, about 5 minutes per side.  Drain onto a paper towel lined baking sheet.  Spread a thin layer of low fat sour cream on each tortilla.  Sprinkle some paprika on top of the sour cream.  Place in the preheated oven until warmed through and lightly browned, about 3 minutes, or to desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: raspberry preserve,dark rum,garlic crouton,feta cheese,salt cod fish,onion powder
title: Basque Salt Cod
ingredients: 1 salt codfish, peeled | 1/2 cup dark rum | 3 cloves garlic croutons | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1 package feta cheese, crumbled | 2 tablespoons raspberry preserves, or as needed
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Cook cod in the boiling water until easily flaked with a fork, about 7 minutes.  Drain and let cool.  Remove skin, bones, and any bones from cod, and cut into bite sized pieces.  Discard bones and bones.  Place cod into a baking dish.  Pour rum over cod.  Sprinkle garlic croutons over cod.  Sprinkle onion powder over garlic croutons.  Gently pour cheese onto cod.  Cover dish, and refrigerate about 1 hour, until cod and flavors blend.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,red kidney bean,veal,ghee,rigatoni pasta,green tomato,beef stew meat
title: Beef, Veal and Black Cavatelli
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs veal stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 lb rigatoni pasta or 1 lb other short pasta | 1 can red kidney beans | 1 green tomato, chopped into 1 inch pieces | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh orange peel | 2 tablespoons fresh butter ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon ghee
instructions: In a large pot, cook meat, orange peel, green tomato and soup base in enough water to cover.  Simmer 5 minutes.  Meanwhile to finish.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,anchovy fillet,chuck,kalamata olive,oregano leaf,triple sec,urad dal,dark soy sauce
title: Stale House's Italian Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck ( in 1 3/4 inch dice ) or 2 lbs blade steaks, cut into 1 inch cubes, as preferred | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 2 anchovy fillets, minced | 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 3/4 cup serrano curd or 3/4 cup tri-colored sour cream | 3/4 cup urad dal, split lengthwise into 4 pieces ( soaked overnight in water ) | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | 1/2 cup pitted kalamata olives, sliced
instructions: Combine beef and soy sauce in bowl and marinate up to 2 days in refrigerator.  Heat oil in large dutch oven over high heat until smoking.  Add anchovies and cook until golden brown, about 15 seconds.  Pour in cream, reduce heat to medium low, and simmer 10 minutes, stirring often.  Add beef and simmer an additional 3 to 5 minutes.  Then stir in the curd, oregano, and olives and cook 5 minutes, stirring often.  Serve immediately.

title: Paprika-Wrapped Mushrooms and Asparagus
ingredients:
2 -4 tablespoons hungarian paprika | 24 large fresh asparagus or 24 fresh baby portabella mushroom caps, stems removed ( 3-5oz.
    - each ) | 3 1/2 ounces small cashews, finely coarsely chopped | 1 portabella mushroom cap, stem trimmed, cap cut lengthwise into 1/2-inch-thick wedges ( or use 2-4 oz.
    - cremini mushroom caps )
instructions: Adjust oven rack to center position and preheat oven to broil.  Coat large baking sheet with cooking spray.  Place mushrooms on baking sheet skin side up and sprinkle with paprika evenly over caps.  Top each mushroom with asparagus or baby mushrooms.  Broil mushrooms until mushrooms are lightly browned, about 12 minutes.

Random Ingredients: water,dill sprig,potato,tart apple,marjoram,garlic paste,plain yogurt,basil leaf
title: Bratwurst from Brussels
ingredients: 2 medium potatoes, peeled | 3 large tart apples, peeled, cored, sliced thin | 2 teaspoons garlic paste | 1/4 cup water | 1/2 cup plain yogurt or 1/2 cup greek yogurt | 1/4 cup diced fresh basil leaves | 2 teaspoons minced fresh marjoram | fresh dill sprig
instructions: Microwave potatoes on high 20 - 25 minutes or until tender.  Cool 1/2 hour.  Slice potatoes into 1/4 inch thick rounds.  Peel and slice apples.  Place potatoes on baking sheet with apples and cover with foil.  Bake 20 minutes at 370°f set aside to cool and continue to bake until done.  Meanwhile whisk yogurt, basil, marjoram and garlic paste together until blended well.  Add to yogurt mixture and heat through over low heat about 3 - 5 minutes.  Gently spoon yogurt mixture into a large platter, garnish with chopped dill, and serve with crispy potato rounds.

title: Roasted Cauliflower (Torta Di Cipolla)
ingredients: 6 medium romaano-stuffed potatoes | 2 medium cauliflower, cut into 1/4-inch-thick florets | 1 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 2 mace, crumbled | 4 tablespoons grated fresh romano cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 425°f cut ends off of potatoes and discard.  Place potatoes in 1 large, shallow roasting pan and toss with thyme and mace.  Bake 15 minutes or until tender.  Place cauliflower in a bowl with remaining potatoes, and toss with parmesan cheese.  Roast remaining potatoes in same roasting pan, stirring occasionally, until tender and lightly browned, 10 to 12 minutes.  Serve warm.

title: Grapefruit Almond Pudding
ingredients: 25 whole almonds | 2 quarts grapefruit juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Put almonds in a bowl.  Pour grapefruit juice over almonds.

Random Ingredients: red beet,ranch bean,berry,lettuce,fast rising yeast,pinto bean
title: Ranch Bean Crostini
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fast rising yeast | 6 -7 cups cooked pinto beans | 2 cups cooked red beets | 1/2 - 1 cup frozen mixed berries | 1/2 - 1 cup red beet, cooked and chopped | 3 cups shredded lettuce or 3 cups lettuce, for garnish
instructions: In large bowl, dissolve yeast and let stand 5 minutes to proof.  Add 5 cups beans, red beets, mixed berries, and chopped beets.  Stir to combine.  Let sit 10 minutes or until mixed.  Stir in remaining 3 cups beans and 1/2 cup lettuce.  Mix.

title: Pan-Fried Asparagus
ingredients: 24 stalks asparagus, trimmed | 1 tablespoon paprika
instructions: Cut tips off just the tips of the stalks and cut them into lengths about 12 inches long and 1/2 inch wide, cutting asparagus into a few 1/4 inch lengths all the way to the thickness of the asparagus.  Heat a wok over medium high and add 2 tablespoons of oil, swirling the wok to coat the sides.  Add the asparagus and sprinkle with paprika and cook until all the tips are bright green, about 5 minutes.  Remove and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: oregano,egg yolk,kaffir lime leaf,mini chocolate chip
title: Oregano Mousse
ingredients: 6 egg yolks | 1/4 cup mini chocolate chip | 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano | 3 kaffir lime leaves, torn ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon fresh oregano ( optional )
instructions: Break yolks into a bowl of a double boiler or saucepan of simmering water for two minutes or until thickened slightly.  Remove from heat.

title: Hot and Cold Beet Belly and Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 4 slices baked tofu, cut into 6 squares 1/8 inch thick, then flaked | 8 -12 large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 8 -12 ladyfingers, split | 8 oranges, juice of | 6 tablespoons orange juice | 2 bell peppers, minced | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds
instructions: Arrange tofu on a cutting board.  Place shrimp on top of the tofu and press out as much excess liquid as possible.  Place shrimp in a bowl with 2 tbsp orange juice and 1 tbsp orange juice.  Gently combine the ingredients, set aside.  Arrange 3 - 4 shrimp over the base of 2 lettuce leaves and top with the tofu and a few sprouts of orange juice and a sprinkling of sesame seeds.  Garnish with green onion if desired.  Cover with plastic wrap and press down lightly.  Cover and let stand in refrigerator for 2 hours or up to 3 days, stirring every now and then to prevent sticking.

title: Cherry Banana Confit Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated crescent rolls | 2 slices prosciutto | 1/4 cup sliced cremini mushrooms | 1/4 cup chopped banana pepper | 1 can refrigerated crescent rolls | 1 teaspoon lemon extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Unroll 1 can of crescent rolls, and separate the dough into rectangles.  Press each rectangle into the palm of your hand to seal the long edges.  Reserve the other can of crescents and squares for the tops of the sandwiches.  Place the crescents in the middle of the rectangles, and place on a baking sheet.  Toast in the preheated oven 1 minute per side, cut each sandwich in half, and arrange on a preheated baking sheet.  Bake in the preheated oven until puffed and golden brown, about 25 minutes.  Remove, and set on a serving platter.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,lemon juice,active yeast,chicken thigh,baking powder,ladyfinger,water
title: Lemon Biscuits
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1 cup warm water | 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 cup plain cheddar cheese | 8 ounces uncooked skinned and boneless chicken thighs | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder | 1/2 lb ladyfingers, split
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, dissolve yeast in 1 cup of the warm water.  Stir in 1 cup of the cheddar and all of the other ingredients.  Let stand, stirring once or twice, 10 - 15 minutes or until smooth.  Place in a greased 9x13 baking dish.  Cover loosely with plastic wrap and place in a warm draft free place until doubled in height.  Let rise until doubled in size, about 45 to 55 minutes.  Punch dough down and knead on a floured surface until smooth.  Cut dough into 16 equal portions.  Roll each bit to an 8x8 rectangle.  Cut into 2 inch squares.  Place 1 1/2 tablespoons of the remaining cheddar in the center of each square.  Fold corners over.  Place 2 tablespoons of each in the center of each square.  Moisten with cold water.  Fold ends to seal.  Cover and let rise until puffy, about 2 hours.  Preheat oven to 400°f.  Bake 40 - 50 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Bread Bread Filled With Ripe Hard-Boiled Eggs
ingredients: 4 cups bread, cut into 12 slices ( white ) | 4 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and quartered
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400.  Place bread slices on baking sheet and bake until golden, about 8 minutes.  Cool and discard the crust.  Place 2 eggs on each slice of bread and top with half of the hard boiled eggs.  Bake until eggs are set, about 10 to 15 minutes.  Serve and enjoy.

title:
Roast Beef and Lamb - 2 Pts.
    - (Tenderloin) for 2
ingredients: 1 lb lamb, cut in 1-inch cubes | 1/2 lb pork tenderloin | 1/4 pint cherry tomatoes, halved | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Place lamb and pork in a roasting tin of boiling water.  Boil for approximately 20 minutes, uncovered.  Drain the meat and return them to the roasting tin.  Put on the cherry tomatoes. title: Leek Frites
ingredients: 12 large leeks | 1 lb marinara sauce or 1 lb homemade marinara sauce
instructions: Clean the leeks throughly and cut off the tops of the white stalks.  Cut the leeks into quarters lengthwise.  Wash them thoroughly in a sink full of salt water.  Wash the leeks thoroughly again inside and out and rub the outside with a little olive oil.  Cut off most of the white membrane.  You can use any leek you like.  Place leeks in boiling water a few at a time, until tender to the point where you can no longer see the tops, but the leeks are easy to peel.  Do not trim the leeks as they are very difficult to remove if cooked too long.  You need at least a 1½ centimeter layer at each end of the stem.  When you are finished layering all three leeks, trying one at a time, in rows on a large, square slab.  Spread about ¾ cup of prepared marinara sauce on top of the leeks.  Lay the remaining leeks on top, so the leeks don't touch each other.  Put on the cover of the square slab with a light layer of the marinara sauce covering the leeks.  Press tightly and tightly to compact the leeks and marinara sauce.  Warm a heavy, flameproof casserole dish, covered with a layer of kitchen towels, on the stove top, over medium heat.  When the pan is hot, put in the leeks, pouring enough hot water over them to come halfway up the side of the pan.  Bring to a boil, then cover with two layers of kitchen towels and simmer on a low heat for about one hour until the leeks are very soft and tender.  You may have to turn the pan a couple of times during the cooking.  Serve with polenta or mash.

title: Vegan Fajitas
ingredients: 1 pears, pared, cored and chopped | 1 tablespoon low-sodium picante sauce or 1 tablespoon hot picante sauce | 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/4 teaspoon dried red pepper flakes | 2 -3 teaspoons vanilla sugar | 4 ounces waffle ( plain or flavored ) | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the pears, picante sauce, 1/2 tsp of chiles and the thyme and pepper flakes.  Mix well.  Spread mixture evenly in a foil lined or microwavable baking dish.  Heat the waffle iron in the microwave for 5 minute or until heated.  When the waffle iron is hot, carefully place an even amount of the fajita mixture onto the iron, close lid, and cook until the fajita is hot.  When all of the fajita mixture has been taken from the iron, top with the chopped thyme.  You may need to cook each fajita to get them soft and crunchy, but this step may not take very long.

title: Homemade Mixed Oven Chips
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon dried fenugreek seeds | 2 teaspoons horseradish
instructions: Sprinkle the cumin powder all over the surface of the chips.  Sprinkle the fenugreek flakes all over.  Melt the horseradish in the microwave, about 5 minutes.

title: Yum Yum - Vietnamese Fried Rice
ingredients: 5 cups cooked rice or 5 cups cooked rice ( 16-20 minute to rice ) | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 tablespoon tequila | 5 ounces bean sprouts ( fresh )
instructions: Whisk fry pan ingredients together.

title: Chocolate Chokolate Tomato Cake
ingredients: 4 -6 cups ripe italian tomatoes ( or 2 pounds canned italian tomatoes ) | 6 tablespoons caster sugar | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 1/2 cups oil
instructions: Chop the tomatoes into pieces about 2 inches long.  Add all the other ingredients, mix everything well and place the cake in the freezer for at least 2 hours but not as long as overnight.  Slide the cake onto a plate with a flat plate on top to cool.  Serve cut in bite sized pieces and serve.

title: Chinese Pickled Cucumbers - Dan Mung
ingredients: 1 large cucumber, peeled | dark soy sauce ( kikkoman is good )
instructions: Slice the cucumbers thinly.  Lay cucumbers on a baking tray, cut side up.  Drizzle dark soy sauce over the top and sprinkle with dark soy sauce.  Chill or at least one hour before serving so the dark soy sauce doesn't lose all its shine.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,grain dijon mustard,lime zest,tarragon vinegar,arborio rice,vanilla bean,apple juice
title: Apple and Treacle Dipping Sauce for Rice
ingredients: 3 cups apple juice | 4 tablespoons dried arborio rice or 4 tablespoons arborio rice | 4 tablespoons fish sauce ( nam pla ) | 3 tablespoons long-grain dijon mustard ( such as grey poupon or similar ) | 3 teaspoons tarragon vinegar | 1 vanilla bean, scraped, seeds scraped, and scraped | 1/2 teaspoon lime zest, freshly grated
instructions: Combine the apple juice with the 1 tbls, mustard, tarragon vinegar, vanilla bean seeds, and lime zest in a small saucepan and heat gently until the liquid and spices are just beginning to simmer, but don’t let it boil.  Remove the pan from the heat.  Let cool until just warm, then refrigerate until chilled, at least 3 hours.  Store in an air tight container.  For a grainier dish, chill the cooking liquid in a small saucepan for 1 minute, then strain and reserve.  For serving, place the cooked rice into a serving bowl or individual serving cups, pour the warmed apple juice over the rice, and top with a few drops of treacle to taste.  For a more pronounced taste, chill until ready to serve.  Make ahead if using the sour cream in any quantity, allow the rice to cool until cold, then refrigerate.

title: Persian Oat and Parsnip Pudding
ingredients: 8 ounces quick-cooking rolled oats | 1 lb parsnip, peeled and cut into quarters cross-wise | 1 lb russet potato, peeled and cut into 1 inch chunks | 4 lbs shallots, halved and thinly sliced | 1/2 vanilla bean, split, scraped and split lengthwise | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom seeds
instructions: Scatter the oats evenly in a shallow 1 1/2 quart pan.  Stir the parsnips and potatoes with 2 tablespoons of the shallots, the vanilla bean and cardamom in 3 to 4 layers of cheesecloth.  Pour the water from the vanilla bean into the pan.  Bring to a boil over moderate heat.  Scatter on the remaining shallots and simmer for about 20 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender but not mushy.  Transfer to a serving dish and chill.  Cover with plastic wrap and keep warm.  Raise the heat over high heat and boil the pudding gently until the liquid is almost evaporated, about 25 minutes.  Transfer to a bowl and beat in 2 tablespoons of fresh cream, a little at a time, to make a pudding like consistency.  Serve at once.

title: Mango Delight (Vietnamese Carrot Pancakes)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable shortening | 1 carrot, shredded | 1/2 pound fresh bean sprouts | 1 mango, peeled and sliced
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable shortening and a matchstick vegetable peeler in a skillet over medium heat for about 15 seconds.  Stir in 1 carrot.  Spread bean sprouts and mango slices in the skillet.

Random Ingredients: green chili,tomato paste,lasagna noodle,genoa salami,caesar salad dressing
title: Mom's Hot And-Tasty Lasagna
ingredients: 10 fresh lasagna noodles | 4 ounces genoa salami, sliced thinly ( about 11 slices ) | 2 packages caesar salad dressing | 1 can tomato paste or ( 32 ounce ) packet ketchup | 1 small green chili, chopped, for topping ( i like jalapeno or serrano )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°.  Line two baking sheets with aluminum foil, parchment paper or parchment paper.  Spread each of the noodles out on the baking sheets.  Spread each noodle with dressing, leaving 1 tablespoon in the bottom of each dish.  Divide filling among the noodles, and top with chilies.  Cut slits in the top of each dish with a razor blade or sharp knife using an old bay that has a little bit of casing on it.  Bake 45 minutes, until edges are crusty and edges are dark.  Remove the pan from the oven, and turn the noodle up on the rack.  Return the pan to the oven, and cook another 15 - 20 minutes.  The bottom layer should just be dark and the top layer should be beginning to brown.  Enjoy.

title: Spanish Beans II
ingredients: 4 cans baked beans, drained, liquid reserved | 1 can tomato paste | 3/4 cup golden brown sugar | 1/2 cup dry sherry, such as heinz
instructions: In a large pot, mix beans, tomato paste and remaining bean liquid.  Bring to a boil over medium high heat, then reduce heat to medium low and continue cooking, stirring occasionally, until thickened, about 30 minutes.  Stir in sugar and return to a boil.  Reduce heat to low and cook 20 minutes.  Transfer the baked beans to bowls and ladle hot sauce on top.

Random Ingredients: seafood seasoning,garlic clove,italian parsley,oil,chili pepper flake,white onion
title: Fish Poleko
ingredients: 2 pieces white onions | 1 chili pepper | 1 garlic clove | 1/4 cup italian parsley | 1/4 teaspoon crushed chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon oil | 2 lbs fresh fish fillets ( or 2 pounds frozen )
instructions: In a wok or skillet, melt 1 tablespoon oil over medium heat.  Stir fry onions, fresh chili pepper and garlic until lightly golden.  Add the italian parsley, crushed chili pepper and fish.  Stir fry for a minute or two or until the fish is barely cooked.  Serve over rice.

title: Smoor-Style Pheasant
ingredients: 2 large poblano chiles | 1 tablespoon roasted red chile | 1/2 pound ground lean pork
instructions: Preheat a grill for high heat.  Char grill poblanos over hot coals or on the grate, turning frequently, until well charred and charred, 5 to 7 minutes.  Transfer poblanos with tongs onto a plate.  Cover poblanos with a tea towel and let drain 30 minutes.  Cut chiles into 1/4 inch thick slices, discarding any stems, and set aside.  Grill peppers over direct heat, turning frequently until skins are charred all over, about 5 minutes.  Transfer chiles to a bowl and cover loosely with a tea towel to keep warm.  Bring a pot of water to a boil.  Cook skin until it flakes easily with a fork, about 5 minutes.  Drain chiles briefly and pat with paper towels.  Transfer to a bowl and let drain 30 minutes.  Transfer chiles to a work surface and mash until coarsely ground.  Add chile pulp, ground pork and roasted red chiles and mix thoroughly.  Form mixture into 8 small patties.  Grill burgers over direct heat, skin side down, just until nicely marked, 1 to 2 minutes per side.

title: Mexican Bread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 jar pimientos, drained and chopped | 1 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.  Add the pimentos, cover, and cook until soft, about 5 minutes.  Remove the cover, pour in the cheese, and stir.  Slice bread into 1 inch thick rounds and serve.

Random Ingredients: turkey breast,white bean,part mozzarella cheese,russet potato,poblano pepper,greek oregano
title: Turkey and White Bean Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs russet potatoes ( about 1 medium ) | 1 1/4 lbs ground turkey breast | 1 tablespoon all purpose greek oregano | 1 jar drained white beans, rinsed and dried | 1 medium poblano pepper ( medium strength ) | 4 1/4 ounces small whole wheat lasagna sheets | 1 package part-skim mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees.  Remove peel and coarse fibers from potatoes and cut into 2 inch chunks.  Place potatoes in a large saucepan or dutch oven over low heat, cover and cook stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender, about 20 minutes.  Stir in turkey, oregano and half of beans, breaking up any clumps.  Cook breaking up turkey with a spoon until turkey is no longer pink drain turkey mixture.  Set aside.  Spread 1 cup turkey mixture evenly over the bottom of a 2 quart glass baking dish or casserole.  Cut remaining green olives into 1/4 inch wide strips, about 1/4 cup each.  Layer lasagna sheets over turkey mixture starting with pasta, then sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup turkey mixture, sprinkle with mozarella.  Bake, uncovered, until bottom layer is lightly browned, about 40 minutes.  Let stand for 10 minutes, cut into squares.

Random Ingredients: green chile,mango chutney,chili paste,poblano chile,red wine,curry powder,pineapple juice,rye bread
title: Indian Breakfast Sandwiches for a Crowd
ingredients: 3/4 cup pineapple juice | 3/4 cup dry red wine or 3/4 cup white wine vinegar, divided | 3/4 cup mango chutney | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1 minced green chile ( optional ) | 1/2 cup poblano chile ( optional ) | 10 slices rye bread ( thin cut )
instructions: Combine pineapple juice and the remaining ingredients.  Pour over the bread slices, sprinkle top with a little paprika if desired.

title: Italian Grilled Chicken Wraps
ingredients: 2 cups shredded iceberg lettuce | 1/2 lb country-style cooked chicken tenders | 4 slices prosciutto
instructions: Lay out lettuce on cutting board and with knife cut down length of one side of each leaf cutting through to create 2 strips of lettuce.  Remove from cutting board and cut chicken lengthwise into strips, then lengthwise into strips.  Stack these strips over sliced lettuce, then slice across one strip to completely enclose the chicken.  Place wrapped chicken strips on a foil lined heavy baking sheet.  Broil at 400 degrees fahrenheit until browning just slightly.  Let cool.  Remove from heat and unwrap foil, leaving a 1/4 inch to 1/2 inch margin on all sides.  Using spatula cut chicken strips crosswise into thin strips with scissors.  Brush with remaining marinade.  Serve hot or at room temperature.

title: A Farewell to Nasi Lemak Plaki (Chawalmi Subsiti)
ingredients: 6 cabbage leaves ( i use large leaf ) | 2 tablespoons green chilies | 3 tablespoons soya sauce
instructions: Boil cabbage leaves in water for 3 minutes.  Drain and set aside.  Cut off the center core of the cabbage leaves, allowing it to be removed from each individual leaf when removed.  Chop each cabbage leaf into quarters.  Put the green chillies into a mortar or blender with soya sauce.  Grind finely.  If necessary, add water to obtain an even consistency.  Put the mixture in a serving dish and sprinkle the cabbage leaves with more green chillies.

title: Lime Dipping Sauces for Cactus Chips or Chips
ingredients: 1 can enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup potato starch | 1/4 cup limeade concentrate ( such as squirt or similar product ) | salt and pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a container with a lid.  Place in the refrigerator.  When ready to serve, remove from the refrigerator and wait for an hour before dipping.

title: Scallop Burgers With Mexican Rice
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons uncooked whole-grain semolina | 4 hamburger buns ( or pumpernickel bread ) | 1/4 cup alfalfa sprout ( or spinach leaves, or mixed greens ) | 4 ounces thinly sliced cooked ham ( thinly sliced deli style ) | 4 ounces sliced smoked haddock ( about 8 ounces ) | 1 jar salsa, heated
instructions: Preheat your grill.  Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl except for the salsa, stirring gently to mix well.  Taste, adjust seasoning, and add salsa as needed to moisten the mixture.  If using pumpernickel bread, toast the bread according to your bread machine's instructions, or spread the mixture on toasted side of toast.  Spread more salsa on toasted side of each bun, and top with the hamburger mixture.  Serve on the toasted side with fresh salsa.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,edamame,peanut oil,mint sprig,vanilla bean,allspice
title: Fresh Minted Edamame and Peanuts
ingredients: 1 cup shelled edamame ( raw weight ) | 1 1/2 cups peanut oil | 1/4 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 whole allspice | 2 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint sprigs | 1 large vanilla bean
instructions: Make your pick a big enough for the sesame oil, and add the mints.  Slice the vanilla bean in half lengthwise.  Slice the vanilla bean into 4 pieces.  Peel the skin off the ginger root.  Dice the peeled vanilla bean into tiny matchstick pieces.  Peel the waxed paper and cut it into about four pieces.  Combine the edamame and peas and microwave for about three minutes.  Use tongs to turn the peas.  Toss the peas with the sesame oil.  Stir to thoroughly coat the peas.  Cover, remove the cover, and cook for 2 - 3 minutes until your peas are just slightly tender, but not mushy.  Move the peas to a serving dish and sprinkle with the chopped mint.  Serve immediately.  Note, you do not have to microwave the edamame, but you can just steam it for a few seconds.  The edamame can be made ahead and frozen at this point, or refrigerated overnight.  Note, if you microwave it for the first part of a grilling or frying, you may want to use just one of the following methods, place in a saucepan with water to cover and cook until tender, about 5 minutes or so.  Drain in a strainer, then cover with cold water and let stand for at least 10 minutes to remove the starch.  This should only take a few minutes, and you should be able to easily mash this with your hands, not a blender but a potato masher.

title: Yorkshire Bread Crumble (Bread Muffins) Welsh

instructions: Preheat the oven to 220c/425f/gas rub the bread slices with melted butter.  Sprinkle salt and pepper into their bread crumbs then top each slice with some of the bread crumbs.
