Random Ingredients: red chilies,white corn,red bell pepper,green chili pepper,pesto sauce,celery rib,cake flour,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Corn and Pesto Cake
ingredients: 2 corn, fresh or frozen, thawed | 2 teaspoons sweet mixed spice ( mccormick's pesto and chilli blend ) | 3 cups fresh flat-leaf italian parsley, leaves washed and trimmed | 5 celery ribs, diced small | 2 -4 hot red chilies, chopped | 1 green chili pepper, seeded and chopped | 1/2 red bell pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons cake flour | 1 cup prepared pesto sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 400f degrees.  In a food processor, or blender, whirl together all ingredients until well blended and set aside.  Spread mixture into a 10 inch springform pan.  Bake 25 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: spinach leaf,whipping cream,green lentil,porcini mushroom,beef broth,spring onion,cider vinegar
title: Lentil, Mushroom & Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 3/4 cup green lentil | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon grated fresh porcini mushrooms | 2 spring onions, finely chopped or 3 green onions, finely chopped diagonally | 300 ml beef broth or 300 ml chicken broth | 150 g spinach leaves | 1/2 cup whipping cream
instructions: Rinse lentils and pout on to absorb any excess water.  Mix together vinegar, porcinis and spring onions and place them in a deep sided pan or wok.  Add the broth, cover and simmer for about fifteen minutes.  Add the lentils and heat through, about 5 minutes.  Stir in mushrooms.  Cook until just beginning to soften, then stir in the spinach, cooking just until wilted.

title: Asian Shrimp Alfredo
ingredients: 1 jar alfredo sauce, warmed | 1/3 cup ketchup | 2 teaspoons fresh ginger, minced | 1 teaspoon asian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon toasted sesame oil | cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Spoon warmed alfredo sauce, ketchup, ginger, italian seasoning, and sesame oil into a shallow serving dish.  Arrange cherry tomatoes over sauce.  Garnish with reserved toasted sesame oil.

title: Spinach Cheese Tart
ingredients: 1 prepared double crust pie | 2 packages fresh baby spinach leaves, washed | 2 tablespoons raisins
instructions: Heat oven to 450 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Spread spinach over one third of the prepared pie crust.  Sprinkle spinach with raisins.  Cover with remaining crust, pressing edges together.  Press a piece of parchment onto the edges.  Cut steam vents in the top crust.  Bake in preheated oven until crust is golden brown, 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Grilled Chicken and Kebabs
ingredients: 1 pint pear, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 pint ketchup | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 8 chicken thighs
instructions: In a large bowl, gently combine the pear chunks with the ketchup and fennel seeds.  Pour the contents of the bowl onto the chicken pieces and allow to marinate for at least 1 hour.  Grill the chicken over medium hot coals or under a hot broiler for 10 minutes each side, brushing with the marinade while cooking.

Random Ingredients: ear corn,almond extract,queso fresco,arborio rice,italian bread,chicken leg
title: Garlic Almond Stuffed Chicken Legs
ingredients: 8 chicken legs ( about 3 pounds ) | 2 cups arborio rice ( about 1/2 cup ) | 3 tablespoons anise extract | 1/4 lb queso fresco, crumbled | 2 cups sliced almonds, unblanched roasted in a frying pan | arugula or fresh curly-leaf parsley, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Rinse off the outside of the chicken legs, but do not remove the skin.  Remove the strings at the bottom on each leg, leaving about 1/2 inch at each end and just a little of both end exposed.  Rinse lightly and gently pat dry with paper towels.  In a medium mixing bowl, mix together the rice, extract and cheese with 1/2 cup of the almonds.  Place the other 1/2 cup on top of the cheese in a large, deep sauté over medium low to medium low heat.  When the cheese is starting to melt, remove it from the heat.  Spread the almonds on the underside of the breast halves.  Turn the skin side up and add a good 1/4 cup of the rice mixture into the middle of the breast.  Fold each end of the underside over the rice, and roll up into a cylinder about 1/4 inch thick.  Transfer the chicken legs to a plate, cover loosely with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 5 hours and up to 12 hours, rearranging the legs several times with your hands to ensure even, even coating and even distribution of the rice mixture and almonds.

title: Crunchy Oats
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 1/2 cup old fashioned oats | 1 can vegetable broth | 1 1/2 teaspoons canola oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Place the cumin in a small skillet over medium heat and cook, swirling the pan, until it is fragrant and starts to darken, about 1 minute.  Add the oats, stir and toast the mixture, stirring frequently, until golden, about 3 minutes.  Add the broth and oil, bring to a boil, then reduce the temperature to low and cook for 5 minutes more.  Serve warm.

title:

ingredients: 2 ounces pearl barley, broken into small pieces | 10 -12 ounces fresh cranberries
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan or pot and cook over low heat for 2 to 3 hours or just until the barley is soft.  Serve with your favorite ice cream and fresh fruit.

title: Pizza Toss
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon light yoghurt or 1 -1 1/2 tablespoon sour cream | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1 pinch seasoning salt
instructions: Mix well.  Serve on pita bread for dipping.  We recommend topping it with salsa and salsa verde, and a bit of cheese, and use it on pizza with salads and tomato slices as well.

Random Ingredients: fennel bulb,orange juice zest,mayonnaise,baking potato,kaffir lime leaf
title: Fennel and Lime Potato Salad With Mayonnaise
ingredients: 4 1/2 ounces baking potatoes, peeled, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 6 1/2 ounces fennel bulbs, trimmed, halved and cut into 1/4 inch slices | 3/4 cup orange juice, juice and zest of | 1/3 cup mayonnaise | 1 kaffir lime leaf, cut into thin strip
instructions: Place the potatoes in a mixing bowl and cover with cold water.  Set aside for 30 minutes or until tender. .  Drain and return potatoes to the skillet, add the fennel, orange juice, mayonnaise and lime leaves.  Mix well and season with salt and pepper.  Pour over the vegetables and serve.

title: Cafe Au Lait (A French Coffee With White Pepper)
ingredients: 1 1/2 liters brewed coffee ( regular or organic preferred ) | white pepper ( optional )
instructions: Mix together finely.  Add white pepper to taste.

title: Easy Saffron Macaroni
ingredients: 3 cups elbow macaroni ( uncooked ) | 2 cups broth, warmed | 1/4 cup orange juice ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon saffron threads | 2 tablespoons apple cider ( optional )
instructions: Cook noodles in the broth with saffron and orange juice.  Drain.  Add saffron oil to skillet of stewing stewed macaroni.  Cook for 5 minutes or until macaroni has browned slightly.  Add macaroni to stewed sauce.  Add more saffron oil.  Add cider.  Serve hot.

title: Raspberry Cheddar Spread
ingredients: 8 ounces cheddar cheese, grated | 15 tablespoons raspberry jam | 1/2 cup apple, coarsely chopped | 1 ounce butterscotch chips, grated
instructions: Blend the cheese and jam in a food processor until smooth and creamy.  Stir in the apple and butterscotch chips.

Random Ingredients: italian sausage,pistachio nut,pepperoni,vegetable oil cooking spray,avocado,nonfat plain yogurt,coconut,asparagus
title: Coconut-Asparagus Sausage Patties
ingredients: 1/2 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 1/2 lbs bulk italian sausage | 1 lb fresh asparagus, steamed | 1 1/2 tablespoons shredded unsweetened grated coconut | 2 teaspoons chopped pistachio nuts | 4 slices pickled pepperoni | 8 slices pickled avocado
instructions: Prepare grill for medium high heat.  Combine yogurt, oil and 1 teaspoons salt in a medium bowl.  Mix well to combine.  Combine asparagus, coconut, pistachios, remaining salt and pepperoni in a large bowl.  Place one patty on a sprayed grill pan.  Place a second patty under grill and grill until browned, 5 - 7 minutes per side.  Cut into 6 wedges.  Remove and rest on cutting board.  Cut out the center of each wedge and serve with salsa and fresh avocado.

title: Tuna Corned Beef
ingredients: 200 g tuna in water, drained | 2 teaspoons caster sugar | 1 beef brisket
instructions: Combine fish, sugar and 2 tbsp of water in a dish, cover and refrigerate for 1 hour.  Preheat grill to high.  Brush the brisket with some of the remaining liquid.  Grill brisket, uncovered, for 3 - 5 minutes on each side or until cooked.  Serve with remaining sauce.

title: Cashew and Zucchini Calzones
ingredients: 1 medium zucchini | 1/8 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 3/4 cup cashews
instructions: Cut zucchini lengthwise into ¼ inch thick slices and place it in a colander, sprinkle with ½ teaspoon salt, and let drain for 10 minutes.  Then cut them in half, then cut the pieces in half again, and finally in ½ inch chunks.  Coarsely chop the cashews and set aside.  Heat a nonstick skillet over moderate heat and add 1/4 teaspoon Tabasco and 1/4 teaspoon chili powder.  Add the cashews and nuts and fry, stirring constantly, until golden.  Turn off the heat and add the zucchini back to the skillet and fry, stirring frequently, until golden again.  Serve hot.

title: Bunuelos (Portuguese Vegetable Pancakes)
ingredients: 16 ounces fresh rice noodles, cooked, drained and rinsed | 1 package frozen broccoli florets, thawed | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1 cup salsa con cuadre ( see ingredient note ) | 24 ounces mesclun ( see advocaat ) | 3/4 cup self-rising flour
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f grease and flour an 8x8 inch pan.  Place drained noodles and broccoli on a cutting board and slice to about 1/2 inch thickness.  Place rice noodles and broccoli in a mixing bowl and cover with boiling water.  Allow to sit 10 seconds to blanch the noodles, then drain and toss with the vinegar and salsa con cuadre.  Transfer to a sprayed skillet and cook over medium low heat 10 to 12 minutes, stirring frequently.  Transfer to the prepared pan and spread evenly.  In a large bowl, stir the flour with 1/4 cup water.  Add to the vegetable mixture and continue to stir 5 or 6 times to bring the mixture together.  Spread the batter evenly into the pan.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown.  Cool 1 minute in the pan and turn out onto a board that has been coated with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: ice,red pepper,garlic salt,cooking apple,taco seasoning mix,lemon zest,tofu
title: Apple Tuna Spread
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu, crumbled | 3 cups crushed ice | 3 tablespoons taco seasoning mix | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 cup chopped cooking apples
instructions: Place tofu in a large bowl.

title: Mango-White Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 cups drained canned white beans | 1 mango - peeled, seeded and cubed | 2 ripe tomatoes | 1/4 cup rum | 1/4 cup brandy
instructions: Toss white beans and mango together in a bowl.  Place tomatoes and brandy in a small saucepan over medium low heat, and heat until heated through, about 2 minutes.  Pour rum over the tomatoes to serve.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,bay leaf,brandy,phyllo pastry,part ricotta cheese,corn,veal
title: Picante Meat Pies With Phyllo Chips
ingredients: 2 cans whole milk ground veal | 2 ounces canned corn, drained well | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 1 bay leaf | veal pieces or chicken | 8 sheets phyllo pastry | 1/2 cup part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese, grated
instructions: In a bowl, combine the ground veal with half the picante sauce, bay leaf and 1/2 cup of water.  Cover and chill 1 hour.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place a layer of phyllo neatly in a large baking pan on the bottom, then pour a thin layer of sauce over each.  Spread ricotta over the phyllo and top with remaining phyllo.  Cover with a sheet of phyllo and place another sheet on top of this.  Repeat 2 times with rest of ingredients.  Pour more sauce over the phyllo until all the dough is used.  Sprinkle with grated mozzarella and bake in a 400 degree oven 45 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Eggplant With Strawberries and Braggs
ingredients: 2 large eggplants ( about 1 pound each ) or 2 medium eggplants ( about 1 pound each ) | 2 tablespoons braggs liquid aminos, to taste | 1/4 cup thinly sliced green onion, divided | fresh strawberry, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f.  Rinse eggplants and cut into quarters lengthwise.  If large, slice across and cut quarters into 6 slices.  Place in a lightly oiled shallow baking dish and cover with foil.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until tender.

title: Nogado (Stewed Soybeans)
ingredients: 1 lb fresh soybeans | 1 cup beef drippings | 5 slices american cheese
instructions: Clean soybeans and soak at least overnight.  The soaking method is the easiest way to do this.  Put them in a pot with enough hot water to cover them by 2 inches.  Add the drippings and cook for 3 hours.  The water should be so hot that they can be skimmed off by now, so add more.  Drain and serve with crumbled cheese on top.

title: Spiced Edamame and Veggie Sandwich
ingredients: 1 small eggplant, sliced lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices | 1 cup frozen mixed vegetables, thawed ( zucchini, cauliflower, onions and broccoli ) | 12 curry leaves | 15 slices swiss cheese | 6 large eggs | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon piri-piri, sauce ( caribbean spice islands spice islands spice islands spice islands ) | fresh strawberries, sliced and blanched in hot tomato-based sauce
instructions: Heat a nonstick 12 inch nonstick skillet over high heat until hot.  Arrange eggplant slices in a single layer in the skillet.

title: Papeles Con Poblanos
ingredients: 2 lbs poblano chiles | 3 tablespoons corn oil | 4 tablespoons orange juice concentrate
instructions: Clean and clean the poblanos and remove seeds and stems.  Rinse well in clean, hot tap water.  Make sure the chiles are completely covered by the water.  Place them directly over the fire and char on all sides for about 5 minutes.  Turn only once and continue charring until dark brown on all sides.  While the chiles are charring, heat the oil in a large skillet.  When it is good and hot, remove the chiles from the fire and add them to the skillet with 1 tablespoon of the oil per chile. title: Guatemalan Girl Tiramisu
ingredients: 3 large eggs ( separated ) | 4 star anise | 2 fresh sage leaves ( chopped ) | 2 teaspoons anise seeds ( whole | 1 tablespoon green food coloring ( or to taste ) | 1 lb fresh ladyfinger ( about 25 ladyfingers ) | 3 tablespoons guacamole ( to taste )
instructions: In a medium bowl beat egg whites till stiff but not dry, 3 - 5 minute, gradually beat in yolks all at once, a total of 3 minute.  Set aside. Fold in 1/3 egg yolk with a rubber spatula.  Spread 1/2 of the egg batter into the middle of a parchment lined cake pan, leaving 1/2 inch margin of edge on each side of the pan.  Invert a pallet knife under the ladyfingers to ease them out.  Spread 2 tablespoons of guacamole over the batter smoothing it out with your fingers.  With the pallet knife, trace 1 or 2 lines on the guacamole for shine and look, and sprinkle the ladyfingers with the rest of the guacamole.  Carefully lift the ladyfingers from the parchment covered pan with the spatula, dragging them gently along the pallet until the entire surface of the cake is coated with guacamole. .  Remove the pan from the oven.  Let the cake stand for 2 minutes, then using a paring knife, loosen it.  Carefully slide in the ladyfingers, and using the spatula, poke the cake with both the pallet pans at 1 or 2 places to tighten them, rearranging them invert the pan and removing the ladyfingers.  Serve warm, or at room temperature.  Refrigerate leftovers to use as needed.

title: Apple and Saffron Hot Pot

instructions: Pour enough boiling water over the saffron strand in a frying pan to cover it completely.  Heat the saffron mixture, stirring occasionally until reduced to 1½ - 2 tablespoons.  Add the saffron vegetable stock to the heated stock.  Add the apple slices and continue cooking over a high heat, stirring gently.  Reduce the heat, cover and simmer gently for 15 - 20 mins or until the apples are tender.

title: Betsy's Beef Bolognese
ingredients: 1 package of dry lentils | 3 lbs stew meat | 4 cans apple juice | 1 lb ground veal
instructions: Simmer over a low heat for 4 hours.  While this is cooking up, saute the stew meat and beef together over a medium to high heat.  After the 4 hours it should be falling apart.  Remove meat and set aside to cool.  Skim fat off the top and discard.  Then, put the cooked lentils back in the pot.  Add the apple juice and veal.  Stir everything up and simmer until lentils are soft.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,spinach leaf,pepperoni,basil,ice cube,green mango,ketchup
title: Phenomenal Salad With Ginger
ingredients: 1 box graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup ketchup | 2 lbs frozen spinach leaves | 1 lb green mango, peeled and finely chopped | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh basil | 8 ounces pepperoni, sliced and drained | ice cube, for serving ( optional )
instructions: Combine the graham cracker crumbs and ketchup in a bowl.  Add the spinach leaves and let stand for about 5 minutes.  Add the mango and basil and combine, then add cubed pepperoni.  Serve in individual bowls, with ice cubes if you want.

title: Filet Mignon Teriyaki
ingredients: 4 filet mignon | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 2 tablespoons irish cream
instructions: Marinate 8 to 24 hours.  Heat pan with ketchup until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: tomato juice,cherry,couscous,tomato,green chilies,tomato puree,pasta,self raising flour
title: Tasty Spanish Tomato Couscous Cake
ingredients: 12 ounces large wholemeal couscous | 1 pint cherry tomatoes | 1/2 pint cherry tomatoes diced | 10 green chilies, minced | 1 can diced tomatoes | 2 cups tomato puree | 2 tablespoons self-raising flour | 1 pint tomato juice
instructions: Soak the couscous in warm water for 20 minutes.  Grease a 6 cup capacity ovenproof dish.  Place a layer of rice in the bottom of the dish.  Top with a layer of couscous, then cherry tomatoes, then cherry tomatoes.  Repeat for the remaining, covering the ingredients with couscous.  In a bowl, combine the green chillies, tomatoes, tomato puree, flour and juices.  Pour over the couscous.  Sprinkle over the top of the ingredients and bake at 180c for 1 hour.

title: Spicy Veal (Menemen)
ingredients: 500 g veal, cut into 6 serving sized pieces
instructions: Fry in oil, in a vessel with a small quantity of water, till browned on the outside but not burnt on the inside.  Add 1/4 cup hot water every 20 minutes for 1 - 2 hours and it will be very dry.  Serve with tomato ketchup or corriander.

Random Ingredients: ham hock,feta cheese,kaffir lime leaf,arborio rice,pearl barley
title: Greek Stew With Barley (Kaffir Lime)
ingredients: 2 lbs ham hocks | 1/2 cup pearl barley | 2 cups arborio rice | 1 tablespoon dried kaffir lime leaf | 1/4 cup feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees.  Place ham hocks in large dutch oven or pot with enough water to cover by 1 inch.  Stir in pearl barley, rice and lime.  Season with salt and pepper.  Cover, and reduce heat to lowest possible setting.  Cook for 2 to 2 1/2 hours, or until ham is very tender.  Cook rice according to package directions.  Add feta cheese during last 20 minutes of cooking.  If the ham dries out during this time, remove lid and continue cooking until most of the liquid evaporates and cheese melts.  Serve when rice is hot.

title: Guilt Free French Kiss
ingredients: 5 drops banana liqueur
instructions: Put 5 drops of banana in your hand.  Then take a few good shakes of guilt free french Kiss flavored liqueur and smear it over the entire thing.  If you have a cocktail shaker, it will help the ingredients get coated with flavor.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder roast,sriracha sauce,carrot,sun tomato oil,yellow mustard
title: Beef Vindaloo
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder roast | 2 tablespoons sriracha sauce ( sriracha sauce ) | 3 carrots, cut into 1-by-1 1/4-inch sticks or 1 large peeled carrot, cut into 1-by 1-inch sticks | 2 pinches yellow mustard | 1 lb sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained
instructions: Trim excess fat from roast.  Combine sriracha, carrots and mustard in large bowl.  Add pork and toss to coat.  Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour and up to 2 days.  Remove pork from the refrigerator 30 minutes before baking.  When serving, sprinkle with paprika.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,white mushroom,chicken breast fillet,emmenthaler cheese,hash brown potato,glace cherry,onion powder,white sugar
title: Cheesy Potato & Chicken
ingredients: 2 chicken breast fillets | 4 cups hash brown potatoes, cubed | 1/4 cup finely chopped onion | 10 ounces sliced fresh white mushrooms | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 8 ounces white mushrooms, halved | 1/2 cup pitted glace cherries
instructions: Place chicken in a greased baking dish.  Top with potato and onion.

Random Ingredients: espresso powder,corn flake,wide egg noodle,caster sugar
title: Baked Noodles With Espresso and Nuts
ingredients: 400 g caster sugar | 2 tablespoons instant espresso powder | 4 cans creamed corn flakes | 1 packet wide egg noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees c.  Cook the sugar in a small pan over a medium low heat until it becomes caramel coloured, about 10 minutes.  Remove the pan from the heat.  Stir in the espresso powder, then set aside to cool slightly.  Place the creamed cornflakes in a pan of boiling water and stir over the heat until they have melted.  Drain the pasta, then return to the pan with caramelised sugar.  Mix together well.  Place the mixture into a large ovenproof dish.  Sprinkle over the nescafe mix, then bake for 20 minutes.  Serve straight away, with extra caramelised sugar.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,button mushroom,parmesan cheese,white tequila,flour tortilla,white flour
title: Mushrooms & Artichokes Enchiladas With Crispy White Tequila Chips
ingredients: 12 white tequila-flavored flour tortillas ( or use pam corn tortillas ) | 1/4 cup white flour | 1 cup fresh breadcrumb | 5 ounces button mushrooms, sliced thin | 2 cups artichoke hearts, well drained ( reserve marinade ) | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese
instructions: Place flour tortillas on a large heavy duty paper towel.  Place about 1 1/2 tablespoons of the dough on a tortilla and roll into a 3 inch circle, about 1/8 inch thick and 6 inches in diameter.  Using the same flour tortilla, repeat with the remaining dough, making 12 tortillas total.  Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a 12 inch nonstick skillet over moderately high heat until hot but not smoking, then fry tortillas, without turning, stirring, 1 at a time, until puffed and crisply golden, about 1 minute per side.  Remove hot tortillas to paper towels to drain.  Heat remaining 2 tablespoons of the oil in a 12 inch nonstick skillet over moderate heat until hot but not smoking and fry mushrooms, stirring, until brown, about 6 minutes, add artichokes, increase the heat to moderate, and cook until liquid in the pan measures about 1 cup, stirring, about 3 minutes.  Spoon some mushrooms and artichoke mixture into each of 24 warmed pasta tortillas, top with remaining filling, and arrange tortillas, seam side down, about 2 teaspoons of cheese on top and remaining filling in a 9 inch ovenproof baking dish.  Bake enchiladas in moderately hot oven until just heated through, about 2 minutes.  Transfer to plates.

title: Melt of the Dark Chili - Spicy Lamb
ingredients: 500 g lamb fillets | 200 g fresh parsley | 100 g dark chocolate, chopped | 400 g sprite | 4 cardamom pods | 2 teaspoons grated gingerroot
instructions: Put all ingredients into a non reactive saucepan.  Stir until smooth.  Heat, but don't boil.  The mixture will thicken up.  Remove from heat and leave to stand for 30 - 60 minutes.  Cut lamb into 1 cm cubes.  Spray a non stick frying pan with oil.  Fry lamb in batches until lightly browned on all sides.  Remove from pan, keep warm.  Pour off any excess fat from frying pan.  Reheat the chili and serve.  Note, i use 4 cardamom pods in the spice mix.

title: Spicy Kiwi Kiwi Fritters (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 15)
ingredients: 1 kiwi fruit, peeled and chopped ( optional ) | 1 raspberries, drained and rinsed | 1 teaspoon dried minced onion | 8 small round wheat tortillas | 2 tablespoons light cheddar cheese, grated | dumpling, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Combine kiwi fruits and raspberries in a small bowl.  Sprinkle with dried onion.  Cover and place under grill until kiwifruit mixture is tender.  Stir.  Spread fritters with gildadilla.  Sprinkle with cheese and fold in half diagonally.  Serve with kiwi fritters.

Random Ingredients: frying chicken,chive,mexican cheese,plain nonfat yogurt,pork loin chop,thyme
title: Easy Shredded Chile Pork & Cheese
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork loin chops | 1 -2 teaspoon dried thyme | 4 -6 tablespoons mexican blend cheese | 4 ounces cooked pork loin or 4 ounces chorizo pork, diced | 4 tablespoons chopped fresh chives | 8 ounces plain nonfat yogurt
instructions: Place pork and thyme in a crockpot.  Top with cheese and the chives.  Pour yogurt over meat and cover.

Random Ingredients: red delicious apple,cauliflower,zucchini,arborio rice,lemonade,ghee,anaheim chilies,white wine
title: Cauliflower & Zucchini With Wine Risotto
ingredients: 2 zucchini, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1/2 zucchini, chopped | 1/2 cup cauliflower, chopped | 2 anaheim chilies, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons ghee | 3 cups arborio rice | 2 cups white wine | 8 ounces white wine | 7 ounces lemonade
instructions: Combine zucchini, cauliflower, chilies & rice in a sauce pan.  In a large sauce pan, heat ghee, stir in arborio and rice.  Cook over medium heat until all moisture is absorbed, stir in wine and lemonade and bring to a simmer.  Continue to add 1/2 cup of wine & cook, stirring until wine is absorbed.  Stir in the remaining wine & cook until liquid is reduced to 1 & stir in the cauliflower and zucchini mixture.  Cook just until heated through.  Serve and enjoy.

title: Parsnips or Parsnips with Nuts
ingredients: 1 lb parsnip, peeled and cut in 2-inch pieces | 4 garlic cloves, minced | 2 teaspoons dried thyme sprigs | 3 tablespoons espresso
instructions: Cook parsnips until crisp tender, about 5 minutes, stirring frequently.  Drain on paper towels.  Meanwhile, heat remaining ingredients.  Stir until combined.  Add parsnips and heat through.  Serve warm.

title: Baked Asparagus and Cabbage
ingredients: 4 ounces cauliflower | 1 ounce white cabbage | 12 7/8 ounces fresh asparagus | 1/8 teaspoon chili | 1 tablespoon vegetables seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 2 teaspoons fresh chives
instructions: Preheat oven at 400°f.  Peel and cut the vegetables into 1 inch pieces.  Coat the sides of a nonstick baking sheet with cooking spray or use cooking spray and place in the oven for 25 - 30 minutes, until tender.  Combine the chili with the veggie seasoning and salt and brush the asparagus with the vegetable seasoning mixture.  Bake asparagus for 5 minutes until crisp and golden.  Sprinkle with chopped fresh chives and serve hot with salad.

title: Gorgonzola & Pear Nests
ingredients: 150 g pearl barley, washed & drained | 1 teaspoon fennel seed, crushed | 250 g gorgonzola cheese or 250 g mozzarella cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives | cherries, to garnish
instructions: Place the barley in a large saucepan.

title: Curried Parsnips
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs parsnips, peeled and sliced into about 1/4-inch rounds | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 2 1/2 tablespoons light soy sauce
instructions: Place the parsnips in a large pot with boiling water on high heat.  Cover and bring to a boil.  Once the parsnips are floating, remove to a serving bowl and stir them, cooking until tender.  Once all of the parsnips have been cooked, place them in a separate serving bowl and toss with one of the dipping sauce ingredients.  Serve immediately.

title: Sweet Greek Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 package angel hair pasta | 1/2 cup chopped pistachios | 2/3 cup finely diced ripe mango | 1 medium fresh english cucumber, chopped | 2 1/2 cups coarsely cooked rice | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1/4 cup chopped pistachios
instructions: Cook pasta according to instructions.  Drain and rinse under cold water.  Cool.  While pasta is boiling, combine ½ cup pistachios and the mango in a bowl.  Slice cucumber into thin strips.  Add to mango mixture.  Stir in remaining pistachios.  Chill.  Combine rice and baking soda.  Stir into pasta mixture.  Pour into 1 quart clear glass serving dish with about 1/2 inch rim around the rim.

Random Ingredients: yellow pea,red chile pepper,celery rib,worcestershire sauce,wine,garlic granule
title: Yellow Split Pea and Celery
ingredients: 1 cup yellow split peas, washed and picked through | 2 celery ribs, roughly chopped | 1 red chile pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1/2 teaspoon garlic granules | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red chile pepper
instructions: Combine the split peas, celery, red chile pepper, worcestershire sauce, garlic granules, and crushed red chile in a pressure cooker.  Cook over high heat for 5 minutes.  Release steam, and stir.  Cover, and bring to high pressure over high heat for up to 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: manhattan clam chowder,saffron,plain yogurt,butter bean,couscous,worcestershire sauce
title: Quick and Easy Greek-Med Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 can butter beans, well drained | 1 can plain yogurt | 1 1/3 tablespoons fresh worcestershire sauce | 1 pinch saffron | 1 pinch saffron | 1 1/2 cups quick-cooking couscous | 1 1/2 cups manhattan clam chowder
instructions: Prepare rice according to package directions.  If using saffron instead of saffron add 1 - 2 tablespoons to boiling water.  After removing one cup of boiling water, add it back to the cooked rice.  In a bowl, add yogurt, worcestershire sauce, saffron, and a pinch of saffron soaked in 1 tablespoon hot water.  Blend well.  Add 1 - 2 teaspoons saffron butter into soup.  Drain beans and chop in 1/2 inch chunks.  Add back to soup.  Add 1 1/2 cups of chilled manhattan clam chowder.  Mix.  Simmer for 5 - 7 minutes.  Serve with a fresh loaf of bread or pita slices.

title: Veal Nuggets With Pepper and Cocoa
ingredients: 6 -8 thick veal cutlets | 1/4 cup chopped peanuts | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 4 tablespoons crunchy cocoa powder | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 1/2 tablespoons peanut oil or 1 1/2 tablespoons other neutral oil | buns, to serve
instructions: Trim excess fat from cutlets.  Trim off any visible fat around edges.  With a sharp knife, cut away as many of the very thin shreds of meat as possible on a sharp knife, without the membrane and all of the meat's connective tissue.  Cut the meat into 1/4 inch strips.  Toss with peanuts, cilantro, cocoa powder and rice vinegar.  Cover and marinate at least 2 hours.  Heat oil in a heavy skillet over medium high heat.  Add meat strips and cook, turning once, until browned all over.  Remove meat from skillet.

Random Ingredients: mussel,vegetable oil cooking spray,linguine,mustard seed,vegetable broth,rice noodle,cayenne,penne pasta
title: Rice Noodle Fish in Mustard Seed Vegetables
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1 lb linguine pasta | 1 lb cooked sea bass or 1 lb cod fish, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 quart vegetable broth | 1 lb uncooked wide rice noodles | 3 cups raw mussels, scrubbed and debearded | 1 pinch cayenne
instructions: In a large skillet, coat the bottom with vegetable oil.  In a large skillet, heat 2 teaspoons oil.  When fragrant, add mustard seeds.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,sirloin,garbanzo bean chickpea,pepperoni,cider vinegar,italian breadcrumb,sun tomato
title: Italian Hamburgers With Garbanzo Beans
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 1/4 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup hoagie buns ( about 2 slices ) or 1/2 cup kaiser roll | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato, spreadable tomato, thinly sliced ( about 1/4 cup ) | 1/4 cup canned garbanzo beans ( chickpeas ) | 4 pieces pepperoni, sliced ( about 4 ounces each ) | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine beef and bread crumbs and, using fingers, mix with hands until mixture resembles coarse meal.  Form mixture into four 3 inch thick patties.  Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray and set over high heat.  Add burgers and cook 4 minutes each side or until browned and cooked to desired doneness, adding more cooking time if necessary.  Spread hoagie rolls with 1/4 cup sun dried tomato spread.  Evenly top with bean slices and pepperoni slices.  Combine vinegar and other ingredients and spread over burgers and pepperoni.  Serve with additional tomato spread on top.

title: Spinach and Rice Appetizers
ingredients: 1 package frozen spinach, thawed and well drained | 1 cup rice, cooked | 1 red chili pepper, diced ( optional ) | 1 package dinner rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add spinach, and cook, uncovered, until liquid has cooked off and spinach is tender, about 3 minutes.  Drain, and squeeze the excess liquid from the spinach.  Stir rice, red pepper, and chili pepper into the spinach mixture.  Place equal amounts of the hot spinach mixture into the rolls.  Bake in the preheated oven until rolls are heated through, 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Chile Tomatillos
ingredients: 12 fresh tomatillos | 1/2 cup peanut butter
instructions: Heat a grill pan or outdoor grill for 10 to 15 minutes.  Place the tomatillos on the grill, cook until they start turning slightly on the outsides, remove to a bowl and keep warm.  Place the peanut butter in a small bowl, stir in enough water to make a thick paste that coats the tomatillo skins.  Place the tomatillos on a serving platter and top with the peanut butter paste.

title: Lemon Grass, Mushroom and Oat Salad
ingredients: 1 stalk lemongrass, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 400 g mushrooms, sliced | 300 g quick-cooking oats | 1/4 cup cornstarch | 1 tablespoon dry mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons corn oil
instructions: Combine cornstarch and 1/2c boiling water in a small bowl.  Stir well.  Stir in remaining ingredients, except the corn oil to thicken the dressing, reserving some for garnishing the salad.

title: Pico De Gallo With Gorgonzola Cheese and Pico De Gallo
ingredients: 8 ounces pico de gallo | 1/2 ounce gorgonzola ( optional )
instructions: On a plate, put pico de gallo on the plate, then top with gorgonzola, if using.  Serve immediately.  Note, to keep cheese from releasing it's moisture while it's still hot or hot, put a piece of plastic wrap on the board and, if it sticks, sprinkle the cheese on top.  This is a simple but delicious recipe that goes well with warm pita bread.

title: Creamy Indian Dessert
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups buttermilk | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 3 tablespoons orange juice ( fresh or canned ) | 1/2 cup chilled whipped topping
instructions: Place buttermilk and ginger paste in a small pot and bring to a simmer.  Simmer for 10 minutes to soften slightly.  Remove from heat and allow to cool, about 10 minutes, then whisk in orange juice.  Add whipped topping, stir and refrigerate until very cold.  Serve over plain basmati rice or hot rice immediately.

Random Ingredients: crescent,flat rice noodle,curry,yellow food coloring,phyllo dough,cocoa powder
title: Spicy Chocolate Phyllo Rolls
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated crescent roll dough | 1 package refrigerated phyllo dough | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 teaspoon curry | 4 drops yellow food coloring | 3/4 cup flat rice noodles or 3/4 cup jasmine rice noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Roll each phyllo dough out on a floured surface into a rectangle about 10 x 3 inches.  Cut each rectangle into 6 squares.  Place 1 1/2 squares of phyllo dough in the center of a sprayed cookie sheet, pressing into corners with fingers.  Bake in the oven until phyllo are lightly browned, about 7 minutes.  Remove from oven.  In a small bowl mix the cocoa, curry and food coloring until smooth.  Stir in drained noodles.  Spread about 1/3 cup of chunky cocoa mixture over each phyllo square.  Using clean fingers, spread some chunky cocoa mixture over noodles.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,mint,pork tenderloin,egg noodle,butternut squash,hazelnut,tomato puree
title: Minted Noodle and Beef Soup (Gurkamaka)
ingredients: 400 g butternut squash, ends trimmed | 150 g egg noodles, broken into chunks | 1/2 teaspoon dried mint | 3 cups chopped tomatoes with puree | 1 tablespoon hazelnuts, chopped ( optional ) | 1/2 liter rice vinegar | 4 cups cold chicken or 4 cups pork stock
instructions: Peel the squash and cut into chunks, steam until soft.  Meanwhile, cook the noodles according to the directions on the packet.  Drain and rinse the noodles under cold water.  Return to the pan.  Heat a little butter in a large frying pan, add the mint and stir fry for 1 minute.  Add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.  Drain the noodles, reserving 1/4 cup of the cooking liquid.  Add them to the tomato mixture, stir in the hazelnuts.  Mix well.  Add the noodles and simmer for 2 - 3 minutes.  Add the reserved liquid and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Add the stock and cook a further 3 - 4 minutes.  Serve.

title: Smoky Spanish Rice With Pecans and Chipotle
ingredients: 1 package spanish rice mix | 1 can chipotle chiles ( mild, medium or hot ) | 1 cup pecans
instructions: Prepare spanish rice according to package instructions.  Set aside and add chipotle chiles.  Let the rice cook while you make the pecans while mixing the pecans with the chipotle mixture.  When rice is done, mix with pecan mixture and serve. .

title: Frozen Meat Filling for Corn Dogs
ingredients: 1 ounce extra lean ground beef | 2 ounces fruit pectin
instructions: Pour 1 teaspoon of oil into a small pan or dutch oven.  Pour in all of the measured pints of fruit pectin.  Allow them to bubble on the bottom of the pan for 10 minutes, before taking off the heat.  While still hot, roll the meat mixture into balls the size of your index finger using some of the pan drippings.  Deep fry them in the pan until dark brown on all sides.

Random Ingredients: bailey irish cream,chicken stock,basmati rice,venison,rice vinegar,japanese eggplant
title: Baileys Bird
ingredients: 1 small japanese eggplant, cut into 1-inch cubes | 3 cups basmati rice | 1 lb ground venison | 1/2 cup biley's irish cream | 1/2 cup instant rice vinegar | 4 cups chicken stock
instructions: Boil enough water to cover the rice and eggplant until tender.  Drain and set aside.  In a large skillet, brown the venison in the biley's until browned.  Drain the venison well.  Return the venison and bones to the same skillet.  Add the rice, vinegar and stock.  Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat, simmer for about 20 minutes.  Serve immediately.

title: Grace Spice Blend
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fine salt | 1 tablespoon fresh ginger paste
instructions: Mix ingredients thoroughly and store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: pork sparerib,bay leaf,hamburger,red cabbage,superfine sugar,buttermilk,thai fish sauce,pork roast
title: Pork and Beef Pork Adobo
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork spareribs ( or pork shoulder ) | 1/2 lb extra lean hamburger | 1/2 lb pork roast, cut in 1/4 inch cubes | 2 teaspoons superfine sugar | 3 tablespoons finely diced thai fish sauce | 1 bay leaf | 1 cup shredded red cabbage | 1 cup buttermilk
instructions: Cut spareribs into 3 inch squares and place in a 6 qt saucepan.  Add pork, hamburger, curing salt, sugar and fish sauce.  Add bay leaf and cabbage and mix well.  Add 1 cup of buttermilk or water and stir.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium low, cover, and cook for 1½ to 2 hours.  Stir occasionally.  Remove bay leaf and serve with rice.

title: Chile Chile (Pappardelle) Soup
ingredients: 8 large fresh poblano chiles ( can be substituted with a california or new mexican chile blend ) | 1/2 cup whole white flour | 3/4 cup thick light soymilk ( or milk of choice ) | 1 1/4 cups low-sodium stock | 1 cup chunky salsa ( you can choose mild, medium or hot ) | 3 tablespoons coconut, grated ( optional )
instructions: Cut poblano chiles in half lengthwise.  Remove seeds using a knife.  Chop poblanos into small, uneven pieces.  Combine chiles through 1/4 cup flour in a medium pot over low heat.  Stir constantly with a wooden spoon until the mixture begins to foam, then cook 5 minutes.  Slowly stir in soymilk and stock.  Add salsa, if using, and cook 5 - 10 minutes until the soup is creamy and hot but not boiling.  Stir in poblanos and remove from stove.  You can either serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,prune,vital wheat gluten,banana lengthwise,egg white,coconut,jalapeno pepper,gruyere cheese
title: Porjies
ingredients: 1 cup shredded coconut | 1/2 cup grated gruyere cheese | 1 egg white | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 tablespoon minced jalapeno pepper | 1 tablespoon potato-flavored egg whites | 1 tablespoon vital wheat gluten | 1 small banana, halved lengthwise | 1/4 cup prune
instructions: Combine coconut, gruyere cheese, egg white, shrimp, rum, jalapeno pepper, potato flour, and egg white in a bowl.

title: Easy Leg of Lamb With Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb whole wheat pasta | 1 lb boneless leg of lamb | 2 tablespoons scallions | 1 teaspoon vanilla
instructions: Cook whole wheat pasta according to directions as directed on package.  Meanwhile, cut lamb into 1 1/2 1 1/2 x 2 1/2 inch slices and then fry in nonstick skillet or stew pan with scallion and vanilla until brown.

title: Beef  and Okra Crostini
ingredients: 1 baguette, cut in half diagonally ( long, thin slices, about 3 ounces each ) | 4 -8 ounces ground beef | 8 ounces frozen okra, thawed
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees.  Line 9 by 6 inch pan with foil.  Line pan with one or two thick slices of bread.  Trim crust from okra.  In a large bowl, make one or two criss cross, three color long rolls.  Dunk okra into okra, one half at a time.  Put ground beef on two or three pieces of bread and place top half of slices over mixture.  Cut two or three more okra slices crosswise into 5 slices, then put a piece of okra and a good sprinkling of remaining pepper on top.  Repeat with remaining slices and serve.  Variation a can be made using the ground beef of your choice and placed in a casings shape.

title: Spinach and Curry Cake (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 3 )
ingredients:
1 sponge cakes, 5 x 1 cm ( about 2 1/2 inch rounds ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons low-fat green curry paste ( i use sharwood's thai chicken curry paste, i use mr.
    - yoshida's easy curry paste ) | 1 1/4 cups baby spinach | 1 pinch cayenne, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c.  Grease two baking trays, spread the curry paste onto the cakes, making sure it covers them slightly.  Bake the cake on the baking trays for 5 - 7 minutes.  When cooled, slice the cake into 3/4 inch squares.  Cut the cake into triangles or squares.  Scatter the spinach over the curry and serve.

title: Fondue D'Elena
ingredients:
1 can pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup chopped green olives | 1 1/2 teaspoons white vinegar | 1 teaspoon seasoning, e.
    -g.
    - morton's nature's seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 3 leaves fresh mint, chopped
instructions: Drain the pinto beans and rinse under cold water.  Place in the bowl of a food processor or blender.  Add all remaining ingredients except the mint.  Turn into a fondue pot and cook over medium heat until warm through.

Random Ingredients: ladyfinger,brandy,seasoning salt,belgian endive,bread crumb,white flour,velveeta cheese
title: Brandy Crumbs of Endive Au Gratin
ingredients: 1 lb of sliced endive | 4 -5 ounces white flour | 2 ounces brandy | 1 lb velveeta cheese, cubed ( i use sharp white melting cheese ) | 1/8 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/4 cup of thickly chopped italian bread crumbs | 1 package ladyfingers
instructions: Remove the bottom stem from the endive leaves and wash.  Slice the endive leaves about 1/4 inch thick.  Place about a tablespoon of the seasoned crumbs in the center of a dinner plate.  Mix the cheese and the crumbs well, then place these in the cheese and crumbs, mixing well with a spoon.  Coat a large, shallow pan with cooking spray.  Place a layer of ladyfingers on the bottom of your pan.  Top ladyfingers with half of the crumb mixture.  Add one more layer of endive leaves.  You may also add another layer of crumbs, a third of cheese crumbs and one third of crumbs.  Spread all of the cheese mixture over the endives.  Spread the top with the remainder of the crumb mixture.  Make sure endive leaves are well coated with crumbs and cheese.  Sprinkle top with the rest of the crumb mixture.  Sprinkle the top with crumbled italian cheese until covered.  Sprinkle top with more italian cheese.  Make sure cheese does not fall off while cooking, it should fall off when in a few turns.  Place pan in an 350 degree oven for approximately 45 minutes or until endives are slightly charred on top.  Cooking time may vary based on oven and thickness of your cheese slices.  I cook mine in a 350 degree oven for around 90 minutes or so.

Random Ingredients: feta cheese,cardamom pod,nori,basil leaf,ice water,arborio rice,green chili
title: Feta Rice With Green Chiles
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice | 1 tablespoon chopped green chili | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/3 cup crumbled feta cheese | 6 tablespoons ice water | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil leaves | 1 nori top sheet, cut into 4 pieces, seaweed
instructions: In a pot with boiling water, cook arborio till just tender.  Remove from heat, drain.  Heat oil over medium heat in a medium size frying pan.  Add green chiles, stir fry for 5 minutes. title: Easy Beef and Potato Baked Beans

instructions: Start by poaching your chorizo on stove and removing any casings.  Put in a pan along with the orange, garlic, olive oil, sugar, zest, chorizo, chipotle and the orange pepper.  Toss everything together with the sausages, breaking them up in your pan.  Put in the fridge, leave it for an hour, shaking every so often as they cook.  Add cauliflower with salt to taste, put in the fridge and leave for an hour or a half, shaking every so often.  Take out of the fridge and enjoy.

title: Quick 'n' Easy Pesto and Beef Rollups
ingredients: 6 small frozen roast beef | 1 jar prepared pesto sauce, any flavor
instructions: Thaw meat if frozen.  Combine pesto and meat.  Brush roll ups with oil.  Roll up.  Secure with tooth picks.  I like the pinched edges.  Bake at 375 degrees f until nice and brown and meat is hot and crusty in some areas.

title: Warm Swiss Chard on a Stick (Diabetic)
ingredients: 1 lb swiss chard | 1 cup canned chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1/4 cup light coconut milk | 1/2 cup broth, canned or homemade | 1 tablespoon olive
instructions: Trim the end ribs and the flat ends of the swiss chard.  Cut the chard crosswise into 2 long slices.  Trim the ends of the stems, and cut the leaves crosswise into 1 - 2 pieces.  Place the chard, chickpeas and coconut milk into the bowl of a food processor, and pulse until the chard is finely chopped.  Add the broth and process until the chard is chopped up and well blended.  Transfer the mixture to a frying pan over medium heat, add the olive oil and cook, stirring, for about 1 minute, or until the oil is very hot.  Put in the chard leaves, and toss until the chard is heated through.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,sea salt pepper,hamburger,chili oil,mustard seed,grand marnier,picante sauce
title: TEX Chilli Beef Hash #5FIX
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt and pepper, to taste | 3 lbs russet potatoes, peeled & cut into 1/2-inch chunks | 1 jar picante sauce | 1/2 cup grand marnier
instructions: Brown hamburger with seeds and the oil, add seasonings and potato.  Cook on low heat about an hour stirring often.  When the potatoes are soft, remove from heat.  Cool and slice.  Add picante sauce and sour cream.

title: Mango Salad
ingredients: 3 mangos, peeled and sliced | 3 radishes, sliced
instructions: Arrange mango slices on plates.  Top with radishes.  Drizzle with olive oil and sour cream.

title: Quick Sausage & Kielbasa Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 cup red wine | 1/4 cup canola oil | 1 lb kielbasa, sliced in 3-5 pieces | 2 egg whites, lightly beaten | 1 package pizza crust, ready-baked
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Pour half the wine into a 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish.  Add the oil and kielbasa to the skillet and cook over medium high heat for 3 - 5 minutes or until kielos are no longer pink, stirring often to keep them from sticking.  Combine the remaining wine and egg whites.

title: Simple Beef Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 pound beef stew meat | 1 bottle chili paste
instructions: Place beef into a large saucepan, and sprinkle with chili paste to cover.  Pour enough water into the saucepan to cover the meat, and bring to a boil.  Skim off any scum that forms on the surface of the sauce, cover, and simmer 20 minutes.  Serve over boiled or steamed rice.

title: Potato Cheese and Carrot Wedges
ingredients: 1 package red potatoes | 6 ounces carrots, shredded | 1 lb mozzarella cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Cut each potato in half lengthwise.  Place in a saucepan or large baking sheet, and cover with water.  Add carrots to water, and bring to boil over high heat, cooking for 12 minutes.  Drain and run cold water around the edge of the carrots to cool potatoes until easily handled.  Drain water from onions and toss potatoes with carrots in large bowl.  Stir in the shredded mozzarella cheese.  Transfer potato mixture to sheet of foil, and sprinkle cheese of your choice on top.  Bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes or until filling is heated through.

title: Vanilla Pudding With Chocolate
ingredients: 2 scoops vanilla ice cream | 3 tablespoons grand marnier ( or substitute another liquor of your choice ) | 3 maraschino cherries
instructions: Spray a large baking dish with cooking spray and line with parchment paper.  In a small bowl, whip the ice cream to soften slightly and set aside.  Make a slit in the cream to create a snifter or thumbprint.  In the baking dish, place a scoop of ice cream, one tablespoon of grand marnier and two cherries into the shell of the dish.  Repeat with another scoop of ice cream and cherry to create 4 scoops of ice cream, a total of 4 ice cream piped into each of the 4 dessert shells in each dish.  Place the filled plates in the freezer for at least 2 hours.  Just before serving the dessert, remove the paper from the glass and invert the pudding onto a platter.

title: Bitter Chocolate Broccoli Fritters
ingredients: 1 lb broccoli floret, finely chopped | 3 squares bittersweet chocolate, coarsely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt, to taste | 1/2 teaspoon bitter chocolate
instructions: Place the broccoli in a bowl of cold water and let sit 30 - 60 minutes to soften.  Drain the broccoli but do not peel off any of the skin.  Coarsely chop the broccoli and return it to a large bowl with the unsweetened chocolate.  Sprinkle with the sea salt, but do not stir.

title: Stuffed Chickpea Samosas - Samosas
ingredients: 2 medium russet potatoes | 2 large dried red chiles | 3 -4 tablespoons flour ( to coat potatoes ) | 1 can diced figs, undrained | 1 can chickpeas, undrained | 1 -2 tablespoon dried fruit, of your choice ( optional )
instructions: Cut 1/8 inch off stem end of each chile and snip off seeds.  Place chiles around stem stem of chiles and close shut.  Place wrapped chiles in bowl and cover with warm water.  Let sit 15 - 20 minutes or until completely cooled.  Peel and coarsely chop potatoes.  Place potatoes in large bowl with water, covering by 2 inches.  Soak until tender, about 2 hours, drain.  Heat oven to 300 degrees.  Drain and discard chiles.  Place chiles in a baking pan or roasting pan.  Add 1 - 2 tbs flour and 1 c undrained figs plus 1 - 2 tbsp of the bean liquid.

title: Blueberry Ziti Bites
ingredients: 1 cup ziti pasta, cooked | 1 cup blueberries ( washed and drained ) | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs or 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon poppy seed | 1/4 cup fresh parsley ( chopped )
instructions: Mix all ingredients except bread crumbs and parsley in a large bowl.  Form into bite sized patties.  Grill in a pan sprayed with cooking spray.

title: Grilled Beef and Eggplant (Aubergine) Rolls
ingredients: 2 eggplants, sliced lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick slices | pepper, to taste | 2 lbs rump steak, sliced 1/4 inch thick, 1/4 inch thick ( i use 3-inch thick )
instructions: Heat an outdoor grill, or prepare a grill pan and lightly oil it.  Brush a grill pan or griddle with oil.  Place eggplant slices on grill and cook, flipping once, until tender, about 30 minutes, turning once.  Spread some pepper onto beef slices during the last few minutes of grilling.  Serve beef rolls topped with eggplant and freshly ground black pepper to taste.

title: Vegetarian Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1 cup arborio rice or 1 cup carnaroli rice | 2 cups salsa verde ( found in latin or mexican markets ) | 1 box frozen chopped broccoli, thawed and drained and steamed til tender
instructions: Saute the rice with vegetable oil.

title: Tangerine Bacon Quesadilla
ingredients: 4 pieces bacon, fried | 1 cup chopped tangerine | 1/2 cup italian-style salad dressing | 2 tablespoons hot barbecue sauce | 8 whole wheat tortillas
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp.  Remove bacon.  Add tangerines to pan and cook until soft.  Add dressing, barbecue sauce and bacon and continue cooking until heated through.  Lay 3 - 4 tortillas on a hot skillet.  Add 2 t oil, bacon and tangerine mixture on half the tortilla, fold the other half over and browned on the other side.  Turn over on both sides and brown the other side.  Serve with salsa.

title: Mushroom Capsicum
ingredients: 100 g red beans, drained | 150 g white mushrooms, thickly sliced | 6 garlic cloves, roughly sliced | 1 cardamom, crushed | 3 tablespoons blue cheese | 1 tablespoon ground cardamom
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a microwave proof dish with a lid and microwave for 5 minutes until hot.  Serve in small pieces.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,clove,scallion,mahi fillet,tomato green chile pepper,liquid honey
title: Mahi mahi with dark brown sugar and scallions
ingredients: 1 mahi mahi fillet | 1/2 cup chopped scallion | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 teaspoon liquid honey | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chile peppers | 1 clove crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Arrange mahi mahi in a 9x13 inch glass baking dish.  Place in prepared baking dish.  In a small bowl, whisk the scallions, rice vinegar, honey, tomatoes, and chiles together in a microwave on high.  Heat in microwave until heated through, about 1 minute.  Pour over the mahi.  Cover dish with foil and bake in preheated oven 40 minutes, or until fish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Bunuelos with Beef & Bacon
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 2 cups bread flour
instructions: Brown ground beef and remove from pan and drain.  Add crumbled bacon back to pan.  Add flour and cook until mixture coats bread and bacon.  Remove from fire.  Drop dough or a teaspoon of dough in to balls and then roll into ropes about 5 inches long and 4 - 5 inches long.  Flatten slightly with the bottom of your hand.  Place meat on the bread and bake at 350 degrees for 10 - 15 minutes until golden.  Serve with a green salad.

title: Grilled Beef Tenderloin with Mango and Water Chestnuts
ingredients: 5 lbs beef tenderloin | 4 green peppers, cut into thin strips | 2 cups mango, cut into thin strips | 8 ounces water chestnuts, sliced | 1/3 cup dry sherry | 1/4 teaspoon salt
instructions: Prepare grill.  Combine steak, green pepper strips, mango, water chestnuts, sherry.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,brown sugar,garlic powder,tomato green chilies
title: Chili Cheese Noodles
ingredients: 1 package dry egg noodles | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chilies | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon brown sugar
instructions: Cook egg noodles according to package directions.  Drain, then rinse with cold water.  Toss noodles, tomatoes, garlic powder and brown sugar together.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,lemon,white flour,chipotle chile,turmeric,peanut butter,active yeast
title: Homemade Whole Wheat Pizza Crust
ingredients: 1 package active dry yeast | 1/4 cup white flour | 1/4 cup whole wheat flour | 1 cup low-fat peanut butter | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour ( use 1 tablespoon to make vegan ) | 3 -6 canned chipotle chiles, cut in half ( see note below, in description ) | 3 -4 tablespoons turmeric
instructions: Sprinkle the yeast over 2 cups warm water over a bowl, sprinkle in 1/4 cup of the white flour and let sit about 5 minutes until creamy and foamy.  Put the remaining white and whole wheat flour in another bowl and set aside.  Dissolve the turmeric in 1/2 cup of the white flour.  Melt the peanut butter on low heat, add the turmeric and allow to cool until you have a smooth creamy creamy foam but the consistency does not change and starts to smell like butter.  Stir in the chipotles and mix in the yeast.  You need to have everything and blend well.  Add the flour, a cup at a time, stirring to make sure it gets incorporated evenly and in between each addition, until they become a dough that can be kneaded, about 8 minutes.  Knead on a floured surface for about 10 minutes, place in a well oiled bowl and put in a warm spot.  Allow to rise.  Punch down and place in a well oiled bowl and cover.  Allow to rise again for about 1 hour before using, or 1/2 hour and 45 minutes.  When dough is double in bulk, punch it down.  Divide into 6 equal portions, using dough on floured surface.  Stretch each portion and roll out to fit pizza pan, spreading the mixture as thin as possible.  Sprinkle on your choice of toppings, i use a bit of sesame oil, dried basil, dried oregano, and a bit of sweet greek seasoning.  Bake on preheated pizza stone or pizza pan at your preferred temperature.  Baking at 400f or 200°c, until bread looks dark and puffy, 30 - 35 minutes.  Note, depending on the wetness of the dough, you may need to check for the progress of the cooking process with a toothpick.

title: Zucchini Italian Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf italian bread | 1 medium zucchini, sliced | 2 sprigs fresh rosemary
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Remove crusty top from bread.  Cut the loaf into 24 slices.  Arrange bread slices in a single layer on a large baking sheet.  Arrange sliced zucchini on top.  Sprinkle freshly chopped rosemary over zucchini.  If you want, spoon about 1/2 cup boiling water over zucchini.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until bread is lightly browned and zucchini is tender.  Remove rosemary sprigs from water and serve bread with butter and zucchini slices.  Note marinara has a million days to prepare.

title: Chile Con Carne
ingredients: 1/2 kg grape tomatoes, halved, deseeded, cut in half | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 500 g pre-made pasta shells | 100 g dark chocolate, chopped coarsely
instructions: Dice the tomatoes and set aside.  Heat the oil in a pan, add the tomatoes and stir through.  Cook on a very low heat for 15 minutes.  Cooking the pasta.  Place the pasta into a large saucepan of boiling water.  Cook until just tender, drain.  Add the tomatoes and chocolate to the pasta and toss well.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: chipotle pepper,granny smith apple,coriander,hazelnut,garlic powder,liquid smoke,avocado,linguine
title: Chocolate Apple Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 box linguine, cooked al dente | 1 head radicchio or 1 head granny smith apple, peeled, cored, thinly sliced, then sliced thin crosswise | 2 -6 large mushrooms, sliced thin | 4 -6 cloves garlic powder, crushed | 1 1/2 teaspoons liquid smoke | 2 -3 tablespoons hazelnuts, toasted and finely chopped, or to taste | 1 chipotle pepper, seeded and finely chopped | 2 teaspoons ground coriander
instructions: In a large serving bowl combine the pasta, apple slices, mushrooms, garlic powder, liquid smoke and half of the chopped hazelnuts.  Toss lightly, then sprinkle the remaining toasted hazelnuts on top.  Sprinkle on the chipotle pepper and cover and refrigerate for at least one hour or until the ingredients are to your liking.  Serve chilled or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: cardamom pod,black olive,lemon pepper,onion flake,italian herb seasoning,chocolate chip,red wine vinegar,red onion
title: Alton Brown's Olive Kugel
ingredients: 6 ounces bittersweet chocolate chips | 2/3 cup red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 1 tablespoon dried italian herb seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1 cup chopped red onion | 1 can sliced ripe olives | 1/4 cup lemon pepper, packed
instructions: In a blender or food processor, melt chocolate morsels in red wine vinegar until smooth.  Stir in minced onion, italian herb seasoning, cardamom pod, black pepper, red onion, olives, and lemon pepper.  Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Herbed Oatcakes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons instant mashed yeast | 1 tablespoon ground dry instant malted butter | 1 cup self-rising flour | 4 cups rolled oats | 2 tablespoons hot pepper sauce | 1 stalk leek
instructions: Mix yeast, butter, flour, oats, and hot pepper sauce together in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment on high speed or a dough hook on low speed.  Knead dough for 2 minutes on well floured surface until smooth, elastic, and elastic.  Place dough in a lightly oiled bowl.

title: Finnish Potato Rice
ingredients: 2 large potatoes, peeled, diced | 1 cup long grain white rice
instructions: Combine rice, diced potatoes and salt.  Microwave on high for 45 seconds per batch, until heated throughout.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt,vegetable oil cooking spray,pepper sauce,red chilies,sirloin,mexican cheese,yellow bell pepper,rump roast
title: Beef With Chiles Cheese Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless sirloin, cut into thin 2-rib sections | 1 red chilies, seeded and finely diced | 1 1/2 cups julienned yellow bell peppers | vegetable oil cooking spray | kosher salt | 8 rump roast, cooked per roti recipe directions | 2 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 -4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce ( or more to taste )
instructions: Heat a large skillet to medium high heat.  Spray with nonstick cooking spray.  Add chiles and bell peppers and cook, stirring until peppers are softened, about 3 - 4 minutes.  Transfer to a bowl and stir in beef.  Season with kosher salt and pepper.  In another pan, heat oil over medium high heat.  Working in batches, add beef, cooking until well browned all over, about 3 - 4 minutes per side.  Transfer to a cutting board and cut meat into thin slices, about 1/2 inch thick.  Return meat to pan, add cooked peppers and any accumulated juices and toss well.  Spoon beef slices onto a plate lined with paper towels.  Top with cheese and hot sauce.

title: Baja Fish
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peppercorns, cracked | 3/4 lb cod, boneless and skinless, cut into chunks | 2 tablespoons basil leaves, loosely backed and coarsely chopped | 1 medium bermuda onion, thinly sliced | 1 -2 tablespoon coconut, grated | 1/2 can red enchilada sauce
instructions: Place the peppercorns in a small dish and crush with a rolling pin.  Set aside.  Put cod in a 12 inch heavy bottomed skillet.  Add enough water to cover the fish by at least 1 inch.  Bring to a second boil, then turn down the heat to medium and simmer the fish until just tender, about 7 minutes.  Cool the fish and set aside.  Discard the water from the pan.  Drain the fish and remove skin and bones.  Chop up the fish coarsely.  Put in a small bowl and stir in the basil, onion and coconut.  Put in a blender jar with 1/2 can of the enchilada sauce and puree.  Heat remaining enchilada sauce over medium heat but do not boil.  Spoon over fish, garnish with basil and serve.

Random Ingredients: pie crust,kosher salt,coriander powder,flat leaf parsley
title: Spiced Herb Crust
ingredients: 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 4 teaspoons kosher salt | 5 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, finely chopped | 1 package refrigerated pie crusts
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f in a medium size mixing bowl, combine the coriander, salt, parsley and 1/2 cup water.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,dashi,apple cider,jalapeno chile,red pepper flake,raisin,cardamom seed
title: Spaghetti Adobo
ingredients: 2 tablespoons abura age instant dashi | 2 fresh jalapeno chiles, seeded and minced | 10 cups dashi | 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds | 1 cup raisins | 1/2 cup apple cider | 1 lb dried spaghetti
instructions: Prepare the adobo, cook dried spaghetti according to package directions.  Meanwhile make the adobo sauce, in a small saucepan, heat the oil on low heat until it simmers, being careful not to burn it.  Add the chili, and fry gently.  Add the adobo sauce and increase the heat up.  Reduce heat to low, and simmer for 10 minutes.  Add the raisins and stir once.  When the pasta is ready, pour it into a serving bowl.  Pour adobo sauce over it and serve.

title: Mini Criss crosses
ingredients: 8 slices crusty bread | 3 -4 tablespoons full fat ricotta cheese | fresh thyme sprig ( optional ) | 100 g black pepperoni | 8 tablespoons crumbled feta | 12 bocconcini, halved | 12 slices prosciutto ( preferably sopapillas ) ( optional ) | 150 ml double cream ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200oc.  Place the bread slices on a baking tray lined with baking paper and toast for about 8 to 10 minutes.  Allow to cool slightly then transfer the bread slices to a chopping board.  While they are still warm, roughly chop them up.  Place into a large bowl with the ricotta, thyme and pepperoni cheese.  Mix well breaking up the pepperoni and feta into small pieces.  Add the crumbled feta and combine.  Roll each slice of bread in the cheese mixture and place on baking tray.  Cook for about 10 to 15 minutes until crisp and golden and filling is set.  Serve hot with a dollop of cream and slices of prosciutto if desired.

title: Cauliflower stuffed with Curried Lamb
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, broken into florets | 4 tablespoons mild curry paste | 500 g ground lamb | 2 -3 green chili peppers, chopped | freshly cracked pepperoni, to serve
instructions: Put the cauliflower florets into a large pan of boiling water, cook uncovered for about 30 seconds to 1 minute or until they rise to the surface.  Drain well and tip into a heat proof bowl.  Cover with foil and set aside for 10 - 15 minutes to steam through.  Heat the curry paste in a large non stick frying pan over medium low heat for 2 minutes, stirring all the time.  Add the lamb mince and chilli, stir, cook stirring for about 3 minutes or until browned and cooked through.  Add the cauliflower and cook for another 2 - 3 minutes or until lightly charred.  Divide between two warmed plates and serve with cracked pepperoni, and extra curry if you like.

title: Carnival (Mexican Carnitas Verde)
ingredients: 3 lbs pork shoulder | 6 -8 medium pickles, cut into chunks | 1 can mandarin oranges ( drained but reserving juice ) | 5 small serrano chilies, stemmed thinly sliced ( optional )
instructions: The day before you are planning to serve it, combine the pickles, orange juice and the chiles in a large bowl.  Add the pork.

title: Homemade Spoons - Eggs
ingredients: 10 -12 hard-boiled eggs | 1 1/2 - 2 cups unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 4 -5 basil sprigs
instructions: Wash and coarsely chop eggs.  Mix all ingredients until incorporated.  Keep at room temperature at least 1 hour, preferably overnight.  Break apart into pieces or put into cups, let chill till cold then store in airtight container or freezer.

Random Ingredients: chicken leg,mint,red chili powder,chunky peanut butter,cayenne,red onion,dark rum,chicken bouillon cube
title: Peanut Nuts (Chicken leg portions)
ingredients: 6 chicken legs ( legs or thighs ) | 1/2 cup chunky peanut butter | 1/2 cup dark rum | 3 chicken bouillon cubes ( or 2 beef cubes, soaked in water ) | 2 dried red chili powder | 1/2 cup red onion, chopped | cayenne | 2 tablespoons of fresh mint, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  In a shallow roasting pan pour peanut butter on top.  Mix rum, bouillon cubes, chili powder, and red onion in a blender until well combined and pour mixture over peanut butter until chicken is completely covered or in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,mustard seed,gin,poblano pepper,sugar substitute,beef chuck roast
title: Carottes en Choclo (Beef Roast & Poblano Beans)
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | 2 poblano peppers ( roasted, seeded & amp, membrane removed ) | 1 lb baby carrots | 1/2 cup sugar substitute | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 1 bottle gin
instructions: Roast poblanos as above.  Remove stems & seeds & set aside for 5 minutes.  Trim roast & cut into pieces about 2 inches long & 2 inches wide.  Chop the poblanos fine.  Roast both peppers a couple at a time on a high setting until blackened on all sides.  This will mean you are making a small blackened roast.  Immediately place blackened roast into a glass bowl.  Cover with a paper bag to cool slightly then place in the refrigerator for 3 to 4 hours. .  When done, set aside to let cool slightly then drain off any excess liquid.  Place the roast in the bowl of a food processor or blender along with a pinch of sugar substitute & mustard seeds.  Puree until smooth, about 1 minute or so.  Add the poblanos & set aside.  Pour the bottle of gin over the roast, cover with plastic wrap, & marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour, then put into a crock pot on low setting or on high setting & cook until meat is tender.  Do not over cook it, you are adding spice once the meat has been prepared.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,yellow pepper,american cheese,sirloin steak,tabasco sauce,red chili powder,orange zest
title: Tex Mex Orange Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange juice | 1 tablespoon orange zest | 1 tablespoon fresh orange juice | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 2 tablespoons minced american cheese | 2 lbs sirloin steaks, 1-inch thick, trimmed and cut into 1-inch chunks | 1/2 cup diced red chili powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients except beef in a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: balsamic vinegar,asparagus spear,italian tomato,grain rice,pastry crust pie,chipotle pepper,italian seasoning mix
title: Smoky Chipotle Asparagus Rice Pie
ingredients: 1 recipe pastry for a 9 inch single crust pie | 1/2 cup dry short-grain rice, uncooked | 1 can italian-style diced tomatoes | 1 can chipotle peppers, diced | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning mix ( wildtree italian seasoning mix ) | 1 1/2 cups steamed asparagus spears, cut diagonally into 2 inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Line a 10 inch pie plate with pastry.

title: Salmon Salad With Peanuts and Cucumbers
ingredients: 2 teaspoons coarse sea salt | 1 teaspoon coarse sea salt | 1 large cucumber, peeled, seeded, thinly sliced | 2 cups of thinly sliced cooked salmon, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/2 cup green seedless grape, halved | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 cup sliced dry-roasted unsalted peanuts
instructions: Combine the sea salt, cucumber, and salmon in a large bowl.  Stir in the green seedless grapes.  Pour in half of the salt.  If planning on serving immediately, chill, covered, for several hours.  Before serving, sprinkle top with salt.  Garnish with peanuts.

title: Crunchy Capsicum Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup bread flour, plain | 1/2 cup desiccated coconut flakes | 1 cup desiccated green capsicum | 1/2 cup cornstarch | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, finely chopped
instructions: Place dry ingredients in a bowl and cut in the nuts until finely chopped.  With your hands, blend the hazelnuts into the mixture.  Roll the dough into balls and flatten into smooth cookies.  Refrigerate until required.

title: Grilled Cheese Quesadillas
ingredients: 4 slices sharp cheddar cheese ( about 3 cups ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce
instructions: In a small bowl, using a very sharp knife, cut several 1 - 2 1/2 deep slashes into cheese with knife running over and off sides of cheese.  Insert pepper sauce diagonally into slashes and secure end of cheese with a wooden spoon.  Place 2 slices of cheese on hot griddle.  Cover griddle and cook 2 - 3 minutes on each side or until cheese is well melted and slightly brown.  Serve hot or at room temperature, with favorite mexican dishes for dipping.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,peanut oil,coffee,shallot,chicken breast half,cornflour,lettuce leaf
title: Crunchy Chinese Chicken Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 150 g skinless chicken breast halves, cut in thin strips | 2 tablespoons shallots, finely chopped | 150 g roasted peanuts, shelled & crushed | 1/4 cup cake flour | 1/4 cup cornflour | 1 tablespoon instant coffee | 3/4 cup warm milk
instructions: Mix together the chicken, shallots, peanuts & flour, then mix in the instant coffee stir in the warm milk to form a sticky, thick & smooth paste.  Divide onto each of the lettuce leaves then roll up tightly.  Secure with tooth picks if desired.  Heat the oil in a wok over a high heat, then place the rolls into it & fry quickly for 30 seconds on each side.  Serve hot.

title: Bifes De Atun (Red Wine Dipping Sauce)
ingredients: 600 ml red wine | 4 tablespoons honey | 1 tablespoon ground coriander ( or a mixture of cilantro and mint leaves ) | 250 ml creme fraiche | 1 tablespoon dry red wine
instructions: Pour the red wine, honey, ground coriander, creme fraiche and red wine into a pan, making sure to mix and heat it through.  Do not boil, the honey will keep cooking with the wine.  Serve with fresh bread or vegetables of your choice.

title: Barley Tomatoes & Beefsteak
ingredients: 2 lbs beefsteak tomatoes | 1 cup pearl barley | honey
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees.  Wash the tomatoes & slice them in 3/4 inch slices.  Place in a casserole dish and cover with water.  Cover and bake for 1 hour.  Mix the barley and tomato liquid together in a saucepan.  Bring to a boil & cover the saucepan.  Cook on low heat until barley is tender, about 20 - 25 minutes.  To serve, drain the barley, and ladle tomato mixture inches.  Top with honey and serve with steamed new potatoes, if desired.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,tomato green chilies,cardamom seed,golden raisin,dill pickle relish,bean sprout,chicken breast fillet
title: Moroccan Chicken Salad
ingredients: 400 g chicken breast fillets | 1 lemon juice and zest, grated | 100 ml dill pickle relish | 100 g tomatoes with green chilies, chopped coarsely | 200 g mixed bean sprouts | 100 g fresh tomato rounds, halved | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed
instructions: Place chicken in a shallow nonreactive baking dish.  Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl with a splash of olive oil and sprinkle over the chicken.  Combine salad ingredients and serve.

title: Mexican Pumpkin and Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 600 g fresh brussels sprouts, trimmed | 1/2 cup fresh jalapeno, diced | 1 beef bouillon cube, crushed | 275 g pumpkin or 275 g winter squash, diced | 2 green tomatoes, chopped
instructions: Trim off any thick stems from sprouts, then cut in half lengthways and boil for 6 - 8 minutes until tender.  Drain and plunge sprouts and jalapenos into cold water to halt the cooking process.  Transfer into a large saucepan, pour over broth cube and water and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat, add pumpkin and tomatoes.  Bring back to simmer and simmer gently until the sprouts are just tender, about 25 - 35 minutes.

title: Easy Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 trimmed boneless beef chuck roast, trimmed | 4 quarts instant tea | 1 quart whipping cream | 5 teaspoons kosher salt
instructions: Place roast in a dutch oven large enough to hold it, with enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil over medium high heat, cover, and cook until easily pierced, 1 to 2 hours.  While the roast is cooking, cover the pot with a lid or plastic wrap and bring to a boil over medium high heat.  Let simmer until easily pierced, about 15 minutes. title: Leek & Hot Pepper Scented Scented Leeks

You can leave out all the vegetables at this stage or keep at room temperature.
