ingredients: 9 cups loosely packed shredded cabbage | 1 cup white cheddar cheese or 1 cup other mild-flavored cheese | 1/4 cup thinly sliced green olives in brine ( can be mixed for a milder cajun flavor if desired ) | 1/4 cup pickle relish | 2 teaspoons basmati rice or 2 teaspoons white cheddar cheese
instructions: In 1 1/2 to 2 qt.  Dutch oven, layer the first three ingredients and beginning and ending with the cheese.  Cover loosely with foil and bake 2 hours at 325 degrees.  Serve with sliced almonds if desired.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,kosher salt,cayenne pepper,kaffir lime leaf
title: Homemade Kaffir Lime Salt
ingredients: 2 cups kosher salt | 2/3 cup dried red chili pepper or 2/3 cup cayenne pepper, coarsely chopped | 2/3 cup dried kaffir lime leaves | 2 teaspoons cayenne pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl, stirring for a minute or two.  Rinse off seeds and coarsely crush and mix with crushed lime leaves and cayenne pepper.

title: Danish Apricot and Cardamom Cookies (Vanille Kremen)
ingredients: 4 ounces apricot nectar ( may use honey if nectar is nectar ) | 4 ounces cake flour | 1/2 teaspoons dried marjoram or 1/2 teaspoon rosemary
instructions: Add nectar, cake flour and marjoram to blender until smooth.  Cut with a knife into 1 1/2 inch pieces.  Heat oil in small pan over medium heat until hot, cook, stirring constantly for 3 - 4 minutes or until bubbles appear on pan surface.  Immediately transfer cookies to paper towel lined plate and sprinkle with paprika.  Let dry until cool.  Store in a covered container at room temperature.

title: Oatmeal--Sorrel Groenkuchen
ingredients: 10 cups rolled oats | 2 stalks celery, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place all of the ingredients in an oven proof bowl and stir with a wooden spoon until the oats are well mixed and smooth.  Pour into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish and cook in the preheated oven for 45 to 55 minutes, or until the oats are puffed and browned.  Leave for 15 minutes after removing from the oven, to cool completely.

Random Ingredients: red apple,tomato green chile pepper,black bean,kielbasa,corn oil,egg bread,chicken bouillon cube,mayonnaise
title: Black Bean and Apple Pan Fry
ingredients: 2 teaspoons corn oil | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chile peppers, drained | 2 cans cooked black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 egg bread, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon cubes | 1 package kielbasa, cut into slices | 2 medium red apples, thinly sliced
instructions: Lightly coat pan with canola or light olive oil.  Heat oil on medium high heat.  Place bread in pan.

title: Spanish Tapas (Warm-Up)
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated flah-style flour tortillas | 1/3 cup half-and-half | minced fresh apricot preserves ( optional ) | 1/3 cup finely chopped kalamata olives | 1 tablespoon rice wine
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f.  Arrange tortillas in a rectangular baking dish just large enough to hold them, one at a time.  Brush evenly with half and half.  Cover with foil.  Bake at 350°f for 25 - 35 minutes, or until heated through.  To serve, top each tortilla with a spoonful of apricot preserves and a small handful of pitted kalamata olives, if using.

Random Ingredients: beer,farfalle pasta,chicken thigh,fennel seed,orange juice zest,raspberry jam,green mango
title: Chicken with Nuts with Raspberry-Egg Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken thighs | 1/3 cup orange juice and zest | 1 cup dry farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 green mango - peeled, seeded, and cut into thin wedges | 6 frozen raspberries in light syrup | 2 tablespoons raspberry jam | 2 teaspoons fennel seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add farfalle pasta, and cook until al dente, about 8 minutes.  Drain.  Transfer farfalle to a clean dish, and cut into 4 serving pieces.  Cut up the chicken into thin bite size pieces.  Spray the chicken pieces with cooking spray, and stir in orange juice and zest.  Place into prepared 9x13 inch baking dish.  Place mango into a bowl, and cut into 2 wedges each.  Arrange around the chicken, and top with raspberries and raspberry jam.  Cover, and bake 30 minutes in the preheated oven.  Remove from oven, and let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package ramen noodles | 1 package cauliflower florets | 1 teaspoon potato starch | 1 cup russet potato, diced
instructions: Cook noodles until tender and drain.  Cook potatoes in boiling water.  While potatoes are cooking, combine noodles, cauliflower, and starch in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: allspice,angel hair pasta,cream corn,cucumber,silken tofu,white wine
title: Tofu Pasta
ingredients: 1 package angel-hair pasta, broken into four pieces, or to taste | 2 packages silken tofu | 1/2 cup sliced cucumber, or more to taste | 2 cans cream-style corn, drained | 2 cups white wine | 1 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Pour a large pot of lightly salted water into the center of a steamer.  Bring water to a boil, and immerse the angel hair pasta pieces into the water until cooked, about 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: red lentil,peanut butter,red chili powder,jalapeno pepper,swiss cheese
title: Lentils Ww
ingredients: 250 g red lentils | 100 g swiss cheese, grated | 1/4 cup peanut butter, free of salt | 1 red chili powder, crushed ( i used adobo brand ) | 1/4 teaspoon red chili powder
instructions: Soak lentils in water for 1 hour.  Drain.  Place in large bowl.  Cover with water and leave at room temperature for 1 hour.  Drain into colander over bowl.  In medium saucepan, combine cheese, peanut butter, chili powder, chili powder, and salt.  Add to lentils, mixing well.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack pepper cheese,dark brown sugar,coriander powder,brown mustard seed,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Brown Mustard Cheese Spread
ingredients: 8 ounces monterey jack pepper cheese, grated ( about 1 cup ) | 2 tablespoons brown mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 cup firmly packed dark brown sugar | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Heat a small nonstick skillet over medium heat.  Sprinkle mustard seeds on lightly buttered ground mustard seeds.

title: Crazy Delicious & Easy Low Fat Low Calorie Seafood & Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean ground beef ( i prefer 93 % fat, but use what you like ) | 1/2 lb fresh crabmeat or 1/2 lb imitation crabmeat, shredded | 1/2 cup dry red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons sherry or 2 tablespoons whiskey | fat-free topping, of choice ( i use miracle whip )
instructions: Mix all ingridients.  Roll into 1 balls.  Bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes.  Serve over crackers, if desired.  They are yummy.  I use the Miracle Whip & drizzle on top of each one while cooking so the kids don 't mind.

title: Chilled Tomato Soup with Raspberry
ingredients: 1 can raspberries | 1 can tomato paste | 2 cups beef stock ( or more )
instructions: Combine raspberries and tomato paste in small saucepan and heat over low heat.  Slowly pour in beef stock, stirring until boiling and simmering for 5 minutes, remove from heat and whisk soup until smooth.  Ladle into bowls, top with a bit more raspberry, or serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno chile,vinegar,pork tenderloin,sage leaf,frangelico,red pepper flake,red capsicum,cucumber

ingredients: 1/4 cup shredded mixed pecorino cheese or 1/4 cup grated pecorino cheese | 1 red capsicum, deseeded and finely chopped | 1 jalapeno chile, seeded and finely chopped | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes or 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 cup finely chopped seeded cucumber | 4 fresh sage leaves, or more to taste | 1 1/2 cups coarsely country-style pork tenderloin, cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1 teaspoon frangelico ( optional, optional ) or 1 teaspoon grand marnier ( optional, optional )
instructions: Stir together pecorino cheese and capsicum until creamy, then add chilli, red pepper and cuke and stir to combine.  Place pork cubes between sheets of plastic wrap and using your hands, flatten until about 1 1/2 inches thick and place in a freezer bag. Grill over high direct heat, turning occasionally, for 6 to 7 minutes, or until pork is cooked through and pork is cooked through.  Transfer to a serving plate, and serve drizzled with the chile and cucumber relish.

title: Chocolate Cracked Black Truffles
ingredients: 10 ounces unsweetened cocoa | chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Combine the cocoa and parsley in a small heavy saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly until the cocoa has melted.  Remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: head cabbage,green chile,yeast,sun tomato,white wine vinegar,kidney bean
title: Mexican Colcannon-Cabbage Rolls-W-Dressing
ingredients: 1 tablespoon instant yeast | 1/2 cup white wine vinegar | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato, chopped | 1/2 cup canned kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 small head of cabbage, shredded ( about 1 pound ) | 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons minced seeded green chiles ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in vinegar set aside.  Combine 1/3 cup sun dried tomatoes, beans, cabbage, sun dried tomatoes, and optional chiles in a bowl.  Stir together and set aside.  To use, spray a medium saucepan with nonstick oil add 1/2 tablespoon sun dried tomato dressing and set over medium high heat.  When the pan is hot, add the mustard mixture and spread the cabbage mixture evenly into the pan.  When cabbage leaves have spread, remove from heat and set aside.  Preheat the oven, 425 degrees f, or pizza stone.  Place a 9x13 baking pan on the oven rack and immediately unroll the colcannon mix.  Place in the middle of the baking sheet.  Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until the crust is browned and the filling has browned.  Let cool for at least 15 minutes before slicing.  Note, if the colcannon mixture is to liquid, boil it down with a potato masher.  To use, rinse the colcannon and spread it on a plate or cutting board, sprinkle with the 1 tablespoon of sun dried tomato dressing, and top with some sliced cabbage.

title: Olive Oil and Couscous
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon freshly chopped thyme sprigs | 1 tablespoon couscous
instructions: Put extra virgin oish in a bowl with the oil and herbs.  Pour over the couscous and mix well.  Enjoy.

title: Vermicelli

instructions: Cook vermicelli according to package directions.  While still hot, add remaining ingredients, stirring to mix well, and mix in using a pastry blender or slotted spoon.  Turn into a lightly greased 10x15 inch baking dish, and bake in a preheated 350 degree oven until slightly browned, about 40 to 45 minutes.  Cool, release form heat, and cut in squares to serve.

title: Tres Leches
ingredients: 1 medium head cabbage | 1 package hamburger | 1/2 cup canadian bacon | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1/4 cup kahlua | 1/4 cup kahlua | mustard powder | cumin
instructions: Cook cabbage in boiling water according to package directions.  Drain and cool.  Meanwhile, saute hamburger and bacon until browned.  Drain and reserve 1/2 cup of the drippings.  Shred cabbages or shred using two forks.  To hamburger and bacon mixture, add 1/2 cup of the liqueur and 1/2 cup of the canola.  Mix well.  Add mustard and cumin and season with additional mustard and cumin if necessary.  To assemble stack the cabbage and meat mixture on a platter.

Random Ingredients: parmesan cheese,pork shoulder,chipotle powder,cumin powder,shortening,soy sauce
title: Mexican Pork
ingredients: 1/4 cup shortening | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1/4 cup snipped parsley-garlic chile powder | 2 teaspoons cumin powder | 1/3 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon dried chipotle powder
instructions: Cut shortening in bowl with pastry brush.  Add remaining ingredients.  Mix all ingredients together lightly.  Roll mixture into 1/2 inch balls.

title: Maple Syrup Wafers
ingredients: 2 large pears, peeled, cored, chopped | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 1 medium apple, peeled, finely diced | 125 g fresh snow peas
instructions: Place the pears in a large bowl and pour over the maple syrup.  Add the apples, then sprinkle over the sea salt.  Stir to mix.  Let stand for 30 minutes.  Preheat the oven to 220 degrees centigrade.  Place the snow peas in a roasting tray lined with baking paper and roast in the centre of the oven for 10 minutes.  Reduce the temperature to 180 degrees centigrade, then roast for an additional 10 minutes.  Transfer to a clean tea towel to drain.  Place in shallow bowls to serve.

title: French Country Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons quick-cooking spray | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | 1 cup sherry wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 f.  Spray a roasting pan with cooking spray and add the bouillon and sherry.  Place chicken on top of the sherry and lightly coat the chicken with this mixture.  Bake uncovered 20 minutes or until chicken is tender.

Random Ingredients: double acting baking powder,vegetable juice,red chili pepper,chicken breast,chicken cutlet,golden syrup
title: Chilli Chicken and Chicken Biscuits
ingredients: 2 ounces vegetable juice | 6 ounces chicken breast, boneless cut into strips | 6 ounces chicken cutlets | 7 ounces double-acting baking powder | 2 ounces golden syrup | 1 red chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped or 1 teaspoon crushed dried red pepper | 7 fluid ounces vegetable juice
instructions: Heat the griddle or frypan, put the chicken in, put aside.  Put the oven to 300°f mix and sift the oil and baking powder into a bowl, put the golden syrup, chile and vegetable juice into the bowl and mix.  Add the wet mixture to the dry and stir well.  Line a deep ovenproof dish with baking parchment and set aside.  Dip chicken in mix and then shake off any excess.  Put the chicken on the parchment and cook slowly until golden, for about 10 - 12 minutes, turning once or twice during that time.  Remove from the oven and set aside with stock.  Put the stock on to cook the chicken.

title: Tahini Puree
ingredients: 2 cups tahini | 1/2 cup honey
instructions: In a blender, combine tahini, honey and 2 1/2 cups water.  Cover and process until smooth.

title: Carnitas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs pork butt | 4 cans kidney beans | canola oil | 1/2 cup fresh basil
instructions: Chop pork, if using large pieces.  Rinse.  Boil beans until al dente, drain.  Heat oil to 375°f.  Using an oven proof skillet, place pork butt fat in skillet and brown on all sides.  Place in a slow cooker and add 1 drained can of kidney beans, fresh basil.  Cook on low for 3 hours.  Serve over fresh jasmine rice.

title: Pimiento and Leek Popcorn
ingredients: 600 g fresh leeks | 1 large leek | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 6 tablespoons ketchup | 1 pinch grated orange peel | 40 g sliced pimientos, drained
instructions: Dice leeks into 3mm pieces.  Chop leek finely.  Heat oil.  Chop leeks into 3mm pieces.  Stir fry leeks for 5 minutes add ketchup and orange peel, and fry 1 minute.  Add drained pimientos.  Cover and cook for another 3 - 4 minutes or until leeks are soft.

Random Ingredients: chili flake,celery salt,cranberry,chili pepper,mint leaf,stewing beef,brown rice,cinnamon
title: Crock Pot Stifado (Stifado)
ingredients: 750 g stewing beef, cubed | 1 1/2 cups brown rice or 1 1/2 cups pearl barley | 2 -3 teaspoons chili flakes | 1/4 chili pepper, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons dried cranberries | 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1 tablespoon dried mint leaves | 1 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Place beef and brown rice in a 5 litre freezer bag.  Add the chilli, cranberries, chili flakes, celery salt and cinnamon.  Seal tightly and shake until well combined.  Place in a slow cooker.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,garam masala,sea salt,beef brisket,water chestnut,golden raisin
title: Corned Beef With Raisins
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 2 tablespoons coarse sea salt | 1 can water chestnuts, in water drained and chopped | 2 tablespoons golden raisins, seed in | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Place corned beef, fat side down on a rack in an oven, and roast at 350 degrees for 1 1/2 hours to tenderize the meat.  Meanwhile, in a medium bowl combine salt, garam masala, and 1/2 tablespoons salt.  Drain water chestnuts and place in a colander.  Toss with remaining salt until well coated.  Place raisins and sesame seeds over meat and allow to sit for 10 to 15 minutes.  Add water chestnuts and raisins.  Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: red pepper powder,cardamom pod,bean sprout,saffron thread,egg,taco seasoning,red wine vinegar
title: Easy Tunisian Egg Salad
ingredients: 4 eggs | 1/2 teaspoon saffron threads or 1/2 teaspoon saffron, crushed | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons red pepper powder | 4 teaspoons taco seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom pod | 1/2 cup bean sprouts
instructions: Crack eggs into a small bowl and mash with a fork.  Place egg yolks in a medium bowl and add saffron, vinegar, red bell pepper powder, taco seasoning & cardamom.  Mix well.  Add bean sprouts and the mashed eggs and mix well again.  Refrigerate for 2 hours.

title: Easy Parsnips Casserole
ingredients: 2 cups cooked rice | 1 1/2 lbs parsnips, peeled and sliced | 1 1/2 cups brown onions, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons all purpose greek seasoning ( use kosher if you can find it )
instructions: Saute rice in olive oil until browned.  Add onions and parsnips.  Sprinkle on greek seasoning.  Sprinkle top with paprika.  Bake 400 degrees for 20 minutes or until the casserole is bubbly.

title: Grilled Chicken Breasts With Molasses
ingredients: 4 chicken breast fillets ( skinless or boneless ) | 3 tablespoons molasses | ice cube
instructions: Remove any fat from the chicken fillets and discard.  Heat the grill to medium high and cook the chicken fillets for 2 minutes on each side, or until lightly browned.  Meanwhile, place the molasses in a small bowl.  Dip each chicken breast into the molasses and roll them up.  Place them on a grill/broiler tray.  Place the chicken under a preheated grill and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, turning them over once or twice, brushing or spraying with a little water halfway through cooking.  You may want to add an orange wedge and a little lime juice to the molasses mixture at this point, depending on the sweetness of the meat.  Serve with a bowl of cold water to soak.  Tip, this can also be made on a foreman grill and grilled.  Grill time will vary, depending on the thickness of your fillets.

title: Jamaican Carnitas
ingredients: 4 lbs pork roast | 2 cups milk powder
instructions: Cook pork roast on the stovetop on a low heat setting for the first 9 - 10 hours or until internal temperature reaches 160°f before removing from the heat.  When cool enough to handle, remove roast and reserve it for carnitas.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,black eyed pea,ham,flat leaf parsley
title: Ham & Black Eyed Pea Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2 cups shelled black-eyed peas, washed | 3 3 ounces cooked ham or 3 ounces smoked bacon, diced | 1 tablespoon fresh flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped
instructions: Put the beans in a large, wide, thick pan, and add the water, bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer uncovered for 5 - 7 minutes.  Drain, then cool.  When cool, stir through the ham.  Season to taste with salt and pepper, and gently mix through the parsley.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,wood chip,red wine vinegar,rosemary,golden raisin,granny smith apple,chili oil,russet potato
title: Apple and Potato Salad
ingredients: 5 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 3 tablespoons chili oil | 1 tablespoon rosemary | 2 lbs granny smith apples, cored, peeled and julienned | 1/2 cup golden raisin, halved | 2 1/2 lbs russet potatoes, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 6 large lettuce leaves | 8 wooden skewers or 8 bamboo skewers, soaked in water
instructions: In small bowl, whisk together vinegar, chili oil and rosemary.  Toss apple, raisins and potatoes with dressing, cover and refrigerate for 1 hour.  Preheat broiler.  Place rack 6 inches from heat and preheat broiler.  Brush or spray cookie sheet with a light layer of oil.  Arrange half of the potatoes in a single layer on cookie sheet.  Spread with half of the apple mixture.  Top with half of the rest of the potatoes.  Arrange three lettuce leaves on top.  Spoon half of the dressing over the slaw and sprinkle with remaining ingredients.  Cover and broil until heated through, 3 1/2 to 6 minutes.

title: Codfish and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 1/4 kg cod, skin & scales removed | 3 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 300 g mushrooms, sliced | 1 egg, beaten | 1 tablespoon marjoram | chutney, for serving
instructions: Rinse the cod with cold water and pat dry with paper towel, dust with a little of the flour, then dip into boiling water for about 3 - 4 minutes.  Once the fish is white and cooked, remove the bones from the fish and cut into serving sized pieces.  Drain and reserve the broth.  Add the fresh mushrooms to the pot, simmer for about 5 - 10 minutes, until they are softened and beginning to give off liquid.  Add the reserved broth and stir.  Cover and set aside.  Beat the egg in a bowl with the remaining flour, marjoram & salt.  Dip into the egg, coat lightly and marinate for 3 hours.  Serve the cod with the mushroom mixture and pass crusty bread cubes.  To serve, top with chutney.

ingredients: 1 pork loin roast, cut 1 inch thick | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes, or more to taste | 1 teaspoon dried orange peel, or to taste | 1 can refrigerated crescent rolls | 1 can crushed beets in syrup, or more to taste ( optional ) | 1 package mixed salad greens, or more to taste | 1 bottle chili pepper flavored cocktail with liquid
instructions: Rinse pork loin and pat dry with paper towels.

title: Cantaloupe Filling (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 lbs cantaloupe, seed and chop | 1/3 cup raisins | 3 tablespoons vegetarian worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon tequila
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Mix all ingredients together.  Fill pastry lined jelly roll pan with the filing.  Bake 20 - 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,american cheese,canola oil,cottage cheese,white chocolate,chili pepper flake,green bean,granny smith apple
title: Green Bean & Apple Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans | 1/2 lb fresh white chocolate | 1 granny smith apple, chopped | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 15 ounces cottage cheese, drained | 1/2 cup canola oil | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 cup shredded american cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.  Line a 9 x 13 baking dish with aluminum foil and spray liberally with non stick cooking spray.  Cut the green beans in half lenghtwise.  Toss with about half of the chopped apple, cannellini beans and half of the cottage cheese until coated.  Sprinkle with chile flakes.  Grate the remaining apple and scatter over mixture.  In a large bowl, combine your shredded cheese and remaining cottage cheese.  Fold the cheese into your cheese mixture.  Stir until mixed well.  Spoon mixture evenly into the prepared pan.  Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, until lightly browned on top.

Random Ingredients: red beet,dark rum,parsley flake,monterey jack cheese,fontina cheese
title: Biftekos (Red Beet Chips)
ingredients: 2 large red beets | 1/4 cup shredded parmesan cheese or 1/4 cup asiago cheese | 1/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1/4 cup shredded fontina cheese | 1/4 cup dry dark rum or 1/4 cup brandy
instructions: Set oven to 400°f cut a slit in each beet to form a crown.  Cut away the tough bottom, and discard.  Cut the beets into 1/8 inch slices.  Heat 1/4 inch oil in a large skillet over medium high heat.  Add beets and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown about 8 to 10 minutes.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Remove to large baking sheet.  Drizzle with rum or brandy.

title: Penne Rosa con Salsa E Vitello
ingredients: 2 lbs veal, cut into cubes | 1 package spaghetti | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 1 tablespoon black mustard seeds | 1/2 cup sugar cube | 1 jar salsa
instructions: Heat the chili oil in a skillet.  Put the mustard seeds in a cup and sprinkle over a baking sheet.  In a separate bowl, put the veal and sugar.  Coat the entire veal and sugar, then put them into the skillet containing the mustard seeds and chili oil.  Cook over low until it becomes dry and tender.  Then put the contents into a pot and add the salsa, stirring well to bring it all together.  Let this simmer on low for 20 minutes.  Pour into a large bowl with a lid.

instructions: Cook bacon in a frying pan for about 5 minutes drain bacon, reserving 3 tbsp fat.  Add leek and chicken stock to bacon fat in pan.  Cover and simmer for about 20 minutes.  Stir in limeade concentrate and whole kernel corn.  Cook for 5 minutes.  Add cherry tomatoes and heat through.  Pour soup into a casserole or bowl, sprinkle with bacon.

ingredients: 350 -450 g broiler-fryer chickens | 100 g couscous | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 2 green cardamom pods | 1 teaspoon jalapeno pepper, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon oats | 1 tablespoon plain oatmeal
instructions: Cut the chicken in half and remove any skin & visible fat.  Cut the chicken pieces and keep it aside discard the fat.  Cook the couscous in boiling water for approximately 7 minutes. Mix the oats and oatmeal together in a shallow bowl.  Coat a non stick frypan with baking spray and heat it over a medium high heat and then add the chicken.  Cook for approximately 10 - 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables have softened and turned golden brown in color.  Serve the pan and chicken with the dressing poured over.

instructions: In a small saucepan mix together the skim milk and yeast.  Add the beef slices, cover with water and bring to a boil.  Reduce to a simmer and cook for 7 minutes. Preheat the oven to 120c or gas mark grease a 5 liter ovenproof bowl.  Spoon in the yoghurt then bake for approximately 20/25 minutes or until set.

title: White Gazpacho
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked rice | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon dried mint leaves | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon minced green chili | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon minced jalapeno pepper | 1/4 cup chopped onion powder | 1/4 cup dry white wine or 1/4 cup vegetable broth | 2 ounces brandy or 2 ounces whiskey
instructions: Place rice in a bowl of cold water.

title: Grapeseed
ingredients: 2 teaspoons capers | 2 teaspoons coarsely chopped yellow bell peppers | 12 flour tortillas
instructions: Rinse the capers under cool running water, drain, and set aside.  Heat a skillet over medium heat until very hot.  Add the bell pepper, capers, and 1/4 teaspoon of the salt.  Cook, stirring and turning over, until most of the liquid has evaporated and the peppers are softened, about 3 minutes.  Place a tortilla, or an ungreased griddle, on the cooking grate over medium heat.  Spread the peppers evenly and cook until just beginning to brown, 30 to 45 seconds.  Flip the tortilla over and cook about 30 seconds longer or until the tortilla is slightly crisped on the bottom.  Slide the tortilla with a spatula onto a plate.  Spread the peppers over the tortillas and serve warm.

title: Fruity Cheese Filled Grape Leaves
ingredients: 32 -36 grape leaves | 14 ounces greek yogurt | 4 ounces double cream | 1/2 - 1 ounce mixed herbs ( your choice ) | 1 -2 teaspoon tomato juice | 1 -2 cup shredded mexican cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese, and chill well.  Heat in a small saucepan over a low heat. Spread about 2 tbs of cooled mixture onto a grape leaf and sprinkle with shredded cheese.  Fold over to make a half circle.  Serve, with french bread or as a sandwich with grilled veggies and salsa fresca.

title: Steak and Quinoa with Herring
ingredients: 1/4 cup quinoa | 1/4 cup herring fillets | 1/2 cup prepared pasta sauce | 1 1/2 cups leftover steak, shredded

instructions: Combine rice, oats, coffee liqueur, celery, bacon, and broccoli in a large bowl, stirring lightly.  Mix in vegetables.  Cover and refrigerate 1 to 15 minutes.  Serve.

title: Easy Phyllo Crust
ingredients: 16 sheets frozen phyllo dough, thawed | 1 cup hot sauce, divided | 1/2 cup bottled sweet sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Unroll one sheet of phyllo dough, then set it on a piece of wax paper.  Repeat with remaining sheets and phyllo dough, placing them on a floured work surface and pressing them so they’re evenly spaced.  Place 3 phyllo sheets on top, overlapping each to about half an inch of thickness.  Sprinkle about 2 tablespoons of hot sauce liberally onto phyllo sheets, then top with a second sheet, brushing this with 1 tablespoon of hot sauce.  Roll up and place on a work surface.  Drape the sheet lengthwise.  Repeat with 3 more sheets and remaining sheets, brushing each roll with leftover hot sauce.  Wrap in the waxed paper and place on a cookie sheet.  Repeat with the remaining phyllo, sauce and phyllo.  Bake in the preheated oven until the crust is bubbling and golden, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,brown rice,salsa,pork loin,kidney bean,wheat flour
title: Mexican Pork and Rice Burgers
ingredients: 3/4 cup cooked brown rice | 1/3 cup canned kidney beans, drained | 1/4 cup salsa ( mild or hot ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 3/4 cup mexican blend cheese, grated | 1 1/2 lb pork loin ( cooked )
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high.  Combine all ingredients except the cheese until well mixed, pour seasoning onto meat and cook about 1 minute.  Shape meat into 6 patties.  Grill 3 minutes or until done to your liking.

Random Ingredients: pimiento,vidalia onion,ha avocadoes,irish cream,swiss cheese,ice water
title: Danish Avocado Cream With Reisins
ingredients: 8 ripe hass avocadoes | 1/2 cup irish cream, whipped | 1/2 cup smoked swiss cheese, shredded | 2/3 cup vidalia onion, finely chopped | ice water
instructions: Remove avocados from shells, remove shells and mash very lightly.  Add in the remaining ingredients.  Put in a collander and garnish with parsley or coriander.  Serve in an avocados or other decorative glass.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,penne pasta,kidney bean,limeade concentrate,fennel,rosemary,almond,pear
title: Bow Ties With Kidney Beans and Pears
ingredients: 1 1 lb penne pasta or 1 lb elbow macaroni | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed ( red kidney beans may also be used, but the red kidney bean adds more flavor ) | 3 -4 teaspoons frozen limeade concentrate | 3 -4 teaspoons rosemary ( fresh, chopped or chopped ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel, chopped ( dried & crushed, if fresh, add more ) | 8 ounces pears, peeled, cored, sliced | 1/4 cup toasted whole almond, slivered ( optional ) | fresh flat-leaf italian parsley or green onion, for garnish
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook pasta to al dente, according to package directions.  Drain and set aside.  If you're using dry lentils, rinse well.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil and cook elbow macaroni al dente, or other similar pasta, until al dente, drain.  Drain.  While macaroni is cooking, combine the limeade concentrate with the rosemary, fennel, pears and about 2 tsp of the slivered almonds.  Pour soup into a 3 quart casserole and spread evenly.  Thin with a little cornstarch if necessary.  Add drained pasta, toss gently to mix all ingredients together with soup, adding additional cornstarch if desired.  You can garnish with additional green onions if desired.

title: Scallops and Onions
ingredients: 16 large scallops | 1 cup whole wheat flour | 1/2 cup finely chopped red onion
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Dust a baking sheet with flour.  Spread scallops in a half inch layer on the baking sheet.  Sprinkle with red onion.  Make sure scallops are well covered.  Bake 12 - 15 minutes, remove scallops and place on a plate covered with a warm tea towel.  Sprinkle scallops with white wine vinegar or lemon juice and toss gently.  Serve immediately.

title: Easy Smoky Pie (French Apple Pie)
ingredients: 1 lb frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 1/4 cups loose smoked bread, finely crumbled | olive or corn flakes, for sprinkling on pie
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f.  Roll out the pastry on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of 1/8.  With a 2 1/2 or 3 round cutter cut out 8 circles, each circle approximately 1 1/2 inches in diameter, with a 6 inch diameter circle.  Place each circle on a lightly greased or parchment lined baking sheet.  Combine the olives with the bread crumbs and pinch to blend thoroughly.  Sprinkle the surface of the pie with some of the crumb mixture.  Bake for 15 to 18 minutes or until golden brown.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: yellow cake mix,pork,balsamic vinegar,cheese,iceberg lettuce,dill weed,jalapeno
title: Crock Pot Italian Pork Sandwich
ingredients: 3 lbs bone-in pork ( boston butt ) | 10 cups chopped, shredded cheese ( i used mozzarella and provolone ) | 1 1/4 cups chopped fresh dill weed | 1 cup finely chopped jalapeno ( about 4 medium ) | 1 box yellow cake mix | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 2 cups iceberg lettuce, shredded
instructions: Place meat in the bottom of a crock pot.  Top with cheeses, dill, jalapeños and jalapeño.  Whisk together the yellow cake mix and vinegar.  Pour over meat.  Cover and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours.  Cut meat across grain and serve on bread with lettuce.

instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Place potato wedges on the lined baking sheet and brush both sides of each wedge with olive oil or olive oil.

title: Hummus - Quick & Easy
ingredients: 250 g farmer cheese, cut into small cubes | 1 can chickpeas, drained
instructions: Empty contents of tin into a bowl and microwave for 1 1/2 minutes.  Stir in the farmer cheese cubes, drained chickpeas and 2 tbsp water.

title: Berry or Raspberry Bruschetta
ingredients: 1 lb fresh strawberries | 1/2 cup fresh raspberry, toasted | sun-dried tomato oil, to brush
instructions: Put berries in a bowl and pour over enough sun dried tomato oil to cover the berries.  Marinate for at least 30 minutes.  Lightly brush the raspberries onto a small plate.  Roll each ramekin up firmly and cut each piece in half.  Lay the raspberries on the serving plate.  Garnish and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: white bread,spaghetti squash,green cardamom pod,worcestershire sauce,salt black pepper,paprika,white onion,rigatoni pasta
title: Spaghetti Squash and Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked rigatoni pasta | 1 squash - peeled, seeded and sliced into 3/4-inch thickness | 2 1/2 tablespoons paprika | 1 white onion, chopped | 1 pinch ground green cardamom pods | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1/4 cup white worcestershire sauce | 2 slices white bread, crusts removed
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook rigatoni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.  Drain.  Place a steamer insert into a saucepan over boiling water, and set over the saucepan.  Cook the spaghetti squash slices, uncovered, in the steamer until tender and slightly shrunken, turning occasionally, about 45 minutes.  Whisk paprika, onion, green cardamom, salt, black pepper, and white worcestershire sauce together in a bowl.  Slice bread into 1 1/2 inch slices, and spread bread slices on a cutting board.  Roll drained spaghetti squash slices in the paprika mixture to coat, and slice into 1/4 inch wide strips, using more or less to cover bread slices, if desired.  Arrange rice on a serving platter, and top with sliced bread.

title: Chili Chicken Packets
ingredients: 2 boneless chicken breast halves | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Cut slits in the top of each chicken breast.  Set chicken breasts aside, but do not cut the ends of the chicken.  Place chicken on foil lined cookie sheet.  Top with cheese.  Bake at 400 oven for 20 - 25 minutes or until chicken is cooked and cheese is melted.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,pork shoulder,steak,cream mushroom soup,ginger,parsley
title: Pork Chop
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 3 kaffir lime leaves or 6 -8 slices lime peel | 1/2 cup sour cream ( can also use low fat ) | 1/2 cup fresh parsley, chopped | ginger, cut into wedges ( optional )
instructions: Trim fat from chops, and trim off fat.  Cut into 1 1/2 cubes, and season with salt, pepper and lime leaves. title: Rigatoni With Watermelon and Turnips (Salat Iz Pomidorhas)

instructions: Place watermelon, walnuts, and orange juice in a medium saucepan with a lid.  Heat over medium high heat, stirring occasionally.  Cook until steam rises from surface, about 5 minutes.  Stir rigatoni into melty melty melty melty melty melty melty melty melty melty melty melty melter.  Cook until pasta is tender, about 10 minutes.  Cook turnip in boiling water until tender, about 5 minutes.  Drain and serve.

title: Crunchy Brown Rice

instructions: Place the rice in a bowl or pan with just enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil.  Simmer covered, for 10 minutes, until all the water is absorbed and the rice is tender. Serve or keep warm.

For herb wraps, mix the dried spices into the prepared paste and coat the lentils.  Arrange the lentils, french onion and tarragon mixture on a bed of baby lettuce.

instructions: Place chicken breasts in greased 13 x 9 pan, and top with bean mixture.  Cover with noodles.  Add cool whip and mushrooms, and sprinkle with cheese.  Bake, uncovered in 350 degree oven for 20 minutes, or until cheese begins to bubble.

instructions: Toast the sunflower seeds according to package directions, and set aside in a dish to cool.  In a medium bowl, toss the lima beans, chopped dates, chopped shallot, sour cream, 1/4 cup sunflower seeds, fennel seeds, and 1 teaspoon sunflower seeds toasted sunflower seeds.  In a 13x9 inch metal baking dish, layer half of the tilapia fillets in a single layer with 1/3 of the bean mixture, top with 1/3 of the date and sunflower mixture, followed by 1/3 of the creamed cheese mixture.  Repeat layering tilapia and date/sunflower mixture, ending with creamed cheese.  Spread thyme sprigs and last teaspoon of sunflower seeds across top.  Cover, and refrigerate overnight to soak up the flavors.  Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.  Remove from the refrigerator in the last 15 minutes of baking, and sprinkle evenly with the remaining sunflower and thyme sprigs.  Bake for 35 minutes, covered, until crisp and golden.  Serve with sour cream and remaining sunflower seeds.

title: Faux Linguine Bolognese
ingredients: 1 package fresh linguine | 1 pound corned beef brisket ( cut into 1-inch cubes ) | 1 can cannellini beans ( rinsed and drained ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons ground almonds ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 4 leaves iceberg lettuce- rinsed and dried
instructions: Place the prepared brisket in a large pot with water to cover, bring to a boil, and cook until the meat has turned white on the outside and the liquid is thick.  Set aside, and let cool.  Place the corned beef in a resealable plastic bag, and add enough cold water to cover it by an inch.  Shake the bag around to remove any excess air, and refrigerate several hours or overnight.  Place the corned beef, corned beef, cannellini beans, ground almonds, and almond extract into a large pot over medium high heat.  Cook and stir just until heated through, and set aside to cool.  Serve on a large platter, topped with lettuce leaves, and serve with warm cooked linguine.

title: Kukya Puffs
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry | 5 green cardamom pods | 1 1/4 cups liquid smoke, melted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f / 190 degrees celsius.  Take pastry sheet out of freezer, line flat baking sheet with pastry.  Flatten the pastry sheet slightly.  Remove half the uncut pastry sheet at a time and cut into diamond shapes.  Repeat with remaining sheet slices.  Brush the inside of each diamond with melted butter.  Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, until puffs have risen.  Remove from oven, and cool on a wire rack.  Variation, for a birthday celebration, take the birthday celebration with a special kukya pudding and add chocolate kutchatti.  Stored in a small, non metallic bowl, combine hot pudding with cold water to form a soft glaze.  Spoon some of the glaze into your kukya glaze, and allow to soak inches.  Then spoon the rest of the glaze onto the kukya puffs, leaving about a 5 cm / 2 cm border of kukya at either the edge and the edge.  Bake for another 15 minutes or until puffs are very bubbling around the edges.

title: Baked Green Apple and Potato in Wine - Make Ahead and Slice
ingredients: 300 g english green potatoes | 250 g greek mixed sprouts | 2 granny smith apples | 1/4 cup chinese wine or 1/4 cup mirin | 1 tablespoon brown mustard seeds | 1/2 liter tea ( hot )
instructions: Place the potato and sprouts in a large pan and fill with cold water. Mix the wine and mustard in a microwave safe bowl and place for 40 seconds on a high power setting.  Place all the remaining ingredients in a large ovenproof dish or pan.  Add the mustard seeds and mix well.  Drain the potato, mix together with the potato mix and pour into an oven proof dish.  Cook for 1 - ½ hours on the top shelf until golden brown and a skewer comes out clean.  Serve warm and enjoy, makes 30 servings.

instructions: Combine celery, chutney and raspberries in glass bowl or jar.  Cover tightly and set into refrigerator to set chutney.  Store in refrigerate for up to one month.

instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the yogurt, parsley, miso, garlic, and chile peppers.  Refrigerate the mixture at least 1 hour. With a slotted spoon, remove the nuts and set aside on a baking sheet.  Top with the prepared breaded nuts. Use a spatula to lightly cool the chops.

instructions: Slice the beef thinly and then halve it length wise.  Cut the beef into thin strips about 3/4.  Combine the triple sec and nectarine and brush on the beef. title: Italian Cauliflower Salad "nuts"
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cauliflower florets, coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 cups cauliflower florets, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup green bell pepper, seeded, chopped | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing mix | 1/2 teaspoon yeast | 1/8 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1 kiwi, peeled- cut in 1/4-inch slices
instructions: In a 3 3/4 to 4 quart pan or wok combine the cauliflower, sliced green bell pepper and saute over medium heat for 5 minutes stirring frequently.  Stir in the salad dressing mix, and yeast.  Reduce heat to low, cover and cook for about 5 minutes, or until vegetables are tender.  Stir in the thyme, and allow to cool to room temperature.  Transfer to a bowl, cover, and refrigerate overnight, stirring often.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  The next day, to serve, remove from heat and allow to come to room temperature.

Random Ingredients: pork belly,maple syrup,pine nut,chicken tender,milk chocolate,penne,streaky bacon,oregano
title: Smoked Pork and Maple Pea Pasta with Maple Syrup and Bacon
ingredients: 150 g smoked bacon, trimmed | 1 chicken tenders, trimmed | 600 g baby portobello mushrooms, trimmed ( about 8 ounces ) | 150 g smoked pork belly, trimmed of fat and sinew cut into thick slices | 60 g milk chocolate, roughly chopped | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | fresh oregano, to garnish | 60 100 g macaroni rolls or 60 g penne pasta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees centigrade.  Cook the bacon in a large, deep sided frying pan until beginning to smoke, about 10 minutes, then transfer it to a plate to cool.  Break it into roughly 2 inch pieces and set aside.  Add the chicken and brown in the bacon fat for 8 minutes.  Add the mushrooms, bacon, choclate, oregano and maple syrup and toss until thoroughly coated in the marinade.  Cook, stirring every 2 minutes, for a further 6 minutes.  Transfer the pasta to a large roasting tin, then top with the smoked pork and sprinkle with a little oregano.  Roast in the oven for 40 minutes, or until it is golden and the pork is cooked through.  Allow the pasta to rest for 15 minutes and transfer it to a warmed serving platter.  Remove the pot from the stove and scatter over the crumbled bacon and oregano.  Top with a sprinkling of crumbs, fresh oregano and chopped oregano just before serving.

Random Ingredients: cilantro leaf,french bread,mexican tomato,puff pastry,ham,irish cream,watermelon
title: Baked Mexican Tomato Ham and Melon Parcels
ingredients: 2 french bread ( toasted or frozen ) | 3 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed ( to line 10 x 15 inch sheet pan ) or ( 11 ounce ) sheets frozen puff pastry ( to cover 10 x 15 inch sheet pan ) | 2/3 lb mexican ham, thinly sliced across the grain | 2 tablespoons diced mexican tomatoes ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons chopped pickled ginger ( to taste ) | 1/3 cup mexican crema ( to taste ) or 1/3 cup sour cream ( to taste ) | 1/3 cup watermelon, chunks chopped | 1/3 cup fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Line a large baking sheet with foil.  Preheat oven to 400°f.  Spread the sliced ham out in the pan.

title: Steamed Oysters With Chicken (Murgh Bathe)
ingredients: 12 large oysters | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1-inch chunks | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Place the oysters on a cutting board and pull out the beak and blemishes around them with a sharp knife.  Discard any large shucked oysters.  Wear your hands dry and gently push some of the oyster water back under the oysters to wash away the sand that you're holding.  Break off the top shell of each oyster shell through the shell and remove the beak as much as possible from shell.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,coriander,marjoram leaf,puff pastry,irish soda bread,self rising flour,chunky peanut butter
title: Peanut Dipping Bread & Butter Puffs
ingredients: 10 tablespoons natural chunky peanut butter | 1/2 cup golden raisins | 1 2/3 cups self-rising flour | 1 tablespoon dried marjoram leaves or 1 tablespoon dried sage | 1 tablespoon dried coriander | 12 ounces puff pastry ( cut into 12 rounds ) | mixed marjoram leaves ( to garnish ) | 3 tablespoons chunky peanut butter
instructions: Place the peanut butter, raisins and herbs into a mixing bowl.  Add the flour and stir until a shaggy dough forms.  Turn out onto a lightly floured surface.  Knead until smooth.  Roll out the puff pastry into a rectangle about 12 inches in diameter.  Spread the chunky peanut butter mixture into the center of the pastry.  Place the puff pastry dough over the peanut butter mixture and smooth out the surface to an even thickness.  Place the pastry top on a baking sheet and lightly dust the top with mixtures of dried herbs, peanut butter and mixed marjoram leaves.  Wrap in parchment paper or plastic wrap and refrigerate for 3 - 4 hours.  Preheat the oven to 400°f.  Bake for 10 minutes or until the pastry is puffed and golden.  Remove & allow to cool before slicing.

title: Bei Chien
ingredients: 1 large shallot | 4 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 3/4 cups yellow onions, finely chopped | 1/3 cup fresh basil leaf, finely chopped | 4 cardamom pods, crushed lightly to release the aromatic aroma | 2 cans cannellini ( white kidney beans )
instructions: Peel the shallot and finely chop the peel.  Heat half the oil in a deep, heavy based pan over medium heat.  Add the chopped shallots and cook, stirring, for about 5 minutes, till soft.  Add the onion and basil and continue cooking for another 5 minutes, till the onion is soft and beginning to caramelise slightly.  Add the crushed cardamom and turn the heat down further.  Add the cannellini and cook, uncovered, for about 20 minutes, until creamy.  Transfer to a blender, food processor or electric processor and blend, gradually, until smooth.

title: Veal with Mexican Vegetables
ingredients: 2 teaspoons creole seasoning | 1 pound ground veal | 1/2 pound frozen whole mixed vegetables | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: Heat a pot with about 1 inch of water over medium heat.  Cook and stir beef, creole seasoning, and veal in the hot water until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes.

title: Randy's Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 bag of lasagna noodles ( we like the hot variety but they are not recommended ) | 2 cups randy's or 2 cups cheddar cheese ( more or less ) | 2 cups lettuce | 1 package pepperoni, sliced | 2 cans of sliced olives | 1 cup frozen cranberries | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 1/2 cup liquid smoke | 1/8 cup dry crushed peanuts or 1/8 cup cashews
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions.  When noodles are done, drain and cool under running water, in separate bowl, mix together cheese, lettuce, pepperoni, olives, cranberries, salt, pepper, and liquid smoke.  Add noodles.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,red chili pepper,mushroom stem,swiss cheese,vegan cream,black olive,pesto sauce
title: Spicy Mushrooms With Swiss Cheese and Kalamata
ingredients: 7 ounces mushrooms stems, cleaned, trimmed, sliced on the diagonal into 1/2-inch-thick rounds ( or green ) | 9 ounces medium fresh mushrooms, trimmed, trimmed, sliced 1/2-inch thick ( or green ) | 3 ounces black olives, pitted, sliced ( or green ) | 1 -2 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper ( or to taste ) | 1 -2 slice swiss cheese or 1 -2 slice provolone cheese, about 1/2-inch dice | 6 -8 kaffir lime leaves ( or use 1/2 tsp red food coloring ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons pesto sauce ( try kha or kame khing, for a sweeter version ) | 1/2 cup vegan sour cream
instructions: In a heavy nonstick skillet, saute the mushrooms, breaking them up, in 1 - 2 tablespoons water until barely tender and beginning to stick to the pan, about 12 minutes.  Add olives and chiles, and continue to saute until olives are heated through, about 1 - 2 minutes longer.  Transfer mixture to a warm serving bowl.  Cut kaffir lime leaves in half, and cut half in half again, then slice each half crosswise into 1/2 strips.  Stir the kaffir lime leaves and pesto into the mushroom mixture.  Scoop into warm or room temperature bowl, then let stand for 10 minutes to chill slightly.  Spoon about 1/4 cup mushroom topping over each koula or slice of cheese, and gently spoon in remaining sauce.  Garnish with kaffir lime leaves.

title: Spinach With Cauliflower and Pineapple Glaze

title: Red Bell Pepper and Coriander Wraps
ingredients: red bell pepper | 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 2 teaspoons crushed dried coriander leaves | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1/8 teaspoon ground fennel bulb ( optional ) | 2 scoops vanilla ice cream | 2 scoops unbuttered ice | 10 flour tortillas
instructions: Blanch and peel the bell pepper.  With the end facing you, split each pepper through its core lengthwise to make a 2 inch chunk.  Place in a bowl of cold water, and drain. Add the ice cream, and allow the mixture to sit at room temp for 20 minutes to let the ice crystals melt to create a smooth.  Toss with the pepper mixture.  Arrange about 20 scoops of the chilled ice cream on each warmed tortilla, top with fresh ground black pepper and grated lime zest if desired.  Fold the ends of the tortillas around the filling, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: vanilla yogurt,dark sesame oil,chicken bouillon cube,fenugreek leaf
title: Chicken & Fenugreek Dip
ingredients: 100 g fenugreek leaves | 3/4 cup low-fat vanilla yogurt | 1/2 chicken bouillon cube | 2 teaspoons dark sesame oil

title: Crispy Herb Bread
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups biscuit, cookies | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 4 teaspoons pine nuts ( or other nuts you like ) or 4 teaspoons almonds ( or other nuts you like ) | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 orange bell pepper, sliced | 1/4 cup leaves of fresh basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or parchment paper.  In large bowl with a fork or with a food processor, combine biscuit crumbs, olive oil, almond extract and orange pepper slices and basil.  Place dough in a large plastic bag.  Using a rolling pin, roll dough out to 1/4 thick, 2 to 3/4 wide.  With a very sharp knife cut dough into 3x2 squares and place on prepared baking sheet, leaving 2 inches between squares.  Bake 10 to 13 minutes or until crisp.  Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes on baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: ziti pasta,lamb,mango chutney,grain rice,splenda granular,mozzarella cheese
title: Lamb & Mango Rissoni
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 1/2 cup uncooked long grain rice | 1 can sliced mango chutney | 1 teaspoon splenda granular | 8 ounces mozzarella cheese, shredded | 4 ounces ziti pasta
instructions: Cook the lamb and rice according to package directions.  Drain if using fresh meat.  Add the mango chutney, splenda, and 1/2 of the mozzarella cheese.  Mix well and set aside.  Cook ziti according to package directions, drain and cool under running water.  Set aside.  When ziti is almost cooked add the lamb mixture and stir to heat through.  Spread ziti in a large baking dish coated with cooking spray.  Layer ziti over the meat mixture, then top with the remaining mozzarella.  Bake, uncovered, at 350°f for about 25 minutes or until bubbly.  Serve warm, or chill up to 3 hours.

title: Rosemary and Caramelized Spanish Onions
ingredients: 4 cups spanish onions ( or other sweet onions ) | 1/4 cup catsup | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary, minced ( or 1 tsp dried )
instructions: Cut onions lengthwise in half, then crosswise into 3/4 slices.  Place on a wire rack in the broiler, and broil for 8 - 10 minutes, turning once, or until lightly browned.  While onions roast, combine remaining ingredients, and mix well.  After onions are browned, pour sauce over browned onions.

title: Cantaloupe with Amaretto
ingredients: 1 ripe cantaloupe | 2 tablespoons amaretto
instructions: Peel the melon by scooping out the seeds and membrane.  Put some amaretto in the top of a double thickness of foil.  Put a melon baller on top of the amaretto.  Wrap securely and foil over it and heat in a preheated medium to low oven, no more than 122 degrees f.  When the melon is cooked, transfer the melon baller to a serving platter and serve, garnished with a dollop of cream, if desired.

title: Chicken Livers With Pineapple
ingredients: 24 chicken livers | 3/8 cup cilantro, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 can crushed pineapple, drained
instructions: Remove the stem and any undesirable portions from the chicken livers with a sharp knife on a cutting board.  You should have 2 cups of liver.  Cut a piece of heavy duty foil that is about 1/2 inch thick and lay it alongside the chicken liver on a chopping board.  Place the chicken livers in the foil and put it on a flat surface.  Stuff the chicken livers with the can of crushed pineapple.  Wrap the chicken livers in the foil, securing the ends with toothpicks.  Sprinkle the cilantro and cayenne pepper evenly over the livers, pressing it into the pineapple.  Wrap each breast in this way.  Seal with the toothpicks or tie them with string.  Lay the filled chicken livers on your work surface with the toothpicks or tie them with string.  Cover the chicken livers with the remaining foil and let the ends of the foil be slightly drapes.  Lightly sprinkle your heavy pan with vegetable cooking spray and heat over medium heat.  Arrange the stuffed chicken livers in the pan and cook, turning once, until they are deep golden brown, about 2 minutes per side.  Serve.

title: German Potato Pastry Tray
ingredients: 2 medium red potatoes | 1 1/2 cups red wine | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds or 2 tablespoons paprika powder | 1/4 cup filling
instructions: Remove the skin and outer layers from the potatoes.  Shred and cut into 3/4 dice.  Peel the potatoes and place in a bowl.  Add the remaining ingredients and mix well.  Cut the mustard from the filling into thin strips and drop into the potato mixture with the mustard strips.  If desired, place on a greased baking sheet and bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 20 - 25 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Variation, instead of filling use 1/3 cup cream cheese and 1/3 cup goat cheese mixture and combine.  Add any other filling to the potato mixture.  If desired, add mustard seeds or paprika powder.  Cream cheese dough ingredients together using a mixer or food processor and if necessary, add a little extra cream cheese.  Once your pastry crust is done, place it on a cutting board and carefully pull it so the short end runs right through the cutting board.  With moist hands, push a small chunk of the dough into the center of your baking sheet.  Repeat this until your mixture is gone.  Place the dough into the greased 9x13 baking dish and place in the freezer.  Turn your oven on to 350 for 10 - 15 minutes.  Do not bake the pastry for longer than 5 minutes, or your pasty will be dry.  When the pastry is done, brush some pastry dough on the top and sides of the tray.  Place the tray in the oven and bake for 1 hour.  Serve hot.

title: Baked Okra and Tomatoes With Cumin
ingredients:
16 ounces frozen okra ( sliced or chopped ) | 10 tablespoons dry onion flakes ( or 1 t.
    - dried ) | 3 tablespoons dried coconut ( flaked ) | 2 tablespoons dried onion flakes ( or 1 t.
    - dried onion ) | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 2 cans diced tomatoes and green chilies
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Put frozen okra in a colander and salt liberally to stop cooking.  Cover a large baking sheet with plastic wrap and toss in okra until they are well coated.  Spread okra on sheet and repeat.  When all okra is distributed evenly, sprinkle 1 teaspoons dried onion flakes evenly over okra.  Spread in a single layer and put into preheated oven.  Roast okra at 400 degrees f.  For 40 - 45 minutes, or until done.  While okra is roasting, spread 2 tablespoons dried onion flakes and 1 t.  Of dried coconut flakes evenly on a large plate.  Drain off excess moisture from the tomatoes and chilies and put in a blender or food processor and mix well.  Add the other seasonings and the tomatoes.  Pulse about three times or until mixed and chopped.  When okra is done, remove from oven and slice it thinly and place it on top of the coconut mix and spread evenly.

title: Crock Pot Sinkared Skirt Steak
ingredients: 3 -5 lbs skirt steaks | 2 cans of rotel diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 3/4 cup flour ( i prefer lawrys )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in crock pot and allow to cook on low 6 - 8 hours or overnite.  If the gravy is too thin, thicken with milk of reduced fat butter and flour mixed together and simmer until thickened or use as desired with cooked meat.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,red wine vinegar,pork sausage,pear,elbow macaroni,self rising flour
title: Macaroni in Sausage and Pear Fritters
ingredients: 2 lbs pork sausages ( cut into chunks ) | 1/2 cup unbleached self-rising flour ( or half all purpose flour, half whole wheat ) | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 3 cups uncooked elbow macaroni | 1 - 1 1/4 cup coarsely chopped pear, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Heat a few tablespoons of oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Saute the pears until crisp tender.  Push them to the side of the pan, then set aside.  Meanwhile, combine flour, vinegar, and asafoetida in a large bowl.  Add cooked sausage and stir until coated.  Pour in 2 cups water, and stir again until batter is smooth.  Heat remaining 2 tablespoons oil, drop in batter, and fry until golden brown.  Sprinkle with pear.  Season with salt and pepper to taste, and serve immediately.

title: Quick Jalapeno Peanuts
ingredients: 1 lb roasted peanuts | 2 jalapeno peppers ( seeded if like me )
instructions: Boil peanuts in water until soft, no more than 125 degrees f.  Drain and dry on paper towel.  Cut in half and set aside.  Toast in single layer, about 5 minutes.  Watch closely and do not let peanut dry.  Place in an airtight container and refrigerate until firm.  Enjoy.

title: Chilies and Cheese Phyllo Rollups
ingredients: 1/4 cup low-fat worcestershire sauce | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 can diced green chilies | 36 miniature phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Line a large baking sheet with foil.  In a bowl, mix worcestershire sauce, rice vinegar, chilies and cheese.  Lay out four phyllo rectangles on the sheet.  Brush the tops with water.  Cover with a damp towel and lightly moisten with more water.  Fold phyllo dough over the top.  Place on baking sheet seam side up.  Brush tops with water.  Bake in a 400 degree f oven for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Mock Pops

instructions: Pour barbecue sauce into a piping bag fitted with a star tip.  Snip off a corner.  Tear off small bits from bag, and pipe circle into star shapes on top of the barbeque sauce.

instructions: Preheat a grill.  In a large bowl, combine the creme fraiche, orange zest, sage and sage.

title: Curried Game Hens
ingredients: 4 rock cornish game hens | 4 teaspoons curry powder, divided | 1 -2 teaspoon lemon zest | 3 cups pesto sauce
instructions: Rinse hens under cold running water.  Place 2 tsp curry powder in body cavity of hens.  Rub remainder with lemon zest.  Stuff cavity of each hen with pesto.  Place hen, flesh side up, on a rack in pan and bake 25 minutes.  Turn hens over and bake a further 9 - 10 minutes or until chicken juices run clear.

title: Chana Dal Parathas

instructions: Put the chana dal in a big pan of water.  Bring to the boil then reduce the heat.  Keep stirring.  When you smell the coconut smell, take it off the stove and put it in a bowl to cool.  Put 200g of caster sugar in a pan and heat on a low fire, stirring, until the sugar melts and turns a light golden brown in colour.  Take the pan off the heat and add 2 tablespoons of molasses.  Mix well.  Mix the yoghurt in it.  Add the yogurt mixture.  Let it cool down.  Cut the wings in half or, if you prefer, cut them on the diagonal.  Put in a large pan.  Add 500ml water and the other 500ml water.  Turn the heat to low and cook on medium fire for 20 - 30 minutes.  The smell is a bit more intense but the sauce is enough.  When done, mash some chicken dal and spread around the base.  For each paratha you got, put a spoonful of the yoghurt sauce, spread around it, and top it with a piece of chicken wings.  When done, spread on clean english spinach.  Cut the chickelelelelelelelele is an english spinach.  Put it back in the pan over the paratha, add more oil if necessary.  Cook for a minute.  Top with a dash of balsamic vinegar and a sprinkle of chilli flakes.  Serve with your favourite greens, pickles, pickled vegetables or salad.

title: Slow Cooker Mexican-Style Dirty Rice
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless beef chuck, trimmed of visible fat | 1 1/2 cups hot picante sauce | 1 cup enchilada sauce | red food coloring | pepperoncini pepper, slices | red chili powder | jasmine rice, cooked
instructions: Place beef in crock of a slow cooker.  Combine picante sauce, chile powder, red chili powder, and a spoonful of enchilada sauce on meat.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,turkey bacon,beef stew meat,baby carrot,mayonnaise,dark sesame oil,galangal
title: Curried Beef in Caramelized Onions
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 1/3 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1 1/2 inch diagonal slices | 1/4 cup light mayonnaise | 2 1/2 cups baby carrots, cut diagonally 1/2 inch thick | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh ginger, julianne or 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh galangal, minced | 8 slices turkey bacon, crisp cooked crisp | 1 celery rib, cut into 1 1/2 inch slices
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a 6 qt glass or stainless steel pot over high heat.  Cook meat 7 - 8 minutes, until barely browned.  Using a slotted spoon, transfer meat to a plate.  Add 1 3/4 tablespoons hot oil to pot, if necessary.  Add carrots and stir fry 3 - 4 minutes.  Add ginger, stirring often, and stir 1 minute more.  Add meat, stirring to break up clumps.  Stir in fish sauce.  Add mayonnaise.  Cook 2 - 3 minutes, tossing occasionally.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to medium, then cover and cook about 5 minutes, or until meat is cooked and sauce is slightly thickened.  Stir in carrots, add celery, adjust seasoning to taste.

title: Tuscan Beef, Spinach & Bean Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb cooked steak, sirloin or 1 lb lean ground sirloin | 16 ounces frozen spinach, thawed, squeezed dry | 2 cups baby spinach, torn | 1 cup cannellini beans, rinsed and drained ( white kidney beans ) | 2 green onions, sliced | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace or 1/4 teaspoon cardamom | 2 tablespoons cracked wheat germ
instructions: Preheat the broiler.  Cut the steaks into 1/2 inch cubes.  Place the spinach in a small colander and drain well under running water.  Pat dry with paper towels and toss with the greens and beans.  Slightly mash with a fork.  Stir in the onions and mace.  Shape into 6 patties and arrange on a baking sheet sprayed with pam.  Broil for 3 to 4 minutes on one side or until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,ra el hanout spice mix,tequila,flour,pecan half,vanilla bean,butter
title: Tequila Roasted Pecans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 3 lbs pecan halves | 1/4 cup ra el hanout spice mix | 1 cup sugar | 1/4 cup vinegar | 2 -3 tablespoons tequila | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400 degrees.  Grease a 5 or 6 pound loaf pan with 1 tbs oil.  In a small bowl, sift together the flour, el hanout and sugar.  Add the ra el hanout to the dry mixture and blend.  Stir in the tequila and vanilla bean.  With your fingertips, mix well.  Add the pecans and turn the mixture so that they are coated evenly with the mixture.  Spread evenly into the prepared pan and bake for 25 - 30 minutes, or until the mixture has set and top is nicely browned.  Enjoy.

title: Bok choy (Fried Cheese) Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 4 leaves bok choy ( leaves roughly chopped ) | 10 g active dry yeast | 150 g sharp cheddar cheese ( shredded )
instructions: Dry fry the bok choy leaves in a little olive oil until it turns slightly limp with a crunchy green stalk.  Remove it to a bowl.  Dissolve the yeast in a little warm water, then add this to the fried bok choy leaves.  Work into a smooth dough.  Put the dough on a baking tray or oiled baking paper and leave to rise in a warm place for about 40 minutes until it has doubled in size.  When it has risen, flatten it with your hand.  Put all the remaining ingredients on top of the dough and knead it slightly, using a spoon.  Put the dough onto greased baking tray, or lightly oil it if it is not already covered with oil.  Leave it to rise again for about 5 minutes.  Slice it into 12 rounds, or 1 inch rounds, and leave aside on a tray in a warm place for a further 10 minutes.  Spread the tops of each round with the soft cheese.

Random Ingredients: pasta,self rising flour,onion,vegetable oil,kosher salt pepper,red lentil,kirsch
title: Red Lentil and Noodles
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups red lentils | 1 medium onion | 2 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 1 teaspoon kosher salt and pepper | vegetable oil, for frying | 1 tablespoon kirsch ( cherry brandy )
instructions: Rinse lentils.  Place lentils and onion in a pot, cover with 1 inch of water, bring to a boil, and simmer until tender, about 50 minutes.  Drain, refrigerate 10 minutes, or until cold.  Cover and set aside.  Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Grease 2 baking sheets.  Finely chop onion in a food processor, add flour, salt, and pepper, and pulse 5 times or until dough forms.  Turn dough out onto a floured work surface, gather into a compact ball, and pat into a 6x5 inch rectangle with a 1 inch thickness.  Cut dough in half crosswise, then crosswise into 1/4 inch wide strips.  Cut each strip lengthwise into 4 strips, then cut those 4 strips crosswise into 3 smaller triangles.  Transfer to a baking sheet, spacing triangles apart, and brush with oil.  Bake in preheated oven until golden, 45 minutes to 1 hour.  Fill a bowl with warm puddings, such as kirsch, and toss with desired spuds, and serve.

title: Lamb Salatasi
ingredients: 6 slices rump roast or 6 slices prime rib roast | 2 lbs lamb shoulder, shoulder bone in ( about 3 pounds ) | 1 tablespoon harissa | 1 banana pepper, sliced | shrimp, shelled
instructions: Trim off any excess fat or impurities.  Place all the roast in a flat 6 gallon roasting tin or other container suitable for the roast.  Sprinkle the harissa over the meat, then add the oil to just cover the meat.  Place the banana pepper on top of the roast and season well.  Marinate in the refrigerator at least 1 hour or overnight.  Preheat the oven to 350 deg or 160 deg c.  Transfer the roast to a roasting pan and cook, basting every hour or so, until the meat is just tender, and there is much to do but it is still pink inside.  Shrimp will sink to the bottom which must baste as the liquid in the pan dries up.  Serve sprinkled with extra harissa.

title: Raspberry & Cream Pate for One
ingredients: 375 g penne, cooked and drained ( you can also use asparagas or fettucine ) | 150 g raspberries | 150 ml rum
instructions: Mix together with cream.  Garnish with raspberries and serve with garlic bread or basil leaves.

title: Avocado Salad With Corn, Avocados and Spicy Cream
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock ( or water ) | 1 cup corn kernel ( fresh or frozen ) | 1 3/4 cups low fat cottage cheese | 1 tablespoon light sour cream or 1 tablespoon light yogurt | 1/2 avocado, chopped
instructions: Pour stock into a saucepan, bring to simmer.  Remove from heat and stir in the corn.

title: Santa Fe Hot Chestnut Queso Content
ingredients: 2 bags sliced chestnuts, well drained and cut into 1-inch chunks | 1 1/2 cups apple cider | 3 tablespoons molasses | 3 cans diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained ( rotel ) | 2 slices provolone cheese ( or more if desired )

instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit.  Mix all ingredients, except for baking powder, together.  Shape into a 4 inch square wrap and cut into four wedges.  Poke holes on 2 opposite sides with a fork, so that the scones will not stick together later.  Place wedges on a greased baking sheet.  Sprinkle with baking powder.  Bake for about 15 minutes, or until golden.  Turn and bake for another 5 to 10 minutes.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cabbage,red chile pepper,lime juice,pesto sauce,romaine lettuce
title: Chile Wrapped Coleslaw
ingredients: 1/2 head cabbage | 1 package fresh leaves romaine lettuce | 1 jar pesto sauce | 3 tablespoons red chile peppers, chopped | 2 tablespoons lime juice
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  In a medium bowl, mix together cabbage, lettuce, pesto sauce, red chile peppers, and lime juice.  Pour into the boiling water, and stir.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,red chili pepper,egg yolk,egg white,cream cheese,zucchini,baking powder
title: Zucchini & Chili Pepper Muffins
ingredients: 2 large zucchini, grated | 2 egg yolks ( from 2 egg whites ) | 2/3 cup cream cheese | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1/2 cup red chili pepper, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons fresh red chili pepper, finely chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh red chili pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Heat oven to 200°c.  Line 2 muffin tins with paper and lightly grease with cooking oil spray.  Combine zucchini, egg yolks, cream cheese, baking powder and mustard in large bowl and blend well.  Stir in chilli and chillies, stirring until well blended.  Spoon half the zucchini mixture into prepared muffin tin.  Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Clam Chowder
ingredients: 800 g minced clams | 1/4 cup golden caster sugar | 4 teaspoons tamari | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 125 g plain yogurt ( to serve ) | 1/4 cup parmesan cheese ( to serve ) ( optional )
instructions: Throw all the ingredients into a heavy based pan and bring to the boil.  Lower heat, and simmer for 30 mins, stirring occasionally.  The soup is done when most of the sauce has reduced, so you may need to add a little water, but be careful not to burn the basil.  Serve topped up with the yogurt.

title: Herbs & Oranges
ingredients: 2 oranges | 7 fresh herbs | 1 jar dried basil, leaves and stems
instructions: Wash, peel and slice the oranges into thick rounds, then cut them into thin slices.  In a large skillet add orange slices, herbs and herbs and pour boiling water over the oranges.  Cover and cook over medium heat until tender, about ten minutes.  Take off heat and let sit 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,yellow squash,yellow onion,avocado,walnut,angel hair pasta,apricot
title: Avocado Salad
ingredients: 1 package angel hair pasta | 1 large ripe avocado | 16 dried apricots, halved | 1 small yellow squash, halved, cut into 2-inch chunks | 1 small yellow onion, halved and quartered | 1/3 cup unsalted walnuts | 2 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: Cook angel hair pasta according to package instructions, omitting salt.  Drain, then rinse with cold water.  Cut avocado in half, remove stone and skin, then cut fruit from pit into bite sized pieces.  Place pasta into large bowl.  Add the avocado, apricots, yellow squash, onion and walnuts to pasta and toss to coat.  Add sesame oil and toss well.

title: Cauliflower-Pumpkin-Linguine
ingredients: 1/2 cup butter | 2 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled and seeded, cut into 1-inch dice | 2 cups cauliflower florets | 1/2 cup roasted pumpkin ( from 1 pumpkin and 1 pumpkin ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1 lb linguine | shredded maraschino cherry
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Meanwhile melt butter in a separate large skillet over medium heat.  Add poblano chiles and cauliflower.  Cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly softened, about 5 minutes.  Blend the pumpkin with the baking powder and pour in skillet.  Cook, stirring over medium heat until all the pumpkin pieces are thoroughly coated, about 10 minutes.  Drain pasta and add.  Add the sauteed cauliflower/pumpkin mixture and toss to thoroughly coat.  Transfer to a large serving dish and sprinkle with parmesan cheese.

title: Chocolate Lime Noodles
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles | 2 cups peanut butter | 1/2 cup orange or lime juice, divided | 1 cup unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook lasagna in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 8 minutes.  Drain.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Prepare a 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray.  In a large bowl, mix noodles and 1/2 cup peanut butter until coated.  Stir in 1/2 cup orange juice.  Spread noodle mixture in prepared baking dish.  Top with remaining peanut butter mixture.  Sprinkle cocoa evenly over noodle mixture.  Bake, covered, about 35 minutes, until hot and bubbly.

title: Korean Beef Skillet
ingredients: 10 ounces beef round roast, bone in ( or boneless sirloin steak, cut in serving size ) | 5 cups udon noodles ( korean, use medium size udon or medium wheat udon noodles ) | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Brown meat on all sides.  Meanwhile mix noodles with meat.  When meat is done, remove from heat and place in a serving platter.  Sprinkle lightly with toasted sesame seeds.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,rice,pork rib,five spice powder,leek
title: Chinese Savoury Pork Ribs (Rangoon)
ingredients: 2 lbs country-style pork ribs, cut into chunks | 3 lbs leeks, white parts and pale green parts, sliced thinly crosswise | 4 teaspoons five-spice powder, divided | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | cooked rice, for serving
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f.  Season the meat with 1/3 of the five spice powder and a generous amount of salt and freshly ground pepper.  In a cast iron casserole, toss the pork with half of the five spice powder and a drizzle of olive oil, plus 2 tbsp of water.  Place the leeks in rows across the bottom of the pan.  Add the meat to the pot and scatter 1 tsp of the five spice powder all over.  Cover with aluminum foil and bake in the oven for 1 to 1½ hours, checking once or twice to ensure it’s thoroughly cooked.  Remove from the oven and let sit.  Serve with rice.

title: Spicy Hot Dog Mix
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cream of tartar | 1 teaspoon cayenne powder
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the cream of tartar and cayenne.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,red food coloring,pork tenderloin,watercress,espresso coffee,asparagus,lettuce leaf,lettuce
title: Pork Tenderloin With Hazelnut-Coffee Lettuce-Asparagus Lettuce Cups
ingredients: 1/3 cup asparagus, chopped | 2 tablespoons watercress, minced | 2 tablespoons brewed espresso coffee ( or more to taste ) | 1/4 cup hazelnuts, toasted and coarsely chopped | 3/4 cup green asparagus, chopped | 1/4 cup log lettuce leaf ( optional ) | 1 cup low-fat lean pork tenderloin, trimmed | 2 -3 drops red food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Combine asparagus and watercress in a small saute pan over medium high heat and, stirring often, cook until tender crisp, 4 - 5 minutes.  Stir in coffee.  Set aside.  Using a mortar and pestle, crush hazelnuts.  Set aside.  Preheat oven to 350°f.  Place tenderloin in a shallow roasting pan and sprinkle both sides with hazelnut mixture.  Roast till thermometer registers 140° for medium rare, about 25 minutes.  Turn off oven.  Carefully remove roast from pan.  Transfer to a platter and let stand 10 minutes.  Using a slotted spoon, transfer to a platter and let cool.  When slightly cooled, coarsely chop asparagus.  Cut remaining 1/2 inch long pieces into 1/2 inch wide strips, about 2 tbs.  Each.  Stir asparagus into chopped green beans.  Meanwhile combine orange sections & roasted hazelnuts in a medium bowl.  Let stand 10 minutes.  Drain well.  Reserve 1 tbs.  Asparagus and hazelnut oil.  Spread bean mixture evenly over roast.  Let stand 10 minutes to plate.  Top with grilled asparagus and reserved asparagus oil.

title: Nettie Cronish's Grilled Eggplant (Eggplant) Salad
ingredients: 1/2 medium eggplant | 1 large pear | 1 tablespoon lemongrass, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high.  Combine the eggplant, and pear in a medium bowl.  Stir lemon grass into the mixture.  Arrange on a medium grill and grill 2 minutes on each side.  Turn, and grill 4 minutes on each side, turning occasionally.

Random Ingredients: dill pickle,oatmeal,veal cutlet,pam cooking spray,oyster sauce
title: Veal Nuggets
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs veal cutlets, about 24 slices | 1/3 cup rolled oatmeal | 1/3 cup oats ( not instant or regular ) | 1/3 cup dill pickle, finely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons oyster sauce | pam cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees.  Spray pam in pan.  Lay veal slices on pam.  Bake until slightly browned and cooked through approx 8 - 10 minutes.
