title: Tasty Vegetarian Rice Wraps (Rice Pigs)
ingredients: 1/2 cup long grain white rice | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste, grated ( you may not need the full cup ) | 40 corn tortillas or 40 flour tortillas, cut into 4 strips | 1 tablespoon corn or 1 tablespoon canola oil | 500 g mixed salad greens or 500 g whole grain white rice | 1 can chopped glace cherries or 2/3 cup chopped frozen mixed fruit
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions, cool completely.  When rice is cool, stir in rice flavouring.  Place one strip of corn or fruit in each tortilla and roll up individually in a warmed corn or flour stuffed tortilla slice.  To serve, sprinkle each wrap with finely chopped glazed cherries or mixed fruit.

title: Quick and Easy Kofte
ingredients: 1 lb lamb meat or 1 lb chicken meat, any, cooked and cut into bite size chunks | 1/2 cup raw long grain white rice | 1 cup green beans, chopped | 1 cup green onion, chopped | noodle
instructions: Spray pan with no stick spray and put on med heat.  When very hot, add all ingredients except noodles.  Cook and stir for 5 min or until rice is done.

title: The Best, Easiest, Easy, and Deliciousest, Easy, Seasoned and Delicious Tastiest and Yummiest spaghetti sauce
ingredients: 3/4 lb linguine, broken into 2-inch chunks | 1 envelope taco blend seasoning ( no salt ) | 4 tablespoons taco sauce ( i prefer sweet taco seasoning ) | 2 small red dates, chopped | 1 medium orange, peeled and sliced into thin rounds ( optional )
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat in a cast iron skillet.

title: Easy Grilled Apple Salad
ingredients: 2 tart apples, such as kiwi | 1 medium red capsicum, roasted
instructions: Peel and cut apples and capsicum into thin slices.  Heat grill to high.  Arrange apple and capsicum onto serving plate.  Drizzle with a little of the olive oil.  Grill until apple are beginning to brown.

title: Easy Tuna and Spinach Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 8 large firm fresh tuna, cut in cubes | 10 tablespoons butter, divided | 3 stalks celery, finely diced | 5 sheets enoki mushrooms | 3 tablespoons golden syrup | 6 -8 large fresh curry leaves | paprika ( a little for garnish )
instructions: Drain the tuna from its shells, place them in a bowl with a dash of salt and plenty of freshly ground black pepper.  Melt 2 tbsp of the butter in a saucepan and fry the celery and enoki mushrooms for 3 - 4 minutes until crisp.  Add the syrup and bring to the boil.  Place the tofu and its oil into a heated oven proof dish.  Season to taste with a little paprika and scatter over the rest of the butter.  Place into the oven and cook for 10 - 15 minutes or until hot.  Serve with steamed rice or a crisp green vegetable.

title: Apricot Wraps With a Crunchy Mayo
ingredients: 200 g canned sweetened apricots, drained | 1/4 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup corn tortilla, torn to 3mm size | 5 cardamom pods, bruised | 15 g coarsely chopped celery ribs | 1/4 cup iceberg lettuce, shredded
instructions: Combine apricots and 1/4 cup of the mayonnaise in a medium bowl.  Stir to combine.  Combine remaining 2/4 cup of mayonnaise and the cardamom.  Add to apricot mixture.  Place corncobs in a food processor with celery.  Process until smooth.  Stir mayonnaise mixture, apricot mixture and remaining 1/4 cup of mayonnaise into mixture.  Divide mixture among the tortillas.  Roll up.  Wrap tightly and refrigerate for 30 minutes.  Spray a 30cm x 20cm slice tin lightly with oil.  Working from one end, lift a roll from the chilled roll and place in tin.  Repeat with remaining rolls and filling.  Cooks note, if using wooden skewers, soak in warm water at least 30 minutes before using to prevent burning.

instructions: Cook pasta in 5 quarts boiling water until al dente.

title: Luxury Dressing
ingredients: 1 can cream of celery soup | 3/4 cup dry porcini mushrooms, drained ( italian or french-fried mushrooms ) | 1 tablespoon creamy champagne vinegar | 1 tablespoon light beer
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

instructions: Combine all ingredients, let marinate meat for up to 2 days, covered in the refrigerator.  Discard used marinade.  Allow to come to room temperature before cooking or basting, if desired.  Pour enough or less of the olive oil in a skillet to coat.

title: Simple Mexican Dip Mix

instructions: Whisk together the picante sauce, creole seasoning, celery seed, and garlic powder or crushed red pepper flakes in a bowl until thoroughly incorporated.

instructions: In a large bowl, toss the chicken strips with the mango chutney, olive oil, parmesan cheese, ginger paste, and capers.  Marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour to set.

title: Agua De Lima

instructions: Cut the peas in halves removing any hard center core if you do not want the pea sections to be concerushed.  Rinse, drain and set aside.  Toss the cherry pieces with the 1 tsp.  Basmati rice powder angostura bitters and chili powder.  Add pineapple juice.  Set aside.  Dry the peas and cherry halves for 3 minutes.  Dredge with chili powder.  Place in pan with a small amt.  Of water over medium heat.  When bubbles start to form, add the peas, cherry pieces and any extras or extra juice.  Cover and cook until the peas are tender.  Don't overcook.  Turn off the heat.  Serve with fresh chili sauce if desired.

title: Shrimp and Beans over Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 package fettuccine | 32 ounces cooked shrimp, drained | 12 ounces red cherry pepper green chili, diced | 2/3 cup creamy peanut butter | 1 can kidney beans, drained | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1/2 cup chopped fresh dill
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.  Toss hot cooked shrimp, chili, peanut butter through pasta and stir.  Add kidney beans and chopped fresh dill, simmer over low heat for 3 - 5 minutes, stirring to warm through.  Garnish with fresh dill if desired.

title: Cha Trai (Soy Cream Toast)
ingredients: 14 ounces cream ( i use double cream ) | 1 pinch asafoetida powder or 1 pinch hing | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 6 slices of good quality white bread | 4 1/2 ounces baker's german sweet chocolate
instructions: Whisk cream with asafoetida, until it forms a smooth paste.  Melt chocolate on top of the cream/chocolate syrup.  Pour into a piping bag and pipe into the top of the toast.  Put in the fridge until set, then turn to cool off.  Serve garnished with chocolate curls and sprigs of fresh thyme.

title: Apple and Salami Sausage
ingredients: 8 ounces pork loin roast | 1/4 cup tahini | 1/4 cup apple juice | 1 sausage
instructions: Combine the tahini and apple juice and brush onto the roast.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.  Cook in a 375 degree f oven for about 40 minutes.  Slice or slice and serve with cooked turkey.  Also good on a bed of greens.

title: Stuffed Chocolate Spaghetti
ingredients: 12 ounces spaghetti sauce ( homemade or store-bought ) | 3 ounces cheese ( grated ) | 2 teaspoons yeast | 2 ounces dark chocolate, chopped ( see note above )
instructions: Combine the grated cheese and yeast in a bowl, place in microwave, cook on high 3 minutes, stirring once with a fork.  Set aside.  Stir spaghetti sauce, a splash of water, into the yeast mixture.  Add all of the sauce and mix well.  Spread evenly on an ungreased baking sheet, or parchment. .  Top with a sprinkling of the grated cheese.  Set in a warm place and leave undisturbed for at least 1 hour to let the yeast bubble up.  Serve at once.

title: Traditional British Brandy Dipping Sauce for Seafood
ingredients: 1 tablespoon bacon drippings | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 3 tablespoons vodka
instructions: Put the bacon drippings, caster sugar and vodka into a fry pan and stir over a medium heat until the sugar has dissolved.  When the mixture is bubbling, add the bacon fat.  Transfer into a glass jar seal and keep refrigerated,.

title: Kumquat's Potatoes With a Pretzel - Kosher
ingredients: 6 large baking potatoes, peeled | 1 package egg roll wrappers | 1/4 cup finely crushed pretzel flakes ( kumquat's, or similar kosher food processed pretzel coating )
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f.  Line a baking sheet with foil.  Place potatoes in a pot of salted boiling water.  When they begin to soften, remove skins and then simmer until potatoes are tender.  Drain and reserve 4 cups of potato water.  Peel the potatoes while warm, then slice into rounds 1/2 to 3/4 inch thick.  Place the potato slices in a bowl with 1 cup of potato water, and allow to sit for 10 minutes.  Drain the potatoes, and spread the cooked potatoes on the prepared baking sheet.  Brush the potato slices with crunched pretzels.  Bake 20 minutes, or until golden brown.  Allow to cool.  Serve cold.

title: Balsamic Glazed Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 4 teaspoons fresh parsley leaves ( chopped or 1/4 tsp dried parsley ) | 1 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into 2-inch chunks | 2 teaspoons fresh sage ( or 1/2 tsp dried rubbed sage ) | 1 tablespoon fat-free roasted salted cashews | 1 small onion, cut in wedges
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f place in a bowl the vinegar and parsley.

title: Italian Baked Pepperoni

instructions: Roll out frozen bread dough and make two loaves.  Cut each loaf in half to form two 1 cm thick strips.  Place half of the pepperoni in the center of each strip of dough.  Top with cherry slices, then cover the pepperoni with the cheese.  Fold the ends of the dough around the cheese, making sure the ends are sealed.  Place on a greased baking tray and brush with oil.  Bake in an oven of 180°c for 20 minutes, until golden.

title: Chicken Lollipops With Dippies and Charred Onions

instructions: Preheat the oven to 140c/fan 140c/gas put the baby corn in a heatproof bowl and cover with boiling water.  Stand on a microwave safe plate until just tender, about 1 minute.  Drain and refresh under cold water.  Meanwhile, put the spring onions, kaffir lime leaves, capers, yoghurt, and 2 tablespoons of the chicken stock in a large bowl.  Toss well, then season with salt and pepper.  Pour over half of the hot babycorn in a single layer.  Arrange the remaining corn on top and brush with some of the stock.  Repeat layering with remaining babycorn, kaffir lime leaves, and capsicum.  Brush the tops with remaining stock, then sprinkle the chopped bar pieces over and bake for 15 to 20 mins on the top shelf of the oven, or until golden.  Serve from warmed plates top with pickles.

title: Onion Broquettes

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit.  Place sliced onions on cookie sheet and spray with pam.  Bake at 400 fahrenheit for 15 to 20 minutes, or until onions are soft and golden brown.  Put about one tablespoon of onions into each hot crouton, just enough to start cooking them together.  In a medium bowl, stir together dry onion soup mixes, worcestershire sauce, and anchovy.  Pour this mixture over hot croutons, and sprinkle with more cornstarch.  Serve immediately.

instructions: Heat oil in a small skillet.  Add thai red curry paste and jalapenos if using and cook for about 1 minute, until fragrant.  Add salt and pepper and toss mixture. Store refrigerated, and use sparingly, as the heat from the jalapenos will dilute the curry if too hot for you.

title: Gorgonzola Spread
ingredients: 5 ounces gorgonzola, crumbled | 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice or 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Use an electric mixer or food processor.

title: Chili and Mustard Covered Gruyère
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coriander seeds, lightly crushed | 1 cup honey | 1/4 cup minced yellow mustard | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1/4 cup minced fresh cilantro | 1 medium chili, stemmed seeded and slit lengthwise ( i used jalapeno ) | 2 large cups shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 475°f spread coriander seeds in small bowl, pressing to lightly crush, on rimmed baking sheet.  Wrap in plastic wrap, refrigerate 30 minutes. Combine remaining ingredients except cheese in heavy medium skillet.  Add coriander seeds and cook 30 seconds.  Remove from heat.

instructions: Follow the directions on the rice package, and then add the coconut oil.  The garlic is pretty strong, but not too strong.  If using steamed rice, cook in batches and allow to cool to room temperature before proceeding with steps 1 & 2.

title: Chicken and Vegetable Rice

instructions: Combine chicken and 2 teaspoons vegetable stir fry in large saucepan.  Cook over medium high heat for 4 - 5 minutes or until golden brown.  Add 1 cup rice, vegetables and stock powder.  Simmer for 1 - 5 minutes or until thickened.

title: Easy Chicken Mole
ingredients: 1 cup low sodium vegetable broth | 1 1/2 lbs skinless chicken breasts, cut in strips | 4 ounces dark chocolate, coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine broth with chicken in medium saucepan and bring to boil.  Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes or until chicken is just cooked through.  While chicken is simmering, melt chocolate in small container and stir until smooth.  Remove chicken from simmered broth and heat to just boiling pour chocolate into bowl and stir until smooth.

title: Mayonnaise Guinness and Donut
ingredients: 1 baking potato, peeled and cut into large chunks | 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 3 tablespoons mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 2 tablespoons guinness stout beer
instructions: Add the baking potato chunks to a large pot of boiling water.  Meanwhile, make the guiness topping by combining the coconut mayonnaise and the grand marnier and mixing until blended.  Pour about 1 tablespoon of the guiness topping into each bowl of guiness in the bowl.  Pour the guinness over the guiness in the bowl and serve.

title: Swiss Rhubarb Cheese Bread
ingredients: 1/2 lb swiss cheese | 1 cup mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup light or regular half-and-half cream | 1/2 cup carrots or 1/2 cup frozen finely chopped carrots | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 can rhubarb ( drained drained, i've used a mix of all berries ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f grease 2 loaf pans.

Random Ingredients: beef mince,poultry seasoning,sherry vinegar,tamarind paste,chicken thigh,lasagna noodle,beef tenderloin
title: Tamarind Beef Bites
ingredients: 2 garlic cloves, sliced | 500 g beef mince | 2 teaspoons tamarind paste | 4 teaspoons sherry vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon poultry seasoning | 8 chicken thighs | 8 sheets of filo mince | 12 sheets lasagna noodles
instructions: To make the filling and assemble the dish, mix the beef with 4 teaspoons of tamarind paste, 5 teaspoons of sherry vinegar, 1/4 teaspoons poultry seasoning and 1/2 teaspoons of the crushed garlic.  Set aside for 30 minutes.  Place 1 chicken thigh fillet on each sheet of mince, then spread 1 teaspoon of the remaining crushed garlic mixture over each sheet.  Roll up each piece, starting at the long end and rolling up to make little parcels.  Cut each parcel in half lenghtways and secure with kitchen string.  Preheat the oven to 220 degrees c.  Cook the lasagna parcels in a large pan of boiling water for 2 minutes.  Drain and refresh under cold water.  Meanwhile, place the remaining chicken thigh fillet on a dry frying pan and cook over a medium heat until browned.  Combine the remaining coriander with 2 teaspoons of tamarind paste and the remaining 1 teaspoons of sherry vinegar and pour into the frying pan.  Stir to combine then bring to the boil.  Put the parcels on a baking tray and bake for 20 minutes.  Toss the fillets in the remaining marinade and cook under a hot grill for 3 to 4 minutes on each side, or until golden and crusty.

Random Ingredients: tamari,lamb rib chop,anchovy paste,arborio rice,basil leaf,broth
title: Quick Lamb Risotto With Basil
ingredients: 6 lamb rib chops, bone in | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 1 cup arborio rice | 2 cups broth or 2 cups beef stock | 14 basil leaves, torn | 1/4 - 1/3 cup tamari
instructions: Toast the anchovy paste in a small frying pan over medium heat for 1 - 2 minutes, then remove from heat.  Rinse out the pan and dry any access oil.  Brown the lamb chops quickly in batches, then set aside.  In the same frying pan, add a couple tbsp of olive oil and heat up the 2 tbsp of oil over medium high.  Add half the rice, and toast a few minutes, until just starting to turn opaque.  Add a couple more tbsp of olive oil if necessary so any oil from the lamb is absorbed.  Add half the broth or stock.  Bring to a low boil, then add the reserved paste and 1 tbsp basil.  Cover and simmer for 25 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the stock has absorbed into the rice.  Check for seasoning and add any other herbs if desired.  Add the other tbsp of basil until just wilted but still a bit crisp at the end.  You may need to add a bit more stock as the rice absorbs some of the liquid.  When the rice is tender, stir in the tamari sauce and remove from heat.  If the rice is too dry to stir, add 1/4 cup hot water, and stir quickly until the rice absorbs it.  Remove any meat cubes that come off the bone and slice into 1/2 coins.  Serve topped with parmesan or romano cheese.

title: Pumpernickel Bread (From Homebrewers Academy)
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons table salt | 1/4 cup warm sour cream | 1 1/2 tablespoons honey or 1 1/2 tablespoons agave syrup | 2 teaspoons prepared horseradish | 1 teaspoon freshly roasted irish rye bean paste or 1 teaspoon sunflower oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried yeast | 1 cup finely chopped frozen raspberries | 1/4 cup amaretto or 1/4 cup apricot preserves, to drizzle ( optional )
instructions: In a small small bowl, with a wooden spoon, mix together the salt, sour cream, honey and remaining ingredients.  If using yeast, stir into sour cream mixture.  Cover and set aside at room temperature for 1 hour.  In a small container, place frozen raspberries.  Cover and place in the freezer.  Turn on oven heat to 400 degrees f and place rack in middle of oven.  Remove rack and place bread in oven.  Place a pan of hot water on the rack, making sure water does not reach the bottom of the bread pan.  Using wet fingers, flatten the raspberries slightly.  Transfer the raspberries to a bowl, and stir in the amaretto or preserves.  If using dry yeast, stir mixture into sour cream and honey mixture.  Transfer the breads to a baking screen, and place in oven with rack.  Bake for 45 minutes.  Cool, and slice.  Serve with homemade cream, crackers or sliced baguette slices or homemade crackers.

title: Halibut in Red Wine Sauce

instructions: Preheat a large microwaveable glass bowl on high power for 1 minute.  Add beef.  Microvave on high power for about 7 minutes or until meat has browned.  Reduce power to low.

title: Lettuce, Lentils & Vodka Salad

title: Lamb and Asiago Meat Taquitos

title: Marinara Sauce for Roasted Peanut Roasted Fish

title: Elegant French Dip for Two

title: Korean Pilav (Rice Pudding)

instructions: Pour rice wine into a small jar with a tight fitting lid.  Cover the jar tightly with aluminum foil, and marinate in the refrigerator 3 hours or overnight. title: Ancho Bread and Wine
ingredients: 1 lb linguine | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 1 teaspoon chopped dried ancho chile powder ( or other hot chile powder ) | 4 ounces dark rum ( can substitute bacardi 151 liquor ) | 2 -3 sprigs toasted bread, for dipping
instructions: Cook linguine in boiling water, as per package directions, just to al dente, drain.  Meanwhile whisk olive oil and ancho chili powder into warm rum.  Pour over linguine and toss well.  Serve immediately with fresh bread.

title: Nacho Nachos

title: Quick and Easy Microwave Beetroot (Or Chicken) and Tater Wedges

title: Dorothy Smith's Pounded Scotch Eggs for One

instructions: Heat up your frying pan.  Cut out the hard muscley vein from the shrimp, if any.  Put them into the frying pan with the shrimp. ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can salsa | 1/4 cup island dressing ( or sub 1/4 cup miracle whip or miracle whip ) | 2 tablespoons rum, or | 2 tablespoons sake
instructions: Mix cream of mushroom soup, salsa, miracle whip, rum, and the sake together.  Place mixture in crockpot on low.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,white onion,chili pepper flake,red jalapeno chile,ricotta cheese,chow mein stir fry noodle,baguette
title: Spicy Artichoke Crostini
ingredients: 12 ounces artichoke hearts, fresh ( about 1 bag ) | 16 ounces ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup white onion, chopped | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes ( optional, use as much as you like ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried red jalapeno chile, minced | 1 baguette | 1 baguette
instructions: Slice baguette into rounds and put on sheet pan.  Bake bread rounds at 325 for 15 minutes or until golden brown, but not burnt.  Turn bread over.  Combine ricotta cheese, onions, chili peppers & garlic, if using, and chile flakes in mixing bowl.  Cut baguette rounds into 4 rounds each.  Spray a skillet with olive oil.  Put 4 bread rounds in the skillet and spread half of cheese mixture over them.  Add 1/4 of the artichoke hearts & 1/4 of remaining cheese mixture.  Top with other 4 bread rounds.  Spread remaining artichoke mixture on top of bread rounds.  Fold both pieces of bread over and press.  Cook for about 10 - 12 minutes, or until bread is toasty.  Let cool 5 minutes then cut into 6 thick slices.

title: Pistachio Shortbread  (Gift-Giving or Care)
ingredients: 1 lb unsalted butter, room temperature | 1/4 cup chocolate syrup ( i use nuttart's unsweetened chocolate syrup )
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f.  Line baking sheet with parchment.  Sift the butter and chocolate syrup into a large bowl.  Beat at high speed with an electric mixer until the butter is a smooth, fluffy consistency.  It may take a few minutes.  Beat in any leftover butter for 2 - 3 minutes with a spatula.  Add sugar 1 tablespoon at a time until the mixture is thick and creamy all the way, stopping to scrape the sides.  Continue beating on high speed until the sugar is incorporated into the dough.  The dough will seem dry, but it will become moist and a bit stiffer as you expand your hands.  Spread desired amount on parchment.  Bake 20 - 25 minutes, or until slightly darker.  Transfer to wire rack and cool.  Store in airtight container, and cut into squares or diamonds.  Store bars in an airtight container, and this will keep them in the refrigerator for several months.

title: Chicken & Beer Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs chicken, meat shredded or can of shredded chicken | 1 can baked beans in dry sherry ( do not use sauce cans ) | 2 -3 cups ice | 1/2 cup chicken sauce, sauce ( optional ) ( optional ) or 1/2 cup chili sauce ( optional )
instructions: Place chicken and beans in a pot.  Add chicken sauce and boil for 20 minutes or until chicken is fully cooked in sauce.  To make dipping sauce, place 4 cups of ice cubes in a bowl.  Dip a chicken piece into chicken sauce and pour about a cup of the sauce on the piece of chicken.  Wrap the chicken piece through the ice until completely covered with the sauce and serve.

title: Homemade Beef or Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs lean ground beef or 2 lbs lean ground chicken | 15 ounces canned pumpkin puree
instructions: In large covered pot bring water to boil.  Add ground meat or chicken.  Cover and reduce heat.  Simmer 15 minutes.  Cool.  Skim off foam.  Add pumpkin in batches to pot.  Strain to remove any meat particles.  Return to pot.  Stir meat in well seasoned dry mixture.  Pour out into bowl and refrigerate at least three hours before using to make certain flavors have melded.

title: French Bread Appetizers With Walnuts and Shallots
ingredients: 200 g croissants | 100 g unsalted walnuts oil | 2 shallots, very finely chopped | 125 g beans sprouts, very finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Cut the croissants into 1/2 inch slices.  Lightly roast the croissants in the oven for 1 - 2 minutes.  Meanwhile, warm 3 teaspoons of the oil in a small frying pan over a medium heat.  Add the walnuts and cook, shaking the pan frequently, until they are lightly toasted.  Take the walnuts out of the frying pan and allow them to cool slightly.  When the nuts have cooled, add the shallots to them and mix with walnuts, about 30 seconds.  Spread the bean sprouts on bread.  Pour the warm walnuts over the bean sprouts and finish with a little sherry vinegar.  Serve.

title: Simple Herbed Arugula and Arugula Dip-- Quick & Easy!
ingredients: 1 head arugula | 1/2 cup beef broth
instructions: In a medium bowl whisk together the broth and arugula.  Use your hands to bring the broth to a low boil then whisk in the arugula mixture.  Serve with toasted pita chips or as a sandwich spread.  Enjoy with crusty bread, garlic fries, or with roasted vegetables.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,arborio rice,chicken,tamarind paste,pomegranate seed,catsup,baby portabella mushroom
title: Sweet and Sour Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup tamarind paste | 1 package baby portabella mushroom | 1 cup arborio rice | 8 -12 ounces ground chicken | 2 tablespoons pomegranate seeds | lime wedge, for serving | pixie wafer, for serving
instructions: To make tamarind sauce, soak tamarind pods in 3 cups of warm water for 30 to 90 minutes to soften.  Drain tamarind pods and transfer to a blender or food processor.  Blend until the mixture is smooth and the texture is very thick.  Reserve 2 tablespoons sauce for garnish and set aside.  Bring a medium sized pot of water to a boil and cook the mushrooms for three minutes, then remove.  Reserve the liquid and discard the stems.  In a medium saucepan, combine the reserved sauce with rice and 2 cups of the retained water.  Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce temperature to very low.  Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes until all of the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender.  Meanwhile, place the chicken, pomegranate seeds, and reserved 1 ounce liquid in a large mixing bowl and begin to heat a large saute pan over medium high heat for 2 to 3 minutes or until the chicken is cooked thoroughly.  Drain the chicken and divide into four portions.  Sprinkle each portion with a few pomegranate seeds, squeeze some lime juice, and place on serving dishes.  Spoon over the reserved sauce.  Serve with a lime wedge on the side.

title: Apricot & bamboo shoot cocktail Appetizer
ingredients: 4 apricots | 1 cup papayas apple wood vinegar | 1 tablespoon sea salt | 250 g dried bamboo shoots, chopped | 1 lemon, thinly sliced
instructions: Remove the stem ends from the apricots then cut each 1 cm wide by 1 cm long strips.  Cut them into 1cm cubes.  Place all the ingredients in a bowl and mix until well blended.  Arrange the apricot and pear halves on an oven tray and cook at 150 degrees c for 10 - 15 minutes.  Remove from the oven and place lemon slices on top of everything.  Return to the oven for 5 minutes.  Serve on an ice cream cone.

Random Ingredients: hot red pepper flake,cayenne powder,peppercorn,cooking oil
title: Homemade Chinese Pepper Powder II
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons hot red pepper flakes ( dried hot red chiles ) | 1 teaspoon dried peppercorn ( cracked peppercorns, if available ) | 2 teaspoons cayenne powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons powdered peppercorn ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons cooking oil
instructions: In a small bowl combine the dried red chilies, cracked peppercorns, cayenne powder, powdered peppercorn, and oil.  Mix well, then store in an airtight container.  Use within a week.

Random Ingredients: blue cheese,tahini,lamb,green bell pepper,cashew,rigatoni pasta,egg noodle
title: Yummy Baked Rigatoni
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds lean ground lamb | 2 tablespoons peanut or cashews | 2 green bell peppers, chopped | 2 packages frozen egg noodles | 2 packages rigatoni pasta | 1 tablespoon tahini | 1 package blue cheese, crumbled
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Cook rigatoni in boiling salted water until al dente.  Drain, crumble, and set aside.  In the 9x13 inch baking dish spread 3 tablespoons sunflower oil over the bottom.  Mix ground lamb, cashews, green peppers, egg noodles, and hot noodle sauce.  Spread rigatoni into the baking dish.  Arrange the crumbled blue cheese over the rigatoni.  Top with the remaining rigatoni.  Sprinkle the top with the remaining 1 tablespoon of sunflower oil and 1 tablespoon of tahini.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,white cabbage,chicken meat,butter,red chilies,romaine lettuce,sharp cheddar cheese,grain white rice
title: Chicken Rice Skillet
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter | 1 medium white cabbage, cut in 8 wedges | 1/2 cup chopped red chilies | 1 can diced romano-free red chilies, drained | 1 cup uncooked medium grain white rice | 1 1/2 cups cubed cooked chicken meat | 1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | salt and pepper
instructions: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat until foaming, add cabbage wedges and sauté 5 minutes, or until tender crisp.  Remove from skillet and set aside.  To skillet, add chilies, rice and cubed chicken.  Sprinkle with cheese and sauté 2 minutes until cheese is melted.  Top with hot cabbage mixture.

Random Ingredients: ancho chile powder,walnut,green food coloring,clam juice
title: Ancho Chile Jelly
ingredients: 1 cup walnuts | 1 tablespoon dried ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon green food coloring | 2 cans chopped clams with juice
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle, pound the walnuts with ancho chili powder until fine.  Add the green food coloring.  Fill a large pot with about 7 cups water.  Bring to a boil over high heat.  Remove from heat, and add soaked walnuts.  Stir to coat completely in the liquid.  Cover the pot, and let mixture stand for 1 hour.  Refrigerate jelly, stirring occasionally, for at least 3 days.  Bring clams to a boil in a saucepan over high heat.  Reduce heat to medium low, and simmer for about 5 minutes, or until clam juice has reduced.  Pour the reduced clam juice into a jar with a lid, and top with clams.  Cover, and store jelly in a cool water bath for up to 5 weeks.  Bring clams to a boil in a saucepan over high heat.  Reduce heat to medium, and simmer for 5 minutes.  Stir in jelly, and allow to cool to warm at room temperature.  The jelly will keep, covered, for 6 months.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,heavy whipping cream,coconut milk,rigatoni pasta,blue curacao
title: Blue Curacao Rachael Ray
ingredients: 1 pound rigatoni pasta | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/2 cup coconut milk | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon blue curacao, or to taste
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.  Once the water is boiling, stir in the rigatoni, and return to a boil.  Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.  Drain well in a colander set in the sink.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Mix together the rice vinegar, coconut milk, cream, and blue curacao in a bowl.  Stir in the hot pasta, and transfer to a baking dish.  Bake in the preheated oven until warm through, about 15 minutes.

title: Nana's Portabella Mushroom Rolls
ingredients: 2 cups white flour, sifted | 1/2 cup pickling salt ( i use kosher ) | 1 package baby portabella mushrooms ( baby portabella mushrooms )
instructions: Mix flour and salt together thoroughly in a wide, flat container to a thick batter like paste with a drop or two of water added.  Mushrooms should be fully submerged in this batter.  If they are large, they are more likely to be sticky.  Preheat oven to 350°f.  Remove mushrooms from their packaging, and remove stems and soft shrivings.  Roll mushrooms into a ball until they are fully coated with the batter.  Place onto a parchment sheet, and pat out flat until you have a nice square cake about 1 inch thick.  Place the mushrooms onto your parchment, and flatten, and then flatten again so they are somewhat flattened.  Spray your oven walls with a no stick cooking spray during the last few minutes of cooking so they don't stick to the bread or burn.  Bake for 10 to 15 minutes in your oven, or until crust is golden brown on the top.

Random Ingredients: veal brisket,canola oil,parmigiano reggiano cheese,iceberg lettuce
title: Veal Salad Milanese
ingredients: veal brisket, from 3-4 lbs | 6 cups sliced iceberg lettuce ( about 5 large ) | 2 ounces freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 tablespoons canola oil, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Line large rimmed baking sheet with foil.  Cut brisket in half crosswise using very sharp knife.  Transfer half of mixture to shallow baking dish.  Tear one third off brisket and reserve separately.  Place meat on rack of oven and roast until light brown and well puffed, about 1 hour 15 minutes.  Turn meat over and roast until well puffed and meat is 90% cooked through, about 1 hour 15 minutes more.  When meat is well puffed and puffed, transfer to plate, cover loosely with foil and let rest for 15 minutes.  Cut meat into thin slices.  Place lettuce in a large serving platter.  Sprinkle with cheese and 1 tbsp canola oil.  Sprinkle with remaining cheese and remaining canola oil.  Using wide, shallow dish or dish, arrange lettuce on lettuce.  Ladle salad with vinaigrette over.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,rigatoni pasta,colby jack cheese,green chile
title: Rigatoni With Green Chile and Roasted Garlic
ingredients: 2 lbs baking potatoes, peeled, cut into wedges | 1 1/2 lbs ragu green chiles, slit lengthwise, seeds removed | 2 1/2 cups bottled roasted garlic ( use a whole head, unwaxed, leaving peel in tact only ) | 1 lb rigatoni pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Toss potatoes with garlic in a large bowl, add 1/2 cup of water, and spread in a large roasting pan.  Add chiles to water.

title: Gruyere & Banana Crumble
ingredients: 3 medium bananas, cut in 1/4 inch strips | 2 cups gruyere cheese, grated | 1/4 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, minced | 2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 2 cups half-and-half
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f.  Spray 15x10x1 inch jelly roll pan with cooking spray.  Mix all ingredients except half and half in medium bowl.  Top evenly with half and half.  Bake 1 hour or until top is lightly browned and bubbly.  Cool until warm but not hot, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,garlic paste,tilapia fillet,pepper sauce,belgian endive,curd cottage cheese
title: Lemon Garlic Fish
ingredients: 2 tilapia fillets | 1 jar medium-strength dry curd cottage cheese | 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1 teaspoon bottled garlic paste | 1 teaspoon shredded mexican-style cheese blend | 4 heads belgian endive, halved lengthwise and cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Place both tilapias on a clean dry skillet over medium heat and lightly sear until fish flakes easily with a fork, about 10 minutes.

title: Texas Pecans
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chopped pecans | 2 tablespoons chopped green onions | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar
instructions: Blend pecans, green onions, cilantro, and cider vinegar in a food processor until mixture comes together into a compact crumbly mixture, about 5 minutes.  Add pecan mixture into a resealable plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: queso fresco,curry powder,pork loin roast,sherry wine,lamb steak,goat cheese
title: Pork Roulades
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lamb steaks or 1 1/2 lbs boneless pork loin, chopped | 1/2 lb goat cheese, diced | 1/4 lb queso fresco, diced | 2 teaspoons curry powder | 1/4 cup sherry wine or 1/4 cup cider vinegar | 1 lb country-style prepared pork roll or 1 lb pork roll, cut in 1/2-inch slices
instructions: Place meat on lightly oiled foil and place in freezer.  For the pork, preheat the oven to 425°f.  Combine butter, goat cheese, monterey jack cheese, curry powder and sherry and mix well.  Divide the mixture evenly between the meat slices.  Roll up each slice tightly and place in a shallow baking dish covered with foil so that the meat does not touch the bottom of the dish.  Bake for 30 minutes.  Remove the meat from the oven, turn the meat slices over and bake for an additional 20 - 25 minutes or until brown and internal temperature registers 155°f.  Cut into 1/2 slices and serve.

title: Basic Tomato Salad Dressing, 2 Variations - Low Fat, Low Sodium
ingredients: 3/4 cup plum tomato, chopped | 1 teaspoon cumin | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl, mixing well.  Cover and chill for at least 2 hours before serving, stir once a day for the flavors to combine and blend.

title: Raspberry and Poached Pork Sausages
ingredients: 8 ounces lean pork | 2 ounces fresh raspberries | 2 ounces pearl onions
instructions: Remove the pork from the fridge and wash thoroughly.  This step will take around 10 mins, then rinse and dry off in a clean tea towel.  Set the raspberries in a heatproof bowl.  Cover with boiling water and leave to soften for 3 minutes, drain.  Place the pork sausages under a hot grill for 6 - 9 minutes on each side until cooked to your liking.  Meanwhile, place the raspberries in a roasting tin and top with the pearl onions.  Cover and cook in the oven for 20 minutes or until the onions are soft and the raspberries are starting to burst.  You will need to check the pork and raspberries regularly to make sure their juices boil away.  Serve with lots of freshly cooked bread for the dipping meal.

title: Simple Creamy Ricotta and Tomato Pie
ingredients: 1 cup nonfat sour cream | 1 cup 2 % low-fat milk ricotta cheese | 1 1/2 cups seedless grapes in tomato, quartered | 9 inches pastry for a double crust pie
instructions: Mix sour cream and ricotta cheese completely.  Spread about 1 teaspoon in the bottom of a pie dish.  Spread about 1 cup of the ricotta cheese mixture on top of the sour cream.  Spread about 1 1/2 cups of the grape tomatoes on top of the ricotta mixture and add 1/2 cup of the reserved tomato tops.  Top with remaining pastry.  Place pie in a 350 degree oven for 25 minutes or until crust is lightly browned.  Serve warm or refrigerate for up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,heavy whipping cream,kaffir lime leaf,buttermilk biscuit,chicken stock,sultana
title: South African Dessert Soup
ingredients: 8 cups chicken stock | 6 slices firm buttermilk biscuits | 6 kaffir lime leaves | 1/3 cup sultana | 1/3 cup long grain white rice | 3 tablespoons heavy whipping cream
instructions: Bring the stock to a boil in a large soup pot.  Add the biscuits and return to a boil.  Drop by the spoonfuls, one at a time, into the stock along with the kaffir lime leaves, sultanas and rice.  Return to boil.  Reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, for 25 minutes or until rice is tender.  When creamy enough to blend with a ribbon, stir in cream and serve hot.  Note, soup can be prepared 2 days in advance and reheated, covered, in a small crock pot.

title: Irish Snowballs (Ice Cream)
ingredients: 1 cup ice cold water | 2 cups confectioners'sugar | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Combine the ice and water in a container with a tight fitting lid.  Freeze for 10 minutes, or until mixture is partially frozen solid.  Drain and roll in the confectioners' sugar.  Return to the freezer until serving time.  Add vanilla essence or orange essence to taste.

Random Ingredients: egg white,tequila,pork shoulder,baby bok choy,no salt tomato,jicama
title: Saucy Sweet Pork
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork shoulder, diced to 1/2 inch | 1 small jicama, peeled and diced ( about 1/2 lb ) | 1 can no-salt-added whole plum tomatoes, drained or 3/8 cup canned tomato puree | 1 package baby bok choy, cut into 1/4 inch slices ( about 4 cups ) | 5 tablespoons egg whites, lightly beaten | 1/2 cup tequila
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a large nonstick frypan and stir fry over medium high heat for 5 minutes or until the pork has a dark pink color, turning the pork occasionally.  Serve hot.

title: Mexican Beef Turnovers
ingredients:
1 1/2 lbs ground round | 1 can crushed tomatoes with juice | 1 teaspoon wasabi paste | 1 teaspoon dried orange peel | 1/4 teaspoon dried chipotle powder ( from a 6-oz.
    - can ) | 1 pinch table salt or 1 pinch kosher salt | 0.

instructions: For beef mixture, in large nonstick skillet, over medium high heat, cook the ground round, breaking up the meat, until no longer pink, about 5 minutes.  Pour off most of the fat but leave enough to coat the bottom of the skillet.  Add tomatoes, wasabi paste, orange peel, chipotle powder, and a sprinkling of table salt or kosher salt.

Random Ingredients: fish sauce,leg lamb,lime wedge,portobello mushroom,yellow pepper
title: Thai Roast Lamb Salad (Mushroom and Peppers)
ingredients: 1 kg leg of lamb | 1 yellow pepper, finely sliced | 1 cup portobello mushroom, finely sliced | 1/4 cup fish sauce | 2 tablespoons lime wedges
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the lamb in a large bowl.  Add lamb and toss to coat.  Cover with cling wrap and leave to marinate in fridge for at least 30 minutes and up to 3 hours.  Preheat grill to high.  Place lamb on hot grill with yellow pepper slice and mushrooms.  Grill for 10 minutes.  Transfer lamb to serving plate and cover with foil.  Let rest for 30 minutes before serving.  Carve lamb as desired.

Random Ingredients: lemon pepper,graham cracker crumb,mozzarella cheese,egg substitute,red wine,chicken broth
title: Delicious Low Fat No-Bake Cheesy Red Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup fat free low-sodium chicken broth | 1 cup fat free mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup egg substitute ( i like egg beater ) | 1/4 cup dry red wine | 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees.  In a large saucepan, bring the chicken broth to a boil.  Lower heat and add the cheese in a small stream and stir until melted together.  Mix the red wine with the lemon pepper in a small bowl.  Place the cracker crumbs in a small bowl.  Dip half of each mozzarella cheese cube in the egg mixture to coat cheese.  Dip cheese into the cracker crumbs.  Add the cheese to the pot of cheese and broth and bring back to a full boil.  Stir frequently.  Simmer about 3 minutes.  Remove from heat and enjoy with a nice loaf of bread, vegetables, or fresh veggies.  Makes about enough for a large number.

title: Chipotle Pepper Bark
ingredients: 18 1/2 ounces all-purpose active dry yeast | 6 ounces tamarind chutney | chipotle chile
instructions: Dough, add tamarind chutney and the chilis to the bowl of a food processor, blend.  Add 5 tbsp cold water, the yeast, and process until the mixture forms a slightly coarse paste.  Gradually add the rest of the ingredients, and continue to process until a dough forms.  Pinch off small balls of the dough about the size of a teaspoon.  Roll them in the palms of your hands into balls and set them on a parchment lined baking tray lined with a floured baking sheet.  Let the Bark dry, covered with plastic wrap, in a draft free place for at least 2 hours, or overnight.  Use as directed.

title: Sour Cream Corn
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 can corn or 1 can peas
instructions: Empty cans of soup into medium sauce pan.  If you are not sure about the size of the pan you are using, first you have to stir on low until soup is thick.  Next, add the corn or peas.  Cook at low for about an hour or more until heated through, then serve.

title: Tibetan Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 tablespoons rice bran | 750 g uncooked medium prawns, cleaned and deveined ( about 1 '' by 2 '' ) | 4 tablespoons wheat bran | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 40 g fresh parsley leaves, chopped | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke, such as tabasco | 8 ounces tea
instructions: Place the 2 tablespoons of oil to a nonstick skillet placed over medium high heat.  Add half of the prawns, making sure they are completely submerged.  Cook until the prawns are pink and the prawns are cooked, stirring gently so not to break the shells but to make sure the prawns cook evenly in the pan.  Add the 1 tablespoon of wheat bran and 1 tablespoon of cornstarch and stir to mix well.  Add the parsley, liquid smoke, and remaining beef broth.  Simmer covered, for 10 minutes.  While the stew simmers, bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Add the rice noodle and return to a boil.  Reduce the heat, cover, and simmer for 10 minutes, until the noodles are tender.  Fluff the noodles with a fork and remove the prawns and parsley.  Cover and set aside to let the liquid from the beef consume.  Add the 2 tablespoons of rice bran to the beef broth and bring to a boil over high heat.  Reduce heat to simmer and set aside at least 30 minutes for the flavors to mingle.  If you make this stew ahead of time, just add 2 tablespoons of rice bran and cook longer.  Stir and remove the prawns and parsley leaves before serving.

title: Shrimp Toast With Chilli
ingredients: 1 large yellow bell pepper, sliced | 1 large green pumpkin, sliced | 1 1/2 teaspoons shrimp paste ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 16 slices bread, diagonally slices ( i like to use gluten-free to make pita bread ) | 1 can rotel tomatoes ( no oil added )
instructions: Cook and cool bell pepper on grill, about 10 minutes or until bright green and softened.  Set aside.  Place pumpkin in food processor and pulse with shrimp paste and vanilla until well mixed.  Heat a nonstick pan and place a teaspoon of oil in it.  Saute green pepper for about 15 minutes, or until golden brown.  Dip bread slices in chili for about 20 seconds on each side, or until golden brown, and heated through.  Spoon on top of pepper mixture and top with slices of chilled pepper mixture.

title: Barefoot Contessa's Tiramisù
ingredients: 1 lb ladyfinger | 1 lb yellow squash, roasted | 2 tablespoons cocoa | 1 lb tortilla, cut in small squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Combine ladyfingers, roasted squash and cocoa in a bowl.  Spoon 1/2 cup of the cocoa mixture over half of the ladyfingers.  Tightly roll up ladyfingers and arrange in a baking pan.  Repeat layers of ladyfingers, squash and cocoa mixture and tortillas until pan is full.  Bake 35 - 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,avocado,cream tartar,chicken bouillon cube,beef chuck,cucumber,tabasco sauce,range chicken
title: West Indian Shredded Steak and Quinoa Casserole
ingredients: 4 free range chicken bouillon cubes | 1 carton hot cream of tartar | 3 lbs beef chuck, cut into 3- to 3-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons tabasco sauce | 3 1/2 cups quinoa, cooked | 2 1/2 cups cooked free range chicken | 1 1/2 cups guacamole tomatoes or 1 1/2 cups cucumbers, chopped | 1 large avocado, peeled and sliced
instructions: In 1 gallon zipper bag combine bouillon and tartar.  Add cubed meat and knead to mix.  Transfer meat and marinade to 3 - 4 quart baking dish.  Cover and refrigerate for up to 4 hours.  Bake for 1 hour at 400°f.  Preheat oven to 425°f.  Pour 1/2 the quinoa into a 9 x 13 inch baking dish.  Arrange sliced tomatoes in a spoke fashion on top.  Place quinoa in baking dish, top with sliced avocado.  Bake for 20 minutes or until cheese is melted and golden brown.

title: Seared Cavatelli With Chickpeas
ingredients: 400 g penne pasta ( fresh or dried ) | 240 g canned chickpeas, drained ( or 1 1/4 cup cooked ) | 125 g sliced button mushrooms | 2 tablespoons pizza sauce | 1 tablespoon low-sodium white vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon peppercorn
instructions: Cook penne pasta according to directions, drain, and set aside.  In a non stick pan fry mushrooms for a few minutes, then toss with chickpeas and cook for another 2 mins, stir in pizza sauce, vinegar and peppercorns.  Toss through cooked pasta and cheese, serve warm.

title: English Muffin Toasted Chocolate Sandwich
ingredients: 2 english muffins | 1 chocolate square, melted
instructions: Split the english muffins lengthwise.  Spread 1/2 of the melted chocolate over the cut side of the top of each muffin half.  Place muffins on a baking sheet and spread top side of each muffin with remaining melted chocolate.  Bake in the upper and lower thirds of a 350 degree oven until chocolate is melted and top is crisp.

Random Ingredients: vodka,pumpkin pie spice,curry paste,mustard seed,vanilla,garlic granule
title: Malaysian Spice Mix
ingredients: 1/2 cup prepared mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons vanilla | 4 tablespoons curry paste | 2 teaspoons paprika ( not hot ) | 1/2 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice ( or to taste ) | 1 -2 teaspoon garlic granules or 1 -2 teaspoon fresh and ground peppercorns
instructions: In a small bowl, combine mustard seeds, vanilla and curry paste.  Combine spices.  Store in air tight container in refrigerator.

title: Salsa Verde
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked quinoa | 8 12-inch corn tortillas | 1 cup of fresh mint leaves
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package directions.  To plate the quinoa, cut tortillas in half into thin strips.  Stack tortillas over the quinoa and place a teaspoonful of the quinoa and mint in the centre.  Fold the sides of each toothpick in half and then roll and tuck into the quinoa.  Warm quinoa mixture on the grill or in the oven or until cheese is melted, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,coconut,broth,saffron,thai red curry paste,pepperoncini pepper,pasta sauce,rump steak
title: Shrimp Malaysian

instructions: Shell and devein shrimp.  Place shrimp in a large saucepan.  Add broth or water.

title: Tofu and Guava Dip
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu, cut into 6 1/2-inch cubes | 1 cup guava nectar | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 1 sprig fresh rosemary
instructions: Place tofu into a shallow roasting pan, and pour in the guava nectar, vinegar, and rosemary sprigs.  Cover, and marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes.  Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Bake in the preheated oven until tofu is soft and slightly browned, about 1 hour.  Serve warm.

title: Kraft Swiss Steak Stew

instructions: Preparing the food, in a large saute pan over med high heat, combine the sriracha pepper paste, kielbasa, chile pepper and remaining sriracha.  When the paste begins to change colour, add the edamame and cook, stirring, about 2 minutes.  Stir in the shelled edamame pods and cocoa powder.  Add the seafood and increase heat to medium high.  Cook seafood, stirring constantly, about 4 minutes.  Adjust heat to low.  Cook 3 to 5 minutes, or just until the seafood turns opaque.  Sprinkle with parsley.

instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  In small bowl mix together orange flower water, maple syrup, coffee powder, dried chili, green chiles. Place cauliflower in the bottom of a 9x13 inch pan.  Spoon prepared capicum mixture over cauliflower.  Bake at 375 degrees for 20 minutes or until top is golden brown.

instructions: The zaar computer won't let me list a serving size zaar i use.  You should be able to find 10 - 12 saffron strands in the zaar. title: Frozen Blueberry and Kidney Beans Pockets

title: Asian Lamb Shank With Pearlified Dipping Sauce

instructions: Grind or process sesame seeds into a fine powder. Thread lamb shanks onto bamboo skewers, making sure there are no gaps between each ‘slab.  Place lamb skewers on a tray and pour over the grand marnier, shaking off any excess. title: Solo Vietnamese Seasoning
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dried herbs | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla | 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 -1 finely chopped serrano pepper
instructions: Combine everything and store in an airtight container.

title: Brown Derby Mushrooms for Halloween
ingredients: 12 ounces button mushrooms | 1 cup good quality coffee-flavored cocoa
instructions: Prepare mushrooms as directed on package.  Remove stems and cut fresh mushrooms in half if smaller.  Place 1/3 of the sliced mushrooms on a cookie sheet, cover with a clean towel, and place in microwave on high, power for 1 - 1 1/2 minutes until mushrooms are soft and all moisture is absorbed.  Let cool slightly.  Stir in about half of the cocoa.  Pour over the remaining cocoa, place back in microwave and heat for 90 seconds.  Remove from microwave, and store in a clean container away from light and heat for 1 - 2 minutes to set cocoa.

instructions: Combine the beef gravy, 1/2 cup water, chicken and mushrooms in the bottom of your food processor or blender.  Stir in lemon juice, chives or scallions or rose petals and cilantro. Secure with toothpicks, or secure with toothpicks inserted directly in the meat.  Serve warm or cold.

title: Homemade Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups canned chopped tomatoes with puree | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Combine tomatoes, cayenne pepper, and tomato puree in a large, heavy pot over medium heat.  Heat until thick, about 10 minutes.  Use immediately.

title: Frozen White Chocolate
ingredients: 6 ounces white chocolate | 1 red onion, finely chopped
instructions: Pour the chocolate into a pan and heat gently.  Stir in the chopped red onion and set aside for up to a week, stirring occasionally.

title: Vegetarian "Cindy" and "Rice Nests
ingredients: 1 bag elbow macaroni | 1 1/2 cups crushed vegetable bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon cinnamon | 1 cup chili sauce ( such as kikkoman sweet chile sauce ) | 3/4 cup creamed coconut ( coco cola ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons cajun hot sauce ( frank's red hot )
instructions: Cook macaroni al dente according to package directions.  Drain and rinse under cold water to cool slightly while the noodles cook.  Combine macaroni, cooked noodles and 1 cup of remaining liquid from the bag in a large bowl.  Mix well.  Meanwhile, combine remaining ingredients, except cajun hot sauce, and bring to a boil over medium heat.  Reduce heat to low, and simmer, covered, until most of the liquid is absorbed, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes.

title: Taco Watercress
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh watercress leaf, cleaned well | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder ( haldi ) | 3 tablespoons taco sauce
instructions: Wash the watercress well and remove the center rib.  With knife slice through the bottom leaf to make two rib sections and discard.  Place the leaves back on the stem and slice very thin.  Remove the outer layer of leaves and slice thin.  Place the turmeric powder in a small pan with tumeric.  Place watercress leaves face down on heat.  Stir a few times and let it heat through.  Transfer watercress leaves to dish and pour taco sauce over all.  Serve with fresh, soft crusty bread.

title: Potato Fritters
ingredients: 8 large red potatoes, scrubbed | 1 white onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | sweet and sour guacamole, for serving
instructions: Place the potatoes in a large saucepan and cover with cold water.  Bring to a boil over high heat.  Reduce heat to medium low and simmer until tender, about 12 minutes.  Drain into a bowl and cool until cold.  Drain and set aside.  Place the onions, parsley and fennel seed in a food processor and process until finely ground.  With the machine running, add the sweet and sour guacamole and process for 30 seconds or so until well mixed.  Set aside.  Mash the potatoes with a potato masher or potato masher.  Mix in the ground ingredients and season to taste with salt and pepper.  Form potato mixture into six patties.  Heat a nonstick frying pan over medium high heat and add about 1/4 cup oil.  Add the potatoes to the pan and turn once so both sides are light golden brown.  Drain the potato patties on paper towels.  Serve with salsa and sour cream if desired.

title: Beef Stew in Port
ingredients: 2 lbs lean stewing beef, cut into 2-inch cubes | 1 lb beef stew meat, cut into 2-inch cubes | 1 lb veal | 1 1/2 lbs boiling onions | 1/2 cup raisins | 1/2 cup figleaf marjoram leaves or 1/2 cup marjoram leaves | 1/2 cup yoghurt | 1 1/2 cups port wine
instructions: Cut meat into chunks.  Place in crockpot.  Combine remaining ingredients.  Pour over meat and cook on low all day.

title: Steamed Parsnips
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground cumin, dry | 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon | 4 teaspoons vinegar ( apple cider or rice wine ) | 2 lbs parsnips, peeled and very thinly sliced ( about 4 large ) | 2 1/3 lbs broccoli, cut into florets and steamed until crisp and tender | 3/4 cup plain flour | 4 tablespoons vinegar | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 lemon, juice of
instructions: Combine cumin, cinnamon, vinegar and 1 tsp sugar and set aside.  Drain parsnips, reserving juice.  Place in a bowl, cover with cold water and set aside.  Steam the vegetables until crisp tender, about 5 minutes.  Drain.  Place the parsnips and broccoli in a saucepan with enough boiling water to cover the vegetables and bring to the boil.  Cook until tender crisp.  Drain.  Combine flour, vinegar and remaining 3 tbsp/2 tsp sugar in a large bowl.  Add parsnips and broccoli and toss well.  Serve the vegetables, sprinkled with the reserved cumin cinnamon cinnamon mixture and a little grated lemon rind.

title: Greek Burger (Low Fat)
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground sirloin | 2 tablespoons breading or 2 tablespoons low-fat ground bread | 2 tablespoons pizza sauce | 1/2 celery rib, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon honey | 1/2 teaspoon oregano | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl, combine beef, bread crumbs, pizza sauce, celery, honey, oregano and turmeric.  Mix thoroughly with a fork.  Divide into 8 servings and shape into 2 patties.  Place on baking sheet sprayed with cooking spray.  Cover and bake at 400 for 10 minutes or till desired doneness.

title: Roasted Raspberry Berries
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh raspberries or 2 lbs frozen berries, washed and patted dry | 2 jars bainchre boulange ( french herb boursin or similar herb flavoured berry )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Tear the berries into 3 sections and place them into a small baking dish or platter.  Sprinkle with sugar, or, if desired, a bouquet garni.  Stir gently to combine.  Bake for about 20 minutes, or until the berries are bubbly.  Cool.  Remove any berries with the sugar and bouquet garni from the oven.  Place them on a dish and cover with plastic wrap.  Keep them out of direct sunlight while you sleep.  You'll be tempted to use only the prettiest flavours in the marinade, such as berry juice, rum, or strawberry puree.  Makes about 4 pounds.

instructions: Combine chives and cheese in a bowl, stir together.  Let set for several hours.

instructions: Place beef in a slow cooker.  Add olives, anchovies, mustard paste, chili sauce and apple.  Cover and cook on low 7 to 9 hours, or until just a hint of celery is starting to show.  Serve over egg noodles.

Serve in small wedges as desired.

title: Thyme-Spiced Low-fat Milk

instructions: In a medium sized pot, mix the milk and thyme.  Bring to the boil over medium heat.  Slowly stir the hot milk into the hot milk.  Lower heat to medium/low and simmer, uncovered for 5 - 6 minutes.  Remove thyme sprigs and discard.  Cool slightly.  Refrigerate, covered until ready to use.

title: Spicy Indian Chutney

instructions: Pour 1/4 cup of the chutney into a 1 gallon size glass measure, fill with boiling water.  Put the ginger paste into a medium saucepan over medium heat, and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant.  Stir in the drained chutney.  Add the peeled tomatoes, and 1 1/2 cups of water, and bring to a boil.  Add the water to the saucepan, and bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Pour mixture over the chutney.  Cover, and put in the fridge until completely set, at least 3 - 6 hours.  I make my chutney with 2 cup jasmine rice, which i made a day in advance and had the rice on hand.

title: Veal Parmesan

instructions: Cook pasta of choice.  Drain and set aside.  Heat oven to 375 degrees.  Trim and pound veal very thinly with a meat mallet or the side of a cleaver.  Place on a rack set in a roasting pan or other large ovenproof dish.  Dot with a little of the reserved pasta cooking liquid pour over the veal and spread evenly.  Cook for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.  During the last 30 minutes of cooking, sprinkle the pasta with the reserved cooking liquid.  Serve over hot browned sauce and some grated parmesan cheese.  For those who think this must be with tomatoes or with tomato sauce, bake the veal to your liking, stirring it around.  You might also add a little dried parsley to the sauce.

title: Mexican Baked Peanuts

instructions: Saute onions and spices in oil until onions are tender, about 5 minutes,.  In a bowl, stir together grated cheese and rotel until well mixed, about 2 minutes.  Add in peanuts and drained coconut.  Stir in peanut butter.  Spread evenly in a 9 x 13 shallow casserole dish.  Bake at 350 degrees for about 20 minutes, or until topping is slightly browned.  Let cool, then cut into squares.  Store in refrigerator.

Spread 1/4 cup of peanut butter mixture over the top layer of potato mixture and cover with a lid or plate and a tight fitting lid.  Place in the oven and let bake for 45 minutes until crispy on top.

title: Nuts In Cheese

instructions: Heat the oven to 200 degrees celcius.  Drain the farmer cheese in a colander, and roll into a rough ball by stretching your hands in a circular motion.  Put the ball, rolled onto the cookie sheet lined with waxed paper, flatten into a rough oval circle.  Use your hands to spread the cheese mixture over the top, and sprinkle with nutmeg, sea salt.  Use kitchen scissors to cut a hole in the middle of each nugget.  Bake in the centre of the oven for 10 minutes, or until golden brown.  Cut each nugget into 8 smaller rounds with a sharp knife.  Serve hot or cold.

title: Italian Style Shredded Steak Beef

instructions: Cut chuck roast into 3/4 inch cubes.  Heat fat from tomatoes to boiling in small skillet.  Add chuck roast.  Cover and cook slowly until tender, about 1 1/2 hours.  Remove meat.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,sea salt,salt pepper,green pepper,ginger root,red chili pepper,brie cheese,broccoli
title: Chinese Brie Salad
ingredients: 2/3 package fresh broccoli, cut in small florets | 1/2 green pepper, sliced thinly | 1/2 red chili pepper, sliced thinly | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh ginger root | 2 teaspoons chopped red chili powder | 1 pinch salt | 1 pinch red chili powder | 1/2 cup brie cheese | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add broccoli and cook about 4 minutes.  Drain and cool.  Place broccoli in a bowl, and mix with green pepper, red pepper, ginger and chile powder.  Add 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder.  Stir to combine.  Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour.  Sprinkle cheese over broccoli salad, and serve immediately.

title: Easy Orange Pepper and Quinoa
ingredients: 1 cup orange bell pepper, chopped | 1 onion, chopped | 1 cup quinoa
instructions: Combine all ingredients together in a microwave safe dish.  Microwave on high for 5 minutes, stir every minute until the quinoa is fluffy and a little browned.

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place the loaves of pita bread on a baking sheet, and toast in the preheated oven for 10 to 15 minutes, until crisp and lightly brown and the edges are lightly browned.  Open the pita bread.

instructions: Chill the green onions.  Place onions and picante sauce in saucepan and heat to a boil.  Reduce temperature, stirring constantly, until slightly thickened about 2 minutes.  Pour the sauce into individual ramekins.  Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring after each minute.  Check with a skewer to see if desired.  Serve with your favorite meat.

title: Tahini Queso Burgers With Prosciutto

instructions: Whisk lime juice, hoagie style bread crumbs, coconut, prosciutto and tahini in small bowl.  Spoon into small serving bowl.

ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint | 1 teaspoon sugar | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Combine all ingredients thoroughly.  Stir to mix.  Allow to sit for a few moments before using as needed.

title: Mexican Rice and Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 2 cups plain flour | 1 1/2 cups jasmine rice ( long grain or basmati or jasmine ) | 2 cups mexican blend cheese ( we use cheddar and mexican blend ) | 1 cup grated monterey jack cheese | 1/3 cup sour cream | 1/3 cup chunky salsa | 3 cups shredded mexican blend cheese | 2 tablespoons sour cream | chopped cherry tomatoes
instructions: Coat 2 - 3 tins with nonstick cooking spray, and preheat oven to 300°f.  Cook rice until tender.  Remove from heat and combine well, set aside.  Combine 1 1/2 cups mexican cheese and 1 cup monterey jack cheese, and set aside.  In another bowl, combine sour cream and hot sauce until well combined.  Spread half of cheese mixture in 4 qts x 2 1/2 casserole dish, top with rice, then 1/3 of sour cream mixture.  Repeat layers, beginning with rice.  Top with remaining cheeses.  Spread sour cream mixture on top layer.  Sprinkle chopped tomatoes on top of sour cream layer and bake for 30 - 40 minutes until bubbly.

title: Tami  Sauce
ingredients: 1 pinch tamari soy sauce ( or more if desired ) | 1 tablespoon cold water
instructions: Simply pour the water into a bowl, add the tamari sweet soy sauce.  Stir, taste and adjust seasonings if needed.  Pour into a dipping dish and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,ginger juice,cream,parmigiano reggiano cheese,canadian bacon,black tea,dark rum
title: Canadian Bacon Tea Splash
ingredients: 1 ounce canadian bacon, finely chopped | 1 ounce fresh ginger juice | 2 ounces sweet cream | 4 ounces dark rum | 2 ounces lemon juice | 1/4 teaspoon ginger juice | 1/4 lb shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Toasted, 1/4 3/4 inch deep dish gratin dish.  Preheat oven to 425 degrees.  Mix all ingredients together in a bowl.  Spread mixture evenly over the gratin dish and bake for 35 minutes or until bubbly.  Let cool for five minutes before serving.

title: Japanese Soba Noodles
ingredients: 1 package soba noodles | 1 1/2 cups club soda | celery salt to taste
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil.  Stir in soba noodles, and return to a boil.  Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still slightly firm, about 11 minutes.  Drain well and stir in the club soda.

title: Parsnip With Spiced Yoghurt
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg parsnips, peeled and sliced | 2 tablespoons coriander seeds | 600 ml vanilla low-fat yogurt, plain | 25 ml mustard oil | lime wedge, to serve
instructions: Blanch the parsnips in boiling, slated water for 5 - 8 minutes until tender.  Drain and refresh under cold water.

Random Ingredients: cheddar monterey jack cheese,apricot jam,egg substitute
title: Warm Apricot Cheese Soufflés
ingredients: 1/3 cup apricot jam | 1/2 cup egg substitute, mixed with | 1/3 cup cheddar & monterey jack cheese
instructions: In 9 x9 pan, cover with foil and let it warm up slowly until it starts to thicken, then cut foil to fit inside for easier separation later.  Butter foil with mixture.  On a plate, spread cooled jam to about 1/4 inch depth.  Over jam cover with cheddar/jack cheese mixture, then pour egg white over mixture.  Place under broiler until golden brown.  Serve immediately.

title: Lek Soup
ingredients: 2 leeks, sliced | 1 cup chicken stock | 1/4 - 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Wash the leeks and slice in 1/4 inch slices.  Place in a large saucepan.  Add the chicken stock.  Bring to a boil and reduce heat to medium.  Cover and simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Nut and Vegetable Crust Pizza - 2 Ww Points
ingredients: 1 cup canned black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 pizza crust | vegetable oil cooking spray or shortening, for brushing | 1/2 cup walnut oil | 6 ounces peeled yellow squash or 6 ounces zucchini, sliced | 1/2 cup chopped pistachio nut | 1 cup tzatziki ( thickened cream cheese spread ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f.  Spray the pizza crust with cooking spray or shortening, then press the mixture evenly into the desired quantity.  Brush pizza crust with oil.  Put walnut oil in a large nonstick skillet and fry the squash for 5 minutes or until slightly softened.  Stir in pistachios and spread with the tzatziki.  Scatter over the nut mixture and season with salt and pepper.  Bake 10 - 12 minutes, until cheese is melted and crust is crisp and golden brown.  Cut into wedges to serve.

title: Garnall a La Venezia (Vermont Milk Pudding)
ingredients: 1/2 cup condensed milk | 1 tablespoon dry vermouth, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine condensed milk and vermouth.  Cook over medium heat until hot, stirring constantly, about 20 minutes.  Pour milk mixture into a serving dish, and refrigerate for 2 hours to meld flavors.  Serve warm, chilled, or at room temperature.

title: Dijon Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 4 teaspoons dijon mustard | 2 teaspoons chili paste | 2 teaspoons dried sage
instructions: Mix mustard with chili paste and serve with fish, meat, eggs and vegetables.

title: Ethiopian Pepper Rings Recipe
ingredients: 1 kg yellow bell pepper ( about 3-inch squares ) | 2 kg baking powder | 600 g gingerroot, finely minced | 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper ( cayenne pepper is more ) | 1 teaspoon thickener
instructions: Wash and dry the tops and bottoms of the peppers.  Cut off all of the top, bottom, and stem portion of the pepper, and discard the inside of the pepper pieces.  Cut the pepper pieces into 5mm thick slices vertically.  Coat each pepper slice with the oil from the peppers in a deep, heavy nonstick frying pan.  Heat on medium flame.  Once heat is medium, put ginger in a bowl and grind together with cayenne pepper and about 400ml water, stirring constantly to combine.  After 15 minutes, stir the ginger into the cayenne pepper mixture, and continue to stir until the mixture thickens.  Keep stirring frequently until mixture collects in the bottom of the pan.  Remove from heat, and put mixture in the refrigerator for 4 days, or longer.  Mix the thickener with a little water, then pour it over the pepper rings and let them marinate overnight.  Cooking time includes marinating time.

title: Pan Con Pimenton (Stacked Baked Bell Peppers)
ingredients: 18 medium dried bell peppers, stems removed | 3 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed
instructions: Soak peppers in large bowl of warm water overnight, covered.  Drain and discard any remaining water.  Place in a 5 or 6 quart heavy skillet.  Sprinkle with anise seed, and add enough cold water to cover peppers by 1 inch.  Bring to a boil, cover, and boil 20 minutes.  Remove cover, reduce heat and simmer slowly until peppers are tender, about 30 minutes.  Uncover pan, and roast peppers until a darker crust forms on top of the peppers, about 25 minutes.  Cool slightly.  Wrap in foil to keep warm and keep baking until peppers are tender, 1 1/2 to 2 days.

title: Black-Eyed Peas With Coconut Milk (Coconut Milk With Peppers) and Nuts
ingredients: 4 green chilies, chopped | 1 package sliced pepperoni ( i like spicy but mellow would be great ) | 2 cans coconut milk ( i've used coconut cream also ) | 1 teaspoon fresh ground cardamom | 3 tablespoons fresh cilantro, chopped | 2 packages ladyfingers | 1 can black-eyed peas
instructions: If you have access to a canning jars, they are easier to process these ingredients, but can be left off range for a few days or even up to 6 months.  After peeling the green chilies, cut them in half lengthwise and core.  If you are using canned coconut milk, drain.  If not, then just chop enough.  Otherwise, the coconut milk is the only chance you will have chicken or vegetable broth.  In a large pot, heat a small amount of oil and add the green chili peppers.  Let soften a bit, then add the black eye peas.  Stir fry over medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes.  Add in the green chilies.  Stir in the coconut milk, cardamom and cilantro.  The entire mixture should cover everything, but if not add one can of milk at a time until you get a nice creamy consistency.  The coconut milk will almost immediately start bubbling away.

title: Crusty Croissant Pastry II
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1 celery rib, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Separate rolls of dough into 2 sections.

title: Crispy Baked Fish #RSC
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless skinless cod, cut into chunks | 1 cup vital wheat gluten | 1/2 cup guacamole | 1/2 cup steak spice bagels, split in half | 8 small baking potatoes, quartered | 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless cod, cut into chunks | 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks, cut into thirds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Combine the dry ingredients in a medium bowl.  Roll fish pieces in the mixture to coat.  Bake breaded fish in batches for 20 minutes, turning once.  Bake fish for 20 minutes, remove and place on a baking sheet with the cut sides up.  Bake for an additional 40 minutes.  Place potatoes in a steamer with some water in a 2 qt saucepan, and heat over low heat, partially covered, stirring occasionally.  Stir fry steamed potatoes for 3 - 15 minutes until firm.  Slice steak against grain into strips.  Place fish in a large mixing bowl and toss with potatoes, flank steak, and spice mixture.  Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes to let flavors marinade.  Bake.

title: Easy Tasty Beef and Vegetable Samosas
ingredients: 2 lbs stew meat | 3 tablespoons tapioca starch | 2 tablespoons ground almonds ( meal ) | 1 tablespoon garam masala | 2 tablespoons chicken bouillon | 1 tablespoon store bought pesto sauce | 8 -10 baby spinach | 1 bunch bok choy or 1 bunches coriander leaves
instructions: Dredge meat in tapioca.

title: Blueberry Pork Roasted With Mango Chutney Salad
ingredients: 2 pork tenderloin | 2 teaspoons artificial sweetener, plus more to taste | 2 teaspoons mango chutney, plus more to taste | 1/2 shallot, chopped ( about 1 1/2 tablespoons ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 cup blueberry topping, with juices | reduced-sugar mango chutney
instructions: Heat oven to 450°f rub the pork with the sweetener and place on a rack in a roasting pan.  Roast for 20 to 25 minutes or until a meat thermometer registers 145°f.  Transfer to a carving board and let stand 10 minutes and slice.  Meanwhile, combine the chutney with the shallots and nutmeg and rub over the pork.  Serve with the blueberry topping.

title: Homemade Sweet Pasta, Chinese Style
ingredients: 1 bag crushed saltines ( preferably the ones sold at the store ) | 1/4 cup sesame oil or 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 1/2 cup oriental sesame oil | 1/4 cup water
instructions: If using crushed saltines, add them only to a quart dishwasher or other small oven safe container that can accomodate water and heat in a low oven, about 115 degrees.  If using vegetable oil, add to a pot over medium heat.  When the water begins to bubble and/or starts to shimmer, add the sesame oil and vinegar.  Stir to combine and set aside.  Add crushed saltines to the bowl of a food processor fitted with a steel blade or blender and process at high speed until they resemble cornmeal, about 1 minute.  Set aside.  Place sesame oil/vegetable oil in a deep 12 inch skillet.  When the oil is very hot, but not smoking, add the pasta from the sherry cracker bag.  Cook, stirring constantly, until pasta breaks apart, 3 to 4 minutes.  Drain pasta and transfer to a serving bowl.  Return the sesame oil/vegetable oil/vinegar mixture to the skillet, add the water and turn off the heat.  Serve over hot cooked pasta with freshly grated parmesan.  Note, may add 1 or 2 tablespoons chicken stock to taste.

title: Tropical Shrimp Skewers
ingredients: 1/4 cup shrimp paste | 1/4 cup artichoke, fresh with stalks ( frozen if frozen ) | 1 mango | 15 whole cloves
instructions: Peel, remove seeds of mango.  Cut into cubes.  Peel shrimp and marinate in mixture of shrimp paste, artichokes and mango.  Cover and refrigerate 4 hours.  Toss with skewers.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,baking soda,red cabbage,white wine vinegar
title: Smoked Red Cabbage
ingredients: 3 1/4 lbs red cabbage | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 1/2 cup dry white wine vinegar | ground red cabbage
instructions: Wash cabbage, remove and discard the outer leaves and any tough outer leaves.  Place in large pan and sprinkle with baking soda, salt and vinegar.  Cover and let stand for 2 hours or until limp.  Cut into wedges and serve cold.

title: Lemongrass and Sausage
ingredients: 20 shrimp, shelled and de-veined | 2 stalks lemongrass, white part only, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried cumin seeds | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark chocolate, chopped | 1 package polish sausage, sliced | 8 leaves swiss chard
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f and lightly grease a baking sheet.  Put shrimp, lemongrass, cumin, and chocolate in a small bowl and mash together with a fork.  Lay chard on a clean dry towel and pound down.  Wrap bag of sausage in a clean, dry towel and squeeze out excess moisture.  Spread 1 - 2 tablespoons of spice mixture onto shrimp in a small pan and toast over low heat, shaking the pan for a few seconds, until fragrant.  Remove from pan and place on a plate lined with wax paper.

title: Mock Chicken Pie

instructions: Cut 9 pieces from the 10 oz.  Of dates.  Cut one piece in half, and slice the other half.  Put 12 pieces of dates on each pie half, cut side down, and cover with 1/2 of your favorite marinara sauce.  Dredge with breadcrumbs, if desired, and bake in a 450f oven for 30 minutes, or until golden brown on top.

Random Ingredients: green bean,vegetable oil cooking spray,broccoli floret,broccoli
title: Spicy Broccoli and Green Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking spray | 1 package frozen chopped broccoli florets, thawed and drained | 1 package frozen chopped green beans, thawed, drained | 1 package frozen chopped broccoli, thawed, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f spray large baking dish with cooking spray.  Add broccoli, cover and cook in oven about 5 minutes until broccoli is crisp tender.  Transfer broccoli and broccoli to a serving bowl.  Add green beans to broccoli mixture.  Stir together well.

title: Brandy Glazed Beef

instructions: Place the beef in a large dutch oven or other heavy pot.  Cover with water and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Turn the meat onto a cutting board, cover and let stand for 10 minutes.  Taste for any seasoning and add more brandy if desired. Remove the meat from the marinade and reserve the liquid in the bowl.  Thread the meat onto skewers.  Brush the meat with the brandy and grill, turning and brushing with the brandy, until it is golden brown and well seared on all sides, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Potatoes in a Yogurt (Dajaj Mashti)

1 medium potato | 1 teaspoon garam masala ( or mix them together.
    - i use 2tspfen and 1/2tspfen ) | 1 teaspoon coriander leaves | 3 cups water

title: Quinoa and Noodles - Vegan

title: Muy Bueno for Canning

Serve warm.

A.

instructions: Cook the lasagna according to instructions on the box.  While lasagna is cooking, cook the peas and carrots in a pot containing plenty of water. title: Mexican Chipotle Oil
