title: Hot Chickpea Stew
ingredients: 4 cups low sodium beef broth | 1 1/2 cups frozen corn, thawed | 1 tablespoon virgin olive oil | 2 lbs baking potatoes, peeled ( about 2 cups cut into 2-inch cubes ) | 2 cups dried chickpeas ( can use canned ) | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/2 teaspoon msg or 1/2 teaspoon other hot pepper sauce
instructions: Add broth and corn to a 4 quart slow cooker.  Cover and cook on low heat setting 6 - 8 hours.  If using canned chickpeas, drain them and rinse well under cool water.  Drain well.  Preheat oven to 400°f.  Heat oil in a wok until hot but not smoking.  Add potato and toss to coat.  Remove chickpeas from the broth and reserve broth.  Place chickpeas and reserved broth back into the slow cooker.  Mix remaining ingredients in a 3 1/2 qt.  Heavy saucepot.  Heat, without boiling, over moderately high heat, stirring, until heated through, about 3 minutes.  Transfer about 3/4 cup of broth to a bowl and add vinegar, scraping up any brown bits from the bottom of the pan.  Add to slow cooker along with hot broth and cook, stirring, until heated through, about 2 minutes.  Stir in rest of the broth and heat to boiling.  Add chickpeas and cook, stirring to coat, until heated through.

title: Spiced Noodle Salad With Pesto and Raspberry
ingredients: 9 -12 ounces angel hair pasta ( bowtie ) | 3 tablespoons basil pesto & strawberry sauce | 1 tablespoon mixed spice | 1 1/2 cups fresh raspberries or 1 1/2 cups frozen raspberries ( thawed ) | spice ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups fresh cranberries or 1 1/2 cups frozen cranberries
instructions: Cook pasta until just tender.  Drain pasta.  Rinse pasta to make sure it is clean.  Drain if desired.  Dressing, combine pesto & sauce.  Toss with pasta.  Refrigerate 1 to 2 hours.  Add extra pesto if desired.

title: Pizza Dough (For Canapes)
ingredients: 1 cup honey ( i use organic ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons bread machine yeast | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried basil ( crushed ) | 1/2 cup fresh broccoli flove ( coarsely chopped ) | 1/2 cup thinly sliced pepperoni
instructions: In bowl, combine honey, yeast and basil and stir well.  Add remaining ingredients and mix lightly.  You can use a food processor at this point but dough should not stick.  Drop dough onto greased baking sheets.  I find it helps if a tb spoon is placed evenly across the top and corners.  Allow to rise about 45 minute.  Brush or spray the tops and bottoms of the dough and allow to rise until doubled in volume about 3 or 4 minute brush with egg wash and bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 35 minute.

Random Ingredients: cardamom,vegetable oil,penne pasta,chili pepper flake,mint sauce,rump roast,button mushroom,golden raisin
title: Beef and Mushroom Stir-Fry With Penne
ingredients: 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/2 cup chopped fresh chili peppers or 1/2 cup dried chili pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons chili pepper, from a jar of chili peppers | 1 tablespoon cardamom | 3 lbs of high quality rump roast, trimmed and cut in the thin strips | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 can of button mushrooms, drained and chopped | 1 lb penne pasta or 1 lb fettuccine ( linguine can also be used )
instructions: Drain the raisins, if using fresh chili peppers, in a small bowl and rinse with warm water.  Drain then add them to a small saucepan with a little water.  Bring to a boil over medium high heat, then reduce heat to low.  Cover and simmer for 15 - 20 minutes, stirring occasionally until the fruit has softened and the liquid has reduced.  Remove from heat and allow to stand covered while preparing the rest of the recipe.  Toss the beef with the chili pepper and cardamom then transfer the meat to a non metallic dish, add the oil, mushrooms and raisins and marinate for 1 hour or longer.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil, add pasta and cook according to the package directions.  Drain the pasta, then return it to the saucepan over high heat and add the sauce, stirring.  Cook for 1 minute, then drain the pasta well and add it to the pan with the meat and sauce.  Cook for 1 - 2 minutes, or until heated through.  Serve with grated parmesan cheese and red chili sauce on the side.

title: Basic Oatcakes - British Biscuits (Made by your local store )
ingredients: 3/4 cup caster sugar ( or superfine sugar ) | 3 cups rolled oats
instructions: Prepare the oats and roll out the mixture until they are about 3/4 inch thick.  Bake on lightly buttered pan or tray in medium heat, for about 20 - 25 minutes, until the bottom turn golden brown and a tester comes out almost cooked well.  Leave to cool slightly in the tin, then store in an airtight container.

title: Sugar-Free & Yummy Blackberry Vinegar
ingredients: 1 bag blackberries | 2 tablespoons orange peel ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1/2 cup scotch, plus | 1 tablespoon scotch
instructions: Drain the blackberries in a colander, rinse under cold water and drain again.  Combine the blackberries with the orange peel in a medium size bowl.  Whisk together the rice vinegar, orange peel, and scotch in a small saucepan over medium heat until the sugar dissolves.  When the mixture comes to a boil, slowly stir in the hot vinegar.  When the vinegar has reduced by half, pour the hot vinegar into the blackberry mixture.  Stir well, cover, and let stand until the blackberry mixture starts to bubble, about 1 to 2 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,almond extract,caraway seed,mexican cheese,thyme sprig
title: Caraway Spread
ingredients: 1 tablespoon caraway seed ( green or mustard ) | 32 ounces shredded mexican blend cheese | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme sprig | 2 teaspoons minced fresh thyme | fresh ground white pepper, if desired | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Heat caraway seeds in a small skillet over medium heat, turning until blackened, about 2 minutes.  Set aside to cool.  Transfer caraway seeds to a spice mill or coffee grinder, or mortar and pestle and grind coarsely.  Combine 3/4 c cheese, thyme, black pepper, almond extract and ground caraway seeds in mixing bowl.  Spoon into serving bowl and refrigerate until well chilled, about 30 minutes.  If desired, store remaining cheese mixture in a tightly closed container in the refrigerator for up to 6 weeks.

title: Baked Melon With Raspberry Compote
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 medium cantaloupe, cored and sliced into 1/4-inch rounds ( about 3 cups ) | 1 tablespoon sweetened saffron thread | 1 pint raspberries
instructions: Place a baking sheet with sides on the middle rack in oven.  Preheat oven to 450°.  Place melons on the baking sheet, and spray with cooking spray.  Bake melons, cut sides down with a wide spatula, for 10 minutes, or until softened.  When cool, remove from baking sheet, and transfer to a serving platter.  To serve, arrange melons on a platter, and carefully remove the raspberries, letting them run down the center.  Garnish platter with the saffron.

title: Eggplant (Ratatouille)
ingredients: 3 large white eggplants | 2 cups baby carrots
instructions: Cut 2 inch length strips of eggplant lengthwise and crosswise.  Arrange eggplant in a 9x13 inch, lightly oiled baking pan.  Roast in 400 degree f oven for 45 to 50 minutes, or until tender.  Meanwhile, put carrots, and 1/2 cup water in a medium saucepan.  Bring to boil.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 8 minutes.  Heat broiler.  When done, remove from oven.  Place vegetables on a baking sheet and broil about 4 minutes.

title: Apple and Pepperoni Pizza - Microwave
ingredients: 1 cup corn ( whole kernel ) | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder, ground | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary, crushed | 1 medium apple ( peeled, cored and finely diced ) | 2 tablespoons pepperoni ( chopped ) | 1/2 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: To toast the pepperoni cut it into slices with a long narrow knife or food processor.  Combine all the ingredients in a microwave safe bowl, cover and heat on high for 2 minutes.  Stir and serve.

title: Shiitake Mushroom Pate
ingredients: 25 dried shiitake mushrooms | 1 teaspoon coriander, leaf | 1 teaspoon vanilla schnapps | 1/4 teaspoon oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon crisco | 1/2 cup tasty cheese | 3 cherry rolls
instructions: Briefly blanch the mushrooms for about one minute then squeeze out the water inside.  Discard the mushrooms and slice the caps into 2 cm thick portions.  Place the mushrooms and corriander in a small bowl and beat well with a knife.  Add the schnapps, oyster oil and crisco to the mushroom mixture.  Beat in the cherry and blend well.  Spoon the mixture into the tin and freeze until solid.  Cut into wedges.  Sprinkle with a little sugar and serve with crackers or crisp wholemeal toast.

title: Roasted Apples (Tart Apples)
ingredients: 3 medium tart apples, such as fuji | 1/3 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs
instructions: Peel apples, leaving the cores in the apples.  Cut into quarters and then cut each quarter in half horizontally.  Insert a cut out core into each quarter.  Place chicken pieces into a baking dish and set out the apples, skin side up.  Pour any excess juices over chicken.  Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight or up to 2 days.  Preheat oven to 325 degrees.  Bake casserole dish 45 minutes or until apples are soft.

title: Portuguese Egg Halusse
ingredients: 3 eggs | 3 cups port wine | 1 teaspoon cumin seed
instructions: In a glass bowl, whip the eggs with the port wine, cumin seeds, and salt.  Pour into a 9x13 pan with 1 inch of water.  Let stand 15 minutes the water should be cloudy.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight.  Spread out the egg pieces evenly into the pan.  Let stand 10 minutes over low heat.  Carefully pour off the moisture so that they will not stick.  Reduce the temperature as follows, cook 1 hour, turn off the heat and cool 10 minutes more on the counter.  Store in a sealed container.  Serve with bread slices or fresh vegetables.

title: Italian Grilled Vegetables
ingredients: 6 summer squash, halved | 2 stalks celery, chopped | 1 can prepared pesto sauce | 1/4 cup dry marsala | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil leaves | 1/2 small serrano pepper, finely minced | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Place the squash halves cut side up on a greased grill rack that has been sprayed with oil.  Grill over high heat 1 to 2 minutes on each side or until the flesh is tender.  Remove from the grill and cut into 1/4 inch slices.  Meanwhile, combine pesto sauce with the marsala and herbs, stirring well.  When the vegetables are grilled, place in a serving dish, drizzle with the vinaigrette and serve.

title: Macaroni with Veal & Peas #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package elbow macaroni | 8 ounces lean ground veal | 16 ounces veal or 16 ounces other ground beef | 1 can coconut milk | 1 jar salsa, medium | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1 hard-boiled egg, chopped
instructions: Cook macaroni according to the package directions drain and set aside.  Meanwhile, slice the ground beef into 1/4 inch slices.  Cook over a medium to high heat until no longer pink and begin to break into pieces with a rolling spoon.  When the meat has begun to cook, drain it and set aside.  Drain any excess fat and stir in the coconut milk, vinegar and the chilie.  Simmer while preparing the meat mixture.  In an ungreased 2 quart casserole, place half the macaroni in an even layer.  Add the meat mixture and cover with half of the salsa stir to combine and top with the remaining macaroni.  Cover with remaining salsa and sprinkle with eggs.

title: Kheresi (Balki) Dip - Vegan Version
ingredients:
1 container greek yogurt ( homemade is best.
    - ha! ) | 1/3 - 1/2 cup chili paste ( see intro )
instructions: Combine yog's and chili paste in small container with tight fitting lid.  Let sit for 30 minutes before using the dip or just serve as a garnish alongside bread.

title: Kielbasa and Cheese Lasagna (Low Fat)
ingredients: 32 ounces sharp cheddar cheese | 12 ounces kielbasa, sliced | 18 lasagna noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Place cheese on bottom of a 13x9 dish.  Layer ingredients as follows, noodles, kielbasa, and sauce on noodles, kielbasa, and sauce.  Repeat layers.  Sprinkle with additional cheese.  Place in oven.  Cook until bubbly and cheese on top browns.  Cool at least 6 hours before slicing and serving.

title: Spicy Indian Black Beans
ingredients: 1 lb black beans, rinsed and sorted | 1 teaspoon curry powder | 2 -10 drops chili hot sauce
instructions: Blend beans, curry and chilli until beans are smooth.  Taste and adjust seasoning.

title: Pecorino Con Chile Verde
ingredients: 500 g pecorino romano cheese, grated | 1 pinch dried red chili powder | 1 -2 teaspoon ghee
instructions: Put the ghee in a fry pan.  Add pcorino.  Boil.  Remove, drain and cut into small cubes.  When cooled, break it into small pieces.  Put into the blender and blend till smooth.  Pour it into a plate.  Serve.

title: Spicy Thai Red Curry Paste  (Nam Prik Num)
ingredients: 3/4 cup red curry paste | 1 stalk fresh lemongrass, trimmed and chopped
instructions: Toss the curry paste with the lemongrass, refrigerate for 30 minutes before serving.  Bring to room temperature before serving.

title: Limeade and Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 cups cheddar cheese | 1 can limeade
instructions: Mix all ingrediatntine in a crockpot for about 4 hours on low.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon schnapps,greek yogurt,campari,water,italian sausage link,sesame seed,shell pasta
title: Sausage and Pasta With Sesame Seeds and Greek Yogurt
ingredients: 1 lb sweet italian sausage link | salt and water, to taste | 1 lb cooked small shell pasta, preferably medium or 1 lb ziti pasta | 1/2 cup greek yogurt ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon light sesame seeds | 1/4 cup campari or 1/4 cup tomato sauce | 1/8 teaspoon cinnamon schnapps ( optional )
instructions: Prep and cook sausage.  When finished cooking the sausage cut sausage into bite size pieces and set aside.  Preheat oven to 400°f.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil over high heat.  Add large shrimp or lobster tail to pot and cook, stirring frequently, 5 minutes or until shrimp or lobster is pink.  Drain.  Add pasta to hot water and cook until just tender, stirring occasionally, 3 - 5 minutes or until al dente.  Meanwhile stir together yogurt, sesame seeds, campari, and cinnamon schnapps.  Stir into pasta and toss to coat evenly.  Transfer to a large serving platter and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: wood ear mushroom,guacamole,chili sauce,almond,chinese barbecue sauce,doritos,jicama,salad green
title: Barbecue Ramen
ingredients: 1/4 cup chinese barbecue sauce ( chiu mai-yee ) | 3 ounces canned wood ear mushrooms | 3/4 cup jicama, thinly sliced | 1 cup salad greens | 1 cup guacamole | 1/2 cup spicy chili sauce ( a taste of sriracha chili sauce ) | 1/2 cup lightly toasted slivered almonds | 1 tablespoon crispy fried almonds
instructions: In a wok or large frying pan, combine chinese beef barbecue sauce with wood ears.  Cover and cook over moderate heat until liquid evaporates and chiu mia is tender, about 5 to 7 minutes.  Set aside to cool to room temperature.  Divide greens among 4 dinner plates.  Spread guacamole evenly over half of greens.  Top with sauteing jicama.  Spoon grilled shiitaki onto center of each dish and top with hot barbeque sauce.  Top each serving with sliced almonds.  Serve immediately.

title: Cashew Nut, Broccoli and Swiss Fondue
ingredients: 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 7/8 ounce hazelnuts, toasted and skinned | 5 -6 ounces broccoli, cut into small florets | 5 ounces emmenthaler cheese or 5 ounces gruyere cheese, grated | 6 -12 ounces mixed greens | romaine lettuce | freshly roasted cashew nuts, toasted
instructions: Pour the sunflower oil into a wide saucepan and fry the hazelnuts until they become fragrant and give off a strong aroma.  Add the broccoli and fry until it is just beginning to soften and turn bright green.  Remove from the heat.  Turn up the heat slightly and add a few cubes of cheese.  Turn up the heat and add a little more oil.  Add the mixed greens, stir well and bring to a boil.  Now add the mixture to the saucepan, stir well to coat everything in a thickened paste.  Remove from the heat.  Deglaze the pan with a little more oil if required.  Place the fondue on a warmed serving dish.  Place the frites onto the hot fondue and place into an oven heated to 400f degrees f, about 10 mins or until the cheese has melted and begun to lightly brown.  Serve frites with steamed carrots, broccoli, tomatoes, onion and hot new potatoes for a nice snack with extra cheese.

title: Coconut Balls - Old Coconut Spices
ingredients: 300 ml coconut cream, chilled | 2 teaspoons curry powder
instructions: Pour 2 tablespoonful liquid from the chilled coconut into a blender bottle.  Add curry powder, mix well to dissolve.  Chill until use.  The mixture can also be stored in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,whipping cream,creme fraiche,taco seasoning mix
title: Apple Tea
ingredients: 1/2 ounce taco seasoning mix | 1/2 ounce apple juice | 3/4 ounce whipping cream | creme fraiche, to serve
instructions: To make the tea, pour boiling water over the taco seasoning mix, then add 1 tbsp apple juice.  Cover with plastic wrap and leave to stand for 2 minutes.  Stir well with a wooden spoon or a rotary whisk, then fill 2 cup sized glasses with hot water and fill with ice cubes.  Top with cream and a drizzle of creme fraiche.

title: Barbecued Beef(ATK)
ingredients: 1/4 cup salt-free liquid smoke | 3 pounds blade steaks, cut into thick slices
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat.  Wrap the grain of meat around the salt free liquid smoke to keep it from burning.  Place the pan in the preheated grill.  Cook 8 minutes, turning once, or until the meat is cooked to your liking with internal internal temperature 155 degrees f.  Remove the meat slices to a separate platter, and cover to keep warm in the oven.  Preheat a grill for high heat.  Quickly brush the steak slices with oil.  Grill the slices until nicely browned, 2 to 3 minutes per side for rare.  Transfer to a plate lined with paper towels, and sprinkle with salt free liquid smoke to serve.  Let meat stand, covered with foil, for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Hot French Bread Crocks
ingredients: 1/2 lb cremini mushroom | 9 -10 slices french bread | string bean ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 275 degrees fahrenheit.  Wash and pick the mushrooms clean.  Rinse with cold water, being careful not to remove stems.  Slice the french bread diagonally in half.  Put mushrooms in a bowl, cover with warm water and turn over several times to soak through the water.  Let stand 15 minutes.  Then drain well and squeeze out excess water.  Sprinkle fresh water on mushrooms and toss with your hands so as not to get the soup stuck.  Place the french bread halves about half filled with the mushroom soup, turning the bread over if necessary.  Close top and let stand 15 minutes, or until heated through.  Pour into a baking dish or small casserole dish.  You may have to work in batches to fit the crocks on the dish to get a complete layer.  Cut string beans in half and then into small pieces if using them.  Place on a cookie sheet and bake until golden brown in color.  Turn half way through.  Place remaining soup into individual bowls as desired.  Add toasted bread to soup over the top.

title: Peanut Butter Candy-Candy (Or Mix It Up)
ingredients: 2 cups crunchy peanut butter | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Put the peanut butter in a clean container and microwave it on high power until it starts to melt and smooth.  Stir it in with a spoon when it gets foamy.  Put the candy on paper lined pans.  It should be just a little bit softer.  Use a large spoon to break up smaller pieces of peanut butter into smaller pieces.  Let it cool until you can see a small amount of solid tiny pieces of peanut butter falling off, but it shouldn't be a big lot of that.  You may need to do this in 2 batches.  Sprinkle it with some kosher salt, if you wish.

title: Macaroni Soup
ingredients: 100 g macaroni | 3 medium beets | 100 g walnut pieces | 600 ml double cream | 5 -6 slices italian bread or 5 -6 slices crusty bread
instructions: Boil macaroni in plenty of water, and cook until there's about 20 minutes of resistance at the end of the cooking time.  Beet is one of the varieties that goes well with it.  Wash beets well, and grate them on a grater.  Preheat oven to 180c/180c fan forced.  Heat cream in a saucepan, and stir in grated beet beetroot.  Add macaroni and a little salt.  Heat through and season with pepper.  Place 2 slices of bread on the bottom of the oven safe soup tin, then spoon hot soup on top.  Repeat the layers until both sides are covered with macaroni.  Bake in the oven for 8 - 10 minutes, or until top is puffed up and golden.  Serve immediately.

title: Leisa's Mexican Queso Fresca
ingredients: 1 lb linguica sausage, casings removed ( spicy or mexican style ) | 8 ounces fresh mozzarella cheese, sliced ( about 3/4 cup ) | 2 dried guajillo chilies ( or to taste )
instructions: On a cutting board, place the sliced linguica, mozzarella slices, chiles, and guajillo chilies, placing them on the cutting board.  Use a large sharp knife or the flat side of your knife to slice the chilies into long pieces, then crosswise into about half moons.  Spray a skillet with a little olive oil, then place over medium low heat.  When the pan is hot, pour in the queso fresca and cook about 4 minutes, or until the bottom is browned.  Cut the queso fresca into quarters to serve.

title: Spicy Salmon Wraps (Guilt Free)
ingredients: 400 g salmon, chopped | 125 g strawberries, chopped | 4 habanero peppers, chopped | 2 tablespoons mustard powder | 1/4 - 1/2 cup chili paste, depends on how hot | tortilla
instructions: Mix everything together and spread out on a plate with your hands or roll into a log.  Chill for about 15 - 20 minutes or until firm.  Cut into about 18 slices and then wrap individually in your tortilla.  Enjoy a little chilli sauce poured onto wrap, to keep it fresh.

title: Penne Aglio-Arrachioso
ingredients: 1 lb penne rigate, cooked | 1/4 cup aged balsamic vinegar | 1 medium thyme leave, packed | 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce
instructions: Rinse pasta under cold water and drain.  Cut into 3/4 inch squares.  Set aside.  Combine vinegar, thyme, and tabasco.  Pour over noodles and toss.  Sprinkle with thyme leaves and serve.

Random Ingredients: jasmine rice,udon noodle,nonstick cooking spray,grand marnier,cottage cheese,whipping cream,kielbasa,mushroom
title: Beef and Sausage Ramen
ingredients: 1 package jasmine rice, rinsed and drained | nonstick cooking spray | 3 packages kielbasa ( thinly sliced ) | 1 package chopped mushrooms ( optional ) | 1 pint whipping cream | 8 ounces cottage cheese | 1/2 cup grand marnier | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro or 1/4 cup parsley
instructions: Place rinsed rice in a large bowl and cover with warm water.  Soak until most of the water is absorbed, about 15 - 20 minutes.  Drain well.  Coat a large skillet with nonstick cooking spray.  Add kielbasa and saute 2 minutes or until meat is cooked through.  Remove kielbasa from skillet.  Add mushrooms and cream to skillet.  Heat to boiling, stirring until heated through.  Add cooked rice to skillet.  Stir to combine.  Garnish with parmesan cheese and cilantro.

title: Indonesian Chicken and Sorbar
ingredients: 1/4 cup soy milk ( dark ) | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 1 teaspoon saffron | 1/2 teaspoon dried tumeric or 1/2 teaspoon allspice | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh lemongrass ( or one inch ) | 1 lb chicken tenders or 1 lb chicken breast | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Combine soy milk, parsley, saffron, tumeric, lemongrass in a medium bowl, add chicken tenders and toss to coat well.  Cover and refrigerate in marinade for at least 1 hour or overnight.  Bring mixture to a boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally.  Lower heat, cover and simmer for about 30 minutes, turning chicken occasionally until chicken is well cooked through.

title: Pork Tenderloin Portabella
ingredients: 16 ounces pork tenderloin | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 14 ounces portabella mushroom caps, rinsed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Trim fat from tenderloin and slice into 3/4 inch wide medallions.  Lay 2 medallions of tenderloin on each of 4 sheets of wax paper and sprinkle each with almond extract and 1/4 teaspoons salt.  Spread each with 2 more medallions of the butter.  Top with another 2 slices of tenderloin and sprinkle with remaining 1/4 teaspoons salt.  Fold wax paper into 4 packets and place, seam side down, on lightly greased cookie sheet.  Bake 25 minute to allow juices to penetrate.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chicken wing,beef consomme,red chili pepper,cream,salsa,ginger root
title: Chicken Wings With Sour Cream and Chili
ingredients: 1 whole chicken wings, cut into thirds | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger root | 2 canned red chili peppers, minced | 1 can condensed beef consomme | 2 cups salsa | 1/2 cup sour cream
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat.  Place chicken wings, ginger, and chile peppers in a large saucepan with enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil.  Cook, uncovered, until chicken is cooked through, 25 to 30 minutes.  Drain off all but 1/4 cup of liquid and discard chicken.  Return pan to heat.  Stir consommé, salsa, and sour cream in the saucepan.  Transfer mixture to a bowl and stir in cooked chicken.  Cover, and refrigerate overnight.

Random Ingredients: red chilies,chicken leg,anise liqueur,chunk chicken,taco seasoning,lemon wedge,bell pepper,vegetable
title: Spicy Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken legs | 1 lb mexican-style sliced vegetables, broccoli, cabbage, carrot | 4 bell peppers | 8 ounces chunk chicken pieces | 1 jar roasted red chilies, chopped, drained ( in a can ) | 3/4 cup anise liqueur | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 2 lemon wedges ( optional )
instructions: Place chicken legs in shallow dish.  Bake at 350 degrees f.  For 45 minutes.  Turn chicken into warm oven and bake for 45 minutes.  Remove chicken pieces and set oven to broil at highest setting.  Boil veggies until just tender.  Add peppers and chicken and combine well.  Return to oven and broil for 2 minutes.  Remove chicken pieces to serving platter with lemon wedges.

title:
Smoky Beef Sandwiches for a Rainy Night.

    -.
    -
ingredients: 1 head corned beef chuck | 1/4 cup dark rum, for intense flavor ( optional ) | 1/4 cup brown sugar, packed | 3/4 cup seedless cucumber slices | 12 slices rye bread
instructions: Cut a deep slit in the surface of the corned beef.  Place the meat in a baking dish and pour the rum over it.  Place on a sheet of parchment paper.  Dot with brown sugar.  Add the cucumber slices to the bread, pressing them to soak up the juices into the bread.  Refrigerate for at least one hour.  Preheat the barbeque, setting the fire on medium.  Grill the beef to desired doneness, about 5 to 7 minutes per side for rare or 3 to 4 minutes per side for medium well or until slightly charred outside.  Serve with the rum and pickled red cabbage.

title: Swedish Mace Gravy with Cream (Dansk Gravym
ingredients: 2 tablespoons beef consomme | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/4 teaspoon ground mace | 1/2 cup heavy cream
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the consomme, salt, and mace.  Bring just enough cream to boil in a heavy saucepan over medium high heat.  Reduce heat to low.  Add the prepared cream, and stir to combine.  Pour into cups, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: masa harina flour,spaghetti squash,ruby port,mace,dark sesame oil,lemon pepper seasoning
title: Sweet Spaghetti Squash Chips (Mexican)
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti squash | 2 1/2 cups masa harina flour | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace ( mexican isle ) | 1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice or 1 teaspoon lemon pepper seasoning | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1/2 cup ruby port
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees f.  Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.  Prepare a large ziploc baggie with a flat tip.  Place your squash on the baking sheet and bake for about 40 minutes.  Remove, allow to cool and then peel off the skin.  Cut and remove the seeds.  Cut it into 1 sticks. .  Using two forks, toss the squash strips in the flour.  Season the sticks with the mace, pumpkin pie spice, sesame oil and port.  Drain most of the liquid from the baking sheet.  Place the strands in a large bowl and mix well so all sides of the chips have been covered.  Spray the baking sheet with cooking spray and arrange the chips on the cookie sheet.  Bake for 35 minutes or until golden brown.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,chicken bouillon granule,flour tortilla,broccoli
title: Crispy Burritos
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breast halves, cut | 6 flour tortillas | 2 packages frozen broccoli, thawed and liquid reserved | 1 package chicken bouillon granules
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f place the chicken breast halves on a nonstick baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: salt pork,coconut milk,shortbread crust,cornflour,raspberry preserve,pizza crust,salt cod fish
title: Salt Cod Pizza With Raspberry Glaze
ingredients: 1/4 lb salt cod fish | 12 ounces canned cornflour | 1 1/2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 tablespoon coconut milk | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 1 refrigerated shortbread crust | pizza sauce or raspberry preserves
instructions: Chill cod overnight in fridge.  If freezing, remove and flake fish, cover with cold water and allow to defrost overnight.  If freezing, remove fish and rinse with cold water.  Combine cornflour, coconut milk and salt in a large bowl and stir well.  Cut 1 shortbread dough in half, flatten into a 6” circle and brush with a little of the cornflour mixture.  Add layer of fish, sprinkle with breadcrumbs and top with more breadcrumbs.  Lightly score top of crust with diagonal lines and lightly score the top.  Score dough in 4 equal squares.  Lightly brush with raspberry preserves and bake in a large preheated ridged frypan at 190°c/375°f until golden brown, approx 12–14 minutes.

title: Cilantro Rub for Salads and Rice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice ( from about 3 lemon lemons )
instructions: Whisk 1 tablespoon of the chopped cilantro, the 1/2 teaspoon lemon juice and the remaining 1/8 teaspoon of cilantro in small bowl to blend.  Brush outside surface of 2 slices of ras el hanout with 1/4 teaspoon of the herb blended mixture.  Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon of the herb spread over each of the 2 slices.  Arrange coated ras el hanout slices on a nonstick cookie sheet.  Let cool to room temperature.

title: Curried Yogurt
ingredients: 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 1 -2 tablespoon red sweet pepper, grated | 1/4 teaspoon curry powder or 1/4 teaspoon curry powder | 1 pinch vanilla | 2 -3 olives ( optional )
instructions: Blend all ingredients.  Serve over couscous.

title: Classic American Marmalade

Carefully remove from the fryer and place on a clean paper towel to drain.  Sprinkle kecap manis and sugar over the fried tortillas and gently tumble them around the tin to coat in the spice mixture.  Allow to cool slightly before serving, keeping in mind that the flavours will strengthen as it ages.

title: Baked BBQ Beet Wedges (Belgi)

Add orzo, orange rind and sugar.  Garnish with a few slices of banana and orzo.

title: Southern Comfort Breadcrumbs

instructions: Prep shrimp.  Mix the shrimp and shrimp in a large bowl.  Add green pepper and cayenne pepper, mix well.  Make the mixture into large flat shells about 2 inches diameter.

title: Baked Mangoes

instructions: Slice the mangoes in half and scrape out the seeds.  Put them in a large, lightly greased bowl and cover with plastic wrap.  Place in a preheated oven in an oven set at 100 degrees f. title: Lily Kebabs

instructions: Wash, peel and dice small apples and place them in a bowl. title: Spinach Pomegranate Balls - Pressure Cooker

instructions: Open frozen spinach and squeeze excess liquid out the bag.  Place all ingredients in the pressure cooker.  Close lid.  Over high heat, bring to pressure and cook for 10 minutes.  Uncover and cook an additional 5 minutes to achieve desired consistency.

ingredients: 600 g raw prawns ( raw ) | 3 firm italian birds eye pears, halved and cored | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar or 3 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons bailey's irish cream or 2 tablespoons anjou pear syrup | crushed dried italian seasoned breadcrumbs
instructions: Cut prawn heads, discarding the beak.  If using raw prawn heads, peel and cut into thin strips with scissors. Serve as a dipping sauce or with toasted italian breadcrumbs.

ingredients: 2 medium granny smith apples, peeled, cored and sliced thinly ( about 3 cups ) | vegetable juice ( enough to cover ) | 2 teaspoons sambal oelek chili paste, more if desired | kosher salt and cracked black pepper, to taste | 1/4 cup yellow cornmeal or 1/4 cup all-purpose flour
instructions: Place the apples in a medium mixing bowl, then add enough v 8 vegetable juice to cover.  Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour, or overnight.  Preheat grill. title: Namurrah

instructions: Place the pork roast in the crock.  Surround the roast with slices of fresh vegetables.  Sprinkle with coconut.  Cook on the low fire setting for 5 hours, or until pork is cooked and vegetables are tender.  Eat, but not too dry.

Drain hamburger and onions, pour into greased casserole dish and top with bread crumbs, then place crumb on top and press down slightly.  Bake at 325f degrees for about 30 mins or until golden brown.  Serve with a salad and a fruit salad.

title: Chili Con Queso

In a small bowl, combine cornstarch, cream of tartar and cocoa.  Stir 1/3 cup of hot pepper mixture into this mixture, stirring until thickened.  Stir chili mixture back into chili mixture.  Heat, stirring constantly, until sauce boils and has thickened slightly.  Remove from heat.

instructions: Using a blender combine all ingredients.  Cover and blend on high 1 minute.  Store in refrigerator.

title: Grilled Sweet Potato With Yogurt and Marjoram

2 -3 sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into quarters, about 1-2-2-1/3 lbs.

instructions: Heat the oil over medium heat.  Add the vanilla beans and cook until fragrant, about 10 to 15 minutes, shaking the pan at even speed. title: Fried Chickpeas

instructions: Slice pork into thick slices and place in a saucepan with marinara sauce and season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper, if using, and bring to a simmer. Brush pork chops with marinara sauce and cook for 2 to 3 minutes on each side, or until golden and cooked through.  Serve with the pickle sauce and extra ginger ale.

title: Beer Stuffed Wraps  (Vegetarian)

instructions: Place the cheese slices on a cutting board and slice into about 3/4 thick slices. instructions: Prep the chicken meatballs, remove the solid pieces of the frozen artichoke hearts.  Remove and drain them well. title: Kitchen Kouture Taco Seasoning Mix

instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f.  Place the taco seasoning packet in a resealable plastic bag.  Mix together the taco seasoning mix and anise seed. Spread the seasoning mix into a 9x9 inch baking dish.  Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, then remove from the oven.  Cover with aluminum foil.  Allow to cool.  Break out air pockets, and store in a resealable plastic zipper bag.

title: Couscous and Red Cabbage Soup

title: Baked Sea Bass With Canadian Bacon and Coconut

instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°f.  Using an oiled and parchment lined baking sheet, toast bread until it's golden brown.  Remove the bread from oven and set aside.  In a small saucepan, combine the coconut cream and stock and bring to a boil.  Remove from heat and cool.  Season the fish on both sides with salt and pepper.  Place half of the bread, canadian bacon, and 1/3 of the fish in a large, heavy, ovenproof dish.  Spoon the bean mixture on top of the bread and bacon. Brush top half of the breast with some of the coconut cream/stock/chive sauce.  Add the whole remaining fish to the pan and cover with remaining bread, bacon, and coconut cream mixture.  Bake for 40 minutes, basting every 10 minutes.

instructions: Heat remaining ingredients in pot over medium heat, stirring constantly and scraping bottom of pan.  Cook until liquid is reduced to about half, but does not thicken. instructions: Add the salt it has been soaking in to a medium mixing bowl.  Add the barley to the bowl and mash it with a potato masher.  Add sultanas if using them stir to combine.  Add the cooked barley to the bowl with the other ingredients.  Chill and serve.

instructions: Using a very sharp knife, slice cucumber thinly as possible, with seeds.  Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl.  Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.  Serve at once.  Note, this can be made with a small amount of prepared salsa, if desired.

title: Bacon, Egg, and Cheese Pies

instructions: Place 1/2 cup tomato juice and 2 tablespoons soy milk in a small bowl.  Set aside.  Place 2 tablespoons soy milk into a saucepan over medium high heat.  Stir in the 1/2 cup vinegar. Bring another 1/2 cup tomato juice and 1/2 cup of soy milk to a boil in a large skillet.  Cut off and discard the ends from 2 cucumbers, and cut into 3/4 inch thick slices.  Place cucumber slices in a 2 quart baking dish, and drizzle with the vinegar mixture.  Place the baking dish into a larger, larger, larger skillet over high heat.  Place a lid on the skillet, and bring the tomato juice to a boil.  Simmer on a low heat until thickened, about 5 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Place 1/2 cup tomato juice and 1/2 cup soy milk into a saucepan, and heat on medium high heat until warmed through, but not boiling.  Cut off and discard the cucumber slices, and set aside.  Cut remaining 2 tablespoons tomato juice into 2 tablespoons measuring bits and set aside.  Place 1 teaspoon of bleu cheese into a small spoonful of warm tomato juice, and stir to coat the chunks with a light sprinkling of bleu cheese.  Add hot sauce to tomato juice, and mix until melted and combined.  Pour tomato sauce and tomato juice mixture into the reserved bowl of tomato juice and soy milk.  Mix thoroughly. Top each patty with a few tablespoons of crumbled blue cheese.  Bake in a 350 degree f oven for 8 to 10 minutes, until crusts are lightly browned.

title: Five-Spice Beef and Eggplant With Raspberry Jam
ingredients: 4 whole white bread | 1 eggplant, ends trimmed | 1 beef bouillon cube, smashed | 4 slices fresh firm white bread | 1/8 cup raspberry jam | 1/3 teaspoon cumin | 1/4 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1/3 cup maraschino cherry, sliced 1/4-1/2 thick
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f.  Place the bread between 2 slices of wax paper, pressing on them to flatten slightly. .  Cut the crusts off of the bread, and tear off a few of the bread slices to use for sandwich filling.  Cut each slice of bread in half lengthwise, and scoop out the bread centers.  Place the bread centers into a small baking dish, and drizzle with the honey.  Bake in the oven until slightly browned and dried out, about 30 minutes.  Set aside.  Place a rack in a roasting pan, and set aside.  Break 2 of the eggs into a small bowl, and beat well using a fork.  Beat in the remaining 3 egg whites, and the cumin and five spice powder.  Spread one half of each slice of bread with the jam, and place the bread in the egg white.  Top with the other half of the bread and the egg whites, and then top with the maraschino cherry slices.  Repeat to make two more sandwiches of bread, stuffing or cherries.  Bake in the preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes, until crisp and brown on the outside.

Random Ingredients: hash brown,pine nut,parmigiano reggiano cheese,chipotle chile adobo,yellow squash,salmon fillet
title: Smoked Salmon #SP5
ingredients:
1 salmon fillet ( about 17 oz and 1.
    -5lbs ) | 1 cup chopped yellow squash | 1 cup pine nuts, toasted | 1 chipotle chile in adobo, chopped | parmigiano-reggiano cheese, shaved ( optional ) | 1 package simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion
instructions: Preheat the smoker to 325 degrees f.  Line the inside of your smoker basket with the salmon fillet.  In the mean time, put the squash in a pan and coat with olive oil and salt.  Grill the salmon for about 15 minutes so the outside is nice and crispy.  Take the salmon out of the smoker and poke with a sharp knife all over the flesh.  Take the salmon out of the baking tray and put in your smoker.  It should take about 8 - 10 minutes to get your smoked salmon temperature.  Turn it down to 300 degrees f.  While the mixture is heating up, toast the pine nuts in a small skillet over low heat for about 3 minutes.  Remove them all from the pan and place them in a bowl of ice water to cool.  When the mixture has cooled slightly, place it in a food processor with 1/2 cup of the cooled pine nuts and 1 chipotle in adobo and puree until smooth.  Once the salmon is done, drain the water from the inside of the smoker, leaving just enough to get about 1/3 of the liquid in the blender.  Open and remove any scales and bones from the fish and transfer it to the blender.  Smoke for about 7 minutes or so and check with your fish for doneness.  It should have a bit of pink on the exterior.  Take the salmon out of the grill and add a small handful of shaved cheese, if using.  Place back in the smoker and continue to smoke for about 3 minutes more, or until the salmon has done a bit of a charcoaled sear.  Turn up the heat a bit and add the potatoes to the bowl of mashed potatoes and toss until fully combined.  Sprinkle each plate with a little of the remaining shaved cheese if desired.

title: Feta Cheese Sauce With Parsley
ingredients: 3 tablespoons fresh flat-leaf parsley, coarsely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons good quality honey or 1 1/2 tablespoons agave nectar | 3/4 lb feta cheese
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the parsley, honey and 2 t.  Of the water.  Bring to the boil over moderate heat, stirring frequently, until the water is absorbed.  Remove from the heat and set aside to cool slightly.  Chop the feta cheese very coarsely.  With a food processor or a hand held blender, puree the cheese until smooth.  Add the remaining 1/4 cup water and process briefly until the consistency of creamy yogurt.  Transfer the minted feta cheese to a bowl and stir in the parsley mixture, leaving a bit of the mixture in the bowl.  Serve warm or refrigerate for up to 1 day.  Serve with toasted pita chips.  Yield 4 servings.

Random Ingredients: mace,ice cube,sultana,pork rib,tarragon leaf,cointreau liqueur,flour tortilla
title: Costa Rican Pork and Pintos
ingredients: 1/2 cup sultana or 1/2 cup craisins | 1/2 cup flour tortilla, warmed | 4 -6 tablespoons fresh tarragon leaves, chopped | 2 tablespoons pintos rum or 2 tablespoons cointreau liqueur | 3 smoked pork ribs ( country style preferred-smoked pork rinds removed ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 1/2 cups fresh ice cubes ( can use the frozen )
instructions: Place sultanas and 1/2 cup of the soaking liquid in a bowl.  Pour the remaining soaking liquid into a measuring cup.  Add the rum or cointreau and set the rum flavored oil in a saucer.  Set the mixture aside.  Rub 1/2 teaspoon mace on both sides of the ribs.  Place ribs with rum in an 11 x 7 inch baking dish.  Cover with plastic wrap.  Place in a cold oven and set aside to marinate for 1 hour.  Drain the soaking liquid from the ribs.  Reserve 1/2 cup of the soaking liquid.  Strain the remaining liquid in a large saucepan.  Stir in the reserved soaked vegetables, tarragon, the reserved soaked liquid and the reserved rum flavored oil.  Simmer over medium heat, uncovered, stirring occasionally for 15 minutes.  Remove from heat and allow to cool to room temperature. .  Place the ice cubes over the pan of pork, cover and place in the refrigerator until ready to serve.  Serve with pork and spanish rice and garnish with additional sprigs of tarragon.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,tomato sauce,pork tenderloin,brown mustard seed,arborio rice,basil leaf
title: Quick Herbed Pork Tenderloin Risotto and Rice
ingredients: 1 cup basamic vinegar or 1 cup balsamic vinegar | 2 cans tomato sauce | 1 teaspoon brown mustard seeds | 2 pork tenderloins, trimmed of excess fat | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley, minced | 2 cups arborio rice or 2 cups carnaroli rice
instructions: If using red wine vinegar omit the red wine vinegar and allow it to be bottled.  Bring tomato sauce, mustard seeds and salt to simmer in medium saucepan over medium high heat.  Add pork tender to simmering sauce, cook until desired doneness.  Remove pork, cover and set aside to cool at least 15 minutes.  Drain excess fat off of sauce, discard cooked pork.  Place lid on saucepan, turn heat to medium low.  Cook until heated through, about 5 minutes.  Remove pork from slow cooker, cover and set aside.  Increase heat to medium high, bring tomato sauce, reserved pork and vinegar mixture, and mustard seeds to simmering in saucepan.  Cover and simmer until slightly reduced about 5 minutes.  Stir in pork, parsley and rice.  Continue cooking until cooked through and rice is heated through, about 5 minutes.

title: Grpa Spice Mix
ingredients: 1/4 cup grated fresh coconut powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and blend well.  Keep in the refrigerator for up to 3 months.

title: Harry's Chicken (Pound Method)
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chickens or ( 7 pound ) chicken fillet, in 1/2 inch pieces
instructions: Trim excess fat and gristle from chicken and place in a bowl.  Sprinkle all over with salt and let stand 15 minutes.  Preheat oven to 500 degrees f and arrange the chicken pieces on a rack in a shallow casserole or roasting pan.  Roast the chickens in the preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until juices run clear when chicken is pierced with a fork.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,russet potato,creme fraiche,pork butt shoulder
title: Baked Pork and Apples
ingredients: 4 lbs lean boneless pork butt, cut into 3/4-inch cubes | 2 lbs large russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch rounds | 1 1/2 lbs granny smith apples, peeled, cored, and quartered | 1 container creme fraiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Butter a 1 quart casserole dish.  Toss pork with potatoes, apples, and creme fraiche in a large bowl.  Transfer to casserole dish, and bake covered, until pork and potatoes are tender, about 2 hours.

title: Pound Cake Seasoning
ingredients: 4 cups baking powder | 1 1/2 cups crushed onion and onion soup mix ( kraft brand )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in an air tight container.  Shake often and cook over medium heat.  Remove from heat and let cool.  Use as directed for a pound cake.

title: Easy Chinese Chicken Wings
ingredients: 4 pounds chicken wings, tips discarded | 1/4 cup hot red pepper flakes
instructions: Heat the hot red pepper flakes in a skillet or wok over medium high heat.  Lightly rub the hot pepper flakes on each piece of chicken and cook briefly in the hot, dry skillet until lightly browned.  Cover and keep hot.  In a large bowl, toss the chicken wings with the hot pepper flakes and serve.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,jalapeno,french bread,coriander powder,stewing beef,dijon mustard
title: French Steak Skewers With Coriander, Capsicum and Dijon Crust
ingredients: 1 kg stewing beef, cut into cubes | 1 bunch fresh coriander | 2 -3 red capsicums | 1 -2 jalapeno | 1 -2 tablespoon dijon mustard | 2 slices french bread
instructions: Remove the roots from the coriander.  Place the coriander in a clean cloth.  Rinse in a few changes of water, drain and squeeze out as much water as possible.  Put the coriander roots in a pan of boiling water and leave for a few minutes and then dry on a clean tea towel.  Soak the capsicum in water for 15 - 20 minutes.  Drain.  Wash the beef cubes and pat dry with paper towel.  Cut into large cubes the size of the capsicum and cut the meat into large cubes.  Take the stems and all the other coriander roots and cut lengthways into 3 6.  Take the whole coriander roots and chop finely and place in a frying pan with a little veg oil and 1 tbsp dijon mustard.  Turn down the heat and add the meat cubes.  Cook on low for an hour, stirring occasionally.

title: Honey String Beans
ingredients: 12 -16 fresh string beans ( cut from about 1-1-inch of stringy stems if they are larger ) | 1 -2 tablespoon liquid honey ( to taste ) | 2 fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.  Toss well.  Refrigerate at least 1 hour.  Serve at room temperature.  Enjoy.

title: French Beans and Pork
ingredients: 500 g pork loin, fat trimmed | 1 package green beans
instructions: Cut pork into thin slices.  Place in a casserole dish.  Add beans.  Add water to cover.  Season to taste.  Cover and bake in a moderate oven for 3 hours or until pork is tender.

Random Ingredients: ice water,pork loin,egg yolk,steak,sirloin,sherry,lemon zest,lime juice
title: Seared Beef With Lime Shredded Pork
ingredients: 6 ounces dried whole flank steak | 6 ounces lean pork loin | 1 egg yolk, lightly beaten | 1/4 lb sandwich steaks | 1/4 cup ice water | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1 tablespoon fresh lime zest, minced | 1 tablespoon dry sherry
instructions: Cut flank steak into very thin pieces.  Place meat on counter and sprinkle with salt.  Soak 2 hours, refrigerated.  Turn every 15 minutes.  Soak a small, hot saute pan over high heat, add beef and turn until well browned on all sides.  Remove as meat as it loses moisture.  When meat is done, drain.  Combine egg yolk, water, lime juice, zest and sherry.  Place 1/6 of the thinly sliced flank steak into a shallow glass dish, pour in egg yolk mixture and stir to blend.  Spread beef onto the meat and roll.  Heat a large ridged grill pan over high heat.  Coat pan with nonstick cooking spray.  Place meat on grill.  Sprinkle generously with sherry.  Grill about 10 minutes or until meat reaches internal temperature of 145°f.

title: Pear Fritters
ingredients: 1 p pear, peeled, cored and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon mixed nuts, chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and mix well.

title: Australian Brunch and Spinach Soup (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 15)

instructions: Combine bread, sunflower seeds, 1 cup broth, 1 cup broth and 1 cup spinach in a food processor and process until smooth, stopping to scrape down sides as needed. title: Chipotle Flour Coated Beef for Tacos
ingredients: 4 lbs beef roast | 5 teaspoons adobo seasoning | 5 teaspoons poultry seasoning
instructions: Combine spices on work surface.  Rub mixture onto beef evenly.  Place all over roast.  Wrap securely and refrigerate 8 hours.  Place beef in a slow cooker.  Place on low setting for 6 to7 hours or high for 3 hours.  After removing from slow cooker, shred beef using 2 forks or 1 cup of shredded meat.  Heat and serve with warmed flour tortillas.  Note, when slicing beef, use a slotted spoon and slice across the grain, if desired.

title: Chinese Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package chinese noodles | 1 large fresh prawns, peeled | 1 can chinese fish cakes, shredded or chopped or sliced | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes ( i like san bei ji brand ) | 4 ounces fresh wild rice | 1/4 cup crispy saltine crackers | reynolds wrap foil | chinese cabbage

instructions: Wash and clean beets and set aside.  If using beets you will need to scrub them very well.  Cut the beet halves into very thin slices and arrange in a medium bowl.  Top with red onion.  Chill at least 1 hour before serving.  Toss with sour cream on the side.

instructions: Cut lamb into 2 inch cubes or so.

title: Tomatillo-Sour Soup
ingredients: 4 medium tomatillos salsa ( or any salsa you prefer ) | 1/2 medium red cabbage, shredded | brandy
instructions: Place cabbage in a large saucepan with enough water to cover.  Place over medium heat.  Cook until leaves are softened, stirring occasionally.  Place cabbage in a blender jar and puree until smooth.  Return blended salsa to saucepan.  Heat through.  Place tomato and cabbage puree over medium heat until mixture just begins to boil.  Pour into bowls.  Top with brandy and season to taste with salt and pepper.  Garnish with sprigs of cilantro if desired.

title: Creamy Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup sunflower oil | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 4 large cucumbers, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 dash dried basil | 1 cup crushed corn chips
instructions: Combine all but chips in a large serving bowl.

title: Simple Vietnamese Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 jar pimento-stuffed dried shrimp or 6 -8 ounces shrimp, peeled | 1/4 cup grapeseed oil | 1/2 cup minced pimiento ( optional )
instructions: Soak shrimp in water to cover about 15 minutes.  Drain and blot with paper towels.  Cut shrimp vertically into 1/4 inch slices or you can use smaller shrimp of your choice.  Pour oil in wok or large skillet to a depth of 1 inch and heat over high heat.  When the oil is warm, swirl in about 1/2 a teaspoon of the shrimp or pimentos.  When they turn pale and just begun to turn brown, remove them with a slotted spoon and repeat until all shrimp or pimentos are cooked.  Continue heating and stirring oil and shrimp around until it is hot but still slightly bubbling.

title: Quick and Easy Phyllo Tricks
ingredients: 1/2 cup passion fruit | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1/2 cup smoked paprika | 1/2 cup olive oil | 4 ladyfingers, split lengthwise
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place the passion fruit and chili powder in a small bowl.  Sew them tightly together with your hands to create an open mouth pocket.  Fill the pocket with half of the smoked paprika and sprinkle it all over the spiced pulp.  Drizzle the oil over the passion fruit pulp and spread it out evenly.  Lay 2 ladyfingers on top of the paprika.  Fold the edges of the ladyfingers over the ladyfingers, pressing gently.  Repeat with remaining ladyfingers.  Repeat with remaining rings.  Place the tricks on a baking sheet, brush tops of phyllo with olive oil and sprinkle with more paprika.  Bake in a preheated oven until crisp and golden, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,flour tortilla,anaheim chilies,sushi rice,chicken,self raising flour
title: Chicken Sushi Roll
ingredients: 300 g chicken breasts, ground | 1/2 medium bunch fresh anaheim chilies or 1/2 medium serrano chili, finely chopped | 2 cups self raising flour | 1 cup sushi rice | 2 cups chicken, cooked and shredded | 2 flour tortillas
instructions: Place the ground chicken on a plate and add chopped peppers and chillies.  Sieve flour into large bowl and knead well.  Add rice and mix well.  Place the filling in the center of the two tortillas, roll, and tie with string.  Repeat until you have used up all the filling.  Brush the ends of the rolls with a little egg wash to prevent sticking.  Bake in a moderately hot oven for 10 minutes.

title: Grilled Cherry Sacks
ingredients: 15 k cherries | 8 serrano peppers, stemmed, seeded, and cut into 2-inch pieces | 12 bamboo skewers, soaked in water
instructions: To make a charcoal grill, line a large rimmed baking sheet with foil.  Place the cherry skewers onto a baking sheet.  Grill the cherries over moderately high heat, 4 to 6 minutes, turning and brushing each with about 1/4 cup water.  Transfer the cherries to the foil covered baking sheet, brush with water, and sprinkle with serrano chile pieces.

title: Bacon Wrapped Cheesy Tortellini
ingredients: 1 lb cheese tortellini | 1/4 cup pecans, chopped | 4 slices bacon bits | 2 tablespoons peppercorn-flavored oatmeal, dry | 1 tablespoon peanut butter | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs, minced ( oregano, basil, or chives ) | 3 slices white bread, crusts removed
instructions: Cook tortellini in rapidly boiling water according to package directions, about 10 minutes for fresh or 15 minutes for dried pasta.

title: Lobster Thermidor
ingredients: 500 g lobster meat | 1 tablespoon cornflour
instructions: First cut lobster into bite sized sized serving sized pieces.  Next, remove intestines, and cut into bite sized pieces, as per the instructions on the packet.  Repeat this with other seafood, and mix all together.  Now let the lobster and lobster meat mix together in a medium size pot.  Add in cornflour mixed with water, and bring to boil.  Once it starts boiling, it will thicken.  Once it thickens again, and you will see bubbles coming up, you should add in more water and/or cornflour.  Keep on stirring.  When it returns to boil, remove from stove and serve.

Random Ingredients: thai red curry paste,water chestnut,red chilies,plain yogurt,black olive,oyster sauce,white pearl onion
title: Capsicum and Black Olive Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces white pearl onions | 4 ounces oyster sauce | 2 -3 tablespoons green thai red curry paste | 4 ounces water chestnuts | 8 ounces plain yogurt | 4 fresh small red chilies ( optional ) | 4 black olives
instructions: Mix the remaining ingredients together to combine and allow to rest for 30 minutes.  Cut off the tops of the onions, then chop the onions into quarters and then halve the quarters again.  Using a spoon, remove the root end of the chillies unless they are very large, or leave them whole if you prefer.  Slice the onions into quarters again.  Wash and dry the onions, then stir through the paste.  You can stir through the olives if you wish, but they need to be washed and dried before you serve this salad.  Pour onto a serving dish or individual plates, garnish with the sliced onions, and serve.

title: Italian Sesame Roasted Vegetables
ingredients:
4 -5 medium zucchini, sliced lengthwise, cut crosswise into 1/4-in.
    - slices | 2 pieces english cucumbers, halved, lengthwise and seeded | 4 medium potatoes, scrubbed, unpeeled and quartered lengthwise | 1 jar alfredo sauce | shortening, as needed | slivered unsalted pistachios or pine nuts, for garnish if desired | sesame seeds or poppy seeds, for garnish for garnish ( optional ) | 1/3 cup acorn squash, chopped, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 375°f heat 1/3 cup olive oil over medium low heat and stir in zucchini and potatoes slices, adding salt and pepper to taste.  Cook 5 minutes, stirring frequently.  Spoon ¾ cup enchilada sauce on top of vegetables.  Drizzle with 2 tablespoons shortening and sprinkle with pistachios or pine nuts, if desired.  Place in oven, and cook for 30 minutes.  Garnish with remaining sauted vegetables, if desired.

title: Easy and Delicious Fajitas in a Bag #4
ingredients: 8 ounces cake, cut from frozen sliced deli | 8 ounces yellow bell peppers | 4 packets reynolds wrap foil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Slice the bell peppers into strips and lay them cut side together in a sprayed baking pan.  Place on the red table with the yellow bell peppers cut side down and open a window over.

title: Ukrainian Beet Salad
ingredients: 1 cup cauliflower, finely chopped | 1 cup beet, finely chopped ( canned is ok ) | 1 cup white flour | 1 cup apple juice | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce | cooking spray
instructions: Rinse and drain the vegetables, chop stems from carrots and parsnips, and cut carrots into rounds or sticks for presentation.  Bring a pot of water to a boil, add the cauliflower and beets and cook until vegetables are easily pierced with a fork.  Drain and allow to cool slightly.  In a small bowl, mix flour with apple juice until a dough is formed.  Add 1/2 the dk.  Of flour/apple juice to the dough, mix well.  Heat another 1/2 the dk.  Of flour/juice and add to the dough.  Knead for 4 - 5 minutes until dough becomes smooth and elastic.  Divide the dough into 16 portions, roll out each portion into a 3/4 inch thick circle.  Cut the dough into 3/4 to 1 inch squares.  In a large nonstick skillet, spray cooking spray with cooking oil, and cook the squares until golden brown.  Drain on paper towels and sprinkle with paprika.

title: Gherkin Soup
ingredients: 4 medium gherkins | 2 beetroots, blanched | 2 cups raw beef broth | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed ( or crushed red pepper )
instructions: Heat broth.  Add gherkins, beetroot and the crushed aniseeds and simmer very slowly for 1 hour.  Use a food processor to puree soup.  Cool and serve immediately with a dollop of creamy butter on each plate.

title: Pasta With Creamy Pesto
ingredients: 2 cups fresh farfalle pasta or 2 cups penne pasta | 1 cup panir, cubed ( cooked and cubed ) | 1/2 cup rice vinegar ( or more to taste ) | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon cayenne powder ( or more to taste ) | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon worcestershire sauce ( or more to taste ) | 1 teaspoon marjoram ( or oregano ) | 1/8 teaspoon dried savory ( or other dried savory )
instructions: Drain your farfalle pasta and place into a large bowl, pour boiling water over and stir to keep it hot.  In a small bowl combine 1/2 cup of your pesto mix with the cornstarch.  Add to this the remaining pesto mix and cornstarch, then add the cayenne, worcestershire and marjoram.  Stir and set aside.  Add the cooked and cubed paneer to the pan the last few minutes of cooking the pasta.  Add remaining pesto sauce to your pasta and stir to combine.  Serve on a side with a fresh leaf salad.

Random Ingredients: vidalia onion,cream tartar,lemon myrtle,tapioca starch,icing sugar,heavy whipping cream
title: Myrtle and Onion Filled Cookies

instructions: Cook onion in a saucepan of boiling salted water until tender.  Drain onion, reserving liquid, and place onions in food processor with reserved onion liquid and cream.  Cover and process until onion is finely chopped.  Combine with sifted icing sugar and set aside approximately 10 minutes.  For the cookies, combine icing sugar and cream of tartar.

Random Ingredients: serrano chilies,italian herb seasoning,head cauliflower,apricot,cherry tomato,cheese,gingerroot
title: Ginger Vegetable Packets With a Cherry Tomato Chutney for Two
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cleaned | 1 large fresh gingerroot, peeled, grated ( about 1 1/2 teaspoons ) | 1 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning | 2 serrano chilies, seeded | 2 -3 cherry tomatoes, halved ( or grape tomatoes ) | 50 g cheese, diced ( optional, your choice ) | fresh oregano or fresh thyme ( to garnish )
instructions: Preheat ovent to 200c.  Trim the cauliflower head and trim and discard outer leaves.  In a bowl, gently mix the cauliflower, ginger, herb seasoning, chilies & tomatoes with a grinding of black pepper.  Using a teaspoon or a small spoon, pack the cherry tomatoes into the centre of the packet, leaving a little room at the top.  Place a handful of cheese on top of the tomatoes & add an herb sprig at the top.  Place the packets on a flat tray, bake for 12 - 15 minutes, until bubbling and lightly browned.  Serve at room temperature sprinkled with oregano or thyme.

title: Asparagus Tomato Primavera
ingredients: 1 lb fresh asparagus | 1 roma tomato, finely diced
instructions: Cook asparagus until crisp tender.  Drain.  While asparagus is cooking chop up roma tomato and add to asparagus.  Serve.

title: Spicy Beef Rub from India!
ingredients: 15 garlic cloves ( or equivalent ) | 5 tablespoons garlic-flavored hot pepper sauce ( ( or more or less to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon ground pepper sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients in crockpot on low heat for at least 30 minutes, or at least 3 hours the longer you leave it it there the more flavorful the result.  Remove from crockpot after a few hours and make sure the garlic is completely mixed together.  You don't want to mix the garlic in the rub or eat it in as a spread or make it more of any desired.  Use as required.

title: Bourbon Pork Roast in Lemon Vinegar
ingredients: 1 pork roast ( about 5 pounds ) | 1 1/2 cups dry lemon juice | 1 jar clam juice
instructions: Preheat oven 450°f wrap meat in foil, place on rack in roasting pan, roast uncovered, in 350°f oven 20 minutes.  Remove foil, roast and turn oven to 475f degrees.  Add wine, lemon juice and juice to juices.  Cover and braise for 20 minutes.  Remove and discard the excess fat and any remaining juices in pan.  Remove juices from pan and place in crockpot or braiseer.  Cover and cook on high for 3 hours, or until meat easily pulls apart.  Shred meat and serve on platter, spoon juices.  Serve with your favorite bread and wine. .

title: Wasabi Fennel and Quinoa
ingredients: 1 fennel bulb | 1 cup quinoa | 2 1/2 teaspoons wasabi paste
instructions: Wash the fennel well and cook on the stovetop along with the quinoa.  Wash and chop the fennel bulb.  Mix together the wasabi with about 1/4 cup water so that is easier for you to blend everything together.  Serve with wasabi and wasabi flavored quinoa, and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,romano cheese,cardamom powder,cornmeal,white onion,black bean,savory
title: Jorge's South American Cornbread
ingredients: 1 white onion, chopped | 15 ounces black beans, canned drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup parm romano cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon sazon goya ( goya, con azafran ) | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/2 teaspoon savory | 1/2 cup cornmeal | 8 tablespoons romano cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon dried maraschino cherries | fresh savory

Grill the breasts for 7 minutes on each side or until they are cooked through, brushing frequently with the remeber.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: tabasco sauce,flour tortilla,kale,bulk italian sausage,green onion,brown sugar

Remove the tortillas and drain them in a colander.  Sprinkle the top with dried kale or chard leaves and chopped green onion.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,fenugreek seed,mint,soy sauce,pecorino cheese,cornstarch,tomato paste,pimiento
title: Italian Cheese Dip
ingredients: 3 tablespoons tomato paste | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 cup grated pecorino cheese | 1/2 cup chopped pimiento | 1 tablespoon dried mint | 1 tablespoon dried fenugreek seeds | 2 teaspoons dried mint, crushed
instructions: To make the filling, combine all ingredients in a medium sized bowl.  To prepare the dip, stir together the cornstarch and the dried mint. Random Ingredients: sea salt,white mushroom,soymilk,rice wine,white flour,almond,italian breadcrumb
title: Cape Cod With White Wine and Mushroom
ingredients: 1/3 cup whole almond, finely ground | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 1/2 cup whole milk | 1/2 cup unbleached white flour | 1/2 cup soft white breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons white flour | 4 tablespoons rice wine or 4 tablespoons dry white wine | 1 lb fresh white mushrooms | 2 teaspoons coarse sea salt
instructions: Process almonds in a food processor until finely ground.  Add salt, milk and flour and process briefly.  Turn dough into a lightly floured surface and knead it briefly. title: Matzoh Crackers
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups matzoh meal | 1 package rye bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Line 2 baking sheets with aluminum foil.  Combine the matzoh meal and rye meal in a bowl, and beat with a rotary beater until well combined.  Spread half of the mixture on each baking sheet.  Using clean hands, press together to flatten the mixture slightly.  Repeat with the remaining mixture.  Bake for 30 to 35 minutes in the preheated oven, until lightly golden.  Cool on wire racks.

title: Leek Tacos
ingredients: 1 leek, white part only | 3 corn tortillas | 1/4 cup brandy
instructions: Cut the leek lengthwise into thin slices, then cut them into very thin slices.  Cook the tortillas, one by one, at a time so they are hot and pliable.  Warm the brandy in a skillet or skillet pan by dropping a couple of drops of brandy into it.  As soon as the brandy is warm and pliable, remove it from the heat.  Place one tortilla on a large plate or platter, then pour 1/4 of the chilled brandy mixture over the top.  Sprinkle with some of the chopped leeks.  Fold the tortilla in half.  Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: rye bread,dark brown sugar,vegetable broth,mango,sun tomato oil
title: Mango-Rye Bread With Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 large mango, chopped ( ripe ) | 1 can vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons soft dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 1 loaf rye bread | 2 teaspoons vegetable broth or 2 teaspoons apple juice | 1 -2 teaspoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil
instructions: Make sure you have all the ingredients ready before placing on the bread.  Make the syrup, in small saucepan, combine the 2 tablespoons of sugar with the 2 tablespoons of broth and bring to boil.  Remove from heat and allow to cool.  Slice the bread and toast lightly on both sides in the broiler.  Remove from the oven and place on a serving platter.  Pour the cooled syrup over the bread.  This is best eaten hot but also good eaten warm.

title: Avocado Stuffed with Bacon and Strawberry
ingredients: 2 hass avocados ( about 1 pound ) | kosher salt | 2 slices bacon | 1/2 cup vegetable oil ( olive oil will give a more interesting flavor, so adjust amount according to your taste ) | 3 cups strawberries ( can also be sliced in quarters, if you don't like them )
instructions: Peel and remove pit from each avocado, and gently remove the pit with a teaspoon.  With a sharp or serrated knife, cut a lengthwise slit across the avocado to create a pocket approximately 2/3 of the way thru.  With a small spoon or melon baller, scoop out avocado flesh into bowl, and mash it roughly with a fork.  Transfer mashed avocados to a serving platter or serving sink and sprinkle liberally with kosher salt.  In the same platter, fry bacon until crispy, then transfer to paper towel lined plate to drain.  In a medium bowl, mash avocados, adding oil just as you see for desired texture.  Season to taste with salt.  To serve, line a plate with plastic wrap or wax paper, and carefully surround with avocado mixture.  Surround with strawberries and serve immediately.

title: Copycat Mc Donald's Pizza With Irish Eyes
ingredients: 2 hass avocadoes ( medium size peeled and cut in quarters ) | 1 ounce hot pizza sauce ( heaping ) | 2 tablespoons irish whiskey
instructions: Use a fork to spear avocados on the bottom of pizza pan.  Place hot pizza sauce on top.  Drizzle with whiskey.  Bake at 450 degrees for 5 - 10 minutes until avocados are soft and golden.

title: Grilled Zucchini With Corn
ingredients: 2 small zucchini, cut in half lengthwise | 1/4 cup corn kernel or 1/4 cup frozen corn kernels
instructions: Cook zucchini and corn in large nonstick skillet on medium high heat, 4 to 5 minutes or until tender.  Remove from skillet.

title: Yoghurt and Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a small bowl.  Serve immediately on italian bread or toasted pita bread.

title: Cherry Rice Balls
ingredients: 1 package arborio rice or 1 package risotto rice ( or you can use long grain rice ) | 1 cup cherries, pitted, chopped | 1/2 cup cocoa powder | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon ( or other hot spices )
instructions: Place rice in colander lined with cheese cloth or sieve, place on dinner plate.  Toss drained cherry cubes with cocoa powder, tarragon and seasoning.  Roll in seasoning mixture and place on rack of baking dish/salt.  Chill until required.  The rice balls can be frozen before freezing.

title: Chicken Florentine
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breast, cubed | 2 1/4 lbs dried spaghetti sauce | 2 lemons, juice of | 1 cup frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed of excess liquid | 3 -4 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 2 cups chicken legs | 6 -8 rosemary branches
instructions: Note, add enough water to the spaghetti sauce to equal 3 cups liquid, about 3 cups chicken broth.  Add the chicken pieces to the sauce, and let soften.  While the chicken is soaking, drain and tear the spinach in pieces.  Squeeze the lemon juice into the bowl with the chicken.  In a large saucepan combine 1 cup of the liquid and the flour until there are little floury clumps and the liquid is thick.  Add chicken mixture, and cook for 1 to 2 minutes.  Stirring constantly, add the spinach, lemon, tomato sauce and 1/2 cup reserved broth.  Season with salt to taste.  Simmer on a low heat, covered, for about 30 minutes.  Add 2 more cups of broth and simmer 5 minutes more.  Spoon the sauce over prepared pasta, and garnish with chopped rosemary branches.

title: Cherry Sauce for Pasta and Chicken
ingredients: 3 lbs tomatoes, very ripe ( and preferably the larger ones, san marzano are my fa ) | 1/2 cup sweet wine ( chianti imbotties recommended ) | 1 cup dried apricot, in syrup ( optional ) | 1 cup dark soy sauce | parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1 tablespoon vanilla
instructions: Using a food processor puree the tomatoes until you can get it uniform, stopping to scrape down the sides of the work bowl.  You'll be tempted to use a hand held blender, but it won't work, it's all right there in the processor.  Add all the other ingredients into your processor and turn on the machine.  Stop to scrape down the side as needed.  Start again and restart the machine as it'll get spicier.  Start again whenever the process goes well into your blender with the tomatoes, then go ahead.  You want to leave about four or five little pieces of tomato, and if you like you can mix it a little more with the other ingredients.  The longer you stir and the thicker you get it will be easier when the mix is still chunky.  That should be a good start.  It's your choice.

title: Sautéed Caramelized Onions (Porteños a La Criolla)
ingredients: 4 medium spanish onions, thinly sliced ( about 1-inch ) | 1/4 cup port wine | 3 tablespoons minced fresh mint leaves ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon lemon zest
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat.  Add onions, and sauté until lightly browned, about 10 minutes.  Stir in port, mint, and lemon zest.  Serve warm.

title: Kiwi and Cumin Penne
ingredients: 2 pounds dry penne pasta | 1 quart milk | 3 teaspoons ground cumin | 1 teaspoon ground coriander seed | 1 teaspoon vodka | 1 kiwi fruit, sliced
instructions: In a large pot bring just enough water to cover the pasta.  Bring to a boil, and cook the pasta until al dente, about 11 minutes.  Drain.  Meanwhile, heat the milk in a saucepan over medium heat, and bring to a boil.  Stir in the cumin, coriander, and vodka.  Remove from heat.  Mix in the drained pasta.  Transfer to bowls, and sprinkle with kiwifruit slices before serving.

Random Ingredients: arugula,currant,phyllo pastry,italian salad dressing mix,beet,sirloin steak,kalamata olive

title: Italian Barley & Pepper Rolls

instructions: Drain the beans and place in a casserole dish.  Add tea, stir well. .  Add chicken and cream of tartar and stir well.  Sprinkle with sage.  Bake uncovered in a 400 degree oven for 10 - 15 minutes or until top is slightly browned.

ingredients: 9 ounces raw egg noodles | 1 lb lean ground round | 1 jar sweet pitted prunes, drained and halved | 1 large green bell pepper, seeded and julienned
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  In large nonstick skillet, cook beef over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until brown, about 7 to 10 minutes.  Drain off fat.  Stir in prunes. ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans, drained | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1 bunch cremini and shiitake mushrooms | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 container fat-free thawed whipped topping
instructions: Open the beans, rinse to remove the stones, and put them into a food processor or electric food mill.  Add the bouillon cubes, and process to a smooth paste. Cover with plastic wrap and place in the refrigerator while preparing other ingredients.

title: Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 package coleslaw mix | 1 package cremini mushrooms, quartered | 1 plum, thinly sliced | 1 small dill weed, chopped
instructions: Prepare dressing and add to coleslaw mix.  Add mushrooms, plum, dill, and mix.

title: Italian Eggplant Fans
ingredients: 1 large eggplant | 1 1/4 cups flour, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 475 degrees f.  Using a vegetable peeler, remove about 1/2 inch thick strips of peel from the eggplant, and slice lengthwise into 1/2 inch thick chunks.  Sprinkle flour over the eggplant, and toss until coated.  Pat crumbly crumbs onto a baking sheet lined with aluminum foil.  Place eggplant in the preheated oven, and bake until the tops of the strips are lightly browned and the eggplant is golden, about 20 minutes.

title: Crunchy Sunflower Fingers
ingredients: 1 cup bisquick baking mix | 2 teaspoons sunflower oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c.  Press bisquick mix into a 24cm x 24cm, 12cm x 2cm swiss roll pan.  Brush lightly with oil.  Bake for 12 - 15 minutes.  Remove. Cool.  Meanwhile beat together remaining mix ingredients.  Turn out onto a floured surface and knead for 5 minutes or until smooth.  Roll into 2 cm slices, then place on a greased baking paper. title: Scandinavian  Holiday Fruitcake Recipe
ingredients: 3 large cooking apples, peeled, cored and thinly sliced | 3 medium dried arugula | 2 packages frozen snow peas | 6 fluid ounces kirschwasser | 2 tablespoons sweetened soda water | 1/4 cup clarified butter

Reduce the heat to low and pour the batter over the apples and snow peas.  Bake in the preheated oven until brown and bubbly, about 35 minutes.

title: Fiery Potato Appetizer Appetizer
ingredients: 2 baking potatoes | 1/4 cup apple cider ( or orange flavored white vinegar ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 4 corn tortillas ( about 4 inch diameter )
instructions: Peel and cut potatoes into 1 slices.  Arrange half of the potatoes and half of the apple cider in a greased 9 inch skillet. Arrange 2 triangles of tortilla, slightly overlapping, over the potato mixture and sprinkle with remaining 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom.  Repeat with remaining triangles of tortillas, potato mixture and cardamom.  Arrange potato mixture on a parchment lined baking sheet.  Bake in middle of a 350°f oven, until golden brown and heated through, about 8 minutes.

title: Grilled Salmon Terrine(Antillam
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped scallion | 2 serrano chilies, thinly sliced | 1 jar shrimp - peeled, deveined and minced | 1 cup chopped salmon | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced bay leaves | 1 package phyllo dough | 2 teaspoons finely chopped scallions
instructions: Arrange 1/2 cup chopped scallions on a cutting board and spread a layer of serrano peppers over it.  Sprinkle with 1/4 cup chopped chiles, then a few dashes of minced shrimp. Cut a slit down the center of the strips to within 1/2 inch of the top layer.  Pinch the two strips together, and cut strips into 1 inch squares.  Arrange 1 piece phyllo square on a lightly greased griddle or frying pan.  Lightly brush with oil and lightly sprinkle with scallions.  Cook under a preheated broiler 3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.

title: Microwave Spanish Cauliflower and Ham on One Hour
ingredients: 4 slices deli ham ( deli is key so follow your package directions ) | 1 cauliflower, cut into florets | 2 teaspoons ground beef cubes | 3 cups medium grain rice, such as arborio
instructions: Preheat microwave on high.  Layer ham and cauliflower in two 3 1/2 quart casserole dishes.  Top with beef cubes.  Cook covered 2 minutes.  Add uncooked rice.  Recover and continue cooking uncovered 5 minutes on high, until all rice is absorbed.  Serve immediately.

title: Spinach With Nuts, Pistachios and Olives
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh spinach leaves | 3/4 cup dried pitted kalamata olives | 3 tablespoons butterscotch chips | 1/4 cup coriander leaves
instructions: Soak dried kalamata olives in water for a few hours, then place them in the blender with 1/2 cup water and process until coarsely chopped, or until slurry is like rice, about 45 seconds. Process until the mixture is thick and smooth about 20 seconds.  Let the mixture cool to room temperature, then refrigerate until it is cold, at least 30 minutes.

title: Italian Mushroom Dip
ingredients: 1 can mushrooms, with liquid | 1 package mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon oregano | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 cup water
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor and process until smooth.  Enjoy.

instructions: Heat stock cube in a saucepan.  Add tomatoes with the skin and vanilla, then simmer for 3 more minutes.  Put tortillas in a glass bowl with boiling water and place into the stock. Bbq, heat grill or broiler pan to high.  Brush with 2 t.  Margarine.  Grill kabobs 5 - 10 minutes, turning once, or until internal temperature of meat reaches 160 degrees.
